papers.title: World Models' Last Exam in Physics
papers.abstract_en: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 World Models' Last Exam in Physics：40 个受控物理任务（力学、光学、流体、热与相变、电磁、表面张力）配初始图像与生成提示，用任务可观测性筛选加任务专属定量物理测量直接判定视频是否符合物理规律，无需参考视频。八个视频生成模型共 1,280 条视频上仍存在普遍物理不一致，最佳模型总分仅 57.76/100。
Motivation: 视频世界模型能生成视觉逼真但物理不自洽的序列，威胁具身 AI 的预测与规划可靠性；现有评测依赖模型判断或参考视频，直接物理测试又只覆盖力学。
Method: 基准为每任务给出初始图像、生成提示与预定义物理准则；评测器结合任务可观测性筛选 (task-observability screening) 与任务专属定量物理测量，并在已知物理关系的合成视频上检验测量模块有效性，同时与直接 vision-language model 基线比较人类一致性。
Result: 八个视频生成模型、1,280 条视频上存在持续的物理不一致且任务间差异显著，最佳模型总分 57.76/100；合成视频检验支持测量模块在受控条件下的有效性；评测器在任务内排序与成对比较上与人类判断的一致性均高于直接 VLM 基线。
Conclusion: 以可测量证据打分、覆盖多物理域并显式标注测量局限的基准，可作为诊断视频世界模型物理不一致与追踪进展的可解释依据。

papers.title: Building Rome from a Single Image
papers.abstract_en: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把面向孤立物体的 3D 生成器 Trellis 2 改造成单图整场景网格生成方法：按到相机距离自适应切块（近处小块保细节、远处大块罩建筑），提升图像特征并显式区分自由空间/已观测面/未观测区域，再合成约 4,000 个室外场景补数据。在 Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++ 与野外图像上，几何精度与感知质量全面超过全部基线，室内外均成立。
Motivation: 预训练 3D 物体生成器只在固定规范体积内生成孤立物体，且室外 3D 数据稀缺导致其偏室内，无法从单张图补出相机未观测表面的完整场景网格。
Method: 改造 Trellis 2：(a) 按相机距离自适应分块，近处小块保留细节、远处大块覆盖建筑；(b) 提升图像特征使生成器显式建模 2D-3D 对应，并让模型感知自由空间、已观测表面与未观测区域；(c) 合成约 4,000 个室外场景扩充训练数据。
Result: 在 Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++ 及野外图像上，几何精度与感知质量均超过所有基线，且在室内与室外场景上同时成立。
Conclusion: 物体级 3D 先验可以通过距离自适应分块与显式 2D-3D 对应改造为室内外通用的单图场景生成器，室外数据缺口用合成场景补足。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
papers.abstract_en: Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. We introduce QF3 (Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients), an online off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy with flow matching plus the critic's action gradient, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow's output. To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action. To our knowledge, QF3 is the first off-policy flow RL method to train humanoid locomotion policies from scratch and transfer them zero-shot to hardware. Paired with a high-throughput off-policy training recipe, it trains humanoid locomotion and motion-tracking policies with a 10x wall-clock speedup over FPO++, a recent on-policy flow RL method. We further apply QF3 to fine-tune pretrained flow-based manipulation policies on both ABC-Sim and Robomimic tasks. These results suggest that QF3 can both learn robot policies from scratch and refine those acquired from demonstrations. Website: https://qf3-rl.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QF3 是面向 flow policy 的在线 off-policy RL 算法：用 flow matching 加 critic 的动作梯度，并把该梯度只施加在仍接近 replay action 的动作维度上，经一步 flow 输出预测反传。它能从零训练人形运动策略并零样本迁移到硬件，训练比 on-policy 的 FPO++ 快 10 倍。
Motivation: 预训练 flow policy 需要 RL 微调或从零交互学习，但 off-policy 更新中 critic 与其一步预测不可靠的区域会给出错误动作梯度，导致更新方向失真。
Method: QF3 用 flow matching 目标加 critic 的动作梯度训练 flow policy，梯度经 flow 输出的一步预测反传；为限制更新范围，只对保持在 replay action 附近的动作维度施加 critic 梯度，并配合高吞吐 off-policy 训练配方。
Result: 据作者所知是首个从零训练人形运动 (humanoid locomotion) 策略并零样本迁移到实体硬件的 off-policy flow RL 方法；相对 on-policy 的 FPO++ 达到 10 倍 wall-clock 加速；另在 ABC-Sim 与 Robomimic 任务上微调预训练的 flow 操作策略。
Conclusion: 按维度过滤 critic 梯度可让 off-policy flow RL 同时胜任从零学习与演示策略的精修，且训练效率显著高于 on-policy 方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conformal Prediction Sets Quantify Information Gain: A Theoretical Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction is a popular tool for uncertainty quantification that outputs prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees. While prediction set size is commonly used as a heuristic measure of uncertainty, the information-theoretic basis for this interpretation remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide such a foundation using a decision-theoretic generalization of entropy tailored to set-valued prediction. In particular, we introduce a family of generalized information measures based on the size and coverage of conformal prediction sets. Notably, Shannon mutual information admits an exact integral representation in terms of these measures. We then show that, in standard classification settings, the reduction in conformal set size from additional information (i) is sandwiched between calibration-dependent members of this family and (ii) obeys a data processing inequality, both up to finite-sample calibration and model error terms. Together, our results formally relate conformal prediction to classical information-theoretic quantities and justify using set-size reduction as an information gain metric. Empirically, we validate our theory across 11 classification settings and show that set-size reduction and Shannon mutual information can rank features differently in a greedy feature selection experiment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为 conformal prediction 的集合大小给出信息论基础：用面向集合预测的广义熵定义一族信息度量，证明 Shannon 互信息可由这些度量的积分精确表示，且新增信息带来的集合缩小被校准相关的度量夹逼并满足数据处理不等式（含有限样本校准与模型误差项）。在 11 个分类设置上验证，并显示集合缩小与 Shannon 互信息在贪心特征选择中会给出不同的特征排序。
Motivation: conformal prediction 的集合大小常被当作不确定性的启发式度量，但其信息论依据一直不清楚，难以说明集合缩小是否真的等于获得了信息。
Method: 提出基于 conformal 预测集合大小与覆盖率的广义信息度量族（面向集合预测的决策论熵推广），给出 Shannon 互信息关于这些度量的精确积分表示；在标准分类设定下证明集合缩小被校准依赖的度量夹逼并服从数据处理不等式，误差项为有限样本校准与模型误差。
Result: 在 11 个分类设置上做经验验证；在贪心特征选择实验中，集合大小缩小与 Shannon 互信息会对特征给出不同的排序。
Conclusion: 集合大小缩小可以作为信息增益的合法度量，因为它与经典信息论量有形式化联系；但两种度量在特征排序上并不一致，排序依赖于选哪个。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: 4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 4D-HOF 用条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 把视觉基础模型给出的粗糙手-物状态输运到交互流形上，前馈式修正平移、旋转与对齐误差，并在生成过程中直接用物理交互约束和 2D 观测做测试时引导，取代事后逐序列优化。在 out-of-domain benchmark 上达到 SOTA，重建更稳定更准确。
Motivation: 现有 4D 手-物重建依赖昂贵的逐序列优化，生成式方法又从随机噪声合成交互，导致交互预测不稳定。
Method: 训练条件流匹配模型，把基础模型导出的 hand-object 状态作为条件输入，向交互流形做生成式输运；测试时在输运过程中用物理交互约束与观测到的 2D 证据直接引导演化状态，替代事后优化；生成模型在多样数据集上训练。
Result: 在 out-of-domain benchmark 上取得 state-of-the-art，产出更稳定、更准确的 4D 手-物重建；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把基础模型的粗估计交给带测试时引导的流匹配生成过程，可以在前馈推理内完成误差修正，摆脱逐序列优化并提升跨域泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
papers.abstract_en: Scientific research often begins by synthesizing ideas from a set of related papers to identify gaps and formulate new directions. However, training language models to perform this form of literature-grounded ideation remains challenging, as existing approaches based on prompting or feedback lack structured supervision for how papers should be synthesized. We introduce IdeaAnchor, a paradigm for training LLMs to perform research ideation using structured specifications as privileged signals. Each IdeaAnchor instance encodes how each input paper should be synthesized into a successful idea, including their functional roles, relationships, and target synthesis criteria. We build this paradigm by mining instances from published papers, capturing how real ideas emerge from prior literature. We then train models via demonstration, self-distillation, and reinforcement learning, and further enhance generation with retrieval at inference time. Experiments show consistent improvements in ideation quality. Our analysis reveals a functional decomposition: anchor-based training strengthens creative synthesis, retrieval enhances detail elaboration, and combining both yields the best performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IdeaAnchor 用从已发表论文中挖掘的结构化合成规格（每篇输入论文的功能角色、关系与目标合成标准）作为特权监督信号训练 LLM 做文献驱动的科研构思，训练方式包括 demonstration、self-distillation 与强化学习，推理时再加检索。实验显示构思质量一致提升，且功能分解表明 anchor 训练强化创造性合成、检索增强细节展开，两者结合效果最好。
Motivation: 让语言模型基于一组相关论文识别研究空白并提出新方向仍很困难：现有 prompting 或 feedback 方法缺少关于论文应如何被合成的结构化监督。
Method: 提出 IdeaAnchor 范式：每个实例编码各输入论文如何被合成为成功构思（功能角色、关系、目标合成标准），实例从已发表论文中挖掘得到；随后用 demonstration、self-distillation 和 reinforcement learning 训练模型，并在推理时加入检索增强生成。
Result: 实验显示构思质量一致提升（consistent improvements in ideation quality）；分析给出功能分解：anchor-based training 强化创造性合成，retrieval 增强细节展开，两者结合取得最佳表现。

papers.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026. Project page: https://www.jaibardhan.com/depthworld. 32 pages including supplementary material, 15 figures, 7 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DepthWorld 用标定管线把学习式立体深度与联合因子图结合，为 DROID 生成稠密度量深度与重标定多视角外参的 DROID-3D，并在其上训练基于 Stable Video Diffusion、经 spatial latent tiling 联合预测多视角 RGB 与深度的世界模型。深度监督在同等训练预算下把 RGB 预测 PSNR 提高 1.48 dB，同时给出可用于几何推理的度量深度。
Motivation: 机器人操作的世界模型只用 RGB 训练，逐帧看着对但无法组成一致的 3D 世界，而策略评估、改进与规划都依赖忠实的 3D 几何；缺口在于缺少大规模操作 3D 监督，以及能吸收这种监督又不破坏强预训练视频先验的架构。
Method: 标定管线把学习式立体深度与联合因子图 (factor graph) 结合，把同一实体机器人采集的所有 episode 池化，联合恢复其共享运动学参数与逐场景外参，产出 DROID-3D；再以 Stable Video Diffusion 为骨干，用 spatial latent tiling 联合预测多视角 RGB 与深度，且保持预训练 VAE 不变。
Result: DROID-3D 在外部相机上 90% 的 episode 重投影误差 <0.7 px；在相同训练预算下，深度监督相对同构的 RGB-only 基线把 RGB 预测 PSNR 提升 +1.48 dB，并同时输出度量深度。

papers.title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
papers.abstract_en: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALIVE 是首个让插入物体真正参与视频交互（被拿起、被操纵）的编辑框架：用编辑后的首帧加一条只点名新增物体的指令，配 35,800 对「目标物体存在与否、周围动作保持不变」的编辑数据训练，并额外训练一个 VLM 从相同输入预测交互引导。在自建 ALIVE-interaction 基准与通用视频物体插入基准上，无 VLM 引导时 Overall 分别比最强基线高 43.9% 和 4.4%，加入 VLM 预测引导后 ALIVE-interaction 分数再涨 0.95 分且无需额外用户输入。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑器能插入物体，却难以让插入物与原视频内容发生连贯交互（如被拿起、被操纵），交互保真度缺乏统一评测手段。
Method: 以编辑后的首帧加只命名新增物体的指令为输入；整理 35,800 对编辑数据，混合 3D 渲染、模型生成、真实视频与 ROSE 的通用编辑对，每对仅在目标物体存在性上不同而保持周围动作不变；另训练一个 VLM 从相同输入预测交互引导；提出 ALIVE-interaction 基准，用统一的 VLM 评测协议衡量交互保真、源保持与视觉连贯。
Result: 无 VLM 引导时，ALIVE 在 ALIVE-interaction 基准与通用视频物体插入基准上 Overall 分别比最强被评估基线高 43.9% 和 4.4%；加入 VLM 预测的交互引导后 ALIVE-interaction 分数再提升 0.95 分，且不需额外用户输入。
Conclusion: 让插入物体参与交互的关键在于「同场景、仅物体存在性不同」的配对数据加可预测的交互引导，VLM 引导能在零额外输入下继续抬高交互保真度。

papers.title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable problem solvers, but being able to solve a problem is not the same as being able to teach it. Existing approaches to training LLMs as teachers rely on demonstrations, preference data, or predefined pedagogical criteria that specify what good teaching looks like. However, these signals are often not grounded in individual student learning outcomes, where effective teaching strategies can vary substantially across learners. To address this, we introduce Sherpa, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that instantiates multiple student archetypes with LLMs conditioned on distinct learning preferences and trains a teacher model to adapt its instruction by directly maximizing their learning outcomes. Teacher LLMs trained with Sherpa improve instructed students' performance across all archetypes by an average of 20.5 percentage points. Under MathTutorBench's evaluation, Sherpa raises the overall pedagogy score from 52.5% to 79.2%, indicating better teaching responses. Our human studies show that the trained teacher is preferred over the base model in 79.6% of pairwise comparisons. Together, Sherpa trains LLM teachers to adapt to diverse simulated students and become better aligned with human teachers, paving the road towards AI tutors teaching real students.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 6 figures. Code and model are available at https://github.com/SALT-NLP/Sherpa
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sherpa 用多轮强化学习把教师 LLM 的训练信号直接绑定到模拟学生的学习结果：实例化多个带不同学习偏好的学生 archetype，让教师通过自适应讲解最大化这些结果。训练后学生表现平均提升 20.5 个百分点，MathTutorBench 总体 pedagogy 分数从 52.5% 升到 79.2%，人类评审在 79.6% 的成对比较中更偏好该教师而非 base model。
Motivation: 现有把 LLM 训成教师的方法依赖示范、偏好数据或预设教学标准，这些信号不落在单个学生的真实学习结果上，而有效教学策略因学习者而异。
Method: 多轮强化学习框架：用带不同学习偏好的 LLM 条件实例化多个学生 archetype，教师模型在与这些学生的多轮交互中直接以学习结果为奖励进行优化；评测用 MathTutorBench 并配合人类成对偏好研究。
Result: 训练后的教师使各 archetype 上被指导学生的成绩平均提高 20.5 个百分点；MathTutorBench 总体 pedagogy 分数由 52.5% 提升至 79.2%；人类研究中该教师在 79.6% 的成对比较里胜过 base model。
Conclusion: 以模拟学生的学习结果为训练信号，可以让 LLM 教师对多样化学习者自适应调整讲解，并更接近人类教师的偏好，朝 AI 辅导真实学生迈进。

papers.title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CtrlCache 是面向交互式视频世界模型的免训练控制感知缓存框架：利用控制信号在去噪前就已到达这一事实，把 chunk 按 initial/transition/turning/steady 四态调度，在选定的内部去噪步对 turning 与 steady 复用同 chunk 最近一次完整计算的 transformer residual，并用 frequency-mixed history prior guidance 注入前一 clean latent 的低频信息。在 Matrix-Game 2.0 与 LingBot-World v1/v2 上取得 1.21x–1.41x DiT 加速，且三个模型的 WBench Overall 分数均高于原始推理。
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型的 chunk 级自回归生成每块仍需多次昂贵去噪；现有免训练缓存只依据模型内部去噪动态做复用决策，不考虑控制切换，而控制信号在去噪前就已可用。
Method: action-aware scheduling 与 refresh policy 检测跨 chunk 与 chunk 内的动作变化，把每个 chunk 标为 initial、transition、turning 或 steady；在选定的内部去噪步，initial 与 transition 保留完整计算，turning 与 steady 复用同 chunk 最近完整计算步的 transformer residual；再用 frequency-mixed history prior guidance 融合前一 clean latent 的互补信息，且不额外做 DiT forward pass。
Result: 在 Matrix-Game 2.0 与 LingBot-World v1/v2 上，DiT backbone 加速 1.21x 至 1.41x，无需模型重训练，且三个模型的 WBench Overall 分数均超过原始推理。分析显示相邻 chunk 在动作变化附近结构相似度下降，而低频结构比高频细节更持久。
Conclusion: 控制序列本身是零开销的缓存调度信号，按控制状态区分计算保留与复用，可以在不重训的前提下同时提速并提升交互式视频生成质量。

papers.title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can solve many narrow tasks, but querying them separately for millions of related instances can be prohibitively expensive. Can LLM agents autonomously create cheaper solutions for such workloads? We call this ability "bottling": the ability to turn general capabilities into task-specific solutions that balance answer quality and amortised cost. We introduce BOTTLED, a benchmark in which agents receive an entire unlabelled workload and must complete it under fixed time, compute and LLM API budgets. Agents choose their own approach, such as training a small model or writing a reusable program. Across ten models and three tasks, we find that strong zero-shot task performance does not reliably translate into strong bottling capabilities. Models with similar zero-shot scores can differ substantially after bottling, and 48 of 60 bottling runs score below the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of their model's zero-shot performance. Moreover, 31 of 60 runs underperform the stronger of two small-model distillation baselines with the same token budget. Nevertheless, bottling can yield substantial savings: on query-product relevance classification, Opus 5 retains about 82% of its zero-shot macro-F1 at roughly 657 times lower reported cost. Bottling is also competitive with Jev, a "system one" model built especially for cheap, repetitive inference: Opus 5 on the same task recovers about 94% of Jev's macro-F1 at a quarter of Jev's projected full-workload cost. BOTTLED provides a basis for evaluating and improving agents' ability to invest limited resources in reusable solutions for large, repetitive workloads.

papers.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
papers.abstract_en: Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user's goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a task stops teaching once the agent solves it. We introduce AdvSim2Real, which co-evolves a task curriculum, an injection adversary, and the agent inside a frozen web world model. The curriculum is rewarded for tasks the agent solves about half of the time, and the adversary only for a success flip, an injection that turns a judged success into a failure. Training in the simulator makes a 4B agent both more capable and more robust: its completion rises with and without attacks, holds against a frontier-model adversary it never trained against, and its capability gain carries over to a real browser. On 150 web tasks, AdvSim2Real raises completion under this unseen adversary by 33.6\% relative to the base agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdvSim2Real 在冻结的 web world model 内同时演化任务课程、注入对抗方与 agent 本身：课程只奖励 agent 约 50% 完成率的任务，对抗方只在成功翻转（把判定为成功变成失败）时获奖励。训练使 4B agent 能力与鲁棒性同时提升，在从未对练过的前沿模型对抗方下，150 个 web 任务的完成率相对基线 agent 提高 33.6%，且能力增益可迁移到真实浏览器。
Motivation: web agent 读取第三方撰写的页面，页面上的注入指令会把 agent 引离用户目标，但页面同时承载任务所需的取值与控件，无法简单忽略。现有防御在训练前固定注入、或在对抗训练中固定任务，都会被自适应攻击者绕过或很快停止提供学习信号。
Method: 在冻结的 web world model 中三方共演化：任务课程按 agent 约一半完成率筛选任务，注入对抗方按成功翻转获奖励，agent 在此课程上训练；训练在模拟器内进行，随后把能力迁移到真实浏览器。
Result: 在 150 个 web 任务上，面对训练中从未遇到的前沿模型对抗方，AdvSim2Real 使 4B agent 的完成率相对 base agent 提高 33.6%；完成率在有攻击与无攻击两种条件下均上升，并能保持对该未见对抗方的鲁棒性，能力增益迁移到真实浏览器。
Conclusion: 把任务课程与注入对抗方一起在冻结 world model 内共演化，可同时提升 web agent 的能力与对自适应 prompt injection 的鲁棒性，且模拟器内获得的能力能带到真实浏览器。

papers.title: Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BASA：把 DiT 的视觉自注意力换成跨层移位的局部窗口注意力 (shifted local-window attention)，让被窗口边界分开的 token 在后续层通信，从而消除网格状伪影。不引入任何不规则算子或定制 kernel，实测加速超过理论估计的 90%，在 Wan 上注意力加速 4.52×，生成质量保持竞争力。
Motivation: 全注意力的二次复杂度让高分辨率图像/视频生成代价过高；窗口注意力虽高效但孤立窗口阻断跨窗交互、产生可见网格伪影，细粒度滑窗注意力恢复交互却因不规则计算模式导致理论与实际加速差距大，且需为每个硬件后端定制 kernel。
Method: BASA 用移位局部窗口注意力替换视觉自注意力，并在 DiT 各块之间引入结构化移位窗口方案，使一层被窗口边界切开的 token 在下一层通信，实现全局信息交换；设计不含额外不规则算子或定制 kernel，可直接部署在现有 attention 后端上。
Result: 在 FLUX 上实测加速超过理论估计的 90%；在 Wan 上取得 4.52× 的注意力加速，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
Conclusion: 跨层移位窗口可以在不牺牲全局信息交换的前提下，把理论稀疏度真正兑换成跨后端的实际加速，同时消除窗口导致的视觉伪影。

papers.title: Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap
papers.abstract_en: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.
papers.comment: paper accepted for presentation at IEEE-WHISPERS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 高光谱图像 (HSI) patch 分类中，同一影像上随机划分训练/测试会让空间 patch 重叠，把测试像素泄漏进训练。Pavia University 上 3D-CNN 随机采样 OA 达 96.17%，换成非随机空间采样掉到 55.20%；patch 从 5x5 增到 19x19 使重叠比例 (OP) 从 23.28% 升到 77.02%。结论是随机 patch 评测会大幅虚高精度，尤其对强依赖空间上下文的模型。
Motivation: 同一影像内随机采样使训练与测试 patch 空间重叠，造成数据泄漏与过于乐观的精度估计，而现有评测未量化重叠程度与精度虚高的关系。
Method: 提出两个重叠度量：全局重叠比例 (OP) 统计被重叠的测试像素总量，平均重叠率 (AOR) 刻画受影响测试 patch 的局部严重度；在 Pavia University 上对比随机与非随机空间采样，覆盖 SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT、MorpMamba，并做 patch 尺寸分析。
Result: 随机采样下 3D-CNN OA 96.17%，非随机空间采样下降至 55.20%；ViT 与 2D-CNN 分别下降 40.71 和 38.81 个百分点 (PP)。patch 尺寸由 5x5 增至 19x19，随机采样重叠比例 (OP) 从 23.28% 升到 77.02%。
Conclusion: 随机 patch 评测会大幅虚高 HSI 分类精度，强依赖空间上下文的深度模型受影响最大；评测应改用非随机空间采样并报告 OP/AOR。

papers.title: Rapid Fredholm stabilization of the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky equation with unrestricted, spatially-varying anti-diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We develop the first feedback design for rapid stabilization of the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky equation with a spatially varying anti-diffusion coefficient. For constant coefficients, the single-input Fredholm design of Coron and Lü (2015) excludes a discrete set of values at which repeated unstable eigenvalues cause a loss of controllability. We overcome this obstruction by introducing a second boundary input and assigning the two inputs distinct roles. The key idea, inspired by Heymann's Lemma, is to use the boundary value $u(0,t)$ entirely for a pre-feedback that renders the modified plant controllable through the curvature input $u_{xx}(0,t)$. The latter input then stabilizes the plant through a Fredholm backstepping transformation. We show that two inputs suffice for controllability and are necessary when the plant has an unstable double eigenvalue. However, the Fredholm kernel still must be approximated for implementation. Hence, to enable kernel and gain approximation, we prove continuity of the coefficient-to-gain design map on compact admissible design classes. Unlike Volterra-based continuity proofs using successive approximations, our proof uses the modal representation to control the spectral data, the inverse coefficient system, and the tails of the kernel and gain series. This yields a single neural operator approximation of the gain to any prescribed $L^2$ accuracy across the class. Finally, we establish rapid local stabilization of the nonlinear closed-loop system under both the exact gains and sufficiently accurate approximations. We conclude with numerical results that illustrate prescribed decay rates and the computational cost of the approximations. In particular, we train a Fourier neural operator that achieves typical relative gain errors of approximately $0.1\%$ and stabilizes all held-out cases tested, including a plant with an unstable double eigenvalue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对具有空间变反扩散系数的 Kuramoto--Sivashinsky 方程，提出首个双边界输入的快速反馈稳定设计：用 u(0,t) 做预反馈使被控对象经曲率输入 u_{xx}(0,t) 可控，再由该输入经 Fredholm backstepping 变换完成稳定。证明系数到增益的设计映射在紧致容许类上连续，从而用单个 Fourier neural operator 把增益逼近到任意 L2 精度，典型相对增益误差约 0.1%，并在含不稳定重特征值的留出算例上全部实现稳定。
Motivation: Coron 与 Lü (2015) 的单输入 Fredholm 设计在常系数下会排除一组离散系数值——重特征值导致可控性丧失；且 Fredholm 核需数值近似，缺少跨系数类的增益逼近保证。
Method: 双输入分工：边界值 u(0,t) 全部用于预反馈，使含空间变反扩散系数的被控对象经曲率输入 u_{xx)(0,t) 可控（思路受 Heymann's Lemma 启发），再由后者经 Fredholm backstepping 变换稳定；用模态表示证明系数到增益映射在紧致容许类上连续（区别于 Volterra 的逐次逼近证明），据此训练 Fourier neural operator 逼近增益，并分析非线性闭环在精确增益与足够精确近似下的快速局部稳定。
Result: 两个输入足以保证可控，并在被控对象具有不稳定重特征值时是必要的；Fourier neural operator 的典型相对增益误差约 0.1%，在全部留出测试算例上实现稳定（含带不稳定重特征值的被控对象）；数值结果展示规定的衰减率与近似的计算开销。
Conclusion: 引入第二个边界输入并让两个输入各司其职，可绕开单输入 Fredholm 设计在重特征值处的可控性障碍；系数到增益映射的连续性使单一神经算子能在整个系数类上逼近增益并保持快速局部稳定。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.tldr: 针对具有空间变反扩散系数的 Kuramoto--Sivashinsky 方程，提出首个双边界输入的快速反馈稳定设计：用 u(0,t) 做预反馈使被控对象经曲率输入 u_{xx}(0,t) 可控，再由该输入经 Fredholm backstepping 变换完成稳定。证明系数到增益的设计映射在紧致容许类上连续，从而用单个 Fourier neural operator 把增益逼近到任意 L2 精度，典型相对增益误差约 0.1%，并在含不稳定重特征值的留出算例上全部实现稳定。
summary_sections.motivation: Coron 与 Lü (2015) 的单输入 Fredholm 设计在常系数下会排除一组离散系数值——重特征值导致可控性丧失；且 Fredholm 核需数值近似，缺少跨系数类的增益逼近保证。

papers.title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. We introduce VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of the policy, training curriculum, and judge. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VeriFine 用策略、课程与判官三者共演化来扩展验证能力：策略改进循环用 rubric 判官诊断反复失败并生成自适应课程，判官改进循环在验证成为瓶颈时对信息量大的失败案例查询人工指导，经 coactive calibration 收敛到物理推理的客观 rubric。驾驶与机器人导航实验显示策略与判官能力在强化学习与监督微调下都能持续自我提升。
Motivation: 自我提升策略会不断产生新的失败模式，固定的判官既限制优化反馈也限制有用训练样本的发现，在需要空间落地、因果推理与安全感知决策的具身推理中评估可靠性问题更突出。
Method: 提出 agent harness 框架 VeriFine，含两个循环：Policy Improvement Loop 用 rubric judge 诊断反复失败、构造自适应课程并优化策略；当进展停滞、验证成为瓶颈时，Judge Improvement Loop 对信息量大的失败案例选择性查询人工指导，通过 coactive calibration 让人与智能体消解分歧、逼近物理推理的客观 rubric，修订后的判官再指导下一轮数据选择与策略优化。
Result: 在驾驶与机器人导航任务上，策略与判官能力在强化学习与监督微调两种范式下都表现出持续自我提升。
Conclusion: 验证能力可以随策略失败模式的演化而扩展，判官与策略、课程共演化是支撑持续自我提升的机制。

papers.title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in world models have enabled increasingly realistic visual synthesis. However, these generated environments remain largely silent. Bringing sound to world models poses three core challenges: real-time generation to keep pace with interactive video streams, interactive control to respond to mid-stream sound instructions, and spatially aligned stereo to reflect scene geometry and camera motion. To address these demands, we introduce WorldSonus, an interactive video-to-audio framework designed for real-time spatial sound synthesis in world models. For real-time generation, WorldSonus employs a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that synthesizes audio chunks at a low real-time factor (RTF) of 0.41. For interactive control, we incorporate an audio-centric captioning pipeline with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling, enabling dynamic manipulation of sound events during generation. For spatial alignment, we leverage high-quality stereo supervision curated from diverse stereo and ambisonic data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while tailored for world models, WorldSonus generalizes effectively to open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks, matching or outperforming state-of-the-art bidirectional models in both acoustic quality and spatial alignment. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/
papers.comment: 25 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldSonus 是面向 world model 的交互式 video-to-audio 框架，用流式因果自回归扩散 (streaming causal autoregressive diffusion) 实时合成空间立体声，RTF 达 0.41，并支持生成中途用音频描述指令改写声音事件。在开放域 video-to-audio 基准上与 SOTA 双向模型在声学质量与空间对齐上持平或更优。
Motivation: world model 已能生成逼真视觉，但生成环境基本无声；要跟上交互式视频流，需同时满足实时生成、中途可控、以及反映场景几何与相机运动的空间立体对齐三个难题。
Method: 三部分：流式因果自回归扩散架构按 chunk 合成音频；以音频为中心的 captioning 管线配合 chunk 索引的 prompt 调度，实现生成中动态操控声音事件；用精选的立体声与 ambisonic 数据做高质量立体声监督。
Result: 实时因子 (RTF) 0.41；在开放域 video-to-audio 基准上，声学质量与空间匹配达到或超过 SOTA 双向模型（摘要未列具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 为 world model 设计的流式因果音频生成可以同时做到实时、可中途控制和空间对齐，并能泛化到开放域 video-to-audio 任务。

papers.title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
papers.abstract_en: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种针对 3D Gaussian Splatting 的后训练语义提升 (post-training semantic lifting) 方法：逐类累积所有视角的目标与非目标证据并按可见性加权，再用主阈值 β 选高置信种子、次阈值 γβ 扩展连通域，把标签从 Gaussian 转移到可见且有标注的 mesh 顶点，从而分离 2D 检测器、提升与表示间转移三类误差。在 ScanNet++ 十个留出场景上用统一阈值取得 mIoU 0.80（数据集标注掩码）与 0.54（YOLO 掩码），相比逐视角阈值化提升 0.24，且残余误差主要来自检测器。
Motivation: 同一 Gaussian 在不同视角下的类别判断会因遮挡与检测器置信度差异而不一致，而两次训练产生的 Gaussian 不同导致真值只能以标注 mesh 给出，逐视角阈值化无法统一处理类别与场景。
Method: 后训练阶段逐个目标类工作，同时累积目标与非目标证据并按每个 Gaussian 在每个视角的可见性加权；随后用主阈值 β 选出高置信种子、较低阈值 γβ 纳入其周围连通域；再把标签从 Gaussian 转移到既可见又有标注的 mesh 顶点，借此把误差拆成 2D 检测器、提升与表示间转移三部分。阈值与转移算子在 Replica 七个验证场景上选定。
Result: Replica 验证场景平均 mIoU 为 0.93（数据集标注掩码）与 0.65（YOLO 掩码）；ScanNet++ 十个留出测试场景为 0.80 与 0.54，所有场景与类别共用同一组阈值。相比上一版逐视角证据阈值化，本方法（按证据比例筛选）使测试 mIoU 提高 0.24，并使两个数据集的全部类别与场景可共用单一阈值；误差分析显示残余误差大部分来自检测器。
Conclusion: 跨视角加权累积证据加双阈值连通域筛选，可以在不重训 3DGS 的前提下用一套阈值覆盖多类别多场景，并把误差预算归因到检测器这一主导项。

papers.title: Neural Petri flows for chemical reactions
papers.abstract_en: Petri nets have been used to describe chemical processes such as reactions.They map well to chemistry: Places are the bonds between atoms and the free valence of each atom, a token is a unit of bond order, a transition forms or breaks a bond, the conserved quantities are the valence budgets of the atoms, and the enabling rule is the valence rule. These semantics are not guaranteed by learned models of reactions or neural networks that are built on Petri nets that use the net as a scaffold for message passing. Here, we ask what architecture remains a Petri net for every value of its weights. We find the answer in the theory, where all semantics of a net share the firing form $m^\prime=m+Cσ$, locality, as enabling reads only the inputs of a transition, and the enabling rule, and we prove that conservation forces the firing form and that non-negativity forces the enabling rule on local rate laws. This leaves free the rate law, which is the propensity of each transition to fire. We introduce Neural Petri Flow, which learns this rate law, or a readout for classification, and hard-wires the rest as parameter-free layers. On what we denote a valence net, atom mapping, reaction classification, and forward prediction become three tasks on one firing vector. Without training, the minimum firing vector maps 88.8% of the curated Golden set against 85.6% for RXNMapper, and 88.7 against 77.9% of the enzymatic reactions of EnzymeMap. On USPTO-480K, NPF trained on these firing vectors predicts 87.7% of the products and 67.4% when trained on a 1% subset of the training reactions. EC numbers of ECREACT are predicted at the third level for 90.2% of reactions, 5.6 points ahead of the best published method. With electrons as tokens, the same token game predicts 90.5% of the elementary steps of FlowER first, ahead of the published baseline, and every top-1 prediction is a valid molecule without a filter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Neural Petri Flow 把化学反应的 Petri 网语义（守恒、局部性、使能规则）硬编码为无参数层，只学习速率律（rate law），使原子映射、反应分类与产物预测统一为同一 firing vector 上的三个任务。在 Golden 集上零训练的最小 firing vector 映射 88.8%（RXNMapper 85.6%），USPTO-480K 产物预测 87.7%，1% 训练子集仍达 67.4%。
Motivation: 学习型反应模型或以 Petri 网为消息传递脚手架的网络并不保证保持 Petri 网语义（守恒、局部使能），需要一种对任意权重取值都仍是 Petri 网的架构。
Method: 理论上证明守恒强制 firing 形式 m′=m+Cσ、非负性在局部速率律上强制使能规则，从而只留速率律可学；提出 Neural Petri Flow，将速率律（或分类用 readout）作为学习部分，其余硬编码为无参数层，并在 valence net 上把原子映射、反应分类、正向预测统一为 firing vector 上的任务。
Result: 零训练的最小 firing vector 在 curated Golden 集映射 88.8%（RXNMapper 85.6%），在 EnzymeMap 酶促反应上 88.7%（对照 77.9%）；USPTO-480K 上 NPF 预测 87.7% 产物，用 1% 训练反应子集训练时为 67.4%；ECREACT 的 EC 号第三层级预测 90.2%，领先已发表最佳方法 5.6 个百分点；以电子为 token 时 FlowER 基元步骤 top-1 预测 90.5%，且每个 top-1 预测都是无需过滤的有效分子。
Conclusion: 把守恒与使能规则固定为无参数层、只学习速率律，可在不牺牲精度的前提下让网络对任意权重都保持 Petri 网语义，并把三类反应任务收敛到同一 firing vector 表示上。

papers.title: Linear Bandits under Exact Sliding-Window Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study linear bandits under exact sliding-window constraints, where every consecutive block of actions must belong to a prescribed feasible set. In the offline setting, where the reward function is known, we show that convexity and cyclic-shift invariance make a stationary solution optimal when $w\mid T$ and within an additive $O(w)$ gap otherwise. In the online setting, we show that geometric structure alone is insufficient for learning, and sublinear regret can be impossible. We introduce a transition diameter $τ$ that quantifies feasible reachability and develop a rare-switching OFUL algorithm with regret $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{T}+τd+w)$ against the offline-optimal feasible trajectory. Finally, we remove cyclic invariance and consider general sliding-window constraints, where optimal behavior may be non-stationary. We represent recent action history as the state of a finite-memory control problem and introduce a history-state diameter $D$ that measures feasible communication between viable histories. Combining optimistic remaining-horizon planning with rare policy updates, we obtain a regret bound of $\widetilde{O}(d\sqrt{T}+dD+w)$. We evaluate our approach on real-world and synthetic benchmarks, showing that it maintains exact feasibility while achieving reward and regret comparable to baselines with substantially fewer policy updates.
papers.comment: 53 pages, including supplementary material; 8 figures and 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线滑动窗口约束下的线性 bandit 中，仅靠几何结构不足以学到次线性 regret，甚至可能不可能；作者引入刻画可行可达性的 transition diameter τ，提出稀疏切换的 OFUL，得到对离线最优可行轨迹的 regret Õ(d√T+τd+w)。去掉循环不变性后，把近期动作历史当作有限记忆控制问题的状态，用 history-state diameter D 度量可行历史间通信，配合乐观剩余时域规划与稀疏策略更新，regret 为 Õ(d√T+dD+w)，在真实与合成基准上保持精确可行且策略更新次数显著少于基线。
Motivation: 滑动窗口约束要求每个连续动作块都落在给定可行集内，最优行为可能非平稳；在线设定下几何结构本身不足以支撑学习，次线性 regret 可能根本无法实现，需要新的可达性度量与算法。
Method: 离线情形利用凸性与循环移位不变性证明 w|T 时平稳解最优；在线先定义 transition diameter τ，设计稀疏切换的 OFUL 算法；一般（非循环不变）约束下把近期动作历史建模为有限记忆控制问题的状态，定义 history-state diameter D，结合乐观剩余时域规划与稀疏策略更新。
Result: 离线：w|T 时平稳解最优，否则与最优相差加性 O(w)。在线：稀疏切换 OFUL 对离线最优可行轨迹的 regret 为 Õ(d√T+τd+w)；一般约束下 regret 为 Õ(d√T+dD+w)。在真实与合成基准上保持精确可行，reward 与 regret 与基线相当，而策略更新次数大幅减少。
Conclusion: 滑动窗口约束下的可学性由可达性直径（τ 或 D）而非几何结构决定，稀疏策略更新足以在保持精确可行性的同时达到次线性 regret。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Conformal Action Sets: An Application to Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Sequential recommenders typically use a fixed slate size even though the number of useful alternatives changes within a session. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Calibrated Pruning (RLCP), which adapts the retained action set using critic scores and an online threshold. The threshold is updated from binary feedback indicating whether the set contains an action in a proxy target. We prove a deterministic bound on the observed proxy miss rate along adaptive trajectories. To quantify the effect of pruning on reward, we derive an exact decomposition of value loss into filtering and selection losses. Under explicit proxy and critic approximation conditions, this decomposition yields a finite session reward bound that also accounts for imperfect selection and set truncation, without requiring the learning parameters to converge. Experiments on KuaiRand-Pure and MovieLens 1M compare two RLCP implementations with four RL baselines. In each of the 19 configurations, at least one RLCP variant achieves the highest catalog diversity, reaching $1.11\times$ to $5.21\times$ that of the strongest baseline, with competitive session depth and no larger retained sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 序列推荐里固定 slate 大小不随会话内有用选项数变化，RLCP 用 critic 分数加在线阈值动态裁剪保留动作集，阈值由二值反馈（集合是否含代理目标动作）更新。在 KuaiRand-Pure 与 MovieLens 1M 的 19 个配置中，每个配置至少一个 RLCP 变体取得最高目录多样性，达最强基线的 1.11× 至 5.21×，同时会话深度有竞争力且保留集不更大。
Motivation: 序列推荐器通常用固定 slate 大小，但一个会话内有用备选数量是变化的，固定大小既可能保留无用动作也可能截掉有用动作。
Method: RLCP (Reinforcement Learning with Calibrated Pruning)：按 critic 分数与在线阈值裁剪保留动作集，阈值用二值反馈（集合是否包含代理目标中的动作）更新；理论上给出沿自适应轨迹的代理漏失率确定性界，并把价值损失精确分解为 filtering loss 与 selection loss，在代理与 critic 近似条件下导出有限会话奖励界，不要求学习参数收敛。
Result: 在 KuaiRand-Pure 与 MovieLens 1M 上，RLCP 的两种实现对比四个 RL 基线，共 19 个配置；每个配置中至少一个 RLCP 变体取得最高 catalog diversity，为最强基线的 1.11× 至 5.21×，session depth 有竞争力且保留集不大于基线。
Conclusion: 按 critic 分数在线裁剪动作集可以在不增大保留集的前提下显著提升目录多样性，且价值损失可被分解为过滤与选择两部分并给出有限会话奖励界。

papers.title: On the Computational Tractability of Robust Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Learning when the environment does not belong to the learner's hypothesis class is typically handled using agnostic learning guarantees. However, for anything beyond supervised learning, agnostic guarantees are difficult to come by. Recently, imprecise bandits (Kosoy, 2025) (later renamed to robust bandits in Appel and Kosoy, 2025) were introduced as another approach to unrealizable learning in the bandits setting and a $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ regret learner was shown for a large class. However, no computational guarantees were provided. In this paper we identify a special case that admits a polynomial-time learner with $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret. We also show that several small generalizations of this special case are NP-hard thus indicating that the special case is at the boundary of what is tractable. It has been recently suggested (Kosoy, 2018) that computationally efficient learners for unrealizable learning problems are crucial for solving the AI alignment problem. This work is a small step in that direction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 robust bandits（原 imprecise bandits）中找出一个特例，其不可实现学习 (unrealizable learning) 存在多项式时间学习器且 regret 为 Õ(√T)；同时证明该特例的若干小幅推广是 NP-hard，说明这个特例正处在可解 (tractable) 的边界上。
Motivation: 不可实现学习（环境不在学习者假设类内）通常靠 agnostic 保证处理，但监督学习之外很难得到；robust bandits 此前只有 Θ(√T) 的统计 regret 结果，没有任何计算复杂度保证。
Method: 在 robust bandits 框架下识别一个可多项式时间求解的特例并构造对应学习器，再对这个特例的若干小幅推广证明 NP-hard，以刻画可解边界。
Result: 给出一个多项式时间学习器，regret 为 Õ(√T)；并证明该特例的若干小幅推广是 NP-hard。此前已知结果是对一大类 imprecise/robust bandits 存在 Θ(√T) regret 学习器但无计算保证。
Conclusion: robust bandits 的统计可学性与计算可解性之间存在清晰分界，该特例位于多项式时间可解的边界；作者将其定位为用高效学习器处理不可实现学习、进而服务 AI alignment 的一小步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Denoising Hierarchical Representations: Joint Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) hold the promise of order-agnostic, parallel text generation. Recently, continuous diffusion and flow matching models have seen substantial gains, driven by carefully crafted token representations and diffusion/flow spaces. In this work, we introduce Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (H-CDLMs), a simple framework that further improves continuous DLMs with minimal compute and parameter overhead. Drawing on the discrete DLM and continuous image diffusion literature on joint diffusion, we diffuse multiple modalities in parallel. These modalities represent tokens at different semantic granularities: in our instantiation, the tokens themselves and coarser clusters obtained by clustering pretrained token embeddings. We propose a general setup that allows per-modality samplers and schedules to enhance the interplay between modalities. Applied to CoBit, this yields H-CoBit, which delivers large empirical gains across benchmarks. At dataset entropy, H-CoBit improves MAUVE and reaches a generative perplexity (GenPPL) of 49.4 on LM1B and 50.4 on OWT, improving on the baseline by 24.2 and 20.7 points and surpassing even discrete DLMs of comparable size. On GSM8K, it reaches 27.4% accuracy, outperforming prior continuous diffusion and flow-based models. We further apply H-CDLM to the flow matching model FLM, obtaining consistent gains with H-FLM and demonstrating that the framework generalizes across continuous generative paradigms. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/matol-16/HCDLM.git .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出层级连续扩散语言模型 (H-CDLM)：在连续扩散中并行扰动两种语义粒度的模态——原始 token 与预训练 embedding 聚类得到的粗粒度簇，并为每个模态配独立采样器与调度。套到 CoBit 上得到 H-CoBit，在数据集熵水平下 GenPPL 达到 LM1B 49.4、OWT 50.4，较基线分别改善 24.2 与 20.7 点，GSM8K 准确率 27.4%，超过同规模离散 DLM。
Motivation: 连续扩散语言模型的收益高度依赖 token 表示与扩散空间的设计，单一粒度的扰动没有利用 token 的层级语义结构，且需要在少量算力与参数开销下继续提升。
Method: 借鉴离散 DLM 与图像联合扩散 (joint diffusion) 的思路，对多模态并行做扩散：模态为 token 本身与对预训练 token embedding 聚类得到的粗簇；框架允许为每个模态指定独立的采样器与调度以协调模态间交互。实例化到 CoBit 得到 H-CoBit，并迁移到流匹配模型 FLM 得到 H-FLM。
Result: 在数据集熵 (dataset entropy) 设置下，H-CoBit 提升 MAUVE，GenPPL 在 LM1B 上为 49.4、OWT 上为 50.4，较基线分别改善 24.2 点与 20.7 点，并超过同规模离散 DLM；GSM8K 准确率 27.4%，优于此前的连续扩散与流匹配模型；迁移到 FLM 得到 H-FLM 有一致增益。
Conclusion: 在连续扩散中并行扰动多语义粒度并按模态定制采样调度，能以极小算力与参数开销跨 CoBit 与 FLM 两种连续生成范式带来一致提升。

papers.title: Optimal and Efficient Online Inverse Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In online inverse linear optimization, a learner recommends an action and then observes the choice of an expert who maximizes a fixed, unknown linear objective on $\mathbb{R}^{d}$; the goal is to learn to optimize this objective without observing it. Sakaue recently obtained the optimal regret $O(\sqrt d)$ with a randomized algorithm making $(dT)^{O(d)}$ linear optimizations per round, and asked whether it can be attained in polynomial time. We answer positively: our deterministic algorithm has regret $O(\sqrt d)$ for every horizon $T$ and runs in time polynomial in $d$ and $T$. It is a variant of the variable-metric algorithms of Sakaue et al.\ and Cai et al., in which a metric update is revoked once the query point moves far enough from where the update was made.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线逆线性优化中，学习者推荐动作后观察专家对固定未知线性目标的最优选择，目标是在不观测目标函数的情况下学会优化它。本文给出确定性算法，在任意时间跨度 T 上达到最优 regret O(√d)，且运行时间对 d 和 T 均为多项式，回答了 Sakaue 提出的多项式时间可否达到该 regret 的问题。
Motivation: Sakaue 此前用随机算法达到最优 regret O(√d)，但每轮需做 (dT)^{O(d)} 次线性优化，指数级代价使其不可行；问题是最优 regret 能否在多项式时间内实现。
Method: 基于 Sakaue 等与 Cai 等的变度量 (variable-metric) 算法改造：当查询点离上次更新位置足够远时撤销该度量更新，得到确定性版本，每轮只做多项式次线性优化。
Result: 确定性算法对每个时间跨度 T 的 regret 为 O(√d)，运行时间关于 d 和 T 为多项式，对比 Sakaue 随机算法的 (dT)^{O(d)} 次每轮线性优化。
Conclusion: 最优 O(√d) regret 在线逆线性优化可以在多项式时间内达到，随机性与指数级线性优化次数并非必要。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 在线逆线性优化中，学习者推荐动作后观察专家对固定未知线性目标的最优选择，目标是在不观测目标函数的情况下学会优化它。本文给出确定性算法，在任意时间跨度 T 上达到最优 regret O(√d)，且运行时间对 d 和 T 均为多项式，回答了 Sakaue 提出的多项式时间可否达到该 regret 的问题。

summary_sections.method: 基于 Sakaue 等与 Cai 等的变度量 (variable-metric) 算法改造：当查询点离上次更新位置足够远时撤销该度量更新，得到确定性版本，每轮只做多项式次线性优化。
summary_sections.result: 确定性算法对每个时间跨度 T 的 regret 为 O(√d)，运行时间关于 d 和 T 为多项式，对比 Sakaue 随机算法的 (dT)^{O(d)} 次每轮线性优化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 最优 O(√d) regret 在线逆线性优化可以在多项式时间内达到，随机性与指数级线性优化次数并非必要。

papers.title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric human data offer a path to scaling robot learning beyond costly robot demonstrations, yet the embodiment gap makes raw human trajectories a poor supervisory target for control. Our key insight is that, although low-level actions are embodiment-specific, their underlying motion intent can capture task-relevant structure that transfers across humans and robots. We introduce EgoLAP, a VLA pre-training framework that jointly learns from human and robot trajectories through a shared language-based action chain-of-thought. EgoLAP expresses motion intent as structured, temporally abstracted language actions and pairs them with motion-level reasoning grounded in scene geometry, physics, and object affordances. Across extensive real-world and simulated experiments, EgoLAP transfers human experience to robot control more effectively than alternative action representations and reaches 80.1% mean real-world task progress, a 2.3x performance gain over alternative action representations. Motion-level reasoning also outperforms a composite reasoning format that combines subtask, object-box, and visual-trace reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EgoLAP 是一个 VLA 预训练框架，把人类第一视角轨迹转成结构化、时间抽象的语言动作链式思考 (language-based action chain-of-thought)，并配上基于场景几何、物理与物体可供性 (affordance) 的运动级推理，从而把人类经验迁移到机器人控制。真实世界实验中平均任务进度达 80.1%，相对其他动作表示提升 2.3 倍，且运动级推理优于子任务+物体框+视觉轨迹的复合推理格式。
Motivation: 机器人演示成本高，第一视角人类数据是扩展机器人学习的路径，但具身差异 (embodiment gap) 使原始人类轨迹无法直接作为控制的监督目标。
Method: EgoLAP 以共享的语言动作链式思考联合学习人类与机器人轨迹：把运动意图表达为结构化、时间抽象的语言动作，并与场景几何、物理、物体 affordance 上的运动级推理配对，作为 VLA 预训练框架。
Result: 在大量真实与仿真实验中，EgoLAP 比其他动作表示更有效地迁移人类经验，真实世界平均任务进度 80.1%，性能为其他动作表示的 2.3 倍；运动级推理优于结合子任务、物体框 (object-box) 与视觉轨迹 (visual-trace) 的复合推理格式。
Conclusion: 跨具身迁移应监督运动意图而非底层动作：语言化的运动意图加运动级推理比替代动作表示与复合推理格式更适合把人类数据用于机器人控制。

papers.title: Does an Agent's History Tell You When Compaction Will Hurt? A Modest, Bounded Effect on the TRACE Paired-Replay Corpus
papers.abstract_en: Many long-horizon agents compact their context on a global rule, usually a token budget, blind to what the agent was doing. We ask whether the agent's recent behaviour predicts when a compaction will hurt. TRACE's public corpus of 590 harness-triggered AppWorld compaction boundaries replays each boundary from a re-executed prefix state under the pre-compaction context and under the summary, and records the burden of the next actions: calls that error or repeat a call already made. We find that pre-boundary history predicts post-compaction harm only weakly. An internally prespecified contrast by prefix placement is a wide null, and the naive "has-written" label behind it turns out to measure trajectory phase. The best extension-protocol trigger reaches held-out AUROC 0.66 (0.64 on the replicate's own label) against a same-boundary replicate of 0.72; the best frozen, interpretable trigger avoids 21% of harmful (positive-burden) boundaries while keeping 84% of compaction opportunities, and exceeds the random-rule expectation on count but not on burden mass (a post hoc comparison). Whether the best trigger beats a token-budget rule at matched retention cannot be evaluated on the release. We state what corpora should ship to answer it.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 20 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 用 590 个 harness 触发的 AppWorld 压缩边界做配对重放，检验 agent 压缩前的近期历史能否预测压缩后的损害。结论是预测力很弱：按前缀位置的预设对比是宽泛的零结果，最佳可解释触发器 held-out AUROC 仅 0.66（复现自身标签 0.64，同边界复现 0.72），可避开 21% 有害边界同时保留 84% 压缩机会。
Motivation: 长程 agent 按全局 token 预算压缩上下文，完全不看 agent 当时在做什么；需要判断压缩前的历史行为是否真的能预测压缩何时会造成损害。
Method: 在 TRACE 公开语料的 590 个 harness 触发 AppWorld 压缩边界上，从重执行的前缀状态分别以压缩前上下文和摘要重放，记录后续动作负担（出错调用或重复已做调用）；用按前缀位置的预设对比与多种触发规则（含冻结可解释触发器）做预测。
Result: 压缩前历史对压缩后损害只有弱预测：按前缀位置的预设对比为宽泛零结果，naive "has-written" 标签实际测的是轨迹阶段；最佳扩展协议触发器 held-out AUROC 0.66（复现自身标签 0.64），同边界复现为 0.72；最佳冻结可解释触发器避开 21% 有害（正负担）边界、保留 84% 压缩机会，在计数上超过随机规则期望但在负担质量上没有（事后比较）。
Conclusion: 压缩前的 agent 历史不足以可靠预测压缩损害，最佳触发器能否在同等保留率下胜过 token 预算规则在该发布语料上无法评估；作者指出语料应附带哪些内容才能回答这一问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: WorldSolver: Can LLM Agents Simulate the Physical Dynamics via Solver Generation?
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are increasingly advancing scientific and engineering problem solving, with physics simulation emerging as a challenging yet practical testbed for reproducing complex physical phenomena with application in embodied AI, games and films. As the workhorse of such simulation, a solver computes how the state of a dynamic system evolves over time. Building such solvers requires physical understanding to identify appropriate models, mathematical reasoning to formulate the underlying dynamics, and software engineering to implement them as executable code, yet this capability of LLM agents remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce WorldSolver, a benchmark of 168 simulation tasks derived from physical phenomena in 61 classic computer graphics papers, spanning 7 physical domains. Each task contains a code scaffold that provides a fixed simulation environment for the scene, with the solver implementation left for the agent to complete. Specifically, we evaluate them along three dimensions: Execution Checks for successful execution, Visual Fidelity for reproducing the intended dynamic behavior in the rendered simulation, and Physical Plausibility for physics-grounded verification of the generated dynamics. Experiments on frontier agents reveal that producing executable solvers is difficult itself, and satisfying visual and physical correctness is even harder. GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 perform comparatively better than the other evaluated agents, yet achieve overall scores of only 48.7% and 46.7%, respectively. WorldSolver is an early step toward agentic solver generation, and we hope it helps drive progress toward agents that can faithfully simulate the dynamic physical world. Code is available at https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldSolver 是一个让 LLM agent 自己写物理仿真 solver 的基准：168 个任务取自 61 篇经典计算机图形学论文、覆盖 7 个物理域，agent 只拿到固定场景的代码脚手架，需补全 solver 实现。评测按执行成功、视觉保真 (Visual Fidelity)、物理合理性 (Physical Plausibility) 三维打分，GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Claude-Opus-5 最好但总分仅 48.7% 与 46.7%，说明生成可执行 solver 本身就难，同时满足视觉与物理正确更难。
Motivation: LLM agent 做科学工程求解正在推进，但要当好仿真核心的 solver，需要选模型、列动力学方程、写可执行代码三重能力，这一能力在 agent 上仍被严重低估，缺少可复现的评测抓手。
Method: 从 61 篇经典计算机图形学论文抽取物理现象，构造 168 个跨 7 个物理域的仿真任务；每个任务给定固定场景的代码脚手架，solver 实现留给 agent 补全。评测分三个维度：Execution Checks（能否成功执行）、Visual Fidelity（渲染结果是否复现预期动态行为）、Physical Plausibility（对生成动力学做基于物理的验证）。
Result: 在 frontier agent 实验中，生成可执行 solver 本身已困难，同时满足视觉与物理正确性更难；GPT-5.6-Sol 与 Claude-Opus-5 相对其他被测 agent 表现更好，但整体得分分别只有 48.7% 与 46.7%。
Conclusion: WorldSolver 是 agentic solver generation 的早期一步：前沿 LLM agent 距离能忠实模拟动态物理世界还有明显差距，代码已开源在 github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: When Forgetting is not Catastrophic: On the Mechanics of Spurious Forgetting
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge that a language model appears to forget during finetuning often remains stored and can be recovered, a phenomenon called spurious forgetting. Finetuning on new facts can even produce forgetting that undoes itself: recall of the old facts collapses, recovers as training continues on new facts alone, and only then erodes for good. We seek to understand when such forgetting is not catastrophic. A minimal associative memory reproduces these dynamics with three ingredients: keys with shared structure, concentrated new values, and normalization in the network. Finetuning moves all old representations along a common direction, hiding the old facts while preserving their relative geometry; normalization withdraws this shift once the new facts are learned, whereas fact-specific changes accumulate and cause the erosion. Moreover, subtracting the common shift eliminates the collapse in a Transformer trained on synthetic data, and removing a single direction from each weight update restores old facts in a pretrained language model. Forgetting thus combines a shared, reversible loss of access with a slow erosion of individual facts, and only the second is catastrophic. Which one dominates depends on whether the new data move old memories together or apart.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 微调中的“遗忘”由两部分叠加：共享方向上的可逆访问丢失，以及逐事实的缓慢侵蚀，只有后者才是灾难性的。最小联想记忆模型复现出“旧事实召回先崩、仅在新事实上继续训练后恢复、最终才永久衰退”的动力学，其三个必要成分是带共享结构的 keys、集中的新 values 与网络内的 normalization；减去共享位移可在合成数据 Transformer 上消除崩溃，在预训练语言模型中从每次权重更新里移除单一方向即可恢复旧事实。
Motivation: 微调新知识时模型看似遗忘旧知识，但这种遗忘常可恢复，其机制与何时真正不可逆尚不清楚，需要区分可逆的访问丢失与不可逆的事实侵蚀。
Method: 构建一个最小联想记忆模型，包含 keys 共享结构、新 values 集中、网络 normalization 三要素，用它复现微调遗忘动力学；再在合成数据训练的 Transformer 中减去共享位移，并在预训练语言模型中从每次权重更新中移除单一方向，检验对旧事实的恢复。
Result: 最小模型复现出旧事实召回先崩溃、仅在新事实上继续训练后恢复、随后永久衰退的完整时序；减去共享位移消除了合成数据 Transformer 上的崩溃，从预训练语言模型的权重更新中移除单一方向即可恢复旧事实。
Conclusion: 遗忘是共享、可逆的访问丢失与逐事实缓慢侵蚀的叠加，只有后者是灾难性的；哪一部分占主导取决于新数据是把旧记忆一起移动还是彼此分开。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment
papers.abstract_en: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 flow matching 的插值路径也交给网络学，用同一个 alignment loss 联合训练路径网络与速度场，会触发 path overfitting：loss 继续降但样本质量变差。诊断出病因是诱导概率路径的低熵瓶颈（样本被挤过过于集中的中间边缘分布）后，作者加入随机路径正则器，对路径网络隐藏部分源信息但保持端点精确，给训练路径边缘一个显式熵下界，从而抑制瓶颈并让联合训练真正有效。
Motivation: 固定插值路径限制了 flow matching 的表达空间，但直接学路径时 alignment loss 本身不可靠——它会单调下降而生成质量恶化，缺少可诊断的失败模式与对应修复。
Method: 联合训练一个保端点的路径网络与一个 flow 网络，共享同一 alignment loss：flow 匹配路径速度，路径速度对齐当前 flow。诊断出低熵瓶颈后引入 stochastic path regularizer，对路径网络遮蔽部分源信息、保持端点精确，为随机训练路径边缘给出显式熵下界；推理端架构与采样器不变。
Result: 在 ImageNet-256x256 上用 SiT backbone，FID 在各模型规模上均一致改善，并可扩展到 model-guidance 训练；推理时架构与采样器保持不变。
Conclusion: alignment loss 单独不足以指导路径学习，必须用熵下界约束中间边缘分布；加上该正则后联合 path-flow 训练才有效，且代价不落在推理侧。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Prediction-powered inference for time series across space
papers.abstract_en: The following motif is common in spatiotemporal settings: we have a sequence of covariate and label pairs observed for a relatively short, recent time period. We have access to unlabeled covariates over a longer time period. Data is observed over many spatial locations. For instance, crop yield might be observed over a large geographical area for recent years, but weather data (which is informative about crop yield) is available for a much longer period. The goal is to estimate, at each spatial location, the expected label (e.g., crop yield) in the future and provide a valid confidence interval for this value. The observed time period alone is too short for reliable estimates. Imputing missing labels with machine learning can cause substantial bias. Prediction-powered inference (PPI) can correct for this bias, but it relies on an i.i.d. assumption that breaks under our expected temporal dependencies. Heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent (HAC) procedures account for temporal correlation, but have not been adapted to cases where some labels are imputed. We provide reliable point estimates and confidence intervals given: short labeled time series (across spatial locations), a longer unlabeled time series, and an imperfect predictor of labels given covariates. We show our method outperforms natural alternatives.
papers.comment: Accepted to TS-LIMITS Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把预测驱动推断 (prediction-powered inference, PPI) 扩展到有时空相关的短标签序列：在标签仅覆盖短近期、协变量覆盖更长时段、且存在不完美预测器的设定下，用 HAC 型修正替代 i.i.d. 假设，给出各空间位置的期望标签点估计与有效置信区间。作者称该方法优于自然替代方案。
Motivation: PPI 依赖 i.i.d. 假设，在存在时间依赖时失效；而处理时间相关的 HAC 方法尚未被改造到部分标签由机器学习插补的场景，短观测期直接估计又不可靠、插补会引入实质偏差。
Method: 输入为各空间位置的短标签协变量-标签序列、更长的无标签协变量序列，以及给定协变量的不完美标签预测器；把 HAC (heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation consistent) 修正引入 PPI，处理插补标签下的时间相关与异方差，输出点估计与置信区间。
Result: 在短标签时序、长无标签时序加不完美预测器的设定下，方法给出可靠的点估计与置信区间，并优于自然替代方案；摘要以作物产量配长期天气数据为例说明该时空设定。
Conclusion: PPI 要用于有时空依赖的序列推断，必须同时处理时间相关与标签插补，否则置信区间不可信。

papers.title: SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpaTime 把因果 3D 几何 token 逐帧注入语言模型，让流式 VLM 在视频仍在到达时就作答，并用 response-time loss 把逐帧回答概率映射为可微的期望回答时间、惩罚其偏离真实帧。在自建的 StreamVSTI-Bench 上整体准确率 49.2%，平均回答时间误差比最强流式基线降低 66%。
Motivation: 带 3D 几何先验的 VLM 空间推理强但必须等整段视频到齐才能离线作答；现有流式 VLM 能因果处理帧并自行决定何时回答，却缺少显式 3D 表示，具身智能体无法在观察到足够场景后立即答题。
Method: SpaTime 在每一帧把因果 geometry token 融合进语言模型，只使用当前已观测到的帧；提出 response-time loss，将逐帧回答概率映射为可微的期望回答时间，并惩罚其与真实帧的距离，以此监督模型何时作答。评测构造了 StreamVSTI-Bench 与 StreamVSI-Bench，即 VSTI-Bench 和 VSI-Bench 的流式改版。
Result: 在 StreamVSTI-Bench 上 SpaTime 整体准确率 49.2%，平均回答时间误差 (mean response-time error) 相对最强流式基线降低 66%。
Conclusion: 把显式 3D 几何表示与可微回答时机监督一起放进流式 VLM，可以在视频流式输入下同时拿到空间推理准确率和及时的回答时机。

papers.title: Local Content-Style Control for Diffusion-based Image Stylization
papers.abstract_en: Image stylization with latent-diffusion models entangles two independently refined axes: what a region depicts and how it is depicted. Such pipelines expose only global controls, yet professional retouching demands deliberate, region-specific control. We lift two conditioning weights already present in a ControlNet + IP-Adapter stylization pipeline from global scalars to per-location spatial maps, yielding local, per-axis control of content and style in a single generative pass. Because the two weights act on disjoint pathways, adjusting them independently spans a 2x2 retouching vocabulary, from free regeneration to identity preservation. We validate that edits stay confined to the retouched region and that each weight predominantly steers its own axis. Our approach requires no retraining and drops unchanged into any such pipeline.
papers.comment: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications. 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Supplemental material included as an ancillary file
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 ControlNet + IP-Adapter 风格化管线里原本是全局标量的两个条件权重（内容权重与风格权重）提升为逐位置空间图，从而在单次生成中实现区域级、分轴的内容-风格控制。由于两条权重作用于互不相交的通路，独立调节可构成 2×2 的修图词汇，从自由再生成到身份保持；编辑被约束在被修改区域内，且每个权重主要只引导自己那一轴。方法无需重训练，可直接插入同类管线。
Motivation: 潜在扩散 (latent diffusion) 图像风格化把「区域画什么」和「怎么画」纠缠在一起，管线只暴露全局控制量，而专业修图需要针对特定区域的独立控制。
Method: 在 ControlNet + IP-Adapter 风格化管线中，把已有的两个条件权重从全局标量改为逐位置空间图 (per-location spatial maps)，分别控制内容轴与风格轴，单次生成完成；两条权重走互不相交的通路，因此可独立调节，且不改动权重即可插入现有管线（无需重训练）。
Result: 验证了编辑被限制在被修改的区域内，且每个权重主要只引导其对应的轴（内容或风格）；两个权重的独立组合形成 2×2 的修图词汇，覆盖从自由再生成到身份保持的范围。
Conclusion: 把已有的全局条件权重空间化，就能在不重训练的前提下把内容与风格解耦成可分区、可独立调节的控制轴，直接嵌入现有 ControlNet + IP-Adapter 风格化管线。

papers.title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
papers.abstract_en: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person's accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta's public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone's screen and the computer's. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://nanomuse.cn ; Code: https://github.com/nano-muse/nanoMuse
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: nanoMuse 是 GPL-3.0 开源的个人 agent，对标 Meta 2026 年 9 月的闭源 Muse：一个 agent 覆盖用户全部设备，通过任何人可自建的 relay 共享同一段对话，所有动作经 Sentinel 审核，记忆是可读文件，模型可自选。报告以五个问题和三个 horizon 定义个人 agent，并给出开源路线图（带来源的记忆、手部操作评测套件、开源操作模型）。
Motivation: 2026 年的个人 agent 需要跨周记忆、跨设备操作与主动开口，但现有代表（Meta Muse）是厂商云内、单国部署的闭源系统，没有开放对应物，第三方无法审计其记忆与动作。
Method: 报告先从 Meta 公开记录与一份生产 prompt 副本逆向解读 Muse 的构建方式，每条陈述标注来源；再提出 nanoMuse：设备端 agent 通过可自建 relay 共享对话，动作过 Sentinel，记忆存为可读文件，模型由用户选择，尺寸与成本以估计值给出。
Result: 产出为定义性框架与开源实现：个人 agent 的五个问题与三个 horizon、Muse 的来源标注式逆向分析、GPL-3.0 的 nanoMuse 代码与项目页，以及包含记忆来源、手部操作评测套件和开源操作模型的路线图；尺寸与成本仅以估计形式给出。
Conclusion: 个人 agent 本质是软件而非模型，可以做成跨全部设备、记忆可读、动作可审查的开放实现，与厂商云闭源方案并行。

papers.title: GeneICL: A Tabular Foundation Model for Bulk Transcriptomics
papers.abstract_en: Gene expression is widely measured in biomedicine, yet clinical outcome prediction remains challenging due to high dimensionality, strong feature correlations, and limited labeled data. Large self-supervised transcriptomic foundation models often fail to outperform simple supervised baselines. Tabular foundation models offer an alternative through in-context learning, but are typically pretrained on generic synthetic data rather than transcriptomic structure. We ask whether transcriptomics-aware pretraining, rather than scale, is the missing ingredient. Towards this end, we introduce GeneICL, a 4.2M-parameter tabular foundation model combining a semi-synthetic pretraining prior built from measured bulk expression profiles with a parameter-efficient recurrent architecture. We further enable right-censored survival prediction via a training-free reduction to regression using Cox partial-likelihood residuals. We evaluate GeneICL on 80 clinical outcome-prediction tasks spanning classification, regression, and survival. Tabular foundation models consistently outperform self-supervised transcriptomic models, while GeneICL achieves the best overall rank among evaluated foundation models and tuned baselines. GeneICL does so with up to 387$\times$ fewer parameters, no gradient updates at inference, and predictions within seconds on a laptop CPU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeneICL 是一个 4.2M 参数的表格基础模型，用实测 bulk 表达谱构建的半合成预训练先验加参数高效循环架构做 in-context 学习，并把右删失生存预测以训练免调的方式化归为 Cox 偏似然残差回归。在 80 个临床结局预测任务上，它在全部被评估的基础模型与调参基线中取得最佳总体排名，参数量最多少 387 倍，推理零梯度更新，笔记本 CPU 上数秒出结果。
Motivation: 临床结局预测受高维、强特征相关和标注稀缺限制，而现有转录组自监督基础模型常打不过简单监督基线；通用表格基础模型的预训练数据又不含转录组结构。
Method: GeneICL 以实测 bulk 表达谱为种子生成半合成预训练数据，配合参数高效循环架构；右删失生存任务通过 Cox partial-likelihood 残差化归为回归实现，推理阶段不做梯度更新。
Result: 在 80 个覆盖分类、回归与生存的临床结局任务上，表格基础模型整体稳定优于自监督转录组模型；GeneICL 在被评估的基础模型与调参基线中总体排名最佳，参数量最多减少 387 倍，笔记本 CPU 上数秒完成预测。
Conclusion: 对转录组而言，面向转录组结构的预训练比单纯扩大规模更关键，且表格基础模型的 in-context 范式足以在低标注临床结局任务上取胜。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ScienceClaw: Benchmarking Continual Self-Evolution of AI-for-Science Agents Across the Natural and Social Sciences
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are accelerating scientific automation, yet verified executions rarely become persistent program-level improvements, and existing evaluations do not examine this process across sequential tasks in both the natural and social sciences. We formalize ScienceClaw as fixed-parameter program self-evolution that unifies task solving, scientific verification, and program updates. ScienceClaw-Eval spans 23 disciplines and measures scientific correctness, evolutionary gain, retention, cross-dataset transfer, and evolution cost through sequential streams and independent reset evaluation. Our framework repairs executable workflows through multi-turn interaction, converts re-execution-verified failure--success trajectories into linked Skill and Operator candidates, and retains an update only when source-task replay reproduces the repair and independent scientific tasks improve. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ScienceClaw 把 AI-for-Science agent 的持续自进化形式化为固定参数的程序自进化，统一任务求解、科学验证与程序更新：多轮交互修复可执行工作流，把重执行验证通过的失败-成功轨迹转成 Skill 与 Operator 候选，仅当源任务回放复现修复且独立科学任务提升时才保留更新。在覆盖自然科学与社会科学 23 个学科的 ScienceClaw-Eval 顺序任务流与独立重置评测中，衡量科学正确性、进化增益、保持、跨数据集迁移与进化成本。
Motivation: LLM agent 的已验证执行很少沉淀为程序级的持久改进，且现有评测不考察跨顺序任务、跨自然科学与社会科学的这一进化过程。
Method: 将 ScienceClaw 定义为固定参数的程序自进化，统一任务求解、科学验证与程序更新；框架通过多轮交互修复可执行工作流，把重执行验证的失败-成功轨迹转为关联的 Skill 与 Operator 候选，保留条件是源任务回放复现修复且独立科学任务有提升。评测用顺序任务流加独立重置评测。
Result: ScienceClaw-Eval 覆盖 23 个学科，沿顺序任务流与独立重置评测度量科学正确性、进化增益、保持、跨数据集迁移和进化成本五类指标；代码发布于 github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw。
Conclusion: 科学 agent 的自进化应以可回放复现的修复加独立任务提升作为更新保留判据，而非仅凭单次成功执行。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Probabilistic Counterfactual Inference for Discrete Outcomes in Gaussian-Process Causal Models
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual inference in Gaussian-process structural causal models (GP-SCMs) has been developed primarily for continuous endogenous variables, limiting applicability to causal graphs that contain discrete child nodes with continuous parents. We introduce a unified probabilistic framework for counterfactual inference with heterogeneous variable types by pairing GP predictors with explicit exogenous noise mechanisms. For discrete outcomes, we derive exact conditional noise-abduction procedures using a uniform threshold for binary variables, a Gumbel-max race for nominal categories, and a latent Gaussian cut-point model for ordinal ones. In each case, we propagate abducted noise through interventions while accounting for posterior uncertainty in the GP latent functions, and prove that the resulting mechanisms reproduce the fitted model's observational and interventional distributions. On synthetic SCMs with known ground-truth counterfactuals, we evaluate estimation accuracy, consistency, and robustness to coupling misspecification. A key finding is that applying a categorical coupling to ordinal data inflates counterfactual error roughly threefold even when observational fit remains comparable, and that this error does not diminish with more data. As the training set grows, the fitted structural equation converges to the truth while the counterfactual error flattens onto a floor. In the reverse direction, forcing a false order onto nominal data instead degrades the fitted equation itself. The choice of coupling must therefore be justified on structural grounds rather than read off the fit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 GP 结构因果模型 (GP-SCM) 的反事实推断推广到离散结果：二值用均匀阈值、名义类用 Gumbel-max race、序数用潜在高斯切点模型做噪声绑架 (noise abduction)，并证明所构造机制复现拟合模型的观测与干预分布。在已知真值反事实的合成 SCM 上，把序数数据当名义类耦合会使反事实误差约放大三倍，且不随数据增多而消失——结构方程收敛到真值时误差反而触底。
Motivation: GP-SCM 的反事实推断此前主要面向连续内生变量，含离散子节点、连续父节点的因果图无法处理。
Method: 将 GP 预测器与显式外生噪声机制配对，对离散结果分别推导精确条件噪声绑架：二值用统一阈值、名义类用 Gumbel-max race、序数用潜在高斯切点模型；噪声经干预传播时计入 GP 潜函数的后验不确定性，并证明机制复现观测与干预分布。
Result: 在已知真值反事实的合成 SCM 上评估估计精度、一致性与耦合误设稳健性：序数数据套用名义类耦合使反事实误差约增三倍（观测拟合仍相当），且该误差不随数据量下降，训练集增大时结构方程收敛而反事实误差平移到一个下限；反向把虚假顺序强加给名义数据则会损害拟合的结构方程本身。
Conclusion: 耦合方式必须依据数据的结构（序数还是名义）来选定，而不能从观测拟合优度反推；观测拟合可比并不代表反事实正确。
Relevance: 0
