papers.title: RenderBench: Benchmarking Render-to-Real Video Transfer with Reconstructed Digital Twins
papers.abstract_en: Modern video models can generate realistic videos from real appearance references and proxy renders that specify scene structure, viewpoint changes, and motion. Evaluating this render-to-real capability requires a real target video depicting the same scene evolution, paired with an editable, geometrically registered 3D replica. Such data has traditionally required substantial manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort. We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark of 12 reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both static and dynamic settings. Our construction pipeline combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring. Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and accepted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation. Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RenderBench 提出渲染到真实 (render-to-real) 视频迁移基准：12 个重建的真实场景，每个评测单元配对真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配的 proxy render 与渲染器原生标注，用于按物体、可见性、关节与运动定位失败。首版保留 14 个配准样本中的 12 个（85.7%），共 1,496 对真实-proxy 帧，proxy 诊断给出 depth si-RMSE 0.2170、instance mIoU 0.3673。
Motivation: 评估视频模型的 render-to-real 能力需要同一场景演化的真实视频与可编辑、几何配准的 3D 副本配对，而这类数据传统上依赖大量人工建模、标定与动画投入。
Method: 构建管线融合视觉几何、神经重建与辅助 3D authoring：场景分解为静态物体与动态 actor，配准到拍摄相机，仅在多视角几何与时间一致性校验通过后收录；评测时将迁移模型与配对真实目标视频对比，保留 PAI-Bench-C 兼容的结构投影，并用场景标注按物体、可见性、关节 (articulation)、运动定位失败。
Result: 首个版本从 14 个配准样本中保留 12 个（85.7%），含 1,496 对真实-proxy 帧；全部发布场景通过文件完整性与环境编辑审计；proxy 诊断 depth si-RMSE 为 0.2170，instance mIoU 为 0.3673。
Conclusion: 配对真实观测加可编辑场景状态，可同时评估外观保真度以及几何与动态的保持程度，且经多视角几何与时间校验的样本才进入基准。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Coupled but Late: Turn-Taking Between Full-Duplex Speech Models in Unscripted Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex speech models are trained to converse with a person, but they are increasingly made to converse with each other, in self-play data generation, agent societies, and model-based evaluation. In that loop no human absorbs a timing error: each model's turn-taking is the other's input. We ask what timing the loop settles into. Two PersonaPlex-7B instances exchange audio tokens on a shared clock in unscripted conversation, and one floor-transfer rule is applied to them and to Switchboard. Their timing is coupled: re-pairing speakers across conversations destroys it. But the floor changes hands late, at a median of 400-560 ms against 137 ms for humans, and the last 120 ms of the partner's turn, where human projection places a tenth of its transfers, holds 1% of theirs. Delaying one direction of the channel shifts the response one-for-one and leaves the run-up to it empty, consistent with a reactive wait after the perceived end rather than the turn-end projection human timing requires.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 两个 PersonaPlex-7B 全双工语音模型在共享时钟上自发对话时，换手时机确实互相耦合（跨对话重配对会破坏耦合），但换手系统性偏晚：中位换手 400–560 ms，而人类为 137 ms；人类靠预测在对方话轮最后 120 ms 内完成的换手占十分之一，模型只把 1% 放在那里。人为延迟单向信道会让响应一比一后移且前置空转，说明模型是在感知到话轮结束后被动等待，而非人类那种话轮末端预测（turn-end projection）。
Motivation: 全双工语音模型越来越多地两两对话，用于自博弈数据生成、agent society 与模型评测；此时没有人类兜底时序误差，一方的换手时机就是另一方的输入，但这种闭环最终稳定成什么时序尚不清楚。
Method: 让两个 PersonaPlex-7B 实例在共享时钟上交换 audio token 进行无脚本对话，对它们与 Switchboard 语料施加同一条换手规则（floor-transfer rule）；用跨对话重配对检验耦合，并通过单向信道延迟扰动区分被动等待与话轮末端预测。
Result: 换手时机是耦合的，跨对话重配对说话人会破坏该耦合；但换手偏晚，中位 400–560 ms，对比人类 137 ms；人类投影落在对方话轮最后 120 ms 内的换手约占其十分之一，模型仅 1%；单向延迟使响应一比一后移，且到响应为止的前置时段为空。
Conclusion: 模型间时序是反应式等待感知到的话轮结束，而非人类时序所依赖的话轮末端预测，因此自博弈与模型评测闭环中的换手节奏系统性晚于人类。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Systematic Study of Small Language Models on Abstract Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Endpoint accuracy on abstract-reasoning benchmarks does not reveal whether a language model has acquired a transferable rule or fit distribution-specific regularities. We study this distinction in small language models on the ARC-TGI benchmark, which organizes abstract grid transformations into controllable task families and supports resampling, spatial shifts, and cross-benchmark transfer. Across more than 1,000 runs, we profile decoder-only, encoder--decoder, and mixture-of-experts model families under supervised fine-tuning. We examine the efficiency and stability of skill acquisition, robustness beyond the training distribution, interactions with model family and task formulation, and layer-wise attention signatures that accompany behavioral differences. Substantial in-distribution accuracy is attainable, but acquisition is sensitive to optimization and unevenly distributed across task families. Performance deteriorates sharply outside the training distribution, including when the rule is retained but grid scale changes. Greater training-set depth and breadth yield uneven gains, while the effect of additional in-context examples depends on model family. Executable-rule induction also yields correct solutions not observed under direct grid generation. On selected tasks, attention diagnostics show distinct concentration and context-dependence profiles, but do not establish general causal mechanisms. Overall, abstract-reasoning scores are conditional on the model, adaptation regime, evaluation distribution, and response format.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ARC-TGI 抽象推理基准上系统考察小语言模型是否学到可迁移规则而非分布内拟合：超过 1,000 次运行覆盖 decoder-only、encoder-decoder 与 MoE 三类模型的监督微调。分布内准确率可以做到较高，但技能习得对优化敏感、在任务族间分布不均；一旦离开训练分布（包括规则不变只改网格尺度）性能急剧下降，因此抽象推理分数必须连同模型、适配方式、评测分布与作答格式一起解读。
Motivation: 端点准确率无法区分模型是掌握了可迁移规则还是拟合了分布特定规律，而小模型在抽象推理上的泛化能力正是这一区分的关键。
Method: 在 ARC-TGI 基准上做系统研究：该基准把抽象网格变换组织成可控任务族，支持重采样、空间平移与跨基准迁移；在监督微调下对 decoder-only、encoder-decoder、mixture-of-experts 三类模型做超过 1,000 次运行，考察技能习得的效率与稳定性、训练分布外鲁棒性、模型族与任务表述的交互，并辅以逐层 attention 诊断。
Result: 分布内可获得可观准确率，但习得对优化敏感且在任务族间分布不均；训练分布外性能急剧恶化，包括规则保留而网格尺度改变的情形；扩大训练集的深度与广度收益不均，额外 in-context 示例的作用依模型族而异；executable-rule induction 能给出直接网格生成下未出现的正确解；选定任务上 attention 诊断呈现不同的集中度与上下文依赖模式，但不足以确立一般因果机制。
Conclusion: 抽象推理分数是模型、适配方式、评测分布与作答格式的条件量，不能当作模型已获得可迁移规则的证据。

papers.title: Secure Speculative Decoding for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates inference for a large language model (LLM), referred to as the \emph{target model}, by first using a smaller model, referred to as the \emph{draft model}, to generate candidate tokens and then verifying them with the target model for acceptance or rejection. Prior studies primarily focused on the efficiency-utility trade-off of speculative decoding, e.g., lossy speculative decoding, leaving its security implications largely unexplored. In this work, we bridge this gap by providing the \emph{first} systematic study of the security implications of speculative decoding. Through a large-scale measurement study, we reveal a pronounced security-utility asymmetry: across a wide range of lossy speculative decoding methods, improvements in inference efficiency come at a disproportionately high cost to security, with attack success rates for jailbreak and prompt injection attacks increasing much faster than utility degrades. We then propose SecureSD, a new theory-guided speculative decoding method that enhances security while maintaining efficiency and utility. Specifically, our theoretical analysis reveals that security degradation primarily originates from the early tokens generated by the draft model. Motivated by this insight, SecureSD applies a stricter verification criterion to draft-model tokens at early decoding positions. Extensive experiments on both security and utility benchmarks demonstrate that SecureSD significantly improves security while preserving efficiency and utility compared to existing speculative decoding methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统测量揭示有损投机解码 (lossy speculative decoding) 存在安全-效用不对称：推理效率的提升以安全为代价，jailbreak 与 prompt injection 的攻击成功率上升速度远快于效用下降速度。理论分析指出安全退化主要源自 draft model 早期生成的 token，据此提出 SecureSD，在早期解码位置对 draft token 采用更严格的验证准则，在保持效率与效用的同时显著提升安全。
Motivation: 已有工作只关注投机解码的效率-效用权衡（如有损投机解码），其安全影响基本未被研究；而 draft model 生成的候选 token 被目标模型接受或拒绝的机制可能被攻击者利用。
Method: 先做大规模测量研究，覆盖多种有损投机解码方法，量化推理效率、效用与 jailbreak/prompt injection 攻击成功率之间的关系；再做理论分析定位安全退化来源，提出 SecureSD：对 draft model 在早期解码位置的 token 施加更严格的验证准则，最后在安全与效用基准上做实验。
Result: 测量结果显示安全-效用不对称：在广泛的有损投机解码方法上，攻击成功率（jailbreak 与 prompt injection）的上升速度远快于效用的下降速度。SecureSD 的实验在安全与效用基准上相比已有投机解码方法显著改善安全，同时保持效率与效用。
Conclusion: 投机解码的安全退化主要由 draft model 的早期 token 引入，因此在早期位置收紧验证即可在不牺牲效率与效用的前提下提升安全性。

papers.title: Variance-Optimal Off-Policy Evaluation with Conjunct Effect Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) for contextual bandit policies becomes challenging when action-level importance weighting incurs excessive variance. Doubly robust (DR) estimation remains unbiased under common support but retains these high-variance action-level weights. A prior estimator, Off-policy evaluation with Conjunct Effect Model (OffCEM), replaces them with more stable cluster-level weights, at the cost of relying on local correctness of the reward model. In this paper, we show that, under the assumptions required by DR and OffCEM, there exists an unbiased family of estimators that interpolates between OffCEM and DR. Building on this result, we propose the Variance Optimal-CEM (VOCEM) estimator, which selects the interpolation coefficient to minimize variance. We derive the population-optimal coefficient in closed form and show that the resulting estimator has variance no larger than either endpoint, OffCEM or DR. Experiments in controlled synthetic settings and on two large-action benchmarks show that VOCEM improves upon both endpoints in all 23 evaluated conditions, exhibiting greater stability and empirical robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在上下文老虎机 (contextual bandit) 的离策略评估 (off-policy evaluation) 中，动作级重要性权重方差过大时，DR 与 OffCEM 各有短板。作者证明在 DR 与 OffCEM 共同假设下存在一族无偏估计量，闭式给出使方差最小的插值系数，得到 VOCEM，其方差不高于两个端点；在受控合成设定与两个大动作 benchmark 的全部 23 个评估条件下均改进两端点。
Motivation: 动作级重要性加权使 DR 估计量方差过高，而用簇级权重的 OffCEM 以奖励模型局部正确为代价换取稳定，OPE 需要兼顾无偏与低方差的估计量。
Method: 证明在 DR 与 OffCEM 所需假设下存在介于 OffCEM 与 DR 之间的无偏估计量族，按方差最小化选择插值系数，并推导总体最优系数的闭式解，得到 VOCEM 估计量。
Result: 推导出的 VOCEM 方差不高于 OffCEM 与 DR 任一端点；在受控合成设定和两个大动作 benchmark 上，全部 23 个评估条件中 VOCEM 均优于两个端点，表现出更强稳定性与经验稳健性。
Conclusion: 在 DR 与 OffCEM 的共同假设下，通过方差最优的插值系数可以在不引入偏差的前提下同时压过两个端点的方差。

papers.title: EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EC-RAG 把长视频先切成语义连贯的片段并连成显式事件链 (event chain)，再按 query 在链上定位事件、跨语音/文本/视觉模态收集证据做问答，全程 training-free。在 Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench 上一致优于 frame-level 检索基线。
Motivation: 长视频 LVLM 逐帧独立处理，难以捕捉跨事件的时间依赖；现有检索增强多停留在帧或片段粒度，无法建模事件如何演化与相互关联。
Method: 训练无关框架：先将视频划分为语义连贯片段，用多模态信号表示各片段，再按时序连成保留事件间关系的结构化链；给定 query 后在链上定位相关事件并从关联模态收集证据，可即插即用接入现有 LVLM backbone，无需额外训练或专有模型。
Result: 在 Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench 三个长视频理解基准上，事件级设计一致优于 frame-level 检索基线。
Conclusion: 长视频理解的关键在于建模时间结构而非孤立帧，事件级抽象加结构化多模态融合比帧级检索更可靠地定位内容，且可零训练接入现有 LVLM。

papers.title: PDB: Point-Based Deformation Blending for Facial Animation Retargeting
papers.abstract_en: Mesh-agnostic facial animation retargeting transfers expressions across meshes with different structures, but preserving facial motion without surface artifacts remains challenging. To address this, we present PDB, Point-Based Deformation Blending for facial animation retargeting. PDB predicts a compact set of deformed control points from a source neutral-expression pair and blending weights from the target neutral mesh. The weights are computed once per target and reused across frames, while the control points vary with each source expression. ReLU enforces non-negative weights and permits exact zeros, followed by row-wise normalization. The target mesh is reconstructed directly by multiplying the weights and control points, without a predefined cage, precomputed coordinates, a learned per-element deformation decoder, or a global reconstruction solve. Trained only with self-retargeting reconstruction supervision, PDB supports cross-identity transfer without paired cross-identity training expressions. Experiments demonstrate accurate retargeting, fast inference, and localized support in the learned weights. Joint evaluation of expression accuracy and local surface preservation shows reduced surface artifacts relative to the evaluated dense displacement method while retaining the intended motion. Perceptual evaluations further support expression fidelity and visual quality in both self- and cross-retargeting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PDB 用点式变形混合做与网格结构无关的表情重定向：从源中性-表情对预测少量变形控制点，从目标中性网格预测混合权重，权重经 ReLU 保证非负且可精确为零再逐行归一化，直接以权重乘控制点重建目标网格。仅用自重定向重建监督训练即可跨身份迁移，相对被评估的稠密位移方法表面伪影更少，同时保住预期动作。
Motivation: 跨不同拓扑网格迁移面部动作时，保持运动且不引入表面伪影仍然困难；现有做法依赖预定义 cage、预计算坐标、逐元素变形解码器或全局重建求解。
Method: 从源中性-表情对预测紧凑的变形控制点，从目标中性网格预测混合权重；权重每个目标只算一次并跨帧复用，控制点随源表情逐帧变化。ReLU 使权重非负且允许精确零，随后逐行归一化；目标网格由权重与控制点直接相乘重建，不设 cage、不预计算坐标、不用逐元素解码器与全局求解。训练仅用自重定向重建监督。
Result: 实验展示准确的重定向、快速推理以及学习权重中的局部支撑；表情精度与局部表面保持的联合评估显示，相对被评估的稠密位移方法表面伪影减少且保留预期动作；感知评估在自重定向与跨重定向上都支持表情保真度与视觉质量。
Conclusion: 不依赖 cage 或全局求解的点式变形混合，配合仅自重定向的监督，即可实现跨身份的表情迁移并减少表面伪影。

summary_sections.result: 实验展示准确的重定向、快速推理以及学习权重中的局部支撑；表情精度与局部表面保持的联合评估显示，相对被评估的稠密位移方法表面伪影减少且保留预期动作；感知评估在自重定向与跨重定向上都支持表情保真度与视觉质量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 不依赖 cage 或全局求解的点式变形混合，配合仅自重定向的监督，即可实现跨身份的表情迁移并减少表面伪影。

papers.title: Principled Under Pressure: Post-Training Decides Whether LLMs Act on Their Own Moral Judgment
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly act as agents. An agent that says an action is wrong and then takes it anyway is a different failure from one that does not know better, and evaluations of stated values cannot see it. We build a pre-registered panel of 248 scenarios across five kinds of pressure. Each scenario is posed twice to the same model, once as the agent choosing what to do and once in the third person asking which option is right, so the model's own judgment is the reference. Every scenario has a twin with the pressure removed, and every model gets a positive control in which its operator orders the violating action, so that a missing gap can be told apart from a blind instrument. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, the model takes the action it judged wrong on about one in five pressuring scenarios, more often than on the same scenarios with the pressure removed. Across four instruct models the gap depends on the post-training recipe: OLMo-3 and Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct carry it; Tulu 3 shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.01 in probability) or on its own most-pressuring scenarios; Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct shows none on the whole panel (above about 0.02) and is unresolved on its own (0.083, -0.028 to 0.195). Meta's recipe and Ai2's Tulu 3 start from the same Llama-3.1 weights, and only Meta's carries the gap. Reading a chat model outside its chat template reverses the sign of its gap with nothing at stake (-0.038 against +0.055 under the template on OLMo-3), a distortion present on two of three recipes. On both models that carry it, reasoning about the stakes before acting moves the choice back toward the model's own judgment, against a same-length non-moral task, with or without the pressure; on OLMo-3, naming the norm at stake does about a third of that. The gap is a measurable target for post-training recipes, not a fixed property of pretrained weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 248 个场景的预注册面板测出：LLM 在压力下会执行自己判定为错误的动作，OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 约五分之一的施压场景如此，且高于无压力对照。该差距由 post-training 配方决定——Tulu 3 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 全面板上无差距，同源 Llama-3.1 权重上只有 Meta 配方保留差距；行动前推理利害可把选择拉回模型自身判断。
Motivation: 只测模型口头陈述的价值观，看不见「嘴上说错、手上照做」这类失败；需要把模型自身的判断当作参照，量化压力下的言行差距，并区分差距缺失与测量工具失灵。
Method: 构建预注册的 248 场景面板，覆盖五类压力；每个场景对同一模型问两次——一次以 agent 身份选择行动，一次第三人称判断何为正确，以后者为参照；每个场景配去压力孪生体，并给每个模型加一个操作者下令违规的正对照。比较四个 instruct 模型（OLMo-3-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Tulu 3、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct），并测试脱离 chat template 读取与行动前道德推理两种干预。
Result: OLMo-3-7B-Instruct 在约五分之一施压场景执行自判错误的动作，高于同场景去压力版本。四模型差距取决于 post-training 配方：OLMo-3 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 保留差距；Tulu 3 全面板无差距（概率阈值约 0.01）；Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 全面板无差距（约 0.02），其自身最施压场景未定（0.083，区间 -0.028 到 0.195）。Meta 与 Ai2 Tulu 3 起点同为 Llama-3.1 权重，仅 Meta 保留差距。脱离 template 读取在无利害时反转符号：OLMo-3 为 -0.038 对 template 下的 +0.055，三种配方中两种存在该畸变。两个保留差距的模型上，行动前推理利害使选择回到自身判断（对同长度非道德任务），有无压力皆然；OLMo-3 上点名所涉规范约达该效果的三分之一。
Conclusion: 言行差距是 post-training 配方可测的目标，而非预训练权重的固定属性；测它需要以模型自身判断为参照并配正对照，读取方式本身也会扭曲结果。

papers.title: MemFLoRA: Memory-Floor LoRA for CNN Adaptation at the Edge
papers.abstract_en: On-device learning is necessary when the model encounters user-,sensor-, or environment-specific shifts after deployment. Although parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, particularly Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) variants, enable efficient adaptation at the edge, the limiting resource for Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) adaptation is often not the number of trainable parameters but the activation state that must be retained until the backward pass. This paper introduces Memory-Floor LoRA (MemFLoRA), a low-rank CNN adapter built around a memory-first design principle rather than a direct application of transformer-oriented LoRA. Instead of merely reducing trainable weights, we define an activation-memory-floor criterion: trainable backward computations must not depend on full-width layer inputs. The resulting adapter freezes the down-projection, trains a scale-matched up-projection, and combines eval-mode backbone normalization with activation-minimal backward rules, reducing saved state to the low-rank branch. Evaluated on three Human Activity Recognition (HAR) datasets and two CNN backbones under subject, body-location, and sensor-placement shifts, MemFLoRA reduces saved-activation memory by 98.5-98.7% and peak training-state memory by 94.9-97.3% relative to full fine-tuning, while matching or exceeding CNN PEFT baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 32nd Asia and South Pacific Design Automation Conference (ASP-DAC 2027), January 25-28, 2027, Tokyo, Japan. Code: https://github.com/mehmetemreakbulut/MemFLoRA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemFLoRA 提出以激活内存为约束的低秩 CNN 适配器：定义“反向计算不得依赖全宽层输入”的激活内存下限准则，冻结 down-projection、只训练尺度匹配的 up-projection，并结合 eval-mode backbone 归一化与最小激活反向规则，把保存状态压到低秩分支。在三个 HAR 数据集、两种 CNN backbone 的 subject/body-location/sensor-placement 偏移下，相对全量微调保存激活内存降 98.5–98.7%、峰值训练状态内存降 94.9–97.3%，同时持平或超过 CNN PEFT 基线。
Motivation: 边缘设备部署后会遇到用户、传感器或环境偏移，需要 on-device learning；但 CNN 适配的瓶颈往往不是可训练参数量，而是反向传播前必须保留的激活状态，直接照搬面向 transformer 的 LoRA 解决不了这一点。
Method: 提出 Memory-Floor LoRA (MemFLoRA)：以激活内存下限准则约束设计，冻结 down-projection、训练尺度匹配的 up-projection，配合 eval-mode backbone normalization 与 activation-minimal backward rules，使保存状态只限于低秩分支；在三个 HAR 数据集、两种 CNN backbone 上按 subject、body-location、sensor-placement 三类偏移评测。
Result: 相对全量微调，保存激活内存减少 98.5–98.7%，峰值训练状态内存减少 94.9–97.3%；在三类偏移设置下性能持平或超过 CNN PEFT 基线。
Conclusion: CNN 边缘适配应以激活内存而非参数量作为设计约束，把反向路径限制在低秩分支即可在大幅省内存的同时保持 PEFT 精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Semantic Behavioral Watermarking: Paraphrase-Robust and Forgery-Resistant Provenance for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral watermarking embeds an owner identifier in an LLM agent's high-level action choices, giving provenance without touching output tokens. Prior agent watermarks break in two ways. First, all three prior schemes bind the watermark to the exact action symbol, so renaming a tool desynchronizes decoding even when the observation is untouched; in AgentMark's own robustness test, paraphrasing the observation alone drops bit-recovery to 16.8%. Second, every prior agent watermark studies only removal: none asks whether an adversary can forge a trajectory that verifies as someone else's, a question answered affirmatively for text watermarks (Jovanović et al., 2024). We present Semantic Behavioral Watermarking (SBW): watermarking over semantic action clusters under history conditioning, with the public-cluster bin replaced by keyed collision-resistant binning whose fresh-bucket assignment is provably unpredictable in the random-oracle model. Across five agent models (3B-14B, four vendors) and three encoders the ordering holds on both benchmarks: on ToolBench (600 trajectories per model) detection under rewriting is 0.49-0.66 for cluster-level versus 0.05-0.17 for exact-symbol at a permutation-calibrated 1% FPR, at 72-83% choice agreement against 22-27% for logit biasing; on ALFWorld (100 episodes per model) it is 0.92-0.97 versus 0.00-0.01. Keyed binning takes adaptive forgery from 100% to the false-positive floor at the primary operating point (bge, r=64). We also mark the boundary that guarantee does not cover: when the adversary copies the victim's own steps, shuffled splicing is neutralized (0.000 on Qwen2.5-3B) but chained replay remains at 0.76-0.98 across the five models, reported as open. Paraphrase robustness costs about half of the per-step watermark capacity. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SBW-Agent-Watermark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SBW 把 LLM agent 的行为水印从精确动作符号移到语义动作簇上，并用带密钥的抗碰撞分桶替代公开簇分桶，使改写观测后仍能恢复标识。在 ToolBench（每模型 600 条轨迹）上改写后检测率为 0.49–0.66（精确符号仅 0.05–0.17，置换校准 1% FPR），ALFWorld（每模型 100 集）上 0.92–0.97 对 0.00–0.01；带密钥分桶把自适应伪造从 100% 压到假阳率下限，但链式重放 (chained replay) 仍在五个模型上保持 0.76–0.98。
Motivation: 既有 agent 水印把标识绑死在动作符号上，工具改名或观测改写就失步（AgentMark 中仅改写观测即把比特恢复率打到 16.8%）；且此前只研究移除攻击，无人检验对手能否伪造出他人可验证的轨迹。
Method: 在历史条件化下对语义动作簇做水印，公开簇分桶换成带密钥的抗碰撞分桶，新桶分配在随机预言机模型下可证明不可预测；在五个 agent 模型（3B–14B、四家厂商）与三个编码器上，于 ToolBench 与 ALFWorld 检验改写鲁棒性、选择一致性与伪造攻击。
Result: ToolBench 上改写后簇级检测 0.49–0.66 对精确符号 0.05–0.17（置换校准 1% FPR），选择一致性 72–83% 对 logit biasing 的 22–27%；ALFWorld 上 0.92–0.97 对 0.00–0.01。带密钥分桶在主操作点（bge, r=64）把自适应伪造从 100% 降到假阳率下限；对手复制受害者自身步骤时，乱序拼接被中和（Qwen2.5-3B 上 0.000），但链式重放在五个模型上仍为 0.76–0.98。改写鲁棒性约损失一半每步水印容量。
Conclusion: 语义簇加带密钥分桶能同时解决改写失步与伪造验证两类失效，代价是约一半的每步容量；链式重放超出该保证范围，作者将其作为开放问题报告。

papers.title: Knowing When to Trust a Prior: Reliability-Gated Cue Fusion for Video Gaze Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model-domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion's latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FocusGate 用逐帧门控把无注视先验 (gaze-free priors) 融入视频注视预测：门读取散焦图的三个形状统计量，只在估计器平均优于随机的帧上启用，被拒帧完全退回基线。加到四个有监督预测器（含 NTIRE 2026 冠军）上后，16 个模型-领域组合的 shuffled AUC 全部提升、15 个显著，冠军延迟只增 1%。
Motivation: gaze-trained 模型已主导视频注视预测，但 gaze-free 先验含有它们未吸收的信号；无条件融合在 sports 上有害、在 web 上无效，说明关键在于知道何时该信任先验。
Method: 提出 FocusGate：一个允许成员弃权的 gaze-free 先验门控集成。逐帧门读取 defocus map 的三个形状统计量，选择估计器平均高于随机的帧；midrank 归一化使全零先验能以零参数弃权，被拒帧严格退回 base。
Result: 在 film、sports、web 视频上门控融合显著为正，而无条件融合在 sports 有害、web 无效。加到四个有监督预测器（含 NTIRE 2026 冠军）后，16 个模型-领域组合的 shuffled AUC 全部提升，15 个显著，其中一个领域为预注册单次评分；冠军延迟仅增 1%。单独使用时，以 16 帧 causal mean 在 film 上的 shuffled AUC 超过 TASED-Net 与 UNISAL。
Conclusion: 按帧门控选择性融合 gaze-free 先验可以在几乎不增加延迟的前提下稳定提升各类有监督注视预测器，而盲目融合会适得其反。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ParanoiaEval: Benchmarking Unnecessary Defensive Work in Agentic Coding
papers.abstract_en: As coding agents increasingly undertake real-world work autonomously, judging whether their risk treatments are warranted has become important. Existing work evaluates related agent behaviors from separate perspectives, but lacks a systematic framework for unifying these behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce ParanoiaEval, the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Grounded in the well-established Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance framework in software engineering risk management, ParanoiaEval operationalizes its 4 fundamental treatments for coding-agent settings and contains 200 evidence-controlled repository-level task pairs, each differing only in treatment-defining evidence. We further introduce dedicated metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness, using a human-calibrated agentic judge for reliable evaluation. Large-scale experiments on 8 representative models and a post-hoc human study reveal that (I) unnecessary risk treatment occurs in 11.2%-58.7% of runs despite explicit evidence, with substantial variation across agent configurations; (II) stronger task capability does not ensure more appropriate risk treatment, while treatment violations substantially harm developers' experience, establishing risk treatment as an independent capability dimension; and (III) agents exhibit systematic patterns consistent with established risk-management findings, suggesting that knowledge from human practice can guide the diagnosis and improvement of this capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ParanoiaEval 是首个统一评测编码智能体风险处置（risk treatment）能力的基准，把软件工程的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 四类处置落到编码任务上，用 200 组仅在处置证据上不同的仓库级任务对来测智能体是否做出无谓防御。在 8 个代表性模型的大规模实验中，即使有明确证据，11.2%–58.7% 的运行仍出现不必要风险处置，且任务能力强不等于处置更恰当。
Motivation: 编码智能体自主承担真实工作时，其风险应对是否必要缺乏统一评测框架，已有工作只从分散视角考察相关行为，无法把过度防御等表现归到同一能力维度上。
Method: 以软件工程风险管理中成熟的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 框架为依据，把 4 类处置操作化为编码场景，构造 200 组证据受控的仓库级任务对（每对仅在定义处置的证据上不同）；提出针对风险处置违规与证据响应性的专用指标，并用人工校准的 agentic judge 保证评测可靠。
Result: 在 8 个代表性模型上的大规模实验与事后人工研究显示：即使有明确证据，11.2%–58.7% 的运行仍发生不必要风险处置，且随智能体配置差异显著；任务能力更强并不保证处置更恰当，处置违规会明显损害开发者体验；智能体表现出与既有风险管理研究一致的系统性模式。
Conclusion: 风险处置是独立于任务能力的能力维度，人类风险管理实践中的知识可用来诊断并改进编码智能体的这一能力。

papers.title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Select-RL 把跨模型能力迁移的对象从端点参数改为 RL 阶段的参数更新，只保留更新中幅值占优的矩阵主方向并迁移到 VLM 的语言模块。在三个模型家族、五个视觉推理基准的 15 组比较中有 12 组优于全更新插值，Qwen 受体上 MathVision 提升 8.55 个百分点；对照实验表明单靠更新幅值或任意低秩都复现不了这些增益。
Motivation: 基于端点的模型合并会把模型原有差异与推理后训练带来的变化混在一起，而整段 RL 更新直接迁移又并非最优，因为更新各分量的跨模型可迁移性差异很大。
Method: Select-RL 先隔离 RL 阶段的参数更新，按矩阵层面保留幅值占优的主方向（magnitude preservation），再把这些方向迁移到 VLM 的语言模块；用更新幅值匹配与任意低秩匹配的对照实验排除幅值与低秩本身的作用。
Result: 在三个模型家族、五个视觉推理基准上，Select-RL 在 15 组比较中的 12 组改进了全更新插值，其中 Qwen 受体上 MathVision 提升 8.55 个百分点；匹配对照显示仅更新幅值或任意低秩无法复现这些增益。
Conclusion: 后训练期间学到的内容与跨模型可迁移的内容并不相同，按训练阶段更新的选择性迁移比整段更新迁移更有效，且效果来自主方向而非幅值或低秩本身。

papers.title: Steering Diffusion Models to Rare Events with Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are increasingly used as surrogates for expensive simulators in weather prediction, molecular dynamics, and materials design. In these models, computing the probability $p_0[E]$ of an event $E$ is difficult, especially when the event of interest is rare. A stable estimate using Monte Carlo becomes computationally intractable, requiring a growing sample size $\propto\!1/p_0[E]$ to compensate for an increasing rarity. In this paper, we present Diffusion Importance Sampling of Rare Events or DireSMC, a sequential Monte Carlo scheme that guides a population of weighted samples towards the rare event, giving access not only to samples but also to a calibrated estimate of its probability. We set up our guidance using an analytical relaxation of the event set, allowing the method to easily extend to a wide range of user-defined rare events. We validate our method on a toy problem with analytical solutions and on a score-based climate emulator, where we obtain accurate rare-event probabilities on a range of rarities from $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-5}$, achieving net speed-ups of $9\times$ to $1413\times$ over Monte Carlo.
papers.comment: A previous version of this work was presented at the NeurIPS 2026: AI for Stochastic Dynamics workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DireSMC：用序贯蒙特卡洛 (sequential Monte Carlo) 引导扩散模型的加权样本群朝稀有事件演化，既给出样本也给出校准后的事件概率估计。在解析可解的 toy problem 与基于 score 的气候 emulator 上，对 10^-3 到 10^-5 稀有度的事件给出准确概率，相对朴素 Monte Carlo 净加速 9× 到 1413×。
Motivation: 扩散代理模型用于天气、分子动力学等昂贵模拟器时，稀有事件概率 p_0[E] 难以估计：朴素 Monte Carlo 需要随稀有度增长的样本量（∝1/p_0[E]），计算上不可行。
Method: DireSMC 用序贯蒙特卡洛对扩散模型的加权样本群做导向，事件集采用解析松弛 (analytical relaxation)，使方法可推广到用户自定义的各类稀有事件；验证分两步：有解析解的 toy problem 与 score-based climate emulator。
Result: 在 toy problem 与 score-based climate emulator 上，对稀有度 10^-3 至 10^-5 的事件给出准确的稀有事件概率估计，相对 Monte Carlo 实现 9× 到 1413× 的净加速。
Conclusion: 序贯蒙特卡洛导向可以把扩散代理模型从采样器变成能输出校准概率的稀有事件估计器，并在 10^-3–10^-5 稀有度区间显著优于按 1/p_0[E] 增长的朴素 Monte Carlo。
Relevance: 58

papers.title: A Case Study in Assuring AI-Written Software
papers.abstract_en: Software-engineering agents can enable people without formal software training to build systems they could not otherwise implement and simultaneously can produce more code than even experts can meaningfully inspect. In both cases, exhaustive code review is not reliable as the sole basis for human control. We report a case study of a production healthcare platform built through coding agents and governed by an operator without formal software-engineering training. Over time, its workflow grew into a human-led meta-agent system where one agent wrote code, other agents supervised and reviewed it, and project rules carried lessons forward. The operator found that tests, monitors and reviewing agents used to supervise the system were fallible. Some monitors measured proxies rather than outcomes, some audits failed silently, missing checks disappeared from reported results and one automated repair caused operational disruption. In this case, human control depended on keeping the intended outcome, the evidence used to judge it, the agents' permissions and the final human decision were all tied to the same underlying objective.
papers.comment: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Meta-Agents Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 一个由 coding agent 搭建、非软件工程背景运营者治理的生产级医疗平台，最终演化为人主导的 meta-agent 系统：一个 agent 写码、其他 agent 监督与评审、项目规则沉淀经验。案例发现测试、监控与评审 agent 都会失效——有的测代理指标而非结果、有的审计静默失败、缺失检查从上报结果中消失、一次自动修复造成运行中断；人的控制取决于把预期目标、判定证据、agent 权限与最终人工决策绑定到同一底层目标上。
Motivation: 软件 agent 能让无正式训练的人构建本无法实现的系统，却也产出远超专家可审查的代码量，穷尽式代码审查不足以作为人类控制的唯一依据。
Method: 对一个生产医疗平台做案例研究：该平台由 coding agent 构建、由无软件工程训练的运营者治理，工作流演化为 human-led meta-agent 系统（一个 agent 写码、其他 agent 监督评审、项目规则传递经验），并考察测试、监控与评审 agent 的失效方式。
Result: 观察到的失效包括：部分监控测量代理指标而非最终结果、部分审计静默失败、缺失检查从上报结果中消失、一次自动修复引发运行中断；最终人工控制依赖目标、证据、权限与决策绑定到同一底层目标。
Conclusion: 在 agent 写码的系统里，人的控制不来自更多测试或评审 agent，而来自让预期目标、判定证据、agent 权限与最终人工决策共用同一底层目标。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Stable Scores, Unstable Answers: Frame Phase and Option Order in Video Multiple-Choice Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Video-language models are ranked by multiple-choice accuracy on frames from a uniform grid. The grid has two parameters, a rate and a phase, and benchmarks report only the rate. The phase moves answers: two deployed samplers differing only by a half-step phase offset answer 23.6% of questions differently while scoring within a point, and across four releases from two families shifting only the phase changes roughly one answer in five after controlling option order. PHASEFUSION decodes three offset grids and averages the option posteriors. The grids are the polyphase components of the dense grid. Fusion matches a 32-frame single pass in accuracy within a prespecified margin (logit-scored) and cuts the answers a half-step shift of all three grids changes from 18.2% to 10.1%. Option order, which changes only the presentation, is flagged instead by a one-pass answer margin. Report the phase convention with the budget, or marginalize it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 视频多选评测只报告均匀采样网格的帧率而忽略相位，相位本身就能移动答案：两个仅差半步相位偏移的采样器有 23.6% 的题目答案不同，总分却相差不到 1 分。提出 PHASEFUSION，解码三个偏移网格并对选项后验做平均，把半步相位移动导致的答案翻转从 18.2% 降到 10.1%，精度与 32 帧单次通过在预设容差内持平；选项顺序则由单次通过的答案边际单独标记。作者主张把相位约定连同帧预算一起报告，或直接对相位做边缘化。
Motivation: 视频语言模型用均匀网格抽帧做多选排名，但基准只报帧率不报相位，相位这一自由度足以在不改变总分的情况下改写约五分之一的答案，使模型排名不可复现。
Method: PHASEFUSION 解码三个相互偏移的采样网格（它们构成稠密网格的 polyphase 分量），对选项后验取平均；选项顺序这种只影响呈现的扰动，则用单次通过的答案边际 (answer margin) 标记出来。
Result: 仅差半步相位偏移的两个已部署采样器，23.6% 的题目答案不同而总分相差不到 1 分；在两个家族共四个版本上，只移动相位（控制选项顺序后）约五分之一答案改变。PHASEFUSION 的精度与 32 帧单次通过在预设容差内持平（logit 打分），并把三个网格整体半步移动所改变的答案比例从 18.2% 降到 10.1%。

papers.title: SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids. First, there is a re-exploration cost: redundant effort spent by parallel workers reconstructing context that the orchestrator already possesses, such as prior decisions, that would otherwise be inherited implicitly in a serial execution. Second, there is an alignment cost: the overhead required to reconcile inconsistencies across independently generated outputs. We thus derive a principled decision criterion: a layer should be parallelized only when its critical-path cost, plus re-exploration and alignment overheads, is lower than the corresponding serial cost. While this criterion is naturally expressed in wall-clock time, we observe that LLMs are poorly calibrated when asked to estimate task duration. To address this, we instead measure cost in predicted output tokens, which we empirically find LLMs can estimate substantially more reliably than wall-clock time. Building on this token-based criterion, we propose SquidAgent. It estimates all token budgets in a single planning step, forks each worker directly from the orchestrator's session to eliminate re-exploration cost, and replaces post-hoc reconciliation with a pre-generated shared convention block that converts alignment into a bounded upfront cost. A deterministic scheduler then applies the criterion layer by layer. Empirically, SquidAgent achieves a 2.2$\times$ mean throughput improvement and a 2.6$\times$ mean wall-time speedup over Claude Code, and a 2.0$\times$ throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SquidAgent 把 LLM 多智能体并行执行的开销拆成重探索成本与对齐成本，导出「关键路径成本 + 两项开销低于串行成本才并行」的判据，并用预测输出 token 数（而非墙钟时间）度量成本。每个 worker 直接从 orchestrator 会话 fork 消除重探索，用预生成的共享约定块把对齐变成有界的前置开销，再由确定性调度器逐层应用判据；相对 Claude Code 平均吞吐提升 2.2×、墙钟加速 2.6×，相对最强多智能体基线吞吐提升 2.0×。
Motivation: 并行多智能体系统本应接近线性加速，实际却常慢于单智能体基线；瓶颈在于并行独有的重探索成本与对齐成本，且 LLM 估计任务时长时校准很差，无法直接用墙钟时间做并行决策。
Method: 以预测输出 token 数替代墙钟时间作为成本度量（LLM 对其估计更可靠），在单次规划步骤中估算全部 token 预算；每个 worker 直接从 orchestrator 会话 fork 以继承上下文，用预生成的共享约定块 (shared convention block) 取代事后调和，最后由确定性调度器逐层套用「关键路径 + 重探索 + 对齐 < 串行」的判据。
Result: 相对 Claude Code 平均吞吐提升 2.2×、平均墙钟加速 2.6×；相对最强多智能体基线吞吐提升 2.0×。
Conclusion: 并行化的收益取决于能否把重探索与对齐开销压进判据之内，而 token 预算比墙钟时间更适合作为 LLM 可估计的成本量。

papers.title: HygieneRoboBench: Benchmarking Hygiene-Aware Planning for Household Robots
papers.abstract_en: Contact with contaminated objects can spread hazards through a household robot's grippers, tools, and shared surfaces, while new contacts can make an existing plan unsafe. Existing benchmarks do not jointly assess how planners identify hygiene risks from contact history and plan safe continuations after new contact events. Planners must do so within time and resource limits while respecting user priorities. We introduce HygieneRoboBench, with 624 instances across 134 task families, to evaluate safe resolution of household tasks from a given execution history. Tasks capture contamination through two grippers and shared objects, treatment costs, and user priorities. We combine controlled history, profile, and event comparisons with independent plan evaluation. These assess safe resolution, cost efficiency under user priorities, and responses to contact events. Evaluation of LLM-based and symbolic planners shows that safely completing a task does not guarantee the lowest execution costs under the user's priorities. To address this problem, we introduce Hygiene-NSP. It combines LLM-based grounding, contact-history reconstruction, and CP-SAT to jointly plan hygiene treatment and task execution under user priorities. Hygiene-NSP achieves safe resolution and optimal safe resolution rates of 94.4% and 90.4%, respectively. Both rates are higher than those of the evaluated baseline planners on the full dataset. Project page: https://euron-zc.github.io/HygieneRoboBench/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出家务机器人卫生感知规划基准 HygieneRoboBench，含 134 个任务族共 624 个实例，从给定执行历史评估规划器识别接触污染风险并安全续解任务的能力。评测发现安全完成任务不等于在用户优先级下执行成本最低；据此提出 Hygiene-NSP，用 LLM 语义解析、接触历史重建与 CP-SAT 联合规划卫生处理与任务执行，安全解出率 94.4%、最优安全解出率 90.4%，两项均高于所评测的基线规划器。
Motivation: 现有基准不联合评估规划器能否从接触历史识别卫生风险、以及在新接触事件后规划安全续解，而污染会经夹爪、工具与共享表面扩散，新接触可能使原计划失效。
Method: HygieneRoboBench 覆盖 134 个任务族共 624 个实例，任务建模双夹爪与共享物体的污染、处理成本和用户优先级；评测组合受控的历史、画像与事件对比以及独立的计划评估。方法 Hygiene-NSP 结合 LLM 语义解析 (grounding)、接触历史重建与 CP-SAT，在用户优先级下联合规划卫生处理与任务执行。
Result: Hygiene-NSP 在全数据集上安全解出率 94.4%、最优安全解出率 90.4%，两项均高于所评测的基线规划器；对 LLM 与符号规划器的评测显示，安全完成任务并不保证在用户优先级下执行成本最低。
Conclusion: 卫生风险识别与安全续解需要联合规划处理与执行，且安全可行与成本最优是两个必须分开考核的目标。

papers.title: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
papers.abstract_en: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RGE 把预训练视觉模型中稀疏、对来源敏感的内部成分当作“法证储备”，用 Forensic Lens 按真图与生成图的响应差筛出储备位点与方向，再只在这些位点插入 Forensic Reserve Adapter 并仅训练其系数映射。仅用 500 张标注训练图、可训练参数低于骨干的 0.2%，在三个伪造检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能且不做目标基准适配，并在八种编码器上一致优于对应冻结检测器。
Motivation: 现有图像伪造检测主要靠任务特定监督去改造视觉基础模型表征，没有充分挖掘模型内部已有的法证知识来引导检测。
Method: 先用 Forensic Lens (F-lens) 把各层与 token 组的激活分解为独立成分，按真图与生成图的响应差全局筛选，确定储备位点与方向；再把这些方向映射回 hidden-state 空间构成固定储备子空间，仅在识别出的位点插入 Forensic Reserve Adapter (FRA)；训练时冻结骨干参数、已拟合的参考分类器与子空间基，只训练 FRA 系数映射，产生受子空间约束的输入相关残差更新。
Result: 仅用 500 张标注训练图、可训练参数低于骨干 0.2%，RGE 在三个图像伪造检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能，且不做目标基准适配；在覆盖自监督与视觉-语言预训练的八种编码器上，RGE 均一致优于对应的冻结检测器。
Conclusion: 预训练视觉模型中存在被闲置的、跨模型广泛共享的潜在法证能力，用结构约束的轻量适配即可把它激发出来，而不必依赖大规模任务监督。

papers.title: Spectral Recovery of Point Clouds from Noisy Geometric Graphs
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of recovering low-dimensional latent geometry from a random geometric graph generated by noisy, high-dimensional data. Specifically, we analyze the performance of a spectral embedding algorithm on the Signal+Noise Graph Model, in which vertices are associated to points perturbed by Gaussian noise, and edges are included for pairs whose inner product exceeds a specified alignment threshold. In the high-dimensional regime where the number $n$ of points and the ambient dimension $d$ both tend to infinity, we show that under a spectral gap condition, the top eigenvectors and eigenvalues of the graph's adjacency matrix can be used to approximately recover the point cloud up to an orthogonal transformation. We illustrate our results on point clouds sampled from nested spheres and high-dimensional sinusoid curves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Signal+Noise Graph Model 下，当点数 n 与环境维度 d 同时趋于无穷且满足谱隙条件时，邻接矩阵的前几特征向量与特征值可在正交变换意义下近似恢复被高斯噪声污染的低维点云；数值示例用嵌套球面与高维正弦曲线点云说明该结论。
Motivation: 从含噪高维数据生成的随机几何图中恢复低维潜在几何结构缺少理论保证，尤其在 n、d 同阶增长的高维体制下，谱嵌入能否近似复原点云并不清楚。
Method: 分析 Signal+Noise Graph Model：顶点对应被高斯噪声扰动的点，两点内积超过对齐阈值即连边；对邻接矩阵做谱嵌入，取前几特征向量与特征值，在谱隙条件下证明可近似恢复点云（至正交变换），并以嵌套球面和高维正弦曲线采样的点云作示例。
Result: 在 n、d 均趋于无穷的高维体制与谱隙条件下，证明邻接矩阵前几特征向量与特征值可近似恢复点云（正交变换意义下）；在嵌套球面与高维正弦曲线点云上给出数值示例。
Conclusion: 谱隙条件足以让随机几何图的谱嵌入在高维含噪体制下近似复原低维潜在几何，恢复精度以正交变换为基准。

summary_sections.conclusion: 谱隙条件足以让随机几何图的谱嵌入在高维含噪体制下近似复原低维潜在几何，恢复精度以正交变换为基准。

papers.title: Parallel Predictive World Models for Accurate and Efficient Long-Horizon Planning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon world-model planning typically relies on autoregressive rollouts, where predicted states are repeatedly fed back into the model. This preserves temporal structure but creates a horizon-length sequential path and exposes later predictions to recursive decoded-state feedback. We introduce Parallel Predictive World Models (PPWM), which predict a finite-horizon trajectory in parallel while retaining causal interaction among future representations. Each horizon is conditioned on its causal action prefix, and future representations interact before decoding, separating temporal causality from state-by-state output recursion. We formalize this distinction by viewing autoregressive rollout as a causal trajectory map and identifying the decoded-state feedback pathway removed by PPWM. Across four visual-control tasks, PPWM achieves the lowest long-horizon prediction error and the highest Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) simulator success among the evaluated predictive interfaces. Meanwhile, PPWM achieves more than a 3$\times$ average CEM planning speedup over the autoregressive LeWM baseline. These results suggest that accurate and efficient long-horizon world-model planning does not require state-by-state autoregression, but can instead be achieved through parallel causal trajectory prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PPWM 把长时程世界模型规划从逐状态自回归 rollout 改为并行预测整段有限时域轨迹：每个时域只以自己的因果动作前缀为条件，未来表征在解码前先互相交互，从而切断解码状态的递归反馈通路。在四个视觉控制任务上，它取得最低的长时程预测误差和最高的 CEM simulator success，并相对自回归 LeWM 基线带来超过 3× 的平均 CEM 规划加速。
Motivation: 自回归 rollout 虽保留时间结构，却形成一条随时域线性拉长的串行路径，且后续预测不断暴露在解码状态的递归反馈之下，导致长时程规划既慢又易累积误差。
Method: 提出 Parallel Predictive World Models (PPWM)：并行预测有限时域轨迹，同时保留未来表征间的因果交互——每个时域以因果动作前缀为条件，未来表征在解码前交互，把时间因果性与逐状态输出递归分离开；并把自回归 rollout 形式化为因果轨迹图 (causal trajectory map)，据此指认 PPWM 移除的解码状态反馈通路。规划用 Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)，对照基线为自回归 LeWM。
Result: 在四个视觉控制任务上，PPWM 在所评估的预测接口中取得最低的长时程预测误差与最高的 CEM simulator success；相对自回归 LeWM 基线，平均 CEM 规划加速超过 3×。
Conclusion: 准确且高效的长时程世界模型规划不必依赖逐状态自回归，通过并行的因果轨迹预测即可达成。

papers.title: Feature Information Dynamics in Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generate data through a continuum of denoising problems, and are widely observed to reveal coarse structure before fine detail. Yet, this intuition is mostly empirical and qualitative. We introduce feature information dynamics, an information-theoretic framework for localizing when a feature is generated during diffusion. Using the I-MMSE identity, we connect the rate of feature mutual information change to a gap between optimal unconditional and feature-conditional denoising losses, yielding practical estimators for feature information density. We further develop a chained decomposition that separates shared from incremental information in a feature hierarchy. We use this framework first to quantitatively confirm spectral autoregression in pixel diffusion, and then to extend the analysis beyond frequency: under a class $\to$ mask $\to$ Canny conditioning chain, the per-feature information densities differ across pixel, SDVAE, VAVAE, and RAE, exposing fundamental differences between these representations and suggesting that ordered generation could be beneficial for training diffusion models. Our code is available at https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/feature-information-dynamics.
papers.comment: Accepted as poster at NeurIPS 2026. 28 pages, including references, appendices, and checklist
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出特征信息动力学 (feature information dynamics)：用 I-MMSE 恒等式把特征互信息变化率联系到最优无条件与特征条件去噪损失之差，从而定位扩散模型中每个特征被生成的时刻。在像素扩散上定量确认了频谱自回归；在 class→mask→Canny 条件链下，逐特征信息密度在 pixel、SDVAE、VAVAE、RAE 表征间显著不同，提示有序生成对训练扩散模型有益。
Motivation: 扩散模型先生成粗结构再补细节的观察长期停留在经验与定性层面，缺少可量化定位“某特征何时被生成”的信息论工具，也难以比较不同潜空间表征的生成顺序差异。
Method: 基于 I-MMSE 恒等式，将特征互信息变化率与最优无条件去噪损失和特征条件去噪损失之差挂钩，构造特征信息密度的实用估计器；再提出链式分解 (chained decomposition)，在特征层级中分离共享信息与增量信息，并在 class→mask→Canny 条件链上跨表征应用。
Result: 在像素扩散中定量确认频谱自回归 (spectral autoregression)；在 class→mask→Canny 条件链下，逐特征信息密度在 pixel、SDVAE、VAVAE、RAE 四种表征间呈现差异，暴露表征间根本不同。
Conclusion: 特征信息密度可作为定位扩散生成时序的通用度量，且不同表征的生成顺序差异支持“有序生成可能有利于扩散模型训练”这一判断。

papers.title: Early Memory Selection for Balanced Adam
papers.abstract_en: We propose a method for choosing the shared memory parameter $β_1=β_2=β$ in Adam from a short pilot training. The selected $β$ remains fixed during the subsequent full training. A local model of Adam's normalized direction balances sampling variability against the delay introduced by averaging past gradients. This balance gives a cubic memory rule, whose two coefficients are estimated from gradient probes at a few pilot checkpoints. The estimator uses the numerator and denominator jointly, preserving their covariance. With a 200-update pilot and sixteen probe gradients at each of four checkpoints, a seed-matched retrospective evaluation on eleven vision and language workloads reduces mean relative validation gap by 40.7% and worst-quarter mean gap by 44.3% against the grid representative of shared $β=0.95$. The mean gap is also 32.3% lower than that of the best constant $β$ chosen across all eleven workloads.
papers.comment: Includes theoretical proofs and reproducibility appendices. Code and data: https://github.com/AlbertoFdezHdez/Adam_beta_rule_cubic
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出从短 pilot 训练中一次性选定 Adam 共享记忆参数 β1=β2=β 的方法：用 Adam 归一化方向的局部模型在采样波动与历史梯度平均带来的延迟之间做平衡，导出 cubic memory rule，其两个系数由少量 pilot 检查点的梯度探针估计，分子分母联合估计以保留协方差。选定后 β 在完整训练中固定。在 11 个视觉与语言任务上，200-update pilot、每 4 个检查点各 16 个探针梯度的 seed-matched 回溯评估中，相对共享 β=0.95 的网格代表，平均相对验证差距下降 40.7%、最差四分位平均差距下降 44.3%；平均差距也比跨 11 个任务选出的最佳常数 β 低 32.3%。
Motivation: Adam 的共享 β 通常靠网格搜索或固定 0.9，跨任务选一个常数 β 会牺牲单个任务的表现；调网格成本高，且没有从训练早期信号推断合适 β 的准则。
Method: 对 Adam 归一化方向建立局部模型，在采样变异与历史梯度平均延迟之间做平衡，导出 cubic memory rule；用 200-update pilot 中 4 个检查点、每处 16 个探针梯度估计两个系数，分子分母联合估计以保留协方差；选定的 β 在后续完整训练中保持不变。
Result: 在 11 个视觉与语言工作负载上的 seed-matched 回溯评估：相对共享 β=0.95 的网格代表，平均相对验证差距降低 40.7%，最差四分位平均差距降低 44.3%；平均差距比跨全部 11 个工作负载选出的最佳常数 β 还低 32.3%。
Conclusion: 共享 β 可以从一次短 pilot 的梯度探针中按 cubic memory rule 定出并固定，比固定 0.95 网格和跨任务最佳常数 β 都得到更小的验证差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agentic RCA for Internet-Scale Services Using Constrained Creativity
papers.abstract_en: System administrators of Internet-scale services need to resolve failure incidents to maintain reliability of such services. Ideally, we want a troubleshooting system to be: (1) expressive to known and unknown incidents with high accuracy; (2) cost efficient at scale; (3) explainable to provide actionable insights operators can act on; and (4) entail low effort from the operators. Unfortunately, most existing systems, including emerging LLM-assisted agentic workflows and structured frameworks for authoring diverse RCA algorithms fall short of achieving all four requirements. We present E4, a novel agentic system for troubleshooting for Internet-scale services. E4 embodies the paradigm of constrained creativity that combines the best of LLM-assisted automation and exploration with the explainability and efficiency of a structured approach. Instead of allowing an LLM agent to write arbitrary code or generate arbitrary responses, we provide the agent a restricted DSL to generate its response via simple loop-free data flow programs. This DSL, equipped with high level operators for troubleshooting, makes E4's output accurate, verifiable and explainable. On a mix of synthetic and real-world workloads, E4 achieves up to 62% better accuracy compared to state-of-the-art solutions, while providing more explainable responses at up to 12x reduced cost.
papers.comment: 21 pages, including the references and appendix; 10 figures; 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: E4 用受限 DSL 约束 LLM agent 的“受约束创造力”：不让它任意写代码或自由作答，而是只生成由高层排障算子构成的无环数据流程序，使输出可验证、可解释。在合成与真实工作负载混合测试上，E4 相比最先进方案精度最高提升 62%，同时成本最高降低 12 倍。
Motivation: 互联网规模服务的故障根因定位 (RCA) 需要同时满足对已知与未知故障的高精度、规模化成本可控、可解释、低人力四点，而现有系统（含 LLM 辅助 agentic 工作流与结构化 RCA 框架）无法同时满足。
Method: E4 给 LLM agent 一个受限 DSL，只允许生成简单的无环数据流程序 (loop-free data flow programs)，DSL 内置高层排障算子；把 LLM 的自动化探索能力与结构化方法的可解释性和效率结合，而非放任任意代码或任意回答。
Result: 在合成与真实工作负载混合的测试上，E4 精度相比 state-of-the-art 方案最高提升 62%，同时给出更可解释的回答，成本最高降低 12 倍。
Conclusion: 用受限 DSL 约束 LLM agent 的输出空间，可以在互联网规模 RCA 中同时拿到高精度、可解释性与低成本，而不必在自动化探索和结构化验证之间二选一。

papers.title: Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness
papers.abstract_en: Recent game design agents have made substantial progress in generating playable games. However, program correctness does not ensure an enjoyable experience for players. We present Recursive Game Creator, an experience-oriented harness to advance agentic game development from rough game prototypes into entertaining games. Recursive Game Creator organizes recursive development around four components: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user instructions and Reviewer's feedback into detailed plans. The Builder turns these plans into candidate games. The coding-native Player creates and executes reusable policies through programmatic interfaces to efficiently collect diverse gameplay trajectories, mitigating evaluation bias caused by slow GUI-based collection. The Reviewer uses carefully designed trajectory-based metrics to induce player preferences, integrating with visual evidence and explicit textual preferences to evaluate games against game-specific criteria. Finally, the Reviewer accepts the better version and provides improvement reviews for the next round, closing the recursive loop. Our method achieves state-of-the-art overall performance of 77.89 on GameCraft-Bench. On GameASG-Bench, it achieves a strict task success rate of 53.2%, a 34.1% improvement over the same-model baseline, and the highest mean runtime-check pass rate at 93.4% among compared methods. A user study shows longer playtime and higher ratings. Code is coming soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Recursive Game Creator 用 Designer、Builder、Player、Reviewer 四组件把游戏生成做成以体验为目标的递归迭代闭环：Reviewer 用轨迹指标加视觉证据与文本偏好挑出更好版本并给出下一轮改进意见，coding-native Player 通过程序化接口复用策略收集轨迹以规避 GUI 采集慢导致的评估偏差。在 GameCraft-Bench 上取得 77.89 的总体最优成绩，GameASG-Bench 严格任务成功率 53.2%（比同模型基线高 34.1%），运行时检查通过率均值 93.4% 为对比方法最高，用户研究显示游玩时长与评分均提高。
Motivation: 现有游戏设计 agent 能生成可玩程序，但程序正确不等于玩家体验好，粗糙原型难以迭代成真正有趣的游戏。
Method: 递归开发闭环含四组件：Designer 把用户指令与 Reviewer 反馈转成详细计划，Builder 据此生成候选游戏，coding-native Player 通过程序化接口创建并执行可复用策略以高效收集多样化游玩轨迹，Reviewer 用轨迹指标结合视觉证据与显式文本偏好按游戏特定标准打分，接受更好版本并输出下一轮改进意见。
Result: GameCraft-Bench 总体成绩 77.89 达到 state-of-the-art；GameASG-Bench 严格任务成功率 53.2%，较同模型基线提升 34.1%，运行时检查通过率均值 93.4% 为对比方法中最高；用户研究显示更长的游玩时长与更高评分。
Conclusion: 把评估目标从程序正确性换成可度量的玩家体验并做成递归闭环，能把 agent 生成的游戏从原型推进到更耐玩的成品；代码即将发布。

papers.title: LiDAR Resolution Recovery via Foundation-Model-Guided Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a $δ_{1.25}$ accuracy of $66.8$% from $4$-beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only $45.1$%. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Stable Diffusion 作骨干、以 2D foundation model 生成的伪深度为监督，微调 LiDAR 条件深度模型，训练时随机按不同 beam 预算稀释输入，从而从极稀疏扫描恢复稠密角采样。在 nuScenes 上按物理留出的真实光束评测，4-beam 输入下 δ1.25 达 66.8%，而散点插值只有 45.1%；类别分层显示平面先恢复、含深度断点的物体最先退化。
Motivation: 高线数 LiDAR 成本高，而许多感知管线需要稠密角采样；需要量化从重度 decimated 输入能恢复多少扫描、以及恢复精度随 beam 预算如何变化。
Method: 以预训练 Stable Diffusion 为骨干，用 2D foundation model 给出的伪深度目标微调 LiDAR 条件深度模型；训练时将 LiDAR 条件随机 decimate 到不同 beam 预算，评测时在 nuScenes 上对物理留出的真实光束检验，并把恢复 (recovery) 与拟合精度 (fit accuracy) 分开报告。
Result: nuScenes 上 4-beam 输入 δ1.25 为 66.8%，散点插值 (scattered interpolation) 仅 45.1%，优势在极稀疏 regime 最大；类别分层误差显示平面表面先恢复，引入深度断点的物体最早退化。
Conclusion: foundation-model 引导的 LiDAR 增强在极稀疏 beam 预算下收益最大，且恢复难度由场景几何（深度断点）决定，量化了 recovery/resolution 的权衡。

papers.title: Classifications in modular restricted Boltzmann machines
papers.abstract_en: We consider a modular associative neural network made of $L$ Hopfield models (HMs), coupled so that intra-module interactions are Hebbian and inter-module interactions are anti-Hebbian; this competitive coupling is known to endow the network with pattern-disentanglement capabilities. The integral representation of this system coincides with an assembly of $L$ restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) whose hidden layers are coupled, thereby extending the HM-RBM duality to the modular setting. We then train this modular RBM, via one-step contrastive divergence, to perform a classification task in which a query encoded on the visible layers is mapped onto an $L$-tuple of labels read off the hidden layers. When the query is composed of $L$ patterns that are mutually orthogonal on average, we prove that the RBM weights obtained as empirical means over the training dataset, as suggested by the HM-RBM equivalence, constitute a fixed point of the learning dynamics, and we derive an explicit, non-asymptotic bound on the residual drift. We then turn to a harder classification task in which each module is queried with a mixture of $L$ patterns and we show numerically that the same setting for the RBM weights still provides an effective set-up, letting the network jointly classify and disentangle the mixture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把含 L 个 Hopfield 模型、模块内 Hebbian 与模块间 anti-Hebbian 耦合的联想网络对偶成隐藏层相互耦合的模块化 RBM，并用一步 contrastive divergence 训练做分类：可见层查询映射为隐藏层的 L 元标签。当查询由 L 个两两平均正交的模式组成时，作者证明按 HM-RBM 等价性取训练集经验均值作为权重是学习动力学的不动点，并给出残余漂移的显式非渐近上界；在每个模块被 L 个模式混合查询的更难任务上，数值上同一权重设定仍能同时完成分类与混合解缠。
Motivation: 模块化联想网络的 pattern-disentanglement 能力此前停留在 HM 表述，缺少可训练的生成式对应物与分类任务下权重选取的理论保证。
Method: 将 L 个 Hopfield 模型的积分表示化为隐藏层耦合的 L 个 restricted Boltzmann machines (RBM)，扩展 HM-RBM 对偶到模块化设定；用一步 contrastive divergence 训练，把可见层查询映射为隐藏层 L 元标签，权重取训练数据集上的经验均值。
Result: 对两两平均正交的 L 模式查询，证明经验均值权重是学习动力学的固定点，并导出残余漂移的显式非渐近界；在每模块查询 L 模式混合的更难任务上，数值结果显示同一权重设定仍有效，网络可联合分类并解缠混合。
Conclusion: HM-RBM 对偶给出的权重选取在模块化分类中既是理论不动点又在更难的混合查询下数值有效，可同时实现分类与 pattern 解缠。

papers.title: A Swarm-Coordinated Multi-Robot System for Early Stress Detection in Agricultural Rows Using Multimodal Leaf Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Early stress detection in crops is a necessity today to improve efficiency and reduce waste of time, money, and effort. However, most modern techniques, such as hyperspectral imaging and AI-based systems, are too costly and complex for medium and small-scale farmers to implement. This paper showcases CropSentry, a low-cost, ground-based multi-robot system that uses multimodal leaf sensing to continuously monitor crop health by tracking stress levels. The system comprises two autonomous bots that continuously detect leaf color and environmental data row by row. The observations are spatially mapped and sent over to the master bot, which uses color-coded row segments to generate a real-time web-based dashboard displaying crop health. After 63 observations were collected during the experiments, the results showed an overall crop health classification accuracy of 84.12%, with 82.60% for healthy plants, 88% for nutrient-deficient plants, and 80% for diseased plants. Also, 100% wireless communication success rate across 10 slave observations was achieved. Close-range leaf inspection across multiple bots can detect early stress in crops while remaining affordable, accessible, and scalable. It provides farmers with timely information to improve resource utilization and crop management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CropSentry 用两台低成本地面机器人逐行采集叶片颜色与环境数据，空间映射后回传主机器人生成实时网页仪表盘，把作物早期胁迫检测做成中小农户可负担的系统。63 次观测实验中总体作物健康分类准确率 84.12%（健康 82.60%、缺养分 88%、病害 80%），10 次从机观测的无线通信成功率 100%。
Motivation: 高光谱成像与 AI 系统成本高、实现复杂，中小规模农户难以部署，作物早期胁迫因此得不到及时发现。
Method: 两台自主 bot 逐行检测叶片颜色与环境数据，观测做空间映射后无线回传 master bot，用颜色编码的行段在实时网页仪表盘上呈现作物健康；实验共采集 63 次观测。
Result: 63 次观测下总体作物健康分类准确率 84.12%，其中健康植株 82.60%、缺养分植株 88%、病害植株 80%；10 次 slave 观测的无线通信成功率 100%。
Conclusion: 多机器人近距叶片检测能在保持可负担、可访问与可扩展的同时发现作物早期胁迫，为农户提供及时的资源利用与作物管理信息。

papers.title: When does conformal calibration need censoring weights? Cause-of-failure prediction sets under competing risks
papers.abstract_en: Split conformal prediction sets for competing-risks labels at a fixed horizon require calibration labels that right censoring can leave unobserved. Complete-case calibration guarantees coverage for the label-complete subpopulation, but its population coverage can deviate in either direction, even at the true class probabilities. We study how selection changes the score distribution near the population quantile. At the true score in our main simulation family, with independent draws, complete-case calibration covers 0.8723 at a nominal 0.900 when 22% of subjects are event-free at the horizon. In 4 of 48 further designs using per-draw normalisation, estimating cause incidences as one minus the exponential of the negative of the cause-specific Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazards, with the event-free probability as the clipped and renormalised remainder, puts complete-case coverage at least four standard errors below nominal. In these designs, weights from a correctly specified censoring model keep coverage near nominal. Extending the argument of Yi et al. (2025) to a cause label, we establish a finite-sample coverage lower bound with an explicit penalty for censoring-model error. Misspecifying the censoring model can also lead to under-coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 竞争风险下 split conformal 的校准标签会被右删失截断，complete-case 校准即使在真实类别概率处也会偏离名义覆盖：主模拟族中名义 0.900 时实际只覆盖 0.8723（22% 受试者在预测时点仍无事件）。48 个设计中有 4 个用 Nelson-Aalen 累积风险估计病因发生率并做逐次归一化时，complete-case 覆盖低于名义至少四个标准误；此时正确设定的删失模型权重把覆盖拉回名义附近。
Motivation: 固定时点竞争风险标签的 conformal 校准需要完整标签，而右删失使部分校准标签不可观测；complete-case 校准只保证标签完整子总体的覆盖，其总体覆盖可向任一方向偏离，即便类别概率已知。
Method: 研究选择效应如何改变分位数附近的分数分布；在主模拟族与 48 个进一步设计中比较 complete-case 与删失加权校准，病因发生率用 1−exp(−Nelson-Aalen 病因别累积风险) 估计、无事件概率作为裁剪后重归一化的余项；并把 Yi et al. (2025) 的论证推广到病因标签，给出带删失模型误差显式惩罚项的有限样本覆盖下界。
Result: 主模拟族在真实分数、独立抽样下，22% 受试者时点无事件时 complete-case 覆盖 0.8723（名义 0.900）；48 个逐次归一化设计中 4 个的 complete-case 覆盖低于名义至少四个标准误，而正确设定删失模型的权重使覆盖接近名义；删失模型误设也可导致 under-coverage。
Conclusion: 删失加权只有在删失模型正确设定时才把覆盖拉回名义，误设会转为欠覆盖；有限样本覆盖下界给出删失模型误差的显式惩罚，据此判断何时 conformal 校准必须加删失权重。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: One for All, All for One: Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering via Stochastic Optimal Control
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models often produce structured outputs composed of interacting components. Modelling these outputs with a single model requires learning both the component distributions and their interactions. We pursue a modular alternative: reuse independently trained component generators and learn only how to coordinate them to produce coherent structured outputs. Our framework, Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering (CMDS), treats frozen pretrained diffusion models as reusable generative primitives and coordinates their reverse processes through a learned control. We formulate coordination as a stochastic optimal control problem, balancing an assembly-level reward that specifies the desired properties of the combined output against deviations from the pretrained dynamics. The learned control amortises this optimisation, allowing reuse across new task instances. Experiments show that CMDS can recover a known target distribution, satisfy different spatial constraints with the same trained control, and recover individual sources from degraded mixtures. Across multi-agent maze navigation, articulated robot planning, and text-conditioned human motion, CMDS turns frozen models into coordinated multi-agent generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CMDS 把多个各自训练好的冻结扩散模型当作可复用生成原语，用一个学习出来的控制量协调它们的反向过程，把协调写成随机最优控制：在装配层奖励与偏离预训练动力学之间做权衡，该控制可摊销优化并跨新任务实例复用。在多智能体迷宫导航、铰接机器人规划和文本条件人体动作三个任务上，CMDS 能恢复已知目标分布、用同一控制满足不同空间约束，并从退化混合中恢复各个源。
Motivation: 深度生成模型要同时学各组成部分的分布及其交互，单模型建模代价高；希望复用各自独立训练的组件生成器，只学如何把它们协调成一致的结构化输出。
Method: Coordinated Multi-Agent Diffusion Steering (CMDS)：把冻结的预训练扩散模型作为生成原语，学习一个控制量协调其反向过程；协调被表述为随机最优控制问题，目标是装配层奖励（指定组合输出的期望性质）与偏离预训练动力学的惩罚之间的平衡，学习到的控制摊销该优化以跨新任务实例复用。
Result: 实验显示 CMDS 能恢复一个已知目标分布，用同一个训练好的控制满足不同的空间约束，并从退化混合 (degraded mixtures) 中恢复各个独立源；评估场景为多智能体迷宫导航、铰接机器人规划与文本条件人体动作。
Conclusion: 冻结的独立扩散模型可以通过一个摊销的随机最优控制式控制被组织成协调的多智能体生成器，无需重新训练各组件。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Multi-Label Perceptual Bug Detection in Video Games using Deep Learning on Gameplay Footage
papers.abstract_en: Traditional approaches for automated bug detection in video games, such as manual testing, can be beneficial for the improvement of quality assurance, but they can be expensive and time-consuming. The scarce number of tools available to detect multiple perceptual bugs in the same video frame introduces detection challenges for automated bug detection tools in real-world scenarios. We propose a deep learning model for multi-label perceptual bug detection and compare it against video classification models such as Inflated 3D ConvNet and 3D ResNet. Our proposed model, ResNet-BiLSTM, achieved an F1 score of 85.78% on the benchmark dataset. Our results demonstrated that temporal dependency modelling is beneficial for accurate video-based bug detection. We believe this work with multi-label perceptual bug detection on gameplay videos will help save resources spent on manual testing workloads in video games. Furthermore, we introduce a new dataset with multi-label perceptual bugs in this work. The dataset contains 77,969 video clips across different genres of games with approximately 1.2 million frames, containing combinations from 5 classes of bugs in the same video frame.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ResNet-BiLSTM 做游戏画面多标签感知型 bug 检测，用时序依赖建模在同一帧上同时识别多类 bug，在基准数据集上 F1 达 85.78%，优于 Inflated 3D ConvNet 与 3D ResNet 等视频分类模型。作者同时发布含 77,969 段视频、约 120 万帧、5 类 bug 可同帧组合的新数据集。
Motivation: 游戏 QA 依赖人工测试，昂贵且耗时；现有工具难以在同一视频帧上同时检出多个感知型 bug，真实场景下自动化检测受限。
Method: 提出 ResNet-BiLSTM 深度模型做多标签视频分类，以时序依赖建模捕捉帧间信息，并与 Inflated 3D ConvNet、3D ResNet 对比；配套构建多标签感知型 bug 数据集，覆盖不同游戏类型。
Result: ResNet-BiLSTM 在基准数据集上 F1 为 85.78%；新数据集含 77,969 段视频、约 120 万帧，5 类 bug 可在同一帧中组合出现。
Conclusion: 时序依赖建模对基于视频的游戏 bug 检测有利，多标签感知型检测可望减少人工测试工作量。

papers.title: CNet: A Complex-Valued Deep Learning Framework with Wirtinger Autodifferentiation and FFT--Hadamard Convolution
papers.abstract_en: CNet is a C++/CUDA framework for building and training deep complex-valued neural networks (CVNNs) and, more generally, for optimizing complex-valued functions by gradient descent with Wirtinger (CR-calculus) derivatives. It takes a physics-native stance: a network is a cascade of complex -- and often unitary (the DFT) -- operations acting on an amplitude vector, and classification is a Born-rule measurement $p_k = |z_k|^2 / \|z\|^2$ rather than a softmax over real logits. Every layer ships a CPU reference and a CUDA kernel checked against finite differences, and the computation graph is cloned across the batch for GPU execution. On top of the base layers we add signal-processing primitives that turn the identity conv(x,k) = IFFT(FFT(x) . FFT(k)) into a learnable complex convolutional network, together with a true-Adam optimizer and a reduced-memory inference mode. We report three studies. First, a fully complex-valued, FNet-style causal sequence model built on a new $O(N \log N)$ causal Fourier mixer -- a triangular-masked DFT evaluated by a Bluestein / chirp-z factorization: once properly tuned it matches or exceeds a parameter-matched real-valued causal FNet on character-level language modeling, reaching the real model's converged quality in under half the training steps. Second and third, bottleneck analyses on radio-modulation classification (RML2016.10a) and the Fourier phase problem of coherent-diffraction imaging, which isolate exactly where complex-valued networks still need new operators. Across all three the complex formulation provably learns the physically correct structure. Code: https://github.com/crasmarum/CNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CNet 是一个 C++/CUDA 复值神经网络 (CVNN) 框架，用 Wirtinger (CR-calculus) 导数做复值函数的梯度下降，把网络视为作用在幅度向量上的级联复（常为酉/DFT）运算，分类用 Born 规则 p_k=|z_k|^2/‖z‖^2 取代实 logits 上的 softmax。基于它构建的 O(N log N) 因果 Fourier mixer（Bluestein/chirp-z 分解的三角掩码 DFT）在字符级语言建模上以不到一半的训练步数达到参数量匹配的实值因果 FNet 的收敛质量。
Motivation: 复值网络缺少一个从底层算子到优化器都按复数语义实现、且每层可用有限差分校验的训练框架；同时复值网络在哪些任务上仍缺合适算子并不清楚。
Method: 框架提供带 CPU 参考实现与 CUDA kernel（以有限差分校验）的各层、跨 batch 克隆的计算图、把 conv(x,k)=IFFT(FFT(x)·FFT(k)) 变成可学习复卷积的信号处理原语、true-Adam 优化器与低显存推理模式；三项研究分别用全复值 FNet 风格因果序列模型、以及两个瓶颈分析展开。
Result: 因果 Fourier mixer 在字符级语言建模上匹配或超过参数量匹配的实值因果 FNet，并在不到一半的训练步数内达到其实值模型的收敛质量；另两项为 RML2016.10a 调制分类与相干衍射成像 Fourier 相位问题的瓶颈分析，定位复值网络尚缺的算子。
Conclusion: 作者主张复值表述能学到物理上正确的结构（三项研究中可证明），并指出复值网络在调制分类与相位恢复上仍需新算子。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: MINDSET: Energy-based Schema Evolution for Long Conversational Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long conversational agents have become essential in our daily lives. They must remember what was said long back in order to help us efficiently complete a task without needing the user to repeat instructions and context repeatedly. However, the main issue is that instructions and context change over time and so the agents must be able to adapt accordingly. A useful memory system should preserve both current and historical states, distinguish stale information from active knowledge, retrieve evidence appropriate to the query and avoid repeatedly invoking a large language model to rewrite prior interactions. We introduce MINDSET, a memory controller that stores a conversation as immutable episodes and organizes them into versioned schemas through minimum-energy state transitions. Each incoming episode may reinforce, supersede, split or create a schema. The transition decision balances representation distortion, contradiction, historical damage, fragmentation and internal inconsistency, while hysteresis prevents isolated contradictions from prematurely rewriting stable memory. We evaluate MINDSET against 5 memory systems on a reproducible sample of 850 questions (700 LoCoMo + 150 MemoryAgentBench). MINDSET obtains the highest observed LoCoMo answer F1 while significantly improving retrieval ranking (Recall@8, MRR and nDCG@8) over the second best method LightMem (p<0.01 after Holm correction). It obtains the highest observed scores on MemoryAgentBench although the relative difference is low. Ablations identify controlled fragmentation and schema-aware assignment as the largest contributors to answer quality. Additionally, a 700-question cross-model evaluation with GLM-4.7 and Gemma-4-31B supported model independence. These results show that long-term memory can be better handled as constrained state management rather than continual summarization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MINDSET 把长对话记忆当作受约束的状态管理问题：对话存为不可变 episode，经最小能量状态转移组织成带版本的 schema，转移在表示失真、矛盾、历史损伤、碎片化与内部不一致之间权衡，并用滞回 (hysteresis) 阻止单点矛盾改写稳定记忆。在 850 题（700 LoCoMo + 150 MemoryAgentBench）上对 5 个记忆系统评测，其 LoCoMo answer F1 最高，检索排序 Recall@8、MRR、nDCG@8 相对次优 LightMem 显著提升（Holm 校正后 p<0.01）。
Motivation: 长对话 agent 的指令与上下文随时间变化，记忆系统既要保留当前与历史状态、区分过期与有效知识，又要避免反复调用 LLM 重写既有交互；持续摘要式记忆难以处理 schema 的演化。
Method: MINDSET 作为记忆控制器，把对话存为不可变 episode，用最小能量状态转移把 episode 归入带版本的 schema，每次新 episode 可强化、取代、分裂或新建 schema；转移决策在表示失真、矛盾、历史损伤、碎片化与内部不一致之间平衡，滞回机制防止孤立矛盾过早改写稳定记忆。
Result: 在 850 题可复现样本（700 LoCoMo + 150 MemoryAgentBench）上对 5 个记忆系统评测：LoCoMo answer F1 取得最高观测值，Recall@8、MRR、nDCG@8 相对次优 LightMem 显著提升（Holm 校正后 p<0.01）；MemoryAgentBench 得分最高但相对差距较小。消融显示受控碎片化 (controlled fragmentation) 与 schema 感知分配是答案质量的最大贡献项；另有 700 题跨模型评测（GLM-4.7、Gemma-4-31B）支持模型无关性。
Conclusion: 长期记忆更适合按受约束的状态管理而非持续摘要来处理，其中受控碎片化与 schema 感知分配是答案质量的关键。

papers.title: Random Feature Gaussian Process Attention: Linear-Time Probabilistic Attention with Calibrated Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Transformers provide a state-of-the-art modeling framework, yet poor calibration limits their reliability in safety-critical applications. A promising direction addresses this issue by interpreting attention as a Gaussian process (GP) posterior, which enables principled uncertainty calibration but incurs cubic complexity in sequence length due to the inversion of the kernel; although decoupled GP variants reduced the cost to quadratic, the computation remains prohibitive in practice. In this paper, we propose the plug-and-play random Fourier feature Gaussian process attention (RFF-GPA) module, which represents the attention as a GP with a stationary kernel approximated by random Fourier features. This low-rank approximation results in linear-time complexity for approximating the posterior mean and variance, making it far more scalable compared to previous work. Empirical results on multiple real-world datasets show that our attention module improves calibration while maintaining predictive accuracy, and simultaneously reduces computational complexity to linear in the sequence length.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RFF-GPA 把注意力解释为平稳核高斯过程后验，用随机傅里叶特征 (random Fourier features) 做低秩近似，使后验均值与方差的计算从核求逆的三次复杂度降到序列长度线性。在多个真实数据集上，该即插即用注意力模块在保持预测精度的同时改善校准 (calibration)，并把计算复杂度降为线性。
Motivation: Transformer 校准差限制其在安全关键场景的可靠性；把注意力视作 GP 后验虽能做原则性不确定性校准，但核求逆带来序列长度三次复杂度，解耦 GP 变体也仅降到二次，实际不可行。
Method: 提出即插即用 (plug-and-play) 的随机傅里叶特征高斯过程注意力 (RFF-GPA) 模块：用平稳核的随机傅里叶特征近似，把注意力表示为 GP，以低秩近似计算后验均值与方差，避免核矩阵求逆。
Result: 在多个真实数据集上的实证结果显示，该注意力模块改善校准同时保持预测精度，并把计算复杂度降为序列长度的线性；相对先前 GP 注意力的三次与二次复杂度实现可扩展性提升。
Conclusion: 用随机傅里叶特征低秩近似 GP 注意力，可以在不牺牲预测精度的前提下同时获得更好的校准与线性时间复杂度，使概率化注意力变得可扩展。

papers.title: How Learning Governs Unlearning across the Memorization-Generalization Spectrum
papers.abstract_en: While unlearning seeks to negate undesired capabilities acquired through learning, little research has examined how the way models learn shapes their subsequent unlearning. In this paper, we investigate this connection from the perspectives of memorization and generalization, the two most representative yet competing strategies that models employ during training. We first classify memorization- and generalization-heavy models using grokking in modular addition and compare their responses to unlearning, showing that the latter suffer greater retain damage, i.e., a larger performance drop on the retain set. Furthermore, we conduct a finer-grained analysis by introducing bucketed modular addition, in which the respective contributions of the two strategies can be explicitly controlled across the memorization-generalization spectrum. In this setup, we reaffirm that the same trend persists and is nearly monotonic. We further demonstrate that this relationship also holds in LLM unlearning across verbatim and factual recall settings. Finally, we provide two practical insights for developing better unlearning methods, highlighting the importance of accounting for learning dynamics in unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文考察模型的学习方式如何决定其遗忘 (unlearning) 表现：以 grokking 模块加法构造记忆型与泛化型模型，泛化越重的模型在遗忘后 retain set 性能下降越大，且该趋势在可控的记忆-泛化谱上近乎单调，并在 LLM 的逐字与事实回忆遗忘设定中同样成立。
Motivation: 遗忘研究多关注如何抹除目标能力，却几乎不考察模型当初以记忆还是泛化的方式学会该能力，而这直接关系到遗忘时保留集受损的程度。
Method: 先用 grokking 模块加法 (modular addition) 分类出记忆型与泛化型模型并比较其遗忘响应；再提出 bucketed modular addition，在记忆-泛化谱上显式控制两种策略的贡献；最后把结论推广到 LLM 的 verbatim 与 factual recall 遗忘设定。
Result: 泛化型模型遗忘后 retain damage 更大，即 retain set 性能下降更明显；在 bucketed modular addition 的谱上该趋势近乎单调；同一关系在 LLM 的逐字回忆与事实回忆遗忘设定中也成立。
Conclusion: 学习动态（记忆与泛化的配比）决定了遗忘的副作用，设计更好的遗忘方法必须把学习过程纳入考量。

papers.title: FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 ISIC 2018 训练/验证集上模拟分布式环境做皮肤病变图像的联邦分割 (federated learning)，得到的模型在 ISIC 2018 测试集与 PH2 数据集上表现与集中式训练相当，并稳定优于各本地单独训练的模型，从而无需集中汇总医学图像。
Motivation: 医学图像分割依赖把图像与掩码集中到服务器，带来隐私风险并占用大量中心算力，限制了多机构协作训练。
Method: 用 ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge 的训练集与验证集模拟分布式学习环境，训练联邦分割模型，再在 ISIC 2018 测试集和外部 PH2 数据集上评测泛化性，与集中式训练及本地训练对照。
Result: 联邦模型性能与集中式训练相当，并一致优于本地训练模型；评测覆盖 ISIC 2018 测试集与 PH2 数据集两个数据源。
Conclusion: 皮肤病变分割可以在不集中汇总医学图像的前提下通过联邦学习协作完成，且不牺牲分割性能。
