papers.title: Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sparse2comm 把协同 3D 目标检测中的不可靠通信当作对退化特征的渐进式恢复：先用随机 mask 采样的前景稀疏特征传输并由自车重建稠密语义，再依次做延迟对齐与自监督空间校准。对比 Where2comm，在 DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V、V2V4Real 三个数据集的混合退化设定下 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 分别提升 +20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07、+15.36/+12.61。
Motivation: 车载协同感知受带宽受限与丢包、传输延迟、空间错位等不可靠因素共同制约，现有方法多只降通信开销或补偿单一退化，耦合扰动处理不足。
Method: Sparse Feature Encoding 将通信表示为随机 mask 采样的前景特征，自车由稀疏观测重建稠密语义（同时覆盖超低带宽与丢包恢复）；其上叠加 Latency-Aware Alignment 预测 motion flow 补偿延迟消息、Self-Calibrating Fusion 自监督估计残余空间偏移，再做跨车自适应融合，形成语义-时间-空间的有序恢复流水线。
Result: 在 DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V、V2V4Real 上，相对 Where2comm 的混合退化设定 AP@0.5/AP@0.7 分别提升 +20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07、+15.36/+12.61；干净精度保持有竞争力，并在单一与混合真实退化下一致提升鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 把不可靠协同按语义完整性、时间一致性、空间对齐的顺序逐级恢复，可在超低带宽下同时保住干净精度并显著提升对耦合退化的鲁棒性。

papers.title: RAG-PIBench: A Leakage-Aware Benchmark for Prompt-Injection Detection in Trustworthy RAG Systems
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to prompt-injection attacks embedded in retrieved content. We introduce RAG-PIBench, a benchmark for RAG-style prompt-injection detection containing 4,876 contextual examples across frozen train, validation, and protected-test splits. Using a leakage-aware construction pipeline and strict evaluation protocol, we compare keyword-based, semantic-reference, TF-IDF, and transformer-based detectors. DistilBERT achieves the best protected-test performance (F1 = 0.896, PR-AUC = 0.968), while TF-IDF SVM and logistic regression remain competitive. Our results demonstrate the value of leakage-aware benchmark design and strong sparse baselines for reliable prompt-injection detection in RAG systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAG-PIBench 是一个防泄漏的 RAG 提示注入检测基准，含 4,876 条上下文样本与冻结的 train/validation/protected-test 划分，用严格评测协议对比关键词、语义参考、TF-IDF 与 transformer 检测器。DistilBERT 在 protected-test 上最好（F1 = 0.896，PR-AUC = 0.968），TF-IDF SVM 与逻辑回归仍具竞争力。
Motivation: RAG 系统会把检索到的内容当作可信输入，嵌入其中的提示注入可绕过检测；已有评测若数据泄漏会高估检测器性能，需要一个泄漏感知的基准来可靠比较检测方法。
Method: 构建 leakage-aware 的数据管线，生成 4,876 条上下文样本并冻结 train、validation、protected-test 三个划分，配合严格评测协议；对比 keyword-based、semantic-reference、TF-IDF 以及 transformer 类检测器（含 DistilBERT、TF-IDF SVM、逻辑回归）。
Result: 在 protected-test 上 DistilBERT 取得最佳表现，F1 = 0.896、PR-AUC = 0.968；TF-IDF SVM 与逻辑回归作为稀疏基线仍保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 泄漏感知的基准设计加上强稀疏基线，是可靠评估 RAG 提示注入检测的关键；DistilBERT 与简单稀疏方法都能达到可用水平。

papers.title: Less Is More: A Leakage-Controlled Study of Dermoscopic Preprocessing for Joint Skin Lesion Classification and Segmentation with YOLO26
papers.abstract_en: Handcrafted preprocessing is widely employed in automated dermoscopic analysis to suppress imaging artifacts and enhance lesion visibility. Nevertheless, its actual contribution to modern real-time models remains unclear, particularly when evaluation protocols do not adequately control correlations among images of the same lesion. This study presents a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint evaluation of dermoscopic preprocessing and augmentation for joint multi-class lesion classification and instance segmentation using a fixed nano-scale YOLO26 segmentation model (YOLO26n-seg). From HAM10000 (10,015 images), quality control yields 10,013 valid image-mask pairs from 7,468 unique lesions, partitioned into mutually exclusive sets by lesion identity. With the architecture, resolution, training budget, and evaluation protocol held fixed, we compare minimally processed images plus online augmentation against offline class balancing, DullRazor-CLAHE preprocessing, and raw-processed hybrid views, over three random seeds. On the lesion-disjoint test set, the raw baseline achieves a mask mAP$_{50:95}$ of $0.5636 \pm 0.0234$, a Dice score of $0.9356 \pm 0.0024$, and a macro-F1 score of $0.6917 \pm 0.0202$. Offline augmentation does not improve the mean performance, while the combined and hybrid strategies reduce both class-aware segmentation and classification accuracy. At only 2.69 million parameters, the model runs at approximately 50 frames per second. Under a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint protocol with all non-input factors held fixed, minimally processed dermoscopic images combined with standard online augmentation deliver a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than increasingly complex deterministic preprocessing, which yields no consistent joint benefit across three seeds on HAM10000.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 HAM10000 上以固定 YOLO26n-seg 做皮肤病变分类与分割的泄漏控制（按病灶身份切分）对比显示：最小化预处理加在线增强优于复杂离线预处理。原始基线在 lesion-disjoint 测试集上 mask mAP50:95 为 0.5636±0.0234、Dice 0.9356±0.0024、macro-F1 0.6917±0.0202；离线类别平衡不提升均值，DullRazor-CLAHE 与混合策略反而同时降低分割与分类精度。
Motivation: 手工预处理被广泛用于去伪影、增强病灶可见性，但当评估协议未控制同一病灶多张图像间的相关性时，其对现代实时模型的真实贡献无法判定。
Method: 固定 nano 级 YOLO26n-seg（269 万参数）、分辨率、训练预算与评估协议，仅改变输入处理：最小处理+在线增强 vs 离线类别平衡 vs DullRazor-CLAHE 预处理 vs 原始-处理混合视图，跑三个随机种子；HAM10000 经质控得 10,013 个有效 image-mask 对、7,468 个唯一病灶，按病灶身份互斥切分。
Result: lesion-disjoint 测试集上原始基线 mask mAP50:95 0.5636±0.0234、Dice 0.9356±0.0024、macro-F1 0.6917±0.0202；离线增强不提升均值，组合与混合策略同时降低类别感知分割与分类精度；模型 2.69M 参数、约 50 FPS。
Conclusion: 在泄漏受控、非输入因素全部固定的协议下，最小化预处理加标准在线增强在 HAM10000 三个种子上给出更好的精度-效率权衡，复杂确定性预处理没有一致的联合收益。

papers.title: Singular Value Decomposition: A Geometric Rediscovery, Where Proofs Become Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: This article is a geometric rediscovery of the singular value decomposition, with a further claim: the construction it builds is the machinery behind much of machine learning. The same argument that answers an idle question about ellipses is the algorithm behind principal component analysis, kernel methods, and PageRank, and it is not only the results that transfer but the proofs themselves, run as procedures. The usual introduction states $A = UΣV^T$ and justifies it via the spectral theorem applied to $A^T A$. This is correct but unilluminating, since it assumes a powerful theorem to reach a result that is, in the end, about ellipses. Part I reverses the order. A linear map sends the unit circle to an ellipse; one asks which input directions map to its axes, and finds, example after example, that they are perpendicular. In the plane this can be watched: rotate a frame, track how far its images are from perpendicular, and a sign change forces a frame where they are exactly perpendicular, which is also where the map stretches hardest. Maximizing the stretch and recursing generalizes this to n dimensions, with singular values falling out in order, and the construction proves the spectral theorem rather than assuming it. Part II puts each construction to work: maximize-and-recurse becomes the power method and PageRank; the lemma locating the maximizer becomes the stopping rule of gradient descent; the duality between $A^T A$ and $A A^T$ becomes the transport at the heart of kernel PCA. Each connection is stated with its boundary, saying what the decomposition supplies and where another idea takes over. Prerequisites are the standard sophomore sequence, and the worked examples are small enough to check by hand.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 标准教科书用谱定理作用于 A^T A 来证 SVD，等于借一个强定理去得到一个本质上关于椭圆的结论，掩盖了构造本身；作者要倒转顺序，让证明直接变成可执行的算法。
Method: Part I：线性映射把单位圆送到椭圆，平面中旋转坐标并追踪像的非垂直度，符号变化逼出恰垂直且拉伸最大的帧，最大化加递归推广到 n 维，构造过程本身证明谱定理。Part II 把每个构造投入使用：maximize-and-recurse 变成 power method 与 PageRank，定位极大值的引理变成 gradient descent 的停止规则，A^T A 与 A A^T 的对偶变成 kernel PCA 的 transport；每条联系都注明边界，前置只要标准大二数学，例题小到可手算。

papers.title: Valid for Free: Homophily-Gated Conformal Prediction for Training-Free Node Classification with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) can classify the nodes of a graph without training on it, by reading node and neighborhood features as table rows next to labeled context rows. Work in this line reports predictive performance, not conformal coverage or prediction-set size. To our knowledge, we give the first reliability study of the setting, with TabICL as the TFM and half of each graph as labeled context. As for any predictor fixed before calibration, a frozen in-context predictor makes split conformal prediction exactly valid in finite samples, with no training, validation fold, or tuning on the target graph. An audit across ten graphs then shows that the training-free TabICL posterior has lower expected calibration error (ECE) than GCN with temperature scaling (GCN+TS) on nine of them. Its mean ECE over the ten graphs is 0.019, about 35 percent below the 0.029 of GCN+TS. We also introduce HG-DAPS, a training-free diffusion score whose homophily gate reads only the in-context labels, so the guarantee still holds. Relative to adaptive prediction sets (APS), it reduces mean set size by 5.8 to 17.1 percent on six homophilous graphs and changes it by under 1 percent on four heterophilous ones. On two binary, class-imbalanced graphs, a pre-registered trap case shows that gating on raw rather than adjusted homophily lowers coverage among low-homophily nodes by 0.27 and 0.12. Marginal coverage stays at the nominal 0.90 and masks this drop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用冻结的表格基础模型 TabICL 做图节点分类的 split conformal prediction，因预测器在校准前已固定，有限样本覆盖严格有效且无需在目标图上训练或调参。十个图上其 ECE 均值 0.019，比 GCN+温度缩放的 0.029 低约 35%；提出的同质性门控扩散分数 HG-DAPS 相对 APS 在六个同质图上把预测集缩小 5.8%–17.1%，四个异质图上变化不足 1%。
Motivation: TFM 做免训练节点分类这条线只报预测性能，不报 conformal 覆盖率与预测集大小，可靠性无从判断。
Method: 以 TabICL 为冻结的 in-context 预测器，每张图一半节点作 labeled context，做 split conformal prediction；再提出 HG-DAPS，一个只读 in-context 标签的同质性门控扩散分数，使有效性保证保持。
Result: 十个图审计中，免训练 TabICL 后验有九个图 ECE 低于 GCN+TS；十图平均 ECE 0.019 对 0.029，低约 35%。HG-DAPS 相对 APS 在六个同质图上平均集大小降 5.8%–17.1%，四个异质图上变化不足 1%。两个二类不平衡图的预注册陷阱案例中，用原始而非调整后同质性做门控，使低同质性节点覆盖分别下降 0.27 与 0.12，而名义 0.90 的边际覆盖仍掩盖该下降。
Conclusion: 冻结 in-context 预测器可直接给出有限样本有效的 split conformal，且校准质量可优于训练过的 GCN；但门控必须用调整后同质性，否则边际覆盖会掩盖子群失效。

papers.title: Adaptive Power Sampling for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Sequence-level power sampling has recently emerged as a training-free approach to reasoning by sampling from a sharpened output distribution of a base large language model (LLM). Nevertheless, existing methods typically sharpen the base model distribution uniformly across queries, overlooking variations in query difficulty and in how well the base model already handles each query. The goal of this work is to equip power sampling with query adaptivity. Theoretically, we show that the benefits of further sharpening are determined by the self-reward gap between correct and incorrect responses. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Adaptive Power Sampling} (APS), which adjusts the sharpening exponent on a per-query basis at test time using the relationship between answer agreement and the model's self-reward. Experiments across diverse reasoning tasks, including MATH500, HumanEval, and GPQA, show that APS consistently outperforms power sampling with a fixed sharpening exponent, without additional training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APS 在测试时按查询自适应调整 power sampling 的锐化指数：理论表明锐化收益由正确与错误回答的 self-reward gap 决定，因此用答案一致性与模型 self-reward 的关系逐题定指数。在 MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA 上一致优于固定锐化指数的 power sampling，且无需额外训练。
Motivation: 现有 sequence-level power sampling 对所有查询统一锐化输出分布，忽略查询难度差异以及基模型对每题的既有处理能力，导致锐化幅度无法按题匹配。
Method: APS (Adaptive Power Sampling) 在测试时逐查询调整锐化指数，依据是答案一致性与模型 self-reward 之间的关系；其理论出发点是锐化收益由正确与错误回答的 self-reward gap 决定，全程不引入额外训练。
Result: 在 MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA 等多样推理任务上，APS 一致优于使用固定锐化指数的 power sampling，且无需额外训练。
Conclusion: 锐化幅度应当按查询自适应而非全局统一，self-reward gap 可作为判断该题是否值得进一步锐化的依据。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Reasoning Rewards: Minimax-Optimal Rates with Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard tool for post-training language models on reasoning tasks, where the policy is updated by reward feedback while exploring the space of responses. Despite its empirical success, theoretical understanding of RL post-training remains limited, in particular of why on-policy exploration combined with a neural reward model is effective. In this paper, we address this question by modeling the reward as a hierarchical function on the response space: the reward consists of infinitely many local components, each of which becomes relevant only after the preceding ones have been resolved. We show that a natural Transformer-based actor--critic algorithm, which alternates between sampling from the current KL-regularized policy, fitting a Transformer critic to the observed rewards, and updating the policy, achieves the minimax optimal rates in the query budget and in the regularization strength up to logarithmic factors, and is minimax optimal for a fixed number of prompts. In contrast, we prove that sampling from the fixed reference distribution, as in offline reward modeling, can limit regret decay to a logarithmic rate. These results show that on-policy exploration progressively zooms in on the region where the reward is concentrated, and quantify its benefit for RL post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把奖励建模为响应空间上的分层函数（局部成分逐层生效），证明基于 Transformer 的 on-policy actor-critic 在查询预算与正则强度上达到 minimax 最优速率（差对数因子），而固定参考分布采样（offline reward modeling）会把 regret 衰减限制在对数速率。结论是 on-policy 探索会逐步聚焦到奖励集中的区域。
Motivation: RL post-training 在经验上成功，但为何 on-policy 探索配合神经奖励模型有效缺少理论解释。
Method: 将奖励建模为分层函数：由无穷多个局部成分组成，每个成分只在前一层被解析后才起作用。给出 Transformer actor-critic 算法，交替从当前 KL 正则策略采样、用 Transformer 拟合 critic、更新策略；并对比从固定参考分布采样的 offline reward modeling。
Result: 该算法在查询预算与正则强度上达到 minimax 最优速率（至多差对数因子），且对固定数量 prompt 也是 minimax 最优；固定参考分布采样可使 regret 衰减仅限于对数速率。
Conclusion: on-policy 探索逐步放大奖励集中区域，从而量化其对 RL post-training 的收益；offline 式固定分布采样在 regret 上有本质劣势。

papers.title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结的 VideoLLM 内部已线性可读出「回答所需证据是否到齐」的 readiness 信号，无需另训触发器。该信号在 7 个模型上 AUROC 0.733–0.905、问题条件化（66.1% 对翻转）、答错时仍存（0.722），据此做 Readiness Gating 在匹配视频时长下最高提升 +9.75 pp。
Motivation: 流式视频问答需要判断证据是否到齐，现有系统把这一决策当作独立触发器另训；本文追问未修改的模型是否已自行计算该量。
Method: 用带时间戳的证据（而非模型输出）给冻结 VideoLLM 的激活打标签，训练线性 probe 读出 readiness；在字节一致的窗口上做问题条件化对照与 question-blind 控制，并与不确定性估计器、已发布 streaming trigger 及人类判断比较，再把读出转为 Readiness Gating 答题时机策略。
Result: 7 个模型在最严 not-ready 采样下 AUROC 0.733–0.905（此时拟合时钟接近随机）；probe 不见某 benchmark 家族素材仍可读出该家族；字节一致窗口上仅换问题即在 66.1% 对上翻转读出；答错样本中 AUROC 仍 0.722；readiness 在延迟匹配的答题选择上胜过不确定性估计器及其监督组合，且比置信度更贴近人类判断；已发布 trigger 与其基座模型激活近似正交、解码远差于 probe；Readiness Gating 在匹配视频时长下最高 +9.75 pp、开销可忽略，26 个配置中增益随任务可用 headroom 变化，干预移动 headroom 则增益随之移动。
Conclusion: 证据就绪度是冻结 VideoLLM 中已存在、问题条件化且独立于答对与否的线性信号，直接读出它做答题时机控制即可在不增算力下提升准确率，增益上限由任务 headroom 决定。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Latent space bias directions in LLMs capture confidence, not fairness
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering has gained popularity as a lightweight inference-time debiasing technique for large language models. However, prior work reports that steering vectors generalise poorly, with unintended effects on model performance and limited transfer to new datasets. Our work analyses what the debiasing direction used for activation steering actually encodes, in order to shed light on its inconsistent performance. We study the linear debiasing direction obtained by contrasting the activations of anti-biased and biased prompts, and evaluate it as a steering intervention across bias and general knowledge benchmarks. We find that this direction is dominated by model confidence, pointing from regions of high to low-probability tokens in activation space rather than encoding a meaningful representation of model bias. Steering along it does reduce measured bias, but this is a consequence of reducing model confidence: on QA benchmarks we find that this steering drives the model to abstain from answering, with a side effect of improving fairness metrics. Our experiments show that model confidence is the dominant separating factor between biased and anti-biased prompts in hidden space, indicating that isolating a linear representation of bias which is disentangled from model confidence is difficult and steering-based debiasing results should be interpreted with care. In short, steering appears to reduce bias, not by correcting the model's underlying preferences, but by making it less confident, even on tasks unrelated to bias.

Motivation: 先前工作报告 steering vector 泛化差、对模型性能有副作用、迁移到新数据集有限；本文追根到去偏方向本身到底编码了什么。
Method: 取反偏 (anti-biased) 与带偏 (biased) 提示的激活差得到线性去偏方向，作为 steering 干预在偏见基准与通用知识基准上评估，并分析该方向在隐空间中与模型置信度的关系。

papers.title: Systemization of Knowledge (SoK): Human-Centered AI Safety for Youth
papers.abstract_en: While HCI increasingly examines AI-safety for youth, the literature lacks a comprehensive view of what risks have been identified, how they are addressed, and whether proposed protections work in-practice. We systematically reviewed 100 empirical HCI studies involving children and youth interacting with or exposed to AI across schools, homes, care settings, and public services. Using the YAIR taxonomy for risks and the MIT Mitigation Taxonomy for countermeasures, we map which risks have been identified, whether each risk is addressed by countermeasure(s), and whether each countermeasure for that risk is implemented and even evaluated. The risk-countermeasure mapping shows that most risks are matched only with proposed/ideated countermeasures; few countermeasures have been implemented, and fewer still evaluated; and existing evaluations often measure technical performance rather than protection from harm. We identify where coverage is absent, where safeguards remain untested, and propose concrete directions for HCI research to strengthen youth AI-safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 100 项儿童与青少年接触 AI 的 HCI 实证研究做系统综述，用 YAIR 风险分类与 MIT Mitigation Taxonomy 建立风险—对策映射，发现多数风险只对应“提议/构想”层面的对策，真正实现的对策很少、被评估的更少，且现有评估多测技术性能而非实际防伤害效果。
Motivation: HCI 虽日益关注青少年 AI 安全，但缺少对已识别风险、应对方式及其实际有效性的全景视图，导致无法判断哪些保护措施真正落地。
Method: 系统综述 100 项涉及儿童青少年与 AI 互动的实证 HCI 研究，覆盖学校、家庭、照护与公共服务场景；以 YAIR taxonomy 标注风险、MIT Mitigation Taxonomy 标注对策，逐项映射风险是否被对策覆盖、对策是否实现及是否评估。
Result: 映射结果显示：多数风险仅匹配到 proposed/ideated 对策，实现者少、评估者更少；已有评估多衡量技术性能而非对伤害的防护；综述识别出覆盖空白与未测试的保障措施位置。
Conclusion: 青少年 AI 安全的瓶颈在于对策停留在构想、缺乏落地与以伤害防护为指标的评估，作者据此提出 HCI 研究的具体推进方向。

papers.title: DeltaTTT: Layerwise Optimization for Nonlinear Recurrent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Sequential test-time training adapts a memory network through successive updates, each computing an inner-loop gradient based on the network's previous state. Intuitively, this state dependence should allow each update to account for what the memory has already learned and better incorporate new information. However, we find that this expected advantage does not consistently materialize in nonlinear memories: a fixed-base parallel TTT baseline outperforms its serial counterpart. Our exploratory experiments point to a key underlying difficulty: nonlinear memories can be harder to optimize than linear ones within a single pass over the sequence. To alleviate this optimization difficulty, we introduce DeltaTTT, which replaces joint inner-loop optimization of a two-layer memory network with layerwise learning. Each layer is assigned a local prediction target and updated through a state-dependent delta rule. This formulation retains a nonlinear readout while enabling chunkwise parallel computation. Experiments on DeltaNet and LaCT backbones show improvements in language modeling and retrieval over their recurrent baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeltaTTT 把两层非线性循环记忆的联合内层优化拆成逐层优化，每层配一个局部预测目标并用状态依赖的 delta rule 更新，从而保留非线性 readout 又支持 chunkwise 并行。在 DeltaNet 与 LaCT 骨干上，该逐层方案在语言建模与检索任务上优于各自的循环基线。
Motivation: 序列式 test-time training 依赖前一状态算内层梯度，本应利用记忆已学到的信息，但在非线性记忆中这一优势并不稳定出现：固定基座的并行 TTT 反而胜过串行版本，根源是非线性记忆在单次序列扫描内更难优化。
Method: DeltaTTT 用逐层学习 (layerwise learning) 取代两层记忆网络的联合内层优化：每层被指派一个局部预测目标，通过状态依赖的 delta rule 更新；该形式保留非线性 readout，同时允许 chunkwise 并行计算。
Result: 探索性实验发现固定基座的并行 TTT 基线优于其串行对应版本；在 DeltaNet 与 LaCT 骨干上，DeltaTTT 在语言建模与检索上相对各自的循环基线均有提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 非线性记忆在 TTT 中的优化困难可以通过逐层局部目标加状态依赖 delta rule 缓解，且不必牺牲非线性 readout 或并行性。

papers.title: AnyBottle: A Recipe to Only Keep the Concepts You Really Need
papers.abstract_en: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make predictions inspectable and intervenable by routing them through human-interpretable concepts, but originally required concept annotations. Annotation-free variants remove this requirement, but typically use large concept vocabularies, static at both training and inference, producing bottlenecks larger than any task or prediction needs and harder to inspect. We propose AnyBottle, a single recipe for building compact, task-specific CBMs. AnyBottle assumes only a frozen backbone and an unsupervised concept pool, such as a sparse autoencoder. A black-box teacher trained on the same backbone then guides selection: each round adds the concept that best explains the bottleneck's current failures, with candidates restricted to regions of teacher/student disagreement. Trained with nested dropout over this selection order, the final bottleneck predicts accurately from any concept prefix, so inference spends fewer concepts on inputs it is confident about early and more on hard ones. Since no stage is modality-specific, a new domain and task requires swapping only the backbone and concept pool. Across six vision and two text datasets and two teacher paradigms, AnyBottle yields bottlenecks with fewer concepts and higher concept consistency than annotation-free baselines, while staying close to the black-box reference. Overall, AnyBottle shows that going annotation-free need not mean going large: a small, discovered vocabulary can be as expressive as a much larger, fixed one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnyBottle 用一条配方把概念瓶颈模型 (CBM) 压到任务真正需要的规模：冻结 backbone 加无监督概念池（如 sparse autoencoder），由同 backbone 的黑盒 teacher 逐轮挑选最能解释当前失败的概念，候选限定在师生分歧区域，再用按挑选顺序的 nested dropout 训练，使瓶颈从任意概念前缀都能预测。在六个视觉与两个文本数据集、两种 teacher 范式上，它比无标注基线用更少概念、概念一致性更高，同时贴近黑盒参考，说明无标注不必等于大词表。
Motivation: 无标注 CBM 变体依赖训练和推理都固定的大概念词表，瓶颈远超任务与预测所需，也更难检查。
Method: 只假设冻结 backbone 与无监督概念池（如 sparse autoencoder）；黑盒 teacher 在同一 backbone 上训练，逐轮加入最能解释瓶颈当前失败的概念，候选限制在 teacher/student 分歧区域；按该挑选顺序做 nested dropout，使最终瓶颈能从任意概念前缀预测，推理时对自信输入用更少概念、难例用更多；全流程无模态特定设计，换领域只需换 backbone 与概念池。
Result: 在六个视觉数据集与两个文本数据集、两种 teacher 范式上，AnyBottle 得到的概念瓶颈比无标注基线概念更少、概念一致性更高，同时保持接近黑盒参考的预测表现。
Conclusion: 无标注不必意味着大词表：一个规模小、被发现出来的概念词表可以和大得多的固定词表一样有表达力，且推理可按输入难度自适应分配概念数。

papers.title: How High Is 0.6? Floors, Ceilings, and Headroom in Interpretability Probing
papers.abstract_en: Probes are the workhorse of interpretability. If a model's hidden states predict a variable, the model is said to represent it. But a probe score has no fixed meaning. An $R^2$ of 0.6 may only reflect what the input already gives away, and the same score can mean different things on different data. We propose reading every probe score against two reference points: a floor, what a declared set of simple inputs already predicts, and a ceiling, what the full input can predict. The gap between them, the headroom, is the range in which a probe can show that a model computes something beyond the simple inputs. We prove that headroom vanishes in two ways: the target stops depending on a hidden variable the model must infer, or the input stops revealing it. We test this on transformers trained for in-context meta-analysis, which must infer the hidden heterogeneity between studies to weight them correctly, and where both reference points are known. Under distribution shift, probe scores fall and prediction error rises $12$--$15\times$, yet the model recovers a similar share of the headroom, indicating that the data lost information, not the representation. We then analyze the real models. The single-cell foundation model scGPT encodes biological variability only partially. We also revisit four influential LLM probing studies, which claim that models represent geography, the state of an Othello board, truth, and the demographics of their users. Against a floor computed from the input text alone, some of these claims hold, while others are largely explained by the text itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把探针 (probe) 分数对照两个参考点解读：floor（声明的简单输入已能预测多少）与 ceiling（完整输入能预测多少），二者之差 headroom 才是模型超出简单输入的计算空间。证明 headroom 在两种情形下消失：目标不再依赖模型必须推断的隐变量，或输入不再揭示该隐变量。在分布偏移下探针分数下降、预测误差上升 12–15 倍，但模型恢复的 headroom 份额相近，说明丢信息的是数据而非表示。
Motivation: 探针分数没有固定含义：同一个 R²=0.6 可能只反映输入本身已泄露的信息，且在不同数据上含义不同，导致“模型表示了某变量”的结论不可比。
Method: 为每个探针分数定义 floor（由声明的简单输入集预测）与 ceiling（由完整输入预测），以 headroom 区间判定探针是否证明模型做了超出简单输入的计算；先在为 in-context meta-analysis 训练的 transformer 上检验（两个参考点已知），再分析 scGPT 与四项 LLM 探针研究。
Result: 证明 headroom 消失的两种机制；在 in-context meta-analysis transformer 上，分布偏移使探针分数下降、预测误差上升 12–15 倍，而模型恢复的 headroom 份额相近；scGPT 对生物变异性的编码只是部分的；对照仅由输入文本算出的 floor，四项 LLM 探针结论（地理、Othello 棋盘状态、真实性、用户人口统计）中部分成立、部分主要可由文本本身解释。
Conclusion: 探针分数必须相对 floor 与 ceiling 解读：headroom 为零时不能声称模型表示了该变量，而分布偏移下分数下降本身不足以判定表示退化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Micro Neural Policies for Safe Real-Time Robotic Control
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the synthesis of Micro Neural Policies (MNP) to enable safe and robust real-time robotic control on computationally constrained embedded devices. We demonstrate that integrating Evolution Strategy (ES) and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification for policy search can drastically reduce neural network size without compromising safety and robustness. We conduct a large-scale training and evaluation of MNP on Cartpole and Quadrotor control tasks, varying control frequencies and network architectures. After validating these policies in simulation, we evaluate their deployability through zero-shot transfer to physical systems. Our experiments show that MNP can successfully achieve safe sim-to-real transfer without sacrificing control performance. We then show that the policies' memory footprint, ranging from 0.5 to 7.5 kB, allows deployment on microcontrollers, where they achieve real-time inference latency with under 25 ns of jitter while leaving the chip idle for over 97% of the time for additional workloads. This makes them a highly practical solution for severely resource-constrained robotic systems.

papers.title: Toward Alignment Scaling Laws: A Framework and First Preregistered Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Whether alignment gets easier or harder as models grow is often argued from isolated findings, as if alignment were one property. We treat it as a family of measurable scaling relations: for each risk category r, the alignment burden needed to hold a fixed safety target is modeled as B_r(N)=a_rN^alpha_r, with N a capability proxy; against a budget proportional to N, scaling helps if alpha_r<1, keeps pace if alpha_r~1, and accumulates alignment debt if alpha_r>1. We give three operationalizations of burden and distinguish observed, audited and true alignment. A toy model, in which corrections consume capability headroom, makes the consequences explicit. We prove that the largest exponent among corrected risks, not an average, sets the long-run regime; that above 1 any policy holding headroom above a floor must grow super-exponentially; that, for burdens that are positive mixtures of power laws, fits on small models underestimate large-scale exponents; and that an audit that uncovers hidden failures without false positives never underestimates true alignment. We propose a pre-registrable protocol and apply reduced versions of it twice. A preregistered reanalysis of public adversarial-training data for Pythia classifiers finds that the compute needed to bring attack success under 10% grows as N^0.60. A preregistered pilot on Qwen2.5 0.5B-72B finds exponents of -0.05 for truthfulness and 0.48 for stated dispositions (both scaling helps under its reduced rule, though local slopes approach 1 at the top; replicated on Qwen3 0.6B-14B), while sycophancy (0.89, or 0.83 with two seeds added at 72B) and a planted backdoor are undetermined: the backdoor is removed quickly when its trigger is known but survives blind safety training at four of five sizes. We release four browser games that play these laws (www.aisafety.fun). We make no claim about which regime holds for current frontier models.

papers.title: RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RSJEV 把遥感场景分类从自回归文本生成改写为候选条件下的多模态判别决策：OnePass Decider 一次性抽取多模态决策状态，直接在候选类别空间输出类别概率，跳过逐 token 解码。在 UC Merced、AID、NWPU-RESISC45 三个基准上优于 CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP 与 MLLM 代表方法，仅用 0.8B 参数模型即取得更优精度-效率权衡并显著降低推理开销。
Motivation: 视觉分类器受限于预定义标签空间，CLIP 类方法依赖静态图文对齐，而 MLLM 对候选类别明确的分类任务仍做逐 token 自回归生成，带来不必要的推理开销。
Method: 提出 one-pass 多模态决策框架 RSJEV：将视觉表征、任务指令与候选类别语义联合建模，OnePass Decider 抽取多模态决策状态并在候选类别空间内直接估计类别概率，保留视觉-语言交互但取消自回归解码。
Result: 在 UC Merced、AID、NWPU-RESISC45 三个遥感场景分类基准上，相比 CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP 与 MLLM 类方法取得更优分类性能；模型仅 0.8B 参数，推理成本显著降低，精度-效率权衡更佳。
Conclusion: 对候选类别明确的遥感场景分类，状态条件下的多模态判别决策可替代自回归生成，在保持视觉-语言交互的同时实现高效图像理解。

papers.title: From Shared Demand Patterns to Local Uncertainty: Probabilistic Load Forecasting by Mixing Compact Adaptations
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic load forecasting has been widely studied for power-system operation and planning, but customer- and transformer-level forecasting introduces a distinct scalability challenge. At these levels, load uncertainty is strongly affected by customer behavior, weather, and mixed load composition, making it difficult for a single shared model to capture heterogeneous patterns. Using separate probabilistic models can improve local accuracy, but becomes costly to train, store, update, and validate at scale. To address this challenge, we develop a scalable customer-aware forecasting framework that learns common demand behavior through a shared model while adapting only a compact subset of parameters. Rather than using an independent model for each load or assigning each load to a specialized model, the proposed design learns a small bank of low-dimensional adaptation components and allows each load to combine them according to its forecasting characteristics. This preserves shared knowledge across customers while providing sufficient flexibility for heterogeneous and mixed load compositions. Experiments on 590 load profiles from the SMART-DS dataset show consistent improvements in deterministic accuracy and probabilistic quality over statistical, neural-network, Transformer-based, and pretrained time-series baselines, while retaining low storage and inference costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向客户/变压器级概率负荷预测，提出共享模型 + 低维适配组件库的混合框架：每个负荷按自身预测特征组合少量适配分量，而非各自训练独立模型。在 SMART-DS 的 590 条负荷曲线上，确定性精度与概率质量相对统计、神经网络、Transformer 及预训练时序基线一致提升，同时保持低存储与低推理开销。
Motivation: 客户与变压器级负荷预测中，不确定性受用户行为、天气与混合负荷构成影响，单一共享模型难以刻画异质模式；而为每个负荷单独建模在规模上训练、存储、更新与验证成本过高。
Method: 学习共享需求模式的公共模型，只训练一小批低维适配组件（adaptation components）构成的库，每个负荷依据自身预测特性将这些组件线性组合，从而在保留共享知识的同时适配异质与混合负荷构成。
Result: 在 SMART-DS 数据集的 590 条负荷曲线上，相对统计方法、神经网络、Transformer 类与预训练时间序列基线，确定性精度与概率质量指标均一致改善，并保持较低的存储与推理成本。
Conclusion: 用小型适配组件库按负荷组合，可在客户级概率负荷预测中同时获得比逐负荷独立建模更好的精度与更低的规模成本。

papers.title: FlowCF: Sparse Counterfactual Explanations for Mixed-Type Tabular Data using Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: In the field of Explainable AI (XAI), counterfactual (CF) explanations interpret a model's decision by suggesting the changes to the input that would lead to a more favourable outcome. To be useful in practice, such an explanation should change few features and change them as little as possible, properties known as sparsity and proximity. We observe that existing methods remain limited in this respect, especially for numerical features, whether they are model-agnostic and amortised, or gradient-based with full access to the model. In this paper, we propose FlowCF, a model-agnostic generative method that frames CF generation as sparse transport from the factual to the target class. We solve this transport with flow matching, which we extend to mixed feature types with a novel mixed flow operator, and exploit the resulting geometry to optimise for sparsity through a gating network that minimises the number of features the transport changes. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that FlowCF produces the best numerical sparsity and proximity, changing 29% of the numerical features where the best baseline changes 89%, at 70% smaller displacement, while remaining comparable on the other desiderata.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL) Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlowCF 把反事实解释生成形式化为从原始样本到目标类的稀疏传输，用 flow matching 求解，并提出 mixed flow operator 扩展到混合类型表格特征，再用 gating network 最小化被改变的特征数以优化稀疏性。在六个基准数据集上，它只改动 29% 的数值特征（最佳基线为 89%），位移小 70%，其余性质保持相当。
Motivation: 现有反事实解释方法在稀疏性与邻近性上受限，尤其是数值特征，无论模型无关的摊销方法还是可访问模型的梯度方法都如此。
Method: FlowCF 是模型无关的生成方法：把 CF 生成表述为从原始类到目标类的稀疏传输，用 flow matching 求解该传输；扩展出 mixed flow operator 以处理混合特征类型，并利用所得几何结构，通过 gating network 优化稀疏性，最小化传输改变的特征数量。
Result: 在六个基准数据集上，FlowCF 取得最佳数值稀疏性与邻近性：只改动 29% 的数值特征，而最佳基线改动 89%，位移小 70%，在其他期望性质上保持相当。
Conclusion: 把反事实生成当作稀疏传输并用 gating network 约束改动特征数，可在混合类型表格数据上同时改善数值特征的稀疏性与邻近性。

papers.title: How Bregman Divergences Shape Shampoo
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the principles behind Shampoo has recently guided the development of more effective neural network optimizers. These methods learn a preconditioner by optimizing the Frobenius or Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence against the gradient second moment. In this work, we investigate how the choice of divergence shapes preconditioning, which remains unclear and blocks further improvements. To do so, we develop a unified Bregman divergence framework that connects all popular divergences, allowing us to study them jointly. Through empirical spectral analysis of gradient second moments, we examine how divergence choice shapes Kronecker approximation and interacts with finite-sample error in preconditioning. We find that some divergences can better compensate for finite-sample underestimation of the empirical second moment, helping explain the differing behavior of their corresponding Shampoo variants. We further validate this explanation through GPT-2 pretraining experiments. By connecting divergence choice to practical training behavior, we believe our framework provides principled guidance for understanding the foundations of, and further improving, Shampoo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Shampoo 类优化器用的 Frobenius、KL 等散度统一进 Bregman 散度框架，通过梯度二阶矩的经验谱分析考察散度选择如何塑造 Kronecker 近似及其与有限样本误差的交互。发现某些散度能更好地补偿经验二阶矩的有限样本低估，从而解释不同 Shampoo 变体的行为差异，并在 GPT-2 预训练实验中验证该解释。
Motivation: Shampoo 及其后续优化器通过优化 Frobenius 或 KL 散度来学习预条件器，但散度选择如何影响预条件仍不清楚，这阻碍了进一步改进。
Method: 建立统一的 Bregman 散度框架，把主流散度纳入同一视角联合研究；对梯度二阶矩做经验谱分析，考察散度选择如何塑造 Kronecker 近似以及它与预条件中有限样本误差的交互；再用 GPT-2 预训练实验验证解释。
Result: 经验谱分析显示，某些散度能更好地补偿经验二阶矩的有限样本低估，这解释了对应 Shampoo 变体的行为差异；该解释在 GPT-2 预训练实验中得到验证。
Conclusion: 散度选择与预条件的有限样本行为直接挂钩，Bregman 框架为理解 Shampoo 的基础并进一步改进它提供了有原则的指导。

papers.title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
papers.abstract_en: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM). 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多模态几何对齐分数对模态退化的响应不由扰动位移的大小决定：位移幅度最多只能解释绝对响应 15% 的样本外方差，而幅度配对的样本响应系统性不同。作者从 Gramian 体积的一阶展开导出方向几何响应 (DGR)，即位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，其绝对一阶项样本外 R² 达 0.838–0.969。结论是几何响应取决于表示的工作点、位移大小与位移方向三者共同作用，DGR 是解释量而非部署时预测器。
Motivation: Gram 行列式一类几何对齐分数被用来刻画多模态高阶一致性，但其对模态退化的响应规律不清楚：现有理解默认响应由扰动幅度决定，而幅度配对样本响应不同说明这一假设失效。
Method: 在冻结的 MSR-VTT (N=878) 与 DiDeMo (N=980) 视频-音频样本上施加受控视频模糊与音频噪声，分析分数所定义的关系几何的响应；对 Gramian 体积做闭式一阶展开，得到 Directional Geometric Response (DGR)，即位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，并与无方向替代量及预注册的增益归一化候选 V/(g_V+eps) 在相应评估协议下对比。
Result: 位移幅度最多解释绝对响应 15% 的样本外方差；幅度配对样本响应系统性不同。DGR 绝对一阶项样本外 R² 为 0.838–0.969，幅度配对排序准确率 0.864–0.963，响应符号准确率 0.909–0.989；被测无方向替代量在对应协议下弱或不稳定；V/(g_V+eps) 未通过其可预测性与 clean-order 门槛。
Conclusion: 几何响应由工作点、位移大小与位移方向共同决定，标量幅度无法组织该响应；DGR 因使用观测到的退化态位移，只作解释量而非部署时预测器。

papers.title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedCORE 把医学影像诊断拆成临床定义的 criteria，用 Graph Attention 建模 criteria 间依赖、与临床文本描述对齐，再以不确定性校准加权聚合证据。在 ISIC 2018、BUSI、IDRiD 三个模态上分别取得 89.2%/96.1%/84.3% accuracy，并在 CNN、transformer、生物医学 VLM、concept-based 与 prototype-based 基线上一致提升。
Motivation: 现有深度模型把图像特征直接映射到疾病标签，跳过临床医生系统评估的形态与纹理判据，诊断过程不透明，限制安全的临床部署。
Method: 在 vision-language 架构中把诊断分解为临床 criteria，将每条 criteria 空间定位到相关图像区域，用多尺度表征编码宏观结构与微观纹理证据，再用 Graph Attention Network 建模 criteria 间依赖；表征与临床文本描述对齐，经 class-wise visual prototypes 强化，最后用 uncertainty-calibrated weighting 按置信度折扣低置信证据并聚合。
Result: ISIC 2018 上 accuracy 89.2%、macro-F1 85.7%、AUC 96.4%；BUSI 上 accuracy 96.1%、macro-F1 95.2%、AUC 98.4%；IDRiD 上 accuracy 84.3%、macro-F1 80.2%、AUC 92.8%。三个异质成像模态上相对 CNN、transformer、生物医学 vision-language、concept-based 与 prototype-based 基线均有一致提升。
Conclusion: 把临床判据显式化、定位并按不确定性加权聚合，可在皮肤镜、乳腺超声与眼底三种模态上同时获得可解释性与强诊断性能。

papers.title: PHBA: Prefix-State Hybrid Block Attention
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid architectures combining linear sequence models with softmax attention provide an effective balance between efficient long-context modeling and precise token retrieval. Existing designs such as Native Hybrid Attention (NHA) combine compressed long-term states with sliding-window attention, but their exact attention is restricted to a fixed local window. In this work, we introduce Prefix-State Hybrid Block Attention (PHBA), which replaces local sliding-window attention with top-k block-sparse retrieval and couples each retrieved block with a compact prefix state summarizing its preceding context. The prefix states are constructed by a gated linear recurrence at block boundaries and retrieved together with the corresponding token blocks, allowing the model to combine precise long-range evidence with compressed historical context within a unified layer. We further develop a hardware-aware Triton implementation that streams routed token blocks and prefix states without materializing large intermediate tensors. Experiments show that PHBA improves long-context and retrieval performance over strong linear and hybrid baselines while retaining efficient training and inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PHBA 把混合架构中固定滑窗的精确注意力换成 top-k block-sparse 检索，并为每个被检索的块在块边界用门控线性递归 (gated linear recurrence) 构造一个压缩前缀状态，随 token 块一起取回，使长程精确证据与历史压缩上下文在同一层内结合。实验显示其长上下文与检索性能优于强线性与混合基线，同时保持训练与推理效率。
Motivation: 现有混合架构（如 Native Hybrid Attention, NHA）把压缩长期状态与滑窗注意力结合，但其精确注意力被限制在固定局部窗口内，无法直接检索窗口之外的长程 token。
Method: 用 top-k block-sparse 检索替代局部滑窗注意力；每个被检索块配一个在块边界由门控线性递归生成的紧凑前缀状态，与对应 token 块一同取回，统一进单层。另配硬件感知的 Triton 实现，流式处理路由的 token 块与前缀状态，不物化大中间张量。
Result: 实验表明 PHBA 在长上下文与检索任务上优于强线性基线和混合基线（含 NHA 类设计），并保持高效的训练与推理。
Conclusion: 把精确注意力的范围从固定滑窗改为 top-k 块检索、并用块边界前缀状态补足被跳过的上下文，可以在混合架构中同时拿到长程检索精度与线性模型的效率。

papers.title: WareFly-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for UAV Navigation and Human Tracking in Smart Warehouses
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored, hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions, and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization, and tracking in warehouse environments. It contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command. Two aerial tasks are covered: target approach and person following, under occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation, and clutter. A unified benchmark of four open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, pi_0 and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses is far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose, and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines, and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WareFly-VLA 提出面向智能仓库的语言条件无人机导航框架与数据集，含 507 段人工遥操作飞行、8,504 条高分辨率 RGB 转移，每条配目标工人外观描述与四自由度同步控制指令。在泄漏无关的 episode 级协议下统一评测 SmolVLA、GR00T N1.7、pi_0、OpenVLA 四个开源 VLA：仓库内语言条件空中控制远未解决，严格泛化设置下性能大幅下降，连续动作建模稳定优于离散动作 token 化，仅前向通道可从单帧可靠学习。
Motivation: 语言条件的无人机控制在智能仓库场景基本空白，缺一个同时提供连续低层飞行动作、细粒度自然语言目标描述和真实工业环境的基准。
Method: 在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中采集 507 段人工遥操作飞行与 8,504 条高分辨率 RGB 转移，覆盖接近目标与跟随人物两项任务，含遮挡、远距离搜索、高度变化与杂乱场景；以泄漏无关的 episode 级协议在两种控制频率下统一评测 SmolVLA、GR00T N1.7、pi_0、OpenVLA 四个开源 VLA 架构，并附视频、语言、动作、位姿与难度标注。
Result: 严格泛化设置下性能大幅下降；连续动作建模一致优于离散动作 token 化；仅前向通道可从单帧可靠学习；现有基础模型接口从地面与人形本体迁移到空中平台效果差。
Conclusion: 仓库内语言引导的空中自主远未解决，连续动作建模是当前更有效的动作表示，且需要为飞行本体专门设计的接口而非直接沿用地面/人形模型。

papers.title: Multi-model ocean oxygen fields predicted by conditional diffusion models
papers.abstract_en: Dissolved oxygen is important for the ocean's ecosystems and biogeochemical cycles. Yet, Earth System Models (ESMs) vary in their simulations of the present-day and future ocean oxygen inventory. To narrow down the uncertainty in estimates of ocean oxygen content, we train a conditional generative diffusion model on outputs of a multi-model ESM ensemble to learn the conditional distribution of upper-ocean oxygen given physical input variables such as temperature and salinity. This generative model has considerable skill in the Atlantic and Southern Oceans, and can generate realistic oxygen samples under conditions not seen in the training data. We validate this model using observational datasets, and use it to generate oxygen fields for models without oxygen data using only temperature and salinity as conditioning inputs. This physics-conditioned extrapolation suggests that model biases in the tropical Pacific Oxygen Minimum Zone may be smaller than currently assumed when considering a larger set of physical ocean states. Our approach provides a complementary way to represent probabilistic multi-model climate distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多模式 ESM 海洋氧输出上训练以温盐为条件的生成式扩散模型，学习上层海洋氧的条件分布，从而为没有氧数据的模式补出氧场。模型在大西洋与南大洋有可观技巧，能生成训练中未见条件下的合理样本；据此外推提示热带太平洋氧最小值区 (OMZ) 的模式偏差可能比目前认为的更小。
Motivation: 不同 ESM 对现今与未来海洋氧储量模拟差异大，氧含量估计存在不确定性；部分模式没有输出氧场，无法直接参与多模式比较。
Method: 训练条件生成式扩散模型 (conditional diffusion model)，以温度、盐度等物理变量为条件，学习多模式 ESM 集合输出的上层海洋氧条件分布；用观测数据集验证，并把模型用于仅有温盐条件、无氧数据的模式做外推。
Result: 模型在大西洋与南大洋表现出可观技巧 (considerable skill)，可生成训练数据中未见条件下的真实氧样本；经观测数据集验证后，为无氧数据的模式生成氧场，其物理条件外推显示热带太平洋 OMZ 的模式偏差在纳入更广物理海洋状态后可能小于当前估计。
Conclusion: 以物理变量为条件的生成式扩散模型可作为表征概率性多模式气候分布的补充途径，并可能下调热带太平洋 OMZ 偏差的量级判断。
Relevance: 41

papers.title: 2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata
papers.abstract_en: Many modern learning approaches are still struggling with spatial reasoning tasks, i.e. they lack the ability to utilize geometric information of perceived entities and their spatial relation to each other to solve problems. We introduce a novel Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA) architecture which uses deformable convolutions to dynamically adapt the perceptive field and iteratively reason over 2D spatial relations on grid-like data structures (e.g. images). Empirical results on public benchmarks show state of the art comprehensible results with high generalization abilities for solving image based puzzles like Sudoku or finding the shortest path in a maze.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自适应神经元胞自动机 (aNCA)，用可变形卷积动态调整感受野，在网格结构上迭代推理 2D 空间关系，用于数独、迷宫最短路等图像谜题，摘要称在公开基准上取得可解释且泛化能力强的结果。
Motivation: 现代学习方法难以利用实体几何信息及其相互空间关系来解题，图像类空间推理任务因此受限。
Method: aNCA 架构以元胞自动机式迭代更新为基础，用 deformable convolutions 动态适配感受野，在网格状数据结构（如图像）上逐步推理 2D 空间关系。
Result: 在公开基准上解决 Sudoku 与迷宫最短路等图像谜题，摘要称取得 state of the art 且可理解的结果，并具备高泛化能力；未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把可变形卷积嵌入迭代式元胞自动机，是让模型显式利用几何与空间关系解图像谜题的一条有效路径。

papers.title: How Much Evidence Should a Coding Agent's Self-Correction Carry? Adaptive Dirichlet Evidence for Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Execution feedback lets coding agents revise programs and learn from their own corrections. A correction's learning weight should reflect both the transitions supported by its executions and the amount of evidence behind that support. We introduce Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation (EESD), which represents these quantities separately. Normalized execution relevance determines relative transition support and an effective pseudo-count mass; a Dirichlet posterior then produces an uncertainty-penalized weight for KL-anchored correction learning. Under a symmetric prior, changing mass preserves category ordering, and effective mass yields a supervised coefficient bounded by its matched fixed-mass counterpart. Across four model-domain history sweeps, increasing visible observations from one to eight reduces future-outcome NLL by 55.0-59.3%. At eight observations, effective mass achieves lower NLL than fixed mass in all four comparisons. In the primary matched DeepSeek/RunBugRun study, argmax predictions agree on all 3,000 examples, with the largest NLL gain under concentrated relevance. After one correction-learning round, DeepSeek/CodeARC all-tests Pass@1 increases from 15.0% to 20.4%, with a paired 95% source-bootstrap interval of [+2.8, +8.0] percentage points. The twelve-setting downstream evaluation establishes the model-domain scope of this update. These results show how separating evidence support from evidence mass changes probability estimation and correction learning in coding agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Effective-Evidence Self-Distillation (EESD)：把执行反馈对程序修正的“转移支持度”和“证据质量”分开建模，用归一化执行相关性给出伪计数质量，再由 Dirichlet 后验产生带不确定性惩罚的 KL 锚定修正学习权重。可见观测从 1 增到 8 使未来结果 NLL 下降 55.0–59.3%，8 条观测时 effective mass 在四个对比中全部取得更低 NLL；一轮修正学习后 DeepSeek/CodeARC 全测试 Pass@1 从 15.0% 升到 20.4%。
Motivation: 执行反馈驱动的自我修正中，一条修正的学习权重应同时反映其执行所支持的状态转移和支撑该支持的证据量，但二者常被混为一谈，导致概率估计与修正学习权重失当。
Method: EESD 将二者解耦：归一化执行相关性 (normalized execution relevance) 决定相对转移支持并给出有效伪计数质量 (effective pseudo-count mass)，Dirichlet 后验据此产出不确定性惩罚权重，用于 KL 锚定的修正学习；在对称先验下给出保持类别排序、且 effective mass 的监督系数被同质量固定质量版本所约束的性质。
Result: 四个模型域历史扫描中，可见观测由 1 增至 8 使未来结果 NLL 下降 55.0–59.3%；8 条观测时 effective mass 在全部四个对比中 NLL 低于 fixed mass。主匹配 DeepSeek/RunBugRun 研究中 3,000 个样本 argmax 预测全部一致，集中相关性下 NLL 增益最大；一轮修正学习后 DeepSeek/CodeARC 全测试 Pass@1 由 15.0% 升至 20.4%，配对 95% source-bootstrap 区间为 [+2.8, +8.0] 个百分点；下游评测共十二个设置。
Conclusion: 把证据支撑与证据质量分开会改变编码智能体的概率估计与修正学习效果，且该更新的作用范围由十二设置下游评测界定为模型域内。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Wiki-Talkie: Multilingual Benchmarking of Persona-Based Agents on Real-World Discussions
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in social environments, making it critical to study their ability to faithfully simulate human interactions. Central to this is grounding agents in realistic user personas, yet existing datasets rely on fictional personas and are limited to a handful of languages, lacking the empirical grounding necessary to evaluate behavioral fidelity across diverse populations. We introduce Wiki-Talkie, a multilingual dataset of real-world conversations from Wikipedia Talk pages across five languages spanning two language families: Germanic (German, English) and Romance (Spanish, French, Italian), paired with personas derived from real user communities and encompassing sociodemographic attributes, self-descriptions, and behaviorally grounded interaction traits. Using Wiki-Talkie, we evaluate agent interactional behavior on a next-turn generation task across various persona conditioning strategies. Our evaluation assesses whether agents collectively reproduce the distributional behavioral patterns observed in human discussions. Results show that user's comment history exemplifying interaction behavior consistently outperforms explicit persona information. In addition, models systematically underproduce negative or extreme sentiments, while over producing references and suggestions, revealing biases toward agreeableness and positivity. Crucially, these patterns hold robustly across languages, with small cross-lingual differences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Wiki-Talkie 用五个语言的 Wikipedia Talk 页真实对话加真实用户社区画像，评测 LLM agent 在下一轮生成中能否复现人类讨论的分布行为。结果显示用户历史评论所体现的交互行为一致优于显式 persona 信息，模型系统性少产负面与极端情绪、多产引用与建议，表现出亲和与正面偏向，且这些模式跨语言稳健、跨语言差异小。
Motivation: 现有 persona 数据集依赖虚构人物、只覆盖少数语言，缺少评估跨人群行为保真度 (behavioral fidelity) 所需的真实依据。
Method: 构建 Wiki-Talkie：从 Wikipedia Talk 页采集德、英、西、法、意五种语言（Germanic 与 Romance 两个语系）的真实对话，配以来自真实用户社区的 persona（社会人口属性、自我描述、行为交互特质）。任务为 next-turn generation，比较多种 persona conditioning 策略，评估 agent 是否复现人类讨论的分布行为模式。
Result: 用户评论历史所体现的交互行为一致优于显式 persona 信息；模型系统性少产负面或极端情绪、多产引用与建议，呈现亲和与正面偏向；这些模式跨语言稳健，跨语言差异小。
Conclusion: 基于真实社区的 persona 加行为历史比显式属性更能约束 agent 行为，而 LLM agent 普遍偏向 agreeableness 与 positivity，且该偏差跨语言一致。

papers.title: Cylindrical Geodesic Flow Matching for Quasiperiodic Physiological Signal Transformation
papers.abstract_en: Paired translation between quasiperiodic physiological waveforms (i.e., recovering a target oscillatory signal from the source) is central to the interpretation of cardiovascular signals derived from wearables placed at different body locations. This source-to-target mapping in these problems carries inherent geometric structure: the phase wraps around the cycle and must be treated as a circular variable, the amplitude remains strictly positive, and the beat-to-beat alignment can drift unpredictably across cycles and subjects. While deep neural networks have been used for phase estimation and complex-valued signal modeling, prior work does not explicitly learn phase transport between paired signals. Consequently, neither endpoint-supervised regression nor the standard affine path used in flow matching accounts for this phase--amplitude structure. We introduce \emph{cylindrical geodesic flow matching} for paired cardiovascular waveform translation. We show that the standard affine path used in flow matching distorts intermediate amplitude and instantaneous frequency when interpolating between quasiperiodic signals; replacing it with a closed-form geodesic on the phase--amplitude cylinder eliminates these artifacts and converts each training pair into dense, geometry-consistent velocity supervision. On zero-shot photoplethysmography and limited-support seismocardiography adaptation benchmarks, our method consistently outperforms interpolation baselines and matches or exceeds direct supervised prediction, reducing Hilbert Transform, $L_2$, and Dynamic Time Warping distance by up to ${\sim}15\%$ over the strongest competing baseline. These results suggest that bridge geometry is a critical inductive bias for flow matching on oscillatory signal translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出柱面测地流匹配 (cylindrical geodesic flow matching) 做准周期生理波形的源到目标转换：把相位当圆变量、幅度保持严格为正，在相位-幅度柱面上用闭式测地线替代 flow matching 的标准仿射路径。标准仿射路径在插值时会扭曲中间幅度与瞬时频率，柱面测地路径消除这些伪影，并把每个训练对转成稠密、几何一致的速度监督；在零样本 PPG 与有限支撑 seismocardiography 适配基准上，Hilbert Transform、L2 与 DTW 距离相对最强竞争基线最多降低约 15%。
Motivation: 可穿戴设备在不同身体位置采集的准周期心血管波形需要成对互译，但相位绕周期回绕、幅度严格为正、逐拍对齐跨周期与跨受试者漂移；端点监督回归与 flow matching 的标准仿射路径都不建模这种相位-幅度结构，此前工作也没有显式学习成对信号间的相位传输 (phase transport)。
Method: 在相位-幅度柱面上构造闭式测地线 (closed-form geodesic) 作为 flow matching 的插值路径，替代标准仿射路径，使每个训练对提供稠密且几何一致的速度监督；相位按圆变量处理、幅度约束为正，并允许逐拍对齐漂移。评测用零样本 photoplethysmography (PPG) 与有限支撑 seismocardiography (SCG) 适配两类基准，对照插值基线与直接监督预测。
Result: 在零样本 PPG 与有限支撑 SCG 适配基准上，方法持续优于插值基线，并达到或超过直接监督预测；相对最强竞争基线，Hilbert Transform 距离、L2 距离与 Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) 距离最多降低约 15%。
Conclusion: 桥接路径的几何形状是 flow matching 做振荡信号转换的关键归纳偏置：用柱面测地线替代仿射路径即可消除中间幅度与瞬时频率伪影，从而在成对准周期波形转换上取得更好结果。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: X-OPM: Explainable Automatic Digital On-Chip Power Modeling for Enhanced Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Proactive power management systems reduce processor dynamic power through runtime power prediction and power-aware scheduling. Accurate, stable and low-overhead digital on-chip power meters (OPMs) are crucial for improving the prediction quality. Recent studies have explored various modeling methods, including using linear models, decision trees, and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) to construct OPMs. However, most current approaches train models end-to-end without analyzing the physical interpretability of features, affecting their ability to generalize to unseen workloads. Grounded in the design principles of synchronous digital VLSI circuits, X-OPM introduces a robust feature engineering framework that uses tree-based models to capture feature interactions and linear models for prediction. It also incorporates a human-in-the-loop workflow to balance model accuracy against modeling effort. Evaluated on a commercial C906 vector processor, X-OPM consistently achieves $R^2 > 0.93$ across all workloads with sampling window size set below $8$ cycles. In contrast, state-of-the-art methods including APOLLO, COBIT, and standard MLPs fail to generalize across all test cases. Layout with commercial EDA tools shows that X-OPM incurs an area overhead below $0.1\%$, which is on par with lightweight tree-based and linear models, and significantly smaller than MLP-based models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: X-OPM 用同步数字 VLSI 设计原理做特征工程，树模型捕捉特征交互、线性模型做预测，并加入 human-in-the-loop 权衡精度与建模成本。在商用 C906 向量处理器上，采样窗口小于 8 周期时全负载 R² > 0.93，而 APOLLO、COBIT 与标准 MLP 无法跨全部测试用例泛化；版图面积开销低于 0.1%。
Motivation: 现有 OPM 多为端到端训练、不分析特征的物理可解释性，导致面对未见负载时泛化能力差，而准确稳定的低开销数字 OPM 是功耗预测与功耗感知调度的前提。
Method: 基于同步数字 VLSI 电路设计原理构建鲁棒特征工程框架：用 tree-based 模型捕捉特征交互，再用线性模型做预测，并嵌入 human-in-the-loop 流程在建模精度与建模工作量之间取舍；与线性模型、决策树、MLP 等既有 OPM 建模方法对照。
Result: 在商用 C906 向量处理器上，采样窗口设为 8 周期以下时 X-OPM 在所有负载上 R² > 0.93；APOLLO、COBIT 与标准 MLP 在全部测试用例上无法泛化。商用 EDA 工具版图显示面积开销低于 0.1%，与轻量树模型和线性模型相当，显著小于基于 MLP 的模型。
Conclusion: 把电路级可解释特征与树-线性混合建模结合，可在极小采样窗口和低于 0.1% 面积开销下获得跨负载稳定的片上功耗建模，端到端黑箱模型做不到这一点。

papers.title: Language-model ratings of depression reflect the rater more than the patient
papers.abstract_en: Depression has no diagnostic blood test. Language models promise tireless, consistent assessment, but can accurate raters disagree about individuals? We pre-registered 880 language-model raters, crossing 11 open models with prompting and scoring choices, and applied them to 189 interviews against the eight-item Patient Health Questionnaire. Model choice explained 30.0% of summed-symptom score variance, stable participant differences 10.5%. Two randomly drawn raters with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) >= 0.70 disagreed on screening decisions for 40% of participants, on average. Average over-rating governed how many were flagged, yet equal-capacity raters chose differently for about one participant in five. A locked analysis of 86 new interviews reproduced the main pre-registered findings. Exploratory recalibration with 40 labelled participants raised accuracy from about 60% to 75% and halved disagreement, leaving one participant in five decided differently. Calibration repaired much of the rater dependence without securing agreement about individuals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 11 个开源语言模型配上不同 prompt 与打分方式，预注册 880 个 LLM 评分者对 189 段访谈按 PHQ-8 打分：模型选择解释了 30.0% 的症状总分方差，而稳定的个体差异只占 10.5%，即评分更多反映评分者而非患者。两个 AUC≥0.70 的随机评分者对 40% 的参与者给出不同筛查结论；用 40 名带标签参与者做探索性重标定后准确率从约 60% 升到 75%、分歧减半，但仍有约五分之一参与者被判得不同。
Motivation: 抑郁筛查没有客观检验，语言模型评分看似不知疲倦且一致，但准确的评分者之间仍可能对同一个体给出互相冲突的判断，使个体级筛查结论不可靠。
Method: 预注册 880 个语言模型评分者，交叉 11 个开源模型与 prompt/打分选择，对 189 段访谈按八项 Patient Health Questionnaire (PHQ-8) 评分；用方差分解区分模型选择与稳定个体差异，另做锁定分析与探索性重标定。
Result: 模型选择解释症状总分方差的 30.0%，稳定个体差异仅 10.5%；两个 AUC≥0.70 的随机评分者平均对 40% 参与者的筛查决定不一致；容量相同的评分者对约五分之一参与者选择不同。86 段新访谈的锁定分析复现了主要预注册发现；40 名带标签参与者的探索性重标定把准确率从约 60% 提到 75%、分歧减半，仍留约五分之一参与者结论不同。
Conclusion: 重标定能修复大部分评分者依赖，却不能就个体达成一致：LLM 抑郁评分的系统性偏差主要来自评分者而非患者，个体级筛查结论仍不稳定。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Information-Dense Synthesis for Molecular Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning can accelerate molecular discovery by designing molecules and planning experiments. However, many scientific challenges demand molecules with very rare properties, and in this sparse setting, existing algorithms offer little gain over random guessing. We propose a method to efficiently search large regions of molecular space using algorithmically controlled stochastic synthesis. Rather than design, make and test individual molecules, we design and make complex mixtures, test them as a pool, then deconvolute the molecule-activity map. We optimize synthesis to encode maximal information. Theoretically, this approach can reduce the number of experiments required to find the optimal molecule among $d$ candidates from $\mathcal{O}(d)$ to $\mathcal{O}(\log d)$ or $\mathcal{O}(1)$. In simulation, on estimated protein fitness landscapes, it finds active molecules with an order of magnitude fewer experiments than existing Bayesian optimization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对分子发现中稀有性质导致现有算法相对随机搜索几乎无增益的问题，提出用算法控制的随机合成 (algorithmically controlled stochastic synthesis) 直接设计并合成复杂混合物、按池测试后再解卷积出分子-活性图，并把合成过程优化为编码最大信息量。理论上把从 d 个候选中找到最优分子的实验次数从 O(d) 降到 O(log d) 或 O(1)；在估计的蛋白适应度景观模拟中，比现有贝叶斯优化方法少约一个数量级的实验找到活性分子。
Motivation: 许多科学挑战要求分子具备极罕见性质，在这种稀疏设定下现有分子设计与实验规划算法相对随机猜测几乎无增益，逐个设计-合成-测试的范式实验成本过高。
Method: 用算法控制的随机合成搜索大范围分子空间：不逐个制备分子，而是设计并合成复杂混合物，作为池 (pool) 一起测试，再解卷积 (deconvolute) 出分子-活性图；同时对合成过程做信息最大化优化，使每次实验编码尽可能多的信息。
Result: 理论上将从 d 个候选中找到最优分子所需实验数从 O(d) 降到 O(log d) 或 O(1)；在估计的蛋白适应度景观 (protein fitness landscapes) 模拟中，找到活性分子所需实验比现有贝叶斯优化方法少一个数量级 (order of magnitude)。
Conclusion: 在稀有性质的分子搜索中，把信息密度做进合成与混合物池测试，可以比逐分子设计和贝叶斯优化大幅节省实验次数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Knee3DVLM 把 DESS 与 TSE 两个全容积膝关节 MRI 序列一起喂进序列感知 VLM，联合预测 MOAKS 的 57 个解剖部位二分类诊断目标。在 1,074 例留出检查上，双序列融合模型平均准确率 72.98%、平衡准确率 71.17%、平均 ROC-AUC 78.96%、macro ROC-AUC 78.74%，为三种配置（DESS-only、TSE-only、配对融合）中最高。
Motivation: VLM 已开始用于三维医学影像，但膝关节 MRI 上应用很少，尤其难以同时处理临床常规中互补的多个成像序列，结构化报告的自动判读因此受限。
Method: 序列感知的 VLM 接收全容积 DESS 与流体敏感 TSE 两个序列，联合预测 MOAKS（MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score）派生的 57 个解剖部位二分类目标；用 subject-disjoint 的 Osteoarthritis Initiative 划分对比 DESS-only、TSE-only 与配对 DESS-TSE 三种配置，并在与已发布 3DReasonKnee 队列对齐的多分类任务上做次级分析。
Result: 在 1,074 例留出检查上，融合模型平均准确率 72.98%、平衡准确率 71.17%、平均 ROC-AUC 78.96%、macro ROC-AUC 78.74%，为三种配置中最高；在与 3DReasonKnee 队列对齐的五类病理多分类分析中，Knee3DVLM 数值上高于已报告的最强 3DReasonKnee 配置。
Conclusion: 双序列全容积建模是膝关节 MRI 全面评估的有效路径，配对 DESS-TSE 优于任一单序列配置。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.method: 序列感知的 VLM 接收全容积 DESS 与流体敏感 TSE 两个序列，联合预测 MOAKS（MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score）派生的 57 个解剖部位二分类目标；用 subject-disjoint 的 Osteoarthritis Initiative 划分对比 DESS-only、TSE-only 与配对 DESS-TSE 三种配置，并在与已发布 3DReasonKnee 队列对齐的多分类任务上做次级分析。
summary_sections.result: 在 1,074 例留出检查上，融合模型平均准确率 72.98%、平衡准确率 71.17%、平均 ROC-AUC 78.96%、macro ROC-AUC 78.74%，为三种配置中最高；在与 3DReasonKnee 队列对齐的五类病理多分类分析中，Knee3DVLM 数值上高于已报告的最强 3DReasonKnee 配置。
summary_sections.conclusion: 双序列全容积建模是膝关节 MRI 全面评估的有效路径，配对 DESS-TSE 优于任一单序列配置。

papers.title: MetaLearnNCA: Few-Shot Offline Meta-Learning via Interacting Neural Cellular Automata
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot meta-learning traditionally formulates task adaptation either as analytical gradient descent through unrolled computational graphs or as metric-based distance comparisons over flattened 1D fea- ture vectors, which either incur costly test-time backpropagation or discard native 2D spatial geometry. In this work, we propose METALEARNNCA, a decentralized framework that achieves few-shot adapta- tion through the dynamical interaction of coupled Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) without computing analytical gradients during inference. MetaLearnNCA decomposes task adaptation into an Active- NCA, which executes task inference conditioned on a continuous 2D spatial memory grid termed the spatial program, and a learned Meta-NCA, which acts as a decentralized cellular optimizer by diffusing spatial error residuals across local neighborhoods to dynamically update this program. METALEARN- NCA is competitive against canonical meta-learners in-distribution (96.12% on Omniglot) with Out-Of- Distribution transfer gains on MNIST, KMNIST, and Fashion-MNIST transfer across 10 independent testing seeds across 1-, 5-, and 10-shot regimes (e.g., surpassing Prototypical Networks by +10.54% on 10-shot MNIST and a +3.87% gain on 10-shot Fashion-MNIST over FOMAML). Our results establish that robust, gradient-free learning-to-learn can emerge from decentralized cellular dynamics on non-von Neumann substrates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaLearnNCA 用耦合 Neural Cellular Automata 的去中心化动力学替代推理期梯度回传：Active-NCA 在连续 2D 空间记忆网格（spatial program）上做任务推理，Meta-NCA 作为细胞优化器在局部邻域扩散误差残差来更新该程序。在 Omniglot 上达到 96.12%，与经典 meta-learner 相当；在 MNIST、KMNIST、Fashion-MNIST 的 OOD 迁移上取得增益，如 10-shot MNIST 超过 Prototypical Networks +10.54%，10-shot Fashion-MNIST 相对 FOMAML +3.87%。
Motivation: 现有 few-shot meta-learning 要么通过展开计算图做解析梯度下降、测试期反向传播代价高，要么把特征压平成 1D 向量做度量比较、丢掉原生 2D 空间几何。
Method: 提出去中心化框架 MetaLearnNCA：Active-NCA 以连续 2D 空间记忆网格（spatial program）为条件执行任务推理，学得的 Meta-NCA 充当去中心化细胞优化器，把空间误差残差在局部邻域扩散以动态更新该 program，推理期不计算解析梯度。
Result: 在 Omniglot 上 96.12%，与经典 meta-learner 相当；在 MNIST、KMNIST、Fashion-MNIST 的 OOD 迁移上，跨 10 个独立测试种子、覆盖 1-shot、5-shot、10-shot 设定取得增益，例如 10-shot MNIST 超过 Prototypical Networks +10.54%，10-shot Fashion-MNIST 相对 FOMAML +3.87%。
Conclusion: 无需解析梯度的 learning-to-learn 可以从非冯·诺依曼基底上的去中心化细胞动力学中涌现，并在分布外迁移上超过基于度量与基于梯度的经典 meta-learner。

papers.title: Learning PDE solution operators with variable initial conditions via Latent Dynamics Networks
papers.abstract_en: In many-query scenarios, data-driven surrogate models provide an efficient alternative to high-fidelity solvers for simulating physical systems governed by Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). In this context, the Latent Dynamics Network (LDNet) has recently demonstrated remarkable performance in predicting the response of spatio-temporal systems, combining Neural Ordinary Differential Equations with nonlinear dimensionality reduction. However, the original formulation assumes a fixed initial condition, limiting its applicability to many real-world applications where a system evolves from varying starting states. In this work, we overcome this limitation while keeping the end-to-end training procedure of the original LDNet and its encoder-free nature, which preserves its intrinsic independence from spatial resolution and grid topology. We infer the initial latent state directly from a small set of early-time observations, treating latent-state initialization as an adaptation problem, and investigate two strategies: an auto-decoding formulation and a meta-learning approach in which the initial latent state acts as a task-specific context variable. We demonstrate the accuracy of the proposed methods across diverse physical phenomena, spanning advection-diffusion, fluid dynamics, and solid mechanics. Meta-learning markedly accelerates latent-state inference and induces smoother, better-conditioned optimization landscapes, and spontaneously organizes the latent space into a structured representation that reflects physically meaningful features of the underlying dynamics. The coordinate-based decoder enables training from spatially subsampled data while recovering high-resolution solution fields at inference. The resulting approach provides an efficient and resolution-independent surrogate modeling framework for many-query simulations of time-dependent PDEs with varying initial conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LDNet 原本只支持固定初始条件，本文把初始隐状态推断改写成 adaptation 问题：从少量早期时刻观测直接推断初始隐态，比较 auto-decoding 与 meta-learning 两种策略，同时保留端到端训练和 encoder-free 结构。Meta-learning 显著加快隐态推断并带来更平滑、条件更好的优化景观，还自发把隐空间组织成反映动力学物理特征的结构化表示。
Motivation: LDNet 原始形式假设固定初始条件，限制了它在从不同起始状态演化的实际系统中的可用性；而 many-query 场景需要能替代高保真求解器的高效代理模型。
Method: 保留原 LDNet 的端到端训练与 encoder-free 特性，把初始隐状态从少量早期时刻观测中推断，作为 adaptation 问题处理；比较两种策略：auto-decoding 公式，以及把初始隐态当作 task-specific context variable 的 meta-learning。坐标式 decoder 支持从空间下采样数据训练，并在推理时恢复高分辨率解场。
Result: 在 advection-diffusion、fluid dynamics、solid mechanics 等多种物理现象上验证所提方法的准确性；meta-learning 明显加速隐状态推断，产生更平滑、条件更良的优化景观，并自发组织出反映底层动力学物理特征的结构化隐空间表示。
Conclusion: 把初始隐态推断当作 adaptation 问题后，LDNet 可扩展到变初始条件的 many-query PDE 模拟，且 meta-learning 在推断速度与隐空间结构上优于 auto-decoding；坐标式 decoder 使框架与分辨率和网格拓扑无关。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: UNREAL: Unifying Retrieval and Long-Context with a Single Model
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) handle evidence selection at vastly different scales, from a single long prompt to an entire corpus. We ask whether a single model-internal mechanism can select evidence across this range. We introduce UNifying REtrieval And Long-Context with a Single Model (UNREAL), a model-native evidence selection framework to span corpus retrieval and long-context inference. UNREAL encodes chunks and derives retrieval queries directly from the frozen LLM's internal representations. It adds fewer than 500K trainable parameters and leaves the backbone unchanged. On a 3B-token, 21M-chunk Wikipedia index, all four dense and hybrid UNREAL backbones outperform state-of-the-art retriever-reranker systems. The best model raises recall from 49.1% to 73.2% on HotpotQA, from 31.7% to 60.1% on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and from 8.8% to 14.4% on MuSiQue. Applied to long-context tasks, the same selection mechanism removes distractors before generation, raising NoLiMa accuracy from 1.0% to 24.83% at its maximum context length of 128K tokens, and LV-Eval's F1 score from 49.97% to 54.66% at 256K. UNREAL also reduces FLOPs and time-to-first-token relative to full-context inference from roughly 32K tokens onward, with larger gains as context grows. Together, these results establish model-internal evidence selection as a common foundation for corpus retrieval and evidence-sparse long-context inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UNREAL 用冻结 LLM 的内部表征直接生成检索 query 并编码 chunk，把语料级 RAG 检索与长上下文证据选择统一为同一模型内机制，新增可训练参数不足 500K。在 3B token、21M chunk 的 Wikipedia 索引上，四个 dense/hybrid 骨干全部超过 SOTA retriever-reranker：HotpotQA recall 49.1%→73.2%，2WikiMultiHopQA 31.7%→60.1%，MuSiQue 8.8%→14.4%；同一选择机制在生成前剔除干扰项，使 NoLiMa 在 128K 上下文下准确率 1.0%→24.83%，LV-Eval F1 在 256K 下 49.97%→54.66%，并从约 32K token 起降低 FLOPs 与首 token 延迟。
Motivation: RAG 与长上下文推理在完全不同的尺度上做证据选择（单条长 prompt 对整个语料库），需要两套独立机制，且长上下文推理被干扰项拖累、算力开销随上下文增长。
Method: UNREAL 从冻结 LLM 的内部表征直接派生检索 query 并编码文档 chunk，用单一模型内机制覆盖语料检索与长上下文推理；骨干保持冻结，新增可训练参数不足 500K。在 3B-token、21M-chunk 的 Wikipedia 索引上评测四个 dense 与 hybrid 骨干，并把同一选择机制用于生成前剔除干扰项的长上下文任务。
Result: 检索侧：最佳模型在 HotpotQA 上 recall 49.1%→73.2%，2WikiMultiHopQA 31.7%→60.1%，MuSiQue 8.8%→14.4%，四个 dense/hybrid 骨干均超过 SOTA retriever-reranker 系统。长上下文侧：NoLiMa 在 128K 最大上下文下准确率 1.0%→24.83%，LV-Eval F1 在 256K 下 49.97%→54.66%。效率上，相对全上下文推理从约 32K token 起减少 FLOPs 与 time-to-first-token，上下文越长收益越大。
Conclusion: 模型内部证据选择可以作为语料检索与证据稀疏长上下文推理的共同基础，且无需改动骨干、只加不到 500K 参数。

papers.title: One-Shot Private Confidence Regions via Resampling
papers.abstract_en: We propose a simple framework for constructing differentially private confidence regions \textit{in one shot}, i.e., by adding noise only to the final resampling quantile instead of privatizing the estimator computed on each resample. The cost of privacy of our procedure is only logarithmic in the number of resamples $B$ under with-replacement ($m$-out-of-$n$) sampling and independent of $B$ under without replacement sampling (subsampling), avoiding the $\sqrt{B}$ factor that arises in previous works. We provide nonasymptotic Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP) and utility guarantees for both subsampling and $m$-out-of-$n$ resampling, covering mean-like estimators with small global sensitivity as well as estimators admitting efficiently computable smooth sensitivity bounds, including quantiles and degenerate U-statistics. This allows us to also obtain private confidence regions for degenerate U-statistics where the private error is much smaller than the non-private error. In all, we provide a toolbox for widely applicable DP uncertainty quantification procedures under popular resampling strategies while avoiding the computational and privacy costs of privatizing many intermediate resample statistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一次性构造差分隐私置信域的框架：只对最终的重采样分位数加噪，而不是对每个重采样样本上的估计量分别加噪。隐私代价在有放回 (m-out-of-n) 采样下只随重采样次数 B 呈对数增长，在无放回 (子采样) 下与 B 无关，从而避开已有工作中的 √B 因子。
Motivation: 对每个重采样副本的估计量逐一做差分隐私会累积隐私预算，代价随重采样次数 B 出现 √B 因子，同时带来大量中间统计量的计算开销，阻碍了重采样式不确定性量化的隐私化。
Method: 框架只对最终重采样分位数加噪，给出子采样与 m-out-of-n 重采样两种情形下的非渐近 Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP) 与效用保证；覆盖全局敏感度小的均值类估计量，以及可高效计算 smooth sensitivity 的估计量，包括分位数与退化 U-统计量。
Result: 隐私代价在 m-out-of-n 有放回采样下仅为 log B 量级，在无放回子采样下与 B 无关，避免了先前工作的 √B 因子；对退化 U-统计量可得到私有误差远小于非私有误差的私有置信域。
Conclusion: 只私有化最终重采样分位数即可在常用重采样策略下提供广泛适用的 DP 不确定性量化工具箱，同时避开逐个私有化中间重采样统计量的计算与隐私成本。
