papers.title: Agentic AutoRAG: RAG Pipeline Optimization through Reasoning-Driven Agents
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a widely used approach for grounding large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge. However, configuring a pipeline is an expensive hyperparameter optimization problem over many interacting choices, from chunking and embedding model to reranking and generation. Existing optimizers, from greedy search to Bayesian optimization, reduce each trial to an aggregate score and search without modeling why a configuration performed as it did, even though the retrieved chunks already provide evidence about whether each failure occurred during retrieval or after it. We introduce Agentic AutoRAG, an LLM-agent optimizer for multi-objective RAG hyperparameter optimization with retrieval-versus-generation failure attribution. It proposes configurations scored on a frozen exam from the corpus: after each trial a Diagnoser attributes each failed question to retrieval or generation, and a Proposer, grounded in a knowledge base of model rankings and pricing, selects the next configuration, weighing accuracy against cost to trace a Pareto frontier. On three multi-hop QA benchmarks it reaches higher LLM-judge accuracy than every baseline we compare, and within its first 10 trials it matches or beats the statistical baselines' full 30-trial judge accuracy. In its cost-aware mode on a real-world healthcare corpus it reaches a median exam accuracy of 77%, above the strongest baseline's 71.5%, at about 58% of that baseline's cost per query, and it matches that 71.5% at about 22% of the cost.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Agentic AutoRAG 用带失败归因的 LLM agent 优化 RAG 超参：每轮试验后 Diagnoser 把答错的题归因到检索或生成，Proposer 依据模型排名与价格知识库选下一配置，在准确率与成本间追踪 Pareto 前沿。在真实医疗语料上其成本感知模式中位考试准确率 77%（最强基线 71.5%），仅用约 58% 的单查询成本；用约 22% 成本即追平 71.5%。
Motivation: RAG 管线配置是分块、嵌入、重排、生成多环节耦合的昂贵超参搜索；现有贪心与贝叶斯优化把每次试验压成一个总分，不建模失败发生在检索还是生成。
Method: LLM-agent 优化器在语料构成的冻结考卷上评分：每轮试验后 Diagnoser 将每道错题归因到 retrieval 或 generation，Proposer 结合模型排名与定价的知识库选下一配置，权衡准确率与成本以追踪 Pareto 前沿。
Result: 在三个 multi-hop QA 基准上 LLM-judge 准确率高于所比较的全部基线，且前 10 次试验即追平或超过统计基线跑满 30 次试验的 judge 准确率；在真实医疗语料的成本感知模式下中位考试准确率 77% 对最强基线 71.5%，成本约为其 58%，并以约 22% 成本追平 71.5%。
Conclusion: 把检索与生成的失败归因喂给提议 agent，能在更少试验与更低单查询成本下逼近或超过传统超参搜索的 RAG 准确率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Rethinking Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation: From Alignment Coverage to Supervision Reliability
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own generations using teacher feedback. With different tokenizers, comparing teacher and student predictions requires alignment at both sequence and vocabulary levels. In this paper, we examine whether expanding this alignment coverage improves learning. Across three heterogeneous teacher--student pairs on mathematical reasoning and code generation, strict 1:1 groups already cover most student-generated tokens despite substantial vocabulary mismatch. On responses sampled from the students before distillation, the shared vocabulary retains nearly all teacher and student probability mass at strictly aligned positions on average. Restricting reverse KL to a student-selected top-16 subset of the shared vocabulary at each strict position achieves accuracy comparable to full shared-vocabulary OPD, outperforming the evaluated cross-tokenizer baselines. Adding mean squared error supervision on span log-probabilities in mismatch groups gives complete supervision coverage, yet reduces accuracy. At checkpoints from training with only the strict loss, the span gradients show weak or negative directional agreement with the strict gradients and grow in magnitude relative to them. These diagnostics may help explain the accuracy drop from adding span supervision. Our findings motivate a shift from maximizing alignment coverage to prioritizing supervision reliability: compact supervision at strict positions can be more effective than broader coverage that introduces weakly aligned or conflicting training signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 跨 tokenizer 的 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中，扩大对齐覆盖并不提升效果：在数学推理与代码生成的三组异构师生模型上，严格 1:1 对齐位置已覆盖学生生成的大部分 token，且共享词表在这些位置几乎保留全部教师与学生概率质量。把 reverse KL 限制在每个严格位置的学生 top-16 共享词表子集，精度与全共享词表 OPD 相当并优于所评测的跨 tokenizer 基线；而在错配组上追加 span 对数概率的 MSE 监督虽补齐覆盖，精度反而下降。作者主张从最大化对齐覆盖转向优先监督可靠性。
Motivation: 师生 tokenizer 不同时，OPD 需要在序列与词表两个层面做对齐；扩大对齐覆盖是否真的改善学习，此前缺少直接检验。
Method: 在数学推理与代码生成的三组异构师生对上比较：严格 1:1 对齐位置上的 reverse KL（可限制到学生选定的 top-16 共享词表子集），以及在错配组上追加 span 对数概率 MSE 监督；并用蒸馏前采样响应统计概率质量保留，用训练检查点上 span 梯度与严格梯度的方向一致性和幅度比做诊断。
Result: 严格 1:1 组已覆盖学生生成 token 的大部分，共享词表在严格对齐位置平均保留几乎全部教师与学生概率质量；top-16 子集 reverse KL 的精度与全共享词表 OPD 相当，并优于所评测的跨 tokenizer 基线；加入 span MSE 后覆盖完整但精度下降，且 span 梯度与严格梯度方向一致度弱或为负、幅度相对增长。
Conclusion: 紧凑但可靠的严格位置监督比引入弱对齐或冲突信号的更广覆盖更有效，OPD 应优先保证监督可靠性而非对齐覆盖率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AssemState: Manual and Physical-State-Guided Reasoning for Zero-shot Furniture Assembly
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made significant progress in visual understanding, but precise 3D spatial reasoning integrated with physical environment remains difficult. Furniture assembly requires not only recovering step-level operations from diagrammatic manuals, but also translating semantic attachment relations into 6D pose updates that enable parts to physically interact with the environment and previously assembled components. To study this problem, we propose AssemState, a zero-shot framework for manual and physical-state-guided furniture assembly. It firstly employs anchor-guided boundary assembly states to decompose manual pages into single-part operations and recover an assembly-tree. Then, it uses iterative after-state feedback refinement to guide successive (SE(3)) updates and corrections, and validates their physical plausibility through simulation-based release tests. Experiments show that compared with the strongest prior baseline, AssemState improves F1 from 38.58\% to 62.80\% and Tree Exact Match from 28.24\% to 53.92\% for assembly-tree recovery. On 243 independently evaluated part-level operations, our proposed iterative refinement improves judge-accepted operations from 0 to 5.3\% and reduces mean Chamfer distance from 5.4111 to 1.7744. However, visually plausible candidate poses may still suffer from collision, floating, mirror-orientation errors, incomplete seating, and wrong-side attachment. These results show that AssemState improves operation-structure recovery and selected local pose metrics, while MLLMs remain limited for spatial relationship reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AssemState 是零样本家具装配框架：用 anchor-guided boundary assembly state 把说明书页面拆成单件操作并恢复 assembly-tree，再用迭代 after-state feedback 做 SE(3) 位姿更新，并用仿真 release test 校验物理合理性。相比最强基线，assembly-tree 恢复 F1 从 38.58% 提到 62.80%、Tree Exact Match 从 28.24% 提到 53.92%；243 个部件级操作上 judge-accepted 比例从 0 升到 5.3%，平均 Chamfer distance 从 5.4111 降到 1.7744。
Motivation: MLLM 视觉理解已有进展，但从图示说明书恢复步骤级操作、再把语义连接关系转成能与环境和已装配件交互的 6D 位姿更新仍然困难。
Method: 先用 anchor-guided boundary assembly states 把说明书页分解为单件操作并恢复 assembly-tree；再用迭代 after-state feedback refinement 引导连续 SE(3) 更新与修正，并通过 simulation-based release test 验证物理合理性，全程零样本。
Result: 相对最强先前基线，assembly-tree 恢复 F1 从 38.58% 升至 62.80%，Tree Exact Match 从 28.24% 升至 53.92%；在 243 个独立评估的部件级操作上，迭代 refinement 使 judge-accepted 操作从 0 升到 5.3%，平均 Chamfer distance 从 5.4111 降到 1.7744。
Conclusion: AssemState 改善了操作结构恢复与所选局部位姿指标，但视觉上合理的候选位姿仍可能出现碰撞、悬浮、镜像朝向、未完全落座与装反面等错误，MLLM 在空间关系推理上仍受限。

papers.title: Scalable Regularized Vector Multiplicative Error Models for Positive-valued Financial Time Series
papers.abstract_en: The logarithmic multiplicative error model (log-vMEM) has been useful in modeling and forecasting multivariate positive-valued financial time series. The number of parameters grow rapidly with the dimension of the system and the lag order, making estimation computationally demanding in high-dimensional settings. This paper describes regularized estimation via hierarchical lag structures (Nicholson et al., 2020) for log-vMEM models with multivariate gamma error distribution of Tsionas (2004). The parameter estimation is performed using a blockwise coordinate descent algorithm with a Gauss-Seidel-style update scheme (Wright, 2015). This enables an efficient computation strategy compared to traditional penalized maximum likelihood approaches. The competing models are juxtaposed against each other by combining three hierarchical lag structures (componentwise, elementwise, own-other) and four penalties(group-lasso, adaptive group-lasso, group-mcp, and group-scad). Extensive simulation runs have been performed to test the parameter recovery for both the unpenalized and the penalized models. We apply the proposed methods to model the joint dynamics of robust intraday realized volatility measures for Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) for the competing models. The numerical integration step of the log-likelihood is identified to be the principal computational bottleneck. We address this issue by using GPU-accelerated quadrature integration thus improving computational scalability of the proposed models.
papers.comment: ISBIS-STATFIN Conference 2026 contributed talk (Conference link: https://statfin.cmi.ac.in/ISBIS2026/, Talk link: https://statfin.cmi.ac.in/ISBIS2026/#:~:text=72-,Rohan%20Chattre,-UConn)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向高维正值金融时间序列的 log-vMEM，用层级滞后结构加 group 惩罚做正则化估计，并以分块坐标下降（Gauss-Seidel 式更新）和 GPU 加速求积解决对数似然数值积分瓶颈。模拟检验参数恢复，实证用于 MSFT 日内稳健已实现波动率的联合动态建模。
Motivation: log-vMEM 的参数量随系统维度与滞后阶数快速增长，高维下传统惩罚极大似然估计计算代价过高，难以用于多资产高频波动率联合建模。
Method: 在 Tsionas (2004) 多元 gamma 误差分布下，结合 Nicholson et al. (2020) 的三种层级滞后结构（componentwise、elementwise、own-other）与四种惩罚（group-lasso、adaptive group-lasso、group-mcp、group-scad），用 Wright (2015) 的分块坐标下降加 Gauss-Seidel 式更新做正则化估计；对数似然的数值积分改用 GPU 加速求积。
Result: 模拟实验检验未惩罚与惩罚模型的参数恢复；实证应用于 Microsoft（NASDAQ: MSFT）日内稳健已实现波动率的联合动态建模，对比三种滞后结构与四种惩罚的组合；识别出对数似然的数值积分是主要计算瓶颈，GPU 加速求积提升了模型的计算可扩展性。
Conclusion: 层级滞后结构加 group 惩罚的分块坐标下降可让高维 log-vMEM 的估计更高效，GPU 求积是突破似然积分瓶颈、实现可扩展计算的关键。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HuC-VideoMAE: Human-Centric Video Masked Autoencoding from synthetic data
papers.abstract_en: Modern action recognition models rely on video transformers pretrained on massive collections of web-crawled videos, such as Kinetics-700. However, the use of such data raises ethical concerns, as subjects' consent is typically not obtained. Recent high-quality synthetic video datasets generated from motion-capture data, such as BEDLAM2.0, offer a promising ethical alternative. In this work, we investigate self-supervised pretraining of video transformers on synthetic human-motion datasets. We first show that directly applying the standard VideoMAE masking strategy leads to substantially worse performance than pretraining on Kinetics. To address this limitation, we propose a human-centric masking scheme that leverages body keypoints and person bounding box regions. Our approach encourages the model to focus on the structure and dynamics of human motion during pretraining. Experiments on NTU RGB+D and Toyota-Smarthome demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms standard VideoMAE pretraining on synthetic data, closing 49% of the gap to Kinetics pretraining on NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject without using a single real frame during pretraining. To promote the use of ethical action recognition models, we will publicly release our pretrained models.
papers.journal_ref: ECCV 2026 Workshop on Privacy, Fairness, Accountability and Transparency in Computer Vision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在合成人体动作数据 BEDLAM2.0 上做视频 Transformer 自监督预训练时，直接套用标准 VideoMAE 掩码会明显掉点；改用结合人体关键点与人框区域的人本掩码 (human-centric masking)，让模型聚焦人体结构与动态。在 NTU RGB+D 跨视角跨受试设定下，该方法相对标准 VideoMAE 预训练显著提升，并在完全不用真实帧的前提下补上了与 Kinetics 预训练差距的 49%。
Motivation: 动作识别模型依赖 Kinetics-700 等网络爬取视频，未获被摄者同意，存在伦理问题；而直接在合成人体动作数据上套用标准 VideoMAE 掩码，性能远差于在 Kinetics 上预训练，使合成数据难以替代真实数据。
Method: 在合成人体动作数据集上对视频 Transformer 做 VideoMAE 式自监督掩码预训练，并提出人本掩码方案：利用人体关键点 (body keypoints) 与人物 bounding box 区域决定掩码位置，引导模型关注人体运动的结构与动态。
Result: 在 NTU RGB+D 与 Toyota-Smarthome 上评测，该方法显著优于在合成数据上的标准 VideoMAE 预训练；在 NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject 设定下，预训练阶段不使用任何真实帧即补上了与 Kinetics 预训练差距的 49%。
Conclusion: 合成人体动作数据配合人本掩码可以替代真实视频做伦理友好的动作识别预训练，掩码策略必须针对人体结构与动态设计，直接沿用标准 VideoMAE 掩码行不通；预训练模型将公开发布。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 在合成人体动作数据集上对视频 Transformer 做 VideoMAE 式自监督掩码预训练，并提出人本掩码方案：利用人体关键点 (body keypoints) 与人物 bounding box 区域决定掩码位置，引导模型关注人体运动的结构与动态。
summary_sections.result: 在 NTU RGB+D 与 Toyota-Smarthome 上评测，该方法显著优于在合成数据上的标准 VideoMAE 预训练；在 NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject 设定下，预训练阶段不使用任何真实帧即补上了与 Kinetics 预训练差距的 49%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 合成人体动作数据配合人本掩码可以替代真实视频做伦理友好的动作识别预训练，掩码策略必须针对人体结构与动态设计，直接沿用标准 VideoMAE 掩码行不通；预训练模型将公开发布。

papers.title: EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces
papers.abstract_en: Improving embodied agents often focuses on optimizing the underlying model through training, while the surrounding agent harness that controls planning, context, and tool use is typically engineered. We ask whether this harness can instead improve itself directly from experience traces under sparse environmental feedback. We propose EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization (EMHO), a self-evolving framework that keeps the embodied model frozen and iteratively revises its harness by analyzing execution trajectories and prior harness history. EMHO optimizes beyond skills or recovery prompts, modifying how the agent monitors progress, uses vision tools, grounds observations, and responds to failures. To support multiple subtasks with a single harness, we introduce EMHO-Merge, which addresses trade-offs in jointly optimizing a single shared harness across subtasks by using episode-level gains and losses to guide evidence-supported refinement of when and how revised behaviors are applied. We evaluate EMHO on EmbodiedBench across navigation and manipulation tasks, and EMHO consistently improves task success for both Qwen 9B and 27B models. Qualitative analysis shows that EMHO goes beyond recovering from failures and unproductive actions to reshape how the embodied agent interprets and interacts with its environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EMHO 让具身智能体的 harness（控制规划、上下文与工具使用的外壳）在模型冻结的前提下靠执行轨迹自我改写，而非靠训练模型。在 EmbodiedBench 的导航与操作任务上，EMHO 对 Qwen 9B 与 27B 均一致提升任务成功率，EMHO-Merge 用 episode 级增益/损失协调共享 harness 在多子任务间的取舍。
Motivation: 具身智能体改进通常只优化底层模型，harness 靠人工工程化；在稀疏环境反馈下，harness 能否直接从经验轨迹 (experience traces) 自我改进尚无答案。
Method: EMHO 冻结具身模型，迭代分析执行轨迹与既往 harness 历史来修订 harness，改动覆盖进度监控、视觉工具使用、观测 grounding 与失败响应；EMHO-Merge 用 episode 级增益与损失指导共享 harness 在多子任务上的证据支持式修订。
Result: 在 EmbodiedBench 的导航与操作任务上，EMHO 对 Qwen 9B 和 27B 模型均一致提升任务成功率；定性分析显示其作用超出恢复失败与无效动作，重塑了智能体解释和交互环境的方式。
Conclusion: 在模型冻结的条件下，仅靠修订 harness 也能稳定提升具身任务成功率，harness 本身可作为从经验轨迹优化的对象。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: NeMo-DCR: Bit-Exact Delta-Compressed Refit for Scalable Agentic RL at Trillion-Parameter Scale
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) disaggregates training from rollout, so each policy update must reach the rollout clusters before the next batch. Transferring a full 1T checkpoint for such weight synchronization (refit) takes 87.5 min between two AWS regions. Measurements of BF16 training show that about 1% of weights change their stored values per step. Recent systems exploit this sparsity but fall short on placement, exactness, or efficiency: they reimplement placement rules, assemble full tensors, rebuild values arithmetically, or use a cross-cluster collective, and none fully recovers from mid-refit failures. We present NeMo-DCR (Delta-Compressed Refit), which sends only changes yet is bit-exact: receivers obtain the same parameter and buffer bits as a dense refit. For placement, fixed affine mappings project changes from training shards into the checkpoint's canonical coordinates, residual conversion covers the other changes, and the serving runtime's native loader places all changes in receiver storage. For exactness, compressible XOR masks carry affine changes whose projection and loader preserve stored bits, and overwrites carry the others. Receivers apply both in place, retries overwrite partial writes, and a joint commit binds the policy to the baseline for the next delta. For efficiency, object storage or a relay tree streams payloads during delta construction, without a cross-cluster collective. Even at 3% and 5% change rates, NeMo-DCR refits of 30B-1T models are 12-40$\times$ faster than a transport-only full-checkpoint reference. A 1T relay-tree refit at 3% takes 150 s instead of 87.5 min, making refits practical for cross-cluster agentic RL at trillion-parameter scale.
papers.comment: The code is open-sourced in NVIDIA NeMo RL PR #2444 at https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/RL/pull/2444
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeMo-DCR 只传输每步变化的权重位并保证与稠密 refit 位级一致 (bit-exact)，使跨集群 agentic RL 的万亿参数权重同步从 87.5 分钟降到 150 秒。
Motivation: Agentic RL 把训练与 rollout 分离，每次策略更新都必须把 checkpoint 送达 rollout 集群；1T 全量 checkpoint 跨 AWS 区域传输需 87.5 分钟，而 BF16 训练每步仅约 1% 权重改变存储值，现有稀疏方案在放置、位级精确性、效率或 mid-refit 失败恢复上不完整。
Method: NeMo-DCR 用固定仿射映射把训练 shard 的变化投影到 checkpoint 规范坐标，残差转换覆盖其余变化，由 serving runtime 原生 loader 放置；可压缩 XOR 掩码承载仿射变化、overwrite 承载其余，原地应用、重试覆盖部分写入、联合 commit 绑定策略与基线；delta 构建期间用对象存储或 relay tree 流式传输，不依赖跨集群 collective。
Result: BF16 训练实测约 1% 权重每步改变存储值；在 3% 与 5% 变化率下，30B–1T 模型的 NeMo-DCR refit 比仅做传输优化的全量 checkpoint 参考快 12–40 倍；1T relay-tree refit 在 3% 变化率下耗时 150 秒，而全量传输为 87.5 分钟。
Conclusion: 只发送变化且位级等价于稠密 refit 的方案，配合 relay tree 流式传输，可让万亿参数规模的跨集群 agentic RL 权重同步变得实际可行。

papers.title: Symmetry-Aware Feature Learning: A Polynomial Separation for Multi-Index Models
papers.abstract_en: We establish a polynomial sample complexity separation between symmetry-aware and symmetry-agnostic feature learning. We study growing-rank multi-index models with high-dimensional Gaussian covariates in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and $r=Θ(d^δ)$ teacher directions forming a cyclic symmetry orbit, where $0<δ<1/2$. We compare three ways of exploiting this structure: architectural weight sharing, data augmentation over the full symmetry group, and learning without access to the symmetry. In particular, we analyze a symmetry-tied convolutional network, an untied network, and the same untied network trained with full-group data augmentation, using spherical online SGD with correlation loss. For a class of polynomial links with information exponent $p\ge3$, we prove matching sample complexity bounds up to logarithmic factors: the tied and augmented learners achieve weak directional recovery in $\widetildeΘ(d^{p-1})$ samples, whereas the symmetry-agnostic learner requires $\widetildeΘ(rd^{p-1})$. For the pure quadratic Hermite link, the same separation holds for weak recovery of the teacher subspace, with sample complexities $\widetildeΘ(d)$ and $\widetildeΘ(rd)$, respectively. Thus, full-group data augmentation matches the sample efficiency of architectural weight sharing, and both provide a polynomial advantage over training without symmetry. For $p\ge3$, the proof reveals a two-stage mechanism: fluctuations at initialization select one direction in the teacher orbit, after which localized growth amplifies its overlap to the weak recovery scale while competing overlaps remain near their initialization scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高斯协变量、r=Θ(d^δ) 个教师方向构成循环对称轨道的 growing-rank multi-index 模型上，证明对称感知特征学习相对对称无关学习存在多项式样本复杂度分离：对信息指数 p≥3 的多项式 link，权重共享网络与全群数据增强都只需 ~Θ(d^{p-1}) 样本达到方向弱恢复，而对称无关学习需 ~Θ(rd^{p-1})。纯二次 Hermite link 下子空间弱恢复同样分离，~Θ(d) 对 ~Θ(rd)。
Motivation: 对称结构可以通过架构权重共享或数据增强两种途径利用，但二者在样本效率上是否等价、相对完全不用对称的训练能带来多大优势，此前缺少严格的样本复杂度刻画。
Method: 研究 growing-rank multi-index 模型：d 维高斯协变量，r=Θ(d^δ)（0<δ<1/2）个教师方向形成循环对称轨道。比较三种利用方式——对称绑定 (tied) 卷积网络、非绑定网络、以及非绑定网络加全对称群数据增强；训练用 spherical online SGD 配 correlation loss。对 p≥3 的多项式 link 给出匹配（至多差对数因子）的样本复杂度上下界，并对纯二次 Hermite link 单独处理子空间弱恢复。
Result: p≥3 多项式 link 下，tied 与 augmented 学习者达到方向弱恢复需 ~Θ(d^{p-1}) 样本，对称无关学习者需 ~Θ(rd^{p-1})；纯二次 Hermite link 下子空间弱恢复分别为 ~Θ(d) 与 ~Θ(rd)。证明揭示两阶段机制：初始化涨落先在教师轨道中选出一个方向，随后局域化增长把该方向的重叠放大到弱恢复尺度，其余重叠停留在初始化尺度。
Conclusion: 全群数据架构权重共享在样本效率上等价，且相对无对称信息训练给出多项式级优势；分离的机制是初始化选择加定向增长的两阶段过程。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Deformable CT-US Registration via Anatomy-Aware Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Slice-to-volume registration between ultrasound (US) and preoperative computed tomography (CT) imaging would enhance many minimally invasive interventions, for example by locating soft tissue structures intra-operatively that are discernible in CT. While optical tracking enables initial rigid registration, contact from the probe induces soft tissue deformations that inhibit accurate alignment. In this work, we introduce a deformable CT-ultrasound registration framework that incorporates anatomical priors derived from CT to improve registration under deformation. Rigid registration is first established using a robot-assisted optical tracking system, after which a deformable transformation is estimated using a sinusoidal implicit neural representation (SIREN) optimized per frame. Tissue stiffness is approximated from CT-based HU values and used as spatially varying regularization, suppressing deformation in rigid structures such as bone while allowing more flexibility in soft tissue. Two additional constraints capture the physics of probe contact: a contact-zone displacement prior that drives the displacement field to compress tissue below the probe face, and a fan-geometry regularization term based on beam direction and convex transducer field of view. Model parameters are optimized with a normalized gradient field (NGF). The proposed approach improves alignment over rigid initialisation by 17% and outperforms classical deformable baselines while maintaining near-zero topological folding.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Advances in Simplifying Medical UltraSound (ASMUS 2026), held with MICCAI 2026; to appear in Springer LNCS 17276 (MICCAI 2026 Workshops and Challenges). Open-access camera-ready: https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2026-sat/ASMUS_047.html
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 CT-超声形变配准框架：先用机器人辅助光学跟踪做刚性配准，再逐帧优化正弦隐式神经表示 (SIREN) 的形变场，用 CT 的 HU 值近似组织刚度作空间可变正则，并加入探头接触位移先验与扇形几何正则。相对刚性初始化对齐改善 17%，优于经典形变基线，同时保持接近零的拓扑折叠。
Motivation: 术中超声探头接触会使软组织形变，导致与术前 CT 的对齐失效，而光学跟踪只能给出刚性初始位姿，缺少利用 CT 解剖先验约束形变的手段。
Method: 刚性配准由机器人辅助光学跟踪系统建立；形变用逐帧优化的 SIREN 表示，以 CT HU 值近似组织刚度作空间可变正则（抑制骨等刚性结构、允许软组织形变），并加入接触区位移先验（压缩探头下方组织）与基于波束方向和凸面换能器视野的扇形几何正则；模型参数用归一化梯度场 (NGF) 优化。
Result: 相对刚性初始配准改善 17%，并优于经典形变基线，同时保持接近零的拓扑折叠 (near-zero topological folding)。
Conclusion: 把 CT 派生的解剖与接触物理先验写进形变正则，可在探头接触形变下把 CT-US 配准做得比刚性和经典形变方法更准且不产生折叠。

papers.title: From the Drosophila Visual Connectome to General-Purpose Computer Vision
authors: for the Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Neuroimaging Initiative
for the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
papers.abstract_en: Biological connectomes encode structured solutions to visual computation that may provide reusable inductive biases for artificial vision. We develop ConnectomeX around FlyVision, a trainable architecture that preserves parallel ON/OFF processing, recurrent computation and population-level graph interaction while scaling model capacity across tasks. FlyVision reached 99.34% accuracy on MNIST with 80,608 parameters and 78.03% on CIFAR-10 with 81,408 parameters. On ImageNet-1K, FlyVision Base and Large reached 60.79% and 66.25% top-1 accuracy with 1.8 and 3.7 million parameters, while a Large local-k7 model with a learned low-frequency branch reached 66.53%, compared with 69.25% for ResNet18 with 11.7 million parameters. On a 22-class skin-disease benchmark, FlyVision Large achieved 63.78% accuracy and 95.28% macro-AUROC with 2.99 million parameters. In four-class chest radiography, ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Base and Large reached 92.60% and 92.76% accuracy with 1.33 and 2.97 million parameters, compared with 91.56% for ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 with 11.18 million. BrainAGE extends FlyVision to volumetric T1-weighted MRI by applying a shared ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder to 24 sagittal, coronal and axial slices per scan and combining slice-level age estimates by confidence-modulated Gaussian voting. On 433 held-out scans, three-axis fusion achieved a mean absolute error of 5.98 years and R^2 = 0.868. Across the 224x224 classification tasks, the best FlyVision configuration remained within three percentage points of ResNet18 on ImageNet-1K and skin-disease classification and exceeded it on chest radiography with substantially fewer parameters. papers.title: Ariadne's Thread of LipSync: Unraveling Forgeries via Inconsistency between Lip Motions and Head Poses
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in LipSync generation technology have led to the creation of highly realistic videos, posing severe societal risks. However, existing defense strategies struggle against LipSync forgeries, as advanced LipSync generation methods not only achieve better lip synchronization but also eliminate visual artifacts. An important reason is that they overlook an inherent biological coupling between lip movements and head poses in natural speech videos. In this paper, we propose LipDA, a novel framework for joint LipSync Detection and Attribution, which takes advantage of the inconsistency between head and lip. For detection, the framework learns to quantify this discrepancy by contrasting lip and pose features from authentic versus forged videos. For attribution, our method is designed to capture the unique temporal dynamics and audio-visual synchronization patterns that act as the fingerprint of models, enabling source tracing. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging LipSync datasets as well as our own proposed large-scale and multi-generator dataset. LipDA achieves over 97\% AUC in detection and 97.5\% accuracy in model attribution, significantly outperforming existing methods. Code and the proposed LipSync-A dataset are available at https://github.com/AnsonShe/LipDA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LipDA，用唇动与头部姿态之间的生物学耦合不一致来检测并归因 LipSync 伪造：检测端对比真实与伪造视频的唇部/姿态特征差异，归因端捕捉各生成模型特有的时序动态与音画同步模式作为指纹。在两个公开 LipSync 数据集及自建多生成器 LipSync-A 上，检测 AUC 超过 97%，模型归因准确率 97.5%，显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 先进 LipSync 生成方法在提升唇同步质量的同时消除了视觉伪影，现有防御依赖视觉痕迹因而失效；唇动与头姿的天然耦合这一被忽视的生物一致性信号可作为新判据。
Method: LipDA 框架联合做检测与归因：检测端通过对比真实与伪造视频的唇部特征和头部姿态特征来量化二者不一致；归因端建模各生成模型独有的时序动态与音画同步模式作为来源指纹。
Result: 在两个公开 LipSync 数据集及自建的大规模多生成器 LipSync-A 数据集上，检测 AUC 超过 97%，模型归因准确率 97.5%，显著优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 唇动与头姿的耦合不一致是 LipSync 伪造的可利用信号，联合检测与来源归因可同时实现识别与溯源；代码与 LipSync-A 数据集已开源。

papers.title: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding for Privacy-Friendly AIoT
papers.abstract_en: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications. In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstreams without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation. To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出直接在编码图像字节序列上做细粒度分类与描述生成的 IBFU 范式，并给出基础模型 Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG)，由 Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) 直接建模比特流语义、Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG) 自回归生成描述，全程不把图像解码到像素域。在自建的 Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D) 上，比特流受损时 BFG 在 Stanford Dogs Caption 上平均 CIDEr 仅从 0.6339 变到 0.6077，而 Qwen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM、Gemini、GPT 等视觉语言模型性能严重下降。
Motivation: AIoT 管线中图像在传输与存储环节会发生比特流损坏，而先解码到像素域再理解既暴露视觉内容又对损坏敏感，隐私友好场景需要不重建像素的细粒度理解路径。
Method: BFG 包含 BSeE 与 FSeG：BSeE 直接从编码比特流建模语义表征、不做显式像素重建，FSeG 把比特流语义自回归转成自然语言描述；训练与评测依托自建的 CFU-D 数据集，覆盖完整比特流与多种损坏类型、多个严重度等级的变体。
Result: 在 Stanford Dogs Caption 上，比特流损坏下 BFG 平均 CIDEr 从 0.6339 仅变为 0.6077，保持稳定的细粒度描述生成；同条件下 Qwen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM、Gemini、GPT 等视觉语言模型性能严重下降。
Conclusion: 不重建像素、直接在比特流上做细粒度理解，可以在传输存储损坏下保持描述生成稳定，为隐私友好的 AIoT 提供可行范式。

papers.title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Cross-Domain and Multi-Turn Generalization of Latent Underspecification Signals
papers.abstract_en: Large language models routinely answer questions that cannot be answered from the information given, and in dialogue they answer before enough has been said. Unanswerability is linearly decodable from hidden states, but it is unclear which of its forms share a representation and whether the signal is useful in dialogue. We contribute a turn-labeled multi-turn benchmark (423 conversations, 1,661 labeled turn-states) and an evaluation harness with a simulated user who answers clarifying questions, and use them with six datasets and six open-weight LLMs to test how far probes for unanswerability carry. Probes transfer robustly between datasets that share a ground of unanswerability: missing information in math (AUROC 0.77-0.97) and in a passage (SQuAD 2.0<->MuSiQue, 0.77-0.90). Probes for epistemic "known-unknowns" transfer poorly to math, but this separation weakens under lexical controls and changes with layer and coordinate system, so it remains unresolved. Single-turn probes fail zero-shot to detect when a conversation becomes answerable; in-structure probes recover it, but no better than a bag-of-words classifier. A gate on the calibrated probe, with no model fine-tuning, fires on underspecified turns far more precisely than chance, and its end-task success comes within 0.08 of a gate given the true labels. Yet across four models it does not reliably beat vanilla generation or prompted consolidation. The remaining gap lies mostly in how models use a clarification, not in detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文构建带轮次标注的多轮不可回答性基准（423 段对话、1,661 个轮次状态标注），配合含模拟用户的评测框架，用六个数据集与六个开源 LLM 检验不可回答性线性探针的跨域与跨轮迁移。共享不可回答性根源的数据集间探针迁移稳健（数学缺信息 AUROC 0.77–0.97，SQuAD 2.0↔MuSiQue 0.77–0.90），但单轮探针零样本无法识别对话何时变得可回答；基于校准探针的门控虽远高于随机精度、端到端成功率达真值门控的 0.08 以内，却并不稳定优于 vanilla generation 与 prompted consolidation，剩余差距主要在模型如何使用澄清而非检测本身。
Motivation: 大模型会回答给定信息无法回答的问题，在多轮对话中还会在信息说够之前就作答；不可回答性虽可从隐层线性解码，但其不同形式是否共享表征、该信号在对话中是否有用仍不清楚。
Method: 提出轮次标注的多轮基准（423 段对话、1,661 个轮次状态）与含模拟用户（会回答澄清问题）的评测框架；在六个数据集与六个开源 LLM 上训练不可回答性探针并测试跨数据集、跨轮次迁移，辅以词汇控制 (lexical controls)、分层与坐标系变化分析；在探针校准值上加门控，不微调模型。
Result: 共享不可回答性根源的数据集间探针迁移稳健：数学缺信息 AUROC 0.77–0.97，段落缺信息 SQuAD 2.0↔MuSiQue 0.77–0.90；epistemic known-unknown 探针迁移到数学表现差，但该分离在词汇控制下减弱、且随层与坐标系变化而改变。单轮探针零样本无法检测对话何时变得可回答，结构内探针可恢复但不优于词袋分类器。门控触发精度远高于随机，端到端成功与真值标签门控差距在 0.08 以内；跨四个模型并不稳定优于 vanilla generation 或 prompted consolidation。
Conclusion: 不可回答性检测本身已基本够用，多轮问答门控的剩余瓶颈在于模型如何利用澄清信息，而非识别未充分指定的轮次。

papers.title: Decoy and disclosure radii of invariant shape descriptors
papers.abstract_en: A recognizer that compares rotation-invariant descriptors sees a surface only up to the fiber of the descriptor. We measure this fiber by its radius in the orbit distance from the enrolled surface. A large radius admits decoys, that is, distant shapes that pass the matcher. A small radius discloses the enrolled shape to anyone who captures the stored value. For star-shaped surfaces truncated to spherical harmonics of degree at most $L$, with $n$ coefficients, a descriptor of generic rank $r$ has generic fibers of dimension $n-3-r$ modulo rotations. The standard pool of band powers, even bispectra, and three invariants of the degree-three band therefore admits decoy families of dimension $5$, $13$, $20$ at $L=4,6,8$. Its rank first reaches $n-3$ at $L=16$, and a mirror decoy remains at every $L$. The odd bispectra remove the mirror decoy generically for $L \geq 4$. Yet at fixed mean radius the same pool determines the enclosed volume exactly, and it does not determine whether a surface meets a clearance requirement. We certify two cases by exact and interval arithmetic. At $L=6$ a decoy matches all $32$ invariants to relative precision $2 \cdot 10^{-18}$ at orbit distance at least $0.87$ times the norm of the enrolled tuple. For the radar shape model of asteroid (101955) Bennu, the pool recovers the modeled volume, misses the handedness, and leaves the keep-out radius uncertain by more than $7 \, \mathrm{m}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在旋转不变描述子的比对框架下，把识别子的纤维半径定义为诱饵 (decoy) 与泄露 (disclosure) 的统一度量：半径大则远距离形状能通过匹配，半径小则存储值直接暴露真实形状。对截断到 L 阶球谐的星形曲面，band powers、even bispectra 与三阶 band 三个不变量在 L=4,6,8 分别留下维数 5、13、20 的诱饵族，L=16 才达到满秩 n-3 且镜像诱饵始终存在；加入 odd bispectra 可在 L≥4 一般性地消掉镜像诱饵。
Motivation: 旋转不变描述子只把曲面看到其纤维为止，纤维半径直接决定匹配器是否会被远距离诱饵欺骗、以及存储的描述子是否泄露真实形状；对小行星等需要体积与 keep-out 半径的场景，这一风险需要可判定的度量。
Method: 对截断到 L 阶球谐、含 n 个系数的星形曲面，按轨道距离 (orbit distance) 定义描述子纤维半径，推导一般秩 r 的纤维维数 n-3-r（模旋转）；用精确算术与区间算术认证两个具体案例，并在雷达形状模型上检验不变量池。
Result: 不变量池在 L=4,6,8 分别留下维数 5、13、20 的诱饵族，秩到 L=16 才达到 n-3 且镜像诱饵始终存在，odd bispectra 在 L≥4 一般性去掉镜像诱饵；固定平均半径下该池精确确定所围体积，却无法判定曲面是否满足 clearance 要求。L=6 时一个诱饵以相对精度 2×10⁻¹⁸ 匹配全部 32 个不变量，轨道距离至少为已注册元组范数的 0.87 倍。对小行星 Bennu (101955) 的雷达形状模型，该池恢复建模体积、漏掉手性 (handedness)，keep-out 半径不确定度超过 7 m。
Conclusion: 不变量池在体积上可认证、在手性与 clearance/keep-out 半径上不可判定，因此匹配器的诱饵半径与泄露半径必须分开度量；odd bispectra 能消镜像诱饵但不解决 clearance 判定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learning from Failures: A Failure-Driven Prompt Refinement for LLM-Based Vulnerability Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models have emerged as promising tools for software vulnerability analysis, but their effectiveness depends heavily on prompt design. Existing research primarily compares prompting strategies using aggregate performance metrics, providing limited insight into why models fail or how prompts can be improved systematically. We propose Failure-Driven Prompt Refinement (FDPR), a methodology that analyzes recurring model failures to guide evidence-based prompt refinement. Using the Damn Vulnerable Java Application (DVJA), we identify recurring failure modes, including false positives, false negatives, unsupported reasoning, and CWE misclassification, and translate them into targeted prompt refinements. We then evaluate the resulting prompt on the Juliet Test Suite and perform cross-model validation to assess generalizability. The results show that failure-driven refinement improves the reliability of LLM-based vulnerability analysis while yielding reusable prompt design principles. More broadly, this work demonstrates that recurring model failures provide a principled foundation for prompt engineering, enabling the systematic development of more reliable LLM-based vulnerability analysis systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at CSoNet 2026. 15 pages, 6 figures/tables combined
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出失败驱动的提示词精炼方法 FDPR：先在 DVJA 上归纳 LLM 漏洞分析的反复失败模式（误报、漏报、无依据推理、CWE 误分类），再把每类失败翻译成针对性提示词修改，最后在 Juliet Test Suite 上评测并做跨模型验证。结果表明失败驱动的精炼提升了 LLM 漏洞分析的可靠性，并沉淀出可复用的提示词设计原则。
Motivation: 现有提示词策略研究只比聚合指标，说不清模型为何失败、提示词如何系统改进，漏洞分析的可靠性提升缺少可操作路径。
Method: FDPR 流程：在 Damn Vulnerable Java Application (DVJA) 上识别反复出现的失败模式（false positives、false negatives、unsupported reasoning、CWE misclassification），逐类转化为针对性提示词精炼；随后在 Juliet Test Suite 上评测精炼后的提示词，并做 cross-model validation 检验可迁移性。
Result: 在 Juliet Test Suite 上的评测与跨模型验证显示，失败驱动的精炼提升了 LLM 漏洞分析的可靠性，并产出可复用的提示词设计原则；摘要以定性结论呈现，未列出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 反复出现的模型失败可作为提示词工程的原则性依据，据此能系统地构建更可靠的 LLM 漏洞分析系统，且精炼出的提示词原则可跨模型复用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SSR: Sparse Segment Reduction for Ternary GEMM Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) require substantial computational resources, limiting their deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Ternary LLMs mitigate these demands through weight quantization via ternary values, achieving significant compression often with 50-90% sparsity. However, existing approaches have limitations: methods optimized for ternary weights, such as BitNet, redundant segment reduction (RSR), and its improved version RSR++, do not exploit sparsity structures, while conventional sparse formats neglect ternary characteristics, foregoing dual optimization opportunities. In this paper, we introduce Sparse Segment Reduction (SSR), a ternary matrix multiplication method designed to accelerate the inference of ternary LLMs and general Ternary Weight Networks (TWNs). SSR has a dedicated optimized ternary data format and an algorithm that systematically exploits sparsity patterns through computation trees that scale with the sparsity. SSR provides theoretical gains with asymptotically faster inference than RSR++ for sparsity above 50%, while practical evaluations reveal performance improvements across all sparsity levels. Evaluation results show that SSR achieves 2.1-11.3x speedup over RSR++ on ternary GEMM with 45-95% sparsity. Furthermore, SSR achieves 3.5-6.3x end-to-end speedup and 4.9% of memory saving over RSR++ on the Llama-3 1B model inference.
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the Design, Automation & Test in Europe Conference (DATE 2026)
papers.journal_ref: 2026 Design, Automation & Test in Europe Conference (DATE), pp. 1-7, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向三值权重 GEMM 的稀疏段归约 (SSR)：专用三值数据格式加随稀疏度扩展的计算树，同时利用三值特性与稀疏结构。稀疏度超过 50% 时渐近快于 RSR++，在 45–95% 稀疏度的三值 GEMM 上取得 2.1–11.3 倍加速。
Motivation: 三值 LLM 权重常有 50–90% 稀疏度，但 BitNet、RSR/RSR++ 等三值优化方法不利用稀疏结构，常规稀疏格式又忽略三值特性，两者无法叠加优化。
Method: SSR 设计专用三值数据格式，并用随稀疏度扩展的计算树 (computation trees) 系统利用稀疏模式，面向三值 LLM 与通用 Ternary Weight Networks (TWNs) 的推理加速。
Result: 在 45–95% 稀疏度的三值 GEMM 上相对 RSR++ 加速 2.1–11.3 倍；在 Llama-3 1B 模型推理上端到端加速 3.5–6.3 倍，内存节省 4.9%；稀疏度超过 50% 时相对 RSR++ 具有渐近更快的推理复杂度，且各稀疏度档位均有实际性能提升。
Conclusion: 把三值编码与稀疏结构放在同一套表示和调度里做联合优化，可以在各稀疏度下加速三值 GEMM，并在 Llama-3 1B 上转化为端到端收益。

papers.title: VETTA: Coordinating Turn- and Token-Level Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn LLM agents often receive sparse task feedback across several interactions, while generating each response token by token. This creates two related credit-assignment questions: which responses helped achieve the outcome, and which generation decisions mattered within each response? Existing methods typically focus on only one level: turn-level methods evaluate complete responses but do not distinguish the decisions within them; token-level methods can propagate feedback across turns but do not explicitly model credit for each response. These complementary limitations motivate learning credit at both levels and coordinating it in a single policy update. We introduce VETTA, a credit assignment method that jointly learns turn- and token-level values through separate heads on a shared lightweight critic. VETTA computes advantages along both temporal sequences and combines each turn advantage with a within-response-centered token residual for PPO updates. Furthermore, to reduce value-learning cost, the critic retains only early Transformer blocks from the pretrained checkpoint used to initialize the actor. On two challenging agent benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop, VETTA improves success rates over PPO by 37.5% and 22.3%, respectively, with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and achieves success rates of 95.5% and 76.0%, respectively, with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Critic-depth comparisons further show strong task performance with substantially lower critic-side computation. These results suggest that a compact shared critic can coordinate turn- and token-level credit to improve agent performance while keeping value estimation efficient. Code is available at https://github.com/Jiaju-Chen/VETTA-official.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VETTA 在共享轻量 critic 上加两个头，同时学 turn 级与 token 级价值，把 turn advantage 与以响应内为中心的 token residual 合并做 PPO 更新。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 相对 PPO 成功率分别提升 37.5% 与 22.3%，Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 达到 95.5% 与 76.0%。
Motivation: 多轮 LLM agent 只拿到稀疏任务反馈，turn 级方法不区分响应内部决策，token 级方法不显式建模每个响应的 credit，两者互补的缺口让单次策略更新难以同时定位。
Method: 在共享轻量 critic 上设独立的 turn 级与 token 级价值头，沿时间序列算 advantage，并把每个 turn advantage 与响应内居中的 token residual 结合后做 PPO 更新；critic 只保留用于初始化 actor 的预训练 Transformer 的前几层以降低价值学习开销。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 两个 agent benchmark 上，Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 的成功率相对 PPO 分别提高 37.5% 与 22.3%；Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 成功率分别为 95.5% 与 76.0%。critic 深度对比显示在大幅降低 critic 侧计算量的同时仍保持强任务表现。
Conclusion: 紧凑的共享 critic 足以协调 turn 级与 token 级 credit assignment，在提升多轮 agent 成功率的同时把价值估计开销控制在较低水平。

papers.title: GeoPID: Decomposing and Steering Visual Information in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose \textsc{GeoPID}, a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. \textsc{GeoPID} decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoPID 是一个免训练框架，用视觉与文本表示子空间的几何关系把 VLM 中的多模态信息分解为 Redundant、Modality-Unique、Synergistic 三部分，并在推理时选择性放大 vision-unique 子空间上的视觉表示。在 22 个 VLM、14 个 benchmark 上，需要强视觉接地的问题中正确预测呈现更强的 vision-unique 分量，干预后平均相对精度提升 7.63%，且不更新任何模型参数。
Motivation: VLM 普遍低估视觉信息、过度依赖文本上下文，缺少在推理阶段定位并增强视觉独有成分的手段。
Method: 免训练的 GeoPID：从几何视角分析视觉与文本表示子空间的关系，将多模态信息分解为 Redundant、Modality-Unique、Synergistic 三类分量；再基于该分解设计定向干预，在推理时选择性放大 vision-unique 子空间方向上的视觉表示，不做参数更新。
Result: 覆盖 22 个 VLM 与 14 个 benchmark 的分析显示：当问题强烈需要视觉接地时，正确预测具有更强的 vision-unique 分量；据此实施的干预使视觉接地能力增强，平均相对精度提升 7.63%，全程无参数更新。
Conclusion: VLM 的视觉接地不足可归因于 vision-unique 分量被压制，仅在推理期放大该子空间即可在不训练的前提下换来可观的相对精度收益。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Atom-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for 3D Atomistic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining has reshaped modern machine learning, substantially advancing the ability of language and vision models to generalize across downstream tasks. While deep learning has driven considerable progress in modeling atomistic systems in recent years, self-supervised pretraining in this domain has not yet achieved comparable downstream generalization. To address this, we introduce Atom-JEPA, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns latent representations from unlabeled 3D structures through complementary atom-level and substructure-level objectives inspired by joint-embedding predictive architectures. We pretrain Atom-JEPA on large-scale molecular and crystalline datasets and evaluate its transfer performance by fine-tuning on a diverse set of downstream property prediction tasks. Atom-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance on molecular ADMET and quantum-chemical property prediction tasks, and is highly competitive in predicting the physical properties of crystalline materials. These results demonstrate the potential of latent-space predictive pretraining to support broad downstream generalization from structural data alone. Code and pretrained model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/khelverskovp/atom-jepa

papers.title: UP-MOPD: Update Projection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation from multiple teachers combines expertise from different domains in a single student, but conflicting gradients can hinder this integration. Gradient corrections directly constrain parameter updates under plain SGD. With optimizers such as AdamW, however, momentum, adaptive scaling, and weight decay can turn a corrected gradient into an update that increases a domain loss to first order. To address this gap, we propose Update Projection for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (UP-MOPD). UP-MOPD lets the original mixed gradient update the optimizer state and generate a candidate displacement, then projects only violating candidates before they are committed to the parameters. The projection gives the unique feasible update closest to the candidate in Euclidean distance. In experiments combining medical and general domains, UP-MOPD improves IFEval-loose accuracy late in training by 2.96 points over vanilla M-OPD. It achieves an average score of 60.03 across eight metrics, compared with 59.00 for gradient projection and 59.15 for update rejection. On a public benchmark covering mathematics, code, and instruction following, it achieves the best average across six tasks (32.67), leads on LiveCodeBench v5, and ties for the best IFEval result.These results support projecting optimizer updates to reduce interference between domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UP-MOPD 在多教师在线蒸馏 (multi-teacher on-policy distillation) 中改在优化器更新层面做投影：让原始混合梯度照常更新 AdamW 的优化器状态并生成候选位移，只对违反约束的候选位移做欧氏距离最近的可行投影后再写入参数。在医疗+通用域实验中，训练后期 IFEval-loose 比 vanilla M-OPD 高 2.96 点，八项指标均分 60.03，高于梯度投影 59.00 与更新拒绝 59.15。
Motivation: 多教师在线蒸馏中不同域的梯度互相冲突；梯度修正只在 plain SGD 下直接约束参数更新，而 AdamW 的动量、自适应缩放和 weight decay 会把已修正的梯度变成一阶上反而增大某个域损失的更新。
Method: UP-MOPD：原始混合梯度照常更新优化器状态并产生候选位移，仅对违反约束的候选做投影（取与候选欧氏距离最近的唯一可行更新）后再提交到参数；对比 vanilla M-OPD、梯度投影 (gradient projection) 与更新拒绝 (update rejection)。
Result: 医疗与通用域合并实验中，训练后期 IFEval-loose 准确率比 vanilla M-OPD 高 2.96 点；八项指标平均 60.03，梯度投影 59.00，更新拒绝 59.15。在覆盖数学、代码与指令跟随的公开基准上，六任务均分 32.67 为最佳，LiveCodeBench v5 领先，IFEval 并列最佳。
Conclusion: 作者主张对优化器更新而非梯度做投影，可以减少多域蒸馏中域间干扰，且在 AdamW 下比梯度级修正更贴合实际的参数位移。

papers.title: Foresight-over-Graph: Reasoning Beyond Local Horizons for Knowledge Base Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in question answering, yet they still frequently suffer from hallucinations on knowledge-intensive tasks. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide LLMs with structured, interpretable, and updatable factual grounding, making them a promising external knowledge source for reliable reasoning. However, existing LLM-guided graph reasoning methods typically rely on hop-wise greedy or beam-style pruning during evidence retrieval. Such local decision processes are inherently myopic: evidence that appears weak near the source may become crucial only after deeper graph context is explored, causing answer-critical branches to be discarded prematurely and making the reasoning chain difficult to recover. To address this limitation, we propose Foresight-over-Graph (FoG), a foresight-aware evidence retrieval framework for knowledge base question answering (KBQA). FoG iteratively constructs a question-relevant evidence subgraph and uses far-to-near feedback to guide path exploration, and maintains a compact memory subgraph to support continued exploration. Extensive experiments on widely used KBQA benchmarks demonstrate that FoG achieves state-of-the-art performance, with a particularly large improvement of 16.58% in Hit on CWQ, while also reducing LLM calls and token usage. Our code is available at https://github.com/yhong7/FoG .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向知识库问答 (KBQA) 的前瞻式证据检索框架 Foresight-over-Graph (FoG)，用远到近反馈 (far-to-near guidance) 指导路径探索并维护紧凑记忆子图，避免逐跳贪心/束剪枝过早丢弃关键分支。在常用 KBQA 基准上达到 SOTA，CWQ 的 Hit 提升 16.58%，同时减少 LLM 调用与 token 用量。
Motivation: LLM 引导的图上推理多采用逐跳贪心或束式剪枝，属于局部短视决策：近源处看似弱的证据可能在更深图上下文中才关键，关键分支被过早剪掉且推理链难以恢复。
Method: FoG 迭代构建与问题相关的证据子图，用远到近反馈 (far-to-near feedback) 引导路径探索，并维护一个紧凑的记忆子图 (memory subgraph) 支持持续探索。
Result: 在常用 KBQA 基准上达到 state-of-the-art，CWQ 上 Hit 提升 16.58%，同时降低 LLM 调用次数与 token 用量。
Conclusion: 把前瞻信息引入证据检索、以远到近反馈替代局部逐跳剪枝，可在知识密集问答中减少幻觉相关的错误剪枝并取得 SOTA。

papers.title: Decision-Focused Learning in MDPs: An Occupancy Measure Approach
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we consider decision-focused learning (DFL) for a Markov decision process (MDP), where existing methods differentiate through the KKT conditions of the Bellman equation and require solving a linear system over all state-action pairs, limiting its scalability. We address this by reformulating the MDP as an occupancy measure-based linear program (LP), whose feasible region is induced by predicted dynamics, and we derive a closed-form gradient by identifying the active constraints in the feasible polyhedron via the pivoting algorithm. This occupancy measure-based LP layer raises two challenges: (1) LP's solution gradient is discontinuous when active constraints change, and (2) the LP backward cost still scales with the state size, which is costly for large or continuous state spaces. We address the challenges with an augmented Lagrangian surrogate and smooth the boundary jumps by random row sketching of the constraints, and a learnable soft state-aggregation layer and its function-approximation generalization that scales the LP to large finite and continuous-state MDPs. Across multiple tasks, our methods reach lower regret than KKT-based DFL and two-stage baselines with significantly lower computation cost. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/A-Eshragh/State_Aggregation_Project.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MDP 的决策聚焦学习 (decision-focused learning) 重写为以 occupancy measure 为变量的线性规划，用 pivoting 算法识别可行多面体的活跃约束直接导出闭式梯度，绕开对 Bellman 方程 KKT 条件求导并解全状态-动作线性系统的做法。活跃约束切换导致的梯度不连续用增广拉格朗日代理加约束行随机 sketching 抹平，再叠加可学习的软状态聚合层及其函数逼近推广，使 LP 可扩展到大规模有限与连续状态 MDP。在多个任务上该方法的 regret 低于 KKT 型 DFL 与两阶段基线，同时计算开销显著更低。
Motivation: 现有 MDP 决策聚焦学习要对 Bellman 方程的 KKT 条件求导，并在全部状态-动作对上解一个线性系统，代价随状态规模增长，难以扩展到大状态空间或连续状态空间。
Method: 把 MDP 改写为由预测动力学诱导可行域的 occupancy measure 线性规划 (LP)，用 pivoting 算法识别可行多面体的活跃约束，从而导出闭式梯度；针对活跃约束变化处 LP 解梯度不连续，用增广拉格朗日 (augmented Lagrangian) 代理并对约束做随机行 sketching 平滑边界跳变；再引入可学习的软状态聚合层及其函数逼近推广，把 LP 扩展到大规模有限与连续状态 MDP。
Result: 在多个任务上，该方法取得比 KKT 型 DFL 和两阶段 (two-stage) 基线更低的 regret，且计算成本显著更低；源码发布于 github.com/A-Eshragh/State_Aggregation_Project。
Conclusion: 以 occupancy measure LP 加活跃约束识别替代 KKT 求导，配合梯度平滑与状态聚合，可以在降低计算开销的同时改善 MDP 决策聚焦学习的 regret。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: UniCounting: Instance-Aware Proposal Consolidation for Image-Query-Free Multi-Category Counting
papers.abstract_en: Visual counting is commonly formulated as counting a single specified target, with a model receiving an image-specific exemplar, text query, or target category and returning a single count. We instead study fixed-vocabulary image-query-free multi-category counting. A global vocabulary is fixed for each run, and, given only an RGB image, the model predicts a complete category--count vector without being told which categories appear. We present UniCounting, which casts counting as instance-aware structural inference over an over-complete proposal set. Generic segmenters produce duplicate masks, partial views, and proposals from neighboring instances; semantic scores can name them but cannot determine which denote the same object. Frozen SAM~2.1 generates masks, while frozen DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features. A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head predicts same-instance affinities from instance-mask-derived supervision. Sparse graph construction, representative selection, labeling, and background-margin admission then convert each admitted component into one count with replayable group evidence. Only the relation head is trained, without count or density-map targets. On COCO clean500, UniCounting obtains lower point-estimate vector $\ell_1$ error and absent-class false mass than calibrated OWLv2-All80, with comparable micro presence F1. Under a matched decoder, the learned relation reduces both errors relative to mask containment, mask IoU, CLIP, and DINO, while revealing a fragmentation--merge trade-off. We also report transfer diagnostics on OmniCount-sub, FSC-147, and CARPK.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniCounting 把多类别计数重写为固定词表下的实例感知结构推断：冻结 SAM 2.1 出掩码、DINOv2 与 OpenCLIP 出关系与类别特征，只训练一个 3,267 参数的共享关系头预测同实例亲和度，再经稀疏图构建与代表选择把每个连通分量折算为一个计数。在 COCO clean500 上其向量 ℓ1 误差与 absent-class false mass 低于校准后的 OWLv2-All80，micro presence F1 相当；匹配解码器下学习到的关系优于 mask containment、mask IoU、CLIP 与 DINO，并呈现 fragmentation–merge 权衡。
Motivation: 常规视觉计数每次只针对一个指定目标（给示例、文本或类别），而固定词表、无图像查询的多类别计数要求模型在未被告知哪些类别出现的情况下直接输出完整类别-计数向量；通用分割器给出的重复掩码、部分视图与相邻实例提案无法由语义分数判定是否同一物体。
Method: 把计数建模为 over-complete 提案集上的实例感知结构推断：冻结 SAM 2.1 生成掩码，冻结 DINOv2 与 OpenCLIP 提供关系与类别特征；3,267 参数的类别共享关系头从实例掩码派生的监督预测 same-instance 亲和度；随后做稀疏图构建、代表选择、标注与 background-margin 准入，把每个被接纳分量折算为一个计数并保留可回放的组证据。仅训练关系头，不使用计数或密度图目标。
Result: 在 COCO clean500 上，UniCounting 的 point-estimate 向量 ℓ1 误差与 absent-class false mass 低于校准的 OWLv2-All80，micro presence F1 与之相当；在匹配解码器下，学习到的关系相对 mask containment、mask IoU、CLIP 与 DINO 同时降低两类误差，并显示 fragmentation–merge 权衡。另在 OmniCount-sub、FSC-147 与 CARPK 上给出迁移诊断。
Conclusion: 计数可以只靠实例关系推断而无需计数或密度图监督，语义分数负责命名、关系头负责判定同一物体；学到的关系在匹配解码器下优于几何与视觉-语言相似度判据，但存在 fragmentation 与 merge 的取舍。

summary_sections.result: 在 COCO clean500 上，UniCounting 的 point-estimate 向量 ℓ1 误差与 absent-class false mass 低于校准的 OWLv2-All80，micro presence F1 与之相当；在匹配解码器下，学习到的关系相对 mask containment、mask IoU、CLIP 与 DINO 同时降低两类误差，并显示 fragmentation–merge 权衡。另在 OmniCount-sub、FSC-147 与 CARPK 上给出迁移诊断。
summary_sections.conclusion: 计数可以只靠实例关系推断而无需计数或密度图监督，语义分数负责命名、关系头负责判定同一物体；学到的关系在匹配解码器下优于几何与视觉-语言相似度判据，但存在 fragmentation 与 merge 的取舍。

papers.title: Accelerating the Development of PLGA In Situ Forming Depots Through AI-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Developing long-acting injectable formulations requires the simultaneous optimization of drug loading, release kinetics, viscosity, injectability, stability and other objectives. To navigate this multidimensional space, Corbion and Intrepid combined Corbion's diverse PURASORB bioresorbable polymer library with Intrepid Labs' proprietary AI algorithm (ANDROMEDA 1) to develop in situ forming depots for a therapeutic peptide. Over approximately 15 weeks, 181 unique formulations spanning drug loadings of 6-12% w/w were prepared and characterized through broad design-space mapping and targeted multi-objective optimization. Four lead candidate formulations were identified at 6%, 9%, and 12% w/w drug loading. Each met the predefined viscosity and injectability criteria while providing distinct 30-day in vitro release profiles. The study evaluated polymers spanning a broad range of molecular weights, including commercially available PURASORB grades and new polymers under development by Corbion to expand its polymer toolbox. ANDROMEDA 1 identified that polymers with intermediate molecular weights provided a favorable balance between sustained release and solution viscosity. Together, these findings demonstrate how integrated polymer expertise and AI-driven optimization can rapidly identify differentiated formulation candidates, focus the development space, and establish a strong data-driven foundation for further optimization and in vivo evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PLGA 原位形成库 (in situ forming depot) 的多目标配方开发被 ANDROMEDA 1 算法与 PURASORB 聚合物库联合压缩：约 15 周内制备并表征 181 个独特配方，覆盖 6–12% w/w 载药量，最终筛出 4 个候选，分别位于 6%、9%、12% w/w。算法判定中等分子量聚合物在缓释与溶液黏度之间给出最佳平衡。
Motivation: 长效注射制剂需同时优化载药量、释放动力学、黏度、可注射性、稳定性等多个相互冲突的目标，多维配方空间靠经验试错探索成本高、周期长。
Method: Corbion 的 PURASORB 可降解聚合物库与 Intrepid Labs 的专有 AI 算法 ANDROMEDA 1 联合，先做大范围设计空间映射 (design-space mapping)，再做定向多目标优化；考察的聚合物覆盖很宽的分子量范围，含在售 PURASORB 等级与 Corbion 在研新聚合物，对象为某治疗性肽的原位形成库。
Result: 约 15 周内制备并表征 181 个独特配方，载药量跨度 6–12% w/w；筛出 4 个先导候选，分布于 6%、9%、12% w/w，均满足预设黏度与可注射性标准，并给出各异的 30 天体外释放曲线。ANDROMEDA 1 判定中等分子量聚合物在缓释与溶液黏度之间取得有利平衡。
Conclusion: 聚合物专业知识与 AI 驱动的多目标优化结合，可以快速收敛配方候选、收窄开发空间，并为后续优化与体内评价建立数据驱动基础。

papers.title: Evolutionary One-Step Generators: Fast and Diverse Sampling for Discrete Design
papers.abstract_en: Several discrete design tasks, such as molecular discovery, require diverse collections of useful candidates at low computational cost. High validity alone does not guarantee a useful candidate library: repeatedly generating the same valid structures leaves few distinct alternatives. Training for both feasibility and diversity is challenging because many relevant criteria can only be evaluated after hard decoding. To address this challenge, we propose EGO (Evolutionary Generators with One-step inference), a framework for training compact generators directly on discrete outputs. The method combines distribution matching with structural constraints and optional diversity or history-dependent rewards, using antithetic low-rank evolution strategies without requiring criterion-specific differentiable surrogates. Once trained, the generator produces the entire graph in a single neural-network evaluation. On molecular generation benchmarks, our compact generator achieves over $50\times$ the valid-and-unique yield per estimated dense operation compared to recent one-step flow-map baselines while retaining high chemical validity. In scaffold completion, EGO achieves an observed $44.3\times$ speedup over MoLeR in generation to SMILES and produces approximately $10\times$ as many filter-passing proposals within matched time budgets for generation and screening. Beyond chemistry, EGO produces $1.54\times$ as many distinct held-out elite architectures as relaxed gradient training on NAS-Bench-101. The low generation cost may enable real-time candidate generation across discrete design tasks, supporting interactive exploration of constrained design spaces and rapid construction of candidate sets for downstream evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出离散设计的一次性生成框架 EGO：用分布匹配加结构约束、可选多样性与历史依赖奖励，配合反向低秩进化策略 (antithetic low-rank evolution strategies) 直接在离散输出上训练紧凑生成器，无需针对准则的可微代理，训练后单次前向即生成整张图。在分子生成基准上，每估计一次密集运算的有效且唯一产出是近期 one-step flow-map 基线的 50 倍以上；scaffold completion 中相对 MoLeR 观测到 44.3 倍加速，同等生成与筛选时限内产出约 10 倍过筛候选；在 NAS-Bench-101 上产出的不同 held-out elite 架构是松弛梯度训练的 1.54 倍。
Motivation: 离散设计任务（如分子发现）需要低成本产出多样且有用的候选库，但只保证有效性会反复生成相同结构；而可行性与多样性相关的许多准则只能在硬解码之后评估，难以用可微代理训练。
Method: EGO 框架把分布匹配与结构约束、可选的多样性奖励和历史依赖奖励组合起来，用反向低阶进化策略 (antithetic low-rank evolution strategies) 直接在离散输出上训练紧凑生成器，不需要针对各准则的可微代理；训练完成后生成器单次神经网络评估即输出整张图。
Result: 在分子生成基准上，每估计一次密集运算 (estimated dense operation) 的 valid-and-unique 产出超过近期 one-step flow-map 基线的 50 倍，同时保持高化学有效性；scaffold completion 中 EGO 相对 MoLeR 观测到 44.3 倍的生成到 SMILES 加速，并在匹配的生成与筛选时限内产出约 10 倍的过筛 (filter-passing) 提案；在 NAS-Bench-101 上产出的不同 held-out elite 架构是松弛梯度训练的 1.54 倍。
Conclusion: 作者主张低生成成本可支撑离散设计任务中的实时候选生成，用于受限设计空间的交互式探索和下游评估候选集的快速构建。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Stevens's Power Law Check-up of GPT-5.5's Image-Based Visualization Reading
papers.abstract_en: We adapt Stevens's power law to measure the innate ability of AI models to read visualizations, which can reveal the built-in perceptual mechanisms of algorithmic models. In our pilot study, models see no legend. A model first views a reference visual representation and estimates its magnitude, then estimates the magnitude of each subsequent image of the same representation relative to that reference. Our evaluation of twelve visual variables makes how algorithmic models read visual encodings measurable, comparable with human perception, and more interpretable to humans.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, including supplementary material. Accepted by the VISxGenAI workshop at IEEE VIS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Stevens 幂律 (power law) 改造成测量 AI 模型读图能力的工具：模型先看一张参考可视化并估计其量值，再在无图例条件下估计同一表示后续各图相对参考的量值，从而把算法模型读取视觉编码的过程变成可与人类感知对比、可解释的量。评测覆盖十二个视觉变量。
Motivation: AI 模型读取可视化（chart/visualization reading）的内在感知机制缺少可量化、可与人类感知对照的测量手段。
Method: 改编 Stevens 幂律作为度量；试点设定中模型看不到图例，先对参考视觉表示估计绝对量值，再逐张估计同一表示后续图像相对参考的量值；评测十二个视觉变量。
Result: 在十二个视觉变量上给出可测量、可与人类感知比较、对人类可解释的读图能力评估；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: Stevens 幂律可作为探针，揭示算法模型读取视觉编码时的内在感知机制，并使其与人类感知可比。

papers.title: Transect: Retaining Observability for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI evaluations increasingly use open-ended, agentic, long-horizon tasks whose transcripts can span hundreds of pages of outputs and actions from complex multi-agent networks. The observability envelop-the range of what evaluators can reliably infer about an agent's behaviours-is therefore narrowing. Language model assistants can help classify and interpret agent behaviour but also afford human evaluators significant analytical degrees of freedom, threatening the reproducibility and auditability of language-model-based transcript analysis. Transect is an open source package built on Inspect Scout to help evaluators understand how a long agent run unfolded, identify behaviour worth investigating, and check interpretations against the transcript. Users specify task context and behavioural vocabulary in a reusable evaluation-family configuration, with judge models and analysis settings supplied separately. Transect's navigable reports align recorded events, token use, sub-agent activity, and model-generated behavioural labels on a common turn-based timeline. Reviewers can quickly grasp a run's narrative, trace any label or event to its source turns, and export the underlying data tables for cross-run analysis. We demonstrate the workflow on an AI R&D evaluation that generated almost 13 million tokens, dividing the agents' work into behavioural phases aligned with research-skill classifications, sub-agent delegations and interactions, and token use. The combined view shows a focus on operational work and manuscript production, with little evidence of a sustained hypothesis generation stage-arguably a necessary component for high-quality scientific outputs. Transect's flexible, customisable transcript-analysis pipeline will enable evaluators to keep pace with longer, more complex, more frequent AI evaluations while supporting scientific rigour, transparency, and reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Transect 是基于 Inspect Scout 的开源长时程 LLM agent 评测可观测性工具：用可复用的 evaluation-family 配置声明任务上下文与行为词表，judge 模型与分析设置单独提供，把事件、token 用量、子 agent 活动与模型生成的行为标签对齐到统一的按轮次时间线上，每个标签都可回溯到源轮次并导出数据表。在一个生成近 1300 万 token 的 AI R&D 评测中，该工具把 agent 工作切成与科研技能分类对齐的行为阶段，视图显示工作集中在操作性事务与论文产出，几乎没有持续的假设生成阶段。
Motivation: 长时程 agent 评测的记录可达数百页，评测者能可靠推断的行为范围（observability envelope）在收窄；用语言模型助手做转录分析又带来分析自由度过大，威胁可复现性与可审计性。
Method: 开源包 Transect，构建于 Inspect Scout 之上；用户在可复用的 evaluation-family 配置中声明任务上下文与行为词表，judge 模型和分析设置另行提供；生成可导航报告，把记录事件、token 使用、子 agent 活动与模型生成的行为标签对齐到按轮次的时间线，标签与事件可回溯到源轮次，并可导出底层数据表做跨 run 分析。
Result: 在一个 AI R&D 评测上演示完整流程，该 run 生成近 1300 万 token；工具把 agent 工作划分为与科研技能分类对齐的行为阶段、子 agent 委派与交互以及 token 使用，合并视图显示关注点集中在操作性工作与论文产出，几乎没有持续假设生成阶段的证据。
Conclusion: 把行为词表配置与按轮次可回溯的时间线对齐，能让评测者在更长、更复杂、更频繁的 AI 评测中保持可观测性，同时支撑科学严谨、透明与可复现的转录分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explainable Failure Prediction and Prevention in Maritime
papers.abstract_en: Maritime systems operate in highly dynamic environments where unexpected equipment failures can compromise safety, reliability, and operational efficiency. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, digital twins, and predictive maintenance enable proactive failure prediction and prevention. However, ensuring trustworthy and explainable decision-making remains a major challenge in safety-critical maritime applications. This chapter reviews key AI technologies required for explainable failure prediction and prevention in maritime systems and presents a conceptual architecture capable of supporting autonomous or human-in-the-loop corrective actions. This architecture integrates data acquisition, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, risk assessment, decision-making, and explainable AI into a closed-loop framework. With reference to the architectural components, a review and discussion of relevant maritime studies is performed, outlining their methods, advantages, and limitations. Furthermore, it highlights current challenges, including uncertainty and robustness, model generalization, explainability, limited availability of maritime datasets, and operational deployment, and identifies future research directions toward trustworthy AI-assisted maritime decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇面向海事系统的章节综述，梳理可解释故障预测与预防所需的 AI 技术，并提出一个把数据采集、时间序列预报、异常检测、风险评估、决策与可解释 AI 串成闭环的概念架构，以支撑自主或人在环的纠正动作。它同时指出海事数据集稀缺、模型泛化与不确定性、可解释性和部署是当前主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 海事设备在高动态环境下突发故障会危及安全与运营效率，而安全关键场景要求决策可信且可解释，现有 AI 预测维护难以满足这一要求。
Method: 提出闭环概念架构，集成数据采集、时间序列预报、异常检测、风险评估、决策与可解释 AI 六类组件；以该架构为参照综述相关海事研究，逐项讨论其方法、优势与局限。
Result: 给出面向海事故障预测与预防的可解释闭环架构及配套文献综述；归纳出的挑战包括不确定性与鲁棒性、模型泛化、可解释性、海事数据集可用性有限以及实际部署。
Conclusion: 可信的 AI 辅助海事决策需要把预报、异常检测、风险评估与可解释性放进同一闭环架构中，数据稀缺与部署仍是通往该目标的主要障碍。

papers.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Quantized ViTs via Single-Pass Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss. Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution. We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 MB (0.01% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QuAR 是面向量化 ViT 的单次前向测试时适应 (TTA) 方法：不反传、不更新参数，只在冻结量化器入口把测试流的逐通道运行统计量映射回源校准分布，从而修复分布偏移下激活占用校准区间导致的码字分布失真。在 ImageNet-C 的 ViT-B 上，3/4/6/8-bit 权重激活精度下取得无反传 TTA 中最高平均精度，8-bit 比最强基线高 2.28 点、3-bit 高 4.00 点，延迟低 46%，内存开销仅 0.17 MB。
Motivation: 量化后的 ViT 在分布偏移下格外脆弱，而现有 TTA 要么依赖反传、要么仍需额外前向或参数更新，且都没有直接针对量化特有的失效模式：偏移使激活以不同方式落入冻结量化器的校准区间，扭曲码字分布。
Method: QuAR 在冻结量化器的输入端重校准激活，把测试流的逐通道运行统计量映射回源校准统计量；单次前向完成，既不反向传播也不更新任何模型参数。
Result: ImageNet-C + ViT-B 上，在 3、4、6、8-bit 权重/激活精度下取得无反传 TTA 方法中最高平均精度，比最强基线在 8-bit 高 2.28 点、3-bit 高 4.00 点；延迟降低 46%，内存开销 0.17 MB（占推理峰值内存 0.01%）。单一固定配置在连续流、非独立同分布标签偏移、七套 OOD 套件和另外三种骨干网络上保持领先。
Conclusion: 量化模型在偏移下的额外精度损失主要来自冻结量化器的逐通道码字分布失真，在量化器入口做统计量重校准即可恢复，且无需反传或参数更新。

papers.title: Sensor Geometry as a Flow-Matching Prior for Multi-Channel Brain Signals
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching models start from an isotropic Gaussian source, the standard choice when the correlation structure of the data is unknown in advance. For multi-channel brain recordings, however, part of this structure is known in advance. Electrodes sit at fixed positions on the head, and volume conduction through the skull and scalp makes nearby electrodes co-vary in a way that is shared across subjects. Existing EEG generative models nonetheless leave the network to learn this from scratch. We put this structure into the source instead. From the sensor coordinates alone, we build a k-nearest-neighbor graph and take a graph-Matérn function of its Laplacian as the source covariance, so the flow starts from spatially coherent patterns rather than channel-independent noise. The change adds no learned parameters, works with any coupling and any drift network, and uses the same three hyperparameters on every dataset. Across eight EEG datasets and four flow-matching methods, the graph-Matérn source lowers the spectral discrepancy between generated and real signals in the five clinical bands (PSD-KL) on most datasets. PSD-KL falls by 12% to 17% in geometric mean over datasets depending on the method and by up to 40% on PhysioNet-MI, the densest montage. We show that the improvement stems from the spatial eigenvectors of the local graph of sensor positions, since randomizing the eigenvectors while preserving the eigenvalue spectrum eliminates the gain. Furthermore, a prior fitted directly to the empirical data covariance performs worse than isotropic noise. The same construction applies unchanged to MEG, intracranial EEG with patient-specific grids, and a traffic-sensor network, lowering PSD-KL for every method on each. https://jd730.github.io/projects/GraphPrior
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把传感器几何写进 flow-matching 的源分布：仅用通道坐标建 kNN 图，取图 Laplacian 的 graph-Matérn 核作为源协方差，使生成从空间相干的模式而非通道独立噪声出发。在八个 EEG 数据集、四种 flow-matching 方法上，五个临床频段的 PSD-KL 按数据集几何平均下降 12%–17%，最密电极布局 PhysioNet-MI 上最多降 40%；打乱空间特征向量后增益消失，直接拟合经验协方差的先验反而差于各向同性噪声。
Motivation: 多通道脑电的通道相关结构部分是先验已知的（电极固定位置加容积传导），但现有 EEG 生成模型仍让网络从各向同性高斯源里重新学一遍。
Method: 仅由传感器坐标构建 k-nearest-neighbor 图，取其 Laplacian 的 graph-Matérn 函数作为 flow-matching 源协方差；不引入可学习参数，兼容任意 coupling 与 drift 网络，所有数据集共用同一组三个超参数。
Result: 在八个 EEG 数据集、四种 flow-matching 方法上，五临床频段 PSD-KL 按数据集几何平均下降 12%–17%（随方法而定），PhysioNet-MI（最密 montage）上最多下降 40%，多数数据集改善。消融显示增益来自传感器位置局部图的空间特征向量：保持特征值谱不变而随机化特征向量即消除增益；直接拟合经验数据协方差的先验比各向同性噪声更差。同一构造原样用于 MEG、患者特异颅内 EEG 网格与交通传感器网络，每种方法在每个数据集上均降低 PSD-KL。
Conclusion: 把已知的传感器几何放进源分布而非交给网络学，就能在不加参数的前提下改善多通道信号生成；关键在空间特征向量本身，而不是协方差谱。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification Is Indispensable for Reliable Connectome-Based Graph Learning: A Narrative Review and Case Study
papers.abstract_en: While graph neural networks (GNNs) have shown substantial promise in connectome-based diagnostic classification, deterministic models inevitably suppress pipeline-induced noise and model ambiguities, yielding overconfident predictions. Although uncertainty quantification (UQ) is widely adopted in voxel-level segmentation, its role in connectomic graph learning remains largely unaddressed. This paper presents a comprehensive narrative review of UQ frameworks tailored to connectome graph learning alongside an empirical case study demonstrating the perils of uncalibrated predictions. We delineate sources of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty across neuroimaging pipelines and review prominent UQ paradigms, from Bayesian approximations and ensemble methods to evidential learning and conformal prediction. In our case study, a temporal Graph Attention Network (GAT) trained on dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) matrices from the SUDMEX CONN dataset achieves 80.0% diagnostic accuracy (F1 = 0.794) for Cocaine Use Disorder. However, a post-hoc uncertainty audit via Monte Carlo dropout reveals severe overconfidence (ECE = 0.127), with misclassified subjects assigned prediction confidences up to 95%. This empirical divergence between discrimination and calibration underscores the confidence paradox in deep connectomics. Our findings establish that rigorous UQ, calibration, and selective prediction mechanisms are indispensable for deploying trustworthy graph-based biomarkers in clinical neuroscience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在连接组 (connectome) 图学习中，确定性 GNN 会压掉管线噪声与模型歧义而过度自信；用 temporal Graph Attention Network 在 SUDMEX CONN 的动态功能连接 (dFC) 矩阵上做可卡因使用障碍诊断，判别准确但校准崩坏。案例中诊断准确率 80.0%（F1 = 0.794），Monte Carlo dropout 事后审计给出 ECE = 0.127，被错分的受试者置信度最高达 95%。结论是 UQ、校准与 selective prediction 是临床部署图生物标志物的必要条件。
Motivation: GNN 在连接组诊断分类上表现好，但确定性模型必然掩盖管线引入的噪声与模型歧义，产生过度自信的预测；UQ 在体素级分割中已被广泛采用，却基本没有进入连接组图学习。
Method: 叙事性综述梳理面向连接组图学习的 UQ 框架，按 aleatoric 与 epistemic 不确定性划分神经影像管线中的来源，覆盖 Bayesian 近似、ensemble 方法、evidential learning 与 conformal prediction；配套案例研究用 temporal Graph Attention Network 训练于 SUDMEX CONN 数据集的动态功能连接 (dFC) 矩阵，并用 Monte Carlo dropout 做事后不确定性审计。
Result: 案例中 Cocaine Use Disorder 诊断准确率 80.0%，F1 = 0.794；事后不确定性审计显示严重过度自信，ECE = 0.127，被错分受试者的预测置信度最高达 95%。
Conclusion: 判别性能与校准可以严重背离（confidence paradox），因此严格的 UQ、校准与 selective prediction 机制是把基于图的生物标志物部署到临床神经科学的必要条件。

papers.title: How Much Planning Is Enough? Reducing Search and Computation in World-Model Planning
papers.abstract_en: Visual world models enable goal-directed control through decision-time action search, but their deployment efficiency is often limited by conservatively large planning budgets. We show that competitive task performance can be achieved without agreement with the Full-budget action, that sufficient budgets vary across model--task pairs, and that iterative planners repeatedly encode solve-invariant context. To address these inefficiencies, we propose {SufficientPlan}, a simple deployment framework that requires no modification to pretrained world models or planner updates. Its {Paired Sequential Budget Certification (PSBC)} component uses paired closed-loop evidence to search for and certify a reduced model--task-specific budget within a predefined Full-performance tolerance. Its {Static-Context Reuse (SCR)} component caches observation and goal representations across search iterations while preserving candidate-dependent planning and selected actions. Experiments across multiple world-model backbones and visual-control tasks show that SufficientPlan substantially reduces search budgets and planning latency while maintaining competitive control performance.

summary_sections.method: 提出 SufficientPlan 部署框架，含两个组件：Paired Sequential Budget Certification (PSBC) 用成对闭环证据在预设 Full-performance 容差内搜索并认证模型-任务特定的缩减预算；Static-Context Reuse (SCR) 缓存观测与目标表征跨搜索迭代复用，同时保留依赖候选的规划与所选动作。无需修改预训练世界模型或更新规划器。

papers.title: Network Intervention by Polling Strategic Agents
papers.abstract_en: A planner in a network of strategic agents faces three entangled challenges: the optimum depends on agents' private information, queried agents may misreport to steer the outcome, and exact computation does not scale. We study these challenges in multi-activity network games with heterogeneous private technologies, in which the planner sets non-discriminatory prices. We show that the optimal prices admit a centrality-based decomposition of the welfare kernel: each agent's contribution scales with its squared centrality in a network reweighted by agents' preferences across activities. This decomposition motivates Poll, a polling algorithm in which the planner samples one agent per round, walks briefly through the agent's neighborhood, and updates the price from a local report. From the same decomposition flow three forms of efficiency: computationally, Poll uses significantly fewer operations than exact computation and other distributed methods, requiring up to three orders of magnitude less communication on a real-world network with over 300,000 agents; statistically, its query complexity scales with topology and preference heterogeneity rather than explicitly with population size; and economically, it converges to welfare-maximizing prices while admitting behavior-specific implementations that induce truthful reports and detect adversarial deviations.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在网络博弈中，规划者设非歧视性价格时，最优价格可按福利核的中心性分解写成：每个 agent 的贡献随其在网络（按跨活动偏好重加权）中中心性的平方缩放。据此提出轮询算法 Poll：每轮抽一个 agent、在其邻域内走查并用局部报告更新价格，收敛到福利最大化价格，且可给出诱导如实报告、检测对抗偏离的实现。在超过 30 万 agent 的真实网络上，通信量比精确计算与其他分布式方法最多低三个数量级。
Motivation: 网络中规划者的最优价格依赖 agent 的私有信息，被查询者可能为操纵结果而谎报，且精确计算无法扩展；三个问题相互纠缠。
Method: 在具有异质私有技术的多活动网络博弈中，规划者设非歧视性价格；证明最优价格对福利核做基于中心性的分解（按跨活动偏好重加权网络中中心性平方），并据此设计 Poll 轮询算法：每轮采样一个 agent、在其邻域内走查、用局部报告更新价格。
Result: 在超过 300,000 个 agent 的真实网络上，Poll 所需通信量比精确计算与其他分布式方法最多低三个数量级；查询复杂度随网络拓扑与偏好异质性缩放，而非显式随人口规模；算法收敛到福利最大化价格。
Conclusion: 中心性分解同时给出计算、统计、经济三重效率：轮询式局部更新足以逼近福利最优价格，并可配套诱导如实报告与检测对抗偏离的实现。

papers.title: PolarScale: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Radiometrically Consistent RGB-to-Stokes Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Polarization imaging provides physical cues beyond intensity imaging but typically requires specialized hardware. Recent methods infer polarization from RGB-like inputs, yet predict only normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, from which the radiometric scale needed for full Stokes reconstruction has been divided out. We introduce PolarScale, a benchmark that makes this scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. Built on existing trichromatic full-Stokes measurements, PolarScale takes the per-scene normalized total-intensity image $s_0$ (a scene-referred linear image, not a consumer sRGB photograph) and asks models to predict normalized Stokes components, AoLP/DoLP/DoCP, and a per-scene scale. Because the scale is divided out of the input, it is not physically identifiable; PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation against a constant-scale control, together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. Across seven restoration-based and generative backbones and three prediction strategies, the strongest restoration models estimate the scale with 3.6-4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7% for the constant control and violate physical bounds on fewer than 0.25% of pixels, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale; explicit descriptor supervision improves descriptor accuracy (23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR for MAE). Predicted full-Stokes representations improve diffuse/specular separation, material segmentation, and glare classification, although in diffuse/specular separation the learned scale performs only on par with the constant control.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 17 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolarScale 把 RGB 偏振估计中被除掉的辐射尺度 (radiometric scale) 单列为显式预测与评测目标：输入是场景参考线性图 s0，模型需同时输出归一化 Stokes 分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 与逐场景尺度。七个恢复式与生成式骨干上，最强恢复模型尺度平均相对误差 3.6–4.3%（常数尺度对照 5.7%），物理界违反像素 <0.25%；显式描述子监督把 MAE 的 PSNR 从 18.88 提到 23.66 dB。
Motivation: 现有从 RGB 推偏振的方法只预测归一化 Stokes 分量或相对描述子，辐射尺度在输入端已被除掉，导致全 Stokes 重建缺少物理一致的绝对量纲，也没有针对该尺度的评测目标。
Method: 基于既有三色全 Stokes 测量数据构建 benchmark，输入为逐场景归一化总强度图 s0（场景参考线性图，非消费级 sRGB），要求模型预测归一化 Stokes 分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 与逐场景尺度；因尺度不可物理辨识，评测采用数据集条件化的语义尺度估计对照常数尺度控制，并配角度、自洽性与物理界三类指标，覆盖七个恢复式/生成式骨干与三种预测策略。
Result: 最强恢复模型尺度平均相对误差 3.6–4.3%，常数尺度对照为 5.7%；物理界违反像素占比 <0.25%；两个生成式基线尺度塌缩到近零。显式描述子监督使描述子精度提升（MAE 上 PSNR 23.66 vs 18.88 dB）。预测的全 Stokes 表示改善漫射/镜面分离、材质分割与眩光分类，但漫射/镜面分离中学习到的尺度仅与常数对照持平。
Conclusion: 辐射尺度可作为显式预测目标来评测并被恢复式模型学到（优于常数对照且几乎不违反物理界），但生成式骨干会塌缩到近零尺度；在漫射/镜面分离下游，学习尺度相对常数对照尚无增益。
