papers.title: High-Dimensional Statistical Inference for Sparse Support Vector Machines
papers.abstract_en: Using a replica-symmetric high-dimensional characterization, we develop an inferential framework for sparse support vector machines when the sample size and number of features grow proportionally. The main challenge is the nonsmooth hinge loss, which prevents direct application of debiasing arguments developed for smooth classification losses. We overcome this difficulty by representing the $L_1$-penalized support vector machine (SVM) as a linear program and identifying the hinge-loss subgradient through its dual variables. This yields a computationally accessible debiased estimator whose coordinates are asymptotically Gaussian under the proportional asymptotic regime. The resulting distributional characterization provides confidence intervals and hypothesis tests for individual features and enables false-discovery-rate-controlled variable selection. Extensive simulations examine calibration, power, and variable-selection performance under a range of covariance structures, including strongly correlated designs. An analysis of high-dimensional breast cancer gene-expression data illustrates how the proposed inference can distinguish statistically significant features from variables selected by the original sparse SVM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在样本量与特征数同比例增长的高维渐近体制下，用 replica-symmetric 高维刻画为 L1 惩罚 SVM 建立推断框架：把 SVM 写成线性规划，经对偶变量识别 hinge loss 次梯度，构造可计算的 debiased 估计量，其各坐标渐近服从高斯分布，从而给出单特征置信区间、假设检验与 FDR 控制的变量选择。
Motivation: hinge loss 非光滑，光滑分类损失上成熟的 debiasing 论证无法直接套用，稀疏 SVM 因此缺少可用于单特征推断与 FDR 变量选择的理论工具。
Method: 以 replica-symmetric 高维刻画刻画 proportional 渐近体制下的稀疏 SVM；将 L1 惩罚 SVM 表示为线性程序，通过对偶变量定位 hinge-loss 次梯度，据此构造 debiased 估计量并导出坐标级渐近高斯分布，进而生成置信区间、检验与 FDR 控制的选择程序。
Result: 在多种协方差结构（含强相关设计）下考察校准 (calibration)、检验功效 (power) 与变量选择表现；并在高维乳腺癌基因表达数据上说明该推断能区分统计显著特征与原稀疏 SVM 所选变量。
Conclusion: 把 hinge loss 的非光滑性转到线性规划对偶上处理，可在 proportional 渐近体制下为稀疏 SVM 提供坐标级渐近高斯推断与 FDR 变量选择。

papers.title: DIPrune: Task-Aware Token Pruning with Dual Importance for Efficient Multimodal Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent training-free pruning approaches for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively cut computational overhead by exploiting visual redundancy or text-vision attention. However, they frequently suffer from semantic degradation due to their task-agnostic design or unreliable attention estimates. Based on our empirical analysis, we have found that this issue arises because salient tokens in shallow layers persistently suppress emerging semantic ones through numerical inertia, leading to premature discarding of signals crucial for deep reasoning. To address the aforementioned issue, from the task-oriented aspects, we first reformulate training-free pruning as a minimization of the distortion in the final task loss and derive a tractable, token-wise upper bound to serve as a surrogate objective. Specifically, this formulation inherently reveals a previously neglected inter-layer term that accounts for gradients across layers. Accordingly, for the implementation, we propose DIPrune, a rank-based framework that employs a dual importance scoring mechanism to jointly optimize intra-layer static feature saliency and inter-layer dynamic semantic evolution. Extensive experiments on LLaVA and Qwen-VL demonstrate that DIPrune consistently achieves state-of-the-art results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIPrune 把训练无关的 MLLM 视觉 token 剪枝重写为最终任务损失失真的最小化问题，推出逐 token 可计算的上界代理目标，其中暴露出被忽略的跨层梯度项。据此用双重要性打分联合层内静态特征显著性与层间动态语义演化，按秩剪枝，缓解浅层显著 token 因数值惯性压制新兴语义 token 导致的过早丢弃。在 LLaVA 与 Qwen-VL 上取得 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有训练无关剪枝依赖任务无关设计或不可靠的注意力估计，浅层显著 token 长期压制正在浮现的语义 token，导致深层推理所需信号被过早丢弃，产生语义退化。
Method: 将训练无关剪枝形式化为最终任务损失失真的最小化，推导逐 token 的可处理上界作为代理目标，其中包含跨层梯度项；实现为 DIPrune：秩基 (rank-based) 框架，用双重要性打分联合层内静态特征显著性与层间动态语义演化。
Result: 在 LLaVA 与 Qwen-VL 上的大量实验中，DIPrune 一致取得 state-of-the-art 结果。
Conclusion: 以任务损失失真为剪枝目标并显式建模跨层语义演化，可在训练无关设定下同时保住 MLLM 的推理语义并削减计算开销。

papers.title: Digital Twin-Driven Real2Sim2Real: Simulator-Conditioned Generation via Paired Driving-Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based 3D perception for autonomous driving relies heavily on large annotated datasets, and deploying such a system to a new target region typically requires data collection and annotation. Generative augmentation has been proposed to reduce this cost, but existing approaches face a fundamental trade-off: label-conditioned methods consume the very annotations they aim to replace, while simulator-conditioned methods offer free annotations but lack visual grounding to specific real environments. This work investigates the extent to which a digital-twin-driven Real2Sim2Real pipeline (DT-R2S2R) can substitute for target-region real data. By reconstructing recorded driving clips inside a georeferenced digital twin (DT-R2S), we condition a diffusion model on geometrically aligned simulator renderings, establishing a digital twin-grounded Sim2Real model (DT-S2R). As a result, DT-S2R synthesizes photorealistic driving images given low-cost yet georeferenced simulator data across both reconstructed and novel simulator scenes within digital-twin coverage. The efficacy of generated data is verified on diverse 3D detectors. DETR3D, especially, reports 93.18% of mAP obtained by a target-region real-data oracle, without employing target images for detector training. Furthermore, simple co-training with existing out-of-target real data outperforms the oracle. Thus, DT-R2S2R can substantially reduce the cost of manual on-site data collection and annotation in digital twin-available districts, providing a practical foundation for scaling 3D perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出数字孪生驱动的 Real2Sim2Real 管线 DT-R2S2R：在地理配准数字孪生中重建已录制行车片段，用几何对齐的模拟器渲染去条件化扩散模型，生成带免费标注的逼真驾驶图像。DETR3D 仅用生成数据训练即达到目标区域真实数据 oracle 的 93.18% mAP，且不使用任何目标区域图像；再与目标区域外真实数据简单 co-training 即超过 oracle。
Motivation: 相机 3D 感知依赖大规模标注数据，换到新区域要重新采集与标注；标签条件生成消耗本想省掉的标注，模拟器条件生成标注免费却缺乏对真实环境的视觉锚定。
Method: DT-R2S 在地理配准数字孪生中重建录制行车片段，DT-S2R 以几何对齐的模拟器渲染为条件训练扩散模型，从低成本地理配准模拟器数据合成图像，覆盖重建场景与孪生范围内的新场景；生成数据用于训练多种 3D 检测器，并与目标区域外真实数据 co-training。
Result: 在多种 3D 检测器上验证：DETR3D 用生成数据训练达到目标区域真实数据 oracle 的 93.18% mAP，且训练中不使用目标区域图像；与既有目标区域外真实数据简单 co-training 后超过 oracle。
Conclusion: 在数字孪生覆盖的城区，DT-R2S2R 能大幅替代目标区域的现场采集与人工标注，为规模化 3D 感知提供可行路径。

papers.title: Machine Learning for German Redispatch Forecasting under Data Delays and Temporal Distribution Shift
authors: Faris Shamim (2) ((1) KIST Medical College and Teaching Hospital
papers.abstract_en: Public redispatch records provide empirical data for grid congestion forecasting, but delayed reporting, zero-inflated distributions, and temporal shift present major modeling challenges. We assess the accuracy and reliability of probabilistic machine-learning forecasts using published German transmission records under experimentally imposed information-age constraints. The benchmark evaluates eight daily series of upward and downward intervention energy across four German transmission system operators from 2021 to 2024 (48,242 eligible records; 354 evaluation dates in 2024). We compare seasonal empirical, regularized autoregressive (ARX), quantile LightGBM, GRU, and Transformer models under a minimum seven-day target-latency constraint. Neural architectures use a zero-censored output head to accommodate exact-zero outcomes. Static, rolling, and adaptive delayed-feedback calibration are evaluated using normalized weighted interval score (nWIS), empirical coverage, and block-bootstrap inference. Raw LightGBM achieved nWIS 0.7952, outperforming ARX (1.0604) and the seasonal baseline (0.8739) by 25.0% and 9.0%, respectively (Holm-adjusted p<0.005). Rolling calibration improved LightGBM to nWIS 0.7767 versus 0.8251 for static calibration (p=0.0092), with 91.81% coverage for nominal 90% intervals. The zero-censored Transformer achieved nWIS 0.8161, with no significant difference from LightGBM (p=0.260). However, aggregate coverage concealed substantial undercoverage during high-volume interventions (61.91% coverage among above-threshold events). These results show that boosted-tree models with rolling calibration provide accurate probabilistic forecasts of aggregate redispatch volumes under target delays, while nominal aggregate validity does not ensure reliability during extreme congestion events.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code available at https://github.com/faraz-shamim/german-redispatch-ml
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在德国电网再调度 (redispatch) 记录上评估概率预测：LightGBM 加滚动校准在 7 天目标延迟约束下 nWIS 0.7767，优于静态校准的 0.8251，90% 名义区间覆盖 91.81%。但高量干预事件覆盖率仅 61.91%，说明聚合层面的名义有效性不等于极端拥堵时可靠。
Motivation: 公开再调度记录存在上报延迟、零膨胀分布与时间分布漂移，聚合预测即使整体校准良好，也可能在极端拥堵事件上失效。
Method: 在 2021–2024 年德国四家输电系统运营商的 8 条日序列（48,242 条合格记录，2024 年 354 个评估日）上，对比季节经验基线、正则化 ARX、分位数 LightGBM、GRU 与 Transformer，神经模型用零截断 (zero-censored) 输出头处理精确零值；评估静态、滚动与自适应延迟反馈校准，指标为 nWIS、经验覆盖率与 block-bootstrap 推断。
Result: 原始 LightGBM nWIS 0.7952，较 ARX (1.0604) 与季节基线 (0.8739) 分别改善 25.0% 与 9.0%（Holm 校正 p<0.005）；滚动校准把 LightGBM 提到 0.7767，优于静态校准 0.8251（p=0.0092），名义 90% 区间覆盖 91.81%；零截断 Transformer nWIS 0.8161，与 LightGBM 无显著差异（p=0.260）；但超阈值高量事件覆盖率仅 61.91%。
Conclusion: 提升树模型加滚动校准可在目标延迟下给出准确的聚合再调度量概率预测，但聚合层面的名义有效性不保证极端拥堵事件上的可靠性。

papers.title: Transferable Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack on Black-Box Vision Language Models for Autonomous Driving
authors: Heyam Bin Jahlan Areej Alhothali Abeer Alhothali
papers.abstract_en: The rapid integration of Vision Language Models (VLMs) into sensitive systems introduces critical safety vulnerabilities that remain unexplored in exist studies. While adversarial attack robustness has been extensively studied for image-based models, the susceptibility of VLMs to temporally-aware adversarial attacks against video in driving context poses a distinct and under examined threat. In this paper, we introduce novel adversarial attack against video targeting VLM models used for autonomous driving scenes named Spatial Temporal Coherence Adversarial Attack (STCA). Our attack comprise from three stages: modalities expansion, Spatial attack, and STCA attack. In modalities expansion, we propose caption-guided frame selection method in order to ensure that adversarial perturbation target the most semantically significant frames. Secondly.In spatial attack, we craft effective perturbation and preserve high similarity. Then the perturbed video generated fed into STCA stage that disrupt cross-frame temporal coherence using motion guided mask. Our method operate under black box threat model against victim target VLMs, relying solely on transferability from white-box surrogate model.We conduct our experiments on the BDD100K and nuScenes autonomous driving datasets across three VLM models: Video LLaVA-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Dolphin. Experimental results demonstrate spatial attack achieves an ASR with high SSIM. Our finding reveal that existing video language model, remain highly susceptible to adversarial attack in autonomous driving scenarios, underscoring the urgent need for robust defense for VLM models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向自动驾驶视频的黑盒对抗攻击 STCA，分三阶段：caption 引导的关键帧选择、保持高 SSIM 的空间扰动、以及用 motion guided mask 破坏跨帧时序一致性的 STCA 阶段，仅靠白盒代理模型的迁移性攻击目标 VLM。在 BDD100K 与 nuScenes 上对 Video LLaVA-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Dolphin 三个模型测试，空间攻击取得高 ASR 且保持高 SSIM，说明现有 video language model 在驾驶场景下仍高度易受对抗攻击。
Motivation: 图像模型的对抗鲁棒性已被大量研究，但自动驾驶场景中 VLM 面对时序感知的视频对抗攻击这一威胁几乎未被探索，而 VLM 正被快速集成进敏感系统。
Method: STCA 三阶段：modalities expansion 用 caption-guided frame selection 挑选语义最关键帧；spatial attack 制作扰动并保持高相似度；STCA 阶段用 motion guided mask 打断跨帧时序一致性。威胁模型为黑盒，仅依赖白盒代理模型的迁移性。
Result: 在 BDD100K 与 nuScenes 上针对 Video LLaVA-7B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Dolphin 三个 VLM 实验；空间攻击取得高 ASR 同时保持高 SSIM（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 现有 video language model 在自动驾驶场景下对对抗攻击仍然高度易受，凸显为 VLM 建立鲁棒防御的紧迫性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: MoF: Preference-Aware Mixture Modeling for Black-Box LLM Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Proprietary Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across a wide range of tasks, yet aligning their outputs with diverse user preferences remains challenging. Existing personalization approaches for black-box LLMs often rely on user-specific scoring heads, causing the number of personalized parameters to grow linearly with the number of users and requiring additional adaptation for unseen users. To address these limitations, we propose Mixture-of-Facets (MoF), a scalable personalization framework for black-box LLMs that models user preferences as compositions of shared latent preference facets rather than dedicated user-specific parameters. MoF performs personalization through history-conditioned routing over shared facet heads, enabling personalization for users unseen during training without additional parameter updates. Across diverse personalization tasks, MoF delivers stronger personalization performance while maintaining a more scalable and parameter-efficient design than prior approaches. Additional analysis indicates strong generalization to unseen users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoF 把黑盒 LLM 个性化从「每用户一个打分头」改为共享潜在偏好 facet 的组合，用历史条件路由 (history-conditioned routing) 选择 facet head，使未见用户无需新增参数更新即可个性化。在多种个性化任务上性能强于既有方法，同时参数量不随用户数线性增长，对未见用户泛化良好。
Motivation: 黑盒 LLM 个性化普遍依赖用户专属打分头，参数量随用户数线性增长，且新用户需要额外适配，难以扩展。
Method: 提出 Mixture-of-Facets (MoF)：把用户偏好建模为共享潜在偏好 facet 的组合，而非专属参数；通过基于用户历史的条件路由在共享 facet head 上完成个性化，训练期间未见的用户也不需参数更新。
Result: 在多种个性化任务上，MoF 的个性化性能强于既有方法，同时设计更具可扩展性、参数效率更高；附加分析显示对训练中未见用户的强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 用共享 facet 组合加历史条件路由替代每用户专属参数，可以在黑盒 LLM 个性化上同时拿到性能与可扩展性，并覆盖未见用户。

papers.title: An AI-Assisted Formalization of the Poincaré Conjecture
papers.abstract_en: We present an AI-assisted Lean 4 formalization of the Poincaré conjecture. The project began with limited reusable formal infrastructure for the geometric analysis behind the proof. To organize this work, we combined a proof blueprint prepared by mathematicians with explicit milestone statements. These milestones enabled parallel agent work and gave mathematicians clear points to locate blockers and provide effective mathematical guidance. Our analysis identifies the human interventions and organizational choices behind this workflow. The project provides a starting point toward reusable infrastructure for future formalization projects; such infrastructure, once developed, could eventually reduce the cost of verifying mathematical results in geometric analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Lean 4 对 Poincaré 猜想做 AI 辅助形式化：数学家先给出证明蓝图并拆成显式里程碑语句，多智能体并行推进各里程碑，人只在里程碑处定位阻塞点并给出数学指导。作者分析了该工作流背后的人工介入与组织选择，产出可复用的形式化基础设施起点。
Motivation: 几何分析证明的形式化几乎没有可复用的基础设施，整套验证成本极高，需要一种让数学家能有效介入并行智能体工作的组织方式。
Method: 结合数学家准备的 proof blueprint 与显式 milestone statements 驱动并行 agent 工作，用里程碑作为定位阻塞点和给出数学指导的接口；以 Lean 4 为形式化语言，并对工作流中的人工介入与组织选择做分析。
Result: 项目在缺乏可复用形式化基础设施的起点上完成了面向 Poincaré 猜想的形式化工作组织，识别出工作流背后的人工介入与组织选择，并发布代码至 frenzymath/PoincareConjecture（15 页、2 图）。
Conclusion: 里程碑化的蓝图加并行 agent 是形式化大型定理的可行组织方式，其产出可作为未来形式化项目的可复用基础设施起点，最终有望降低几何分析结果的验证成本。

papers.title: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in medical question answering and clinical reasoning, yet their improvement remains constrained by static parametric knowledge and costly expert supervision. Self-evolving agents offer a promising alternative by enabling models to improve through iterative task generation and problem-solving. However, most existing self-evolving methods are designed for easily verifiable domains such as mathematics and coding, where solutions can be checked by exact answers or executable programs. Medical reasoning is fundamentally different: it is open-ended, knowledge-intensive, and often only partially verifiable. We present MedZERO, a self-evolving framework for open-ended medical reasoning. MedZERO couples an Examiner that generates frontier medical question-option pairs with a Reasoner that solves them through evidence-grounded multi-turn reasoning with external knowledge tools. To support reliable, continual improvement, MedZERO adopts controlled knowledge accumulation, which maintains temporary exploratory knowledge and curated persistent knowledge in reasoning. We evaluate MedZERO on five public medical reasoning benchmarks using 4B- and 8B-scale base models under open-ended evaluation. Across all settings, MedZERO consistently outperforms the underlying base models and prior self-evolving baselines, achieving up to 13.7 average accuracy-point gains over the next-best self-evolving baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedZERO 把自进化智能体搬到难以精确验证的开放式医学推理上：Examiner 生成前沿医学题干-选项对，Reasoner 借外部知识工具做基于证据的多轮推理，并用受控知识积累区分临时探索性知识与精选持久知识。在五个公开医学推理基准、4B 与 8B base 模型的开放式评测中，各设置下均超过底层 base 模型与既有自进化基线，最高比次优自进化基线高出 13.7 个平均准确率百分点。
Motivation: 现有自进化方法依赖可精确校验的数学或编程域，而医学推理开放式、知识密集且只能部分验证；同时静态参数化知识与昂贵专家监督限制了模型持续提升。
Method: 框架含 Examiner 与 Reasoner 两个组件：Examiner 负责生成前沿医学 question-option 对，Reasoner 通过外部知识工具进行基于证据的多轮推理求解；受控知识积累 (controlled knowledge accumulation) 在推理中同时维护临时探索性知识与精选的持久知识，以支撑可靠持续改进。
Result: 在五个公开医学推理基准上，用 4B 与 8B 规模 base 模型做开放式评测，MedZERO 在所有设置中一致优于底层 base 模型与既有自进化基线，最高取得比次优自进化基线高 13.7 个平均准确率百分点的增益。
Conclusion: 自进化范式可以迁移到只能部分验证的开放式医学推理，前提是把知识积累做成受控的临时/持久分层，而非无约束累积。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Structure-Aware Graph Abstention for Reliable Selective Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Selective forecasting abstains on high-risk test windows under a retained-coverage budget. Existing gates such as TEM (Brusokas et al., 2025) score each forecast as a whole; for multivariate outputs, trajectories can look plausible while violating dependencies among variables. We treat instance-level plausibility and relational consistency as distinct reliability axes and operationalize the latter via a learned sparse graph and a Dirichlet-style structural energy E_struct, trained with error-weighted graph regularization and score-error alignment. On seven long-horizon benchmarks and four backbones, structural gating often reduces selective MSE versus TEM at matched coverage, with the largest gains where cross-variable structure appears more informative in our benchmarks; gains are not universal, indicating a complementary abstention signal. Table 1 is a Protocol A ranking diagnostic (seed 2024); three-seed deployable Protocol B on an aligned subset is in Table 3 (full validation-to-test grids: Appendix A).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把选择性预报 (selective forecasting) 的弃权判据从单条轨迹打分拆成实例合理性与跨变量关系一致性两条轴，用可学习稀疏图加 Dirichlet 式结构能量 E_struct 做结构门控。在七个长时程多变量基准、四个骨干网络上，结构门控在匹配保留覆盖率下常比 TEM 降低选择性 MSE，且增益在跨变量结构更有信息的基准上最大，但并非普遍成立。
Motivation: TEM 等现有门控把整条预报当作一个整体打分，多变量输出里轨迹可能看起来合理却违反变量间依赖，高风险测试窗口因此被错误保留。
Method: 用可学习稀疏图刻画变量间关系，定义 Dirichlet 式结构能量 E_struct 作为关系一致性分数，训练时用误差加权图正则 (error-weighted graph regularization) 与分数-误差对齐 (score-error alignment) 联合优化；在保留覆盖率预算下用该结构分数对测试窗口做弃权，与实例级打分并列为两条可靠性轴。
Result: 在七个长时程基准与四个骨干网络上，结构门控在匹配覆盖率下的选择性 MSE 常低于 TEM，增益在跨变量结构更有信息的基准上最大，但增益并非普遍，说明结构信号是互补的。评测含 Protocol A 排序诊断（seed 2024）与对齐子集上的三 seed 可部署 Protocol B，完整 validation-to-test 网格见附录 A。
Conclusion: 跨变量关系一致性是与实例级合理性互补的弃权信号，可在匹配覆盖率下进一步压低选择性 MSE，但其收益取决于基准中跨变量结构的信息量。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: SCOPE: Certified Theorem Proving with a Language Model as the Policy Planner
papers.abstract_en: In proof assistants such as Lean, a generated proof must pass machine compilation checks, so evaluation needs no human scoring. Direct generation fails on multi-step numeric propositions: a proof is valid only if every content integer is correct, so the pass rate is bounded by the k-th power of the per-integer accuracy. Controlled corruption across 2,617 reference proofs confirms this power law. SCOPE (State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution) enforces the natural division of labor: the model plans over an operator vocabulary, a symbolic engine executes the numerics, and a compiler renders the proof. On a 218-problem suite it certifies 191/218 (87.6%) with a 135M backbone; the 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL certifies 18/218 at 27.5 times the tokens and 37.5 times the wall-clock, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B certifies zero on a bidirectional dual suite. Multi-step thinking costs 6.12 discrete decision actions per problem and produces no natural-language thinking text. Replacing the lagged engine state in the decision frame with the current one lifts the pass rate from 117/218 to 191/218, while up-weighting the chain-end loss hurts. On the public Lean-Workbook library, 2,132 of 3,536 gradeable admissible problems certify (60.29%) with zero regression on the main suite. All readings come from a version-frozen review with independent rechecks and reverse verification. Restricting free generation and keeping decision-time information visible is a more direct route than enlarging the model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCOPE 把 Lean 证明拆成「模型在算子词表上规划、符号引擎执行数值、编译器渲染证明」的分工，使多步数值命题的正确性由机器编译保证而非人工评分。218 题套件上 135M 骨干认证 191/218（87.6%），而 7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 在 27.5 倍 token、37.5 倍墙钟下仅 18/218；把决策帧中的滞后引擎状态换成当前状态使通过率从 117/218 升到 191/218。
Motivation: 直接生成在多步数值命题上失败：证明要求每个内容整数都正确，通过率被每位整数准确率的 k 次幂封顶，2,617 条参考证明的受控腐蚀实验确认了这一幂律。
Method: SCOPE（State-Conditioned Operator Planning and Execution）让模型只在算子词表上做离散决策规划，数值由符号引擎执行，证明由编译器渲染；决策帧携带当前引擎状态，多步思考表现为平均 6.12 个离散决策动作且不产生自然语言思考文本。
Result: 218 题套件上 135M 骨干认证 191/218（87.6%）；7B DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL 认证 18/218，token 用量为 27.5 倍、墙钟 37.5 倍；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在双向对偶套件上认证 0。用当前引擎状态替换滞后状态使通过率 117/218 → 191/218，上调 chain-end loss 则变差。Lean-Workbook 公开库上 3,536 道可评分可容许问题中 2,132 道认证（60.29%），主套件零回归；全部读数来自版本冻结复核、独立复查与反向验证。
Conclusion: 限制自由生成并让决策时信息可见，比放大模型更直接地提升可认证证明率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MARCO: The Radioactive Watermark for Protein Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Protein Generative Models (PGMs) have revolutionized structural biology by enabling the design of complex 3D protein structures from sequence data. However, this breakthrough introduces a dual-use challenge, exposing high-value PGMs to economic risks like unauthorized model extraction and biosecurity threats such as biohazard synthesis. To mitigate these threats, we propose \textbf{MARCO} (\textsc{COnformation waterMARk}), the first radioactive watermarking framework specifically tailored for PGMs. MARCO establishes a Dual-Layer defense that simultaneously protects intellectual property and ensures the forensic traceability of potential biosecurity misuses. (i) To preserve efficiency, MARCO iteratively embeds watermarks during diffusion reverse denoising via an auxiliary encoder-decoder, allowing the original PGM parameters to remain frozen for broad compatibility. (ii) To preserve biophysical fidelity and maximize robustness, we employ specialized loss functions targeting $C_α$-atom pairwise distances and torsion angles ($ψ, φ$) within an adversarial training framework integrated with stochastic attack simulations. (iii) Crucially, MARCO exhibits ``radioactivity'' where the watermark automatically transfers to the outputs of any pirate models trained on the watermarked data, effectively countering model extraction attacks. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that MARCO achieves superior fidelity and robustness while successfully validating watermark transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARCO 是首个面向蛋白质生成模型 (PGM) 的放射性水印框架，在扩散反向去噪过程中用辅助 encoder-decoder 迭代嵌入水印，同时保护模型知识产权与生物安全取证溯源。水印会自动转移到用带水印数据训练的盗版模型输出上，从而对抗模型提取攻击；作者称实验显示其在保真度与鲁棒性上更优并验证了可转移性。
Motivation: 蛋白质生成模型可从序列设计复杂 3D 结构，带来双重用途风险：经济上的未授权模型提取，以及生物安全上的有害合成，现有防护无法同时覆盖知识产权与滥用溯源。
Method: 双层防御：在扩散反向去噪中经辅助 encoder-decoder 迭代嵌入水印，原 PGM 参数保持冻结以保证兼容性；损失针对 Cα 原子成对距离与扭转角 (ψ, φ)，置于对抗训练框架并整合随机攻击模拟。
Result: 综合实验表明 MARCO 取得更优的保真度与鲁棒性，并成功验证水印可转移性（即放射性：转移到盗版模型输出）。
Conclusion: 冻结参数的迭代嵌入加生物物理约束损失，可让水印在不改动原模型的前提下同时实现 IP 保护、抗提取与取证溯源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Catastrophic Forgetting in Sequential Thermal Anti-UAV Detection: The Role of Scale-Conditioned Gradient Imbalance
papers.abstract_en: Counter-UAV systems based on thermal infrared detection must stay accurate as operational datasets evolve, yet sequential fine-tuning causes catastrophic forgetting of prior tasks, a problem that remains insufficiently characterized in this domain. This continual-learning study measures the stability-plasticity trade-off in YOLOMG, a YOLOv5-based detector run as a single thermal-infrared stream with the motion channel disabled, trained sequentially across three anti-UAV benchmarks of rising scale difficulty: Anti-UAV-RGBT, Anti-UAV410, and CST Anti-UAV. Naive fine-tuning on CST yields a Forgetting Measure of -0.605 against the Stage 1 ceiling, corresponding to a 90% capability loss, with -0.572 occurring in Stage 3 alone. In contrast, knowledge distillation from a frozen teacher is associated with FM = -0.033 +/- 0.004 across three seeds, corresponding to 95% retention. Because no Stage 2 no-KD control is included, this result establishes retention under KD training rather than a causal KD effect. Per-stratum analysis shows large-target detection collapsing to near zero within the first epoch, despite an inter-stage cosine similarity of 0.987 over the gradient-updated weights, pointing to scale-conditioned gradient imbalance, rather than weight drift, as a candidate mechanism. Scale-Stratified Herding (SSH), a 300-exemplar buffer balanced across four UAV size strata, roughly halves the forgetting (FM = -0.605 to -0.311) and keeps large-target detection non-zero. An ablation attributes the gain primarily to scale stratification rather than herding: random-stratified replay performs at least as well (FM = -0.221 versus -0.311 for SSH). These replay results are single-seed and should therefore be treated as preliminary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在热红外反无人机检测的顺序微调中，YOLOMG 在 CST 上朴素微调的 Forgetting Measure 为 -0.605（约 90% 能力损失），而冻结教师知识蒸馏 (KD) 下 FM = -0.033 ± 0.004（约 95% 保留）。大目标检测在第一个 epoch 内塌到近零，而梯度更新权重的阶段间余弦相似度高达 0.987，指向尺度条件化的梯度失衡而非权重漂移；300 样本、按四个 UAV 尺寸分层的回放把遗忘减半到 -0.311，且消融显示收益主要来自尺度分层而非 herding。
Motivation: 热红外反无人机系统需随数据集演化持续微调，但顺序训练导致的灾难性遗忘在该领域刻画不足，尤其是不同目标尺度上的稳定性-可塑性权衡。
Method: 以 YOLOv5 为基础的 YOLOMG 检测器（单热红外流、运动通道关闭）在三个递增难度基准 Anti-UAV-RGBT、Anti-UAV410、CST Anti-UAV 上顺序训练；对比朴素微调、冻结教师知识蒸馏，以及 300 样本、四个 UAV 尺寸分层的 Scale-Stratified Herding (SSH) 回放，并做分尺度分层分析与随机分层回放消融。
Result: 朴素微调在 CST 上 FM = -0.605（相对 Stage 1 上限约 90% 能力损失），其中 Stage 3 单独为 -0.572；冻结教师 KD 得 FM = -0.033 ± 0.004（三个种子，约 95% 保留）。大目标检测在第一个 epoch 内塌到近零，梯度更新权重的阶段间余弦相似度为 0.987。SSH 把 FM 从 -0.605 改善到 -0.311 并保持大目标检测非零；随机分层回放 FM = -0.221，不差于 SSH 的 -0.311。
Conclusion: 遗忘的候选机制是尺度条件化的梯度失衡而非权重漂移，缓解手段是按目标尺度分层的回放；作者明确 KD 结果只确立 KD 训练下的保留（缺 Stage 2 no-KD 对照），且回放结果为单种子、属初步。

summary_sections.motivation: 热红外反无人机系统需随数据集演化持续微调，但顺序训练导致的灾难性遗忘在该领域刻画不足，尤其是不同目标尺度上的稳定性-可塑性权衡。
summary_sections.method: 以 YOLOv5 为基础的 YOLOMG 检测器（单热红外流、运动通道关闭）在三个递增难度基准 Anti-UAV-RGBT、Anti-UAV410、CST Anti-UAV 上顺序训练；对比朴素微调、冻结教师知识蒸馏，以及 300 样本、四个 UAV 尺寸分层的 Scale-Stratified Herding (SSH) 回放，并做分尺度分层分析与随机分层回放消融。
summary_sections.result: 朴素微调在 CST 上 FM = -0.605（相对 Stage 1 上限约 90% 能力损失），其中 Stage 3 单独为 -0.572；冻结教师 KD 得 FM = -0.033 ± 0.004（三个种子，约 95% 保留）。大目标检测在第一个 epoch 内塌到近零，梯度更新权重的阶段间余弦相似度为 0.987。SSH 把 FM 从 -0.605 改善到 -0.311 并保持大目标检测非零；随机分层回放 FM = -0.221，不差于 SSH 的 -0.311。
summary_sections.conclusion: 遗忘的候选机制是尺度条件化的梯度失衡而非权重漂移，缓解手段是按目标尺度分层的回放；作者明确 KD 结果只确立 KD 训练下的保留（缺 Stage 2 no-KD 对照），且回放结果为单种子、属初步。

papers.title: The Standardization Trap: Certifying Joint Label Processing in Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Linear regression and kernel smoothing offer tractable explanations of in-context learning: in both, the features determine the weight assigned to each context label. However, whether this fixed-weight account describes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) remains unclear. Testing this account using derivatives runs into a standardization trap: public TFM packages standardize the labels before the model sees them, yet ordinary derivatives also reflect behavior outside the set of standardized labels, making a model appear nonlinear even when every prediction it makes agrees with a fixed-weight map. We propose two certificates that depend only on predictions at standardized labels and can reject two distinct explanations: fixed-weight prediction and sums of independent nonlinear label transformations. Across the five public TFMs that we evaluate, our certificates show that changing one context label alters how other labels influence the prediction, a behavior we call joint processing. We further find that joint processing emerges with training and that attention scores carry most of the measured interaction. Together, these findings motivate TFM explanations that account for how context labels change the influence of individual examples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对表格基础模型 (TFM) 中固定权重解释的检验难题，提出两个只依赖标准化标签处预测值的证书，可分别否证固定权重预测与独立非线性标签变换之和两种解释。在五个公开 TFM 上，证书显示改动一个上下文标签会改变其他标签对预测的影响（joint processing），该行为随训练出现，且大部分交互由 attention score 承载。
Motivation: 线性回归与核平滑给出的固定权重解释能否描述预训练 TFM 尚不清楚；直接用导数检验会落入标准化陷阱——公开 TFM 包在模型看到标签前先做标准化，而普通导数反映标准化标签集之外的行为，使模型看起来非线性，即便其全部预测都与固定权重映射一致。
Method: 构造两个证书，只依赖标准化标签处的预测，无需导数：一个针对固定权重预测解释，一个针对独立非线性标签变换之和的解释；在五个公开 TFM 上评估，并考察 joint processing 随训练的演化与 attention score 的贡献。
Result: 在五个公开 TFM 上，证书否证了固定权重与独立非线性变换之和两种解释：改动一个上下文标签会改变其他标签对预测的影响（joint processing）；joint processing 随训练出现，且大部分测得的交互由 attention score 承载。
Conclusion: TFM 的解释必须刻画上下文标签如何改变单个样本的影响，固定权重式的 in-context 学习说明不足以描述这些模型。

papers.title: CoDe-LoRA: Mitigating the Orthogonality Dilemma in Continual Learning of LLMs via Knowledge Consolidation and Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning (CL) is essential for Large Language Models (LLMs) to sequentially adapt to evolving tasks. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, recent advances implement low-rank adaptation with orthogonal projections (e.g., O-LoRA) to isolate task parameters. However, we reveal that such strict geometric constraints trigger an "Orthogonality Dilemma": rigid parameter isolation impedes the transfer and accumulation of shared representations across semantically related tasks. In this work, we propose a new replay-free method, called Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA (CoDe-LoRA), for CL of LLMs. CoDe-LoRA disentangles the learning process into Consolidating Universal Knowledge and Decoupling Task-Specific Knowledge. To achieve this, CoDe-LoRA leverages an adaptive null space projection mechanism and semantic routing to balance knowledge accumulation with task-specific adaptation. Experimental results across four backbones and three CL benchmarks show that CoDe-LoRA achieves the best average accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/CoDe-LoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoDe-LoRA 指出 O-LoRA 一类正交投影约束会触发“正交困境”：严格参数隔离阻碍语义相关任务间共享表示的迁移与积累。它以自适应零空间投影 (adaptive null space projection) 加语义路由 (semantic routing) 把学习拆成通用知识巩固与任务特定知识解耦，在四个 backbone、三个持续学习基准上取得最佳平均准确率。
Motivation: 持续学习中用正交投影隔离任务参数虽能抑制灾难性遗忘，但刚性几何约束让语义相关任务之间无法迁移和积累共享表示。
Method: 提出免回放 (replay-free) 的 Consolidation and Decoupling LoRA：把学习过程拆为巩固通用知识与解耦任务特定知识两步，用自适应零空间投影机制与语义路由在知识积累和任务适配之间做平衡。
Result: 在四个 backbone 和三个持续学习基准上，CoDe-LoRA 取得最佳平均准确率。
Conclusion: 严格正交隔离并非持续学习的最优解，用零空间投影与语义路由解耦通用与任务特定知识，可在免回放设定下同时保住积累与适配。

papers.title: Mitigating Concept Drift in QoS Prediction for Teleoperation of Autonomous Vehicles Using Historic Data
papers.abstract_en: Teleoperation serves as the fallback solution to autonomous driving but reliable functions of the teleoperation require a certain amount of mobile network resources, which cannot be guaranteed at all times. Therefore, predictive quality of service (pQoS) is introduced as a concept to increase the resilience of the teleoperation. In this paper, based on a data measurement campaign, we propose a prediction framework to prediction two important network KPIs of teleoperation: uplink data-rate and round-trip latency. Furthermore, we introduce a method to alleviate the performance degradation of machine-learning-based prediction models on previously unseen data due to concept drift by incorporating historic data into the prediction pipeline. Additionally, we introduce the metric of critical scenario detection to evaluate the prediction performance specifically for teleoperation.
papers.comment: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向自动驾驶远程操作 (teleoperation) 的预测 QoS (pQoS)，提出把历史数据纳入预测流水线以缓解概念漂移导致的模型在未见数据上性能退化，并预测上行数据率与往返时延两个网络 KPI，另提出关键场景检测 (critical scenario detection) 指标来专门评估远程操作场景下的预测表现。
Motivation: 远程操作依赖移动网络资源，但网络资源无法始终保证，预测 QoS 是提升远程操作韧性的前提；机器学习预测模型在未见数据上会因概念漂移而性能下降。
Method: 基于实测数据采集活动 (data measurement campaign) 构建预测框架，预测上行数据率与往返时延两个 KPI；将历史数据纳入预测流水线以缓解概念漂移带来的退化，并引入关键场景检测指标评估预测性能。
Result: 产出为一套基于实测数据的 pQoS 预测框架、缓解概念漂移的历史数据方法，以及面向远程操作的关键场景检测评估指标；摘要未给出具体数值对比。
Conclusion: 把历史数据纳入预测流水线可缓解概念漂移对未见数据上预测模型的性能退化，且远程操作的 QoS 预测需要按关键场景而非整体平均来评估。

papers.title: OxiGen: Oxidation-State-Aware Crystal Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have the potential to accelerate inorganic materials discovery by enabling inverse design, but generating experimentally realisable crystals remains challenging. Oxidation states are widely used to assess the compositional validity of crystals and guide inorganic materials discovery. While existing generative models for crystals can generate materials with charge-neutral oxidation-state assignments, they poorly reproduce the distributions of oxidation states observed in synthesised materials. To address this limitation, we propose OxiGen, an oxidation-state-aware crystal diffusion model that explicitly represents oxidation states during generation. OxiGen enforces global charge neutrality by construction using a structured output layer with exact inference over a finite-state automaton. Empirically, OxiGen substantially improves oxidation-state fidelity, generates the highest rate of stable, unique, and novel crystals among evaluated methods, and maintains high compositional validity even under property conditioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OxiGen 是一个在生成过程中显式表示氧化态的晶体扩散模型，用结构化输出层对有限状态自动机做精确推理，从而按构造保证全局电荷中性。实验中它显著提升氧化态保真度，在被评估方法中生成的稳定、唯一、新颖晶体比例最高，且在属性条件生成下仍保持高组成有效性。
Motivation: 现有晶体生成模型虽能给出电荷中性的氧化态分配，但生成结果的氧化态分布与已合成材料的观测分布差距很大，限制了实验可实现性与逆向设计的可用性。
Method: OxiGen 在扩散生成中显式建模氧化态，通过结构化输出层对有限状态自动机 (finite-state automaton) 做精确推理，按构造强制全局电荷中性；同时支持属性条件生成 (property conditioning)。
Result: 在被评估方法中氧化态保真度 (oxidation-state fidelity) 显著提升，稳定、唯一、新颖 (stable, unique, novel) 晶体的生成比例最高，并在属性条件生成下保持高组成有效性 (compositional validity)。
Conclusion: 把氧化态作为生成过程的一等对象并用自动机精确推理保证电荷中性，是提高晶体生成可实现性与组成有效性的有效路径，且不牺牲属性条件下的有效性。

papers.title: Where Do Two Populations of Persistence Diagrams Differ? Calibrated Local Inference at a Fixed Budget
papers.abstract_en: Many two-sample tests for populations of persistence diagrams assess global differences without identifying the regions of the birth-death plane that contribute to them. We study simultaneous inference for local mean contrasts when the number of available diagrams is fixed. They are differences in expected weighted feature mass within $\ell_\infty$ neighborhoods at several centers and radii. We estimate these contrasts using additive landmark responses. A Gaussian multiplier bootstrap calibrates simultaneous confidence intervals while allowing unequal group covariances. The neighborhoods whose intervals exclude zero form a map with approximate family-wise error control, and selecting a subset of original intervals for display preserves their joint coverage guarantee. On the simultaneous coverage event, every reported neighborhood lies within twice its radius of the support of the mean-measure difference. A geometric result gives sufficient radius conditions for a displaced feature to produce a nonzero contrast. A comparison of sufficient detection thresholds quantifies the tradeoff between reducing the number of tested coordinates and reserving observations for an independent pilot. In simulations with 40 to 120 diagrams per class, the bands achieved 94%-98% simultaneous coverage under both the strict null and equal means with unequal covariances. In the latter setting, a permutation maximum and the pooled-t implementation of the two-stage persistence-image test of Moon and Lazar rejected in up to 32% and 26% of runs, respectively. In the fixed-budget simulations, spending a third of the observations on a pilot to choose landmarks or radii located changes less often than a prespecified grid at a single radius. On the MUTAG benchmark, the localized region concentrates on rings of fused-ring systems, an exploratory reading.
papers.comment: 45 pages, 9 figures. Appendices with proofs and additional experiments. Under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在可用 persistence diagram 数量固定的前提下，对 birth-death 平面上局部均值对比做同时推断：用加性 landmark 响应估计 ℓ∞ 邻域内的加权特征质量差，Gaussian multiplier bootstrap 校准同时置信区间并允许两组协方差不等。40–120 张/类的模拟中区间同时覆盖率达 94%–98%，而 Moon–Lazar 两阶段 persistence-image 检验的 permutation maximum 与 pooled-t 实现分别在最多 32% 与 26% 的运行中错误拒绝。
Motivation: 现有 persistence diagram 两样本检验只给出全局差异判定，无法指出 birth-death 平面上哪些区域贡献了差异，且样本量固定时缺少带错误率控制的局部定位手段。
Method: 在若干中心与半径的 ℓ∞ 邻域上定义期望加权特征质量差作为局部均值对比，用加性 landmark 响应估计；Gaussian multiplier bootstrap 校准同时置信区间并允许组间协方差不等，区间不含零的邻域构成具近似族错误率控制的定位图，展示时选取子集仍保联合覆盖。另给出几何结果给出位移特征产生非零对比的充分半径条件，并比较充分检测阈值以权衡减少检验坐标数与留出独立 pilot 观测。
Result: 模拟中每类 40 至 120 张 diagram，区间在严格零假设与均值相等但协方差不等两种情形下同时覆盖率为 94%–98%；后一情形下 Moon 与 Lazar 两阶段 persistence-image 检验的 permutation maximum 与 pooled-t 实现分别在最多 32% 与 26% 的运行中拒绝。固定预算模拟中，用三分之一观测做 pilot 选 landmark 或半径，其定位改变频率低于预设的单一半径网格。MUTAG 基准上定位区域集中于稠环体系的环状结构（探索性解读）。
Conclusion: 在固定样本预算下，bootstrap 校准的局部同时区间能在控制族错误率的同时定位差异区域，且比两阶段 persistence-image 检验更稳健；留出 pilot 选 landmark/半径的定位稳定性优于固定网格。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 在可用 persistence diagram 数量固定的前提下，对 birth-death 平面上局部均值对比做同时推断：用加性 landmark 响应估计 ℓ∞ 邻域内的加权特征质量差，Gaussian multiplier bootstrap 校准同时置信区间并允许两组协方差不等。40–120 张/类的模拟中区间同时覆盖率达 94%–98%，而 Moon–Lazar 两阶段 persistence-image 检验的 permutation maximum 与 pooled-t 实现分别在最多 32% 与 26% 的运行中错误拒绝。

papers.title: Scalable extraction and visualization of multi-attribute logical and functional dependencies in tabular data
authors: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the structural relationships among attributes in tabular data is fundamental to machine learning and pattern recognition. While functional dependency (FD) discovery has been extensively studied, scalable discovery of logical dependencies (LDs), particularly as the number of attributes and dependency order increase, remains underexplored. These dependencies capture non-deterministic, condition-specific relationships among pairwise or multiple attributes. Furthermore, existing approaches do not provide a unified framework for extracting multi-attribute LDs and FDs. To address these limitations, we propose LDTool and HLDTool for extracting and visualizing multi-attribute LDs and FDs from tabular data. LDTool extends dependency discovery beyond pairwise relationships, while HLDTool enables scalable extraction through hypergraph-guided search-space reduction. Experiments on three simulated and eleven real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework extracts meaningful LDs and FDs while improving scalability. LDTool recovers the same FDs as existing FD discovery methods with lower runtime in high-dimensional feature spaces, whereas HLDTool enables dependency discovery in datasets with hundreds of features. The proposed framework provides interpretable visualizations of dependency structures and supports applications in exploratory data analysis and the quantitative evaluation of synthetic tabular data.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Pattern Recognition Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 LDTool 与 HLDTool，从表格数据中抽取并可视化多属性逻辑依赖 (LD) 与函数依赖 (FD)：LDTool 把依赖发现从成对关系扩展到多属性，HLDTool 用超图引导的搜索空间压缩实现可扩展抽取。在三个模拟与十一个真实数据集上，LDTool 在高维特征空间以更低运行时复现既有 FD 发现方法的相同 FD，HLDTool 可处理数百特征的数据集。
Motivation: FD 发现研究充分，但属性数与依赖阶数增大时可扩展的逻辑依赖 (LD) 抽取仍不充分，且现有方法没有统一抽取多属性 LD 与 FD 的框架。
Method: LDTool 扩展依赖发现以覆盖成对之外的多属性关系；HLDTool 用超图引导的搜索空间缩减 (hypergraph-guided search-space reduction) 支持可扩展抽取，并提供依赖结构的可视化。
Result: 在三个模拟数据集与十一个真实数据集上，框架抽出有意义的 LD 与 FD 并改善可扩展性；LDTool 在高维特征空间以更低运行时复现既有 FD 发现方法得到的相同 FD，HLDTool 支持在数百特征的数据集上做依赖发现。
Conclusion: 多属性 LD 与 FD 可以放进同一框架抽取，超图引导的搜索空间缩减是让依赖发现在数百特征规模上可行的关键；框架还用于探索性数据分析与合成表格数据的定量评估。

papers.title: Event Detection in Table Tennis Videos using 2D Keypoints
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses the challenge of automatic, frame-accurate event detection in table tennis videos. Current methods for estimating 3d ball trajectories and ball spin typically require that key events, such as ball-racket contacts, have already been identified in advance. This requirement makes it difficult to apply these methods to longer, unedited video recordings. To overcome this limitation, we propose EventNet, a two-stage pipeline to detect key events: (1) 2d keypoints are extracted of the upper-body poses for both players, table corners and ball center. A small keypoint transformer combines them into a compact representation that is robust to changes in viewpoint, lighting, and background clutter. (2) The temporal sequences of these frame-based representations are processed by a transformer encoder that predicts two time-to-event values for each frame, indicating how close the current frame is to the next and previous ball-racket contact. One novelty is a new, temporal cosine-like target signal. Furthermore, we introduce viewpoint augmentation via 3D reprojection and frame-rate augmentation to improve robustness and generalization. Our extensive ablation study gives deeper insights into the importance of various architectural and training aspects. Experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1 score of 91.16% and a mean frame deviation between ground truth and predicted frame of 0.42 on the Latte-MV dataset and 73.08% / 1.16 on the challenging TTHQ dataset. Overall, our work demonstrates that 2d keypoint-based temporal modeling with our EventNet architecture is a promising and practical approach for automatic event detection in table tennis videos.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 9th International ACM Workshop on Multimedia Content Analysis in Sports
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 EventNet 两阶段流水线，用 2D 关键点（双方上身姿态、球台角点、球心）经小型 keypoint transformer 压成视角鲁棒表征，再由 transformer encoder 逐帧回归到上一次与下一次击球接触的 time-to-event，实现未剪辑乒乓球视频的帧级事件检测。在 Latte-MV 上 F1 达 91.16%、平均帧偏差 0.42，在难例 TTHQ 上为 73.08% / 1.16。
Motivation: 现有 3D 球轨迹与旋转估计方法要求球-球拍接触等关键事件事先标定，难以直接用于较长的未剪辑比赛录像。
Method: 两阶段 EventNet：先抽取双方上身姿态、球台角点与球心的 2D 关键点，用小型 keypoint transformer 融合成对视角、光照和背景杂乱鲁棒的逐帧表征；再用 transformer encoder 对每帧预测到前后两次球-球拍接触的两个 time-to-event 值，训练目标为新提出的 temporal cosine-like 信号，并加入基于 3D 重投影的视角增强与帧率增强。
Result: Latte-MV 数据集上 F1 91.16%、真值与预测帧的平均帧偏差 0.42；TTHQ 数据集上 F1 73.08%、平均帧偏差 1.16。另做了覆盖架构与训练各方面的广泛消融研究。
Conclusion: 基于 2D 关键点的时序建模加 EventNet 架构是自动乒乓球事件检测中切实可行的方案，可绕开对预先标定接触事件的依赖。

papers.title: Whose Face Is It Anyway? A Multi-Model Audit of Facial Affect Recognition on Children, and Why the Gap Is the Head, Not the Features
papers.abstract_en: Facial affect models are trained almost entirely on adults, yet are increasingly applied to children in education, health, and developmental research. We present a controlled, multi-model audit of five AffectNet-pretrained expression models (EmoNet, EmotiEffLib, DDAMFN++, OpenFace 3.0, LibreFace) on children, across four child image datasets, the AffectNet-8 validation set, and two spontaneous child video datasets, through one shared harness. Three findings emerge. First, the child gap is model-agnostic: every architecture degrades from posed to naturalistic faces and shares the fear$\rightarrow$surprise confusion. Second, it is concentrated and corroborated across all five models: open-mouth faces (read as surprise, correlating with the AU26 jaw drop) and South-Asian children degrade systematically, with a smaller averted-gaze penalty, while closed-mouth faces, White and Black children, and direct gaze do not; the bias tracks expression morphology and specific populations, not skin tone. Third, the gap is diagnosable: a linear probe on frozen features reaches 0.75-0.91 on unseen children versus 0.48-0.66 zero-shot, so it lies largely in the classifier head, not the representation, whereas dimensional valence/arousal regression degrades sharply under domain shift. Building on this, recalibrating only the head on a little target data recovers $+0.13$ to $+0.28$ on the two largest child sets across all five models at negligible adult cost, though the gain is in-distribution and does not transfer across child collections. We will release the harness, per-sample predictions, and analysis code; the child face data stays license-locked and is never redistributed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用统一 harness 审计五个 AffectNet 预训练表情模型在儿童上的表现，发现儿童差距是模型无关的：所有架构都从摆拍脸退化到自然脸，并共享 fear→surprise 混淆；退化集中在张嘴脸（读成 surprise，对应 AU26 下颌下垂）与南亚儿童，闭嘴脸、白人与黑人儿童、直视则不退化。线性探针在冻结特征上对未见儿童达 0.75–0.91，而 zero-shot 仅 0.48–0.66，说明差距主要在分类头而非表征；只用少量目标数据重标定头部即可在两个最大儿童集上跨全部五个模型恢复 +0.13 至 +0.28。
Motivation: 表情识别模型几乎全用成人训练，却被用于教育、健康与发育研究中的儿童；需要判断退化是表征问题还是分类头问题，以及偏差究竟跟随肤色还是表情形态与特定人群。
Method: 在一个共享 harness 下审计五个 AffectNet 预训练模型（EmoNet、EmotiEffLib、DDAMFN++、OpenFace 3.0、LibreFace），覆盖四个儿童图像数据集、AffectNet-8 验证集与两个自然儿童视频数据集；用冻结特征上的线性探针对比 zero-shot，并只在头部用少量目标数据重标定，同时做 valence/arousal 维度回归。
Result: 五个模型全部从摆拍退化到自然脸并共享 fear→surprise 混淆；张嘴脸与南亚儿童系统性退化，侧视有较小惩罚，闭嘴脸、白人与黑人儿童、直视不退化。冻结特征线性探针在未见儿童上 0.75–0.91，zero-shot 0.48–0.66；维度 valence/arousal 回归在域偏移下急剧退化。仅重标定头部在两个最大儿童集上跨五个模型恢复 +0.13 至 +0.28，成人侧代价可忽略，但增益是 in-distribution 的，不跨儿童数据集迁移。
Conclusion: 儿童差距主要落在分类头而非表征，偏差跟随表情形态与特定人群而非肤色；少量目标数据重标定头部即可缓解，但增益不跨儿童数据集迁移。

papers.title: Two-Sample Testing via Generative Processes
papers.abstract_en: Deciding whether two samples come from the same distribution is a classical problem in statistics, and generative transport offers a new way to approach it. We build a stochastic interpolant directly between the two samples and observe that, for a symmetric schedule, its law is invariant under the time reflection $t \mapsto 1-t$ whenever the two distributions coincide. We therefore test whether the marginals at times t and 1-t agree by computing their Jensen--Shannon divergence. Both marginals are explicit mixtures over all cross-pairs of observations, so nothing is learned, and permutation calibration gives an exact finite-sample level. For Gaussian noise, this divergence equals a time integral that pairs the reflection defects of the velocity field and of the score, so the test compares transport dynamics rather than endpoints alone. With a narrow-plus-broad noise design, the test attains the minimax separation rate n^{-2s/(4s+d)} over bounded, compactly supported densities whose difference has Sobolev smoothness s > 3d/4, with no lower bound on the densities. Fusing a dyadic grid of noise scales through their permutation ranks, without sample splitting, preserves exact level and adapts to unknown s at an iterated-logarithmic cost. Empirically, the test matches or outperforms state-of-the-art kernel two-sample tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于随机插值 (stochastic interpolant) 的两样本检验：在两组样本间直接构造对称 schedule 的插值过程，两分布相同时其律对时间反射 t→1−t 不变，用 t 与 1−t 两个边缘的 Jensen–Shannon 散度做检验。窄+宽噪声设计下达到极小极大分离率 n^{-2s/(4s+d)}（Sobolev 光滑度 s>3d/4，密度无下界），多尺度 dyadic 融合保持精确水平并自适应未知 s；实验中匹配或优于 SOTA 核两样本检验。
Motivation: 两样本检验的经典问题中，核方法多比较端点分布，而生成式 transport 提供了比较整条动力学路径的新途径，且需要在不假设密度下界的情况下达到极小极大率。
Method: 在两样本间构造 stochastic interpolant，检验对称 schedule 下 t 与 1−t 边缘是否一致，用 Jensen–Shannon 散度度量；两边缘是所有 cross-pairs 的显式混合，不学习任何参数，用 permutation calibration 得到精确有限样本水平。高斯噪声下该散度等于速度场 reflection defect 与 score reflection defect 配对的时间积分；采用窄+宽噪声设计，并通过 permutation ranks 融合 dyadic 噪声尺度网格，无需样本分割。
Result: 在差的 Sobolev 光滑度 s>3d/4、有界紧支撑密度类上达到极小极大分离率 n^{-2s/(4s+d)}，且对密度无下界要求；多尺度融合保持精确检验水平，对未知 s 自适应，代价为 iterated-logarithmic；实证上匹配或优于 state-of-the-art 核两样本检验。
Conclusion: 两分布重合时插值律的时间反射不变性可转化为精确水平的两样本检验，比较的是 transport 动力学而非仅端点，并在理论上达到极小极大率、在实验中与最强核检验相当或更好。

summary_sections.method: 在两样本间构造 stochastic interpolant，检验对称 schedule 下 t 与 1−t 边缘是否一致，用 Jensen–Shannon 散度度量；两边缘是所有 cross-pairs 的显式混合，不学习任何参数，用 permutation calibration 得到精确有限样本水平。高斯噪声下该散度等于速度场 reflection defect 与 score reflection defect 配对的时间积分；采用窄+宽噪声设计，并通过 permutation ranks 融合 dyadic 噪声尺度网格，无需样本分割。
summary_sections.result: 在差的 Sobolev 光滑度 s>3d/4、有界紧支撑密度类上达到极小极大分离率 n^{-2s/(4s+d)}，且对密度无下界要求；多尺度融合保持精确检验水平，对未知 s 自适应，代价为 iterated-logarithmic；实证上匹配或优于 state-of-the-art 核两样本检验。
summary_sections.conclusion: 两分布重合时插值律的时间反射不变性可转化为精确水平的两样本检验，比较的是 transport 动力学而非仅端点，并在理论上达到极小极大率、在实验中与最强核检验相当或更好。

papers.title: Performative Prediction with Selective Labels
papers.abstract_en: Many social applications of machine learning exhibit performative effects: population behavior changes in response to deployed models. Performative prediction studies this interaction through a distribution map that relates each model to the population distribution it induces. One of the main results in this framework showed that repeated risk minimization (RRM), which updates models by retraining on the most recent data, can converge to a stable model that minimizes risk on its own induced distribution. However, existing analyses typically assume access to the complete distributions of features and labels after model deployment, ignoring the possibility of selective labels: observing labels only for the accepted subset of the population. In this work, we formalize performative prediction with selective labels and show that retraining only on observed data can misguide the retraining procedure and undermine the guarantees of convergence to a stable solution. We then propose a worst-case objective based on knowledge of a confidence interval on the probability of a positive label. Applying RRM to this objective permits us to remain within a bounded distance to the true stable point. Under a sensitivity assumption on the conditional label distribution, we further show how previously accepted data can tighten these confidence intervals over time. Experiments in a lending application with fairness regularization show that our robust optimization approach closely matches the performance of RRM with complete label access.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在选择性标签（只观测被接受样本的标签）下，直接对已观测数据做重复风险最小化 (RRM) 会把重训练引向错误方向、破坏收敛到稳定解的保证。作者提出基于正类概率置信区间的最坏情形目标，使 RRM 保持在真实稳定点的有界距离内；在带公平正则的借贷实验中，该鲁棒优化接近拥有完整标签的 RRM 表现。
Motivation: 既有 performative prediction 分析假设部署后能拿到完整的特征与标签分布，而现实中标签只在被接受的子集上可观测，这会破坏 RRM 收敛到稳定模型的既有结论。
Method: 先形式化带选择性标签的 performative prediction，证明只在已观测数据上重训练会误导过程；再提出利用正类概率置信区间的最坏情形目标，并在条件标签分布的敏感性假设下用历史已接受数据逐步收紧该置信区间，最后把 RRM 用于该目标。
Result: 理论上，所提目标使 RRM 与真实稳定点保持有界距离；实验上，在带公平正则的借贷应用中，鲁棒优化方法的表现与可访问完整标签的 RRM 接近。
Conclusion: 选择性标签下不能直接对观测数据重训练，用置信区间构造的最坏情形目标可在只有部分标签时保住收敛保证；收紧置信区间依赖条件标签分布的敏感性假设。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Segment Reward Feedback under Linear Function Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Classical reinforcement learning (RL) assumes that a reward is observed for every visited state-action pair. However, in real-world applications such as autonomous driving, such fine-grained feedback can be costly or difficult to collect, whereas trajectory-level feedback may be too sparse for efficient learning. To provide a general feedback model bridging these two extremes and handle large state spaces, we study RL with segment reward feedback under linear function approximation. Our work answers how the granularity of segment feedback and the choice of segmentation influence learning. For equal-length segments with known transitions, we design algorithms $\bitssegd$ and $\edlinucbsegd$ for binary and sum feedback types, respectively. They adopt posterior sampling with planning to achieve computational efficiency and the E-optimal experimental design to attain near-optimality. Nearly matching lower bounds are established. For equal-length segments with unknown transitions, we develop a unified $\seglsvits$ framework with two instantiations for binary and sum feedback, which carefully integrates the posterior estimated reward parameters into least-squares value iteration. These results reveal a fundamental insight: under binary feedback, increasing the number of segments significantly reduces the regret through an exponential factor, while surprisingly, under sum feedback, the granularity of segments does not affect learning much. Finally, to investigate whether segmenting according to state-action features can further expedite learning, we design an algorithm $\uneqsegbitsd$ that allows arbitrary segmentations. The resulting regret bound shows that under the usual elliptical potential analysis, the influence of state-action features on the regret appears only through logarithmic factors, and equal segmentation achieves the best performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性函数逼近下研究分段奖励反馈 (segment reward feedback) 的强化学习，设计了已知/未知转移下针对二值与求和两种反馈的算法，并给出几乎匹配的下界。核心结论是：二值反馈下增加分段数能把 regret 降低一个指数因子，而求和反馈下分段粒度几乎不影响学习；按状态-动作特征做不等长分段只通过对数因子影响 regret，等长分段表现最好。
Motivation: 自动驾驶等场景中逐状态-动作的细粒度奖励采集成本高，而整条轨迹级反馈又过于稀疏；需要一个介于两者之间的分段反馈模型，并回答分段粒度与分段方式如何影响学习效率。
Method: 在分段奖励反馈与线性函数逼近框架下：对等长已知转移情形提出 BITSSEG-D（二值反馈）与 EDLinUCB-SegD（求和反馈），用 posterior sampling 加规划保证计算效率、用 E-optimal 实验设计达到近最优；对等长未知转移情形提出统一的 SEGLSVI 框架，把后验估计的奖励参数并入 least-squares value iteration，含二值与求和两个实例；另提出 UNEQSEGBITS-D 允许任意分段。
Result: 建立了几乎匹配的 regret 下界；二值反馈下分段数增加带来指数因子的 regret 下降，求和反馈下分段粒度对学习影响不大；任意分段的 regret 在通常的 elliptical potential 分析下，状态-动作特征只通过对数因子起作用，等长分段最优。
Conclusion: 反馈粒度的作用取决于反馈类型：二值反馈应尽量细分段以获得指数级 regret 收益，求和反馈则无需在意粒度，且等长分段已是最好选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DySCo: Dynamic Sharding for Collaborative Edge-Cloud LLM Inference with Depth-Synchronized Batching
papers.abstract_en: Pervasive intelligent applications are increasingly deployed on mobile and Internet of Things (IoT) edge devices. Consequently, Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support these applications. Yet, due to their high resource demands, LLMs are mostly deployed in the cloud. Layer-wise edge-cloud inference lets resource-constrained edge devices contribute computation to LLMs they cannot host in full. However, heterogeneous split points introduce two coupled inefficiencies. First, edge execution and communication create idle gaps between cloud invocations. Second, requests arriving at different model depths cannot be conventionally batched. We present DySCo, a collaborative runtime that keeps KV caches local and introduces dyForward, a model-aware layer-range executor that runs configurable contiguous layer ranges from resident model shards without reloading weights. For multi-edge serving settings, we introduce depth-synchronized batching (DSB), which advances heterogeneous requests to the deepest cut and batches their common suffix. Experiments across heterogeneous devices, two model families, and local and wide-area links show that idle gaps increase the latency of subsequent GPU forward calls even when waiting time is excluded, adding up to 25 ms of additional cloud-side suffix latency per decoding step in our measurements. At an average concurrency of eight, DSB improves throughput by 275% over FIFO, 48% over exact-match batching, and 79% over round-robin interleaving while reducing mean per-session latency. Together, these results show that requests with different edge-cloud splits can reuse resident cloud weights and share batched suffix computation. The artifact repository for this work is publicly available at: https://github.com/Large-scale-Sustainable-Computing-LSC/dysco-artifact
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DySCo 是面向边缘-云协同 LLM 推理的运行时：dyForward 在常驻模型分片上执行可配置连续层区间而不重载权重，DSB 把异构请求推进到最深切分点后批处理其公共后缀。测量中空闲间隙使每次解码步的云端后缀延迟额外增加最多 25 ms；平均并发 8 时 DSB 吞吐比 FIFO 高 275%、比精确匹配批处理高 48%、比轮转交错高 79%，同时降低平均会话延迟。
Motivation: 层切分的边缘-云 LLM 推理中，异构切分点带来两处耦合低效：边缘执行与通信在云端调用之间留下空闲间隙，且到达不同模型深度的请求无法按常规方式组批。
Method: DySCo 运行时把 KV cache 留在本地，并用模型感知的层区间执行器 dyForward 直接在常驻分片上跑可配置的连续层区间、不重载权重；多边缘场景下引入 depth-synchronized batching (DSB)，把异构请求推进到最深切分点后批处理公共后缀。实验覆盖异构设备、两个模型家族以及本地与广域链路。
Result: 空闲间隙即使排除等待时间也会抬高后续 GPU 前调用延迟，实测每次解码步额外增加最多 25 ms 的云端后缀延迟；平均并发为 8 时，DSB 吞吐较 FIFO 提升 275%、较 exact-match batching 提升 48%、较 round-robin interleaving 提升 79%，并降低平均单会话延迟。
Conclusion: 不同边缘-云切分点的请求可以复用常驻云端权重并共享批处理后的后缀计算，从而同时消掉空闲间隙与深度不一致导致的组批失败。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: zkLLMPoT: Efficient Zero Knowledge Proof of Training for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Auditing the claimed outcomes of large language model (LLM) training is challenging when model weights and training data are private, while cryptographically proving the full training process is prohibitively expensive at Transformer scale. We present zkLLMPoT, a zero-knowledge framework that certifies auditor-defined properties of a trained checkpoint through forward evaluation rather than verification of its optimization trajectory. zkLLMPoT includes 2 phases: 1) The trainer fixes the architecture and the model weights are committed. Then the auditor selects challenge sequences, preventing the trainer from modifying the checkpoint in response to the audit data. 2) Then the trainer proves the objective value attained by the committed model on those sequences. This formulation makes the certification cost independent of the number of training iterations, without revealing model weights or requiring access to private training data. We build on sumcheck- and lookup-based arguments to certify Transformer computations, while supporting next-token loss and task-specific audit objectives. Across four model families, operator-level benchmarks yield proving times of 41-59 seconds for 1.1-1.5B-parameter models and 131 seconds at 13B for the covered operators, with verification below half a second at a sequence length of 512.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: zkLLMPoT 用「先承诺权重、审计方出题、再证明目标函数值」的两阶段零知识框架审计 LLM 训练，把证明成本与训练迭代次数解耦，无需暴露权重或私有训练数据。基于 sumcheck 与 lookup 论证证明 Transformer 计算，1.1–1.5B 模型算子级证明 41–59 秒，13B 为 131 秒，序列长 512 时验证低于半秒。
Motivation: 模型权重与训练数据私有时难以审计 LLM 训练结果，而在 Transformer 规模上密码学证明完整训练过程代价过高。
Method: 两阶段流程：训练方固定架构并承诺模型权重，审计方随后选择 challenge 序列（防止训练方针对审计数据改权重），训练方再证明该承诺模型在这些序列上的目标值；底层用 sumcheck 与 lookup 论证证明 Transformer 计算，支持 next-token loss 与任务特定审计目标。
Result: 在四个模型族上做算子级基准：1.1–1.5B 参数模型证明时间 41–59 秒，13B 为 131 秒（针对所覆盖的算子），序列长度 512 时验证时间低于 0.5 秒；认证成本与训练迭代次数无关。
Conclusion: 审计对象应从优化轨迹改为对已承诺 checkpoint 的前向评估，这样能在不泄露权重、不接触私有训练数据的前提下把证明开销压到与训练步数无关。

papers.title: MASC: A Multi-Agent Self-Calibration Framework with Latent Construct Alignment for Consistent Client Role-Playing in Psychological Counseling
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate clients for counselor training and psychological counseling research, but reliable simulation requires clients to remain psychologically coherent across extended interactions. Existing role-playing methods largely rely on static profile prompts and may exhibit persona drift, unrealistic cooperativeness, or inconsistent psychological states, communicative actions, and emotions. Existing evaluations also lack a unified testbed for both stable client characteristics and evolving psychological dynamics. We propose MASC, a Multi-Agent Self-Calibration framework with latent construct alignment for consistent client role-playing in psychological counseling. MASC combines construct-guided generation, collaborative refinement, consistency verification, and memory-based revision in a closed calibration loop that detects and corrects inconsistencies as dialogue unfolds. We further introduce CRPC-Bench, a benchmark covering session-level profile information and Big-Five personality traits, as well as turn-level psychological state, communicative action, and emotion expression. CRPC-Bench contains 38 motivational interviewing client profiles augmented with personality and emotion annotations. Experiments show that MASC outperforms existing methods across profile, personality, receptivity, and turn-level consistency, with the heterogeneous configuration achieving the strongest overall performance. MASC and CRPC-Bench provide a unified foundation for developing and evaluating psychologically coherent client simulations for AI-assisted counseling research and training.

papers.title: LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs
papers.abstract_en: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LeanPlan 用 agentic loop 让 LLM 迭代生成可复用的领域启发式、其 admissibility 证明与所需领域假设，并在 Lean 4 中机器检查启发式实现、grounding 与搜索，从而用 LLM 生成的启发式找到最优规划。在 IPC 的十个领域加三个新领域、测试任务物体数最多为训练任务 57 倍的设置下，GPT-5.6 Sol 全部成功生成启发式与证明，所得启发式通常比 Scorpion 展开更少状态并解出更多任务。
Motivation: LLM 生成的启发式在 satisficing planning 上已达 SOTA，但不保证 admissible，会给出次优解；要在保持 LLM 启发式性能的同时保证最优性，需要机器可检查的 admissibility 证明。
Method: 给定领域描述与训练任务，agentic loop 用 planner 反馈迭代改进领域专用启发式、其 admissibility 证明和所需领域假设；启发式实现、证明以及高效的 planner（含机器检查的 grounding 与搜索）均在 Lean 4 中实现。
Result: 在 International Planning Competition 的十个领域加三个新领域上评估，测试任务的物体数最多为训练任务的 57 倍；用 GPT-5.6 Sol 跑 agentic loop，全部领域都成功生成启发式与 admissibility 证明；配这些启发式，LeanPlan 通常比 SOTA 的 Scorpion planner 展开更少状态，且总体解出更多任务。
Conclusion: LLM 生成的启发式可以配上机器检查的 admissibility 证明并用于最优规划，在跨领域泛化（物体数放大至 57 倍）下仍通常比 Scorpion 更省状态、解题更多。

papers.title: Sensor-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Sensors are useful not only for understanding the world but also for deciding what to do next. Existing sensor models however largely stop at perception: they recognize states or predict outcomes, leaving actions modeled separately through task-specific and often closed label spaces. We introduce Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) modeling, a framework that connects multimodal sensor observations, natural language, and actions within a unified model. SLA uses language as a semantic interface between sensing and acting, allowing heterogeneous actions to be represented, predicted, and explained while remaining grounded in the underlying sensor evidence. We build a large-scale SLA benchmark consisting of datasets that span more than 116,000 individuals, 79 sensor modalities, and 60 action groups, together with a multi-faceted captioning pipeline that aligns user context, sensor dynamics, and action evidence. Building on this framework, we present OpenSLA, a unified SLA model for hierarchical action prediction, state understanding, and action explanation. Extensive experiments on real-world tasks in clinical prediction, operating rooms, and metabolic health verify its superior performance over the state-of-the-art. OpenSLA also demonstrates intriguing capabilities including language-guided evidence grounding and zero-shot generalization to unseen actions and cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sensor-Language-Action (SLA) 建模框架，用自然语言作为感知与动作之间的语义接口，把多模态传感器观测、语言与异构动作统一进一个模型，并构建覆盖 116,000+ 个体、79 种传感器模态、60 个动作组的 SLA benchmark。基于该框架的 OpenSLA 支持层级动作预测、状态理解与动作解释，在临床预测、手术室、代谢健康等真实任务上超过 SOTA，并展现语言引导的证据归因与对未见动作/人群的零样本泛化。
Motivation: 现有传感器模型止步于感知：只识别状态或预测结果，动作则由任务特定且封闭的标签空间单独建模，感知证据与决策之间缺少统一接口。
Method: SLA 框架以语言为语义接口连接传感与动作，使异构动作可被表示、预测和解释且仍锚定传感器证据；配套多面 captioning 管线对齐用户上下文、传感器动态与动作证据；其上构建 OpenSLA 统一模型，做层级动作预测、状态理解和动作解释。
Result: benchmark 规模为 116,000+ 个体、79 种传感器模态、60 个动作组；OpenSLA 在临床预测、手术室、代谢健康等真实任务上超过 SOTA，并展示语言引导的证据归因与对未见动作和人群的零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 把语言作为传感到动作的统一接口，可在同一模型内同时完成动作预测、状态理解与动作解释，并对未见动作和人群保持零样本泛化。

papers.title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
papers.abstract_en: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OSFP4 为 NVFP4 LLM 推理量化提出联合优化方案：对每个线性投影学习一个对角平滑矩阵，其元素与 block scales 一起以最小化矩阵乘积量化误差为目标联合求解，并兼容 round-to-nearest 与 GPTQ 式逐次干扰消除两种舍入。实验中它在对应量化设置下取得被评对手的最高平均精度，同时保留约 94–97% 的厂商 NVFP4 prefill 吞吐。
Motivation: NVFP4 存储紧凑且有 tensor-core 原生加速，但直接量化会掉精度；现有平滑与缩放做法各自独立调参，未针对 NVFP4 的舍入过程联合优化。
Method: 对每个线性投影引入对角平滑矩阵，元素按 NVFP4 下的平方矩阵乘积量化误差优化，并显式纳入所用舍入过程（round-to-nearest 或 GPTQ 式 successive interference cancellation）；通过分析 multiplicative-dither FP4 量化器（而非固定确定性量化器）使平滑元素与 block scales 的联合优化可解。
Result: 在所评测的对应量化设置下，OSFP4 取得所有被评对手中的最高平均精度；在所测工作负载上保留约 94–97% 的厂商 NVFP4 prefill 吞吐。
Conclusion: 把对角平滑与 block scales 在 NVFP4 舍入模型下联合优化，可以在保住厂商 NVFP4 prefill 吞吐大部分（约 94–97%）的同时拿到最高平均精度；代码已开源。

papers.title: TSRN-RTVD: Real-Time Video Deblurring System
papers.abstract_en: As video capture moves to handheld and edge devices, motion blur from camera shake has become a pervasive degradation that lowers perceptual quality and harms downstream vision tasks. The strongest deblurring networks recover impressive detail, yet they remain computationally heavy and overwhelmingly complex, so their quality comes at a cost that consumer hardware cannot pay in real time. This gap between restoration quality and on-device speed is exactly what makes real-time deblurring difficult. We developed and implemented TSRN-RTVD, an efficient video deblurring system that explicitly reconstructs the underlying camera trajectory during exposure and uses the recovered motion to guide restoration. This approach turns the physical cause of blur into a signal that drives sharpening. Our system runs on a single consumer GPU and restores the video at 30 FPS while reaching 30.08 dB PSNR on the GoPro dataset. We demonstrate TSRN-RTVD on consumer devices with interactive side-by-side visualization of the blurry input and the deblurred output, live throughput, and an on-screen view of the recovered camera trajectory. Demo video is available at https://youtu.be/3alMwVrVALU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TSRN-RTVD 是面向消费级 GPU 的实时视频去模糊系统：先在曝光期间显式重建相机运动轨迹，再用恢复出的运动引导锐化，把模糊的物理成因变成驱动修复的信号。在单张消费级 GPU 上以 30 FPS 处理视频，GoPro 数据集上达到 30.08 dB PSNR。
Motivation: 手持与边缘设备上相机抖动造成的运动模糊普遍存在，而最强的去模糊网络计算量大、结构复杂，质量好却无法在消费硬件上实时运行，恢复质量与端侧速度之间存在明显落差。
Method: 系统显式重建曝光期间的底层相机轨迹，并用恢复的运动信息引导去模糊过程，将模糊的物理成因转化为锐化信号；整套流程部署在单张消费级 GPU 上，并提供模糊输入与去模糊输出的并排可视化、实时吞吐显示以及恢复轨迹的屏幕展示。
Result: 在单张消费级 GPU 上以 30 FPS 恢复视频，GoPro 数据集上 PSNR 达到 30.08 dB。
Conclusion: 把相机轨迹重建作为中间信号引入去模糊，可以在消费级硬件上同时保住实时吞吐与恢复质量，使系统能在消费设备上交互式演示。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Confidence-Ordering Reversal under Contextual Priors in Neural Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Contextual priors improve neural-to-language decoding by reshaping candidate scores. However, confidence is read from the same reshaped scores, so the errors a prior leaves behind can become more confident with no change in accuracy to reveal it. We study how a prior shapes confidence in speech retrieval on MEG-MASC and MOUS using local decoding scores, a contextual prior combined by additive shallow fusion, and the fused top-two margin as confidence. Among initially incorrect predictions, we find a confidence-ordering reversal: a larger margin makes a repair more likely when the correct candidate starts near the top of the local ranking, but less likely when it starts lower. On MEG-MASC, pooled correctness AUROC is 0.87, yet AUROC separating repairs from residual errors falls from 0.70 at initial ranks 2-3 to 0.39 at ranks 21-50. Errors starting beyond rank 20, inside the reversed region, make up 46.6% of all post-fusion errors. We propose a score-level account: a repair must first close the correct candidate's initial deficit, limiting its final margin, whereas a residual error can build a large margin between two incorrect candidates. A causal intervention that changes only the fusion weight moves the reversal to deeper ranks as predicted. Under a word-level LM prior, it keeps moving after accuracy gain peaks, so a weight chosen for accuracy does not settle confidence. Reading local and prior scores separately improves selective decoding: the decoder answers on 74.5% of windows instead of 56.7%, while 92% of output sets still contain the correct candidate. Confidence after contextual fusion should retain the local and contextual evidence behind each prediction, not just the fused scores. Project website: https://confidencereversal.github.io/; Code: https://github.com/AmadeusFake/NeuDecodingConfReversal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 上下文先验用加性浅层融合 (additive shallow fusion) 改写候选分数后，置信度也从同一融合分数读出，导致 MEG 解码中出现置信度排序反转：初始排名靠前时 top-two margin 越大越可能修复，排名靠后时反而越不可能。MEG-MASC 上整体正确性 AUROC 为 0.87，但区分修复与残留错误的 AUROC 从初始排名 2–3 的 0.70 降到 21–50 的 0.39；作者建议选择性解码时分开读取局部分数与先验分数。
Motivation: 上下文先验能改对预测，却把置信度建立在被改写的融合分数上：准确率不变时，先验留下的错误反而变得更自信，无法从准确率察觉。
Method: 在 MEG-MASC 与 MOUS 的语音检索 (speech retrieval) 上，用局部解码分数、加性浅层融合组合的上下文先验，以及融合后的 top-two margin 作为置信度；提出分数层面解释（修复需先补上正确候选的初始亏损，残留错误则在两个错误候选间堆出大 margin），并用只改融合权重的因果干预检验反转位置。
Result: MEG-MASC 上整体正确性 AUROC 0.87，区分修复与残留错误的 AUROC 从初始排名 2–3 的 0.70 降至 21–50 的 0.39；初始排名超过 20（反转区）的错误占融合后全部错误的 46.6%。因果干预使反转随预测移向更深排名；在词级 LM 先验下，准确率增益见顶后反转仍在继续。分开读取局部与先验分数后，解码器在 74.5% 的窗口上作答（原 56.7%），且 92% 的输出集合仍含正确候选。
Conclusion: 按准确率选出的融合权重不能稳定置信度；上下文融合后的置信度应保留每个预测背后的局部与上下文证据，而不只是融合分数。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: How Many Independent Samples Does a Satellite Image Contain? Generalization Bounds for Spatially Dependent Data
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning classifiers for remote sensing imagery are typically evaluated as though every pixel were an independent sample. Spatial autocorrelation violates this assumption, since neighboring pixels carry redundant information which inflates sample sizes. How many independent samples does a satellite image actually contain? For an $n \times n$ image whose spatial correlation persists over a range of $r$ pixels, the effective sample size is $Θ(n^2/r^2)$, not $n^2$. We prove this as a finite-sample upper bound for classifiers on spatially correlated data, and show via a matching lower bound that the rate is tight, and no algorithm can do better. We extend the results to images with directional correlation and spatially varying correlation structure. Our result justifies spatial cross-validation since block holdout with separation proportional to the correlation range achieves optimal generalization guarantees, while random holdout can underestimate confidence interval widths by a factor proportional to $r$. We validate the theory on synthetic data and satellite image tiles from three sensors (Landsat 8, Sentinel-2, and Sentinel-1).
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing (2026) vol. 64
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 卫星影像分类按像素独立评估会高估有效样本量：当空间相关持续 r 个像素时，n×n 图像的有效样本量是 Θ(n²/r²) 而非 n²，且该速率紧致、无算法可超越。由此按相关范围成比例留出的分块交叉验证 (block holdout) 达到最优泛化保证，而随机留出可能把置信区间宽度低估 r 倍量级。
Motivation: 遥感分类器通常把每个像素当作独立样本评估，空间自相关使邻近像素携带冗余信息，从而虚增样本量、让置信区间过窄。
Method: 对空间相关数据上的分类器证明有限样本有效样本量上界 Θ(n²/r²)，并给出匹配下界证明速率紧致；结果扩展到方向性相关与空间变化的相关结构，再用合成数据与三种传感器影像瓦片验证。
Result: 有效样本量上界 Θ(n²/r²)（n×n 图像、相关范围 r 像素），匹配下界证明该速率紧致且无算法可更好；随机留出可把置信区间宽度低估约 r 倍；验证用合成数据及 Landsat 8、Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1 影像瓦片。
Conclusion: 空间相关下按相关范围成比例的分块留出是达到最优泛化保证的评估方式，随机留出会系统性低估不确定性。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: VOMMI: Collecting and Leveraging Portable Demonstrations for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Portable mobile-manipulation demonstrations can help alleviate data scarcity for embodied intelligence, but obtaining reliable, low-cost, and robot-free motion supervision from RGB observations remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on teleoperation or specialized devices equipped with additional sensing hardware, while directly using estimated visual odometry (VO) trajectories can introduce inconsistencies due to accumulated drift and imperfect motion supervision. We present the Visual-Odometry-Conditioned Mobile Manipulation Interface (VOMMI), a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects portable RGB demonstrations to vision-language-action (VLA) post-training through offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning. VOMMI synchronizes body and hand views to capture navigation context and local object interactions without requiring human-robot kinematic correspondence calibration. R2-VO refines offline demonstration trajectories using sparse geometric anchors and produces causal local-motion tokens over multiple prediction horizons for online policy conditioning. An action-group residual adapter incorporates these tokens only into the base branch. Experiments use a 500-trajectory portable for each task, with 75 trajectories held out for RGB-VO evaluation, and 200 robot demonstrations as references. Our policy, post-trained only on portable demonstrations, achieves 18.2% lower base-velocity error than a policy trained with robot-collected demonstrations, while maintaining comparable end-effector translation accuracy. Offline reconstruction reduces absolute trajectory errors for the body and hand streams by 24.6% on average relative to the best evaluated baseline for each stream. The complete system improves the mean success rate by 8.3 percentage points over OpenPI 0.5 across three real-robot tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VOMMI 用普通 RGB 设备采集移动操作演示，靠 R2-VO 离线重建轨迹并生成因果局部运动 token 在线约束策略，把便携演示接到 VLA 后训练。仅用便携演示后训练的策略，基座速度误差比用机器人采集演示训练的策略低 18.2%，末端执行器平移精度相当；完整系统在三个真机任务上比 OpenPI 0.5 平均成功率高 8.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 移动操作的演示数据稀缺，而现有采集依赖遥操作或带额外传感的专用设备；直接用视觉里程计 (VO) 轨迹又会因累积漂移和不完美的运动监督引入不一致。
Method: VOMMI 同步身体与手部视角以捕捉导航上下文和局部物体交互，无需人机运动学对应标定。R2-VO 用稀疏几何锚点离线精修演示轨迹，并在多个预测时域上产生因果局部运动 token 供在线策略条件化；动作组残差适配器 (action-group residual adapter) 只把这些 token 注入基座分支。
Result: 每个任务采集 500 条便携演示，其中 75 条留出做 RGB-VO 评估，另有 200 条机器人演示作参照。仅用便携演示后训练的策略基座速度误差比用机器人演示训练的策略低 18.2%，末端执行器平移精度相当；离线重建使身体流与手部流的绝对轨迹误差相对各流最佳评估基线平均下降 24.6%；完整系统在三个真机任务上比 OpenPI 0.5 平均成功率提高 8.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: 便携 RGB 演示配合 VO 精修与运动 token 条件化可以替代机器人采集的演示做移动操作 VLA 后训练，并在真机任务上带来成功率提升。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN): Resource-Aware Hybrid Vision-Language Fusion via Trainable Entanglement
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal vision-language systems typically fuse image and text embeddings through classical operators such as concatenation, attention, bilinear pooling, or tensor interactions. We propose Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that introduces parameterized entanglement as a structured inductive bias for multimodal fusion. Pretrained visual and textual features are projected into compact latent spaces, encoded as angle-parameterized quantum states, processed through intra-modal and paired cross-modal entangling circuits, and measured to produce fused representations for retrieval. Under matched parameter budgets and identical frozen CLIP backbones, QEMFN outperforms classical fusion baselines on COCO-5k and Flickr30k, including multilayer perceptron, tensor fusion, FiLM, cross-attention, compact transformer, and a dequantized paired-topology analogue. An ablation suite isolates the quantum module's contribution from the surrounding classical projections, and quantum-centric analyses report Meyer-Wallach entangling capability, expressibility, gradient variance against barren-plateau bounds, and entropy-performance correlation under controls for training progress alongside an intervention study on the entangling component. QEMFN is executed under shot-based estimation, a noise-modeled fake backend, and a real superconducting device with zero-noise extrapolation. This work does not claim quantum computational advantage; the contribution is the framework together with a controlled empirical and quantum-centric evaluation that positions trainable entanglement as an interpretable, hardware-executable fusion mechanism at scales accessible on contemporary devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QEMFN 把预训练视觉与文本特征投影到紧凑潜空间后编码为角度参数化量子态，经模态内与跨模态纠缠线路处理并测量得到融合表示用于检索。在匹配参数预算与冻结 CLIP 主干下，它在 COCO-5k 与 Flickr30k 上超过 MLP、tensor fusion、FiLM、cross-attention 等经典融合基线，并在含噪 fake backend 与真实超导器件（配 zero-noise extrapolation）上以 shot-based 估计执行。
Motivation: 多模态融合长期依赖拼接、注意力、双线性池化等经典算子，缺少可解释且能在当代量子设备上执行的结构化归纳偏置。
Method: 预训练 CLIP 视觉/文本特征投影到紧凑潜空间，编码为角度参数化量子态，经 intra-modal 与 paired cross-modal 纠缠线路处理后测量出融合表示；配套 ablation 分离量子模块贡献，并做 Meyer-Wallach 纠缠能力、expressibility、梯度方差对 barren-plateau 界、熵-性能相关性分析与纠缠组件干预研究。
Result: 在匹配参数预算与相同冻结 CLIP 主干下，QEMFN 在 COCO-5k 与 Flickr30k 上优于 MLP、tensor fusion、FiLM、cross-attention、compact transformer 及 dequantized paired-topology 类比基线；执行环境包括 shot-based 估计、含噪 fake backend 与配 zero-noise extrapolation 的真实超导器件。
Conclusion: 可训练纠缠可作为可解释、可在当代设备上执行的融合机制；作者明确不主张量子计算优势，贡献是框架加受控的实证与 quantum-centric 评估。
Relevance: 2
