papers.title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
papers.abstract_en: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge. These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts. We also vary game instances to test whether agents can apply what they have learned to new situations. Therefore, we evaluate how backbone models, self-evolving methods, and agent harnesses affect agents' learning ability, revealing three findings: (1) Experience retention: Retaining complete records of actions and feedback can support more effective learning than summarizing these experiences into rules or strategies. (2) Human agent gap: Top-performing human players achieve higher peak scores than the evaluated agents. Human explore more varied strategies, and repeat actions less. (3) Harness matters: With the backbone fixed, changing the harness can improve performance while reducing estimated inference cost. Together, these findings provide insights into how LLM agents learn from experience and suggest directions for future work to improve their learning ability. Project website: https://liushiliushi.github.io/learn2play-bench-website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Learn2Play Bench 用规则新颖或反直觉的自研文本游戏评测 LLM agent 从交互中学习的能力，从而把「从交互学习」与「调用预训练知识推理」区分开。三条发现：完整保留动作与反馈记录比把经验总结成规则/策略更有效；顶尖人类玩家峰值分数高于所有被测 agent；固定 backbone 时更换 agent harness 可以在降低估计推理成本的同时提升性能。
Motivation: 现有经验学习基准的题目规则写在指令里或已被预训练模型见过，无法区分 agent 是真的从交互学到东西，还是靠已有知识推理。
Method: 构建一组新设计的文本游戏，规则新颖或反直觉，提供可复现反馈与自动打分，支持跨重复尝试的受控学习评测；并变换 game instance 检验迁移。评测维度包括 backbone model、self-evolving 方法与 agent harness 三类。
Result: 三条定性发现：完整记录动作与反馈优于把经验压缩成规则或策略；表现最好的人类玩家峰值分数高于被测 agent，且人类策略更多样、重复动作更少；固定 backbone 下改 harness 可同时提升性能并降低估计推理成本。
Conclusion: LLM agent 的经验学习能力受经验存储形式与 harness 影响很大，且当前与人类仍有差距；保留原始交互记录是比经验总结更有效的学习路径。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 现有经验学习基准的题目规则写在指令里或已被预训练模型见过，无法区分 agent 是真的从交互学到东西，还是靠已有知识推理。
summary_sections.method: 构建一组新设计的文本游戏，规则新颖或反直觉，提供可复现反馈与自动打分，支持跨重复尝试的受控学习评测；并变换 game instance 检验迁移。评测维度包括 backbone model、self-evolving 方法与 agent harness 三类。
summary_sections.result: 三条定性发现：完整记录动作与反馈优于把经验压缩成规则或策略；表现最好的人类玩家峰值分数高于被测 agent，且人类策略更多样、重复动作更少；固定 backbone 下改 harness 可同时提升性能并降低估计推理成本。
summary_sections.conclusion: LLM agent 的经验学习能力受经验存储形式与 harness 影响很大，且当前与人类仍有差距；保留原始交互记录是比经验总结更有效的学习路径。

papers.title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
papers.abstract_en: We report on an approach to teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, based on the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology, used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. LogiKEy uses classical higher-order logic (HOL) as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics; through these semantical embeddings a single proof assistant (e.g. Isabelle/HOL), with its automated theorem provers and (counter-)model finders, becomes one environment in which students learn, experiment with, and compare logics. After making the pedagogical case for proof assistants in the logic classroom, we present a graded sequence of classroom examples, each transition motivated by a limitation of the preceding representation, by a need for more explicit modelling resources, or by a new application. A liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle leads from propositional to modal logic; the Wise Men puzzle leads on to dynamic epistemic logic; Boolos's curious inference illustrates what a higher-order meta-logic buys, even for automated proof search; Chisholm's paradox takes the sequence into deontic logic, and from standard to dyadic deontic logic; and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. We then rebut the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL is monism rather than pluralism, reflect on three years of teaching such a course, and sketch the portability of the approach beyond Isabelle.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LogiKEy 用高阶逻辑 (HOL) 作为通用元逻辑，通过语义嵌入把经典与非经典对象逻辑编码进单一证明助手 Isabelle/HOL，配自动定理证明器与（反）模型查找器，让混专业学生在同一环境中学习比较多种逻辑。该方法已在课程、暑期学校与教程中使用十余年，并给出从命题逻辑到模态、动态认知、道义乃至 Gödel 本体论论证的分级课堂序列。
Motivation: 面向 CS、数学、哲学混班教逻辑时，经典与非经典逻辑各自需要不同工具，学生难以在同一环境中对比不同逻辑的语义与推理行为。
Method: 以 HOL 为元逻辑，用语义嵌入 (semantical embeddings) 定义对象逻辑语义；在 Isabelle/HOL 中调用自动定理证明器与（反）模型查找器；按受限性递进组织课堂案例：liars-and-truth-tellers 引出模态逻辑、Wise Men 引出动态认知逻辑、Boolos 推理展示高阶元逻辑对自动证明搜索的作用、Chisholm 悖论引入道义逻辑与 dyadic deontic logic、Gödel 本体论论证收尾。
Result: 方法在课程、暑期学校与教程中沿用超过十年，并有三年该课程的教学反思；给出五个分级课堂案例的完整序列，并回应“全部嵌入经典 HOL 是一元论而非多元论”的质疑，同时勾勒脱离 Isabelle 的可移植性。
Conclusion: 把多种逻辑统一嵌入经典 HOL 并复用一个证明助手，可在逻辑课堂上同时支撑教学、实验与逻辑间比较，且该做法并非放弃逻辑多元论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RACE-FPP: A Robust AI-assisted Characterisation Enhancement for Fringe Projection Profilometry
papers.abstract_en: Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP) requires precise system characterisation to achieve reliable three-dimensional (3D) reconstructions; however, characterisation accuracy strongly depends on robust checkerboard feature localisation, which can deteriorate under challenging imaging conditions such as lens blur and characterisation target orientations. Existing deep learning-based corner detectors are typically assessed using detection metrics and camera reprojection error alone, without considering their wider impact on projector characterisation, camera-projector stereo characterisation consistency, or overall measurement accuracy. In this work, we introduce a complete FPP characterisation pipeline that incorporates deep learning-based corner detection into the standard camera characterisation workflow. We also characterise the projector by sampling phase values at the centres of the white squares in the characterisation target. Rather than treating corner detection as an isolated task, the proposed framework explicitly analyses how localisation errors propagate throughout the entire FPP characterisation chain. Performance is evaluated using detection metrics (e.g., precision and recall), camera and projector reprojection errors, and the camera and projector stereo characterisation. Across a mixed dataset of clean and degraded images, the camera reprojection error is reduced from 1.237 pixels to 0.259 pixels, while the projector reprojection error is reduced by roughly 50%. Dimensional evaluation of reconstructed artefacts shows improved geometric accuracy compared with those resulting from the conventional pipeline. Overall, the findings indicate increased robustness of system-level characterisation under challenging imaging conditions, thereby enabling more reliable industrial FPP measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RACE-FPP 把深度学习角点检测嵌入完整的条纹投影轮廓术 (FPP) 系统标定链，并在标定靶白方块中心采样相位值来标定投影仪，显式追踪定位误差如何沿标定链传播。在干净与退化（镜头模糊、靶面姿态变化）混合图像集上，相机重投影误差从 1.237 像素降到 0.259 像素，投影仪重投影误差下降约 50%，重建工件的几何精度优于传统流程。
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的角点检测器只用检测指标和相机重投影误差评估，忽略了角点误差对投影仪标定、相机-投影仪立体标定一致性乃至最终测量精度的传播影响；而镜头模糊和标定靶姿态等恶劣成像条件会使角点定位退化。
Method: 提出完整的 FPP 标定流水线：把深度学习角点检测接入标准相机标定流程，并在标定靶白方块中心采样相位值来标定投影仪；框架显式分析定位误差在整个 FPP 标定链中的传播，而非把角点检测当孤立任务。
Result: 在干净与退化图像混合数据集上，相机重投影误差从 1.237 像素降至 0.259 像素，投影仪重投影误差下降约 50%；评估指标包括检测 precision/recall、相机与投影仪重投影误差以及相机/投影仪立体标定；重建工件的尺寸评估显示几何精度优于传统流程。
Conclusion: 把角点检测放进系统级标定链并联合评估，可在恶劣成像条件下提升 FPP 系统标定的稳健性，从而支持更可靠的工业 FPP 测量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Anytime-valid simulation-based hypothesis testing
papers.abstract_en: For a given data distribution $(X_t)_{t \in \mathbb{N}} \sim Q$ i.i.d., we investigate the hypothesis testing problem: $H_0: Q = P_0$ vs. $H_1: Q = P_1$, for two different model probability distributions $P_0$ and $P_1$. In contrast to the standard setting, where analytic densities $p_0$ and $p_1$ are given, here, we consider the density-free setting, where we only have access to i.i.d. simulations $(Z^0_t)_{t \in \mathbb{N}} \sim P_0$ and $(Z^1_t)_{t \in \mathbb{N}} \sim P_1$. For this simulation-based hypothesis testing setting, we construct an e-test martingale, resulting in a sequential test with anytime-valid type-I error guarantees, approximate growth optimality, geometrically decaying type-II error bounds, and asymptotic power one. Most ingredients used in our constructions are variants of well known concepts. The value of this paper lies in the compact presentation of an effective, anytime-valid solution for the density-free simulation-based sequential hypothesis testing case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只能拿到 P0、P1 的 i.i.d. 模拟样本、没有解析密度的场景下，构造一个 e-test martingale，把模拟式假设检验做成序列化检验：type-I 错误具有 anytime-valid 保证，type-II 错误按几何速率衰减，渐近功效为 1，并近似增长最优。
Motivation: 标准序贯检验假设 p0、p1 解析可得；许多模型只能模拟采样、密度不可得，此时既无法直接算似然比，也难给出随时有效的 type-I 控制。
Method: 针对 H0: Q=P0 对 H1: Q=P1（数据 (X_t) i.i.d. ~ Q），仅用 i.i.d. 模拟样本 (Z^0_t)~P0、(Z^1_t)~P1 构造 e-test martingale，形成序贯检验；作者称所用构件多为已知概念的变体。
Result: 得到 anytime-valid 的 type-I 错误保证、近似增长最优性 (approximate growth optimality)、几何衰减的 type-II 错误界，以及渐近功效为 1；摘要未给出数值实验。
Conclusion: 作者认为本文价值在于以紧凑形式给出密度不可得的模拟式序贯假设检验的一个有效、anytime-valid 的解决方案。

papers.title: STRUCTURALCOST: A controlled reading time dataset for modeling human sentence processing difficulty
papers.abstract_en: We introduce STRUCTURALCOST, a self-paced reading dataset of 475 participants and 40,800 observations isolating the processing cost of long-distance subject-verb dependency resolution. We replicate a low-powered psycholinguistic finding at NLP scale, namely that human reading times at the main verb increase with dependency length, driven by syntactic embedding beyond linear distance. Different language models -- spanning n-gram models, SSMs, and transformers -- partially mirror this graded difficulty profile, yet underestimate the integration cost humans incur, with a gap that persists across architectures and model sizes. This suggests these models capture the predictive component of human processing but not the full integration cost that working memory imposes. STRUCTURALCOST provides data needed to drive progress toward evaluating the cognitive plausibility of language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STRUCTURALCOST 是一个自定步速阅读数据集，475 名被试、40,800 条观测，专门分离长距离主语-动词依存解析的加工代价。它复现了心理语言学中主语阅读时间随依存长度增加的发现，且增长由线性距离之外的句法嵌入驱动；n-gram、SSM 与 transformer 都部分复现这一梯度难度，但系统性低估人类的整合代价，且该差距跨架构与模型规模持续存在。
Motivation: 依存长度效应此前只有小样本心理语言学证据，缺少在 NLP 规模上检验语言模型是否复现人类句法加工代价的受控数据集。
Method: 自定步速阅读 (self-paced reading) 实验，475 名参与者产生 40,800 条观测，刺激设计用于分离长距离主语-动词依存的加工代价，并区分句法嵌入深度与线性距离的贡献；随后用 n-gram、状态空间模型 (SSM) 与 transformer 三类语言模型对照人类阅读时间的梯度剖面。
Result: 人类在主语处的阅读时间随依存长度上升，且该效应由句法嵌入而非单纯线性距离驱动；三类语言模型部分复现这一梯度难度剖面，但都低估人类的整合代价，差距在不同架构与模型规模下持续存在。
Conclusion: 现有语言模型捕捉了人类加工的预测成分，却没有覆盖工作记忆施加的完整整合代价；该数据集用于评估语言模型的认知合理性 (cognitive plausibility)。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Tool-calling retrieval versus vector RAG for a small Greek--English knowledge base: accuracy and robustness to how users type Greek
papers.abstract_en: Assistants grounded in a small, frequently edited knowledge base can retrieve through tool calls to a live data interface or through vector retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We compare the two on KyGround, a benchmark of 198 questions drawn from the published records of a Greek--English agricultural platform on Kythera, Greece, with answers verified automatically against the records and each question posed in up to nine forms, including Greek without accents, in capitals and in three Latin-script (Greeklish) schemes. With Claude Haiku 4.5 as router and answer model, a reconstruction of the platform's tool agent answered 71.6\% of canonical Greek questions correctly and vector RAG 95.3\% (difference $-23.6$ percentage points, 95\% CI $-33.1$ to $-15.1$). Letting the router write the vector query changed nothing, and placing the whole knowledge base of about 26,000 tokens in the prompt reached 99.3\%. The tool agent's losses arose in retrieval. Its literal searches returned nothing when the router's arguments did not occur verbatim in a record, for example when it transliterated Greek into Latin script or combined words that occur in a record but not as one phrase, and the agent then abstained. Unaccented and capitalised questions cost the tool agent about 20 points and vector RAG at most 2; accent-insensitive search removed this loss, and matching stemmed tokens raised the tool agent to 83.8\% on canonical Greek. Greeklish cost both designs about 21 to 32 points. Tool interfaces for community knowledge bases need search that tolerates how users type.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 KyGround（198 道题、每题最多 9 种输入形式）上对比工具调用检索与向量 RAG：Claude Haiku 4.5 路由下，工具 agent 在规范希腊语问题上答对 71.6%，向量 RAG 95.3%（差 -23.6 个百分点，95% CI -33.1 至 -15.1），整库约 26,000 token 直接塞 prompt 达 99.3%。损失全在检索端：字面匹配在无重音、全大写时各掉约 20 分，改用重音不敏感检索并匹配词干 token 后工具 agent 回到 83.8%；Greeklish（拉丁转写）让两种方案都掉 21–32 分。结论是社区知识库的工具接口必须容忍用户的输入方式。
Motivation: 小型、频繁编辑的知识库常用工具调用或向量 RAG 两种检索路径，但希腊语用户会输入无重音、全大写或 Greeklish 等多种形态，字面检索接口在这些输入下会直接失配并弃答。
Method: 构建 KyGround 基准：198 道题取自希腊 Kythera 农业平台的公开记录，答案自动对照记录校验，每题最多 9 种形式（规范希腊语、无重音、全大写、三种 Greeklish 转写方案）。以 Claude Haiku 4.5 作路由与回答模型，对比重建的平台工具 agent、向量 RAG、让路由改写向量查询，以及把约 26,000 token 的整库放进 prompt。
Result: 规范希腊语上工具 agent 71.6%、向量 RAG 95.3%，差 -23.6 个百分点（95% CI -33.1 至 -15.1）；让路由写向量查询无变化，整库入 prompt 达 99.3%。无重音与全大写让工具 agent 各损失约 20 分、向量 RAG 至多 2 分；重音不敏感检索消除该损失，加词干 token 匹配后工具 agent 在规范希腊语上升到 83.8%；Greeklish 让两种设计都损失约 21 至 32 分。

papers.title: Finding the Heads and the Neurons Responsible for Network Information Retrieval in Language Models
authors: Daniel Sonntag (1 and 2) ((1) University of Oldenburg
(2) German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI)
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether specific attention heads, and more finely specific neurons inside those heads, are responsible for recognizing that a language model's context contains network infrastructure information (a hostname paired with its IP address), and whether that responsibility can be validated causally rather than by correlation alone. At the head level the answer is yes, across five models spanning three architecture families: in every model, a small set of heads (1 to 9 out of 128 to 1152 candidates), found by causal ablation screening and tested for selectivity against matched negative and context-free controls, supports a detector with 99.5--100\% held-out accuracy. We then ask whether a head's responsibility concentrates into one neuron or stays spread across its dimensions; this is model-specific. In one model, the top head's signal concentrates into a single neuron, found independently by both a causal intervention and a correlational ranking, which agree exactly (AUC = 1.000, matching the full head). In another, the single clean head works as a whole (AUC = 1.000) but the best causally ranked neuron inside it does not (AUC = 0.665), so the responsibility there is spread across the head. The remaining three models fall in between. On an independent dataset collected by a different institution (reverse-DNS records rather than the discovery data), every model's full-head detector flags 100\% of positive records; the single-neuron versions transfer less reliably, and in one model score below chance. Causal head-finding for a specific network-information entity works across models and architectures; how far that finding can be pushed down to individual neurons varies, and needs to be checked for each model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在五个模型、三种架构族上，用因果消融筛选出 1–9 个注意力头（候选 128–1152 个），即可支撑识别上下文中主机名-IP 配对的检测器，held-out 准确率 99.5–100%。责任能否下沉到单个神经元因模型而异：一个模型中因果干预与相关性排序完全一致（AUC = 1.000，与整头持平），另一个模型整头 AUC = 1.000 而最佳因果神经元仅 0.665。跨机构独立数据集（reverse-DNS 记录）上整头检测器全部命中 100% 正例，单神经元版本迁移更差、有一个模型低于随机水平。
Motivation: 相关性归因无法证明某头或某神经元对特定实体识别负因果责任，且这种责任是否集中到单个神经元尚无跨模型结论。
Method: 先用因果消融筛选 (causal ablation screening) 定位支持检测器的注意力头，再用匹配负例与无上下文对照检验选择性；随后在头内用因果干预与相关性排序分别定位神经元，并在另一机构采集的 reverse-DNS 独立数据集上检验迁移。
Result: 五个模型、三种架构族中各只需 1–9 个头（候选 128–1152），held-out 检测准确率 99.5–100%。一个模型的因果与相关性神经元定位完全一致，AUC = 1.000，与整头持平；另一个模型整头 AUC = 1.000 而最佳因果神经元 AUC = 0.665，其余三个模型居中。独立数据集上每个模型的整头检测器标记 100% 正例，单神经元版本有一个模型低于随机水平。
Conclusion: 针对特定网络信息实体的因果找头法可跨模型与架构成立，但能否下沉到单个神经元是模型特有的，必须逐模型检验。

papers.title: MacJEPA: Missingness-Robust Audio-Visual Recognition from Untrimmed Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract_en: Audio-visual models improve egocentric action recognition by exploiting complementary cues, yet typically assume that both streams remain available at inference. Existing missing-modality methods operate on trimmed, single-event clips in which a stream is entirely present or absent, whereas real sensors fail and recover within long, untrimmed observations. We redefine egocentric modality missingness as temporally localized sensor outages within untrimmed, multi-event observations, with whole-clip absence as the limiting case. We introduce \textbf{MacJEPA}, a missing-modality-robust \textbf{Ma}sked-\textbf{c}ontext query \textbf{JEPA} that recognizes visual actions and acoustic events from supplied interval queries over audio-visual context. Window-local modality dropout simulates these sensor outages during training. MacJEPA further repurposes masking in JEPA from a self-supervised pretext into a supervised robustness objective, aligning masked and clean latent representations of both multimodal content tokens and the task-conditioned queries. All objectives are optimized jointly with recognition in a single stage, requiring no test-time adaptation. Across Epic-Kitchens-100 and Epic-Sounds, a single checkpoint remains competitive under complete input and consistently surpasses published missing-modality baselines when either the dominant or auxiliary stream is removed. MacJEPA thus unifies strong full-input recognition with temporal missing-modality robustness in a single model operating on untrimmed multi-event videos.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MacJEPA 把长时非剪辑第一人称视频中的模态缺失重新定义为时间局部的传感器中断（整段缺失只是特例），用窗口局部 modality dropout 模拟中断，并把 JEPA 的 masking 从自监督前缀任务改成监督鲁棒目标，对齐掩码与干净的多模态内容 token 及任务条件 query 的隐表示。在 Epic-Kitchens-100 与 EpicSounds 上，单一 checkpoint 在完整输入下保持竞争力，且在移除主/辅任一模态时一致超越已发表的 missing-modality 基线。
Motivation: 现有 missing-modality 方法只处理剪辑后的单事件片段（某流整段有或整段无），而真实传感器在长时多事件观测中是中途失效又恢复的，这一失效模式此前没有被建模。
Method: 提出 Masked-context query JEPA (MacJEPA)：对给定的区间 query 在音视频上下文上识别视觉动作与声学事件；训练时用 window-local modality dropout 模拟传感器中断；把 JEPA 的 masking 从自监督 pretext 改为监督鲁棒目标，对齐掩码与干净隐表示（覆盖多模态内容 token 与任务条件 query），所有目标与识别损失单阶段联合优化，无需测试时自适应。
Result: 在 Epic-Kitchens-100 与 EpicSounds 上，单一 checkpoint 在完整输入下保持竞争力，并在移除主导流或辅助流时一致超过已发表的 missing-modality 基线。
Conclusion: 强完整输入识别与时序缺失鲁棒性可以在单一模型中统一，前提是把缺失建模为非剪辑视频中的时间局部中断并用窗口级 dropout 与掩码对齐来训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PIE-PS: Photometric Stereo from Physical Irradiance Event Streams
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras record asynchronous log-image-irradiance changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range. These properties are useful for photometric stereo under moving illumination, but raw events are sparse and depend on an unknown contrast threshold. We start from the event trigger model and derive a physical relation between adjacent events, light motion, and surface normals. This relation gives a direct physics-only solver, but the solver needs the threshold, enough events at each pixel, and independent per-pixel optimization. To address these limits, we introduce PIE-PS, a learning-based framework for dense surface normal reconstruction from raw event streams and known lighting. We form Physical Irradiance Events (PIEs) by pairing two adjacent events at the same pixel with their corresponding light directions. Each PIE provides a Physical Irradiance Event Feature (PIEF), defined as the signed event rate. PIEF does not require the unknown contrast threshold. To share spatial and temporal context across nearby PIEs, we introduce PIE-GNN, which treats each PIE as a graph node and encodes it with its light-pair geometry. Since the reliability of PIE observations can vary with local appearance, illumination geometry, and sensor noise, Reliability-Grading Attention (RGA) predicts reliability weights to down-weight unreliable PIEs. Pixel aggregation then produces dense normals. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that PIE-PS outperforms prior event-based photometric stereo methods and the direct solver baseline.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PIE-PS 用事件相机做光度立体 (photometric stereo)：把同像素相邻两事件与对应光向配对成 Physical Irradiance Events，其 signed event rate 特征 PIEF 不依赖未知对比度阈值，再用 PIE-GNN 图节点编码与 Reliability-Grading Attention 加权聚合出稠密法线。在合成与真实数据上超过既有事件光度立体方法与直接物理求解器基线。
Motivation: 事件相机的微秒延迟与高动态范围适合移动光照下的光度立体，但原始事件稀疏且依赖未知对比度阈值；由触发模型导出的直接物理求解器需要阈值、每像素足够事件数，并须逐像素独立优化，难以稠密重建。
Method: 从事件触发模型导出相邻事件、光运动与表面法线的物理关系；将同像素两相邻事件与其光向配对为 PIE，定义不依赖阈值的特征 PIEF（signed event rate）；PIE-GNN 把每个 PIE 当作图节点并以光对几何编码，Reliability-Grading Attention 依据局部外观、光照几何与传感器噪声预测可靠度权重下调不可靠 PIE，最后像素聚合出稠密法线。
Result: 在合成数据与真实数据两类实验中，PIE-PS 均超过既有基于事件的光度立体方法以及直接物理求解器 (direct solver) 基线。
Conclusion: 用阈值无关的物理事件特征加图网络可靠度加权，可以把需要逐像素优化的物理求解器替换为稠密法线重建框架，并在合成与真实数据上取得更好结果。

papers.title: Compact Robot Policies Need Fine-Grained Visual Representations
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task manipulation policies differ in architecture, scale, and pretrained priors all at once, so published comparisons cannot attribute performance to any single component. We argue that most of it comes from the visual representation, and that parameter scale and generative priors are largely incidental. To test this, we build CoRP (Compressed Representation Policy), a deliberately compact policy (48.9M parameters, no vision-language model and no video-generative prior) that factorizes into a representation extractor and a flow-matching action generator. It reaches 97.0% on LIBERO and 75.78%/73.36% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized, matching systems 40.9-163.6x larger. Holding the action generator fixed, we then vary one extractor property at a time. Pretrained initialization is decisive: a random ViT-S/14 drops to 78.1% and an ImageNet ResNet-34 to 74.5% on LIBERO. Pretraining alone is not enough, as freezing the encoder costs 19.8 points. Compression matters as much: resampling each view to 48 tokens beats passing all patch tokens (97.0% vs 83.2%), and a variational information bottleneck over those tokens is worse than a hard token budget, cutting LIBERO-Goal from 95.8% to 33.0% by suppressing the instruction-dependent token selection the policy relies on. Language conditioning contributes only where the observation leaves the goal ambiguous (LIBERO-Goal: 9.2% to 95.8%), while on RoboTwin 2.0, where observations are unambiguous, removing it slightly improves success. Therefore, we argue that a compact policy works when its representation is pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed. Project page: https://corp-policy.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoRP 把多任务操作策略压缩到 48.9M 参数（无 VLM、无视频生成先验），由表征提取器与 flow-matching 动作生成器组成，在 LIBERO 达 97.0%、RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized 达 75.78%/73.36%，匹配大 40.9–163.6 倍的系统。逐项消融显示：预训练初始化是决定性的（随机 ViT-S/14 掉到 78.1%、ImageNet ResNet-34 掉到 74.5%），冻结编码器再损失 19.8 点；每视图重采样到 48 token 优于全 patch token（97.0% vs 83.2%），而对这些 token 施加变分信息瓶颈会把 LIBERO-Goal 从 95.8% 砍到 33.0%。结论是紧凑策略可行的条件是表征同时做到预训练、任务适配与压缩。
Motivation: 多任务操作策略在架构、规模与预训练先验上同时变化，已发表的对比无法把性能归因到单一组件；作者主张性能主要来自视觉表征，参数规模与生成先验基本是附带的。
Method: 构建 CoRP（Compressed Representation Policy）：48.9M 参数、不含 vision-language model 与视频生成先验，分解为表征提取器与 flow-matching 动作生成器；固定动作生成器，每次只改变提取器的一个属性（预训练初始化、是否冻结、token 压缩方式、语言条件），在 LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 2.0 上做受控消融。
Result: CoRP 在 LIBERO 达 97.0%，RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized 分别 75.78%/73.36%，匹配大 40.9–163.6 倍的系统。随机 ViT-S/14 使 LIBERO 降至 78.1%，ImageNet ResNet-34 降至 74.5%；冻结编码器损失 19.8 点；每视图重采样 48 token 为 97.0% vs 全 patch token 83.2%；变分信息瓶颈 (VIB) 把 LIBERO-Goal 从 95.8% 压到 33.0%；语言条件在 LIBERO-Goal 上贡献 9.2%→95.8%，而在观测无歧义的 RoboTwin 2.0 上移除它反而略升成功率。

papers.title: View Matters: Keyframe-Guided Text-Driven 3D Gaussian Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-driven 3D Gaussian editing commonly does not distinguish the editing reliability of rendered views, although different viewpoints provide supervision of substantially different quality. Views that clearly show the scene and match the edit instruction provide reliable guidance, while less informative views may weaken the edit when all views are treated equally. We present View Matters, a view-importance-aware framework that conducts editing around reliable keyframes. Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE) identifies reliable views using geometric visibility, semantic distinctiveness, and edit relevance. Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) then propagates their editing signals asymmetrically to non-keyframes without noisy reverse influence, while Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO) preserves this reliability preference during 3DGS optimization. Across 23 scene-prompt pairs, View Matters achieves the highest average CLIP text-image similarity of 0.2822 and directional similarity of 0.2564 among the evaluated methods, with a four-minute editing time. Additional adjacent-view analysis indicates that the fidelity-oriented editing process maintains cross-view coherence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文本驱动的 3D Gaussian Splatting 编辑把各视角一视同仁，会因低信息视角削弱编辑效果。View Matters 用 Keyframe Importance Estimation 按几何可见性、语义独特性与编辑相关性选出可靠关键帧，再由 Keyframe-Guided Editing 把编辑信号非对称地传播到非关键帧、Importance-Aware Optimization 在 3DGS 优化中保持该偏好。在 23 组 scene-prompt 上取得最高平均 CLIP text-image similarity 0.2822 与 directional similarity 0.2564，编辑耗时四分钟。
Motivation: 不同视角提供的编辑监督质量差异很大，但现有文本驱动 3DGS 编辑对所有视角等权处理，信息不足的视角会削弱整体编辑效果。
Method: 三模块框架：Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE) 依据几何可见性、语义独特性与编辑相关性判定可靠视角；Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) 将关键帧编辑信号非对称传播到非关键帧，避免噪声反向影响；Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO) 在 3DGS 优化中维持该重要性偏好。
Result: 在 23 组 scene-prompt 对上，平均 CLIP text-image similarity 0.2822、directional similarity 0.2564，均为所评估方法中最高；编辑耗时四分钟。相邻视角分析显示保真导向的编辑过程维持了跨视角一致性。
Conclusion: 视角重要性差异应被显式建模：围绕可靠关键帧做非对称编辑，可在四分钟内同时提高文本对齐与方向相似度并保持跨视角一致。

papers.title: On the Intrinsic Limited Robustness of Latent-Based Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Existing latent-based watermarking methods for diffusion models have overestimated their robustness to image distortions, including geometric transformations such as rotation, scaling, and translation (RST). Moreover, this paradigm of watermarking approaches may suffer from inherent limitations arising from the domain in which the watermark is embedded. In this paper, we provide the first theoretical analysis explaining why these methods lack invariance to perturbations. By relaxing the invariant relation, we derive a maximum perturbation bound that characterizes the relationship between pixel-space perturbations and their corresponding effects in latent space. In addition, we present the first analytical formulation that captures all components of practical detection mechanisms. Finally, we conduct experiments to validate the theoretical findings and the limitations of latent-based watermarking methods. Our theoretical and empirical results indicate that, under the current design paradigm, latent-based watermarking methods intrinsically exhibit limited robustness. We conclude by providing the analytical tool and design guidelines that future research could follow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出扩散模型的隐空间水印 (latent-based watermarking) 对图像失真、尤其 RST 几何变换的鲁棒性被高估：给出首个理论分析解释其为何缺乏不变性，放松不变关系后推导出像素空间扰动与其隐空间效应之间的最大扰动界，并给出覆盖实际检测机制全部成分的解析形式。理论与实验一致表明，在当前设计范式下隐空间水印本质上鲁棒性有限。
Motivation: 现有隐空间水印方法对包括旋转、缩放、平移 (RST) 在内的图像失真高估了鲁棒性，且水印嵌入所在域本身带来固有限制；此前缺少解释这种不变性缺失的理论。
Method: 放松不变关系，推导像素空间扰动与隐空间效应之间的最大扰动界；给出首个覆盖实际检测机制全部成分的解析公式；再用实验验证理论发现与隐空间水印的局限。
Result: 给出最大扰动界与检测机制的解析形式两项理论结果，并以实验验证理论发现；结论为在当前设计范式下隐空间水印方法本质上鲁棒性有限。
Conclusion: 隐空间水印的有限鲁棒性是当前嵌入域设计范式的内在属性，而非实现细节问题；作者提供解析工具与设计指南供后续研究遵循。

papers.title: LFHE: Local-First Heuristic Evolution for Bounded Local Topology Search in Decentralized Learning with Non-IID Data
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized learning is highly sensitive to communication topology under non-IID data. Adaptive peer-selection methods can exploit local model information, but broader peer discovery may require increasingly large control state, whereas direct spectral optimization typically relies on graph-wide information. We study the intermediate setting of bounded local topology search and propose Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a representation-driven rewiring framework whose candidate discovery and scoring use only ego-neighborhood and friend-of-a-friend (FoF) information. The structural score admits an exact interpretation through graph Dirichlet energy: its sum across clients equals twice the representation Dirichlet energy, which under standard linear consensus dynamics governs the instantaneous dissipation of representation disagreement. LFHE combines this state-dependent structural signal with early exploration and degree control, while algebraic connectivity remains an offline graph diagnostic. Under bounded sparse degree, its FoF candidate state remains local rather than expanding toward population-wide peer tracking. Across four image, speech, and text benchmarks, LFHE achieves competitive decentralized learning performance. Matched-protocol controls identify the structural term as the principal empirical topology-selection signal, while comparison with broader peer discovery exposes a trade-off between predictive performance and discovery-state locality. Together, these results motivate state-aware bounded local topology search between pairwise peer selection and globally informed topology optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LFHE 在非 IID 数据的去中心化学习中做有界局部拓扑搜索：候选发现与打分只用 ego 邻域和 friend-of-a-friend (FoF) 信息，结构分数等价于图 Dirichlet 能量（跨客户端求和等于两倍表征 Dirichlet 能量，线性共识动力学下决定表征分歧的瞬时耗散）。在图像、语音、文本四类基准上取得有竞争力的去中心化学习性能，匹配协议对照把结构项识别为主要经验拓扑选择信号，并暴露预测性能与发现状态局部性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 去中心化学习对通信拓扑高度敏感：自适应对等选择若扩大发现范围会带来越来越大的控制状态，而谱优化通常依赖全图信息，中间的有界局部拓扑搜索缺少方法。
Method: 提出 Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE)，一种表征驱动的重连框架：候选发现与打分仅用 ego 邻域与 FoF 信息；结构分数由图 Dirichlet 能量给出精确解释，与早期探索和度数控制结合，代数连通度 (algebraic connectivity) 仅作离线图诊断；在有界稀疏度下 FoF 候选状态保持局部，不扩展为全群体对等追踪。
Result: 在图像、语音、文本四个基准上 LFHE 取得有竞争力的去中心化学习性能；匹配协议对照 (matched-protocol controls) 识别结构项为首要经验拓扑选择信号；与更广对等发现的比较暴露预测性能与发现状态局部性之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者主张在成对对等选择与全局信息拓扑优化之间存在一个值得做的状态感知有界局部拓扑搜索区间，且扩大发现范围要用控制状态局部性换性能。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Beyond the Leaderboard: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Dense and Mixture-of-Experts Models for Automated Program Repair
papers.abstract_en: Automated Program Repair (APR) with language models is usually evaluated by whether a generated patch passes the test suite, which can hide differences in maintainability, security, and computational cost. We propose a Weighted Quality Index (QI), inspired by the ISO/IEC 25010 software quality model, that combines functional correctness, maintainability, security, and generation efficiency under configurable weighting schemes. We evaluate three dense Qwen2.5-Coder models (3B, 7B, 14B) and the 16B-parameter DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model (2.4B active parameters) on 40 QuixBugs and 90 Defects4J bugs, all run locally on identical hardware to control for infrastructure effects. Model rankings change with the weighting scheme, showing that single-metric evaluation can hide trade-offs. The MoE model shows almost no statistically significant difference in correctness from the 7B and 14B dense models (McNemar's exact test) while using 3-6 times fewer active parameters, whereas correctness increases significantly across the three dense scales. These results suggest that active parameter count can be a more informative lens than total parameter count for sparse code models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出加权质量指数 Weighted Quality Index (QI)，把功能正确性、可维护性、安全性与生成效率按可配置权重合成，用于自动程序修复 (APR) 评测。在 40 个 QuixBugs 与 90 个 Defects4J bug 上，模型排名随权重方案改变；16B MoE 的 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite（2.4B 激活参数）与 7B/14B 稠密模型在正确性上几乎无统计显著差异（McNemar's exact test），却少用 3–6 倍激活参数。
Motivation: APR 通常只看补丁是否通过测试套件，会掩盖可维护性、安全性与计算成本上的差异，单指标评测掩盖权衡。
Method: 提出受 ISO/IEC 25010 软件质量模型启发的 Weighted Quality Index (QI)，在可配置权重下合并功能正确性、可维护性、安全性与生成效率；评测三个稠密 Qwen2.5-Coder（3B、7B、14B）与 16B 参数的 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite MoE（2.4B 激活参数），全部在相同本地硬件上运行以控制基础设施影响，用 McNemar's exact test 比较正确性。
Result: 在 40 个 QuixBugs 和 90 个 Defects4J bug 上，模型排名随权重方案变化；MoE 模型与 7B、14B 稠密模型的正确性几乎无统计显著差异（McNemar's exact test），激活参数少 3–6 倍；三个稠密规模之间正确性随规模显著上升。
Conclusion: 对稀疏代码模型，激活参数量比总参数量是更有信息量的比较视角，单指标 APR 评测会掩盖权衡。

summary_sections.method: 提出受 ISO/IEC 25010 软件质量模型启发的 Weighted Quality Index (QI)，在可配置权重下合并功能正确性、可维护性、安全性与生成效率；评测三个稠密 Qwen2.5-Coder（3B、7B、14B）与 16B 参数的 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite MoE（2.4B 激活参数），全部在相同本地硬件上运行以控制基础设施影响，用 McNemar's exact test 比较正确性。
summary_sections.result: 在 40 个 QuixBugs 和 90 个 Defects4J bug 上，模型排名随权重方案变化；MoE 模型与 7B、14B 稠密模型的正确性几乎无统计显著差异（McNemar's exact test），激活参数少 3–6 倍；三个稠密规模之间正确性随规模显著上升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对稀疏代码模型，激活参数量比总参数量是更有信息量的比较视角，单指标 APR 评测会掩盖权衡。

papers.title: Visual Orchestration Tax in Agentic VLM Pipelines: Auditing and Certifying Visual Evidence Reuse
papers.abstract_en: Agentic VLM pipelines increasingly pass the same static visual evidence through multiple specialist agents and tools. This design creates an orchestration-level redundancy mode: semantically unchanged images are repeatedly reconstructed as image-conditioned requests at the VLM API boundary. We call this phenomenon visual orchestration tax and develop a measurement-to-certification framework for visual evidence reuse in agentic VLM pipelines. The audit side defines $\mathrm{M1}_{\mathrm{trace}}$ to count raw visual-evidence touches and M2 to measure structural touch redundancy, with query-level distributions, bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired quality tests. Across SeeingEye and MAMMQA on chart, document, general-VQA, and multi-modal-QA tasks, audits reveal 66.8-75.6% visual-evidence touch redundancy, and every audited query exceeds the predefined gate. The certification side introduces SharedVisCache, a contract-aware evidence reuse hook keyed by image content, preprocessing fingerprint, and encoder assumptions. On SeeingEye, contract validation certifies 75.0-75.5% repeated touches as reusable while preserving 350/350 output strings and $Δ\mathrm{M5}{=}0$. At the physical layer, certified hits reduce $F_{\mathrm{vision}}$ from 800 to 200 in ChartQA-200 trace replay and from 200 to 50 inside live SeeingEye translator-stage physical integration, preserving 800/800 replay strings and 200/200 integrated call outputs. The results position visual reuse as a measurable, behavior-preserving property of agent orchestration and define an agent-layer contract that makes backend prefix or token reuse semantically interpretable.

TL;DR: 针对 agentic VLM 流水线把同一静态图像反复重建成 image-conditioned 请求的冗余，提出从度量到认证的视觉证据复用框架：审计侧用 M1_trace 计数原始视觉触碰、M2 度量结构性触碰冗余，认证侧用按图像内容、预处理指纹与编码器假设做 key 的 SharedVisCache 复用 hook。SeeingEye 与 MAMMQA 上审计出 66.8–75.6% 触碰冗余，认证可把 75.0–75.5% 重复触碰判为可复用且输出字符串 350/350 不变、ΔM5=0。

Method: 审计侧定义 M1_trace 统计原始视觉证据触碰次数、M2 度量结构性触碰冗余，配 query 级分布、bootstrap 置信区间与配对质量检验；认证侧提出 SharedVisCache，按图像内容、预处理指纹与编码器假设做 key 的契约感知复用 hook，并在 ChartQA-200 trace replay 与 SeeingEye translator-stage 物理集成层做物理层验证。

papers.title: Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture
papers.abstract_en: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters. Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把合金配方反推（成分+工艺参数→显微组织与织构的逆向链）当作可学习任务：在 107 组镁合金挤压条件、14 种合金的自建数据集上，用常规晶粒/织构统计量、预训练视觉编码器嵌入和晶粒网络图神经网络三种描述子，配对两个预测头（Task A 由工艺推成分，Task B 由成分推工艺）。5 折交叉验证下常规描述子识别正确合金达 65%（瞎猜最常见合金为 17%），学习到的嵌入反而低于 30%；显微组织把温度误差相比只用成分大致减半。
Motivation: 合金开发正向调组织以达目标性能，但从优化组织反推配方仍依赖专家经验；需要检验这一步能否从数据中学到。
Method: 自建 107 组镁合金挤压条件、覆盖 14 种合金的数据集，每条含金相显微照片与 X 射线织构测量；比较三种显微组织/织构描述子——常规晶粒与织构统计量、预训练图像编码器的视觉嵌入、作用于晶粒网络的图神经网络——各自配 Task A（给工艺预测成分）与 Task B（给成分预测工艺）两个预测头，5 折交叉验证；因合金与压机设定均为少量离散选项，采用在已知有序选项中选择的头而非自由回归值。
Result: 5 折交叉验证下常规描述子在留出条件上识别出正确合金的比例为 65%，对照总是猜最常见合金为 17%，而学习到的视觉嵌入低于 30%。Task B 中工艺参数可恢复但噪声更大：与仅用成分相比，加入显微组织把温度误差大致减半。有序离散选项的头优于预测自由值的头。
Conclusion: 反推配方这一步可以学，但常规晶粒/织构统计量已胜过学习到的图像嵌入；且在合金与工艺设定都为少量离散选项的现实里，按已知有序选项做分类比回归自由值更有效。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Align, Then Correct: Training-Free Two-Stage Low-Rank Compensation for Extremely Quantized Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank quantization error compensation (LQEC) recovers the accuracy lost under aggressive weight quantization by attaching a closed-form rank-$r$ adapter beside each frozen quantized weight, without any training. We show that existing compensators are limited by two shared simplifications. They calibrate symmetrically, evaluating the full-precision and compensated weights on the same activation, which yields a compensation target that is inherently high-rank -- so a fixed rank budget captures only a small fraction of it. And they minimize only the second-order term of the loss, although the compensated model is not stationary: a first-order descent direction larger than the applied compensation itself remains in every layer, and no reconstruction objective can absorb it. We propose a two-stage closed-form framework that removes both simplifications. Stage 1 aligns each layer's output with the full-precision model under a Fisher-weighted asymmetric objective, concentrating the rank budget on a rank-compressible target. Stage 2 re-measures statistics on the compensated model and applies a rank-constrained natural-gradient step that absorbs the remaining first-order signal. Every adapter is the result of a single truncated SVD; backward passes serve only to collect statistics. At 2 bits under QuIP#, our method reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 12.43 to 10.26 on Qwen3-8B and from 21.11 to 13.22 on Qwen3-4B. On the held-out C4 corpus, it recovers 51% and 84% of the gap to FP16, versus 31% and 63% for the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in the seven-task zero-shot average, at higher bit-widths, and under a distinct quantizer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 2-bit 极低比特量化下闭式低秩补偿 (LQEC) 的两个简化——对称校准导致补偿目标天然高秩、只最小化损失二阶项——提出两阶段免训练框架：先用 Fisher 加权非对称目标把各层输出对齐全精度模型以压缩目标秩，再在补偿后模型上重测统计量并施加秩约束自然梯度步吸收一阶信号。在 QuIP# 2-bit 下 Qwen3-8B 的 WikiText-2 perplexity 从 12.43 降到 10.26，Qwen3-4B 从 21.11 降到 13.22。
Motivation: 现有 LQEC 补偿器在对称校准下得到的补偿目标是高秩的，固定秩预算只能覆盖一小部分；且补偿后模型非平稳，残留的一阶下降方向比补偿本身还大，任何重构目标都吸收不掉，导致极低比特量化精度恢复受限。
Method: 两阶段闭式框架：Stage 1 用 Fisher 加权的非对称目标，让各层输出对齐全精度模型，把秩预算集中到可秩压缩的目标上；Stage 2 在补偿后模型上重新测量统计量，施加秩约束的自然梯度步吸收剩余一阶信号。每个 adapter 由单次截断 SVD 得到，反向传播仅用于收集统计量，全程免训练。
Result: QuIP# 2-bit 量化下，WikiText-2 perplexity：Qwen3-8B 从 12.43 降至 10.26，Qwen3-4B 从 21.11 降至 13.22；在留出的 C4 语料上分别恢复到 FP16 差距的 51% 与 84%，最强基线为 31% 与 63%；七任务 zero-shot 平均分、更高比特宽度以及另一种量化器下均有一致增益。
Conclusion: 同时打破对称校准与仅二阶补偿这两个简化，用 Fisher 加权对齐加自然梯度修正的免训练闭式流程，可在极低比特 (2-bit) 权重量化下大幅收复精度差距，且跨比特宽度与量化器保持增益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Failure Is in the Readout: Fine-Grained Emotion Recognition Benchmarks Measure Elicitation, Not Perception
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained emotion recognition supports therapy tools and social robots, but it needs facial data, which raises privacy and data-protection concerns. EmoNet-Face-HQ answers that with generated portraits, expert-rated over a $40$-category taxonomy far finer than the usual six to eight basic emotions. Under the protocol it ships with, vision-language models (VLMs) score poorly on that taxonomy, and the benchmark concludes that a dedicated fine-tuned model is necessary: Empathic-Insight-Face (EIF; Small/Large). We show that off-the-shelf VLMs match or beat that fine-tuned model when the answer is not generated but read from the logits, as one binary query per category. We keep the benchmark's images, taxonomy and ratings, and change only how the answer is read. Experts agree at $κ_w = 0.468$ on the five categories they measure most reliably. Generatively, no interval among eleven open-weight VLMs lies entirely above that anchor ($κ_w=0.268$-$0.486$). Under verification all eleven clear it, each of them significantly better at $κ_w=0.507$-$0.586$. Three also significantly beat EIF sitting at $κ_w = 0.551$ (Small; $0.534$ Large). The gain comes from the graded probability and not from asking a yes/no question: as a control, thresholding those same probabilities to yes/no costs 142% of the average gains and drops binarization below generative elicitation to $κ_w=0.254$-$0.423$. A replication on real photographs (FACES) is weaker and mixed: of the ten models that pass a validity gate, six gain, three are neutral to positive and one is negative, so the effect is not confined to synthetic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 细粒度情绪识别基准 EmoNet-Face-HQ 的低分来自生成式读出方式而非模型感知能力：把答案从生成改为对每个类别做一次二值查询、直接读 logits，11 个开源 VLM 全部超过专家一致性锚点 κ_w=0.468，达到 0.507–0.586，其中 3 个显著超过微调模型 EIF（Small 0.551）。对照实验表明收益来自分级概率而非 yes/no 提问，把同一概率阈值化成 yes/no 会损失 142% 的平均增益并跌回 0.254–0.423。
Motivation: 细粒度情绪识别依赖面部数据，带来隐私与数据保护问题，因此基准改用生成人像；但基准协议下 VLM 得分低并被判定必须训练专用模型，这个结论可能把读出方式的缺陷误当成感知能力的缺陷。
Method: 保留 EmoNet-Face-HQ 的图像、40 类分类体系与专家评分，只把答案读出从生成改为 verification：对每个类别做一次二值查询并读 logits，用加权 Cohen's κ_w 与专家一致性锚点比较；对照组把同一概率阈值化为 yes/no；另在真实照片数据集 FACES 上做复现并设有效性门槛。

papers.title: Symphony for Text Generation: Benchmarking Clinical Note Generation
papers.abstract_en: Ambient documentation systems are rapidly gaining adoption, yet their impact on clinical note quality remains poorly characterized. We introduce MedConv, a multilingual dataset of 300 clinical encounters in English, Danish, and German, and use it alongside the Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark (ACI-BENCH) to compare Corti, a clinical AI platform, with two leading, accessible ambient scribe software applications built on general-purpose AI. We present a controlled clinical evaluation framework that combines entailment metrics with LLM-judged pairwise comparisons across eight dimensions adopted from PDSQI-9. Results show that Corti's API-based text-generation infrastructure is on par with or outperforms leading commercial scribes. We further show that Corti's configurable API provides the flexibility necessary to fine-tune quality dimensions for specific documentation use cases. We present the evaluation methodology and release a dataset to support future reproducible comparison of ambient documentation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MedConv 多语言临床对话数据集（300 段就诊，含英语、丹麦语、德语），配合 ACI-BENCH 与基于蕴含 (entailment) 指标加 LLM 评判的八维（取自 PDSQI-9）成对比较框架，对比 Corti 临床 AI 平台与两款通用 AI 商用 ambient scribe。结果显示 Corti 的 API 文本生成质量与领先商用 scribe 持平或更优，且可配置 API 能按具体文书场景微调各质量维度。
Motivation: ambient documentation 系统快速普及，但其对临床文书质量的实际影响缺乏刻画，缺少可复现的横向比较基准。
Method: 构建 MedConv（300 段英语/丹麦语/德语临床就诊）并与 ACI-BENCH 联用；受控临床评估框架把蕴含指标与 LLM 判定的成对比较结合，比较维度取自 PDSQI-9 的八项；对比对象为 Corti 平台与两款可获取的商用 ambient scribe 软件。
Result: Corti 基于 API 的文本生成质量与领先商用 scribe 持平或更优；其可配置 API 支持针对特定文书用例微调质量维度；发布数据集与评估方法以支持后续可复现比较。
Conclusion: 临床文书生成质量可用蕴含指标加 LLM 八维成对比较来受控评估，专用临床 AI 平台在该框架下不输于通用大模型驱动的商用 scribe。

papers.title: Making COMET Comparable Across Scripts: Diagnosis and Correction of Tokeniser-Induced Script Bias in Indic MT Evaluation
authors: Swapnil Hingmire (1) ((1) Indian Institute of Technology Palakkad)
papers.abstract_en: COMET reports translation quality as a single number, and that number is routinely compared across target languages written in different scripts. Such a comparison assumes Script Invariance: the score should not depend on the writing system that carries the target. We test it on IndicMT Eval by re-encoding the target into Latin script, which changes orthographic form while holding content and human ratings fixed. Script identity then accounts for 22.9% of native-script COMET variance, and agreement with annotators falls in all five languages studied. We trace the effect to the tokeniser and measure it with three label-free diagnostics. The bias is two faults, not one. Scores from different scripts occupy incompatible ranges, and within a single script the metric orders translations less accurately. No order-preserving transform of the score can repair the second fault. The first is removed exactly by COMET-QN, which maps the score distribution of each (language, script) pair onto a shared reference. Pooled agreement with annotators rises from 0.300 to 0.399, which is what makes scores from different scripts safe to place on one axis, and every within-language ordering is provably preserved. A regressor over parity features recovers a further 17.1% of the lost sensitivity. The remainder belongs to the encoder, and no post-processing can reach it. We therefore recommend publishing the normalised score, the three diagnostics, and the identity of the tokeniser they were computed against, so that a reader can tell how much of a score reflects translation quality and how much reflects the writing system.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures. Camera-ready version, accepted at WMT 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/John-salvin/script-bias-comet-normalisation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COMET 跨文字系统比较存在两处故障：不同 script 的分数落在不可比区间，且同一 script 内排序能力下降。COMET-QN 把每个 (语言, script) 的分数分布映射到共享参考，池化与标注者一致性从 0.300 升到 0.399，并可证明保持语言内排序。
Motivation: MT 评测常把 COMET 单一分数跨不同文字系统的目标语言直接比较，隐含 Script Invariance 假设，但该假设未经检验，一旦不成立会使跨语言分数不可比。
Method: 在 IndicMT Eval 上把目标文本重编码为 Latin script（内容与人工评分固定）以隔离 script 效应，用三个无标签诊断度量偏差，并提出 COMET-QN 分布映射归一化与基于 parity 特征的回归器。
Result: script 身份解释了原生 script COMET 方差的 22.9%，五种语言与标注者一致性全部下降；COMET-QN 使池化一致性从 0.300 升至 0.399；parity 特征回归器再恢复损失敏感度的 17.1%。
Conclusion: 偏差是两处故障而非一处，分数区间问题可由归一化精确修复，排序损失只能部分恢复，剩余属于 encoder 本身；作者建议发布归一化分数、三个诊断及其所用 tokeniser 身份。

papers.title: Token-Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration via System One-Guided Computational Division of Labor
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have become a promising paradigm for complex information-seeking and reasoning tasks by enabling collaborative problem solving among specialized agents. However, existing MAS frameworks tightly couple task reasoning with coordination operations, including task selection, role assignment, message routing, and context management. As interactions grow, using powerful LLMs for these bounded control decisions introduces substantial token overhead and latency, limiting the scalability of agentic Web services. In this paper, we investigate whether coordination can be decoupled from expensive reasoning without compromising collaborative performance. We propose S1-MAS, a token-efficient multi-agent framework based on System One-guided computational division of labor. S1-MAS assigns bounded coordination decisions to lightweight System One models while reserving open-ended reasoning for capable LLM workers. Specifically, a lightweight controller selects inspection conditions, chooses subsequent tasks, and determines termination, while a compact reader retrieves condition-relevant evidence from authorized sources to support these decisions. Through a decision-evidence loop, selected tasks dynamically determine worker roles and source access, enabling adaptive collaboration without task-specific training. Extensive experiments on seven diverse benchmarks demonstrate that S1-MAS achieves superior accuracy while substantially reducing the inference cost. Across individual comparisons with AgentVerse, DyLAN, and SelfOrg on seven benchmarks, S1-MAS reduces GPT-4o token consumption by 44.9%-97.2% and measured end-to-end latency by 37.8%-93.0%. These results highlight its potential for scalable and cost-effective agentic Web applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S1-MAS 把多智能体协作中的有界协调决策（任务选择、角色分配、终止判定）从昂贵推理中拆出，交给轻量 System One 模型，开放式推理仍留给强 LLM worker。在七个基准上对比 AgentVerse、DyLAN、SelfOrg，GPT-4o token 消耗降低 44.9%–97.2%，端到端延迟降低 37.8%–93.0%，同时保持更优准确率。
Motivation: 现有 MAS 把任务推理与协调操作紧耦合，随交互增长用强 LLM 做有界控制决策带来大量 token 与延迟开销，限制 agentic Web 服务的可扩展性。
Method: S1-MAS 用轻量 controller 决定检查条件、后续任务与终止，配一个 compact reader 从授权来源检索条件相关证据，构成 decision-evidence loop；被选任务动态决定 worker 角色与来源访问，无需任务特定训练，开放式推理交给强 LLM worker。
Result: 在七个基准上与 AgentVerse、DyLAN、SelfOrg 逐项对比，S1-MAS 使 GPT-4o token 消耗减少 44.9%–97.2%，实测端到端延迟减少 37.8%–93.0%，同时达到更优准确率。
Conclusion: 有界协调可以交给轻量 System One 模型而不损害协作性能，从而在保持准确率的同时大幅压缩 agentic Web 应用的推理成本。

papers.title: Penalty-Framed No-Valid-Option MCQA: Analyzing LLM Abstention under Invalid Choices
papers.abstract_en: Multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) is commonly used to evaluate large language models under the assumption that one of the provided options is correct, typically using answer-selection accuracy. However, in real deployments, users or retrieval systems may provide invalid option sets in which none of the listed choices is correct, and selecting one of them may incur downstream cost. We study this setting as penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA. Using the mathematics subset of MMLU-Pro, we remove the labeled correct option, allow models to either choose a remaining option or output ABSTAIN, and penalize invalid forced-choice responses. We further introduce correct-conditioned analysis, evaluating abstention only on instances that the model originally answered correctly. Experiments show that high MCQA accuracy does not fully guarantee abstention reliability: even under explicit no-valid-option-aware instructions and penalty-based scoring, models still produce invalid forced-choice responses for a subset of originally correct instances. These results show that penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA reveals an aspect of model reliability not captured by standard answer-selection accuracy.
papers.comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference (Short Paper)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 MCQA 改写成 penalty-framed no-valid-option 设定：在 MMLU-Pro 数学子集上删掉正确选项，模型只能在剩余错误选项中作答或输出 ABSTAIN，且对强行作答施加惩罚。结果发现高 MCQA 准确率并不保证弃答可靠——即使给出明确的 no-valid-option 指令与惩罚计分，模型仍对一部分原本答对的题目给出无效强行选择。
Motivation: 标准 MCQA 用 answer-selection accuracy 评估，前提是选项中必有正确答案；但实际部署中用户或检索系统可能给出无一正确的选项集，强行选错会产生下游代价，这一可靠性维度未被标准准确率刻画。
Method: 在 MMLU-Pro 数学子集中移除带标注的正确选项，允许模型选择剩余选项或输出 ABSTAIN，并对无效的强行选择施加惩罚计分；另提出 correct-conditioned analysis，只在模型原本答对的样本上评估弃答行为。
Result: 实验显示高 MCQA 准确率不能完全保证弃答可靠性：在显式 no-valid-option 意识指令与基于惩罚的计分下，模型仍对一部分原本答对的实例产生无效强行选择。
Conclusion: penalty-framed no-valid-option MCQA 揭示了标准 answer-selection accuracy 捕捉不到的模型可靠性面向，即答对能力与识别无有效选项并弃答是两种不同的性质。

papers.title: Navier-Stokes lost in translation: Why Lean verification of AI autoformalisation does not guarantee correct natural language proofs
papers.abstract_en: Autoformalisation is increasingly used to verify mathematical texts, including those generated by AI, as in OpenAI's announced proof of blow-up of solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations. In this process, an AI system translates the text from a natural language (NL) into a formal language such as Lean. Once this translation is done, the argument expressed in the formal language can easily be mechanically verified. The purpose of this article is to demonstrate why this process may offer no confidence in the original NL argument, owing to the various difficulties in performing the translation semantically faithfully. In particular, we highlight that the problem of resolving ambiguities in mathematical NL text, which is necessary in order to provide semantically faithful translation, is arbitrarily high up in the Solvability Complexity Index (SCI) hierarchy/arithmetical hierarchy (the SCI $= \infty$). Hence, informally, providing semantically faithful AI autoformalisation is harder than any computational problem including the Halting problem (which has SCI $= 1$). To demonstrate the effect of this result we provide several examples of AI mistranslations of NL statements and proofs into Lean in practice, resulting in mismatches between NL proofs and their Lean `verifications'. These include OpenAI's announced Navier-Stokes proof. In particular, we show that the formalised Lean proof does not correspond to the NL proof of blow-up of solutions to the Navier-Stokes equations.

papers.title: Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents' local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner's hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent's interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PIP 在合作智能体一方间歇性离开视野的零样本协调 (zero-shot coordination) 中，用 Joint-view VAE 把双方局部观测并集里的训练期证据蒸馏成仅靠局部观测即可用的伙伴表征，再用 Partner-state Belief 网络从交互历史推断伙伴隐藏位置与行为倾向。在 Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO 与 Melting Pot 三个基准上取得所比较方法中的最高平均性能，且在 Burrito-PO 的人类评测与消融诊断中，两个组件在伙伴被遮挡时的贡献都得到支持。
Motivation: 具身场景中伙伴间歇性出视野，现有方法只能拿到含糊的伙伴表征，对隐藏伙伴状态的不确定性无法处理，零样本协调因此退化。
Method: PIP 含两个组件：Joint-view VAE 在训练时把两个智能体局部观测的并集作为更丰富证据，蒸馏出仅依赖单方局部观测的伙伴表征；Partner-state Belief 网络基于 ego 智能体的交互历史推断伙伴隐藏位置与行为倾向。评测覆盖 Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO、一个 Melting Pot substrate，并在 Burrito-PO 上做人类评测。
Result: 在 Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO 与 Melting Pot substrate 三个基准上，PIP 的平均性能在所比较方法中最高；人类评测与诊断分析支持其与未见过伙伴的协调能力，并支持两个组件在伙伴遮挡条件下各自的贡献。
Conclusion: 把伙伴表征蒸馏与隐藏状态信念推断结合起来，可以在伙伴被遮挡时维持零样本协调，且两个组件缺一都会削弱效果。

papers.title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose \method, which introduces \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, \emph{Rubric-Aligned Collaboration} verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练无关的测试时智能体进化方法，在法律长程推理中用 Test-Time Memory Evolution 检索并适配既往案件经验，用 Rubric-Aligned Collaboration 按行为与程序要求核验修订各角色动作。在 J1-EVAL 与 LegalWorld 上、五种 backbone 模型下，相对代表性推理与 agent 基线取得一致改进，且交互与计算开销合理。
Motivation: 真实法律部署中案件在事实、证据与程序情境上高度异质，静态 agent 策略失效；而跨角色、跨阶段的推理相互依赖，使全局可靠性不同于单角色能力。
Method: 训练无关的测试时适配：Test-Time Memory Evolution 从前序案件检索可复用经验、按当前事实与程序情境改写并固化；Rubric-Aligned Collaboration 依据行为与程序要求核验并修订各角色动作，实现跨角色跨阶段协同。
Result: 在 J1-EVAL 与 LegalWorld 上、覆盖五种 backbone 模型，相对代表性推理与 agent 基线取得一致改进，交互与计算开销合理；消融与案例研究显示两个组件在经验适配与跨角色协同上带来互补收益。
Conclusion: 测试时经验进化与 rubric 对齐的协同可同时提升长程法律推理的可靠性与效率，且无需更新模型参数。

papers.title: Rethinking Visual Provenance: Detection and Watermarking Across Direct Visual Generation and LLM-Driven Code Rendering
papers.abstract_en: AI systems create images and videos with image/video generation models or by writing code and graphics descriptions that are then rendered. These routes can produce similar visible artifacts but expose different representations, intervention points, and provenance evidence. We develop a production-centered framework that compares detection and watermarking across both routes. An explicit verification specification distinguishes passive inference, message recovery, and authenticated provenance. We organize image, video, source-code, and rendering-aware watermarks by production stage. We examine the different requirements of generated images and video, plots and SVG, programmable video, and agent-composed workflows. Documented Claude, OpenAI, and rendering-tool interfaces connect the framework to concrete systems. We pose ten scoped research questions on identifiability, observability, fair comparison across stages, recoverable payload, reconstruction, synchronization, composition, hybrid local contribution, and private production-event authentication. The result is a conceptual research agenda grounded in published methods, inspected interfaces, and elementary boundary examples. It reports no experiments and claims no new theorems; its appendix results are elementary calculations, and documentation and source inspection establish interfaces, not empirical robustness.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Conceptual research agenda; no experiments. Video: https://youtu.be/14SMl0d_e48. Project page: https://zhenggao-30.github.io/Rethinking-Visual-Provenance/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出以生产链为中心的视觉溯源 (visual provenance) 框架，把图像/视频生成模型直出与 LLM 写代码再渲染两条生成路径下的检测与水印放在同一套验证规范下比较，区分被动推断、消息恢复与带认证的溯源三类目标。按生产阶段组织图像、视频、源码与渲染感知水印，并提出十个限定范围的研究问题（可辨识性、可观测性、跨阶段公平比较、可恢复载荷、重建、同步、组合、混合局部贡献、私有生产事件认证）。
Motivation: 图像/视频生成与 LLM 驱动代码渲染能产生相似可见痕迹，但表征、介入点与溯源证据完全不同，现有检测与水印工作缺少跨这两条路径的统一比较口径。
Method: 构建生产中心框架：显式验证规范区分被动推断、消息恢复、认证溯源；按生产阶段归类图像、视频、源码与渲染感知水印；结合已发表方法、Claude/OpenAI/渲染工具接口文档与源码检查，并给出初等边界算例。
Result: 产出为概念性研究议程：十个限定研究问题，附录结果为初等计算；文档与源码检查用于确立接口，不构成经验鲁棒性证据；摘要明确声明无实验、无新定理。
Conclusion: 跨两条生成路径的检测与水印比较应以验证规范和生产阶段为组织轴，且当前结论停留在概念与接口层面，鲁棒性需后续实验回答。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VLA-ACL: Action-Consistent Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but incur high computational costs from processing long token sequences at every control step, limiting real-time deployment. Visual token pruning offers a direct solution, as visual patches dominate the input sequence and contain considerable redundancy. Existing approaches, however, either rely on indirect training-free heuristics, such as attention scores and motion thresholds, or require costly fine-tuning of the base VLA model. We introduce VLA-ACL (Action Consistency Learning), which learns a lightweight visual token pruning policy through action-level supervision while keeping the base VLA model entirely frozen. The training objective encourages actions produced from pruned visual contexts to remain consistent with the full-context teacher, with ground-truth actions as auxiliary supervision. This directly ties token selection to its effect on the downstream control output. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-ACL prunes up to 87.5% of visual tokens while retaining competitive performance, reduces computation by up to 75%, and achieves a 1.5x inference speedup. These results establish a stronger performance-efficiency trade-off than existing frozen-VLA pruning methods and demonstrate the value of action-level supervision for visual token selection. Code is available at https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLA-ACL 用动作级监督学习一个轻量视觉 token 剪枝策略，在完全冻结基座 VLA 模型的前提下让剪枝后动作与全上下文 teacher 动作保持一致，并以真值动作作辅助监督。在 LIBERO 与真实操作任务上最多剪掉 87.5% 视觉 token、计算量最多降 75%、推理加速 1.5 倍，同时保持有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: VLA 模型每个控制步都要处理长 token 序列，算力开销大、难以实时部署；现有剪枝方案要么依赖注意力分数、运动阈值等间接的 training-free 启发式，要么需要对基座 VLA 做昂贵微调。
Method: 提出 VLA-ACL (Action Consistency Learning)：训练一个轻量视觉 token 剪枝策略，损失要求剪枝后视觉上下文产出的动作与全上下文 teacher 动作一致，并加入真值动作作为辅助监督，把 token 选择直接绑定到下游控制输出；基座 VLA 全程冻结。
Result: 在 LIBERO 与真实世界操作任务上，最多剪枝 87.5% 视觉 token 仍保持有竞争力的性能，计算量最多减少 75%，推理加速 1.5 倍；相较已有 frozen-VLA 剪枝方法取得更强的性能-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 动作级监督可以在不微调基座 VLA 的情况下有效指导视觉 token 选择，用远少于全上下文的 token 换来 1.5 倍加速与 75% 计算节省。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond Marginal Monitoring: Distributed Joint-Distribution Testing for Data Concept Drift in Large Scale E-Commerce Operations
papers.abstract_en: Concept drift threatens production machine learning, yet the empirical behavior of multivariate two-sample drift detectors at scale remains under-characterized. Existing benchmarks rarely address the hundreds of millions of rows and high-cardinality features typical of industrial-operational datasets. We evaluate five multi-column two-sample tests (marginal, projection-based, and kernel embedding methods) across three complementary environments: the Harvard Dataverse, a validated Failing Loudly reproduction (mean absolute error between 0.030 and 0.053), and a novel synthetic-injection benchmark on the 137.5-million-row Trendyol collection-ranking feature table. Testing four drift types across two severity-scope regimes, we demonstrate that distributed Maximum Mean Discrepancy with Random Fourier Features on Apache Spark scales robustly. Averaged over the four drift types in the strong regime and under a calibrated threshold, it achieves a Pearson correlation of r = 0.940 with expected drift magnitude, an 80.4% true positive rate, and a 3.2% false positive rate. Conversely, the per-dimension Kolmogorov-Smirnov test failed due to statistic saturation from ID-like columns under asymmetric sampling, establishing a critical constraint for large-scale sampling design. At weak configurations (realized-flip fractions of at most 0.57%), detectors struggled to reliably discriminate, highlighting the need for future intensity-grid power analyses to distinguish fundamental sensitivity bounds from scalable threshold shifts.

Motivation: 多变量两样本漂移检测器在工业规模（数亿行、高基数特征）下的实证行为刻画不足，现有基准很少覆盖这种数据形态。
Method: 评估五种多列两样本检验（marginal、projection-based、kernel embedding 三类），在三个环境上测试：Harvard Dataverse、经验证的 Failing Loudly 复现（MAE 0.030–0.053）、以及在 Trendyol collection-ranking 特征表上构造的合成注入基准；覆盖四种漂移类型与两个 severity-scope 体制，核心方法为 Apache Spark 上的分布式 MMD + Random Fourier Features。

papers.title: Mu-DisCoCat: A Variational Pipeline for Compositional Generalization on Quantum Processors
papers.abstract_en: Achieving compositional concept generalization (CoCoGen), the ability to understand novel situations by recombining learned primitives, remains a fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence. Compositional semantic models such as Compositional Distributional Semantics (DisCoCat) offer solutions by generalising vectors to tensors, but suffer from scaling bottlenecks when learning the tensors. Mapping DisCoCat onto Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) resolves this limitation for text, yet the methodology has not been expanded to multimodal situations such as the ones involved in CoCoGen. This paper introduces Mu-DisCoCat: a multimodal variational quantum learning framework for DisCoCat that achieves CoCoGen. The framework first learns stable object representations from single-object image-text pairs, then fixes these and uses them to learn the relations between them in multi-object situations. In classical simulations, the model used Uhlmann state fidelity to compute the overlap between the multimodal circuit representations and achieved higher relational OOD accuracy than the evaluated CLIP baseline. Its deployment was evaluated using the destructive SWAP test across noisy quantum emulators, including a range of IBM fake backends, IQM FakeAphrodite, and the IBM Marrakesh quantum processor. Despite real-world device noise, the hardware-executed models maintained a strong positive correlation with simulated fidelities, reliably distinguishing unseen similar and dissimilar pairs. Our work establishes a framework for executing CoCoGen on VQCs, demonstrating a viable use case for near-term quantum hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mu-DisCoCat 把多模态组合语义模型 DisCoCat 映射到变分量子电路 (VQC)，先从单物体图文对学稳定物体表征并固定，再学多物体关系，实现组合概念泛化 (CoCoGen)。经典模拟中用 Uhlmann state fidelity 计算多模态电路表征的重叠，关系 OOD 准确率高于所评估的 CLIP 基线；在 IBM fake backends、IQM FakeAphrodite 与 IBM Marrakesh 处理器上用破坏性 SWAP test 部署，尽管有真实噪声，硬件执行结果与模拟 fidelity 仍保持强正相关，可靠区分未见过的相似与不相似对。
Motivation: DisCoCat 用张量替代向量可做组合语义建模，但学习张量存在扩展瓶颈；已有 VQC 方案只覆盖文本，尚未扩展到 CoCoGen 所需的多模态情境。
Method: 提出多模态变分量子学习框架：先从单物体 image-text 对学习稳定物体表征并固定，再用它们学习多物体情境中的关系；经典模拟用 Uhlmann state fidelity 计算多模态电路表征间的重叠，硬件部署用 destructive SWAP test。
Result: 经典模拟下关系 OOD 准确率高于所评估的 CLIP 基线；在 IBM fake backends、IQM FakeAphrodite 与 IBM Marrakesh 量子处理器上执行的模型与模拟 fidelity 保持强正相关，能可靠区分未见过的相似与不相似对。
Conclusion: 在 VQC 上执行 CoCoGen 是可行的，多模态关系泛化可在含噪近期量子硬件上完成，为 NISQ 设备提供了一个可用场景。

papers.title: Do LLMs Act on What They Know? From Partner Representations to Cooperative Actions
papers.abstract_en: Cooperation with unfamiliar partners requires adapting to communication conventions that are not known in advance. We study this problem in a controlled Hanabi-derived environment with scripted hint generation, LLM-controlled receiving decisions, and frozen model weights. Across eight LLMs, linear probes recover intent conventions substantially more accurately than target conventions, yet receiving choices do not consistently agree with the sender's convention. We compare probe-predicted and ground-truth conventions presented either as general rules or as externally computed action recommendations. Rule statements yield modest and model-dependent changes in cooperation, whereas action translation produces larger gains on average. In a Qwen3-8B case study, matched-state statement reversals reveal much greater sensitivity to action recommendations than to rule statements. Activation transfers from oracle-action and non-oracle hint-restatement donors improve intent accuracy on both action classes, but the tested alternatives do not reliably reproduce these benefits. Together, these results distinguish convention decodability, sensitivity to convention information, and cooperative performance, and highlight limitations in turning available partner information into receiving decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Hanabi 衍生的受控合作环境中，用线性探针从 8 个 LLM 的激活中解码伙伴约定，发现意图约定比目标约定更可解码，但接收方选择并不与发送方约定一致。把约定翻译成外部计算的动作建议比写成通用规则更能提升合作表现，Qwen3-8B 的匹配状态反转实验显示模型对动作建议的敏感度远高于规则陈述。
Motivation: 与陌生伙伴合作需要适应事先未知的通信约定，但现有 LLM 是否真能把已解码的伙伴信息转成接收决策尚不清楚。
Method: 在脚本化提示生成、LLM 控制接收决策、模型权重冻结的 Hanabi 衍生环境中，用线性探针解码约定，再把探针预测或真值约定以通用规则或外部动作建议两种形式注入，比较合作表现；另做 Qwen3-8B 匹配状态反转与激活迁移（activation transfer）实验。
Result: 跨 8 个 LLM，线性探针解码意图约定的准确率显著高于目标约定，但接收选择与发送方约定不总一致；规则陈述带来温和且因模型而异的合作变化，动作翻译平均带来更大增益；Qwen3-8B 反转实验对动作建议的敏感度远高于规则陈述；从 oracle-action 与 non-oracle hint-restatement 迁移激活可提升两类动作的意图准确率，但所测替代方案不能可靠复现该收益。
Conclusion: 约定的可解码性、对约定信息的敏感度与合作表现是三件不同的事，把已有的伙伴信息转成接收决策仍存在明显障碍，动作级建议比规则级陈述更有效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Supermarket Product Detection and Recognition: Utilizing Deep Learning with Rectified Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Product Identification has sprung up to become one of the most challenging problems in the automation of the retail industry. With the new industry 5.0 standards, automated inventory management, and catalog creation tasks are vitally important. Object identification models have emerged as a viable answer with their unprecedented identification and localization accuracy. However, the close-knit rack design of supermarkets generates the problem of angle variation in capturing images. The angle-variant densely packed images(a single image contains many objects) become overwhelming for these models alone. In this paper, we try to supplement object detection models with traditional Hough transform (HT) and homogeneous estimation concepts. We study the effect of rectified images using homography estimation and hough transform and their limitations on the problem of grocery identification. We make a case for creating a new dataset to test the effects of such rectification and produce analytical results on different scenarios of angle variation and object densities per image. Extensive experiments on different object detection models suggest that image rectification of angled images improves the detection accuracy of grocery products in images. The results also highlight the limitation of rectification on the angle of image capture and the object density of the image.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 超市货架密集陈列导致拍摄角度多变、单图目标极多，作者用 Hough transform (HT) 与 homography estimation 对倾斜图像做 rectification，再送入目标检测模型识别商品。实验表明对倾斜图像做 rectification 能提升杂货商品检测精度，但当拍摄角度过大或单图物体密度过高时 rectification 收益受限。
Motivation: 零售自动化的 Industry 5.0 标准要求自动库存管理与目录生成，但超市紧凑货架造成角度变化与单图多目标叠加，单靠目标检测模型难以应对。
Method: 将传统 Hough transform 与 homography estimation 结合，对倾斜图像做 rectification 后再输入目标检测模型；作者主张构建新数据集来检验 rectification 效果，并在不同拍摄角度与单图物体密度场景下做分析。
Result: 在多个目标检测模型上的大量实验表明，对倾斜图像做 rectification 可提升杂货商品检测精度；同时结果凸显 rectification 受拍摄角度与单图物体密度限制。
Conclusion: 图像 rectification 是提升密集货架商品检测的有效补充手段，但其收益随拍摄角度增大和物体密度升高而衰减。

papers.title: Beyond Waypoint Regression: Query-Based Cost Learning over Reachable Ego Futures for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end planners based on waypoint regression achieve strong open-loop accuracy, but they primarily learn to mimic expert geometry and remain difficult to adapt to deployment-time safety constraints. We propose a query-based cost-learning framework that estimates bounded costs for dynamically reachable ego trajectory queries, rather than dense BEV cells or a small regressed trajectory set. Compact joint scene tokens capture coherent multimodal agent futures, while contingency-aware cost aggregation and cost-guided intra-cluster MPPI mixing convert the learned cost topology into feasible ego plans. On nuScenes, our method improves over prior cost-estimation planners such as ST-P3 and NMP, outperforms most regression baselines in collision rate, while remaining competitive in L2, and retaining an interpretable cost interface. On real-world driving logs, the proposed planner reduces collision rates compared with SparseDrive and Alpamayo without fine-tuning, while maintaining a diverse set of candidate trajectories.
papers.comment: Accepted in the 18th Asian Conference on Computer Vision (ACCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 端到端驾驶规划中，waypoint regression 只模仿专家几何且难适配部署期安全约束；本文改为对动力学可达的自车轨迹 query 直接学有界代价，再用 contingency-aware 聚合与 cost-guided intra-cluster MPPI 混合把代价拓扑转成可行规划。在 nuScenes 上碰撞率优于多数回归基线且 L2 保持竞争力，真实驾驶日志上无需微调即降低碰撞率。
Motivation: waypoint regression 规划器开环精度高，但主要学专家几何的模仿，且部署期安全约束难以注入。
Method: 提出 query-based cost-learning 框架：对动力学可达的自车轨迹 query 估计有界代价（而非密集 BEV 格或少量回归轨迹），用 compact joint scene tokens 表示多模态 agent 未来，经 contingency-aware cost aggregation 与 cost-guided intra-cluster MPPI mixing 生成可行自车规划。
Result: 在 nuScenes 上，相对 ST-P3、NMP 等代价估计规划器有提升，碰撞率优于多数回归基线，同时 L2 保持竞争力并保留可解释的代价接口；在真实世界驾驶日志上，相对 SparseDrive 与 Alpamayo 无需微调即降低碰撞率，并维持多样的候选轨迹集。
Conclusion: 把回归几何换成对可达轨迹 query 的代价学习，能在保持 L2 竞争力的同时改善碰撞率，并让安全约束可注入、代价可解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attenuated in-context identification in time-series foundation models: diagnosis under counterfactual inputs and repair by synthetic forced-system fine-tuning
papers.abstract_en: Covariate-aware time-series foundation models (TSFMs) promise training-free what-if answers for instrumented plants: the change in output that a different future input would cause. We test this on forced engineering systems with exact counterfactuals, comparing Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and TabPFN-TS with classical system identification fitted to the same context. Through their default covariate interfaces, TimesFM-2.5 and TabPFN-TS are memoryless: the predicted effect of an input change is a same-time function of that change ($R^2 = 1.000$ for TimesFM-2.5). Chronos-2 identifies dynamics in context but attenuates them. Its predicted effect is 0.33-0.80 of the true effect, its recovered impulse response has the wrong shape, and its error on a one-degree-of-freedom oscillator levels off at 0.57 with 8192 context samples, where ARX fitted to 256 samples reaches 0.02. Context dither at inference lowers the what-if error on all six synthetic classes without training. A 26-minute fine-tune on synthetic forced systems restores the response magnitude (sensitivity 0.83-0.96) and outperforms structure-agnostic identification on Wiener-Hammerstein and a held-out friction class. A specialised in-context identifier trained on the same data comes close, so the forced-system data carry most of the gain. On three of four measured plants classical identification remains clearly better, and the fine-tuned model loses part of its univariate forecasting skill. Paired counterfactual inputs, together with shuffled future inputs on measured records, test two properties: whether the covariate interface can represent dynamics and whether the pretraining prior covers the plant's time scale. Only the counterfactual pairs expose the attenuation.

Motivation: 协变量感知的时序基础模型 (TSFM) 承诺对仪表化装置做 training-free 的 what-if 推断，但其协变量接口能否真正表示动力学、预训练先验是否覆盖装置时间尺度，此前缺少带精确反事实的检验手段。

papers.title: Energy-Aware Path Following: Comparative Analysis of Reinforcement Learning and NMPC for Electric Vehicles
papers.abstract_en: Path-following control strategies typically follow the bi-objective optimization dilemma: minimizing deviations from a reference path while maintaining smooth speed profiles. The latter objective is especially relevant for Electric Vehicles (EVs), since their limited driving range can be extended by recovering energy through regenerative braking, a feature that has not yet been sufficiently studied in the literature. In this work, we perform a comparative analysis of four controllers under one common Frenet frame-based kinematic vehicle model, utilizing a validated energy model (VT-CPEM) with explicit regenerative braking. Herein, we implement the following controllers: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC), Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), gain-scheduled Ackermann state-feedback baseline (PID-SF), and a Stanley geometric baseline. To satisfy real-time requirements, we implement the NMPC using JIT-compiled CasADi. Moreover, we train the PPO using traditional straight and S-curve tracks, after which we successfully transfer the unmodified policy to unseen tracks, including: an ISO 3888-1 lane-change, a chicane, randomly-generated parameterized-splines, and a $\pm3^\circ$ graded road. In addition, the policy transfers to a dynamic single-track vehicle model with linear tires, zero-shot with an acceptable initial performance, which was optimized after brief fine-tuning. Thereby, we demonstrate that our PPO is readily transferable to more comprehensive vehicle models. We conclude with a performance analysis of developed controllers and discuss ideas for future work.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, currently submitted for review at the journal (Robotics and Autonomous Systems) https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/robotics-and-autonomous-systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在统一的 Frenet 坐标运动学模型与含再生制动的 VT-CPEM 能量模型下，对比 NMPC、PPO、PID-SF 与 Stanley 四类路径跟踪控制器。PPO 在直线与 S 弯上训练后，零改动迁移到 ISO 3888-1 变道、chicane、随机样条与 ±3° 坡道，并零样本迁移到带线性轮胎的单轨动力学模型，微调后性能进一步提升。
Motivation: 路径跟踪的双目标（贴合参考路径与保持平顺速度）中，平顺性对续航至关重要的再生制动回收在文献中研究不足；同时需要检验 RL 策略在不同赛道与更高保真车辆模型上的可迁移性。
Method: 在同一 Frenet 帧运动学车辆模型上实现四个控制器：JIT 编译 CasADi 的 NMPC、PPO、增益调度 Ackermann 状态反馈基线 PID-SF 与 Stanley 几何基线；能量评估用含显式再生制动的 VT-CPEM；PPO 在直线与 S 弯训练后直接迁移到未见赛道与单轨动力学模型。
Result: PPO 策略零改动迁移到 ISO 3888-1 变道、chicane、随机参数化样条与 ±3° 坡道；并零样本迁移到带线性轮胎的单轨车辆模型，初始表现可接受，经简短微调后提升。摘要给出的定量内容为赛道与坡道规格（±3°）、控制器数量（4 个）与文档规模（20 页、12 图）。
Conclusion: PPO 路径跟踪策略可直接迁移到更全面的车辆模型与未见赛道，再生制动应作为电动车路径跟踪的显式优化目标；作者以四控制器性能分析收尾并讨论后续工作。
