papers.title: Beyond Training from Scratch: Foundation Models for Data-Efficient and Generalizable Cardiac MRI Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction aims to recover high-quality images from undersampled acquisitions, enabling faster scans while preserving diagnostic fidelity. Recent reconstruction methods are typically trained from scratch and often require large amounts of task-specific data, limiting their robustness under data scarcity and distribution shifts. In this work, we investigate whether pretrained vision foundation models can serve as effective priors for accelerated cardiac MRI reconstruction. We propose a reconstruction framework that integrates frozen and parameter-efficiently adapted visual encoders, including CLIP, BiomedCLIP, and DINOv2, within a transformer-based reconstruction architecture. Extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 and CMRxRecon2024 benchmarks demonstrate that pretrained representations consistently outperform a transformer trained from scratch across multiple acceleration factors. We further evaluate performance under limited supervision and cross-dataset transfer, showing that foundation models provide superior data efficiency and generalization. While frozen representations are particularly effective in extreme low-data regimes, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) yields additional gains when moderate amounts of training data are available. Among the evaluated backbones, DINOv2 achieves the strongest overall performance. These findings highlight the potential of vision foundation models as robust and transferable priors for cardiac MRI reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把预训练视觉基础模型（CLIP、BiomedCLIP、DINOv2）作为冻结或参数高效适配的先验，嵌入 transformer 心脏 MRI 重建架构，在欠采样加速重建上稳定超过从零训练的 transformer。在 CMRxRecon2023/2024 多个加速因子下均成立：极低数据量时冻结表征最有效，中等数据量时 LoRA 追加增益，DINOv2 整体最强。
Motivation: 现有心脏 MRI 重建方法多从零训练且依赖大量任务特定数据，在数据稀缺与分布偏移下鲁棒性不足。
Method: 在 transformer 重建架构中集成冻结与参数高效适配的视觉编码器（CLIP、BiomedCLIP、DINOv2），并用 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 做中等数据量下的适配；在 CMRxRecon2023 与 CMRxRecon2024 基准上测试，并考察有限监督与跨数据集迁移设置。
Result: 在 CMRxRecon2023 和 CMRxRecon2024 上，预训练表征在多个加速因子下均优于从零训练的 transformer；有限监督与跨数据集迁移实验显示基础模型带来更好的数据效率与泛化；极低数据 regime 下冻结表征特别有效，中等数据量时 LoRA 额外增益；被评骨干中 DINOv2 整体表现最强。
Conclusion: 视觉基础模型可作为心脏 MRI 重建的稳健可迁移先验：数据极少时直接用冻结表征，数据变多再上 LoRA，DINOv2 是首选骨干。

papers.title: Enhancing Diffusion Language Models with Autoregressive Post-Training Weights
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, offering flexible token-update orders and parallel decoding. Recent dLLMs are often initialized from pretrained AR models before diffusion conversion in order to inherit their learned representations. After the conversion, however, they typically ignore the extensive post-training ecosystem of their AR ancestors. In this work, we show that these existing AR post-training weight updates can instead be effectively recycled to enhance diffusion models. Despite the changes by AR-to-diffusion conversion, directly adding an AR post-training weight update to a diffusion base model remains effective, bringing its performance close to that achieved by direct diffusion post-training. Notably, AR and diffusion post-training updates are nearly orthogonal in weight space, yet induce substantially more aligned representation changes in the diffusion model. Their distinct updates are also complementary: composing their weights can retain gains from both regimes and further improve the post-trained diffusion model. Based on these findings, we propose A2D, a simple training-free framework for enhancing diffusion models with existing AR post-training resources. A2D can transfer capabilities from AR post-trained models to diffusion base models, and further improve already post-trained diffusion models by composing AR and diffusion post-training updates. Across various dLLMs, including Dream, DreamReasoner, DiffuCoder, Dream-Coder, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion, and DiffusionGemma, A2D reliably improves instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and coding with both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning updates, without additional training, or inference-time computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: A2D 把自回归 (AR) 模型的后训练权重更新直接加到扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 上，无需任何额外训练或推理时计算。AR 与扩散后训练更新在权重空间近乎正交，却在扩散模型中诱导出高度对齐的表征变化，二者组合还能叠加双方增益，在 Dream、DiffuCoder、DiffusionGemma 等多个 dLLM 上稳定提升指令遵循、数学推理与代码能力。
Motivation: dLLM 常从预训练 AR 模型初始化以继承表征，但扩散转换后完全弃用了 AR 庞大的后训练生态（SFT 与 RL 资源），这些现成权重更新被浪费。
Method: A2D 是一个 training-free 框架：直接把 AR 后训练权重更新加到扩散 base model 上，并可将 AR 与扩散两套后训练更新在权重空间组合；适用于监督微调 (SFT) 与强化学习 (RL) 两类更新。
Result: 在 Dream、DreamReasoner、DiffuCoder、Dream-Coder、Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion、DiffusionGemma 等多种 dLLM 上，A2D 在指令遵循、数学推理与代码任务上均带来提升，且不引入额外训练或推理时计算；直接相加 AR 更新即可让性能接近直接做扩散后训练的水平。
Conclusion: AR 后训练权重更新与扩散后训练更新近乎正交但表征变化对齐、且能力互补，因此可直接回收复用，无需重新训练即可增强 dLLM。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Exploiting Acoustic and Content-Oriented Speaker Verification Attacks Against Multilingual Voice Anonymization
papers.abstract_en: Attacker ASV systems for voice anonymization have been studied primarily in English, leaving their behavior in multilingual settings largely unexplored. Conventional ASV has shown that both acoustic and contextual information are important for multilingual speaker verification. Inspired by this, we investigate whether the same holds for attacker ASV on anonymized speech. We evaluate both acoustic- and content-oriented attackers on multilingual anonymized speech and construct a multilingual voice-converted dataset to improve cross-lingual generalization. Our results show that attacker effectiveness depends on the linguistic utility of the anonymized speech. Overall, acoustic-oriented attackers achieve better performance. However, when linguistic information is well preserved, the performance gap between content- and acoustic-oriented attackers narrows compared with conditions involving stronger speech distortion. The multilingual voice-converted dataset further improves performance and partially reduces the cross-lingual gap. These findings highlight the need for more comprehensive attacker modeling and evaluation protocols that consider both privacy and utility, rather than relying on a attacker strategy\footnote{Full code and pretrained models and MultiVC Dataset link are available at: https://github.com/monkeyDarefeen/DAST
papers.comment: Accepted in IEEE Spoken Language Technology (SLT) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多语言语音匿名化场景下评测声学型与内容型说话人验证 (ASV) 攻击者，发现攻击有效性取决于匿名化语音的语言信息保留程度：整体上声学型攻击者更强，但当语言信息保存较好时，内容型与声学型攻击者的性能差距比强失真条件下更小。构建的多语言语音转换数据集 MultiVC 进一步提升攻击性能并部分缩小跨语言差距。
Motivation: 针对说话人匿名化的攻击者 ASV 研究几乎都在英语上进行，多语言设定下的行为基本未被探索，而常规 ASV 已表明声学与上下文信息对多语言说话人验证都很重要。
Method: 评测声学导向 (acoustic-oriented) 与内容导向 (content-oriented) 两类攻击者 ASV 在多语言匿名化语音上的表现，并构建多语言语音转换数据集 MultiVC 以提升跨语言泛化；开源代码、预训练模型与数据集。
Result: 整体上声学型攻击者取得更好的攻击性能；当匿名化语音中语言信息被良好保留时，内容型与声学型攻击者的性能差距相比强语音失真条件收窄；MultiVC 数据集进一步提升攻击性能并部分缩小跨语言差距。

papers.title: ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance rapidly, while conventional benchmark development lags behind, delaying investigation of newly observed capability gaps. Such investigation requires an expressive task format and an on-demand construction process: information-rich charts make chart question answering (Chart QA) suitable for probing coupled perception and reasoning. Automated Chart QA construction is intended to shorten the benchmark-development cycle by turning identified gaps into targeted samples on demand. Current methods, however, commonly separate target guidance from scratch generation: target-guided systems often require prepared data, charts, or templates, while scratch-generation systems primarily ensure artifact validity, without explicitly controlling whether newly synthesized requirements and content remain aligned with an externally specified diagnostic target. We introduce ChartBmkAgent, which turns an identified capability gap into targeted diagnostic evidence by constructing complete Chart QA samples from sparse error-taxonomy specifications. Throughout construction, a central harness governs specialized agents, requires stage-specific evidence of alignment with the original error category, and records the basis for each acceptance decision. On 300 taxonomy-wide samples, MLLM accuracies ranged from 32.7% to 84.3% with distinct category profiles, showing that generated samples reveal capability differences. Across three source-model comparisons, targeted follow-ups scored 50.0% versus 82.2% on matched controls ($p=8.96\times10^{-6}$); all six cross-model comparisons had the same direction, demonstrating targeted validation and diagnostic-data generation. Multiple evaluator models assessed whether each sample tested its specified error category; 86.4% met this criterion, providing empirical evidence of target preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ChartBmkAgent 用一个中心 harness 约束多个专职 agent，把稀疏的错误分类 (error-taxonomy) 规格直接变成完整的 Chart QA 诊断样本，并要求每个阶段提交与原始错误类别对齐的证据。300 个样本上 MLLM 准确率分布在 32.7%–84.3% 且类别画像各异；定向追问样本得分 50.0% 对匹配对照 82.2%（p=8.96×10⁻⁶），86.4% 的样本经多评估模型判定确实测到了指定错误类别。
Motivation: MLLM 能力缺口出现后，常规 benchmark 开发周期太长；现有自动构造方法把目标引导与从零生成割裂开，要么依赖预置数据、图表或模板，要么只保证产物合法，不检查合成内容是否仍对齐外部诊断目标。
Method: 中心 harness 调度专职 agent，从稀疏 error-taxonomy 规格生成完整 Chart QA 样本；每阶段强制提交与原始错误类别对齐的证据，并记录每次接受决策的依据；再由多个 evaluator 模型判定样本是否真的在测指定错误类别。
Result: 300 个 taxonomy 范围样本上 MLLM 准确率 32.7%–84.3%，类别画像分明；三次源模型对比中定向追问 50.0% 对匹配对照 82.2%（p=8.96×10⁻⁶），六次跨模型对比方向一致；86.4% 样本被多评估模型判定符合其指定错误类别。
Conclusion: harness 治理的多 agent 构造能把能力缺口转成有针对性的诊断证据，且生成样本在多数情况下保住了目标错误类别，可用于定向验证与诊断数据生成。

papers.title: DSV-Mem: Evaluating Multimodal Memory in Professional Workflows for MLLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows, from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations. Yet this capability remains underexplored: existing benchmarks largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios featuring photographic natural images, isolated static artifacts, and recall-oriented questions. In contrast, professional scenarios often involve structured, information-heavy artifacts that undergo frequent revisions and authority updates, and compositional queries requiring reconciliation of many artifact versions while tracking state precisely. To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem, a benchmark for evaluating Dense Stateful Visual Memory. DSV-Mem comprises expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal). A Hartley-inspired criterion favors questions with broader visual-evidence inspection demands. We also introduce a generation harness that produces evaluation suites by decoupling state-transition synthesis from conversation filling. Evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier and open-weight models and memory management methods reveals that the strongest baseline scores below 45% on DSV-Mem. Analysis surfaces findings: 1) multimodality and information density both contribute to difficulty, but state evolution, particularly the number of governing updates, is the dominant tested factor. Raw conversation/haystack length, OCR, and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks; 2) models often fail to verify user premises against prior state updates before answering; 3) increased reasoning effort and memory management methods yield limited gains, whereas state-aware designs prove more effective. The benchmark and code will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSV-Mem 是评测多模态大模型智能体 (MLLM Agent) 在专业工作流中稠密有状态视觉记忆 (Dense Stateful Visual Memory) 的基准：1000 道专家审核题目覆盖 Current State、Past State、Derived State、Change History、Conflict/Refusal 五类，配一个把状态转移合成与对话填充解耦的生成框架。27 个配置（前沿与开源权重模型、各类记忆管理方法）中最强基线得分低于 45%，且状态演化（尤其管辖性更新次数）是主导难度因素，推理加码与常规记忆管理收益有限，state-aware 设计更有效。
Motivation: 现有智能体基准多围绕日常闲聊、静态照片式图像与回忆型提问，而专业场景的工件结构化、信息密集、频繁修订与权限更新，查询需要跨多版本对账并精确跟踪状态，这一能力尚缺评测。
Method: 构建 DSV-Mem 基准：专家审核场景与 1000 道题，按五个用户视角类别组织；用受 Hartley 启发的准则筛选视觉证据考察面更广的题目。另提出生成框架，把状态转移合成与对话填充解耦，批量产出评测套件。
Result: 在覆盖前沿与开源权重模型及记忆管理方法的 27 个配置上评测，最强基线在 DSV-Mem 上得分低于 45%。分析显示多模态与信息密度都增加难度，但状态演化（尤其管辖性更新次数）是被测到的主导因素；原始对话/haystack 长度、OCR 与算术不是主要瓶颈；模型常在回答前不拿先前状态更新核验用户前提；加大推理 effort 与记忆管理方法收益有限，state-aware 设计更有效。
Conclusion: 专业工作流中的多模态记忆瓶颈在状态演化而非上下文长度或感知能力，改进方向应是让智能体在作答前对照历史更新核验前提的 state-aware 设计。基准与代码将公开发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Shared memory coordinates agents' actions, but correct records do not establish that those actions satisfy task requirements. Memory governance and failure diagnosis regulate or inspect recorded information; they do not by themselves establish whether it is sufficient to judge task duties. We define execution consistency through duties governing state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, with explicit evidence conditions for judging fulfillment. Our core claim is that identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Controlled removal of evidence such as receipt, action dependence, or response validity leaves 82.4% of opposite-label pairs indistinguishable; restoration separates 97.9% of the merged pairs. Natural-log annotations identify the defined violations in actual executions. However, existing logs do not always explicitly represent the execution relationships needed for these judgments. To assess the definition's practical value, we use CAVERT, a framework for consistency diagnosis and recovery, to extract supported relationships from logs and apply these criteria. It consistently outperforms contract-prompted LLM and rule-based baselines in diagnosis across all 12 benchmark-executor settings. Under the same gate and executor limits, it also outperforms rule-guided recovery in all four evaluated environments. These findings identify execution evidence that agent-memory and execution interfaces should preserve for reliable judgment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体系统里共享记忆记录正确并不等于执行满足任务要求：作者定义 execution consistency，用状态使用、信息交接、最终状态一致三类职责加显式证据条件判定。核心发现是同一份保留记录可同时对应合规与违规执行，删除回执、动作依赖、响应有效性等证据后 82.4% 的异标签对无法区分，恢复证据可分开 97.9% 的合并对；CAVERT 框架在全部 12 个 benchmark-executor 设置上诊断优于 contract-prompted LLM 与规则基线。
Motivation: 记忆治理与失败诊断只规范或检查已记录信息，无法判断记录是否足以判定任务职责是否履行；同一日志可能同时对应合规与违规执行，导致诊断不可靠。
Method: 定义 execution consistency：以管辖状态使用、信息交接、最终状态一致的职责加显式证据条件判定履行；用 CAVERT 框架从日志中抽取受支持的执行关系并套用这些判据，与 contract-prompted LLM 和规则基线比较诊断，并在四个环境中比较规则引导的恢复。
Result: 受控删除回执、动作依赖、响应有效性等证据后，82.4% 的异标签对不可区分；恢复证据后 97.9% 的合并对被分开。CAVERT 在全部 12 个 benchmark-executor 设置的诊断上一致优于 contract-prompted LLM 与规则基线，并在同门限与执行器限制下于全部四个评估环境中优于规则引导恢复。自然语言日志标注可在真实执行中识别所定义的违规。
Conclusion: 执行证据（回执、动作依赖、响应有效性）是 agent-memory 与执行接口必须保留的判定依据，仅靠记录正确性不足以支撑合规判断。

papers.title: Surviving the Router: Optimizing Skill Injections for Retrieval and Execution
papers.abstract_en: AI agents increasingly rely on modular third-party "skills" that are dynamically selected by skill routers to execute complex tasks. While recent studies highlight the threat of prompt injections embedded in these skills, existing evaluations often assume settings where the malicious skill is already selected for execution. We show that this assumption can substantially overestimate attack success. In realistic multi-skill environments, injected skills must first compete for retrieval, reducing the effective attack success rate (ASR) of existing injections by 87-97%. To address this limitation, we introduce CORSA (Cluster Optimization for Router-Aware Skill Attacks), a router-aware attack that optimizes skill injections for both retrieval and execution across clusters of related tasks. We evaluate skill injection attacks under router-managed multi-skill settings by extending the benchmark introduced by SkillRouter with eight malicious payload categories. CORSA uses successive optimization stages to first improve retrieval and then optimize end-to-end attack success, while we evaluate user utility and injection naturalism separately. Our experiments show that CORSA substantially improves both retrieval and end-to-end attack success over existing skill injections while preserving user utility, and that the resulting attacks transfer across different router architectures and LLM backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多技能环境中，恶意 skill 必须先被 router 检索到才能执行，这一竞争使现有 prompt injection 的有效攻击成功率 (ASR) 下降 87–97%，说明以往假设恶意技能已被选中的评测严重高估攻击风险。作者提出 CORSA（Cluster Optimization for Router-Aware Skill Attacks），分阶段先优化检索、再优化端到端攻击成功，并在跨 router 架构与 LLM backbone 上保持迁移。
Motivation: 现有 skill injection 评测默认恶意技能已被 router 选中执行，忽略了检索竞争这一现实环节，导致 ASR 被系统性高估，无法反映多技能部署下的真实威胁。
Method: CORSA 采用多阶段优化：先提升技能在 router 下的检索命中，再优化端到端攻击成功；优化在相关任务簇 (clusters) 上进行，并单独评估用户效用 (user utility) 与注入自然度 (injection naturalism)。评测基于扩展 SkillRouter 基准，加入八类恶意 payload。
Result: 在 router 管理的多技能设定下，现有注入的有效 ASR 因检索竞争下降 87–97%；CORSA 在检索与端到端攻击成功上均显著优于现有 skill injection，同时保持用户效用，且攻击可跨不同 router 架构与 LLM backbone 迁移。
Conclusion: 对 skill injection 的评测必须把 router 检索竞争纳入，否则会高估威胁；面向 router 的注入优化能同时打通检索与执行两个环节并保持跨架构迁移。

summary_sections.method: CORSA 采用多阶段优化：先提升技能在 router 下的检索命中，再优化端到端攻击成功；优化在相关任务簇 (clusters) 上进行，并单独评估用户效用 (user utility) 与注入自然度 (injection naturalism)。评测基于扩展 SkillRouter 基准，加入八类恶意 payload。
summary_sections.result: 在 router 管理的多技能设定下，现有注入的有效 ASR 因检索竞争下降 87–97%；CORSA 在检索与端到端攻击成功上均显著优于现有 skill injection，同时保持用户效用，且攻击可跨不同 router 架构与 LLM backbone 迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对 skill injection 的评测必须把 router 检索竞争纳入，否则会高估威胁；面向 router 的注入优化能同时打通检索与执行两个环节并保持跨架构迁移。

papers.title: When Tools Lie: Reliability of Mathematical Agents Under Corrupted Tool Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Mathematical problem solving often requires deterministic computational steps that agents delegate to tools and implicitly trust. Yet tools can fail silently, returning plausible but incorrect results. How well can agents detect and correct corrupted tool call outputs? We study this through a controlled corruption framework where a hidden interceptor replaces tool call results with plausible incorrect information on targeted problems. We evaluate agents across 31 problems under four verification designs including no verification (baseline), mandatory same-context reflection, optional fresh-context verification, and optional structural verification. Without verification, corruption causes dramatic accuracy loss, from 100% down to 72.4%. Mandatory reflection fully recovers this performance to 100%. Optional verification improves accuracy only when models actively invoke it. Our results show that checking frequency is strongly associated with robustness differences, while unequal invocation prevents a controlled comparison of verifier quality. A supporting recovery experiment shows that full problem restart succeeds in 100% of cases after explicit detection. These findings demonstrate that verifier availability and verification policy are separate components of mathematical-agent reliability. Mandatory policies enforce verification while optional policies depend on the model's own choice to invoke it.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MathAI) at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 31 道数学题上用隐藏拦截器把工具返回结果替换成看似合理但错误的输出，比较四种验证设计：无验证时准确率从 100% 跌到 72.4%，强制同上下文反思 (mandatory same-context reflection) 完全恢复到 100%，可选验证只有在模型主动调用时才提升准确率。结论是验证器可用性与验证策略是数学智能体可靠性的两个独立组件，强制策略才能保证检查发生。
Motivation: 数学求解中智能体把确定性计算外包给工具并默认信任其返回，工具可能静默失败、给出貌似合理的错误结果；需要区分验证器本身的质量与模型是否真的去调用验证。
Method: 受控腐败框架：隐藏拦截器在定向题目上把工具调用结果替换为貌似合理的错误信息；在 31 道题上对比四种验证设计——无验证基线、强制同上下文反思、可选新上下文验证、可选结构性验证；另有一个恢复实验考察显式检测后整题重启。
Result: 无验证时腐败使准确率从 100% 降到 72.4%；强制反思把性能完全恢复到 100%；可选验证仅在模型主动调用时提升准确率；检查频率与鲁棒性差异强相关，而调用不均使验证器质量无法受控比较；显式检测后整题重启在 100% 的案例中成功恢复。
Conclusion: 验证器可用性与验证策略是分离的两个组件：强制策略保证执行验证，可选策略取决于模型自身是否调用，因此评估验证器质量必须先控制调用率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QRAKEN 是一个免训练、与本体无关的神经符号管线：离线蒸馏器把图上实际填充的多跳模式、条件频率和路径条件字面量压成 TTQL，再用确定性语法/词汇/数据模型检查驱动迭代修正，让 LLM 在陌生 RDF 图上生成的 SPARQL 对齐真实数据模型而非 schema 预期。在 CK25（First International Text2SPARQL Challenge）QLever 快照的同条件重算下，strict F1 达 0.643±0.026（GPT-4.1 mini）与 0.652±0.012（GPT-5.4），相对最强参赛系统提升 30% 与 32%。
Motivation: LLM 做 Text-to-SARQL 时在陌生图上常生成语法合法但与已填充数据模型不符的查询，schema 本身不足以约束生成。
Method: 离线蒸馏器产出 TTQL（多跳模式、条件频率、路径条件字面量示例）与类-属性共现矩阵；在线阶段 TTQL 引导 LLM，配合确定性语法、词汇与数据模型检查做迭代修正，共现矩阵用于拒绝无支撑的 triple pattern；对比 auto-derived SHACL 与 shape-only 基线。
Result: CK25 上同条件重算：strict F1 0.643±0.026（GPT-4.1 mini）、0.652±0.012（GPT-5.4），相对最强参赛者分别提升 30% 与 32%；消融显示 TTQL 模式是主导因素，比 shape-only 基线高 +0.31 strict F1；相对 auto-derived SHACL strict F1 高 64%；两个本地 35B 4-bit 开源模型零边际成本即可追平最强参赛者。
Conclusion: 经验性图模式（TTQL）比 schema 暴露更能防止合法但错配的 SPARQL，修正循环是低成本兜底；结果来自单一较小基准，跨域开放图上的整体 TTQL 注入仍是主要局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAGE: Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution for Grounded Medical QA Data Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Developing reliable models for clinical tasks, such as Medical Question Answering (QA), is severely constrained by the limited availability of high-quality, expert-annotated training data. This challenge is exacerbated by stringent privacy requirements and the impracticality of utilizing large open-source corpora or proprietary cloud APIs within resource-limited clinical settings. To address these obstacles, we introduce SAGE (\textit{Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution}), a novel data synthesis framework that enables small, locally deployed models to generate high-quality medical training data. SAGE leverages lightweight, publicly available taxonomies such as MeSH as semantic anchors, imposing a structured prior to effectively guide and ground the data generation process. At its core, SAGE iteratively interleaves atomic (individual concept-based) and associative (relation-based) synthesis, bootstrapping training data from minimal seeds. This approach eliminates the need for large collections of medical documents or reliance on external APIs, providing a practical solution for on-premises data creation. Extensive experiments across multiple medical question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that models fine-tuned with SAGE-synthesized data consistently outperform those trained using self-derived or conventional document-based paradigms, highlighting tangible improvements in data efficiency and resource utilization for medical LLM development. Code is available at https://github.com/DIaacKr/SAGE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAGE 用轻量公开分类体系 MeSH 作语义锚点，让本地部署的小模型交替做原子概念合成与关系联想合成，从极少种子迭代生成医学 QA 训练数据，摆脱大语料与外部 API 依赖。在多个医学问答基准上，用 SAGE 合成数据微调的模型一致优于自派生或常规文档式数据训练的模型。
Motivation: 临床任务缺乏高质量专家标注数据，隐私约束与资源受限环境又使大开源语料和专有云 API 不可用，医学 QA 训练数据获取受限。
Method: SAGE（Semantic Anchor-Guided Evolution）以 MeSH 等轻量公开分类体系作为语义锚点施加结构先验，迭代交替进行原子（单概念）合成与联想（关系）合成，从极少种子自举训练数据，全程由本地小模型完成。
Result: 在多个医学问答基准上，用 SAGE 合成数据微调的模型一致优于用自派生数据或常规文档式范式训练的模型，体现数据效率与资源利用的改进；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 以分类体系作结构先验的迭代合成可在不依赖大医学文档库与外部 API 的前提下产出可用的医学 QA 训练数据，适合本地化数据创建。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Explainable Rule Mining of IPv6 Extension-Header Presence Patterns from Paired-Vantage Captures
papers.abstract_en: IPv6 extension headers (EHs), such as fragmentation, segment routing, and in-situ telemetry, are operationally important yetwidely dropped in transit, and characterising their behaviour from packet captures is a recurring measurement problem. We ask whetheran explainable miner can recover human-readable rules of EH behaviour, and we contribute two reusable tools: a negative-control protocol that diagnoses whether a mined "temporal" network rule reflects genuine cross-packet dynamics or mere within-packetco-occurrence, and a sender-conditioned, per-family EH-retention measurement. Applying an interpretable temporal-logic rule miner to the JAMES paired-vantage dataset, we recover a portable Fragment-EH rule that the protocol reveals to be a within-packet,near-definitional co-occurrence rather than a temporal pattern, so the temporal-logic machinery does no work for this dominant rule;the retention measurement independently recovers the expected within-window ordering of EH observability. Our main result istherefore an honest, controlled negative finding, corroborated by executed decision-tree and large-language-model baselines: on theevaluated JAMES traces network-temporal structure does not carry the dominant Fragment-EH signal, and we supply the controls thatestablish when it would, validated on a synthetic positive control containing a genuine cross-packet dependency.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 JAMES 双视角抓包数据集上用可解释时序逻辑规则挖掘器提取 IPv6 扩展头 (EH) 行为规则，负对照协议判定占主导的 Fragment-EH 规则实为包内近定义性共现而非跨包时序模式，时序逻辑机制对这条规则不起作用；该否定结论由决策树与大语言模型基线以及一个含真实跨包依赖的合成正对照共同佐证。
Motivation: IPv6 扩展头（分片、段路由、在途遥测）在传输中被大量丢弃，从抓包中刻画其行为是反复出现的测量问题，但挖掘出的“时序”规则可能只是包内共现，缺少判定手段。
Method: 贡献两个可复用工具：一是负对照协议，用于诊断挖掘出的时序网络规则反映真实跨包动态还是包内共现；二是按发送端、按协议族的 EH 保留率测量。将可解释时序逻辑规则挖掘器应用于 JAMES 配对视角数据集，并以决策树和大语言模型基线及合成正对照做对照。
Result: 在 JAMES 抓包上恢复出一条可迁移的 Fragment-EH 规则，负对照揭示其为包内近定义性共现而非时序模式；EH 保留测量独立复现了窗口内 EH 可观测性的预期顺序；决策树与 LLM 基线佐证网络时序结构不承载主导的 Fragment-EH 信号，结论在含真实跨包依赖的合成正对照上得到验证。
Conclusion: 主结果是一个受控的诚实否定发现：在所评估的 JAMES 轨迹上，网络时序结构不携带主导的 Fragment-EH 信号；负对照与正对照共同界定了何时该结论会翻转。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Plans Change Answers: Formalizing Cost-Accuracy Optimization for Semantic Queries
papers.abstract_en: In semantic query engines, predicates are evaluated by machine-learned models, and the choice of a query plan affects not only the cost of a query but also its result. Existing systems either apply a fixed threshold to each semantic operator or tune accuracy per operator, without accounting for how errors propagate through joins. We give a formal problem definition for cost-accuracy optimization of such queries. Our starting point is the calibrated confidence that decision models such as Jev attach to each decision. It yields an expected error for every decision; weighting these errors by each decision's contribution to the output (in the simplest case, its fan-out) gives the expected output quality of a plan without any labeled data, and the same computation in reverse turns an output-level accuracy target into a price on each base or intermediate tuple. Building on this, we define an oracle semantics for relational algebra with semantic operators, physical plans as pairs of a logical plan and a decision policy, declarative output-level targets, and a hierarchy of plan equivalence. We show that accuracy is plan-invariant under pointwise-deterministic policies, and that selection pushdown is not quality-sound when escalation bands are calibrated on the plan's own candidates. Expected quality can be computed in polynomial time under bag semantics; under set semantics it follows the dichotomy of tuple-independent probabilistic databases when every relation carries a semantic predicate. Choosing which tuples to drop is NP-hard, while the optimization problem decomposes into per-tuple decisions through two Lagrange multipliers. Simulations on a synthetic workload illustrate these effects; an evaluation on real engines is left for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为语义查询引擎给出代价-精度优化的形式化框架：把决策模型的校准置信度转成每条决策的期望误差，按其对输出的贡献（最简单情形为 fan-out）加权，无需标注数据即可得到查询计划的期望输出质量，并可反向把输出级精度目标折算成每条元组的价格。理论上证明点态确定性策略下精度与计划无关、选择下推在按计划自身候选标定 escalation band 时不是 quality-sound；期望质量在 bag 语义下可多项式时间计算，选丢哪些元组是 NP-hard，但优化可经两个 Lagrange 乘子分解为逐元组决策。
Motivation: 语义查询中谓词由机器学习模型判定，现有系统要么对每个语义算子用固定阈值、要么逐算子调精度，都不考虑误差如何沿 join 传播，导致计划选择同时影响代价与结果质量且无法在输出级设定目标。
Method: 以 Jev 一类决策模型给出的校准置信度为起点，推出每条决策的期望误差，按其对输出的贡献（fan-out）加权得到计划的期望输出质量；定义带语义算子的关系代数 oracle 语义、把物理计划表示为逻辑计划与决策策略的二元组、声明式输出级目标以及计划等价层级；复杂度分析用 bag/set 语义与 tuple-independent 概率数据库的 dichotomy，并用 Lagrange 乘子做分解。
Result: 证明点态确定性策略下精度是 plan-invariant 的，而当 escalation band 按计划自身候选标定时选择下推不是 quality-sound；bag 语义下期望质量可在多项式时间计算，set 语义下遵循 tuple-independent 概率数据库的 dichotomy；选择丢弃哪些元组是 NP-hard，优化问题经两个 Lagrange 乘子分解为逐元组决策。在合成工作负载上用仿真说明这些效应。

papers.title: Multi-Dataset Diagnostic Utility of Clinical Visual Concepts in AI Systems for Dermatology
papers.abstract_en: The clinical integration of AI systems in digital dermatology relies heavily on human trust. Clinically interpretable visual concepts can act as intermediate representations enhancing trust and reliability. However, research in this domain is currently limited by scattered, heterogeneous dataset annotations. In this work, we introduce SkinLex, a harmonized dataset of 48 clinical morphological attributes across four public datasets (SkinCon, DermaCon-IN, MM-Skin, and PASSION) for a total of 20,411 records. Supervised nine-partition classification of skin conditions shows that limiting features to specific visual groups, like shapes or colors alone, reduces diagnostic accuracy. Bootstrapped backward elimination reveals that the set of 48 visual concepts has some degree of redundancy for algorithmic nine-partition diagnosis on the examined dataset. This demonstrates that coarse diagnosis on the selected dataset requires a relatively small but varied combination of clinical concepts, and motivates further research to improve concept taxonomy. Results can be translated into clinical benefits by reducing inputs for concept-based models, improving efficiency for annotation and modeling, and further enhancing interpretability. Code and prompt templates are available at https://github.com/Digital-Dermatology/SkinLex.
papers.comment: Accepted at the MICCAI ISIC Workshop 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/Digital-Dermatology/SkinLex
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkinLex 把四个公开皮肤科数据集的标注统一成 48 个临床形态学视觉概念，共 20,411 条记录，用于九分类皮肤病诊断。监督分类显示只保留形状或颜色等单一概念组会降低诊断准确率，而自助法后向消除表明这 48 个概念对九分类存在冗余，即粗粒度诊断只需少量但多样的概念组合。
Motivation: 皮肤科 AI 的临床可信度依赖可解释的中间视觉概念，但该方向受制于各数据集标注分散且异构，概念级研究难以跨数据集开展。
Method: 构建 SkinLex：跨 SkinCon、DermaCon-IN、MM-Skin、PASSION 四个公开数据集统一 48 个临床形态学属性，共 20,411 条记录；在其上做九分区 (nine-partition) 皮肤病变监督分类，并用自助法后向消除 (bootstrapped backward elimination) 检验概念集合的冗余，同时发布代码与 prompt 模板。
Result: 在该数据集的九分区诊断中，把特征限制在形状或颜色等特定视觉组会降低诊断准确率；后向消除显示 48 个概念对算法式九分类存在一定程度冗余，粗粒度诊断只需少量但多样的概念组合。
Conclusion: 概念集合可以精简而不损失九分类诊断能力，因此应改进概念 taxonomy，并据此减少概念模型的输入以提升标注与建模效率和可解释性。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: POLAR: Ontology-Guided Risk Prevention for Tool-Calling LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM tool-use agents operate in dynamic environments where many actions carry operational risk. However, most safety mechanisms react only after errors manifest. Existing pre-emptive approaches either fine-tune the agent on chain-of-thought deliberation or compile natural-language guardrails into runtime checks, but they do so without exposing a structural, auditable verdict. We propose POLAR, a guardrail framework for small tool-calling agents that assesses reversibility through a structured two-layer ontology. POLAR assigns each action a graded reversibility score by deriving a candidate inverse sequence; calls failing a threshold are pruned before execution. Evaluated on $τ^2$-bench across six agent models, POLAR improves mean task reward by 0.11 to 0.18 points on airline for four of six agents, but only eight of eighteen model--domain cells improve overall; retail and stronger agents often regress. POLAR provides an auditable structural check and characterizes its task-utility trade-offs. Reward is not a direct measure of prevented harm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POLAR 为工具调用 LLM agent 提出本体论引导的护栏：用两层可逆性本体为每个动作打分级可逆分并推导候选逆操作序列，低于阈值的调用在执行前被剪枝。在 τ²-bench 六个 agent 模型上，airline 域四个模型平均任务奖励提升 0.11–0.18，但十八个模型-域组合中仅八个整体改善，retail 与更强 agent 常出现回退。
Motivation: 工具调用 agent 的多数安全机制只在错误发生后才反应；已有前置方案要么用思维链微调、要么把自然语言护栏编译成运行时检查，都不给出结构化、可审计的判定。
Method: POLAR 面向小型工具调用 agent，用结构化两层本体评估动作可逆性，为每个动作推导候选逆序列并给出分级可逆分，未达阈值的调用在执行前剪枝，输出可审计的结构性判定。
Result: 在 τ²-bench 上评测六个 agent 模型：airline 域中四个模型的平均任务奖励提升 0.11 至 0.18；十八个模型-域组合中仅八个整体改善，retail 域与更强 agent 常回退。
Conclusion: POLAR 提供可审计的结构化前置检查并刻画任务效用权衡；作者指出 reward 并非被阻止危害的直接度量。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ProximalFM: Amortized Proximal Causal Inference under Hidden Confounding
papers.abstract_en: Standard causal identification methods often assume no unmeasured confounding and can fail when relevant confounders are unobserved. Proximal causal inference instead uses proxy variables to identify effects under hidden confounding. However, nonparametric proximal estimation can be challenging in practice: recovering causal estimands such as the conditional average treatment effect (CATE) requires solving an ill-posed integral equation that is data-hungry, hyperparameter-sensitive, and optimization-unstable. Bayesian inference for such models provides a desirable alternative, mitigating these difficulties by regularizing through the prior. However, computing a posterior is itself challenging, as a typical likelihood function will include latent variables. Following the recent success of tabular foundation models in backdoor, instrumental variable, and frontdoor settings, we propose that prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) are uniquely suited to resolve this bottleneck. Indeed, by training on synthetic data sampled from compliant structural causal models with access to oracle counterfactuals, we simplify the task substantially, amortizing the implied Bayesian operator inversion into a single transformer forward pass. Compared to prior literature that focuses primarily on point estimation, our model, ProximalFM, explicitly targets the Bayesian posterior distribution of the CATE. One unique aspect of this problem is that we need to provide Monte Carlo estimates of the oracle CATEs, leading to a novel variation of PFNs that accounts for the added stochastic error. Across a diverse suite of proximal regimes, ProximalFM achieves consistently strong CATE-estimation performance without dataset-specific tuning, with its largest advantage when latent confounding is substantial and the proxies are weakly informative; it also provides fast inference through a single amortized forward pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProximalFM 用 prior-data fitted network (PFN) 把隐混杂下 proximal 因果推断的贝叶斯算子反演摊销成一次 transformer 前向：在符合约束的结构因果模型上采样合成数据并访问 oracle 反事实训练，直接输出 CATE 的贝叶斯后验而非点估计，并用一个能容忍 Monte Carlo 估计噪声的 PFN 变体处理 oracle CATE 的随机误差。在多组 proximal 设定上 CATE 估计表现稳定且无需逐数据集调参，潜变量混杂较强、代理变量信息弱时优势最大，推理只需一次前向传播。
Motivation: 非参数 proximal 估计要解病态积分方程，数据饥渴、超参敏感且优化不稳；贝叶斯推断能靠先验正则化缓解，但似然含潜变量使后验计算本身困难。
Method: 在符合约束的结构因果模型 (compliant SCMs) 上采样合成数据并拿到 oracle 反事实，训练一个 PFN 直接摊销隐含的贝叶斯算子反演，单次 transformer 前向即得 CATE 后验；针对 oracle CATE 只能给 Monte Carlo 估计这一新情况，提出能吸收额外随机误差的 PFN 变体。
Result: 在多样的 proximal regimes 上 ProximalFM 的 CATE 估计表现持续强劲且无需 dataset-specific tuning，优势在潜混杂显著、代理变量弱信息时最大；推理为单次摊销前向，速度很快。
Conclusion: 把 proximal 因果推断的贝叶斯后验计算改写成 PFN 摊销问题，可以在隐混杂下绕开病态积分方程求解与逐数据集调参，且直接给出 CATE 后验分布而非点估计。

papers.title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to $24.2$ pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when $37$--$98\%$ of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where $98\%$ of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at $0.0\%$ success, while adding SRD reaches $60.6\%$ under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD)：把交互后才可见的完整轨迹（hindsight）蒸馏成交互前视角下的 foresight 预测，作为 RLVR 的补充训练目标，foresight 只在训练时用、推理时不生成。在 10 个工具集成推理与长程 agentic 任务上最高提升 24.2 个百分点；当 37–98% 的 rollout 组奖励全同、组相对目标信号消失时仍能从轨迹中榨出学习信号，2B 模型 98% 组全失败时 RLVR 训练收敛到 0.0% 成功率，加 SRD 在相同 rollout 预算下达 60.6%。
Motivation: RLVR 主要靠交互后的标量结果奖励，组相对目标在所有 rollout 同奖励时信号完全消失，但轨迹本身仍包含任务要求与失败方式的信息。
Method: 提出 prospective learning：用事后经验监督同一策略在交互前视角的 foresight 预测，实例化为 Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD)，把特权 hindsight 蒸馏成 trajectory-blind foresight；foresight 仅作训练目标，推理时不必显式生成，与 RLVR 和 self-distillation 基线互补。
Result: 在 10 个工具集成推理与长程 agentic 任务上，SRD 相对 RLVR 与 self-distillation 基线最高提升 24.2 pp；跨模型规模有 37–98% 的 rollout 组奖励全同，SRD 仍能从采样轨迹中提取学习信号；2B 设置下 98% 的组全失败，RLVR 训练最终成功率 0.0%，加 SRD 在相同 rollout 预算下达 60.6%。
Conclusion: 事后 agent 经验不只用于评估或改进行为，还能在交互发生前塑造预测性表征，从而在奖励对比稀缺的组相对 RLVR 中补上消失的梯度信号。

summary_sections.motivation: RLVR 主要靠交互后的标量结果奖励，组相对目标在所有 rollout 同奖励时信号完全消失，但轨迹本身仍包含任务要求与失败方式的信息。
summary_sections.method: 提出 prospective learning：用事后经验监督同一策略在交互前视角的 foresight 预测，实例化为 Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD)，把特权 hindsight 蒸馏成 trajectory-blind foresight；foresight 仅作训练目标，推理时不必显式生成，与 RLVR 和 self-distillation 基线互补。

summary_sections.conclusion: 事后 agent 经验不只用于评估或改进行为，还能在交互发生前塑造预测性表征，从而在奖励对比稀缺的组相对 RLVR 中补上消失的梯度信号。

papers.title: SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning
papers.abstract_en: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents' capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SPEEDRUNBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SPEEDRUNBENCH is a useful testbed for studying agents' strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpeedrunBench 用 9 款电子游戏的速通 (speedrunning) 任务评测前沿 LLM agent 的策略形成能力：agent 需在自我与他人竞速的长时程任务中反复改进策略、反思表现并复用已获知识。实验显示前沿 agent 在简单平台跳跃游戏上接近人类世界纪录，但在更长、更复杂的游戏与实际预算下仍落后于人类。
Motivation: 现有 LLM agent 基准多有可测的人类解，容易饱和；缺少考察 agent 能否自行发明超越人类既有解法的策略的评测场景。
Method: 提出 SPEEDRUNBENCH，跨 9 款游戏评测前沿 LLM agent，要求其在长时程动作序列中反复改进策略、反思表现、利用已学知识并推理，目标是不断刷新更快的通关时间。
Result: 实验显示前沿 agent 在简单平台游戏上接近人类世界纪录；在更长、更复杂的游戏与实际预算下仍落后于人类表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SpeedrunBench 既是研究 agent 策略形成的测试床，也是抗饱和的评测手段，因为总存在更快的通关时间可被发现。

papers.title: Optimization Encoders: Rethinking Second-Order Meta-Learning for Neural Fields
papers.abstract_en: Conditional neural fields represent signals continuously, but their effectiveness depends on how the conditional latent representations are inferred from observed data. In meta-learning, this encoding occurs through gradient updates induced by the decoder, tying representation learning directly to decoder design. We formalize this connection by interpreting latent optimization as an optimization encoder, unifying the roles of second-order differentiation, latent parameterization, and task supervision. This concept enables second-order meta-learning for end-to-end training of the encoding procedure alongside the decoder, and clarifies which learning pathway first-order approximations discard. Guided by this view, we introduce Attentive Latent Fields (MetaLF), an equivariant transformer-based neural field that contextualizes a latent pointcloud through self-attention. These interactions shape both field predictions and the updates that construct their representation, allowing local observations to inform coherent non-local structure. Disentangling the inner encoding objective from outer task supervision unifies reconstruction, classification, and segmentation within an end-to-end meta-learning framework, using reconstruction-only latent adaptation at test time. Controlled experiments on polynomial fields link latent coordination to lower effective rank and stronger alignment with the underlying function space. Across image and 3D shape reconstruction, MetaLF improves fidelity within three to five gradient updates, while supporting semantic prediction across images, shapes, and volumes. Together, these findings position the optimization encoder perspective as a unified basis for designing neural fields around how representations are constructed, coordinated, and used.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把条件神经场的潜变量优化重新表述为「优化编码器 (optimization encoder)」，据此用二阶 meta-learning 端到端联合训练编码过程与解码器，并提出以 self-attention 组织潜点云的等变 Transformer 神经场 MetaLF。在图像与 3D 形状重建上，MetaLF 在三到五次梯度更新内提升保真度，测试时仅用重建式潜适配即可同时支撑图像、形状与体积上的语义预测。
Motivation: 条件神经场的潜表示由解码器诱导的梯度更新推断，使表示学习被绑死在解码器设计上；一阶近似丢掉了哪些学习通路也缺少统一刻画。
Method: 将潜变量优化形式化为优化编码器，统一二阶微分、潜参数化与任务监督；内层编码目标与外层任务监督解耦，在端到端 meta-learning 框架内统一重建、分类与分割，测试时只做重建式潜适配。具体模型 MetaLF 是等变 Transformer 神经场，用 self-attention 对潜点云做上下文化。
Result: 受控的多项式场实验把潜协调与更低的 effective rank、以及与底层函数空间更强的对齐联系起来；在图像与 3D 形状重建中，MetaLF 在三到五次梯度更新内提升保真度，并在图像、形状与体积上支持语义预测。
Conclusion: 优化编码器视角可作为围绕表示如何被构建、协调与使用来设计神经场的统一基础，二阶通路对端到端训练编码过程是必要的。

papers.title: Two Halves are More than One: Phase-wise Velocity Distillation for Fast and High-Quality Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion-based image generation backbones have grown substantially in scale, making the network inference cost increase rapidly. While diffusion distillation techniques can reduce the number of inference steps, high-quality image generation within a single full-backbone-forward compute budget remains challenging. Existing one-step methods typically allocate this budget to a single evaluation of a monolithic student. However, approximating the heterogeneous coarse-to-fine transport with a single monolithic mapping is difficult and often leads to over-smoothed outputs. To address this issue, we propose Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD), which partitions the generation timeline into a coarse and a fine phase, and models the transition within each phase via the average velocity. A dedicated half-sized expert is assigned to each phase, decoupling structural composition from detail refinement while keeping the cumulative computation equivalent to one full-backbone forward pass. We show that the use of two half-sized phase-specific experts outperforms a single full-size monolithic student. On class-conditional image generation, PVD achieves an FID of 1.48 on ImageNet 256 x 256. On more complex text-to-image (T2I) tasks, PVD-distilled models (Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image) produce results competitive with their multi-step teachers, significantly outperforming prior distillation methods. Moreover, across the evaluated T2I backbones, PVD reduces active parameters by 49.10-50.89% and peak VRAM by 45.76-48.36% compared to the corresponding teachers. Source code and distilled models are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/PVD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD)：把生成时间轴切成粗阶段与细阶段，各由一个半尺寸专家用平均速度建模，两个半尺寸专家的累计计算量等于一次完整 backbone 前向。ImageNet 256×256 类条件生成 FID 达 1.48，蒸馏后的 SD 3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image 与多步教师相当，活跃参数减少 49.10–50.89%、峰值 VRAM 减少 45.76–48.36%。
Motivation: 扩散 backbone 规模膨胀使推理成本激增，单步方法把一个完整前向预算全押在单一整体 student 上，难以逼近粗到细的异构传输，输出常过平滑。
Method: PVD 将生成时间轴分为 coarse 与 fine 两阶段，各阶段用平均速度 (average velocity) 建模状态转移；每阶段配一个半尺寸专家，把结构合成与细节精修解耦，累计计算量保持等于一次完整 backbone 前向。
Result: 类条件 ImageNet 256×256 上 FID 1.48；在 SD 3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image 三个 T2I backbone 上，PVD 蒸馏模型与多步教师相当并显著优于先前蒸馏方法；相对各自教师，活跃参数减少 49.10–50.89%，峰值 VRAM 减少 45.76–48.36%。
Conclusion: 用两个半尺寸阶段专家替代单一整体 student，可在等计算预算下同时提升单步生成质量并大幅削减参数与显存；代码与蒸馏模型已开源。

papers.title: Detecting a Shift Is Not Enough: Exact Minimax Limits of Linear Representation Repair
papers.abstract_en: A mean shift between two data sources can be easy to detect but hard to remove without substantially changing their representations. We cast its removal as a statistical decision problem: from noisy differences between paired calibration measurements in $\mathbb{R}^d$, learn one linear map, applied to both sources under a hard distortion budget, that leaves as little of the shift as possible on fresh data. We derive the exact finite-sample minimax risk over all such maps, $(d-k) \mathbb{E}[1/(d+2J)]$ with $J\sim\mathrm{Pois}(κ/2)$, where the budget allows deleting $k$ directions and $κ$ is the calibration signal-to-noise ratio. Projecting out the mean calibration difference attains it without knowing $κ$ or the noise scale. This exposes a detection-repair gap: detecting the shift needs only $κ\gg\sqrt d$, whereas removing a fixed fraction of it at constant distortion needs $κ\asymp d$, as for estimating its direction. Standard linear concept erasers (MP, SAL, LEACE) remove the same calibration difference, so the formula gives, before fitting, exactly how much shift they leave on fresh data and how much calibration a target requires. The limit is robust: pairing keeps it exact for non-Gaussian shared content, the projection keeps its guarantee under anisotropic noise, and selective abstention cannot close the gap. On paired clinical and wearable sleep EEG, where differences between participants act as calibration noise, the formula predicts the device shift left in new participants, and more recordings per person soon stop helping. Together, these results tell whether a correction that falls short needs a better method, more recordings, or more participants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把两个数据源间的均值偏移去除建为统计决策问题：在硬失真预算下学一个同时作用于两源的线性映射，推导出有限样本精确 minimax 风险 (d−k)·E[1/(d+2J)]，J~Pois(κ/2)。核心结论是检测—修复鸿沟：检测偏移只需 κ≫√d，而在恒定失真下移除固定比例需 κ≍d；投影掉均值校准差即达该风险，且无需知道 κ 或噪声尺度。
Motivation: 两个数据源间的均值偏移容易检测却难以在不大改表示的前提下去除，而现有线性概念擦除器缺少对残留偏移的精确刻画。
Method: 把偏移去除形式化为从配对校准测量的含噪差分（R^d）中学习单一线性映射的决策问题，施加硬失真预算（允许删除 k 个方向），推导全映射类的精确有限样本 minimax 风险 (d−k)E[1/(d+2J)]，J~Pois(κ/2)，κ 为校准信噪比；证明投影掉均值校准差即达此界，并将公式用于 MP、SAL、LEACE 等标准线性概念擦除器。
Result: 精确 minimax 风险为 (d−k)E[1/(d+2J)]，J~Pois(κ/2)；检测偏移只需 κ≫√d，而在恒定失真下移除固定比例的偏移需 κ≍d（与估计其方向同阶）。配对使界对非高斯共享内容仍精确，投影在各向异性噪声下保持保证，选择性弃权 (selective abstention) 无法闭合该鸿沟。在配对的临床与可穿戴睡眠 EEG 上（被试间差异充当校准噪声），公式预测新被试上的残留设备偏移，并指出每人更多记录很快不再有帮助。
Conclusion: 检测到偏移不等于能修复它：修复所需校准量比检测高一个量级（κ~d 对 κ≫√d），且该下界对配对、非高斯内容、各向异性噪声与选择性弃权都稳健；公式可在拟合前判定校正不足时应换方法、加记录还是加被试。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: PhysTacGen: Physics-Aware Visual-Tactile Sensor Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Realistic physical interaction is a cornerstone of embodied intelligence, yet collecting paired visual--tactile data remains costly. Visual-to-tactile synthesis offers a promising approach to augmenting such data, but learning this mapping is complicated by the gap between visual appearance and contact-related material properties, as well as spatial misalignment in paired observations. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{PhysTacGen}, a visual-to-optical-tactile image generation framework that integrates material-aware descriptions with geometric conditioning. First, we introduce Group Tactile Policy Optimization (GTPO), a reinforcement learning strategy that refines a vision--language model to generate structured material descriptions using task-specific rewards. Second, we combine DINOv2-based pair curation with monocular relative-depth estimation to select training pairs and provide geometric priors. Finally, an SDXL ControlNet synthesizes optical tactile images conditioned on RGB, relative depth, and GTPO-generated text. Experiments on curated SSVTP data demonstrate improved structural similarity over the compared baselines, while a blinded user study shows a preference for GTPO-generated descriptions. Generated tactile inputs also improve performance on an attribute-derived force-coefficient prediction proxy. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of PhysTacGen for optical tactile image synthesis and its utility in the evaluated downstream task.The code will be available at https://github.com/VDIGPKU/PhysTacGen.

Method: 三部分：Group Tactile Policy Optimization (GTPO) 以任务特定奖励用强化学习微调视觉语言模型生成结构化材料描述；DINOv2 配对筛选加单目相对深度估计挑选训练对并给出几何先验；SDXL ControlNet 以 RGB、相对深度和 GTPO 文本为条件合成光学触觉图像。

Conclusion: 材料感知描述与几何条件结合可有效合成光学触觉图像，并对所评估的下游力系数预测任务有用。

papers.title: Language Carries the Expert's Impression: Instrument-Anchored LLM Judges Transfer Counseling-Quality Assessment and Beat In-Domain Training
papers.abstract_en: Automatic assessment of communication quality in dyadic counseling conversations is bottlenecked by data: expert-rated corpora are small and expensive to grow. We study cross-domain transfer of expert overall-impression prediction across three German corpora of simulated counseling (two general-practice medical, one school-related parent-teacher; $n=195$ expert-rated sessions, one corpus after scale equating). Training on the other domains beats training in-domain: leave-one-domain-out transfer reaches nested Spearman $ρ= 0.54$ against $\le 0.48$ within the target domain, a paired session-level gap of $+0.15$ that holds at $+0.12$ when the training-set sizes are matched, so it is not simply data volume. The decisive features are session-level construct scores from small open-weight LLMs reading the two-speaker transcript, with the constructs largely derived from the experts' rating instruments: the instrument-derived battery lifts a single judge from $0.32$ to $0.41$ over generic dialogue qualities, judges from three model families ensemble to $0.51$ language-only, and a nonverbal-dyadic block adds $+0.03$ more, not separable from noise at this sample size. We also price the recording setup: one corpus lost its per-speaker audio, 16% of its diarised segments carry the wrong speaker, and repair is worth $+0.07$ there. At practically attainable corpus sizes, the expert's overall impression is carried by what is said, and by other communication programs' data more than by one's own.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三个德语模拟咨询语料（n=195 段专家评分）上，用读双人转录的小型开源 LLM 按专家评分量表构造 session 级构念分数做评委，跨域迁移反而胜过域内训练：留一域迁移 Spearman ρ=0.54，域内 ≤0.48。量表派生构念把单评委从 0.32 提到 0.41，三模型家族集成达 0.51，非言语块再加 +0.03 但与噪声不可分。
Motivation: 专家评分的对话质量语料小且昂贵，域内训练受限于数据量；需要判断专家总体印象究竟由什么承载，以及能否借其他沟通领域的数据补足。
Method: 在三个德语语料（两个全科医疗模拟咨询、一个家校沟通）上做留一域迁移，nested Spearman ρ 评估；特征为小型开源 LLM 读双人转录给出的 session 级构念分数，构念主要由专家评分量表推导，配合三个模型家族的评委集成与非言语-双人特征块，并对训练集规模做匹配对照。
Result: 留一域迁移 nested Spearman ρ=0.54，域内 ≤0.48，配对 session 级差 +0.15，训练集规模匹配后仍 +0.12；量表派生构念使单评委从 0.32 升到 0.41（对比通用对话质量特征），三家族集成 0.51（仅语言），非言语块再 +0.03 但在此样本量下与噪声不可分；一个语料丢失逐说话人音频、16% diarised 片段说话人标错，修复在该语料值 +0.07。
Conclusion: 专家总体印象主要由说了什么承载，且来自其他沟通项目的数据比来自本域的更能预测它；说话人分离与录音配置的质量直接折算成可量化的评分损失。

papers.title: A Riemannian Geometry for Low-rank Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is widely used as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique for pre-trained deep neural networks, which approximates the weight update via full fine-tuning by a low-rank matrix $BA^\top$. This parameterization leads to the equivalence relation $(B, A) \sim (BG^{-1}, AG^\top)$ for any invertible matrix $G$ because $BA^\top = BG^{-1}(AG^\top)^\top$ and thus both pairs yield the same loss value. This relation induces a quotient manifold where matrices $(BG^{-1}, AG^\top)$ for all $G$ are identified, eliminating redundant directions along which the loss value remains unchanged. To respect the geometry of this manifold, the original search space is endowed with a Riemannian metric that is invariant under the equivalence relation. Such a metric induces preconditioning at each gradient step and ensures that each weight update via LoRA changes the loss value, leading to efficient optimization. In this paper, we propose a new Riemannian metric that is specifically tailored to LoRA to close the gap to full fine-tuning at the weight level. We theoretically show that LoRA with our preconditioning induced by this metric satisfies the following two properties at each iteration: (i) The weight update follows the direction closest to the gradient of full fine-tuning within the subspace of first-order weight changes allowed by the LoRA parameterization. (ii) The updated weight matrix is closer in Frobenius norm to that of full fine-tuning than the updated weight matrices of LoRA with conventional preconditioning and without preconditioning. These theoretical insights suggest that our preconditioning makes LoRA better approximate full fine-tuning, thereby leading to more efficient optimization. Experiments show the effectiveness and efficiency of our preconditioning for LoRA on fine-tuning tasks with language and vision domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoRA 的 (B,A) 参数化存在 (B,A)~(BG^{-1},AG^{	op}) 的等价关系，损失沿冗余方向不变。作者在该商流形上给出专为 LoRA 设计的 Riemannian 度量，其诱导的预条件使每步权重更新在 LoRA 允许的一阶子空间内最接近全微调梯度，且更新后权重在 Frobenius 范数下比常规预条件与无预条件的 LoRA 更接近全微调；语言与视觉微调实验验证其有效性与效率。
Motivation: LoRA 的低秩分解把同一权重更新表示成无穷多对 (B,A)，损失沿这些冗余方向不变，常规预条件无法对齐全微调轨迹，导致与 full fine-tuning 仍有差距。
Method: 把等价关系 (B,A)~(BG^{-1},AG^{	op}) 视为商流形，赋予在该等价下不变的 Riemannian 度量；度量在每个梯度步诱导预条件，并针对 LoRA 构造新度量以在权重层面逼近全微调。
Result: 理论上证明两点：每次迭代的权重更新是 LoRA 参数化所允许的一阶权重变化子空间内最接近全微调梯度的方向；更新后的权重矩阵在 Frobenius 范数下比采用常规预条件与不采用预条件的 LoRA 更新更接近全微调的更新权重。实验在语言与视觉域的微调任务上显示该预条件对 LoRA 的有效性与效率。
Conclusion: 在 LoRA 的商流形上选对 Riemannian 度量，其预条件能让 LoRA 在权重层面更好地逼近全微调，从而更高效地优化。

papers.title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents often lack the operational knowledge to act reliably in new environments, as they must discover specific tool behaviors or environment conventions on their own. Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories. To address this, agentic systems typically rely on human-written guidelines or on procedural memory built from training tasks and an oracle verifier, both of which require prior knowledge of the environment. We present DAEDALUS, a method for bootstrapping reusable agent memory from self-generated practice without existing tasks or oracle verifiers. DAEDALUS pairs two agents: an explorer that interacts with the environment to generate challenging yet solvable tasks, and a solver that attempts them. A heuristic is derived from each solver failure and accepted only after the solver repeatedly succeeds with that heuristic in context. These outcomes also provide feedback for the explorer to refine the difficulty of future tasks. Accepted heuristics are then consolidated into a memory bank for test-time use. Across AppWorld, $τ^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most. We show that performance gains already emerge with a small exploration budget, and that its heuristics also benefit agents from other model families. Our ablations further reveal that solver traces provide the key information needed to derive effective heuristics, while factorizing early discoveries makes exploration more cost-efficient. Beyond memory construction, we find that the tasks generated by DAEDALUS can serve as a proxy for benchmark tasks when ranking models by performance. Code and artifacts: www.github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus.
papers.comment: 9 pages (31 including Appendix), 8 figures (11 including Appendix). We release the code and artifacts, including generation and inference traces, at https://github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DAEDALUS 让两个 LLM agent 配对自举可复用记忆：explorer 在环境中自生成有挑战但可解的任务，solver 尝试执行，从每次失败提炼启发式 (heuristic)，只有当 solver 带着该启发式反复成功后才收进 memory bank 供测试时使用。在 AppWorld、τ²-bench、AutomationBench 上，相对无记忆基线平均成功率最多提高 15.9 个百分点、pass^5 最多提升 2.2 倍，且推理成本低于多数使用训练任务的方法。
Motivation: LLM agent 缺少新环境中的操作性知识，没有对过往尝试的记忆就会跨任务重复同样的错误，导致失败更多、轨迹更长；而现有做法依赖人工指南或基于训练任务与 oracle verifier 的程序性记忆，都需要环境先验知识。
Method: explorer 与 solver 两个 agent 配对：explorer 与环境交互生成任务并依据 solver 的反馈调节后续难度，solver 执行任务；从 solver 失败中提炼启发式，仅在 solver 带该启发式于上下文中反复成功后接受，再把已接受的启发式合并为测试时使用的 memory bank。
Result: 在 AppWorld、τ²-bench、AutomationBench 上，相对无记忆基线平均成功率最多提高 15.9 个百分点，pass^5 最多提升 2.2 倍；性能与使用训练任务的方法相当，推理成本低于其中多数。小的探索预算即可出现增益，启发式还能惠及其他模型家族的 agent；消融显示 solver 轨迹是提炼有效启发式的关键信息，对早期发现做因子化 (factorizing) 使探索更省成本。
Conclusion: 无需既有任务与 oracle verifier，仅靠自生成实践与失败驱动的启发式筛选即可构建可用的 agent 记忆；DAEDALUS 生成的任务还可作为基准任务的代理用于模型排名。

papers.title: SepsisLens: Structure-Preserving Sequence Modelling for Decomposable Early Sepsis Warning
papers.abstract_en: Early sepsis warning from ICU records can be cast as a structure-preserving prediction problem. A model needs to detect deterioration from irregular measurements while keeping each alert connected to the physiological signals that support it. Many temporal models fuse clinical variables into a patient-level representation, supporting scalar risk prediction but weakening the structure needed for clinical decomposition. We present SepsisLens, which preserves variable-indexed temporal states until risk composition. Observation-aware representations encode each variable's dynamics and measurement history, while a shared temporal encoder models each trajectory without collapsing the variable axis. The StructuredRiskHead composes multi-horizon risk from explicit variable-level and organ-level components. We evaluate SepsisLens on three public ICU cohorts and one private-hospital cohort under a common pre-onset protocol. SepsisLens achieves strong discrimination on all four cohorts and lower alert burden at matched event recall on MIMIC-IV. Structural ablations support the design, while input-side masking shows that the ranked components reflect variables with greater influence on prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SepsisLens 把 ICU 脓毒症早期预警做成结构保持的序列建模：变量索引的时序状态一直保留到风险合成阶段，由 StructuredRiskHead 从变量级与器官级显式分量合成多提前期风险。在三个公开 ICU 队列与一个私有医院队列的统一 onset 前协议下四个队列均取得强判别力，并在 MIMIC-IV 上以同等事件召回取得更低告警负担。
Motivation: 多数时序模型把临床变量压平成患者级表示，只能给标量风险，丢掉了把告警拆回支撑它的生理信号所需的结构，临床分解因此不可行。
Method: Observational-aware 表示编码每个变量的动力学与测量历史，共享时序编码器逐条轨迹建模而不压掉变量轴；StructuredRiskHead 从显式变量级与器官级分量合成多提前期风险。在三个公开 ICU 队列与一个私有医院队列上按统一 pre-onset 协议评估，并做结构消融与输入侧 masking 检验排序分量。
Result: 四个队列上判别力均强；在 MIMIC-IV 上同等事件召回下告警负担更低。结构消融支持该设计；输入侧 masking 显示排序靠前的分量对应对预测影响更大的变量。
Conclusion: 把变量轴保留到风险合成、再用显式变量级与器官级分量组合，可以在不牺牲判别力的前提下降低告警负担，并让每个告警可追溯到具体生理变量。

papers.title: Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出重复运行评估框架，用 theme churn（返回类别集合的归一化变化）与 volume disagreement（持续类别计数变化）度量同一证据下前沿模型的 run-to-run 不稳定。在三个客户反馈任务、八个前沿模型、100–5,000 条语料上，固定 Claude Opus 4.8 与 1,000 条语料时，taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) 相对原始生成与层级分解把 theme churn 降低 86–88%，匹配主题的计数分歧为零。
Motivation: 知识工作自动化要求证据不变时类别、优先级与计数在多次运行间不发生实质漂移，而单次看似合理的回答掩盖了这种不稳定，缺少对重复合成的量化评测手段。
Method: 提出 repeat-run 框架：先语义对齐等价类别，再测两个指标——theme churn 与 volume disagreement；对比三种执行设计——raw generation、taxonomy-free 层级分解、以及使用持久 theme/subtheme 与 record-level 预测的 taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA)，在三个反复出现的客户反馈任务、八个前沿模型、100 到 5,000 条语料与多种 prompt 上评测。
Result: 固定 Claude Opus 4.8 与 1,000 条语料时，TGA 相对 raw generation 与层级分解把 theme churn 降低 86–88%，matched-theme volumes 分歧为零；TGA 比筛查中每个 raw 模型都更稳定，在每种语料规模下都更稳定，且在主题匹配更严或更松时优势保持。
Conclusion: taxonomy grounding 能让反复性知识工作的输出更一致、更可重复，该框架面向的重复合成对象还包括财报、法律文件、事故记录与科学文献。

papers.title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
papers.abstract_en: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Code, policies, evaluation and videos: https://github.com/JordyKieto/puffermoba-dyna
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在十英雄 MOBA 上用连续异步 Dyna 回路把真实对局数据回灌世界模型，只在想象中用 dream-PPO 训练的策略在真实对局中以 radiant 身份赢下 70.2%（600 场中 421 场，95% CI 66.4–73.7），而纯 dream 训练为 0%、回路启动前为 33.7%。模型利用在梦内不可见，未加锚定的运行几次更新内全部崩溃；世界模型在策略自对局上被 Dyna 修复带来 +9.2 个百分点真实胜率。
Motivation: 世界模型通常用预测损失、想象回报或画面观感从内部评价，无法说明策略在真实环境里是否真的变强；且在训练语料上准确的模型会在策略自身产生的对局上严重失真。
Method: 构建覆盖完整十英雄 MOBA 的结构化多智能体世界模型（206 个单位、每个英雄每 tick 行动、单局最长 6,000 tick），在其中用 1,400-tick 自由运行想象回合训练 dream-PPO 策略；真实对局不提供梯度，只把策略自身对局作为世界模型训练数据，并用在线评估选择并锚定策略，构成连续异步 Dyna 回路。
Result: radiant 胜率 70.2%（421/600，95% CI 66.4–73.7，测试种子未参与任何决策），对比纯 dream 训练 0% 与回路前 33.7%；dire 一场不胜，出厂对手自对局同样不胜。Dyna 修复世界模型在策略自对局上的误差，在策略配方不变时贡献 +9.2 个百分点真实胜率；所有未锚定运行均在几次更新内崩溃且梦内指标无一反映。
Conclusion: 世界模型必须由策略自身产生的对局数据持续修复并用真实评估锚定，否则梦内指标会掩盖模型利用；策略会逐机制继承世界模型的保真度画像——模型不懂 crowd control、cast timing 与 lethality，策略便靠全图施压而非协同团战取胜。

papers.title: Spectra: Exact Component Transport for Test-Time Prior Adaptation in Simulation-Based Inference
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based inference (SBI) has become a powerful approach to Bayesian inference in complex scientific models whose likelihoods are difficult or impossible to evaluate. Amortized SBI learns reusable inference models from simulated data, enabling rapid posterior inference for new observations, and modern generative models have made these models increasingly expressive. However, this reuse is limited to the prior distribution chosen during training, whereas scientific analyses often need revised priors as knowledge accumulates or alternative assumptions are tested. We introduce Spectra, a test-time adaptation method for diffusion-based SBI. Spectra uses an exact score-transport identity to obtain the adapted score from a frozen diffusion model in closed form for structured prior changes, without additional simulation or training. Across six SBI benchmarks, Spectra achieves accurate adaptation under strong prior shifts at low online sampling cost. This enables pretrained SBI models to incorporate updated prior information at test time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Spectra 针对扩散模型式仿真推断 (diffusion-based SBI) 提出测试时先验适配方法：用一个精确的 score-transport 恒等式，在结构化先验变化下把冻结扩散模型的 score 闭式改写为适配后的 score，无需额外仿真或训练。在六个 SBI 基准上，强先验偏移下仍实现准确适配，且在线采样开销低。
Motivation: Amortized SBI 的复用被训练时选定的先验锁死，而科学分析随知识积累需要修订先验或检验替代假设；重训或重仿真代价高。
Method: 对冻结的 diffusion-based SBI 模型应用精确 score-transport 恒等式，针对结构化先验变化闭式推导适配后的 score，测试时直接采样，不引入新仿真也不做再训练。
Result: 在六个 SBI 基准上，Spectra 在强先验偏移 (strong prior shifts) 下实现准确的先验适配，并保持低在线采样成本。
Conclusion: 预训练 SBI 模型可以在测试时通过闭式 score 传输纳入更新的先验信息，无需为每次先验修改重新仿真或重训。

papers.title: Learning consistent molecular mechanics force fields from first principles
papers.abstract_en: Classical force fields (FFs) remain the workhorse for large-scale simulations even as machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approach ab initio accuracy. They decompose total configuration energies into simple effective interactions whose parameters are traditionally assigned based on atom or bond types, enabling efficient simulations but also limiting their ability to adapt across configurations. Recent machine learning approaches have improved the accuracy and transferability of bonded parameters in these FFs by inferring them as functions of local atomic environments, but still rely on empirical nonbonded parameters for practical simulations. In this work, we introduce a unified approach, \texttt{grappa-fullFF}, which learns both bonded and nonbonded parameters \emph{consistently} and simultaneously from ab initio reference data. By incorporating physically inspired regularization via supervision of the electrostatic potential and an architecture that facilitates charge equilibration, our model recovers accurate electric response properties, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on geometry optimization benchmarks, and reproduces the conformational sampling of both classical and existing machine-learned FFs, without relying on externally assigned nonbonded parameters.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ML4Molecules Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: grappa-fullFF 把经典力场的成键与非成键参数放在同一框架里，从 ab initio 参考数据同时学习，并用静电势监督的物理正则与促进电荷平衡 (charge equilibration) 的结构约束训练。模型无需外部指定的非成键参数即可恢复准确的电响应性质，在几何优化基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，并复现经典力场与已有机器学习力场的构象采样。
Motivation: 经典力场按原子/键类型固定参数，难以跨构型自适应；已有机器学习方法把成键参数学成局部原子环境的函数，但非成键参数仍靠经验指定，限制了精度与可迁移性。
Method: 提出统一方法 grappa-fullFF：从 ab initio 参考数据一致且同时地学习成键与非成键参数；加入由静电势 (electrostatic potential) 监督的物理启发正则，并采用促进电荷平衡的架构，使模型不依赖外部指定的非成键参数。
Result: 模型恢复了准确的电响应性质，在几何优化基准上达到 state-of-the-art 精度，并复现了经典力场与已有机器学习力场的构象采样；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 成键与非成键参数可以由同一 ab initio 数据源一致地联合学习，物理正则与电荷平衡架构足以替代经验非成键参数而保持精度与采样行为。

papers.title: FOSLS-deRhaNN: native de Rham neural classes for H(div) and H(curl) with applications to first-order system least-squares neural network methods for partial differential equations
papers.abstract_en: We construct neural approximation classes native to the graph spaces H(div) and H(curl), in two and three dimensions and, for H(div), in any dimension. Every realization lies in the space for all parameter values, and with kinked potentials, such as ReLU networks, the admissible jumps appear at finite width. The classes are images of scalar and componentwise networks under fixed operators of the de Rham complex, and do not involve a mesh or finite element emulation. For H(div) in R^n two native classes are given on an equal footing, with a skew-symmetric potential $A$: $\mathrm{Div}\,A+R_nq+\mathbf{h}$, with the divergence $q$ as an explicit unknown, and $\mathrm{Div}\,A+\mathbf{z}$ with an $H^1$ field $\mathbf{z}$; for H(curl) the analogous classes are $\mathrm{grad}\,φ+Sr+\mathbf{h}$ in two dimensions and $\mathrm{grad}\,φ+\mathbf{z}$ in two and three dimensions. In all of them every interface jump of the field is carried by the potential term, $\mathrm{Div}\,A$ or $\mathrm{grad}\,φ$, while the remaining part has no interface jump (it is an $H^1$ field in the regular-decomposition classes); the classes with $\mathbf{z}$ are the componentwise approach enriched by this term. Known or learned interface geometry enters the potential through factors with trainable amplitudes, and the remaining part if the divergence jumps. The classes lead to the FOSLS-deRhaNN method, first-order system least squares with de Rham neural networks, whose loss is the least-squares functional posed in the natural spaces of the weak formulation; for elliptic equations this includes $H^{-1}$ right-hand sides and $H^{1/2}$ Dirichlet data. Elliptic equations with discontinuous coefficients and curl-curl problems are treated as instances, with the functional equivalent to the error; linear transport with discontinuous solutions and conservation laws with shocks use the same flux classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 构造原生属于 H(div) 与 H(curl) 图空间的神经逼近类：把标量或分量网络经 de Rham 复形的固定算子映射而成，无需网格或有限元模拟，且对任意参数值都落在空间内；再以此导出 FOSLS-deRhaNN 方法，用弱形式自然空间中的一阶最小二乘泛函作损失。
Motivation: 用神经网络逼近含间断系数、curl-curl、激波守恒律等 H(div)/H(curl) 弱解时，普通分量网络难以保证散度或旋度结构与界面跳跃的正确承载，而有限元模拟路线又引入网格依赖。
Method: 类定义为标量网络与分量网络在 de Rham 复形固定算子下的像：H(div) 给出 Div A + R_n q + h（散度 q 为显式未知，A 反对称）与 Div A + z（z 属 H1）两类，H(curl) 给出二维 grad φ + Sr + h 与二/三维 grad φ + z；界面几何以可训练幅值因子进入势项，跳跃全部由 Div A 或 grad φ 承载，其余部分无跳跃。损失为一阶系统最小二乘 (FOSLS) 泛函，右端项取 H^{-1}、Dirichlet 数据取 H^{1/2}。
Result: 构造性结论：每个实现对所有参数值都属于目标空间；带 kink 的势（如 ReLU 网络）在有限宽度下即可出现允许跳跃；H(div) 在 R^n 任意维成立，H(curl) 覆盖二维与三维。应用对象为间断系数椭圆方程、curl-curl 问题、含间断解的线性输运与含激波守恒律，其中最小二乘泛函与误差等价。
Conclusion: 把结构与界面跳跃放进 de Rham 势项、其余部分保持 H1，可以在无网格的前提下让神经解天然满足 H(div)/H(curl) 正则性，并统一处理椭圆、curl-curl、输运与守恒律问题。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Can phenotypic activity be predicted without experimental readouts?
papers.abstract_en: Molecular encoders contrastively pretrained on paired molecule-morphology data, such as CLOOME and CellCLIP, have been proposed as cheap surrogates for phenotypic prediction, avoiding the need to run a Cell Painting assay. We evaluate this idea for these molecular encoders under a protocol designed to control for two confounds that can inflate apparent performance: leakage across an encoder's own pretraining boundary, and the correlation between phenotypic activity and cytotoxicity. Testing six representations, including a non-pretrained MLP control matching CLOOME's input and layer count, on two distinct Cell Painting screens, we find that once these confounds are controlled for, the pretrained molecular encoders show no clear advantage over plain physicochemical descriptors, and that toxicity is generally easier to predict than phenotypic activity across representations. Our results suggest leakage-aware, confound-controlled evaluation should be standard practice before phenotype-pretrained encoders are trusted as surrogates for phenotypic drug discovery.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ML4Molecules: Agentic Systems for Molecular Sciences Workshop at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在控制预训练边界泄漏与表型活性-细胞毒性相关这两个混淆后，CLOOME、CellCLIP 等对比预训练分子编码器在 Cell Painting 表型预测上并不比普通理化描述符更优，且毒性普遍比表型活性更容易预测。作者主张在把表型预训练编码器当作无实验读出的替代物之前，应先做泄漏感知、混淆受控的评测。
Motivation: 用分子-形态对比预训练编码器替代 Cell Painting 实验被视为廉价的表型预测方案，但跨预训练边界的泄漏和活性-毒性相关会虚高表现，使这类替代物是否可信无法判断。
Method: 在两个不同的 Cell Painting 筛选数据上测试六种表示，其中包括与 CLOOME 输入和层数一致的非预训练 MLP 对照；评测协议专门控制预训练边界泄漏与表型活性-细胞毒性相关两个混淆。
Result: 控制两个混淆后，预训练分子编码器相对普通理化描述符没有明显优势；在所有表示上毒性普遍比表型活性更容易预测。
Conclusion: 表型预训练编码器在被信任为表型药物发现的替代物之前，泄漏感知、混淆受控的评测应当成为标准做法。

papers.title: TICDA: Tabular In-Context Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong predictive performance by conditioning on labeled demonstrations provided in context, without any parameter update. Yet how individual demonstrations shape a given prediction remains poorly understood. This gap matters in practice: the context is often assembled from whatever labeled data is available, potentially leading to the inclusion of mislabeled, redundant, or low-quality examples that degrade performance. Standard data attribution methods do not transfer to the TFM setting: resampling-based approaches such as DemoShapley require a combinatorial number of forward passes, and gradient-based estimators such as influence functions require computing training point's effect on the model parameters, which in-context learning never updates. We introduce TICDA, a method that measures the influence of every demonstration in the context directly from linear surrogates trained on TFM latent embeddings, in a single forward pass and at negligible cost. We show that TICDA offers the best compromise against competitors across four tasks: detecting labeling errors, curating context to preserve predictive accuracy while lowering inference cost, producing attribution scores that transfer across TFMs, and supporting an acquisition strategy for efficient active learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TICDA 用 TFM 潜在嵌入上训练的线性代理 (linear surrogate) 在单次前向传播中直接度量上下文里每条 demonstration 对预测的影响，成本可忽略。在四个任务上（检测标注错误、在保持精度的同时降低推理成本的上下文筛选、跨 TFM 迁移的归因分数、支撑主动学习的采集策略）与 DemoShapley、influence functions 等竞争方法相比取得最佳折中。
Motivation: 表格基础模型靠上下文中的带标签示例做预测，但单条示例如何影响预测不清楚，上下文里混入错标、冗余或低质样本会掉性能；现有归因方法要么需要组合级前向传播 (DemoShapley)，要么依赖训练点对参数的影响 (influence functions)，而 in-context learning 根本不更新参数。
Method: 在 TFM 的 latent embeddings 上训练线性代理，由代理直接给出上下文中每条 demonstration 的归因分数，单次前向传播完成，无需重采样或梯度回传到参数。
Result: 在四个任务上与竞争方法比较取得最佳折中：检测标注错误、在保持预测精度的同时降低推理成本的上下文筛选、跨 TFM 迁移的归因分数，以及支撑高效主动学习的采集策略；归因在单次前向传播中以可忽略成本算出。
Conclusion: 对 in-context 归因，用嵌入上的线性代理替代重采样与梯度估计，可以在不更新参数的前提下同时兼顾质量与开销。
