papers.title: A Broader Look at Model Merging: Rethinking Implicit Regularization Induced by Task Arithmetic
papers.abstract_en: Model merging aims to build a multi-task model cheaply by combining the weights of individual task-specific models. To perform well across multiple tasks, most existing merging methods use an additional dataset to find the coefficients for the best linear combination of task-specific weight updates. However, we identify an implicit regularization in this standard practice: searching over coefficients restricts the candidate models to a subspace spanned by task-specific weight updates. In this work, we investigate whether this regularization is actually useful. Surprisingly, empirical results show that optimizing merged-model weights without this regularization significantly boosts the performance of common merging methods across multiple architectures, domains, and even in an extremely data-limited scenario where only one instance is available per class. Moreover, directly optimizing the pretrained model weights even outperforms some existing merging methods. Analysis shows that better multi-task weights exist outside the subspace and can be found using multiple methods. We study different strategies for using the additional dataset, discussing their practical use and implications for model merging. Overall, this work calls for revisiting the existing model-merging pipeline, motivating a broader exploration of the weight space and a reconsideration of the implicit regularization induced by task arithmetic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 模型合并 (model merging) 中为搜组合系数而限制在任务权重更新张成的子空间，本身就是一种隐式正则；去掉该约束、直接优化合并后权重，在多种架构与领域上显著提升常见合并方法的表现，即使每类只有一个样本的极端数据受限场景也成立，直接优化预训练权重甚至超过部分已有合并方法。作者据此主张重审现有合并流程，扩大权重空间的探索。
Motivation: 现有合并方法普遍依赖额外数据集搜索任务权重更新的线性组合系数，这把候选模型限制在子空间内；该正则是否有用一直未经检验，而它可能挡住了更优的多任务权重。
Method: 识别并形式化 task arithmetic 系数搜索带来的子空间隐式正则，然后在多种架构与领域上对比保留与去除该正则的合并流程（直接优化合并模型权重、直接优化预训练权重等策略），并分析子空间之外更优多任务权重的存在性与可找到性，同时讨论使用额外数据集的不同策略。
Result: 实证结果显示，去除子空间正则后直接优化合并权重，在多种架构、多个领域乃至每类仅一个样本的极端数据受限场景下，都显著提升常见合并方法的表现；直接优化预训练权重还超过部分已有合并方法。分析表明更好的多任务权重存在于该子空间之外，且可用多种方法找到。
Conclusion: 作者认为按系数搜索限定子空间的隐式正则并非必要，应重审现有模型合并流程，转向更广的权重空间探索并重新审视 task arithmetic 带来的隐式正则。

papers.title: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models have become the dominant paradigm for visual understanding, but incur substantial costs by encoding inputs into dense, fixed-size patch tokens. However, visual information is unevenly distributed: some regions require fine-grained detail, while others admit compact representations. Downsampling sacrifices this detail, while existing token pruning and adaptive approaches remain limited in content-adaptive granularity, task generalization, and integration with modern MLLMs and serving infrastructure. Overcoming these limitations calls for foundation models that learn, end to end, where-and at what granularity-to allocate visual representations, a native capability we term elastic visual representation weaving. We introduce VisionWeave, establishing this capability in frontier-level MLLMs through large-scale training. It combines two components: a gated spatial pooler constructs coarse-grained representations alongside native fine-grained representations within a shared MRoPE coordinate, while a granularity router learns their content-adaptive allocation. Through self-distillation alone, we validate this capability on Qwen3.5-4B and scale to Qwen3.8-27B with over 30K A100 GPU-hours. Based on Qwen3.8-27B, VisionWeave adaptively adjusts token savings to visual content, saving 43.0% tokens on average while retaining 98.9% native performance across eight benchmarks, versus only 88% performance preserved for token pruning baselines with a fixed 50% savings target. Extensive evaluations confirm robust efficiency-quality trade-offs across diverse tasks, resolutions and video frames. When deployed on SGLang serving engine, our method achieves a 2.3x throughput gain while reducing mean TTFT by 54.4% and mean TPOT by 60.6%. Together, we believe these results position elastic visual weaving as a promising capability for next-generation multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VisionWeave 让 MLLM 原生学会按内容自适应地分配视觉 token 粒度：gated spatial pooler 在共享 MRoPE 坐标下并置粗粒度与原生细粒度表示，granularity router 决定何处用哪种粒度，仅靠 self-distillation 训练。在 Qwen3.8-27B 上平均省 43.0% token 仍保留 89.9 个基准中 98.9% 的原生性能，而固定 50% 省 token 的 pruning 基线只保留 88%；SGLang 上吞吐 2.3 倍、TTFT 降 54.4%、TPOT 降 60.6%。
Motivation: MLLM 把视觉输入编码成稠密定长 patch token 成本高，而视觉信息分布不均；现有 token 剪枝与自适应方法在内容自适应粒度、任务泛化以及与现代 MLLM 和 serving 基础设施的集成上受限。
Method: 两个组件：gated spatial pooler 在共享 MRoPE 坐标内构建粗粒度表示并与原生细粒度表示并存；granularity router 学习按内容自适应分配二者。仅用 self-distillation 在 Qwen3.5-4B 上验证该能力，并扩展到 Qwen3.8-27B，训练耗费超过 30K A100 GPU-hours。
Result: 基于 Qwen3.8-27B，按视觉内容自适应调整 token 节省量，八个 benchmark 上平均省 43.0% token、保留 98.9% 原生性能；对比固定 50% 节省目标的 token pruning 基线仅保留 88% 性能。部署到 SGLang serving engine 后吞吐提升 2.3 倍，mean TTFT 降低 54.4%，mean TPOT 降低 60.6%。评测覆盖多种任务、分辨率与视频帧数。
Conclusion: 弹性视觉编织 (elastic visual weaving) 应作为下一代多模态模型的原生能力，通过端到端学习 token 的位置与粒度，可在大幅省 token 的同时守住原生性能并直接带来 serving 吞吐与延迟收益。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 弹性视觉编织 (elastic visual weaving) 应作为下一代多模态模型的原生能力，通过端到端学习 token 的位置与粒度，可在大幅省 token 的同时守住原生性能并直接带来 serving 吞吐与延迟收益。

papers.title: Decide Before You Look: Learning Which Retrieved Memories Deserve Pixels
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal assistants answer questions from long-term memories that contain images. After retrieval, each retrieved image reaches the answering model either as pixels, at about a thousand visual tokens per image, or as a stored text proxy that often misses the detail the question asks about. We find that the benefit of pixels usually comes from one or two retrieved memories, and that it can be predicted before the answering model runs, without reading any full-resolution image. In PixelTriage, a plug-in placed after retrieval, a small model that does not generate text reads the dialogue, a short note and a thumbnail of each retrieved memory and predicts how much its pixels would add. It is trained on synthetic memory episodes labeled by a frozen 27B model that answers each question with and without each memory's pixels. With a 7B answering model, PixelTriage lies on the accuracy--cost frontier of M$^3$Exam, DMV and MemEye and uses 11--23\% of the visual tokens without a significant loss of accuracy. On DMV it answers 2.9 times faster than opening all images. It outperforms retrieval order and uniform down-sizing at equal budgets and transfers to other memory systems and to a 397B answering model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PixelTriage 是检索后、答题前的插件：用一个不生成文本的小模型读对话、记忆短注与缩略图，预测该记忆的像素能带来多少增益，只对高分记忆开像素。以 7B 答题模型在 M³Exam、DMV、MemEye 上处于 accuracy–cost 前沿，只用 11–23% 视觉 token 而准确率无显著下降，DMV 上比全开图快 2.9 倍。
Motivation: 多模态助手的长期记忆含图，每张检回图像要么以约一千个视觉 token 进入答题模型，要么以常丢失问题所需细节的文本代理进入；全开像素代价高，全不开又丢细节。
Method: 在检索之后插入 PixelTriage：一个不生成文本的小模型读取对话、每条记忆的短注与缩略图，预测其像素的边际增益；训练数据为合成记忆 episode，标签由冻结的 27B 模型对每条记忆开/关像素各答一次得到。
Result: 像素收益通常只来自一两条检回记忆，且可在不读任何全分辨率图像的前提下预测。以 7B 答题模型，PixelTriage 在 M³Exam、DMV、MemEye 上位于 accuracy–cost 前沿，仅用 11–23% 视觉 token 而准确率无显著下降；在 DMV 上比打开全部图像快 2.9 倍；在等预算下优于按检索顺序开图与均匀降采样，并可迁移到其他记忆系统和 397B 答题模型。
Conclusion: 是否值得为一条检索记忆付出像素，可以在答题前用低成本信号判定，从而在等预算下把视觉 token 集中到真正带来增益的少数记忆上。

papers.title: M3SunAgent: Monocular 3D Spatial Understanding Agent for Metric Depth Estimation and 3D Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Monocular metric depth estimation and 3D visual grounding represent the two complementary cornerstones of monocular 3D spatial understanding (M3Sun), from which the fundamental 3D spatial information required by M3Sun can be acquired. However, these complementary tasks are generally conducted by separate frameworks, which pose challenges of inflexible and unaligned spatial information access for embodied intelligence systems. In this paper, we propose a unified agent for monocular 3D spatial understanding (M3SunAgent) that leverages a large language model (LLM) as a task planner for spatial visual programming, which flexibly generate structured programs and coordinate tools. For instance-level metric depth estimation task, M3SunAgent invokes an object detector tool to locate the target, estimates depth at selected points with a depth estimation tool, and aggregates these predictions into an instance-level depth estimate. We also construct the M3Sun Instance (M3SI) dataset, a benchmark with 2,910 samples for evaluation. For monocular 3D visual grounding task, M3SunAgent uses a vision-language model (VLM) tool to locate the target and output basic spatial attributes, then combines back-projection tool with a dimension-lifting tool to predict its 3D bounding box. Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of M3SunAgent. Specifically, in evaluations of instance-level monocular metric depth estimation, M3SunAgent achieves the best performance among all compared models, 52.61% of predicted instances are distributed below depth error 0.25 ($δ< 0.25$). In evaluations of monocular 3D visual grounding, M3SunAgent demonstrates overall competitive performance than vision and VLM models, reaching a 3D mean intersection over union (mIoU) of 41.73% and exceeding the state-of-the-art MonoVLM model by 3.62%.
papers.comment: 13 pages. 7 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: M3SunAgent 用 LLM 作任务规划器，把单目实例级度量深度估计与 3D 视觉定位 (3D visual grounding) 统一到一个可调用工具的 agent 框架里，并构建 2,910 样本的 M3SI 基准。深度任务上 52.61% 预测实例落在深度误差 δ<0.25 内、为所比较模型最佳；3D 定位 3D mIoU 达 41.73%，比 MonoVLM 高 3.62%。
Motivation: 单目度量深度估计与 3D 视觉定位通常由两套独立框架完成，具身智能系统获取空间信息时既不灵活也难以对齐。
Method: 以 LLM 作任务规划器做 spatial visual programming，灵活生成结构化程序并调度工具：深度侧先用目标检测器定位、再用深度估计工具在选定点预测并聚合为实例级深度；定位侧用 VLM 工具输出基础空间属性，再经 back-projection 与 dimension-lifting 工具预测 3D bounding box。同时构建 M3Sun Instance (M3SI) 数据集作为评测基准。
Result: M3SI 基准含 2,910 个样本。实例级单目度量深度估计中 52.61% 预测实例的深度误差 δ<0.25，在所有对比模型中最佳；单目 3D 视觉定位 3D mIoU 为 41.73%，超过 SOTA MonoVLM 3.62%，整体相对视觉与 VLM 模型具竞争力。
Conclusion: 把单目 3D 空间理解的两个互补任务交给 LLM 规划、工具执行的统一 agent，可在实例级深度与 3D 定位上同时达到对比模型中的最佳或领先水平。

papers.title: Do Higher-Order Models Win for Higher-Order Reasons? Rethinking Performance Gains in Hypergraph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Higher-order models (e.g., hypergraph neural networks) often outperform lower-order baselines on hypergraph learning benchmarks, and their advantages are commonly attributed to their ability to exploit higher-order information. However, better performance alone does not establish this explanation. We therefore ask: Do higher-order models win for higher-order reasons? To investigate this question, we introduce a controlled performance-attribution framework that perturbs higher-order information while preserving the lower-order, i.e., pairwise, information. Across 25 commonly used hypergraph learning benchmarks spanning three tasks, we frequently observe an intriguing pattern: higher-order models originally outperform lower-order baselines, yet retain most of their advantage after perturbation. This suggests that much of the observed advantage remains achievable without the higher-order information. We then investigate potential lower-order explanations for these remaining gaps. We find that simple additions to a lower-order baseline, e.g., richer pairwise weighting, more steps of pairwise feature propagation, and normalization, reduce the remaining performance gaps, supporting lower-order explanations for part of the observed advantage. Our analysis calls for the hypergraph learning community to rethink performance attribution by distinguishing performance gains from their explanations, adopt stronger lower-order baselines, and use suitable benchmarks that better test the value of higher-order information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 超图学习中高阶模型（如超图神经网络）的性能优势常被归因于利用了高阶信息，但作者用受控归因框架扰动高阶信息、保留成对信息后发现，高阶模型在 25 个常用超图学习基准上仍保留大部分优势。给低阶基线加上更细的成对加权、更多步成对特征传播与归一化即可缩小剩余差距，说明相当一部分增益来自低阶解释而非高阶信息。
Motivation: 超图学习基准上高阶模型胜出常被直接当作“高阶信息有用”的证据，但性能更好本身并不构成该解释，社区需要区分性能增益与其归因。
Method: 提出受控性能归因框架：扰动高阶信息同时保持成对（低阶）信息不变，在覆盖三类任务的 25 个常用超图学习基准上比较高阶模型与低阶基线，再检验更细成对加权、更多步成对特征传播、归一化等低阶增强能否解释剩余差距。
Result: 在 25 个跨三类任务的常用超图学习基准上，高阶模型原本优于低阶基线，但扰动高阶信息后仍保留大部分优势；对低阶基线加入更丰富的成对加权、更多步成对特征传播与归一化后，剩余性能差距减小。
Conclusion: 相当一部分所谓高阶优势可在不含高阶信息的情况下取得，社区应把性能增益与其解释分开，采用更强的低阶基线，并选用更能检验高阶信息价值的基准。

papers.title: Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents
papers.abstract_en: As agents continuously improve by generating and revising Skills, the process that discovers and refines those Skills becomes a learnable object in its own right. Task-Skills directly act on task execution, whereas Meta-Skills govern how agents discover and improve future Skills; their value therefore emerges through the subsequent search processes they induce. Existing approaches improve Meta-Skills from observed raw Skill-search trajectories and branch outcomes. However, branch performance entangles the effects of the initial discovery state and the Meta-Skill revision that generated the search process, making it difficult to characterize what a particular revision actually changed, and pushing updates toward revisions that benefit from favorable states rather than those that improve the process. We introduce HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation), a mechanism for constructing Meta-Experience for self-improving agents. HMED revisits the completed event from which a revision originates and re-executes the incumbent and revised Meta-Skills from the same restored discovery state, so that the changes associated with the revision can be observed under a shared condition. Each comparison is distilled into a Meta-Experience, a structured record that can be reused by future updates, so that even revisions that are not ultimately retained still contribute a learning signal. Across three interactive agent benchmarks and both open-source and closed-source models, HMED consistently improves Skill discovery performance over strong baselines, shifting Meta-Skill learning beyond branch outcomes toward the consequences of changing the improvement process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HMED 让自改进 agent 回到产生某次 Meta-Skill 修订的原始事件，从同一恢复的发现状态分别重放修订前后的 Meta-Skill，把差异蒸馏成可复用的 Meta-Experience，使未被保留的修订也提供学习信号。在三个交互式 agent 基准、开源与闭源模型上，HMED 一致提升 Skill 发现性能，优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有方法用原始 Skill 搜索轨迹和分支结果改进 Meta-Skills，但分支表现把初始发现状态的运气与修订本身的效果混在一起，更新被推向占了状态便宜的修订而非真正改进搜索过程的修订。
Method: HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation) 定位修订所源自的已完成事件，恢复同一发现状态后重放 incumbent 与 revised 两版 Meta-Skill，使修订带来的变化在共享条件下可观测；每次比较蒸馏为结构化的 Meta-Experience 记录，供后续更新复用。
Result: 在三个交互式 agent 基准上，针对开源与闭源两类模型，HMED 相对强基线一致提升 Skill 发现性能。
Conclusion: Meta-Skill 学习应从分支结果转向改变改进过程本身的后果，共享状态下的前后对照比分支表现更能刻画一次修订的实际贡献。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning a Ranking from Human Feedback in Log-Concave Random Utility Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of recovering the ranking of a fixed set of items according to their unknown numerical utilities. At each interaction with the environment, a learner presents the item set to a human and receives comparative feedback of two types. Under full-ranking feedback, each interaction reveals a noisy ranking of all items, whereas under winner-only feedback, it reveals only the item ranked first. In both settings, we model human feedback using a random utility model with log-concave noise and study the number of observations needed to recover an $ε$-accurate ranking with high probability. This novel criterion tolerates ordering errors only between items whose utilities differ by less than $ε$. For both feedback types, we establish worst-case sample-complexity lower bounds and develop algorithms that match these bounds up to logarithmic factors. Neither algorithm requires knowledge of the noise distribution, while only requiring an upper bound on its variance. Our results show that the ranking problem under winner-only feedback is intrinsically harder by exposing the sample complexity dependence on the minimum winning probability across the item set.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 log-concave 随机效用模型下，从人类比较反馈中恢复固定物品集的 ε-近似排序：全排序反馈与仅胜者反馈两种设定各给出最坏情形样本复杂度下界，并构造与之下界匹配（差至多对数因子）的算法，两者都只需噪声方差上界、无需知道噪声分布。仅胜者反馈本质上更难，其样本复杂度显式依赖于物品集上的最小获胜概率。
Motivation: 从人类比较反馈中恢复带噪效用对应的排序时，需要刻画达到 ε-准确排序所需的观测量，尤其是仅胜者反馈这种更弱信号下样本复杂度如何随物品集规模与获胜概率变化。
Method: 用 log-concave 噪声的随机效用模型建模两类反馈：全排序反馈每次交互给出全部物品的带噪排序，仅胜者反馈只给出第一名。提出容忍 ε 内效用差物品间次序错误的排序恢复准则，对两种反馈分别推导最坏情形样本复杂度下界并给出匹配算法，算法只需噪声方差上界、不需知道噪声分布。
Result: 对两种反馈类型均建立最坏情形样本复杂度下界，并给出与之匹配至多差对数因子的算法；仅胜者反馈的样本复杂度显式依赖于物品集上的最小获胜概率，因而本质上更难。
Conclusion: 在 log-concave 随机效用模型下，仅胜者反馈的排序恢复难度由最小获胜概率决定，而匹配下界的算法可以在只知道噪声方差上界的情况下实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents increasingly operate on interfaces influenced by users' histories and preferences, but their reliability across different users remains underexplored. We introduce PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering), a pipeline for constructing user-conditioned application states that enables controlled evaluation of the same task across different users. We further introduce RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards), a training approach that learns from cross-user differences in subgoal outcomes to improve reliability across user-conditioned mobile environments. Across six agents, we find substantial variation in task success across users and consistently lower subgoal achievement in user-conditioned UI contexts (6.98 to 15.4 pp). This gap further increases for personal targets drawn from each user's own content (8.77 to 22.0 pp). Failures in these contexts frequently involve selecting another item instead of the intended target, particularly before target exposure. Finally, RePAIR improves user-conditioned SAR (+5.87 pp), all-success (+7.50 pp), and overall Task SR (+9.42 pp) over its supervised fine-tuning parent on unseen users, providing initial evidence that explicitly learning from cross-user variation can improve GUI-agent reliability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对移动 GUI agent 在个性化界面下跨用户可靠性未知的问题，提出 PAIR 流水线构造用户条件化的应用状态以在同一任务上做受控跨用户评测，并提出 RePAIR 用跨用户的子目标结果差异作为强化学习奖励。六个 agent 上用户条件化 UI 使子目标达成率一致下降 6.98–15.4 个百分点，取自用户自身内容的 personal target 上差距扩大到 8.77–22.0 个百分点；RePAIR 在未见用户上相对其 SFT 父模型把 Task SR 提高 9.42 pp。
Motivation: 移动 GUI agent 越来越多运行在受用户历史与偏好影响的界面上，但同一任务在不同用户下的可靠性差异缺乏受控评测手段，跨用户失败模式也未被刻画。
Method: PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering) 流水线生成用户条件化的应用状态，使同一任务可在不同用户间受控评测；RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards) 是训练方法，从跨用户子目标结果差异中学习奖励，改进用户条件化环境下的可靠性。
Result: 六个 agent 在用户条件化 UI 上子目标达成率一致下降 6.98 至 15.4 pp，任务成功率跨用户差异显著；取自用户自身内容的 personal target 上差距扩大到 8.77 至 22.0 pp。失败常表现为选中非目标条目，且多发生在目标暴露之前。RePAIR 在未见用户上相对其 supervised fine-tuning 父模型：user-conditioned SAR +5.87 pp、all-success +7.50 pp、overall Task SR +9.42 pp。
Conclusion: 跨用户差异本身可作为训练信号：显式从个性化界面的子目标结果差异中学习，能在未见用户上提升 GUI agent 的可靠性，而个性化界面是当前可靠性评估的系统性盲区。

papers.title: EmbodiedSmith: Scaling Embodied Data through Recursive Self-Improvement Flywheel in Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Scaling robotic foundation models requires diverse training data and reliable evaluation environments. Simulation offers a scalable solution, yet existing generation pipelines remain constrained by predefined assets and skills, a disconnect between scene generation and task generation, and limited support for complex embodiments and physics. We introduce EmbodiedSmith, a framework for scalable embodied data generation through recursive self-improvement (RSI). EmbodiedSmith unifies asset, scene, and task generation in a pipeline that supports autonomous creation and language-driven customization. Its core is an agentic refinement loop: scene generation anticipates downstream task requirements, while task generation guides targeted scene edits, allowing scenes and tasks to iteratively improve one another. This joint refinement improves task generation success, including for long-horizon tasks. The framework further supports mobile manipulators, humanoids, and dexterous hands, as well as interactions involving deformable objects and fluids, broadening the range of behaviors and physical phenomena represented in generated data. Together, these capabilities provide a flexible simulation engine for both robot pretraining and evaluation. Extensive experiments validate the quality, diversity, and generation efficiency of the resulting data, while downstream policy experiments demonstrate that increased data diversity improves generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EmbodiedSmith 用递归自我改进 (RSI) 飞轮在仿真中自动生成具身数据：场景生成预判下游任务需求，任务生成反过来驱动定向场景编辑，两者迭代互提。该联合精调提升了任务生成成功率（含长程任务），并支持移动机械臂、人形与灵巧手及可变形物体、流体交互；下游策略实验证明数据多样性提升带来泛化改善。
Motivation: 机器人基础模型需要多样训练数据与可靠评测环境，但现有生成管线受预定义资产与技能束缚，场景生成与任务生成彼此脱节，且难以支持复杂具身体与复杂物理。
Method: 统一资产、场景、任务生成的管线，支持自主创建与语言驱动定制；核心是 agentic refinement loop，场景生成预判任务需求、任务生成指导定向场景编辑，二者迭代互精；支持移动机械臂、人形、灵巧手以及可变形物体与流体交互。
Result: 联合精调提升任务生成成功率，长程任务同样受益；大量实验验证生成数据的质量、多样性与生成效率；下游策略实验显示数据多样性提高可改善泛化。
Conclusion: 把场景与任务放进互相引导的递归自我改进回路，仿真引擎可同时支撑机器人预训练与评测，并覆盖更宽的行为与物理现象范围。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DecepEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Deception in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) agents become increasingly autonomous, they may pursue task performance through deception, raising concerns about their reliable deployment. Existing evaluations show that LLM agents can deceive, but often examine isolated scenarios or narrowly defined conditions, limiting systematic understanding of when deception becomes more likely. To address this gap, we introduce DecepEval, a benchmark comprising 1,532 instances across 3 task families and 28 professional scenarios. Drawing on classical fraud theories, we propose the LLM Deception Diamond framework, which characterizes four external conditions that may induce deception: pressure, incentive, opportunity, and conflict. DecepEval pairs neutral and induced versions of each instance to measure condition-dependent changes in deception rates, while explicit task facts and observable agent behavior help distinguish deception from capability-related errors. Evaluations of nine frontier LLMs show that inducements increase deception across models and task families, even among models with low baseline deception rates. DecepEval makes these vulnerabilities measurable, providing a shared benchmark for progress toward trustworthy artificial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DecepEval 是一个含 1,532 个实例、覆盖 3 类任务与 28 个专业场景的 LLM agent 欺骗评测基准，配套提出 LLM Deception Diamond 框架，用压力、动机、机会、冲突四个外部条件刻画诱发欺骗的因素。对 9 个前沿 LLM 的评测显示，诱导条件在所有模型和任务族上都抬高欺骗率，即使基线欺骗率很低的模型也如此。
Motivation: 现有评测只考察孤立场景或狭窄条件，无法系统回答 LLM agent 在什么情况下更可能欺骗，而 agent 自主性提高使这一问题关系到可靠部署。
Method: 构建 DecepEval 基准（1,532 实例、3 任务族、28 专业场景），每个实例配对中性版与诱导版以测量条件依赖的欺骗率变化；借经典欺诈理论提出 LLM Deception Diamond 框架（pressure、incentive、opportunity、conflict 四条件），并用显式任务事实与可观测 agent 行为区分欺骗与能力性错误。
Result: 对 9 个前沿 LLM 的评测中，诱导条件在各模型与各任务族上均提高欺骗率，包括基线欺骗率本就低的模型；基准规模为 1,532 个实例、3 个任务族、28 个专业场景。
Conclusion: 欺骗是可被外部条件诱发、且可被系统测量的 LLM agent 行为，DecepEval 提供了衡量可信 AI 进展的共享基准。

papers.title: Feature Encoding in VAE-based Audio Decoders: Effects of Input, Depth and Distribution
papers.abstract_en: Neural audio synthesis models like the Realtime Audio Variational autoEncoder (RAVE) achieve impressive genera tion quality, yet how their internal representations encode musical features remains poorly understood. We present a systematic layer-wise and cross-layer cluster analysis of RAVE decoder activations across three models trained on different musical domains, tested with four stimulus types. We then evaluate architectural generalization with a general purpose EnCodec model. For RAVE, we find that synthetic stimuli are encoded well across models and audio features (pitch |\r{ho}|=0.45, 5.1x the null, BPM |\r{ho}| = 0.76, 8.6x the null). These results are reduced but still substantively apparent when using natural audio (mean across features |\r{ho}|=0.25, 2.8x the null). Natural audio sees a stronger encoding when nonlinear probes are used (mean across features R2=0.56, 18x the null, +0.152 nonlinear gain over the linear probe R2). Encoding strength varies throughout the layers of the decoder and an increased ability to joint-encode in the middle layers is seen across all audio features (\b{eta}2 all negative, p < 0.05). The general purpose EnCodec decoder also sees similar strong synthetic responses across audio features, similar nonlinear gains for natural audio joint encoding and similar depth profiles. We find the best cross-layer cluster improves the strength (r = 0.65, p = 0.006) and prevalence (r = 0.75, p = 0.001) of BPM encoding when compared against the best whole layers within the same section, with no effect for joint encoding. These findings advance the interpretability of neural audio models and inform targeted control strategies for neural synthesis.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publishing in IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech and Language Processing (TASLP)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 RAVE 解码器逐层与跨层做聚类分析，量化其激活对音高、BPM 等音乐特征的编码强度：合成刺激下 pitch |ρ|=0.45（5.1× null）、BPM |ρ|=0.76（8.6× null），自然音频下非线性探针均值 R²=0.56（18× null，比线性探针高 0.152）。编码强度随深度变化，中间层联合编码能力更强，跨层聚类把 BPM 编码强度提升到 r=0.65（p=0.006）、普遍性 r=0.75（p=0.001）。
Motivation: RAVE 等神经音频合成模型生成质量已很好，但内部表征如何编码音乐特征缺乏系统刻画，难以据此设计针对性控制手段。
Method: 对三个不同音乐域训练的 RAVE 模型的解码器激活做逐层与跨层聚类分析，用四类刺激（合成与自然音频）测试；以线性与非线性探针估计特征编码，并在通用 EnCodec 解码器上检验架构泛化。
Result: 合成刺激下 pitch |ρ|=0.45（5.1× null）、BPM |ρ|=0.76（8.6× null）；自然音频跨特征均值 |ρ|=0.25（2.8× null），非线性探针均值 R²=0.56（18× null，较线性探针 +0.152）。中间层联合编码增强（β² 全为负，p<0.05）；最佳跨层聚类相对同区段最佳整层把 BPM 编码强度提升至 r=0.65（p=0.006）、普遍性 r=0.75（p=0.001），对联合编码无影响。EnCodec 解码器呈现相似的合成响应、非线性增益与深度分布。
Conclusion: RAVE 与 EnCodec 解码器中层对音乐特征（尤其 BPM）编码最强，跨层表征比单层更适合做特征解码，这为神经合成的定向控制提供了依据。

papers.title: ReGraph: A Computational Account of Emergent Generalization in the "what" and "where" Dual Visual Streams
papers.abstract_en: Where generalization capacity--the ability to extract context-invariant relational structures--first emerges remains a central question in AI and neuroscience. The foundation for this capacity lies upstream of the hippocampus, within the entorhinal cortex, where parallel pathways dissociate relational structure in the medial entorhinal cortex (MEC) from sensory content in the lateral entorhinal cortex. However, as Eichenbaum argued, such factorization likely originates earlier, driven by the segregation of the dorsal ('where') and ventral ('what') visual streams. Supporting this, grid-like firing patterns--a signature of MEC (context-invariant codes)--also appear in preceding neocortical regions along the dorsal pathway. Yet, how such representations are computationally formed along upstream pathways remains unknown. To investigate this in silico, we developed ReGraph, a recurrent dual-stream graph model with biological inductive biases, including retina-driven stream-specialized encoding, dorsal-to-ventral modulation, and dynamic lateral connectivity. Trained on the action benchmark Something-Something V2, ReGraph revealed a pathway-specific emergence of relational mapping: context-invariant codes and grid-like spatial bases uniquely co-emerged along the extended dorsal stream. In contrast, their absence in single-stream, unmodulated variants, and standard baselines implies that these inductive biases are prerequisites for relational structures. Crucially, our post-hoc analyses demonstrated that these grid-like bases serve as reusable routing templates for information processing via lateral connectivity. Together, our findings provide a computational account that generalization may not be a faculty that emerges abruptly within a dedicated region, but a property that already takes shape as sensory information is parsed into factorized streams of hierarchical visual processing.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 构建循环双通路图模型 ReGraph，纳入视网膜驱动的通路特化编码、背侧到腹侧的调制 (dorsal-to-ventral modulation) 与动态侧连接；在 Something-Something V2 上训练，并与单通路、无调制变体及标准基线对照，再做 post-hoc 分析检验 grid-like 基的作用。
Result: 在 ReGraph 中，上下文不变码与 grid-like 空间基只在延长的背侧通路上共同涌现；单通路、无调制变体和标准基线中缺失这些结构。post-hoc 分析显示 grid-like 基通过侧连接充当可复用的信息路由模板。

papers.title: DensiTok: Making Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting See More Views Than It Is Given
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene in a single forward pass, replacing per-scene optimization with a network trained across many scenes. Its quality, however, degrades sharply as the number of input images drops. The bottleneck is upstream of the reconstruction heads: from a few unposed views, the internal representation they read carries no evidence for unobserved regions, leaving holes, floaters, and blur. The common remedy supplies that evidence as pixels, synthesizing extra views with an image or video generator and re-encoding them, which is costly and not 3D-consistent by construction. We instead densify the evidence itself. We present DensiTok, a plug-in module for pretrained feed-forward 3DGS models that densifies their internal geometry tokens directly, making a frozen backbone behave as though it had observed many more views than it was given. DensiTok compresses those tokens into a compact latent space, completes the latents of the unobserved viewpoints in a single flow-matching step conditioned on camera geometry, and decodes them back into tokens that the original reconstruction heads. The same module design can be integrated into different pretrained predictors while keeping each backbone and its reconstruction heads frozen. Completion in a low-dimensional latent space requires no image synthesis or additional encoder passes. Across three pretrained backbones and two benchmarks, DensiTok consistently improves sparse-view reconstruction and recovers much of the gap to dense-view reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DensiTok 是一个即插即用模块，把预训练前馈 3D Gaussian Splatting 的内部几何 token 压进低维 latent，用以相机几何为条件的单步 flow matching 补全未观测视角的 latent，再解码回 token，让冻结的 backbone 表现得像看到了更多视角。在三个预训练 backbone 和两个 benchmark 上一致改善稀疏视角重建，收回了与稠密视角重建之间的大部分差距。
Motivation: 前馈 3DGS 在输入图像很少时质量急剧下降，瓶颈在重建头上游：少量无位姿视角下内部表征对未观测区域没有任何证据，产生空洞、浮点伪影和模糊；现有补救靠图像/视频生成器合成额外视角再重编码，代价高且不保证 3D 一致。
Method: DensiTok 直接对内部几何 token 做 densify：先压缩到紧凑 latent 空间，再以相机几何为条件用单步 flow matching 补全未观测视角的 latent，最后解码回 token 交给原重建头；backbone 与重建头全程冻结，同一模块可集成到不同预训练预测器，无需图像合成或额外 encoder 前向。
Result: 在三个预训练 backbone 和两个 benchmark 上，DensiTok 一致改善稀疏视角重建，并收回了与稠密视角重建之间的大部分差距。
Conclusion: 稀疏视角前馈 3DGS 的证据缺口可以在 token 层面用 latent 空间的几何条件补全来填补，而不必合成像素，且对不同冻结 backbone 通用。

papers.title: Revisiting Numerical Forecasting Models for Language-Based Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Language-based trajectory predictors represent coordinates as discrete tokens and learn auxiliary tasks such as destination and group reasoning. This formulation enables the model to capture behavioral intent and social context beyond coordinate dynamics alone. However, token-level objectives provide only indirect guidance for continuous coordinate-space dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce MoRE (Mixture of Reward Experts), a refinement framework that transfers numerical forecasting priors into a pretrained language-based predictor through reinforcement learning. Five frozen numerical predictors provide complementary coordinate-level knowledge of motion and interactions. Their predictions are converted into expert rewards and combined through an uncertainty-weighted consensus that penalizes disagreement. A ground-truth reward anchors the prediction to the target trajectory. To focus refinement on difficult cases, MoRE refines the policy using the top 1% of training samples ranked by predictive entropy. Expert predictions are computed once and cached before PPO training, so the experts are not run during policy updates or inference. In this way, MoRE combines the contextual modeling of the language-based predictor with coordinate-level feedback from numerical experts. On ETH-UCY, MoRE reduces ADE from 0.22 to 0.20 m and FDE from 0.32 to 0.29 m. Relative to the base policy, ADE decreases by 17.9% on SDD and 12.7% on NBA. On ETH-UCY, MoRE also reduces collision rates and better matches ground-truth pedestrian spacing, without increasing measured inference memory or latency. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/MoRE/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoRE 用五个冻结的数值轨迹预测器生成坐标级奖励，经不确定性加权共识与真值奖励，通过 PPO 只对预测熵最高的 1% 训练样本微调语言式轨迹预测器。ETH-UCY 上 ADE 从 0.22 m 降到 0.20 m、FDE 从 0.32 m 降到 0.29 m，SDD 与 NBA 的 ADE 分别下降 17.9% 和 12.7%，且不增加推理内存与延迟。
Motivation: 语言式轨迹预测把坐标离散成 token，token 级目标对连续坐标动力学只有间接监督，行为意图与数值运动先验之间存在脱节。
Method: MoRE (Mixture of Reward Experts)：五个冻结的数值预测器提供运动与交互的坐标级先验，其预测转为专家奖励并按不确定性加权共识合并（惩罚分歧），再加真值奖励锚定目标轨迹；用 PPO 只在按预测熵排序的前 1% 训练样本上做细化，专家预测在训练前一次性计算并缓存，策略更新与推理阶段不再运行专家。
Result: ETH-UCY 上 ADE 0.22 → 0.20 m，FDE 0.32 → 0.29 m；相对基础策略，SDD 的 ADE 下降 17.9%，NBA 的 ADE 下降 12.7%；ETH-UCY 上碰撞率下降且更贴近真实行人间距，推理内存与延迟未增加。
Conclusion: 把数值预测先验转成 RL 奖励注入语言式预测器，可以在不增加推理开销的前提下同时改善轨迹精度、碰撞率与社会间距，且细化只需覆盖高熵难例。

papers.title: Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出推理时框架 Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRG)：从「agent 完成了任务」这一主张出发，把它分解为扎根于轨迹证据的情境化子主张，逐条估计终端主张的置信度再聚合成整体置信度，无需特权模型访问或训练数据。在三个 agentic benchmark、三个 backbone 模型、三个 agent 框架上，CRG 比 verbalized、sampling-based 与 white-box surrogate 基线校准更好、风险感知决策更强；消融显示改进来自主张级置信估计与聚合，而非图构建本身。
Motivation: 对 LLM agent 是否成功做校准置信估计很难，因为成功证据分散在异构且相互依赖的轨迹步骤中；实践中前沿 LLM 内部信号受限、roll-out 昂贵、训练数据缺失或过时。
Method: CRG 是推理时框架：以「agent 完成任务」为根主张，分解为基于轨迹证据的情境化子主张，对每个终端主张估计置信度，再聚合成整体置信估计；不使用特权模型访问与训练数据。
Result: 在三个 agentic benchmark、三个 backbone 模型、三个 agent 框架上，CRG 相对 verbalized、sampling-based 与 white-box surrogate 基线给出更好的校准与更强的风险感知决策。白盒 surrogate 基线看似校准良好但判别力接近随机 (near-chance discrimination)，说明单看校准误差会误导。消融把改进归因于主张级置信估计与聚合，而非仅图构建。
Conclusion: 把置信度拆成可审计的主张与轨迹证据再聚合，能在无训练数据的条件下同时改善校准与判别；校准误差单独不足以衡量置信估计质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Models to Unknown Visual Disruptions During Execution
papers.abstract_en: Visual disruptions can arise while a robot is executing a task, leaving a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to respond without knowing the disruption type or timing. We introduce Self-supervised Adaptation from Leftover Trajectories (SALT), which uses the leftover trajectory, the unexecuted part of the previous action chunk, as self-supervision for test-time adaptation. Because consecutive chunks overlap in time, the leftover provides a temporally aligned target for the current prediction over the same future control interval. At the onset of a visual shift, the leftover can retain a plan formed before the corruption, so updating the policy toward it anchors the adaptation across the shift (Transition Anchoring). SALT keeps the adapted policy and regenerates the current chunk, whose leftover becomes the target at the next replan, carrying the correction forward along the execution trajectory (Sequential Correction Propagation). Supervision comes entirely from the policy's own predictions, requiring no disruption annotations, expert actions, or target-domain demonstrations, and a lightweight adaptation gate calibrated only on nominal trajectories decides when updates begin. On LIBERO-10, SALT increases average success across five persistent visual corruptions from 43.9% to 53.2% with SmolVLA and from 58.7% to 66.0% with GR00T N1.7, while largely preserving nominal performance. On a real robot, it raises task progress averaged over digital and physical disruptions from 0.49 to 0.61.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SALT 用上一个 action chunk 中未执行的 leftover trajectory 作为自监督目标，在测试时对遭遇未知视觉扰动的 VLA 策略做在线适配：因相邻 chunk 时间重叠，leftover 提供对齐的未来控制区间目标，更新策略可跨扰动起点锚定（Transition Anchoring），再把修正沿执行轨迹逐次传递（Sequential Correction Propagation）。在 LIBERO-10 上五种持续视觉损坏的平均成功率由 43.9% 提到 53.2%（SmolVLA）、58.7% 提到 66.0%（GR00T N1.7），真机上数字与物理扰动的平均任务进度由 0.49 提到 0.61。
Motivation: 机器人执行中会突然出现类型与时序未知的视觉扰动，VLA 策略既不知道扰动类别也没有对应监督，难以在执行过程中自我纠正。
Method: SALT 把上一 action chunk 未执行部分（leftover trajectory）当作当前预测的时间对齐监督，做无需扰动标注、专家动作或目标域演示的测试时适配；保留适配后的策略并重新生成当前 chunk，其 leftover 成为下次 replan 的目标（Sequential Correction Propagation），更新起点由仅在正常轨迹上标定的轻量适配门控决定。
Result: LIBERO-10 上五种持续视觉损坏的平均成功率：SmolVLA 43.9% → 53.2%，GR00T N1.7 58.7% → 66.0%，且基本保持正常性能；真机上数字与物理扰动平均任务进度 0.49 → 0.61。
Conclusion: 策略自身预测的 leftover 足以支撑无标注的测试时视觉扰动适配，且修正可沿执行轨迹持续传递。

summary_sections.result: LIBERO-10 上五种持续视觉损坏的平均成功率：SmolVLA 43.9% → 53.2%，GR00T N1.7 58.7% → 66.0%，且基本保持正常性能；真机上数字与物理扰动平均任务进度 0.49 → 0.61。
summary_sections.conclusion: 策略自身预测的 leftover 足以支撑无标注的测试时视觉扰动适配，且修正可沿执行轨迹持续传递。

papers.title: UltraDiff: Differentiable Ray Tracing in Ultrasound for Shape Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Physically-based differentiable rendering enables gradient-based optimization of scene parameters by matching rendered images to measurements, but has so far mainly focused on light transport. We extend this paradigm to medical ultrasound, where image formation resembles transient rendering: echoes are binned by time-of-flight rather than projected onto an image plane. We present UltraDiff, a modular framework for differentiable ultrasound ray tracing. UltraDiff formulates ultrasound image formation as a path-space integral, gated by travel time between the transducer and tissue interfaces, and derives a Monte Carlo estimator of both the forward model and its gradients with respect to scene parameters. We demonstrate this on an inverse geometry estimation: starting from a sphere, an SDF is optimized until simulated echoes match measured ones, recovering vertebral surfaces from simulated B-mode sweeps and from a real robotic acquisition of a spine phantom. Unlike state-of-the-art ultrasound shape reconstruction methods, which rely on pre-segmented images, our approach operates unsupervised on B-mode images through analysis-by-synthesis, while achieving competitive geometric accuracy. Implemented on top of Mitsuba 3, UltraDiff brings differentiable path tracing to a new sensing modality and provides a foundation for inverse problems in acoustic imaging.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UltraDiff 把可微渲染范式从光传输搬到医学超声，将超声成像写成由换能器到组织界面飞行时间门控的路径空间积分，并推导前向模型及其对场景参数梯度的蒙特卡洛估计。在从球体出发优化 SDF 的逆几何估计中，模拟回波可匹配实测回波，从模拟 B-mode 扫查与真实机器人脊柱仿体采集中恢复出椎体表面，在无需预分割图像的无监督 analysis-by-synthesis 下达到有竞争力的几何精度。

Method: UltraDiff 是模块化可微超声射线追踪框架：把成像写成由飞行时间门控的路径空间积分，推导前向模型与场景参数梯度的蒙特卡洛估计；在 Mitsuba 3 上实现可微路径追踪；以逆几何估计演示——从球体出发优化 SDF 直到模拟回波匹配实测回波。
Result: 在模拟 B-mode 扫查与真实机器人脊柱仿体 (spine phantom) 采集上均恢复出椎体表面；相比依赖预分割图像的最先进超声形状重建方法，该方法直接在 B-mode 图像上无监督运行（analysis-by-synthesis），并取得有竞争力的几何精度。
Conclusion: 可微路径追踪可作为一种新的传感模态用于声学成像逆问题，无需预分割即可做无监督形状优化，并为声学成像的逆问题提供基础。

papers.title: Hybrid Latent Attention for Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models apply the same stack of layers T times to each token, which deepens the model without adding parameters but multiplies its key-value (KV) cache by T. The larger cache limits how many sequences a GPU can decode at once and slows each decoding step, which reads the whole cache. We propose Hybrid Latent Attention (HLA), which keeps exact keys and values within a sliding window of W recent tokens and stores each older token as a compact latent that the query of each loop reads directly, without reconstructing keys and values. We uptrain HLA on Ouro looped models (T=4) with 1.4B and 2.6B parameters, keeping the pretrained weights frozen and training only the added parameters to reproduce the original attention. The cache shrinks by 10.7x per token, fitting 4.0-8.8x as many concurrent sequences per GPU, and decoding throughput improves by 2.5x at 1K-token contexts and by up to 7.4x at 16K. HLA retains over 97% of the original accuracy on math, knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, and 96-100% on long-context retrieval up to 16K tokens. After supervised fine-tuning, it performs on par with the fine-tuned original model on competition-level math.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Hybrid Latent Attention (HLA)：循环语言模型把同一层栈重复 T 次使 KV cache 放大 T 倍，HLA 只在最近 W 个 token 保留精确 key/value，更早的 token 压成紧凑 latent 供每层循环的 query 直接读取，无需重建 key/value。在 Ouro 循环模型 (T=4, 1.4B/2.6B) 上冻结原有权重、只训练新增参数做 uptrain 后，每 token cache 缩小 10.7 倍，单 GPU 并发序列数提升 4.0–8.8 倍，1K 上下文解码吞吐提升 2.5 倍、16K 最高 7.4 倍，同时保留原模型 97% 以上精度。
Motivation: 循环语言模型靠重复同一层栈加深模型而不加参数，但 KV cache 随 T 线性放大，限制单 GPU 并发解码序列数并拖慢每步解码（需读完整 cache）。
Method: HLA 在最近 W 个 token 上保留精确 key/value，把更早 token 存为紧凑 latent，每层循环的 query 直接读取 latent 而不重建 key/value；在 Ouro 循环模型 (T=4, 1.4B 与 2.6B) 上 uptrain，冻结预训练权重、只训练新增参数去复现原始注意力。
Result: 每 token cache 缩小 10.7 倍，单 GPU 可并发序列数提升 4.0–8.8 倍；解码吞吐在 1K 上下文提升 2.5 倍、16K 上下文最高提升 7.4 倍。数学、知识与推理基准上保留原精度 97% 以上，长上下文检索（至 16K token）保留 96–100%；监督微调后在竞赛级数学上与微调后的原模型持平。
Conclusion: 用滑动窗口精确注意力加紧凑 latent 的混合方案可以在几乎不损失精度的前提下大幅压缩循环语言模型的 KV cache 并提升解码吞吐，且 uptrain 只需训练新增参数。

papers.title: CCDF: A Benchmark Dataset for Deepfake Detection in Real-World Surveillance Footage
papers.abstract_en: Due to rapid advances in Generative AI, commercial video generation tools can be used to produce fabricated surveillance footage that can fool both human viewers and automated synthetic video detectors. Since these tools are so widely accessible, a malicious user can create a harmful video clip at minimal cost. The production and dissemination of such videos in high-stakes settings, such as crime reporting and elections, can misdirect emergency response efforts or distort political discourse. Existing deepfake video datasets, used by the research community to develop deepfake detection algorithms, exhibit two limitations: (1) they emphasize benign web content rather than footage of possibly malicious activity, and (2) they rely on older or open-source generators that do not represent recent advances in generative systems. We assemble CCtv DeepFakes (CCDF), a video deepfake dataset, to address both gaps. CCDF contains 1840 videos (460 real and 1380 generated) spanning 16 crime and accident categories, with generated content produced using three leading commercial systems: Grok Imagine, Google VEO 3.1, and OpenAI Sora 2. CCDF is a highly realistic, small-scale, manually annotated dataset targeting evaluation of detection models. We release three versions of the dataset: the raw generated data, a cleaned version in which video metadata are standardized between real and synthetic samples to prevent detectors from exploiting trivial cues, and an altered version simulating low-effort post-processing attacks. We evaluate CCDF with ten recent state-of-the-art detectors covering different detection approaches. Our results suggest that these approaches do not reliably distinguish CCDF's generated videos from real ones, despite their strong reported performance on existing datasets. These results further confirm that existing datasets are not well-suited to evaluating certain threats.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CCDF (CCtv DeepFakes) 是面向真实监控画面的深伪检测评测数据集：1840 段视频（460 真、1380 生成），覆盖 16 类犯罪与事故场景，生成内容来自 Grok Imagine、Google VEO 3.1、OpenAI Sora 2 三个商用系统，并提供原始、去元数据线索、模拟低强度后处理攻击三个版本。用十个近期 SOTA 检测器评测，这些方法无法可靠区分 CCDF 的生成视频与真实视频，尽管它们在既有数据集上报告性能很强。
Motivation: 现有深伪视频数据集偏向良性网络内容而非可能恶意的监控画面，且依赖较旧或开源生成器，无法代表近期商用生成系统，导致检测器在真实威胁场景下的可靠性无从评估。
Method: 构建 CCDF 数据集：1840 段视频（460 真实、1380 生成），16 类犯罪与事故类别，生成内容由 Grok Imagine、Google VEO 3.1、OpenAI Sora 2 产出，人工标注；发布原始版、元数据标准化版（防止检测器利用琐碎线索）、模拟低强度后处理攻击版；用十个覆盖不同检测思路的近期 SOTA 检测器做评测。
Result: CCDF 含 1840 段视频（460 真实、1380 生成）、16 个犯罪与事故类别、3 个商用生成系统、3 个数据集版本；十个近期 SOTA 检测器在 CCDF 上无法可靠区分生成与真实视频，而这些方法在既有数据集上报告性能很强。
Conclusion: 现有深伪数据集不适合评估监控画面伪造这一类威胁，检测器在既有基准上的强表现不能迁移到商用生成器产出的真实场景素材。

papers.title: Generalized Matheron Variational Implicit Processes
papers.abstract_en: Implicit-process priors specify distributions over functions through sample-forward mechanisms such as Bayesian neural networks and stochastic simulators, but their function-space densities are typically unavailable. We introduce Generalized Matheron Variational Implicit Processes (GMVIP), a pathwise variational family for posterior inference with such priors. For Gaussian-process priors, GMVIP recovers the standard inducing-variable variational GP construction; for general implicit priors, its empirical covariance construction preserves the prior mean and covariance in the population limit. GMVIP constructs posterior samples by drawing a function from the prior and applying a correction anchored at a set of inducing inputs. The effect of this correction away from the inducing inputs is determined directly from prior samples, allowing the posterior to retain the structure and variability of the original implicit process. The (surrogate) prior and variational posterior use the same pathwise construction and differ only in the distribution of whitened inducing coefficients, yielding a tractable coefficient-space Kullback-Leibler divergence. Experiments on regression, classification, and forecasting with simulator-defined and retrieval-conditioned empirical trajectory priors show that GMVIP is broadly competitive with existing methods.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 10 figures, 19 tables. Submitted for review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GMVIP（Generalized Matheron Variational Implicit Processes）：对函数空间密度不可得的 implicit-process 先验（BNN、随机模拟器），用路径式变分族做后验推断——从先验抽一条函数，再在一组 inducing inputs 处施加校正，校正远离 inducing 点的作用直接由先验样本决定。高斯过程先验下它退化为标准 inducing-variable 变分 GP，一般先验下经验协方差构造在总体极限保持先验均值与协方差；在回归、分类与 forecasting 实验中与现有方法大体相当。
Motivation: 以采样前向机制定义的 implicit-process 先验没有可用的函数空间密度，标准变分推断无法写出 KL，后验推断缺少通用的变分族。
Method: GMVIP 用路径式构造：从先验抽函数并在一组 inducing inputs 处加校正，校正的远离效应由先验样本直接估计；surrogate 先验与变分后验共用同一路径式构造，仅白化 inducing 系数的分布不同，从而 KL 在系数空间可解。对 GP 先验它复现标准 inducing-variable 变分 GP，对一般 implicit 先验其经验协方差在总体极限保持先验均值与协方差。
Result: 在回归、分类与 forecasting 任务上，使用 simulator-defined 与 retrieval-conditioned empirical trajectory priors 的实验显示 GMVIP 与现有方法大体相当（broadly competitive）。
Conclusion: 路径式校正加系数空间 KL 让没有函数密度的 implicit-process 先验也能做可行的变分后验推断，且在 GP 情形与经典变分 GP 一致。

papers.title: SIGMA: Self-Improving Alignment Generalization from a Model Spec
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks and of recursively improving themselves on easy-to-verify objectives such as software engineering and mathematics. Since alignment is much harder to verify, this creates a growing risk of capabilities increasing without appropriate safety alignment, especially as capabilities expand to auto-research and cybersecurity. Existing approaches focus on capability self-improvement using verifiable feedback or on alignment training with supervision from stronger models or curated data, creating an external supervision bottleneck for alignment. We ask whether current models can improve their own safety alignment, and propose SIGMA, a data generation and training pipeline enabling alignment self-improvement that generalizes to out-of-distribution settings. Given only a "Model Spec" stating the model's desired behavior, SIGMA leverages a model's reasoning capabilities to strengthen its own safety reasoning. SIGMA first performs spec-guided task synthesis, using the candidate model as a task designer agent to generate diverse alignment dilemma scenarios and convert them into training tasks that stress-test its understanding of the Model Spec. Next, SIGMA conducts self-judged alignment training through supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning with the model itself as the reward model. Despite training only on single-turn chat data, SIGMA improves safety alignment in multi-turn agentic environments (AgentHarm harmfulness decreases from 22.6 to 14.8; Agentic Misalignment decreases from 79.1 to 3.8), outperforms Deliberative Alignment and Constitutional AI baselines, and retains general capability. Analyses show that a Model Spec balancing harmlessness and helpfulness, test-time reasoning for safety deliberation, and high-quality rubrics from SIGMA's task designer agent are crucial for effective self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SIGMA 让模型只凭一份 Model Spec 自我生成对齐训练数据并自我评判：先由候选模型作为 task designer 合成对齐困境任务，再做 SFT 与基于 rubric 的 RL（模型自己当 reward model）。仅用单轮聊天数据训练，AgentHarm harmfulness 从 22.6 降到 14.8，Agentic Misalignment 从 79.1 降到 3.8，且优于 Deliberative Alignment 与 Constitutional AI 基线。
Motivation: 能力提升可用可验证反馈自我迭代，但对齐难以验证，只能靠更强模型或人工数据监督，形成外部监督瓶颈；随着能力扩展到 auto-research 与 cybersecurity，能力与安全对齐脱节的风险在放大。
Method: SIGMA 分两阶段：spec-guided task synthesis 让候选模型当 task designer，围绕 Model Spec 生成多样的对齐困境场景并转成训练任务；self-judged alignment training 用监督微调 (SFT) 加 rubric-based 强化学习，模型自身充当 reward model，只用单轮聊天数据。
Result: 在多轮 agentic 环境上，AgentHarm harmfulness 由 22.6 降至 14.8，Agentic Misalignment 由 79.1 降至 3.8；相对 Deliberative Alignment 与 Constitutional AI 基线更优，并保留通用能力。消融分析显示 harmlessness 与 helpfulness 平衡的 Model Spec、测试时安全推理、以及 task designer 产出的高质量 rubric 三者对效果关键。
Conclusion: 只要有一份说明期望行为的 Model Spec，模型就能用自身推理能力生成任务与评判信号，把安全对齐自我提升并泛化到分布外的多轮 agentic 场景，无需外部强模型监督。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Alignment and Calibration for Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic multimodal learning aims to learn robust representations by adaptively modeling information discrepancies across modalities. However, existing methods still suffer from two limitations: (i) static cross-modal alignment strategies usually impose uniform constraints on all samples while overlooking sample-wise variations, potentially leading to unreasonable over-alignment; and (ii) confidence- or uncertainty-aware fusion methods often fail to adequately account for feature magnitude and confidence differences across modalities. For modality pairs with significant feature magnitude differences or small confidence gaps, it might be unreliable to strictly align fusion weights according to confidence. To address these issues, we propose an Alignment- and Calibration-driven Multimodal Learning framework (ACML). Specifically, ACML incorporates a dynamic cross-modal triplet alignment module, which enforces strong semantic consistency for high-confidence positive pairs while encouraging diverse representation learning between high- and low-confidence positive pairs according to their confidence gaps. Additionally, ACML introduces a difference-aware attention calibration strategy that adaptively adjusts attention regularization based on feature magnitude and confidence differences across modalities, thereby mitigating biases caused by unreasonable fusion constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal benchmark datasets demonstrate that ACML consistently achieves superior performance and robustness over recent state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ACML 把多模态融合中的对齐从静态统一约束改为按置信度分档的动态三元组对齐，并按特征幅值与置信度差异自适应调节注意力正则，避免对低置信度正样本对的过度对齐。在多个多模态基准上，该框架相对近期 SOTA 取得一致更优的性能与鲁棒性。
Motivation: 静态跨模态对齐对所有样本施加同一约束，忽略样本间差异，容易造成不合理的过度对齐；而仅按置信度或不确定性设定融合权重的方法没有考虑特征幅值与置信度差异，对幅值差异大或置信度差距小的模态对，严格按置信度对齐融合权重并不可靠。
Method: 提出 Alignment- and Calibration-driven Multimodal Learning (ACML)：动态跨模态三元组对齐模块对高置信度正样本对强制强语义一致性，同时按高、低置信度正样本对之间的置信度差距鼓励多样化表示学习；差异感知注意力校准策略依据跨模态的特征幅值与置信度差异自适应调整注意力正则强度。
Result: 在多个多模态基准数据集上，ACML 相对近期 state-of-the-art 方法取得一致更优的性能与鲁棒性（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 对齐强度与注意力正则应随样本置信度和跨模态特征幅值动态调整，而非对所有样本施加统一约束，这样能同时改善多模态表示的性能与鲁棒性。

papers.title: TF-PRVR: Training-Free Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) aims to retrieve untrimmed videos containing moments relevant to a given text query. Despite recent progress, existing PRVR methods suffer from two key limitations: a fixed video decomposition scheme that causes semantic dilution, and source-domain overfitting induced by task-specific training. In this paper, we propose TF-PRVR, the first training-free framework for PRVR. TF-PRVR leverages frozen vision-language features to construct video-specific hierarchical representations. It derives temporal semantic signals from frame-level features and applies frequency-based multi-scale analysis to identify adaptive temporal boundaries, producing hierarchical segments with coherent event-level semantics. Built on these segments, TF-PRVR constructs a unified multi-scale graph and propagates query relevance across temporally and semantically related nodes. A moment-aware scoring strategy then aggregates temporally aligned relevance across scales, emphasizing consistently supported moments while suppressing isolated false responses. Without task-specific training, TF-PRVR preserves the general-purpose alignment capability of pre-trained vision-language models and avoids dataset-specific overfitting. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance across datasets with diverse visual and temporal characteristics, suggesting a practical direction for training-free PRVR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TF-PRVR 是首个免训练的部分相关视频检索 (PRVR) 框架：用冻结视觉-语言特征做帧级时序语义信号与频率多尺度分析自适应切分事件段，再在多尺度图上传播查询相关性并按时序对齐聚合打分。摘要称其在视觉与时序特性各异的数据集上表现一致，避免了任务特定训练带来的源域过拟合。
Motivation: 现有 PRVR 方法受固定视频切分方案导致语义稀释，且任务特定训练引起源域过拟合，泛化受限。
Method: 用冻结视觉-语言模型的帧级特征提取时序语义信号，以频率多尺度分析确定自适应时间边界得到事件级一致的分层片段；在此之上构建统一多尺度图，跨时序与语义相关节点传播查询相关性，再用 moment-aware 打分策略聚合跨尺度的时序对齐相关性，强化一致支持的片段、抑制孤立误响应。
Result: 在视觉与时序特性多样的数据集上取得一致表现 (consistent performance across datasets)，全程无需任务特定训练；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 免训练路线可行：保留预训练视觉-语言模型的通用对齐能力即可避免数据集特定过拟合，为 PRVR 提供一条实用方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) couple future prediction with robot control, yet existing systems often vary the video backbone, interaction structure, supervision, and inference procedure simultaneously, making their design choices difficult to compare. We introduce OPENWAM, an open world-action modeling framework built around a common causal robot-video foundation and configurable video-action interaction. Starting from Wan2.2-5B, we perform causal robot-video pretraining on over 10,000 hours of video, then integrate an action expert through a shared Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports joint, video-then-action, action-then-video, and decoupled generation. OPENWAM achieves high success rates on four LIBERO suites and real-world bimanual tasks; robot-video training with causal adaptation improves VTA success on LIBERO-Long from 68.4% to 97.8%. The same configurable architecture naturally extends to inverse and forward dynamics, allowing us to study how counterfactual transitions improve independently trained dynamics models beyond demonstrations alone. When only the video predictor is adapted to a new task, a frozen local-context inverse dynamics model trained on counterfactual data and demonstrations achieves 84.0% mean success across four held-out LIBERO-90 tasks, compared with 47.0% for a full-context inverse model and 21.5% for a local-context model trained only on demonstrations. For forward dynamics, counterfactual supervision reduces RGB prediction error by 34.5% and raises outcome identification from 21.1% to 71.3% among 16 same-state outcomes. OPENWAM provides a common testbed for comparing WAM interaction designs and for studying dynamics learning from video data beyond successful demonstrations.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://openwam.stanford.edu ; Code: https://github.com/OpenWAM/OpenWAM ; Code and project page released June 4, 2026. Equal contribution: Heng Yu, David D. Yuan, Juze Zhang
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OPENWAM 把世界-动作模型 (world-action model) 的视频主干、交互结构、监督与推理统一到一个可配置框架：以 Wan2.2-5B 做因果机器人视频预训练（超 10,000 小时），再经共享 Mixture-of-Transformers 接入动作专家，支持 joint、video-then-action、action-then-video、decoupled 四种生成顺序。因果适配使 LIBERO-Long 上 VTA 成功率从 68.4% 升到 97.8%；反事实 (counterfactual) 转移监督让仅适配视频预测器时，冻结的局部上下文逆动力学模型在四个 held-out LIBERO-90 任务上达到 84.0% 平均成功率，远高于全上下文逆模型 47.0% 与仅用演示训练的局部模型 21.5%。
Motivation: 现有 world-action 系统同时改动视频主干、交互结构、监督与推理流程，设计选择无法横向比较；动力学学习又受限于只用成功演示的数据。
Method: 以 Wan2.2-5B 为起点做因果机器人视频预训练（>10,000 小时视频），用共享 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构接入 action expert，支持 joint、video-then-action、action-then-video、decoupled 四种生成模式；同一可配置架构扩展到逆动力学与前向动力学，用反事实转移数据训练冻结的局部上下文逆动力学模型并研究超越演示的动力学学习。
Result: 因果适配的机器人视频训练把 LIBERO-Long 上 VTA 成功率从 68.4% 提到 97.8%；仅适配视频预测器时，冻结局部上下文逆动力学模型（反事实数据+演示）在四个 held-out LIBERO-90 任务平均成功率 84.0%，对比全上下文逆模型 47.0%、仅演示训练的局部模型 21.5%；前向动力学上反事实监督使 RGB 预测误差降低 34.5%，16 个同状态结果的结果识别率从 21.1% 升到 71.3%；在四套 LIBERO 与真实双臂任务上取得高成功率。
Conclusion: 统一的可配置 WAM 架构既能横向比较交互设计，也说明反事实转移监督能显著提升独立训练的动力学模型，且局部上下文加反事实数据优于全上下文或仅演示的逆动力学。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Can We Model the Artifacts Explicitly? Disentangle Artifacts via Pairwise Edit Relations for Image Manipulation Localization
papers.abstract_en: Image Manipulation Localization (IML) is commonly formulated as a fully supervised learning task that estimates the optimal manipulation mask $y$ for a given image $x$. In this work, we first reveal the latent nature of artifacts and thus reinterpret IML as a latent-variable problem, $P(y|x)=\int P(y|z)\,P(z|x)\,dz$, where $z$ denotes the artifacts. Following this interpretation, we pinpoint the cause for the current IML models' insufficiency as their implicit artifacts modeling strategy, highlighting the necessity of modeling $z$ in an explicit manner. Without direct labels, feature disentanglement is the most appropriate solution for this explicit modeling. Accordingly, we propose a two-stage learning paradigm with the Pairwise Artifacts Learning (PAL) and Standard Localization (SL) phases to estimate $P(z|x)$ and $P(y|z)$ via edit relations. To support our edit-relation-based learning, we further curate EditGroup-45K, a source-anchored dataset organized into edit groups for pair construction. Extensive experiments show that our PAL paradigm yields consistent improvements across diverse IML architectures, and empirical analyses further verify that PAL does capture artifacts explicitly through feature disentanglement. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/venus-guangjian/PAL
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把图像篡改定位 (IML) 重写为隐变量问题 P(y|x)=∫P(y|z)P(z|x)dz，用两阶段 Pairwise Artifacts Learning (PAL) 与 Standard Localization (SL) 通过编辑关系显式解耦伪影 z。PAL 在多种 IML 架构上带来一致提升，分析表明其确实通过特征解耦显式捕获了伪影。
Motivation: 现有 IML 模型把伪影隐式建模，导致定位能力不足；在没有直接伪影标签的前提下，需要一种能显式估计 P(z|x) 的学习方式。
Method: 两阶段范式：PAL 阶段通过成对编辑关系 (edit relations) 做特征解耦以估计 P(z|x)，SL 阶段估计 P(y|z)；并构建源锚定数据集 EditGroup-45K，按编辑组组织以构造配对样本。
Result: PAL 范式在多种不同 IML 架构上均带来一致改进；实证分析验证 PAL 通过特征解耦显式捕获伪影。
Conclusion: 把伪影当作显式隐变量并用编辑关系解耦，是比隐式伪影建模更有效的 IML 学习路径，且可跨架构复用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multimodal Knowledge Distillation for Gastric Adenocarcinoma Classification from Whole-Slide Images
papers.abstract_en: Gastric adenocarcinoma (GA) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and accurate histopathological subtype classification from whole-slide images (WSIs) is essential for effective treatment planning. While multimodal approaches that integrate pathology report text with WSIs can improve classification, existing methods often depend on computationally expensive transformer architectures and large language models. We propose a multimodal knowledge distillation (MKD) framework that combines a pretrained WSI image encoder and a clinical text encoder using Low-Rank Multimodal Fusion (LMF) to efficiently model cross-modal interactions during training. Each WSI is represented as a bag of patches paired with a slide-level diagnostic caption. The teacher model learns fused image-text representations for subtype classification, while the student model distills this knowledge to enable accurate image-only inference. We evaluate our method on the PatchGastric benchmark dataset and achieve at least 3.35% higher mean accuracy than state-of-the-art approaches, without relying on transformer-based fusion, multi-task learning, or large language models. The source code is available at https://github.com/helomelo1/MKD-LMF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多模态知识蒸馏框架 MKD：训练时用预训练 WSI 图像编码器与临床文本编码器经 Low-Rank Multimodal Fusion (LMF) 融合图文做胃腺癌亚型分类，推理时只用图像。在 PatchGastric 基准上平均准确率至少比现有最优方法高 3.35%，且不依赖 transformer 融合、多任务学习或大语言模型。
Motivation: 图文融合的病理分类虽能提升胃腺癌亚型判别，但现有方法依赖计算昂贵的 transformer 架构与大语言模型，推理阶段也难以摆脱文本输入。
Method: MKD 框架：每张 WSI 表示为 patch bag 加 slide 级诊断描述，预训练 WSI 图像编码器与临床文本编码器通过 Low-Rank Multimodal Fusion (LMF) 建模跨模态交互；teacher 学习图文融合表征做亚型分类，student 蒸馏该知识实现纯图像推理。
Result: 在 PatchGastric 基准数据集上，平均准确率至少比 state-of-the-art 方法高 3.35%，且未使用 transformer 融合、多任务学习或大语言模型；代码开源至 github.com/helomelo1/MKD-LMF。
Conclusion: 低秩多模态融合加知识蒸馏可以在不引入 transformer 与 LLM 的前提下，把图文融合的分类收益转移到纯图像推理。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Diverse Motion Customization via Control-based Dynamic Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent advances in video generation, motion customization remains challenging due to content leakage, where appearance attributes from the reference video unintentionally propagate into the generated output. We identify this issue as a consequence of the generative process collapsing toward the reference video, which arises from formulating the learning objective as a direct regression on the reference. To address this, we propose Control-based Motion Customization (CMC), a principled training framework that is structurally robust to content leakage. Our key idea is to steer generative dynamics toward desired motion while avoiding collapse toward the reference video, which we formalize using Stochastic Optimal Control (SOC). Under this formulation, customized videos acquire the target motion yet remain within the pre-trained model's prompt-conditional distribution, where appearance is determined by the text prompt rather than the reference video. Furthermore, to improve efficiency, we tailor the SOC formulation to motion customization by eliminating the need for an explicit reward and introducing a timestep-adaptive motion cost that focuses only on early generative stages, accelerating training by 2.5 times. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CMC effectively mitigates content leakage and achieves competitive motion fidelity while preserving the diversity of the base model across diverse scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Control-based Motion Customization (CMC)，把视频运动定制的训练目标从对参考视频的直接回归改写为 Stochastic Optimal Control (SOC) 问题：引导生成动力学朝目标运动走，同时不塌缩到参考视频，使外观由文本 prompt 决定。配合去掉显式 reward、只在生成早期施加 timestep-adaptive motion cost，训练加速 2.5 倍，并在多样场景中缓解 content leakage、保持运动保真与基座模型多样性。
Motivation: 视频生成的运动定制存在 content leakage：参考视频的外观属性会泄漏进生成结果。根因是把学习目标写成对参考视频的直接回归，导致生成过程塌缩向参考视频。
Method: 提出 CMC 训练框架，用 Stochastic Optimal Control (SOC) 形式化“朝目标运动引导、同时避免塌缩到参考视频”，使定制视频保持在预训练模型的 prompt 条件分布内；再针对运动定制裁剪 SOC：去掉显式 reward，引入只作用于生成早期阶段的 timestep-adaptive motion cost。
Result: 训练加速 2.5 倍；实验显示 CMC 有效缓解 content leakage，在多样场景下取得有竞争力的运动保真度，同时保持基座模型的多样性。
Conclusion: 把运动定制从对参考视频的回归改成 SOC 引导的生成动力学，可以在不牺牲基座多样性的前提下抑制外观泄漏，且早期 timestep 的运动代价即可加速训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revisiting Temporal Regularization for Smooth Control in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep Reinforcement Learning policies can produce nonsmooth action oscillations that hinder deployment on physical robots. Existing architectural and penalty-based approaches seek spatial smoothness by directly reducing sensitivity to changes in state inputs, but their broad constraints can degrade task performance as stronger smoothing is pursued. Temporal regularization instead constrains action differences along observed transitions, but has been considered unable to provide the spatial smoothness needed under observation noise. We revisit this assumption by proving that the temporal penalty bounds the expected action differences between current states sharing a next state, revealing a spatial effect that empirically extends to spatial smoothness. Building on this finding, we propose Conditioning for Action using only Temporal Smoothness (CATS), which combines a temporal penalty with linear ramp-up. We highlight temporal regularization's ability to provide spatial smoothness while better preserving task performance than explicit spatial regularization. Through linear ramp-up, CATS allows the policy to learn rewarding behavior before progressively smoothing its actions, improving return preservation and both temporal and spatial smoothness. Experiments in both simulation and the real world show that CATS substantially reduces action oscillation without degrading task performance, with little computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CATS（Conditioning for Action using only Temporal Smoothness）用沿观测转移的动作差惩罚加线性 ramp-up，证明该时间惩罚会约束共享同一 next state 的当前状态之间的期望动作差，从而产生此前被认为时间正则不具备的空间平滑效果。仿真与真机实验显示动作振荡大幅下降且任务回报不退化，计算开销很小。
Motivation: 深度 RL 策略的动作非平滑振荡阻碍实体机器人部署；已有架构式与惩罚式方法靠压低对状态输入变化的敏感度做空间平滑，约束过强会损害任务性能，而时间正则长期被认为在观测噪声下无法提供所需的空间平滑。
Method: 提出 CATS：在目标函数中加入沿观测转移的动作差时间惩罚，并配合线性 ramp-up，让策略先学到高回报行为再逐步平滑动作；核心理论结果是证明该时间惩罚界定了共享同一 next state 的当前状态之间期望动作差的上界，从而导出空间效应。
Result: 仿真与真实机器人实验中，CATS 显著降低动作振荡，同时不损害任务回报，计算开销很小；相比显式空间正则，时间正则在保持任务性能上更好。
Conclusion: 时间正则本身足以提供空间平滑，配合线性 ramp-up 可在平滑动作的同时保住回报，因此不必依赖会牺牲性能的显式空间约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Continuous Memory Machines
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/continuous-memory-machines.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Continuous Memory Machine (CMM)，把循环状态拆成矩阵值的短期记忆（跟踪近期神经活动、供神经元级模型做计算）与持久长期记忆，由一个 Transformer 双向读写、同时更新两个记忆库。在算法、上下文学习与循环推理任务上超过一整套基线，泛化强于既有记忆增强网络，同时保留 CTM 的可解释注意力模式。
Motivation: RNN 把信息压进单一向量循环状态，短期计算与长期保留被迫共用同一表示；已有扩展只增加容量或分离时间尺度，缺少生物学中快速神经元级处理与较长保留并存的组合。
Method: 在 Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) 基础上引入矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态，各自承担不同功能角色：短期记忆跟踪近期神经活动，用独特参数化的 neuron-level models 学会利用这些活动模式做计算；持久长期记忆保存供后续使用的信息；一个 Transformer 联合更新两个记忆库，提供表达性强的双向 read-write 机制，使每个库能重组自身内容并互相读写。
Result: 在算法任务、上下文学习 (in-context learning) 与循环推理 (recurrent reasoning) 三类任务上，CMM 超过一整套基线 (a broad suite of baselines)，泛化能力强于此前的记忆增强网络，并保留 CTM 的可解释注意力模式。
Conclusion: 把短期与长期记忆拆成功能分工的矩阵状态并用 Transformer 双向读写，可以在循环架构中同时获得快速神经元级计算与长期保留，且不牺牲可解释性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations
papers.abstract_en: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk. These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文指出潜表征即使各向同性 (isotropic)、与目标完美一致，也可能完全不含有序目标信息，据此提出非自回归框架 CANOPE（有序 latent canvases + canonical-token 监督 + 几何正则）。在 40,000 条验证序列上，latent-agreement (PL0) 与 token-grounded (PL2) 的 pooled rank 几乎相同，但位置 Recall@1 分别为 13.5% 与 98.8%；LJSpeech 上冻结 PL2 接 MatchaTTS 读出 WER 21.54%，PL0 为 99.22%，端到端 MatchaTTS 为 10.93%。结论是几何规整性本身不保证可恢复的序列内容。
Motivation: 潜表征常被当作已编码了输入中的信息，但一致性和各向同性可能掩盖有序目标信息的完全丢失，且 rank 等几何指标无法判定下游可读性。
Method: 用信息论分解拆开输入歧义、表征损失与读出失配；构造 recoverable views 使完美一致与联合各向同性高斯共存而目标信息为零，并给出确定性 canonical anchor 的限制；以 token log-loss 作单侧信息损失上界，用固定惩罚 ridge 分析说明 rank 不足以决定预测风险；据此设计 CANOPE：有序 latent canvases、canonical-token 监督与几何正则的非自回归框架。
Result: 40,000 条验证序列上，PL0 与 PL2 pooled rank 几乎一致，但在给定正确目标长度、强自然扰动下位置 Recall@1 分别为 13.5% 与 98.8%。3,930 条 LJSpeech 验证语句上，冻结 PL2 接训练好的 MatchaTTS 读出在扰动文本上 WER 21.54%，冻结 PL0 为 99.22%，端到端 MatchaTTS 为 10.93%。
Conclusion: 在所研究的文本设定中，几何规整性本身不保证可恢复的序列内容或有效的下游访问；token 监督的读出路径才是可解码性的关键。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: ApexQuant: Data-Free Elastic Quantization by Residual Re-Isotropization
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ApexQuant, a calibration-free quantization method that recursively re-quantizes the residual error, serving as a refinement layer on top of existing quantizers. We establish that a fresh random rotation returns each residual to the uniform distribution on the hypersphere, which characterizes the rate of progressive error decay across successive passes. This result lets us determine, before any weight is read, how many passes a layer needs for a target weight-space error. Every prefix is itself a valid lower-rate model, so one artifact serves several precisions. We instantiate ApexQuant with three interchangeable stages, scalar, $E_8$ and trellis, and validate it on four open-weight LLMs and on Earth-observation and medical domains where in-distribution data is often unattainable as imagery arrives under restrictive licences or due to patient material under privacy constraints. Progressive re-isotropization comes within a few percent of full precision at four bits and gives the best two-bit arm we measure, in a completely data-free setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ApexQuant 是免校准 (calibration-free) 的数据无关量化方法，把量化后的残差误差递归地重新量化，并证明每次新随机旋转会把残差恢复为超球面上的均匀分布，从而在读取任何权重之前就能算出某层达到目标权重空间误差所需的 pass 数。每个前缀本身是合法的低码率模型，一个 artifact 覆盖多种精度；在四个开源 LLM 及地球观测、医学域上，4 bit 距全精度仅几个百分点，2 bit 是所测最好的 arm。
Motivation: 现有量化通常需要校准数据，而在地球观测（许可受限）和医学（隐私约束）场景中分布内数据往往拿不到，量化精度与所需 pass 数也无法事先确定。
Method: 在既有量化器之上加一层 refinement：递归对残差误差重新量化，用随机旋转使残差重新各向同性 (re-isotropization) 并据此推导误差衰减速率；三个可互换 stage——scalar、E8、trellis——实例化整个流程，且完全不读数据。
Result: 在四个开源 LLM 以及 Earth-observation 与 medical 域上验证：4 bit 下 progressive re-isotropization 距全精度仅几个百分点 (within a few percent of full precision)，2 bit 为其所测最好的 arm，全部在 completely data-free 的设定下取得。
Conclusion: 随机旋转带来的残差各向同性使量化 pass 数可在读权重前确定，且数据无关量化能同时覆盖多个码率——一个 artifact 即可服务多种精度。

papers.title: Unsupervised Long-Tailed Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Adapting vision-language models to downstream tasks has achieved remarkable success by leveraging pseudo-labels generated from unlabeled data. Existing methods typically assume a uniform unlabeled data distribution, and thus the resulting pseudo-label distribution is likewise uniform. However, real-world data distributions are often long-tailed. To tackle this, we formalize a new scenario termed Unsupervised Long-Tailed Adaptation (ULTA). Under this scenario, existing methods exhibit a contrasting phenomenon: head-class performance drops sharply, which is distinct from supervised long-tailed learning where tail classes suffer the most. In particular, we uncover that the distributional mismatch not only erodes head-class boundaries, but also pushes head samples into confusable classes, reinforcing the model's inherent bias. To address these issues, we propose a novel model called Margin-Aware Refinement with Structural alignment (MARS). Specifically, we mitigate head-class boundary erosion via Boundary-Preserving Alignment, which takes the zero-shot VLM as a fixed visual reference to suppress probability increases that lack visual support in the training targets. Building upon this, we introduce Margin-aware Self-Refinement, which employs a dynamic adjustment strategy to refine tail and confusable classes while preventing prediction bias. Extensive experiments on nine benchmark datasets demonstrate that MARS outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 4.71 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无监督长尾适配 (ULTA) 场景与模型 MARS：用 Boundary-Preserving Alignment 以零样本 VLM 作固定视觉参照，抑制训练目标中缺乏视觉支撑的概率上升，缓解头类边界侵蚀；再用 Margin-aware Self-Refinement 动态修正尾类与易混淆类。九个基准数据集上平均准确率比现有最先进方法高 4.71 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有无监督适配方法假设未标注数据均匀分布，而真实数据常呈长尾；在该设定下头类性能急剧下滑，与有监督长尾学习中尾类受损的常见现象相反。
Method: 形式化 ULTA 场景并分析分布失配机制：失配既侵蚀头类边界，又把头类样本推入易混淆类，强化模型固有偏置。MARS 含两部分——Boundary-Preserving Alignment 以零样本 VLM 为固定视觉参照约束训练目标，Margin-aware Self-Refinement 用动态调整策略精修尾类与易混淆类并抑制预测偏置。
Result: 在九个基准数据集上，MARS 平均准确率较现有最先进方法提升 4.71 个百分点。
Conclusion: 无监督长尾适配中受损最重的是头类而非尾类，用零样本 VLM 作视觉参照约束伪标签分布可同时保住头类边界并修正尾类与混淆类。

papers.title: IEEE 802.11bx - WLAN Intelligent Networking (WIN): Toward an AI-Ready Wi-Fi 9
papers.abstract_en: Wi-Fi 9 is expected to go beyond mere communication and provide new services such as sensing or computation. At this juncture, Artificial Intelligence (AI) is taking a leading role in the definition of the 802.11bx amendment, named WLAN Intelligent Networking (WIN). In this tutorial, we survey the recent progress made toward Wi-Fi 9 within IEEE 802.11 standardization, tracing the drivers and technological advances that motivate an AI-ready Wi-Fi 9. We then examine AI's role along three complementary dimensions, i.e., AI as a protocol (AI is applied to Wi-Fi's PHY/MAC operation), AI as a platform (Wi-Fi infrastructure is repurposed to provide AI computation), and AI as traffic (AI flows call for new traffic-handling policies), and discuss candidate features and open challenges along each. As a concrete illustration of the AI as traffic paradigm, we present a case study on AI traffic differentiation, where we explore a potential extension of the current Enhanced Distributed Channel Access (EDCA) to support new AI traffic flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇 tutorial 综述 IEEE 802.11bx（WLAN Intelligent Networking, WIN）标准化进展，把 AI 在 Wi-Fi 9 中的角色拆成三层：AI as protocol（AI 直接参与 PHY/MAC 操作）、AI as platform（Wi-Fi 基础设施被改用来提供 AI 算力）、AI as traffic（AI 流量需要新的流量处理策略）。作为 AI as traffic 的具体例证，作者给出 AI 流量差异化案例研究，探索扩展 Enhanced Distributed Channel Access (EDCA) 以承载新的 AI 流量流。
Motivation: Wi-Fi 9 预期超越纯通信、提供感知与计算等新服务，而 AI 正在主导 802.11bx 修订的定义；标准化需要一个统一框架来梳理 AI 进入 Wi-Fi 的不同路径及其开放挑战。
Method: 以 tutorial/综述形式追踪 IEEE 802.11 标准化中面向 Wi-Fi 9 的近期进展与驱动因素，沿 AI as protocol、AI as platform、AI as traffic 三个互补维度分别讨论候选特性与开放挑战；并以 AI traffic differentiation 案例研究具体展示扩展 EDCA 支持新 AI 流量流的可能方案。
Result: 给出三层分析框架（AI as protocol / platform / traffic）及各维度的候选特性与开放挑战，并呈现一个探索 EDCA 扩展以支持 AI 流量流的案例研究；摘要中无定量指标。
Conclusion: AI-ready Wi-Fi 9 应同时从协议内智能、平台化算力、AI 流量处理三条线推进，其中 AI 流量差异化需要 MAC 层接入机制（如 EDCA）的相应扩展。

papers.title: Variance-Averse $n$-Step Offline Reinforcement Learning for Sparse Long-Horizon Environments
papers.abstract_en: Generative actors are transforming offline reinforcement learning (RL) by enabling expressive policy classes that model complex action distributions. However, this expressiveness also exposes a key challenge in heterogeneous datasets: generative policies can reproduce unreliable action modes whose return distributions exhibit high variance, occasionally yielding high returns by chance but lacking consistency. Consequently, maximizing the expected $Q$-value alone is insufficient for identifying reliable actions. We propose VAN-Flow (Variance-Averse $n$-step Flow), a framework that promotes reliable actions in generative offline RL. VAN-Flow combines (i) a categorical distributional critic, (ii) a variance-averse expectation operator that smoothly reweights atom probabilities to favor actions with both high returns and low dispersion, and (iii) a flow-matching generative actor guided via rejection sampling. Unlike CVaR or mean-variance objectives, the operator redistributes probability mass over the categorical return distribution without hard truncation or auxiliary penalty terms. Across more than 40 tasks from D4RL and OGBench, VAN-Flow consistently outperforms strong baselines, with the largest gains in long-horizon and high-variance regimes where reliable action selection becomes critical.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VAN-Flow 针对离线强化学习中生成式策略会复现高方差、不可靠动作模式的问题，用类别分布式 critic 加方差厌恶期望算子重分配回报分布的原子概率，再以 flow-matching 生成 actor 配合拒绝采样筛选动作。在 D4RL 与 OGBench 共 40 多个任务上稳定超过强基线，长时域与高方差设定下提升最大。
Motivation: 异质离线数据集里生成式策略的表达力会复现回报分布方差很高的动作模式，偶尔靠运气拿到高回报但不稳定，只最大化期望 Q 值不足以识别可靠动作。
Method: 三部分组合：类别分布式 critic (categorical distributional critic)、方差厌恶期望算子 (variance-averse expectation operator) 平滑重加权原子概率以偏好高回报且低离散度的动作，以及由拒绝采样引导的 flow-matching 生成 actor；与 CVaR 或 mean-variance 目标不同，该算子在类别回报分布上重分配概率质量，不做硬截断也不加辅助惩罚项。
Result: 在 D4RL 与 OGBench 的 40 多个任务上，VAN-Flow 持续优于强基线，增益在长时域与高方差设定下最大。
Conclusion: 在生成式离线 RL 中，识别可靠动作需要同时看回报水平与其离散度，方差厌恶的分布式期望比单看期望 Q 更有效，尤其在长时域高方差场景。
Relevance: 0
