papers.title: FC-SWE: Failure-Conditioned RL for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract_en: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) is a challenging long-horizon setting: agents must reason over extended interactions, use tools, and adapt to stateful environments. Recent work trains SWE agents with reinforcement learning methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which independently sample multiple trajectories per issue, test the resulting patches, and compare terminal rewards within a fixed group. However, this training setup does not reuse verifier feedback from failed patches as context for subsequent attempts, even though this feedback contains valuable diagnostic information about what went wrong. Training on recovery trajectories is challenging because the preceding outcome determines whether the next trajectory is generated, while the failed execution determines its conditioning context. We introduce FC-SWE, a failure-conditioned RL framework that incorporates recovery attempts into policy training. After a patch fails verification, FC-SWE restores the repository to its original task state and uses the failed patch and verifier feedback as context for a recovery trajectory. FC-SWE adapts GRPO to these chains of complete, multi-turn tool-use trajectories through two mechanisms. Trajectory-local rewards preserve each attempt's verifier outcome, preventing recovery success from rewarding an earlier failed patch. Active-set advantage estimation forms a comparison group from all initial and recovery trajectories actually executed for the same issue, so failed attempts remain in the group while unexecuted attempts are excluded. On all 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks under a verifier-assisted protocol, FC-SWE with Qwen3.5-4B and SWE-agent achieves 41.7% Resolved@1 and 52.8% Resolved@2, compared with 38.9% and 48.5% for GRPO. Although trained with at most two attempts per chain, FC-SWE reaches 70.7% Resolved@11 under an eleven-attempt test-time budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FC-SWE 把失败补丁与 verifier 反馈作为上下文，让策略在恢复轨迹上继续训练：补丁验证失败后还原仓库状态，用失败补丁加 verifier 反馈生成恢复轨迹，并用轨迹局部奖励与 active-set 优势估计改造 GRPO。在全部 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上，Qwen3.5-4B + SWE-agent 的 Resolved@1 达 41.7%、Resolved@2 达 52.8%，对比 GRPO 的 38.9% 与 48.5%；训练时每条链最多两次尝试，测试时 11 次预算下 Resolved@11 为 70.7%。
Motivation: GRPO 对每个 issue 独立采样多条轨迹、只在固定组内比较终局奖励，失败补丁的 verifier 反馈被丢弃，无法作为后续尝试的上下文；而恢复轨迹的生成取决于前一次结果、其条件上下文又由失败执行决定，直接在其上训练会破坏组内比较。
Method: FC-SWE 在补丁验证失败后将仓库还原到原始任务状态，把失败补丁与 verifier 反馈拼成上下文生成恢复轨迹；对 GRPO 做两处改造：轨迹局部奖励保留每次尝试各自的 verifier 结果，避免恢复成功反过来奖励先前失败补丁；active-set 优势估计把同一 issue 实际执行过的全部初始与恢复轨迹组成比较组，保留失败尝试、排除未执行尝试。
Result: 在全部 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务、verifier-assisted 协议下，FC-SWE（Qwen3.5-4B + SWE-agent）Resolved@1 41.7%、Resolved@2 52.8%，GRPO 分别为 38.9% 与 48.5%；训练时每条链最多两次尝试，测试时十一尝试预算下 FC-SWE Resolved@11 达 70.7%。
Conclusion: 把失败执行的 verifier 反馈作为恢复轨迹的条件上下文并纳入策略训练，可以在同一模型与工具栈上抬高仓库级 SWE 任务的解决率，且训练时的短链尝试能外推到更长的测试时尝试预算。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 在全部 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务、verifier-assisted 协议下，FC-SWE（Qwen3.5-4B + SWE-agent）Resolved@1 41.7%、Resolved@2 52.8%，GRPO 分别为 38.9% 与 48.5%；训练时每条链最多两次尝试，测试时十一尝试预算下 FC-SWE Resolved@11 达 70.7%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把失败执行的 verifier 反馈作为恢复轨迹的条件上下文并纳入策略训练，可以在同一模型与工具栈上抬高仓库级 SWE 任务的解决率，且训练时的短链尝试能外推到更长的测试时尝试预算。

papers.title: Textual Environmental Context and Spatial Graphs for LLM-Based Regional SST Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Sea surface temperature (SST) forecasting depends on local temporal persistence, regional spatial dependence, and environmental conditions that evolve with the forecast date. We study how these heterogeneous conditions can be presented to a large language model (LLM) for regional multi-step forecasting without serializing the full SST grid as text. We formulate forecasting as conditional numerical generation: historical SST and anomaly sequences, date-aligned environmental records, and static ocean knowledge form a textual context, while regional spatial state is supplied through continuous graph-derived prefixes. A static graph encodes persistent geographic--climatological relations, and a dynamic graph encodes recent SST correlations and localized tropical-cyclone influence. Two graph neural networks produce a target-node representation that is mapped by a spatial-prefix fusion and injected into the LLM input. On SST forecasting in the South China Sea, the complete configuration achieves the best MAE and $\Rtwo$ among the compared methods over ten forecast steps. Alongside the numerical forecast, a rule-based module matches predicted trends and environmental-factor directions with knowledge entries to return source-linked, post-hoc contextual explanations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把南海海表温度 (SST) 多步预报表述为条件数值生成：历史 SST 与异常序列、按日期对齐的环境记录、静态海洋知识拼成文本上下文，区域空间状态则以连续图前缀注入 LLM，避免把整个 SST 网格序列化成文本。静态图编码地理-气候学关系，动态图编码近期 SST 相关与局地热带气旋影响，两个 GNN 产出目标节点表征经空间前缀融合送入 LLM。在南海 SST 预报上，完整配置在十个预报步长内取得所比较方法中最好的 MAE 与 R²。
Motivation: SST 预报同时依赖局地时间持续性、区域空间依赖和随预报日期演变的环境条件，把这些异构条件交给 LLM 时若直接序列化整张 SST 网格为文本会不可行。
Method: 条件数值生成框架：文本上下文由历史 SST 与异常序列、按日期对齐的环境记录、静态海洋知识构成；空间状态用静态图（地理-气候学关系）与动态图（近期 SST 相关、局地热带气旋影响）各接一个 GNN，产出目标节点表征，经 spatial-prefix fusion 映射后注入 LLM 输入。另配规则模块，把预测趋势与环境因子方向同知识条目匹配，返回带来源的事后解释。
Result: 在南海 SST 预报上，完整配置在所比较方法中、覆盖十个预报步长取得最佳 MAE 与 R²。
Conclusion: 文本环境上下文加连续图前缀的组合能让 LLM 做区域多步 SST 数值预报，且完整配置（静态图+动态图+文本上下文）优于各消融比较；预测可附带来源可溯的事后解释。

papers.title: Rethinking Faithfulness in LLMs: A Pairwise Context-Sensitive Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are expected to answer questions faithfully based on the provided context, abstaining when the context information is insufficient to answer the questions. Existing faithfulness evaluations typically assess each question-context instance in isolation; however, such instance-level evaluation fails to capture a fundamental requirement of faithful behavior: the ability to adapt model responses to changes in available contexts. In particular, a model should provide correct answers when sufficient evidence is present and abstain when it is not. In this work, we propose a Pairwise Faithfulness Benchmark (PFaithBench) that evaluates whether a model can switch between answering and abstaining for the same question under supporting versus non-supporting contexts. Our evaluations across thirty-nine models with seven model families demonstrate that faithfulness fundamentally involves a trade-off between answering and abstaining, and that most current models exhibit a strong bias toward answering, with most faithfulness errors arising from over-answering, i.e., models tend to fabricate a response even when the provided context is insufficient. We further conduct a series of studies on faithfulness training under different data constructions. Our results show that training outcomes are highly sensitive to the specific composition of answering and abstaining data. Constructing answering and abstaining data from mismatched sources can cause models to rely on dataset-specific shortcuts rather than actual context sufficiency. Moreover, increasing answer-supervised data improves answering performance but exacerbates over-answering, while increasing abstaining data reduces hallucination but leads to over-abstention. The code and data are released at https://github.com/tmlr-group/PFaithBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出成对忠实性基准 PFaithBench：对同一问题分别给支持性与非支持性上下文，检验模型能否在作答与弃答之间切换。在 39 个模型、7 个模型家族上评测显示忠实性本质是作答与弃答的权衡，多数模型强烈偏向作答，忠实性错误主要来自上下文不足时仍编造回答；训练结果对作答/弃答数据配比高度敏感，增加答案监督数据提升作答表现但加剧 over-answering，增加弃答数据减少幻觉却导致 over-abstention。
Motivation: 现有忠实性评测把每个问题-上下文实例孤立评估，无法刻画随上下文变化调整回答这一根本要求：证据充分时应作答、不足时应弃答。
Method: 提出 Pairwise Faithfulness Benchmark (PFaithBench)，对同一问题构造 supporting 与 non-supporting 上下文成对评测模型在作答与弃答间的切换能力；另做一系列不同数据构造下的忠实性训练研究，考察作答/弃答数据配比与来源匹配的影响。
Result: 在 39 个模型、7 个模型家族上评测：忠实性涉及作答与弃答的根本权衡，多数模型强烈偏向作答，多数忠实性错误来自 over-answering（上下文不足仍编造回答）。训练研究显示结果对作答与弃答数据的具体配比高度敏感；从不匹配来源构造数据会让模型依赖数据集特定捷径而非真实上下文充分性；增加答案监督数据提升作答表现但加剧 over-answering，增加弃答数据减少幻觉但导致 over-abstention。
Conclusion: 忠实性不能靠孤立实例评测或单向增加某类监督数据解决：模型需在上下文充分性上做权衡，数据构造的来源匹配与作答/弃答配比直接决定训练出的是真判断还是捷径。代码与数据已发布于 github.com/tmlr-group/PFaithBench。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Visual Abstention in Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate understanding and generation, yet their generative behavior is rarely governed by what they understand about the task. We formalize visual abstention: when a requested visual transformation is impossible under the task's rules, the model should recognize that no valid solution exists, state this, and decline to generate. We introduce Draw-or-Decline (DoD), a benchmark of 1,050 feasible-infeasible request pairs across 7 task categories that jointly measures editing success and the refusal of infeasible requests. Evaluating 8 UMMs, we find that editing ability and abstention are distinct capabilities: even the strongest editor, at 68.4% editing accuracy, refuses only 0.4% of infeasible requests under ordinary instructions. Their reasoning shows why: the models rarely notice the conflict, and instead plan the edit as if the request were possible, often describing objects that are not in the image, or quietly change the request into one they can complete. Explicitly prompting these UMMs to report infeasibility increases textual refusals but reduces editing accuracy. We propose VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention), a training method that pairs feasible and infeasible examples so that a model judges feasibility before deciding whether to generate. We train VisTA-BAGEL to perform feasible edits and decline infeasible requests. Without any reminder, it refuses 93.0% of infeasible requests, up from 0.4% for the strongest editor, while falsely refusing only 0.8% of feasible ones. Unlike a reminder, this does not cost editing accuracy: VisTA-BAGEL completes 74.3% of feasible edits, more than any of the 8 evaluated UMMs.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables. Project page: https://visual-abstention.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把视觉编辑中的“不可行请求识别”形式化为 visual abstention，并提出配对可行/不可行样本的训练方法 VisTA，让模型先判可行性再决定是否生成。在 1,050 对请求的 Draw-or-Decline 基准上，VisTA-BAGEL 无提醒拒答 93.0% 不可行请求（最强编辑器仅 0.4%），误拒仅 0.8%，可行编辑完成率 74.3%，高于所评 8 个 UMM。
Motivation: 统一多模态模型 (UMM) 的生成行为很少受其任务理解约束：面对规则上不可行的视觉变换，模型不会拒绝而是照常规划编辑，甚至编造图中不存在的对象或悄悄改写请求。
Method: 提出 Draw-or-Decline (DoD) 基准，含 1,050 个可行-不可行请求对、7 个任务类别，联合度量编辑成功与拒答；并提出 VisTA (Visual Transformation and Abstention) 训练方法，配对可行与不可行样本，让模型先判可行性再决定是否生成，训练出 VisTA-BAGEL。
Result: 评测 8 个 UMM：最强编辑器编辑准确率 68.4%，但在普通指令下仅拒答 0.4% 不可行请求；显式提示报告不可行会提高文本拒答却降低编辑准确率。VisTA-BAGEL 无提醒拒答 93.0% 不可行请求（对比 0.4%），误拒仅 0.8% 可行请求，完成 74.3% 可行编辑，超过 8 个被评 UMM 中的任何一个。
Conclusion: 编辑能力与弃答 (abstention) 是两种可分离的能力，可通过配对可行性样本的训练同时获得，而不必像显式提醒那样以牺牲编辑准确率为代价。

papers.title: ShanLiangRen: A Nutrition Agent for Personalized Daily Meal Planning
papers.abstract_en: Dietary nutrition planning plays an important role in chronic disease management and maintaining a healthy body. In applications, it must simultaneously satisfy personalized constraints and reasonable multidimensional nutritional goals. These two aspects often conflict, and user constraints evolve with feedback, resulting in a substantial gap between generic guidelines and executable plans. To bridge this gap, we first propose the personalized fully quantified multiobjective dietary planning problem (MDP). To tackle MDP, we develop a nutrition agent, ShanLiangRen. The system first transforms dietary specifications, nutrient data, user attributes and natural language requirements into an individualized constrained planning instance. It then employs an exact retrieval-augmented generation method to shrink the feasible candidate set from a large scale ingredient and recipe space. Finally, it adopts a refinement guided by Pareto principles, where an LLM iteratively revises candidate plans under deterministic nutrition computation and feedback from constraint verification. The system outputs fully quantified meal plans with explicit ingredients and portion sizes, together with reports on nutrition compliance that show constraint satisfaction and nutrient interval attainment. We have released the system online as a WeChat Program, ShanLiangRen. A demo video is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=652OtY5VlGA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题 (MDP) 与营养智能体 ShanLiangRen：把膳食规范、营养数据、用户属性和自然语言需求转成受约束规划实例，用精确检索增强生成 (RAG) 缩小食材与菜谱候选集，再由 LLM 在确定性营养计算与约束校验反馈下按 Pareto 原则迭代修订方案。输出带明确食材与份量的全量化餐单及营养合规报告，已上线为微信小程序。
Motivation: 通用膳食指南与可执行餐单之间存在明显落差：个性化约束与多维营养目标相互冲突，且用户约束随反馈不断演化，难以直接生成满足条件的具体方案。
Method: 三段式流程：先将膳食规格、营养数据、用户属性与自然语言要求转化为个体化受约束规划实例；再用精确检索增强生成在大规模食材与菜谱空间中收缩可行候选集；最后以 Pareto 原则引导 LLM 在确定性营养计算和约束校验反馈下迭代修订候选方案。
Result: 系统输出全量化餐单（明确食材与份量）并生成营养合规报告，展示约束满足与营养区间达成情况；已作为微信小程序 ShanLiangRen 上线，并提供演示视频。
Conclusion: 把个性化膳食规划形式化为 MDP 并用精确 RAG 加 Pareto 式 LLM 修订求解，可产出可执行且可核查营养合规性的餐单。

papers.title: Label-Efficient Deep Learning for ECG Delineation: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark against Widely Used Delineation Tools
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiogram (ECG) delineation, the identification of waveform boundaries, is a foundational step that translates raw ECG signals into clinically interpretable measurements. Deep learning has advanced this task but remains dependent on costly expert annotations. Label-efficient strategies such as self-supervised pretraining and semi-supervised learning are expected to ease this burden, yet it remains unclear whether they yield reliable delineation and whether the deep models they produce outperform the delineation tools used in practice. We address this in two stages. First, comparing self-supervised objectives with supervised or semi-supervised fine-tuning across one internal and four external datasets, we find that pretraining helps but the objective matters, and that the value of semi-supervised fine-tuning depends on the pretraining objective. Second, we benchmark the selected deep learning model against widely used open-source (NeuroKit2, Prominence, ECGdeli) and commercial (CalECG) tools using three complementary metrics. The model ranks best on every metric and dataset, outperforming the strongest tool by a clear margin on the rhythm-diverse set (mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%; averaged point-wise sensitivity 92.6 vs. 76.4%), and degrades the least from sinus to arrhythmia. A rhythm-stratified and point-wise analysis further characterizes the distinctive behavior of each tool, yielding practical guidance for tool selection. These results provide systematic, multi-dataset evidence that self-supervised pretraining is effective for ECG delineation and enables a label-efficiently trained deep learning model to outperform widely used delineation tools by leveraging abundant unlabeled data. This supports adopting such models in diverse, real-world clinical settings.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. First two authors contributed equally

papers.title: Learned Adaptive Multiresolution Diffusion Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive multiresolution methods reduce representation cost by concentrating fine-scale degrees of freedom where needed, but their tree updates are usually governed by fixed local criteria. We introduce Learned Adaptive Multiresolution Diffusion Imaging (Learned AMDI), which preserves the AMDI fixed-tree propagator and hierarchy constraints while replacing the post-propagation selector with a shared local policy trained by proximal policy optimization. Regression tests reproduce deterministic AMDI trajectories to machine precision when identical trees are used. In the Haar implementation studied here, the deterministic one-step selector accepts no refinements in 54 decisions. Across nine held-out cases, Learned AMDI executes 393 refinements and reduces the mean terminal reference discrepancy from $0.17496$ to $0.13657$, while occupancy rises from $0.13737$ to $0.26660$. Step-resolved diagnostics reveal occasional small adaptation-energy increases; fixed-tree energy stability therefore does not guarantee monotonicity of the learned outer iteration. At comparable occupancy, a validation-tuned observed-detail threshold reaches a discrepancy of $0.13792$ with slightly better RMSE and SSIM, placing both methods on essentially the same accuracy--occupancy tradeoff. A decision-1-only control reaches $0.13742$, indicating that most of the improvement on this static benchmark arises from the initial allocation. The shared actor transfers without retraining to $64\times64$ and $128\times128$ images, improving reference discrepancy, RMSE, and SSIM relative to deterministic AMDI, while the frozen threshold rule remains competitive. Learned AMDI thus provides a hierarchy-constrained, resolution-transferable mechanism for adaptive allocation and clarifies the contribution of sequential decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Learned AMDI 用近端策略优化 (PPO) 训练的共享局部策略替换自适应多分辨率扩散成像 (AMDI) 的传播后固定选择器，保留固定树传播子与层次约束。在九个留出案例上执行 393 次细化，平均终端参考偏差从 0.17496 降到 0.13657，但占用率从 0.13737 升到 0.26660；与验证调优的 observed-detail 阈值 (0.13792) 相比处于同一精度-占用权衡上，且大部分改进来自第 1 步的初始分配。
Motivation: 自适应多分辨率方法靠树更新节省表示开销，但树更新通常由固定局部准则决定，缺少可学习、可跨分辨率迁移的分配机制。
Method: 保留 AMDI 的固定树传播子与层次约束，用 PPO 训练的共享局部策略取代传播后选择器；Haar 实现，先做相同树下的确定性轨迹回归测试，再在九个留出案例上运行，并与验证调优的 observed-detail 阈值及 decision-1-only 控制对比，逐步诊断 adaptation energy。
Result: Haar 实现中确定性单步选择器在 54 次决策里不接受任何细化；九个留出案例上 Learned AMDI 执行 393 次细化，均值终端参考偏差 0.17496 → 0.13657，占用率 0.13737 → 0.26660；同占用率下阈值规则偏差 0.13792 且 RMSE、SSIM 略好；decision-1-only 控制达 0.13742；共享 actor 无需重训练迁移到 64×64 与 128×128 图像，相对确定性 AMDI 改善偏差、RMSE 与 SSIM。
Conclusion: 学习到的顺序选择在该静态基准上的收益主要来自初始分配，固定树能量稳定并不保证外层迭代单调；Learned AMDI 提供层次受约束、可跨分辨率迁移的自适应分配机制，与调优阈值规则处在基本相同的精度-占用权衡上。

papers.title: Revar3r: gauge-aware perturbation uncertainty for feed-forward 3d reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: A correctly reconstructed distant point appears uncertain even when a frozen 3D model processes equivalent inputs because its output frame rotates fractionally. This exposes a weakness of trainingfree perturbation uncertainty: when outputs contain an unobserved symmetry, run-to-run variation potentially reflects symmetry rather than error. Existing alternatives have trade-offs: built-in confidence is outperformed in most evaluated conditions, while trained evidential heads require modelspecific supervision. For point maps, this research derives a closed-form, error-independent variance term that grows with scene extent and potentially overwhelms the desired signal. Simulation reproduces the effect; all 30 real VGGT view-sets tested exhibit its predicted $\|x_p\|^2$ signature. ReVar3R robustly registers predictions to a common similarity frame before computing per-point variance, without retraining or modifying the frozen model. Optional calibration and fusion use a held-out split. Across VGGT, π3, and MASt3R on six datasets, the same estimator on every backbone lowers AUSE below built-in confidence in 15 of 18 conditions. The staged evaluation yields 11 of 18 wins for the label-free core, 12/18 for label-free equal-weight fusion, 14/18 with held-out weights, and 15/18 when the built-in signal is included. Against a trained evidential head, the result is a trade-off: the head calibrates magnitude better and leads in its training domain, whereas ReVar3R transfers across backbones without adaptation. Its ranking improves point filtering, but it does not detect stable systematic bias, aid novel-view synthesis, or transfer calibration across domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReVar3R 指出训练无关的扰动不确定性在 3D 点图上会被输出坐标系的微小旋转对称性污染，因此先将预测配准到统一 similarity frame 再逐点算方差，无需重训或改动冻结模型。在 VGGT、π3、MASt3R 三个 backbone 与六个数据集的 18 个条件中，同一估计器使 AUSE 低于内置置信度的条件数从 11/18（无标签核心）提升到 15/18（纳入内置信号）。
Motivation: 冻结 3D 模型对等价输入的输出帧会微小旋转，使远处正确重建点也显得不确定；训练无关的扰动不确定性把这种未观测对称性当成误差，而内置置信度多数条件下更差、训练式 evidential head 又需要模型专属监督。
Method: 先对预测做鲁棒的 similarity frame 配准再计算逐点方差；推导出点图上与误差无关、随场景范围增长的闭式方差项；可选校准与融合使用 held-out split，核心估计器无需标签。
Result: 仿真复现了该方差效应，VGGT 上全部 30 个真实 view-set 都呈现预测的 ‖x_p‖² 特征；六个数据集、三个 backbone 的 18 个条件中，AUSE 低于内置置信度的条件数为：无标签核心 11/18、无标签等权融合 12/18、held-out 权重 14/18、纳入内置信号 15/18。与训练式 evidential head 相比是权衡：head 在其训练域内幅值校准更好并领先，ReVar3R 则跨 backbone 免适配迁移。
Conclusion: 先消除输出对称性再算扰动方差，可以在不重训的前提下跨 backbone 改善点不确定性排序与点过滤；但它检测不到稳定系统偏差、无助于 novel-view synthesis，校准也不能跨域迁移。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自参照社会偏好 (self-referenced social preferences)：每个智能体只学自己的奖励模型，把它套到他人观测到的转移上、从自身视角评估对方结果，再喂进标准社会偏好，从而在不观测他人奖励的情况下学出合作。在 Escape Room、Clean Up、Commons Harvest 三个序列社会困境中，该方法在独立学习者失败的设置里仍促成合作，并常比能拿到真实奖励的智能体给出更公平的收益分配。
Motivation: 现有基于社会偏好的多智能体合作方法要求观测同伴的奖励信号，而现实交互中通常只能看到对方行为与结果，拿不到其私有奖励。
Method: 每个智能体学习自身奖励模型，将其应用于他人观测到的转移以从自身视角评估结果，再把该评估接入社会偏好；两种接入方式为修改学习奖励（reward together with value look-ahead）或用于加权策略更新 (policy-update weighting)，并在部分可观测设置下检验。
Result: 在三个序列社会困境 Escape Room（志愿行为）、Clean Up（公共品贡献）、Commons Harvest（资源克制）上，智能体在不观测他人奖励时学到合作行为，包括独立学习者无法合作的设置；相比拥有真实奖励访问权的智能体，常取得更公平的联合产出分配。不平等厌恶 (inequity aversion) 配合 value look-ahead 的奖励接入效果最好，纯善意 (benevolent) 偏好则受益于策略更新加权；部分可观测下策略更新方式仍支持合作。
Conclusion: 显式访问他人奖励信号对学习合作行为并非必需，社会偏好可以建立在由他人观测行为推导出的自参照结果评估上；最佳接入点取决于所用社会偏好的类型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: On-Policy Distillation with Negative-Policy Rollouts
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has been widely studied as a post-training method in which a student model obtains token-level supervision from a stronger teacher on its own rollouts. Recent studies have improved OPD through alternative distillation reward formulations and teacher configurations, while the objective of distillation remains centered on mimicking the teacher. However, when a stronger teacher has limited distributional overlap with the student, such positive guidance can provide insufficient learning signals. In this work, we introduce Negative-Policy OPD (NP-OPD), which complements teacher supervision with rollouts from a lower-performing, lower-capability negative policy that serves as a negative reference for the student. Rather than modifying the distillation reward formulation, NP-OPD introduces the negative policy at the rollout stage, continuously supplying tokens preferred by the negative policy over the teacher so that they remain exposed to teacher supervision throughout training. This provides an explicit negative signal through negative-policy rollouts while preserving the positive teacher supervision used in OPD. Through extensive experiments, we show that NP-OPD improves OPD across model scales, generation modes, reasoning domains, and different OPD variants. Furthermore, our analyses show that NP-OPD effectively suppresses tokens preferred by the negative policy over the teacher and moves the student away from the negative policy. These results support our design of introducing negative signals through negative-policy rollouts and provide new insight into the role of the rollout policy in OPD. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/np-opd.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Negative-Policy OPD (NP-OPD)：在 on-policy distillation 的 rollout 阶段引入一个表现更弱的 negative policy 作为负参考，持续产出它比教师更偏好的 token，让这些 token 全程暴露在教师监督下，从而在不改动蒸馏奖励形式的前提下补上正向信号。实验显示 NP-OPD 在不同模型规模、生成模式、推理领域和多种 OPD 变体上均带来提升，并有效压制 negative policy 偏好而教师不偏好的 token。
Motivation: 当更强教师与学生的分布重叠有限时，只模仿教师的正向引导提供的学习信号不足，OPD 收益受限。
Method: NP-OPD 不修改蒸馏奖励公式，而是在 rollout 阶段加入一个低表现、低能力的 negative policy：其 rollout 持续提供比教师更受 negative policy 偏好的 token，使这些 token 在训练全程都接受教师监督，同时保留 OPD 原有的正向教师监督。
Result: 在模型规模、生成模式、推理领域和不同 OPD 变体上，NP-OPD 均改进了 OPD；分析显示它有效抑制了 negative policy 相对教师更偏好的 token，并把学生推离 negative policy。
Conclusion: rollout policy 本身可以作为引入负信号的机制：用负策略 rollout 补充教师监督，比只改奖励形式更能缓解分布重叠不足时的信号匮乏。

papers.title: CueRator: Agentic Search for Symbolic Rules to Adapt Frozen Multimodal Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents have been used to search over symbolic structures such as programs and equations. We propose CueRator, an agentic framework for policy-aware decision-rule discovery, which adapts frozen contrastive multimodal encoders by searching for the decision rule that converts their cross-modal similarities into predictions. We validate it on open-vocabulary audio-visual event perception, where existing methods involve a trade-off between adaptivity and generalization to unseen categories: trained modules adapt at the cost of generalization, and fixed rules the reverse. The framework pairs a symbolic formulation for generalization with a lightweight policy that predicts its parameters per video for adaptivity. A report-guided multi-agent loop discovers the formulation offline, evaluating each candidate on its expressive ceiling and on whether a trained policy can realize it. On OV-AVEBench, CueRator raises the total average from 57.8 to 60.2 and unseen-category performance from 55.8 to 59.9 over the best existing method, reducing the seen-unseen gap from 7.1 to 1.2. Ablations attribute the gains to both the formulation and the policy and show that both feedback signals are necessary for effective search. CueRator also improves over the respective baselines on two further audio-visual event perception tasks, and the discovered rule remains competitive across encoders with only the policy retrained. Code is available at https://github.com/cvsp-lab/cuerator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CueRator 用 LLM agent 离线搜索把冻结对比多模态编码器的跨模态相似度转成预测的符号决策规则，再配一个按视频预测规则参数的轻量 policy，兼顾对未见类别的泛化与逐视频适应性。在 OV-AVEBench 上总平均从 57.8 提到 60.2，未见类从 55.8 提到 59.9，seen-unseen 差距从 7.1 收窄到 1.2。
Motivation: 开放词汇音视事件感知中，训练出来的适应模块牺牲未见类泛化，固定规则则相反，适应性与泛化之间存在此消彼长。
Method: 报告引导的多-agent 循环离线搜索符号规则形式，每个候选按其表达上限以及可否被训练出的 policy 实现两项反馈打分；policy 是轻量网络，逐视频预测该规则的参数，编码器保持冻结。
Result: OV-AVEBench 上总平均 57.8 → 60.2，未见类性能 55.8 → 59.9，seen-unseen 差距 7.1 → 1.2（对比最优已有方法）；消融显示形式与 policy 都带来增益、两个反馈信号缺一不可；在另外两个音视事件感知任务上也分别优于各自基线，且换编码器只重训 policy 后发现的规则仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 符号形式负责泛化、逐视频 policy 负责适应，两者配合可同时压低 seen-unseen 差距；搜索必须同时用表达上限和 policy 可实现性两个反馈。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ReFold: Training-Free Reversible Inter-Turn Context Folding for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents act on an append-only interaction history that is re-sent to the model at every step, so the context and its cost grow with steps until the sessions exceed the context window. Existing methods manage the context through context requirement prediction, relying on additional model calls, heuristic rules, or trained policies. However, these predictive approaches introduce runtime overhead, invalidate prefix caches, and permanently discard content with no guarantee of recovery. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ReFold: a training-free rendering layer that preserves the underlying interaction history while compressing only the model's rendered context. It removes two kinds of inter-turn redundancy without an auxiliary predictor: content an earlier turn already displayed, replaced by a stub, and turns the agent itself reports finished, folded into a one-line note. Both operators use chunked rendering, rewriting the cached prefix once every few steps rather than at every step. Every removal is strictly reversible, a wrong removal costs one restore from the history rather than permanent content loss. Because it operates at the rendering layer, ReFold is plug-and-play across standard ReAct-style harnesses. Evaluations across five long-horizon benchmarks and two frontier LLMs demonstrate that ReFold reduces token consumption by up to 2.5x and halves the KV-cache memory per session without degrading task success rates. Under capped context budgets, it avoids up to 92% of forced compactions. Under concurrent serving workloads, it reduces request queuing delays by up to 100%, accelerating inference by up to 1.7x, while cutting inference costs by up to 3.4x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReFold 是面向长程 LLM agent 的免训练渲染层：保留原始交互历史，只压缩送入模型的渲染上下文，把前轮已展示内容替换为 stub、把 agent 自报完成的轮次折叠成一行注释，两种操作都严格可逆，错误删除只需一次 restore。在五个长程基准与两个前沿 LLM 上，token 消耗最多降 2.5 倍、每会话 KV-cache 内存减半且任务成功率不降，上下文预算受限时避免最多 92% 的强制压缩。
Motivation: append-only 交互历史随步数增长直到超出上下文窗口；现有依赖额外模型调用、启发式规则或训练策略的上下文需求预测会带来运行时开销、破坏 prefix cache，且永久丢弃内容无法恢复。
Method: 在渲染层做可逆的轮间上下文折叠 (reversible inter-turn context folding)：一类冗余是前轮已显示的内容，替换为 stub；另一类是 agent 自报完成的轮次，折叠为一行注释。两种算子采用 chunked rendering，每隔若干步才重写一次缓存前缀；每次删除严格可逆，误删只需从历史恢复一次。作为即插即用层接入标准 ReAct 式框架，无需训练或辅助预测器。
Result: 在五个长程基准、两个前沿 LLM 上：token 消耗最多降至 1/2.5，每会话 KV-cache 内存减半，任务成功率不下降；在受限上下文预算下避免最多 92% 的强制 compaction；并发服务负载下请求排队延迟最多降低 100%，推理加速最多 1.7 倍，推理成本最多降至 1/3.4。
Conclusion: 上下文管理可以在渲染层完成而不必预测需求：保留完整历史、只折叠渲染结果并保证可逆，就能同时省 token、省内存、避免强制压缩并提升并发吞吐，且不牺牲任务成功率。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A self-learning scientific agent for X-ray diffraction
papers.abstract_en: A central challenge for scientific agents is to turn analytical experience into reusable expertise grounded in physical evidence. Here we introduce Gan Jiang, a self-learning agent for powder X-ray diffraction built on a diffraction-analysis ecosystem we developed: XMatcher, XQueryer, XDecomposer and WPEM. Together, these engines span phase identification, multiphase decomposition and physics-constrained whole-pattern modelling. Gan Jiang converts analytical experience into executable skills by diagnosing failures, revising skill instructions and code, and validating revisions before reuse, without retraining the language model or changing the underlying physical models. Skills selected using development data and frozen before held-out evaluation achieve higher refinement scores than the original expert-designed skills across FullProf, GSAS-II and PyWPEM. The agent resolves strongly overlapping reflections, quantifies a five-phase ancient Egyptian cosmetic, tracks lattice evolution in an operating battery and compares atomic configurations in a disordered oxide catalyst. On DeltaXRDbench, it leads the evaluated methods in single- and multiphase identification across simulated and experimental data. Without supplied composition, single-phase top-1 accuracies reach 96.30\%, 81.78\% and 40.83\% on MP500, RRUFF and opXRD, respectively, compared with 58.00\%, 58.47\% and 26.45\% for the strongest comparator. These results demonstrate how an integrated scientific tool ecosystem can support agents that extract structural knowledge from measurements while accumulating validated analytical expertise that transfers to new samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出自学习科学智能体 Gan Jiang，把粉末 X 射线衍射 (XRD) 分析经验固化为可执行技能：诊断失败、改写技能指令与代码、验证后再复用，不重训语言模型也不改物理模型。在 DeltaXRDbench 上其单相与多相识别领先被评方法，无成分先验时单相 top-1 在 MP500、RRUFF、opXRD 上分别达 96.30%、81.78%、40.83%，对照最强比较方法的 58.00%、58.47%、26.45%。
Motivation: 科学智能体难以把分析经验沉淀为可复用、可检验的专业能力；XRD 分析中强重叠衍射峰与多相分解依赖专家手工调参，经验难以迁移到新样品。
Method: 构建衍射分析生态 XMatcher、XQueryer、XDecomposer 与 WPEM，覆盖物相识别、多相分解与物理约束全谱建模；Gan Jiang 在其上以诊断失败、修订技能指令与代码、验证修订三步迭代技能，用开发数据选技能并在留出评测前冻结，底层物理模型与语言模型均不变。
Result: 冻结后的技能在 FullProf、GSAS-II、PyWPEM 上的 refinement score 均高于原始专家设计技能；在 DeltaXRDbench 的模拟与实验数据上单相与多相识别均领先被评方法；无给定成分时单相 top-1 准确率 MP500 96.30%、RRUFF 81.78%、opXRD 40.83%，最强比较方法为 58.00%、58.47%、26.45%。应用案例包括解析五相古埃及化妆品、追踪在役电池晶格演化、比较无序氧化物催化剂原子构型。
Conclusion: 集成的科学工具生态加自学习技能修订，能让智能体从测量中提取结构知识并在新样品上迁移已验证的分析经验，无需重训模型。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorkflowOps 让多智能体工作流编排层积累历史协作先验：用转移概率矩阵软引导 DAG 构建，用语义匹配触发按需新建智能体并同步注入协作矩阵，用分层语义匹配把 LLM 路由调用减少 80% 以上。在混合代码、数学与问答套件上端到端 pass 率高于近期工作流构建基线，收益集中在结构化、可分解且历史交接模式可迁移的任务上。
Motivation: 多智能体系统的编排层基本是无记忆的：每个新任务都从零分解、分配、执行，历史成功执行带来的协作经验无法复用。
Method: 三个耦合机制：转移概率矩阵记录历史工作流中智能体两两协作频率，通过层内排序优化、按概率阈值的边建议与传递归约 (transitive reduction) 最大化并行度，作为 DAG 构建的软引导；充分性驱动的智能体创建环用语义匹配分数检测能力缺口，由 LLM 生成专用智能体并同时注入协作矩阵，使新智能体立即带有预测的协作先验；分层语义匹配先用预训练 sentence embedding 做快速确定性匹配，仅对低置信样本调用 LLM 校验。
Result: 相比纯 LLM 路由方案，LLM 路由调用减少 80% 以上；在混合代码、数学与问答套件上端到端 pass 率高于近期工作流构建基线，最大增益出现在结构化、可分解且历史智能体交接模式可迁移的任务上。
Conclusion: 把历史协作先验与按需智能体创建耦合进编排层，可在降低 LLM 路由开销的同时提升端到端成功率，收益依赖任务的可分解性与历史模式的可迁移性。

summary_sections.motivation: 多智能体系统的编排层基本是无记忆的：每个新任务都从零分解、分配、执行，历史成功执行带来的协作经验无法复用。
summary_sections.method: 三个耦合机制：转移概率矩阵记录历史工作流中智能体两两协作频率，通过层内排序优化、按概率阈值的边建议与传递归约 (transitive reduction) 最大化并行度，作为 DAG 构建的软引导；充分性驱动的智能体创建环用语义匹配分数检测能力缺口，由 LLM 生成专用智能体并同时注入协作矩阵，使新智能体立即带有预测的协作先验；分层语义匹配先用预训练 sentence embedding 做快速确定性匹配，仅对低置信样本调用 LLM 校验。
summary_sections.result: 相比纯 LLM 路由方案，LLM 路由调用减少 80% 以上；在混合代码、数学与问答套件上端到端 pass 率高于近期工作流构建基线，最大增益出现在结构化、可分解且历史智能体交接模式可迁移的任务上。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把历史协作先验与按需智能体创建耦合进编排层，可在降低 LLM 路由开销的同时提升端到端成功率，收益依赖任务的可分解性与历史模式的可迁移性。

papers.title: Tram-FL: Reducing Communication and Computation Costs through Sequential Model Circulation in Decentralized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Conventional decentralized federated learning (DFL) often focuses on clients, with each client maintaining a model copy, performing updates individually, and undertaking model exchange and integration. While fully leveraging computational resources can shorten training times, it can also lead to significant computational and communication waste. This is especially pronounced with non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) data, where achieving high model accuracy demands extra resources. This research shifts focus to the model itself, aiming to realize DFL with minimal computation and communication costs. To this end, we propose Tram-FL (Traveling Model Training Mechanism for Decentralized Federated Learning), a mechanism designed to efficiently address these challenges. It sequentially trains a single model by circulating it among nodes. We address the training scheduling problem in model circulation-based training, specifically determining which nodes should update the model and the number of updates to perform. This is approached by considering the model's circulation route and update iteration allocation, for which we propose simple yet effective methods. Additionally, with quantized momentum, Tram-FL achieves high accuracy with fewer model circulations while controlling communication load per transmission. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm, even with non-IID data, converges to a global model with reduced communication and computation.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tram-FL 把去中心化联邦学习从「每个客户端各持一份模型」改为单模型在节点间顺序巡回训练，用巡回路线与更新迭代分配的调度方法决定哪些节点更新、更新几次，再配合量化动量 (quantized momentum) 在更少巡回次数内达到高精度并压低单次传输负载。实验显示该算法在 non-IID 数据下仍收敛到全局模型，同时降低通信与计算开销。
Motivation: DFL 中每个客户端各自维护模型副本、独立更新再交换整合，充分利用算力虽能缩短训练时间，却造成大量计算与通信浪费；non-IID 数据下要达到高精度还需额外资源。
Method: 提出 Tram-FL（Traveling Model Training Mechanism）：让单个模型在节点间巡回、顺序训练，针对模型巡回路线与更新迭代分配给出调度方法，决定参与更新的节点与更新次数；并引入 quantized momentum，以更少的模型巡回达到高精度，同时控制每次传输的通信负载。
Result: 实验结果显示，所提算法即使在 non-IID 数据下也收敛到全局模型，并减少通信与计算开销；quantized momentum 使模型以更少的巡回次数达到高精度，同时控制单次传输的通信负载。
Conclusion: 把 DFL 的优化对象从客户端转向模型本身，用单模型顺序巡回加调度与量化动量，可在 non-IID 条件下以更低通信与计算成本训练出全局模型。

papers.title: A Decision-Focused Neural Optimization Framework for Personalized Route Reproduction from Vehicle Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: This study formulates individual route reproduction as a shortest-path problem over learned driver-specific latent link costs. The central idea is that, once such latent costs are inferred from contextual information, observed routes can be reproduced without enumerating alternative route sets. We propose a neural pipeline that includes a perception model that embeds context covariates, which comprises individual characteristics, trip-specific attributes, and network-level traffic states, into the personalized link costs. A constrained optimization (CO) layer, which determines the shortest path (SP) based on these estimated costs, follows the perception encoder. To enable end-to-end training, we employ decision-focused learning to align the predicted shortest paths with observed routes. The implicit maximum likelihood estimation (iMLE) provides an approximate gradient of the loss function that contains the non-differentiable CO layer. Furthermore, a regularization term anchors the latent cost distribution to the empirical scale of observed link travel times, mitigating the scale ambiguity inherent in shortest-path supervision. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that the proposed framework outperforms baseline route choice models in path reproduction. The learned latent costs, interpreted as proxies for perceived travel costs, provide plausible explanations for heterogeneous route choices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把个体路径复现写成在学习到的驾驶员专属潜在链路成本上求最短路：感知编码器把个体特征、行程属性与路网交通状态嵌入个性化链路成本，后接可微的约束优化 (CO) 层输出最短路，用 decision-focused learning 端到端对齐观测路径。实证评估中该框架在路径复现上优于基线路径选择模型，学到的潜在成本可解释为感知出行成本的代理。
Motivation: 复现个体实际选择的路径通常要枚举候选路径集，且难以把异质路径选择归因到可解释的感知成本上。
Method: 感知模型把个体特征、行程属性、路网级交通状态三类协变量嵌入个性化链路成本；其后接约束优化层在这些成本上求最短路 (SP)，用 decision-focused learning 让预测路径与观测路径对齐；不可微 CO 层的损失梯度由 iMLE 近似给出，另加正则项把潜在成本分布锚定到观测链路行程时间的经验尺度，以缓解最短路监督的尺度歧义。
Result: 实证评估显示该框架在路径复现 (path reproduction) 上优于基线路径选择模型；学到的潜在成本作为感知出行成本的代理，能给出对异质路径选择的合理解释。
Conclusion: 一旦从上下文推断出驾驶员专属潜在链路成本，观测路径可在不枚举候选路径集的情况下被复现，且这些成本本身构成解释路径选择异质性的变量。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Lost in the bf16 Cast: Exporting Ternary Language Models Can Revert Most Low-Learning-Rate Code Changes
papers.abstract_en: Ternary language models such as BitNet b1.58, Falcon-E and BitCPM are fine-tuned with higher-precision latent weights and deployed as ternary codes produced by an export step that, in the labs' documented pipelines, first casts the latents to bf16. We audit those pipelines across three labs. In released checkpoints, fp32 quantization of the shipped latents disagrees with the deployed codes on 0.83-1.77% of codes in Falcon-E and BitCPM and on 1.530% in BitNet 2B-4T; for Falcon-E and BitCPM most disagreements are products that bf16 rounding lands exactly on the threshold, which ties-to-even maps to zero, and the unmodified onebitllms exporter reproduces all four Falcon-E releases byte for byte. At fine-tuned endpoints, with learning rates selected to match a nominal learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP ratio, the documented export lowers greedy GSM8K strict accuracy from 58.79% to 0.78% for Falcon-E-1B-Base and from 36.13% to 0.39% for BitCPM-CANN-0.5B, and a bf16 save and reload lowers BitNet 2B-4T's strict accuracy by 27.54 points while its last-number accuracy rises. Two compatibility remedies, writing the training quantizer's codes directly or adjusting the bf16 inputs until the unchanged tools emit them, each met a 4-point strict-accuracy non-inferiority criterion against online evaluation in all three models. In two model families, randomized interventions on the initial distance from the threshold support distance-dependent selection of the codes that fine-tuning changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 三值语言模型 (BitNet b1.58、Falcon-E、BitCPM) 的导出管线先把高精度 latent 权重 cast 到 bf16 再量化成三值码，这一步会抹掉低学习率微调学到的改动。在按 learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP 比值选定学习率的微调端点上，文档化导出使 Falcon-E-1B-Base 的 GSM8K greedy 严格准确率从 58.79% 跌到 0.78%、BitCPM-CANN-0.5B 从 36.13% 跌到 0.39%；直接写训练量化器的码或微调 bf16 输入这两个补救办法，在三个模型上都满足相对在线评估的 4 个百分点严格准确率非劣判据。
Motivation: 三值模型靠导出步骤把微调后的高精度 latent 变成部署用三值码，而该步骤的 bf16 cast 可能静默丢弃低学习率微调的全部收益，实验室文档化管线在三个实验室间存在这种不一致。
Method: 审计三家实验室的导出管线：用 fp32 量化已发布 latent 与部署码逐位比对，检查 onebitllms exporter 是否逐字节复现 Falcon-E 发布版；在按 learning-rate-to-bf16-ULP 比值选定学习率的微调端点上做 bf16 导出与保存/重载干预，并测试两种兼容性补救（直接写训练量化器的码、调整 bf16 输入使原工具输出目标码），另在两个模型族上对初始阈值距离做随机化干预。
Result: 已发布 checkpoint 中 fp32 量化与部署码的不一致比例为 Falcon-E 与 BitCPM 的 0.83-1.77%、BitNet 2B-4T 的 1.530%，其中 Falcon-E 与 BitCPM 的多数分歧是 bf16 舍入恰好落在阈值上、ties-to-even 映射为零；未改动的 onebitllms exporter 逐字节复现全部四个 Falcon-E 发布版。微调端点上文档化导出使 Falcon-E-1B-Base 的 GSM8K greedy 严格准确率 58.79% → 0.78%、BitCPM-CANN-0.5B 36.13% → 0.39%；BitNet 2B-4T 经 bf16 保存重载后严格准确率下降 27.54 点而末位数字准确率上升。两种补救在全部三个模型上都达到相对在线评估的 4 个百分点严格准确率非劣判据。
Conclusion: bf16 cast 是三值导出的语义破坏点：低学习率微调改动的选择取决于初始阈值距离，因此部署前应绕过该 cast 或改写 bf16 输入以保住训练量化器输出的码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workflows enable large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by coordinating reasoning, tool use, and verification. However, a workflow optimized for an entire task collection can overlook differences in the reasoning strategies that individual queries need, while searching for a new workflow for every query repeats costly optimization. To address this tradeoff, we introduce RA-MoWE, a framework that uses workflow-affinity embeddings to cluster queries and guide the generation of reusable expert workflows. Each embedding records how well a fixed set of reference workflows solves a query, revealing similarities in which reasoning strategies are effective. RA-MoWE uses each cluster's queries and average embedding to initialize and refine a specialized workflow through execution feedback. An embedding encoder predicts these embeddings from query text, allowing new queries to select a generated expert without first executing the reference workflows. On a 300-query test set drawn from four benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and programming, RA-MoWE improves average task score by 4.04 percentage points over selecting among the reference workflows, while using 27.7% fewer language-model calls at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RA-MoWE 用「workflow-affinity embedding」给查询聚类：每条 embedding 记录一组固定参考 workflow 解该查询的效果，据此把查询分簇，再用簇内查询与平均 embedding 初始化并靠执行反馈迭代出专用的可复用 expert workflow；另训一个从查询文本直接预测该 embedding 的编码器，使新查询不必先跑参考 workflow 就能选中生成的 expert。在覆盖数学、科学、编程四个 benchmark 的 300 条测试查询上，平均任务分比「在参考 workflow 中挑选」高 4.04 个百分点，推理阶段 LLM 调用数少 27.7%。
Motivation: 为整个任务集合优化出的单一 workflow 会忽略单条查询各自需要的推理策略，而逐查询重新搜索 workflow 又要重复付出昂贵的优化成本，两者构成取舍。
Method: 三步：以固定参考 workflow 集合在查询上的表现为坐标构造 workflow-affinity embedding；按 embedding 聚类，用簇内查询与平均 embedding 初始化 specialized workflow 并依据 execution feedback 迭代精化；训练 embedding encoder 从查询文本直接预测 embedding，让新查询直接选择生成的 expert workflow。
Result: 在 300 条测试查询（取自数学、科学、编程四个 benchmark）上，平均任务分较「在参考 workflow 中选择」提高 4.04 个百分点，推理时 LLM 调用次数减少 27.7%。
Conclusion: 按查询与 workflow 的亲和度聚类并生成分簇专用 workflow，可以在少调用 LLM 的前提下超过直接挑选参考 workflow 的做法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has become a standard approach for adapting large language models to downstream tasks. However, most existing PEFT methods rely on uniform and static adaptations, without accounting for the structured heterogeneity of attention across dimensions, heads, layers, and input tokens. In practice, attention representations exhibit non-uniform behavior, and positional encoding mechanisms such as rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) induce dimension-dependent positional structure, making uniform adaptation suboptimal. In this work, we propose DyPAM (Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation), a PEFT method that adapts how positional information contributes to attention by operating directly on the query and key representations. DyPAM combines input-conditioned, dimension-wise modulation with head-wise and layer-wise structural modulation, performing fine-grained adaptation of positional attention aligned with the RoPE-induced structure without modifying the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks across multiple backbone models demonstrate that DyPAM consistently outperforms existing strong PEFT baselines.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD '26), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DyPAM：一种直接作用于 query/key 表示的 PEFT 方法，按输入条件做维度级调制，并叠加 head 级与 layer 级结构调制，使位置信息对注意力的贡献沿 RoPE 诱导的维度结构做细粒度适配，且不改动预训练 backbone。在多个 backbone 上的数学与常识推理基准中，DyPAM 一致优于现有强 PEFT 基线。
Motivation: 现有 PEFT 方法多采用均匀且静态的适配，未考虑注意力在维度、head、layer、token 上的结构异质性，而 RoPE 本身带来维度依赖的位置结构，均匀适配因此次优。
Method: DyPAM (Dynamic Positional Attention Modulation) 直接修改 query 与 key 表示：输入条件化的维度级调制 (input-conditioned, dimension-wise modulation) 加上 head 级与 layer 级结构调制，对齐 RoPE 诱导的结构，不修改预训练 backbone。
Result: 在数学与常识推理基准、多个 backbone 模型上的实验中，DyPAM 一致优于现有强 PEFT 基线。

papers.title: Scen-Opt: A Scenario Optimization Toolbox for Data-Driven Convex Programming
papers.abstract_en: The scenario approach is a well-established statistical framework for data-driven decision-making. In particular, in data-driven optimization, the scenario approach unveils how the problem structure governs out-of-sample generalization, and offers a principled basis for assessing and certifying the reliability of the optimal solution as per constraint satisfaction. Despite its strong theoretical development and wide applicability, no software toolbox has been available to date that enables user-friendly, data-driven convex optimization within the scenario-approach framework. In this paper, we introduce Scen-Opt, an open-source software tool that integrates convex programming with data samples while providing statistical guarantees grounded in scenario theory. Scen-Opt is implemented in Python, supporting data-driven linear, quadratic, and semidefinite programming, and offers a Python-based web application with an intuitive and reactive graphical user interface (GUI) built using modern web technologies. Scen-Opt can be used directly through its online interface or installed locally, accommodating both manual input and data-file uploads (CSV, JSON, TXT, TSV, MAT, Excel, NPY, NPZ, Parquet). Built on a Python backend with a modern JavaScript frontend, Scen-Opt offers a highly user-friendly experience and efficient usability across desktops, laptops, tablets, and mobile devices. In this paper, Scen-Opt is applied to a set of representative benchmarks, demonstrating its practical effectiveness for data-driven convex optimization with guaranteed performance.
papers.comment: 49 pages. Software archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23177690 (v1.0); source code at https://github.com/Kiguli/Scen-Opt; web app at https://scen-opt.woodingben.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Scen-Opt 是首个把场景方法 (scenario approach) 与数据驱动凸优化整合到一起的开源 Python 工具箱，为最优解的约束满足提供基于场景理论的统计保证。它支持线性、二次与半定规划，配 Web GUI 与多格式数据导入，并在一组代表性基准上演示了带保证的实用效果。
Motivation: 场景方法理论成熟、应用广泛，但此前没有可用软件让用户友好地做带统计保证的数据驱动凸优化。
Method: Python 后端 + JavaScript 前端，支持数据驱动的线性、二次与半定规划 (SDP)，统计保证由场景理论给出；提供在线 Web GUI 与本地安装，支持手动输入及 CSV、JSON、TXT、TSV、MAT、Excel、NPY、NPZ、Parquet 数据上传，覆盖桌面到移动端。
Result: 在一组代表性基准上应用 Scen-Opt，展示了其在带保证性能的数据驱动凸优化上的实际有效性；软件以 v1.0 归档于 Zenodo，源码在 GitHub，另有在线 Web 应用。
Conclusion: 场景方法的统计保证可以封装成通用、跨设备可用的凸优化工具箱，直接服务于带约束满足认证的数据驱动决策。

papers.title: CHARTER: Auditing Reference Substitution in Hierarchical Compact-Evidence Evaluation for Computational Pathology
papers.abstract_en: In digital pathology, compact evidence is often used to explain or audit predictions made by whole-slide image multiple instance learning models. In hierarchical compact-evidence pipelines, candidate filtering introduces a strategy-specific candidate-conditioned prediction alongside the original full-bag prediction. If the evaluation reference changes while the intended target remains the original full-bag prediction, however, not only can the measured fidelity of the same compact evidence change, but comparisons between competing candidate strategies can also change. To make this dependence explicit, we introduce CHARTER, a reference-aware evaluation charter that asks researchers to DECLARE the intended target and reference, QUANTIFY candidate-induced prediction shift, and AUDIT the stability of comparative conclusions. Across the 15 comparisons in our main five-seed Random-K audit, 4 showed determinate reversals; in a matched native-ranking stress test, the ACMIL comparison changed from REVERSED to PRESERVED. CHARTER turns otherwise implicit candidate-filtering and reference choices into an auditable evaluation specification, helping distinguish genuine preservation of the intended prediction from apparent gains induced by changing the prediction being explained.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CHARTER 是面向计算病理学分层紧凑证据 (compact-evidence) 评测的参考声明规范：要求研究者 DECLARE 预期目标与评测参考、QUANTIFY 候选筛选引起的预测偏移、AUDIT 比较结论的稳定性。在五随机种子的 Random-K 主审计 15 组比较中 4 组出现确定性反转；匹配的 native-ranking 压力测试里 ACMIL 的比较从 REVERSED 变为 PRESERVED。
Motivation: 分层紧凑证据管线中候选筛选会引入策略特定的候选条件预测，而评测参考若被换成该预测、预期目标仍是原始 full-bag 预测，同一紧凑证据的保真度读数和竞争策略之间的排序都可能随之改变，这类参考替换在评测中是隐式的。
Method: 提出 CHARTER：把候选筛选与参考选择写成可审计的评测规范，依次声明预期目标与参考、量化候选诱导的预测偏移、审计比较结论的稳定性；以五随机种子的 Random-K 审计和匹配的 native-ranking 压力测试作为检验场景，涉及 ACMIL 等候选策略比较。
Result: 主五随机种子 Random-K 审计的 15 组比较中 4 组出现确定性反转 (determinate reversals)；在匹配的 native-ranking 压力测试中，ACMIL 的比较由 REVERSED 翻转为 PRESERVED。
Conclusion: 紧凑证据的保真度与策略排序依赖于评测参考的选择，只有把候选筛选和参考显式声明并审计偏移，才能区分对原始预测的真实保持与更换被解释对象带来的表面提升。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Privileged Context as Drift in On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a language model to match a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context. Existing work varies what privileged context contains and how it is produced while also changing models, data, and training setups, making the effects of privileged context design difficult to isolate. Motivated by efforts in continual learning to reduce catastrophic forgetting, we study how the choice of privileged context affects policy drift. Specifically, we vary two axes: content (a demonstration, feedback, or rephrase) and source (external, self-generated with a verifier, or self-generated without a verifier). We train Qwen2.5-7B with OPSD across these nine combinations and three datasets, measuring target-task accuracy, prior-task retention, reverse KL from the base policy, and parameter-update geometry. Holding source fixed, changing content spans a wider median KL range than holding content fixed and changing source. The ratio between these ranges is $5.1\times$ for per-token KL and $2.2\times$ for per-sequence KL. Parameter-update geometry shows the same pattern: updates from adapters that share content are more closely aligned (mean cosine $0.571$) than updates from adapters that share source ($0.255$). For continual learning, these findings suggest that privileged context should be treated as part of OPSD's stability design because it is associated with how far and in what direction the policy moves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 中，特权上下文的内容（demonstration/feedback/rephrase）比来源（外部/带验证器自生成/无验证器自生成）更能决定策略漂移：固定来源换内容所跨的 KL 中位数范围是固定内容换来源的 5.1 倍（per-token）与 2.2 倍（per-sequence），参数更新方向也呈现同样格局（共享内容的 adapter 更新平均余弦 0.571，共享来源仅 0.255）。结论是特权上下文应被当作 OPSD 稳定性设计的一部分。
Motivation: 现有 OPSD 工作在改变特权上下文内容与产生方式的同时还换了模型、数据和训练设置，导致特权上下文设计对策略漂移 (policy drift) 的影响无法分离；持续学习中灾难性遗忘的关切使这一归因问题变得关键。
Method: 在两个轴上系统变化特权上下文：内容轴（demonstration、feedback、rephrase）与来源轴（external、self-generated with a verifier、self-generated without a verifier），共九种组合；用 Qwen2.5-7B 在三个数据集上训练 OPSD，测量目标任务准确率、先前任务保持率、相对 base policy 的 reverse KL，以及参数更新几何。
Result: 固定来源改变内容所跨的中位 KL 范围大于固定内容改变来源，两者比值为 per-token KL 5.1×、per-sequence KL 2.2×；参数更新几何同向：共享内容的 adapter 更新平均余弦 0.571，共享来源的为 0.255。评测覆盖九种组合、三个数据集与 Qwen2.5-7B。
Conclusion: 特权上下文的内容选择与策略漂移的幅度和方向相关，因此在持续学习场景下应纳入 OPSD 的稳定性设计来约束策略移动多远、朝哪个方向移动。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DHCG: Dynamic Construction of Hierarchical Collaboration Graphs for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex problems across diverse domains. Recently, the dynamic orchestration of agent systems has become an important research direction. However, existing methods suffer from limited composition, misaligned dependencies, and inflexible scale, restricting their ability to adapt to reasoning requirements during execution. To address these limitations, we reframe MAS design as a partially observable Markov decision process, in which both the composition and scale of the MAS are dynamically determined. We propose DHCG, a novel framework that coordinates three modules (Planner, Worker, and Generator) to progressively construct a dynamic hierarchical collaboration graph from scratch based on the query and evolving execution feedback. At each step, guided by feedback, the Planner generates a set of distinct and complementary roles tailored to the current reasoning needs and selectively routes relevant information to each role. It can also finalize the hierarchical collaboration graph early or progressively expand it when additional reasoning is required. We further introduce action-aware preference optimization to train the Planner to make more effective decisions when constructing hierarchical collaboration graphs. We systematically evaluate DHCG across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and domain-specific reasoning benchmarks. DHCG achieves state-of-the-art average performance among the compared methods, improving over the single-agent baseline by 13.06 points and outperforming both static and dynamic MAS baselines by 2.77-8.02 points. Additional experiments further demonstrate its generalization across different Planner backbones and unseen Worker models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DHCG 把 LLM 多智能体系统的设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程 (POMDP)，由 Planner、Worker、Generator 三模块依据查询与执行反馈从零动态构建分层协作图，并用 action-aware preference optimization 训练 Planner。在代码生成、数学推理与领域推理基准上，平均性能较单智能体基线提升 13.06 点，较静态与动态 MAS 基线提升 2.77–8.02 点。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体编排方法组合受限、依赖关系错配、规模不灵活，难以在执行过程中随推理需求调整。
Method: 将 MAS 设计建模为 POMDP，动态决定智能体组合与规模；Planner 按当前推理需要生成互异互补的角色并选择性路由信息，可提前定稿或逐步扩展协作图，Generator 汇总输出；用 action-aware preference optimization 训练 Planner 的构图决策。
Result: 在代码生成、数学推理和领域推理基准上取得所比较方法中的平均最优性能：较单智能体基线提升 13.06 点，较静态与动态 MAS 基线提升 2.77–8.02 点；对不同 Planner backbone 与未见过的 Worker 模型均能泛化。
Conclusion: 把 MAS 构建做成受反馈驱动的序贯决策并配合偏好优化，可在执行中按需定规模与结构，从而同时优于单智能体和固定/已有动态多智能体方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Retrieval Is Not Enough: Refreshing Memory for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented time-series forecasting uses the continuations of historical segments similar to the current context as references for a forecaster. Most existing methods build the retrieval memory once from the training segment, leaving observations revealed after deployment unavailable as references, and generally do not calibrate how much the retrieved information should influence a frozen forecaster. We identify two key determinants of retrieval utility for a frozen forecaster: whether the history still reflects the current state, and whether the correction it induces aligns with the forecaster's residual errors, an alignment that can shift between validation and deployment when the memory becomes stale. We propose FreshCast, a plug-in retrieval framework that keeps the forecaster frozen, continuously updates a non-parametric memory with new observations, forms a memory forecast through relational kernel regression, and calibrates its weight in closed form on the validation segment. Under a simplified generative model, we characterize the optimal combination gain through the second-order relation between forecaster error and memory correction, and show that a sufficiently long look-back can make periodic memory information redundant. Across seven benchmarks and ten forecasting architectures, FreshCast reduces average MSE for every evaluated forecaster and input length, by 14.6% and 5.6% at input lengths 96 and 720, and achieves lower MSE than the evaluated retrieval-augmented and online baselines in their comparison settings. Ablations show that freezing the memory at the end of training removes most of the gain, identifying post-training observations as a primary source of improvement. For a frozen forecaster, useful historical references must remain timely and provide information that helps correct its remaining errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreshCast 是面向冻结时序预测器的即插即用检索框架：持续用部署后新观测刷新非参数记忆，用 relational kernel regression 生成记忆预测，并在验证段上闭式标定其权重。在 7 个基准、10 种预测架构上，输入长度 96 与 720 时平均 MSE 分别下降 14.6% 与 5.6%，且在各评估设置中低于检索增强与在线基线；把记忆冻结在训练结束会去掉大部分增益。
Motivation: 检索增强时序预测的记忆多在训练段一次性构建，部署后新观测无法成为参考，且检索信息对冻结预测器的影响权重缺乏校准；记忆变陈旧时其修正方向与预测器残差的对齐会在验证与部署之间漂移。
Method: FreshCast 保持预测器冻结，用新观测持续更新非参数记忆，通过 relational kernel regression 形成记忆预测，并在验证段上以闭式解标定该记忆预测的组合权重；在简化生成模型下，用预测器误差与记忆修正的二阶关系刻画最优组合增益。
Result: 在 7 个基准、10 种预测架构上，FreshCast 对每个被评估的预测器与输入长度都降低平均 MSE：输入长度 96 时降 14.6%，长度 720 时降 5.6%；在各对比设置中 MSE 低于被评估的检索增强与在线基线。消融显示把记忆冻结在训练结束会去掉大部分增益。理论刻画表明足够长的 look-back 会让周期性记忆信息变冗余。
Conclusion: 对冻结预测器，有用的历史参考必须保持及时并能修正其余误差，因此部署后观测的持续记忆刷新是主要增益来源，而非检索本身。

papers.title: Harness Engineering for Software Engineering via Modular Executable Dev-Primitives
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) equipped with terminal access have demonstrated strong capabilities in automating software engineering tasks. However, existing agents remain brittle on long-horizon workflows, where they must repeatedly reconstruct program state scattered across source files, configurations, tests, dependencies, and runtime behavior, leading to increasingly long interaction histories, context explosion, and semantic drift. Large repositories further complicate the identification of task-relevant components. To address these challenges, we introduce \textbf{Dev-Primitives} (\emph{Development Primitives}), a modular and executable abstraction that transforms repository components from passive software artifacts into active participants in software engineering. Each Dev-Primitive pairs a repository artifact with a resident LLM, which gives the artifact an agent-native interface grounded in its own implementation and dependencies, enabling natural-language reasoning, inter-component communication, and localized self-modification. Building on Dev-Primitives, we propose \textbf{HERMES}, a Harness Engineering framework for software engineeRing via Modular Executable Dev-PrimitiveS, which instantiates these primitives at repository scale through a dependency-aware dynamic activation mechanism and a bug diagnosis mechanism that maps execution evidence back to the components that must be revised. Extensive experiments on four software engineering benchmarks demonstrate that HERMES outperforms matched baseline harnesses by 12.4\% on average. Moreover, when paired with strong activation and diagnosis models, HERMES, even with Qwen3-8B Dev-Primitives, remains within 4.5\% of the homogeneous GPT-5.6 Sol configuration across all four benchmarks, while reducing inference cost by 26.2\% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, highlighting the importance of harness design in software engineering agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dev-Primitive：把仓库构件与常驻 LLM 配对成可执行抽象，再用 HERMES 框架在仓库规模上做依赖感知动态激活与执行证据回溯的 bug 诊断。四个软件工程基准上比匹配基线 harness 平均高 12.4%；配强激活与诊断模型时，Qwen3-8B 版本距同质 GPT-5.6 Sol 配置不到 4.5%，并在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上把推理成本降 26.2%。
Motivation: 带终端访问的 LLM agent 在长程工作流上脆弱：程序状态散落在源码、配置、测试、依赖与运行时中，反复重建导致交互历史膨胀、上下文爆炸与语义漂移，大仓库还加剧任务相关组件的定位难度。
Method: Dev-Primitive 将仓库构件与一个常驻 LLM 配对，给出基于自身实现与依赖的 agent 原生接口，支持自然语言推理、组件间通信与局部自修改；HERMES 在仓库规模上实例化这些原语，含依赖感知的动态激活机制与把执行证据映射回待修改组件的 bug 诊断机制。
Result: 在四个软件工程基准上，HERMES 比匹配的基线 harness 平均高出 12.4%；配合强激活与诊断模型时，即便 Dev-Primitive 用 Qwen3-8B，在全部四个基准上与同质 GPT-5.6 Sol 配置的差距不超过 4.5%，并在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上降低 26.2% 推理成本。
Conclusion: 软件工程 agent 的瓶颈在 harness 设计而非单纯换更大模型：模块化可执行原语加激活与诊断机制，能让小模型逼近大模型配置并显著降本。

papers.title: Agentic Semantic Sensing for Resource-Adaptive AI-RAN
papers.abstract_en: Semantic sensing (SemS) acquires task-relevant information rather than reconstructing complete physical information. Existing SemS formulations typically operate open loop: sensing configurations and observation schedules are fixed before inference and cannot respond to evolving task-level evidence. We propose Agentic SemS, a closed-loop framework for AI-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) that controls sensing within a communication-feasible profile set. A profile-conditioned causal Transformer updates the semantic belief from streaming observations, while key-value caching enables efficient state updates across profile changes without repeatedly processing the complete history. A semantic utility network estimates the task-level benefit of acquiring the next observation block under each feasible profile after accounting for sensing cost. The resulting continuation utilities jointly support next-profile selection and semantic early exit, adapting sensing configuration and duration to evolving evidence. The expected semantic gain is further related to conditional mutual information, providing a value-of-information interpretation of continued online sensing. Experiments on Widar3.0 with six emulated sensing profiles show that, in comparison with full-sequence High, the resource-efficient Agentic setting reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. At the same utility checkpoint, semantic early exit provides a further 12.35% cost reduction over adaptive sensing without early exit, with a 0.97-percentage-point Macro-F1 decrease.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把语义感知 (semantic sensing) 改成闭环 agentic 框架：在通信可行的 profile 集内用 profile 条件因果 Transformer 更新语义信念，语义效用网络决定下一个观测块的 profile 与语义早退。Widar3.0 六个仿真 profile 上，相比全序列 High，资源自适应设置把归一化累计感知成本降 25.33%，Macro-F1 达 85.79%；同一效用检查点上早退再省 12.35% 成本，Macro-F1 仅降 0.97 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有语义感知 (SemS) 是开环的：感知配置与观测调度在推理前固定，无法随任务级证据演化调整，导致在 AI-RAN 上为拿到可用语义付出不必要的感知开销。
Method: 提出 Agentic SemS 闭环框架：profile 条件因果 Transformer 借 key-value 缓存从流式观测更新语义信念，切换 profile 时不必重算完整历史；语义效用网络在扣除感知成本后估计每个可行 profile 下获取下一观测块的任务收益，其 continuation utility 同时驱动下一 profile 选择与语义早退；期望语义增益与条件互信息挂钩，给出继续在线感知的 value-of-information 解释。
Result: Widar3.0、六个仿真感知 profile 的实验中，与全序列 High 相比，资源高效的 Agentic 设置把归一化累计感知成本降低 25.33%，同时 Macro-F1 为 85.79%；在同一效用检查点上，语义早退相对不带早退的自适应感知再降 12.35% 成本，Macro-F1 下降 0.97 个百分点。
Conclusion: 在通信可行约束内按任务级证据自适应地选 profile 并早退，可以在语义精度几乎不变的前提下显著压缩 AI-RAN 的累计感知成本。

papers.title: Forecast Accuracy Is Not Trading Profit: Evolving Small Recurrent Networks for Stock Return Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting models are typically compared on pointwise error, which scores a prediction in isolation from the decision it is produced for, and a lower forecast error does not imply a better decision downstream. A parallel debate asks whether modern transformer architectures forecast better than recurrent and other lightweight models. We compare linear, fixed recurrent, transformer, and mixing based architectures against recurrent networks evolved by neuroevolutionary architecture search, evaluating each on forecast accuracy and on the net return of a daily long/short strategy. All models are fit on a pooled panel, one network trained across the whole universe. Across four mid-cap portfolios and three trading years, the evolved networks rank first on both forecast accuracy and net trading performance, while the second most accurate model loses money once positions are formed and costs are charged. The advantage tracks a horizon match, since rank IC for the evolved networks rises from a one-day to a ten-day scoring horizon while every model above 300 parameters declines. They are also the cheapest end to end: a CPU-only search of 16 minutes yields 66-weight networks that predict in 10.8~$μ$s on a Raspberry Pi Zero, against transformer baselines of up to 817,153 parameters that require GPU training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在股票收益预测上，用神经进化架构搜索 (neuroevolutionary architecture search) 演化出的小型循环网络同时赢得预测精度与多空策略净收益：在四个中盘组合、三个交易年度上两项均排第一，而第二准确的模型在计入仓位与成本后亏损。优势来自 horizon match——演化网络的 rank IC 从 1 天到 10 天评分视界上升，而所有超过 300 参数的模型都下降；端到端也最省，CPU 搜索 16 分钟得到 66 权重网络，在 Raspberry Pi Zero 上推理 10.8 μs，对比最高 817,153 参数、需 GPU 训练的 transformer 基线。
Motivation: 时序预测模型惯用逐点误差排名，但更低的预测误差不等于下游决策更好；同时关于 transformer 是否优于循环等轻量架构的争论也未把决策质量纳入评价。
Method: 对比 linear、fixed recurrent、transformer、mixing 四类架构与经神经进化架构搜索演化的循环网络，全部在合并面板 (pooled panel) 上用单一网络覆盖整个股票池训练；每个模型同时按预测精度和日频多空策略净收益评估。
Result: 在四个中盘组合、三个交易年度上，演化网络在预测精度与净交易表现均排第一；第二准确的模型在形成仓位并扣除成本后亏损。演化网络 rank IC 从 1 天视界升到 10 天视界，而所有参数量超过 300 的模型均下降。CPU-only 搜索 16 分钟得到 66 权重网络，Raspberry Pi Zero 上推理 10.8 μs；transformer 基线最高 817,153 参数且需 GPU 训练。
Conclusion: 逐点预测误差不能替代下游交易决策的评价，小到 66 权重的演化循环网络在精度、净收益与端到端成本三方面同时占优，视界匹配是其 rank IC 随 1→10 天上升的原因。

papers.title: CANDLE: Cortical Null-Space Decomposition for Noninvasive Brain Source Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Electrophysiological source imaging (ESI) aims to estimate cortical source activity from noninvasive electrophysiological measurements such as electroencephalogram (EEG). However, ESI is fundamentally ill-posed because source activity is substantially higher-dimensional than sensor observations, resulting in non-unique solutions. Recent learning-based approaches address this ambiguity by learning data-driven source priors, yet they often struggle to generalize across subject-specific cortical geometries. To address this, we propose CANDLE, a learning-based ESI model that estimates source activity on subject-specific cortical geometries. CANDLE learns a prior over the null space induced by the source-to-sensor mapping derived from T1-weighted MRI, restricting learning to unobservable source components while preserving geometric constraints. To train CANDLE, we develop a whole-brain simulator spanning over 1,100 subject-specific cortical geometries with source configurations derived from over 26,000 statistical brain maps. Trained exclusively on simulated data, CANDLE outperformed prior ESI methods on simulated source activity estimation and generalized to two empirical tasks: (i) intracranial stimulation localization from simultaneously recorded scalp EEG and (ii) epileptogenic zone estimation from presurgical interictal EEG. Our project page is available at https://candle-esi.pages.dev}{https://candle-esi.pages.dev.

papers.title: TTNet: Multi-Task Deep Learning for Table Tennis Player Analysis with Smart Racket
papers.abstract_en: The AI CUP 2025 Precise Analysis of Table Tennis Smart Racket Data Competition introduced smart table tennis rackets that collect extensive player swing data, enabling research on table tennis big data. These data support in-depth analysis of players' return techniques and swing-force consistency, improving the accuracy of player skill assessment. This study focuses on six-axis sensor data collected by smart table tennis rackets and proposes TTNet, a novel deep learning model with multitask learning capabilities, to advance table tennis data analysis and related applications. TTNet combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs), residual networks (ResNet), and self-attention mechanisms to simultaneously predict four player attributes: gender, playing hand, years of experience, and skill level. We adopt a two-stage training strategy that incorporates data augmentation and task-specific loss functions to improve generalization on imbalanced data. Our approach achieved second place on the official competition leaderboard.

TL;DR: TTNet 用 CNN、ResNet 与 self-attention 组成的多任务模型，从智能球拍六轴传感器挥拍数据同时预测性别、持拍手、球龄与技能等级四项属性，并用两阶段训练、数据增强与任务专属损失处理类别不平衡。在 AI CUP 2025 智能球拍数据分析竞赛官方榜上取得第二名。
Motivation: 智能球拍积累了大量挥拍六轴传感器数据，但要从中同时判定球员多项属性，需在类别不平衡条件下提升技能评估的准确度。
Method: TTNet 融合 CNN、ResNet 与 self-attention 机制，多任务同时预测 gender、playing hand、years of experience、skill level 四项属性；采用两阶段训练策略，配合数据增强与任务专属 loss function 改善不平衡数据上的泛化。
Result: 在 AI CUP 2025 Precise Analysis of Table Tennis Smart Racket Data Competition 官方排行榜上获得第二名；预测目标为四项球员属性，输入为智能球拍六轴传感器挥拍数据。

papers.title: $α$Transfer: Coefficient Transfer for Efficient Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Model merging offers a promising solution for combining multiple fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model through parameter arithmetic. However, finding optimal merging coefficients requires an extensive search that becomes prohibitively expensive as models scale in both size and number, due to high memory requirements and combinatorial growth in the search space. We show that, within the same model family, models exhibit highly congruent performance distributions over merging coefficients across different model sizes. This distributional similarity enables a practical paradigm we call \textit{$α$Transfer}: searching for optimal coefficients on a small proxy model, then directly transfer them to larger target models. We verify $α$Transfer across multiple merging methods, model families, and tasks. Experimental results demonstrate a 6$\times$ speedup and 70\% memory reduction on vision transformers, and a 20$\times$ speedup and 85\% memory reduction on large language models, while maintaining comparable performance. Our findings establish $α$Transfer as an efficient and generalizable approach to scaling model merging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 模型合并中合并系数的搜索成本随模型规模与数量组合爆炸，αTransfer 发现同族不同规模模型在合并系数上的性能分布高度一致，因此在小代理模型上搜系数后直接迁移到大目标模型。在 vision transformers 上达到 6× 加速与 70% 内存下降，在大语言模型上达到 20× 加速与 85% 内存下降，同时保持相当性能。
Motivation: 合并系数的最优搜索需要大量试算，模型变大、变多后内存开销与搜索空间组合增长，使搜索变得不可承受。
Method: αTransfer：在同族小代理模型上搜索合并系数，再直接迁移到更大目标模型；验证覆盖多种合并方法、模型家族与任务。
Result: vision transformers 上 6× 加速、70% 内存下降；大语言模型上 20× 加速、85% 内存下降，性能保持相当。
Conclusion: 同族模型在合并系数上的性能分布相似，使小模型搜得的系数可直接用于大模型，αTransfer 是可扩展且通用的模型合并加速途径。

papers.title: One Step at a Time: Trading LLM Autonomy for Process Predictability
papers.abstract_en: Organizations automating operational processes need more than a correct outcome: they need to predict how a process will run, know which one actually ran, and inspect it step by step. When an agent is the executor that predictability is normally lost: the prescribed procedure goes into the system prompt, and only a final answer comes back. We deliver the procedure step by step over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) instead: a server releases one step at a time, the agent executes it, and each step returns a structured step_output. This trades autonomy for predictability, and two properties then follow by construction, independent of the executor. The execution path is prescribed before the run, so the process is predictable in advance rather than reconstructed afterwards; and the completed step records form a machine-readable execution log that downstream tooling can audit and optimize step by step. Evaluating 15,475 trials across 13 SOP-Bench domains and four open-weight executors from frontier (Kimi K2.5) to lightweight (Ministral 3 8B), we find step-level delivery makes the executed process predictable and inspectable for every executor, and additionally raises accuracy when the executor is small. Across all four, process adherence rises significantly (76-95% to 95-99%) and ungrounded answers (correct outputs produced without executing the SOP) near-vanish, falling from 2.1-4.5% to 0.2-0.3% of trials (all 95% CIs exclude zero); under prompt-based delivery, 31-49% of correct answers on know_your_business bypass the SOP entirely, even for the frontier executor. Accuracy is where the executor's capability enters: the lightweight executor gains +6.5pp grounded accuracy because supplying the process externally removes a reconstruction burden it cannot carry, while capable ones trade a small raw-accuracy decrement for a predictable, auditable process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 通过 MCP 逐步下发 SOP 而非塞进 system prompt，让 LLM agent 按步执行并返回结构化 step_output，用可预测性换取自主性。在 15,475 次试验、13 个 SOP-Bench 域、四个 open-weight executor 上，流程遵循率从 76-95% 升到 95-99%，无依据作答从 2.1-4.5% 降到 0.2-0.3%，轻量 executor 的 grounded accuracy 提升 +6.5pp。
Motivation: 把流程写进 system prompt 时，执行路径不可预测、事后只能靠最终答案反推，组织无法预先规定、逐步审计操作流程。
Method: 用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 由 server 一次释放一个 SOP 步骤，agent 执行后返回结构化 step_output，形成机器可读执行日志；在 SOP-Bench 的 13 个域上以四个 open-weight executor（Kimi K2.5 到 Ministral 3 8B）做 15,475 次试验，对比 prompt-based 与 step-level 两种下发方式。
Result: 流程遵循率由 76-95% 升至 95-99%，无依据作答（未执行 SOP 却给出正确输出）由 2.1-4.5% 降至 0.2-0.3%（95% CI 均不含零）；prompt-based 下 know_your_business 域有 31-49% 的正确答案完全绕过 SOP，即使 frontier executor 也不例外；轻量 executor 的 grounded accuracy 提升 +6.5pp，强 executor 则以小幅原始精度下降换取可预测、可审计的流程。
Conclusion: 把流程外部化为逐步下发的结构，可让任意 executor 的执行路径预先规定且可审计；能力弱的 executor 还因此免去流程重建负担而更准，能力强的则用少量原始精度换可预测性。

papers.title: Do I Need the Cloud? Uncertainty-Aware Step-Level Handoff for Small Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive as local agent controllers because they reduce remote inference, latency, and deployment footprint, yet structured tool errors can cause an agent step to fail. Existing routers typically select a model once per query. However, agents expose sequential decision points whose difficulty dynamically changes based on intermediate observations. We propose STEPGATE, an uncertainty-aware handoff framework that scores each local SLM action and selectively escalates challenging steps to a stronger model. On a 52-task held-out single-step BFCL-derived test split, the Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B pair attains 82.7% task success with 30.8% escalation, versus 67.3% local-only and 75.4% random escalation (which uses 33.8% escalation). In a separate multi-turn evaluation, STEPGATE achieves 69.0% trajectory success and 84.0% action success using only 30.0% cloud actions, compared with 48.0%/70.5% local-only, 60.0%/78.2% random escalation, and 57.0%/77.1% query-level routing (strong-only achieves 82.0% trajectory success at 100% cloud actions). These results suggest that step-level escalation recovers a large share of the performance gap to the stronger Qwen2.5-7B backend at a matched cloud-action rate while transmitting fewer tokens remotely. However, our evaluation is limited to one model family, a single stronger backend, and scripted tasks. Furthermore, the test sets are small, multi-turn comparisons rely on paired intervals and statistical tests, and our risk tiers serve as research annotations rather than formal safety guarantees.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris, France, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STEPGATE 让本地 SLM 逐步自评不确定性，只把高风险的 agent step 升级到更强云端模型，而非每条 query 只路由一次。在 52 任务 BFCL 单步划分上 Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 组合达 82.7% 成功率、升级率 30.8%，多轮任务用 30.0% 云端动作拿到 69.0% 轨迹成功率。
Motivation: 现有 router 每条 query 只选一次模型，但 agent 的逐步决策难度会随中间观测动态变化，一次性路由在结构化工具错误面前要么全本地失败、要么全量上云。
Method: STEPGATE 对本地 SLM 的每个动作打分，按不确定性选择性地把困难 step 升级到更强模型（Qwen2.5-7B）；评测分两段：52 任务 held-out 单步 BFCL-derived split，以及单独的多轮轨迹评测，对照 local-only、random escalation、query-level routing 与 strong-only。
Result: 单步 BFCL split：Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B 组合 82.7% task success、30.8% escalation，对比 local-only 67.3%、random escalation 75.4%（用 33.8% escalation）。多轮评测：STEPGATE 69.0% trajectory success / 84.0% action success，仅用 30.0% cloud actions；local-only 48.0%/70.5%，random escalation 60.0%/78.2%，query-level routing 57.0%/77.1%，strong-only 82.0% trajectory success 但用 100% cloud actions。
Conclusion: 在匹配的云端动作比例下，step 级升级能补回与 Qwen2.5-7B 后端差距的很大一部分，同时远程传输更少 token；作者限定结论范围为单一模型族、单个更强后端与脚本化任务，风险分层只是研究标注而非正式安全保证。

papers.title: Stochastic Gradient Descent Ascent is Suboptimal for Nonconvex-PL Min-Max Games
papers.abstract_en: How far can stochastic gradient descent ascent (SGDA) go by tuning its timescale ratio and step sizes in nonconvex min-max games? We answer this question for nonconvex-PL (NC-PL) games by establishing the first tight complexity of two-timescale SGDA with a fixed timescale ratio and non-increasing step sizes. For $\ell$-smooth games with an inner $μ$-PL inequality, we prove a complexity lower bound $Ω(κ^2\ell\varepsilon^{-2}+κ^4\ellσ^2\varepsilon^{-4})$, where $κ=\ell/μ$ is the condition number, $σ^2$ is the gradient variance, and $\varepsilon$ measures the outer gradient norm. This matches existing SGDA upper bounds and establishes a complexity separation from Smoothed-AGDA (Yang et al., 22'). In addition, we show that SGDA can fail to find a stationary point when its timescale ratio is as small as $o(κ^2)$. Our negative results highlight the fundamental limitation of SGDA in NC-PL games, and justify the development of alternative methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明在非凸-PL (NC-PL) 极小极大博弈中，固定时间尺度比、非增步长的双时间尺度 SGDA 已是最优难：ℓ-光滑且满足 μ-PL 时给出紧的复杂度下界 Ω(κ²ℓε⁻²+κ⁴ℓσ²ε⁻⁴)，与已有 SGDA 上界匹配，并与 Smoothed-AGDA 形成复杂度分离；时间尺度比小到 o(κ²) 时 SGDA 甚至找不到驻点。
Motivation: 调时间尺度比与步长能否让 SGDA 在 NC-PL 博弈中达到更好复杂度，此前缺少下界回答；这决定了是否必须另寻替代算法。
Method: 对 ℓ-光滑、内层满足 μ-PL 不等式的博弈，建立固定时间尺度比与非增步长的双时间尺度 SGDA 的首个紧复杂度下界，其中 κ=ℓ/μ 为条件数、σ² 为梯度方差、ε 度量外层梯度范数；并分析时间尺度比趋于 o(κ²) 时的收敛失败情形。
