papers.title: SIFT: Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer for Multi-Task Personalized Filter Ranking at Airbnb
papers.abstract_en: Search filters help guests navigate vast catalogs in two-sided marketplaces like Airbnb, and recommending the right filters can meaningfully lift booking conversion. Many such production filter-ranking systems, however, represent the guest through hand-engineered, pre-aggregated features generated by ETL pipelines. This makes it expensive to maintain and difficult to extend for new filter types or contextual dimensions (trip length, group size). We present SIFT (Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer), a ranking model built on transformers that learns guest preferences directly from raw behavioral sequences. SIFT replaces manual feature engineering with a unified guest representation that feeds multiple prediction tasks, including booking likelihood, filter engagement, and ordinal capacity thresholds (e.g., 2+ bedrooms) -- a general framework for filter ranking in two-sided marketplaces that accommodates both boolean and numeric-range filter types. Extending SIFT to new filters requires only adding a new head, not a new feature pipeline. To keep serving fast, this guest representation is computed offline on a daily cadence rather than at request time. Offline, SIFT improves booking and amenity-engagement PR-AUC by +51.9% and +62.8% respectively over the production baseline. In online A/B testing, SIFT increased engagement with recommended filters by +20.0%, overall filter usage among searchers by +0.72%, and usage of the newly-supported bedroom, bathroom, and bed filters by +3.9%, +10.7%, and +0.52% respectively. Demonstrating the system's extensibility, we rapidly integrated a novel hotel-intent filter using the same shared representation, driving a +3.8% lift in uncancelled hotel bookings and a +0.76% lift in overall marketplace bookings. SIFT is now fully deployed in production, serving scalable personalization to millions of guests.

TL;DR: SIFT 用 Transformer 直接从用户原始行为序列表示搜索意图，替代 Airbnb 过滤器排序中手工特征工程，一个统一表示同时支撑预订概率、过滤器互动和序数容量阈值等多任务。离线 PR-AUC 相对生产基线提升 +51.9%（预订）与 +62.8%（设施互动），线上 A/B 中推荐过滤器互动 +20.0%、整体过滤器使用 +0.72%，新接入的酒店意图过滤器带来未取消酒店预订 +3.8%。
Motivation: 双边市场的过滤器排序系统依赖 ETL 流水线生成的手工聚合特征，维护成本高，新增过滤器类型或行程长度、团队规模等上下文维度难以扩展。
Method: SIFT (Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer) 用 Transformer 从原始行为序列学习统一的用户表示，喂给多个预测任务头：预订概率、过滤器互动、序数容量阈值（如 2+ bedrooms），同时覆盖 boolean 与数值区间过滤器；该表示按天离线计算而非请求时计算以保证服务速度，新增过滤器只需加一个 head。

Conclusion: 用统一的行为序列表示替代手工特征流水线，可以在 Airbnb 生产环境同时提升多任务过滤器排序效果与新过滤器的接入速度，系统已全量上线服务数百万用户。

papers.title: MASKerade: Token-Routed Mask Experts for Dense-to-MoE Upcycling
papers.abstract_en: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. Dense-to-MoE upcycling reuses pretrained dense models to construct such systems, commonly by copying feed-forward networks (FFNs) into independently trained experts. We introduce MASKerade, a dense-to-MoE training method that instead learns experts as sparse subnetworks of a frozen pretrained FFN. Each expert is defined by a learned binary mask, and a token-level router selects which masked FFNs to execute and combine. The router and mask scores are optimized jointly, while the underlying FFN weight values remain unchanged. This formulation supports neuron-structured, semi-structured, and unstructured experts within the same routing architecture. Our main configuration uses four 2:4 experts with top-2 routing, where two half-dense expert passes have the nominal FFN arithmetic of one dense pass, without requiring independent expert weight matrices. On five vision-language benchmarks with Qwen and Gemma backbones, this configuration achieves the highest performance among the compared baselines. Comparisons across mask granularities, routing interventions, and compute-matched controls distinguish the effects of learned connectivity from expert activation count. These results establish mask learning over frozen weights as a practical alternative for constructing token-routed MoE experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MASKerade 把 dense-to-MoE upcycling 改成在冻结的预训练 FFN 上学二值掩码来定义专家，token 级 router 与掩码分数联合优化而权重不动。主配置为四个 2:4 掩码专家加 top-2 路由，两次半稠密专家前向的名义算术量等于一次稠密前向，在 Qwen 与 Gemma 骨干的五个视觉-语言基准上取得所比较基线中最高性能。
Motivation: dense-to-MoE upcycling 通常把 FFN 复制成各自独立训练的专家，需要额外的专家权重矩阵；作者要让专家容量增长不带来成比例的权重与算力开销。
Method: 每个专家由可学习的二值掩码定义在冻结的预训练 FFN 上，token 级 router 选择并组合被掩码的 FFN；router 与掩码分数联合优化，底层 FFN 权重保持不变，同一套路由架构可容纳 neuron-structured、semi-structured 与 unstructured 三种掩码粒度。主配置为四个 2:4 专家配 top-2 路由，并设置掩码粒度、路由干预与 compute-matched 对照。
Result: 在 Qwen 与 Gemma 骨干的五个视觉-语言基准上，四个 2:4 专家 + top-2 路由的配置取得所比较基线中最高性能；两次半稠密专家前向的名义 FFN 算术量等于一次稠密前向，且无需独立的专家权重矩阵。跨掩码粒度、路由干预与算力匹配对照的比较区分了学习到的连接性与专家激活数量各自的贡献。
Conclusion: 在冻结权重上学掩码可以作为构建 token 路由 MoE 专家的实用替代方案，专家增益来自学习到的连接性而非单纯增加激活的专家数量。

papers.title: Common-Mode Errors Limit Low-Timestep Deep Spiking Q-Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer sparse and event-driven computation, making them attractive for energy-constrained reinforcement learning (RL) on edge devices. In value-based RL, deep spiking Q-networks (DSQNs) combine such efficiency with action-value estimation for decision making. However, existing DSQNs often require multiple simulation timesteps for competitive performance, increasing computational and energy costs, whereas reducing the timesteps can cause substantial performance degradation. We investigate this degradation from the perspective of Q-value estimation errors. By decomposing errors across actions into common-mode and differential-mode components, we find that low-timestep DSQNs suffer disproportionately from common-mode errors shared across action values, which are particularly detrimental to temporal-difference learning through bootstrapped targets. Based on this finding, we propose Common-Mode Compensation Deep Spiking Q-Network (CMC-DSQN), which uses an auxiliary ANN to compensate for common-mode errors in the SNN outputs. At inference, greedy action selection can be performed directly from the SNN outputs, allowing the auxiliary ANN to be completely removed and preserving the energy efficiency of SNNs. Extensive experiments on Atari and MiniAtar environments demonstrate substantial performance improvements under low-timestep settings. CMC-DSQN outperforms state-of-the-art DSQN baselines by nearly $20\%$ at $T=2$ and further surpasses the ANN baseline at $T=4$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 低仿真步数下深度脉冲 Q 网络 (DSQN) 的性能崩塌主要来自各动作共享的 common-mode Q 值误差，它经自举目标污染时序差分学习。提出 CMC-DSQN，用辅助 ANN 补偿 SNN 输出中的 common-mode 误差，推理时贪心选动作只看 SNN 输出、辅助 ANN 可整体移除；Atari 与 MiniAtar 上 T=2 时比 SOTA DSQN 基线高近 20%，T=4 时超过 ANN 基线。
Motivation: DSQN 为节能需要多个仿真步数才有竞争力，降低步数会大幅掉点，但退化来源此前不清楚，限制了边缘设备上低延迟、低能耗的脉冲强化学习。
Method: 把各动作上的 Q 值估计误差分解为 common-mode 与 differential-mode 两部分，定位低步数退化来自 common-mode；据此提出 CMC-DSQN，用一个辅助 ANN 补偿 SNN 输出的 common-mode 误差，推理阶段贪心动作选择直接基于 SNN 输出，辅助 ANN 可被完全移除。
Result: 在 Atari 与 MiniAtar 环境上，低步数设置下性能大幅提升：T=2 时 CMC-DSQN 比 SOTA DSQN 基线高出近 20%，T=4 时进一步超过 ANN 基线。
Conclusion: 低步数 DSQN 的瓶颈是被自举目标放大的 common-mode Q 值误差，训练期用辅助 ANN 补偿即可在不牺牲推理能效的前提下恢复性能。

papers.title: Adaptive Mean Estimation by In-Context Learning: A Gradient-Flow Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Prior Fitted Networks (PFNs) such as TabPFN now rival established statistical procedures across prediction and estimation tasks. A natural explanation is that PFNs have the property of statistical adaptivity, that is, they perform nearly as well as a method tailored to the true data-generating model for a heterogeneous set of models, while not being told which model the data comes from. We study how such adaptivity is learned in a controlled location-estimation problem. Each task is an unlabeled sample whose family is hidden: Gaussian data call for averaging, with error of order $n^{-1}$, whereas uniform data are best estimated from their extremes, at the faster rate $n^{-2}$. We also provide the example of a symmetric Gaussian mixture, for which a rate of $σ^2_n/n$ can be attained. On scalar inputs, softmax attention computes the derivative of the empirical cumulant-generating function. A single primitive therefore both supplies features that distinguish the families and forms estimators interpolating between the sample mean and the mid-range. We combine attention experts through either a softmax mixture of experts or a gated linear unit (GLU), and analyze stagewise gradient flow. With $\widetildeΩ(n^{1+ε})$ pretraining tasks, the learned estimator is asymptotically efficient on Gaussian tasks, within a factor $n^ε$ of the minimax rate on uniform tasks, and order-optimal on mixtures in a shrinking-variance regime. These guarantees extend to new locations and longer contexts. A risk decomposition separates expert error, routing error and normalization error, which clarifies the architectural contrast. Softmax gating enforces normalization and exact translation equivariance, whereas the GLU must learn it: its dynamics separate into fast bias removal followed by slow expert selection. End-to-end experiments recover the predicted specialization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在受控的位置估计问题上解释 PFN（如 TabPFN）的统计自适应性如何被学到：softmax attention 在标量输入上等价于经验累积量生成函数的导数，同一原语既区分数据族又在样本均值与 mid-range 之间插值。用 softmax 混合专家或 GLU 组合 attention 专家并分析阶段式梯度流，在 $~\Omega(n^{1+\epsilon})$ 个预训练任务下，高斯任务渐近有效、均匀任务距 minimax 率至多 $n^\epsilon$ 因子、混合分布在方差收缩体制下 order-optimal。
Motivation: PFN 在预测与估计任务上已接近为真实数据生成模型定制的方法，但这种统计自适应性（不被告知数据来自哪个模型却几乎同样好）是如何在训练中学到的，缺少受控的机制性解释。
Method: 构造族别隐藏的无标签样本任务：高斯数据应用平均（误差 $n^{-1}$）、均匀数据应用极值（$n^{-2}$）、对称高斯混合（$\sigma^2_n/n$）。标量输入下 softmax attention 计算经验累积量生成函数的导数，作为区分族别并插值样本均值与 mid-range 的单一原语；用 softmax mixture-of-experts 或 gated linear unit (GLU) 组合 attention 专家，分析 stagewise gradient flow，并给出分离专家误差、路由误差与归一化误差的 risk decomposition。
Result: 在 $\widetilde\Omega(n^{1+\epsilon})$ 个预训练任务下学到的估计器在高斯任务上渐近有效，在均匀任务上距 minimax 率至多 $n^\epsilon$ 因子，在方差收缩体制的混合分布上 order-optimal；保证可推广到新位置与更长上下文。Softmax gating 强制归一化与精确平移等变性，GLU 则需学习之，其动力学分为快速去偏与慢速专家选择两个阶段；端到端实验复现了预测到的专家特化。
Conclusion: 统计自适应性可由单一 attention 原语加专家路由在梯度流下学得，架构差异体现在归一化与平移等变性是被强制还是被学出，softmax gating 与 GLU 因此呈现不同的训练动力学。

summary_sections.method: 构造族别隐藏的无标签样本任务：高斯数据应用平均（误差 $n^{-1}$）、均匀数据应用极值（$n^{-2}$）、对称高斯混合（$\sigma^2_n/n$）。标量输入下 softmax attention 计算经验累积量生成函数的导数，作为区分族别并插值样本均值与 mid-range 的单一原语；用 softmax mixture-of-experts 或 gated linear unit (GLU) 组合 attention 专家，分析 stagewise gradient flow，并给出分离专家误差、路由误差与归一化误差的 risk decomposition。
summary_sections.result: 在 $\widetilde\Omega(n^{1+\epsilon})$ 个预训练任务下学到的估计器在高斯任务上渐近有效，在均匀任务上距 minimax 率至多 $n^\epsilon$ 因子，在方差收缩体制的混合分布上 order-optimal；保证可推广到新位置与更长上下文。Softmax gating 强制归一化与精确平移等变性，GLU 则需学习之，其动力学分为快速去偏与慢速专家选择两个阶段；端到端实验复现了预测到的专家特化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 统计自适应性可由单一 attention 原语加专家路由在梯度流下学得，架构差异体现在归一化与平移等变性是被强制还是被学出，softmax gating 与 GLU 因此呈现不同的训练动力学。

papers.title: ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Small reasoning models (SRMs) have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought trajectories, but they often fail to recover once their reasoning enters an erroneous path. Existing test-time fusion methods rely on local fusion signals to determine when to trigger fusion, which can be misled by transient uncertainty fluctuations and may reinforce unstable reasoning trajectories. We propose ThinkFuse, a training-free test-time fusion framework that selectively intervenes in unreliable reasoning segments. ThinkFuse compares segment-level uncertainty shifts with trajectory-level uncertainty trends to identify unstable reasoning points and fuse auxiliary reasoning paths into the primary model's trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ThinkFuse outperforms baselines on mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, with consistent gains across model-family combinations, and remains robust with a smaller primary model. Our analysis shows that ThinkFuse requires fewer fusion triggers and generates fewer tokens, highlighting the efficiency of selective triggering. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ThinkFuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ThinkFuse 是面向小推理模型 (SRM) 的免训练测试时融合框架：把片段级不确定性变化与整条轨迹的不确定性趋势对比，定位推理失稳点，再把辅助推理路径融进主模型轨迹。在数学与知识密集推理基准上超过基线，且触发融合次数更少、生成 token 更少，在更小的主模型上仍保持稳健。
Motivation: 小推理模型一旦走进错误推理路径就难以自拔；已有测试时融合方法只靠局部融合信号决定触发时机，容易被瞬时不确定性波动误导，反而强化不稳定的推理轨迹。
Method: 免训练的测试时融合框架 ThinkFuse：比较片段级不确定性偏移与轨迹级不确定性趋势来识别不稳定推理点，选择性地在这些点把辅助推理路径融合进主模型轨迹，从而选择性介入不可靠片段。
Result: 在数学与知识密集推理基准上优于基线，在不同模型家族组合上增益一致，主模型更小时仍稳健；分析显示所需融合触发次数更少、生成 token 更少，体现选择性触发的效率。
Conclusion: 用轨迹级趋势校准局部不确定性信号，可以让测试时融合只在真正失稳处触发，从而同时提升推理正确率与 token 效率。

papers.title: Towards benchmarking Western Bluebird detection in the wild
papers.abstract_en: Bird monitoring in natural environments is challenging due to the small size of some species of birds relative to the scene, background clutter, variability in illumination, and the observers' viewpoint. Progress is further limited by the scarcity of large-scale, realistic datasets, which are essential for understanding behavioral patterns. To address this gap, we introduce a new benchmark dataset for the detection and segmentation of Western bluebirds (Sialia Mexicana), comprising over 6,000 labeled images from 41 recording sessions. The dataset features high-resolution (4K) in-the-wild images in which birds occupy only a small fraction of the image. We evaluated supervised detectors, open-vocabulary models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings, and segmentation approaches. Supervised detectors remain the most reliable overall, with Faster R-CNN achieving the highest detection mAP and RT-DETR offering the best precision-recall trade-off. Open-vocabulary models perform poorly in zero-shot settings; however, fine-tuning substantially improves their performance, with YOLO-World becoming competitive with supervised methods and achieving the highest precision, F1-score, and mAP@0.5. For segmentation, supervised methods significantly outperform Grounded-SAM and SAM 3: Mask R-CNN achieves the highest mask mAP, while YOLOv8-Seg provides the best precision and fastest inference. A diagnostic analysis further shows that failures are not explained by object size alone, but by a combination of apparent scale, brightness, contrast, clutter, blur, crowding, and recording-session variation. Overall, our findings highlight the difficulty of zero-shot bird detection in cluttered ecological scenes and underscore the importance of domain adaptation in small-object settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为野外西蓝鸲 (Sialia Mexicana) 检测与分割建立新基准：6,000+ 张 4K 标注图像、41 个录制会话，评测监督检测器、开放词汇模型（零样本与微调）与分割方法。监督检测器整体最可靠，Faster R-CNN 检测 mAP 最高、RT-DETR 精度-召回权衡最好；开放词汇模型零样本表现差，微调后 YOLO-World 在精度、F1 与 mAP@0.5 上达到最高并接近监督方法。
Motivation: 野外鸟类监测受小目标、背景杂乱、光照与视角变化制约，且缺少大规模真实数据集，限制了对行为模式的理解。
Method: 构建含 6,000+ 张标注图像、41 个录制会话的 4K 野外数据集（鸟体仅占图像一小部分），评测监督检测器（Faster R-CNN、RT-DETR）、开放词汇模型的零样本与微调设定，以及分割方法（Mask R-CNN、YOLOv8-Seg、Grounded-SAM、SAM 3），并做失败归因的诊断分析。
Result: 监督检测器整体最可靠：Faster R-CNN 检测 mAP 最高，RT-DETR 精度-召回权衡最好。开放词汇模型零样本表现差，微调后 YOLO-World 变得具竞争力，取得最高精度、F1 与 mAP@0.5。分割上监督方法显著优于 Grounded-SAM 与 SAM 3：Mask R-CNN mask mAP 最高，YOLOv8-Seg 精度最好且推理最快。诊断分析显示失败不能只由目标大小解释，而是表观尺度、亮度、对比度、杂乱、模糊、拥挤与录制会话变化的共同作用。
Conclusion: 杂乱生态场景中的零样本鸟类检测依然困难，小目标设定下域适应（微调）是关键；失败由多因素组合而非单一尺寸驱动。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Novice Reliance Calibration in AI-Assisted Decision Making: The Role of Explanations and Self-Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools are widely used to support decision making in tasks and domains where no immediate performance feedback is available. In these settings, users cannot learn to adjust their reliance behavior over time through trial and error. However, little is known about how novice users calibrate reliance on AI when external feedback is unavailable, or whether AI explanations can support calibration in its absence. We introduce reliance calibration as an organizing construct for studying how novice users dynamically adjust reliance behavior, and examine how AI explanations and meta-cognitive self-assessment shape it. Through a between-subjects study with 110 participants completing a clinical entity extraction task with AI assistance and limited performance feedback, we observe that novice users exhibit systematic drift toward over-reliance in the presence of explanations, while higher self-reported task understanding is associated with more selective reliance behavior. These results extend reliance calibration research into human-AI collaboration contexts without real-time performance signals and present actionable guidelines on designing AI tools that must support appropriate reliance in these settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无即时性能反馈的 AI 辅助决策中，引入解释 (explanation) 反而使新手系统性地向过度依赖漂移，而更高的自评任务理解度与更有选择性的依赖行为相关。110 人受试者间实验（临床实体抽取任务、有限性能反馈）支持这一方向性结论。
Motivation: 在缺乏即时性能反馈的场景中，新手无法通过试错调整依赖行为，而解释能否替代反馈帮助校准依赖 (reliance calibration) 尚不清楚。
Method: 提出 reliance calibration 作为组织性构念，用受试者间 (between-subjects) 实验考察 AI 解释与元认知自我评估 (meta-cognitive self-assessment) 的作用；110 名参与者完成带 AI 辅助、性能反馈有限的临床实体抽取任务。
Result: 在有解释的条件下新手表现出系统性向过度依赖漂移；自评任务理解度越高，依赖行为越有选择性；实验设置为 110 名参与者的临床实体抽取任务、有限性能反馈。
Conclusion: 解释在缺少实时性能信号时可能加剧而非纠正新手的过度依赖，设计此类 AI 工具应同时支持自我评估以促成恰当依赖。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts
papers.abstract_en: People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap. Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables; Submitted & Accepted to ICAIF'2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在财务信息披露从 8 条降到 0 条的过程中，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 的建议越来越由投资者身份而非财务事实决定：同等财务下两个人设的股票配置建议差距从 4.78 个百分点升到 10.34 个百分点，身份解释的建议差异占比从 5% 升到 96%。作者建议在用户真实达到的披露水平上审计此类投顾系统，并按整个人设空间而非单一属性评判。
Motivation: 用户向 LLM 咨询理财时往往不会完整描述财务状况，而现有评估很少度量财务证据缺失时模型建议对投资者身份（persona）的敏感程度。
Method: 固定财务画像，只改变投资者身份表述；将提示中的财务证据从 8 条事实分级降到 0 条，测量建议股票配置的移动幅度。共 96,600 条提示，由 100 个财务画像、138 个人设、7 种披露条件构成，模型为 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct；用双向聚类 bootstrap（重复提示只计一次）估计比值，并在 persona 层聚类标准差，另做性别方向在 5 层的消融。
Result: 两个人设（财务相同）的平均建议差距从全披露的 4.78 个百分点升到零披露的 10.34 个百分点；聚类 bootstrap 给出比值 2.16（95% 区间 1.69–2.79），只剩 1 条事实时已达 1.69 倍。身份解释的画像内建议差异占比从全披露的 5% 升到零披露的 96%。家庭规模是唯一随证据撤回而影响可靠增大的属性；在 persona 层聚类后，会议版报告的多数属性交互失去显著性，性别表现为全披露也未消除的小幅固定差距。仅声明风险偏好即可把摆动拉回与 2–7 条通用事实相当的区间。零披露时模型一行理由会引用从未被告知的收入、负债与储蓄，且这些虚构财务对更大家庭更常转为不利。网络内部性别在每一层都可线性解码，但在 5 层消融性别方向后总体身份摆动不变。
Conclusion: 财务事实缺失时模型用身份先验填补空白，且该替代不能靠逐属性审计或单层方向消融消除；投顾系统应在用户实际达到的披露水平上、按整个人设空间来审计。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 财务事实缺失时模型用身份先验填补空白，且该替代不能靠逐属性审计或单层方向消融消除；投顾系统应在用户实际达到的披露水平上、按整个人设空间来审计。

papers.title: The Geometry of Empowerment
papers.abstract_en: Empowerment captures the capacity for an agent to actively control its environment. While conceptually appealing as an information-theoretic quantity, the connection between empowerment and structurally central states that provide broad access to future outcomes has remained an open question. In this work, we link empowerment maximization and skill-learning methods to provide new geometries for interpreting and analyzing empowerment. Our analyses answer longstanding open questions on the connections between empowerment and structural centrality. Our analyses also reveal distinctions between information and reward geometries, highlighting important theoretical implications to build scalable empowerment-maximization methods. Website and code can be found at https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 empowerment 最大化与技能学习 (skill-learning) 方法联系起来，给出解释和分析 empowerment 的新几何结构，从而回答 empowerment 与结构性中心度 (structural centrality) 关系这一长期开放问题。分析还区分了信息几何与奖励几何，并指出这对构建可扩展的 empowerment 最大化方法有理论含义。
Motivation: empowerment 虽是信息论上吸引人的量，但它与能广泛通达未来结果的结构性中心状态之间究竟什么关系，一直是未解问题。
Method: 将 empowerment 最大化与技能学习方法相联，构造用于解释和分析 empowerment 的新几何（信息几何与奖励几何），据此分析 empowerment 与 structural centrality 的联系。
Result: 回答了关于 empowerment 与结构性中心度联系的长期开放问题，并揭示信息几何与奖励几何之间的区分；摘要给出的是理论分析结论，无实验数字。
Conclusion: empowerment 与结构性中心度之间存在可由几何刻画的联系，而信息几何与奖励几何的区分是构建可扩展 empowerment 最大化方法的理论依据。

papers.title: Efficient Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression with Standard Video Codecs
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel effective Gaussian Splatting (GS) sequence Compression method that utilizes the Video codec (GSCV). Existing video-based GS sequence compression relies on the Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS) and tracked primitive information to convert GS into smooth 2D videos. However, tracked information is not available for most practical applications, and without it, using the vanilla PLAS can generate images exhibiting weak inter-frame correlation, due to its stochastic nature. GSCV incorporates a simple yet efficient Inter-PLAS method to produce close images between the I- and P-frames of GS, enhancing the inter-frame performance of video codec greatly. GSCV also realizes a new pipeline based on the state-of-the-art video codecs with high bit-depth GS images, achieving higher compressibility while simultaneously providing a higher quality upper bound. Experimental results show that the proposed GSCV exhibits obviously improved performance over MPEG video and point cloud-based anchors in GS sequence compression. The code is available at https://github.com/Qi-Yangsjtu/GSCV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出用标准视频编码器压缩 Gaussian Splatting (GS) 序列的 GSCV：用 Inter-PLAS 让 I 帧与 P 帧图像更接近，从而提升帧间相关性与编码效率，并配合高比特深度 GS 图像的新流程。在 GS 序列压缩上明显优于以 MPEG 视频和点云编码为锚点的基线。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的 GS 序列压缩依赖 PLAS 与被跟踪的 primitive 信息来生成平滑 2D 视频，而实际应用大多拿不到跟踪信息；缺少它时 vanilla PLAS 因随机性产生帧间相关性弱的图像，压缩效率差。
Method: GSCV 引入 Inter-PLAS，使 I 帧与 P 帧图像彼此接近以增强帧间相关性；再基于当前 SOTA 视频编码器搭建以高比特深度 GS 图像为输入的新压缩流程，提高可压缩性并抬高质量上限。
Result: 实验显示 GSCV 在 GS 序列压缩上明显优于以 MPEG 视频编码和点云编码为 anchor 的方法；代码发布于 github.com/Qi-Yangsjtu/GSCV。
Conclusion: 不依赖被跟踪 primitive 信息、靠改善 I/P 帧相似度与高比特深度流程，标准视频编码器即可高效压缩 GS 序列。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry-Constrained Bidirectional Point Cloud Registration for Thin, Sheet-Like Heritage Artifacts
papers.abstract_en: Non-contact three-dimensional reconstruction of thin, sheet-like heritage artifacts poses significant geometric and registration challenges. Due to their fragility, these artifacts cannot be suspended or equipped with artificial markers, necessitating independent acquisition of their front and back surfaces. Subsequent registration proves difficult due to the limited number of shared geometric features and the scarcity of explicit physical constraints, which may result in rotational ambiguity, instability, and structural collapse during iterative optimization. To address these challenges, we propose a geometry-constrained bidirectional point cloud registration method specifically tailored for thin, sheet-like heritage artifacts. The method integrates semantic-guided preprocessing, Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based geometric normalization, and a thickness-aware registration strategy. The estimated physical thickness is incorporated as a geometric constraint to preserve structural integrity during registration. Rotational ambiguity is resolved by evaluating a finite set of global rotation hypotheses, each refined using the point-to-plane Iterative Closest Point (ICP) algorithm, with the optimal transformation selected via a geometry-aware fitness criterion consistent with the thickness scale. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive or improved performance in most cases, particularly in projected area consistency and physically plausible front-back alignment. In addition, the thickness-aware constraint and rotation hypothesis evaluation reduce the risk of degenerate configurations in which the two surfaces are incorrectly flipped while still yielding deceptively acceptable numerical scores, supporting reliable non-contact digitization of delicate and thin heritage artifacts. Implementation details are available at https://zyz-nwpu.github.io/GCBPCR/.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in ACM Journal on Computing and Cultural Heritage
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对薄片状文物正背面需分别采集、共享几何特征少导致配准出现旋转歧义与结构塌陷的问题，提出几何约束的双向点云配准 (GCBPCR)：语义引导预处理加 PCA 几何归一化，把估计的物理厚度作为约束，并在有限全局旋转假设集上逐个用 point-to-plane ICP 精化、按与厚度尺度一致的 geometry-aware fitness 选出最优变换。实验中多数情形达到竞争或更优表现，尤其在投影面积一致性与物理上合理的正背面对齐上，厚度约束与旋转假设评估降低了两面被错误翻转却仍给出可接受数值分数的退化配置风险。
Motivation: 薄片状文物脆弱、不能悬挂或贴人工标记，正背面只能独立采集；共享几何特征少、显式物理约束稀缺，使迭代配准易出现旋转歧义、不稳定乃至结构塌陷。
Method: GCBPCR 由三部分组成：语义引导的预处理、基于主成分分析 (PCA) 的几何归一化、以及厚度感知配准策略；把估计出的物理厚度作为几何约束以保持结构完整性，对有限的全局旋转假设逐一用 point-to-plane ICP 精化，再用与厚度尺度一致的 geometry-aware fitness 准则选出最优变换。
Result: 实验结果显示该方法在多数情形下达到竞争性或更优表现，尤其体现在投影面积一致性与物理上合理的正背面对齐；厚度约束与旋转假设评估降低了两面被错误翻转却仍给出欺骗性可接受数值分数的退化配置风险。
Conclusion: 把物理厚度作为显式约束并显式枚举旋转假设，可让薄片状脆弱文物的非接触正背面配准在数值分数之外仍保持物理可信，支撑可靠的数字化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ServeLearnBench: How Well Can Agents Self-Improve from Serving Experience?
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex tasks in real-world environments. However, the knowledge required for correct behavior in these environments is often implicit, undisclosed, and subject to change over time. Recent continual-learning harnesses seek to address this challenge by enabling agents to improve from serving experience. Yet the effectiveness and limitations of these methods are not yet well characterized. Existing benchmarks provide only partial coverage: some explicitly provide the target knowledge, others assume a static environment, and those that support continual adaptation remain limited in scale and knowledge diversity. To enable systematic evaluation, we formalize an evolving-environment streaming dataset (EESD), in which agents must infer, apply, and revise latent environment knowledge from interaction and outcome feedback as hidden policies evolve, and introduce ServeLearnBench, spanning retail support, banking, and sales-pitch generation with 53 environment windows and 7,718 tasks. We evaluate five learning harnesses (RAG, Mem0, SkillOpt, Continual Harness, and Prime) across six models (GPT-5.6 Terra, Opus 5, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and GLM-5.3 Flash), covering 28 model-harness pairs and 252 learning runs. Our evaluation reveals three main findings: a substantial gap remains between task capability and learning from experience; continual adaptation is costly and can degrade already-correct behavior; and insufficient exploration emerges as a key bottleneck to effective adaptation. Overall, ServeLearnBench provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing these limitations and tracking progress toward agents that continually and reliably improve through serving experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ServeLearnBench：把环境知识隐含且随时间变化的持续学习场景形式化为 evolving-environment streaming dataset (EESD)，让智能体从交互与结果反馈中推断、应用并修正隐藏策略。在 53 个环境窗口、7,718 个任务上评测 5 种学习 harness 与 6 个模型共 252 次学习运行，发现任务能力与从经验学习之间仍有明显差距，持续适应成本高且会损害原本正确的行为，探索不足是有效适应的关键瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有持续学习基准覆盖不全：有的直接给出目标知识，有的假设静态环境，支持持续适应的又在规模与知识多样性上受限，无法系统刻画从服务经验自改进的效果与边界。
Method: 形式化 EESD 流式数据集，隐藏策略随时间演化，智能体须从交互与结果反馈中推断、应用并修正隐性环境知识；基准覆盖 retail support、banking、sales-pitch generation 三个域，评测 RAG、Mem0、SkillOpt、Continual Harness、Prime 五种 harness 与 GPT-5.6 Terra、Opus 5、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GLM-5.3 Flash 六个模型。
Result: 53 个环境窗口、7,718 个任务、28 个 model-harness 组合、252 次学习运行；三项发现：任务能力与从经验学习之间存在 substantial gap，持续适应成本高且会退化已正确的行为，探索不足是有效适应的关键瓶颈。
Conclusion: ServeLearnBench 是诊断这些局限的受控测试床，表明当前 harness 尚不能让智能体持续可靠地从服务经验中改进，探索不足是首要待解瓶颈。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Illusory pattern perception is a well-documented human cognitive tendency to infer meaningful relationships in data that is actually random. Such a tendency, often described as "connecting the dots" where none exist, can result in systematic reasoning errors. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit such perceptual tendencies, which can lead to systematic errors in downstream applications. To our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of illusory pattern perception in LLMs, adapting classic psychological paradigms to three tasks with direct empirical comparison to human behaviors. We find that LLMs frequently exhibit stronger illusory pattern perception than humans. In particular, models tend to over-associate frequent positive attributes with majority groups or large organizations, and show increased tendencies to construct causal narratives from ambiguous events. To uncover the mechanism behind these behaviors, we develop a feature interpretability framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze internal representations. Our results reveal that holistic frequency perception and analytic cognitive orientation are linked to the emergence of illusory perceptions. These findings highlight a previously underexplored cognitive-like illusion that may affect the reliability of LLM reasoning. Code available at https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首次系统研究 LLM 的错觉模式知觉 (illusory pattern perception)：把三个经典心理学范式迁移到 LLM 并与人类行为直接对照，发现模型比人类更常在随机数据中读出关系，尤其倾向把高频正面属性过度关联到多数群体或大型组织、从模糊事件编造因果叙事。基于 Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) 的特征可解释性框架进一步把这种倾向与整体频率知觉和分析性认知取向联系起来。
Motivation: 人类在随机数据中强行寻找规律会导致系统性推理错误；若 LLM 也存在同类认知错觉，会直接削弱其下游推理的可靠性，而这一认知样错觉此前几乎未被研究。
Method: 把三个经典心理学实验范式改编为三个任务，与人类行为做直接实证对照；再构建基于 Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) 的特征可解释性框架分析模型内部表征，定位与错觉模式知觉相关的特征。
Result: LLM 表现出的错觉模式知觉强于人类；模型更频繁地把高频正面属性过度关联到多数群体或大型组织，并更倾向于从模糊事件构造因果叙事；SAE 特征分析显示整体频率知觉 (holistic frequency perception) 与分析性认知取向 (analytic cognitive orientation) 与错觉知觉的出现相关联。
Conclusion: LLM 存在类似人类的错觉模式知觉，且在若干维度上比人类更强，这种认知样错觉会威胁 LLM 推理的可靠性；代码已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: 首次系统研究 LLM 的错觉模式知觉 (illusory pattern perception)：把三个经典心理学范式迁移到 LLM 并与人类行为直接对照，发现模型比人类更常在随机数据中读出关系，尤其倾向把高频正面属性过度关联到多数群体或大型组织、从模糊事件编造因果叙事。基于 Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) 的特征可解释性框架进一步把这种倾向与整体频率知觉和分析性认知取向联系起来。
summary_sections.motivation: 人类在随机数据中强行寻找规律会导致系统性推理错误；若 LLM 也存在同类认知错觉，会直接削弱其下游推理的可靠性，而这一认知样错觉此前几乎未被研究。
summary_sections.method: 把三个经典心理学实验范式改编为三个任务，与人类行为做直接实证对照；再构建基于 Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) 的特征可解释性框架分析模型内部表征，定位与错觉模式知觉相关的特征。

papers.title: Image-Space Refraction Correction for Underwater 3D Reconstruction: Warping Flat-Port Views into Pinhole Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Consumer-grade cameras in flat-port housings are widely used for underwater exploration and mapping of coral reefs and seafloor habitats due to their low cost and accessibility. However, refraction at flat-port interfaces causes bowl-shaped deformation in reconstructed scenes and camera trajectories, compromising the metric accuracy required for mapping and navigation. To remove the dominant refractive distortion before reconstruction, we introduce a physics-based refraction correction in image space. Our method is downstream-agnostic: the refraction-corrected images can be directly used as input to existing reconstruction and SLAM algorithms. We characterize the refractive distortion through ray-tracing simulations and validate our correction on two real underwater datasets with differing scene structures. Compared with conventional and refractive Structure-from-Motion (SfM), our approach removes reconstruction deformation while registering more frames and maintaining low reprojection error. The correction further generalizes across diverse reconstruction and VSLAM backends, demonstrating its broad applicability to downstream vision pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出图像空间的平板舱口折射校正：在重建之前用基于物理的光线追迹把 flat-port 视图 warp 回针孔透视，输出对下游算法无感，可直接喂给现有 SfM 与 SLAM。在两个场景结构不同的真实水下数据集上，相比常规 SfM 与折射感知 SfM，该方法消除碗状形变、注册更多帧并保持低重投影误差。
Motivation: 消费级相机加平板舱口 (flat-port) 外壳是珊瑚礁与海底栖息地测绘的低成本方案，但界面折射使重建场景与相机轨迹呈碗状形变，破坏测绘与导航所需的度量精度。
Method: 先用光线追迹仿真刻画折射畸变，再在图像空间做基于物理的折射校正，把 flat-port 视图 warp 成针孔透视；校正后的图像下游无关，可直接作为现有重建与 SLAM 算法的输入。
Result: 在两个场景结构不同的真实水下数据集上，相比 conventional 与 refractive Structure-from-Motion (SfM)，该方法去除重建形变、注册更多帧并保持低重投影误差；校正进一步跨多种重建与 VSLAM 后端泛化。
Conclusion: 把折射校正前置到图像空间，即可在不改动下游的前提下同时改善水下重建的几何形变与帧注册，且对重建和 VSLAM 后端具有广泛适用性。

papers.title: OOPMAS: Object-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems for Query-Level Workflow Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models have shown strong performance across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and question answering. However, existing methods for automating MAS design mostly operate at the task level, producing a single fixed workflow per benchmark that is applied uniformly to all queries. This assumption fails under realistic conditions. Query difficulty varies widely within a task, and real-world workloads mix heterogeneous task types. We introduce OOPMAS, a training-free framework that generates both the agent set and the coordination workflow at the granularity of individual queries. Agents are represented as object-oriented class definitions with dedicated roles, tools, and persistent state, and workflows are expressed as executable main functions over these agent objects. A dynamic skill library accumulates structured lessons from execution feedback across optimization rounds, enabling in-context improvement without any gradient updates or fine-tuning. On a mixed-task benchmark of queries spanning code, math, and QA, OOPMAS achieves 89.6% accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 18.1 percentage points. A model-swap study across four LLM backbones shows consistent scaling, reaching 92.4% with the strongest model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OOPMAS 是一个免训练框架，按单条 query 而非整个 benchmark 生成 agent 集合与协调 workflow：agent 用面向对象类定义（角色、工具、持久状态），workflow 写成作用于这些 agent 对象的可执行 main 函数，动态技能库从执行反馈累积结构化经验以实现免梯度的上下文内改进。在混合 code、math、QA 的 benchmark 上准确率 89.6%，比最强基线高 18.1 个百分点，换用四个 LLM 骨干后一致扩展，最强模型达 92.4%。
Motivation: 现有 MAS 自动化设计方法停留在 task 粒度，一个 benchmark 只产出一条固定 workflow 并统一套用到所有 query；但 query 难度差异大、真实负载混合异构任务类型，这一假设失效。
Method: 训练-free 的 query 级生成框架：agent 表示为带专属角色、工具与持久状态的面向对象类定义，workflow 表示为操作这些 agent 对象的可执行 main 函数；动态 skill library 从多轮优化的执行反馈中累积结构化教训，实现无梯度更新、无微调的上下文内改进。
Result: 在跨 code、math、QA 的混合任务 benchmark 上 OOPMAS 准确率 89.6%，比最强基线高 18.1 个百分点；在四个 LLM 骨干上的模型替换研究显示一致的扩展性，最强模型达到 92.4%。
Conclusion: 把 MAS 设计从 task 级下移到 query 级并让 agent 以对象形式携带状态与技能，可在不训练、不微调的前提下同时提升混合任务负载的准确率并跨骨干模型保持扩展。

papers.title: Extending Pathwise Gradients to Discrete Random Variables via Finite-Order Relaxation
papers.abstract_en: Pathwise gradients are preferred for continuous random variables because they are unbiased, low variance, and work with a single sample. For discrete variables, however, the pathwise identity cannot generally be exact for every differentiable function. We propose a general framework to construct finite-order exact pathwise gradient estimators for a range of common discrete variables such as Poisson. The estimator is the least-norm solution among all solutions that are unbiased for polynomials of degree at most. The resulting estimators preserve the hard forward sample, require no temperature tuning, and can be implemented in a few lines of codes. Against other admissible solutions, our estimator is unique and minimizes weight variance; in contrast, prior works use categorical variables or augmented representations to approximate non-categorical variables that induces excess variance and computations. To understand approximation bias for functions beyond the prescribed class, we also derive a non-asymptotic bias bound. In experiments our low order methods match or improve tuned baselines across linear, nonlinear and hierarchical latent-variable models, while out-speeding competitors in every runtime benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出有限阶松弛 (finite-order relaxation) 框架，为 Poisson 等常见离散变量构造有限阶精确的 pathwise 梯度估计器：它是对次数不超过给定阶的多项式无偏的所有解中的最小范数解，保留硬前向采样、无需温度调节，且在可解中唯一并最小化权重方差。在隐变量模型实验中，低阶方法在线性、非线性与分层设定上匹配或改进调好参的基线，并在所有运行时间基准上快于竞争方法。
Motivation: pathwise 恒等式对连续变量无偏、低方差、单样本可用，但对离散变量一般无法对任意可微函数精确成立；已有工作用类别变量或增广表示去近似非类别离散变量，带来额外方差与计算开销。
Method: 构造有限阶精确 pathwise 梯度估计器，取对次数不超过给定阶的多项式无偏的解集中的最小范数解；对超出该函数类的函数推导非渐近偏差界 (non-asymptotic bias bound)，估计器保留硬前向采样、无需温度调节，几行代码即可实现。
Result: 在 linear、nonlinear 与 hierarchical 隐变量模型上，低阶方法匹配或改进调好参的基线，并在每个运行时间基准上快于竞争方法；理论上估计器在可解中唯一且权重方差最小，并给出非渐近偏差界。
Conclusion: 离散变量的 pathwise 梯度可以在指定多项式函数类上做到有限阶精确而不牺牲硬采样与速度，代价是超出该类的函数存在可界定的偏差。

papers.title: Attacca: Goal-Directed Control under State Continuity for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: A central capability of embodied agents is to accomplish complex objectives through sequences of interdependent tasks. Yet existing visual goal-conditioned policies underlying these agents are typically evaluated on isolated interactions where the target is already visible, and thus do not capture the conditions that arise during continuous long-horizon task execution. In such settings, each task begins from the state left by the previous one: the agent may end at a different position and orientation, the world may have been modified, and the next interaction target may lie outside the current field of view. As a result, agents relying on such policies may struggle to proceed to the next task when they cannot ground their target in the current observation. To address this challenge, we propose Attacca, a new approach that trains visual goal-conditioned policies on complete search-to-interact trajectories using goal images decoupled from the execution environment. Attacca uses context-decoupled goal sampling to pair each demonstration with a class-compatible masked goal image from another world, removing direct scene and pose correspondence. It learns dense current-view grounding through a target-mask prediction head, providing auxiliary supervision beyond action imitation. We further introduce behavioral-phase conditioning that teaches the policy to distinguish Search, Approach, and Interact stages and adapt its control as execution progresses. We evaluate Attacca on multiple short- and long-horizon embodied tasks in Minecraft. Our method achieves 39.0-47.5% clean success, improving over the strongest baseline by 1.7-2.4x. On long-horizon tasks, it attains 54%, 30%, and 28% completion, yielding up to a 7x improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Attacca 针对长时程具身任务中「上一任务留下的状态使下一目标不在视野内」的问题，用与执行环境解耦的目标图像在完整 search-to-interact 轨迹上训练视觉目标条件策略：context-decoupled goal sampling 配对跨世界的类兼容 masked goal image，target-mask prediction head 提供稠密当前视图 grounding 辅助监督，behavioral-phase conditioning 区分 Search/Approach/Interact 三阶段。在 Minecraft 短程与长程任务上 clean success 达 39.0–47.5%，比最强基线高 1.7–2.4 倍；长程任务完成率 54%、30%、28%，最高提升 7 倍。
Motivation: 现有视觉目标条件策略只在目标已可见的孤立交互上评测，无法覆盖连续长时程执行中每个任务从前一任务遗留状态开始的情形：位置朝向改变、世界被修改、下一目标可能在视野之外，策略无法在当前观测中 ground 目标就难以继续。
Method: 在完整 search-to-interact 轨迹上训练视觉目标条件策略，目标图像与执行环境解耦：context-decoupled goal sampling 从另一个世界取类兼容的 masked goal image 与演示配对，去掉场景与位姿的直接对应；target-mask prediction head 在动作模仿之外提供稠密当前视图 grounding 的辅助监督；behavioral-phase conditioning 让策略区分 Search、Approach、Interact 三阶段并随执行进度调整控制。
Result: 在 Minecraft 的多个短时程与长时程具身任务上，clean success 为 39.0–47.5%，相对最强基线提升 1.7–2.4 倍；长时程任务完成率分别为 54%、30%、28%，最高带来 7 倍提升。
Conclusion: 把目标图像与执行环境解耦、并显式监督当前视图 grounding 与行为阶段，能让视觉目标条件策略在状态连续的长时程任务中持续推进，而不只在目标可见的孤立交互上成立。

papers.title: From Laboratory to Road: Evaluating Wearable Gaze Accuracy for Driving
papers.abstract_en: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations have become a widely used interface between perception and planning in autonomous driving, but they encode what is in a scene, not what is behaviorally relevant to a human driver. Gaze offers a compelling behavioral signal for this gap, yet wearable eye trackers are routinely deployed as if their spatial output were ground truth, despite known sensitivity to head motion, illumination, and calibration drift. We present, to our knowledge, the first unified framework for quantifying wearable gaze accuracy under real driving conditions. Our on-road study contains 41 validated scenes in which one driver fixated a vehicle's license plate. Gaze error is measured as the angular difference between the plate center and the gaze direction estimated by the glasses. Separate indoor studies with the same driver and device systematically analyze how distance, illumination, head motion, target motion, and gaze eccentricity affect both systematic bias and gaze precision. The mean on-road error was 4.58 degrees. Applying an offset estimated from the indoor recordings reduced it to 1.10 degrees and improved all 41 scenes. Because this offset varied between sessions, reliable BEV supervision may require online recalibration and condition-dependent estimates of gaze uncertainty.
papers.comment: Peer-reviewed and accepted as an Extended Abstract at the German Conference on Pattern Recognition (GCPR 2026). Presented as a poster at GCPR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对驾驶场景下可穿戴眼动仪的注视精度被当作真值使用，提出首个统一量化框架：路面 41 个验证场景（驾驶员注视车牌）测角误差，室内同人同设备系统分离距离、光照、头动、目标运动与注视偏心度的影响。路面平均误差 4.58°，用室内估计的偏移校正后降到 1.10°，且 41 个场景全部改善。
Motivation: BEV 是感知到规划的通用接口，但只编码场景里有什么，缺少对人类驾驶员行为相关的注视信息；而可穿戴眼动仪的空间输出常被当作真值，实际受头动、光照与标定漂移影响。
Method: 路面研究含 41 个验证场景，驾驶员注视一辆车的车牌，注视误差取车牌中心与眼镜估计注视方向的角差；室内研究用同一驾驶员与设备，系统分析距离、光照、头动、目标运动、注视偏心度对系统性偏差与精度的影响，并把室内估计的偏移用于路面数据校正。
Result: 路面平均注视误差 4.58°；应用室内记录估计的偏移后降至 1.10°，并改善全部 41 个场景；该偏移在不同 session 间变化。
Conclusion: 可穿戴眼动仪的注视输出需要按条件校正后才能用作 BEV 监督，作者据此提出在线重标定与随条件变化的注视不确定性估计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Persistent Memory in Multi-Agent LLM Inference: What It Costs, What It Buys, and When You Can Tell
papers.abstract_en: Decomposing long-context inference across cooperating agents bounds the active KV cache per call rather than total evidence, which matters when KV-cache memory binds. Many such systems add a persistent tier storing and recalling reasoning traces, usually validated by an ablation reporting an accuracy gain. We measure both on one three-tier agent architecture. Decomposition delivers: peak KV working set of 14.3 MiB per query against 35.5 and 35.3 MiB for single-pass and retrieval-augmented baselines. The persistent tier does not: across eight controlled dataset pairs at n=100 per arm it costs +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590] of peak cache and produces no detectable accuracy change (+0.015, 95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]). We argue the null is structural: single-question benchmarks supply each item with its own evidence and score it independently, and correctness requires resetting stored traces between conditions, so recall has nothing informative to retrieve. Reaching it took four measurement corrections -- three inflating the apparent benefit, the fourth making an effect that size look resolvable -- none visible in the results table. We give the conditions an agent-memory ablation must satisfy and detection procedures that need no knowledge of the specific defect.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the Machine Learning for Systems Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在三层多智能体 LLM 推理架构上同时测量 KV cache 分解与持久记忆层的收益：分解确实把单次查询峰值 KV 工作集压到 14.3 MiB（单遍与检索增强基线为 35.5 与 35.3 MiB），而持久记忆层在八组受控数据集配对（每臂 n=100）上只多花 +0.368 MiB 峰值缓存，准确率变化 +0.015（95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]）不可检出。作者论证这个零效应是结构性的：单题基准各自携带证据、逐条独立打分，且跨条件必须重置已存轨迹，recall 无信息可取。
Motivation: 多智能体长上下文推理系统普遍加一层持久记忆存储与召回推理轨迹，通常只靠一次消融报告准确率增益来验证；但当 KV cache 内存受限时，分解与持久记忆各自的代价和收益从未被同时测量。
Method: 在一个三层智能体架构上同时测量两件事：长上下文推理分解对活跃 KV cache 的约束，以及持久记忆层的增益；用八组受控数据集配对、每臂 n=100 的对照实验，并记录四次测量修正（三次夸大表面收益，第四次让该量级的效应看似可分辨）。
Result: 分解带来峰值 KV 工作集 14.3 MiB/query，对比单遍 35.5 MiB 与检索增强 35.3 MiB；持久记忆层代价为峰值缓存 +0.368 MiB [+0.167, +0.590]，准确率变化 +0.015，95% CI [-0.011, +0.046]，即无可检出的准确率变化。四次测量修正中三次夸大收益、第四次使该量级效应看似可分辨，且都不出现在结果表里。
Conclusion: 单题基准下智能体持久记忆消融的零效应是结构性的，因为正确性要求跨条件重置已存轨迹；作者给出消融必须满足的条件与不依赖具体缺陷知识的检测流程。

papers.title: Quantization Effects on Tool-Failure Recovery Vary Across Prompts and Evaluation Designs
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization reduces the cost of deploying language-model agents, but its effect on recovery from temporary tool failures can depend on how recovery is evaluated. We compare 8-bit and 4-bit variants of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on twenty deterministic tool-use tasks and five prompts. The 8-bit-4-bit recovery comparison changes direction across prompts and evaluation targets. On tasks that both variants complete without faults under the same prompt, the difference ranges from 0 to +20.2 percentage points for Llama and from -50.0 to +35.0 points for Qwen. Full-pipeline point estimates favor 8-bit Llama under all five prompts, whereas the Qwen comparison changes direction across prompts. The evaluation target can also reverse the result. For Llama under one prompt, scoring each variant only on its own clean-passing tasks favors 4-bit by 17.5 points; scoring the same tasks for both variants gives no difference, while scoring the full pipeline favors 8-bit by 28.3 points. Executor leniency is a third such choice. Rescoring the same logs with strict output parsing, which 8-bit Llama violates far more often than 4-bit Llama under that prompt, turns that +28.3 into -15.0 while leaving Qwen essentially unchanged. These findings show that one prompt, one screened task set, and one scoring policy do not establish a stable conclusion about quantized-agent robustness. Evaluations should compare variants on matched tasks, report full-pipeline success for deployment decisions, state the scoring policy, and quantify uncertainty across tasks rather than injected fault sites.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Small Language Models for Agentic Systems (SLM-Agents). 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, plus appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 8-bit/4-bit 后训练量化变体在 20 个确定性工具任务、5 个 prompt 上比较工具故障恢复，发现 8-bit 与 4-bit 的优劣方向随 prompt、评分目标和解析宽松度翻转：同一 prompt 下 Llama 全流程点估计偏向 8-bit，但按各自 clean-pass 任务评分则 4-bit 领先 17.5 个百分点，改用严格输出解析后 +28.3 变为 -15.0。作者主张在匹配任务集上比较、报告全流程成功率、写明评分策略并跨任务量化不确定性。
Motivation: 量化 agent 的鲁棒性结论常由单一 prompt、单一筛选任务集和单一评分策略得出，而这些选择本身足以翻转 8-bit 与 4-bit 的优劣方向，使部署决策不可复现。
Method: 比较 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 8-bit 与 4-bit 后训练量化变体，在 20 个确定性工具使用任务 × 5 个 prompt 上运行；对同一批日志用三种评分目标（各自 clean-pass 任务、共同任务、全流程）与两种解析严格度（宽松 vs 严格输出解析）重评分。
Result: 双方同 prompt 无故障完成的任务上，差值范围 Llama 为 0 至 +20.2 个百分点、Qwen 为 -50.0 至 +35.0 点；全流程点估计在全部 5 个 prompt 下偏向 8-bit Llama，Qwen 则随 prompt 变向。Llama 在某一 prompt 下：按各自 clean-pass 任务评分 4-bit 领先 17.5 点，同任务评分无差异，全流程评分 8-bit 领先 28.3 点；改用严格输出解析（8-bit Llama 在该 prompt 下违反远多于 4-bit）后 +28.3 变为 -15.0，Qwen 基本不变。
Conclusion: 量化 agent 鲁棒性的结论对 prompt、任务筛选和评分策略高度敏感，单一配置不足以支撑稳定判断；评估应在匹配任务上比较、以全流程成功率支撑部署决策、写明评分策略并跨任务（而非跨注入故障点）量化不确定性。

papers.title: APEX: Speculate smarter, not deeper
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding reduces large language model inference latency by drafting multiple tokens before target-model verification, but its effectiveness depends on both the proposal mechanism and draft depth. Fixed configurations cannot respond to changes in predictability, repetition, and acceptance during generation, so deeper drafting can increase wasted computation without proportional speedup. We introduce APEX, a learned controller that balances decoding speed and draft-token waste through request-level expert selection and block-level depth adaptation. APEX-Router selects among EAGLE-3, n-gram, and draft-model speculation for each request, while APEX-Depth adjusts draft length at each verification block using causal decoding signals and recent verifier feedback. APEX models accepted draft length as censored survival feedback, learning position-wise rejection hazards, block execution costs, and an action utility that balances throughput, accepted progress, and wasted tokens. This allows the controller to adapt speculation while retaining the target model's verification procedure. We integrate APEX into vLLM and evaluate it with Qwen3-8B across six workloads, achieving up to 5.24X speedup over autoregressive decoding. Across the aggregate evaluation, APEX-S achieves 4.27X speedup, while APEX-B achieves 3.27X speedup with a 41.0% relative reduction in wasted-token percentage compared with fixed n-gram speculation at k=16, providing distinct operating points for balancing acceleration and draft-token utilization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APEX 是一个学习型投机解码控制器，按请求在 EAGLE-3、n-gram、draft-model 三种草稿机制间选择，并按验证块用因果解码信号与近期 verifier 反馈调整草稿长度，把已接受草稿长度建模为删失生存反馈来学逐位置拒绝风险与动作效用。在 vLLM 上用 Qwen3-8B 跑六种负载，最高比自回归解码快 5.24X；APEX-S 聚合 4.27X，APEX-B 3.27X 且相对固定 n-gram (k=16) 浪费 token 占比降 41.0%。
Motivation: 投机解码的收益取决于草稿机制与草稿深度，而固定配置无法响应生成过程中可预测性、重复度与接受率的变化，加深草稿会浪费算力却换不来等比例加速。
Method: APEX-Router 在每个请求上于 EAGLE-3、n-gram、draft-model 投机之间做专家选择；APEX-Depth 用因果解码信号与近期 verifier 反馈在每个验证块调整草稿长度。控制器把已接受草稿长度当作删失生存反馈 (censored survival feedback)，学习逐位置拒绝风险、块执行成本，以及平衡吞吐、已接受进展与浪费 token 的动作效用，同时保留目标模型的验证流程；实现集成进 vLLM。
Result: 在 vLLM 中以 Qwen3-8B 评测六种负载，最高达 5.24X 相对自回归解码的加速；聚合评测上 APEX-S 为 4.27X，APEX-B 为 3.27X，且相对固定 n-gram 投机 (k=16) 浪费 token 百分比相对下降 41.0%。
Conclusion: 按请求选草稿机制、按块调深度并把接受长度当作生存反馈来学，能在加速与草稿利用率之间给出多个可选工作点，而不必加深草稿。

papers.title: Towards One-for-All Foundation Model for Attributed Graph Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Attributed graph clustering aims to discover node groups by jointly exploiting node attributes and graph topology, yet its unsupervised nature makes model selection and adaptation inherently difficult. Existing methods typically train and tune a separate model for each input graph, leading to costly and fragile pipelines that often fail to transfer across graphs with different feature spaces, structural patterns, and attribute-structure correlations. In this paper, we study a one-for-all alternative: can a single model be trained once and directly applied to diverse attributed graphs without graph-specific training, fine-tuning, or hyperparameter search? We propose OFAG, a foundation model for attributed graph clustering. Building upon Prior-data Fitted Networks, OFAG learns a reusable clustering inference strategy from synthetic attributed graphs generated under broad priors over latent clusters, node attributes, and graph structures. To handle incompatible feature spaces across graphs, OFAG adopts a dimension-agnostic signal-wise graph encoder that treats each feature channel as a graph signal and models its response to shared graph filters. The model is trained with a hyperspherical clustering objective, producing clustering-friendly node representations in a single forward pass at inference time. On ten datasets, one frozen OFAG model achieves the best mean performance and average rank across NMI, ACC, ARI, and F1, while completing all ten datasets in 12.43 minutes total---over 6* faster than the second-fastest baseline and nearly 28* faster than the second-best on clustering quality. Our code and pretrained checkpoint are available at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/OFAG, allowing practitioners to directly apply OFAG to their own attributed graph datasets without additional training or tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OFAG 用 Prior-data Fitted Networks 在广先验生成的合成属性图上训练一次，靠维度无关的 signal-wise 图编码器与超球聚类目标，把聚类推理压成单次前向，直接套用到任意属性图而无需图特定训练、微调或超参搜索。在十个数据集上单一冻结模型的 NMI/ACC/ARI/F1 平均性能与平均排名均为最佳，全部十数据集共耗时 12.43 分钟，比第二快基线快 6 倍以上。
Motivation: 属性图聚类是无监督任务，模型选择与适配本就困难；现有方法对每张图单独训练调参，跨不同特征空间、结构模式与属性-结构相关性的图难以迁移，管线昂贵且脆弱。
Method: 基于 Prior-data Fitted Networks，在潜在簇、节点属性与图结构的广先验下生成合成属性图，从中学习可复用的聚类推理策略；用维度无关的 signal-wise 图编码器把每个特征通道视为图信号、建模其对共享图滤波器的响应以兼容不相容的特征空间；以 hyperspherical clustering objective 训练，推理时单次前向产出聚类友好的节点表示。
Result: 在十个数据集上，单一冻结 OFAG 模型在 NMI、ACC、ARI、F1 四个指标上取得最佳平均性能与平均排名；完成全部十个数据集共用 12.43 分钟，比第二快基线快 6 倍以上，比聚类质量第二名快近 28 倍。
Conclusion: 一次训练的属性图聚类基础模型可以在不重新训练、微调或调参的前提下跨图直接应用，同时在质量与速度上同时领先；代码与预训练 checkpoint 已开源供直接使用。

papers.title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 用 rollout 侧的 FP4 量化结果反向指导训练侧的舍入决策，直接压缩训练与 rollout 两条量化执行路径的差异，并配合量化信息缓存降低 rollout 指导带来的存储与通信开销。在四个大规模 MoE 语言模型的推理、代码与长程 RL 任务上，它实现 FP4 权重/激活与 FP4 KV-cache rollout，RL 性能与 BF16 rollout 相当，rollout 加速最高 5.4 倍，最终 FP4 性能强于对 BF16 训练策略做事后 FP4 量化。
Motivation: RL 后训练中 rollout 生成的计算与内存开销很大，促使人们用低精度 rollout；但现有 FP4 RL 方法分别优化训练路径与 rollout 路径的量化精度，没有直接减小两条量化路径之间的差异。
Method: TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE) 提出 rollout-guided quantization-aware training，用 rollout 侧量化结果指导训练侧 FP4 舍入；并加入量化信息缓存方案，选择性保留深层的 mantissa 与 scale 信息，以削减 rollout 指导引入的存储和通信开销。
Result: 在四个大规模 MoE 语言模型上覆盖推理、代码与长程 RL 任务：支持 FP4 权重/激活与 FP4 KV-cache rollout，RL 性能与 BF16 rollout 相当，rollout 加速最高 5.4 倍；最终 FP4 性能优于对 BF16 训练策略做事后 FP4 量化。
Conclusion: 把训练与 rollout 两条量化路径对齐来训练，而非各自独立优化精度，是让 MoE LLM 的 RL 训练在 FP4 下保持 BF16 级性能并获得数倍 rollout 加速的可行路径。

papers.title: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models
papers.abstract_en: We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource that releases derived telecom datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, together with 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines spanning 10 embedding models, 3 rerankers, and 17 language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. Each baseline starts from an open-weight model and is post-trained on OTel-derived data using an open training recipe, then evaluated on held-out OTel evaluation partitions. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.1% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.947 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 87.8%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, ED Track, Spotlight
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OTel 把电信领域的检索、重排、指令微调与安全/弃权数据统一开源，并附 30 个全参数后训练基线（10 个 embedding、3 个 reranker、17 个语言模型），全部基于开放权重模型用开放训练配方在 OTel 数据上后训练。后训练使三类模型全面提升：embedding 检索 NDCG@10 达 93.1%，重排 MRR@10 达 0.947，语言模型正确率 87.8%。
Motivation: 电信 AI 缺少统一、可复现的开放数据与评测资源，此前的电信数据集与基准分散，模型训练配方不透明，难以横向比较与复现。
Method: 发布带文档的电信数据源、held-out 评测划分、安全/弃权数据；每个基线从开放权重模型出发，用开放训练配方在 OTel 派生数据上做全参数后训练，再在 held-out 划分上评测，覆盖 embedding 检索、重排与上下文接地 LLM 三个模型族。
Result: 后训练后 embedding 检索 NDCG@10 为 93.1%，重排 MRR@10 为 0.947，语言模型正确率 87.8%；截至 2026 年 5 月 3 日模型下载量超 1600 万次，获 157+ 家媒体报道。
Conclusion: 开放训练配方加统一数据划分足以让三类电信模型同时提升，OTel 可作为可复现起点供社区扩展数据与模型。

papers.title: No Transformer Beats Six Covariates: Long-Horizon Prediction of Depressive Symptoms from Childhood Essays
papers.abstract_en: Natural language processing (NLP) models can detect depression-related language in text written near the time symptoms are measured, but whether pretrained transformers can predict depressive symptoms from text written twelve years earlier is largely untested. In the National Child Development Study, a British birth cohort, we predict probable depressive symptoms at age 23 from essays the same people wrote at age 11. Our baseline, a logistic regression on six childhood covariates, outperforms every text model that sees only the essay: seven fine-tuned transformers, a bag-of-words model, frozen embeddings and four zero-shot large language models. Its area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) is 0.737 against 0.670 for the best transformer on the primary seed, and no added text score detectably raises the baseline's AUC-ROC. None of the five domain-pretrained transformers detectably beats its general-domain control after Bonferroni correction. For long-horizon prediction, the baseline remains the model to beat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在英国出生队列 National Child Development Study 中，用 11 岁儿童作文预测 23 岁抑郁症状，仅含六个童年协变量的逻辑回归基线胜过所有只看作文的文本模型：AUC-ROC 0.737 对最强 transformer 的 0.670，且加入任何文本分数都不能显著抬高基线。作者的结论是长时距预测中该协变量基线才是需要击败的对象。
Motivation: NLP 能识别症状测量当期附近的抑郁相关语言，但预训练 transformer 能否从早十二年的文本预测抑郁症状基本未经检验。
Method: 以 National Child Development Study 队列为样本，用 11 岁作文预测 23 岁 probable depressive symptoms；对照组包括六个童年协变量的逻辑回归基线、七个 fine-tuned transformers、bag-of-words、frozen embeddings 与四个 zero-shot LLM，并对五个领域预训练 transformer 与其通用领域对照做 Bonferroni 校正比较。
Result: 基线 AUC-ROC 0.737，主 seed 上最强 transformer 0.670；加入文本分数后基线 AUC-ROC 无可检测提升；五个领域预训练 transformer 经 Bonferroni 校正后无一显著超过其通用领域对照。
Conclusion: 对跨越十二年的抑郁症状预测，结构化童年协变量比作文文本更有效，长时距场景下该逻辑回归基线是后续模型要击败的标杆。

papers.title: ST-Bench: A Spatial-Temporal Benchmark for Multi-Agent System Generation on Scientific Research Tasks
papers.abstract_en: The rapid progress of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) has shown that they largely outperform single agents on coding, math, and QA tasks, where executable tests provide a binary success signal. Whether this advantage transfers to real scientific data analysis remains untested. We introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark designed to answer two questions: whether MAS outperform single agents on complex scientific data analysis tasks, and if so, by how much and at what additional cost. ST-Bench contains 100 data science tasks adapted from published Earth science studies across hydrology, agriculture, and wetland methane research, expanded into 2,067 queries grounded in additional published studies and validated by domain experts. Using ST-Bench, we evaluate five recent MAS generation methods under two training protocols, against single-agent baselines on the same GPT-5 backbone. Nine of the ten MAS configurations exceed the cheapest single-agent baseline, with the strongest reaching nearly three times its composite score. This gain is primarily attributable to coverage: trained workflows produce realistic numerical metrics on a larger fraction of queries, while the quality of those metrics, conditional on producing realistic output, is comparable to that of the single-agent baseline. The strongest configuration requires approximately four times the single-agent inference time, whereas a more economical workflow captures the majority of the benefit at less than twice the cost. MAS specialization confers measurable benefit on scientific data analysis, but the benefit is conditional rather than universal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ST-Bench 把 100 项已发表地球科学（水文、农业、湿地甲烷）研究任务扩成 2,067 条经领域专家校验的查询，用以检验 LLM 多智能体系统 (MAS) 在科学数据分析上是否优于单智能体。在 GPT-5 同一骨干上测五种 MAS 生成方法、两种训练协议：十个配置中九个超过最便宜的单智能体基线，最强者综合分接近其 3 倍，但推理时间约 4 倍；一个更经济的工作流以不到 2 倍成本拿到大部分收益。
Motivation: MAS 在有二值可执行测试信号的编码、数学、QA 上已明显胜过单智能体，但这种优势能否迁移到没有二值信号的真实科学数据分析任务，此前未经检验。
Method: 构建 ST-Bench：100 个改编自已发表地球科学研究的数据科学任务，扩展为 2,067 条查询并由领域专家校验；在相同 GPT-5 骨干上，以单智能体为基线，评估五种近期 MAS 生成方法在两种训练协议下的表现，比较综合分与推理时间成本。
Result: 十个 MAS 配置中九个超过最便宜的单智能体基线，最强配置综合分接近该基线的 3 倍；增益主要来自覆盖度——训练后的工作流在更大比例的查询上产出真实的数值指标，而条件于产出真实输出时，指标质量与单智能体基线相当。最强配置推理时间约为单智能体的 4 倍，更经济的工作流以不到 2 倍成本捕获大部分收益。
Conclusion: MAS 专业化在科学数据分析上带来可测收益，但收益是有条件的而非普遍的：提升来自覆盖面而非单条指标的质量，代价是数倍推理时间，可用低成本工作流换取大部分收益。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose a novel recommendation model, CLARER (Contrastive Learning for Aspect Representation towards Explainable Recommendation) that integrates aspect features learned from textual reviews with rating information to improve the accuracy and explainability of recommendations. Our proposed framework learns user and item representations by combining rating-based features and aspect-based features from reviews. Specifically, rating-based features are learned through a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) model, while aspect-specific review representations are learned using a transformer encoder to capture the semantic information and contrastive learning to better distinguish user preferences. To provide explanations, we train a transformer decoder, using the final representations of users and items from both rating and aspect-based features as context. Experimental results in three benchmark data sets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods in both recommendation (accuracy) and explanation generation.

Result: 在三个基准数据集上，推荐（准确率）与解释生成两项任务均取得优于基线方法的表现；摘要未给出具体数值。

papers.title: Later Is Better: Token Reduction for ViTs Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Training-free token reduction accelerates vision transformers by removing redundant tokens across layers, recovering most of the original accuracy at a fraction of the compute. These methods, however, are designed and evaluated primarily on clean data, and under real-world distribution shift their accuracy gap to the uncompressed model widens with the removal rate. We show that this gap is governed by the reduction schedule, the depth profile of removal, usually left fixed as an implementation detail. Concretely, we introduce a one-parameter late-concentrated power-law schedule that consistently improves out-of-distribution accuracy over flat at no extra inference cost. On ImageNet-C with DeiT-S, the late schedule closes 83% of that gap at a 26% compute reduction (+1.17pp), and 99% of it at a lighter 7% reduction (+0.26pp). The gain cannot be attributed to retaining more tokens or using extra compute: held to flat's compute, the late schedule removes more tokens in total and leaves fewer tokens at the end, yet still wins. Single-layer probes point to a mechanism: earlier reductions perturb features that pass through more remaining layers, front-loading reduction error in depth. The effect is broad, holding across five token-reduction methods (ToMe, EViT, ATS, ATC, PiToMe), nine backbones, all ImageNet-C corruption types, eight further shift suites, and two further modalities, video and vision-language QA. It is also specific to shift, still positive on clean and rising monotonically to ~4x that at the highest severity 5. The schedule keeps its gain under six test-time adaptation methods, and needs no per-input or per-domain tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 训练无关的 ViT token 削减在分布偏移下精度差距随削减率扩大，而差距由削减的深度分布（reduction schedule）决定。提出单参数 late-concentrated power-law 调度，把削减集中到网络后段：ImageNet-C 上 DeiT-S 用 26% 计算削减关闭 83% 差距（+1.17pp），7% 削减关闭 99%（+0.26pp），且在干净数据上仍为正、随严重度 5 单调升至约 4 倍。
Motivation: 现有 token 削减方法在干净数据上设计与评测，真实分布偏移下其与未压缩模型的精度差距随削减率扩大；削减的深度分布一直被当作实现细节，未被当作控制变量。
Method: 提出单参数 late-concentrated power-law 调度，把 token 削减集中到网络后段，替代固定 flat 调度；用单层探针 (single-layer probes) 定位机制——过早削减扰动要穿过更多剩余层的特征，使削减误差在深度上前置。
Result: ImageNet-C + DeiT-S：26% 计算削减关闭 83% 差距（+1.17pp），7% 削减关闭 99%（+0.26pp）；对齐 flat 计算量时 late 调度总削减 token 更多、末端剩余 token 更少仍更优。效应横跨五种削减方法（ToMe、EViT、ATS、ATC、PiToMe）、九个 backbone、全部 ImageNet-C 损坏类型、八个额外偏移套件，以及视频与 vision-language QA 两种模态；干净数据上仍为正，最高严重度 5 处升至约 4 倍；在六种测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation) 方法下保持增益，无需按输入或领域调参。
Conclusion: token 削减的深度调度是分布偏移下精度差距的控制量：把削减推迟到网络后段可在不增加推理成本的前提下稳定缩小 OOD 差距，且无需逐输入或逐领域调参。

papers.title: Trustworthy Method Comparison with AI Judges: Estimation and Design under Order, Batch, and Aggregation Effects
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges for automated AI evaluation. A common practice is to randomize prompt sequences and average the resulting scores, but its statistical validity remains unclear. We show that LLM evaluation mechanisms can be approximated by a class of Markov generalized linear mixed models (GLMMs), supported by out-of-sample predictions across three major commercial LLMs. Using a first-order Markov GLMM, we study leaderboard ranking and group comparison. For leaderboard ranking, randomize-and-average selection is consistent under a mild separation condition, and a Williams square design can improve efficiency when item qualities are close. For group comparison, naive averaging can yield inconsistent conclusions about differences in group-level quality because of the response model's nonlinearity. Empirical results further support the validity of the proposed model-based inference beyond the first-order theory, including settings with higher-order sequence memory. We illustrate the approach in an application where AI judges compare two graphical model estimation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 作为评审打分存在顺序、批次与聚合偏差，本文用一阶 Markov 广义线性混合模型 (Markov GLMM) 刻画该机制：排行榜排序下 randomize-and-average 在温和分离条件下一致，条目质量接近时 Williams square 设计可提升效率；组间比较中朴素平均因响应模型非线性会给出不一致的组质量差异结论。
Motivation: 用 LLM 自动评审时常见做法是随机化 prompt 顺序再平均分数，但这种聚合方式的统计有效性不清楚，组间质量比较可能因此得出错误结论。
Method: 把 LLM 评估机制近似为一类 Markov GLMM，并用三个主流商业 LLM 的样本外预测支持该近似；在一阶 Markov GLMM 下分析排行榜排序与组间比较，引入 Williams square 设计提升条目质量接近时的效率，并将方法用于 AI 评审比较两种图模型 (graphical model) 估计方法的示例。
Result: 样本外预测覆盖三个主流商业 LLM；一阶理论之外，实证结果支持模型推断在更高阶序列记忆 (higher-order sequence memory) 设定下仍有效；示例中 AI 评审比较两种图模型估计方法。
Conclusion: LLM 评审分数应按 Markov GLMM 做基于模型的推断：排序用 randomize-and-average 加分离条件、必要时配 Williams square，组间比较不能依赖朴素平均。

papers.title: Adversarially Trained Linear Transformers Are Optimal Robust In-Context Learners for Gaussian Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial training is one of the most reliable defenses against adversarial attacks, but its high computational cost must generally be paid anew for each task. Robust foundation models offer a promising alternative: adversarially pretrain a model once and then transfer its robustness to downstream tasks through lightweight adaptation. However, a fundamental question remains open: can robustness acquired during pretraining transfer to unseen tasks without further adversarial training? In this study, we answer this question affirmatively. A single model adversarially pretrained at scale can achieve optimal robustness on new tasks without additional task-specific training. Specifically, we show that, for a family of Gaussian-mixture classification tasks, a sufficiently deep linear transformer adversarially trained across tasks can asymptotically attain the robust Bayes error on previously unseen tasks through in-context learning from clean demonstrations. By contrast, a standardly trained model cannot. We further analyze convergence under gradient flow, an accuracy--robustness trade-off, and demonstration complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在高斯混合分类任务族上，跨任务对抗预训练的足够深的线性 transformer，能通过干净示例的上下文学习 (in-context learning) 渐近达到未见任务的鲁棒 Bayes 误差，而标准训练的模型做不到。结论是预训练阶段获得的鲁棒性可以零额外对抗训练迁移到新任务。
Motivation: 对抗训练的高计算成本必须为每个任务重付一次；鲁棒基础模型想靠一次预训练加轻量适配来复用鲁棒性，但预训练鲁棒性能否不经额外对抗训练就迁移到未见任务，此前是开放问题。
Method: 研究对象是一族高斯混合 (Gaussian mixture) 分类任务与足够深的线性 transformer (linear transformer)；在任务间做对抗预训练，下游用干净示例做上下文学习，不加任务特定训练。另用梯度流 (gradient flow) 分析收敛，并讨论精度—鲁棒性权衡与示例复杂度 (demonstration complexity)。
Result: 对抗预训练的线性 transformer 在未见高斯混合任务上渐近达到鲁棒 Bayes 误差，标准训练的模型达不到；并给出梯度流下的收敛性、精度—鲁棒性权衡与示例复杂度的分析。
Conclusion: 对抗预训练获得的鲁棒性可以不经任务特定对抗训练迁移到未见任务，前提是模型是足够深的线性 transformer 且在任务族上充分预训练。

papers.title: From Evidence to Action: How Tool-Using Agents Fail
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents make consequential changes to external state, yet correct outcomes do not guarantee that their actions were supported by evidence established beforehand. We study where this evidence-to-action chain breaks as agents move from deciding whether to act to executing single actions and dependent workflows. Across ten model-harness configurations, strong static action assessment can coexist with much weaker interactive execution. Failures often begin before execution: agents stop with incomplete investigation or act before required evidence is established. Once required evidence is obtained, single-action execution is usually reliable, while multi-action workflows additionally expose unresolved prerequisites and incomplete execution. For this analysis, we introduce SafeActBench, comprising 656 cases across six operational domains and five protocols that progress from static action judgment and investigated non-action to single- and multi-action workflows. A provenance-bound Evidence Ledger and deterministic trajectory evaluator track what information was established, when actions occurred, and whether downstream dependencies were satisfied. These results show that failures arise not only from missing information, but also from how agents use established evidence when deciding and executing actions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SafeActBench，把工具智能体从「决定是否行动」到「执行单动作与依赖工作流」的证据-行动链分段拆解，用证据台账 (Evidence Ledger) 与确定性轨迹评估器判定行动是否由事先确立的证据支撑。十个模型-框架配置下，静态动作判断很强但交互执行明显更弱：失败多发生在执行之前（调查不完整或证据未确立即行动），证据齐备后单动作执行通常可靠，多动作工作流则暴露未解决的前置条件与执行不完整。
Motivation: 工具智能体会对外部状态做有后果的改动，但结果正确并不等于行动由事先确立的证据支撑；现有评测难以定位这条证据-行动链究竟在哪一段断裂。
Method: 构建 SafeActBench：656 个案例，覆盖六个操作域与五级协议，从静态动作判断、经调查后的不行动，递进到单动作与多动作工作流；用绑定来源的 Evidence Ledger 记录信息何时确立，配合确定性轨迹评估器判定行动时点与下游依赖是否满足。
Result: 十个模型- harness 配置上，强静态动作判断与明显更弱的交互执行并存；失败常始于执行之前（调查不完整或证据未确立即行动）；证据确立后单动作执行通常可靠，多动作工作流额外暴露未解决前置条件与执行不完整。
Conclusion: 智能体失败不仅源于信息缺失，也源于它们在决策与执行时如何使用已确立的证据；评测应把静态判断、非行动与执行分段度量。

papers.title: How Well Do LLMs Reason with Noisy Evidence? An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Real-world reasoning rarely reduces to static question answering: agents must actively gather information from tools and sensors that are often noisy and unreliable. Yet most existing active reasoning benchmarks assume that environmental feedback is trustworthy, or introduce noise without exposing an explicit, calibrated uncertainty signal, leaving open how LLMs should reason when the evidence itself is uncertain. We introduce VisualNoiseQA, a novel benchmark for active reasoning under noisy visual feedback. A text-only LLM must solve VQA problems by iteratively querying a fixed, off-the-shelf VLM treated as a stochastic visual sensor. For each query, we draw multiple samples and expose an empirical uncertainty signal via self-consistency, enabling the reasoner to probe from different angles and decide what to ask next and when to stop. Our construction is automatic and scalable: starting from diverse VQA sources and two noisy VLMs, we retain only questions where the sensor is inconsistent yet human-solvable. We evaluate multiple LLM reasoners on 1,000 instances spanning perception, chart understanding, and knowledge-intensive reasoning. VisualNoiseQA thus provides a controlled playground to study how different LLMs exploit uncertainty signals for robust reasoning.

papers.title: Cleave: Scaling Tensor Program Optimization via Decoupled Algebraic Search and Operator Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Optimized kernels such as FlashAttention and FlashDecoding are crucial for accelerating today's large models. Most of them are handwritten by experts because existing ML compilers cannot match their efficiency. Producing such kernels requires fusing computations with multiple reductions, which requires both algebraic transformation of the computation graph and operator scheduling of the transformed graph. Unfortunately, searching the two jointly yields a space too large to navigate. We propose Cleave, an ML compiler built on symbolic decoupling: Cleave discovers transformations by performing superoptimization on a graph with symbolic shapes, and then schedules each resulting graph on concrete shapes. Representing shapes as symbols makes equivalence checking cheap and lets a new Split operator, with a symbolic split count, parallelize along a reduction dimension. Cleave's scheduler fuses graphs with multiple reductions through iterative tiling and horizontal fusion. Evaluation on common LLM subgraphs shows that Cleave generates kernels up to 2.8x faster than the best baseline (1.6x on average) and reduces compilation time by 5.9x on average compared to Mirage. For dynamic workloads captured from production serving traces, Cleave compiles each operator once and achieves geometric mean speedups of 1.4x and 1.7x over FlashInfer's handwritten FA2 and FA3 backends. Cleave's code is available at: https://github.com/nyu-systems/cleave
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cleave 用符号解耦把张量程序优化拆成两步：先在符号形状图上做 superoptimization 发现代数变换，再对每个结果图在具体形状上做算子调度，从而把联合搜索空间降下来。在常见 LLM 子图上生成的 kernel 比最佳基线快至 2.8x（平均 1.6x），编译时间平均比 Mirage 少 5.9x；对生产 serving trace 的动态负载，几何平均加速为 1.4x（对比 FlashInfer 手写 FA2）与 1.7x（对比 FA3）。
Motivation: FlashAttention、FlashDecoding 这类高效 kernel 多由专家手写，因为现有 ML 编译器追不上；而融合含多个 reduction 的计算需要同时做图的代数变换与算子调度，联合搜索空间大到无法导航。
Method: 符号解耦的 ML 编译器：在符号形状图上做 superoptimization 搜索变换，再对每个得到的图在具体形状上调度。形状用符号表示使等价性检查变便宜，并引入带符号 split count 的 Split 算子沿 reduction 维并行；调度器通过迭代 tiling 与水平融合 (horizontal fusion) 融合含多个 reduction 的图。
Result: 常见 LLM 子图上 kernel 最快比最佳基线快 2.8x、平均 1.6x，编译时间平均比 Mirage 降低 5.9x；生产 serving trace 的动态负载下每个算子只编译一次，几何平均加速 1.4x（对 FlashInfer 手写 FA2 后端）与 1.7x（对 FA3 后端）。
Conclusion: 把代数变换与算子调度按符号形状解耦，可以既生成接近手写 kernel 的性能又显著缩短编译时间，且对动态形状只需编译一次。

papers.title: High-dimensional online calibration from harmonic weights
papers.abstract_en: We study the online calibration of multidimensional forecasts over an arbitrary convex set $Y\subseteq\mathbb{R}^d$ relative to an arbitrary error norm $\|\cdot\|_{L}$. For forecasting $d$ binary outcomes simultaneously ($Y=[0,1]^d$), we give the first algorithm that achieves $\varepsilon$-calibration in a number of rounds that is polynomial in $d$ for every fixed accuracy. It requires $d^{O(1/\varepsilon)}$ rounds, exponentially improving the dimension dependence of previous bounds. For multi-class forecasting ($Y=Δ_d$), we obtain the same $d^{O(1/\varepsilon)}$ rate, improving the $d^{\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)}$ bounds of Peng and Fishelson et al. Our algorithm is simple: on each round, it outputs a harmonically weighted distribution over harmonically smoothed past outcomes. The same algorithm works for every forecast set and norm. More generally, it achieves $\varepsilon$-calibration after $\exp(O(γ(Y,L)/\varepsilon))$ rounds, where $γ(Y,L)$ is a geometric parameter defined by a matrix discrepancy problem. The harmonic weights are motivated by the fact that the discrete Hilbert transform matrix achieves the optimal discrepancy up to a universal constant, simultaneously for every $L$. This optimality result may be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出高维在线校准 (online calibration) 的通用算法：每轮输出对历史结果做调和平滑后的调和加权分布，对任意凸预测集与误差范数统一适用。对 d 个二元结果 (Y=[0,1]^d) 首次做到轮数关于 d 多项式，为 d^{O(1/ε)}；对多分类 (Y=Δ_d) 同样达到 d^{O(1/ε)}，把 Peng 和 Fishelson 等人的 d^{Õ(1/ε^2)} 改进为指数级提升。
Motivation: 高维预测的 ε-校准此前轮数对维度依赖过强：二元情形缺少关于 d 多项式的算法，多分类情形已知界为 d^{Õ(1/ε^2)}，在维度与精度上都不实用。
Method: 每轮在历史结果的调和平滑 (harmonically smoothed) 分布上按调和权重 (harmonic weights) 输出预测分布；同一算法对任意预测集 Y 与误差范数 L 通用。一般界为 exp(O(γ(Y,L)/ε)) 轮，其中 γ(Y,L) 由一个矩阵差异 (matrix discrepancy) 问题定义；调和权重的动机是离散 Hilbert 变换矩阵对每个 L 同时达到最优差异（差一通用常数）。
Result: 二元 d 维 (Y=[0,1]^d) 首个关于 d 多项式的 ε-校准算法，轮数 d^{O(1/ε)}，相对先前界指数级改进维度依赖；多分类 (Y=Δ_d) 同为 d^{O(1/ε)}，改进 Peng 和 Fishelson 等人的 d^{Õ(1/ε^2)}；一般情形 exp(O(γ(Y,L)/ε)) 轮。
Conclusion: 调和权重给出一个对任意凸预测集与误差范数通用的高维校准算法，其维度依赖可降到多项式；离散 Hilbert 变换的最优差异性质本身可能独立有价值。
Relevance: 18
