papers.title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Post-discharge risk prediction from electronic health records (EHRs) is difficult because many dependencies that link discharge-time observations to downstream complications, such as comorbidity cascades and drug-disease interactions, are absent from the record. External medical knowledge graphs (KGs) can supply these missing dependencies, but tracing them demands three properties: KG exploration must remain cost-bounded, retrieved evidence must be differentiated by source quality, and the resulting rationale must be citable for retrospective review. Large language models (LLMs) can plan and verify over structured evidence, making them natural candidates for KG reasoning, but existing LLM-based methods do not satisfy these three properties jointly. In this paper, we propose BAR, a Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning framework over medical KGs with three contributions. First, BAR refines the raw KG into disease-specific evidence graphs whose edges carry support scores and provenance records, turning the KG into a quality-annotated reasoning space rather than a static feature source. Second, an LLM then reasons over this graph through a plan-navigate-verify loop that decomposes the question into steps, retrieves evidence under a patient-specific budget, and revises when verification fails. Third, a reasoning policy is trained with a reward that compares predictions with and without acquired evidence, combined with acquisition cost and citation-integrity terms. Across 8 diseases and 3 prediction horizons on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, BAR improves AUPRC by 3.4 points over the strongest baseline, raises citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and consumes only 62-65% of the budget cap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BAR：把医学 KG 精炼成带支撑分数与来源记录的疾病特异证据图，LLM 在患者级预算内做 plan-navigate-verify 推理，并用「有无证据对比 + 采集成本 + 引用完整性」奖励训练推理策略。在 MIMIC-III/IV 的 8 种疾病、3 个预测时窗上，AUPRC 比最强基线高 3.4 点，引用精度从 59.8% 升到 77.9%，且只用掉预算上限的 62–65%。
Motivation: 出院时 EHR 缺少共病级联、药物-疾病相互作用等下游并发症依赖，外部医学 KG 能补但探索必须成本有界、证据按来源质量区分、推理可引用复核，现有 LLM 方法三者不能同时满足。
Method: BAR 三段：把原始 KG 精炼为边带 support score 与 provenance 的疾病特异证据图；LLM 走 plan-navigate-verify 循环，按患者专属预算分步检索并在验证失败时修订；推理策略用对比有无证据的预测、加上采集成本与引用完整性项的奖励训练。
Result: 在 MIMIC-III 与 MIMIC-IV 上覆盖 8 种疾病、3 个预测时窗：AUPRC 较最强基线提高 3.4 点，引用精度由 59.8% 升至 77.9%，实际消耗仅为预算上限的 62–65%。
Conclusion: 把 KG 探索做成带质量标注与预算约束的可引用推理，能在控制采集成本的同时提升出院后风险预测精度与引用可信度。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Nash Social Welfare for Multi Armed Bandits: Trajectory-wise Expected and High Probability Regret
papers.abstract_en: We study fair multi-armed bandits under the Nash Social Welfare (NSW) objective, which measures performance via the geometric mean of accumulated rewards. Existing work defines Nash regret as $\mathrm{NR}_T = μ^\star - (\prod_{t=1}^T \mathbb{E}μ_{I_t})^{1/T}$, where $μ_{I_t}$ is the mean reward of the recommended arm $I_t$ and $T$ is the horizon. Since it applies the geometric mean to per-round marginal expectations, it ignores the joint distribution of rewards across rounds, leaving the NSW fairness motivation unaddressed at the trajectory level. We propose \emph{trajectory-wise Nash regret} $\widetilde{\mathrm{NR}}_T = μ^\star - \mathbb{E}[(\prod_{t=1}^T μ_{I_t})^{1/T}]$, which computes the geometric mean over complete sample paths before taking expectations, capturing NSW fairness more faithfully. By Jensen's inequality, $\widetilde{\mathrm{NR}}_T \geq \mathrm{NR}_T$, making it a strictly stronger metric. We also introduce \emph{high probability Nash regret} $\widehat{\mathrm{NR}}_T = μ^\star - (\prod_t μ_{I_t})^{1/T}$, giving the first high probability regret bounds in fair bandits. Our two-phase algorithm, Round Robin Nash Confidence Bound (\texttt{RR-NCB}), combines round robin exploration with a Nash confidence bound index policy. We show $\widetilde{\mathrm{NR}}_T \leq \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{k\log T/T})$ and, with probability $1-δ$, $\widehat{\mathrm{NR}}_T \leq \widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{k\log(kT/δ)/T})$, matching the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{k/T})$ rate despite the stronger metrics. Optimality follows from a lower bound via AM-GM and standard $k$-armed bandit minimax arguments. Simulations validate our theory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Nash Social Welfare 公平多臂老虎机里，把几何平均从逐轮边缘期望移到完整样本路径上，定义 trajectory-wise Nash regret，并证明其不小于原 Nash regret；配套提出两阶段算法 RR-NCB，轨迹级期望 regret 达到 Õ(√(k log T / T))，高概率 regret 以 1−δ 达到 Õ(√(k log(kT/δ)/T))，仍匹配最优 Õ(√(k/T)) 速率。
Motivation: 现有 Nash regret 对每轮边缘期望取几何平均，忽略各轮奖励的联合分布，使 NSW 的公平动机在轨迹层面落空；且公平老虎机缺少高概率 regret 界。
Method: 定义轨迹级指标 ÑR_T = μ* − E[(∏μ_{I_t})^{1/T}]（由 Jensen 不等式有 ÑR_T ≥ NR_T）与高概率指标 N̂R_T；算法 RR-NCB 两阶段结合 round robin 探索与 Nash confidence bound 索引策略；下界由 AM-GM 与标准 k 臂 minimax 论证给出。
Result: ÑR_T ≤ Õ(√(k log T / T))；以概率 1−δ 有 N̂R_T ≤ Õ(√(k log(kT/δ)/T))，匹配最优 Õ(√(k/T))；Jensen 不等式给出 ÑR_T ≥ NR_T，指标严格更强；下界经 AM-GM 与 k 臂 minimax 论证；仿真验证理论。
Conclusion: 更强的轨迹级与高概率公平 regret 指标不牺牲最优收敛速率，公平多臂老虎机的高概率界由此首次建立。

summary_sections.result: ÑR_T ≤ Õ(√(k log T / T))；以概率 1−δ 有 N̂R_T ≤ Õ(√(k log(kT/δ)/T))，匹配最优 Õ(√(k/T))；Jensen 不等式给出 ÑR_T ≥ NR_T，指标严格更强；下界经 AM-GM 与 k 臂 minimax 论证；仿真验证理论。
summary_sections.conclusion: 更强的轨迹级与高概率公平 regret 指标不牺牲最优收敛速率，公平多臂老虎机的高概率界由此首次建立。

papers.title: Learning to Retrieve via Reinforcement Learning in Embedding Space
papers.abstract_en: Dense retrieval models are typically trained with contrastive objectives that learn effective representations but do not directly optimize retrieval metrics or downstream task performance. To address this problem, we introduce RELER (REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval), a reinforcement learning framework that enables existing embedding models to learn to retrieve directly in embedding space and align to task-specific rewards. We train RELER by sampling unit-length query and document embedding actions from von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distributions centered on normalized encoder outputs, scoring the resulting retrieval or downstream outcomes as rewards, and updating the encoder with REINFORCE using a leave-one-out baseline (RLOO). As exploration in the high-dimensional embedding space is prone to sampling noise, we further propose conditional-mean projection (CMP), which projects each sampled embedding onto the low-dimensional subspace spanned by its encoder output and the candidate embeddings it is compared against, reducing noise in the policy gradient while preserving its expectation. We evaluate RELER on BRIGHT, a benchmark with reasoning-intensive queries that remain challenging for existing embedding models. RELER consistently outperforms InfoNCE and LambdaLoss in average nDCG@10 when post-training BGE-M3 and Qwen3-Embedding backbones. We further evaluate downstream utility through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where we adapt only the query encoder while keeping the document index and generator fixed. Across seven QA datasets, jointly optimizing retrieval and answer rewards improves both average retrieval performance and answer quality in RAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RELER 把检索本身当作强化学习问题：在归一化编码器输出为中心的 von Mises-Fisher 分布上采样单位长度的 query/document 嵌入动作，用检索或下游结果作奖励，以 REINFORCE 加 RLOO 基线更新编码器，并用条件均值投影 (CMP) 把采样嵌入投影到由编码器输出与候选嵌入张成的低维子空间以降噪。在 BRIGHT 上后训练 BGE-M3 与 Qwen3-Embedding，平均 nDCG@10 一致超过 InfoNCE 与 LambdaLoss；在七个 QA 数据集的 RAG 中联合优化检索与答案奖励同时提升检索与答案质量。
Motivation: 稠密检索模型用对比目标训练，学到的表示虽好却不直接优化检索指标或下游任务表现，表示学习与实际检索收益之间存在错位。
Method: RELER (REinforcement LEarning for Retrieval)：从以归一化编码器输出为中心的 von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 分布采样单位长度的 query 与 document 嵌入动作，把检索或下游结果打分作为奖励，用 REINFORCE 配合 leave-one-out 基线 (RLOO) 更新编码器；针对高维嵌入空间探索的采样噪声，提出条件均值投影 (CMP)，将每个采样嵌入投影到其编码器输出与被比较候选嵌入张成的低维子空间，保持策略梯度期望的同时降噪。RAG 评测中只适配 query 编码器，文档索引与生成器固定。

Conclusion: 让现有嵌入模型在嵌入空间内直接按任务奖励学习检索，可以在不改动文档索引与生成器的前提下同时改善检索指标与 RAG 答案质量；CMP 用于压低高维探索的策略梯度噪声。

papers.title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
papers.abstract_en: Typed decision models answer a declared question without generating text: a decision head returns a probability for each of the declared options in a single forward pass. A single pass is fast, intuitive System 1 thinking. We study what lies between one pass and generated reasoning: looping, in which the same layers are recursively applied several times before one typed readout. Each loop lets the model revise its hidden state before it commits to an answer, without generating a token; we call this System 1.5 thinking. We propose SanSi, which turns a pre-trained looped language model into a typed decision model. The option probabilities are read after every loop, and every loop is trained with a proper scoring rule, so that one model serves every budget from one loop to eight in a single run. On 10,027 test decisions from 59 sources, SanSi reaches 72.0% accuracy: 13.5 points above a non-looped model of the same shape trained with the same recipe, 5.3 points above a newer non-looped model of its size, and 1.8 points below one with three times the parameters. On two depth-controlled tasks, loops extend the solvable depth beyond the depths seen in training, where the larger single-pass model fails. Used as the judge for policy optimization with reinforcement learning, without gold answers, SanSi raises the generator's F1 by 7.7 points.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 15 figures, 42 tables. Project page: https://minnesotanlp.github.io/Sansi/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SanSi 把预训练 looped 语言模型改造成 typed decision model：同一组层递归应用多次（1–8 次循环）后才做一次类型化读出，每次循环都用 proper scoring rule 训练，使单个模型覆盖从 1 到 8 的全部推理预算。在 59 个来源的 10,027 条测试决策上准确率 72.0%，比同结构非循环模型高 13.5 点、比同规模较新非循环模型高 5.3 点、比三倍参数量模型低 1.8 点；作为 RL 策略优化的 judge 时把生成器 F1 抬高 7.7 点。
Motivation: 单次前向的 typed decision 快但属于 System 1，生成式推理能多步修订却要逐 token 生成；两者之间缺少一种不生成文本、又能多次修订隐状态的中间形态。
Method: 把预训练 looped 语言模型转为 typed decision model：decision head 对每个声明选项输出概率，同一组层递归应用若干次（loop）后才做 typed readout，每次循环后都读出选项概率并用 proper scoring rule 训练，使一个模型在单次训练中同时服务 1 到 8 的循环预算；另用作无 gold answer 的 RL 策略优化 judge。
Result: 在 59 个来源的 10,027 条测试决策上准确率 72.0%，比同形状同训练配方的非循环模型高 13.5 点，比同规模较新的非循环模型高 5.3 点，比参数量三倍的模型低 1.8 点。在两个深度受控任务上，循环把可解深度推到训练时未见过的深度之外，而更大的单次前向模型在此失败。作为 judge 用于无 gold answer 的 RL 策略优化时，生成器 F1 提升 7.7 点。
Conclusion: 不生成 token 的递归循环（System 1.5 thinking）能在固定参数量下逼近更大单次模型的判断力，并在超出训练深度的推理任务上保持可解；proper scoring rule 让单一模型覆盖全部循环预算。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Foveated Compression: Selective High-Resolution Preservation for Token-Efficient VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Visual tokens are a major source of inference cost in vision-language models, yet simple image downsampling remains a surprisingly strong compression baseline. This raises a complementary question: under a fixed token budget, where should visual fidelity be preserved? We introduce Foveated Compression, which encodes a full-resolution image once and represents it with a mixture of native- and compressed-resolution visual tokens. A behaviorally self-distilled Foveated Merger compresses local visual tokens while preserving compatibility with their native counterparts, and a lightweight Foveated Selector chooses one of nine spatial cells to retain at native resolution using exhaustive budget-matched intervention supervision. At 11.11% visual tokens, uniform Foveated Compression shows no significant paired difference from iso-token downsampling. At 20.99%, the learned selector significantly outperforms random and fixed allocation, but remains below strong whole-image resizing, showing that localized fidelity is not universally preferable. A budget-matched region-choice oracle reaches 82.73 macro accuracy versus 69.61 for the learned selector, revealing substantial headroom within the same spatial action space. Matched probing further shows that signals predicting when compression breaks the answer are substantially more accessible after language-model computation than to the lightweight prefill-free selector. These results expose complementary bottlenecks in region selection and compressed-region fidelity.
papers.journal_ref: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems Workshop (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Foveated Compression 在固定视觉 token 预算下把全分辨率图编码一次，再用原生与压缩分辨率 token 的混合表示，由自蒸馏的 Foveated Merger 压缩局部 token、轻量 Foveated Selector 从九宫格中选一格保留原生分辨率。结果是：11.11% token 时与均匀下采样无显著配对差异，20.99% 时学习到的 selector 显著优于随机与固定分配但仍弱于整图 resize，说明局部保真并非普遍更优。
Motivation: 视觉 token 是 VLM 推理成本的主要来源，而简单整图下采样是很强的压缩基线；在固定 token 预算下，视觉保真度应保留何处这一问题尚无答案。
Method: 整图只编码一次，输出原生分辨率与压缩分辨率 token 的混合；Foveated Merger 通过行为自蒸馏 (behavioral self-distillation) 在压缩局部 token 的同时保持与原生 token 的兼容性；Foveated Selector 用穷举的预算对齐干预监督 (budget-matched intervention supervision) 在九个空间格中选一格保留原生分辨率。
Result: 在 11.11% 视觉 token 下，均匀 Foveated Compression 与等 token 下采样无显著配对差异；在 20.99% 下，学习到的 selector 显著优于随机与固定分配，但仍低于强整图 resize；预算对齐的 region-choice oracle 达到 82.73 macro accuracy，学习 selector 为 69.61；matched probing 显示判断压缩何时破坏答案的信号在语言模型计算之后比对免 prefill 的轻量 selector 更易获取。
Conclusion: 区域选择与被压缩区域的保真度是两个互补瓶颈：局部高分辨率保真在中等预算下有收益但不普遍占优，且同一空间动作空间内 oracle 与学习 selector 的差距说明选择环节仍有很大提升空间。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Structure-aware Keypoint Localization for Videofluoroscopic Swallowing Study
papers.abstract_en: Videofluoroscopic Swallowing Study (VFSS) is one of the gold standard for diagnosing swallowing disorders, providing dynamic X-ray imaging of the swallowing process. Automated kinematic analysis in VFSS relies fundamentally on precise anatomical keypoint localization. However, existing studies focus on limited keypoints (e.g., cervical vertebrae or the hyoid) and overlook critical regions such as the soft palate, while annotating only active swallowing segments and ignoring abundant non-swallowing data, resulting in poor data efficiency. Moreover, leveraging this unlabeled data via standard semi-supervised learning is suboptimal, as generic methods are prone to spatial bias. In medical X-rays with fixed layouts, models tend to memorize absolute coordinates rather than understanding anatomical structures. To tackle these challenges, we introduce VFSSKep, a novel dataset that extends annotations to the soft palate and incorporates large-scale unlabeled data. We further propose S$^3$KL, a Structure-aware Semi-Supervised Keypoint Localization framework designed to overcome spatial bias. It integrates a Structure-Aware Learning strategy to extract high-resolution structural cues for structure-aware representation learning, and a Structural Representation Consistency Learning strategy with block shuffling to enforce invariant structural recognition. Experiments show our method achieves state-of-the-art semi-supervised performance, even with unlabeled and 25% labeled data surpassing fully supervised learning with 100% labeled data. Code and data will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/kaai520/S3KL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对吞咽造影 (VFSS) 关键点标注只覆盖吞咽活动段、忽略软腭等关键区域导致的数据效率低问题，提出 VFSSKep 数据集与结构感知半监督关键点定位框架 S$^3$KL，用 Structure-Aware Learning 提取高分辨率结构线索，并以 block shuffling 的结构表征一致性学习抑制模型记忆绝对坐标的空间偏置。实验显示该方法达到半监督最先进性能：仅用无标注数据加 25% 标注数据即可超过使用 100% 标注数据的全监督学习。
Motivation: VFSS 自动运动学分析依赖精确解剖关键点定位，但现有研究只标少数关键点（如颈椎、舌骨）而忽略软腭，且只标吞咽活动段、丢弃大量非吞咽数据；标准半监督方法在布局固定的医学 X 光上易记忆绝对坐标而非理解解剖结构。
Method: 发布 VFSSKep 数据集，把标注扩展到软腭并纳入大规模无标注数据；提出 S$^3$KL 半监督关键点定位框架，包含 Structure-Aware Learning（提取高分辨率结构线索做结构感知表征学习）与 Structural Representation Consistency Learning（配合 block shuffling 强制不变的结构识别）。
Result: 实验中 S$^3$KL 取得半监督最先进性能：仅用无标注数据加 25% 标注数据即超过使用 100% 标注数据的全监督学习。
Conclusion: 在固定布局的医学 X 光上，用结构感知表征与结构一致性约束替代通用半监督，可让少量标注的吞咽关键点定位追平甚至超过全监督；代码与数据计划在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 实验中 S$^3$KL 取得半监督最先进性能：仅用无标注数据加 25% 标注数据即超过使用 100% 标注数据的全监督学习。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在固定布局的医学 X 光上，用结构感知表征与结构一致性约束替代通用半监督，可让少量标注的吞咽关键点定位追平甚至超过全监督；代码与数据计划在 GitHub 公开。

papers.title: PERSIST: Who-What-When Memory Across Sessions for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Modern voice assistants may be shared by multiple users and should be able to answer questions about earlier conversations such as "When did I originally plan to leave?" or adapt their behavior to individual users based on past interactions. This requires more than retrieving a topically similar passage: the assistant must identify the current speaker, recover the relevant past state, and distinguish it from later revisions. We present PERSIST, a persistent memory system for multi-session, multi-speaker spoken dialogue that explicitly models Who, What, and When. PERSIST structures cross-session histories into readable event records and retrieves them with a 3W joint scoring mechanism that combines semantic content, acoustic speaker identity, and temporal state. For real-time full-duplex interaction, PERSIST further reuses intermediate representations from the dialogue backbone, avoiding query-audio re-encoding and reducing retrieval latency from 578.42 ms to 7.03 ms. We also introduce SpokenTrace, a diagnostic benchmark that factorizes evaluation along memory tasks and speaker-query types, exposing failures in recall, speaker attribution, and temporal-state tracking. On SpokenTrace, PERSIST achieves 85.08% end-to-end task accuracy and improves all-support EM@3 from 49.01% with BGE-large to 82.10%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PERSIST 为多说话人、跨会话全双工语音对话构建显式 Who-What-When 记忆：把跨会话历史整理成可读事件记录，用 3W 联合打分（语义内容 + 声学说话人身份 + 时间状态）检索，并复用对话骨干中间表示避免查询音频重编码。检索延迟从 578.42 ms 降到 7.03 ms，在其自建 SpokenTrace 基准上端到端任务准确率 85.08%，all-support EM@3 从 BGE-large 的 49.01% 提到 82.10%。
Motivation: 共享语音助手需回答早前对话中的问题并按说话人调整行为，这要求区分当前说话人、恢复相关历史状态并把它与后续修订区分开，单纯检索主题相似段落不够。

Result: 检索延迟由 578.42 ms 降至 7.03 ms；在 SpokenTrace 上端到端任务准确率 85.08%，all-support EM@3 从 BGE-large 基线的 49.01% 提升到 82.10%。
Conclusion: 把说话人身份与时间状态同语义一起纳入跨会话记忆检索，并复用骨干中间表示，可在全双工语音对话中同时拿到低延迟与更高的跨会话问答准确率。

papers.title: The Model Plants the Trigger: Answer-Side Backdoor Attacks in Multi-Turn Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing LLM backdoors are almost all input-centric: activation depends on explicit trigger patterns in the user input, so modern guardrails are built to sanitize the input space. We challenge this assumption with a novel answer-side backdoor for multi-turn dialogue. Instead of inserting the trigger into the input, the adversary uses a benign first-turn prompt to naturally induce the model to generate a specific, seemingly innocuous word. Once merged into the dialogue history, this self-generated word becomes the trigger. When a later harmful query arrives, the model detects its own trigger and bypasses its safety refusal, while the user input stays perfectly clean. Across four LLMs, our attack reaches near-perfect Attack Success Rates, approaching 100\% at only a 5\% poisoning rate, while preserving general utility and clean-input safety, and it evades mainstream input-centric defenses. Representation-level analysis shows that the self-generated trigger consistently suppresses the model's refusal signal, exposing a critical blind spot in current LLM defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出答案侧后门 (answer-side backdoor)：用首轮良性提示诱导模型自己生成一个看似无害的词，该词进入对话历史后即成为触发器，后续有害查询命中它便绕过安全拒答，而用户输入完全干净。在四个 LLM 上，仅 5% 投毒率即达到接近 100% 的攻击成功率，并规避主流以输入为中心的防御。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 后门几乎全是输入侧的，防御方据此只清洗输入空间；多轮对话中模型自生成内容进入历史这一路径未被覆盖，安全对齐因此存在盲区。
Method: 答案侧注入：首轮良性 prompt 自然诱导模型产出特定触发词，合并进 dialogue history 后充当触发器；后续有害查询时模型检出自身触发词并跳过拒答。辅以 representation-level 分析定位拒答信号。
Result: 四个 LLM 上攻击成功率接近 100%，投毒率仅 5%；同时保持通用效用与干净输入下的安全性，并规避主流输入中心防御。表示分析显示自生成触发词一致地抑制模型的拒答信号。
Conclusion: LLM 后门不必依赖输入中的显式触发模式，模型自生成词进入对话历史即可构成触发器，当前以输入为中心的防御存在关键盲区。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Exact Calibration and Sharp Risk Geometry for Volume-Sampled Ridge Regression
papers.abstract_en: We study ridge regression from exactly $s$ distinct rows of a fixed design. Responses are fixed, and only the subset is random. The determinant law and selected ridge fit share one positive definite penalty. Established mean identities and exponential-family duality give the unique penalty that matches a prescribed full-data ridge fit in expectation. It exists exactly when $s$ exceeds the target's effective dimension. Our main result concerns centered covariance risk normalized by full-data penalized loss. For balanced signed coordinate replicas, a strict sector inequality gives the sharp risk and all maximizing responses at every budget from the dimension to one below the row count. This holds for any nonzero positive semidefinite query. With the target and query fixed, the maximizing response space is unchanged across these budgets. For general designs, we characterize attainment of a leave-one-out envelope. For existing real equiangular tight frames, flat row query energy characterizes when every nonzero residual response maximizes at two deletions. At three deletions, we give the sharp risk and complete maximizing space for isotropic queries, using unequal triangle weights. The balanced geometry yields a same-sample unbiased ridge--Horvitz--Thompson mixture with lower sharp risk and an exact mean-share improvement boundary. Under full recalibration after feature changes, we prove quadratic regret from searching the complete old maximizing space and a query-uniform bound on the mixture's risk gain. The strongest sector inequalities have exact computer-assisted proofs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究固定设计下从恰好 s 行子样本做 ridge 回归的精确校准与风险几何：行列式律与所选 ridge 拟合共享同一正定惩罚，由指数族对偶可得唯一匹配全数据 ridge 期望的惩罚，且当 s 超过目标有效维度时才存在。主结果给出以全数据惩罚损失归一化的中心化协方差风险的锐利扇形不等式，覆盖从维度到行数减一的每个预算，并导出同分布无偏的 ridge–Horvitz–Thompson 混合，其锐利风险更低且有精确的均值份额改进边界。
Motivation: 固定设计下按行子采样的 ridge 回归缺少与全数据拟合精确对齐的校准准则，以及在各采样预算下风险何时达到最坏情形的锐刻画。
Method: 用行列式律与已建立的均值恒等式、指数族对偶 (exponential-family duality) 求唯一匹配给定全数据 ridge 拟合期望的正定惩罚；对平衡有符号坐标副本证明严格扇形不等式 (sector inequality)，给出各预算下的锐风险与全部极大化响应；一般设计刻画 leave-one-out 包络的可达性，等角紧框架 (equiangular tight frame) 上用不等三角形权重处理三次删除；最强扇形不等式采用计算机辅助证明 (computer-assisted proof)。
Result: 惩罚存在当且仅当 s 超过目标的有效维度；锐风险与极大化响应在从维度到行数减一的每个预算上对任意非零半正定 query 成立，且目标与 query 固定时极大化响应空间跨预算不变。现有实等角紧框架上，平坦行 query 能量刻画何时每个非零残差响应在两次删除处极大化；三次删除时对各向同性 query 给出锐风险与完整极大化空间。平衡几何导出同分布无偏 ridge–Horvitz–Thompson 混合，锐利风险更低并带精确均值份额改进边界；特征变更后全量重校准下，搜索整个旧极大化空间有二次 regret，混合的风险增益有 query-一致界。
Conclusion: 子采样 ridge 的校准惩罚由有效维度门槛决定存在性，而最坏情形风险几何在各采样预算上由同一极大化响应空间刻画，据此可用 ridge–Horvitz–Thompson 混合换取更低锐风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RefRoute: Decoupling Conditioning Cost from References via Compact Residual Conditioning and Spatial Routing
papers.abstract_en: Multi-reference image generation requires preserving the appearance of multiple subjects while composing them into a coherent scene. However, existing diffusion transformers commonly encode references as dense visual token grids and jointly process them with global attention, making conditioning increasingly expensive as the number and resolution of references grow. We present RefRoute, a framework that addresses both reference representation cost and attention overhead through two complementary mechanisms. Compact residual conditioning combines low-resolution latent tokens with lightweight residual features extracted from full-resolution pixels, reducing reference token counts while retaining fine-grained appearance cues. Condition routing and attention routing align reference tokens with their assigned target regions and restrict cross-reference interactions, while allowing selective reference access beyond region boundaries for scene integration. We further introduce RefRoute-Data for training many-reference generation models and ManyRef100, a benchmark spanning human, object, and mixed compositions with 10-17 references. After many-reference fine-tuning, RefRoute achieves an overall Weighted-Ref-VIEScore of 36.06 on ManyRef100, compared with 8.88 for FLUX.2-Klein-9B. Separate inference-cost evaluations show substantially slower latency growth as the reference count increases: at 16 references, our 50-step and 4-step configurations achieve $18.3\times$ and $14.2\times$ speedups over their corresponding FLUX baselines, respectively. These results establish compact reference representations and spatially routed attention as an effective approach to scalable many-reference image generation.
papers.comment: 19 pages. Wanning He and Yuyao Zhang contributed equally and share first authorship
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RefRoute 把多参考图像生成中参考条件的编码与注意力开销解耦：用低分辨率 latent token 加全分辨率像素的轻量残差特征压缩参考表示，再按目标区域做条件路由与注意力路由。在含 10–17 个参考的 ManyRef100 上，多参考微调后 Weighted-Ref-VIEScore 36.06（FLUX.2-Klein-9B 为 8.88），16 参考时 50 步与 4 步配置分别比对应 FLUX 基线快 18.3× 与 14.2×。
Motivation: 扩散 Transformer 把参考图编码成稠密视觉 token 网格并与目标全局注意力联合处理，参考数量与分辨率增长时条件编码和注意力开销都急剧上升，限制了多参考生成的可扩展性。
Method: Compact residual conditioning 用低分辨率 latent token 加从全分辨率像素提取的轻量残差特征，在减少参考 token 数的同时保留细粒度外观线索；condition routing 与 attention routing 把参考 token 对齐到指定目标区域、限制跨参考交互，同时允许越界的选择性访问以完成场景整合；另提出 RefRoute-Data 训练数据方案用于多参考生成模型的训练与微调。
Result: 在 ManyRef100（覆盖人像、物体与混合构图，10–17 个参考）上，多参考微调后 RefRoute 整体 Weighted-Ref-VIEScore 36.06，FLUX.2-Klein-9B 为 8.88；推理开销评测显示延迟随参考数增长明显更慢，16 个参考时 50 步与 4 步配置相对对应 FLUX 基线分别加速 18.3× 与 14.2×。
Conclusion: 紧凑参考表示加空间路由注意力是可扩展多参考图像生成的有效路径，能在保持外观组合质量的同时把条件成本与参考数量解耦。

papers.title: Stability of Measure-to-Measure Transformers on Sub-Gaussian Data
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have exhibited impressive empirical success across various domains, but their theoretical foundations remain less developed. This work constitutes a mathematical study of the measure-to-measure operators defined by transformers. We show that transformers map sub-Gaussian inputs to sub-Gaussian outputs; this ensures that taking arbitrary-length compositions of the softmax operator is well-defined. We then show that transformers are Hölder continuous with respect to the 1-Wasserstein distance on appropriate spaces of sub-Gaussian inputs. This allows us to establish estimates on the error propagation along a transformer between a sub-Gaussian input and its empirical approximation. We also study a mean-field analog of the cross-attention mechanism, which is an operator from a pair of probability measures to a single probability measure. We show that cross-attention exhibits different Hölder regularity and sample-complexity in its two input arguments. Last, we apply our results to deduce approximation guarantees for measure-to-measure transformers. Together, these results provide a firm stability and finite-sample theory for transformers on sub-Gaussian data.

papers.title: Neuromotor Hierarchy Network: Physiological Inductive Biases for Robust Generalization in sEMG Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Surface electromyography (sEMG) provides a wearable, noninvasive interface to neuromuscular activity for movement decoding and human-computer interaction. Population-scale decoding remains difficult because the relationship between sEMG and neuromuscular activity varies across users and sessions, while task-relevant dynamics span channels and multiple timescales. Learning waveform-to-output mappings from task labels leaves the distinction between recording variability and coordinated motor activity implicit. We introduce the Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN), which learns a compact latent neuromotor state from task supervision to represent task-relevant neuromuscular coordination. NHN constructs this latent state through a hierarchy inspired by neuromotor organization.It adapts recording statistics while preserving relative intensity.Its spatiotemporal encoder uses parameter-efficient channel interactions and modulates features with multi-timescale history. The resulting features yield candidate activations of learned motor primitives, which are temporally integrated and continuously weighted to form the state. Theoretical analysis characterizes the efficiency, temporal behavior, and optimization of NHN's core mechanisms. We evaluate the architecture for both continuous hand-pose estimation on emg2pose and touch-typing recognition on emg2qwerty. On emg2pose, NHN reduces user-averaged angular error by 0.52% to 2.84% across all three generalization splits in both Regression and Tracking relative to Hadidi et al.'s best task-specific variants, using 48.42% to 48.51% fewer parameters. On emg2qwerty, NHN reduces beam-search character error rate by 19.40% zero-shot and 30.42% after fine-tuning relative to SplashNet-Upscale, using 65.86% fewer parameters. Physiology-guided inference of a latent neuromotor state supports parameter-efficient sEMG decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出神经运动层级网络 (Neuromotor Hierarchy Network, NHN)，用受神经运动组织启发的层级结构从任务监督中学习紧凑的潜在神经运动状态，显式区分记录变异与协同运动活动。在 emg2pose 上相对 Hadidi et al. 的最佳任务专用变体，三个泛化划分的用户平均角度误差在 Regression 与 Tracking 两种模式下均降低 0.52%–2.84%，参数少 48.42%–48.51%；在 emg2qwerty 上相对 SplashNet-Upscale，beam-search 字符错误率零样本降低 19.40%、微调后降低 30.42%，参数少 65.86%。
Motivation: sEMG 与神经肌肉活动的关系随用户和任务时段变化，且任务相关动态跨通道与多个时间尺度，直接从任务标签学波形到输出的映射会把记录变异与协同运动活动混在一起，跨人群泛化因此困难。
Method: NHN 从任务监督学习紧凑潜在神经运动状态：先适配记录统计量同时保留相对强度，再用参数高效的通道交互与多时间尺度历史调制的时空编码器提取特征，得到学习到的运动基元 (motor primitives) 的候选激活，经时间积分并连续加权合成该状态；作者另给出关于核心机制效率、时间行为与优化的理论分析。
Result: 在 emg2pose 的连续手部姿态估计上，相对 Hadidi et al. 的最佳任务专用变体，用户平均角度误差在全部三个泛化划分、Regression 与 Tracking 两种模式下降低 0.52%–2.84%，参数量少 48.42%–48.51%；在 emg2qwerty 的触摸打字识别上，相对 SplashNet-Upscale，beam-search 字符错误率 (CER) 零样本降低 19.40%、微调后降低 30.42%，参数量少 65.86%。
Conclusion: 生理学引导的潜在神经运动状态推断支持参数高效的 sEMG 解码，在跨用户、跨时段泛化与零样本迁移下同时降低误差和参数量。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mathematical Invariant-Enabled Topological Neural Networks for Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Existing molecular and materials learning approaches often rely on a limited set of structural representations, which may capture only selected aspects of complex three-dimensional structure. Here, we introduce mathematical invariant-enabled topological neural networks (MITNNs), a framework that represents complex structures through multiple complementary mathematical views and integrates them with topological neural architectures. MITNNs combine multiscale invariants from topology, spectral theory, commutative algebra, differential geometry, and discrete curvature, capturing complementary structural information from the same system. Systematic invariant-subset, architecture-subset, and ensemble analyses show that predictive performance depends on how mathematical representations and neural architectures are paired, with selected combinations outperforming individual models and the aggregation of all available components. Across protein-ligand binding, metal-organic framework properties, mutation-induced protein solubility, and molecular toxicity prediction, MITNN consistently outperforms existing methods. These results establish MITNN as a mathematically multimodal framework for scientific machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MITNN 把同一分子或材料体系的多种互补数学不变量（拓扑、谱理论、交换代数、微分几何、离散曲率）与拓扑神经架构组合成多视图表示。不变量子集、架构子集与集成分析表明性能取决于表示与架构的配对方式，部分组合优于单模型乃至全部组件的聚合。在蛋白-配体结合、MOF 性质、突变致蛋白溶解度与分子毒性预测上 MITNN 一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有分子与材料学习方法只依赖有限的结构表示，只能捕捉三维结构的某些侧面，难以覆盖体系的互补结构信息。
Method: MITNN 框架从同一系统提取拓扑、谱理论、交换代数、微分几何与离散曲率的多尺度不变量，作为互补数学视图接入拓扑神经架构；并做不变量子集、架构子集与集成三类组合分析。
Result: 系统性子集与集成分析显示预测性能取决于数学表示与神经架构的配对，选定组合优于单个模型以及全部组件的聚合；在 protein-ligand binding、metal-organic framework 性质、mutation-induced protein solubility、molecular toxicity 四项任务上 MITNN 一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: MITNN 被确立为面向科学机器学习的数学多模态 (mathematically multimodal) 框架，其核心主张是表示与架构的配对方式本身决定预测性能。

papers.title: Comprehensive Evaluation and Fine-Tuning of Foundational Cell Nuclei Segmentation Models in Renal Pathology
papers.abstract_en: Accurate nuclei instance segmentation is essential for quantitative renal pathology, yet general-purpose models often struggle with low contrast, dense nuclei, complex morphology, and strong background staining. In this work, we extended a human-in-the-loop framework by combining 5,901 foundation-model-generated pseudo-labels from well-segmented cases (Easy), 860 newly expert-annotated unresolved challenging cases (Medium), and 198 expert-annotated consensus failure cases (Hard). These annotations, spanning different levels of segmentation difficulty, enabled the systematic evaluation of seven single-source and mixed-source fine-tuning strategies across nine cell segmentation model configurations. Fine-tuning improved all models, with Medium data included in seven of the nine best-performing strategies. LSP-DETR achieved the highest F1 score of 0.8725 with Hard-only fine-tuning, while StarDist showed the largest improvement, increasing from 0.7380 to 0.8332 with Medium-only fine-tuning. These findings show that annotations spanning multiple difficulty levels support effective model adaptation, although the optimal annotation composition remains model dependent.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to SPIE Medical Imaging 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在肾脏病理细胞核实例分割上，用难度分层的人机协同标注（Easy 5,901 条基础模型伪标签、Medium 860 例新专家标注、Hard 198 例共识失败案例）微调九种细胞分割模型配置。微调使全部模型提升，Medium 数据出现在九个最优策略中的七个；LSP-DETR 仅用 Hard 微调取得最高 F1 0.8725，StarDist 用 Medium-only 微调从 0.7380 升到 0.8332。
Motivation: 通用基础模型在低对比度、密集核、复杂形态与强背景染色下核分割困难，需要判断哪种难度层级的标注最能带来模型适配收益。
Method: 扩展 human-in-the-loop 框架：合并 5,901 条基础模型在易例上生成的伪标签、860 例新专家标注的中等难例、198 例专家共识失败的难例；据此系统评估七种单源与混合源微调策略，覆盖九种细胞分割模型配置。
Result: 微调提升全部模型；Medium 数据进入九个最优策略中的七个。LSP-DETR 以 Hard-only 微调取得最高 F1 0.8725；StarDist 提升最大，Medium-only 微调使 F1 从 0.7380 升至 0.8332。
Conclusion: 跨难度层级的标注支持有效的模型适配，但最优标注组合依模型而异，不存在统一配比。

papers.title: Evidence Before Sampling: Interpretable Implicit Negative Candidate Discovery for Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recommender systems learn from observed user-item interactions, but explicit negative feedback is often unavailable. Since deep learning models require negative signals for training, negative sampling methods typically treat selected unobserved interactions as negatives. However, a missing interaction does not explain why a user is uninterested in an item or whether there is sufficient evidence to label it negative. This is especially important in business recommendation, where negative signals should be interpretable and aligned with business objectives. We formulate implicit negative candidate discovery to identify unobserved interactions supported by observed customer behavior. We encode these patterns as symbolic rules, score them based on support, informativeness, and product relevance, and rank the retained rules by evidence. An LLM then interprets the retained rules using business objectives and domain knowledge; the interpretations are combined with the statistical evidence in the final report. We evaluate our method in an industrial B2B setting and across five public recommendation datasets. Candidate-quality evaluations in the industrial setting and three public datasets show higher precision than the evaluated baselines, while symbolic selection improves downstream test PR-AUC by 12.5% over random selection with four negatives per positive example in the industrial task. Our results show that negative candidate validity can be evaluated separately from downstream recommendation performance. This distinction enables evidence-based, business-aligned, and explainable negative selection, improving both interpretability and model training in sparse, skewed, real-world recommendation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把「未观察到的交互」当作负样本会缺乏依据，本文提出隐式负候选发现 (implicit negative candidate discovery)：先用符号规则编码可观测客户行为并按 support、informativeness、product relevance 打分排序，再让 LLM 结合业务目标解释保留规则。在工业 B2B 任务与五个公开推荐数据集上，候选质量精度高于所评基线，符号化选择使下游 PR-AUC 相对随机选择提升 12.5%（每正例四个负例）。
Motivation: 推荐模型训练需要负信号，但显式负反馈常缺失，未观察到的交互既不能说明用户为何不感兴趣，也无法判断是否有足够证据标为负样本；业务推荐还要求负信号可解释且对齐业务目标。
Method: 将问题形式化为隐式负候选发现：把可观测客户行为编码为符号规则，按 support、informativeness 与 product relevance 打分并保留、按证据排序；随后由 LLM 依据业务目标与领域知识解释保留规则，把解释与统计证据合并进最终报告。
Result: 在工业 B2B 场景及三个公开数据集上的候选质量评估中，精度高于所评基线；在工业任务中，符号化选择相对随机选择（每正例四个负例）使下游测试 PR-AUC 提升 12.5%；评测覆盖一个工业设置与五个公开推荐数据集。
Conclusion: 负候选的有效性可以与下游推荐性能分开评估，这种区分支持有证据、对齐业务且可解释的负样本选择，同时改善稀疏偏斜真实场景下的可解释性与模型训练。

papers.title: AgentMemGate: Addressing Speculation Contamination in Conversational Assistant Memory
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI assistants with long-term memory extract facts from user messages into a store consulted in later conversations. A stated plan can enter that store as fact: a user who might move to Seattle may be recorded as already living there. We call this speculation contamination. Final-state memory benchmarks miss this error because they do not probe intermediate state and include few unresolved speculations. We present AgentMemGate, a write-time gate for profile-store memory that classifies extracted statements as speculation, completed event, correction, or other. Speculations remain outside memory, with conditions governing later promotion or deletion. We also contribute a dataset of multi-session conversations in which plans are confirmed, abandoned, or left unresolved. On our 147-conversation held-out set, Mem0 and Graphiti assert unresolved plans as current state for 35.2% and 27.3% of pending plans. On the core benchmark, AgentMemGate eliminates all observed contamination relative to the identical ungated pipeline (87.5% to zero for the most exposed extraction style) and raises task accuracy from 65% to 95%. On the harder held-out set, gated contamination is 3.4% to 5.7% and task accuracy rises by 9 to 13 percentage points. Our analysis identifies field matching as the main remaining bottleneck: realistic speculations often match no profile field and never reach the gate. We release our datasets, prompts, and evaluation code.
papers.comment: Accepted at the PALM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 15 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgentMemGate 是面向对话助手 profile-store 记忆的写入门控，把抽取语句分类为推测、已完成事件、纠正与其他，未决推测不入记忆、待后续提升或删除。在 147 段对话的 held-out 集上，Mem0 与 Graphiti 把 35.2% 和 27.3% 的未决计划写成当前状态；核心基准上该门控把污染从 87.5% 降到 0，任务准确率从 65% 升到 95%。
Motivation: 长期记忆系统会把用户的计划性表述当成既成事实写入存储，而只看最终状态的记忆基准不探测中间状态、未决推测很少，因此这类 speculation contamination 一直测不出来。
Method: AgentMemGate 在写入时对抽取语句做四分类（speculation / completed event / correction / other），推测留在记忆之外并由条件控制后续 promotion 或 deletion；作者另构建含计划被确认、放弃、悬置的多会话数据集，并与无门控的同构流水线对比。
Result: 147 段对话 held-out 集上 Mem0 与 Graphiti 分别把 35.2% 与 27.3% 的 pending plans 断言为当前状态；核心基准上 AgentMemGate 相对同构无门控流水线把污染从 87.5% 降到 0（最易暴露的抽取风格），任务准确率 65% → 95%；更难的 held-out 集上门控后污染为 3.4%–5.7%，任务准确率提升 9 至 13 个百分点。
Conclusion: 写入门控能消除观察到的推测污染并大幅抬高任务准确率，剩余瓶颈是 field matching：现实推测常不匹配任何 profile 字段，因而根本到不了门控。

papers.title: WASD: Wasserstein-based Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in capability, but their increasing scale comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference time. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model via alignment of discrete probability distributions. However, existing KD methods for LLMs primarily rely on divergences that evaluate discrepancies through probability values at each vocabulary index, without explicitly leveraging token-level semantic information. We propose Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD) for LLMs, which incorporates token-level semantic information via the Wasserstein-based distance with a cost matrix derived from token embeddings. To ensure computational tractability, we adopt the Sinkhorn divergence and derive a gradient-equivalent objective that can be efficiently optimized without introducing additional networks. Experiments across multiple LLM families and scales show that WASD consistently improves distillation performance on diverse tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our results highlight the importance of semantic information encoded in the token space for effective distribution alignment in LLM distillation. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WASD 用 token embedding 构造代价矩阵，把 Wasserstein 距离引入 LLM 知识蒸馏，使词表分布对齐带上 token 级语义信息；为保证可计算性改用 Sinkhorn divergence 并推导出梯度等价、无需额外网络的目标。在多个 LLM 家族与规模上，WASD 在指令遵循、数学推理与代码生成任务上一致提升蒸馏性能。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 知识蒸馏 (KD) 依赖逐词表索引比较概率值的散度，未显式利用 token 级语义信息，而推理期大模型的算力与显存成本持续上升。
Method: 提出 Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD)：以 token embedding 导出的代价矩阵计算 Wasserstein 距离，注入语义结构；采用 Sinkhorn divergence 保证计算可行，并推导出可高效优化、不引入额外网络的梯度等价目标。
Result: 在多个 LLM 家族与规模上，WASD 在指令遵循、数学推理和代码生成等多样任务上一致提升蒸馏性能；实现开源至 github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD。
Conclusion: token 空间编码的语义信息对 LLM 蒸馏中的分布对齐有效，基于语义代价矩阵的最优传输散度可作为逐点散度的替代。

papers.title: What Frame-Level Labels Can and Cannot Do for Small-UAV Point Detection in Thermal Video
papers.abstract_en: The growing use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has increased the importance of image-based UAV detection. Learning-based detectors are trained on imagery and annotations, with annotation type determining the information available during training. We focus on learning localization from frame-level target presence/absence labels when sensor or scene changes make spatial annotations for additional training burdensome. We analyze the detection capability, learning behavior, and potential applications of an existing architecture for point detection of small UAVs, trained with presence/absence labels and requiring no external detector. The architecture freezes spatial features learned through classification and trains a readout with the same frame labels to produce spatial score maps and point detections. On two thermal infrared datasets, CST Anti-UAV and Anti-UAV410, we evaluate localization hit rates and detection rates under false-alarm constraints, analyze the effects of training stages, label allocation, synthesis, and model configuration, and compare with bounding-box detectors. We also explore potential applications on Airborne Object Tracking (AOT) using its visible-light imagery and frame labels. Classification training strengthened target-related spatial responses, while readout training helped extract them consistently. Distributing similar label counts across more videos yielded higher localization hit rates, while synthesis effects varied by dataset and evaluation criterion. Higher localization hit rates did not always improve detection under false-alarm constraints, and failures remained when target signals were weak relative to background variation and under cross-dataset transfer. These findings provide guidance on label allocation, spatial representations and readouts, synthesis, and false-alarm control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只有帧级有/无标签、无法获得空间标注的条件下，该架构先冻结分类阶段学到的空间特征，再用同样的帧标签训练 readout 输出空间分数图与点检测。两个热红外数据集上，把相近标签数分散到更多视频能提高定位命中率，但定位命中率高并不总能转化为虚警约束下的检测率提升；目标信号弱于背景变化与跨数据集迁移时失败仍存在。
Motivation: 传感器或场景变化使小 UAV 检测的空间标注成本过高，只能拿到帧级有/无标签，而这类弱标签能否学出可用的空间定位此前缺少系统分析。
Method: 分析一个已有的小 UAV 点检测架构：分类阶段学到的空间特征被冻结，再用同样的帧标签训练 readout，产生空间分数图与点检测，无需外部检测器。在 CST Anti-UAV 与 Anti-UAV410 两个热红外数据集上评测定位命中率与虚警约束下的检测率，并考察训练阶段、标签分配、合成与模型配置的影响，与 bounding-box 检测器对比，另在 Airborne Object Tracking (AOT) 可见光影像上探索应用。
Result: 分类训练增强了目标相关的空间响应，readout 训练使其能被稳定提取；把相近标签数分散到更多视频得到更高定位命中率；合成的效果随数据集与评测标准而异；更高定位命中率并不总能改善虚警约束下的检测；目标信号相对背景变化偏弱以及跨数据集迁移时仍存在失败。
Conclusion: 帧级标签足以学出有指导意义的空间表示与 readout，但标签分配、合成与虚警控制需按数据集和评测标准分别调，定位命中率不能当作虚警约束下检测性能的代理。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Independent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual Semantic-Social World Models
papers.abstract_en: Fully decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), also referred to as independent learning, requires each agent to learn and act using only its local information and experience, without a centralized critic or inter-agent communication. Such a stringent information structure renders the conventional reward signal ambiguous. A poor return may result from an ineffective ego action, an incompatible teammate response, or an effective opponent response, yet scalar rewards alone do not reveal which explanation is responsible. We argue that agents can learn more effectively by prospectively comparing the consequences of candidate actions rather than diagnosing failures only from realized returns. We introduce CASTLE (Counterfactual Action-conditioned Semantic Tokens for Local Execution in Decentralized MARL), an offline-training, online-in-context guidance framework with two complementary world models. A Local Dynamics World Model, offline pre-trained over agents' local trajectories, summarizes the agent's local trajectory dynamics and partial observability, while a Semantic-Social World Model predicts compact short-horizon task and social consequences for each candidate ego action. The latter is trained from counterfactual simulator rollouts that expose plausible teammate and opponent responses to alternative actions taken from the same logged rollout state. During online learning and execution, both world models remain frozen and are queried by agents using only locally available information. Their prediction logits provide in-context guidance to an independent PPO policy. Across 30 matched seeds on Tag, Spread, and Adversary in the benchmark multi-particle environments, our proposed CASTLE achieves the highest mean final score among the evaluated methods, exceeding the strongest baseline on each task by 10.67, 6.46, and 0.33 normalized points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CASTLE 为完全去中心化 MARL 提出离线训练、在线上下文引导框架：冻结的 Local Dynamics World Model 与 Semantic-Social World Model 用反事实模拟器 rollout 预测各候选动作的短时任务与社会后果，其 logits 引导 independent PPO。在多粒子环境 Tag、Spread、Adversary 上 30 个匹配种子中，最终分数均高于所评方法，分别超出最强基线 10.67、6.46、0.33 个归一化点。
Motivation: 完全去中心化（independent learning）下只有局部信息与标量回报，回报差无法区分是自身动作无效、队友响应不配还是对手响应有效，仅靠事后诊断回报学习低效。
Method: CASTLE 含两个互补世界模型：Local Dynamics World Model 在智能体局部轨迹上离线预训练，概括局部轨迹动力学与部分可观测性；Semantic-Social World Model 从同一 logged rollout 状态出发的反事实模拟器 rollout 训练，预测每个候选 ego 动作的紧凑短时任务与社会后果。两者在线学习与执行时保持冻结，仅用局部信息查询，预测 logits 为 independent PPO 提供 in-context guidance。
Result: 在多粒子基准的 Tag、Spread、Adversary 三个任务上，30 个匹配种子中 CASTLE 取得所评方法里最高平均最终分，分别超出各任务最强基线 10.67、6.46、0.33 个归一化点。
Conclusion: 在无中心 critic、无通信的约束下，用反事实动作后果的前瞻比较替代仅从已实现回报做事后诊断，能提升 independent MARL 的最终表现。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: On the Boundary of Admission Gates: An Injected-Truth Study of Falsification-First Selection in Quantitative Strategy Research
papers.abstract_en: Strategy research conflates two problems: finding a profitable rule, and establishing that the finding is not search luck. The latter calls for admission gates -- statistical criteria that must be satisfied before a conclusion is adopted -- yet whether gates work, and at what cost, remains untested. We introduce an injected-truth protocol with a random-admission control that adopts at the same rate as the gate; only if the gate beats this control does it carry information rather than merely raise a threshold. Across synthetic and real-calibrated panels, gates eliminate false discoveries in the weak-signal regime but cut adoption to 1--7%, and add nothing when signals are strong. Most importantly, criteria computed on absolute rather than excess returns silently reject every candidate, including true signals. Keywords: multiple testing, backtest overfitting, strategy admission, injected-truth validation, excess returns, false discovery rate
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code and data to reproduce every result: https://github.com/simplify23/quant-trading-agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 量化策略研究把「找到赚钱规则」和「证明发现不是搜索运气」混为一谈，本文提出注入真值 (injected-truth) 协议加随机准入对照来检验准入门 (admission gates) 是否真的携带信息。在合成与真实校准面板上，弱信号区准入门消除假发现但把采纳率压到 1–7%，强信号区毫无增益；而基于绝对收益而非超额收益的准则会静默拒绝所有候选，包括真信号。
Motivation: 策略研究中「准入门」这类统计准则是否有效、代价多大一直未经检验；若只提高门槛而不优于同采纳率的随机对照，就并不携带信息。
Method: 提出注入真值协议：植入已知真/假信号的合成与真实校准面板，并设置与准入门采纳率相同的随机准入对照，只有门优于该对照才算携带信息；比较绝对收益与超额收益两类准则。
Result: 弱信号区准入门消除全部假发现，但采纳率降至 1–7%；强信号区准入门不增加任何收益；基于绝对收益而非超额收益的准则会静默拒绝所有候选，包括真信号。
Conclusion: 准入门只有在击败同采纳率的随机对照时才携带信息，且其代价在弱信号区表现为极低采纳率；准则必须基于超额收益，否则会连真信号一起拒掉。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 量化策略研究把「找到赚钱规则」和「证明发现不是搜索运气」混为一谈，本文提出注入真值 (injected-truth) 协议加随机准入对照来检验准入门 (admission gates) 是否真的携带信息。在合成与真实校准面板上，弱信号区准入门消除假发现但把采纳率压到 1–7%，强信号区毫无增益；而基于绝对收益而非超额收益的准则会静默拒绝所有候选，包括真信号。

papers.title: Improving Synthetic Data Generation for Argument Mining via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Argument Mining (AM) is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of high-quality structure-annotated datasets. While LLMs have shown promise in synthetic data generation, producing synthetic AM data that is both structurally accurate and sufficiently diverse remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we revisit synthetic data generation for AM from a new perspective and propose a novel adversarial reinforcement learning framework for data synthesis. The proposed framework jointly optimizes the generator and the discriminator in an adversarial loop, in which the generator produces structured AM instances, and the discriminator provides learning signals by distinguishing real data from synthetic candidates. This enables the generator to progressively improve both the structural accuracy of generated argument data while maintaining diversity through adversarial feedback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves AM performance on three benchmark datasets in both full-data and low-resource settings, validating its effectiveness and scalability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对论元挖掘 (Argument Mining) 结构标注数据稀缺，提出对抗强化学习合成框架：生成器产出结构化 AM 实例，判别器以真实数据与合成候选的区分提供反馈，联合优化使生成数据在保持多样性的同时提升结构准确性。在三个基准数据集的全数据与低资源设置下，该框架一致提升 AM 性能。
Motivation: 高质量结构标注数据稀缺是论元挖掘的核心瓶颈；用 LLM 合成的数据难以同时保证结构准确与足够多样。
Method: 对抗强化学习数据合成框架：生成器负责生成结构化 AM 实例，判别器区分真实与合成数据并给出学习信号，两者在对抗回路中联合优化，通过对抗反馈逐步提升结构准确性并维持多样性。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上，于全数据与低资源两种设置下，该框架均一致提升 AM 性能（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 对抗式生成器-判别器联合优化可同时改善合成 AM 数据的结构准确性与多样性，且在低资源场景下同样有效、可扩展。

papers.title: RBMatch: Dual-Level Class Rebalancing for Semi-Supervised Building Footprint Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Accurate building footprint extraction from high-resolution remote sensing imagery is essential for urban planning, disaster response, and environmental monitoring. However, obtaining dense pixel-level annotations is costly, motivating the use of semi-supervised learning (SSL) to leverage unlabeled imagery. In remote sensing, severe foreground--background imbalance poses a particular challenge for self-training, as it can bias pseudo-label generation and the resulting unsupervised optimization toward the majority background class. We show that addressing this imbalance at only one stage is insufficient: balancing pseudo-label selection alone does not prevent background bias from re-emerging during unsupervised loss optimization, a failure mode we term \emph{imbalance leak}. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{RBMatch}, a dual-level class-rebalancing framework that jointly regulates pseudo-label generation and unsupervised optimization. RBMatch combines a supervised learning pathway with a self-training module comprising three components: adaptive class-specific thresholding (ACT) for balanced pseudo-label selection, confidence-aware class-balanced reweighting (CACBR) for mitigating class bias in the unsupervised loss, and distribution alignment (DAL) for matching the predicted unlabeled-data distribution to the labeled-data prior. Experiments on the WHU, INRIA, and Massachusetts building footprint datasets across labeled ratios of 1%--10% show that RBMatch consistently achieves the best building IoU and F1-score among the evaluated methods. The improvement is most pronounced on the highly imbalanced Massachusetts dataset, where RBMatch improves IoU by 1.37 points over the strongest baseline at a 1% labeling ratio and is the only method to outperform the fully supervised baseline across all twelve dataset--ratio settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RBMatch 把半监督建筑轮廓提取的类别再平衡做到伪标签生成与无监督损失优化两个层级：ACT 做自适应类阈值选伪标签，CACBR 做置信度感知类均衡重加权，DAL 对齐无标注数据分布到有标注先验。在 WHU、INRIA、Massachusetts 三个数据集、1%–10% 标注比例共 12 个设置上，它在最不平衡的 Massachusetts 上 1% 标注时比最强基线 IoU 高 1.37 个百分点，且是唯一在全部 12 个设置上都超过全监督基线的方法。
Motivation: 遥感建筑轮廓的像素级标注昂贵，只能走半监督自训练；但前景-背景严重失衡会把伪标签生成和无监督优化一起偏向背景类，只在单一阶段做平衡不足以阻止背景偏置重新出现（imbalance leak）。
Method: RBMatch 由监督通路加自训练模块组成，自训练含三个组件：adaptive class-specific thresholding (ACT) 平衡伪标签选择、confidence-aware class-balanced reweighting (CACBR) 抑制无监督损失中的类偏置、distribution alignment (DAL) 把无标注数据的预测分布对齐到有标注数据先验，两级联合调节。
Result: 在 WHU、INRIA、Massachusetts 建筑轮廓数据集、标注比例 1%–10% 的评测中，RBMatch 的 building IoU 与 F1 在所有被评方法中最高；在高度不平衡的 Massachusetts 上 1% 标注比例时 IoU 比最强基线高 1.37 个百分点，并且是唯一在全部 12 个数据集-比例设置上都优于全监督基线的方法。
Conclusion: 伪标签选择与无监督损失优化必须同时做类再平衡，只平衡其中一级会让背景偏置在另一级重新出现；双层级联后半监督模型可在 1%–10% 标注下稳定超过全监督。

papers.title: Anchor-driven Multi-modal Multi-scale Expert Selection for Survival Prediction
papers.abstract_en: The integrative analysis of histopathological Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) and transcriptomic profiles holds significant promise for cancer survival prediction. However, existing methods typically project multi-modal features directly into a shared latent space without explicit alignment, leading to the entanglement of mismatched morphological cues and molecular signals. Furthermore, current fusion strategies often treat the extreme spatial heterogeneity of WSIs uniformly, lacking mechanisms to adaptively prioritize clinically relevant tissue scales for individual patients. To address these limitations, we propose an Anchor-driven Multi-modal Multi-scale Expert Selection (AM$^2$ES) framework for survival prediction. Specifically, we present an Anchor-driven Multi-modal Fusion (AMF) module, which introduces learnable semantic anchors as cross-modal mediators to bridge the semantic gap by enforcing a structurally regularized alignment between transcriptomic features and multi-scale pathology representations. Built upon this aligned semantic space, we further design a Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (H-MoE) selection module to decouple the hierarchical prognostic selection process. Mimicking the pathologist's diagnostic workflow, H-MoE performs (i) Intra-scale Expert Filtering to discriminatively identify salient tumor regions within each magnification, and (ii) Inter-scale Hierarchy Routing to dynamically weight and select the most informative resolution levels. Extensive experiments on multiple TCGA cancer cohorts demonstrate that our AM$^2$ES achieves state-of-the-art performance while offering fine-grained interpretability by visualizing how specific molecular pathways drive the expert routing decisions across tissue scales. The code will be released at https://github.com/taozh2017/AM2ES.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 AM²ES 框架，用可学习语义锚点 (learnable semantic anchors) 作为跨模态中介，对转录组特征与多尺度病理表征做结构正则化对齐，再在其上用分层混合专家 (H-MoE) 先在各放大倍数内筛选显著肿瘤区域、再跨尺度路由权重。在多个 TCGA 癌种队列上达到 state-of-the-art 生存预测性能，并可视化分子通路如何驱动跨尺度专家路由。
Motivation: 现有方法把多模态特征直接投到共享隐空间而无显式对齐，导致错配的形态线索与分子信号纠缠；融合策略又把 WSI 的极端空间异质性当均匀处理，无法按患者自适应优先选择临床相关组织尺度。
Method: AM²ES 含两个模块：Anchor-driven Multi-modal Fusion (AMF) 用可学习语义锚点桥接语义鸿沟，对转录组特征与多尺度病理表征施加结构正则化对齐；其上接 Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (H-MoE)，分 Intra-scale Expert Filtering（各倍率内判别式挑显著肿瘤区域）与 Inter-scale Hierarchy Routing（动态加权并选择信息量最大的分辨率层级），模仿病理医生诊断流程。
Result: 在多个 TCGA 癌种队列上取得 state-of-the-art 生存预测性能，并通过可视化特定分子通路如何驱动跨尺度专家路由决策提供细粒度可解释性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 显式锚点对齐加层级专家选择能同时解决多模态纠缠与尺度均一化问题，作者称代码将发布于 github.com/taozh2017/AM2ES。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Unlocking Fine-Grained Perception in CLIP via Structurally-Aware Latent Masked Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP excel in global semantic alignment but often lack fine-grained perceptual capabilities. This hinders dense prediction tasks and bottlenecks the visual potential of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing research has attempted to enhance CLIP's visual representations by incorporating geometric priors from vision-centric models. However, these strategies often struggle to achieve deep alignment for both local spatial structures and global semantics, potentially even distorting the original image-text space. To address these limitations, we propose SALM, an unsupervised embedding alignment framework based on structurally-aware latent mask modeling. SALM effectively synergizes local and global alignment via a dual-path design combining explicit and implicit mechanisms, without requiring any image-text pairs. First, we introduce a dual-matrix alignment strategy that explicitly calibrates intra-sample spatial correlations and activation intensities, thereby effectively injecting local geometric priors. Based on this, we further design a latent mask modeling mechanism to guide CLIP to restore the missing semantic details of the target model, thereby implicitly aggregating fine-grained structures into the global semantic space. Furthermore, driven by the empirical observations that CLIP's shallow features inherently possess strong spatial observational capabilities, we naturally extend SALM to a highly efficient self-distillation paradigm, SALM-Self. This unlocks CLIP's intrinsic fine-grained potential without relying on any external models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SALM not only significantly improves performance in dense prediction tasks but also boosts CLIP's zero-shot accuracy, effectively enhancing the fine-grained understanding capabilities of MLLMs. Project page at https://qzfm.github.io/salm_project_page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SALM 用结构感知的潜空间掩码建模在不需要图文对的情况下把局部几何先验注入 CLIP：双矩阵对齐显式校准样本内空间相关与激活强度，潜掩码建模再让 CLIP 还原目标模型缺失的语义细节。实验显示它同时提升稠密预测任务性能与 CLIP 的 zero-shot 准确率，并扩展为不依赖外部模型的自蒸馏版本 SALM-Self。
Motivation: CLIP 擅长全局语义对齐但缺乏细粒度感知，制约稠密预测与 MLLM 的视觉潜力；现有引入视觉中心模型几何先验的方法难以同时对齐局部空间结构与全局语义，甚至会扭曲原有图文空间。
Method: 提出无监督嵌入对齐框架 SALM，双路径结合显式与隐式机制且无需图文对：先用双矩阵对齐策略显式校准样本内空间相关性与激活强度注入局部几何先验，再用潜空间掩码建模 (latent mask modeling) 让 CLIP 恢复目标模型缺失的语义细节，把细粒度结构聚合进全局语义空间；基于 CLIP 浅层特征本身具有强空间观察能力这一经验观察，进一步扩展出无需外部模型的自蒸馏范式 SALM-Self。
Result: 实验表明 SALM 显著改善稠密预测任务表现，同时提升 CLIP 的 zero-shot 准确率，并增强 MLLM 的细粒度理解能力；摘要未给出具体数据集、指标数值或基线对比。
Conclusion: 细粒度感知可以在不依赖图文对与外部视觉模型的条件下，通过结构感知的显式对齐加隐式掩码重建从 CLIP 内部释放出来，且不牺牲其全局语义对齐能力。

papers.title: BluffJAX: Adversarial Imperfect Information Games in JAX
papers.abstract_en: We introduce BluffJAX: an open-source suite of adversarial imperfect information games in JAX. We provide canonical implementations of games designed for high simulation throughputs and parallelization on GPU accelerators. Our suite consists of well-studied benchmarks such as Texas Hold'Em Poker and Kuhn Poker, as well as games that have not been previously studied in reinforcement learning research, such as Bluff, Stud Poker, and Kemps. We hope that implementing a variety of game mechanics and difficulties will introduce new challenges and foster novel research directions in game-theoretic methods for RL. We benchmark the throughput performance and memory usage of our environments in single and multi-GPU settings, demonstrating scaling of up to hundreds of millions of samples per second, and motivating the usage of BluffJAX over related GPU and CPU-based libraries. We benchmark reinforcement learning, tree search, and game-solving algorithms in JAX in order to provide users with baseline results and facilitate future comparisons.

papers.title: Disentangling Dual Image References in Frequency Aware Diffusion Models for Personalized Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized image generation aims to synthesize text-driven images conditioned on reference images, while mainly casting the generation as image customization for foreground and style transfer for background. Previous arts of diffusion models suffers from the text misalignment with background for image customization and foreground for style transfer during the denoising process. Such facts, as we observed, rooted from the entanglement among hybrid frequency bands during the denoising process. To address such salient limitation, in this paper, we study personalized generation based on dual references - customization and color and style reference - and propose a paradigm to disentangle these Dual image references within Frequency-aware Diffusion Models, dubbed Dual-FDM, to simultaneously tackle two crucial personalized image generation tasks: customization style transfer and color style transfer, by disentangling different frequency bands via mask strategy within frequency domain. For customization style transfer, we replace the mid-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from the foreground of the customized reference. For color style transfer, we substitute the low-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from both the foreground and background of the color reference. Both the substituted frequency bands are used as the key and value to reconstruct the query foreground and background of the denoised personalized image.Extensive experiments validate the superiority of Dual-FDM over the state-of-the-art diffusion models for personalized image generation. Our code can be accessed from https://github.com/htyjers/Dual-FDM.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 14 figures, to appear at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney, Australia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Dual-FDM：在频域用掩码把双参考图（定制参考与风格/颜色参考）解耦，定制风格迁移中用定制参考前景的中频带替换风格参考背景中频带，颜色风格迁移中用颜色参考前景与背景的低频带替换风格参考背景低频带，替换后的频带作为 key/value 重建去噪图像的前景与背景。作者称实验验证其优于现有个性化生成扩散模型。
Motivation: 扩散模型做图像定制时背景与文本不对齐、做风格迁移时前景与文本不对齐，根因是去噪过程中混合频带纠缠，双参考条件难以分离。
Method: Dual-FDM 在频域用 mask 策略解耦不同频带：定制风格迁移替换背景中频带（取自定制参考前景），颜色风格迁移替换背景低频带（取自颜色参考前景与背景）；被替换频带作为 key/value 重建去噪个性化图像的前景与背景 query。
Result: 在个性化图像生成的定制风格迁移与颜色风格迁移两类任务上，实验验证 Dual-FDM 优于 SOTA 扩散模型（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
Conclusion: 把双参考按频带解耦并以频带替换方式注入 key/value，可同时处理定制与颜色两类个性化生成任务并超越现有扩散模型。

papers.title: EigenDEXplore: Structured Exploration for Dexterous Manipulation with Human Priors
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation poses a challenging high-dimensional optimization problem, as useful behaviors require coordinated motion across many hand joints. In reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based trajectory optimization, exploration commonly relies on independent robot joint perturbations, making coordinated behaviors difficult to discover. Prior work reduces this search space for grasp learning using low-dimensional spaces of coordinated joint motions learned from human hand data, but this restricts the expressivity required for general manipulation. Some combine learned and joint-space actions to restore expressivity, but this increases dimensionality and introduces redundancy. We study these effects across diverse manipulation settings, varying action dimensionality, exploration strategy, and the source of human data. Our experiments suggest that human-motion priors are most effective when used to structure exploration rather than change the action representation. Motivated by this finding, we propose EigenDEXplore, which induces correlated exploration by adding perturbations along human-derived eigenvectors to independent joint-space noise, leaving the action space unchanged. Across multiple dexterous hands, EigenDEXplore consistently outperforms joint-space and learned action-space baselines in grasping, in-hand reorientation, and contact-rich manipulation. These gains span unstructured and reference-guided RL, trajectory optimization, and sim-to-real deployment, and are largest in settings with less reward shaping and curriculum design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EigenDEXplore 把人类手部动作先验做成探索用的特征向量，在独立关节噪声上叠加沿这些特征向量的扰动，动作空间本身保持不变。在多种灵巧手上，它在抓取、手中重定向和富接触操作中持续超过关节空间与学习动作空间基线，且在奖励塑形和课程设计越少时优势越大。
Motivation: 灵巧操作是高维优化问题，RL 与采样式轨迹优化靠独立关节扰动探索，难以发现多关节协同行为；已有用人类数据降维或混合动作空间的做法分别牺牲表达力或抬高维度并引入冗余。
Method: 先系统改变动作维度、探索策略与人类数据来源，比较人类先验用于改变动作表示与用于结构化探索的差别；据此提出 EigenDEXplore，在独立关节空间噪声之外叠加沿人类数据导出的特征向量 (human-derived eigenvectors) 的扰动，动作空间不变，覆盖 RL 与轨迹优化。
Result: 在多个灵巧手上，EigenDEXplore 在抓取、手中重定向 (in-hand reorientation) 与富接触操作中一致优于关节空间和学习动作空间基线；收益横跨无参考与参考引导 RL、轨迹优化以及 sim-to-real 部署，并在奖励塑形与课程设计较少的设置下最大。
Conclusion: 人类动作先验最有效的用法是结构化探索而非改写动作表示；保留关节空间动作、只在噪声上注入协同方向，即可在多种操作任务与部署路径上稳定提升性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adaptive Model Inversion Attacks Generalize a Privacy-Robustness Tradeoff
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we show that standard evaluations of high-resolution Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) significantly underestimate training-data privacy leakage. State-of-the-art privacy defenses, standard training techniques such as MixUp and Adversarial Training, and undefended models all leak training images at rates 1.16 to 6.59 times higher on FaceScrub under simple adaptive changes to the attack, with the largest increases among defenses reporting the strongest privacy. We further show that measured leakage depends on the feature basis of the external classifier used to evaluate reconstructions: for the same reconstructed images, an adversarially trained Inception evaluator identifies the targeted identity at different rates than the standard Inception evaluator. Our results suggest that standard MIA evaluation can mistake optimization and measurement failures for privacy. These underestimated leakage rates also concealed a broader relationship between privacy and adversarial robustness. Once we adapt the attack and vary the evaluator, reconstruction leakage closely tracks adversarial robustness across recent defenses and standard training regimes, suggesting that robustness provides an attack-agnostic proxy for reconstruction vulnerability that applies far more broadly than previously theorized. This raises an open question: can a practical defense reduce training-data reconstruction without paying a corresponding cost in adversarial robustness?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 标准高分辨率模型反演攻击 (Model Inversion Attack, MIA) 评测严重低估训练数据隐私泄露：在 FaceScrub 上，对攻击做简单自适应改动后，隐私防御、MixUp、对抗训练与无防御模型的图像泄露率都升到原来的 1.16 至 6.59 倍，且自称隐私最强的防御涨幅最大。泄露率还取决于评测重建所用外部分类器的特征基——同一张重建图，对抗训练的 Inception 评测器与标准 Inception 评测器判定目标身份的命中率不同。自适应攻击下重建泄露与对抗鲁棒性紧密同步，鲁棒性因此可作为攻击无关的重建脆弱性代理。
Motivation: 现有 MIA 标准评测把优化失败与测量失败误当成隐私，导致对训练图像泄露的系统性低估，也掩盖了隐私与对抗鲁棒性之间本就存在的联系。
Method: 对 SOTA 隐私防御、MixUp、对抗训练与无防御模型施加对攻击的简单自适应改动后重测高分辨率 MIA；同时更换评测重建用的外部分类器特征基，对比标准 Inception 与对抗训练的 Inception 评测器对同一批重建图的目标身份识别率；再在近期防御与标准训练机制上比较重建泄露与对抗鲁棒性的对应关系。
Result: 在 FaceScrub 上，自适应改动使各模型的训练图像泄露率提高 1.16 至 6.59 倍，涨幅最大的是报告隐私最强的防御；同一重建图像上，对抗训练的 Inception 评测器与标准 Inception 评测器识别目标身份的比率不同；自适应攻击并变换评测器后，重建泄露在近期防御与标准训练机制上与对抗鲁棒性紧密对应。
Conclusion: 标准 MIA 评测会把优化与测量失败误读为隐私，而对抗鲁棒性可作为比既有理论所设想范围更广的重建脆弱性代理；由此留下一个开放问题：能否在不牺牲对抗鲁棒性的前提下降低训练数据重建泄露。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exact-Solution Volume and Length Generalization in Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Research on transformer expressivity shows whether a transformer is capable of solving a given task, but gives little indication of whether the solution, if learned, is generalizable to longer input lengths. We study this question through normalized exact-solution volume (NESV): the fraction of a bounded parameter region that achieves an exact solution on every input of length $n$. For fixed-width, single-layer transformers with $\log n$-scaled attention, we establish asymptotic bounds on NESV for four tasks: FIRST ($Θ(1)$), MAJORITY ($Θ(1/(n\log n))$), INDEX ($Θ(1/n^3)$), and PARITY ($0$). These results are consistent with previous empirical results: the faster the exact-solution volume decays with input length, the harder it is to length-generalize on that task. Looking deeper into INDEX, our volume analysis reveals two error sources that grow with $n$. Consequently, we study a transformer model that would structurally eliminate one of the terms, theoretically improving the NESV bound to $Θ(n^{-1})$, and empirically achieving 85% accuracy when tested at $10\times$ the training length, compared with the 60% accuracy of the original model. We conclude that volume analysis may be a useful approach to identify concrete sources of length sensitivity and thus provide insights into task-specific model refinements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出归一化精确解体积 (NESV)：有界参数区域中能在长度 n 的所有输入上精确求解的比例，用来刻画 transformer 学到的解能否推广到更长输入。对固定宽度单层、注意力按 log n 缩放的模型，FIRST 为 Θ(1)、MAJORITY 为 Θ(1/(n log n))、INDEX 为 Θ(1/n³)、PARITY 为 0，衰减越快长度泛化越难；针对 INDEX 的两个随 n 增长的误差源改造结构后 NESV 界改进到 Θ(n⁻¹)，在 10 倍训练长度上准确率从 60% 提到 85%。
Motivation: transformer 表达力研究只回答模型能否解某任务，不回答学到的解能否推广到更长输入；缺少把长度敏感性与参数空间几何联系起来的分析工具。
Method: 定义 NESV 并对固定宽度单层、log n 缩放注意力的 transformer 推导四个任务的渐近界；深入 INDEX 时分解出两个随 n 增长的误差项，再构造一个在结构上消去其中一项的模型，给出改进的 NESV 理论界并做长度外推测试。
Result: NESV 渐近界：FIRST Θ(1)，MAJORITY Θ(1/(n log n))，INDEX Θ(1/n³)，PARITY 0，与已有经验结果一致——精确解体积随长度衰减越快，长度泛化越难。结构改造后的 INDEX 模型 NESV 界改进为 Θ(n⁻¹)，在 10 倍训练长度测试时准确率 85%，原模型为 60%。
Conclusion: 体积分析能定位长度敏感性的具体来源，从而给出针对任务的模型改进方向；对 INDEX 而言消去一个随 n 增长的误差项即可同时抬高 NESV 界与长度外推准确率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: NESV 渐近界：FIRST Θ(1)，MAJORITY Θ(1/(n log n))，INDEX Θ(1/n³)，PARITY 0，与已有经验结果一致——精确解体积随长度衰减越快，长度泛化越难。结构改造后的 INDEX 模型 NESV 界改进为 Θ(n⁻¹)，在 10 倍训练长度测试时准确率 85%，原模型为 60%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 体积分析能定位长度敏感性的具体来源，从而给出针对任务的模型改进方向；对 INDEX 而言消去一个随 n 增长的误差项即可同时抬高 NESV 界与长度外推准确率。

papers.title: EIO-Agents: The Missing Semantic Layer for AI Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are entering production in increasingly consequential environments without a shared semantic standard for what their evaluations actually mean. Scores, traces, judge outputs, and multi juror findings are increasingly used to justify readiness and release decisions, yet they often do not specify what evidence supports a claim, what that evidence can establish, or how the claim leads to a decision. We introduce EIO-Agents, an open specification for interoperable AI agent evaluation built on two layers. The Evaluation Intelligence Ontology (EIO) provides the semantic layer through typed evidence, versioned behavioral predicates, evidence contracts, claims, witness rules, proof status, recurrence, and computable derivations for metrics, findings, controls, and PASS, REVIEW, or BLOCK decisions. The Portable Evaluation Record (PER) provides the system of record: a canonical, content addressed representation of one evaluation that preserves the evidence to decision chain and can be re derived, explained, and verified. Scores summarize, juries interpret, and traces record, but none of them define what the evidence means or what it can prove. EIO provides that missing semantic contract, while PER preserves the resulting evaluation as a portable and verifiable system of record. As AI agents assume greater operational responsibility, evaluation must become more than a collection of scores and verdicts; it must become an accountable artifact whose meaning, evidence, limitations, and decisions can be independently checked.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EIO-Agents 提出一个开放的 AI agent 评测互操作规范，由两层组成：Evaluation Intelligence Ontology (EIO) 用类型化证据、版本化行为谓词、evidence contracts、claims、witness rules、proof status 与可计算推导，把分数、trace、judge 输出连到 PASS/REVIEW/BLOCK 决策；Portable Evaluation Record (PER) 以内容寻址的规范表示保存整条证据到决策的链路，使其可重推导、可解释、可验证。核心论断是：分数只做汇总、jury 只做解释、trace 只做记录，三者都不定义证据含义，语义契约才是让评测成为可独立核查的问责性 artifact 的缺失一层。
Motivation: AI agent 正进入后果日益重大的生产环境，但评测分数、trace、judge 与多 jury 结果没有共享语义标准，不说明主张由什么证据支撑、证据能确立什么、主张如何导向发布决策。
Method: 规范分两层：EIO 语义层定义 typed evidence、versioned behavioral predicates、evidence contracts、claims、witness rules、proof status、recurrence，以及对 metrics、findings、controls 和 PASS/REVIEW/BLOCK 决策的可计算推导；PER 作为 system of record，用 canonical、content addressed 表示保存单次评测的证据到决策链。
Result: 提出 EIO 与 PER 两层开放规范，PER 中的评测可被重推导、解释与验证；arXiv comment 标注 32 pages、11 figures。
Conclusion: 评测必须从分数与 verdict 的集合变成可问责的 artifact，其含义、证据、局限与决策可被独立核查；EIO 补上语义契约，PER 保存可移植可验证的记录。

papers.title: Evaluating human-AI workflows for field research in viticulture
papers.abstract_en: We assessed the value of two live human-AI interactions in a precision disease control project in California vineyards. The project tested whether 2021-2024 commercial scouting records and remote-sensing measurements across 140 hectares could support 2025 red-leaf symptom forecasting for prioritized scouting and virus testing. In Workflow 1, Aleks v1, a multi-agent research system, developed forecasting models with iterative human refinement. We applied Aleks's 2024 vine-scale model to updated 2025 predictors and evaluated red-leaf forecasts against independent 2025 scouting. In retrospective simulations surveying 45% of all vine positions, adding model-informed row prioritization to adaptive scouting increased the encountered proportion of newly recorded red-leaf observations from 85.8% to 94.1%. Within-block scouting comparisons suggested the model mainly improved scouting allocation among blocks. Despite unreliable internal 2024 performance estimates from synthetic oversampling before train/test splitting, Aleks developed an informative vine-scale model in 145 minutes, increasing throughput and answering our research questions. In Workflow 2, we assessed whether higher model-score vines had more frequent virus detection, and whether Aleks could infer this sampling goal from a general prompt with data and literature. Aleks's plan prioritized balanced vineyard and model score coverage, while our plan prioritized field efficiency and high-model-score oversampling. Aleks's and our plans yielded 41/50 (82%) and 97/100 (97%) sampled vines. Aleks's plan omitted instructions for replacing missing vines, limiting implementation and operational value. Five of 137 sampled vines tested positive for grapevine red blotch virus (model score ROC AUC 0.735). These findings support assessing AI interactions by how well they advance field research objectives under live, project-specific constraints.
papers.comment: 35 pages, including supplementary materials. Supporting files S1-S4: https://doi-org.proxy.library.cornell.edu/10.5281/zenodo.23142108
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在加州葡萄园精准病害控制项目中，用多-agent 研究系统 Aleks v1 迭代开发红叶症状预测模型，并对比人机两套采样方案的落地效果。回溯模拟中，在巡查 45% 葡萄株位的前提下加入模型引导的行优先级，新记录红叶观测的捕获比例从 85.8% 升到 94.1%；采样方案上，作者方案落地 97/100 株（97%），Aleks 方案为 41/50 株（82%），且漏写缺株替换指令。
Motivation: 田间研究受实时人力与地块约束，AI 系统生成的模型与采样计划能否真正推进现场目标（优先巡查、病毒检测）缺少在活项目中的检验。
Method: Aleks v1 通过与人的迭代细化，用 2021–2024 商业巡查记录与遥感测量（140 公顷）开发葡萄株尺度预测模型，再套用到 2025 更新预测因子并以独立 2025 巡查数据检验；Workflow 2 中让 Aleks 从含数据与文献的通用 prompt 推断采样目标，与作者自拟方案对照。
Result: 回溯模拟巡查 45% 株位时，模型引导行优先级使新记录红叶观测捕获比例由 85.8% 升至 94.1%；Aleks 在 145 分钟内建成有信息量的株尺度模型，但其 2024 内部性能估计因先合成过采样后切分而不可靠。采样计划落地：Aleks 41/50（82%），作者 97/100（97%）；137 株取样中 5 株检出 grapevine red blotch virus，模型分数 ROC AUC 0.735。
Conclusion: 评估人机交互应看它在实时、项目特定约束下推进田间研究目标的程度；Aleks 的模型能改善巡查分配，但其采样计划因缺缺株替换指令而限制可执行性。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: CACHEFORGE: LLM-Guided End-to-End Generative Cache Replacement Policy for Performance and Hardware Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Modern cache replacement designs saturate because they operate within fixed representational structures, hand-crafted and heuristic based feature-engineered predictors, or offline imitation models that cannot generate new decision logic on their own. At the same time, replacement is shaped by the causal interaction of prefetching, thrashing, spatial locality, and access-type behavior, producing an enormous design space that is difficult to traverse manually. Prior approaches typically rely on heuristics, parameter tuning, or imitation of an offline optimal policy, capturing correlations rather than synthesizing new mechanisms. As a result, their performance gains often plateau and they overfit under dynamic workload conditions. CACHEFORGE is the first framework to evolve cache-replacement policies end-to-end by embedding a large language model inside a governed hardware-aware loop. In each iteration, the LLM proposes new C++ replacement logic, the policy is evaluated under a trace-based CRC-2 ChampSim simulator, and the framework enforces feasibility through reward shaping, structural checks, dynamic mutation, temperature scheduling, and cross-policy crossover. This closed-loop generation-evolution loop specifically designed for cache replacement policy enables the discovery of compact policies that satisfy hardware constraints while exploring algorithmic transformations beyond fixed predictor structures. Across SPEC CPU2006, CACHEFORGE outperforms all CRC-2 baselines. It improves the total hit rate by 27.36%, 19.69%, 13.72%, 13.15%, 11.83%, and 5.73% over MPPPB, ReD, Hawk-eye, SHiP++, LIME, and LRU, respectively. On memory-intensive workloads, it increases IPC by 10.15%, 7.89%, 6.34%, 3.64%, 3.12%, and 2.71% over LRU, MPPPB, LIME, ReD, SHiP++, and Hawkeye.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CACHEFORGE 把 LLM 嵌进硬件感知的闭环里，让它每轮生成新的 C++ 缓存替换逻辑，再在 CRC-2 ChampSim 上做 trace 级评测，并用 reward shaping、结构检查、动态变异、温度调度与跨策略交叉来保证可行性。在 SPEC CPU2006 上它超过全部 CRC-2 基线：总命中率相对 MPPPB 提升 27.36%，内存密集负载上 IPC 相对 LRU 提升 10.15%。
Motivation: 现有替换策略受限于固定表示结构、手工特征或离线模仿模型，只能捕捉相关性而不能生成新机制，收益易在动态负载下饱和并过拟合。
Method: 在受治理的硬件感知循环中嵌入 LLM：每轮提出新的 C++ 替换逻辑，在 trace-based CRC-2 ChampSim 模拟器中评测，用 reward shaping、结构检查、动态变异、温度调度与跨策略交叉 (crossover) 强制可行性，形成生成-演化闭环。
Result: 在 SPEC CPU2006 上总命中率相对 MPPPB、ReD、Hawk-eye、SHiP++、LIME、LRU 分别提升 27.36%、19.69%、13.72%、13.15%、11.83%、5.73%；内存密集负载上 IPC 相对 LRU、MPPPB、LIME、ReD、SHiP++、Hawkeye 分别提升 10.15%、7.89%、6.34%、3.64%、3.12%、2.71%。
Conclusion: 让 LLM 在受约束的生成-演化闭环中直接合成替换逻辑，可以突破固定预测器结构的收益天花板，产出满足硬件约束的紧凑策略。

papers.title: SENSE: State-aware Emotion Navigation Storytelling Engine
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents SENSE, a state-aware framework for generating playable branching visual novels with multi-track emotional navigation. Integrating a state-based narrative architecture called MIND, a structure analyzer, and a path-aware context management module, SENSE produces narratives that are both structurally coherent and emotionally rich. From minimal high-level inputs, it generates multiple intersecting routes while preserving character consistency and narrative causality. Evaluations using LLM judges, affective metrics, and visual assessments indicate SENSE outperforms baselines in narrative diversity and robust asset integration, while preliminary human trials show directional improvements in emotional fidelity alongside comparable enjoyment.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Games ( Early Access ), 2026, 1 - 11
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SENSE 把状态化叙事架构 MIND、结构分析器与路径感知上下文管理拼成一个框架，从极简高层输入生成多条相互交织、可玩的分支视觉小说路线，同时保持角色一致性与叙事因果。LLM 评审、情感指标与视觉评估显示它在叙事多样性和素材整合稳健性上超过基线，初步人体试验证明情感保真度方向性提升且可玩乐趣相当。
Motivation: 用 LLM 生成分支视觉小说时，多路线交织容易破坏角色一致性与叙事因果，情感走向也难以随路径可控。
Method: SENSE 集成状态化叙事架构 MIND、结构分析器 (structure analyzer) 与路径感知上下文管理模块 (path-aware context management)，从极简高层输入生成多条相交路线；评测用 LLM judges、情感指标 (affective metrics) 与视觉评估，并做初步人体试验。
Result: 在 LLM 评审、情感指标与视觉评估下，SENSE 在叙事多样性 (narrative diversity) 与素材整合稳健性 (robust asset integration) 上优于基线；初步人体试验显示情感保真度 (emotional fidelity) 呈方向性改善，可玩乐趣 (enjoyment) 与基线相当。
Conclusion: 状态化叙事架构加路径感知上下文管理可以在生成分支视觉小说时同时保住结构连贯、角色一致与情感走向，情感保真度的提升目前只有初步人体证据。
