papers.title: Joint Workflow and Prompt Optimization for User Behavior Simulation
papers.abstract_en: User behavior simulation is the computational modeling of user interactions within information systems through the use of simulated agents in place of live users. It supports system testing and evaluation, decision-making and forecasting, and user experience design. Existing simulators rely on hand-crafted rules or domain expertise that transfers poorly across tasks. SWORD (Simulation-driven Workflow and Prompt Optimization with Role-based Design) is introduced as a framework that jointly optimizes multi-agent workflow topology and natural-language prompts. It is guided solely by a scalar task metric, without domain initialization or task-specific engineering. The experimental results demonstrate that SWORD achieves statistically significant gains over prompt-only, workflow-only, and staged-optimization baselines under a controlled, identical-backbone comparison. Against the strongest published domain-specific baseline, SWORD further improves accuracy while using a smaller backbone model, substantially less training data, and a very reasonable API cost (\$4--\$6 for each dataset). Beyond predictive performance, SWORD autonomously discovers domain-relevant signals, review-sentiment mapping rules and epidemiological decay priors, purely from scalar error feedback, establishing textual gradients as a mechanism for unsupervised feature-importance discovery in user behavior modeling.
papers.comment: under review for ACM Transactions on Information Systems Journal, 34 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWORD 在单一标量任务指标驱动下联合优化多智能体工作流拓扑与自然语言 prompt，无需领域初始化或任务定制工程。在受控同骨干对比中，它对 prompt-only、workflow-only 与分阶段优化基线均取得统计显著增益，并以更小的骨干模型、更少训练数据和每数据集 4–6 美元 API 成本超过最强已发布领域专用基线。
Motivation: 现有用户行为模拟器依赖手工规则或领域经验，跨任务迁移差；工作流结构与 prompt 通常分开调优，缺少统一的、不依赖领域知识的优化信号。
Method: SWORD (Simulation-driven Workflow and Prompt Optimization with Role-based Design) 联合优化多智能体工作流拓扑与自然语言 prompt，仅由标量任务指标引导，以 textual gradients 作为反馈机制；实验采用受控的 identical-backbone 对比，并与 prompt-only、workflow-only、staged-optimization 基线比较。

papers.title: MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiography (ECG) records the electrical activity of the heart, aiding diagnosis by detecting abnormalities in cardiac function. ECG foundation models have demonstrated promising results, but are limited by a reliance on ECG interpretation reports as their sole supervision. Because interpretation reports only capture the subset of waveform information routinely recognized by clinicians, this constrains representation learning to overlook the broader diagnostic signals present in ECG. We introduce a new ECG foundation model --- MS-ECG-FM --- that is trained through contrastive alignment to multiple distinct clinical note types, including ECG, echocardiography, radiology, and discharge reports. We evaluate MS-ECG-FM on an extended set of ECG detection benchmarks, showing that it comprehensively outperforms existing methods on the full span of conditions that ECG can detect, including in reduced-lead configurations. Different reports improve representations for different diagnostic domains, while multi-source alignment captures their complementary information and produces consistently strong representations across clinically diverse tasks.
papers.comment: Andrew C. Miller, Joseph Futoma: equal contribution. 52 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables, including supplementary information
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有 ECG 基础模型只以 ECG 解读报告为唯一监督，而报告只覆盖临床医生常规识别的波形子集，使表示学习遗漏 ECG 中更广的诊断信号。

papers.title: Massive Activation Gating Channel in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Massive activations, a phenomenon in which a small number of hidden channels exhibit exceptionally large magnitudes, are pervasive in large language models (LLMs). However, the mechanism by which a token develops massive activations as it propagates through a pretrained LLM remains poorly understood. In this paper, we find that the emergence of massive activations is controlled by a single channel in the input embedding to a spike feed-forward network (FFN). The position of this channel is fixed for a particular LLM. We name this channel the massive activation gating channel (MAGC). When the value of the MAGC is sufficiently large (or small, depending on the LLM), the output of the spike FFN exhibits massive activations. Examining six LLMs across four model families and different model sizes, we verify the existence and effect of MAGC. We further provide a theoretical explanation of the mechanism by which MAGC induces massive activations. When the value of MAGC is sufficiently large (or small), the output of a spike FFN asymptotically reduces to a quadratic form that mixes a few columns of the down-projection matrix of the FFN. Since these columns exhibit the shape of massive activations, the output therefore exhibits massive activations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 中的 massive activation 由输入 embedding 到 spike FFN 的单一通道控制，作者将其命名为 massive activation gating channel (MAGC)，其位置对特定模型固定。当 MAGC 值足够大（或足够小，视模型而定）时 spike FFN 输出 massive activation；理论上此时输出渐近退化为混合 FFN down-projection 少数几列的二次型，而这些列本身呈 massive activation 形状。
Motivation: 少数隐藏通道出现异常大数值的现象在 LLM 中普遍存在，但一个 token 在预训练模型中传播时如何形成 massive activation 的机制仍不清楚。
Method: 在四个模型家族、不同规模的六个 LLM 上定位并验证 MAGC 的存在与作用，并给出理论解释：MAGC 取值足够大或足够小时，spike FFN 输出渐近化为混合 down-projection 矩阵少数几列的二次型。
Result: 在六个 LLM（跨四个模型家族、不同模型规模）上验证了 MAGC 的存在与效应；理论结果表明 MAGC 足够大或足够小时 spike FFN 输出渐近退化为二次型，其混合的 down-projection 列呈 massive activation 形状，故输出呈 massive activation。
Conclusion: massive activation 由单一、位置固定的 gating 通道经 spike FFN 触发，其机制可由 down-projection 少数列构成的二次型给出理论解释。

papers.title: Where Rules End and Judges Begin: Measuring the Judgment Boundary in Multi-Agent Systems Security
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) engage tools, share memory, and delegate tasks, often encountering adversarial content. Current defenses for MAS are typically evaluated in isolation, focusing on one attack type at a time, which can lead to costly and hard-to-audit outcomes. This study organizes defenses into five principles, implementing them as DEFER1 (DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment), which includes a cascade of 28 checks that blocks what it can and refers the rest to a panel of four judges. In independent testing across four domains, attack success rates drop from about 30.0% to approximately 3.0%, with 78% of blocked attacks handled by deterministic checks. Only a quarter of proposals reach the judges in the security-operations domain, illustrating that the rules provide security for attacks violating clear policies, while judges manage those that only misrepresent intent. Both systems have weaknesses, such as a risk-score approval gate that inaccurately approves most attack proposals but few legitimate ones, highlighting the challenges in assessing threats accurately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 LLM 多智能体系统 (MAS) 防御各自孤立评估、难以审计的问题，提出 DEFER1（DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment）：把防御组织成五条原则，用 28 级检查的级联先做确定性拦截，剩余交给四名 judge 面板。在四个领域的独立测试中攻击成功率从约 30.0% 降到约 3.0%，其中 78% 的拦截由确定性检查完成；安全运营领域仅四分之一提案进入 judge，说明规则管违反明确政策的攻击、judge 管只歪曲意图的攻击。
Motivation: MAS 防御通常一次只针对一种攻击类型、彼此孤立评估，导致代价高且难以审计；需要一个把规则拦截与残余判断分工的统一框架。
Method: DEFER1 将防御组织为五条原则并实现为级联：28 项检查先做确定性拦截，无法判定的转交由四名 judge 组成的面板裁决；在四个领域做独立测试，并对照含风险分审批门控等组件的行为。
Result: 四个领域独立测试中攻击成功率由约 30.0% 降至约 3.0%；被拦截攻击的 78% 由确定性检查处理；安全运营领域仅约四分之一（一个季度）提案到达 judge；风险分审批门控错误地放行了大多数攻击提案、却很少放行合法提案。
Conclusion: 规则负责违反明确政策的攻击、judge 负责仅歪曲意图的攻击这一分工有效降低攻击成功率，但风险分审批门控这类组件在威胁评估上仍不可靠。

papers.title: Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models are Minimax Optimal for Estimating Distributions with Small Effective Support Size
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a practically successful framework for generative modeling on discrete product spaces, yet their statistical generalization properties remain poorly understood. Discrete real-world data such as text or biological sequences often concentrate on a small fraction of the astronomically large ambient space because of semantic or physical constraints, but existing bounds fail to capture this distributional structure and instead scale with the size of the ambient space, giving rise to almost vacuous error bounds. We address this gap for uniform discrete diffusion, one of the two dominant discrete diffusion paradigms alongside masking diffusion, by deriving statistical guarantees governed by the effective support size $s_n(P_0)$, a sample-size-dependent measure of distributional complexity. Given $n$ independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples from an unknown data distribution $P_0$ on $[K]^d$, we show that, with appropriate choices of network size and hyperparameters, the expected total variation (TV) loss scales as $O(\sqrt{s_n(P_0)/n})$, while the expected Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence is bounded by $O(\frac{1}{n}s_n(P_0)\log(eK^d/s_n(P_0))\log n)$. Furthermore, we show that the TV rate is minimax optimal and that the KL rate is minimax optimal up to a factor of $\log n$. Together, these upper and lower bounds show that uniform discrete diffusion successfully avoids the curse of dimensionality for distributions with small effective support size: the TV error rate depends on the ambient state-space size only through $s_n(P_0)$, while the corresponding KL rate incurs only an additional logarithmic dependence on the ambient state-space size.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对离散乘积空间上的 uniform discrete diffusion，用样本量相关的有效支撑大小 s_n(P_0) 替代环境空间规模来刻画统计泛化：给定 [K]^d 上 n 个 i.i.d. 样本，适当选择网络规模与超参后期望 TV 损失为 O(√(s_n(P_0)/n))，期望 KL 为 O((s_n(P_0)/n)·log(eK^d/s_n(P_0))·log n)。TV 速率 minimax 最优，KL 速率在相差一个 log n 因子内 minimax 最优，说明小有效支撑分布可避开维数灾难。
Motivation: 离散扩散模型的统计泛化性质缺乏理解；文本、生物序列等真实离散数据只占极大环境空间的一小部分，而现有界随环境空间规模增长，给出的误差界几乎空洞。
Method: 针对 uniform discrete diffusion（与 masking diffusion 并列的两大范式之一），在 [K]^d 上给定 n 个来自未知分布 P_0 的 i.i.d. 样本，推导由样本量相关的有效支撑大小 s_n(P_0) 控制的上界与下界，条件是适当选择网络规模和超参数。
Result: 期望 TV 损失为 O(√(s_n(P_0)/n))，期望 KL 散度上界为 O((1/n)·s_n(P_0)·log(eK^d/s_n(P_0))·log n)；TV 速率 minimax 最优，KL 速率在相差 log n 因子内 minimax 最优。TV 误差对环境状态空间大小的依赖只通过 s_n(P_0) 体现，KL 速率仅多出对环境规模的对数依赖。
Conclusion: 对小有效支撑大小的分布，uniform discrete diffusion 避开了维数灾难：误差界由 s_n(P_0) 而非环境空间规模决定，KL 只多付一个对数因子。

papers.title: Does On-Policy Distillation for Safety Pose Backdoor Risks?
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) has attracted growing attention as an effective way to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models. Recent studies further explore OPD as a tool for improving large language model safety with promising results. However, these approaches typically assume that the teacher and training data are trustworthy. In this paper, we uncover an overlooked threat to OPD for safety: a safety-aligned but backdoored teacher can propagate its hidden malicious behavior to an initially clean student. Under our threat model, a poisoning rate as low as 3% results in an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 70% on the distilled student. We further identify two training choices that can amplify this risk. First, increasing the number of training epochs can lead to high ASR even at low poisoning rates. With only 10 poisoned samples, ASR reaches 67% after 16 epochs. Second, the commonly used top-k KL can accelerate backdoor transfer, causing trigger-conditioned harmful behavior to emerge earlier than sampled-token KL in most settings. Alongside these findings, we explore a simple mitigation, Lazy Defense, which clips KL rewards to make student updates less aggressive, limiting aggressive updates and slowing backdoor learning. Experiments show that Lazy Defense delays backdoor transfer in low poisoning rate settings. Together, our findings reveal that OPD can propagate backdoors, highlighting the need to address the safety risks of OPD.

papers.title: SMART: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Articulated Object Manipulation via Large-Scale Synthetic Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: The ability to interact with articulated objects is essential for embodied intelligent systems, but collecting large-scale real-world demonstrations for these interactions remains challenging due to the precise contact and constraint-following motions involved. Although simulation provides a promising alternative, existing synthetic data efforts cover limited articulated-object categories, while general-purpose synthesis pipelines lack explicit designs for part-level semantics and articulation constraints, hindering agentic task generation and scalable synthesis of high-quality articulated-manipulation demonstrations. To bridge this gap, we introduce SMART, a scalable system leveraging large-scale Synthesized Manipulation demonstrations for ARTiculated-object manipulation. At its core, we develop SMART-Sim, a simulation platform with articulation-aware design that enables effective task generation and efficient demonstration collection. Building on SMART-Sim, we apply agentic task generation and design a scalable distributed synthesis system, using them to synthesize SMART-Data, comprising over 1M demonstrations across 44 atomic task types, 5 robot setups, and 2,507 articulated objects. The vision-language-action (VLA) model pretrained on SMART-Data shows competitive performance on simulation benchmarks and achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and scalable performance in real-world articulated-object manipulation tasks. This highlights the potential of synthetic demonstrations in providing effective and scalable supervision for improving VLA model performance in contact-rich articulated-object manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SMART 用带关节感知设计的仿真平台 SMART-Sim 配合 agentic 任务生成与分布式合成流水线，造出含 100 万以上演示、44 类原子任务、5 种机器人配置、2,507 个铰接物体的 SMART-Data，并在其上预训练 VLA 模型。该模型在仿真基准上表现有竞争力，并在真实铰接物体操作任务上实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。
Motivation: 铰接物体操作需要精确接触与约束跟随动作，真实演示采集困难；已有合成数据只覆盖有限铰接类别，通用合成流水线又缺少部件级语义与关节约束的显式设计，难以规模化生成高质量操作演示。
Method: 构建 articulation-aware 的仿真平台 SMART-Sim 用于任务生成与演示采集，叠加 agentic 任务生成与可扩展分布式合成系统，产出 SMART-Data（超过 1M 演示、44 种原子任务、5 种机器人配置、2,507 个铰接物体），再在其上预训练 vision-language-action (VLA) 模型。
Result: 在 SMART-Data 上预训练的 VLA 模型在仿真基准上取得有竞争力的表现，并在真实世界铰接物体操作任务上实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移与可扩展的性能表现。
Conclusion: 合成演示能为接触密集的铰接物体操作提供有效且可规模化的监督，从而提升 VLA 模型在仿真与真实之间的迁移能力。

papers.title: Matching Object or Relation? Tracing Abstract Reasoning Inside VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel on visual benchmarks but fail systematically on tasks requiring abstract reasoning. Existing benchmarks document this failure but cannot say \emph{why} it happens or which cognitive capability is missing. We close this gap by adopting the Relational Match-to-Sample (RMTS) paradigm from comparative and developmental psychology and pairing it with a mechanistic analysis of the model's internals. On a parametrically controlled stimulus set evaluated across frontier API models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and three open-source families (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, InternVL3), we identify four levers that shift VLMs toward the relational match---capability tier, model scale, the number of objects per scene, and the absence of per-object stimulus noise---together producing a developmental-like trajectory that mirrors the human \emph{relational shift}. Opening up the model, a per-layer representational similarity analysis and a causal mediation analysis reveal that VLM abstract reasoning is implemented by two competing circuits: an early circuit that organises images by their surface object features, and a late circuit that organises them by their abstract relation. Extending the analysis to ARC-AGI-1, we find that ablating the relational heads identified on RMTS degrades performance more than ablating random heads, indicating that the relational circuit is recruited beyond our controlled stimuli. We hope this mechanism-level view serves as a step toward understanding how abstract reasoning is implemented in VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把比较心理学的 Relational Match-to-Sample (RMTS) 范式接到 VLM 内部机制分析上，发现 VLM 从物体匹配转向关系匹配由四个杠杆驱动：能力层级、模型规模、每场景物体数、以及去掉逐物体刺激噪声，合起来复现人类的 relational shift。逐层表征相似度与因果中介分析定位出两条竞争回路——早期按表面物体特征组织图像、晚期按抽象关系组织——在 RMTS 上识别的关系头被消融后，ARC-AGI-1 性能下降幅度大于随机消融。
Motivation: 现有视觉基准只能记录 VLM 在抽象推理上的系统性失败，无法说明失败原因或缺失哪种认知能力。
Method: 采用 RMTS 范式构造参数化可控刺激集，评测 GPT、Claude、Gemini 等前沿 API 模型与 Qwen3.5、Gemma-4、InternVL3 三个开源家族；再用逐层 representational similarity analysis 与 causal mediation analysis 打开模型内部，并把识别出的关系头迁移到 ARC-AGI-1 做消融检验。
Result: 识别出四个把 VLM 推向关系匹配的杠杆：capability tier、model scale、每场景物体数、无逐物体刺激噪声，四者共同形成类似人类 relational shift 的发展轨迹。消融 RMTS 上识别的关系头使 ARC-AGI-1 性能下降多于随机头消融，说明该关系回路在受控刺激之外也被调用。
Conclusion: VLM 的抽象推理由两条竞争回路实现（早期表面物体特征、晚期抽象关系），且 RMTS 上定位的关系回路可迁移到 ARC-AGI-1 这类真实任务。

papers.title: SkillPoison: Progressive Skill Poisoning via Successful Experiences
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly distill successful experiences into persistent, reusable skills. Existing skill attack methods corrupt this learning pipeline by injecting malicious triggers, behaviors, or false facts into individual experiences or extracted skills. However, such attacks are easily detected, and the injected malicious behaviors often fail to accumulate as persistent skills. In this paper, we show that skill poisoning can arise even from verified successful experiences, without making any individual trajectory malicious. Based on this insight, we propose SkillPoison, a novel framework that progressively poisons skill via successful experiences. SkillPoison first constructs a set of successful experiences that reinforce a target behavior, and then removes the contextual conditions that constrain when the behavior applies. Rather than injecting malicious content, SkillPoison shapes how the skill extractor generalizes, allowing useful behavior to support task success while inducing harmful behavior when they are misapplied. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that SkillPoison achieves 95.71% attack success rates, while all injected experiences remain task-correct and pass verification and lexical inspection. Our code, data and implementation details are available for the community at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/SkillPoison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillPoison 针对自改进 LLM agent 的技能蒸馏管线：先构造一组强化目标行为的“成功经验”，再逐步删除限定该行为适用范围的上下文条件，使技能抽取器把行为过度泛化。三个 benchmark 上攻击成功率达 95.71%，且所有注入经验本身任务正确、通过验证与词汇检查。
Motivation: 现有技能攻击靠在单条经验或技能里注入恶意触发器、行为或虚假事实，容易被检测，且注入的恶意行为难以累积成持久技能。
Method: SkillPoison 分两步：先构造一组强化目标行为的成功经验，再移除约束该行为何时适用的上下文条件；不注入恶意内容，而是塑造技能抽取器的泛化方式，使技能在任务成功时表现为有用行为、被误用时触发有害行为。
Result: 在三个 benchmark 上攻击成功率达到 95.71%；所有注入经验保持任务正确，并通过验证与词汇检查 (lexical inspection)。
Conclusion: 即使每条轨迹都无恶意且验证通过，仅靠删除上下文条件的渐进式泛化操纵就足以让技能被毒化，验证与词汇检查对此类攻击失效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Monte Carlo Estimation for KV Cache Eviction
papers.abstract_en: Most KV-cache eviction methods ask, in effect, which memory appeared important while reading the prompt? We instead ask, which memory will matter while answering? Since decoding queries are unavailable at eviction time, prior future-aware methods rely on pseudo-responses or synthetic future-query estimates. We cast fixed-budget future-aware eviction as distributional estimation over plausible model-conditional query trajectories and introduce LORE-KV (Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles for Key-Value caches), a training-free method that samples short autoregressive continuations from the frozen target model and uses their response-side query states to estimate prompt-token utility. Tokens are scored by projected leave-one-out attention-output deletion cost and aggregated across sampled futures with optional trajectory weighting. The temporary continuations are discarded before final decoding, requiring no auxiliary model or training. Ablations isolate the mechanism: at B=128, a single response-side continuation recovers about 89% of the gain over the prompt-window control, while additional futures provide smaller improvements. At B=128, LORE-KV raises the LongBench average on Qwen2.5-14B from 45.49 to 48.24 (+2.75) and the 16K RULER average on Mistral-7B from 45.20 to 51.05 (+5.85). Gains diminish at larger cache budgets and coexist with task-level regressions. LORE-KV incurs 1.46-2.77x AnDPro's per-sample wall-clock time as a one-time compression overhead across six dense and hybrid-attention backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LORE-KV 把固定预算的未来感知 KV cache 淘汰改写成对模型条件查询轨迹的分布估计：训练无关地从冻结目标模型采样短自回归续写，用其响应侧 query 状态按投影的 leave-one-out 注意力输出删除代价给 prompt token 打分，再跨采样未来聚合。B=128 时 Qwen2.5-14B 的 LongBench 平均从 45.49 升到 48.24（+2.75），Mistral-7B 的 16K RULER 平均从 45.20 升到 51.05（+5.85）；预算更大时增益递减且伴随任务级回退。
Motivation: 现有 KV cache 淘汰方法在淘汰时刻只能问“读 prompt 时哪些记忆重要”，而真正决定重要性的是解码时的 query；未来感知方法因此依赖伪响应或合成未来查询估计，缺少对查询轨迹不确定性的直接建模。
Method: LORE-KV（Lookahead Output-perturbation with Reliability-weighted Ensembles）训练无关：从冻结目标模型采样短自回归续写，取响应侧 query 状态估计 prompt token 效用；token 得分用投影的 leave-one-out 注意力输出删除代价，跨采样未来聚合并可选轨迹加权；临时续写在正式解码前丢弃，无需辅助模型或训练。
Result: B=128 时单条响应侧续写即可回收相对 prompt-window 对照约 89% 的增益，追加未来样本只带来更小改进；B=128 下 Qwen2.5-14B 的 LongBench 平均 45.49 → 48.24（+2.75），Mistral-7B 的 16K RULER 平均 45.20 → 51.05（+5.85）。更大 cache 预算下增益递减并存在任务级回退；在六个 dense 与 hybrid-attention backbone 上一次性压缩开销为 AnDPro 单样本墙钟时间的 1.46–2.77 倍。
Conclusion: 未来感知淘汰可以只靠冻结模型自身的短续写采样来估计查询侧效用，单条续写已捕获大部分收益；代价是更大的 cache 预算会稀释收益，且需接受任务级回退与一次性压缩开销。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 未来感知淘汰可以只靠冻结模型自身的短续写采样来估计查询侧效用，单条续写已捕获大部分收益；代价是更大的 cache 预算会稀释收益，且需接受任务级回退与一次性压缩开销。

papers.title: Towards the Automatic Synthesis of Interpretable Chess Tactics
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art reinforcement learning agents are capable of outperforming human experts at games like chess, Go and StarCraft II. These agents do not simply take advantage of their digital hardware in being able to react and calculate faster than humans, but employ better strategies that lead to more victories. Interpreting these strategies would give human players valuable insight into how to improve their play. In this preliminary work, we propose a symbolic sub-policy model for playing chess. Inspired by chess tactics, our model attempts to incorporate domain knowledge to improve interpretability. We adapt patterns learned by an inductive logic programming system called PAL to derive our model. We contribute a divergence metric to evaluate our model against a random baseline, and find a set of tactics that is able to suggest moves of similar playing strength to a human beginner. Finally, we propose a computational evaluation scheme for the model by augmenting an off-the-shelf engine with it.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Explainable Agency in Artificial Intelligence Workshop, 36th AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence, 91-97, Mar 2022
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出可解释国际象棋战术的符号子策略模型：用归纳逻辑编程系统 PAL 学到的模式改造出棋战术规则，配合一个发散度 (divergence) 指标与随机基线比较，并把模型挂到现成引擎上做计算评估。该模型给出的走子达到人类初学者水平的对弈强度。
Motivation: 强化学习智能体已在国际象棋等博弈中超过人类专家，但其策略对人类玩家不可读，无法转化为可学习的棋艺洞见；需要在保留对弈强度的前提下把策略显式化为可解释的战术规则。
Method: 构建符号子策略 (symbolic sub-policy) 模型，把国际象棋战术作为领域知识写入以提升可解释性；规则由归纳逻辑编程系统 PAL 所学模式改造而来；贡献一个发散度指标将模型与随机基线对比，并提出通过给现成引擎 (off-the-shelf engine) 加装该模型的计算评估方案。
Result: 在发散度指标下与随机基线比较，得到一组能给出与人类初学者相当对弈强度走子的战术；评估以上述引擎增强方案进行。
Conclusion: 把 ILP 学到的战术模式固化为符号子策略，可以在不牺牲到初学者水平强度的前提下让棋类策略可解释；作者将其定位为初步工作 (preliminary work)。

papers.title: Learning Explainable Representations of Complex Game-playing Strategies
papers.abstract_en: As part of learning to play complex games, human players develop develop abstractions for concepts and strategies of gameplay consistent with game rules to improve their performance. These concepts are applied to explain other players' actions, and to inform their own actions in-game. Understanding other players' strategies is a crucial part of such improvement, but requires time and effort. In this paper, we propose a strategy similar to human cognition for training RL agents to synthesize learned strategies and policies as executable procedures based on sequences of gameplay actions. We present methods to automatically learn such programs to play chess and to solve tasks in a grid-based environment. We show that the learned strategies produce effective actions, and can be learned from gameplay data.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Eleventh Annual Conference on Advances in Cognitive Systems 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出模仿人类认知的策略学习方法，把 RL 智能体学到的策略与策略合成为基于动作序列的可执行程序 (executable procedures)，并展示可从游戏数据中自动学出下棋与网格环境任务的程序，且这些策略能产生有效动作。
Motivation: 人类玩家靠抽象概念解释他人行动并指导自己，但理解对手策略耗时费力；RL 学到的策略往往不可解释，缺少把动作序列归纳成可读、可执行策略的手段。
Method: 训练 RL 智能体，将学到的策略与策略合成为基于游戏动作序列的可执行程序，方法设计贴近人类认知；给出自动学习程序的两套设定：下棋 (chess) 与基于网格的环境任务求解。
Result: 在 chess 与网格环境两类设定中，学到的策略能产生有效动作，并且这些策略可直接从游戏数据 (gameplay data) 中学习得到。
Conclusion: 游戏策略可以被归纳为可执行、可解释的程序表示，且无需人工编写规则即可从人类或智能体的游戏数据中学出。

papers.title: Asymptotic Analysis of Empirical Risk Minimization on Entry-wise i.i.d. Heavy-Tailed Data
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world datasets exhibit unusually large values far more frequently than predicted by Gaussian models. Heavy-tailed distributions capture this behavior, yet evaluating learning performance under them remains challenging because rare, large feature entries retain non-vanishing effects even in high dimensions. Even in the canonical setting of empirical risk minimization for linear regression with entry-wise i.i.d. symmetric $α$-stable data, a precise asymptotic characterization of prediction has been lacking. In this work, we introduce a functional order parameter that describes the random effective problem associated with each coefficient. Using the replica method, we fully characterize the generalization error in the proportional high-dimensional limit where the sample size and feature dimension diverge at a fixed ratio. Additionally, this analysis establishes a heavy-tail universality law, scaling laws relating typical errors to prediction reliability, and the Bayes-optimal prediction error. In addition to characterizing the effects of extreme entries on the learning process, our method applies broadly to other systems with persistent local heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在逐元素 i.i.d. 对称 α-稳定（重尾）数据的线性回归 ERM 中，用 replica 方法引入描述每个系数随机有效问题的泛函序参量，在样本量与特征维度按固定比例趋于无穷的正比高维极限下完整刻画泛化误差，并得到重尾普适律、典型误差与预测可靠性的标度律以及 Bayes 最优预测误差。
Motivation: 真实数据中极端大值出现频率远高于 Gaussian 假设，且罕见的大特征项在高维下影响不消失，导致重尾分布下学习性能难以评估；即便最经典的逐元素 i.i.d. 对称 α-稳定线性回归 ERM，预测的精确渐近刻画此前仍缺失。
Method: 引入描述每个系数所对应随机有效问题的泛函序参量 (functional order parameter)，用 replica 方法在正比高维极限（样本数与特征维度以固定比例同时发散）下求解线性回归 ERM 的泛化误差。
Result: 给出泛化误差的完整渐近刻画，并建立重尾普适律、典型误差与预测可靠性之间的标度律，以及 Bayes-optimal 预测误差；同时刻画极端特征项对学习过程的影响。
Conclusion: 重尾数据下线性回归 ERM 的预测可在正比高维极限中被精确刻画，且该序参量方法可推广到具有持续局部异质性的其他系统。

papers.title: Measuring climate backlash in Twitter and Reddit archives: Lexical definitions, recorded responses and participant turnover
papers.abstract_en: Social media archives are often used to study resistance to climate action, but words, response counters and observed participants do not measure the same social process. We examine four supplied Twitter and Reddit archives by processing all registered files without sampling and applying transparent, non-exclusive lexical rules. The study links frame co-occurrence to source-specific temporal and response models, then separates event-period changes among returning authors from participant turnover. Renewable-energy terms accompany cost-related language on Reddit, yet narrower backlash phrases sharply reduce cross-source contrasts and reverse the sign of the Paris Agreement contrast in submissions. Cross-discourse history does not improve eligible primary-context forecasts. Denial/hoax terms are associated with higher recorded Twitter likes, whereas Reddit response associations depend on frame, outcome and author specification. Around the 2019 global climate strike, returning-author expression and participant turnover both contribute to increased protest-language shares. An archive endpoint prevents the corresponding Climate Twitter migration inference. Most crossed-cluster estimates lack released intervals, and joint author/month response covariance estimates fail, restricting formal inference. These results show how operational definitions, platform-specific response fields and observation boundaries shape what can be claimed about climate backlash. The contribution is an archive-based account of these measurement consequences, rather than a measure of individual opposition, persuasion or advocacy-induced backlash.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用非排他的词法规则处理四个 Twitter/Reddit 气候档案的全部注册文件，把框架共现接到平台各自的响应模型，并把事件期变化拆成回归作者表达与参与者更替。可再生能源词在 Reddit 伴随成本话语，而更窄的 backlash 短语会削弱跨平台对比并翻转《巴黎协定》对比在投稿中的符号；2019 全球气候罢工期间回归作者表达与参与者更替共同推高抗议话语占比。
Motivation: 社交媒体档案常被用来研究对气候行动的抵抗，但词汇、响应计数与观测到的参与者三者并不测量同一社会过程，操作定义与观测边界会改变可声称的结论。
Method: 对四个 Twitter 与 Reddit 档案的全部注册文件不做抽样处理，应用透明且非排他的词法规则；把框架共现关联到来源特异的时间与响应模型，并将事件期变化分解为回归作者的表达变化与参与者更替，另用跨话语历史做主语境预测。
Result: Reddit 上可再生能源词伴随成本相关语言；更窄的 backlash 短语显著削弱跨来源对比并翻转《巴黎协定》对比在 submissions 中的符号；跨话语历史不改善合格的主语境预测；Denial/hoax 词与 Twitter 更高点赞相关，而 Reddit 的响应关联依赖框架、结局与作者设定；2019 全球气候罢工期间回归作者表达与参与者更替都推高抗议语言占比；档案端点阻止了相应的 Climate Twitter 迁移推断；多数跨簇估计缺少发布的区间，联合 author/month 响应协方差估计失败。
Conclusion: 操作定义、平台特异的响应字段与观测边界决定了关于气候 backlash 能声称什么；该贡献是档案层面的测量后果说明，而非个体反对、说服或倡导诱发 backlash 的度量。

papers.title: Complementary Supervised and Self-Supervised Representations for Out-of-Distribution Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains challenging for graph neural networks (GNNs), as graph distributions can vary substantially across time and domains. Supervised and self-supervised graph representation learning are guided by distinct objectives and offer different perspectives on graph representations. In this work, we study whether self-supervised representations (SSL) can provide complementary signals to improve supervised OOD node classification. We develop two backbone-agnostic frameworks that exploit such information at different stages of learning and prediction. Co-Train jointly learns supervised and SSL representations and adaptively integrates them during training, while Dual-Space Retrieval performs non-parametric prediction in the two representation spaces and combines their predictions through confidence-aware fusion at inference time. The supervised and SSL encoders are separately parameterized and need not share the same GNN architecture. We evaluate multiple GNN backbones and two distinct SSL objectives, DGI and GRACE, on four graph benchmarks spanning temporal and cross-domain distribution shifts. Extensive experiments show that Co-Train consistently outperforms strong supervised OOD baselines, while Dual-Space Retrieval achieves competitive performance as a flexible non-parametric alternative. Results across different backbones and SSL objectives, together with representation analyses and ablations, demonstrate that SSL representations provide complementary information to supervised representations and can improve OOD node classification across diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在图神经网络的分布外 (OOD) 节点分类上，把自监督表示 (SSL) 与监督表示作为互补信号使用可稳定提升性能：Co-Train 在训练中联合学习并自适应融合两种表示，Dual-Space Retrieval 则在两个表示空间做非参数预测并按置信度融合。在覆盖时间与跨域分布偏移的四个图基准上，Co-Train 一致优于强监督 OOD 基线，Dual-Space Retrieval 作为灵活的非参数替代方案取得有竞争力的表现。
Motivation: 图分布会随时间和域大幅变化，GNN 的 OOD 泛化一直困难；监督与自监督图表示学习目标不同、视角不同，但此前未被系统用于互补地改善 OOD 节点分类。
Method: 提出两个 backbone 无关的框架：Co-Train 在训练阶段联合学习监督表示与 SSL 表示并自适应整合；Dual-Space Retrieval 在两个表示空间分别做非参数预测，推理时通过置信度感知融合 (confidence-aware fusion) 合并。监督与 SSL 编码器独立参数化，可使用不同 GNN 架构；评测覆盖多种 GNN backbone 与两种 SSL 目标 DGI、GRACE。
Result: 在四个涵盖时间与跨域分布偏移的图基准上，Co-Train 一致优于强监督 OOD 基线，Dual-Space Retrieval 取得有竞争力的表现；不同 backbone 与 SSL 目标下的结果、表示分析与消融共同表明 SSL 表示携带与监督表示互补的信息。
Conclusion: SSL 表示与监督表示是互补的，把二者在训练期或推理期融合即可在多种分布偏移设定下改善 OOD 节点分类，且该收益不依赖特定 GNN 架构或特定 SSL 目标。

summary_sections.method: 提出两个 backbone 无关的框架：Co-Train 在训练阶段联合学习监督表示与 SSL 表示并自适应整合；Dual-Space Retrieval 在两个表示空间分别做非参数预测，推理时通过置信度感知融合 (confidence-aware fusion) 合并。监督与 SSL 编码器独立参数化，可使用不同 GNN 架构；评测覆盖多种 GNN backbone 与两种 SSL 目标 DGI、GRACE。
summary_sections.result: 在四个涵盖时间与跨域分布偏移的图基准上，Co-Train 一致优于强监督 OOD 基线，Dual-Space Retrieval 取得有竞争力的表现；不同 backbone 与 SSL 目标下的结果、表示分析与消融共同表明 SSL 表示携带与监督表示互补的信息。
summary_sections.conclusion: SSL 表示与监督表示是互补的，把二者在训练期或推理期融合即可在多种分布偏移设定下改善 OOD 节点分类，且该收益不依赖特定 GNN 架构或特定 SSL 目标。

papers.title: Learning to Outgrow a Theory: Experimental Discovery Beyond the Initial Hypothesis Space
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery systems typically optimize experiments within a fixed hypothesis space. This creates a failure mode when all available candidates omit the same missing mechanism: candidate disagreement can collapse even while the model class is systematically wrong. We formulate experimental model-class revision, in which a discovery policy jointly proposes a structural edit and a diagnostic experiment that tests whether that edit is necessary. The method couples a class-level distinguishability objective, in which one shared parameterization must explain all selected experiments, with anytime-valid sequential evidence that triggers structural revision only after the current class is rejected. On 400 held-out controlled dynamical environments, the joint policy reaches 89.5% exact recovery with a budget of 32 real experiments, improving the strongest matched baseline by 10.0 percentage points while requiring fewer executed experiments and candidate fits. The learned revision-experiment pairing transfers across unseen mechanism combinations, held-out but expressible primitives, parameter extrapolation, and shifted experiment costs; when the true mechanism is outside the edit grammar, it detects library insufficiency in 88% of cases with a 5.5% false-support rate. Revision gains also transfer to ODEBench and ODEBase model-library tasks, as well as DiscoverPhysics worlds. These results support a view of scientific discovery in which deciding what mechanisms a theory should make expressible and where to collect evidence are treated as a single sequential decision problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出实验性模型类修订 (experimental model-class revision)：发现策略联合提出结构编辑与检验该编辑是否必要的诊断实验，只有当前模型类被拒绝后才触发修订。在 400 个受控动力系统环境上，32 次真实实验预算内精确恢复率达 89.5%，比最强匹配基线高 10.0 个百分点且执行实验与候选拟合更少；当真实机制不在编辑语法内时，88% 的情形检出库不足，虚假支持率 5.5%。
Motivation: 科学发现系统通常在固定假设空间内优化实验，当所有候选共享同一缺失机制时，候选间分歧会塌缩而模型类仍系统性错误。
Method: 策略联合输出结构编辑与诊断实验，耦合类级可区分性目标（同一共享参数化须解释全部所选实验）与 anytime-valid 序贯证据，仅在当前类被拒绝后才触发结构修订。
Result: 在 400 个 held-out 受控动力环境中，32 次真实实验预算下精确恢复率 89.5%，比最强匹配基线高 10.0 个百分点，且执行实验与候选拟合次数更少；真实机制超出编辑语法时，88% 情形检出库不足、虚假支持率 5.5%。修订增益迁移至 ODEBench、ODEBase 模型库任务与 DiscoverPhysics worlds，并跨未见机制组合、held-out 但可表达的原语、参数外推与实验成本偏移迁移。
Conclusion: 决定理论应让哪些机制可表达与在何处采集证据，应被当作单一序贯决策问题联合求解，而非在固定假设空间内优化实验。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
papers.abstract_en: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Stateless Language Agents (SLA)：研究状态（候选方案与实测结果）由 harness 持有，每次调用重建全新角色化上下文，Advisor 读取汇总证据后给并行 Worker 派发具体实验。在软件工程、kernel 优化、算法设计三类任务、最高 10 亿 token 预算下，SLA 每个任务都取得最好结果，并以少 84% 以上的 token 达到最强 kernel 基线的最终性能。
Motivation: 长时程自动化研究中，更多推理并不等于更多进展：agent 重放不断增长的历史、彼此重复工作、停止实验却继续消耗 token；而现有评测预算短、基准早期饱和，这些失效模式测不到。
Method: 核心原则是 stateful search with stateless agents：agent 跨调用不携带对话，harness 持有研究状态并为每次调用重建新鲜、角色特定的上下文。SLA 框架中 stateless Advisor 读取 harness 汇总的跨搜索方向证据，向并行 Worker 派发具体实验；消融在共享 checkpoint 上分别拆解聚焦上下文与显式派发的贡献。
Result: 在软件工程、kernel 优化、算法设计三个任务上对比三个近期框架，token 预算最高达 10 亿：SLA 每个任务都取得最佳最终结果，用比最强 kernel 基线少 84% 以上的 token 达到其最终性能；共享 checkpoint 消融显示聚焦上下文与显式派发各自贡献进展且可跨整轮复利，Advisor 消耗不到 0.6% 的 token。
Conclusion: 把持久研究状态留在 agent 对话之外，就能在长时程自动化研究中以更少 token 推进更多实验；短评测时程会误判研究系统及其组件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explicit Asymptotic Bounds for Sequential Calibration Beyond $T^{2/3}$
papers.abstract_en: Probability forecasts are calibrated when predicted probabilities match empirical outcome frequencies: among events assigned a probability $p$, we'd hope that the fraction of positive outcomes is close to $p$. We study the problem of sequential forecasting of binary outcomes. The classical $O(T^{2/3})$ bound on expected cumulative $\ell_1$-calibration error established by Foster and Vohra stood for over two decades until Dagan et al. reduced the exponent $2/3$ by an unspecified constant. We establish a new two-phase recursive labeling strategy for the sign-preservation-with-reuse game that yields the bound $O(n^αt^β)$ for all choices of space and time. We then sharpen the reduction from upper bounds on sign preservation to calibration by modifying the equivalence of Dagan et al. to use only $O(\log T)$ instances of the sign-preservation-with-reuse game. This lets us establish an explicit bound of $O(T^{0.662942288})$, the first explicit exponent below $2/3$ for sequential calibration, by combining both improvements and choosing explicit feasible parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对二元结果的序贯概率预报校准，提出 sign-preservation-with-reuse 博弈的两阶段递归标注策略，得到对任意空间与时间取值都成立的 O(n^α t^β) 界；再把 Dagan 等人的等价性改造为只需 O(log T) 个该博弈实例，最终给出显式指数 O(T^0.662942288)，是首个低于 2/3 的显式序贯校准指数。
Motivation: Foster–Vohra 的 O(T^{2/3}) 累积 ℓ1 校准误差界保持了二十多年，Dagan 等人虽把 2/3 的指数降低但常数未指定，缺少可直接使用的显式指数。
Method: 为 sign-preservation-with-reuse 博弈设计两阶段递归标注策略，导出 O(n^α t^β) 界；修改 Dagan 等人的符号保持到校准的归约，使其仅用 O(log T) 个博弈实例；再选取显式可行参数合并两项改进。
Result: 得到显式界 O(T^0.662942288) 的期望累积 ℓ1 校准误差，为序贯校准中首个低于 2/3 的显式指数；归约只需 O(log T) 个 sign-preservation-with-reuse 博弈实例。
Conclusion: 序贯二元校准的指数可以严格压到 2/3 以下并写成显式数值，路径是更强的博弈标注策略加上更省实例的归约。

papers.title: Explore, Then Commit: Measurement-Efficient Scientific Law Discovery with Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Scientific law discovery requires selecting measurements and converting evidence into a governing equation. We evaluate an explore-then-commit protocol in which a large language model proposes hypotheses, a programmatic planner gathers measurements, and a fresh prompt synthesizes the final law from fixed observations. The protocol combines structured probes, automatic numerical diagnostics, restricted measurement batches, and optional interpreter access. Across 576 NewtonBench trials, we compare eight configurations on 12 physics modules using GPT-4.1-mini and a medium-difficulty GPT-4.1 replication. On medium tasks, interpreter-enabled planners use 8.6 versus 22.5 measurements per trial for GPT-4.1-mini and 8.9 versus 43.0 for GPT-4.1. Their mean magnitude-based root-mean-squared logarithmic error falls from 2.514 to 0.202 and from 0.626 to 0.149, respectively. An additional audit retains incomplete and invalid submissions in a coverage-sensitive analysis. Observed symbolic-accuracy gains are less consistent across modules, and random acquisition is competitive with disagreement scoring. Measurement savings occur in every module, but unequal batch constraints prevent attributing them solely to acquisition quality. These results support the complete protocol as a promising measurement-efficient configuration, while leaving its causal components and generalization beyond noiseless direct-equation tasks unresolved.
papers.comment: 19 pages, including Supplementary Material S1; code and data included as ancillary files. Preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 NewtonBench 的 576 次试验上检验 explore-then-commit 协议：LLM 提出假设、程序化 planner 采集测量、新 prompt 从固定观测合成最终定律。启用解释器的 planner 在中等难度任务上把每次试验测量数从 22.5 降到 8.6（GPT-4.1-mini）与从 43.0 降到 8.9（GPT-4.1），均值幅值对数 RMSE 同步从 2.514 降到 0.202、从 0.626 降到 0.149。
Motivation: 科学定律发现要把选测量与从证据写出控制方程两步分开，而测量采集成本高、噪声与无效提交会掩盖协议真实开销，需要在固定观测下同时看测量数与误差。
Method: 协议分三段：LLM 提出假设，程序化 planner 用结构化探针、自动数值诊断、受限测量批次与可选解释器访问 (interpreter access) 采集观测，再用新 prompt 从固定观测合成最终定律；在 12 个 physics 模块上比较八种配置，模型为 GPT-4.1-mini 与中等难度的 GPT-4.1 复现，另做保留不完整与无效提交的 coverage-sensitive 审计。
Result: 中等任务上启用解释器的 planner 每次试验测量数 8.6 对 22.5（GPT-4.1-mini）、8.9 对 43.0（GPT-4.1）；均值幅值对数 RMSE 2.514→0.202 与 0.626→0.149。符号准确率增益跨模块不一致，随机采集与 disagreement scoring 竞争力相当；测量节省出现在每个模块，但不等的批次约束使其无法单独归因于采集质量。
Conclusion: 完整协议是有希望的测量高效配置，但其因果组件与向含噪、非直接方程任务的推广仍未解决。

papers.title: AFA-BANDIT: Provably Near-Optimal Online Multi-Feature Classification Under Budget Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) is a classification problem in which an agent decides which costly features to acquire before predicting each sample's label. Unlike batch AFA, which trains a fixed policy and classifier offline on fully observed data, online AFA updates its predictor from revealed labels as samples arrive. Existing online methods either use deep reinforcement learning (RL) without performance guarantees or maximize cost-adjusted reward rather than enforce a global budget. We formulate online AFA as a combinatorial Bandits with Knapsacks (BwK) problem that couples acquisition and prediction. Unlike prior bandit-based AFA and classical BwK, our setting has combinatorial complexity, evolving rewards, a global budget, and structured side information. We obtain an improved regret upper bound over standard BwK bounds in this framework, leveraging a cardinality-aware confidence bound and the subset update structure. To avoid an exponentially large action space, we propose \emph{LP-Chain}, a variant that searches a cost-aware chain of feature subsets with a size that grows linearly with the number of features. While the regret upper bound is specific to the combinatorial framework, \emph{LP-Chain} empirically achieves comparable predictive performance. On synthetic data, \emph{LP-Chain} outperforms HEDGE-based BwK and deep RL-based online AFA baselines and scales favorably to more features.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 在线 AFA 现有方法要么用深度 RL 且无性能保证，要么只最大化代价调整后的奖励而不强制全局预算；同时该问题具有组合复杂度、演化奖励与结构化旁信息，经典 BwK 与既有 bandit-AFA 的界都不适用。

papers.title: BioStudyBench: Evaluating Agents on Post-Cutoff Biomedical Studies
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate whether AI agents can match the reported findings of published biomedical studies using public data. Existing evaluations do not consistently separate analysis from prior knowledge or retrieval of the published answer. We introduce BioStudyBench, a benchmark of 25 long-horizon analysis tasks drawn from studies first published between July and September 2026, after the developer-reported knowledge cutoffs of the models we evaluate, semi-automatically filtered down from 404,019 PubMed records. In each task, the agent receives a neutral research question but no data files, so it must find and download the relevant public data, search the literature through tools that return only records dated before its cutoff, and report findings through data analysis. To measure gains over prior knowledge, we run every task both with and without access to data and tools. Across eight models, access to data and tools raises the pass rate by 47 percentage points on average over the no-data baseline. Open-weight models across sizes trail closed-weight models, with the best open-weight model passing 81.3% of tasks against 94.7% for the best closed-weight model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BioStudyBench 用 25 项长程生物医学分析任务评测 AI agent 能否复现已发表研究的结论：任务取自 2026 年 7–9 月首次发表、晚于模型知识截止的研究，agent 只拿到中性研究问题，须自行检索并下载公开数据，且文献工具只返回截止日期前的记录。八个模型上，开放数据与工具访问使通过率相对无数据基线平均提高 47 个百分点；最佳开放权重模型通过 81.3%，最佳闭源权重模型 94.7%。
Motivation: 现有评测无法区分 agent 的分析能力与其参数里的先验知识或对已发表答案的检索，导致能力被高估。
Method: 从 404,019 条 PubMed 记录半自动筛出 25 项长程任务，来源研究均发表于 2026 年 7–9 月、晚于被测模型的开发者报告知识截止；每项任务跑两遍（有/无数据与工具），文献检索工具只返回模型截止日期前的记录，结果以通过率 (pass rate) 计分。
Result: 八个模型上，开放数据与工具访问相对无数据基线平均提升 47 个百分点通过率；最佳开放权重模型通过 81.3% 的任务，最佳闭源权重模型为 94.7%，各规模开放权重模型整体落后闭源权重模型。
Conclusion: 生物医学长程分析能力主要来自现场取数与工具使用而非参数记忆，但开放权重模型与闭源模型之间仍存在明显差距。

papers.title: Learning Grasp Targeting from Point Clouds for Log Pile Clearing on a Hydraulic Crane
papers.abstract_en: In mill yards, log loaders clear dense piles by a sequence of bundle grasps: hundreds of logs rest in contact, and each removal changes the pile available to the next grasp. A learned policy chooses where to place and orient the grapple from unsegmented point clouds and runs on a trailer-mounted hydraulic forestry crane. The policy classifies at which observed point to grasp and predicts depth and grapple orientation there. The same network outputs support behavior cloning (BC), reinforcement learning (RL), and deployment. BC learns from successful top-of-pile demonstrations; RL explores for improvements by fine-tuning the cloned policy (BC$\to$RL) or by training from scratch. In simulation, BC clears 98 of 100 piles of 200 logs, while BC$\to$RL improves load stability. Twelve field trials compare a geometric heuristic, RL from scratch, BC, and BC$\to$RL through complete grasp-transport-deposit cycles. BC and BC$\to$RL deposit 93.8% and 88.9% of pooled inventory, against 80.4% for the heuristic. BC$\to$RL deposits logs on 83.6% of its cycles, against 79.6% for the heuristic and 65.7% for BC, while its simulated stability gain does not carry over to the crane testbed. Trained entirely in simulation and run unchanged on the crane, the learned policies clear more than the hand-filtered heuristic while observing unfiltered clouds that still contain the storage rack's rails and poles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在林业堆木场场景下，用未分割点云直接输出抓取点、深度与抓斗姿态的单一网络，同时支撑行为克隆 (BC)、强化学习 (RL) 与实机部署，并在拖车式液压林业起重机上跑通完整抓取-运输-卸放循环。仿真中 BC 清空 100 个各含 200 根原木堆中的 98 个；12 次现场试验里 BC 与 BC→RL 分别卸放 93.8% 与 88.9% 的合并库存，高于手工启发式的 80.4%。
Motivation: 锯木场原木堆由数百根相互接触的原木组成，每次抓取都改变剩余堆型，手工启发式需要过滤货架导轨等干扰结构，抓取成功率与卸放率受限。
Method: 同一网络从未分割点云分类抓取点并回归深度与抓斗朝向；用成功顶部堆示范做行为克隆，再以 BC→RL 微调或从零 RL 探索改进，全程在仿真中训练、原样部署到起重机。
Result: 仿真中 BC 清空 100 个 200 根原木堆中的 98 个，BC→RL 提升负载稳定性；12 次现场试验中 BC 与 BC→RL 卸放库存 93.8% 与 88.9%，启发式 80.4%；BC→RL 在 83.6% 的循环中成功卸放，启发式 79.6%、BC 65.7%；仿真中的稳定性增益未迁移到起重机测试平台。
Conclusion: 仿真训练的抓取策略原样上机即可超过手工过滤的启发式，但仿真中的负载稳定性收益不能直接迁移到真实起重机。

papers.title: Hub for Outliers, Spokes for Inliers: Uniform Latent Space Construction for Dual-Mismatched Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised learning typically assumes that labeled and unlabeled data share an identical class distribution and label space. However, this setting is often violated: unlabeled data may be imbalanced and contain unknown class samples, causing mismatches in both class distribution and label space. Such dual mismatch leads to majority classes dominating the latent space and unknown class samples being overconfidently misclassified, degrading feature discriminability and pseudo-label quality. To address this, we propose a hub-spoke latent geometry, where known classes are uniformly distributed around a central hub and each class forms compact clusters around its prototype, while the hub provides an anchor for a low-evidence region specifically designed for high-uncertainty unknown class samples. Integrated with an evidence-based classifier, this geometry ultimately enhances feature discriminability and uncertainty separation by mitigating majority-class domination through structured feature organization and guiding high-uncertainty unknown class samples toward the hub. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with a maximum improvement of 3.25% across various settings.
papers.comment: Equal contribution by Li Yuan and Yaxin Hou. Corresponding author: Yuheng Jia. Emails: {yuan-li,yaxin,230259148,yhjia}@seu.edu.cn, gaoyb@qlu.edu.cn. 18 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对有标签与无标签数据在类分布和标签空间上双重失配的半监督学习，提出 hub-spoke 潜在几何：已知类围绕中心 hub 均匀排布、各自在原型周围形成紧致簇，hub 作为低证据锚点专门收容高不确定的未知类样本，再配合基于证据的分类器。实验中相对现有方法最高提升 3.25%。
Motivation: 半监督学习默认有标签与无标签数据类分布一致、标签空间相同，但无标签集常不平衡且含未知类样本，双重失配使多数类主导潜在空间、未知类被过度自信地误分类，特征判别性与伪标签质量随之下降。
Method: 构造 hub-spoke 潜在几何：已知类均匀分布在中心 hub 周围并在各自原型处聚成紧致簇，hub 提供一个专为高不确定未知类样本设计的低证据区域；几何结构与基于证据的分类器 (evidence-based classifier) 联合，通过结构化特征组织缓解多数类主导，并把高不确定未知类样本引向 hub。
Result: 在多种设定下的实验中优于 state-of-the-art 方法，最大提升 3.25%；方法同时提升特征判别性与不确定性分离度。
Conclusion: 用 hub-spoke 几何加证据分类器组织潜在空间，可以在类分布与标签空间双重失配时同时缓解多数类主导并把未知类样本推向低证据 hub，从而改善伪标签质量。

papers.title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Neural simulation of high-fidelity deformable bodies is a foundational challenge in computer graphics and physical AI. Long-horizon prediction for high-resolution 3D volumetric meshes is hard: autoregressive methods are susceptible to error accumulation, while direct multi-frame prediction at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. This motivates a compact spatiotemporal latent representation, which is largely unexplored for mesh-based volumetric physics. Meanwhile, it remains unclear whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion is the more appropriate predictive paradigm. To address these coupled challenges, we introduce PhysLDM, a unified latent-diffusion paradigm for one-shot volumetric deformable simulation. Its core is a holistic spatiotemporal VAE that avoids the "staircase" artifacts of standard temporal compression (as in common video VAEs), achieving ~2.48 mm reconstruction precision on meter-scale scenes at up to 78x token compression. Based on this reliable latent space, we systematically compare regression and diffusion methods. Our experiments uncover a key modeling insight: complex deformable dynamics are often chaotic, and in this regime deterministic regression tends to produce non-physical averages, whereas diffusion better models their distribution. Accordingly, we employ a latent diffusion model that effectively learns from the chaotic data to generate physically plausible trajectories. Trained purely kinematically on an Objaverse-scale dataset, a single PhysLDM generalizes zero-shot to unseen OOD datasets (GSO and Toys4K). Its differentiability further enables efficient solution of inverse problems and higher-order design optimization. To our knowledge, PhysLDM is the first high-fidelity spatiotemporal autoencoder and latent-diffusion paradigm for volumetric deformable dynamics, offering a scalable and robust approach to neural simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PhysLDM 用时空 VAE 把米级 3D 体素网格压进潜空间（最高 78× token 压缩、约 2.48 mm 重建精度），再用 latent diffusion 一次性生成长时程可变形体轨迹。对比显示混沌体制下确定性回归会输出非物理的平均解，而 diffusion 能建模其分布；纯运动学训练后可零样本泛化到 GSO 与 Toys4K。
Motivation: 高分辨率 3D 体素网格的长时程可变形仿真中，自回归方法误差累积，原生分辨率直接多帧预测算力不可行；而网格化体素物理上的紧凑时空潜表示基本未被探索，回归与生成式 diffusion 谁更合适也尚无定论。
Method: 核心是 holistic spatiotemporal VAE，规避标准时间压缩（如常见 video VAE）的 staircase 伪影；在其潜空间上系统对比 regression 与 diffusion 后，采用 latent diffusion 生成轨迹，并在 Objaverse 规模数据集上纯运动学 (kinematic) 训练，可微性用于逆问题与高阶设计优化。
Result: VAE 在米级场景达到约 2.48 mm 重建精度、最高 78× token 压缩；实验发现复杂可变形动力学常呈混沌，此体制下确定性回归倾向产生非物理平均解而 diffusion 更好建模其分布；单一 PhysLDM 零样本泛化到未见 OOD 数据集 GSO 和 Toys4K。
Conclusion: 混沌可变形动力学应交给分布式的 diffusion 而非确定性回归，紧凑时空潜空间是让体素级高保真仿真可扩展的前提；PhysLDM 被作者称为首个面向体素可变形动力学的高保真时空自编码器与 latent diffusion 范式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Linear Fitness Subspace in Protein Language Models Enables Sample-Efficient Directed Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Model-guided directed evolution seeks to identify high-fitness protein variants under limited oracle budgets. Protein language models (PLMs) provide rich representations for this task, but task-agnostic zero-shot scores can be misaligned with a target assay, while supervised search in high-dimensional embedding spaces can make surrogate modeling and uncertainty estimation sample-inefficient. We propose the Linear Fitness Subspace (LFS) hypothesis: within mutation-induced residue-level representation changes, a compact, assay-specific set of directions makes fitness variation linearly accessible from few labeled variants. This is a local, supervision-recoverable statement rather than a claim that protein fitness landscapes or global PLM geometry are universally linear. Building on this observation, we introduce Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES), which estimates an LFS from a small initial sample and performs surrogate modeling, uncertainty estimation, and acquisition in the learned subspace. Across 10 core ProteinGym assays, 87 extended static-validation assays, and an 18-assay budgeted-search evaluation, SGES improves fitness prediction and search efficiency over zero-shot PLMs and recent ML-guided protein optimization baselines. Controlled comparisons with PCA, random projections, label-shuffled PLS, classical mutation features, and acquisition ablations further isolate the benefit of a fitness-aligned site-delta coordinate.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Linear Fitness Subspace (LFS) 假设：突变引起的残基层表示变化中存在一组紧凑、assay 特异的方向，使适应度在少量标注变体上即可线性读出。据此提出 Subspace-Guided Evolutionary Search (SGES)，先用小初始样本估计 LFS，再在该子空间内做代理建模、不确定性估计与采集。在 ProteinGym 10 个核心 assay、87 个扩展静态验证 assay 与 18 个 assay 的预算受限搜索评测中，SGES 的适应度预测与搜索效率均优于零样本 PLM 与近期 ML 引导的蛋白优化基线。
Motivation: 模型引导的定向进化要在有限 oracle 预算下找高适应度变体：零样本 PLM 分数与目标 assay 常不对齐，而在高维嵌入空间做有监督搜索又使代理建模与不确定性估计非常吃样本。
Method: SGES 从少量初始标注样本估计 LFS（突变诱导的残基层表示变化中的紧凑 assay 特异方向集），随后把代理模型、不确定性估计与采集函数全部放到学到的子空间内进行；用 PCA、随机投影、标签打乱的 PLS、经典突变特征与采集消融做受控对照。
Result: 在 10 个 ProteinGym 核心 assay、87 个扩展静态验证 assay 和 18 个 assay 的预算受限搜索评测上，SGES 相对零样本 PLM 与近期 ML 引导蛋白优化基线同时改善适应度预测与搜索效率；受控对照把收益隔离到 fitness-aligned 的 site-delta 坐标上。
Conclusion: 适应度变化在突变诱导的表示差分中沿少数 assay 特异方向线性可读，因此在该子空间内做搜索比在全维嵌入中更省样本；作者强调这是局部、可由监督恢复的陈述，而非蛋白适应度景观或 PLM 全局几何普遍线性的断言。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VALSE: Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficient Inference in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper establishes a theoretical framework for vertical adaptive layer skipping, proving three foundational results: (i) an Expected FLOPs formula (theorem 2) giving a closed-form expression for the computational cost of arbitrary per-sample skip schedules as a function of layer-wise skip probabilities; (ii) function-space superset (theorem 10) and strict inclusion (theorem 11) theorems showing that skip-layer models are strictly contained in---yet meaningfully approximate---the full-layer function space, with an explicit separating example; and (iii) a structural duality between VALSE and Mixture-of-Experts architectures (proposition 6), positioning vertical depth-wise sparsity as the orthogonal counterpart to horizontal width-wise sparsity. Building on this theory, we propose VALSE (Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficiency), a per-sample, non-contiguous layer skipping method: a lightweight difficulty estimator scores each input from the first few layers, and per-layer gates selectively skip redundant layers---including arbitrary middle layers while retaining deeper ones---so that only the necessary depth is activated for each input, whose feasibility is preliminarily assessed at prototype scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VALSE 提出逐样本、非连续的垂直层跳过方法：轻量难度估计器用前几层给每个输入打分，逐层门控选择性跳过冗余层（含任意中间层但保留更深层），只激活该输入所需的深度。理论上给出任意逐样本跳过调度的 Expected FLOPs 闭式解（定理 2），证明跳层模型函数空间严格包含于全层空间却能有意义地逼近（定理 10/11），并给出 VALSE 与 Mixture-of-Experts 的结构对偶（命题 6）：垂直深度稀疏是水平宽度稀疏的正交对应物。可行性仅在原型规模上做了初步评估。
Motivation: 逐样本推理成本需要按难度自适应深度，但任意非连续跳过调度的计算代价缺少闭式刻画，其函数空间表达力与 MoE 的关系也未被形式化。
Method: 三层结构：以层间跳过概率为输入的 Expected FLOPs 公式（定理 2）；函数空间超集（定理 10）与严格包含（定理 11）定理，附显式分离例子；VALSE 本体由前几层的轻量难度估计器加逐层门控组成，允许跳过任意中间层而保留更深层。另有命题 6 刻画 VALSE 与 MoE 的结构对偶。
Result: 得到三项理论结果：任意逐样本跳过调度计算代价的 Expected FLOPs 闭式公式（定理 2）；跳层模型函数空间被全层空间严格包含却能有意义逼近的超集与严格包含定理（定理 10、11，含显式分离例子）；VALSE 与 MoE 的结构对偶（命题 6）。方法可行性在原型规模上得到初步评估。
Conclusion: 垂直深度方向的逐样本稀疏可作为与 MoE 水平宽度稀疏正交的效率杠杆，其代价与表达力有可证明的刻画，但当前证据止于原型规模的初步可行性评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emoception: Selective Affective Layer Fine-Tuning of Video Vision Transformers for Player Arousal Change Recognition From Gameplay Footage
papers.abstract_en: This article proposes Selective Affective Layer Fine-Tuning (SALFT), an efficient adaptation framework for Video Vision Transformers in player arousal recognition from gameplay. To bypass computationally expensive full fine-tuning, SALFT introduces a selection criterion based on the L2-norm change in layer parameters after brief adaptation, directly measuring representational shifts and providing a more stable basis than gradient-based alternatives. Evaluated via five-fold cross-validation on the Arousal Video Game AnnotatIoN dataset, SALFT achieves performance comparable to full fine-tuning across all games without statistically significant degradation ($p>0.05$), while updating only $\approx$8% of parameters (over 92% reduction). Notably, in one game, SALFT consistently outperforms both full fine-tuning and the best baseline across all metrics and folds, reaching the theoretical minimum p-value (p=0.0625, exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test). In addition, we introduce an interpretability method to trace attention patterns, enhancing model transparency. These results establish SALFT as an effective and efficient approach for affective game computing.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Games, vol. 18, no. 2, pp. 393-403, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SALFT：用短暂适配后层参数的 L2 范数变化作为筛选准则，只微调 Video Vision Transformer 中表征位移最大的情感相关层，用于从游戏画面识别玩家唤醒度变化。在 AVAG 数据集五折交叉验证中，性能与全量微调相当且无统计显著下降（p>0.05），却只更新约 8% 参数（降幅超 92%）；其中一款游戏上在全部指标与折次上同时超过全量微调与最佳基线。
Motivation: 游戏情感计算中对 Video ViT 做全量微调计算代价高，而基于梯度的层选择准则不稳定，需要一种更稳、更省参数的适配方式。
Method: SALFT 先做短暂适配，按各层参数的 L2 范数变化排序筛选出表征位移最大的层，仅对这些层做情感层微调；评估用五折交叉验证，并配套一种追踪注意力模式的可解释性方法。
Result: 在 Arousal Video Game AnnotatIoN (AVAG) 数据集五折交叉验证下，SALFT 各游戏性能与全量微调相当、无统计显著下降（p>0.05），仅更新约 8% 参数、参数量减少超 92%；在一款游戏上所有指标与所有折次均优于全量微调与最佳基线，达到理论最小 p 值 0.0625（exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test）。
Conclusion: 以 L2 范数变化做层筛选的选择性微调，能在大幅削减可训练参数的同时保持唤醒度识别效果，可作为游戏情感计算中全量微调的高效替代。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Neural JKO Scheme for Hellinger-Kantorovich Gradient Flows via Monge-Growth Pairs
papers.abstract_en: We develop a mesh-free neural JKO scheme for advection-reaction-diffusion equations with a gradient-flow structure in the Hellinger-Kantorovich (HK) geometry of unbalanced optimal transport. Each update is parametrized by a spatial map and a mass-changing factor, allowing spatial redistribution and local mass creation or loss to be treated jointly within a single variational step. Their cone action bounds the squared HK distance from above, yielding a sufficient condition for discrete energy dissipation through comparison with the identity pair. Minimizing the pair objective over all admissible pairs recovers the exact JKO minimum when the source and a minimizer have positive densities. We establish existence and mass bounds for JKO minimizers and, under additional assumptions, obtain positivity and regularity together with a discrete Euler-Lagrange equation and a metric-dissipation identity. The self-consistent chemical potential is then nonincreasing along an optimal map. There exist parametric pairs whose endpoint densities and objective values converge to those of an exact JKO minimizer, provided a regular-pair approximation hypothesis holds. Finally, we show that a primal-dual gap controls objective suboptimality and, for Boltzmann entropy, the $L^1$ density error, assuming exact-step regularity, positive-semidefinite interactions, and global dual feasibility. Numerical experiments examine pointwise agreement with the PDE, energy dissipation, and the roles of transport, reaction, and fully implicit interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无网格神经 JKO 格式，把 Hellinger-Kantorovich (HK) 几何下非平衡最优传输的每一步变分更新参数化为空间映射与质量变化因子的配对 (Monge-Growth Pairs)，使输运与局部反应在一个变分步内联合处理。锥作用给出平方 HK 距离的上界，从而得到离散能量耗散的充分条件；数值实验检验与 PDE 的逐点吻合及能量耗散。
Motivation: 具有梯度流结构的对流-反应-扩散方程在 HK 几何下需要同时处理空间重分布与质量增减，传统网格化 JKO 步骤难以把两者放进同一个变分更新。
Method: 每步 JKO 更新用 Monge-Growth 配对参数化：一个空间映射加一个质量变化因子，配对的锥作用从上方控制平方 HK 距离，与恒等配对比较得到离散能量耗散的充分条件；在源与极小元密度为正时，对所有可行配对最小化可恢复精确 JKO 极小值。理论上给出 JKO 极小元的存在性与质量界，并在附加假设下得到正则性、离散 Euler-Lagrange 方程与 metric-dissipation 恒等式；再用 primal-dual gap 控制目标次优性与 Boltzmann 熵下的 L1 密度误差。
Result: 证明了 JKO 极小元的存在性与质量界，以及最优映射下自洽化学势单调不增；在正则配对逼近假设下，存在参数化配对使端点密度与目标值收敛到精确 JKO 极小元；primal-dual gap 在精确步正则性、正半定相互作用与全局对偶可行条件下控制目标次优性及 Boltzmann 熵的 L1 密度误差。数值实验考察与 PDE 的逐点吻合、能量耗散，以及输运、反应与全隐式相互作用各自的作用。
Conclusion: 把 HK 梯度流的 JKO 步骤拆成空间映射与质量因子的联合配对后，可以在一个无网格变分步里同时承载输运与反应，并由锥作用与对偶间隙给出可证的耗散与误差控制。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Beyond Scalar IoU: Structured Verification from Rollout Groups for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural framework for adapting pretrained models to video temporal grounding, where generated temporal intervals can be scored directly against ground truth intervals. Yet existing overlap verifiers typically score each rollout independently, leaving the joint structure of the rollout group unused. We introduce SUTURE, which conditions verification on the rollout group and exploits its structure at two complementary scales: disagreement across rollouts controls how strongly the target is reweighted, while coverage at each position determines where reward mass is redistributed. We show that the resulting verifier admits an exact decomposition into the standard IoU term and a covariance correction determined by the rollout group. A local gradient diagnostic finds a preference for responses covering relatively less supported target regions in the analyzed groups. Across five temporal grounding benchmarks, SUTURE improves grounding performance at every reported IoU threshold. Its trained policy also shows less video-start anchoring in reasoning traces: for later events, the first temporal mention more often overlaps the annotated target. Together, these results show that the joint structure of a rollout group can support a more informative temporal verifier.

papers.title: Modeling Latent Disturbances for Robust Decision-Making in World Models
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study robust decision-making in the latent space of world models (WMs). Robust optimization is a mathematical framework where, given explicitly specified dynamics and physically meaningful disturbances, a robot can select actions that remain effective even under worst-case disturbances. However, applying this principle to the learned latent space of WMs introduces a fundamental challenge: because WMs have fully learned state spaces and dynamics inferred from high-dimensional observations, it is unclear how to define latent-space disturbances that faithfully represent uncertainty in the underlying system. Our key idea is to model a latent-space disturbance as a perturbation to the learned latent dynamics that induces pessimistic but plausible transitions. Specifically, we construct a set of plausible latent dynamics by combining a dynamics-aware similarity metric that captures plausible transitions with out-of-distribution detection that excludes implausible latent states. We calibrate this uncertainty set over latent dynamics using conformal prediction, ensuring that WM imaginations induced by the latent disturbance remain plausible without becoming overly pessimistic. We then jointly optimize robust robot actions and the worst-case latent disturbances through game-theoretic optimization. We leverage this latent-space robust optimization to robustify policy steering, considering two paradigms: latent safety filtering and sample-and-verify steering of a generative control policy. Our controlled simulation experiments show that our latent disturbance enables robust decision-making directly in WM latent spaces, and hardware experiments with a Franka manipulator show that modeling latent disturbances enables robust policy steering, reducing failures by 70% in safety filtering and 54% in sampling-based policy steering. Project website: https://junwon.me/LatentDisturbance/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 world model 的潜空间里把扰动定义为对学到的潜动力学的扰动，用动力学感知相似度加 OOD 检测构造合理潜动力学集合，再用 conformal prediction 校准该集合，使悲观但合理的转移既不过度悲观也不失真。随后用博弈优化联合求解鲁棒动作与最坏情况潜扰动，用于潜空间安全滤波与生成式控制策略的 sample-and-verify steering；Franka 机械臂硬件实验中安全滤波失败率降 70%，采样式策略 steering 失败率降 54%。
Motivation: 鲁棒优化要求显式给定动力学与物理意义明确的扰动，而 world model 的状态空间与动力学完全从高维观测学出，无法直接定义能忠实反映真实系统不确定性的潜空间扰动。
Method: 把潜扰动建模为对潜动力学的扰动，用动力学感知相似度度量刻画合理转移、用 out-of-distribution 检测排除不合理潜状态，二者结合得到合理潜动力学集合；用 conformal prediction 校准该不确定集，再以博弈优化联合优化鲁棒机器人动作与最坏情况潜扰动，落到 latent safety filtering 与生成式控制策略的 sample-and-verify steering 两种范式。
Result: 受控仿真实验显示该潜扰动可在 world model 潜空间内直接支撑鲁棒决策；Franka 机械臂硬件实验中，建模潜扰动使安全滤波失败减少 70%，采样式策略 steering 失败减少 54%。
Conclusion: 把不确定性放在学到的潜动力学而非潜状态上并用 conformal prediction 校准，就能在 world model 潜空间内做博弈式的鲁棒策略 steering，并在真实机械臂上显著减少失败。

papers.title: The Robot Is Not Its Description: GaugeBench for Representation Robustness in Morphology-Aware Policies
papers.abstract_en: A robot description does more than specify a physical mechanism: it also encodes arbitrary conventions, such as joint-axis direction, joint-angle zero, and the order and names of links and joints. Morphology-aware policies consume interfaces built from these descriptions, yet cross-embodiment evaluation typically changes the robot while keeping those conventions fixed. This leaves a simple question unanswered: does behavior survive when the robot stays fixed but its description changes? GaugeBench isolates this case by rewriting a fixed mechanism under physically equivalent conventions, verifying that its physics and policy interface are preserved, and then evaluating the same policy weights. The result is stark: three MetaMorph policies score 4030.6 on 80 familiar robots, but only 51.6 when those same robots are equivalently re-described, while 98 genuinely held-out robots score 1489.6. A new description can therefore be more damaging than a new robot. Tracing the failure reveals that axis reversal alone reproduces the collapse, joint-angle zero changes are nearly harmless, and reordering lies between them; moreover, changing joint-state and torque coordinates alone is sufficient to cause the failure, while changing description-derived features alone is not. The same phenomenon appears in ModuMorph and an unrelated PyBullet framework. Yet it is not irreversible: exact two-description transport restores the original controller, and training across equivalent axis conventions raises retained return under axis reversal from 3.6% to 80.6%. Together, these results separate mechanism robustness from representation robustness and show that cross-embodiment evaluation should test both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GaugeBench 把同一机器人机构改写成物理等价的描述约定（关节轴方向、关节零位、连杆/关节顺序与命名），再用原权重评测形态感知策略，发现策略对描述的脆弱性远大于对新机器人的脆弱性：三个 MetaMorph 策略在 80 个熟悉机器人上得 4030.6，等价重描述后骤降到 51.6，而 98 个真正留出的新机器人仍有 1489.6。轴反转单独即可复现崩溃，仅改关节状态与力矩坐标就足以致败；跨等价轴约定训练把轴反转下的保留回报从 3.6% 提到 80.6%，精确的双描述传输可恢复原控制器。
Motivation: 跨形态 (cross-embodiment) 评测通常换机器人但固定描述约定，因此没人回答：机构不变、只改描述时行为是否还成立。描述里编码的关节轴方向、零位、命名顺序等任意约定被策略接口直接消费，这一盲区可能让现有评测高估策略的鲁棒性。
Method: GaugeBench 对固定机构生成物理等价的重描述，先验证物理与策略接口保持一致，再用同一策略权重评测；沿轴反转、关节零位改变、顺序重排逐项定位失效来源，并区分改关节状态/力矩坐标与改描述衍生特征两种干预；同时检验精确的双描述传输 (two-description transport) 与跨等价轴约定训练两种修复，并在 ModuMorph 与一个无关 PyBullet 框架上复现。
Result: 三个 MetaMorph 策略在 80 个熟悉机器人上得分 4030.6，等价重描述后仅 51.6，而 98 个真正留出的机器人为 1489.6，即新描述比新机器人更具破坏性。轴反转单独即可复现崩溃，关节零位改变几乎无害，顺序重排居中；仅改变关节状态与力矩坐标即足以致败，仅改描述衍生特征则不足。同一现象出现在 ModuMorph 与一个无关 PyBullet 框架；精确双描述传输可恢复原控制器，跨等价轴约定训练使轴反转下保留回报从 3.6% 升至 80.6%。
Conclusion: 机制鲁棒性与表征鲁棒性是两回事：策略可以在换机器人时存活，却在换描述约定时崩溃，因此跨形态评测必须同时测试两者。崩溃并非不可逆，双描述传输与跨约定训练都能恢复大部分性能。

papers.title: BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid household manipulation requires the arms to act while the body balances, steps and changes posture. We present BiGym 2.0, an adaptation of BiGym for the Unitree G1 across 20 household tasks using a unified whole-body controller for demonstration and evaluation. The suite provides 60 native human virtual-reality demonstrations per task with synchronised multi-camera views and full-body execution records. We benchmark vision-language-action fine-tuning, imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning, and cold-start coding agents given the interaction budget of online reinforcement learning. With the same onboard views, proprioception and whole-body controller for every method, vision-language-action fine-tuning has the highest nine-task mean, and agent-developed programs outperform every demo-driven reinforcement learning baseline on this mean and lead on bimanual reaching. Cross-workspace stacking remains open, $π_{0.5}$ stays low on pick-box, and multi-object transport is hard for imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning and coding agents. All environments, human demonstrations, and evaluation traces are open-sourced at https://github.com/swirl-uk/BiGym2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiGym 2.0 把 BiGym 改造成面向 Unitree G1 人形全身操作的基准，含 20 项家务任务与统一全身控制器，每任务 60 条人类 VR 演示。同观测同控制器对比下，VLA 微调九任务均值最高，coding agent 在该均值上超过全部 demo-driven RL 基线并在双臂抓取领先；跨工作区堆叠、pick-box 上的 π0.5、多物体搬运仍难。
Motivation: 人形家务操作要求手臂作业同时维持平衡与换步态，现有操作基准多为固定基座，缺少在统一全身控制与观测条件下横向比较学习策略与 agent 自研策略的平台。
Method: 将 BiGym 适配到 Unitree G1，提供统一全身控制器用于演示与评测；每任务 60 条原生人类 VR 演示，含同步多相机视角与全身执行记录。在同一机载视角、本体感觉与控制器下，对 VLA 微调、模仿学习、demo-driven RL 与冷启动 coding agent（按在线 RL 交互预算）做基准对比。
Result: VLA 微调取得九任务均值最高；agent 自研程序在该均值上超过每一个 demo-driven RL 基线，并在双臂抓取 (bimanual reaching) 上领先。跨工作区堆叠 (cross-workspace stacking) 仍未解决，π0.5 在 pick-box 上得分低，多物体搬运对模仿学习、demo-driven RL 与 coding agent 都困难。
Conclusion: 在统一全身控制与观测预算下，VLA 微调与 coding agent 是人形家务操作的两条有效路径，而堆叠、单任务弱项与多物体搬运是共同瓶颈。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LSC-DPO: Learning-Signal-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a standard reward-model-free approach for aligning language models with preference data. However, as the scaled preference margin grows during training, the logistic DPO loss becomes progressively less sensitive to further changes. We study DPO from a loss-level geometric perspective and identify the sigmoid factor as a learning signal that characterizes the local sensitivity of the objective. Based on this view, we propose Learning-Signal-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization (LSC-DPO), which dynamically regulates the learning signal near a target regime. A log-space analysis establishes conditions for stable tracking of the target learning-signal regime. Experiments on AlpacaEval 2, MT-Bench, and Anthropic-HH show that LSC-DPO consistently improves over DPO and strong preference-optimization baselines. We further find that different coefficient initializations induce distinct transient learning-signal trajectories even when their later signal levels become similar. Based on this observation, we derive a signal-budget compensation rule that adjusts the target learning signal to compensate for these transient differences. The resulting compensation substantially reduces performance variation across coefficient initializations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LSC-DPO 把 DPO 损失中的 sigmoid 因子识别为刻画局部敏感度的学习信号 (learning signal)，并动态将其调节到目标区间；log 空间分析给出稳定跟踪该区间的条件。在 AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench、Anthropic-HH 上一致优于 DPO 及强偏好优化基线，且信号预算补偿规则显著降低不同系数初始化间的性能波动。
Motivation: 偏好边际随训练增大后，logistic DPO 损失对进一步变化越来越不敏感，导致学习信号衰减、优化停滞。
Method: 从损失层面的几何视角把 sigmoid 因子作为学习信号，动态调节其接近目标区间；用 log 空间分析推导稳定跟踪条件；再根据系数初始化引起的瞬态信号轨迹差异，推导信号预算补偿规则 (signal-budget compensation rule) 调整目标学习信号。
Result: 在 AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench、Anthropic-HH 上 LSC-DPO 一致优于 DPO 与强偏好优化基线；不同系数初始化即使后期信号水平相近也会产生不同的瞬态轨迹，补偿后跨初始化的性能波动大幅下降。
Conclusion: 把 DPO 的 sigmoid 因子当作可控学习信号并补偿初始化带来的瞬态差异，可稳定提升偏好优化表现并压低初始化敏感性。

papers.title: Recurrent Looped Transformer
papers.abstract_en: State tracking requires an update at every input, but the depth a Transformer applies to each token is fixed regardless of sequence length. We introduce the Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT), which splits its layers between a parallel causal encoder and a recurrent decoder. At each token, the decoder merges the encoder output with the previous token's final decoder state, so the computation path grows with sequence length at a fixed per-token cost. On six algorithmic tasks, we compare five splits of eight layers with an eight-layer Transformer over three seeds. Trained on at most 40 bits, two RLT splits generalize parity to 256 bits with 100% accuracy in every seed, while the Transformer stays at chance. On swap-based $S_5$ permutation tracking at eight times the training length, RLT reaches 97% final-state accuracy versus under 1% for the Transformer, and accuracy increases with decoder depth. On modular arithmetic beyond the training lengths, RLT reaches up to 93% versus 33% for the Transformer. Ablations show that these gains depend on the feedback: removing it drops parity and swap-based $S_5$ to chance at every split. Updating the feedback once per four-token chunk lets known tokens in a chunk run in parallel and keeps 64-bit parity at 99%, while permutation tracking depends on per-token feedback: chunking lowers length-64 swap-based $S_5$ from 100% to 20%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RLT 把层分成并行因果编码器与循环解码器，解码器每步合并编码器输出与上一 token 的最终解码状态，使计算路径随序列长度增长而每 token 成本固定。在六个算法任务上，训练长度不超过 40 bit 时两种分层方案在三个 seed 上都把奇偶校验泛化到 256 bit 达 100%（八层 Transformer 仍在随机水平），8 倍训练长度的 swap-based S5 置换追踪达 97%（Transformer 不到 1%），超出训练长度的模运算最高 93%（Transformer 33%）。
Motivation: 状态追踪要求每个输入都更新，但 Transformer 对每个 token 施加的深度固定、不随序列长度变化，导致在超出训练长度的算法任务上无法泛化。
Method: Recurrent Looped Transformer (RLT) 将八层拆为并行因果编码器与循环解码器两部分；每个 token 处解码器融合编码器输出与前一 token 的最终解码状态。在六个算法任务上比较八层中的五种分层方案与八层 Transformer，三个 seed；并做去除反馈与每四 token 分块反馈的消融。
Result: 训练至多 40 bit 时，两种 RLT 分层在每个 seed 上把奇偶校验泛化到 256 bit 达 100% 准确率，Transformer 保持随机水平；8 倍训练长度的 swap-based S5 置换追踪最终状态准确率 97% 对 Transformer 不到 1%，且准确率随解码器深度上升；超出训练长度的模运算最高 93% 对 33%。消融显示去掉反馈后奇偶与 S5 在所有分层都掉到随机；每四 token 反馈一次使 64 bit 奇偶保持 99%，但长度 64 的 swap-based S5 从 100% 降到 20%。
Conclusion: 随长度增长的反馈计算路径是这些外推增益的来源：奇偶校验可容忍分块反馈，而置换追踪必须每 token 反馈。

papers.title: Vine Copula VAR:From Recursive Margins to Joint Forecast Inference
papers.abstract_en: Joint-event forecasts often combine a dependence estimate based on past forecast errors with newly estimated marginal distributions. When each historical error retains the marginal fit available at its issue date, inference must account for an overlapping sequence of estimation errors. We derive their joint influence with the terminal forecast estimates in a stable Vine Copula VAR with normal innovation margins and a fixed, correctly specified Gaussian or positive Clayton vine. An intercept identity and the stable VAR filter reduce the historical correction to harmonically weighted innovation moments, while terminal slope uncertainty remains. The resulting covariance estimator gives asymptotically valid repeated-sample intervals for fixed one-sided event probabilities at the realized forecast state. In the Gaussian submodel, retaining issued transforms adds a positive semidefinite covariance term relative to refitting margins on the same observations. Monte Carlo simulations show that terminal-margin uncertainty is quantitatively more important than this additional term and that logit intervals improve lower-tail coverage in the designs studied. A real-time forecasting application to U.S. macroeconomic releases shows how marginal estimation contributes to uncertainty in predicted probabilities of joint contractions and identifies limitations of the stationary marginal model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对联合事件预报中「历史预报误差依赖结构 + 新估计边缘分布」的推断问题，推导 Vine Copula VAR（正态新息边缘、固定且正确设定的 Gaussian 或正 Clayton vine）下历史校正项与终端预报估计的联合影响，得到协方差估计量并给出固定单侧事件概率的渐近有效重复样本区间。Monte Carlo 显示终端边缘不确定性比「保留已发布变换」新增的正半定协方差项在数量上更重要，logit 区间在所研究设计中改善下尾覆盖；在美国宏观经济发布的实时预报应用中展示了边缘估计如何贡献于联合收缩概率的不确定性。
Motivation: 联合事件预报把历史预报误差的依赖估计与新估计的边缘分布结合，但当每条历史误差保留其发布时点的边缘拟合时，推断必须处理一串相互重叠的估计误差，现有做法未把这部分不确定性计入。
Method: 在稳定 Vine Copula VAR（正态新息边缘、固定且正确设定的 Gaussian 或正 Clayton vine）下推导历史误差与终端预报估计的联合影响：用截距恒等式与稳定 VAR 滤波把历史校正化为调和加权的新息矩，保留终端斜率不确定性，据此构造协方差估计量并给出固定单侧事件概率在实现预报状态处的渐近有效重复样本区间；Gaussian 子模型下与同批观测重拟合边缘相比多出一个正半定协方差项。
Result: Monte Carlo 模拟表明终端边缘不确定性在数量上比该附加正半定项更重要，且 logit 区间在所研究设计中改善下尾覆盖；在美国宏观经济发布的实时预报应用中，边缘估计被识别为联合收缩预测概率不确定性的来源，并暴露出平稳边缘模型的局限。
Conclusion: 保留历史误差发布时点的边缘拟合会在协方差中引入额外正半定项，但真正主导区间宽度的是终端边缘估计不确定性；对联合收缩这类固定单侧事件概率，用该协方差估计量配 logit 区间可改善下尾覆盖，而平稳边缘模型在真实宏观发布上受限。
Relevance: 18
