papers.title: Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation with Cross-Platform User History
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommendation is shifting from platform-centric personalization toward user-governed personalization, where a personal LLM agent can act on the user's behalf across services. We formalize this emerging paradigm as Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation: a platform recommender ranks a candidate set using platform-local information, and a personal agent uses user-authorized cross-platform history to mediate the resulting ranking and produce the final top-K slate. Such mediation is nontrivial: the platform ranking can encode strong population evidence that the personal agent cannot observe, so effective mediation must therefore balance beneficial rescues against harmful overrides. To study this trade-off, we introduce MediateRec, a benchmark that includes scalable proxy cross-platform environments and a real cross-platform test under a controlled platform-agent information boundary. To train the agent to use cross-platform history effectively, we further propose Personal Attribution Mediation Optimization (PAMO), which counterfactually masks that history to estimate personal mediation support and reallocates rank-aware advantage mass under a platform-relative value floor. We theoretically prove that PAMO preserves cutoff-level advantage mass and is locally optimal among first-order reallocations that preserve this mass without lowering average platform-relative value. Experiments on MediateRec show that personal-agent mediation enables meaningful platform corrections, yet even strong proprietary LLMs introduce non-negligible harmful overrides. PAMO consistently improves over matched outcome-only RL across seen and unseen target platforms and on the real cross-platform test, while achieving a better rescue-harm balance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation 范式：平台用本地信息排候选集，个人 LLM agent 用跨平台历史对排序做中介，产出最终 top-K slate。为此构建基准 MediateRec（可扩展代理跨平台环境 + 受控信息边界下的真实跨平台测试），并提出 PAMO：反事实掩蔽跨平台历史估计个人中介支持，在平台相对价值下限下重分配 rank-aware advantage mass。实验显示中介能带来有意义的平台纠正，但强闭源 LLM 仍引入不可忽略的有害覆盖；PAMO 在已见与未见平台及真实跨平台上均稳定优于同配置的 outcome-only RL，且救援-伤害更平衡。
Motivation: 推荐正从平台中心化个性化转向用户自管个性化，但平台排序携带个人 agent 看不到的群体证据，agent 盲目改排会把有益救援变成有害覆盖，缺少刻画这一权衡的评测与训练方法。
Method: 提出 MediateRec 基准，含可扩展代理跨平台环境与受控平台-agent 信息边界下的真实跨平台测试；训练方法为 Personal Attribution Mediation Optimization (PAMO)，反事实掩蔽跨平台历史估计个人中介支持，并在平台相对价值下限约束下重分配 rank-aware advantage mass。
Result: MediateRec 上个人 agent 中介带来有意义的平台纠正，但强闭源 LLM 也产生不可忽略的有害覆盖；PAMO 在已见与未见目标平台以及真实跨平台测试上一致优于同配置的 outcome-only RL，并取得更好的救援-伤害平衡。理论上证明 PAMO 保持 cutoff 级 advantage mass，并在保持该质量的一阶重分配中局部最优。
Conclusion: 跨平台历史的中介必须在有益救援与有害覆盖之间权衡，PAMO 通过带价值下限的 rank-aware 重分配在多个平台上稳定改善这一权衡。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: REViT-v2: Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViT for Equivariant Feature Extraction
papers.abstract_en: We propose a scalable roto-reflection-group-equivariant vision transformer based on windowed group-convolutional self-attention and a hierarchical feature architecture. We demonstrate that our approach can be scaled to group-equivariant vision transformers (ViTs) with millions of parameters and large datasets with practically sized images, i.e., ImageNet. The code and pretrained weights for the proposed Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViTs (REViT-v2) are available at https://github.com/kc-ml2/revit.
papers.comment: 7 pages, Accepted for presentation at NeurIPS NeurREPS workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REViT-v2 用窗口化群卷积自注意力 (windowed group-convolutional self-attention) 与分层特征架构，把旋转-反射群等变 ViT 扩展到百万参数级并适配 ImageNet 规模的真实尺寸图像，代码与预训练权重已开源。
Motivation: 群等变视觉 Transformer 此前难以在大参数量与 ImageNet 这类实际图像尺寸上扩展，等变特征提取的可扩展性是主要瓶颈。
Method: 提出 REViT-v2：以窗口化群卷积自注意力替代全局自注意力，配合分层 (hierarchical) 特征架构构建 roto-reflection 群等变 ViT，可训练至百万参数级并处理 ImageNet 尺寸图像。
Result: 证明该架构可扩展到数百万参数的群等变 ViT 并在 ImageNet 这类大尺寸图像数据集上运行；发布代码与预训练权重（github.com/kc-ml2/revit）。

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Atmospheric Rivers in GraphCast
papers.abstract_en: While AI weather models now rival operational forecasts, how they represent the atmosphere internally remains an open question: feature attribution reveals which input patterns matter, not what the model computes or how it combines information internally. We train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on GraphCast to uncover its learned concepts, using atmospheric rivers as our phenomenon of focus. Both standard and Matryoshka SAEs show GraphCast computes atmospheric river intensity, measured by integrated vapor transport (IVT), as a stable internal variable, despite IVT being neither an input nor a target. In contrast to the unstructured concept retrieval of the standard SAE, the Matryoshka SAE orders concepts by importance and exposes their relations. Atmospheric river concepts persist across depth and direct interventions confirm causality. This method offers a way to find internal variables and determine which of them the model actually relies on, which is a prerequisite for asking whether those variables remain meaningful as the phenomenon changes under a warming climate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GraphCast 上训练稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 解剖其内部表征，发现模型把大气河强度（以 integrated vapor transport, IVT 衡量）当作稳定的内部变量计算，而 IVT 既不是输入也不是预报目标。Matryoshka SAE 按重要性排序概念并暴露其关系，概念跨深度持续存在，直接干预证实因果性。该方法可用于定位模型的内部变量并判断它真正依赖哪些，为检验这些变量在变暖气候下是否仍有效做准备。
Motivation: 特征归因只能说明哪些输入模式重要，无法说明模型内部计算了什么、如何组合信息；AI 天气模型如何表征大气这一问题仍悬而未决。
Method: 对 GraphCast 训练标准 SAE 与 Matryoshka SAE 两种稀疏自编码器，以大气河为研究对象提取学到的概念；用跨深度的概念追踪与直接干预 (direct interventions) 检验概念是否持续、是否具因果性。
Result: 两种 SAE 都显示 GraphCast 将 IVT 计算为稳定的内部变量，尽管 IVT 既非输入也非目标；标准 SAE 的概念检索无结构，Matryoshka SAE 则按重要性排序概念并暴露其关系；大气河概念跨深度持续存在，直接干预确认其因果性。
Conclusion: SAE 解剖可以找出天气模型的内部变量并判定模型实际依赖哪些，这是追问这些变量在变暖气候下是否仍具意义的前提。

papers.title: Representation Bias, Correction Transfer, and Resolution Sensitivity in Three-Dimensional Mitochondrial Morphometry
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative imaging pipelines can produce precise but systematically different measurements of the same object. We present an empirical reliability assessment of three-dimensional mitochondrial morphometry that connects representation bias, a controlled processing intervention, correction transfer, and resolution sensitivity. Using 2,720 development objects from the 3D Mitochondria Shape Library for Optical Microscopy, we find that occupancy-derived volumes exceed reference mesh volumes by 3.665% on average despite an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.994. Boundary analysis identifies an outward label displacement of 0.00304 normalized units. In a controlled label-pipeline reimplementation, removing the depth offset reduces volume error in all 55 analyzed objects by a mean of 1.57 percentage points, approximately 45% of mean reproduced inflation; the source of the remainder is not isolated. A frozen regression using occupancy-derived features reduces median absolute percentage error from 3.481% to 0.664% in 2,728 previously unused objects from the same resource. However, its calibrated error bound covers only 92.1% overall and 49.2% in a low-occupancy subgroup, demonstrating that accuracy and uncertainty transfer must be evaluated separately. In 550 rat-cortex objects from the MitoEM resource, coarsening in-plane spacing from 8 to 24 nanometers changes median surface area by minus 10.60% and sphericity by plus 11.76%, despite a rank correlation of 0.994. These results provide quantitative checks for distinguishing processing-induced descriptor changes from candidate biological differences, without establishing biological invariance or cross-source correction transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 三维线粒体形态测量中，占用体素法算出的体积比参考网格平均高 3.665%，尽管 ICC 达 0.994；去掉标签管线的深度偏移可让全部 55 个对象的体积误差平均再降 1.57 个百分点，约占复现膨胀的 45%。冻结回归把 MAPE 从 3.481% 压到 0.664%，但校准误差界整体只覆盖 92.1%、低占用子组仅 49.2%，说明精度与不确定性迁移必须分开评估。
Motivation: 定量成像管线对同一对象会给出精确但系统性不同的测量，处理引入的描述子变化容易被误读为生物学差异，需要把表示偏差、校正迁移与分辨率敏感性拆开量化。
Method: 在 3D Mitochondria Shape Library for Optical Microscopy 的 2,720 个开发对象上做经验可靠性评估：占用体积对参考网格体积、边界位移分析、受控的标签管线重实现（移除深度偏移），再用占用特征训练冻结回归并在 2,728 个未用对象上检验；另在 MitoEM 的 550 个大鼠皮层对象上做面内间距粗化。
Result: 占用体积平均比参考网格高 3.665%（ICC 0.994），边界向外位移 0.00304 归一化单位；移除深度偏移使 55 个对象体积误差全部下降，平均 1.57 个百分点，约占复现膨胀的 45%；冻结回归把中位绝对百分比误差从 3.481% 降到 0.664%（2,728 个对象），但校准误差界整体覆盖 92.1%、低占用子组 49.2%；MitoEM 上面内间距从 8 粗化到 24 nm，中位表面积 −10.60%、球形度 +11.76%，秩相关仍为 0.994。
Conclusion: 高相关不等于无偏，分辨率与管线处理可在秩相关 0.994 下仍造成 10% 量级的描述子偏移；这些结果给出区分处理诱导变化与候选生物学差异的定量检查，但不确立生物学不变性，也不支持跨源校正迁移。

papers.title: LOGIC: An LLM Benchmark for Intent-Grounded Change Impact in Aerospace Electrical Systems
papers.abstract_en: Aerospace electrical-design revisions can contain multiple genuine changes, although an engineering request may authorize only a subset. Propagating every detected difference can therefore produce overly broad impact reports. We present LOGIC, a controlled benchmark and evaluation framework in which locally deployable language models ground a request in a deterministic candidate-change inventory before selected changes are propagated through a typed electrical traceability graph. This separation permits candidate-selection errors to be distinguished from downstream propagation errors. LOGIC contains 168 scenarios, including 144 selection and 24 abstention cases. We evaluate three 7--8B models against intent-agnostic, lexical, and structured-evidence methods, with an oracle-root upper bound. On 96 explicitly anchored selection cases, gate-only structured evidence achieves candidate F1 of 1.0000, compared with 0.9677 for token-lexical matching. On 12 relational-paraphrase cases, token-lexical F1 is 0.1772 and gate-only F1 is 0.0000, compared with 0.5000--0.6400 for the large language models. Model grounding degrades as candidate inventories grow from 4 to 64 changes, while affected-element and typed-path accuracy remain comparatively stable when frozen selections are replayed over graphs of approximately 1K to 100K nodes. Strict evidence gating suppresses false positives but can remove correct semantic selections. An exploratory evidence-empty abstention policy raises strict abstention accuracy to 0.6667 for all three models and reduces unsafe-report rates to 0.1667, while decreasing answerable-case coverage by 16.0--27.1 percentage points. Four of six conflicting requests remain unsafe for each model. These findings support combining literal evidence and language-model reasoning with engineering review when intent cannot be established reliably.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LOGIC 是面向航空航天电气系统变更影响分析的受控基准：先让本地可部署的 7–8B 语言模型把工程请求锚定到确定性候选变更清单，再沿带类型的电气可追溯图传播所选变更，从而把候选选择错误与下游传播错误分开。结构化证据门控在显式锚定选择上 F1 达 1.0000，但在关系改写场景为 0.0000，语言模型为 0.5000–0.6400；严格证据门控会压制假阳性却也删掉正确语义选择，作者主张字面证据与语言模型推理结合工程审查。
Motivation: 一次工程请求往往只授权一组变更的子集，把检测到的所有差异都传播出去会产生过宽的影响报告，而现有评估无法区分选择错误与传播错误。
Method: 构建 168 个场景的受控基准（144 选择 + 24 弃权），先在确定性候选变更清单上做请求锚定，再在带类型的电气可追溯图上传播所选变更；评测三个 7–8B 模型，对比 intent-agnostic、词法匹配与结构化证据方法，并给出 oracle-root 上界。
Result: 96 个显式锚定选择案例上，gate-only 结构化证据 F1 1.0000，token-lexical 0.9677；12 个关系改写案例上 token-lexical F1 0.1772、gate-only 0.0000，语言模型 0.5000–0.6400。候选清单从 4 增至 64 个变更时模型锚定退化，而冻结选择在约 1K 到 100K 节点图上重放时受影响元素与类型路径准确率相对稳定。探索性 evidence-empty 弃权策略把三个模型的严格弃权准确率提到 0.6667、不安全报告率降到 0.1667，但可回答案例覆盖率下降 16.0–27.1 个百分点；六个冲突请求中每个模型仍有四个不安全。
Conclusion: 当请求意图无法可靠确立时，应把字面证据与语言模型推理结合并保留工程审查，而不是单靠任一方；严格证据门控在抑制假阳性的同时会牺牲正确语义选择。

papers.title: Cooperating with Future Collaborators: Multi-Agent RL under Staggered Participation
papers.abstract_en: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents are often trained under concurrent participation, while in many tasks some agents act earlier and leave task-relevant information that becomes useful to agents participating later. We study this setting as staggered participation (SP), which introduces a cross-time, cross-agent learning dependency because an early action may affect the return through the information it provides and the later policy that uses it. Learning under SP therefore requires both identifying what information is useful for future decisions and learning how later agents should use it. We propose Staggered Participation Learning (SPL), a training-time augmentation that addresses these two parts with prospective acquisition supervision for earlier agents and outcome-supervised receiver learning for later agents. We evaluate SPL across multiple policy-based MARL backbones, environments, and staggered-participation patterns. Across 60 MPE/RWARE backbone setting comparisons, SPL achieves higher observed mean task completion in every case, with an average difference of 14.1%. The gains also extend to eight-agent teams and a physics-based UAV-UGV environment in Isaac Lab, providing evidence across algorithmic, temporal, and embodied settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在合作式多智能体强化学习的交错参与 (staggered participation) 设定下，先行动的智能体留下的信息会影响后参与者的选择与回报，提出训练期增强方法 Staggered Participation Learning (SPL)：对早期智能体用前瞻性获取监督 (prospective acquisition supervision) 学会留下有用信息，对后期智能体用结果监督的接收者学习 (outcome-supervised receiver learning) 学会利用该信息。在 60 组 MPE/RWARE 骨干设定对比中 SPL 每一例都取得更高的平均任务完成率，平均高出 14.1%。
Motivation: 合作 MARL 通常按同步参与训练，但真实任务中智能体先后进入并留下对后来者有用的信息，形成跨时间、跨智能体的学习依赖，现有训练方式既不识别哪些信息有用，也不教后来者如何使用。
Method: 提出 SPL 训练期增强：对早期智能体施加 prospective acquisition supervision，对后期智能体施加 outcome-supervised receiver learning；在多个 policy-based MARL 骨干、多种环境与交错参与模式上评测，并扩展到八智能体团队与 Isaac Lab 中基于物理的 UAV-UGV 环境。
Result: 在 60 组 MPE/RWARE 骨干设定对比中，SPL 每一例的平均任务完成率都更高，平均差异为 14.1%；增益同样出现在八智能体团队与 Isaac Lab 的 UAV-UGV 环境。
Conclusion: 把留下信息与利用信息作为两个监督目标一起训练，可在算法、时间与具身三类设定下一致提升交错参与合作任务的完成率。

papers.title: CETUS: How Far Do Representations Trained on Earth Transfer to Cassini SAR of Titan?
papers.abstract_en: Cassini synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images reveal the dunes, plains, and lake basins of Titan, providing an instance of representations learned from Earth imagery for planetary terrain classification. Cross-domain Evaluation of Earth-to-Titan Transfer Using SAR (CETUS) compares features from DINOv2, DOFA and CROMA with classical image measurements and features from an untrained vision transformer on the U.S. Geological Survey's Cassini SAR mosaic. The classifiers learn terrain labels from an expert geomorphological map and predict those labels in geographically separate Titan regions. Under logistic regression settings, pretrained encoders achieve higher mean macro F1 than the combined classical features. Encoder rankings change when feature scaling, optimization, and regularization change together. Further training on Titan improves DINOv2 performance, degrades DOFA performance, and leads to mixed results for CROMA under the tested settings. Architectural and input processing differences prevent these comparisons from isolating the effect of pretraining. Classifier fitting and performance on individual terrain classes matter when assessing representation transfer for planetary mapping. Since the map draws partly on the same radar observations, the scores measure agreement with expert interpretation.
papers.comment: Research work at NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Available at: https://github.com/magnaprog/CETUS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CETUS 在 Cassini SAR 马赛克上比较 DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA 与经典图像特征的地球到 Titan 表征迁移：logistic regression 下预训练编码器的 mean macro F1 高于经典特征组合，但特征缩放、优化与正则一起改变时编码器排名会翻转，且在 Titan 上继续训练会提升 DINOv2、降低 DOFA、对 CROMA 结果混杂。
Motivation: 行星制图缺少判断「地球上学到的表征能否迁移到 Titan 地形分类」的可比评测，且标签来自专家解译、部分依赖同一批雷达观测，分数实为与专家解释的一致度。
Method: 在 USGS 的 Cassini SAR 马赛克上，用专家地貌图提供地形标签，以 logistic regression 训练分类器并在地理上分离的 Titan 区域预测；对比 DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA、经典图像测量特征与未训练 vision transformer，并考察特征缩放、优化、正则与在 Titan 上继续训练的影响。
Result: logistic regression 设置下预训练编码器的 mean macro F1 高于经典特征组合；特征缩放、优化与正则同时改变时编码器排名发生变化；继续训练使 DINOv2 性能提升、DOFA 下降、CROMA 结果混杂。
Conclusion: 架构与输入处理差异使这些比较无法分离预训练本身的作用，评估表征迁移时必须同时看分类器拟合与各地形类别的表现；分数衡量的是与专家解译的一致性。

papers.title: Two Vectors Replace In-Context Demos: Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) adapts frozen large multimodal models (LMMs) to new tasks from a few demonstrations (demos), but re-encodes them at every query, where each demo image adds up to hundreds of visual tokens. Demo-free methods remove this cost with a compact task state. However, they add it at locations searched per task or at every decoder layer, where task parameters grow with depth. Moreover, inserted tokens or keys cannot change how the original prompt divides its attention within a layer. To address these issues, we propose Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings (STAVE), which replaces demos with two task-specific vectors added to existing input embeddings. Specifically, a readout vector updates the answer-producing tokens and a context vector updates the other structural token groups. Both are trained with answer labels on prompts with and without demos. We justify these design choices theoretically using a first-order analysis of the loss and a margin bound. Extensive experiments on six LMMs and five large language models show that STAVE matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multimodal tasks with far fewer task parameters and surpasses 15-shot ICL and prior task vectors on 18 text tasks, all at zero-shot inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAVE 用两个任务专属向量（readout 向量更新答案生成 token，context 向量更新其余结构 token 组）替代 in-context demos，直接加在输入 embedding 上，从而改变原 prompt 在层内的注意力分配。在六个 LMM 与五个 LLM 上匹配或超越 SOTA demo-free 方法，参数量远少，并在 18 个文本任务上超过 15-shot ICL 与既有 task vector，推理为零额外开销。
Motivation: ICL 每次查询都要重编码 demos，单张 demo 图可带来数百个视觉 token；现有 demo-free 方法要么按任务搜索插入位置，要么逐层插入导致任务参数随深度增长，且插入的 token/key 无法改变原 prompt 层内注意力划分。
Method: 提出 Structured Task Adaptation via Embeddings (STAVE)：仅用两个任务向量加到现有输入 embedding，readout 向量作用于答案 token、context 向量作用于其他结构 token 组，两者都用带与不带 demos 的 prompt 配答案标签训练；设计由损失的一阶分析与 margin bound 给出理论依据。
Result: 在六个 LMM 与五个 LLM 上的多模态任务匹配或超越 SOTA 方法且任务参数量远少；在 18 个文本任务上超过 15-shot ICL 与先前 task vector；推理为零额外开销。
Conclusion: 两个加在输入 embedding 上的任务向量足以替代 in-context demos，既省参数又把推理成本压到零，同时给出一阶损失分析与 margin bound 的设计依据。

papers.title: Unanimously Wrong: Certified Abstention from How Medical LLM Consensus Forms
papers.abstract_en: In clinical practice, agreement among independent experts is treated as evidence of reliability, and multi-round consensus has become a core mechanism of agentic medical question-answering systems. When such a system must decide whether to trust its own answer, the prevailing signal is again agreement, now among the sampled answers. But agreement is a fragile proxy for correctness. A system can be unanimously wrong, returning the same incorrect answer on every sample, and on these questions agreement-based signals carry no information. The cause is that these signals read only the final state of the consensus and discard how it was reached. Agreement that was reached by resolving disagreement with evidence looks identical, at the end, to agreement that was present from the first sample because every sample shares one misconception. ProbeGuard is a certified abstention framework that bases the abstention decision on how the consensus formed. Process features trace agreement trajectories, minority persistence, and retrieval saturation. For unanimous votes, rationale semantic entropy checks whether the reasons behind the vote cohere, and an active probe retrieves counter-evidence and measures whether the consensus survives. A stratified Learn-then-Test calibration then converts these scores into a distribution-free bound on selective risk. We evaluate ProbeGuard on three medical QA benchmarks and a hard-frontier reference, with a published multi-round agentic RAG substrate, against six abstention baselines. On MedQA, 13.4% of unanimous votes are wrong, and no agreement-based signal can flag them. Process signals raise the discrimination of correct from incorrect consensus from chance to 0.696 AUROC. The certified rule answers six in ten unanimous-layer questions at an observed selective risk of 9.0%, and nine in ten once in-domain calibration data accumulate.
papers.comment: Accepted at the GenAI4Health Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProbeGuard 用共识形成过程而非最终一致性来判定医学 LLM 是否该弃答：过程特征追踪一致轨迹、少数派持续性与检索饱和，全票时再做 rationale 语义熵与主动探针取反证，最后由分层 Learn-then-Test 标定成无分布选择性风险上界。MedQA 上 13.4% 的全票回答是错的，任何基于一致性的信号都无法识别；过程信号把正确/错误共识的区分度从随机提到 0.696 AUROC，认证规则在全票层回答约六成问题、观测选择性风险 9.0%，标定数据积累到域内后可回答九成。
Motivation: 多轮共识型 agentic 医疗问答把“一致”当作可信度代理，但一致可能从第一轮就源于同一误解，此时一致性信号对错误完全无信息，系统无法判断自己何时该弃答。
Method: ProbeGuard 是 certified abstention 框架：用过程特征刻画一致轨迹、少数派持续性与检索饱和；对全票投票计算 rationale 语义熵检查理由是否自洽，并用主动探针检索反证、度量共识能否存活；再用分层 Learn-then-Test 标定把上述分数转成无分布 (distribution-free) 的选择性风险上界。评测基于已发布的多轮 agentic RAG 底座，覆盖三个医学 QA 基准与一个 hard-frontier 参照集，对比六个弃答基线。
Result: MedQA 上 13.4% 的全票投票是错误的，且没有任何基于一致性的信号能标记它们；过程信号使正确与错误共识的区分度从随机水平升到 0.696 AUROC；认证规则在全票层回答约十分之六的问题，观测选择性风险 9.0%，当域内标定数据积累后可回答十分之九。
Conclusion: 共识是否可信取决于它如何形成而非最终是否一致，把过程信号纳入认证弃答规则才能在全票错误上给出可用的选择性风险保证。

papers.title: OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception
papers.abstract_en: Dense 3D mapping with semantic understanding is essential for robotic perception in complex environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting-based mapping approaches enable high-fidelity geometry and efficient open-vocabulary perception, but typically represent semantics as unstructured feature fields that limit object-centric reasoning. In contrast, 3D scene graphs explicitly model objects and their relationships for structured reasoning, but are commonly constructed from sparse geometric representations that do not fully exploit dense semantic maps. In this work, we present OpenSplatGraph, a unified framework that constructs persistent 3D scene graphs directly from an online Gaussian-based open-vocabulary semantic map. The proposed framework augments the dense semantic map with a reliability-aware semantic field that maintains lightweight observation statistics for confidence-aware, query-conditioned object extraction. Extracted object instances are associated with persistent graph nodes, allowing object attributes and relationships to be incrementally updated across observations and queries. By tightly coupling dense semantic mapping with persistent object-centric representations, our framework supports both language-guided object grounding and structured relational reasoning while preserving the geometric fidelity of Gaussian-based mapping. Comprehensive evaluations on standard 3D scene understanding benchmarks and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that OpenSplatGraph achieves competitive performance for online open-vocabulary perception and downstream robotic tasks. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/OpenSplatGraph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenSplatGraph 把在线 3D Gaussian Splatting 开放词汇语义地图直接转成持久 3D scene graph：用可靠性感知语义场维护轻量观测统计，做置信度感知、查询条件化的目标抽取，再把实例关联到持久图节点并跨观测与查询增量更新属性和关系。在标准 3D 场景理解基准与真实机器人实验上取得有竞争力的在线开放词汇感知与下游机器人任务表现。
Motivation: 3DGS 类方法几何与开放词汇感知好但语义是无结构特征场，难以做目标中心推理；scene graph 结构化却多从稀疏几何构建，未充分利用稠密语义地图。
Method: 在在线 Gaussian 开放词汇语义地图上叠加可靠性感知语义场，保存轻量观测统计以支持置信度感知、查询条件化的目标实例抽取；抽取结果关联到持久图节点，属性与关系随观测和查询增量更新，稠密语义映射与持久目标中心表示紧耦合。
Result: 在标准 3D 场景理解基准与真实机器人实验中，对在线开放词汇感知与下游机器人任务取得有竞争力的表现，并保持 Gaussian 映射的几何保真度。
Conclusion: 把稠密语义地图与持久目标中心 scene graph 紧耦合，可在不牺牲几何保真的前提下同时支持语言引导目标定位与结构化关系推理。

papers.title: AIMS: Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis for Scalable Novel View Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward novel view synthesis methods achieve strong generalization from posed multi-view inputs, but scaling them to large input view sets remains challenging. Transformer-based approaches that jointly process all input-view tokens incur rapidly increasing computation and memory as the number of views grows, while simple view subsampling discards potentially useful observations. We introduce Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis (AIMS), a scalable framework that decouples the number of available observations from the number of views processed by the global synthesis model. AIMS selects a fixed set of spatially distributed anchor views using farthest point sampling, groups nearby observations around each anchor, and uses a lightweight learnable integrator to fuse their information into enriched anchor representations. This allows additional observations to contribute to synthesis while keeping the downstream global view budget fixed. Evaluations on RealEstate10K and ScanNet demonstrate a favorable quality--efficiency trade-off against transformer-based and Gaussian-based baselines. AIMS achieves 29.41 dB and 17.73 dB PSNR on the two datasets, respectively, with rendering averaging 7.24 ms per view.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AIMS 用 farthest point sampling 选一组空间分布的 anchor 视角，把邻近观测交给轻量可学习 integrator 融合成增强的 anchor 表示，从而把可用观测数与全局合成模型处理的视角数解耦。在 RealEstate10K 与 ScanNet 上分别取得 29.41 dB 与 17.73 dB PSNR，每视角渲染平均 7.24 ms，相对 transformer 与 Gaussian 基线取得更优的质量-效率折中。
Motivation: 前馈式新视角合成 (feed-forward novel view synthesis) 在输入视角增多时，Transformer 联合处理全部视角 token 的计算与内存随视角数急剧膨胀，而简单子采样又丢弃有用观测。
Method: AIMS 用 farthest point sampling 选取固定数量、空间分布的 anchor 视角；围绕每个 anchor 对邻近观测分组，用轻量可学习 integrator 将其融合为增强的 anchor 表示；下游全局合成模型的视角预算保持固定，额外观测仍参与合成。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K 上 PSNR 29.41 dB，在 ScanNet 上 PSNR 17.73 dB；每视角渲染平均 7.24 ms；相对 transformer-based 与 Gaussian-based 基线呈现更优的质量-效率折中。
Conclusion: 把观测数量与全局合成模型处理的视角数解耦，可以在不膨胀全局视角预算的前提下吸收更多输入观测，实现可扩展的新视角渲染。

papers.title: Complementary Feature Domains: Information Preservation Does Not Imply Predictive-Contribution Preservation
papers.abstract_en: Complementary Feature Domains (CFD) theory characterizes predictive value as a context-indexed contribution system induced jointly by representations and their realization family. We show that Shannon-information preservation does not imply preservation of this contribution system: an invertible representation transformation can leave target information unchanged while altering predictive contribution under a restricted decision family. We formalize the resulting transition through a CFD contribution defect that measures how contextual contributions change under controlled recoding. For bounded Lipschitz utility, we show that each coalition utility shift is bounded by the behavioral distance between the attainable action sets before and after recoding; consequently, every contextual contribution defect is bounded by the sum of the corresponding coalition incompatibilities. Exact behavioral closure yields invariance, while increasingly accurate compensation yields restoration. A controlled ECG experiment illustrates the mechanism: a nonlinear bijective recoding preserves the information in a frozen time-frequency representation but changes accuracy under a fixed affine learner; applying the exact inverse restores all tested coalition accuracies. The result separates information preservation from realization-dependent contribution and provides a quantitative transition law for multi-representation prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CFD 理论证明：可逆表示变换即使完全保留 Shannon 信息，也会在受限决策族下改变预测贡献；对有界 Lipschitz 效用，贡献缺陷被行动集行为距离与联盟不相容之和界定，精确行为闭合带来不变性、精确补偿带来恢复。冻结时频表示上的非线性双射重编码在固定 affine learner 下改变精度，施加精确逆变换后全部受测联盟精度恢复。
Motivation: 多表示预测中常把信息保留当作预测贡献保留，但二者在受限决策族下并不等价，缺少刻画重编码下贡献变化的形式化度量。
Method: 提出 Complementary Feature Domains (CFD) 贡献缺陷度量，量化受控重编码下上下文贡献的变化；对有界 Lipschitz 效用证明每个联盟效用偏移被重编码前后可达行动集的行为距离界定，贡献缺陷被联盟不相容之和界定；用冻结时频表示上的非线性双射重编码与固定 affine learner 做受控 ECG 实验。
Result: 可逆重编码在固定 affine learner 下改变精度；施加精确逆变换后恢复全部受测联盟精度。理论上给出贡献缺陷的上界（行为距离与联盟不相容之和），并区分精确行为闭合（不变）与渐近精确补偿（恢复）。

papers.title: Learning a Mixture of GFlowNets
papers.abstract_en: Learning an ensemble of GFlowNets to sample from a discrete target distribution has become a common approach for achieving better state space exploration and convergence than that of a monolithic sampler. However, these methods often add a substantial runtime overhead to the base model, and their conceptual connection remains elusive. To address this, we first propose a general-purpose theoretical framework for describing a mixture of GFlowNets, which we specialize into continuously (CI) and discretely indexed (DI) collections. On the one hand, we show CI GFlowNets can be interpreted through the lens of a random features expansion, provably boosting the sampler's expressivity in graph-structured tasks and reducing learning instability via spectral shifting. On the other hand, we demonstrate DI GFlowNets encompass prior approaches for GFlowNet training and provide the foundation for the newly proposed Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets. This method, which is inspired by the Doob's h-transform of Markov chains, decomposes the state space according to a prescribed modular function and restricts each component to sample from a distinct subset of it. Importantly, SC GFlowNets support centralized and component-wise embarrassingly parallel training, and we show both of them significantly speed up learning convergence and mode coverage without introducing any non-negligible extra computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GFlowNet 混合体的统一理论框架，把连续索引 (CI) 与离散索引 (DI) 两类集合分开刻画：CI 版本可用随机特征展开 (random features expansion) 解释，通过谱移位 (spectral shifting) 提升图结构任务上的表达力并降低学习不稳定；DI 版本涵盖既有训练方法并支撑新提出的 Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets。SC 借鉴 Markov 链的 Doob's h-transform，按给定模块化函数分解状态空间、每个分量只在自己的子集上采样，支持集中式与分量级 embarrassingly parallel 训练，作者称两种方式都显著加快收敛与 mode coverage 且几乎不引入额外计算。
Motivation: 用 GFlowNet 集合采样离散目标分布虽能改善状态空间探索与收敛，但通常给基础模型带来可观的运行时开销，且各方法之间的概念联系不清晰。
Method: 先给出描述 GFlowNet 混合体的一般理论框架，再特化为连续索引 (CI) 与离散索引 (DI) 两种集合；CI 用随机特征展开解释并以谱移位提升图结构任务表达力，DI 归纳既有 GFlowNet 训练方法并导出 Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets——按预设模块化函数分解状态空间、各分量限定采样不同子集，灵感来自 Doob's h-transform，支持集中式与分量级并行训练。
Result: 理论性结果：CI GFlowNet 经随机特征展开可证明地提升图结构任务上的采样器表达力，并通过谱移位减少学习不稳定；DI GFlowNet 覆盖既有 GFlowNet 训练方法。作者报告 SC GFlowNets 的集中式与 embarrassingly parallel 两种训练方式都显著加快学习收敛与 mode coverage，且不引入不可忽略的额外计算。
Conclusion: GFlowNet 混合体可由统一框架按索引类型解释，而按状态空间分层条件化 (SC) 是在不增加明显计算开销的前提下同时改善收敛与 mode coverage 的做法。

papers.title: LARK: A Low-Cost, Accurate, Occlusion-Resilient, Kalman Filter-Assisted Tracking System for Image-Guided Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Image-guided surgery (IGS) depends on accurate tracking of surgical instruments to provide real-time navigation relative to anatomical structures. Commercial stereo infrared trackers are accurate but prone to occlusion and cost-prohibitive for many settings. This work presents LARK, a multi-camera optical tracking system using commodity RGB hardware and multi-view redundancy and fusion. We develop and evaluate two complete tracking methods: multi-view monocular pose fusion and multi-view triangulation. Both methods are assessed under varying occlusion levels using a precision-machined grid and an anatomical head phantom, and compared against a gold-standard stereo infrared system. With five cameras and adaptive Kalman filtering, LARK achieves median target registration errors of 0.64 mm for point localization with triangulation and 0.73 mm for trajectory tracking with pose fusion on the machined grid. Camera-subset experiments show graceful degradation in adaptive pose-fusion accuracy as fewer views remain available. With tracking hardware costing under $1,000 USD, LARK provides a low-cost platform for image-guided surgery research. Hardware designs and software are publicly available at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/software/ , and datasets at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/data/ .
papers.comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, including appendices. Supplementary document included as an ancillary file. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/ApZ8q9DjB-4
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LARK 用五台消费级 RGB 相机加自适应 Kalman 滤波做多视角融合与三角化，在遮挡条件下替代昂贵的双目红外光学跟踪系统：精密加工网格上点定位中位目标配准误差 (TRE) 0.64 mm（三角化），轨迹跟踪 0.73 mm（位姿融合），硬件成本低于 1000 美元。可用视角减少时精度平缓退化。
Motivation: 图像引导手术依赖器械相对解剖结构的实时跟踪，商用双目红外跟踪器精度高但易受遮挡影响且价格昂贵，许多场景无法负担。
Method: LARK 是多相机光学跟踪系统：多视角单目位姿融合与多视角三角化两条完整方法，配合自适应 Kalman 滤波；在不同遮挡水平下用精密加工网格与解剖头部体模评估，并与金标准双目红外系统对比。
Result: 五相机 + 自适应 Kalman 下，加工网格点定位中位 TRE 0.64 mm（三角化），轨迹跟踪中位 TRE 0.73 mm（位姿融合）；相机子集实验显示可用视角减少时自适应位姿融合精度平缓退化；跟踪硬件成本低于 1000 美元。

papers.title: Navigating Route Latent Space for Synthesizable Molecular Design
papers.abstract_en: Goal-directed molecular design has advanced rapidly, yet a substantial proportion of designed molecules remain difficult to synthesize in practice, limiting their real-world utility. Prior synthesizability-aware methods either project generated molecules back to synthesizable analogs that deviate from the intended target, or optimize directly in discrete synthesis spaces that lack a continuous landscape for efficient search. We argue that this limitation mainly comes from the search space rather than the optimizer. To address this, we propose RouteFlow, a framework that reformulates synthesizable molecular design as a search over a continuous route latent space, where each latent maps back to a complete synthesis route and synthesizability is inherently preserved. To navigate this space, we adopt reward-guided flow matching as an efficient sampler that steers toward high-property regions. Since reward optimization may push latents off the manifold of real synthesis routes, where decoding becomes unreliable, we further introduce a cycle-consistency mechanism to stabilize fine-tuning. Across 16 optimization tasks from Therapeutic Data Commons, RouteFlow achieves the best sample efficiency among synthesizability-aware baselines, with the best synthetic accessibility and the highest retrosynthesis success rate. Our results also confirm that the proposed cycle-consistency reliably keeps optimization on-manifold while improving target properties, supporting effective synthesizable molecular discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RouteFlow 把可合成分子设计改写为在连续 route latent space 上的搜索，每个 latent 解码回完整合成路线，可合成性由构造保证；用 reward-guided flow matching 采样推向高性质区域，并以 cycle-consistency 约束微调不偏离真实路线流形。在 Therapeutic Data Commons 的 16 个优化任务上，它在可合成性感知基线中样本效率最佳，取得最好的合成可及性与最高的逆合成成功率。
Motivation: 目标导向分子设计中大量生成分子实际难以合成；已有方法要么把生成结构投影到偏离目标的可合成类似物上，要么在离散合成空间里优化、缺少可供高效搜索的连续地形。
Method: RouteFlow 将可合成分子设计重构为连续 route latent space 上的搜索，latent 到完整合成路线的解码使可合成性天然保持；采样用 reward-guided flow matching 引导至高性质区域，针对奖励优化把 latent 推离真实路线流形导致解码不可靠的问题，加入 cycle-consistency 机制稳定微调。
Result: 在 Therapeutic Data Commons 的 16 个优化任务上，RouteFlow 在可合成性感知基线中取得最佳样本效率，同时拿到最好的 synthetic accessibility 与最高的 retrosynthesis success rate；cycle-consistency 被验证能可靠地把优化保持在流形上并同时提升目标性质。
Conclusion: 可合成性的瓶颈在搜索空间而非优化器：把合成路线做成连续 latent 空间并用流形约束稳定奖励优化，就能在保持可合成性的同时提升目标性质。

papers.title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextual representations, with a task-conditioned gate modulating the final hidden-state update. This enables task-adaptive iterative refinement. Together, these components encourage the model to identify predictive relationships from contextual contrasts during pretraining and dynamically modulate context integration for each task. Across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets, TAFFY attains the lowest average rank.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TAFFY 用 In-Context Diversity Prior 在共享因果过程上做受控干预与分布偏移、采样多个相关环境来构造合成预训练上下文，配合 Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer 迭代细化上下文表征并由任务条件门控调制最终隐状态更新。在六个分类与五个回归基准上取得最低平均排名。
Motivation: 表格基础模型在合成任务上训练可提升上下文学习，但性能取决于模型能否从推理时的上下文中推断任务特定的预测关系，这一能力此前缺少针对性的结构与数据设计。

Result: 在六个分类和五个回归基准数据集上，TAFFY 取得最低平均排名 (lowest average rank)。
Conclusion: 通过上下文对比识别预测关系、并按任务动态调制上下文整合，可在分类与回归基准上把表格基础模型的整体排名做到最低。

papers.title: Seeing the Invisible: Physics-Guided Visual Prompting for Temperature- and Radiation-Aware VLA Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a major paradigm for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN). However, in safety-critical facilities, invisible risks such as radiation or temperature spikes cannot be detected by an RGB camera, and handling each risk is expensive, requiring a new encoder, new data, and model retraining. We propose Physics-Guided Visual Prompting (PG-VP), a plug-and-play multimodal perception module that instead reuses what a frozen VLA model already does well: avoiding visible obstacles. Given a proximal radiation or thermal source, PG-VP performs a physics-guided risk assessment to determine the avoidance direction and overlays a corresponding virtual obstacle that moves across consecutive frames (Dynamic Visual Prompting). The navigation policy then naturally detours around this invisible hazard. The identical virtual obstacle is used regardless of hazard type, so the visual prompting pattern remains fixed as sensors are added. When no hazard is detected, nothing is rendered, and the policy behaves exactly as it would without PG-VP. We evaluate PG-VP on OmniNav using the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, where it guides the policy toward intended low-risk actions in 84.9% and 83.2% of cases, at a cost of 6.8 and 7.9 percentage points in navigation success rate. We further test it with distinct scenarios on a real robot in the presence of actual thermal and radiation sources, all without any retraining. The real test shows that PG-VP effectively avoids these invisible hazards, improving worst-10% average trajectory safety by 63.45% and 32.59% against thermal and radiation sources, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Physics-Guided Visual Prompting (PG-VP)：把辐射、温度等 RGB 看不见的风险转成冻结 VLA 模型已会躲避的虚拟障碍，叠加到连续帧上引导绕行，无需换编码器、新数据或重训练。在 OmniNav 上，R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 中分别有 84.9% 和 83.2% 的案例被导向低风险动作，代价是导航成功率下降 6.8 和 7.9 个百分点；真机测试中 worst-10% 平均轨迹安全性相对热源、辐射源分别提升 63.45% 和 32.59%。
Motivation: 安全关键设施中辐射、温度骤升等不可见风险无法被 RGB 相机察觉，而常规处理方式需要新编码器、新数据和模型重训练，代价高。
Method: PG-VP 是即插即用的多模态感知模块：对邻近辐射或热源做物理引导的风险评估以确定避让方向，把对应虚拟障碍以 Dynamic Visual Prompting 方式叠加到连续帧上；不同风险类型复用同一虚拟障碍图案，无风险时不渲染任何内容，导航策略保持原样。
Result: 在 OmniNav 上按 R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 评测，PG-VP 在 84.9% 和 83.2% 的案例中引导策略采取预期低风险动作，导航成功率代价分别为 6.8 和 7.9 个百分点；真机上面对实际热源与辐射源、全程不重训练，worst-10% 平均轨迹安全性分别提升 63.45% 和 32.59%。
Conclusion: 把不可见物理风险投影为冻结 VLA 已有的避障行为，可在不重训练的前提下提升导航对热与辐射危险的规避，代价是成功率下降数个百分点。

papers.title: CheckerBench: Can Long-Horizon Agents Synthesize Static-Analysis Checkers?
papers.abstract_en: Static-analysis checker synthesis requires agents to interpret a defect specification, inspect a repository, implement analyzer-specific logic, and refine the checker through repeated compilation and analysis feedback. Existing coding-agent benchmarks focus on tasks such as patch generation or vulnerability detection and rarely assess whether an agent can develop a working checker in a repository from start to finish. We introduce CheckerBench, an executable benchmark of 300 tasks derived from 297 CVEs across 167 repositories, 85 CWEs, and five language ecosystems. Each task includes vulnerable and fixed revisions, a pinned analysis environment, and a checker scaffold. We further introduce CheckerLab, a common evaluation framework that independently rebuilds submitted checkers and measures vulnerable-fixed diagnostic contrast, patch localization, false positives, and tool use. Across 21 model-harness configurations and three independent repeats per configuration, mean Pass@1 is 32.30%, while the best reaches 45.33%. These results show that reliable, reusable checker development remains challenging for current coding agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CheckerBench 提出可执行的静态分析 checker 合成基准，含 300 个任务、来自 297 个 CVE、167 个仓库、85 个 CWE 和五种语言生态，每个任务带易修版本、固定分析环境与 checker 脚手架。配套 CheckerLab 独立重建提交的 checker 并度量易修诊断对比、补丁定位、误报与工具使用；在 21 个模型-框架配置、每配置三次重复下平均 Pass@1 仅 32.30%，最好配置 45.33%。
Motivation: 现有 coding-agent 基准多聚焦补丁生成或漏洞检测，很少检验 agent 能否在真实仓库里从零到一做出可运行的 checker。
Method: 构建 CheckerBench：300 个任务源自 297 个 CVE、167 个仓库、85 个 CWE、五种语言生态，每任务含 vulnerable/fixed 两个版本、pinned 分析环境与 checker 脚手架；配套 CheckerLab 评测框架独立重建提交的 checker，度量 vulnerable-fixed 诊断对比、补丁定位、误报与工具使用。
Result: 在 21 个模型-框架配置、每配置三次独立重复下，平均 Pass@1 为 32.30%，最佳配置达 45.33%。
Conclusion: 当前 coding-agent 在可靠、可复用的 checker 开发上仍然吃力，最好的配置也只覆盖不到一半任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decoupled Multi-Agent Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Learned orchestration can automatically construct effective language-model multi-agent systems, but existing approaches couple planning to fixed worker pools and train decomposition and collaboration from the same terminal outcome, limiting transfer and obscuring credit assignment. We introduce DeOrch, which separates worker-agnostic planning from concrete worker selection. Its two-stage planner first decomposes the task without worker information, then chooses collaboration operations using compact, worker-identity-free matchability feedback from the pool, enabling conditional credit assignment to decomposition and collaboration decisions. A lightweight matcher estimates worker suitability from behavior on a fixed probe set and adapts online with a contextual bandit, allowing new workers to be incorporated without retraining the planner or matcher. Across diverse in- and out-of-distribution tasks, DeOrch outperforms prior automatic MAS orchestration methods with fewer worker calls than competing learned orchestrators, remains effective when transferred to an entirely unseen worker pool without retraining, and shows consistent gains from both components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeOrch 把多智能体系统 (MAS) 编排拆成与 worker 无关的规划和具体 worker 选择两步：两阶段 planner 先不看 worker 信息分解任务，再依据紧凑、不含 worker 身份的 matchability 反馈选择协作操作，从而对分解与协作决策做条件化 credit assignment。轻量 matcher 用固定 probe set 上的行为估计 worker 适配度并以 contextual bandit 在线更新，新 worker 无需重训 planner 或 matcher；在分布内与分布外任务上，DeOrch 用更少 worker 调用超过既有自动 MAS 编排方法，迁移到完全未见的 worker 池仍有效，两个组件各自带来一致增益。
Motivation: 现有 learned orchestration 把规划耦合到固定 worker 池，并用同一个终端 outcome 同时训练分解与协作，既限制迁移又掩盖 credit assignment。
Method: DeOrch 两阶段 planner：第一阶段在不使用 worker 信息的条件下分解任务，第二阶段依据来自 worker 池的紧凑、worker-identity-free matchability 反馈选择协作操作，使分解与协作决策获得条件化 credit assignment；另配轻量 matcher，从固定 probe set 上的行为估计 worker 适配度，并用 contextual bandit 在线适应。
Result: 在多样化的分布内与分布外任务上，DeOrch 以更少 worker 调用优于既有自动 MAS 编排方法；迁移到完全未见的 worker 池且不重训仍保持有效；分解与协作两个组件各自都带来一致增益。
Conclusion: 把 worker 无关规划与 worker 选择解耦，配合在线适配的 matcher，可在不重训的前提下跨 worker 池迁移并改善 credit assignment。

papers.title: Global Transport Couplings for Classifier-Free Guided Flows
papers.abstract_en: Optimal-transport couplings have been shown to reduce training variance in unconditional flow models, but their role in conditional generation remains unclear. A natural approach constructs separate couplings for each condition, but this is impractical for large or continuous conditioning spaces found in modern image foundation models. We introduce Global Transport (GT), a global class-agnostic optimal-transport coupling, computed without class labels. GT can associate different conditions with different regions of the source noise, and consequently worsens performance without guidance. However, when combined with classifier-free guidance (CFG), GT consistently improves generation across domains, model scales, and sampling budgets. This reversal suggests that couplings for conditional flows should be evaluated both empirically and theoretically under the guided flow used at inference, rather than on unguided generation. We evaluate GT over both discrete class and continuous text conditioned image generation across model scales, and investigate how coupling choice alters guided trajectories. These results identify coupling design in the guided flow setting as a simple training time axis to improve performance without modifying existing architectures, samplers, or guidance mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出全局传输 (Global Transport, GT)：一种不依赖类别标签的全局类无关最优传输耦合，用于条件流模型训练。GT 单独使用会因把不同条件绑定到源噪声的不同区域而降低无引导生成性能，但与 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 结合后在多个领域、模型规模和采样预算上一致提升生成质量。作者据此主张条件流的耦合设计应在推理所用的引导流下评估，而非在无引导生成上评估。
Motivation: 最优传输耦合已被证明能降低无条件流模型的训练方差，但其在条件生成中的作用尚不清楚；为每个条件分别构造耦合的做法在现代图像基础模型的大规模或连续条件空间下不可行。
Method: 提出 Global Transport (GT)：不使用类标签、全局共享的类无关最优传输耦合，可将不同条件关联到源噪声的不同区域；与 classifier-free guidance (CFG) 联合训练与采样，并考察耦合选择如何改变引导轨迹。
Result: GT 在无引导下会恶化性能，但与 CFG 结合后在跨领域、跨模型规模、跨采样预算的条件下一致改善生成；在离散类别条件与连续文本条件的图像生成上、跨多个模型规模进行了评估。
Conclusion: 条件流的耦合必须在推理时实际使用的引导流下做经验与理论评估；引导流设定下的耦合设计是一个无需改动架构、采样器或引导机制的训练期改进轴。

papers.title: Which and When to Admit: Gradient Admission for Data-Centric Small Language Model Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: LoRA fine-tuning adapts small language models (SLMs) to heterogeneous instruction data within a low-rank update subspace, making it vulnerable to three structural problems: conflicting gradients that cancel, static data selection that cannot track evolving learning dynamics, and subspace saturation that causes later updates to overwrite useful directions. We argue that effective adaptation therefore requires controlling which data-induced gradients enter the LoRA subspace and when. We propose GRADE (GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe), a data-centric framework combining two mechanisms: a state-aware selector that continually admits samples aligned with the evolving multi-task gradient field, and a self-calibrating step-level gate that rejects updates likely to cause destructive overwrite near saturation. Across three current-generation backbones and a heterogeneous seven-dataset instruction pool, GRADE outperforms strong data-selection and PEFT-stabilization baselines in accuracy and robustness. It is the only method to improve consistently over standard LoRA on every architecture, while producing more coherent gradient trajectories and less destructive overwrite. These results show that successful SLM adaptation depends not only on which data are selected, but also on which gradients are allowed to enter and persist in the constrained update subspace.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GRADE 是面向小语言模型 (SLM) LoRA 微调的数据中心框架，用状态感知选择器持续接纳与演化中的多任务梯度场对齐的样本，再用自校准步级门控拒绝在子空间接近饱和时会造成破坏性覆写的更新。在三代 backbone 与七数据集异构指令池上，GRADE 在准确率与鲁棒性上超过强数据选择与 PEFT 稳定化基线，且是唯一在每种架构上都稳定优于标准 LoRA 的方法。
Motivation: LoRA 在低秩子空间内适配异构指令数据时有三个结构性问题：相互冲突的梯度互相抵消、静态数据选择跟不上学习动态演化、子空间饱和导致后续覆写有用方向。
Method: GRADE (GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe) 组合两个机制：状态感知选择器按与演化中多任务梯度场的对齐程度持续接纳样本；自校准步级门控在接近饱和时拒绝可能造成破坏性覆写的更新。
Result: 在三代 backbone 与七数据集异构指令池上，GRADE 在准确率与鲁棒性上超过强数据选择与 PEFT 稳定化基线；它是唯一在每种架构上都一致优于标准 LoRA 的方法，并产生更连贯的梯度轨迹与更少的破坏性覆写。
Conclusion: SLM 适配成败不仅取决于选哪些数据，还取决于哪些梯度被允许进入并保留在受限更新子空间中。

papers.title: Is $\sqrt{d}$ Separation Necessary for Gradient EM to Learn Gaussian Mixtures in High Dimensions?
papers.abstract_en: Learning Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) using the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm and its gradient-based variants is a fundamental problem in machine learning. It is known that randomly initialized (gradient) EM fails to learn multi-component GMMs in the exact-parameterized setting, where the number of components matches that of the ground-truth GMM. Recently, global convergence of gradient EM has been established in the over-parameterized setting, where more components are used, provided that the ground-truth components are well separated. In particular, the minimum separation between ground-truth components is required to scale as $Ω(\sqrt{d})$, where $d$ is the dimension. In this paper, we show that this dimensional dependence is unavoidable in high-dimensional settings. Specifically, we consider a hybrid EM algorithm that uses standard EM updates for the mixing weights and gradient EM updates for the component means. For any $ε> 0$, we prove that when the dimension is sufficiently large, in the worst case a separation of order $Ω(d^{0.5-ε})$ is insufficient to guarantee global convergence of population gradient EM in sub-exponential time under random initialization, even in the over-parameterized regime. Our result establishes an almost optimal worst-case lower bound on the ground-truth separation required for learning Gaussian mixtures via gradient EM in high dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 证明高维高斯混合 (GMM) 上 gradient EM 的 √d 分离度要求不可改进：对混合权重用标准 EM 更新、均值用 gradient EM 更新的 hybrid EM，任意 ε>0，当维度足够大时，最坏情形下 Ω(d^{0.5-ε}) 的分离度仍不足以在随机初始化下保证 population gradient EM 于次指数时间内全局收敛，即便在过参数化设定下也如此。
Motivation: 已知过参数化 gradient EM 的全局收敛要求真实成分间最小分离度为 Ω(√d)，但该维度依赖是否必要并不清楚；本文说明这一依赖在高维最坏情形下不可避免。
Method: 研究 hybrid EM：混合权重用标准 EM 更新，成分均值用 gradient EM 更新；在过参数化设定（成分数多于真实成分数）与随机初始化下，对 population gradient EM 构造最坏情形下界，针对次指数时间内的全局收敛给出证明。
Result: 对任意 ε>0，维度足够大时，最坏情形需要的分离度为 Ω(d^{0.5-ε}) 才能保证 population gradient EM 在次指数时间内全局收敛；即使 Ω(d^{0.5-ε}) 也不足，即使在过参数化设定下亦然。该下界相对 Ω(√d) 要求几乎最优。
Conclusion: 高维 GMM 上 gradient EM 所需的 √d 分离度是本质的：任何低于 √d 阶（差一个 d^{-ε} 因子）的分离度在最坏情形下都无法保证随机初始化的快速全局收敛，构成近最优的最坏情形下界。

papers.title: Foundation Model-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Random Access Network Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Random access (RA) is one of the most foundational medium access control (MAC) layer scheduling schemes for handling unpredictable data traffic from multiple terminals. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has been explored to optimize RA-based wireless networks, its reliance on experience-driven, distributed policy learning incurs significant training overhead for each optimization task, limiting its feasibility in real-world applications. In this work, we propose to leverage a foundation model (FM) to improve MARL efficiency across diverse RA network optimization tasks. Specifically, we design an FM-aided actor-critic algorithm within a consensus-based decentralized MARL architecture and provide its convergence analysis under local reward exchanges and nonlinear value function approximations to show that our algorithm achieves the same convergence order as the conventional MARL with critic model exchanges and linear approximations. Our numerical results show that our FM-based approach significantly enhances MARL speed for RA network optimization.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted in ACM International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing (MobiHoc) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在共识式去中心化 MARL 中引入 foundation model 来加速无线随机接入 (RA) 网络优化的策略学习，提出 FM 辅助 actor-critic 算法，并给出在局部奖励交换与非线性值函数逼近下的收敛性分析，收敛阶与传统 critic 模型交换加线性逼近的 MARL 相同；数值结果显示训练速度显著提升。
Motivation: MARL 优化 RA 网络依赖经验驱动的分布式策略学习，每个优化任务都要付出大量训练开销，难以落地到真实网络。
Method: 在 consensus-based 去中心化 MARL 架构内设计 FM-aided actor-critic 算法，用 foundation model 提升跨多种 RA 网络优化任务的 MARL 效率；收敛性分析设定为仅交换局部奖励且值函数用非线性逼近。
Result: 收敛阶与传统 MARL（交换 critic 模型 + 线性逼近）相同；数值结果表明 FM-based 方法显著加快 RA 网络优化的 MARL 训练速度。
Conclusion: foundation model 可以在不牺牲收敛阶的前提下降低去中心化 MARL 的训练开销，使 RA 网络优化更可行。

papers.title: A Systematic Investigation of Bias in Large Language Models for Advertising Relevance
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to judge how well an advertisement matches a query, but the fairness of these judgments has received limited attention. We conduct a systematic study of fairness in relevance judgments made by LLMs for queries and advertisements. Our counterfactual framework examines the effects of advertiser identity and possible popularity, input language, and demographic wording. We study GPT-4o as a categorical relevance judge and a Qwen-7B model trained specifically for relevance prediction. The advertiser and language experiments use query and advertisement pairs sampled from real advertising logs. Controlled synthetic queries are used to study demographic associations in employment, housing, and credit. For both models, changing the advertiser identity or input language can alter the relevance assessment. Selected demographic comparisons also show patterns consistent with common stereotypes, particularly those involving gender and occupation. We further study mitigation during model inference and training. The results indicate that its effectiveness depends on whether advertiser information is relevant to the query and how advertiser labels are distributed in the training data. These findings can help advertising practitioners identify fairness risks and develop suitable mitigation methods for LLM relevance systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对 LLM 广告相关性判定做反事实公平性研究：改变广告主身份或输入语言会改变 GPT-4o 与 Qwen-7B 的相关性判断，人口统计措辞对比呈现与常见刻板印象一致的模式（尤其性别与职业）。推理期与训练期缓解手段是否有效，取决于广告主信息对该查询是否真的相关，以及训练数据中广告主标签的分布。
Motivation: LLM 被用来判定广告与查询的匹配度，但这类判定的公平性关注不足，广告主身份、语言与人口统计措辞可能系统性地左右结果。
Method: 构建反事实框架，考察广告主身份与可能的流行度、输入语言、人口统计措辞三类扰动；以 GPT-4o 作为分类式相关性判定器，并用专门训练的 Qwen-7B 做相关性预测；广告主与语言实验用真实广告日志采样的查询-广告对，人口统计关联用就业、住房、信贷领域的受控合成查询；另研究推理期与训练期的缓解方法。
Result: 两个模型上，改变广告主身份或输入语言都会改变相关性评估；选定的人口统计对比呈现与常见刻板印象一致的模式，尤其涉及性别与职业；缓解手段的效果取决于广告主信息是否与查询相关，以及训练数据中广告主标签的分布。
Conclusion: LLM 广告相关性判定存在可被反事实扰动触发的公平性风险，缓解方法必须按广告主信息的相关性与标签分布来选择，才能帮从业者识别风险并设计合适方案。

papers.title: Satellite observations of nitrous oxide emissions from adipic acid production
papers.abstract_en: The production of adipic acid generates nitrous oxide as a by-product, which, if emitted, very effectively warms the climate and depletes the stratospheric ozone layer. There exists cost-effective technology to mitigate these nitrous oxide emissions from adipic acid production, but the degree of implementation of this technology, most notably at sites in China, is uncertain. Using satellite observations from summer 2026, we quantify nitrous oxide emissions from three adipic acid production sites in China, finding emissions that total over half a million tonnes per year, a rate that implies limited emissions abatement. With respect to climate change, eliminating the annual emissions from just these three sites would be equivalent to eliminating the annual emissions from 49 coal-fired power plants or 43 million gas-powered vehicles in the United States.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 2026 年夏季卫星观测量化中国三处己二酸生产厂的 N2O 排放，合计超过每年 50 万吨，说明现有减排技术在这些厂基本没有落实。折算下来，仅关停这三处的年排放量即相当于美国 49 座燃煤电厂或 4300 万辆燃油车的年排放。
Motivation: 己二酸生产副产 N2O，增温与平流层臭氧消耗都很强，且已有低成本减排技术，但实际安装率、尤其中国厂点的落实程度不确定。
Method: 以 2026 年夏季卫星观测对中国三处己二酸生产厂做 N2O 排放量化，并将年排放量折算为燃煤电厂与燃油车的等效排放当量。
Result: 三处厂点排放合计超过每年 50 万吨，对应减排程度有限；等效于美国 49 座燃煤电厂或 4300 万辆燃油车的年排放。
Conclusion: 中国这三处己二酸厂的 N2O 排放量级表明低成本减排技术落地不足，卫星观测可直接约束厂级排放。

papers.title: Preserving Unstable Modes Through Inverse Dynamics in JEPA World Models
papers.abstract_en: Robotic systems often exhibit unstable modes, along which small perturbations and disturbances can cause unbounded growth unless corrected through feedback. Controlling such systems from high-dimensional visual observations requires representations that preserve these modes. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) provide a natural framework for learning such representations and their dynamics from visual data. However, we demonstrate that next step prediction combined with anti-collapse regularization does not guarantee that controllable unstable modes are preserved: the training loss can be minimized while these modes are collapsed, making stabilization from the learned representation impossible. To address this, we augment world-model training with an action reconstruction objective (i.e., an inverse dynamics loss) that encourages control-aware representations, namely, visual representations that preserve crucial features for control. We prove that exact action reconstruction makes the encoder injective on the finite-horizon reachable subspace. Thus, the encoder cannot discard any state direction reachable by an action sequence within $H$ steps. Moreover, we show that, as $H$ grows, the dominant eigenspace of the finite-horizon controllability Gramian converges to the controllable unstable subspace. We establish our theoretical results for linear systems and demonstrate empirically that our findings extend to nonlinear visual control tasks (CartPole, Walker2D, and PointMaze), highlighting the benefits of control-aware representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 JEPA 世界模型中，下一步预测加防坍缩正则并不能保证可控不稳定模态被保留：训练损失可以降到很低而这些模态已被坍缩，导致基于学到的表示无法完成镇定。加入逆动力学（action reconstruction）目标后，精确动作重建使编码器在有限时域可达子空间上单射，且随预测时域 H 增大，有限时域可控性 Gramian 的主特征空间收敛到可控不稳定子空间。
Motivation: 机器人系统沿不稳定模态的小扰动会无界增长，必须靠反馈镇定；而从高维视觉观测做控制需要保留这些模态的表示，现有 JEPA 训练目标并不保证这一点。
Method: 在 JEPA 世界模型训练中加入逆动力学损失（action reconstruction），鼓励控制感知表示；理论上对线性系统证明精确动作重建使编码器在 H 步有限时域可达子空间上单射，并证明 H 增大时有限时域可控性 Gramian 主特征空间收敛到可控不稳定子空间；实证上在 CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze 等非线性视觉控制任务上检验。
Result: 证明了精确动作重建下编码器在有限时域可达子空间单射，任何 H 步内可达的状态方向都不会被丢弃；H 增大时可控性 Gramian 主特征空间收敛到可控不稳定子空间；在 CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze 三个非线性视觉控制任务上给出经验证据，表明结论可扩展到非线性情形。

papers.title: Disentangling Models from Personas in Heterogeneous LLM Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent simulations with large language models (LLMs) often operate networks of agents with a single base model. This overlooks the inter-model effects which may dominate engagement dynamics in real-world deployments. To show this, we simulate a heterogeneous social network powered by several different base models and show that the amount of engagement an agent receives depends more on its base model than on its assigned persona. The attraction or repulsion effects of a base model strengthen dramatically when more models are added in the mix, suggesting that networks dynamics may converge to base model effects at scale. To help explain this effect, we conduct a series of content-mediating analyses, showing the predictability of base models across contexts as well as the relationship between a model's lexical patterns and an engagement-maximizing style. In light of recent developments in mass multi-agent interaction, this work underscores the relevance of heterogeneous compositions in driving the outcomes of those networks
papers.comment: Presented as a Spotlight Paper at the Second Workshop on Social Simulation with LLMS, Third Conference on Language Modeling, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多智能体 LLM 社会网络仿真中，把网络换成由多个不同 base model 驱动的异构配置后，一个 agent 获得的 engagement 更多取决于它背后的 base model 而非被分配的 persona；且混入的模型越多，base model 的吸引/排斥效应越强，网络动力学在规模上可能收敛到 base model 效应。作者据此主张大规模多智能体交互必须考虑异构模型构成。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多智能体仿真普遍用单一 base model 驱动全部 agent，忽略了真实部署中跨模型的相互作用，而这种 inter-model 效应可能主导 engagement 动力学。
Method: 构建一个由多个不同 base model 驱动的异构社会网络仿真，对比 persona 与 base model 对 engagement 的贡献；再做一系列 content-mediating 分析，检验 base model 在不同语境下的可预测性，以及模型 lexical patterns 与 engagement-maximizing 风格之间的关系。
Result: agent 获得的 engagement 更多由其 base model 决定而非 persona；base model 的吸引/排斥效应在混入更多模型时显著增强；base model 可跨语境被预测，且其 lexical patterns 与 engagement-maximizing 风格相关。
Conclusion: LLM 社会仿真中 persona 不是主导变量，网络结果由异构模型构成驱动，因此大规模多智能体研究应显式建模 base model 的异质性。

papers.title: SkillFormer: Skill-Decomposed Adaptation for Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Audio language models must handle dozens of distinct skills, from pitch comparison and speaker counting to musical tempo estimation and emotion recognition. Joint training on all skills at once causes interference: gains on one skill often come at the cost of another. We propose \textbf{SkillFormer}, which decomposes audio understanding into skill-specific low-rank adapters and composes them at inference time through a learned router. The router examines the question to decide which adapters to activate and how much weight each should carry, so that a pitch query engages different parameters than a genre classification query. An alternating training schedule updates each adapter on its own skill cluster before jointly calibrating the router, preventing the gradient conflicts that arise in standard multi-task optimization. SkillFormer adds fewer than 4\% of the base model's parameters and requires no changes to the audio encoder or language backbone. Evaluated on three architecturally distinct models across MMSU, MMAU-Pro, and MMAR, it raises the average accuracy by 2.5 to 4.1 points, with balanced gains across perception, reasoning, and semantic subcategories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillFormer 把音频理解拆成按技能簇划分的低秩 adapter，用学习到的 router 在推理时按问题决定激活哪些 adapter 及其权重，交替训练先各自更新 adapter 再联合校准 router，从而避开多任务联合训练的梯度冲突。在三种架构不同的模型上以 MMSU、MMAU-Pro、MMAR 评测，平均准确率提升 2.5 到 4.1 点，感知、推理与语义子类增益均衡，新增参数不到基座模型的 4%。
Motivation: 音频语言模型要同时应付音高比较、说话人计数、节拍估计、情感识别等数十种技能，一次性联合训练会产生梯度干扰，一个技能的收益常以另一个技能的下降为代价。
Method: 按技能簇为每类音频技能训练专属低秩 adapter（LoRA 式），推理时由 learned router 读取问题决定激活哪些 adapter 及各自权重；采用交替训练日程，先在各自技能簇上更新 adapter，再联合校准 router，以避免标准多任务优化中的梯度冲突；不改动音频编码器与语言主干。
Result: 在三种架构不同的模型上、于 MMSU、MMAU-Pro、MMAR 三个基准评测，平均准确率提升 2.5 到 4.1 点，感知、推理、语义子类的增益均衡；新增参数不到基座模型的 4%。
Conclusion: 把音频技能分解为独立 adapter 并用 router 在推理时组合，可以在几乎不增加参数、不改主干的前提下缓解多技能干扰并抬升平均准确率。

papers.title: Benchmarking candidate coverage and rejection policy transfer in typed decision models
papers.abstract_en: Rejection policies must remain useful as candidate sets and tasks change. We compare Laya, Jev and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct using public reference labels, testing Laya/Jev policy transfer at equal calibration budgets and all three models on artificial omission, natural retrieval misses and public out-of-scope queries. Source calibration often fails to preserve the target operating point. A Jev policy calibrated on DBpedia rejects 69.3% of covered Emotion test inputs, while an Emotion policy loses detection entirely. Retrieval exposes a different tradeoff: with ten intent candidates, Laya detects 99.0% of out-of-scope queries but rejects 48.8% of covered queries. Separating missing-answer sources reveals these costs alongside retrieval coverage. The benchmark provides shared inputs, explicit decision and failure categories, and reproducible scoring to assess rejection policies under the conditions in which they are reused. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/luckykevvv/Decision_Model_Benchmark.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures. v2: expanded evaluation with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and CLINC150; added fixed-budget rejection policy transfer, three missing-answer sources, and controlled robustness analyses. Code and benchmark artifacts: https://github.com/luckykevvv/Decision_Model_Benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 typed decision model 的意图候选与拒答 (rejection) 场景下，跨数据集校准的拒答策略无法保持目标工作点：Jev 在 DBpedia 上校准的策略会拒掉 69.3% 的 Emotion 已覆盖输入，而 Emotion 上校准的策略完全失去检测能力。检索到十个意图候选时，Laya 能检出 99.0% 的 out-of-scope 查询，代价是拒掉 48.8% 的已覆盖查询。
Motivation: 拒答策略在候选集与任务变化后仍需可用，但源域校准的工作点在目标域上常常失守，且缺失答案来源不同带来的代价被混在一起看不清。
Method: 用公开参考标签比较 Laya、Jev 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，在等校准预算下测试 Laya/Jev 策略迁移，并在人工遗漏、自然检索遗漏与公开 out-of-scope 查询三类缺失来源上测试三个模型；配套提供共享输入、显式决策与失败类别以及可复现评分。
Result: Jev 在 DBpedia 校准的策略拒掉 69.3% 的 Emotion 已覆盖测试输入，Emotion 校准的策略检测能力完全丧失；十个意图候选下 Laya 检出 99.0% 的 out-of-scope 查询同时拒掉 48.8% 的已覆盖查询。
Conclusion: 源域校准通常无法保持目标工作点，评估拒答策略必须按其被复用时的条件、并把缺失答案来源分开来衡量。

papers.title: SCAD: Structured Credit Assignment and Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract_en: Training long-horizon agents to solve complex tasks requires effective supervision over extended interaction sequences. However, sparse terminal rewards obscure intermediate contributions, while on-policy distillation can lose informative teacher guidance as student-generated histories grow. To address this problem, we introduce SCAD, which organizes interactions into planning and bounded subtask execution, distills execution in local contexts, and refines planning credit through cross-rollout subtask prefix trees, with planning receiving full terminal credit and execution receiving positive terminal credit and teacher guidance. Across all evaluated benchmarks, SCAD improves macro-average accuracy over the strongest training baseline by 4.48 percentage points for text tasks and 4.19 points for multimodal tasks. SCAD effectively combines outcome-based credit assignment with teacher-guided distillation to improve planning and execution in long-horizon agents.
papers.comment: 32 pages; minor typographical correction in Appendix B.6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCAD 把长程 agent 的交互拆成规划与有界子任务执行两层：执行段在局部上下文里做 on-policy 蒸馏，规划段通过跨 rollout 的子任务前缀树 (subtask prefix tree) 重算信用分配，规划拿全部终局信用、执行拿正向终局信用加教师指导。在全部评测基准上，SCAD 比最强训练基线的宏平均准确率高 4.48 个百分点（文本任务）与 4.19 个百分点（多模态任务）。
Motivation: 稀疏终局奖励掩盖了长序列中各中间步骤的贡献，而 on-policy 蒸馏会随着 student 自生成历史变长而丢失教师的有效指导。
Method: SCAD 将交互组织为规划与有界子任务执行两部分：在局部上下文中蒸馏执行，并用跨 rollout 的子任务前缀树细化规划的信用分配；规划获得完整终局信用，执行获得正向终局信用与教师指导。
Result: 在全部评测基准上，SCAD 相对最强训练基线的宏平均准确率提升 4.48 个百分点（文本任务）与 4.19 个百分点（多模态任务）。
Conclusion: 把基于结果的信用分配与教师引导的蒸馏结合起来，可以同时改善长程 agent 的规划与执行。

papers.title: Trading Strategy Optimization via Textual Gradient
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative trading strategy design aims to discover trading programs from historical data that remain effective in future markets, which can be viewed as a black-box program optimization problem. LLM-based textual gradients offer a promising approach by providing explicit optimization directions for iterative strategy refinement. However, directly applying textual gradients faces two challenges: (1) optimization is myopic, underutilizing experience from previous evaluations; and (2) aggregate backtest feedback overlooks temporal robustness, potentially favoring strategies that perform well only in specific market periods. To address these challenges, we propose TradeGrad, an experience-guided textual-gradient framework for robust trading strategy optimization. TradeGrad leverages accumulated optimization experience to estimate textual gradients and employs multi-scale revisions for both strategy exploration and refinement. It further introduces the Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO), which emphasizes performance in unfavorable historical periods to promote temporal robustness. Experiments on cross-sectional and time-series strategy design in Chinese A-share and U.S. equity markets show that TradeGrad achieves the best in-sample and out-of-sample performance across all four settings. Notably, its Chinese cross-sectional strategy achieves 27.99% annualized return, 12.19% maximum drawdown, and a Sharpe ratio of 1.63, approximately 68% higher than the CSI 300 benchmark. Further analyses validate the proposed components and show consistent improvements in both in-sample and out-of-sample performance throughout optimization. The code is available at https://github.com/transcend-0/TradeGrad.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TradeGrad 用 LLM 文本梯度做量化交易策略的黑盒程序优化：以历史优化经验估计文本梯度、做多尺度修订，并用 Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO) 偏重不利历史时段的表现以提升时间稳健性。在中国 A 股与美股的截面/时序四类设定中其样本内外均为最佳，A 股截面策略年化收益 27.99%、最大回撤 12.19%、Sharpe 1.63，约比 CSI 300 基准高 68%。
Motivation: 直接套用文本梯度有两个短板：优化是短视的、浪费此前评估积累的经验；聚合回测反馈忽略时间稳健性，容易选出只在特定行情时段有效的策略。
Method: TradeGrad 框架以累积优化经验估计文本梯度，配合面向策略探索与精化的多尺度修订；引入 Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO)，在目标中强调不利历史时段的表现，从而约束时间稳健性。
Result: 在中国 A 股与美股市场的截面与时间序列策略设计共四个设定上，TradeGrad 的样本内与样本外表现均为最佳；A 股截面策略年化收益 27.99%、最大回撤 12.19%、Sharpe 1.63，约比 CSI 300 基准高 68%；消融与过程分析显示各组件带来一致的样本内外提升。

papers.title: Verifiable, Articulable, and Tacit Components of Preference
papers.abstract_en: What makes a short story gripping; a news article newsworthy; or a math proof elegant? These constructs resist articulation or verification; their meaning is at least partially tacit. However, modern AI models are improved primarily via articulated constitutions, rubrics and verifiers (i.e. in RLAIF and RLVR); tacit components of preferences are typically understudied. We introduce a large, labeled preference dataset CreativePreferences, containing 2.8M texts labeled by 317M human preference judgments across 7 creative domains, with 42 benchmark tasks. We model these labels with executable programs, rubric banks and densely trained models (V, A and VAT, respectively). We observe robust articulability gaps, VAT-VA; and verifiability gaps, VAT-V; we estimate upper and lower bounds for each gap with a novel measurement approach that discovers articulable and verifiable metrics, identifies spurious variables and estimates the value of undiscovered metrics using capture-recapture. These gaps occur across all domains, even in domains traditionally treated as fully verifiable: correctness-centered domains (i.e. mathematics and software engineering) and claim- and novelty-centric domains (i.e. news, patents, peer review). The size of the gap varies based on domain (e.g. peer review and creative writing have the largest articulability gaps) and widens as more people take part in the judgment, consistent with Collins' collective tacit knowledge. We show two consequences: (1) on human generations, the full model more closely matches human preferences, often in disagreement with articulated criteria, and (2) in an analogy to Goodhart's law, articulating preference shifts it away from the tacit dimension. Articulability and verifiability gaps are consequential; we give recommendations on when tasks can be prompted; how learning mechanisms might improve; and when to leave judgments with humans.
papers.comment: 15 pages main text, 14 pages of references, 107-page appendix (136 pages total); 15 figures, 48 tables; 213 references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 CreativePreferences：2.8M 段文本、317M 条人类偏好判断、覆盖 7 个创作领域与 42 项基准任务，用可执行程序、评分细则库和稠密训练模型分别建模偏好中可验证 (V)、可表述 (A) 与整体 (VAT) 三部分，从而量化可表述性差距 (VAT−A) 与可验证性差距 (VAT−V)。差距在所有领域都存在，同行评审与创意写作的可表述性差距最大，且随参与判断人数增加而扩大；对人类生成内容，完整模型更贴近真实偏好、常与已表述的准则相冲突，表述化偏好会把偏好推离 tacit 维度（类比 Goodhart 定律）。
Motivation: 现代 AI 主要靠明文宪法、评分细则和验证器（RLAIF、RLVR）改进，但偏好的 tacit 成分——短篇为何抓人、新闻为何有新意、数学证明为何优雅——既难表述也难验证，长期被低估，导致对偏好学习上限的认识不完整。
Method: 构建大规模标注偏好数据集 CreativePreferences（2.8M 文本、317M 条人类偏好判断、7 个创作领域、42 项基准任务），并用三种形式分别建模：可执行程序 (executable programs)、评分细则库 (rubric banks)、稠密训练模型 (V、A、VAT)。提出一种新的测量方法估计各差距的上下界：自动发现可表述与可验证的指标、识别伪变量 (spurious variables)，并用 capture-recapture 估计尚未发现指标的价值。
Result: 观测到稳健的可表述性差距 (VAT−A) 与可验证性差距 (VAT−V)，在全部领域成立，包括通常被视为完全可验证的正确性导向领域（数学、软件工程）与主张/新颖性导向领域（新闻、专利、同行评审）。差距大小随领域变化：同行评审与创意写作的可表述性差距最大；差距随参与判断的人数增加而变宽，与 Collins 的 collective tacit knowledge 一致。两项后果：在人类生成内容上完整模型更贴近人类偏好、常与已表述准则相冲突；表述化偏好会把偏好推离 tacit 维度。
Conclusion: 偏好的可表述与可验证部分不足以覆盖人类真实判断，差距在正确性领域同样存在并随集体判断规模扩大；作者据此给出何时可用 prompt、学习机制如何改进、以及何时应把判断留给人类的建议。

papers.title: LUMOS: Tracing Parametric Knowledge from Training Data to Behavioral Outputs in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current analyses of LLMs' parametric knowledge are largely output-centric, drawing conclusions about what a model knows without verifying what it was actually trained on. This leaves fundamental questions, such as whether a correct response reflects genuine generalization or rote memorization, grounded in speculation rather than evidence. To resolve these ambiguities, we introduce LUMOS, a diagnostic framework that traces knowledge along the causal chain from training-data exposure to behavioral output, leveraging OLMo 2 with its fully transparent training corpus. By grounding analysis in verified exposure, we reveal that models internally encode rare facts with high separability (84%) yet fail to express them behaviorally (54%), though this retrieval gap narrows with scale. Furthermore, when models are asked to self-reflect on their own answers, they perform reliably on trained content (83%) but drop to random-baseline levels (49%) on unseen content. This collapse persists even under chain-of-thought prompting, which inflates confidence signals rather than improving calibration. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that incorporating the training-data axis into LLM evaluation transforms speculative diagnoses into verifiable claims, and we advocate that this axis should be a standard component of knowledge assessment in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LUMOS 是一个把 LLM 参数化知识沿“训练数据暴露→行为输出”因果链追踪的诊断框架，依托 OLMo 2 完全透明的训练语料来核实模型究竟见过什么。结果显示稀有事实在内部以 84% 可分性编码却只有 54% 被行为表达，自反思在已训练内容上达 83%、在未见内容上跌到随机基线 49%，且 CoT 只抬高置信信号而不改善校准。作者主张把训练数据轴作为 LLM 知识评估的标准组件。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 参数化知识分析以输出为中心，无法区分正确回答来自真正泛化还是死记硬背，诊断结论停留在推测而非证据。
Method: 提出诊断框架 LUMOS，沿训练数据暴露到行为输出的因果链追踪知识，依托 OLMo 2 的完全透明训练语料核实 exposure；在此基础上分别测内部表征可分性、行为表达与自反思校准，并考察规模与 chain-of-thought prompting 的影响。
Result: 稀有事实内部编码可分性 84%，行为表达仅 54%，该 retrieval gap 随规模增大而收窄；自反思在已训练内容上 83%，在未见内容上降至随机基线水平 49%；chain-of-thought prompting 使置信信号膨胀但不改善校准，49% 的崩塌依然存在。
Conclusion: 把训练数据轴纳入 LLM 评估能把推测性诊断变成可验证结论，作者主张将其作为知识评估的标准组件；CoT 在未见内容上只是虚增置信而非提升校准。

papers.title: BitNest: Bit-Nested Speculative Decoding for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a lightweight draft to propose multiple tokens for parallel verification. However, existing methods often require an additional draft model or weight representation, introducing non-negligible memory overhead on resource-constrained devices. Self-speculative approaches reduce this overhead, yet still face trade-offs between draft quality, target quality, and storage efficiency. We propose BitNest, a bit-nested speculative decoding framework that embeds a low-precision draft directly into the higher-precision target representation. Instead of deriving a draft from a predefined target, BitNest first constructs a strong low-precision base and then recovers the higher-precision target through residual refinement, enabling both models to share a single physical weight representation. BitNest further extends this progressive-precision design to the KV cache for long-context inference. Across multiple 7B--8B edge-friendly LLMs and diverse workloads, BitNest achieves an average speculative acceptance rate of 95.2% while closely preserving higher-precision model quality, and delivers 1.48--1.61x end-to-end speedup over FP16 autoregressive decoding. On the LLaMA models supported by all representative self-speculative baselines, BitNest also achieves consistently competitive or higher decoding speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BitNest 把低精度 draft 直接嵌进高精度 target 的同一份物理权重：先构造强低精度 base，再用残差精化恢复高精度 target，并把这套渐进精度设计扩展到 KV cache。在多个 7B–8B 边缘 LLM 上平均投机接受率 95.2%，端到端加速 1.48–1.61×（对比 FP16 自回归解码）。
Motivation: 投机解码通常要额外的 draft 模型或权重副本，在资源受限设备上带来不可忽略的内存开销；自投机方案虽减轻开销，却仍在 draft 质量、target 质量与存储效率之间取舍。
Method: bit-nested 框架：不从预定义 target 派生 draft，而是先构建低精度 base、再经残差精化 (residual refinement) 恢复高精度 target，使两个模型共享单一物理权重表示；同一渐进精度设计延伸至长上下文推理的 KV cache。
Result: 在多个 7B–8B 边缘友好 LLM 与多样负载上，平均投机接受率 95.2%，同时紧密保持高精度模型质量；相对 FP16 自回归解码端到端加速 1.48–1.61×；在所有代表性自投机基线都支持的 LLaMA 模型上，解码加速保持有竞争力或更高。
Conclusion: 让 draft 与 target 共享一份物理权重、以低精度为基再残差精化，可以在压掉额外权重存储的同时保住接受率与端到端加速。

papers.title: Decoupling Memory from Context: Structured Memory for Token-Efficient Test-Time Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in enterprise, scientific, and medical applications, where agents must incorporate domain-specific knowledge and adapt from experience. Context engineering offers a practical alternative to weight updates by improving model behavior through instructions, strategies, and evidence supplied at inference time. However, adapting context online typically requires a costly trial-and-error process, while queries are often processed independently, preventing useful experience from carrying forward. Memory systems address this limitation by retaining information across interactions, but approaches that continually append information to a shared context face increasing token costs, context-window limits, and performance degradation as the context expands. We introduce a unified formulation of context optimization and show that an agent memory system update can be interpreted as an optimization update procedure over the model's context. This perspective attempts to provide a principled framework for studying memory design and its efficiency. We then propose GraphMemory, a lightweight graph-based memory that accumulates, refines, organizes, and connects reusable strategies. For each query, GraphMemory retrieves only the relevant subgraph, enabling online context adaptation without exposing the model to the entire memory. Under bounded retrieval, the amount of retrieved memory remains constant as the number of processed examples grows. Experiments show that GraphMemory achieves competitive downstream performance while using approximately 81-85% fewer memory-construction tokens than our baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GraphMemory 把 LLM 的记忆系统更新统一表述为对模型 context 的优化更新，用轻量图结构累积、精炼、组织并连接可复用策略，每条查询只检索相关子图。检索量在处理样本数增长时保持有界恒定，且在保持竞争力下游性能的同时，比基线少用约 81–85% 的记忆构建 token。
Motivation: 在线调整 context 要靠试错且各查询彼此独立，经验无法延续；而把信息不断追加进共享 context 会带来 token 成本上升、context 窗口上限和性能随 context 扩张而退化。
Method: 提出统一的 context 优化表述，把记忆系统的一次更新解释为对模型 context 的一次优化更新；在此框架下提出 GraphMemory，一种基于图的轻量记忆，负责累积、精炼、组织与连接可复用策略，每条查询仅检索相关子图，实现有界检索 (bounded retrieval)。
Result: 在下游任务上取得有竞争力的表现，同时比基线少用约 81–85% 的记忆构建 token；在有界检索下，被检索的记忆量随已处理样本数增长保持不变。
Conclusion: 把记忆与 context 解耦、按需检索子图，可以在不牺牲下游性能的前提下让测试时持续学习 (test-time continual learning) 的 token 开销不随交互次数增长。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 提出统一的 context 优化表述，把记忆系统的一次更新解释为对模型 context 的一次优化更新；在此框架下提出 GraphMemory，一种基于图的轻量记忆，负责累积、精炼、组织与连接可复用策略，每条查询仅检索相关子图，实现有界检索 (bounded retrieval)。
summary_sections.result: 在下游任务上取得有竞争力的表现，同时比基线少用约 81–85% 的记忆构建 token；在有界检索下，被检索的记忆量随已处理样本数增长保持不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把记忆与 context 解耦、按需检索子图，可以在不牺牲下游性能的前提下让测试时持续学习 (test-time continual learning) 的 token 开销不随交互次数增长。

papers.title: Distributed Learning with Selective State Space Models: Architecture-Aware Convergence Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Modern state space models (SSMs), such as Mamba2, provide a compelling alternative to transformers by combining linear-time sequence modeling with recurrent state-space dynamics. However, the behavior of SSMs in distributed learning settings remains poorly understood. In particular, the existing standard federated learning methods are largely architecture-agnostic, and do not account for the stability, selectivity, and state-space parameterization that characterize modern selective SSMs. To address this, we derive architecture-aware gradient and smoothness bounds for single- and multi-layer selective SSMs, and convergence bounds for FedAvg and FedProx, characterizing how recurrent stability, input-dependent discretization, and state projection norms affect federated optimization. We then numerically validate the single-layer bounds on sequences generated by a teacher SSM, using a learner that follows the analyzed recurrence. We use this analysis to formulate expectations about the effects of local training and client heterogeneity, and examine these expectations by comparing nine federated learning algorithms on Mamba2 language modeling across six text domains. These experiments illustrate how SSM-specific bounds can provide a basis for interpreting the behavior of practical federated learning algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为选择性状态空间模型 (selective SSM, Mamba2) 的联邦学习推导架构感知的梯度、光滑性与收敛界，指出循环稳定性、输入依赖离散化与状态投影范数直接决定 FedAvg/FedProx 的优化行为。随后在 Mamba2 语言建模上比较九种联邦学习算法、覆盖六个文本域，用实验检验由界导出的关于本地训练与客户端异质性的预期。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习方法基本是架构无关的，未考虑选择性 SSM 的稳定性、选择性与状态空间参数化，导致 SSM 在分布式训练下的收敛行为缺乏理论刻画。
Method: 推导单层与多层选择性 SSM 的架构感知梯度界与光滑性界，以及 FedAvg 与 FedProx 的收敛界，显式刻画循环稳定性、输入依赖离散化、状态投影范数的作用；先用 teacher SSM 生成序列、learner 遵循被分析递推来数值验证单层界，再据此形成关于本地训练与客户端异质性的预期并加以检验。
Result: 单层界在 teacher SSM 生成序列上得到数值验证；在 Mamba2 语言建模、六个文本域上比较了九种联邦学习算法，用于检验由界导出的预期。
Conclusion: SSM 特有的收敛界可以作为解释实际联邦学习算法行为的依据，架构感知的稳定性与参数化项是联邦优化分析中不可省略的部分。
