papers.title: Sequential Capacity of Quantum Processes with Finite Memory
papers.abstract_en: How complex can the responses of a quantum device become as it runs longer with a fixed internal memory? We quantify this complexity through sequential response capacity: how many adaptive testing stages, each using a fresh run, can continue to separate possible processes by a prescribed gap in response probabilities. For fixed system and memory sizes, we establish a tight law relating this capacity to run length and probability resolution. At fixed resolution, the capacity grows on the order of $K\log K$, where $K$ is the number of time steps in each run. Our construction attains this growth using time-dependent phase rotations on a single visible qubit with no additional internal memory; its tests give response probabilities exactly zero or one. Under the same tests, classical stochastic processes that measure in a fixed basis at every step have only linear capacity at fixed sizes and resolution. For phase sequences selected by a stored classical label, we then quantify how known independent Pauli noise changes this logarithmic enhancement. With ideal controls and weak residual phase noise after correction, we prove matching capacity bounds at a fixed small probability gap. These bounds identify the inverse residual phase-flip probability as the coherence timescale that limits the extra logarithmic growth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 定义量子过程的序贯响应容量：在固定系统与记忆尺寸下，多少个自适应测试阶段（每阶段用一次全新运行）仍能以规定响应概率间隔区分不同过程。固定分辨率下容量随每次运行步数 K 呈 K log K 增长，由单个可见量子比特上的时变相位旋转实现且测试响应概率恰为 0 或 1；同测试下固定基测量的经典随机过程只有线性容量。
Motivation: 固定内部记忆的量子设备随运行变长，其响应复杂度如何增长缺少可量化的刻画；需要一个能同时区分量子与经典过程、并把噪声代价计入的容量指标。
Method: 提出序贯响应容量作为复杂度度量，按运行长度与概率分辨率建立紧致标度律；构造用单可见量子比特的时变相位旋转、无额外内部记忆，测试响应概率取 0 或 1；再对由存储经典标签选择的相位序列，分析已知独立 Pauli 噪声（含校正后残余相位翻转）如何削弱对数增益。
Result: 固定分辨率下容量按 K log K 增长（K 为每次运行的时间步数）；同测试下固定基测量的经典随机过程在固定尺寸与分辨率下仅线性容量；理想控制与校正后弱残余相位噪声下，在固定小概率间隔处证明匹配的容量界，并给出逆残余相位翻转概率作为限制额外对数增长的相干时间尺度。
Conclusion: 量子过程在固定记忆下可获得相对经典的对数额外序贯容量，而残余相位翻转率直接设定这一对数增益的上限。

papers.title: DiDE:Direct Injection with Color-Texture DEcoupling for 3D Stylization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in rectified flow-based image-to-3D generative models have enabled high-fidelity 3D asset generation. Building on this, a growing line of work has exploited these strong 3D priors for training-free stylization, transferring visual attributes from a reference image onto a generated 3D asset. However, existing methods enforce an all-or-nothing paradigm: color and texture are transferred jointly, with no mechanism to control them independently -- a limitation we formalize as Disentangled 3D Stylization(Disen3D). To address this, we propose DiDE, the first training-free framework for Disen3D. Key to our approach is the observation that the structured latent space of image-to-3D models is overcomplete with respect to texture: texture information occupies only a small subset of the style-significant channels, leaving a free subspace available for independent color encoding. DiDE exploits this via a channel partition mechanism that processes a content image, a texture reference, and a color reference through dedicated branches and composes both style signals interference-free at every self-attention layer, preserving content geometry throughout. Experiments on Disen3D-Bench, our newly collected multi-reference benchmark, show that DiDE consistently outperforms 2D and 3D stylization baselines in color fidelity, texture transfer, and content preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiDE 提出首个 training-free 的解耦式 3D 风格化 (Disen3D) 框架：利用 image-to-3D 模型结构化 latent 对纹理过完备、纹理只占少数风格显著通道的特点，用通道划分把颜色编码进空闲子空间，经专用分支在每个 self-attention 层无干扰合成颜色与纹理参考。在自建多参考基准 Disen3D-Bench 上，颜色保真、纹理迁移与内容保持均稳定超过 2D 与 3D 风格化基线。
Motivation: 基于 rectified flow 的 image-to-3D 先验已可做 training-free 风格迁移，但现有方法把颜色与纹理捆绑传输，无法独立控制，作者将其形式化为 Disen3D 问题。
Method: DiDE 观察到 image-to-3D 模型的结构化 latent 空间对纹理过完备，纹理仅占少数 style-significant 通道，剩余自由子空间可用于独立编码颜色；据此设计 channel partition 机制，让内容图、纹理参考、颜色参考各走专用分支，并在每个 self-attention 层无干扰地合成两路风格信号，全程保持内容几何。
Result: 在自建多参考基准 Disen3D-Bench 上，DiDE 在 color fidelity、texture transfer、content preservation 三项指标上一致优于 2D 与 3D 风格化基线。
Conclusion: 颜色与纹理可以借 latent 通道子空间的分工在 3D 风格化中独立控制，且无需训练即可同时保住内容几何。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Knowledge Retrieval for Generation: A Survey on RAG Architectures and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency and versatility across natural language tasks but remain fundamentally limited by their static knowledge and susceptibility to hallucinations, especially in domains requiring up to date or attribute grounded information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these challenges by integrating external retrieval mechanisms with generative models, enabling dynamic, context aware generation grounded in verifiable data sources. This survey presents a comprehensive examination of RAG as a modular and evolving paradigm that enhances factual reliability, adaptability, and task alignment in LLM based systems. We formalize the RAG framework through its three foundational components retrieval, generation, and augmentation and survey state of the art methods spanning dense and sparse retrievers, fusion strategies, embedding optimizations, and reinforcement learning based retrieval policies. Anchored around four emerging axes efficiency, security, user centric interactivity, and complex reasoning we categorize recent innovations and highlight their implications for scalability, robustness, and personalization. The paper also reviews advances in evaluation protocols, domain specific applications, and architectural variants such as Naïve RAG, Advanced RAG, and Modular RAG. Finally, we identify persistent challenges and outline future directions aimed at advancing the integration of retrieval with LLMs for more grounded, interpretable, and controllable generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 RAG（检索增强生成）综述，把检索、生成、augmentation 三段式框架形式化，按效率、安全、用户交互、复杂推理四条轴组织近年方法，并覆盖 Naïve RAG、Advanced RAG、Modular RAG 等架构变体与评测协议。结论是 RAG 仍是提升 LLM 事实可靠性与可控生成的主要路径，但持久挑战集中在检索与生成的整合上。
Motivation: LLM 的知识静态且易幻觉，在需要最新或属性接地信息的领域尤其受限；RAG 领域方法分散、缺少统一的模块化分类框架。
Method: 将 RAG 形式化为 retrieval、generation、augmentation 三个基础组件，综述 dense 与 sparse retriever、fusion 策略、embedding 优化、基于强化学习的检索策略；围绕效率、安全、用户中心交互、复杂推理四条轴分类创新，并梳理 Naïve RAG、Advanced RAG、Modular RAG 架构变体与评测协议。
Result: 综述性论文，给出的是分类与框架层面的整理：三组件形式化、四条创新轴、三类架构变体，以及评测协议与领域应用的进展梳理。
Conclusion: RAG 是一个模块化且持续演进的范式，能提升 LLM 系统的事实可靠性、适应性与任务对齐；作者指出检索与生成的整合仍存在持久挑战，并给出未来方向。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers
papers.abstract_en: Skill evolution offers a promising way to improve large language model agents without updating their parameters, but its use in formal theorem proving remains underexplored. Existing methods mainly target natural-language reasoning, improving skills by analyzing successful and failed trajectories and incrementally revising solving strategies. Although the Lean verifier provides reliable execution feedback, when all sampled trajectories fail, existing skill evolution methods lack successful trajectories from which to infer effective update directions. Furthermore, these methods also focus mainly on the root instruction file, thus underexploring the evolution of reference knowledge including mathematical concepts and proving techniques. To address these limitations, we propose a mutation-enhanced skill self-evolution framework for building skill-augmented Lean provers. The framework jointly evolves a high-level solving policy and its reference knowledge through progressive and mutation-based updates. Progressive evolution derives local improvements from successful and failed trajectories, while mutation is triggered when no complete proof can be generated, sampling mathematical concepts to produce and select new skill candidates under verifier feedback. We evaluate our method on MiniF2F, PutnamBench, the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO 2025), and the 2026 USA Mathematical Olympiad (USAMO 2026). Under the same backbone model, trajectorysampling budget, and test-time compute, our method achieves proof success rates of 100.0%, 90.6%, 4/6, and 4/6, respectively, with GPT-5.5, outperforming the baseline methods. Further analysis shows that concept-guided mutation outperforms random-text-guided mutation by 6.9 and 8.2 percentage points on MiniF2F and PutnamBench, respectively, while solving one additional problem on both IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillEvoLean 提出面向 Lean 定理证明器的变异增强技能自进化框架，在采样轨迹全部失败时触发变异、按数学概念采样并由验证器反馈筛选新技能候选，同时渐进式进化高层求解策略与参考知识。在相同 backbone、轨迹采样预算与 test-time compute 下，用 GPT-5.5 在 MiniF2F、PutnamBench、IMO 2025、USAMO 2026 上达到 100.0%、90.6%、4/6、4/6 的证明成功率，超过基线方法。
Motivation: 现有技能进化方法主要面向自然语言推理，依赖成功轨迹推断更新方向；当所有采样轨迹都失败时无从学习，且只改根指令文件，忽视数学概念与证明技巧这类参考知识的进化。
Method: 框架分两条路径联合进化求解策略与参考知识：progressive evolution 从成功与失败轨迹导出局部改进；当无法生成完整证明时触发 mutation，按数学概念采样产生新技能候选，再在 Lean verifier 反馈下筛选。
Result: 同一 backbone、轨迹采样预算与 test-time compute 下，GPT-5.5 上 MiniF2F 100.0%、PutnamBench 90.6%、IMO 2025 4/6、USAMO 2026 4/6，均优于基线方法。概念引导变异比随机文本引导变异在 MiniF2F 与 PutnamBench 上分别高 6.9 和 8.2 个百分点，并在 IMO 2025 与 USAMO 2026 各多解出 1 题。
Conclusion: 在轨迹全部失败时用概念引导的变异替代随机文本变异，是让技能进化在形式化证明里继续推进的关键；参考知识与求解策略需一起进化。

papers.title: Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot actions, yet they remain susceptible to task-incomplete imagination, where plausible, action-consistent predictions omit the transition needed for task completion. In this paper, we show that this failure is not inherent to the world model backbone, but emerges when adapted for short-chunk control, which can repeatedly favor plausible local continuations over task-completing transitions. To address this, we introduce Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that guides generation toward task completion. Across representative WAMs, CAG improves success from 64% to 70% on a RoboTwin 2.0 subset and from 69% to 75% in zero-shot simulation, while reducing task-incomplete imagination from 79% to 40%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 世界行动模型 (WAM) 在短片段控制微调后会偏向「合理但任务不完整」的局部想象，作者提出免训练的采样引导 Completion Aware Guidance (CAG)，在采样阶段把生成推向任务完成所需的过渡。RoboTwin 2.0 子集成功率从 64% 提到 70%，零样本仿真从 69% 提到 75%，任务不完整想象比例从 79% 降到 40%。
Motivation: WAM 会生成视觉上合理、动作一致却缺少任务完成过渡的想象；作者指出该失败并非世界模型骨干固有，而是为短片段控制做适配后反复偏爱局部合理延续所致。
Method: 提出 Completion Aware Guidance (CAG)，一种免训练 (training-free) 的采样期引导方法，在生成时把轨迹推向任务完成过渡；在多种代表性 WAM 上验证。
Result: RoboTwin 2.0 子集成功率 64% → 70%；零样本仿真成功率 69% → 75%；任务不完整想象 (task-incomplete imagination) 比例 79% → 40%。
Conclusion: 任务不完整想象是短片段控制适配带来的采样偏好问题，可在推理期用完成感知引导缓解，无需重训世界模型骨干。

papers.title: When Does a Second Model Help? Cross-Model Review in LLM Verification
papers.abstract_en: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 30 个 artifact、150 个植入错误、10 种审查条件、900 次审查会话的受控实验中，检验换一个模型做代码/文档审查是否真的更好：顶级跨模型审查与同模型新会话审查 (CCR) 的 F1 无显著差异，两者发现的错误只有 Jaccard 41.2% 重叠；但两次审查调用中「一次 CCR + 一次跨模型」命中 56.7% 的植入错误，显著高于两次 CCR 的 42.7%（Holm 校正 p=.006）。
Motivation: LLM 既生成代码与文档又参与审查，作者要判定第二次审查换一个模型在什么条件下才真正带来增益，而不是把模型差异与审查器能力混为一谈。
Method: 受控实验：30 个 artifact、150 个植入错误、10 种审查条件、900 次审查会话，覆盖来自两家开发者的三个 reviewer 模型；比较同模型新会话审查 (CCR)、跨模型审查与轻量跨模型审查，并测试向审查器隐去需求 (withholding requirements) 的影响；分析前审计全部会话记录，剔除 1 个来源不明的 baseline 运行与 14 次失败调用，同时报告含全部会话的结果。
Result: 顶级跨模型审查与 CCR 的 F1 无显著差异（该检验不构成等价性证明）；两者错误集合 Jaccard 重叠 41.2%；两次调用下一次 CCR 加一次跨模型命中 56.7% 植入错误，两次 CCR 为 42.7%，Holm 校正 p=.006，但与两次顶级跨模型审查无显著差异；轻量跨模型审查得分不高于同模型审查；隐去需求使两个较低档位的 F1 上升、顶级档位不变（未检验的点估计，且模式取决于失败会话的计分方式）；对另一 benchmark 公开 detector 输出的部分核查既未复现也未否定主比较。
Conclusion: 跨模型审查的收益来自审查器能力而非模型差异本身，两次调用时「CCR + 跨模型」比两次 CCR 多命中植入错误，但与两次顶级跨模型审查打平；轻量换模型不带来提升。

papers.title: SpikeMoE: Brain-Inspired Competitive Routing for Flexible Spiking Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) enable event-driven computation through biologically inspired dynamics at the neuronal scale, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) perform conditional computation through expert selection at the model scale. Integrating their strengths offers potential for flexible neural architectures. A key challenge, however, lies in designing an expert selection mechanism based on spiking activity. To address this, we introduce a spike-based k-WTA Router inspired by competition-inhibition observed in the hippocampal CA1 region. The router incorporates lateral inhibition and refractory period to select Top-K experts according to discrete spike counts. Building on this, we present SpikeMoE, a framework that integrates neuronal-scale spiking dynamics with model-scale expert selection. To address incomplete multisensory inputs in multimodal tasks, we further equip SpikeMoE with a two-stage missing-modality modeling module that combines empirical prototypes from an observed-modality pool with modality-specific learnable embeddings to construct missing-modality representations. Experiments on vision, language, and multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that SpikeMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance among the SNN baselines, matches or exceeds the performance of ANN counterparts, and maintains robustness across diverse missing-modality conditions. These results demonstrate a favorable trade-off between performance and energy efficiency, validating the integration of spiking dynamics with sparse expert computation and highlighting SpikeMoE as a promising approach to energy-efficient brain-inspired computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpikeMoE 把 SNN 的神经元级脉冲动力学与 MoE 的模型级专家选择接到一起，用受海马 CA1 竞争抑制启发的 spike-based k-WTA 路由器，依据离散脉冲计数做 Top-K 专家选择，并配两阶段缺失模态模块。在视觉、语言与多模态基准上达到 SNN 基线中的 SOTA，匹配或超过 ANN 对应模型，且在多种缺失模态条件下保持稳健。
Motivation: SNN 的事件驱动计算与 MoE 的条件计算各自成熟，但缺少基于脉冲活动的专家选择机制；多模态任务中输入模态不完整也使专家路由更难稳定。
Method: 提出 spike-based k-WTA Router，引入侧向抑制 (lateral inhibition) 与不应期 (refractory period)，按离散脉冲计数选 Top-K 专家；SpikeMoE 框架整合神经元级脉冲动力学与模型级专家选择，并加两阶段缺失模态建模模块，用观测模态池的经验原型 (empirical prototypes) 加模态专属可学习嵌入构造缺失模态表示。
Result: 在视觉、语言与多模态基准实验中，SpikeMoE 在 SNN 基线中达到 state-of-the-art，匹配或超过 ANN 对应模型，并在多种缺失模态条件下保持稳健，体现性能与能效的折中。
Conclusion: 脉冲动力学与稀疏专家计算可以整合成一个在性能和能效上都有竞争力的脑启发计算方案，缺失模态下也稳。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ReSolve: Reusing Candidate Reasoning through Selective Generative Moderation
papers.abstract_en: Sampling multiple solutions spends computation on intermediate deductions and unfinished arguments as well as final answers. We introduce ReSolve, a training-free inference procedure that reuses this candidate reasoning through selective generative moderation. An answer-distribution controller invokes a model to examine existing derivations when candidates disagree or lack a parseable answer, then incorporates the generated solution into a bounded loop. Under Hybrid scoring on 130 competition-mathematics problems evaluated with two independently sampled candidate pools, ReSolve obtains 100 and 99 correct answers, compared with 91 and 92 for voting over the same four candidates, with no correct-to-incorrect changes relative to that vote in either pool. Eight-sample self-consistency obtains 94 and 96 correct answers while consuming substantially more tokens; ReSolve uses 46.3% and 47.2% fewer tokens in the two evaluations. A controlled ablation removes visible derivations while retaining answer keys, vote counts, and the per-state output-cap rule, reducing accuracy from 100 to 93 correct despite increasing computation. Selective and always-on Uniform moderation both solve 97 problems, while selectivity reduces moderation tokens by approximately 54% and total pipeline tokens by 6.2%. These results support candidate reasoning as reusable inference computation. They do not establish an accuracy advantage over additional sampling or a distinct benefit from specialized route instructions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReSolve 是一种免训练的推理过程复用方法：当多个候选答案不一致或缺少可解析答案时，由答案分布控制器 (answer-distribution controller) 调用模型审查已有推导并把新解纳入有界循环。在 130 道竞赛数学题、两组独立采样候选池上，Hybrid 计分得 100 和 99 题正确，同池投票为 91 和 92，且相对投票无一题由对变错；相比八样本 self-consistency 少用 46.3% 和 47.2% token。
Motivation: 多候选采样把大量算力花在中间推导与未完成论证上，这些中间推理在投票时被丢弃；直接增加采样量又显著抬高 token 开销。
Method: 训练-free 推理流程：答案分布控制器在候选分歧或答案不可解析时调用模型审查现有推导，将生成解并入有界循环；保留可见推导、答案键、投票计数与每状态输出上限 (per-state output cap)。对照为同池投票、八样本 self-consistency、Selective 与 always-on Uniform moderation，并做去除可见推导的受控消融。
Result: 130 道竞赛数学题、两组独立候选池上：Hybrid 计分 100/99 正确，同四候选投票 91/92，两池均无由对变错；八样本 self-consistency 94/96 正确但 token 更多，ReSolve 分别少用 46.3% 与 47.2% token。去掉可见推导后正确数从 100 降到 93，尽管计算量增加。Selective 与 always-on Uniform moderation 均解出 97 题，选择性使 moderation token 约降 54%、全流程 token 降 6.2%。
Conclusion: 候选推理可作为可复用的推理计算，在不牺牲正确性的前提下显著省 token；作者明确指出结果未确立相对额外采样的精度优势，也未确立专门路由指令的独立收益。

papers.title: Does Scaling Reinforcement Learning Really Require More Training?
papers.abstract_en: Scaling reasoning typically spends more compute on reinforcement learning (RL) or on inference. We show that a completed RL training history can yield policies stronger than the checkpoints visited by its optimizer. We call this policy-space scaling: expanding the deployable policy set accessible from a fixed RL history, without extending training or increasing per-query inference computation. We instantiate it with SURGE (Scaling Up RL Gradient-free via Eigenspace fusion). SURGE combines two checkpoints from the same RL run: a high-accuracy anchor and a competitive donor that generates shorter responses. It expresses both checkpoints as changes from their shared initialization, then spectrally decomposes the anchor's update to retain its dominant component and incorporate the donor's complementary component. With a fixed target for how much of the anchor update to retain, SURGE determines the block size from the weights without testing candidate policies. We evaluate two 1.5B mathematical-reasoning histories, DeepSeek and Nemotron, and one 7B coding history, OLMo. SURGE improves benchmark-average accuracy over both input checkpoints while using fewer reasoning tokens than the anchor. It reaches 54.17% on DeepSeek AIME24 against a measured native maximum of 50.83%, and 83.7% on OLMo HumanEval+ against 82.8%. These gains exceed the observed training curves. Geometric controls support the importance of RL-update structure beyond weight displacement or token reduction alone. Each constructed model runs as a single policy. Our findings identify stored RL history as a reusable scaling resource: the capability available from a training run need not end at its best checkpoint.

papers.title: How Much Can Language Models Gain from Test-Time Computation?
papers.abstract_en: How much can test-time computation improve a language model, and at what cost? Test-time scaling is widely proposed as a substitute for larger models, but existing comparisons mostly evaluate one domain at a time and rarely charge selection to the budget. We introduce SELF-POT, a benchmark and evaluation framework that measures the test-time potential of a model across competition mathematics, competitive programming, and agentic workflows. SELF-POT separates candidate coverage from final accuracy on static tasks, tracks correctness transitions under revision, and measures protocol completion alongside task success in agentic environments. Under a unified budget rule, it compares Direct inference with parallel sampling and self-revision under fixed multiples of the Direct budget, and charges every model call, including selection and critique, in dollars. This design supports two kinds of comparison: the gain a model obtains from additional inference, and a lower-cost model with additional inference against a stronger model. Across five low-cost reasoning models on 350 sealed tasks, with Claude Opus 5.5 Direct as the reference, the returns depend on the domain, the selection rule, and failure handling. When we replay the retained programming candidate pools, public-example selection raises correct submissions from 376 to 453 of 500 scheduled cells while saving 12-49% of logical API cost across models, and simply retaining an available candidate when judging fails recovers 61 submissions at unchanged cost. On identical mathematics pools, judging with fallback yields 186 correct submissions versus 182 for voting, while voting saves 12-21% of logical API cost. These controlled replays show how selection and failure handling change the gains realized from the same generated candidates, and they quantify the marginal value of a model judge.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SELF-POT 基准与评测框架，把测试时计算 (test-time computation) 的收益按统一预算规则计价，覆盖竞赛数学、竞赛编程与 agentic 工作流，并把选择与批判的调用也计入美元成本。在 5 个低成本推理模型、350 道密封题上以 Claude Opus 5.5 Direct 为参照：编程候选池用公开样例选择把正确提交从 376 提到 453/500 个计划单元并省 12–49% 逻辑 API 成本，判分失败时保留可用候选在零额外成本下挽回 61 个提交；数学池上带兜底的 judging 得 186 个正确提交对 voting 的 182，而 voting 省 12–21% 成本。
Motivation: 测试时扩展 (test-time scaling) 常被当作换更大模型的替代方案，但现有对比多一次只评一个领域，且几乎不把选择环节的开销计入预算，导致“加推理换来的收益”无法跨领域、跨模型公平核算。
Method: SELF-POT 在静态任务上把候选覆盖率与最终准确率分开度量，跟踪修订下的正确性转移，在 agentic 环境中同时度量协议完成度与任务成功率；统一预算规则下比较 Direct 推理与并行采样加自我修订，按 Direct 预算的固定倍数执行，并把每次模型调用（含 selection 与 critique）按美元计费，从而支持“同一模型多推理的收益”与“低成本模型加推理对打更强模型”两类对比。
Result: 在 5 个低成本推理模型、350 道密封任务上以 Claude Opus 5.5 Direct 为参照：编程候选池重放中公开样例选择使正确提交从 376 升到 453（共 500 个计划单元），跨模型节省 12–49% 逻辑 API 成本；判分失败时保留一个可用候选在成本不变下挽回 61 个提交。相同数学池上带兜底的 judging 得 186 个正确提交，voting 为 182，而 voting 节省 12–21% 逻辑 API 成本。
Conclusion: 同一份生成候选下，选择规则与失败处理方式会实质改变测试时计算兑现的收益，模型 judge 的边际价值可以被单独定价；收益大小取决于领域、选择规则与失败处理，而非单纯堆推理预算。

papers.title: Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear CMDPs
papers.abstract_en: We study episodic adversarial linear constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) with unknown transitions, where both the loss and constraint functions may vary adversarially across episodes. The best previous algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation, leaving a gap to the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ dependence on the number of episodes $K$. We close this gap by proposing a new primal dual algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation without assuming Slater's condition. We further extend the algorithm to achieve the same $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ guarantees for regret and hard constraint violation, which does not allow constraint violations to cancel across episodes. The main challenge is that learning linear CMDPs requires uniform concentration over a value function class with a controlled covering number, whereas standard techniques in constrained online learning, such as policy mixing, can make this class more complex. Our algorithm combines adaptive Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL), contracted value estimation, and an exponential Lyapunov function. An adaptive dual regularizer offsets the dependence on the dual weights in the primal regret bound, removing the need for policy mixing. We further show that the normalization in the FTRL update bounds the policy parameters independently of the magnitudes of the dual weights, which explains why the resulting policy class remains compatible with uniform concentration. Under feature access, the computational complexity is independent of the size of the state space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对对抗性线性约束 MDP（CMDP）中已知最好算法的 regret 与累积约束违反为 Õ(K^{3/4}) 的缺口，提出新的 primal-dal 算法，在不假设 Slater 条件下达到 Õ(√K) 的 regret 与累积约束违反，并进一步扩展到同样 Õ(√K) 的硬约束违反（跨 episode 不允许相互抵消）。
Motivation: 对抗性线性 CMDP 中损失与约束函数逐 episode 变化且转移未知，先前最好结果 Õ(K^{3/4}) 与最优 Õ(√K) 之间存在差距；而 policy mixing 等标准受约束在线学习技术会让值函数类的覆盖数变复杂，阻碍一致集中。
Method: primal-dual 算法组合 adaptive Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL)、contracted value estimation 与 exponential Lyapunov 函数；adaptive dual regularizer 抵消 primal regret 界中对 dual weights 的依赖从而去掉 policy mixing，FTRL 更新中的归一化使策略参数与 dual weights 幅值无关；在 feature access 下计算复杂度与状态空间大小无关。
Result: regret 与累积约束违反由 Õ(K^{3/4}) 改进到最优的 Õ(√K)（K 为 episode 数），且不需 Slater 条件；同一 Õ(√K) 保证也覆盖不允许跨 episode 抵消的硬约束违反。
Conclusion: adaptive FTRL 加 contracted value estimation 与 exponential Lyapunov 可在对抗性线性 CMDP 中闭合到最优 √K 依赖，同时保持值函数类可用于一致集中。

papers.title: Grand Canonical Generators
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GCG 把 Boltzmann generator 扩展到巨正则系综：一种以化学势为条件的变长生成模型，另一种把巨正则分布分解为粒子数分布与正则 Boltzmann 密度，后者可复用任意现有 Boltzmann generator、解析编码化学势的线性依赖并给出可处理似然以支持 SNIS。在 Lennard-Jones 流体与沸石中甲烷吸附上准确复现巨正则系综观测量，跨化学势泛化并经 SNIS 与巨正则 Monte Carlo 校正。
Motivation: Boltzmann generators 此前限于正则系综，无法直接采样粒子数可变的巨正则体系，而吸附、溶液等场景的观测量依赖粒子数涨落与化学势。
Method: 提出两种设计：其一用以化学势为条件的变长生成模型联合采样粒子数与构型；其二将巨正则分布分解为粒子数分布与正则 Boltzmann 密度，正则部分可接任意现有 Boltzmann generator，化学势的线性依赖解析给出，似然可处理并支持自归一化重要性采样 (SNIS)。
Result: 在 Lennard--Jones 流体与沸石甲烷吸附两个体系上，GCG 准确复现巨正则系综观测量，跨化学势泛化，并通过 SNIS 与巨正则 Monte Carlo (GCMC) 做校正。
Conclusion: 把巨正则分布按粒子数与正则密度分解，可让既有 Boltzmann generator 直接用于粒子数可变体系并保持可处理似然。

papers.title: Reconstructing the Dynamic World: A Representation-Centric View of 4D Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: 4D scene reconstruction aims to recover the evolving geometry, appearance, and motion of dynamic environments from visual observations. Despite substantial progress in neural scene representations, reconstructing dynamic scenes remains challenging due to non-rigid motion, occlusions, temporal inconsistencies, and the trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency. Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have introduced diverse approaches to representing and reconstructing dynamic scenes, yet their relationships, underlying design choices, and evaluation protocols remain fragmented. In this paper, we present a unified perspective on 4D scene reconstruction, organizing existing methods around their scene representations, temporal modeling strategies, reconstruction pipelines, and optimization objectives. Through this framework, we examine how different design choices affect geometric fidelity, appearance consistency, motion representation, and computational efficiency. We further consolidate commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, identify limitations in current experimental practices, and discuss open challenges in reconstructing complex, dynamic real-world environments. By connecting methodological developments with their underlying assumptions and evaluation evidence, this work provides a structured foundation for understanding existing approaches and identifying future research directions. An evolving collection of relevant papers and resources is available at https://github.com/ZiyangYan/Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇 4D 场景重建（动态场景 NeRF/3DGS）的综述，按场景表示、时间建模策略、重建流程与优化目标统一组织现有方法，并据此讨论设计选择如何影响几何保真度、外观一致性、运动表示与计算效率。同时梳理常用数据集与评测指标、指出当前实验实践的局限，配套持续更新的论文资源列表。
Motivation: 动态场景重建方法在表示、时间建模与评测协议上高度碎片化，非刚性运动、遮挡与保真度-效率权衡使不同设计选择难以横向比较。
Method: 以场景表示、时间建模策略、重建流程、优化目标四个维度建立统一分类框架，覆盖 NeRF 与 3DGS 两条主线；在此框架下比较设计选择对几何、外观、运动与效率的影响，并汇总常用数据集与评测指标。
Result: 产出为综述性框架与资源集合：统一组织现有 4D 重建方法，整合常用数据集与评测指标，识别当前实验实践中的局限，并维护 Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction 论文列表。
Conclusion: 把方法发展与其底层假设和评测证据对应起来，可为理解现有 4D 场景重建路线与定位开放问题提供结构化基础。

summary_sections.method: 以场景表示、时间建模策略、重建流程、优化目标四个维度建立统一分类框架，覆盖 NeRF 与 3DGS 两条主线；在此框架下比较设计选择对几何、外观、运动与效率的影响，并汇总常用数据集与评测指标。
summary_sections.result: 产出为综述性框架与资源集合：统一组织现有 4D 重建方法，整合常用数据集与评测指标，识别当前实验实践中的局限，并维护 Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction 论文列表。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把方法发展与其底层假设和评测证据对应起来，可为理解现有 4D 场景重建路线与定位开放问题提供结构化基础。

papers.title: Shared Phase and Retention Control for Efficient Adaptive Spectral Recurrence
papers.abstract_en: As new evidence arrives, a sequence model must update what it remembers and how memory influences predictions. While Transformers incur computation and cache costs scaling with context length, fixed-state recurrent models offer constant-memory inference. However, linear and spectral recurrences traditionally rely on static transitions, failing to dynamically revise how stored representations decay or rotate. While recent selective architectures introduce input-dependent transitions, they assign independent controls to every memory mode, coupling control cost to state capacity. We show that high-dimensional spectral memory does not require high-dimensional control, and introduce Shared Phase and Retention Control for Efficient Adaptive Spectral Recurrence (SPARC). SPARC employs just two input-dependent scalar signals to coordinate memory retention and phase rotation across heterogeneous complex modes, while preserving mode-specific baseline timescales and frequencies. Its diagonal affine recurrence supports parallel associative scans for sequence-level BPTT as well as exact structured Real-Time Recurrent Learning (RTRL) for online credit assignment. Across partially observable continuous control, POPGym, and sequence classification, SPARC achieves a 9.09% relative return improvement on Walker-P and a 1.36% relative accuracy gain on FordA over second-best methods. On an NVIDIA Blackwell GPU, our implementation reduces recurrent-mixer training latency by 18.2%-34.2% in fixed-token workloads and accelerates scans by 3.1x-4.7x over an optimized RG-LRU baseline. These results show that two shared control signals can efficiently govern adaptive spectral memory across online and full-sequence settings. Code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/sparc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARC 用仅两个随输入变化的标量信号，统一控制异质复数记忆模态的保留与相位旋转，同时保留各模态自身的基线时间尺度与频率。在部分可观测连续控制、POPGym 与序列分类上，Walker-P 相对回报提升 9.09%，FordA 相对准确率提升 1.36%；Blackwell GPU 上递归混合器训练延迟降 18.2%-34.2%，扫描比优化 RG-LRU 基线快 3.1x-4.7x。
Motivation: 线性与谱递归长期依赖静态状态转移，无法动态修正存储表示的衰减与旋转；而近期选择性架构为每个记忆模态各配独立控制，控制开销随状态容量线性增长。
Method: SPARC 以两个输入依赖的标量信号协调保留与相位旋转，作用于异质复数模态并保留模态各自的基线时间尺度与频率；其对角仿射递归支持并行 associative scan 做序列级 BPTT，也支持精确的结构化 Real-Time Recurrent Learning (RTRL) 做在线信用分配。
Result: 在部分可观测连续控制、POPGym 与序列分类上，Walker-P 相对回报较次优方法提升 9.09%，FordA 相对准确率提升 1.36%；NVIDIA Blackwell GPU 上固定 token 负载的递归混合器训练延迟降低 18.2%-34.2%，扫描相对优化 RG-LRU 基线加速 3.1x-4.7x。
Conclusion: 高维谱记忆不需要高维控制：两个共享控制信号即可在在线与全序列两种设置下有效治理自适应谱记忆，并同时拿到训练延迟与扫描速度收益。

papers.title: MeshOctave: Vertex Split-and-Rewire Cascades for Native Mesh Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating compact, artist-style meshes with explicit topology typically relies on autoregressive models which incur prohibitive sequential per-token costs, or continuous flow models that depend on heuristic connectivity decoders. Next-scale generation paradigms offer a compelling alternative by enabling parallel intra-scale token prediction and coarse-to-fine refinement from global structure to local topology; yet, existing methods derive hierarchical scales via progressive mesh simplification and invert them sequentially. This eliminates intra-scale parallelism and scales generation steps linearly with face count. In this paper, we propose MeshOctave, which instead defines scale through dyadic spatial grid resolutions, framing coarsening as a deterministic collapse that merges vertices sharing a voxel cell and inherits connectivity. Its inverse operation, split-and-rewire, determines which octant sub-vertices are instantiated for each coarse face and resolves local connectivity using discrete structural tokens. These per-face operations require no serialization, each scale transition is modeled as an unordered set that adds one bit of coordinate precision, naturally supporting dynamic-length meshes and adaptive resolution refinement. We construct a scale-conditioned masked-uniform discrete diffusion model to learn split-and-rewire operation from resolution collapse hierarchies. MeshOctave outperforms strong baselines in geometric fidelity and topological validity by a non-trivial margin, while supporting adaptive resolution refinement and extending naturally to mesh subdivision tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshOctave 用二叉空间网格分辨率定义生成尺度，把粗化做成共享体素内顶点合并的确定性 collapse，其逆操作 split-and-rewire 用离散结构 token 决定每个粗面实例化哪些八分体子顶点并解析局部连接。每个面操作无需序列化、每个尺度转换建模为无序集合并增加一位坐标精度，由尺度条件化的 masked-uniform 离散扩散模型学习，从而支持动态长度网格与自适应分辨率细化。
Motivation: 自回归网格生成逐 token 串行代价高，连续流模型依赖启发式连接解码器；现有 next-scale 方法靠渐进网格简化构造层级并串行求逆，消除了尺度内并行性，生成步数随面数线性增长。
Method: 以二叉网格分辨率定义尺度，粗化为继承连接的确定性 collapse；逆操作 split-and-rewire 按面决定八分体子顶点实例化并用离散结构 token 解析连接，尺度转换建模为无序集合。用尺度条件化的 masked-uniform 离散扩散模型从分辨率 collapse 层级中学习 split-and-rewire 操作。
Result: 在几何保真度 (geometric fidelity) 与拓扑有效性 (topological validity) 上以非平凡幅度超越强基线，并支持自适应分辨率细化与网格细分任务；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把生成尺度绑定到确定性的空间网格 collapse 及其 split-and-rewire 逆操作，可在保持显式拓扑的同时获得尺度内并行与动态长度网格，且自然扩展到 mesh subdivision。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reasoning Externalization for Faithful Large Language Model Narratives of Stock Return Predictions
papers.abstract_en: In finance, interpreting machine learning predictions is essential, yet the numerical outputs of explainable AI can be difficult for non-experts to understand. While large language models (LLMs) can translate these outputs into natural language, they may produce errors when inferring numerical changes and feature relations. We propose an LLM narrative framework for cross-sectional stock return prediction that combines temporal Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) evidence with historical regime analogs. Temporal evidence tracks changes in the normalized global SHAP importance of an XGBoost model over six months. Historical analogs are past periods with similar changes in SHAP importance, their model performance and subsequent market returns are provided as comparative context. Using this framework, we conduct a controlled study of progressive reasoning externalization, sequentially providing raw SHAP sequences, deterministic temporal descriptors, and feature relations. Each generated claim is verified against provenance-linked evidence. Across Qwen3, externalizing numerical and relational reasoning improved evidence faithfulness as well as temporal and relational accuracy. Evidence faithfulness increased from 0.696 to 0.996 for Qwen3-32B-Instruct. While historical analogs did not improve structured automatic faithfulness, they received higher human-rated usefulness scores. These results suggest that externalizing verifiable reasoning enhances narrative faithfulness and that historical context adds interpretive value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向横截面股票收益预测的 LLM 叙事框架，把 XGBoost 的时序 SHAP 证据与历史行情类比交给 LLM 生成可核验的自然语言解释，并通过逐步外化数值与关系推理提升忠实度。Qwen3-32B-Instruct 的证据忠实度 (evidence faithfulness) 从 0.696 升到 0.996。
Motivation: 可解释 AI 输出的数值对非专家难懂，而 LLM 转述时容易在数值变化与特征关系上出错，需要让推理过程可外部化、可对照证据核验。
Method: 框架以 XGBoost 六个月的归一化全局 SHAP 重要性时序变化为证据，检索 SHAP 变化相似的历史时期（含模型表现与后续收益）作对照语境；受控实验依次提供原始 SHAP 序列、确定性时序描述子与特征关系，每条生成论断都对照 provenance-linked 证据核验，模型为 Qwen3 系列。
Result: Qwen3-32B-Instruct 的 evidence faithfulness 从 0.696 提升到 0.996，时序与关系准确率同步改善；历史类比未提升结构化自动忠实度指标，但人工评分的有用性 (usefulness) 更高。
Conclusion: 外化可核验的推理能显著增强 LLM 叙事的忠实度，历史语境虽不改善自动忠实度度量，但提供额外解读价值。

papers.title: No Corners Cut: State-Grounded Transitions for Mid-Stream Prompt Switches in Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video generators allow users to dynamically modulate video synthesis via mid-stream prompt switching. Existing streaming methods can respond to the updated instruction while still cutting corners, prematurely realizing goals or taking heuristic shortcuts that bypass necessary intermediate state changes needed for a plausible transition. In this study, we present SEGUE, a novel framework that makes this process explicit and trains the generator to execute these transitions faithfully. At each switch, a training-free planner parses the latest frame and prompts, writes a few segue prompts with roles and durations, and then hands control back to the user's prompt. Furthermore, to address the inherent difficulty of training causal models on short-lived temporal schedules without corrupting preparatory supervision, we introduce SPANDMD, which evaluates each active prompt using the full rollout as temporal context while retaining its DMD residual only within the prompt's assigned span. On OpenTrans-360, a benchmark of 1,800 switches that scores how the old state exits and the new one begins, SEGUE ranks first on all eight transition metrics and raises the overall score over the strongest baseline from 0.866 to 0.887. It also ranks first on four of six instruction-response metrics of StreamAV-Bench, while the planner transfers to frozen autoregressive generators without retraining. Project Page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/No-Corners-Cut-6C5D/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SEGUE 让流式视频生成器在中途换提示时不再抄近路：训练无关的 planner 解析最新帧与提示，写出带角色和时长的 segue prompts，再交还用户提示；SPANDMD 用完整 rollout 作时间上下文评估每个活跃提示，但只在其分配时 span 内保留 DMD 残差。在含 1,800 次切换的 OpenTrans-360 上，SEGUE 八项过渡指标全部第一，总分从最强基线 0.866 提到 0.887。
Motivation: 流式视频生成的中途换提示虽能响应新指令，却常提前达成目标或走启发式捷径，跳过合理过渡所必需的中间状态变化。
Method: SEGUE 框架包含两部分：训练无关的 planner 在每次切换时解析最新帧与提示，生成若干带角色和时长的 segue prompts 后交还用户提示控制权；SPANDMD 训练目标以完整 rollout 作为时间上下文评估每个活跃提示，同时仅在该提示的分配时 span 内保留其 DMD 残差，以避免短时程调度破坏准备性监督。
Result: 在 OpenTrans-360（1,800 次切换、八项过渡指标）上 SEGUE 全部指标排名第一，总分由最强基线 0.866 提升至 0.887；在 StreamAV-Bench 的六项指令响应指标中四项排名第一；planner 可迁移到冻结的自回归生成器而无需重训练。
Conclusion: 把状态过渡显式化并按提示时 span 约束 DMD 残差，能让流式生成器忠实执行换提示过渡而非抄近路，且 planner 具备免重训练的迁移性。

papers.title: KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy
papers.abstract_en: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. More than 35 clinicians contributed to case authoring and benchmark evaluation. In an empirical study, clinicians gave simulated dialogues higher mean quality ratings than reference conversations, which is adapted from real conversation. In each task, an LM has a fixed budget of turns to communicate with the patient, ask about relevant history, request examinations, follow action constraints, and record a final diagnosis. We score these steps separately as well as together. Across 31 models and seven model families, the best-performing models (e.g., GPT-6-astra and Claude Opus 5) succeed on less than 30% of tasks, even though their diagnosis accuracy reaches 90.7%. Some models benefit from talking with the patient; others diagnose well from a complete chart but perform much worse in conversation. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment. All the code and data is available on https://zehui127.github.io/klinikebench/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KlinikeBench 是一个临床 agent 基准：333 个临床医生撰写的任务，每个任务提供隔离沙盒、虚拟患者、临床工具与任务级成功标准，在固定对话轮数预算下分步评分问诊、检查申请、动作约束与最终诊断。在 31 个模型、七个模型家族上，最强模型（GPT-6-astra、Claude Opo 5）任务成功率不足 30%，而诊断准确率达 90.7%，说明诊断准确率高不等于能完成交互式临床评估。
Motivation: 现有临床基准都用完整病例描述考诊断，无法判断 agent 是否主动获取了必要病史、是否安排了恰当检查；且缺少专业临床医生的核验。
Method: 构建 333 个临床医生撰写的任务，每个任务含隔离沙盒、虚拟患者、临床工具与任务专属成功标准；模型在固定轮数预算内与患者沟通、询问病史、申请检查、遵守动作约束并给出最终诊断，各步骤分别评分再合计评分；35 位以上临床医生参与病例撰写与评测。
Result: 31 个模型、七个模型家族上，最佳模型（GPT-6-astra、Claude Opus 5）任务成功不足 30%，而诊断准确率达 90.7%；部分模型靠与患者对话获益，另一些在完整病历上诊断好但对话中表现大幅下降；临床医生给模拟对话的平均质量评分高于改编自真实对话的参考对话。
Conclusion: 诊断准确率与交互式临床评估表现之间存在实质差距，只考诊断无法刻画完整临床接诊能力，需要分步评分的沙盒式测试床。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Storage Is Not Strategy: State-Conditioned Support Control for LLM Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Many localized large language model (LLM) unlearning methods select a small parameter subset from a localization signal and keep it fixed during optimization. The parameters most associated with a target, however, need not be the best ones to update, and candidate interventions can change value as optimization proceeds. In a controlled experiment, a storage-localization score reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.981, yet storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17/36 targets, while low-rank adaptation (LoRA) wins 35/36. We introduce Intervention Score, which ranks editable groups by the predicted effect of the actual unlearning update while accounting for collateral damage, and use it to form the static intervention-value baseline (Static-IV). We then introduce selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R), which revisits that subset only when a calibrated probe justifies the comparison. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, our method has positive descriptive margins in 19/20 comparisons between methods and objectives, although several are near zero. On the LACUNA localization-precision benchmark, our mean terminal utility is higher in all six negative preference optimization (NPO) and SimNPO comparisons: NPO margins range from +0.431 to +0.848, and SimNPO margins range from +0.503 to +0.571. The gradient-difference (GradDiff) objective reveals substantial field dependence. Relative to Static-IV, the primary four-field GradDiff evaluation has six wins, six ties, and no losses, with mean and median paired gains of +0.165 and +0.0025. The evidence supports separating localization, initial intervention selection, and checkpoint-dependent support revision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 遗忘 (unlearning) 中「定位到的参数就是该更新的参数」这一假设被推翻：存储定位分数 AUROC 达 0.981，却只在 36 个目标中的 17 个上与更优干预一致，而 LoRA 在 35/36 上胜出。作者提出 Intervention Score（按实际遗忘更新的预测效果并计入副作用给可编辑分组排序）与选择性动态重排 DIR-R（仅当校准探针证明合理时才重访子集），在 LACUNA 上 NPO 与 SimNPO 六组比较全部取得正边际。
Motivation: 局部化 LLM 遗忘方法从定位信号选出一小撮参数并全程固定，但与目标最相关的参数未必最适合更新，且候选干预的价值会随优化过程改变。
Method: 提出 Intervention Score，按实际遗忘更新的预测效应并计入 collateral damage 对可编辑分组排序，构成静态基线 Static-IV；再提出 selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R)，仅在校准探针 (calibrated probe) 支持比较时才重访该子集，把定位、初始干预选择与随 checkpoint 的支持集修订分开。
Result: 存储定位分数 AUROC 0.981，但存储身份仅在 36 个目标中的 17 个与更优干预一致，LoRA 在 35/36 上胜出。在 Natural-TOFU 上，方法与目标之间 19/20 组比较的描述性边际为正（若干接近零）。在 LACUNA 定位精度基准上，六组 NPO 与 SimNPO 比较的平均终端效用全部更高：NPO 边际 +0.431 至 +0.848，SimNPO +0.503 至 +0.571。GradDiff 目标显示明显场依赖：相对 Static-IV 的四场主评估为六胜六平零负，配对增益均值 +0.165、中位数 +0.0025。
Conclusion: 定位、初始干预选择与随 checkpoint 的支持集修订应当分开处理，参数存储位置并不决定更新策略；干预价值具有目标与场依赖，需按实际更新效果而非定位分数来选。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JudgeProfile: Understanding and Steering Subjectivity in LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: LLM judges are inherently subjective, often favoring different responses in pairwise comparison when neither option is objectively wrong. To study this subjectivity, we introduce JudgeProfile, a framework that dissects LLM evaluation into perception (how a judge compares two responses across specific attributes like clarity, correctness, and detail) and prioritization (how much each attribute influences the final choice). We curate SubjectiveSet, a dataset of 50,013 response pairs from 17 public data sources, evaluated by 21 LLM judges across 87 attributes. We find a hidden consensus in perception: judges frequently agree on attribute judgments even when their overall choices diverge. Building on this separation, we first characterize each judge's prioritization using attribute weights estimated from its own overall choices. These weights differ across judges even when estimated from the same attribute judgments. We then learn new weights from reference labels to adapt their decisions to a target evaluation standard. Reweighting perceived attributes improves average held-out agreement with reference labels from 66.48% to 71.97%, outperforming fine-tuning and rubric prompting. Our findings show that understanding and steering the subjectivity of LLM judges requires attention not only to what they perceive, but also to how they prioritize it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JudgeProfile 把 LLM 评判拆成感知 (perception) 与优先级 (prioritization) 两层，发现各评判者在属性判断上存在隐藏共识，分歧主要来自属性权重。用参考标签重新学习权重可将留出集一致率从 66.48% 提到 71.97%，超过微调与 rubric prompting。
Motivation: LLM 评判者在双方都不客观错误时会系统性偏向不同回答，这种主观性使评判结果难以对齐目标评估标准。
Method: 构建 SubjectiveSet：来自 17 个公开数据源的 50,013 组回答对，由 21 个 LLM 评判者按 87 个属性评估；先从各评判者的整体选择反推属性权重刻画其 prioritization，再从参考标签学习新权重以适配目标标准。
Result: 重加权感知属性使留出集与参考标签的平均一致率从 66.48% 提升到 71.97%，优于 fine-tuning 与 rubric prompting；不同评判者即便基于相同属性判断，估计出的权重也不同。
Conclusion: 理解和引导 LLM 评判的主观性，既要关注它们感知到什么，也要关注它们如何对感知属性排序加权。

papers.title: MLToolBench: Learning Tool-Augmented Agents for Machine Learning Development
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made substantial progress, but learning through ML experimentation remains costly in time and computation. Synthetic environments reduce these costs while introducing variations in data and experimental settings that require task-specific diagnosis. Access to diagnostic tools alone does not ensure that agents learn when to use them or how to act on their findings. We introduce ToolMLBench, a suite of executable tools for data inspection, code verification, and experiment diagnosis, together with an SFT and RL pipeline for learning their use. Diagnostic calls acquire evidence whose value depends on subsequent decisions, so final outcomes provide limited guidance on which calls to reinforce. We address this challenge with SPICE, which measures how privileged context changes the likelihood of a sampled tool action and uses this difference as a turn-level reward alongside the final outcome. We train on 80 synthetic tasks and evaluate on 25 in-domain and 10 out-of-domain tasks. Providing tool interfaces and descriptions alone yields inconsistent gains across unadapted models. With the same diagnostic interface, our training pipeline raises in-domain success from 24.8% to 52.4% for Qwen3-8B and from 35.6% to 69.2% for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. The latter also improves from 31% to 48% out-of-domain, supporting learned diagnostic tool use on held-out sources and targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ToolMLBench：一套面向机器学习开发 agent 的可执行诊断工具（数据检查、代码验证、实验诊断）配合 SFT+RL 训练管线，并用 SPICE 奖励解决诊断调用的中间证据难以被最终结果归因的问题。在 80 个合成任务训练、25 个域内与 10 个域外任务评测下，同接口下 Qwen3-8B 域内成功率 24.8%→52.4%，Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 35.6%→69.2%、域外 31%→48%。
Motivation: MLE agent 通过实验学习耗时耗算力，合成环境带来数据与实验设置变化；只给工具接口和描述并不能让模型学会何时调用工具、如何利用诊断结果，且诊断调用的价值取决于后续决策，最终结果对中间调用的归因信号太弱。
Method: 发布 ToolMLBench：数据检查、代码验证、实验诊断三类可执行工具，配套 SFT 与 RL 训练管线。核心奖励为 SPICE，用特权上下文 (privileged context) 改变采样工具动作似然的差值作为回合级 (turn-level) 奖励，与最终结果奖励叠加；在 80 个合成任务上训练。
Result: 仅提供工具接口与描述时，未适配模型收益不一致；同一诊断接口下训练管线把域内成功率从 24.8% 提到 52.4%（Qwen3-8B）、从 35.6% 提到 69.2%（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B），后者域外从 31% 提到 48%。评测含 25 个域内与 10 个域外任务。
Conclusion: 诊断工具的使用需要显式训练而非仅靠接口暴露；用特权上下文对工具动作的似然变化做回合级奖励，能在域内与域外任务上同时提升 MLE agent 的成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Infrared Subtraction with Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: We present AI-developed local infrared subtraction, building on projection to Born and EFT matching. The framework separates an integrable radiation term from a finite contribution at Born kinematics, referred to as the Born contact. The contact is determined using the EFT singular distribution in a resolution observable such as N-jettiness $τ_N$. Under human physics guidance, an LLM develops two implementations. One uses a neural network for phase space projection and fits the contact by matching to EFT cumulants. The other uses an analytic construction that keeps the Born momenta fixed while integrating over radiation. It combines the EFT $δ(τ_N)$ coefficient with finite 4-dimensional radiation integrals to calculate the contact term directly. This gives a local subtraction formula without a slicing parameter, while reusing existing lower-order radiation calculations and EFT singular predictions. As a demonstration, we reconstruct the full NLO correction for massless 3- and 4-jet production in electron-positron annihilation. The attempt to the NNLO dijet production is also made by recursively using the NLO P2B construction with the LLM designing machine-learning controls to reduce the variance of the contact integral. The tested predictions are in good agreement with EERAD3. The numerical calculation and projection-network training use a 2020 Apple M1 MacBook, without GPU acceleration, illustrating the feasibility of the construction with modest computing resources. The appendices develop an extension of the local subtraction to 3-jet NNLO, giving explicit radiation maps and a proposed contact formula. We also show how to integrate over NNLO radiation while keeping the Born momenta fixed, for any number of massless final-state jets. Our results demonstrate how AI can help higher-order calculations by constructing infrared subtraction and improving its numerical integration.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 11 figs. References and text updated, including the analytic NNLO di-jet contact term calculated by the LLM directly within the P2B+EFT subtraction in 4 dimensions. Prompts and pseudocode for LLM-based agents to reproduce the figs are available in the Ancillary Files section. Prompts for reproducing the analytic contact term can be provided upon request
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出由 LLM 在人类物理指导下开发的局域红外减除 (local infrared subtraction)：把可积辐射项与 Born 运动学处的有限 Born contact 分离，contact 由 EFT 奇异分布（分辨观测量 N-jettiness τ_N）确定，从而得到无 slicing 参数的减除公式。在 e+e− 湮灭中重建 3、4-jet 的完整 NLO 修正，并尝试用递归 P2B 构造 NNLO dijet，结果与 EERAD3 良好一致。
Motivation: 高阶微扰计算中的红外减除通常依赖 slicing 参数，且数值积分方差大；作者希望在不引入 slicing 参数的前提下复用已有低阶辐射计算与 EFT 奇异预测，并让 LLM 参与构造与方差控制。
Method: 框架建立在 projection to Born (P2B) 与 EFT matching 之上：将可积辐射项与 Born 运动学处的有限 contact 分离，contact 由 N-jettiness τ_N 上的 EFT 奇异分布确定。LLM 在人类物理指导下给出两种实现——其一用神经网络做相空间投影、通过匹配 EFT cumulants 拟合 contact；其二保持 Born 动量固定、对辐射积分，把 EFT δ(τ_N) 系数与有限 4 维辐射积分结合直接算出 contact，并由 LLM 设计机器学习控制量降低 contact 积分方差。
Result: 重建了 e+e− 湮灭中无质量 3-jet 与 4-jet 产生的完整 NLO 修正；对 dijet NNLO 用递归 NLO P2B 构造做了尝试，测试预测与 EERAD3 良好一致。数值计算与投影网络训练在 2020 Apple M1 MacBook 上完成、无 GPU 加速。附录给出向 3-jet NNLO 的推广，含显式辐射映射与所提 contact 公式。
Conclusion: 无 slicing 参数的局域红外减除可以在 modest 计算资源上构造并数值实现，AI（LLM 与神经网络）能直接参与高阶微扰计算中的减除构造与数值积分改进。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.motivation: 高阶微扰计算中的红外减除通常依赖 slicing 参数，且数值积分方差大；作者希望在不引入 slicing 参数的前提下复用已有低阶辐射计算与 EFT 奇异预测，并让 LLM 参与构造与方差控制。

papers.title: AX is the New AEO
papers.abstract_en: In 2023, AI models answered from training data and hallucinated when it ran out, and businesses were told to seed that knowledge. Models' training knowledge has since given way to live web search, and the advice followed it there: answer-engine optimization, or AEO, now tells businesses to scatter breadcrumbs across forum threads, listicles, and off-site citations, so AI engines are likelier to surface and recommend them. But being surfaced is no longer enough: an agent opens the results and reads them before deciding, and one buyer question sends it through several rounds of search and fetch. What decides the outcome at this drill-down step is whether the agent can fetch and read the business's own site: agent experience (AX). We argue that AX is the new AEO. We run 37,927 agent journeys, each a buyer question about a business, across four independent harnesses over 1,056 real businesses, matched on fame, prior model knowledge, and two AEO proxies, then split based on their AX level. Only 7-10% of the finished answer comes from the model's training knowledge, whether or not the site is readable. Agent-ready businesses have answers built from their own pages 78% of the time against 56% and are clearly recommended 1.9x more often, while a grounded answer about a not-agent-ready business costs the agent 64% more on average. Holding business, harness, and question fixed, answers built from the site are 41% more accurate on average. The dominant failure is not fabrication but omission: web-built answers are 3.7x more likely to contain none of the facts the buyer asked for. Baselines differ sharply across the four harnesses, with clear-recommendation rates varying sevenfold from stack to stack, yet the recommendation gap holds in every one. In the agentic web era, being readable beats being talked about, and improving a site's AX is the strongest lever a business has.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 AX（agent experience，即站点对 AI agent 的可抓取可读性）正在取代 AEO 成为影响 AI 引擎推荐的主导因素。在 37,927 次 agent 旅程、1,056 家真实企业的四套独立 harness 实验中，agent-ready 企业 78% 的答案由其自身页面构成（非 agent-ready 为 56%），被明确推荐的频率高 1.9 倍，且该推荐差距在四套 harness 中均成立。
Motivation: AEO 只教企业在论坛、榜单和站外引用里撒线索，但 agent 会进一步抓取并阅读企业自有站点后才做决定；这一步的成败取决于站点本身是否可抓可读，而非被谈论的程度。
Method: 运行 37,927 次 agent 旅程（每次为一个关于某企业的买家问题），跨四套独立 harness、覆盖 1,056 家真实企业；企业在 fame、既有模型知识与两个 AEO 代理指标上配对，再按 AX 水平分组对比。
Result: 无论站点是否可读，答案中仅 7-10% 来自模型训练知识；agent-ready 企业答案基于其自身页面的比例为 78%（对照 56%），被明确推荐的频率高 1.9 倍，grounded 答案平均多耗费 agent 64% 成本；固定企业、harness 与问题后，基于站点的答案平均准确率高 41%。主要失败模式是遗漏而非编造：web 构建的答案含买家所问事实全无的可能性高 3.7 倍。四套 harness 的基线差异极大，明确推荐率相差七倍，但推荐差距在每套中都成立。
Conclusion: 在 agentic web 时代，可读性胜过被谈论，提升站点 AX 是企业最强的杠杆；主导失败是遗漏而非幻觉。

papers.title: CLAD: Constrained Abstract Domain for Neural Network Verification
papers.abstract_en: Neural network verification (NNV) formally verifies that a network satisfies a specified property for all inputs within a defined region. Modern NNV tools employ abstract domains to compute a sound over-approximation of the network's behavior from the given input region, thus the tightness of these abstractions essentially determines efficiency. A long line of increasingly precise domains has been developed, but they all describe the valid input region in the same restrictive way, e.g., an Lp-norm ball. A practical input region is rarely a simple Lp ball, but rather a combination Lp ball with additional constraints. Verifying a network over such a region with existing abstraction produces a loose over-approximation, which results in either failing to verify a property or spurious counterexamples. We introduce Constrained Lagrangian Abstract Domain (CLAD), a new abstract domain that computes a sound over-approximation of neural networks over input regions defined by a combination of convex constraints. CLAD propagates these constraints and tightens bounds over the true feasible region. However, bounding a neuron over the intersection of these constraints has no closed-form solution, so CLAD relaxes each constraint into the objective with a Lagrange multiplier and solves the resulting max-min problem with a projected primal-dual method, alternating a projected gradient step on the input with a multiplier update. CLAD supports any convex constraint with a subgradient, e.g., from automatic differentiation. We evaluate CLAD on 1,944 instances across four convolutional networks with motion-blur structured perturbations with halfspace or L2-ball constraints. On standard unconstrained Linf property, CLAD verifies as many instances as GCPCROWN at a similar runtime. On constrained properties, CLAD verifies 60% more instances than GCPCROWN on L2-ball properties, and 22% more in total.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLAD 是一个面向神经网络验证 (NNV) 的约束型抽象域，把输入区域从单一 Lp 球推广到凸约束组合，用拉格朗日乘子把每条约束并入目标，再以投影原始-对偶方法（对输入做投影梯度步、交替更新乘子）求解 max-min 界。在 1,944 个含运动模糊结构化扰动的实例上，约束性质下比 GCPCROWN 多验证 60%（L2-ball）与总计 22%，无约束 Linf 性质上与 GCPCROWN 验证数相当、运行时相近。
Motivation: 现有抽象域都用 Lp 球描述输入区域，而实际输入区域常是 Lp 球加额外约束；在错误区域上做松弛会得到过松的过近似，导致性质验证失败或产生伪反例。
Method: CLAD（Constrained Lagrangian Abstract Domain）在真实可行域上传播凸约束并收紧逐神经元的界；由于约束交集上的界无闭式解，它用拉格朗日乘子把每条约束松弛进目标，用投影原始-对偶方法求解 max-min 问题，交替执行对输入的投影梯度步与乘子更新。支持任意带次梯度的凸约束（可由自动微分给出）。
Result: 在四个卷积网络、1,944 个实例、含运动模糊结构化扰动（halfspace 或 L2-ball 约束）上评测：标准无约束 Linf 性质下 CLAD 验证实例数与 GCPCROWN 相同、运行时相近；约束性质下，L2-ball 性质比 GCPCROWN 多验证 60%，总计多验证 22%。
Conclusion: 把输入区域的凸约束显式带进抽象域传播，可以在不牺牲无约束情形效率的前提下，显著减少因区域描述过粗导致的验证失败与伪反例。

papers.title: Calibrated Uncertainty for Informative Path Planning in Aquatic Environmental Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Informative Path Planning for scalar field reconstruction uses predictive uncertainty to direct sensing vehicles toward maximally informative locations. Gaussian Processes provide this signal but their stationary isotropic kernels are misspecified for non-homogeneous phenomena such as oil spills, producing miscalibrated estimates that degrade planning. We investigate whether replacing the Gaussian Process with a well-calibrated Deep Ensemble improves path planning outcomes, and whether uncertainty quality interacts with the choice of planning algorithm. Five strategies ($ε$-Greedy, Value Greedy, Uncertainty Greedy, Monte Carlo Tree Search, and Receding Horizon Orienteering) share a common Deep Ensemble backbone trained on physics-based oil spill simulations. On held-out stochastic spill scenarios, the Deep Ensemble reduces normalised reconstruction error by $83\%$ relative to the Gaussian Process baseline. Crucially, well-calibrated uncertainty amplifies the importance of the planning strategy: the performance gap between algorithms is negligible under miscalibrated models but becomes substantial under the ensemble, where multi-step lookahead planners outperform greedy selection by up to $32\%$ in reconstruction error and achieve IoU above $0.85$. Monte Carlo Tree Search is the recommended planner, matching Orienteering in reconstruction quality at an order-of-magnitude lower computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在水环境监测的标量场重建中，用在物理驱动溢油仿真上训练的 Deep Ensemble 替换高斯过程 (GP) 作不确定性来源，可把归一化重建误差降低 83%。校准良好的不确定性会放大规划算法之间的差距：多步前瞻规划比贪心选择最高可好 32%，IoU 超过 0.85。作者推荐 Monte Carlo Tree Search，其重建质量与 Receding Horizon Orienteering 相当而计算成本低一个数量级。
Motivation: GP 的平稳各向同性核对溢油这类非均匀现象设定错误，导致不确定性失准、路径规划变差；而不确定性质量与规划算法选择之间的交互此前不清楚。
Method: 以 Deep Ensemble 为共同预测骨干，在基于物理的溢油仿真上训练，替换 GP 的不确定性信号；在其上比较五种规划策略：ε-Greedy、Value Greedy、Uncertainty Greedy、Monte Carlo Tree Search、Receding Horizon Orienteering，并在留出的随机溢油场景上检验。
Result: 在留出的随机溢油场景上，Deep Ensemble 相对 GP 基线把归一化重建误差降低 83%；在失准模型下各算法差距可忽略，而在 ensemble 下差距显著，多步前瞻规划比贪心选择在重建误差上最高好 32%，IoU 高于 0.85；MCTS 以低一个数量级的计算成本达到与 Orienteering 相当的重建质量。
Conclusion: 不确定性校准质量会放大规划算法的价值，因此应先修好预测不确定性再谈规划器选型；MCTS 是推荐的规划器。

papers.title: ZonoGPT: Towards An Abstract Domain for Verifying Large GPT Models
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models are widely used for reasoning, coding, and multimodal agentic tasks. To provide formal assurance of desirable behaviors, such as robustness, safety, and fairness, neural network verification techniques prove required properties and provide auditable guarantees before deployment. However, prior work remains limited to small or restricted Transformers, and maintaining precision across deep models remains challenging. In this work, we introduce ZonoGpt, an abstract domain for verifying large transformers that maintains a space complexity independent of network depth. ZonoGpt uses a structured zonotope and a generator reduction mechanism to efficiently preserve correlations. To maintain precision, it introduces block-specific fused transformations for Attention and LayerNorm that retain feature relations, along with an affine transform for GELU that preserves generator relations. These mechanisms enable ZonoGpt to be the first approach to verify standard architectures, scaling to official HuggingFace models up to GPT-2 Medium (24 blocks, 300M+ parameters) and successfully verifying 1,339 instances across text and vision tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ZonoGPT 是一个面向大 Transformer 形式化验证的抽象域，空间复杂度与网络深度无关，用结构化 zonotope 加 generator reduction 保住相关性，并为 Attention 与 LayerNorm 设计 block-specific fused transformation、为 GELU 设计保持 generator 关系的仿射变换。它能验证标准架构，扩展到官方 HuggingFace 的 GPT-2 Medium（24 blocks、300M+ 参数），在文本与视觉任务上共成功验证 1,339 个实例。
Motivation: 神经网络验证此前只能覆盖小型或受限 Transformer，且在深层模型上维持精度困难，无法为部署前的鲁棒性、安全性、公平性提供可审计保证。
Method: ZonoGpt 用结构化 zonotope 表示抽象域，配合 generator reduction 机制保持相关性；对 Attention 和 LayerNorm 引入保留特征关系的 block-specific fused transformation，对 GELU 引入保留 generator 关系的仿射变换，使空间复杂度不随网络深度增长。
Result: 扩展到官方 HuggingFace 模型最高 GPT-2 Medium（24 blocks、300M+ 参数），在文本与视觉任务上成功验证 1,339 个实例。
Conclusion: 深度无关的空间复杂度加上针对 Attention/LayerNorm/GELU 的定制变换，使标准架构的大 Transformer 可以被形式化验证并给出可审计保证。

papers.title: Enhanced Video Text Editing with Trajectory-Aligned Glyph Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Video text editing aims to replace or add text in a video while keeping the rest of the video unchanged, which requires the edited text to be correct in every frame and to move coherently with the scene. Despite the remarkable progress of video diffusion models, they struggle to reproduce exact stroke structures and often produce garbled or wrong characters, especially for characters with complex strokes. To address this, we propose a trajectory-aligned glyph rendering reference that provides explicit per-frame glyph guidance following the position and perspective of the text, and a depth-normalized recognizer feature supervision that supervises the generated text on multi-depth features of a frozen text recognizer with per-depth normalized errors, targeting stroke errors overlooked by the diffusion loss. We further build VTEdit, a benchmark of 288 real-scene clips with 440 annotated text trajectories covering text replacement and text addition, which will be publicly released to facilitate future research. Experiments on VTEdit show that our method outperforms image text editing methods, video editing methods, and commercial models in text accuracy and background preservation, achieving a sentence accuracy of 0.9408, and receives the highest preference in a user study.

TL;DR: VTEdit 用轨迹对齐的字形渲染参考 (trajectory-aligned glyph rendering) 给视频扩散模型提供逐帧、随位置与透视变化的字形引导，再用深度归一化的冻结文字识别器特征监督纠正笔画级错误。在自建的 288 段真实场景片段、440 条标注文本轨迹基准上，句子准确率达 0.9408，文本准确率与背景保持均超过图像文本编辑、视频编辑方法与商业模型，并在用户研究中获最高偏好。
Motivation: 视频扩散模型难以复现精确笔画结构，常生成乱码或错字，复杂笔画字符尤其严重；且缺少能同时考核逐帧文字正确性与随场景运动一致性的评测基准。
Method: 提出轨迹对齐的字形渲染参考，按文本位置与透视提供显式逐帧字形引导；配合深度归一化识别器特征监督，在冻结文本识别器的多深度特征上以逐深度归一化误差约束生成文字，针对扩散损失忽略的笔画错误；并构建 VTEdit 基准，含 288 段真实场景片段、440 条标注文本轨迹，覆盖文本替换与文本添加。
Result: 在 VTEdit 上，本方法在文本准确率与背景保持上超过图像文本编辑方法、视频编辑方法与商业模型，句子准确率 (sentence accuracy) 0.9408，并在用户研究中获得最高偏好。
Conclusion: 显式逐帧字形引导加识别器特征监督能让视频文本编辑在每帧都写对字并跟随场景运动，VTEdit 将公开以支撑后续研究。

papers.title: KVCMAS: Efficient KV cache Correction for Shared Context in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Prompt-specialized multi-agent systems enable multiple agents to share a model while performing complementary roles to solve complex tasks. However, agent-specific prefixes change the KV cache generated for the same shared context, causing each agent to repeatedly prefill the growing context and construct a separate cache with high computation and memory overhead. Selective recomputation reduces this redundancy but still retains substantial model execution, while existing delta correction methods either support only recurring context relations or maintain memory-intensive online correction states for dynamically changing context. For first seen shared context, these methods also construct a reference cache outside the agent workflow, and an approximate correction at the first agent affects the outputs passed to subsequent agents. We present KVCMAS, an online KV cache correction framework that represents cross-agent cache deviations using compact low-rank states and seamlessly chains corrections along the agent workflow without an additional reference prefill. This design supports dynamically changing shared context while preserving an exact first-agent cache. Across multiple language and vision-language workloads, KVCMAS matches or improves the accuracy of prior KV cache sharing methods while achieving the lowest TTFT under highly concurrent serving. Under controlled serving traces, it provides a 2.0x TTFT speedup over inference without KV cache sharing and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 3.7x relative to a prior KV cache correction method. These results establish KVCMAS as an accurate and scalable KV cache sharing approach for prompt-specialized multi-agent serving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KVCMAS 用紧凑低秩状态表示跨 agent 的 KV cache 偏差，沿 agent 工作流链式传递校正且无需额外 reference prefill，从而在保留首个 agent 精确 cache 的同时支持动态变化的共享上下文。在高并发 serving 下 TTFT 相对不做 KV cache 共享的推理提速 2.0x，峰值 GPU 显存相对既有 KV cache 校正方法最多降低 3.7x，精度匹配或优于既有共享方法。
Motivation: prompt-specialized 多 agent 共享同一模型时，agent 特有前缀使同一共享上下文产生不同 KV cache，各 agent 反复 prefill 增长的上下文并各建一份 cache，计算与内存开销高；既有 delta correction 只支持重复出现的上下文关系，或需维护内存密集的在线校正状态。
Method: KVCMAS 是在线 KV cache 校正框架：用紧凑低秩状态刻画跨 agent 的 cache 偏差，沿 agent 工作流链式传递校正，不额外做 reference prefill；首个 agent 的 cache 保持精确，避免首 agent 的近似校正污染后续 agent 的输入。
Result: 在多种语言与视觉语言负载上，精度匹配或优于既有 KV cache 共享方法，高并发 serving 下 TTFT 最低；在受控 serving trace 下，相对不做 KV cache 共享的推理 TTFT 提速 2.0x，相对既有 KV cache 校正方法峰值 GPU 显存最多降低 3.7x。
Conclusion: 低秩链式校正加精确首 agent cache，可以在 prompt-specialized 多 agent serving 中同时做到精度不降、TTFT 最低与显存最省，是可扩展的 KV cache 共享方案。

papers.title: PReCache: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA Agents via Low-Rank Precomputation and Neutral Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Multi-LoRA agent systems enable efficient role specialization by sharing a common backbone model. However, each agent repeatedly processes the growing shared trajectory and constructs its own KV cache, introducing substantial memory and computation redundancy in long-horizon tasks. Existing KV cache sharing methods reduce this repeated prefill, but they either require additional training or architectural constraints or retain substantial model computation. Moreover, direct cache reuse causes the current agent to rely on cache states generated by the previous agent's adapter, weakening the role-specific behavior encoded by its own LoRA. We present PReCache, a training-free KV cache sharing framework with two designs, namely PreLRShared and ReBaseShared, that share the base cache computed using the pretrained weights and precompute a compact agent-specific low-rank (LR) cache. To remove repeated prefill, PreLRShared precomputes each agent's LR cache when the shared context is first processed, allowing the current agent to use its own LR cache without reprocessing context processed by previous agents. To improve sharing accuracy, ReBaseShared reconstructs the shared base cache from adapter-free hidden states, reducing the remaining error caused by the previous agent's adapted representation. To minimize its reconstruction cost, we propose two inference schemes tailored to single-stream inference and concurrent serving, performing the same reconstruction after each agent's turn or alongside its execution, respectively. Across multiple models and agent benchmarks, PreLRShared achieves up to a 3.1x TTFT speedup and a 2.3x improvement in per-request throughput over inference without KV cache sharing. ReBaseShared best preserves accuracy overall among the evaluated cache-sharing methods, with an average drop of only 1.1 points relative to inference without cache sharing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PReCache 是面向 multi-LoRA agent 的免训练 KV cache 共享框架：PreLRShared 在共享上下文首次处理时预计算各 agent 的低秩 (LR) cache 以省掉重复 prefill，ReBaseShared 从无 adapter 的 hidden states 重建共享 base cache 以纠正上一 agent 表示带来的偏差。在多个模型与 agent benchmark 上，PreLRShared 相对无 cache 共享的推理最高 3.1x TTFT 加速、每请求吞吐提升 2.3x；ReBaseShared 在所评测的 cache 共享方法中精度保持最好，平均仅下降 1.1 点。
Motivation: Multi-LoRA agent 系统中每个 agent 都要反复 prefill 逐渐增长的共享轨迹并自建 KV cache，在长程任务里造成大量内存与计算冗余；现有 cache 共享方法要么需要额外训练或结构约束，要么仍保留可观的模型计算，且直接复用 cache 会让当前 agent 依赖上一 agent adapter 产生的状态，削弱自身 LoRA 编码的角色行为。
Method: 两个设计：PreLRShared 在共享上下文首次被处理时预计算每个 agent 的紧凑低秩 cache，后续轮次直接使用自己的 LR cache 而不重跑前序 agent 处理过的上下文；ReBaseShared 从 adapter-free hidden states 重建共享 base cache，以消除上一 agent 适配表示引入的残余误差。为压低重建开销，另给出两种推理方案：single-stream 下每轮结束后做同样重建，concurrent serving 下与当前 agent 执行并行完成重建。
Result: 在多个模型与 agent benchmark 上，PreLRShared 相对不做 KV cache 共享的推理最高获得 3.1x TTFT 加速与 2.3x 每请求吞吐提升；ReBaseShared 在所评测的 cache 共享方法中整体精度保持最好，相对无 cache 共享的推理平均仅下降 1.1 点。
Conclusion: 免训练的低秩预计算加无 adapter 重建，可以在 multi-LoRA agent 服务中同时拿掉重复 prefill 并保住角色化精度，重建成本可用单流或并发两种推理方案摊掉。

papers.title: SymNetPro: LOS-Aware Directional Multi-Transmitter Localization from Sparse Radio Observations
papers.abstract_en: Directional multi-transmitter localization from sparse received-power observations is difficult because the receiver observes only the source-unresolved aggregate field: multiple directional sources superpose, building blockage fragments their visible regions, and stronger sources can mask weaker ones. We present SymNetPro, which retains the dual-task radio-map reconstruction and localization backbone of SymNet and adds two targeted components. First, a sparse line-of-sight (LOS)-aware attention bias injects obstruction-aware spatial relations into selected token interactions. Second, transmitter-drop augmentation recomposes training scenes after removing one sample-supported transmitter, exposing the model to controlled source-cardinality variation. Experiments on directional ray-traced urban environments show substantially lower OSPA than representative localization baselines under extreme sparse sampling, with consistent gains under measurement noise and increasing transmitter count. A transmitter-specific evidence analysis further shows that remaining misses concentrate in regimes where the target contributes little distinguishable power to the aggregate observation.
papers.comment: Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at:https://github.com/LyuzhouYe98/SymNet--a-multi-task-network-for-joint-radio-map-reconstruction-and-transmitter-localization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SymNetPro 在稀疏接收功率观测下做 LOS 感知的定向多发射机定位：用稀疏 LOS 注意力偏置注入遮挡感知的空间关系，并用 transmitter-drop 增广重组训练场景以覆盖源数量变化。在方向性射线追踪城市环境中，极端稀疏采样下 OSPA 显著低于代表性定位基线，且在测量噪声与发射机数量增加时保持一致增益。
Motivation: 接收机只能看到多个定向源叠加后的未分辨聚合场，建筑遮挡割裂可见区域、强源掩盖弱源，稀疏采样下多发射机定位因此困难。
Method: 保留 SymNet 的双任务 radio-map 重建与定位骨干，新增两组件：稀疏 LOS-aware attention bias 在选定 token 交互中注入遮挡感知空间关系；transmitter-drop 增广在移除一个样本支持的发射机后重组训练场景，控制源基数变化。
Result: 在方向性射线追踪城市环境中，极端稀疏采样下 OSPA 显著低于代表性定位基线，且在测量噪声与发射机数量增加时保持一致增益；发射机级证据分析显示残余漏检集中在目标对聚合观测贡献可区分功率很少的场景。
Conclusion: 遮挡感知关系建模与源基数增广能提升稀疏观测下的多发射机定位，剩余误差由弱目标功率被聚合场淹没这一物理极限决定。

papers.title: SWE-Game: Can Coding Agents Build the Games We Want?
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SWE-Game, a benchmark of 247 tasks grounded in 41 executable reference Godot games spanning 13 gameplay categories in 2D and 3D. Five task types cover development from a brief, implementation from a game design document, skeleton completion, repair of 83 injected-fault cases, and Godot-to-Unity porting. Reference materials specify the intended gameplay, while a shared instrumentation interface lets evaluator-owned drivers and probes execute actions and observe independently implemented games. Evaluation combines engine-state checks, certified reference-input replay, and agent-authored feature demonstrations to assess mechanic correctness, demonstrated playability, and behavioral restoration and preservation after repairs. Game-specific vision-language rubrics separately assess presentation. Across six models, Opus5 achieves the highest overall score in all five task types. Best overall scores remain below 60 out of 100 across the three construction tasks, with Brief-to-Game reaching 50.38. Analysis of reviewed submissions identifies requirement omissions and gameplay logic errors as predominant implementation problems. On human-labeled behaviors from 100 agent-built games, executable checks achieve 92.59% balanced accuracy, compared with 78.41% for a video-based VLM judge. Rubric-based visual scores reach a Spearman correlation of 0.829 with human ratings of 200 gameplay clips. Together, these results characterize current agent capabilities across game-development activities and support combining runtime evidence with visual assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWE-Game 是一个游戏开发基准：247 个任务、41 个可执行 Godot 参考游戏、13 类 2D/3D 玩法，覆盖从需求简报生成游戏、按设计文档实现、骨架补全、83 个注入故障修复与 Godot-to-Unity 移植五类任务。六个模型中 Opus5 在全部五类任务上总分最高，但三类构建任务最佳总分仍低于 60/100，Brief-to-Game 仅 50.38；主要失败模式是需求遗漏与玩法逻辑错误。
Motivation: 现有代码 agent 基准多针对通用软件任务，缺少对可执行游戏成品的机制正确性与可玩性的评测，无法判断 agent 能否真正做出我们想要的游戏。
Method: 评测由三部分组成：引擎状态检查、经认证的参考输入重放 (certified reference-input replay)、以及 agent 自撰的功能演示；共享 instrumentation 接口让评测方驱动器与探针独立执行动作并观测独立实现的游戏，另有按游戏定制的 vision-language rubric 单独评估画面表现。
Result: 六个模型中 Opus5 在五类任务上总分均最高；三类构建任务最佳总分低于 60/100，Brief-to-Game 为 50.38；83 个注入故障修复案例中，主要问题是需求遗漏与玩法逻辑错误。在 100 个 agent 构建游戏的人工标注行为上，可执行检查 balanced accuracy 92.59%，视频 VLM judge 为 78.41%；rubric 视觉分与 200 段游戏片段人工评分的 Spearman 相关为 0.829。
Conclusion: 当前 coding agent 在游戏构建上仍明显不足，最佳成绩不到 60 分；把运行时可执行证据与视觉评估结合起来，比单纯用视频 VLM 判分更可靠。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 评测由三部分组成：引擎状态检查、经认证的参考输入重放 (certified reference-input replay)、以及 agent 自撰的功能演示；共享 instrumentation 接口让评测方驱动器与探针独立执行动作并观测独立实现的游戏，另有按游戏定制的 vision-language rubric 单独评估画面表现。

papers.title: SketchSSM: Write to the Full State, Read from a Compact Sketch
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid-attention models replace most softmax attention layers with linear attention, reducing KV-cache growth and enabling larger decode batches where recurrent-state access becomes a major bottleneck. ReplaySSM amortizes state updates by buffering keys and values, but each new query still requires a full-state read even though the state remains unchanged between state updates. We observe that low-rank state-weighted query approximation accurately preserves state-read outputs. Although future queries are unknown, the basis vectors used to approximate them can be fixed offline. Based on this observation, we introduce SketchSSM, which preserves full-state updates while approximating reads. At each state update, SketchSSM reads the full state once to precompute outputs for these basis vectors, storing them in a compact sketch. Each subsequent decode step combines the sketch vectors with query-dependent coefficients to reconstruct the output without a full-state read. Across four Mamba-2-, GDN-, and KDA-based models, SketchSSM at a mean sketch rank of 8 reduces state-access traffic by approximately 10$\times$ while matching the average accuracy of the FP32 full-state baseline across four decode benchmarks, and preserves recall on four RULER retrieval tasks. At this rank on one NVIDIA B300, linear-attention kernel speedups over the Standard vLLM baseline reach 7.30$\times$, 5.02$\times$, and 5.24$\times$ for Mamba-2, GDN, and KDA, respectively, with up to 2.77$\times$ higher decode throughput on Nemotron 3 Super.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SketchSSM 针对混合注意力模型解码时循环状态访问成为瓶颈的问题，保留全状态更新、只把状态读取做低秩近似：每次状态更新时用固定基向量读一次全状态并预存成紧凑 sketch，之后每个解码步用查询相关系数组合 sketch 向量重建输出。在四个基于 Mamba-2、GDN、KDA 的模型上，平均 sketch rank 8 时状态访问流量降约 10×，四个解码基准的平均精度与 FP32 全状态基线持平，RULER 四项检索任务 recall 保持；单张 NVIDIA B300 上线性注意力 kernel 相对 Standard vLLM 加速 7.30×（Mamba-2）、5.02×（GDN）、5.24×（KDA），Nemotron 3 Super 解码吞吐最高提升 2.77×。
Motivation: 混合注意力模型用线性注意力替换大部分 softmax 层以抑制 KV-cache 膨胀、扩大解码 batch，但循环状态访问成为新瓶颈；ReplaySSM 虽用缓冲 key/value 摊销状态更新，每个新查询仍要读全状态，而状态在两次更新之间其实不变。
Method: 观察到低秩的状态加权查询近似能准确保留状态读取输出，且近似未来查询的基向量可离线固定。SketchSSM 在每次状态更新时读一次全状态，为这些基向量预计算输出并存成紧凑 sketch；后续每个解码步用查询相关系数线性组合 sketch 向量重建输出，不再读全状态，状态更新仍保持全精度。
Result: 在四个 Mamba-2、GDN、KDA 基础的模型上，平均 sketch rank 为 8 时状态访问流量减少约 10×，四个解码基准的平均精度与 FP32 全状态基线持平，并在四个 RULER 检索任务上保持 recall。单张 NVIDIA B300 上，相对 Standard vLLM 的线性注意力 kernel 加速分别为 Mamba-2 7.30×、GDN 5.02×、KDA 5.24×，Nemotron 3 Super 解码吞吐最高提升 2.77×。
Conclusion: 状态在两次更新之间不变意味着读取可以离线预计算到低秩 sketch 中，从而在不损失解码精度与检索 recall 的前提下把状态访问流量降一个数量级并显著提速。

papers.title: Adaptive Latent Capacity for World Models
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Adaptive LeWorldModel (ALeWM), a world model based on a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that learns to concentrate predictive information in compact prefixes of a wide latent representation. To encourage this ordering, ALeWM learns a sequence-conditioned distribution over prefix lengths and trains the predictor to estimate the full next embedding from a sampled input prefix. As standard anti-collapse objectives encourage variation across latent coordinates and do not organize them by predictive importance, we also introduce MixSIGReg. MixSIGReg regularizes the masked embeddings against a prior-weighted mixture with Gaussian active prefixes and zeros in the remaining coordinates. As a result, the ALeWM objective encourages early coordinates to retain information useful for prediction and recursive planning. Our analysis shows that the mixture distribution used by MixSIGReg assigns higher variance to earlier coordinate blocks and lower variance to later ones. In addition, we show that, under specified assumptions, prediction error is minimized by placing the information most useful for prediction in earlier blocks. Empirically, we study the behavior of ALeWM in a controlled dynamical system with known state variables and in goal-conditioned visual control. We show that ALeWM consistently achieves higher mean success rates than tuned fixed-width LeWM, with lower planning capacity on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ALeWM 是基于 JEPA 的世界模型，把预测信息集中到宽隐表示的紧凑前缀上：学习按序列条件的前缀长度分布，用采样的输入前缀预测完整下一嵌入，并用 MixSIGReg 把掩码嵌入正则到「前段高斯活跃、后段置零」的先验加权混合上。分析表明该混合给靠前坐标块更高方差，且在给定假设下把最有预测价值的信息放在前块可最小化预测误差；在已知状态变量的受控动力系统与目标条件视觉控制中，ALeWM 平均成功率高于调优过的固定宽度 LeWM，且所需规划容量更低。
Motivation: 标准防坍缩目标只鼓励各隐坐标之间产生变化，不按预测重要性组织坐标，导致宽隐表示中大量坐标对预测与规划无用。
Method: ALeWM 用 joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA)，学习序列条件的前缀长度分布并从采样前缀预测完整下一嵌入；新增 MixSIGReg，把掩码嵌入正则到先验加权混合分布（前缀坐标为高斯活跃、其余坐标置零），使早期坐标保留对预测与递归规划有用的信息。
Result: 分析给出：MixSIGReg 的混合分布给靠前坐标块更高方差、靠后块更低方差；在给定假设下，把最有预测价值的信息放在前块可最小化预测误差。实验在已知状态变量的受控动力系统与目标条件视觉控制两个设置中进行，ALeWM 的平均成功率一致高于调优过的固定宽度 LeWM，且平均规划容量更低。
Conclusion: 按预测重要性排序隐坐标、并用先验加权混合正则强制这种排序，可以在更小规划容量下达到更高成功率，即宽隐表示的有效信息可压缩进紧凑前缀。
Relevance: 35
