papers.title: Action Shaping: Policies Absorb What They Can Express
papers.abstract_en: Reward shaping has a theorem: a potential-based term can be removed without changing the optimal policy. The same practice on the action channel, an offset added in training and dropped at deployment, has no theorem. Nothing cancels an action offset, so the correction is kept at deployment or removed without a guarantee. We call it action shaping and state its principle. A trainable policy absorbs an offset its own output layer can reproduce exactly, which is what we mean by express; what is absorbed can be removed with the return intact. Its minimal instance is a zero-initialized linear head behind a learnable gate, added to an actor that trains through a learned action-value function, with no penalty or schedule. The gate rises and then falls on its own, for deterministic and stochastic actors alike, and on 20 tasks removing the head costs almost nothing. The condition is exact reproduction, not capacity: a nonlinear head with more parameters is not absorbed, and in a paired control, one linear path added to a nonlinear base head restores absorption. Exact reproduction gives the loss a flat direction that gradient noise drifts along, and the offset's amplitude indicates, before removal, what dropping the head will cost. Action shaping thus gains the counterpart of the shaping theorem, a condition for absorption, together with the mechanism behind it and a diagnostic that reads it. Policies absorb what they can express, and only that.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 reward shaping 的势函数定理搬到动作通道：训练时加在动作上的偏移 (action shaping) 只有当策略自身输出层能精确复现该偏移时才会被吸收，此时可在部署时移除而不改变回报。最小实现是 actor 后接零初始化线性头加可学习 gate，gate 自行先升后降；20 个任务上移除该头代价几乎为零，而参数更多的非线性头不被吸收，给非线性基座头补一条线性通路即可恢复吸收。
Motivation: reward shaping 有势函数定理保证移除不改变最优策略，但同样的做法用在动作通道（训练加偏移、部署丢掉）没有对应定理：偏移没有东西抵消，要么部署时保留、要么无保证地移除。
Method: 提出 action shaping 及其吸收条件：可训练策略吸收其输出层能精确复现的偏移。最小实例是在通过学习到的 action-value function 训练的 actor 后面接一个零初始化线性头与可学习 gate，不加惩罚项也不设调度；同时给出机制解释——精确复现使损失出现平坦方向、梯度噪声沿其漂移——以及一个用偏移幅值预判移除代价的诊断量。
Result: 在 20 个任务上移除该线性头代价几乎为零，确定性与随机 actor 均表现为 gate 自行先升后降；条件是精确复现而非容量：参数更多的非线性头不被吸收，而在配对对照中给非线性基座头加一条线性通路即恢复吸收；偏移幅值可在移除前指示丢掉该头的代价。
Conclusion: 策略只吸收它能表达的东西：动作偏移可被无损移除的充要条件是输出层能精确复现它，这为 action shaping 补上了 shaping 定理的对应物——一个吸收条件、其背后机制和一个可读出该条件的诊断。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Prediction Limits and Koopman Closure of Geometry-Induced Soft State Abstractions
papers.abstract_en: A soft state representation assigns each state a vector of nonnegative class weights that sum to one. We study how the construction of these weights and the state dynamics jointly determine the accuracy of linear prediction. For any fixed measurable representation, we derive a finite-sample lower confidence bound on the smallest population root-mean-square prediction error among matrices with a specified spectral-norm limit. The bound compares variation in successor coordinates within each reference class with the improvement that soft inputs could provide. It is computed from independent evaluation pairs without fitting a prediction matrix. A bound above a chosen tolerance rules out that tolerance for the entire matrix class; a zero bound is inconclusive. For coordinates constructed using Kernel Affine Hull Machines, reconstruction-score margins control disagreement with reference labels and enter bounds on prediction error. Under exact deterministic linear evolution, we also establish the Koopman and reproducing-kernel Hilbert-space adjoint interpretation, accounting for redundant coefficient vectors. A four-state study compares the confidence bound with analytically known optima across 117,000 reported replicate datasets. A Van der Pol representation selected on pilot data is then evaluated on 32 independent datasets under each of two transition laws. The reported bounds are positive at the fitted matrix norm, but can become zero at larger norm limits. Further forecasting studies examine coordinate variation, common prediction targets, and long-horizon error. The results distinguish agreement with reconstruction classes, attainable prediction accuracy, and exact operator closure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文给出一种不拟合预测矩阵的有限样本置信下界，用于判定软状态表示（各类权重非负且和为一）下线性预测误差的可达下限：下界高于给定容差即可排除整个谱范数受限矩阵类，下界为零则不作结论。在 117,000 个重复数据集的四状态研究中下界与解析最优值对照，Van der Pol 表示在 32 个独立数据集上于两种转移律下拟合矩阵范数处的下界为正、更大范数极限下可变为零。
Motivation: 软状态表示的权重构造与状态动力学如何共同决定线性预测精度缺少可计算的判定工具；需要一种无需拟合预测矩阵、能直接排除给定误差容差的有限样本判据。
Method: 对任意固定可测表示，推导最小总体均方根预测误差在指定谱范数受限矩阵类上的有限样本置信下界，比较每个参考类内后继坐标的变化与软输入可能带来的改进，且仅由独立评估对计算；用 Kernel Affine Hull Machines 构造坐标时，reconstruction-score margin 控制与参考标签的一致性并进入预测误差界；在精确确定性线性演化下给出 Koopman 与 RKHS 伴随解释并处理冗余系数向量。
Result: 四状态研究在 117,000 个报告的重复数据集上将置信下界与解析已知最优值比较；Van der Pol 表示在先导数据上选择后，于 32 个独立数据集、两种转移律下评估，报告的下界在拟合矩阵范数处为正、在更大范数极限下可变为零；另考察坐标变化、共同预测目标与长时程误差。
Conclusion: 该下界把与重建类的一致性、可达预测精度与精确算子闭合三者区分开；下界高于容差即可排除该容差，下界为零不作结论。

papers.title: WeaveAgent: A Two-Stage Tool-Routing Agent for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Problem. Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing with vague user intents has two bottlenecks: visual tokens are expensive, and tool calling must be format-reliable (pretrained models emit zero tool calls zero-shot). Method. WeaveAgent, a two-stage tool-routing agent, decouples routing from visual perception. Stage A is routing-first: emission is trained, not elicited. Stage B executes conditionally: intrinsic queries enter visual answering (full-scene thumbnail; a WeaveEarth-style evidence board as an optional fixed-budget, approx. 5k-token compression interface); extrinsic queries execute tool call on original full-resolution imagery, answering from tool observations in a second, observation-masked round. Training: alignment SFT, then GRPO under reward R_WA2. Results. Alignment SFT lifts extrinsic routing from 0% to 80.75% (323/400); GRPO suppresses 9 intrinsic mis-emissions while tool selection is unchanged. The trained 2B system does not beat the zero-shot 8B baseline overall (0.263 vs. 0.250), a diagnostic contribution. Oracle attribution separates two repair ingredients: loading the observation into context lifts extrinsic answer accuracy from 0.025 to 0.425 under marker-free cross-mode returns, and the two-turn SFT stage adds a further +9.3 points to 0.518 at a small routing cost. A +/- image ablation shows emission suppression is visually grounded, and a query-register matrix shows LLM-rewritten queries cost trained checkpoints 2-11 points. Scope. All training and evaluation use the 5,000 / 3,273 / 1,000-record VagueUHR corpus (600 intrinsic + 400 tool-requiring; the base seeds synthesis and is not used for optimization). Single-pass evidence construction runs at 7.31 s per image on an RTX 4090. Code, data, and evaluation protocols will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WeaveAgent 把超高分辨率遥感的工具路由与视觉感知解耦成两阶段：Stage A 先训练工具调用发射（alignment SFT + GRPO，奖励 R_WA2），Stage B 按内在/外在查询分支执行。SFT 把外在查询路由从 0% 提到 80.75%（323/400），但训练后的 2B 系统整体 0.263 仍只略高于零样本 8B 的 0.250；把工具观测载入上下文才把外在答案准确率从 0.025 抬到 0.425，两轮 SFT 再加 9.3 点到 0.518。
Motivation: 超高分辨率遥感影像加模糊用户意图下，视觉 token 昂贵，且预训练模型零样本时一次工具调用都不发（0%），工具调用的格式可靠性成为瓶颈。
Method: 两阶段工具路由：Stage A 路由优先，用 alignment SFT 训练发射，再用 GRPO 配合奖励 R_WA2 抑制内在查询的误发射；Stage B 条件执行——内在查询走全场景缩略图加 WeaveEarth 式证据板（固定预算约 5k token 压缩接口），外在查询在原始全分辨率影像上调用工具，并在第二轮 observation-masked 中依据工具观测作答。全部训练与评测基于 VagueUHR 语料（5,000/3,273/1,000 条记录，含 600 条内在 + 400 条需工具查询）。
Result: Alignment SFT 将外在路由从 0% 提升到 80.75%（323/400）；GRPO 抑制 9 次内在误发射而工具选择不变。训练后的 2B 系统整体 0.263，未超过零样本 8B 基线的 0.250。Oracle 归因：载入观测使外在答案准确率在 marker-free 跨模式返回下从 0.025 升到 0.425，两轮 SFT 再加 9.3 点到 0.518（路由代价很小）。±图像消融显示发射抑制是视觉 grounding 的；查询寄存器矩阵显示 LLM 改写查询使训练后模型掉 2–11 点。单次证据构建在 RTX 4090 上为 7.31 秒/图。
Conclusion: 路由与感知解耦加两轮训练能可靠教会小模型发工具调用，但真正的瓶颈是把工具观测放回上下文；2B 模型整体仍不敌零样本 8B，作者将其定位为诊断性贡献。

papers.title: Learning Hierarchical Causal Representations of the Effects of Forcings on Temperature in Climate Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning (ML) emulators provide a fast and cost-effective method to simulate climate change scenarios after being trained on Earth System Models projections. However, the black-box nature of those data-driven approaches limit the usability and trustworthiness of their outputs and in particular their use as causal attribution tools. Here, we develop a hierarchical causal representation learning framework applied to sea surface temperature fields from a state-of-the-art global climate model. As a key advance over previous work, our framework explicitly models both atmospheric dynamical interactions arising from internal climate variability and forced responses due to changes in atmospheric greenhouse gas and aerosol concentrations. When trained on future climate change scenarios, our method accurately predicts the long-term global mean and regional temperature evolution and shows physically realistic responses to perturbations in greenhouse gas and aerosol concentrations when evaluated on unseen scenarios. Our results underline the potential of causal representation learning frameworks for advancing climate model emulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分层因果表征学习框架，把海温场中的内部变率大气动力耦合与温室气体、气溶胶浓度变化的强迫响应显式分开建模，用于气候模式替代器 (emulator) 的因果归因。在先进全球气候模式的未来情景上训练后，该方法能准确预测长期全球平均与区域温度演变，并在未见过的情景上对温室气体与气溶胶扰动给出物理上合理的响应。
Motivation: ML 气候替代器虽快且便宜，但黑箱性质限制了输出的可用性与可信度，尤其难以作为因果归因工具使用。
Method: 分层因果表征学习 (hierarchical causal representation learning) 框架，输入为先进全球气候模式的海表温度 (sea surface temperature) 场；关键设计是同时建模内部气候变率产生的大气动力学相互作用与温室气体、气溶胶浓度变化导致的强迫响应，在未来气候变化情景上训练。
Result: 在训练所用的未来气候情景上准确预测长期全球平均与区域温度演变；在未见过的情景上，对温室气体与气溶胶浓度扰动的响应物理上合理。
Conclusion: 因果表征学习框架有潜力推进气候模式替代器，使其输出可用于因果归因而非仅作黑箱拟合。

papers.title: Subjects, Not Authors: The Authorship Hazard in Agentic Dataspaces
papers.abstract_en: Dataspace connectors decide whether a transfer may occur, not what the transferred value contains, tolerable for contracted applications, not for LLM agents that compose tool calls. Work on agents that generate governance artifacts evaluates output quality, not who may authorize an artifact for use. A published policy is what the decision point enforces, so publication is a governance event, and agents that are both policy subjects and policy authors write the norms that bind them. We name this the authorship hazard and state one principle: an agent is a subject of the governance plane, never an author of it. Its authorization channel to publication is closed by construction; its influence channel, drafting what humans approve, becomes an enforcement problem. Across 90 preregistered edits to the paper's running agreement, each evaluated on 344,512 requests, the six that only reclassify a field all change authorization and narrow a duty without touching policy text, and a policy-diff classifier passes all six. Read as worded, the privilege-delta conditions also pass 33 of 69 effective policy-text edits; read as covering any relaxation, none. Treating classification as authorship routes all six to review; the registry this requires is not yet built. At the execution boundary, protected fields reach the model in 105 of 105 cases under prompt-stated duties and in 0 of 105 under a compiled tool-call constraint, but values outside named fields are exposed in 7 of 7. At the review share measured, a central approval pool needs one approver per 20 to 138 participants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 agentic dataspace 的 authorship hazard：LLM agent 同时是治理对象与策略作者，会写出约束自身的规范，因此原则是 agent 只能是治理平面的 subject，永远不能是 author，其对发布的授权通道按构造关闭、只保留供人类审批的起草通道。在 90 项预注册编辑（每项 344,512 次请求）上，6 项仅重分类字段的编辑都改变授权而不触碰策略文本且 policy-diff classifier 全部放行；按字面读，privilege-delta 条件还放过 69 项有效策略文本编辑中的 33 项，按“任何放宽”读则一项不放过。执行边界上，prompt 声明职责时受保护字段 105/105 到达模型，编译后的 tool-call 约束下为 0/105，而命名字段之外的取值 7/7 全部暴露；按实测审批份额，中央审批池需每 20 至 138 名参与者配 1 名审批人。
Motivation: dataspace connector 只判定传输是否发生、不看传输内容，这对签约应用够用，但 LLM agent 会自行组合 tool call；已有针对生成治理工件的 agent 工作只评输出质量，不问谁有权授权该工件被使用。
Method: 以“发布即治理事件”为前提提出一条原则（agent 是治理平面的 subject 而非 author），把 agent 的授权通道按构造关闭、把起草通道当作 enforcement 问题；用论文自带 running agreement 的 90 项预注册编辑做测试，每项跑 344,512 次请求，并对比 policy-diff classifier 与 privilege-delta 条件两种读法，同时在执行边界比较 prompt 声明职责与编译后的 tool-call 约束。
Result: 6 项仅重分类字段的编辑全部改变授权、收窄职责且不改策略文本，policy-diff classifier 对这 6 项全部放行；privilege-delta 条件按字面读放过 69 项有效策略文本编辑中的 33 项，按覆盖任何放宽读则 0 项通过。受保护字段在 prompt 声明职责时 105/105 到达模型、在编译 tool-call 约束下 0/105，命名字段之外的取值 7/7 暴露。按实测审批份额，中央审批池每 20 至 138 名参与者需 1 名审批人；把分类当作 authorship 会把 6 项全部送审，而所需 registry 尚未建成。
Conclusion: agent 不应拥有治理平面的发布作者权，其影响只能经人类审批的起草通道起作用；现有按字面书写的 privilege-delta 与 policy-diff 检查会漏掉大量实质放宽，而编译后的 tool-call 约束才是把受保护字段挡在模型之外的机制。

papers.title: KernelOPT: Dispatch-Aware Agentic Search for GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning inference and training performance depends critically on GPU kernel efficiency. Modern compilers such as PyTorch Inductor automatically generate GPU kernels from high-level model code, but frequently underperform expert-written implementations by wide margins. Recent LLM-assisted kernel optimizers can close this gap for standalone kernels, yet treat compiled models as black boxes, generally optimizing individual standalone kernels without respecting the compiler's structural decisions or verifying the model end-to-end. We present KernelOPT, a multi-agent system that treats compiled models as structured artifacts. It preserves vendor library calls (cuBLAS, cuDNN) and exclusively targets generated Triton sub-kernels using five profiling-guided LLM agents. A four-gate verification cascade applies static validation, multi-seed correctness checking, model-level float64-fallback verification, and performance gating ($γ{=}1.03$) to filter candidates and verify the re-stitched model end-to-end. When candidates fail verification, the system preserves the compiler baseline. The system accepts PyTorch nn Modules, standalone Triton kernels, and Helion kernels. Evaluated on 250 KernelBench problems (100 Level 1, 100 Level 2 and 50 Level 3) on NVIDIA H200, KernelOPT achieves geometric mean speedups over torch compile of 1.40$\times$ (L1), 1.15$\times$ (L2), and 1.07$\times$ (L3) across all kernels, including fallback cases. Optimized-only geomeans (excluding cases where verification gates preserve the compiler baseline) are substantially higher: 2.54$\times$ (L1: 36/100), 1.84$\times$ (L2: 23/100), and 1.37$\times$ (L3: 11/50), reflecting where the optimizer achieves meaningful leverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KernelOPT 把编译后的模型当作结构化产物，保留 cuBLAS/cuDNN 调用，只对 PyTorch Inductor 生成的 Triton 子内核用五个 profiling 引导的 LLM agent 重写，并用四道验证门（静态校验、多随机种子正确性、模型级 float64 回退验证、γ=1.03 性能门）筛选候选、失败即回退编译基线。在 NVIDIA H200 上 250 道 KernelBench（L1 100、L2 100、L3 50）相对 torch.compile 的几何平均加速为 1.40×/1.15×/1.07×；仅计优化成功的案例则为 2.54×（36/100）、1.84×（23/100）、1.37×（11/50）。
Motivation: PyTorch Inductor 自动生成的 GPU 内核常大幅落后于手写实现，而现有 LLM 内核优化器把编译模型当黑箱、只优化孤立内核，既不尊重编译器的结构决策，也不做端到端验证。
Method: 多智能体系统 KernelOPT 接受 PyTorch nn.Module、独立 Triton 内核与 Helion 内核；保留厂商库调用，只针对生成的 Triton 子内核，由五个基于 profiling 的 LLM agent 提出候选。四道验证级联依次做静态校验、多 seed 正确性检查、模型级 float64 回退验证与性能门 γ=1.03，对重新拼接后的模型做端到端把关，失败即保留编译基线。
Result: 在 NVIDIA H200 上评测 250 道 KernelBench（100 L1、100 L2、50 L3），相对 torch.compile 的几何平均加速（含回退案例）为 L1 1.40×、L2 1.15×、L3 1.07×；仅统计优化成功案例时为 L1 2.54×（36/100）、L2 1.84×（23/100）、L3 1.37×（11/50）。
Conclusion: 把编译器结构与端到端验证纳入 LLM 内核优化，可在不牺牲正确性的前提下稳定获得加速，且验证门让失败案例自动退回编译基线；有效增益集中在 L1/L2，L3 深层内核的可优化空间明显更小。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ELF-REG: Scaling Continuous Diffusion Language Models to Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Fully continuous diffusion language models (dLMs) denoise continuous representations without intermediate discretization, then decode all response tokens in parallel at the final step. Their performance on challenging reasoning tasks remains less established than that of autoregressive (AR) LLMs and masked dLMs. We scale Embedded Language Flows (ELF) to mathematical reasoning and code generation on GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP. We introduce ELF-REG, which improves learning with representation alignment and entanglement (REPA+REG), where a frozen AR teacher supervises intermediate denoiser features and supplies a global representation that is jointly denoised with the response. ELF-REG-L achieves 55.96% pass@1 on GSM8K at 64 network function evaluations (NFE), and 13.39% on MATH-500 and 22.56% on HumanEval at 128 NFE. It outperforms the evaluated comparable-scale dLMs in pass@1 on GSM8K and code, and improves MATH-500 pass@1 from 10.55% for the ELF-L baseline to 13.39% with ELF-REG-L. Without few-step training, the same task-specific checkpoints support strong low-NFE performance through early-stop, which decodes an intermediate clean prediction without completing the denoising trajectory. At 16 NFE, ELF-REG-L reaches 41.21% HumanEval pass@10, outperforming recent continuous dLMs of comparable scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把连续扩散语言模型 (continuous diffusion LM) 扩到数学与代码推理：ELF-REG 用冻结 AR 教师做表示对齐与纠缠 (REPA+REG)，让教师的中间去噪特征与全局表示同响应一起被去噪。ELF-REG-L 在 GSM8K 上 64 NFE 达 55.96% pass@1，MATH-500 从 ELF-L 的 10.55% 提到 13.39% (128 NFE)，HumanEval 22.56%；不加少步训练、仅靠 early-stop 在 16 NFE 拿到 41.21% HumanEval pass@10。
Motivation: 全连续 dLM 不经离散化、最后一步并行解码全部 token，但在 GSM8K、MATH 这类难推理任务上表现一直不如自回归 (AR) LLM 与 masked dLM，缺少可比规模下的证据。
Method: 把 Embedded Language Flows (ELF) 扩到 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval、MBPP；新增 ELF-REG，用冻结 AR 教师监督去噪器中间特征 (REPA)，并提供一个与响应联合去噪的全局表示 (REG)；另用 early-stop 直接解码中间干净预测以支持低 NFE 推理。
Result: ELF-REG-L：GSM8K 55.96% pass@1 (64 NFE)，MATH-500 13.39%、HumanEval 22.56% (128 NFE)；MATH-500 相对 ELF-L 基线 10.55% → 13.39%；在 GSM8K 与代码上 pass@1 超出所评估的同规模 dLM；16 NFE 时 HumanEval pass@10 41.21%，超过近期同规模连续 dLM。
Conclusion: 用冻结 AR 教师做表示对齐与纠缠，可把全连续 dLM 推到推理任务并在同规模 dLM 中领先；无需少步训练，early-stop 就能让同一任务检查点在极低 NFE 下保持强性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TwinCheck: Evidence-Grounded Negative-Twin Verification for Stateful Tool Agents
papers.abstract_en: A single locally plausible tool call can derail an otherwise successful agent trajectory. Suspicion alone does not justify intervention, because the replacement itself can introduce the very failure verification is meant to prevent. We introduce TwinCheck, an inference-time verification policy that considers replacement only when the trace satisfies an evidence condition tied to a trace-local failure hypothesis. It constructs a trace-grounded counterfactual alternative, a negative twin, and replaces the agent's proposal only if the twin passes structural checks and the pairwise verifier prefers it in both candidate orders. For paired evaluation, exact replay holds the agent's parsed responses and actions fixed until the first accepted replacement, separating intervention effects from resampling. In the primary analysis of 159 multi-turn BFCL V4 tasks with complete exact-replay pairs, the complete policy raises task success for GPT-5.6 Sol from 45.3% to 58.5% (95% task-bootstrap CI [8.2, 18.8]), with no observed success-to-failure regressions. Together, these findings recast execution-boundary repair as a constrained comparison, making the counterfactual action itself the object of verification.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development; Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Third Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TwinCheck 是面向有状态工具智能体 (stateful tool agents) 的推理时验证策略：只有当轨迹满足与局部失败假设绑定的证据条件时才考虑替换，构造反事实的 negative twin，并要求 twin 通过结构检查且成对验证器在两种候选顺序下都偏好它才替换。在 159 个带完整 exact-replay 配对的多轮 BFCL V4 任务上，GPT-5.6 Sol 任务成功率从 45.3% 升到 58.5%（95% task-bootstrap CI [8.2, 18.8]），未观察到成功转失败的回退。
Motivation: 单个局部看似合理的工具调用就能毁掉整条本来成功的智能体轨迹，但仅凭怀疑就干预，替换动作本身可能引入验证本要防止的失败。
Method: 推理时策略分三步：以 trace-local failure hypothesis 绑定的证据条件决定是否考虑替换；构造 trace-grounded 的反事实 negative twin；仅当 twin 通过结构检查且 pairwise verifier 在两个候选顺序下都偏好它才替换。评测用 exact replay 把解析后的响应与动作固定到首次被接受的替换为止，把干预效应与重采样分开。
Result: 主分析覆盖 159 个具有完整 exact-replay 配对的多轮 BFCL V4 任务，完整策略使 GPT-5.6 Sol 任务成功率从 45.3% 提升到 58.5%，95% task-bootstrap CI 为 [8.2, 18.8]，且未观察到 success-to-failure 回退。
Conclusion: 执行边界修复应被当作受约束的比较问题，把反事实动作本身作为验证对象，而不是凭怀疑直接干预。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: JEV-as-a-Judge: Accept When Confident, Escalate When Unsure
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-judge scales evaluation, but reasoning judges are slow and costly. We study JEV-as-a-Judge: evaluation with JEV, a decision-only judge that returns label probabilities instead of text, and whose confidence decides whether to accept its verdict or escalate to a reasoning judge. Against sixteen generative and reward-model judges, with blinded human adjudication, JEV comes within three points of GPT-6 wherever a verdict can be read off the text, at 0.36% of its fee and a 0.15-second median latency, and falls behind where the verdict must be derived, as in math, code, and logic. Its confidence marks this boundary. With a threshold frozen in advance, accepting confident verdicts and escalating the rest is 0.9 points more accurate than GPT-6 on 1,610 held-out pairs at 41% of its fee, and in a pre-specified live test on two new workloads the cascade matches GPT-6's accuracy exactly. Confidence routing weakens on style-adversarial pairs and reference-free prose; we close with a simple recipe for validating thresholds locally.
papers.comment: Expanded the dataset, updated the results and figures, and added new analyses. The previous result reporting 99% of GPT performance at 57% of the cost is retained in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JEV-as-a-Judge 用只输出标签概率的 decision-only 判官 JEV 替代推理型判官，按其置信度决定直接采纳还是升级到 reasoning judge。在 1,610 对留出样本上，冻结阈值的级联比 GPT-6 准确率高 0.9 个百分点、费用为 41%；在两个新工作负载的预设线上测试中准确率与 GPT-6 完全持平。
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 需要规模化评估，但 reasoning judge 又慢又贵，且并非所有判题都需要推理才能读出结论。
Method: JEV 作为 decision-only 判官只返回标签概率而非文本；置信度超过预先冻结的阈值就采纳，否则升级到 reasoning judge。对照十六个生成式与 reward-model 判官，配盲评人工裁决，并在预设的线上测试中检验两个新工作负载。
Result: 在结论可直接从文本读出的场景，JEV 与 GPT-6 差距在 3 个百分点以内，费用为其 0.36%、中位延迟 0.15 秒；在需要推导结论的数学、代码、逻辑上落后，且置信度能标出这条边界。冻结阈值的级联在 1,610 对留出样本上比 GPT-6 准确率高 0.9 个百分点、费用为 41%，线上测试中准确率与 GPT-6 完全一致。级联在风格对抗样本与无参考散文上路由变弱。
Conclusion: 用判官置信度做采纳/升级路由，可在可直接读出结论的任务上以约四成费用匹配甚至略超 GPT-6 的准确率，但需在本地验证阈值以应对风格对抗与无参考文本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Initialization and Stopping Tolerance in CPU Dermoscopic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Contour initialization and numerical stopping can jointly affect the evaluation of active-contour segmentation. We examine their interaction using the open-source scikit-image Chan-Vese implementation on a resized ISIC 2017 mirror. A fixed development set of 100 images selects a common input channel; all 600 images in the repository's held-out partition are then evaluated. Otsu thresholding is compared with checkerboard-, disk-, and Otsu-initialized contours under default and tighter level-set tolerances. At the default tolerance, Otsu initialization increases mean image Dice from 0.6011 to 0.6660 relative to checkerboard initialization, a paired difference of 0.0649 (95% image-bootstrap interval [0.0452, 0.0860]). Otsu thresholding alone achieves 0.6897. The default disk initializer stops after one iteration on 471 images. Tightening the tolerance reduces the Otsu-seed advantage over checkerboard initialization to 0.0197, with most runs reaching the 500-iteration limit. The default-tolerance advantage also reverses between small- and large-lesion strata. These findings show that an improvement over a generic initializer can coexist with deterioration relative to the threshold baseline. Evaluations should retain the unrefined mask as a comparator and report the initial-field definition, stopping tolerance, and observed iteration counts together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 scikit-image 的 Chan-Vese 主动轮廓上，轮廓初始化与停止容差共同决定 ISIC 2017 分割评测结论：默认容差下 Otsu 初始化把平均 Dice 从 checkerboard 的 0.6011 抬到 0.6660（配对差 0.0649），但 Otsu 阈值单独就有 0.6897，即优于通用初始化器的同时相对阈值基线反而变差。收紧容差后 Otsu 对 checkerboard 的优势缩到 0.0197，且多数运行撞到 500 次迭代上限，优势还在小病灶与大病灶分层间反号。作者要求评测保留未细化掩膜作对照，并同时报告初始场定义、停止容差与实际迭代次数。
Motivation: 主动轮廓分割的评测常把改进归给方法本身，但轮廓初始化方式与数值停止容差的交互会同时改变最终掩膜，使相对通用初始化器的增益可能掩盖相对简单阈值基线的退化。
Method: 用开源 scikit-image 的 Chan-Vese 实现，在缩放后的 ISIC 2017 mirror 上做受控对照：固定 100 张开发集选定统一输入通道，再对仓库 held-out 分区全部 600 张图评测；比较 Otsu 阈值与 checkerboard、disk、Otsu 三种初始化轮廓，并在默认与更紧的 level-set 容差两种停止条件下运行，用 image-bootstrap 给出配对差区间。
Result: 默认容差下 Otsu 初始化相对 checkerboard 把平均图像 Dice 从 0.6011 提到 0.6660，配对差 0.0649，95% image-bootstrap 区间 [0.0452, 0.0860]；Otsu 阈值单独达 0.6897。默认 disk 初始化器在 471 张图上仅迭代一次即停止。收紧容差后 Otsu 相对 checkerboard 的优势降到 0.0197，多数运行达到 500 次迭代上限；默认容差下的优势在小病灶与大病灶分层之间发生反转。
Conclusion: 相对通用初始化器的提升可以与相对阈值基线的退化并存，因此主动轮廓分割评测必须保留未细化掩膜作对照，并把初始场定义、停止容差与观测到的迭代次数一并报告。
Relevance: 4

summary_sections.tldr: 在 scikit-image 的 Chan-Vese 主动轮廓上，轮廓初始化与停止容差共同决定 ISIC 2017 分割评测结论：默认容差下 Otsu 初始化把平均 Dice 从 checkerboard 的 0.6011 抬到 0.6660（配对差 0.0649），但 Otsu 阈值单独就有 0.6897，即优于通用初始化器的同时相对阈值基线反而变差。收紧容差后 Otsu 对 checkerboard 的优势缩到 0.0197，且多数运行撞到 500 次迭代上限，优势还在小病灶与大病灶分层间反号。作者要求评测保留未细化掩膜作对照，并同时报告初始场定义、停止容差与实际迭代次数。

papers.title: Observer Choice and Threshold Selection in Retinal Vessel Segmentation: A Subject-Separated Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: The annotation used to select a segmentation threshold is part of the evaluation protocol, yet its effect is easily conflated with model quality. We examine this choice for retinal vessel segmentation using all 28 CHASE DB1 images and both human annotations. A fixed seven-fold protocol keeps both eyes of each of the 14 subjects together. Random forests and Extra Trees are fitted against observer 1 with three random seeds, yielding 42 fits. Five threshold policies share identical score maps: fixed 0.50, observer-1 tuning, observer-2 tuning, mean-observer tuning, and maximin tuning of the per-image lower observer Dice. For random forests, maximin changes the threshold in 19 of 21 fits, but worst-observer Dice decreases from 70.53 percent to 70.45 percent. The paired difference is -0.073 percentage points, with a conditional subject-bootstrap 95 percent interval of [-0.384, 0.238]. Extra Trees shows the same direction. Identical observer-1-tuned random-forest masks score 73.66 percent against observer 1 and 71.06 percent against observer 2. The results support explicit reporting of both the threshold-selection reference and evaluation reference; they do not support an accuracy benefit from maximin tuning in this cohort. All splits, raw predictions, metrics and code are supplied. AI assistance is disclosed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 CHASE DB1 全部 28 张图上，用同一组分数图比较五种阈值选择策略，发现按最差观察者 Dice 做 maximin 调参虽在 21 次随机森林拟合中 19 次改变了阈值，却使最差观察者 Dice 从 70.53% 降到 70.45%（配对差 -0.073 个百分点，subject-bootstrap 95% 区间 [-0.384, 0.238]），不支持 maximin 在该队列带来精度收益。
Motivation: 阈值选择所依赖的标注本身是评估协议的一部分，其影响容易与模型质量混为一谈；同一组掩膜换一个参考观察者打分，指标就会移动，需要把两者拆开报告。
Method: 用 CHASE DB1 全部 28 张图与两份人工标注，按 14 名受试者双眼不分离的固定七折划分；对随机森林与 Extra Trees 各用 3 个随机种子、以观察者 1 为拟合目标，共 42 次拟合；在完全相同的分数图上比较五种阈值策略：固定 0.50、观察者 1 调参、观察者 2 调参、平均观察者调参、以及逐图最差观察者 Dice 的 maximin 调参。
Result: 随机森林中 maximin 在 21 次拟合里 19 次改变阈值，但最差观察者 Dice 由 70.53% 降至 70.45%，配对差 -0.073 个百分点，条件 subject-bootstrap 95% 区间 [-0.384, 0.238]；Extra Trees 方向一致。同一组按观察者 1 调参的随机森林掩膜，对观察者 1 得 73.66%，对观察者 2 得 71.06%。
Conclusion: 应显式同时报告阈值选择参考与评估参考两个观察者；在该队列中 maximin 调参不带来精度收益。全部划分、原始预测、指标与代码均已公开。

papers.title: How Children Design and Reason about Trustworthy AI Chatbots
papers.abstract_en: Children increasingly interact with AI chatbots, making trust calibration essential to AI literacy. Prior research has examined children's trust in AI mainly as users evaluating systems built by others, rather than as designers of their own chatbots. We developed a chatbot-building environment with adjustable trust-relevant traits (e.g., confidence, transparency, formality, assertiveness), rules, and persona. We conducted mixed-methods study with 115 learners (ages 8-18) who made 119 chatbots. We examined how children configured their chatbots, reasoned about trustworthiness, and how closely chatbot behavior aligned with their designs. Younger students (age 10-13) set significantly higher confidence than older students (age 14-18), and some deliberately built chatbots that gave wrong answers on purpose, yet still called them trustworthy, arguing that a chatbot does what it was built to do. Younger students equated trust with purpose-fulfillment, while older students linked it to transparent, calibrated design. Students also calibrated academic chatbots to be more transparent and formal than hobby chatbots. We identify seven design dimensions describing what children believe makes a chatbot trustworthy, and discuss implications for AI literacy tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 8–18 岁学习者的可信 AI 素养，构建可调节信任相关特质（confidence、transparency、formality、assertiveness）、规则与 persona 的 chatbot 搭建环境，并用 115 名学习者、119 个 chatbot 的混合方法研究考察儿童如何配置与推理。10–13 岁显著设定更高 confidence；部分儿童故意让 chatbot 答错仍称其可信，理由是“它做了被设计要做的事”，低龄把信任等同于目的达成，高龄则关联透明且校准的设计。
Motivation: 既往研究把儿童信任当作用户评价他人系统，而非自己作为设计者构建 chatbot 时如何理解可信，缺少对儿童设计维度的刻画。
Method: 开发可调节信任相关特质（confidence、transparency、formality、assertiveness）、规则与 persona 的 chatbot 搭建环境；对 115 名 8–18 岁学习者、119 个 chatbot 做混合方法研究，分析其配置选择、对 trustworthiness 的推理，以及 chatbot 行为与设计的对齐程度。
Result: 10–13 岁学生设定的 confidence 显著高于 14–18 岁；部分学生故意构建给出错误答案的 chatbot 仍称其可信；低龄学生把信任等同于目的达成，高龄学生关联透明与校准的设计；学术类 chatbot 被校准得比兴趣类更透明、更正式；归纳出描述儿童眼中可信 chatbot 的七个设计维度。
Conclusion: 儿童的可信观随年龄从“完成既定目的”转向“透明且校准的设计”，AI 素养工具应据此按年龄差异化地教信任校准。

papers.title: A Latent Distribution Perspective on Evaluating and Improving Latent Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: In latent generative models, reconstruction quality is often assumed to correlate with generative performance. However, reconstruction FID (rFID) can exhibit weak or even negative correlation with generation FID (gFID). We attribute this misalignment to a latent distribution mismatch: reconstruction evaluates the decoder on encoder-induced latents, whereas generation uses the same decoder on latents produced by the generative model. To characterize this shift, we introduce generation-aware reconstruction (GAR), which constructs a continuous trajectory from standard reconstruction toward generation by perturbing encoder latents with noise and denoising them through the generative model before decoding. GAR probes the decoder behavior along this trajectory, making the transition from encoder to generation-time latent distributions observable and diagnosable. The resulting trajectory-based diagnostic, GAR-FID, exhibits strong empirical correlation with gFID across diverse tokenizers and scales. Importantly, intermediate GAR latents become more generation-aware while preserving correspondence with their source images, thereby retaining paired supervision that is absent for fully generated latents. This correspondence enables decoder adaptation on intermediate GAR latents, consistently improving generative quality across model scales. Overall, latent distribution mismatch provides a useful perspective for evaluating and improving latent generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 指出 rFID 与 gFID 弱相关甚至负相关的根源是 latent distribution mismatch：重建用 encoder 诱导的 latent，生成用生成模型产出的 latent。提出 generation-aware reconstruction (GAR)，在两者之间构造连续轨迹并用轨迹上的 GAR-FID 诊断，该指标与 gFID 在多种 tokenizer 和规模上强相关，且中间 GAR latent 可作配对监督用于 decoder adaptation，跨模型规模一致提升生成质量。
Motivation: 潜空间生成模型中重建质量常被当作生成性能的代理，但 rFID 与 gFID 可能弱相关甚至负相关，导致按重建指标选 tokenizer 或调 decoder 会误导。
Method: GAR 对 encoder latent 加噪，再用生成模型去噪后送入 decoder，从而在标准重建与生成之间构造连续轨迹并探测 decoder 沿轨迹的行为；由该轨迹得到诊断量 GAR-FID，并利用中间 GAR latent 与源图像的对应关系做 decoder adaptation。
Result: GAR-FID 在多种 tokenizer 与模型规模上与 gFID 呈强经验相关；中间 GAR latent 在更具 generation-aware 性的同时保留与源图像的对应，可提供完全生成 latent 所缺的配对监督；基于它的 decoder adaptation 在各模型规模上一致提升生成质量。
Conclusion: rFID 与 gFID 的错位来自 encoder 与生成时 latent 分布的偏移，用轨迹式诊断和带配对监督的 decoder 适应可以同时解决评估与改进两个问题。

papers.title: ValueDiff: Value-Geometric KV Cache Eviction for Sink-Suppressed LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLMs with QK-normalization, gated attention, learned attention sinks, or logit softcapping exhibit weaker persistent attention sinks, on which existing KV cache eviction methods primarily rely. We observe that across these models, weaker sinks co-occur with greater value-vector dispersion relative to key-vector dispersion. Motivated by this value-side dispersion, we present ValueDiff, a value-geometric eviction that ranks tokens by the L2 deviation of their value vectors from the cache mean. The same score arises as the minimal-disturbance eviction under a max-entropy assumption about future attention. We evaluate under fixed cache budgets, with eviction at every block boundary during prefill and at every decoding step during generation. On RULER at a tight 2k token budget, ValueDiff retains 88-99% of dense across seven sink-suppressed models (best on 6 out of 7). On LongBench at the 4k budget, ValueDiff averages 92% retention across sink-suppressed models versus 83% for the strongest prior baseline. On MATH-500, ValueDiff is the strongest non-dense method on every sink-suppressed model tested at the 25% cache budget, outperforming prior methods by up to ~20 points on gated-attention models. Across all three benchmarks, value geometry emerges as the more reliable query-invariant eviction signal for sink-suppressed models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ValueDiff 用 value 向量相对缓存均值的 L2 偏离给 token 排序做 KV cache 驱逐，在 QK 归一化、门控注意力、学习式 attention sink、logit softcapping 这类 sink 被削弱的模型上取代依赖 sink 的旧方法。RULER 2k 预算下在 7 个 sink-suppressed 模型上保留 dense 的 88–99%（7 个中 6 个最优），LongBench 4k 预算平均保留 92%（最强先前基线 83%）。
Motivation: 现有 KV cache 驱逐方法主要依赖持久 attention sink，而带 QK-normalization、gated attention、learned attention sinks 或 logit softcapping 的现代 LLM 的 sink 明显变弱，这些方法随之失效；作者观察到 sink 变弱与 value 向量相对 key 向量的离散度更大同时出现。
Method: ValueDiff 按每个 token 的 value 向量与缓存均值的 L2 偏离打分排序驱逐；同一分数可由未来注意力的 max-entropy 假设下最小扰动驱逐推出。评测在固定缓存预算下进行：prefill 阶段每个 block 边界驱逐一次，生成阶段每个 decoding step 驱逐一次。
Result: RULER 在 2k token 紧预算下，ValueDiff 在 7 个 sink-suppressed 模型上保留 dense 性能的 88–99%，其中 6/7 最优；LongBench 在 4k 预算下跨 sink-suppressed 模型平均保留 92%，最强先前基线为 83%；MATH-500 在 25% 缓存预算下，ValueDiff 在每个被测 sink-suppressed 模型上都是最强的非 dense 方法，在 gated-attention 模型上比先前方法高出最多约 20 个百分点。
Conclusion: 在 sink 被抑制的模型上，value 几何（value geometry）是比 sink 依赖更可靠的、与 query 无关的驱逐信号，三个基准一致支持这一判断。

papers.title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
papers.abstract_en: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).

Motivation: 现有 M/EEG 视觉解码方法只把脑信号与预训练视觉编码器的单一全局嵌入对齐，丢弃了中间 patch 表征中更细粒度的视觉信息，这一设计选择是否影响表征学习一直悬而未决。
Method: 提出轻量模块化的 Residual Patch Adapter (RPA)，取 ViT 视觉编码器中间层的全部 patch token 做对齐；配合消融（池化/掩码 patch token、CLS token 作用）与六项定量特征分析（高层语义与颜色、纹理等低层特征），并测试替代脑编码器（含预训练 EEG foundation model）及可替换为卷积、注意力或 ConvNeXt 的即插即用接口。
Result: THINGS-EEG2 Top-1：被试内 95.4%，跨被试 35.5%；THINGS-MEG：65.2% 与 6.7%，两数据集均报 SOTA。消融中池化或掩码 patch token 降低表征质量，CLS token 独有信息很少；六项特征分析表明高层语义与颜色、纹理等低层特征对 EEG-to-image 对齐都必需。

papers.title: PointZero: 3D Point Track Completion for Learning Transferable 3D Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: World models endow perceptual systems with the ability to predict how scenes evolve under interaction. They are most beneficial when trained on diverse volumes of data, to instill a rich prior into downstream applications. Existing methods typically require robot action labels to learn action-conditioned 3D dynamics, which excludes web video data from the training pool. We study 3D point track completion as a pre-training objective for learning transferable 3D dynamics without robot data. Given a single RGB-D observation and sparse partial 3D trajectories (tracks), we predict future 3D tracks of all observed points. We show this objective produces a rich 3D dynamics prior, without requiring robot action labels. We contribute a diverse dataset of 2.9 million synthetic frames spanning deformable, articulated, and rigid objects, and use it to train PointZero. We show that a flexible and expressive transformer, PointZero, outperforms prior methods on the same data. We demonstrate the utility of our pre-training objective by post-training PointZero for two downstream applications: (1) action-conditioned 3D dynamics prediction and (2) imitation learning. When fine-tuned to condition on end-effector pose, PointZero outperforms the baselines on the recent PGND 3D dynamics benchmark. When fine-tuned to predict robot actions and 3D tracks, PointZero outperforms or matches the baselines on 6/7 simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks. We furthermore evaluate training PointZero from scratch to isolate the benefits of our proposed architecture from those of our proposed pre-training objective and dataset. We release the dataset, checkpoints, and full training recipe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PointZero 用 3D 点轨迹补全 (3D point track completion) 作为预训练目标，从单帧 RGB-D 与稀疏部分 3D 轨迹预测所有观测点的未来轨迹，从而在不依赖机器人动作标签的前提下学到可迁移的 3D 动力学先验。配套发布 290 万合成帧数据集（可变形、铰接、刚体物体），微调到末端执行器位姿条件后在 PGND 3D 动力学基准上超过基线，在 6/7 个仿真与真实机器人操作任务上超过或匹配基线。
Motivation: 现有动作条件 3D 动力学方法必须有机器人动作标签，把网络视频数据挡在训练池之外，而世界模型恰恰最需要多样、大量的数据来形成可迁移先验。
Method: 以 3D 点轨迹补全为预训练目标：输入单个 RGB-D 观测与稀疏部分 3D 轨迹，用灵活的 Transformer 架构 PointZero 预测所有观测点的未来 3D 轨迹；训练数据为作者贡献的 290 万合成帧数据集，覆盖可变形、铰接与刚体物体，之后对 PointZero 做后训练以接入两个下游任务。
Result: 在相同数据上 PointZero 超过先前方法；微调到以末端执行器位姿为条件后，在近期 PGND 3D 动力学基准上超过基线；微调到同时预测机器人动作与 3D 轨迹后，在 7 个仿真与真实机器人操作任务中的 6 个上超过或匹配基线；另做了从零训练 PointZero 的对照，以分离架构与预训练目标/数据集各自的贡献。
Conclusion: 无需机器人动作标签的 3D 点轨迹补全预训练即可产生丰富的 3D 动力学先验，可迁移到动作条件动力学预测与模仿学习；数据集、检查点与完整训练配方全部开源。

papers.title: SpliTEE: Fast and Private LLM Inference by Coupling GPU-Assisted Trusted Execution Environments with Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: User prompts provided to large language models (LLMs) may contain private information. One way to protect them is to execute the LLM inside a trusted execution environment (TEE). However, this results in slow inference times as current TEEs are significantly slower than GPUs for LLM inference. To circumvent this, Tramèr and Boneh (2019) proposed Slalom which splits neural network inference between a TEE and an untrusted GPU. They encrypt inputs to computations outsourced to the GPU. In this paper, we extend this split-inference architecture to LLM inference and instead protect intermediate inputs using differential privacy (DP). We first demonstrate that masking intermediate representations is necessary by showing an 80% accuracy on a prompt-reconstruction attack from these representations. Our main contribution is a global sensitivity analysis of key functions in LLM inference, which bounds the required scale of DP noise. Unlike encryption, DP avoids quantization, allowing the LLM to remain in the floating-point domain. We also derive an upper bound on the floating-point error from masking and subsequent noise cancellation as a function of the privacy parameter epsilon, keeping the same quality of the LLM response. We implement our architecture using the Intel TDX TEE and two LLMs: Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen3-4B. Our split execution is nearly twice as fast as fully TDX-based inference. Moreover, it is at most 43% faster than Slalom while achieving higher accuracy. Finally, we demonstrate that prompt reconstruction, even with knowledge of the DP mechanism, cannot recover more information than is contained in an unrelated prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpliTEE 把 LLM 推理在 Intel TDX TEE 与不可信 GPU 之间切分，用差分隐私 (DP) 掩码中间表示替代 Slalom 的加密，从而免去量化、让模型留在浮点域。中间表示若不掩码，提示重构攻击可达 80% 准确率；掩码后即使攻击者知道 DP 机制，重构出的信息也不超过一条无关提示。
Motivation: 把 LLM 整体放进 TEE 保护用户提示会显著拖慢推理，而 Slalom 式的 TEE-GPU 切分依赖加密，迫使中间张量量化、损失模型精度。
Method: 扩展 Slalom 的切分推理架构到 LLM：外包给 GPU 的中间输入改用 DP 掩码而非加密；对 LLM 推理中的关键函数做全局敏感度分析以界定所需噪声尺度，并推导掩码加噪声抵消的浮点误差关于隐私参数 epsilon 的上界。实现基于 Intel TDX，模型为 Llama-3.2-3B 与 Qwen3-4B。
Result: 未掩码中间表示上提示重构攻击准确率 80%；切分执行比纯 TDX 推理快近 2 倍；比 Slalom 最多快 43% 且准确率更高；掩码与噪声抵消后 LLM 回答质量保持不变，浮点误差有随 epsilon 变化的上界；掩码后提示重构即使已知 DP 机制也无法恢复超出无关提示的信息。
Conclusion: 用 DP 掩码替代加密可以在 TEE-GPU 切分 LLM 推理中同时拿到隐私、浮点精度与速度，前提是噪声尺度由全局敏感度分析给出。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: RIGOR: Rig-Informed Geometry for Omnidirectional Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Recent developments in feed-forward 3D reconstruction resulted in models which can recover dense scene representations and camera motion solely from an image stream. However, such predictions are prone to becoming inconsistent over long trajectories, specifically in demanding environments with repetitive structures, weak textures and dynamic objects or people. One way to mitigate those challenges is to use an omnidirectional camera, which provides wide spatial coverage and captures richer visual information. Yet, the majority of models do not offer support for 360-degree imagery or require additional fine-tuning. To bridge these two aspects, we present RIGOR: a large-scale reconstruction pipeline for gravity-aligned omnidirectional videos that retains a frozen feed-forward perspective backbone and exploits each panorama as a four-view virtual rig. The rig structure is used to detect and repair locally inconsistent predictions, to retrieve loop closures through cyclic four-view consensus, and to geometrically verify candidate revisits before global optimization. Verified constraints drive a Sim(3) pose graph that corrects accumulated rotation, translation, and scale drift along the sequence. We demonstrate that the proposed consistency mechanisms improve both trajectory accuracy and reconstructed geometry over a feed-forward baseline on challenging construction-site sequences. The code is made available under this link: https://github.com/TangentH/RIGOR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIGOR 把全向视频的每张全景当作四视角虚拟 rig，用 rig 几何检测并修复前馈 3D 重建的局部不一致，经循环四视角共识取回环闭合、几何验证后再驱动 Sim(3) 位姿图，纠正长轨迹上的旋转、平移与尺度漂移。在有挑战性的工地序列上，这些一致性机制相对前馈基线同时改善了轨迹精度与重建几何。
Motivation: 前馈 3D 重建模型仅凭图像流即可恢复稠密场景与相机运动，但在长轨迹、重复结构、弱纹理与动态物体场景下预测会逐渐不一致；多数模型又不支持 360 度图像或需额外微调。
Method: 面向重力对齐的全向视频，保留冻结的前馈透视 backbone，把每张全景拆成四视角虚拟 rig：用 rig 结构检测并修复局部不一致预测，通过循环四视角共识检索回环，并对候选重访做几何验证；验证过的约束驱动 Sim(3) 位姿图优化。代码开源于 GitHub TangentH/RIGOR。
Result: 在具有挑战性的工地 (construction-site) 序列上，所提一致性机制相对前馈基线同时提升了轨迹精度与重建几何质量。
Conclusion: 把全景当作四视角 rig 并在全局优化前做几何验证的回环，可以在不微调冻结 backbone 的前提下抑制前馈全向重建的累积漂移。

papers.title: UnitBoost: Managing Compound LLM Systems with a Merge Operator, Not a Model
papers.abstract_en: Compound LLM systems often solve a coordination problem by adding a higher-level LLM. The resulting meta-agent reads workers' outputs, writes the final answer, allocates later calls, and decides when to stop. It is expressive, but it also concentrates three control decisions in an opaque, order-sensitive model call. We ask whether the manager needs to be generative at all. UnitBoost replaces that model with a defined meta-level operator: a task-given unit map turns worker outputs into slot-value proposals, a constrained argmax assembles the output, and the slots left unfilled or unsupported become an explicit residual for the next round. The operator is order-free, records unit provenance, and gives a simple guarantee: without coupling constraints, unit-wise maximization under the same admission score dominates selection of any complete candidate. On three held-out benchmarks, it exceeds the best single candidate chosen with gold labels by 0.060-0.195 absolute task-score points and input-matched generative managers by 0.048-0.076. Replacing only the management step improves six compound-system configurations by 0.013-0.182. Residual-directed rounds raise FanOutQA cell F1 from 0.4778 to 0.5524; matched controls show that the true residual outperforms random targets and ordinary rereading, while a label-free supply signal flags exhaustion after one unproductive round. The same analysis measures three conditions in which no such gain is available (one indivisible unit, unavailable unit identity, and an endpoint that charges for every emitted unit) and quantifies cross-unit coupling as a repair cost. The manager gives up semantic freedom and gains order invariance, unit provenance, and testable failure conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Managing Agents that Manage Agents
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UnitBoost 把复合 LLM 系统里的元 agent 换成一个确定性 meta-level 算子：任务给定的 unit map 把 worker 输出转成 slot-value 提案，受约束 argmax 组装输出，未填或无支撑的 slot 作为显式 residual 进入下一轮。在三个 held-out benchmark 上，该算子比用 gold 标签选出的最佳单候选高 0.060–0.195 绝对 task-score，比输入对齐的生成式 manager 高 0.048–0.076；residual 导向轮次把 FanOutQA cell F1 从 0.4778 提到 0.5524。
Motivation: 复合 LLM 系统靠加一个高层 LLM 来做协调，但这个 meta agent 把读取、写终答、分配后续调用、决定停止三类控制决策集中在一个不透明且对顺序敏感的模型调用里。
Method: 用定义好的 meta-level 算子替代生成式 manager：任务给定的 unit map 将 worker 输出映射为 slot-value 提案，constrained argmax 组装最终输出，未填或无支撑的 slot 作为显式 residual 传入下一轮；算子无序、记录 unit provenance，并给出无耦合约束时 unit-wise maximization 在同一 admission score 下支配任意完整候选选择的保证。
Result: 在三个 held-out benchmark 上超过用 gold 标签选最佳单候选 0.060–0.195 绝对 task-score，超过输入匹配的生成式 manager 0.048–0.076；仅替换管理步骤即改善六种复合系统配置 0.013–0.182；residual 导向轮次使 FanOutQA cell F1 从 0.4778 升至 0.5524，对照显示真实 residual 优于随机目标与普通重读，无标签 supply 信号在一轮无产出后标记耗尽；同时量化了三种无增益条件（单个不可分 unit、unit 身份不可得、按输出 unit 计费的终点）及跨 unit 耦合的修复成本。

papers.title: Cost-Aware Hierarchical Multi-Agent Ransomware Detection and Family Attribution under Analysis Budgets
papers.abstract_en: Sandbox execution and memory forensics are among the most constrained resources in malware triage. Static analysis can scale to millions of files, whereas dynamic and memory analysis require minutes of analyst controlled infrastructure for each sample. Despite this difference, multimodal ransomware detectors often apply every modality to every sample, causing analysis cost and time to verdict to increase linearly with sample volume even when static evidence is already sufficient for a decision. We present a cost aware Hierarchical Multi-Agent System that formulates evidence acquisition as a budgeted sequential decision problem. Specialist agents generate schema validated risk signals for each modality, domain controllers aggregate these signals, and a Meta-Orchestrator begins with static evidence and escalates to dynamic and memory evidence only when confidence is insufficient or agents within a controller disagree. An optional, bounded, locally hosted large language model reviewer can adjust a verdict by at most one tier but cannot replace the deterministic pipeline. Each decision is recorded with a complete provenance trace. In multiple runs over 12439 samples from 16 ransomware families and benign samples, the deterministic HMAS achieves F1 0.93 and macro F1 0.97, resolving 57.95% of cases using static evidence alone, 35.83% after adding dynamic evidence, and only 6.21% through the full pipeline. The average internal analysis cost is 6.65 units, compared with 12 for exhaustive analysis, representing a 44.6% reduction. Standalone leave-one-family-out testing further shows that accuracy on families held out during tuning falls to 0.26 to 0.64 outside the Benign and high support classes. We report these results alongside a cost sensitivity analysis, a partial leave one component out ablation, and a full scale comparison with learned early and late fusion and cascade baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把勒索软件多模态取证做成预算约束下的序贯决策：先用静态证据判定，仅在置信不足或控制器内 agent 分歧时才升级到动态与内存分析。在 12439 个样本、16 个勒索家族上，57.95% 案例只靠静态证据结案，平均分析成本 6.65 单位，比穷举分析的 12 单位降 44.6%，F1 0.93、macro F1 0.97。
Motivation: 沙箱执行与内存取证是恶意软件分诊中最稀缺的资源，而现有多模态勒索检测器对每个样本都跑全部模态，使分析成本与判决时间随样本量线性增长，即便静态证据已足以判定。
Method: 提出分层多智能体系统 (HMAS)：各模态 specialist agent 产出 schema 校验的风险信号，domain controller 聚合，Meta-Orchestrator 从静态证据起步、仅在置信不足或 agent 分歧时升级到动态与内存证据；可选的本地托管 LLM 审阅者最多调整一个判决层级且不能替代确定性管线，每次决策记录完整 provenance trace。
Result: 在 12439 个样本（16 个勒索家族加良性）多次运行中，确定性 HMAS 达 F1 0.93、macro F1 0.97；57.95% 案例仅用静态证据解决，35.83% 需加动态证据，6.21% 走完整管线；平均内部分析成本 6.65 单位 vs 穷举分析 12 单位，降 44.6%。留一家族测试中，调参时未见家族的准确率降至 0.26–0.64（Benign 与高支持类除外），并给出成本敏感性分析、留一组件消融及与 learned early/late fusion 与 cascade 基线的全规模对比。
Conclusion: 按置信度与分歧逐级升级证据，可在几乎不牺牲 F1 的前提下把取证成本砍掉近一半；但对调参期间未见的勒索家族泛化明显变差，家族归属仍是短板。

papers.title: Tree-VQ: Progressive Image Compression from Pretrained Vector Quantizers
papers.abstract_en: Progressive image compression requires a single embedded representation whose received prefixes can be decoded without re-encoding the source. Modern vector-quantized (VQ) image models provide strong discrete endpoint representations, but conventional flat codeword indices do not define meaningful intermediate states for a neural decoder. We present Tree-VQ, a post-hoc conversion of a pretrained flat VQ tokenizer into a fine-grained, arbitrary-prefix progressive representation while preserving its encoder assignments and every learned leaf vector. The key idea is to organize the original codebook into a balanced binary hierarchy, associate explicit representations with internal nodes, and transmit branch decisions in depth-major order. Consequently, once the image header is available, every payload prefix uniquely specifies a valid latent state: each additional branch bit refines exactly one token, and transmission can therefore be truncated at essentially any payload position rather than only at a small number of stage boundaries. We further adapt one shared decoder on the complete-depth and mixed-depth latent states encountered under such arbitrary truncation, making these densely spaced prefixes useful for reconstruction rather than merely syntactically decodable. On Kodak, Tree-VQ achieves a DISTS-based BD-rate saving of 52.1% relative to ProGIC, while exposing thousands of valid arbitrary-prefix operating points from a single embedded bitstream.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Tree-VQ 把预训练的平坦 VQ tokenizer 事后改造成平衡二叉码本层级，按深度优先发送分支决策，使任意 payload 前缀都唯一对应一个合法 latent 状态，可在任意位置截断码流而不必重编码。在 Kodak 上相对 ProGIC 取得 52.1% 的 DISTS BD-rate 节省，同时单条嵌入码流暴露数千个任意前缀工作点。
Motivation: 渐进式图像压缩需要单一嵌入表示、前缀可直接解码，但现代 VQ 图像模型的平坦码字索引无法为神经解码器定义有意义的中间状态，只能在少数 stage 边界截断。
Method: 将预训练平坦 VQ tokenizer 事后转换：把原码本组织成平衡二叉层级，为内部节点显式表示，按深度优先 (depth-major) 顺序传输分支决策，保留原编码器分配与全部学习到的叶子向量；再用一个共享解码器在完整深度与混合深度 latent 状态上适配任意截断产生的前缀。
Result: 在 Kodak 上，相对 ProGIC 的 DISTS-based BD-rate 节省为 52.1%；单条嵌入码流暴露数千个合法任意前缀工作点，每个新增分支位恰好细化一个 token。
Conclusion: 把平坦码本改成带内部节点表示的二叉层级并共享适配解码器，可以让 VQ 图像码流在几乎任意 payload 位置截断且仍可重建，而不只限于少数阶段边界。

papers.title: VoxReason: Auditing Source-Grounded Speech Plans Before Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Plan accuracy alone cannot show whether a speech-delivery decision follows its source: a fixed prior may match the original label yet fail to respond appropriately when a cue changes. VoxReason provides a 100-case verifier benchmark that holds each utterance fixed, edits one designated source-label cue, and scores cited evidence, eight plan fields, and the permitted response. On a source-key-disjoint test of 24 cases, a source-emotion prior reaches plan-slot accuracy 0.958, but none of the 24 edited neutral targets appears in its training labels; its required-change accuracy is 0.000. This diagnoses the support boundary of this prior, not its performance on supported edits. In a complementary 32-case emotion-disjoint test, the prior has seen all edited neutral targets but neither original test emotion; its plan-slot accuracy is 0.219 and required-change accuracy is 1.000. The partitions reuse and overlap the same 100 cases, so these deterministic diagnostics are not independent cohorts or learned-planner results. The benchmark evaluates derived labels and structured plans, not audio input, generated speech, or listener judgments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VoxReason 提出一个 100 例的语音计划验证基准：固定话语、只编辑一个指定的源标签线索，检查引用证据、八个计划字段与允许的响应是否随线索变化。结果显示 source-emotion 先验在 source-key-disjoint 的 24 例上计划槽位准确率 0.958，但对 24 个编辑后的 neutral 目标 required-change 准确率为 0.000，说明该先验落在支持边界之外而非性能差。
Motivation: 计划准确率本身无法区分「真的跟随源」与「靠固定先验碰对标签」：先验可能匹配原始标签，却在线索被编辑时不作响应，需要能定位这种支持边界的审计手段。
Method: 构建 100 例 verifier benchmark，保持每句话语不变、只编辑一个指定 source-label cue，对引用证据、八个计划字段和允许的响应打分；划分出 source-key-disjoint 的 24 例测试与 emotion-disjoint 的 32 例互补测试，对同一 source-emotion 先验做确定性诊断。
Result: source-key-disjoint 24 例上先验 plan-slot accuracy 0.958，但 24 个编辑后的 neutral 目标均不在其训练标签中，required-change accuracy 0.000；emotion-disjoint 32 例上先验见过全部编辑后的 neutral 目标但两个原始测试情绪都未见过，plan-slot accuracy 0.219、required-change accuracy 1.000。两个划分复用并重叠同一批 100 例，属确定性诊断而非独立队列或学习型规划器结果；评测对象是派生标签与结构化计划，不含音频输入、生成语音或听者判断。
Conclusion: 计划槽位准确率与 required-change 准确率会给出相反结论，审计必须按线索支持与否分区；该基准定位的是先验的支持边界，而非其在受支持编辑上的性能。

papers.title: Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates generation without changing its output, but on vision-language models (VLMs) a self-reinforcing cycle holds it back. Because an autoregressive drafter pays a sequential pass for each drafted token, it must stay small and can ill afford to attend to the image at each pass. Prior work therefore compresses or hides the image, leaving the drafter weakest on the text the image determines. We present GLANCE, a one-pass block drafter that breaks this cycle on an unmodified VLM target. Its block-diffusion head drafts a whole block in one forward pass over the target's already fused vision-language states, reading the multimodal context once, however deep the draft. The target verifies a wide candidate tree in one pass and commits exactly its greedy output. In one production engine at a fixed round budget, GLANCE decodes up to 3.05 times faster than autoregressive decoding and outpaces the production EAGLE3-VL head on average and by about 11% on grounded tasks. An entropy law explains when drafting pays, predicting the longest accepted blocks on grounded tasks, where the target's next-token entropy is lowest. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/GLANCE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GLANCE 用 block-diffusion 头在目标模型已融合的视觉-语言状态上一次前向起草整块 token，把多模态上下文只读一遍，从而打破 VLM 投机解码中草稿器因逐 token 顺序前向而不敢看图的自强化循环。在生产引擎固定轮次预算下，比自回归解码最高快 3.05 倍，平均超过生产版 EAGLE3-VL 头，grounded 任务上约快 11%。
Motivation: VLM 上的投机解码受限于草稿器每起草一个 token 就要走一次顺序前向，只能做小且不敢逐轮看图，于是先前工作压缩或隐藏图像，恰恰在图像决定的文本上草稿最弱。
Method: GLANCE 是 one-pass block drafter，直接作用于未经修改的 VLM 目标：block-diffusion 头对目标已融合的视觉-语言状态做一次前向产出整块候选，草稿深度不增加读取次数；目标一次前向验证宽候选树并精确提交其贪心输出。
Result: 在生产引擎、固定轮次预算下，GLANCE 解码速度最高为自回归解码的 3.05 倍；平均快于生产版 EAGLE3-VL 头，在 grounded 任务上约快 11%。熵定律 (entropy law) 预测 grounded 任务上被接受的块最长，因为该处目标的 next-token 熵最低。
Conclusion: 让草稿器一次读取多模态上下文并整块起草，可以在不改目标模型的前提下让 VLM 投机解码真正提速；起草是否划算可由目标 next-token 熵判定，grounded 任务收益最大。

summary_sections.method: GLANCE 是 one-pass block drafter，直接作用于未经修改的 VLM 目标：block-diffusion 头对目标已融合的视觉-语言状态做一次前向产出整块候选，草稿深度不增加读取次数；目标一次前向验证宽候选树并精确提交其贪心输出。
summary_sections.result: 在生产引擎、固定轮次预算下，GLANCE 解码速度最高为自回归解码的 3.05 倍；平均快于生产版 EAGLE3-VL 头，在 grounded 任务上约快 11%。熵定律 (entropy law) 预测 grounded 任务上被接受的块最长，因为该处目标的 next-token 熵最低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 让草稿器一次读取多模态上下文并整块起草，可以在不改目标模型的前提下让 VLM 投机解码真正提速；起草是否划算可由目标 next-token 熵判定，grounded 任务收益最大。

papers.title: Beyond Data Scaling: Representation-Centric Continued Pre-training for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Scaling robot data is crucial for building generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, yet robot trajectories are harder to scale than web-scale image-text data because embodied collection is costly and sparsely covers the physical world. This makes representation quality a central bottleneck: under a fixed robot-data budget, continued pre-training must turn limited trajectories into transferable visual-action knowledge rather than merely fit actions. We propose VLAct, a VLA-oriented VLM backbone trained on broad, heterogeneous, multi-embodiment robot data before task-specific fine-tuning. VLAct preserves the broad VLM prior and encourages shared action semantics across embodiments through VLM-prior preservation, multi-head continuous action co-supervision, and a partially unified cross-embodiment action layout, while allowing task-specific action heads during fine-tuning. Across simulation, real-world, and unseen-embodiment transfer, VLAct consistently improves downstream performance under fixed fine-tuning protocols. On LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0, VLAct surpasses industrial VLA systems including ABot-M0 and LingBot-VLA, achieving success rates of 82.6% and 92.5%. On RoboDojo, VLAct ranks sixth among all policies by success rate and outperforms all explicitly designated world-action model (WAM) entries on both metrics. Most notably, on RoboCasa-GR1, an unseen humanoid embodiment, VLAct using only 20% of downstream trajectories outperforms the full-data GR00T-N1.6 baseline. These results are obtained using fully open-source data and only a 16-GPU training setup, showing that representation-centric continued pre-training can deliver highly competitive performance under a modest compute budget and is an important independent axis of VLA progress beyond data scaling.
papers.comment: All models and training pipelines are publicly available at https://starvla.github.io/VLAct
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLAct 在固定机器人数据预算下做以表征为中心的持续预训练：先在多本体、异构机器人轨迹上训练 VLM 骨干，靠 VLM 先验保持、多头连续动作协同监督与部分统一的跨本体动作布局共享动作语义，微调时再放开任务专用动作头。LIBERO-Plus 与 RoboTwin 2.0 成功率达 82.6% 与 92.5%，超过 ABot-M0、LingBot-VLA；在未见人形本体 RoboCasa-GR1 上只用 20% 下游轨迹即胜过全数据 GR00T-N1.6。
Motivation: 机器人轨迹比图文数据难扩展，具身采集成本高且对物理世界覆盖稀疏，固定数据预算下继续预训练若只拟合动作就无法产出可迁移的视觉-动作知识。
Method: 提出面向 VLA 的 VLM 骨干 VLAct：在任务微调前于广覆盖、多本体机器人数据上继续预训练，用 VLM-prior preservation 保留大模型先验，multi-head continuous action co-supervision 共享动作语义，partially unified cross-embodiment action layout 对齐不同本体的动作布局，微调阶段允许任务专用动作头。
Result: 在固定微调协议下，LIBERO-Plus 与 RoboTwin 2.0 成功率 82.6% 与 92.5%，超过工业级 VLA 系统 ABot-M0 与 LingBot-VLA；RoboDojo 上按成功率排第六并在两项指标上胜过所有显式 world-action model (WAM) 条目；RoboCasa-GR1（未见人形本体）上仅用 20% 下游轨迹即超过全数据 GR00T-N1.6 基线。全部结果用完全开源数据与 16-GPU 训练配置得到。
Conclusion: 以表征为中心的持续预训练是独立于数据扩展的 VLA 进步轴，在中等算力预算下即可交付有竞争力的性能。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Contact Geometry and Covariance Deficits in Volume-Sampled Least Squares
papers.abstract_en: We classify when ordinary fixed-size volume sampling followed by unweighted least squares attains its sharp coefficient-covariance ceiling on a fixed design. For a real whitened design without coloops and a fixed positive-loss residual, the contact space is unchanged at every strict-interior sample size. Its possible nonzero values form a finite orthogonal family: each maximal parallel class of normalized Naimark-complement rows determines a deletion nullspace of dimension one less than the class size. A single residual attains an entire query precisely when the query range lies in one class space. The proof starts from two-sided Loewner comparison of every normalized covariance deficit with an explicit leave-one-out operator, using supported omission moments and reverse deletion. Residual augmentation provides resolvent and second-moment upper bounds, while complement geometry yields query-specific margins, angular concentration, local alignment, and a multi-output energy obstruction. Exact families give closed-form margins and covariances, exhibit support-boundary jumps, and approach the ceiling despite a uniformly positive geometric margin. Finally, the same moment identities give upper and lower bounds on expected fixed-query squared-loss excess. The subset draw is the only randomness; all support and endpoint restrictions are explicit.
papers.comment: 55 pages. Revised title and substantially reorganized theoretical exposition. Includes contact-space and whole-query classification, all-size leave-one-out covariance-deficit comparisons, quantitative contact geometry, and query-risk bounds, with proofs, exact constructions, and ancillary exact-arithmetic checks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定设计上分类何时固定容量体积采样 (fixed-size volume sampling) 加非加权最小二乘能达到其尖锐的系数协方差上界：对无 coloop 的实白化设计与固定正损失残差，contact space 在所有严格内部样本量下不变，其可能的非零取值构成有限正交族。单个残差能精确命中一个 query 当且仅当该 query 的值域落在某个 maximal parallel class 的空间内。
Motivation: 体积采样后最小二乘的系数协方差存在一个尖锐上界，但何时达到、query 层面的超额风险如何被几何量控制，此前缺少完整分类与显式界。
Method: 以归一化协方差亏损与显式 leave-one-out 算子的双侧 Loewner 比较为起点，配合 supported omission moments 与 reverse deletion；残差增广给出 resolvent 与二阶矩上界，complement 几何给出 query 级 margin、角向集中、局部对齐与 multi-output energy obstruction；同一批矩恒等式再导出固定 query 平方损失超额的上下界，并用 exact families 与精确算术校验核对闭式构造。
Result: 每个 maximal parallel class（由归一化 Naimark-complement 行确定）给出维数比类大小少一的 deletion nullspace；精确构造给出闭式 margin 与协方差，显示 support-boundary jumps，并在几何 margin 一致为正的情况下仍逼近上界；同时得到固定 query 期望平方损失超额的上下界，随机性仅来自子集抽样。
Conclusion: 体积采样的协方差上界可达性由 contact space 与 parallel class 几何完全刻画，且即便几何 margin 一致为正也可能逼近上界，因此 query 级风险须用矩恒等式给出的界而非 margin 单独判断。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: The Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy: A Framework for Constructing Classifiers and Diagnosing Their Decisions, Applied to Prompt Injection Detection
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a framework for constructing a classifier as a safeguard layer, and for developing a complementary diagnostic that identifies which of the classifier's confident decisions can be trusted. This framework, the Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy, consists of (i) constructing a dimensionality-optimized classifier, in which the embedding dimensionality is empirically selected via cross-validated performance rather than fixed a priori, (ii) locating a relatively small set of latent support vectors (~ 29% of total training examples) representing influential prompts for identifying tokens that alter the classifier's predicted labels, and (iii) utilizing such tokens and their associated attack magnitudes for constructing a diagnostic taxonomy. This diagnostic taxonomy provides an end-to-end guideline for flagging prompts that require different treatments: rely Safely on the classifier's decision; flag Heuristic Bias and Heuristic Override cases; route Insufficient Context cases for further human/safety review. Applying the framework to a classifier trained on a public prompt injection dataset, we find that a substantial fraction of its confident decisions (~ 77%) are not robust to removing a single token, and that this brittleness separates into two distinct failure patterns: a confidence calibration failure and a genuinely exploitable shortcut. For each zone of the taxonomy, we also recommend strategies for remediating diagnosed prompts. We illustrate the framework as a series of steps, demonstrating how each step operates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy 框架：先用交叉验证经验选择嵌入维度构建分类器，再定位约 29% 训练样本的 latent support vectors，找出能翻转预测的 token 及其攻击幅度，据此把分类器的自信决策划分为可安全依赖、启发式偏置/覆盖、上下文不足需人工复核等区。在公开 prompt injection 数据集上，约 77% 的自信决策在移除单个 token 后不再稳健，并分化为置信度校准失败与可利用捷径两种失效模式。
Motivation: 作为安全护栏层的分类器给出高置信决策时，使用者无法区分哪些可信、哪些只是被单个 token 左右；prompt injection 攻击下这种不可诊断性直接削弱防护层的可用性。
Method: 框架含三步：嵌入维度不预设、由交叉验证性能经验选定；在训练集上定位约 29% 的 latent support vectors 作为有影响力的 prompt；用这些样本找出改变预测标签的 token 及其攻击幅度，构建诊断分类体系 (diagnostic taxonomy)，并为每个区给出补救策略。
Result: 在公开 prompt injection 数据集上训练的分类器中，约 77% 的自信决策对移除单个 token 不稳健；latent support vectors 约占全部训练样本的 29%；这种脆性分离为置信度校准失败与真正可利用的捷径两种失效模式。
Conclusion: 分类器的高置信输出应按诊断分类体系分流：可安全依赖、标记为启发式偏置/覆盖、或转人工与安全复审，而不是一律采信。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mapping the Emergence of Regularization-Driven Dynamics in Grokking
papers.abstract_en: For overparameterized neural networks, many solutions can fit the training data equally well while behaving very differently on unseen samples. Grokking separates training fit from visible generalization, providing a window for studying how this selection develops during training. We sweep short, fixed-duration weight decay (WD) perturbations across the pre-generalization plateau and measure how they shift later generalization time. Across three grokking tasks, these shifts are unordered early in the plateau but later form a stable dose ordering before visible generalization, with stronger WD increases leading to earlier generalization and stronger WD decreases leading to later generalization. Test-loss barriers between perturbed and baseline generalization checkpoints collapse toward zero while the ordered timing effects persist. A similar response reorganization is observed under $\ell_1$ regularization in the grokking setting of Junior et al. (2025). Drawing on Waddington's developmental landscape as an analogy, we call this combination of increasingly constrained solution selection and persistent dose-ordered timing shifts the canalization of grokking solution selection. Together, our response maps and loss-barrier measurements reveal a dynamical reorganization before visible generalization that is consistent with the theoretical picture of regularization-driven motion along a stable slow manifold (Boursier et al., 2025).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在过参数化网络的 grokking 中，对预泛化平台期施加短时固定时长的权重衰减 (WD) 扰动，早期引起的泛化时刻位移无序，平台期后期则形成稳定的剂量序：WD 增强使泛化提前、WD 减弱使泛化推迟，且扰动点与基线泛化检查点之间的 test-loss 障碍塌缩到零而剂量序时序效应持续。作者把这种解选择约束增强与剂量序时移并存的现象称为 grokking 解选择的 canalization。
Motivation: 过参数化网络有许多同样拟合训练集的解，泛化如何被逐步选出缺少可观测的动态刻画；grokking 把训练拟合与可见泛化分开，提供了观察这一选择过程的时间窗口。
Method: 在预泛化平台期扫描短时固定时长的权重衰减扰动（增强与减弱两个方向），测量其对后续泛化时刻的位移，并比较扰动检查点与基线泛化检查点之间的 test-loss 障碍；在三个 grokking 任务上做，并在 Junior et al. (2025) 的 grokking 设定下用 ℓ1 正则重复观察。
Result: 三个 grokking 任务中，平台期早期的泛化时刻位移无序，后期在可见泛化之前形成稳定剂量序：更强 WD 增加使泛化更早、更强 WD 减少使泛化更晚；扰动与基线泛化检查点之间的 test-loss 障碍塌缩至零，而有序的时序效应持续存在；ℓ1 正则下观察到类似的响应重组。
Conclusion: 可见泛化之前存在一次动力学重组，与正则化驱动解沿稳定慢流形 (slow manifold) 运动的理论图景 (Boursier et al., 2025) 一致，即 grokking 解选择被 canalization。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Similarity Is Interaction-Driven: Quantum Kernels for Regime-Sensitive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Similarity in many decision systems is governed not by distance alone but by interactions among variables. In fraud and anomaly detection, small local perturbations can cross interaction-sensitive decision boundaries while leaving ambient distance almost unchanged. Motivated by this setting, we introduce a thin-slab interaction model and an interaction-driven quantum kernel constructed from entangled Pauli-string feature maps. The feature map explicitly encodes sparse high-order block interactions. We show that the resulting fidelity kernel is positive semidefinite, admits an exact block-factorized formulation, and induces a geometry sensitive to changes in interaction regime. Across balanced and imbalanced synthetic experiments spanning third-, fourth-, sixth-, and eighth-order interactions, the proposed kernel consistently outperforms linear, radial basis function, Laplacian, and polynomial kernels, as well as an engineered-interaction linear baseline supplied with the planted block products. On real fraud-detection benchmarks, it achieves the highest mean accuracy and F1 on Credit Card Fraud Detection and ranks second on IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection. Executed on a 156-qubit IBM Quantum processor in a fourth-order setting, the hardware-estimated kernel matches the noise-free simulator within seed-to-seed variability and retains its advantage over the baselines. These findings show that quantum-kernel performance depends on alignment between feature-map geometry and the underlying predictive structure, rather than on Hilbert-space dimension alone. Because the prescribed block-factorized kernel can also be evaluated exactly on a classical computer, the results establish predictive and representational value rather than computational quantum speedup.

papers.title: VT-MUSE: Multimodal Unified Sequential Visuotactile Representation Learning for Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: We propose VT-MUSE, a Multimodal Unified SEquential representation learning framework for visuotactilemanipulation. Existing approaches often encode visual and tactile observations independently before fusion, limiting their ability to capture fine-grained cross-modal dependencies. Moreover, most methods focus on observations at the current time step and overlook the temporal evolution of contact. VT-MUSE addresses both limitations through a two-stage representation learning framework. In Stage I, modality specific encoders are jointly adapted via cross-modal temporal alignment and masked-view consistency. In Stage II, a conditional variational latent model processes masked visual sequences together with full tactile histories. Auxiliary decoders reconstruct the masked recent visual observations and predict tactile depth changes, encouraging the latent representation to retain both global visual context and local contact dynamics. The learned representation is subsequently integrated into a lightweight Transformer policy through gated cross-attention. On the simulation benchmark, VT-MUSE outperforms the strongest baseline evaluated on all tasks by 11 percentage points and also achieves substantial improvements in real-world experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VT-MUSE 用两阶段训练把视觉与触觉编码器在时间维度上对齐，再由条件变分隐变量模型同时吃被掩码的视觉序列与完整触觉历史，学到的表征经门控交叉注意力接入轻量 Transformer 策略。在仿真基准全部任务上比最强基线高 11 个百分点，真实实验也有明显提升。
Motivation: 现有方法先把视觉与触觉各自独立编码再融合，抓不住细粒度跨模态依赖，且只看当前时刻、忽略接触的时间演化，导致操作策略缺少接触动态信息。
Method: 两阶段框架：Stage I 用跨模态时间对齐 (cross-modal temporal alignment) 与掩码视图一致性 (masked-view consistency) 联合适配各模态编码器；Stage II 用条件变分隐变量模型 (conditional variational latent model) 处理被掩码的视觉序列与完整触觉历史，辅助解码器重建被掩码的近期视觉观测并预测触觉深度变化；表征经门控交叉注意力 (gated cross-attention) 接入轻量 Transformer 策略。
Result: 在仿真基准上，VT-MUSE 在所有任务上比最强基线高 11 个百分点 (percentage points)；真实世界实验同样取得实质性提升。
Conclusion: 把跨模态依赖与接触的时间演化一起编码进统一隐表征，能同时保住全局视觉上下文与局部接触动态，从而提升操作策略在仿真与真机上的表现。

papers.title: A Critical Audit of Spatiotemporal Forecasting Benchmark Datasets and Models
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are routinely employed for spatiotemporal forecasting, yet their performance across widely used benchmark datasets is inconsistent. Here, we perform an audit of dataset properties and baseline models to assess the quality of the benchmarks, and the robustness of the conclusions drawn from them. Using classical statistical tools, we characterise spatiotemporal lagged dependencies in benchmarks, and examine how temporal differencing changes these relationships and affects model rankings. Motivated by this, we re-evaluate temporal linear baselines, significantly reducing the apparent gains from GNNs on several benchmarks, and surpassing GNNs on others. Suspecting that GNNs struggle to extract linear, node-wise signals, we find that supplying them with autoregressive residuals improves their performance particularly on non-traffic benchmarks. Finally, controlled synthetic experiments reveal that GNNs are sensitive to heterogeneity in temporal dynamics and spatial graph interactions. Together, our findings demonstrate that baseline specification, data pre-processing and system heterogeneity shape the interpretations drawn from benchmark rankings, informing the design and robust evaluation of GNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对时空预测基准做审计后发现，补上被忽视的时间线性基线就能大幅抹平 GNN 的表面增益，甚至在若干基准上反超；给 GNN 输入自回归残差可提升其在非交通基准上的表现，合成实验则显示 GNN 对时间动力学异质性与空间图交互敏感。作者主张基准排名的解读取决于基线设定、数据预处理与系统异质性。
Motivation: GNN 在常用时空预测基准上的表现不一致，而基准数据集属性与基线设定本身未经检验，导致从排名中得出的结论可能不稳健。
Method: 用经典统计工具刻画基准中的时空滞后依赖，考察时间差分 (temporal differencing) 如何改变这些关系并影响模型排名；重新评估时间线性基线，并向 GNN 输入自回归残差 (autoregressive residuals)；辅以受控合成实验操纵时间动力学异质性与空间图交互。
Result: 重新评估的时间线性基线显著缩小了 GNN 在若干基准上的表面增益，并在其他基准上超过 GNN；向 GNN 提供自回归残差改善其性能，在非交通基准上尤为明显；合成实验显示 GNN 对时间动力学异质性和空间图交互敏感。
Conclusion: 基准排名的解读由基线设定、数据预处理和系统异质性共同决定，因此 GNN 的评估必须在规范基线与预处理下才稳健。

papers.title: Systematic Evaluation of TabPFN-TS and Chronos-2 for Zero-Shot Heat Load Forecasting in District Heating Networks
papers.abstract_en: District heating energy hubs require reliable heat load forecasts for efficient operational scheduling. Forecasting models trained on historical data may require retraining as networks evolve. Zero-shot time-series foundation models and in-context forecasting therefore offer a promising alternative: they can adapt at inference time from recent observations rather than by repeated retraining. This study systematically evaluates TabPFN-TS and Chronos-2 for probabilistic heat load forecasting in two German district heating networks and compares them with trained baselines. We assess whether TabPFN-TS, whose underlying model is pretrained entirely on synthetic tabular rather than time-series data, can capture complex district heating dynamics. We analyze covariate choice, context length, temporal resolution, and forecast horizon on selected operating weeks, evaluate the selected configuration over the full year, and assess cross-network transfer. The principal benchmark assumes perfect weather forecasts; a separate sensitivity analysis uses retrospective weather predictions. Hourly 24-hour forecasting with a 12-week rolling context and ambient temperature provides a parsimonious configuration; longer context windows do not improve accuracy. Both TSFMs outperform all trained baselines in deterministic accuracy in the full-year benchmarks. Chronos-2 achieves the best deterministic scores, with TabPFN-TS remaining close: their CVRMSE values on the main data set are 12.48% and 13.07%, respectively. Chronos-2 also achieves lower continuous ranked probability scores in both networks, with TabPFN-TS remaining close. a TSFM-based Multi-Resolution Residual-Correction Forecaster combines an hourly base forecast with short-term high-resolution corrections. Relative to direct high-resolution forecasting, it generally reduces errors in total heat demand over 12-hour periods and recorded prediction times.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 10 figures; Supplementary Information included. Revised following peer review, with expanded evaluation and uncertainty analysis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在两个德国区域供热网上系统评估零样本时序基础模型 TabPFN-TS 与 Chronos-2 的概率热负荷预报：小时级 24 小时预报配 12 周滚动上下文加环境温度即为精简配置，更长上下文不再提升精度。全年基准中两者确定性精度全部超过训练基线，Chronos-2 最优、CVRMSE 12.48%，TabPFN-TS 紧随其后 13.07%。
Motivation: 区域供热能源枢纽的运行调度依赖热负荷预报，但网络随时间演化使训练模型需反复重训；零样本时序基础模型可在推理期从近期观测自适应，避免重训成本。
Method: 在两个德国区域供热网上对 TabPFN-TS（底层完全以合成表格数据而非时序数据预训练）与 Chronos-2 做零样本概率预报，与训练基线对比；分析协变量选择、上下文长度、时间分辨率与预报时距，先在选定运行周筛选配置，再做全年评估与跨网迁移。主基准假设完美天气预报，另用回顾性天气预测做敏感性分析；并提出 TSFM-based Multi-Resolution Residual-Correction Forecaster，用小时基准预报加短期高分辨率修正。
Result: 精简配置为小时级 24 小时预报、12 周滚动上下文、环境温度，更长上下文不提升精度。全年基准中两个 TSFM 的确定性精度均超过全部训练基线，主数据集 CVRMSE：Chronos-2 12.48%，TabPFN-TS 13.07%；Chronos-2 在两个网络上的 CRPS 均更低，TabPFN-TS 接近。残差修正预报器相对直接高分辨率预报，在 12 小时总热需求与记录的预测时点上通常降低误差。
Conclusion: 零样本时序基础模型可在区域供热热负荷上免重训达到并超过训练基线，且精简的上下文与协变量配置已足够；Chronos-2 在确定性与概率指标上领先，TabPFN-TS 以纯合成表格预训练仍紧随其后。

papers.title: RIPE++: Reinforced Keypoint Learning from Positive Pairs Only
papers.abstract_en: Sparse keypoint extraction and matching underpin core tasks in geometric computer vision, including structure-from-motion, visual SLAM, augmented reality, and medical image registration. Learning robust local feature representations, however, typically requires accurate camera poses or depth supervision, which are often unavailable in real-world settings. Reinforcement learning (RL) has recently emerged as a promising alternative, requiring only the information if two images show the same scene or not. However, existing RL formulations such as RIPE rely on coarse binary rewards and carefully constructed negative training pairs, limiting training stability and descriptor discriminability. In this paper, we revisit RL-based keypoint learning and propose a reward that fully exploits the geometric consistency signal, deriving both reward and penalty from a single positive pair without contrasting against negatives. This richer signal provides sufficient supervisory contrast to learn discriminative detectors and descriptors from positive image pairs alone, enabling representation learning under extremely limited supervision. Furthermore, we show that the same RL objective can be extended to the matching stage by adapting LightGlue, raising AUC@5 on MegaDepth1500 from 56.58 to 59.65 and enabling weakly-supervised training of the full sparse matching pipeline from image pairs with partial visual overlap. We validate our approach on established benchmarks, demonstrating competitive results compared to fully-supervised methods. We further show that the method can be even trained on low texture medical video sequences, where camera poses are usually unavailable and standard SfM pipelines often fail. Code and data are available at https://github.com/fraunhoferhhi/RIPEpp .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RIPE++ 把基于强化学习的关键点学习改成只用正样本对：从单个正对的几何一致性信号同时导出奖励与惩罚，无需负样本对，也不需要位姿或深度监督。该目标还能扩展到匹配阶段改造 LightGlue，使 MegaDepth1500 上 AUC@5 从 56.58 提到 59.65，并可在位姿缺失的低纹理医学视频上训练整条稀疏匹配管线。
Motivation: 学习鲁棒局部特征通常要精确相机位姿或深度监督，而真实场景常拿不到；已有 RL 方案如 RIPE 依赖粗粒度二值奖励和精心构造的负样本对，训练稳定性与描述子判别性受限。
Method: 重新设计 RL 奖励：从单个正样本对的几何一致性信号同时导出奖励与惩罚，不与负样本对比，仅凭正对即可学到判别性检测器与描述子；再把同一 RL 目标迁移到匹配阶段，改造 LightGlue，实现仅靠部分重叠图像对的弱监督全管线训练。
Result: 在 MegaDepth1500 上，扩展到匹配阶段后 AUC@5 从 56.58 提升到 59.65；在既有基准上与全监督方法相比具有竞争力，并可训练于相机位姿通常不可得、标准 SfM 常失败的低纹理医学视频序列。
Conclusion: 仅靠正样本对的几何一致性信号就足以同时学出判别性关键点检测器、描述子与匹配器，把稀疏匹配全管线的训练监督门槛降到只需图像对（可含部分重叠）。
Relevance: 0
