papers.title: Enhancing Distance-Based Graph Autoencoders with Structural Penalties for Dynamic Graph Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Graph autoencoders (GAEs) are widely used for learning representations of dynamic graphs. However, their optimisation objectives typically do not take structural heterogeneity across nodes into account. We propose three distance-based GAE variants that incorporate structural penalties into the reconstruction loss. All variants share a two-layer Graph Convolutional Network encoder and a Euclidean-distance decoder trained with distance-based reconstruction objectives. We extend sparsity-corrected loss with two node-level regularization terms: (i) a hub penalty based on degree centrality, and (ii) a penalty based on Natural Community Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (NC-LID). The paper is motivated by prior evidence linking high NC-LID to reduced embedding quality. The proposed methods are designed to emphasize reconstruction errors for structurally ambiguous nodes. Experiments on multiple dynamic graph data sets show that incorporating NC-LID-based regularization consistently improves reconstruction performance over the baseline without structural regularization and the method using hub-aware regularization. These findings highlight NC-LID as a useful structural signal for enhancing distance-based graph autoencoders in dynamic settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对动态图自编码器 (GAE) 忽略节点结构异质性的问题，提出三种基于距离的 GAE 变体，在重构损失中加入结构惩罚：hub 惩罚（基于度中心性）与基于 Natural Community Local Intrinsic Dimensionality (NC-LID) 的节点级正则项，共享两层 GCN 编码器与欧氏距离解码器。多组动态图数据集实验显示，NC-LID 正则在重构性能上稳定优于无结构正则的基线和 hub 惩罚方法。
Motivation: GAE 的优化目标通常不考虑节点间结构异质性，结构模糊节点的重构误差被平均掉，导致动态图表示质量下降；已有证据表明高 NC-LID 与嵌入质量下降相关。
Method: 三种距离式 GAE 变体均采用两层 GCN 编码器 + 欧氏距离解码器，训练目标为基于距离的重构目标；在稀疏性校正损失 (sparsity-corrected loss) 之上加入两个节点级正则项：基于度中心性的 hub 惩罚，以及基于 NC-LID 的惩罚，用于放大结构模糊节点的重构误差权重。
Result: 在多个动态图数据集上，加入 NC-LID 正则的变体在重构性能上一致优于无结构正则的基线和使用 hub 感知正则的方法。
Conclusion: NC-LID 是增强动态场景下距离式图自编码器的有效结构信号，且优于基于度中心性的 hub 惩罚。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PertMind: Eliciting Emergent Biological Reasoning in LLM via Reinforcement Learning on Cellular Perturbation Data
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can describe mechanisms, yet scalable post-training still depends on costly, manually curated biological reasoning traces. Here we show that cellular perturbation atlases can instead become reinforcement-learning environments, where measured gene responses provide computable rewards for biological reasoning. We introduce PertMind, which combines trusted-trajectory supervised initialization with gene-, pathway-, and format-level reinforcement signals. Although trained only on forward perturbation-response prediction, PertMind improves response inference in unseen cellular contexts while retaining general language capabilities. It also transfers, without task-specific post-training, to reverse perturbation identification, double-perturbation reasoning, phenotypic-screen prioritization, and biological-process interpretation. PertMind further generates biological profiles that support competitive gene, cell, and donor representations across multiscale downstream tasks. These results support the hypothesis that reinforcement on experimental endpoints can concentrate reusable biological strategies already accessible to pretrained models. More broadly, perturbation-derived reinforcement learning offers a scalable route for transforming expanding experimental atlases into training environments for general-purpose biological reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PertMind 把细胞扰动图谱 (cellular perturbation atlases) 变成强化学习环境：以实测基因响应作为可计算奖励，用可信轨迹监督初始化叠加基因、通路与格式三级 RL 信号训练 LLM。仅在正向扰动-响应预测上训练，模型在未见细胞情境中提升响应推断，并零任务后训练迁移到反向扰动识别、双扰动推理、表型筛选排序与生物过程解释。
Motivation: LLM 能描述生物机制，但可扩展的后训练仍依赖昂贵的人工标注生物推理轨迹；不断扩张的实验图谱未被用作训练信号。
Method: 可信轨迹监督初始化 (trusted-trajectory supervised initialization) 加基因级、通路级、格式级三类强化信号；奖励来自实测基因响应，训练任务仅为正向扰动-响应预测，并检验通用语言能力保持情况。
Result: 在未见细胞情境中响应推断提升且保留通用语言能力；无需任务后训练即迁移到反向扰动识别、双扰动推理、表型筛选优先级排序和生物过程解释；生成的生物表征在基因、细胞、供体多尺度下游任务上具竞争力。
Conclusion: 在实验终点上做强化可以使预训练模型中已可及的生物策略被集中放大，扰动衍生 RL 是把实验图谱转为通用生物推理训练环境的可扩展路径。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reperesentation Geometry Matters for Planning with JEPA World Models
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive world models support planning through latent predictions, but unconstrained joint training can collapse distinct observations to identical embeddings. Two prominent strategies for avoiding collapse are to inherit pretrained features, as in DINO-WM, or to learn representations end-to-end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM). Yet avoiding collapse does not ensure that latent distances distinguish outcomes in ways that matter for the task. In object manipulation, for example, success depends on the object's position and orientation relative to the goal. Such task-relevant state information can remain accurately decodable while barely influencing latent distance. The resulting planning cost may fail to reflect how close a predicted outcome is to the task goal. In this paper, we propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings), a method that correlates sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in task-relevant state space. Added to LeWM's existing objective, SCALE preserves its architecture, requires privileged state only during training, and adds no planning-time computation. We show that SCALE improves planning success over LeWM across manipulation and navigation tasks with multiple solvers and provide a comprehensive analysis of how SCALE reshapes representation geometry to support planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JEPA 世界模型中避免表征坍缩并不保证潜空间距离与任务目标相关状态距离一致，导致规划代价无法反映预测结果离目标的远近。提出 SCALE（State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings），在 LeWM 目标上加一项把采样成对潜距离与任务相关状态空间距离对齐的正则，仅训练期需特权状态、规划期零额外计算。在操作与导航任务上、跨多种 solver，SCALE 相对 LeWM 提升规划成功率。
Motivation: 无约束联合训练会让不同观测坍缩到相同嵌入；即便用预训练特征或反坍缩正则避免了坍缩，任务相关状态（如物体相对目标的位姿）仍可被准确解码却几乎不影响潜距离，使规划代价与目标接近程度脱节。
Method: SCALE 在 LeWorldModel (LeWM) 现有目标上追加一项约束，使采样得到的成对潜空间距离与任务相关状态空间距离相关；保留 LeWM 架构，仅在训练阶段使用特权状态 (privileged state)，规划时不增加任何计算。
Result: 在操作 (manipulation) 与导航 (navigation) 任务上、配合多种 solver，SCALE 相对 LeWM 提升规划成功率；摘要另给出对 SCALE 如何重塑表征几何以支撑规划的分析，未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 避免坍缩不够，还需让潜距离与任务相关状态距离对齐，规划代价才能反映结果离目标的远近；该对齐可在不改架构、不加规划开销的前提下实现。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Regime-Conditional Verification: Correctness Estimation for Adapting and Monitoring Safety Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Safety classifiers deployed with large language models often fail for two reasons: their decisions reflect the policy learned during training rather than the deployer's desired policy, and their performance degrades as deployment traffic evolves. We present Regime-Conditional Verification (RCV), a lightweight wrapper that adapts an off-the-shelf safety classifier without retraining it. RCV estimates, from the classifier's internal representations, the probability that each prediction disagrees with the deployer's policy, and selectively corrects predictions likely to be wrong. The same correctness estimates also provide a label-free signal for detecting distribution shift, enabling a maintenance loop that updates the correctness estimation layer and resorts to classifier fine-tuning only when repair fails within a label budget. Across three off-the-shelf safety classifiers and two benchmark datasets, RCV improves adherence to the deployer's policy in every classifier-dataset combination, catching up to 0.81 of previously missed unsafe content without modifying the underlying classifier. In a deployment study with ten attack campaigns, each a harm category held out of RCV's training, RCV detects every campaign in a dedicated injection panel; in the maintenance census most drift episodes are repaired without updating the classifier, and the fine-tune is reserved for the residual episodes.
papers.comment: 18 pages including technical appendix, 6 figures. Project page and code: https://rcv.tsandoval.com
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RCV 是包在现成安全分类器外的轻量适配层：从分类器内部表征估计每条预测与部署方策略不一致的概率，只纠正高风险预测，并把同一套正确性估计当作无标签的分布漂移信号。在 3 个安全分类器 × 2 个基准数据集的全部组合上都提升对部署方策略的遵循，最多追回 0.81 的漏判不安全内容；10 个攻击战役（各为训练留出的危害类别）全部在注入面板中被检出。
Motivation: 安全分类器的决策反映训练期学到的策略而非部署方想要的策略，且部署流量演化时性能退化；重新训练成本高，需要不改底层分类器的适配与监控手段。
Method: RCV 从分类器内部表征估计单条预测与部署方策略不一致的概率，选择性纠正可能出错的预测；同一正确性估计提供无标签的分布漂移检测信号，构成维护循环——先在标签预算内更新正确性估计层，修复失败才诉诸分类器微调。
Result: 在三个现成安全分类器与两个基准数据集的每种组合上都提升对部署方策略的遵循，最多追回 0.81 此前漏判的不安全内容，且不修改底层分类器；部署研究含 10 个攻击战役（每个危害类别对 RCV 训练留出），全部在专用注入面板中被检出，维护普查中多数漂移片段无需更新分类器即被修复，微调只留给残余片段。
Conclusion: 不重训分类器、只在外层做正确性估计与选择性纠正，即可同时改善策略遵循并提供无标签漂移监控，微调应作为修复失败后的最后手段。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Post-Grokking Collapse at the Representation-Readout Interface in Muon-Trained Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Muon-trained modular-arithmetic transformers can lose accuracy while retaining linearly decodable task information. Adjacent swaps localize five captured unnormalized failures to AdamW readout updates. Multiplying the actual readout displacement by the large feature mean produces a class-dependent logit offset shared across inputs that nearly reproduces each failure. Training-only decoders recover 98.20-100% held-out accuracy. Method: 用相邻交换 (adjacent swaps) 做参数级归因，把五个未归一化失败定位到 AdamW 的 readout 更新；再用实际 readout 位移乘大特征均值构造类依赖 logit 偏移来复现失败，并用训练期解码器读出保留的任务信息；同时修正交叉熵导数错误并做前瞻对照运行。
Result: 五个失败被定位到 AdamW readout 更新，readout 位移×大特征均值构造的偏移几乎复现每个失败；训练期解码器恢复 98.20–100% 留出精度；修正 CE 导数后五个匹配分支稳定到 step 100,000，四个 prospective accurate-CE RMS 运行经 embedding 更新失败。
Conclusion: post-grokking 崩塌发生在表示-读出界面，由 AdamW readout 更新引入的类依赖 logit 偏移驱动，而任务信息本身并未丢失；修正交叉熵导数可稳定训练，但 embedding 更新路径仍会失败。

papers.title: Local Epistemic Uncertainty Guided Active Sampling for Plug-and-play Diffusive Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have demonstrated remarkable effectiveness in image restoration tasks. However, when guiding image reconstruction, existing Diffusion Model-based Image Restoration (DMIR) methods typically rely on fixed data constraints and uniform step sizes, thereby overlooking the dynamic nature of the generative process. Such rigid designs render the models vulnerable to spatially non-uniform degradations, thus resulting in structural distortions and loss of fine details. Meanwhile, uniform step sizes introduce computational redundancy, whereas naïve step reduction strategies tend to accumulate approximation errors. To address these limitations, we propose a Local Epistemic Uncertainty Guided Active Sampling framework (LEADer). In the spatial domain, LEADer leverages pixel-wise uncertainty to dynamically modulate the prior strength within the null space, which effectively balances detail preservation and artifact suppression. In the temporal domain, it quantifies sampling stability via the uncertainty trace to enable adaptive trajectory pruning, thereby accelerating convergence. Theoretical proofs demonstrate that our framework achieves strict data consistency, while the trajectory pruning strategy admits a deterministic error bound, thereby guaranteeing stable convergence under skip sampling. Notably, our plug-and-play method can be seamlessly integrated into various DMIR baselines. Extensive experiments show that LEADer improves the performance of multiple state-of-the-art DMIR methods, while significantly reducing sampling time with negligible memory overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/JiaqiZhang-Sengoku/LEADer.
papers.comment: 12 Pages, 7 Figures, 5 Tables. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 Oral!
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出即插即用的扩散图像复原框架 LEADer：在空间域用像素级认知不确定性动态调制零空间 (null space) 内的先验强度，在时间域用不确定性轨迹 (uncertainty trace) 量化采样稳定性并做自适应轨迹剪枝。理论证明其满足严格数据一致性且剪枝具有确定性误差界，实验中提升多个 SOTA DMIR 方法的复原性能并显著缩短采样时间、内存开销可忽略。
Motivation: 扩散图像复原 (DMIR) 现有方法用固定数据约束与统一步长，无法应对空间非均匀退化，导致结构失真与细节丢失；统一步长带来计算冗余，而朴素减步策略又会累积近似误差。
Method: LEADer 框架分两域：空间域以像素级认知不确定性动态调制 null space 内先验强度，权衡细节保持与伪影抑制；时间域以 uncertainty trace 度量采样稳定性，做自适应轨迹剪枝加速收敛。作为 plug-and-play 方法可嵌入多种 DMIR 基线。
Result: 理论证明框架满足严格数据一致性，轨迹剪枝策略具有确定性误差界，保证 skip sampling 下稳定收敛；实验显示 LEADer 提升多个 SOTA DMIR 方法的性能，同时显著降低采样时间、内存开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 把不确定性同时用于空间先验调制与时间轨迹剪枝，可在不牺牲数据一致性的前提下让扩散复原更抗非均匀退化并更快收敛。

papers.title: WebRider: Persona-Conditioned Intent Controllers for Live-Web Assistance
papers.abstract_en: Delegating a web task involves more than asking a question; it requires transferring a policy: what to verify, how to handle uncertainty, which preferences matter, and when to stop. Yet, current live-web agents are evaluated solely on the final answer, ignoring the policy constraints that define the delegation. A plausible final answer can conceal violations of that policy. Our full live audit reveals this critical gap: a strong controller completes 99.2% of tasks but honors all policy constraints in only 38.8% of cases. Finishing does not imply fidelity. WebRider bridges this gap by formalizing the delegated policy as an intent contract---an operational record of goals, constraints, evidence obligations, answer form, and task-local persona controls that must hold even as web pages change. WebRider employs a hierarchical architecture: a top-layer controller maintains the contract, a middle layer realizes intentions as guarded executable actions, and a tool layer executes these actions via browser, search, and maps tools. Our benchmark, RiderBench, evaluates this design on 4,096 live-web contracts across 42 public websites, auditing both the internal contract state and the visible user experience to determine if a rollout preserved its policy and if the steps were persona-consistent. The guarded middle interface also serves as a high-quality training signal; an 8B action-policy model trained through this interface outperforms executable-only baselines under a fixed controller. By making the browsing path a first-class object, WebRider enables a system that is auditable, human-judgeable, and learnable without conflating action realization with final-answer decisions. Dataset URL: hf.co/datasets/WebRider/WebRider.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WebRider 把网页任务委派形式化为 intent contract（目标、约束、证据义务、回答形式与 persona 控制），用三层架构（顶层控制器维护契约、中层生成受守卫的可执行动作、工具层调用浏览器/搜索/地图）在网页变化时保持策略。全量实测显示强控制器完成 99.2% 任务却只有 38.8% 完全遵守策略约束，说明完成不等于保真。
Motivation: 现有 live-web agent 只按最终答案评分，忽略委派策略本身的约束；一个看似合理的答案可能掩盖策略违规，任务完成率无法反映委派保真度。
Method: 将委派策略形式化为 intent contract，采用三层分层架构：顶层控制器维护契约状态，中层把意图实现为受守卫的可执行动作 (guarded executable actions)，工具层经 browser、search、maps 执行；中层接口同时作为训练信号，用于训练 8B action-policy 模型。
Result: 全量 live audit 中强控制器完成 99.2% 任务，但仅 38.8% 完全满足全部策略约束。RiderBench 覆盖 42 个公开网站上的 4,096 个 live-web 契约，同时审计内部契约状态与可见用户体验。经中层接口训练的 8B action-policy 模型在固定控制器下优于仅可执行 (executable-only) 基线。
Conclusion: 把浏览路径本身作为一等对象来审计，可使系统可审计、可人工判定、可学习，且不把动作实现与最终答案决策混为一谈；完成率高并不意味着策略保真。

papers.title: Strategic Evaluation of Planning Strategies for LLM Agents in Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-agent evaluations commonly measure task success or agreement with a declared plan. In strategic cyber-physical systems, an architecture must also remain appropriate after autonomous participants respond and physics constrains outcomes. We introduce a controlled benchmark of planning-induced control trajectories: ordered planning operations and directives linking execution architecture to strategic response and physical consequences. Four coded executors (predefined, sequential, hierarchical, and search) control demand response for 40 prosumers on a radial feeder. The LLM declares or advises typed policies and mediates communication; schedules, base prosumer dynamics, stochastic actions, and power flow remain explicit code. Paired forced-mode counterfactuals, exact-prompt caching, common response draws with separate randomness streams, critic isolation, and event-level feasibility isolate comparisons. The Llama-3.3-70B experiments on this feeder distinguish three properties. First, forced search is the oracle in all five baseline seeds under the specified objective. Second, injected objective substitution preserves mode agreement at 1.0 while increasing cumulative voltage shortfall by 2.68x. Third, the 144-scenario, 576-episode factorial bank, using three repeated seeds, contains feasible oracles from predefined, sequential, and search. The prespecified stress-held-out ridge has mean regret 90.7 and no observed value over fixed sequential. A post-hoc constraint-aware analysis reduces regret to 29.0; a simple deadline rule attains 28.7, so this gain does not establish a learning advantage. An all-feasible ablation does not improve over fixed search. These are simulation-internal, descriptive comparisons. A five-model, 300-declaration extension tests interface behaviour, not cross-backbone physical rankings; shared-endpoint latency tails motivate probabilistic live feasibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 40 个产消者 (prosumer) 的辐射状馈线需求响应仿真中，用 Llama-3.3-70B 声明或建议类型化策略、由四种编码执行器 (predefined/sequential/hierarchical/search) 执行，构建规划诱发控制轨迹的受控基准。强制 search 在全部五个基线种子下都是该目标下的 oracle；注入目标替换后模式一致性仍为 1.0，但累计电压缺额升至 2.68 倍，说明只看任务成功率或计划一致性的评估会漏掉物理后果。
Motivation: LLM-agent 评估通常只测任务成功率或与声明计划的一致性，而在战略性 CPS 中，自主参与者会响应、物理约束会限制结果，架构是否仍然合适无法由此判断。
Method: 提出规划诱发控制轨迹基准：有序规划操作与指令把执行架构连到策略响应和物理后果。四种编码执行器控制 40 个 prosumer 的需求响应，LLM 只声明/建议类型化策略并中介通信，调度、基础 prosumer 动力学、随机动作与潮流全部保留为显式代码；用配对强制模式反事实、精确 prompt 缓存、共同响应抽样加独立随机流、critic 隔离和事件级可行性来隔离比较。
Result: 强制 search 在指定目标下五个基线种子全部为 oracle；注入目标替换使模式一致性保持 1.0 而累计电压缺额增至 2.68 倍；144 情景、576 回合、三个重复种子的因子库中 predefined、sequential、search 都存在可行 oracle。预指定 stress-held-out ridge 平均 regret 90.7，未超过固定 sequential；事后 constraint-aware 分析把 regret 降到 29.0，而简单 deadline 规则达到 28.7；全可行消融不优于固定 search。另有五模型、300 次声明的扩展测试接口行为。
Conclusion: 作者把这些结果定位为仿真内部的描述性比较：模式一致性不能替代物理后果评估，事后 regret 改善由简单 deadline 规则即可达到，不构成学习优势；五模型扩展检验的是接口行为而非跨骨干的物理排名。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Rethinking Modality Reliability in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Observations
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) integrates text, audio, and vision to infer human affect, yet real-world multimodal observations are often incomplete. Existing methods for incomplete-observation MSA mainly follow two paradigms. Reconstruction-based methods recover missing information from observed modalities, while joint-representation methods learn directly from incomplete inputs. Although effective, these methods usually treat modality reliability only implicitly within representation learning or fusion design rather than modeling it explicitly. We argue that modality reliability is a central variable in incomplete-observation settings. Failure to model it explicitly gives rise to two related issues. The first is reliability mismatch, in which the affective evidence retained by each modality varies across samples and missing rates. The second is reliability propagation bias, in which messages from degraded modalities may adversely affect cross-modal interaction and predictive performance. To address these issues, we propose MRCF, a Modality Reliability-Calibrated Framework for MSA with incomplete observations. MRCF contains a Reliability-Aware Branch that estimates sample-specific modality reliability from intramodal quality cues and cross-modal semantic consistency, a Reliability-Guided Interaction Branch that uses the estimated scores to modulate cross-modal information flow, and a Reliability-Calibrated Fusion Module that integrates reliability and semantic cues for final prediction. Experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS show that MRCF achieves strong performance under standard incomplete-observation protocols. Further analyses provide evidence that explicit reliability modeling helps mitigate reliability mismatch and reliability propagation bias during interaction and fusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在文本、音频、视觉缺失不全的多模态情感分析 (MSA) 中，MRCF 把模态可靠性作为显式变量建模：由模态内质量线索与跨模态语义一致性估计逐样本可靠性分数，再用它调制跨模态信息流并在融合时校准。在 CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI、CH-SIMS 的标准不完整观测协议下取得强表现，并给出证据表明显式可靠性建模缓解了 reliability mismatch 与 reliability propagation bias。
Motivation: 不完整观测下的 MSA 现有两大范式——重建式与联合表征式——都只在表征学习或融合设计里隐式处理模态可靠性，导致两个问题：各模态保留的情感证据随样本与缺失率变化而失配 (reliability mismatch)，退化模态的消息还会污染跨模态交互与预测 (reliability propagation bias)。
Method: 提出 MRCF (Modality Reliability-Calibrated Framework)，含三个部件：Reliability-Aware Branch 从模态内质量线索与跨模态语义一致性估计逐样本模态可靠性；Reliability-Guided Interaction Branch 用该分数调制跨模态信息流；Reliability-Calibrated Fusion Module 融合可靠性与语义线索做最终预测。
Result: 在 CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI、CH-SIMS 三个基准的标准不完整观测协议下，MRCF 取得强表现；进一步分析给出证据，表明显式可靠性建模在交互与融合阶段缓解了 reliability mismatch 和 reliability propagation bias。
Conclusion: 模态可靠性应作为不完整观测 MSA 中的显式变量来估计并用于调制交互与融合，而不是隐含在表征或融合设计里。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Do AI weather models miss extremes?
papers.abstract_en: AI weather models are often reported to underestimate extremes, but most evidence concerns deterministic regression models verified against reanalysis. We evaluate twelve physical and AI forecast models against ECMWF IFS using ten months of European station observations. The evaluation covers 10 m wind, 2 m temperature, solar radiation, and precipitation within regimes defined from a fixed ERA5 1991-2020 climatology. We find no uniform AI-specific deficit in the tails. Several AI models remain more accurate than IFS under extreme conditions, while others deteriorate markedly; comparable variation occurs among physical models. Every model nevertheless exhibits a common conditional-error pattern, overpredicting low observations and underpredicting high observations. Attenuation of extreme values therefore does not imply a uniform loss of relative skill: tail performance depends on the model, variable, and evaluation setting rather than on whether the forecast is produced by AI or physical numerical modelling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用欧洲十年内十个月的站点观测对照 ECMWF IFS，检验十二个物理与 AI 天气模式是否系统性低估极值：AI 模式在尾部没有统一劣势，部分在极端条件下仍比 IFS 更准，另一些明显退化，物理模式之间也有同等幅度的差异。但所有模式都呈现同一种条件误差——低值观测被高估、高值观测被低估；因此极值衰减不等于相对技巧的统一损失，尾部表现取决于具体模式、变量与评估设置，而非预报来自 AI 还是物理数值模式。
Motivation: AI 天气模式常被指低估极值，但既有证据大多来自以再分析为真值的确定性回归模式，站点观测上的尾部技巧是否真有 AI 特有的系统性缺口尚不清楚。
Method: 以 ECMWF IFS 为参照，评估十二个物理与 AI 预报模式，使用十个月的欧洲站点观测，覆盖 10 m 风、2 m 温度、太阳辐射与降水四类变量；极端与否由固定的 ERA5 1991–2020 气候态划分的 regime 定义。
Result: 尾部不存在统一的 AI 特有劣势：若干 AI 模式在极端条件下仍比 IFS 更准，另一些明显退化，物理模式之间存在可比的差异幅度。所有模式都出现共同的条件误差模式，即高估低值观测、低估高值观测。
Conclusion: 极值衰减不等于相对技巧的统一损失；尾部表现由模式、变量与评估设置共同决定，而不能按 AI 与物理数值建模二分。
Relevance: 62

papers.title: FedGuide: Diffusion Prior Alignment and Value Baseline Guidance for Heterogeneous Federated Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL) enables collaborative policy learning across distributed agents with heterogeneous environments. While recent methods based on variance reduction, divergence penalization, and momentum optimization improve FRL under heterogeneous settings, they still primarily synchronize policy or value-network parameters and do not explicitly address distributional mismatch among heterogeneous clients. Therefore, we propose \textbf{FedGuide}, a FRL framework that uses diffusion priors as behavior models to provide personalized data supported distributions for heterogeneous local policy learning. Instead of directly averaging local policies, FedGuide aggregates those diffusion priors through Optimal-Transport Mixture-of-Experts (OT-MoE), preserving heterogeneous behavior modes in distribution space. It further develops a Distribution Correction Estimation (DICE) value baseline to provide low-variance, return-aware guidance for local policy improvement. Experiments across heterogeneous environments show that FedGuide outperforms representative FRL methods in client-average returns, final-round performance, and worst-round robustness, while maintaining stable learning under stronger heterogeneity.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL), 2026. Spotlight presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedGuide 用 diffusion prior 作为各客户端的行为模型，在分布空间而非参数空间做联邦聚合：以 Optimal-Transport Mixture-of-Experts (OT-MoE) 聚合 diffusion priors 保留异构行为模式，再用 Distribution Correction Estimation (DICE) value baseline 为本地策略改进提供低方差、回报感知的引导。在异构环境实验中，其 client-average returns、final-round performance 与 worst-round robustness 均优于代表性 FRL 方法，且在更强异构下学习仍稳定。
Motivation: 现有 FRL 方法（方差缩减、散度惩罚、动量优化）仍主要同步策略或 value 网络参数，没有显式处理异构客户端之间的分布失配。
Method: FedGuide 以 diffusion prior 作行为模型，为异构本地策略学习提供 personalized data supported 分布；不用直接平均本地策略，而是通过 OT-MoE 在分布空间聚合 diffusion priors；并提出 DICE value baseline，为本地策略改进提供低方差、return-aware 的引导信号。
Result: 在异构环境实验中，FedGuide 在 client-average returns、final-round performance 和 worst-round robustness 三项上均超过代表性 FRL 方法，并在更强异构条件下保持稳定学习。
Conclusion: 联邦聚合应发生在分布空间（用 diffusion prior 保留异构行为模式）并配合回报感知的 value baseline 引导，而非直接平均策略参数。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Latent-Action-Guided Video-Language Feature Learning for Surgical Instrument-Tissue Interaction Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Recognizing instrument--tissue interactions is essential for context-aware surgical AI. Vision-language models offer a natural way to inject semantic structure into surgical representations by aligning video features with textual action descriptions. However, pretrained encoders may lack spatial coherence, while global semantic alignment does not ensure precise spatial and temporal representations. By analyzing frame-to-frame feature changes, we find that semantic alignment increases their dimensionality, but larger increases do not necessarily improve recognition; encoders also differ in how strongly dominant changes localize to interaction regions. Motivated by these findings, we introduce \ours{}, which compresses frame-to-frame changes into latent actions and predicts next-frame features during end-to-end video--language alignment. Without additional spatial or motion annotations, \ours{} improves the interaction grounding of leading feature changes and temporal-direction sensitivity in our evaluated settings. We further characterize how action capacity and prediction strength affect recognition across encoders and triplet components. Using image encoders without large-scale video pretraining, \ours{} achieves competitive recognition with faster inference and smaller INT4 accuracy drops than V-JEPA2/2.1.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 手术器械-组织交互识别中，全局视频-语言语义对齐并不保证时空表征精确；方法把相邻帧特征变化压缩成 latent action，并在端到端视频-语言对齐中预测下一帧特征，从而改善主导特征变化的交互区域定位与时间方向敏感性。在未做大规模视频预训练的图像编码器上仍取得有竞争力的识别效果，推理更快，且 INT4 量化精度下降小于 V-JEPA2/2.1。
Motivation: 预训练视觉语言编码器缺乏空间一致性，全局语义对齐无法保证精确的时空表征；帧间特征变化的维度升高并不必然提升交互识别。
Method: 提出将帧到帧特征变化压缩为 latent action 并预测下一帧特征的视频-语言对齐框架，端到端训练且不需额外空间或运动标注；并系统刻画 action capacity 与 prediction strength 对不同编码器及 triplet 各组成部分识别效果的影响。
Result: 分析发现语义对齐会增大帧间特征变化的维度，但维度增幅更大不必然改善识别，且不同编码器主导变化向交互区域的局域化程度不同；在评估设置下方法改善了主导特征变化的交互 grounding 与时间方向敏感性；在无大规模视频预训练的图像编码器上取得有竞争力的识别效果，推理更快，INT4 量化精度下降小于 V-JEPA2/2.1。
Conclusion: 把帧间变化显式建模为可预测的 latent action，比单纯追求更强的全局语义对齐更能带来可用的时空表征，且可让轻量图像编码器在识别上具备竞争力。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Attention from Above: A Multimodal Model for Drone-Based Object Localization
papers.abstract_en: Drone-based object detection technology has advanced rapidly, becoming increasingly sophisticated and efficient. Recently, research trends have expanded beyond the detection of predefined objects toward the identification of specified target objects. For example, desired targets can be specified through textual prompts, enabling accurate detection of objects of interest. To address this demand, this paper proposes an efficient multimodal-based object detection model aimed at improving small object detection performance. The proposed method is built upon the YOLO-World framework and replaces the C2f layers used in the YOLOv8 backbone with attention-based A2C2f layers. This modification enables more precise representation of local features, particularly for small objects or objects with well-defined boundaries. In addition, the incorporation of attention mechanisms and parallel processing structures significantly enhances the model's computational accuracy. Comparative experiments conducted on the VisDrone dataset demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms the original YOLO-World model. Specifically, precision increases from 43.0% to 45.1%, recall from 32.8% to 35.0%, the F1 score from 37.2% to 39.4%, mAP@0.5 from 32.5% to 35.2%, and mAP@0.5-0.95 from 18.5% to 19.9%, confirming a substantial improvement in detection accuracy. These results verify that the proposed approach provides an effective and highly accurate solution for object detection in drone-based image and video application environments.
papers.comment: Published in the International Journal of Interactive Mobile Technologies
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 YOLO-World 框架上把 YOLOv8 backbone 的 C2f 层换成注意力版 A2C2f 层，用注意力与并行结构强化局部特征表示以改善无人机小目标检测。在 VisDrone 上相对原 YOLO-World，precision 43.0%→45.1%、recall 32.8%→35.0%、F1 37.2%→39.4%、mAP@0.5 32.5%→35.2%、mAP@0.5-0.95 18.5%→19.9%。
Motivation: 无人机场景中小目标与边界清晰的目标检测精度不足，且需求已从检测预定义类别转向按文本提示指定目标的开放词汇检测。
Method: 基于 YOLO-World 的多模态（文本提示 + 图像）检测模型，将 YOLOv8 backbone 中的 C2f 层替换为注意力 A2C2f 层，引入注意力机制与并行处理结构以更精确表示局部特征。
Result: VisDrone 数据集上相对原 YOLO-World：precision 43.0%→45.1%，recall 32.8%→35.0%，F1 37.2%→39.4%，mAP@0.5 32.5%→35.2%，mAP@0.5-0.95 18.5%→19.9%。
Conclusion: 把 backbone 的 C2f 换成 A2C2f 是提升 YOLO-World 在无人机图像/视频环境中检测精度的有效改动，尤其针对小目标。

papers.title: Token-Level Off-Policy Learning for Faithful Generation Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: We propose Token-Level Off-Policy Labeling (TOPL), an off-policy training paradigm that reframes post-training as a token-level correctness prediction task. Our key intuition is that by training the model to distinguish good and bad tokens in a response, we naturally guide the model towards generating good tokens, while avoiding the pitfalls that come with directly training the model to generate off-policy tokens. Experiments on document summarization tasks show that TOPL achieves strong out-of-distribution generalization across 11 datasets against a diverse set of sequence-level and token-level baselines. We further demonstrate that TOPL transfers effectively to machine translation, suggesting that its benefits generalize across different faithful generation tasks. Through ablation studies, we confirm that our token-level learning signal is critical to good performance; sequence-level analogues do not confer similar benefits. Finally, we show that TOPL induces interpretable model updates: the LoRA adapters learned through TOPL function as linear classification heads and steering vectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TOPL (Token-Level Off-Policy Labeling)，把后训练重构为 token 级正确性预测：训练模型区分回答中的好 token 与坏 token，从而间接引导其生成好 token，避免直接在 off-policy token 上训练的弊端。在文档摘要任务的 11 个数据集上相对序列级与 token 级基线取得强分布外泛化，并可迁移到机器翻译；消融显示 token 级学习信号是关键，序列级类比无此收益。
Motivation: 直接在偏离当前策略的 token 上做生成式后训练会带来训练偏差问题，而序列级奖励信号过粗，难以在分布偏移下保持忠实生成。
Method: TOPL 把后训练改写为 token 级正确性预测任务，用判别好坏 token 的学习信号引导生成；用 LoRA 适配器承载该信号，并通过消融与序列级类比对照验证 token 级信号的作用，另在机器迁移任务上检验迁移性。
Result: 在文档摘要任务上，TOPL 在 11 个数据集上相对多种序列级与 token 级基线取得强分布外 (out-of-distribution) 泛化；迁移到机器翻译同样有效；消融确认 token 级学习信号是性能关键，序列级类比不带来同等收益；TOPL 学到的 LoRA 适配器可充当线性分类头与 steering vector，更新可解释。
Conclusion: 把后训练当作 token 级正确性预测而非直接生成 off-policy token，能在分布偏移下获得跨任务的忠实生成收益，且其收益特异于 token 级信号。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning: Towards Task-Specific Zero-Shot Models in Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning (RAIL), a probabilistic meta-learning framework for zero-shot generation of task-specific interpretable models that synthesizes coefficient-space structure from natural-language task descriptions and a memory of previously learned task-specific predictors. RAIL retrieves related source tasks, transfers structure through coefficient space, and generates a new predictor in the original diagnostic-feature space, enabling zero-shot and few-shot clinical procedure prediction with feature-level explanations. Its probabilistic formulation provides uncertainty over retrieval, model coefficients, and predictions, supporting uncertainty-aware deployment: uncertain predictions or unstable explanations can be flagged for additional clinical review rather than treated as automatic decisions. This makes RAIL particularly suited for healthcare settings, where prediction tasks are highly long-tailed, new clinical targets arise frequently, and models must remain inspectable, uncertainty-aware, and compatible with human oversight. Across long-tailed clinical procedure prediction tasks, RAIL improves low-data model generation, benefits from clinically informed task representations, and yields retrieval, uncertainty, and coefficient-level diagnostics that make model behavior more transparent. These results suggest a path toward scalable clinical prediction systems that can adapt to new tasks while preserving interpretability and reliability.
papers.comment: We note that a preliminary, non-archival workshop version of this work is available online under the name RAG-IM. RAIL is the renamed and completed version of the same work. This manuscript supersedes that earlier non-archival workshop version and should be consulted for the current formulation, results, and contributions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAIL 是面向医疗的元学习框架，从自然语言任务描述与既往任务预测器记忆中检索相关源任务，在系数空间迁移结构，零样本生成原始诊断特征空间的可解释预测器，并对检索、系数与预测给出概率不确定性，低数据临床操作预测任务的模型生成得到改善。
Motivation: 临床预测任务高度长尾、新临床目标频繁出现，为每个新目标从头训练既缺数据又难保持可解释性与人工监督兼容性。
Method: RAIL（Retrieval-Augmented Interpretable Learning）作为概率元学习框架：检索相关源任务，通过系数空间 (coefficient space) 迁移结构，在原始诊断特征空间生成新预测器，支持零样本与少样本临床操作预测并给出特征级解释；概率形式同时对检索、模型系数与预测提供不确定性，可将不确定预测或不稳解释标记出来交临床复核。
Result: 在长尾临床操作预测任务上，RAIL 改善低数据条件下的模型生成，且受益于临床先验的任务表示；同时产出检索、不确定性与系数级诊断以提升模型行为透明度。
Conclusion: 作者认为该路径可扩展到能适应新任务同时保持可解释性与可靠性的临床预测系统，且不确定预测应交由临床复核而非自动决策。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Critic Experience Bank: Self-Evolving Step-Level Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents operate in stateful environments, where a single erroneous step can waste limited interaction budget or cause irreversible effects before task failure becomes apparent. Reliable deployment therefore requires step-level confidence estimation: estimating, before execution, the probability that a proposed action will advance the task. Existing LLM confidence estimators are typically designed for static question answering under a fixed task context and evaluation criterion. For an agent, however, its action productivity depends on an environment transition that is observed only after execution. To address this challenge, we introduce Critic Experience Bank (CEB), a training-free framework that turns feedback from completed trajectories into reusable evidence for future confidence judgments. After each trajectory, an LLM assigns hindsight productivity pseudo-labels to individual actions and stores them with the critic's original pre-execution confidence, task context, action, and observed feedback. For a new action, by retrieving related productive and unproductive experiences, CEB grounds pre-execution confidence in feedback from completed trajectories to condition a fixed LLM critic. CEB thereby adapts over a task stream without parameter updates or ground-truth step labels at deployment. Across four agent benchmarks spanning offline and live web navigation, mobile GUI and shell tasks, and three critic backbones, CEB achieves the best or tied-best ECE, Brier score, and AUC in all twelve benchmark-backbone settings under rule-based step labels, reducing ECE by up to 53.8% relative to the strongest training-free baseline. Its confidence scores also improve downstream utility in selective execution and simulated task success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的 Critic Experience Bank (CEB)：把已完成轨迹中动作的事后生产性伪标签与执行前置信度一起存库，检索相关正反经验来校准新动作的执行前置信度。在四个 agent 基准、三个 critic backbone 的全部 12 个设置上，ECE、Brier、AUC 均为最优或并列最优，ECE 相对最强免训练基线最多降低 53.8%。
Motivation: LLM agent 在有状态环境中一步错就烧掉交互预算或造成不可逆后果，而现有置信度估计器面向静态问答、固定评测标准；agent 动作是否有用要等环境转移执行后才可见，执行前难以判断。
Method: CEB 在每条轨迹结束后由 LLM 给各动作打事后生产性伪标签，与 critic 原始的执行前置信度、任务上下文、动作和观测反馈一起入库；面对新动作时检索相关的 productive/unproductive 经验，用完成轨迹的反馈为固定 LLM critic 的执行前判断提供依据，全程无需参数更新与真值步级标签。
Result: 在覆盖离线与在线 web 导航、mobile GUI、shell 任务的四个 agent 基准、三个 critic backbone 上，共 12 个基准-骨干设置中 ECE、Brier score、AUC 全部取得最优或并列最优（规则步级标签下），ECE 相对最强免训练基线最多降低 53.8%；其置信度分数还提升了选择性执行与模拟任务成功率的下游效用。
Conclusion: 把已完成轨迹的反馈转成可复用证据，就能在不更新参数、不需步级真值标签的部署条件下持续校准 agent 的执行前置信度，并转化为下游执行收益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 3D-DefectBench: A Controlled Factorial Study of Vision-Language Model Evaluation Pipelines for Fine-Grained 3D Generation Defects
papers.abstract_en: Automated evaluation is essential for scaling generative 3D systems, where exhaustive human review is costly and slow. Yet the reliability of an automated judge depends on the full evaluation pipeline, including the vision-language model (VLM), asset rendering, visual evidence, task specification, and human reference labels. We introduce 3D-DefectBench, a large-scale benchmark for rigorous evaluation-pipeline analysis. It complements holistic ratings and pairwise preferences with nine fine-grained binary defects spanning geometry, texture, and prompt adherence, with optional human severity annotations. Using a balanced factorial design, we vary the VLM, camera protocol, visual input, and prompt schema across 84 inference designs, and validate the resulting conclusions on a broader set of frontier models. Model choice is the dominant source of variation in agreement with human labels, while other pipeline factors also influence agreement, interact with the model, and can alter the best configuration. A compact six-view RGB protocol performs comparably to denser view sets and configurations augmented with depth or normal channels, making it a strong cost-effective default. Under this fixed design, the best of 12 VLMs still trail trained human labelers, and texture agreement drops sharply from expert-agreement to noisier silver labels. Severity annotations further show that binary judges recover most defects humans flag as severe. These results highlight the importance of evaluating automated judges as complete pipelines and calibrating them across human reference regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 3D-DefectBench 用平衡析因设计把 3D 生成缺陷评测拆成 VLM、相机协议、视觉输入、提示词模板四个因子，在 84 种推理配置上量化各因子对与人工标签一致性的贡献。模型选择是主导变异来源，其余因子也有影响、与模型交互并能改变最优配置；六视图 RGB 协议与更密视图或加 depth/normal 的配置表现相当，是强性价比默认项。固定该设计后，12 个 VLM 中最好的仍不及受训人工标注者，且纹理缺陷一致性从专家标签换到噪声更大的 silver 标签时大幅下降。
Motivation: 生成式 3D 系统规模化后人工全检昂贵缓慢，自动评判的可靠性取决于整条评测管线（VLM、渲染、视觉证据、任务说明、人工参考标签），但此前缺少对管线各因子的受控分析。
Method: 提出大规模基准 3D-DefectBench，在整体评分与成对偏好之外加入覆盖几何、纹理、提示词遵从三类的九个细粒度二元缺陷，可选人工严重度标注；用平衡析因设计在 84 种推理设计上变动 VLM、相机协议、视觉输入与提示词 schema，并在更广的一组前沿模型上验证结论。
Result: 84 种推理设计的析因分析显示模型选择是与人工标签一致性的主导变异来源，其他管线因子亦有影响、与模型交互并可改变最优配置；六视图 RGB 协议与更密视图集及加 depth/normal 通道的配置表现相当。固定该设计下 12 个 VLM 中最佳者仍落后于受训人工标注者；纹理缺陷一致性从专家标签换到 silver 标签时大幅下降；严重度标注显示二元判定能捕获人工标为严重的大部分缺陷。
Conclusion: 自动评判必须作为完整管线来评估，并在不同人工参考标签体系下校准；六视图 RGB 是兼顾成本与一致性的默认配置，但最佳 VLM 仍无法达到受训标注者水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Scaffold Splits: Structural-Frontier Evaluation Reveals Hidden Failures in ADMET Models
papers.abstract_en: Molecular property models are commonly evaluated by holding out Bemis-Murcko scaffolds, yet a scaffold identifier is only one notion of chemical unfamiliarity. We introduce a label-free structural-frontier split that reserves the sparsest and most physicochemically remote scaffold groups, and evaluate it on six public experimental or curated ADMET tasks. Against a 70/10/20 scaffold control with identical acyclic grouping, the frontier inflates equally weighted primary error with a taskwise median of 87.0% and a skew-sensitive mean of 130.3% (descriptive task/seed bootstrap interval, 52.1-246.0%). The mean falls to 75.9% once BBB is removed; that endpoint is the one whose score ranking inverts at the frontier. A message-passing graph-network control still shows a large gap (mean 82.8% over four tasks) and does not invert, so a low-capacity head does not explain the effect. We also test Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (MV-FREX), a count-adjusted tail-risk penalty over four molecular views, and treat it as a falsifiable probe. It changes normalized frontier error by only 0.16% relative to empirical risk minimization for the perceptron head (interval, -0.43-0.84%) and by -1.9% for the graph network; three fixed robust-penalty controls are likewise inconclusive. Against the published Lo-Hi and DataSAIL splitters, the frontier inflates error more on average, though no split is uniformly hardest. An audit of 31,561 marine natural products further shows that OOD status and agreement with legacy ADMET predictions depend on the molecular view, endpoint, and teacher coverage. Split construction and label provenance are important evaluation constraints in their own right, and the tested training penalties do not resolve the frontier failures we observe.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, and 4 tables. Version 3 updates figures and tables caption in the main PDF
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无标签的 structural-frontier 划分：把最稀疏、理化性质最远的 scaffold 组留作测试集，在六个 ADMET 任务上使等权主误差的任务中位数上升 87.0%、偏度敏感均值上升 130.3%（bootstrap 区间 52.1–246.0%）。消息传递图网络对照仍高出均值 82.8% 且排序不反转，说明不是低容量头所致；而 MV-FREX 等训练惩罚只改变归一化前沿误差 0.16%（感知机）与 -1.9%（图网络），无法消除该失败。
Motivation: 常规 scaffold split 只用一个 scaffold 标识符定义化学陌生性，掩盖了模型在真正理化偏远区域的失效；ADMET 模型的 OOD 评估因此可能系统性乐观。
Method: 构造 label-free structural-frontier split，保留最稀疏且理化最远的 scaffold 组，与 70/10/20 scaffold 对照（相同无环分组）比较，在六个公开实验或整理的 ADMET 任务上评测；另设消息传递图网络对照、Lo-Hi 与 DataSAIL 划分器对照，并测试四分子视图上的 Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (MV-FREX) 尾部风险惩罚作为可证伪探针。

papers.title: UniPose9D: Universal Category-Agnostic Object Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Object pose estimation is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Although recent state-of-the-art approaches achieve strong performance, generalization to novel categories and unseen scenes remains challenging. We propose UniPose9D, a unified model for category-agnostic 9D object pose estimation: given an instance mask/ROI and either an RGB-D observation or an RGB image with predicted depth, the model estimates rotation, translation, and metric size without category labels, CAD models, mean-shape priors, or reference views. Specifically, UniPose9D samples point pairs from the observed object geometry and uses DINOv2 and PointNet features to predict NOCS coordinates for each pair. To improve accuracy, we introduce a point-pair-based RANSAC N-hop Kabsch-Umeyama algorithm with an adaptive threshold. We further employ flow matching to address symmetric ambiguities and construct a large-scale training set by curating and aligning pose annotations from existing public datasets. Experiments across eight datasets show that a single unified model achieves competitive performance on standard benchmarks while generalizing to unseen objects, unseen categories, and in-the-wild scenarios. Our code and model are available at https://github.com/qq456cvb/UniPose9D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniPose9D 是类别无关的 9D 物体位姿估计统一模型：给定实例 mask/ROI 与 RGB-D（或 RGB 加预测深度），直接输出旋转、平移与 metric size，不需类别标签、CAD 模型、均值形状先验或参考视角。它从观测几何采样 point pair，用 DINOv2 与 PointNet 特征预测每对的 NOCS 坐标，再经 point-pair 版 RANSAC N-hop Kabsch-Umeyama（自适应阈值）求解位姿，并用 flow matching 处理对称歧义。在八个数据集上单一模型在标准 benchmark 取得竞争力表现，同时泛化到未见物体、未见类别与 in-the-wild 场景。
Motivation: 现有位姿估计方法在新类别与未见场景上泛化差，往往依赖类别标签、CAD 模型或均值形状先验，难以用一个模型覆盖任意类别。
Method: 从观测物体几何采样 point pair，用 DINOv2 与 PointNet 特征预测每对的 NOCS 坐标；引入 point-pair 版 RANSAC N-hop Kabsch-Umeyama 算法配合自适应阈值求解位姿；用 flow matching 处理对称歧义，并通过整理对齐现有公开数据集的位姿标注构建大规模训练集。
Result: 在八个数据集上的实验中，单一统一模型在标准 benchmark 上取得竞争力表现，并泛化到未见物体、未见类别与 in-the-wild 场景；输入可为 RGB-D 或 RGB 加预测深度。
Conclusion: 不依赖类别标签、CAD 模型与均值形状先验，靠 point pair 几何对应加 NOCS 回归即可支撑类别无关的 9D 位姿估计统一模型。

papers.title: On the effectiveness of reward functions in reinforcement learning for confidence calibration of large language models
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we consider the setting where large language models (LLMs) are trained using reinforcement learning (RL) to simultaneously improve reasoning accuracy and verbalize their confidence. Our reward scheme uses two functions for rewarding confidence verbalized by the LLM: one for correct answers and the other for incorrect answers. If poorly designed, such a scheme may incentivize an LLM to answer incorrectly in order for its confidence to be calibrated, a phenomenon we term confidence reward hacking. We introduce the notion of non-hackable confidence reward schemes and provide methods for constructing them. We show that selective confidence reward hacking can arise in practical datasets under hackable reward schemes while non-hackable reward schemes are resistant to hacking. Finally, we place some of these schemes along an overconfidence-underconfidence spectrum for RL-based confidence calibration and demonstrate experimentally that they tend to exhibit the corresponding calibration biases relative to other schemes in the spectrum. The code of our experiments is available in https://anonymous.4open.science/r/rl-confidence-calibration-9ED4/README.md.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在用强化学习同时提升 LLM 推理准确率并让其口头表达置信度的设定下，若对正确与错误答案分别设计置信度奖励，设计不当会诱导模型故意答错以换取校准奖励，作者称之为 confidence reward hacking。论文提出 non-hackable confidence reward scheme 的概念与构造方法，指出可 hack 的方案在真实数据集上会出现选择性 hacking，而非 hack 方案能抵抗；实验还显示各方案在 overconfidence-underconfidence 谱上的位置与其校准偏差方向一致。
Motivation: RL 训练 LLM 同时做推理与置信度表达时，双奖励函数若设计不当会给出「答错更划算」的激励，使校准目标被反向利用，破坏训练可靠性。
Method: 为口头表达的置信度设置两个奖励函数（答对一个、答错一个），形式化定义 non-hackable confidence reward scheme 并给出构造方法；在实际数据集上检验 hackable 方案的选择性 hacking 行为，并把各方案放到 overconfidence-underconfidence 谱上做实验比较，代码已匿名公开。
Result: 在 hackable 奖励方案下，实际数据集上出现 selective confidence reward hacking，而非 hackable 方案对 hacking 具有抵抗力；实验显示谱上不同方案相对其他方案表现出与其位置对应的校准偏差（偏过度自信或偏欠自信）。
Conclusion: 置信度奖励的可 hack 与否决定了 RL 校准是否会奖励答错，构造 non-hackable 方案是让 RL-based confidence calibration 可用的前提，且方案在过/欠自信谱上的位置直接对应其校准偏差方向。

papers.title: Guided Action Flow: Value-Guided Sampling for Frozen Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond supervised fine-tuning, although this typically involves further updates to the policy parameters. For flow-matching policies, iterative action generation provides an additional opportunity to incorporate task information during inference. We introduce Guided Action Flow (GAF), which learns a compact, observation-conditioned action-value critic from robot task rollouts and applies its action gradient to steer reverse-time flow sampling. The supervised-fine-tuned VLA remains frozen throughout critic learning and deployment. Physical-robot experiments show an increase in aggregate success from 60.0% to 82.5% across six nominal manipulation tasks. Under six altered-lighting and object-distractor conditions evaluated on three of these tasks, aggregate success improves from 34.2% to 49.2%. Ablations and rollout analyses support the importance of the learned guidance direction and the critic's visual and proprioceptive inputs. With approximately 2.735M trainable critic parameters alongside a 0.45B-parameter VLA, GAF enables task outcomes to inform action generation through a compact inference-time guidance module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Guided Action Flow (GAF) 在推理时用观测条件化的动作价值 critic 的梯度引导 flow-matching 策略的反向时间采样，VLA 参数全程冻结。六项机械臂操作任务的聚合成功率从 60.0% 升到 82.5%，在三项任务的六种光照改变与物体干扰条件下从 34.2% 升到 49.2%。
Motivation: 用强化学习改进 VLA 通常要更新策略参数，代价高且破坏监督微调成果；flow-matching 策略的迭代动作生成则提供了只在推理阶段注入任务信息的机会。
Method: 从机器人任务 rollout 学一个紧凑的、观测条件化的动作价值 critic，把该 critic 的动作梯度施加到反向时间 flow 采样上做引导；监督微调后的 VLA 在 critic 学习与部署全程保持冻结，critic 可训练参数约 2.735M，VLA 为 0.45B 参数。
Result: 物理机器人实验中六项常规操作任务的聚合成功率由 60.0% 提升至 82.5%；在其中三项任务的六种改变光照与物体干扰条件下，聚合成功率由 34.2% 提升至 49.2%。消融与 rollout 分析支持所学引导方向以及 critic 的视觉与本体感觉输入的重要性。
Conclusion: 任务结果可以通过一个紧凑的推理时引导模块反向作用于动作生成，无需改动冻结的 VLA 参数，且在光照与干扰变化下仍带来成功率提升。

papers.title: Dataset Biases and Shortcut Learning in Motion-Based AI-Generated Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: The visual quality of AI-generated videos has improved drastically in recent years, making it increasingly difficult for humans to distinguish between real and synthetic media. In this work, we evaluate the robustness and applicability of four state-of-the-art motion-based AI-generated video detectors. We identify significant preprocessing and sampling biases in three of the four methods and demonstrate that they account for a substantial portion of their reported performance. Furthermore, we find that these detectors are highly sensitive to motion patterns specific to their evaluation datasets, where AI-generated videos generally exhibit less inter-frame movement than real videos. We show that for all detectors, performance collapses to near-random levels when evaluated on a dataset that does not contain this motion bias. Additionally, through dataset rebalancing and the application of simple spatial augmentations, we observe severe performance degradation across all evaluated models. In contrast, we find that an existing frequency-based detector maintains strong performance across all evaluated datasets, suggesting that frequency-based approaches may offer a more generalizable path forward for AI-generated video detection. We hope that our work raises awareness towards these vulnerabilities and encourages the development of more representative, unbiased datasets and more robust evaluation protocols.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对四个基于运动特征的 AI 生成视频检测器做鲁棒性评估，发现其中三个存在显著的预处理与采样偏差，且检测器高度依赖评测数据集特有的运动模式（AI 生成视频帧间运动普遍少于真实视频）。在不含该运动偏差的数据集上，四个检测器全部塌到接近随机水平；数据集重平衡与简单空间增强也会使所有模型性能严重下降，而既有基于频率的检测器在全部数据集上保持强性能。
Motivation: AI 生成视频画质提升后人眼难辨，现有运动类检测器报告的高性能可能来自数据集偏差而非真实判别能力，导致跨数据集泛化不可信。
Method: 评估四个 SOTA 的 motion-based AI-generated video 检测器，识别其预处理与采样偏差；构造不含运动偏差的数据集做跨集测试，并施加数据集重平衡与简单空间增强观察性能变化；对照一个已有的 frequency-based 检测器。
Result: 四个方法中三个存在显著预处理与采样偏差，且解释了其报告性能的相当部分；在不含运动偏差的数据集上所有检测器性能塌到接近随机水平；重平衡加空间增强后全部模型性能严重下降；frequency-based 检测器在所有评测数据集上保持强性能。
Conclusion: 运动类 AI 视频检测器的性能很大程度上是数据集运动偏差的捷径，frequency-based 路线更可能泛化；作者呼吁构建更有代表性、无偏的数据集与更稳健的评测协议。

papers.title: Prime Fourier Embeddings: A Principled Basis for Modular Arithmetic
papers.abstract_en: Numbers have algebraic structure that standard neural embeddings often fail to expose. We introduce Prime Fourier Embeddings (PFE), which encode integers as prime-indexed (cos, sin) pairs derived from the harmonic analysis of Q, providing a pre-structured representation in which modular arithmetic reduces to selecting the relevant prime channel rather than discovering algebraic structure from scratch. We prove that any linear map equivariant with respect to the product group action on PFE must be block-diagonal with one independent block per prime -- a consequence of Schur's lemma applied to the resulting character decomposition. For square-free composite moduli, the Chinese Remainder Theorem predicts which prime channels are task-relevant. Both predictions are confirmed empirically: ablation studies show specialization ratios exceeding 500x between task-relevant and task-irrelevant channels, with perfect in-distribution test accuracy across all square-free composite moduli tested.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 标准神经嵌入无法暴露数字的代数结构，模运算需从头学习而非直接利用已有结构。
Method: PFE 将整数编码为素数索引的 (cos, sin) 通道；用 Schur 引理与特征分解证明等变线性映射必为每素数一个独立块的块对角形式；对方自由复合模由中国剩余定理预测任务相关素数通道，并以消融实验检验通道分工。
Result: 消融研究中任务相关与不相关通道的 specialization ratio 超过 500 倍；在所有测试的方自由复合模 (square-free composite moduli) 上 in-distribution 测试准确率达到完美。
Conclusion: PFE 把模算术预结构化为按素数选通道的问题，理论预测（块对角等变映射、CRT 通道选择）与实证结果一致。

papers.title: Do Sparse Autoencoders Learn Meaningful Concept Hierarchies?
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become an important tool for unsupervised concept discovery in large models. To make the resulting feature spaces more interpretable and manageable, recent approaches have begun imposing hierarchical structure, either explicitly or as an implicit effect of training constraints, yet rigorous comparison remains difficult. There are no agreed-upon requirements for what a meaningful feature hierarchy should satisfy, and evaluation has largely relied on qualitative illustrations with fragmented quantitative protocols. To address this, we derive a set of key requirements for generalization/specialization hierarchies in unsupervised concept discovery, drawing on semantic net and taxonomy research alongside recent SAE work, and use them to derive a concrete evaluation protocol. Applying this protocol to current SAE approaches trained on visual data, we find that while feature spaces generally provide a basis for sensible hierarchies, establishing good hierarchical structure remains challenging. In particular, feature absorption, both in its well-known hard form and in a continuous, soft form, systematically compromises hierarchy quality, pointing to a fundamental tension that future approaches will need to navigate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文为无监督概念发现中的泛化/特化层级提出一套可操作的评估协议，依据语义网络与分类学研究推导层级应满足的要求。将其用于视觉数据上训练的现有 SAE 层级方法后发现：特征空间大体能支撑合理层级，但建立良好层级结构仍困难，且 feature absorption 的硬形式与连续软形式都会系统性损害层级质量。
Motivation: SAE 层级结构的评估缺乏公认要求，现有比较多依赖定性示例与碎片化的量化协议，导致不同方法难以严格对比。
Method: 借鉴语义网络、分类学研究与近期 SAE 工作，推导泛化/特化层级需满足的一组关键要求，并据此导出具体评估协议；将该协议应用于在视觉数据上训练的当前 SAE 层级方法。
Result: 应用该协议后发现：特征空间总体上为合理层级提供了基础，但建立良好层级结构仍具挑战；feature absorption 的硬形式与连续软形式都会系统性损害层级质量。
Conclusion: 层级质量存在由 feature absorption 引起的根本性张力，未来方法必须正面处理这一张力，而非仅靠训练约束隐式生成层级。

papers.title: Calibration Is Not Control: Intervention Value for LLM-Agent Oversight
papers.abstract_en: Runtime oversight often intervenes when an LLM agent's calibrated failure score crosses a threshold. Yet states with the same failure risk can differ in whether intervention helps. Strictly increasing recalibration preserves the threshold policy class and cannot recover this distinction. We formalize when a summary is sufficient for intervention decisions and the utility lost when it is not. We evaluate the consequences by replaying agent prefixes and executing alternative actions from the same state. On ALFWorld, holding features, estimator, and router fixed while changing the supervision target from failure to intervention utility lowers regret from 0.51 to 0.09; the gain replicates on a second suite of mid-episode prefixes. A deployable intervention-trained scalar also beats the failure-score threshold rule selected on test outcomes. Online, on 300 unseen tasks with a fixed stronger-model handoff, a frozen prefix-feature controller improves utility over failure-triggered routing, handing off less often (35% vs 48%) and succeeding more often (45% vs 37%). Gains depend on intervention value and are small on two reasoning benchmarks. Oversight signals should be evaluated by the decisions they support alongside their predictive quality. Code is available at https://github.com/bennidict23/calibration-is-not-control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 运行时监督若只按校准后的失败分数阈值触发干预，会丢掉“干预是否有用”这一信息；把监督目标从预测失败改为预测干预效用，可在 ALFWorld 上把 regret 从 0.51 降到 0.09。在线 300 个未见任务上，用干预效用训练的前缀特征控制器比失败触发路由交棒更少（35% vs 48%）、成功率更高（45% vs 37%）。
Motivation: 运行时干预通常在 LLM agent 的校准失败分数越过阈值时触发，但失败风险相同的两个状态可能干预价值不同；严格单调的重校准无法恢复这一区分，导致监督信号与实际决策脱节。
Method: 形式化“摘要何时对干预决策充分”及其效用损失；通过回放 agent 前缀并从同一状态执行替代动作来估计干预效用，固定特征、估计器与路由器，仅把监督目标从失败换成干预效用；训练可部署的干预训练标量并与测试集上选出的失败分数阈值规则比较，另在在线 300 任务、固定强模型交棒设置下评测前缀特征控制器。
Result: ALFWorld 上固定特征、估计器、路由器，监督目标由失败改为干预效用使 regret 从 0.51 降至 0.09，该增益在第二个 mid-episode 前缀套件上复现；干预训练标量优于在测试结果上选出的失败分数阈值规则；在线 300 个未见任务中控制器交棒率 35%（失败触发 48%）、成功率 45%（37%）；在两个推理基准上增益很小。
Conclusion: 监督信号应按其支撑的决策而非仅按预测质量来评估：校准不等于控制，把干预价值直接作为训练目标才能改善运行时路由。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Explaining Attention with Program Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: A longstanding goal of research on interpretable deep learning is to replace opaque neural computations with human-meaningful symbolic descriptions. In this paper, we propose an approach for approximating the behavior of components of deep networks with executable programs. We focus on attention heads in transformer language models. For a given head, we first compute its associated attention matrices on a collection of randomly selected training examples. Next, we prompt a pre-trained language model with a summary of these matrices, and instruct it to generate a set of Python programs that can reproduce the associated attention patterns given only text from the input sentence. Finally, we re-rank programs according to how well our final set of programs predict behavior on held-out inputs. We demonstrate that a set of fewer than 1,000 such generated programs can reproduce the attention patterns of heads in GPT-2, TinyLlama-1.1B, and Llama-3B, achieving an average Intersection-over-Union similarity above 75% on TinyStories. Moreover, the best-fit programs can replace neural attention heads without substantially affecting model behavior: replacing 25% of attention heads with programmatic surrogates across the three models incurs only a 16% average perplexity increase, while maintaining performance on a variety of downstream question answering benchmarks. This work contributes a scalable pipeline for reverse-engineering attention heads in transformer models using human-readable, executable code, advancing a path toward symbolic transparency in neural models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用程序合成近似 Transformer 注意力头行为：对随机训练样本算注意力矩阵，让预训练语言模型据此生成可执行 Python 程序，再按留出输入上的预测效果重排。少于 1,000 个程序即可复现 GPT-2、TinyLlama-1.1B、Llama-3B 的注意力模式，TinyStories 上平均 IoU 超过 75%；替换 25% 注意力头仅带来 16% 平均困惑度上升且下游 QA 性能保持。
Motivation: 可解释深度学习长期目标是用人类可读的符号描述替代不透明的神经计算，而注意力头的具体行为目前缺少可执行、可读的刻画。
Method: 对指定注意力头在随机选取的训练样本上计算注意力矩阵，把这些矩阵的摘要作为提示交给预训练语言模型，让它生成一组仅依赖输入句子文本即可复现注意力模式的 Python 程序；最后按程序在留出输入上的预测表现重排。
Result: 少于 1,000 个生成程序可复现 GPT-2、TinyLlama-1.1B、Llama-3B 三个模型注意力头的模式，在 TinyStories 上平均 IoU 相似度超过 75%；用程序替身替换三个模型中 25% 的注意力头，平均困惑度仅上升 16%，并在多种下游问答基准上保持性能。
Conclusion: 注意力头可以被少量人类可读、可执行的程序近似到不显著改变模型行为的程度，为神经模型的符号透明性提供一条可扩展的逆向工程路径。

papers.title: We Need Explanation Cards to Connect Explanation Algorithms to the Real World
papers.abstract_en: Algorithmic explanations are intended to help stakeholders understand opaque algorithmic decisions, but in practice, they often fall short. First, the meaning of algorithmic explanations is often not what one might intuitively expect, so expert knowledge is required to interpret them correctly. Second, recent work has shown that popular explanation algorithms are uninformative about the behavior of complex decision functions. Together, these issues create a gap between what explanations appear to convey and what they actually provide. In this work, we propose Explanation Cards for Explanation Algorithms, which augment standard explanations with complementary information about robustness and validity, as well as clear instructions for interpretation. The complementary information can render otherwise uninformative explanations practically useful, while also helping to detect cases where they are not. Importantly, the interpretation instructions in explanation cards shift responsibility from users to providers: Rather than expecting users to recognize what can and cannot be concluded from an explanation, providers must make this explicit upfront. Using counterfactual explanations and SHAP as examples, we demonstrate how providers can construct explanation cards and that these cards provide users with the guidance needed for sound interpretation. We further argue that explanation cards offer a practical means of operationalising the explainability provisions of the EU AI Act. Overall, explanation cards are a significant step toward making explanation algorithms fit for real-world use cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Explanation Cards：为解释算法附上鲁棒性与有效性的补充信息以及明确的解读说明，把「这个解释能推出什么、不能推出什么」的责任从用户移到提供方。以 counterfactual explanations 和 SHAP 为例演示如何构造卡片，并论证其可用于落实 EU AI Act 的可解释性条款。
Motivation: 算法解释的实际含义常与直觉预期不符，需要专家知识才能正确解读；同时近期工作表明流行解释算法对复杂决策函数的行为不提供信息，造成解释看起来传达的内容与实际提供的内容之间的落差。
Method: 在标准解释之上附加两类补充信息（鲁棒性 robustness 与有效性 validity）以及解读说明，构成 Explanation Cards；以 counterfactual explanations 和 SHAP 为示例展示提供方如何构造卡片。
Result: 补充信息可让原本不提供信息的解释变得实际有用，同时帮助识别解释不起作用的情形；解读说明把责任从用户转移给提供方，卡片为用户提供可靠解读所需的指引，并被论证为落实 EU AI Act 可解释性条款的操作手段。
Conclusion: 解释算法要适配真实使用场景，必须由提供方在交付时显式声明解释的鲁棒性、有效性边界与解读规则，而不是指望用户自行判断。

papers.title: SAE++: Cascaded Sparse Autoencoders Learn Multi-Level Visual Concepts in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on vision-language tasks, yet their internal visual representations remain difficult to interpret. Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) provide a scalable way to decompose dense model activations into sparse, interpretable features. However, existing SAE architectures primarily recover flat feature dictionaries and are less suited for explicit multi-level concept organization. In this paper, we introduce a cascaded sparse autoencoder architecture, dubbed SAE++, for learning hierarchical visual concepts in MLLMs. Rather than nesting or stacking SAE sparse activation codes, SAE++ trains a second-level SAE directly on the decoder weights of the first-level SAE, treating learned low-level feature directions as inputs for higher-level abstraction. This design enables SAE++ to learn "concepts of concepts" while avoiding drawbacks from the shared-prefix coupling of nesting, Matryoshka-style hierarchies and the bottlenecks of naively stacked SAEs. Experiments across Qwen3-VL, Gemma-3, and LLaVA on multiple visual datasets show that SAE++ improves interpretability in terms of hierarchical concept coherence over state-of-the-art SAE baselines. Results on concept steering further demonstrate that the learned concept groups support effective group-level interventions in MLLM outputs. Code is available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/sae-plus-plus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAE++ 把第二级 SAE 直接训练在第一级 SAE 的 decoder 权重上，用低层特征方向作为高层抽象输入，从而学到“概念的概念”式层级视觉概念，避开嵌套结构的共享前缀耦合与朴素堆叠的瓶颈。在 Qwen3-VL、Gemma-3、LLaVA 上，其层级概念一致性优于 SAE 基线，且概念组支持对 MLLM 输出的组级干预 (concept steering)。
Motivation: MLLM 的内部视觉表示难以解释，现有 SAE 只能恢复扁平的特征字典，无法显式组织多层概念结构。
Method: 提出级联稀疏自编码器 SAE++：不嵌套或堆叠稀疏激活码，而是把第一级 SAE 学到的低层特征方向作为输入，直接在其 decoder 权重上训练第二级 SAE，形成层级“概念组”；在 Qwen3-VL、Gemma-3、LLaVA 与多个视觉数据集上实验，并做 concept steering 干预。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL、Gemma-3、LLaVA 多个视觉数据集上，SAE++ 的层级概念一致性 (hierarchical concept coherence) 高于 SOTA SAE 基线；concept steering 结果显示学到的概念组能对 MLLM 输出实施有效的组级干预。
Conclusion: 在 decoder 权重而非激活码上堆叠 SAE，可以在 MLLM 中学到可干预的层级视觉概念，比嵌套或朴素堆叠结构更合适。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Open-World Video Segmentation over Long Horizons
papers.abstract_en: Long videos challenge open-world segmentation systems to continually discover objects and preserve their identities through disappearance and reappearance. Savvy, a zero-shot, semi-online, class-agnostic system for persistent object discovery and identity maintenance, and OGA, an evaluation suite that credits coherent part-level predictions when their granularity differs from the reference annotations. Savvy combines modular mask discovery, deferred admission based on accumulated evidence, and track consolidation to maintain an evolving object set. OGA allows multiple predictions to support one reference while preserving prediction IDs, pairing granularity-aware fidelity with diagnostics of identity bleeding and fragmented support. Across 142 ScanNet videos and 106 HM3D trajectories, evaluated using adaptively sampled prefixes capped at 1,500 source frames, Savvy outperforms DEVA+SAM and EntitySAM in VPQ_inf, STQ, and AQ under both conventional and OGA evaluation. Conventional VPQ_inf reaches 18.44 versus DEVA+SAM's 11.52 on ScanNet and 17.31 versus 6.58 on HM3D. VIPSeg comparisons reveal conventional one-to-one VPQ's sensitivity to annotation granularity. Controlled identity-severing and flicker tests show that OGA detects temporal failures even when frame-level masks remain unchanged. Together, these results demonstrate complementary advances: Savvy improves long-horizon segmentation and association, and OGA distinguishes coherent part-level support from temporal identity failures. Project website: https://github.com/QingSuML/savvy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样本、半在线、类别无关的长视频开放世界分割系统 Savvy，用模块化 mask 发现、基于累积证据的延迟准入 (deferred admission) 和轨迹合并维护持续演化的物体集合，并配套评测套件 OGA。在 142 段 ScanNet 视频与 106 条 HM3D 轨迹（前缀上限 1,500 帧）上，常规 VPQ_inf 达 18.44（DEVA+SAM 11.52）与 17.31（6.58），且 OGA 能在逐帧 mask 不变时检出时序身份断裂。
Motivation: 长视频中物体会消失再出现，开放世界分割系统既要持续发现新物体又要跨长时间保持身份；常规一对一评测对标注粒度敏感，无法区分连贯的部件级预测与时序身份失败。
Method: Savvy 组合模块化 mask 发现、基于累积证据的延迟准入与轨迹合并，维持演化中的物体集合，零样本且类别无关、半在线运行。OGA 评测套件允许多个预测支撑同一参考标注并保留 prediction ID，同时给出 identity bleeding 与 fragmented support 诊断。
Result: 在 142 段 ScanNet 视频与 106 条 HM3D 轨迹、自适应采样且上限 1,500 源帧的前缀上，Savvy 在常规与 OGA 两种评测下的 VPQ_inf、STQ、AQ 均优于 DEVA+SAM 与 EntitySAM。常规 VPQ_inf：ScanNet 18.44 对 DEVA+SAM 的 11.52，HM3D 17.31 对 6.58。VIPSeg 对比显示常规一对一 VPQ 对标注粒度敏感；受控的身份切断与闪烁测试表明 OGA 能在逐帧 mask 未变时检出时序失败。
Conclusion: 长时分割的关联质量与评测粒度是互补的两项进展：Savvy 改善长时分割与关联，OGA 把连贯的部件级支撑与时序身份失败区分开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RefGC-SR$^2$: Reference-guided Super-Resolution and Refinement of AI Generated Content
papers.abstract_en: Reference-guided generation (e.g., object compositing, customization) has progressed rapidly, yet current pipelines share a fundamental limitation: the object-centric high-resolution reference image (HRRI) provided by users is downsampled to a fixed low-resolution (LR) before being fed into the model, so the fine-grained details are discarded before the output is even produced. In addition, the generation step then introduces its own artifacts (e.g., identity distortion) on top of this loss. Existing reference-guided generated content refinement (RefGCR) methods can correct some of these artifacts but still operate in the LR domain; reference-guided super-resolution (RefSR) methods recover resolution but assume natural-image degradations and ignore the artifact distribution of generative pipelines. To address both gaps in a single formulation, we introduce a new task: reference-guided generated content super-resolution-refinement (RefGC-SR$^2$), where the original HRRI is reused at the post-processing stage to recover lost details, refine generative artifacts, and upscale the output simultaneously. We construct the first real-world triplet data generation pipeline for this RefGC-SR$^2$ task, training a diptych-conditioned generator to synthesize paired low-quality anchors that public pretrained models cannot provide. We further present a frequency-aware diffusion transformer model for RefGC-SR$^2$ that selectively injects fine details from the HRRI while removing generative artifacts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our RefGC-SR$^2$ model successfully (i) refines the object identity faithfully with respect to the reference, and (ii) recovers high-resolution details, so that the final result is significantly higher quality and practically more usable compared to existing RefGCR and RefSR baselines.
papers.comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work. The last two authors are co-corresponding authors. Please visit our project page at https://cmlab-korea.github.io/RefGC-SR2/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出新任务 RefGC-SR²：把用户提供的高分辨率参考图 (HRRI) 在后处理阶段重新利用，一次性完成超分与生成伪影修复，而非像现有流程那样先把参考图降采样到固定低分辨率、丢掉细节。构建首个面向该任务的真实三元组数据生成管线，训练 diptych 条件生成器合成公开预训练模型给不出的成对低质量锚点，并给出频率感知 diffusion transformer，选择性注入 HRRI 细节同时去除生成伪影。
Motivation: 参考引导生成管线在输入端就把 HRRI 降采样到固定 LR，细节在生成前已丢失，生成步骤又叠加身份扭曲等伪影；现有 RefGCR 只在 LR 域修复，RefSR 只针对自然图像退化，两者都无法同时解决。
Method: 定义 RefGC-SR² 任务，后处理阶段复用原始 HRRI 同时恢复细节、修复伪影并放大输出；构建首个真实三元组数据生成管线，用 diptych 条件生成器合成配对低质量锚点；模型为频率感知 diffusion transformer，选择性注入 HRRI 细节并去除生成伪影。
Result: 实验表明该模型能忠实依据参考图修复物体身份并恢复高分辨率细节，最终结果相比现有 RefGCR 与 RefSR 基线质量显著更高、更实用。
Conclusion: 把 HRRI 保留到后处理阶段并以单一 formulation 同时做超分与修复，可同时解决参考降采样丢细节与生成伪影两个缺口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OSGuard: A Benchmark for Safety in Computer-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents can complete benign user instructions while violating important constraints of the user's environment. We introduce OSGuard, a dual-granularity benchmark suite for evaluating safety through local, pre-execution guardrail decisions and end-to-end task execution. Its action-level benchmark contains 324 human-annotated examples in which guardrails classify candidate actions as allowed, unrelated, or unsafe given the original instruction and current interface state. Its risk-augmented execution suite contains 45 tasks derived from 40 OSWorld tasks, keeping original instructions unchanged while modifying the environment to introduce state-dependent safety constraints and preserve a safe path to completion. Augmented evaluators retain the original task-success criteria and add explicit state-based safety checks, distinguishing safe completion from nominal success that violates these constraints. On the action-level benchmark, the strongest evaluated guardrail reaches 79.9\% accuracy and 0.80 macro-F1, but performance drops substantially on actions from risk-augmented executions. In full-task evaluation, an unguarded agent completes 62.2\% of tasks safely while 37.8\% result in unsafe completion; adding the strongest guardrail reduces unsafe completion to 33.3\% while leaving safe success unchanged. These results show that state-dependent safety constraints remain challenging both to recognize locally and to preserve during end-to-end computer use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OSGuard 是评估计算机使用智能体 (computer-use agent) 安全性的双粒度基准：动作级护栏决策加端到端任务执行，把「名义成功但违反环境约束」与真正安全的完成区分开。最强护栏在动作级达到 79.9% 准确率、0.80 macro-F1，但把未护栏智能体的不安全完成从 37.8% 降到 33.3% 时安全成功率不变，说明状态依赖的安全约束在局部识别和全程保持两处都仍然困难。
Motivation: 计算机使用智能体能完成良性指令却违反环境中的重要约束，而现有评测只看任务是否名义成功，无法区分安全完成与破坏状态约束的完成。
Method: 双粒度基准套件：动作级基准含 324 条人工标注样本，护栏需结合原始指令与当前界面状态把候选动作判为 allowed、unrelated 或 unsafe；风险增强执行套件含 45 个任务，由 40 个 OSWorld 任务改造而来，保持原指令不变、只修改环境以引入状态依赖约束并保留安全完成路径，评测器在原任务成功标准上追加显式状态安全检查。
Result: 动作级上最强护栏准确率 79.9%、macro-F1 0.80，但在风险增强执行产生的动作上表现明显下降。全任务评测中，未护栏智能体 62.2% 安全完成、37.8% 不安全完成；加入最强护栏后不安全完成降至 33.3%，安全成功率保持不变。
Conclusion: 状态依赖的安全约束既难以在局部动作层面识别，也难以在端到端计算机使用全程保持，仅靠护栏只能部分压低不安全完成率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Sensitivity Shaping for Latent Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Generative dynamics models enable planning in challenging systems, but safe deployment requires detecting policy-induced out-of-distribution (OOD) transitions. Existing methods typically treat learned dynamics as fixed and rely on post hoc support surrogates for OOD detection. This overlooks a critical failure mode: learned dynamics that are insensitive to control changes can map unsupported controls to latent predictions resembling demonstrated transitions, suppressing OOD signals despite large prediction errors. We introduce support-conditioned control-sensitivity regularization to preserve control-induced variation by promoting local responsiveness in well-supported training regions. Experiments in vision-based obstacle avoidance, manipulation, and real-robot navigation demonstrate improved OOD detection and safer closed-loop planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 support-conditioned control-sensitivity 正则，约束学到的 latent dynamics 在数据支撑充分的训练区域内对控制变化保持局部响应，避免把无支撑控制映射成看似正常的隐空间预测而压掉 OOD 信号。在视觉避障、操作与真实机器人导航实验中，该正则改善了策略诱导 OOD 检测并带来更安全的闭环规划。
Motivation: 生成式动力学模型做规划时需要检测策略诱导的 OOD 转移，但现有方法把学到的动力学当作固定不变、只靠事后 support 代理；若动力学对控制变化不敏感，大预测误差反而被伪装成正常转移，OOD 信号被抑制。
Method: 引入 support-conditioned control-sensitivity regularization：在训练数据支撑良好的局部区域促进模型对控制输入的响应性，从而保留控制引起的隐空间变化，作为训练期约束而非事后检测器。
Result: 在基于视觉的避障、操作任务以及真实机器人导航三类实验中，该正则提升了 OOD 检测表现并改善闭环规划安全性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 作者主张 OOD 检测失效的一个根因是学到的动力学对控制不敏感，因此应在训练中显式塑造控制敏感度，而不是只在事后加 support 代理。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 引入 support-conditioned control-sensitivity regularization：在训练数据支撑良好的局部区域促进模型对控制输入的响应性，从而保留控制引起的隐空间变化，作为训练期约束而非事后检测器。
summary_sections.result: 在基于视觉的避障、操作任务以及真实机器人导航三类实验中，该正则提升了 OOD 检测表现并改善闭环规划安全性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者主张 OOD 检测失效的一个根因是学到的动力学对控制不敏感，因此应在训练中显式塑造控制敏感度，而不是只在事后加 support 代理。

papers.title: SalArt-VQA: Diagnosing Whether VLMs Understand Salient Artifacts in Generated Images
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to detect whether AI-generated images contain visible artifacts, yet their ability to analyze such artifacts remains poorly understood. A correct image-level decision can still hide important failures: a model may correctly flag an artifact while relying on the wrong visual cue, selecting the wrong region, or describing a defect that the image does not support. To evaluate these behaviors directly, we introduce SalArt-VQA, a diagnostic benchmark for fine-grained SALient ARTifact understanding in AI-generated images. SalArt-VQA contains 950 images and 3,681 human-authored multiple-choice questions spanning artifact images, matched real reference images, and paired generated reference images. Four aligned question types evaluate presence detection, semantic localization, spatial grounding, and evidence-grounded defect identification, while the reference splits test calibration and abstention when the annotated defect is absent. Across 20 VLMs, SalArt-VQA reveals failures that image-level detection accuracy hides: the strongest model reaches 99.37% detection recall on artifact images but answers all four artifact-side questions correctly on only 53.26% of images. Comparing artifact images with artifact-free references reveals a sensitivity-calibration tradeoff: sensitive models often make unsupported artifact claims, while conservative models avoid false alarms largely by missing real artifacts. These results show that high artifact detection accuracy alone does not imply grounded artifact understanding. SalArt-VQA exposes these hidden failure modes and provides a fine-grained evaluation of whether VLM artifact claims are supported by local visual evidence.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, E&D Track (Oral). 23 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/salartvqa/SalArt-VQA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SalArt-VQA 是诊断视觉语言模型 (VLM) 是否真正理解 AI 生成图像显著伪影的基准，含 950 张图与 3,681 道人工编写的选择题，用四类对齐问题分别测存在检测、语义定位、空间定位与基于证据的缺陷描述，并用无伪影参考划分检验校准与弃答。在 20 个 VLM 上，最强模型在伪影图上检测召回率达 99.37%，却只有 53.26% 的图像四类问题全对，说明高检测准确率不等于有证据支撑的伪影理解。
Motivation: VLM 常被用来判断 AI 生成图像是否有可见伪影，但图像级的正确判定可能掩盖错误线索、错误区域或无中生有的缺陷描述，这类细粒度失败没有直接评测手段。
Method: 构建 SalArt-VQA 基准：950 张图像、3,681 道人工编写多选题，覆盖伪影图、匹配的真实参考图与配对的生成参考图；四类对齐问题分别考察存在检测、语义定位、空间定位与基于证据的缺陷识别，参考划分用于测试标注缺陷缺失时的校准与弃答；在 20 个 VLM 上评测。
Result: 在 20 个 VLM 上，最强模型在伪影图上的检测召回率为 99.37%，但四类伪影侧问题全部答对的图像仅占 53.26%；伪影图与无伪影参考的对比显示敏感性-校准权衡：敏感模型常做无证据支撑的伪影断言，保守模型则主要靠漏掉真实伪影来避免误报。
Conclusion: 仅凭图像级伪影检测准确率无法推断 VLM 具备有局部视觉证据支撑的伪影理解，需要细粒度评测来暴露这些隐藏失败模式。

papers.title: DB-3DME: From Dataset to Benchmark for Human-aligned Automatic 3D Mesh Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D generation have led to substantial improvements in realism, controllability, and efficiency, yet the evaluation of 3D assets remains underexplored. Existing evaluation paradigms, including human evaluation, learned metrics, and vision-language models (VLMs) as judges, suffer from limitations in cost, scalability, resolution handling, or task-specific alignment. In this work, we focus on 3D mesh evaluation and introduce DB-3DME, the Dataset and Benchmark for 3D Mesh Evaluation. DB-3DME contains 2,619 synthetic 3D meshes paired with human ratings on Geometry and Prompt Adherence. Using this dataset, we systematically benchmark state-of-the-art VLMs and identify visual encoding of 3D representations as a key factor for human-aligned evaluation performance. Motivated by this finding, we fine-tune an open-weight VLM, Qwen-2.5-VL-7B, for 3D mesh evaluation by adapting the visual encoder while freezing the language model. The fine-tuned model substantially outperforms existing pre-trained VLMs across multiple evaluation dimensions, establishing a new benchmark for automatic 3D mesh evaluation. We publicly release the benchmark dataset on GitHub and Hugging Face to facilitate future research.
papers.comment: CVPR 2026 workshop paper. 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Dataset available at GitHub and Hugging Face
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 DB-3DME：2,619 个合成 3D mesh 配人工评分（Geometry 与 Prompt Adherence 两维），系统评测主流 VLM 作为评判者，发现 3D 表示的视觉编码方式是人对齐评价的关键因素；据此冻结语言模型、只微调视觉编码器改造 Qwen-2.5-VL-7B，在多个评价维度上大幅超过现有预训练 VLM。
Motivation: 3D 生成在真实感与可控性上进步明显，但 3D 资产评价研究不足：人工评价贵、可扩展性差，学习型指标与 VLM 评判在分辨率处理和任务对齐上各有局限，缺少人对齐的自动 mesh 评价基准。
Method: 构建 DB-3DME 数据集（2,619 个合成 3D mesh，配 Geometry 与 Prompt Adherence 人工评分），用它系统 benchmark 现有 SOTA VLM；基于视觉编码是关键因素这一发现，微调开源权重 VLM Qwen-2.5-VL-7B，冻结语言模型、只适配视觉编码器。
Result: 数据集含 2,619 个合成 mesh 及两维人工评分；benchmark 定位视觉编码 3D 表示为人对齐评价的关键因素；微调后的 Qwen-2.5-VL-7B 在多个评价维度上大幅超过现有预训练 VLM。
Conclusion: 3D mesh 评价的瓶颈在视觉编码而非语言推理，只适配视觉编码器即可让开源 VLM 达到人对齐的自动评价水平；基准数据集已在 GitHub 与 Hugging Face 公开。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: DexPIE: Stable Dexterous Policy Improvement from Real-World Experience
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation presents substantial challenges for imitation learning due to its high-dimensional action space and complex contact-rich dynamics. Policies trained purely from demonstrations often suffer from compounding errors during deployment and require large amounts of expert data to achieve reliable performance. To move beyond the limitations of demonstration data, in this work, we propose DexPIE, a post-training framework for dexterous policy improvement from experience collected through real-world deployment. First, DexPIE enables effective exploration coverage through a dexterous-hand-adapted intervention system and multi-stage DAgger-style data collection across initial and intermediate task stages. Meanwhile, we enhance consistency between training and inference to reduce the distribution shift between rollouts and demonstration data, better aligning rollout behavior with demonstrations, allowing the critic to learn a value function induced by a more consistent underlying policy. Together, these components provide reliable supervision for policy evaluation. Finally, DexPIE improves the policy through conditioning on a continuous optimality indicator, allowing the policy to leverage the quality of data in a more fine-grained manner. Across three challenging real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, DexPIE achieves a 37.3% improvement in success rate over the demonstration-based reference policy, outperforming all baseline methods and demonstrating stronger robustness. The source code and dataset will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DexPIE 是面向灵巧手操作的后训练框架，用适配灵巧手的干预系统与多阶段 DAgger 式数据采集从真实部署经验中改进策略，并以连续最优性指示 (optimality indicator) 作为条件让策略细粒度利用数据质量。在三个真实世界灵巧操作任务上，成功率相对基于演示的参考策略提升 37.3%，超过全部基线方法。
Motivation: 纯靠演示训练的灵巧操作策略在部署时会累积误差 (compounding errors)，且需要大量专家数据才能可靠，高维动作空间与接触动力学使演示数据的覆盖与质量都受限。
Method: DexPIE 分三部分：一是灵巧手适配的干预系统加跨初始与中间任务阶段的多阶段 DAgger 式数据采集，保证探索覆盖；二是增强训练与推理的一致性，缩小 rollout 与演示数据间的分布偏移，使 critic 学到由更一致的底层策略诱导的价值函数；三是以连续最优性指示为条件改进策略。
Result: 在三个具有挑战性的真实世界灵巧操作任务上，DexPIE 相对基于演示的参考策略成功率提升 37.3%，并优于全部基线方法，表现出更强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 从真实部署经验加一致性约束与最优性条件化的后训练，可以在不依赖更多专家演示的情况下稳定提升灵巧操作策略的成功率；源码与数据集将公开。
Relevance: 2
