papers.title: Characterize Then Distill: Mechanistic Reasoning in Large Output Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning-trained language models can perform, zero-shot, multi-label tasks that require selecting a small set of relevant labels from a universe of thousands to hundreds of thousands of candidates. We ask how they do it mechanistically, and whether the mechanism can be distilled. We make the question measurable by treating each decision as a token-level event scored by the model's own decision margin: the token that picks a coarse region of the label space, the tokens that pick a label within it, and the token where the output departs from a close alternative (a near-miss) named earlier in the reasoning. Attribution, exact mean-ablation, knock-in into another example's context, and a null calibration that discounts generic heads then give individual attention heads causal standing. On clinical coding of hospital discharge summaries (MIMIC-IV), with all 5,651 candidate diagnosis codes in context, a small, global, phase-structured set of heads is necessary and sufficient, by ablation and knock-in, on essentially every summary; distinct head families attend to the candidate region and back to the near-miss named earlier; and, for the mentions decided in the reasoning, the region can already be elicited several tokens before the code, from a disjoint mid-layer set that reads the input. We introduce MISTILL: unlike chain-of-thought distillation, which transfers only the teacher's reasoning text, it also supervises the student's pooled attention at exactly these decision events. Read on heads found after training, it nearly doubles the causal recovery of the contrastive decision in a cross-family student and adds a small, seed-stable gain in one that already carries most of it, with no detected task difference when both objectives train bf16 weights and a task cost with fp32 master weights.
papers.comment: substantially revised and extended; supersedes v1. New analysis (token-level decision events, head-level causal tests on MIMIC-IV clinical coding), new distillation method (MISTILL), experiments and text; the author list reflects authorship of this version. 58 pages, 6 figures. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mistill-code-anon-3D07
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把推理模型在数千至数十万候选标签中的多标签选择拆成 token 级决策事件（选区域、选标签、偏离 near-miss），用归因、精确 mean-ablation、knock-in 与 null 校准定位出因果注意力头，再提出 MISTILL 在这些决策事件上同时蒸馏学生的 pooled attention。MIMIC-IV 临床编码（5,651 个候选诊断码）上，跨家族学生的对比决策因果恢复量接近翻倍。
Motivation: 推理模型能在数千到数十万候选的大输出空间里零样本做多标签选择，但其机制是否可解释、能否迁移到学生模型尚不清楚；CoT 蒸馏只传教师的推理文本，不触及决策时刻的内部注意力。
Method: 把每次决策建模为按模型自身 decision margin 打分的 token 级事件（粗区域 token、区域内标签 token、与先前 near-miss 分歧的 token），用 attribution、exact mean-ablation、knock-in 到他人上下文以及折扣通用头的 null 校准赋予单个注意力头因果地位；提出 MISTILL，在这些决策事件上额外监督学生的 pooled attention。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 出院小结临床编码、上下文内含全部 5,651 个候选诊断码的设定下，一个小而全局、相位结构化的头集合经 ablation 与 knock-in 证明在几乎每份小结上既必要又充分；不同头族分别注意候选区域与先前 near-miss，区域信号可在代码前数个 token 由读输入的中层头族提前引出。MISTILL 在训练后找到的头上读取，使跨家族学生的对比决策因果恢复量接近翻倍，对已携带大部分该能力的学生带来小幅、seed 稳定的增益；两种目标在 bf16 权重加 fp32 master weights 的任务成本下训练时未检出任务差异。
Conclusion: 大输出空间中的多标签决策由一组小而全局、相位结构化的注意力头因果承载，且这种机制可以在决策事件层面被蒸馏，而不只靠推理文本。

papers.title: Mean-based algorithms: A lower bound and regret
papers.abstract_en: Mean-based algorithms are online learning algorithms that assign low probability to actions with low average rewards. Recent research shows that they converge to serially undominated actions, which serve as approximations to Nash equilibria in economic games. However, empirical studies indicate that mean-based algorithms converge more slowly in bandit-feedback settings than established no-regret alternatives. This work investigates mean-based algorithms under unknown horizons and bandit feedback. In this setting, we provide the first lower bound on the algorithm-defining sequence $γ_t$, establishing a fundamental limit on the learning speed of such algorithms. In multi-armed bandit problems, this result constrains the rate at which any algorithm can reliably identify low-reward actions while acting according to this knowledge. We also propose two mean-based algorithms: one generalizes $ε$-greedy, and the other extends mean-based Exp3 to unknown horizons. Our experiments show that mean-based algorithms, although slightly slower, can perform competitively with other bandit-feedback algorithms. We further study the relationship to regret. Depending on the choice of $γ_t$, the intersection with no-regret algorithms is non-trivial, and we show that some algorithms are both mean-based and no-regret.

papers.title: FindIt: A Format-Informed Visual Detection Benchmark for Generalist Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are predominantly evaluated on free-form vision-language tasks such as visual question answering, captioning, and summarization. However, their practical use is rapidly expanding to more structured computer vision settings, where users prompt models to perform localization-centric tasks such as object detection, often within larger agentic or decision-making systems. Despite this shift, there is currently no standardized benchmark that systematically evaluates these capabilities at scale. In this work, we introduce the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to assess the promptable localization abilities of generalist MLLMs. Our benchmark spans four core task categories: object detection, referring expression detection, instance-level detection, and video-based detection. To enable consistent and fair evaluation, we develop a unified framework that standardizes inputs, enforces parsable bounding box outputs, and defines transparent evaluation protocols across tasks. Using this suite, we evaluate a diverse set of open-source and proprietary MLLMs, providing an in-depth analysis of their performance and limitations. Beyond accuracy, we examine models' ability to adhere to output format specifications, showing that current systems are highly sensitive to formatting constraints and often fail to generalize even to minor variations. Our results highlight both the strengths and shortcomings of state-of-the-art MLLMs in localization settings, and point toward important directions for improving multimodal model design and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FindIt 是首个系统评测通用多模态大模型 (generalist MLLM) 可提示定位能力的基准，覆盖目标检测、指代表达检测、实例级检测与视频检测四类任务，并用统一框架标准化输入、强制可解析的边界框输出与透明评测协议。评测显示当前模型对输出格式约束高度敏感，即使微小的格式变化也常导致泛化失败。
Motivation: MLLM 的评测长期集中在 VQA、描述、摘要等自由形式任务，而实际使用正转向目标检测等结构化定位任务，尤其嵌在 agentic 系统中，但缺少大规模标准化的定位能力基准。
Method: 构建覆盖四类任务（object detection、referring expression detection、instance-level detection、video-based detection）的统一评测框架：标准化输入、强制可解析的边界框输出、跨任务透明评测协议；在此套件上评测一批开源与闭源 MLLM。
Result: 在统一套件上评测了多样化的开源与专有 MLLM，除准确率外还考察输出格式遵循能力，发现当前系统对格式约束高度敏感、即使微小变体也常无法泛化；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 定位类任务上 SOTA MLLM 的短板不仅在准确率，更在格式遵循的脆弱性，评测与模型设计都应把输出格式规范性作为独立维度。

papers.title: FFR: Forward-Forward Learning for Regression
papers.abstract_en: The Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm offers a computationally efficient and biologically plausible alternative to backpropagation (BP) by training neural networks through purely local, layer-wise optimization. However, FF is inherently designed for classification via contrastive positive-negative sample pairs, and extending it to regression poses fundamental challenges: continuous target space lacks natural "opposites" for contrastive learning, and the standard goodness function carries no information about target magnitude or ordering. We propose FFR (Forward-Forward for Regression), to our knowledge, the first framework to extend FF to real-world regression and demonstrate competitive performance across diverse realworld datasets. FFR introduces three key innovations: (1) an ordinal competitive goodness function that replaces contrastive pairs with competitive learning between partitioned neuron groups under distance-aware ordinal supervision; (2) a stratified ladder architecture where shallow layers learn coarse ordinal discrimination and deeper layers refine into fine-grained regression, with multi-scale feature aggregation for inter-layer collaboration; and (3) hierarchical prediction with uncertainty estimation, where multi-scale predictors jointly provide robust predictions and a single-pass uncertainty score. Extensive experimental results show FFR recovers on average 98.5% of BP's accuracy across six real-world regression benchmarks while reducing peak training memory to only 27% of BP's at depth 8 and 8% at depth 32, with per-iteration time around 72% of BP's, and substantially outperforms all BP-free competitors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FFR 把 Forward-Forward 这种逐层局部优化算法从分类扩展到真实回归任务：用带距离感知的序数竞争 goodness 函数替代正负样本对比，配合分层梯形架构与多尺度预测器做层级预测和单次前向的不确定性估计。在六个真实回归基准上平均恢复 BP 精度的 98.5%，深度 8 时峰值训练显存仅为 BP 的 27%、深度 32 时 8%，单次迭代耗时约为 BP 的 72%，并明显优于所有 BP-free 竞争方法。
Motivation: FF 算法逐层局部优化、计算高效且更符合生物学合理性，但其对比式正负样本机制只适用于分类：连续目标空间没有天然的“对立样本”，标准 goodness 函数也不携带目标幅值或顺序信息，因此难以直接用于回归。
Method: FFR 含三项设计：序数竞争 goodness 函数，把对比样本对换成在分区神经元组之间、受距离感知序数监督的竞争学习；分层梯形 (stratified ladder) 架构，浅层学粗粒度序数判别、深层细化为精细回归，并用多尺度特征聚合实现层间协作；层级预测加不确定性估计，由多尺度预测器联合给出稳健预测与单次前向的不确定性分数。
Result: 在六个真实世界回归基准上，FFR 平均恢复 BP 精度的 98.5%；峰值训练显存在深度 8 时降至 BP 的 27%、深度 32 时降至 8%；每次迭代耗时约为 BP 的 72%；在对比中大幅超过所有 BP-free 竞争方法。
Conclusion: 逐层局部优化的 FF 框架经序数竞争与层级细化改造后可以覆盖真实回归任务，在保持接近 BP 精度的同时把训练显存压到 BP 的 27%（深度 8）乃至 8%（深度 32）。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Flow-Transformed Implicit Processes for Function-Space Variational Inference
papers.abstract_en: Implicit-process priors define distributions over functions through flexible generative mechanisms, making them attractive for Bayesian function-space modelling. However, performing posterior inference with such priors is challenging because their induced function-space distributions are typically not available in closed form. One practical strategy is to approximate the prior using a finite collection of sampled functions, and then represent posterior functions as learned combinations of these samples. Existing approaches commonly place a Gaussian variational distribution over the combination weights. While tractable, this choice limits the shapes of posterior uncertainty that can be represented, especially when the true posterior is asymmetric, heavy-tailed, or multimodal. We propose Flow-Transformed Implicit Processes (FTIP), a variational inference method that makes this finite-dimensional function-space approximation more expressive. Instead of using a Gaussian distribution over the combination weights, FTIP uses a normalizing flow to define a richer variational distribution. This induces a flexible posterior distribution over functions while preserving tractable optimization. We train the model using a Black-Box α objective, allowing us to compare mass-covering and mode-seeking variational behaviour. Experiments show that FTIP captures asymmetric and multimodal posterior structure in function space that Gaussian coefficient approximations tend to smooth or collapse.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FTIP 用 normalizing flow 替换组合权重上的高斯变分分布，使有限样本函数空间近似能表达非对称、重尾、多峰的后验，同时保持可 tractable 优化；用 Black-Box α 目标训练以对比 mass-covering 与 mode-seeking 行为，实验显示它能捕捉高斯系数近似会平滑或坍缩的函数空间后验结构。
Motivation: 隐式过程先验诱导的函数空间分布无闭式，现有方法在组合权重上放高斯变分分布，只能表达受限的后验形状，真实后验非对称、重尾或多峰时会被平滑或坍缩。
Method: 先用有限个采样函数近似先验，把后验函数表示为这些样本的组合；FTIP 用 normalizing flow 定义组合权重上的变分分布而非高斯，训练采用 Black-Box α 目标，可对比 mass-covering 与 mode-seeking 两种变分行为。
Result: 实验显示 FTIP 捕捉到函数空间中非对称与多峰的后验结构，而高斯系数近似倾向于平滑或坍缩这些结构；论文为 27 页、5 图、11 表。
Conclusion: 在有限维函数空间近似上把高斯权重分布换成 normalizing flow，可以在保持可优化的同时显著提升后验表达力，是对称高斯变分近似不足以刻画复杂后验时的替代方案。

papers.title: Task diversity produces systematic transfer but inhibits continual reinforcement learning
papers.abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning (RL) aims to produce agents that never stop adapting to new tasks. A key question is how this interacts with the diversity of tasks an agent experiences. Prior work has shown that training on many diverse tasks leads to agents with strong zero-shot and in-context adaptation. However, this work evaluated agents after they'd stopped learning, i.e. with frozen weights. How task diversity affects an agent's ability to continue learning over a sequence of distribution shifts remains unclear. We introduce Banyan, a GPU-accelerated continual RL domain where one can parametrically control three independent axes that define a task: the map layouts an agent must navigate, the objects it must interact with, and the hierarchical structures of sub-goal dependencies. We find that increasing diversity along each axis induces systematic transfer -- that is, agents begin training on a new task distribution near the performance attained on the previous one, even when the shift changes the structure of the optimal policy. While increasing diversity improves systematic transfer, we find that too much diversity inhibits a learner's ability to continue adapting to new task distributions. As diversity increases, learners plateau in the success rate they achieve on new tasks, yet continue improving on old tasks -- even without further exposure to them. We find this phenomenon manifests across continual learning algorithms, memory architectures, architecture sizes, and in Kinetix -- a physics-based control domain. We release Banyan as a domain for running controlled experiments that study continual RL in the many-tasks regime. Code is available at https://github.com/nhshah15/banyan.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 17 figures. v2 adds Kinetix, transformer, and continual-learning-method experiments. Code: https://github.com/nhshah15/banyan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GPU 加速的持续强化学习域 Banyan，可沿地图布局、物体交互、子目标层级结构三条独立轴参数化控制任务多样性。沿任一轴提高多样性都会带来系统性迁移——新任务分布上的起训性能接近上一分布的水平，即使最优策略结构改变；但多样性过高会抑制持续适应：学习者在新任务上的成功率触顶，却仍在无再接触的情况下继续提升旧任务表现。
Motivation: 既有工作只证明了多样性带来强零样本与上下文内适应，但都是在权重冻结后评估；任务多样性如何影响智能体在连续分布偏移中继续学习的能力尚不清楚。
Method: 构建 Banyan：GPU 加速的持续 RL 域，把任务的三条独立轴（地图布局、需交互的物体、子目标依赖的层级结构）参数化可控；在多种持续学习算法、记忆架构、模型规模上做对照实验，并扩展到基于物理的控制域 Kinetix（v2 增补 transformer 与持续学习方法实验）。
Result: 沿每条轴提高多样性都诱导系统性迁移：新任务起训性能接近上一分布达到的水平，即使偏移改变了最优策略结构；但多样性过大时学习者在新任务的成功率触顶（plateau），同时在不再接触的旧任务上继续提升。该现象跨持续学习算法、记忆架构、架构规模复现，并在 Kinetix 中出现。
Conclusion: 任务多样性对持续 RL 是双刃的：它产生系统性迁移，却在多样性过高时抑制继续适应的能力；Banyan 被发布为多任务体制下做受控实验的域。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 沿每条轴提高多样性都诱导系统性迁移：新任务起训性能接近上一分布达到的水平，即使偏移改变了最优策略结构；但多样性过大时学习者在新任务的成功率触顶（plateau），同时在不再接触的旧任务上继续提升。该现象跨持续学习算法、记忆架构、架构规模复现，并在 Kinetix 中出现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 任务多样性对持续 RL 是双刃的：它产生系统性迁移，却在多样性过高时抑制继续适应的能力；Banyan 被发布为多任务体制下做受控实验的域。

papers.title: The Terminal Representation in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Representation learning is a powerful tool for spatio-temporal abstraction within reinforcement learning (RL). Two well established approaches are through the successor representation (SR) and the default representation (DR). The SR encodes states by the future trajectories they induce, capturing information flow decoupled from reward. The DR builds on this by weighting trajectories with reward, integrating credit-assignment structure into the representation. Eigenvectors of both representations have been used to support a range of downstream tasks -- including option discovery, reward shaping, transfer learning, and exploration. We introduce a structurally distinct formulation: the terminal representation (TR). The TR encodes reward-weighted trajectories similarly to the DR, but can be learned as a lower-dimensionality object, and can be used directly for the mentioned applications without eigenvector computations. Eigendecomposition also imposes the assumption of symmetric transition dynamics, which the TR can bypass. In this work we develop the theoretical foundations of the TR: its derivation, convergence of two learning algorithms, its use for zero-shot compositionality, and equivalences between alternative reward formulations. We further show the TR is embedded in the top DR eigenvector, allowing it to capture the same underlying knowledge without eigendecomposition. Additionally, we provide empirical evidence of the TR as a viable alternative to existing representations in subsidiary applications, while requiring less computational overhead to learn, store, and use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在强化学习表征中提出 terminal representation (TR)：与 default representation (DR) 一样对奖励加权轨迹编码，但可作为更低维对象直接学习，无需特征分解即可用于 option discovery、reward shaping、transfer learning、exploration。TR 嵌入 DR 的首特征向量中，因而承载相同知识，还绕开了特征分解隐含的转移动力学对称假设，并在子应用中以更低学习、存储与使用开销取得经验证据支持。
Motivation: SR 与 DR 的特征向量已被广泛用于 option discovery、reward shaping、迁移与探索，但特征分解带来额外计算开销，并强加转移动力学对称的假设。
Method: 推导 TR 的理论基础：给出两种学习算法及其收敛性、零样本组合性 (zero-shot compositionality)、不同奖励形式之间的等价关系；并证明 TR 嵌入 DR 的首特征向量，从而无需特征分解即可获得同等知识。
Result: TR 可作为低维对象学习，直接用于 SR/DR 特征向量所支持的下游任务而无需特征分解；在子应用 (subsidiary applications) 上给出其作为现有表征可行替代的经验证据，且学习、存储与使用的计算开销更低。
Conclusion: TR 是与 SR/DR 结构不同的奖励加权轨迹表征：绕开对称转移假设与特征分解开销，同时保留 DR 首特征向量所含的底层知识。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Seeing Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Know When Not to Answer Spatial Questions (and Why)?
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning benchmarks typically evaluate whether vision-language models can derive the correct answer from a visual observation. Yet in real 3D environments, the observation itself may be unreliable: occlusion can remove task-relevant evidence, while perspective can make visible geometry misleading. Reliable spatial reasoning therefore requires more than answering a question correctly. A model must also assess whether its current observation provides sufficient and trustworthy evidence for that answer. We introduce SPATIALUNCERTAIN, a controlled evaluation framework for studying viewpoint-dependent observational uncertainty. We study two complementary failure modes: missing evidence caused by occlusion and misleading evidence caused by perspective. We further evaluate whether models can recognize when the current view is unreliable and identify a more informative observation. Across eight open- and closed-source vision-language models, we find that model behavior does not track the reliability of visual evidence. Models do not reliably become more cautious as evidence disappears, and under perspective conflict, their judgments increasingly follow projected appearance rather than the unchanged physical 3D relation. Internal analysis suggests a corresponding representational asymmetry: projected 2D relations are readily available, whereas the underlying physical 3D relation is barely decodable. Moreover, models that can identify an informative viewpoint when explicitly asked often fail to recognize when such an additional view is needed. These failures are not fully resolved by prompting or fine-tuning, and providing a better viewpoint is substantially more effective than adding depth information to the same misleading observation. Our results identify assessing the reliability of visual observations as a distinct and missing component of current spatial reasoning evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPATIALUNCERTAIN 是一个受控评测框架，用遮挡（证据缺失）与透视冲突（证据误导）两类视角依赖的观测不确定性，检验 VLM 是否知道何时不该回答空间问题。八个开源与闭源模型的行为不随证据可靠性变化：证据消失时并不更谨慎，透视冲突下判断越来越跟随投影外观而非不变的 3D 关系；内部表示上 2D 投影关系易解码而物理 3D 关系几乎解码不出。
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准默认视觉观测可靠，只问模型能否答对；但真实 3D 环境中遮挡会抹掉证据、透视会让可见几何产生误导，模型是否评估观测本身是否足够可信这一环从未被单独考察。
Method: 构建受控评测框架 SPATIALUNCERTAIN，围绕两类互补失效模式设计任务：遮挡导致的证据缺失与透视导致的误导证据；评测模型能否识别当前视角不可靠并指出更有信息量的视角，覆盖八个开源与闭源 VLM，并对模型内部表示做可解码性分析，另比较提示、微调、提供更好视角与补充深度信息几种干预。
Result: 八个 VLM 的行为不追踪视觉证据可靠性：证据消失时模型并不相应变得更谨慎；透视冲突下其判断 increasingly 跟随投影外观，而物理 3D 关系本身不变。内部表示呈不对称——投影 2D 关系易于解码，底层物理 3D 关系几乎解码不出。能被明确要求时识别有用视角的模型，往往识别不出何时需要该视角；这些失败无法被提示或微调完全解决，而给出更好视角比在同一误导观测上补充深度信息有效得多。
Conclusion: 评估视觉观测的可靠性是当前空间推理评测中一个独立且缺失的组成部分；对这类视角依赖的不确定性，换视角优于在原误导观测上叠加深度信息，提示与微调不足以补上这一能力。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: FHRFormer: A Self-Supervised Masked Transformer Framework for Fetal Heart Rate Time-Series Inpainting and Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Approximately 10% of newborns require assistance to initiate breathing at birth, and around 5% need ventilation support. Fetal heart rate (FHR) monitoring plays a crucial role in assessing fetal well-being during prenatal care, enabling the detection of abnormal patterns and supporting timely obstetric interventions to mitigate fetal risks during labor. Applying artificial intelligence (AI) methods to analyze large datasets of continuous FHR monitoring episodes with diverse outcomes may offer novel insights into predicting the risk of needing breathing assistance or interventions. Recent advances in wearable FHR monitors have enabled continuous fetal monitoring without compromising maternal mobility. However, sensor displacement during maternal movement, as well as changes in fetal or maternal position, often lead to signal dropout, resulting in gaps in recorded FHR data. Such missing data limits the extraction of meaningful insights and complicates automated (AI-based) analysis. Traditional approaches to handling missing data, such as simple interpolation techniques, often fail to preserve the spectral characteristics of the signals. In this paper, we propose a masked transformer-based autoencoder approach to reconstruct missing FHR signals by capturing both local temporal and frequency components of the data. The proposed method demonstrates robustness across varying durations of missing data and can be used for signal inpainting and forecasting. The proposed approach can be applied retrospectively to research datasets to support the development of AI-based risk algorithms. In the future, the proposed method could be integrated into wearable FHR monitoring devices to achieve earlier and more robust risk detection.
papers.comment: Submitted to Frontiers in Digital Health
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FHRFormer：自监督掩码 Transformer 自编码器，同时重建胎儿心率 (FHR) 序列的局部时域与频域成分，用于信号补全 (inpainting) 与预测。方法在不同长度的缺失段上均表现稳健，可回溯处理研究数据集以支撑 AI 风险算法开发。
Motivation: 可穿戴 FHR 监测中传感器移位与体位变化造成信号缺失，简单插值无法保留信号频谱特征，限制了基于 AI 的风险分析。
Method: 掩码 Transformer 自编码器 (masked transformer-based autoencoder)，自监督训练，联合捕捉局部时域与频率成分，同时完成缺失段重建与预测。
Result: 方法在不同缺失时长下均展现稳健性，可用于信号 inpainting 与 forecasting；摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: FHRFormer 可回溯应用于研究数据集以支持 AI 风险算法开发，未来有望嵌入可穿戴 FHR 设备实现更早、更稳健的风险检测。

papers.title: Neural Scaling Laws for Jet Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recently observed empirical scaling laws describe the performance of foundation-type models as three independent key quantities -- dataset size, compute, and model parameters -- are modified. Extracting these scaling laws informs the training of large complex models for which the tuning of hyperparameters in traditional ways is not feasible. This work for the first time explores if scaling laws can also be observed for the task of particle jet generation -- both relevant as a pre-training objective for foundation models and as in-situ simulation by itself. We indeed replicate the key logarithmic scaling law behavior for model-size scaling. Beyond studying the next token prediction validation loss of the generative model, we also study the sliced Wasserstein distance of five physical quantities that are not immediately available to the model during training. Our study shows that this quantity is monotonically related to the next token prediction validation loss, meaning that this loss is indeed a good proxy for the physics performance. For the scaling with dataset size and compute, we observe substantially weaker scaling behavior of both the loss and the sliced Wasserstein distance. We analyze this behavior by introducing the concept of a learnable window, and argue that autoregressive next token prediction on jet constituents exhibits comparatively rapid saturation relative to language-model studies. We discuss possible origins of this behavior, including the stochastic nature of QCD radiation and differences between generative and supervised learning tasks in collider physics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 首次在粒子 jet 生成任务上检验基础模型式 scaling law，复现出模型规模方向的对数律：next-token prediction 验证损失随模型参数量呈对数下降，且与五个物理量的 sliced Wasserstein distance 单调相关，说明该损失可作物理性能代理。数据量与算力方向的 scaling 明显更弱，作者用 learnable window 概念解释为 jet constituent 上的自回归 next-token prediction 相对语言模型会快速饱和。
Motivation: Foundation 模型的 scaling law 用于在超参传统调优不可行时指导大模型训练，但该范式是否适用于高能物理的 jet 生成这类生成任务此前未被检验。
Method: 对生成式 jet 模型分别沿模型参数量、数据集规模、算力三个独立维度做 scaling 实验，度量 next-token prediction 验证损失，并对训练中不直接可得的五个物理量计算 sliced Wasserstein distance；引入 learnable window 概念分析饱和行为。
Result: 复现了模型规模方向的关键对数 scaling 行为；验证损失与五个物理量的 sliced Wasserstein distance 单调相关，验证损失是物理性能的良好代理；数据集规模与算力两个方向上损失和 sliced Wasserstein distance 的 scaling 都显著更弱，自回归 next-token prediction 相对语言模型研究呈现较快饱和。
Conclusion: Jet 生成具备模型规模上的对数 scaling law，验证损失可代理物理性能，但数据与算力维度受 QCD 辐射随机性及对撞机物理中生成式与监督式任务差异影响而较快饱和。

papers.title: Con-DSO: Learning Short-Horizon Consistency Priors for RGB-D Direct Sparse Odometry
papers.abstract_en: RGB-D direct visual odometry (VO) benefits from metric depth measurements but often degrades in the presence of dynamic objects, occlusions, illumination changes, and unreliable depth, which violate the photometric and geometric consistency assumptions of direct alignment. We propose Con-DSO, a consistency-aware RGB-D direct sparse odometry framework that addresses these challenges through a unified learned uncertainty model. A dual-branch consistency network is trained on adjacent RGB-D frame pairs using flow-guided photometric errors and projective depth-consistency errors to predict pixel-level photometric and geometric uncertainty. The predicted uncertainty is first converted into pairwise quality to guide support-pixel selection and is then fused across adjacent frame pairs to form a host-side quality prior for keyframe-based tracking. To account for the different roles of photometric and depth information in direct RGB-D optimization, the quality prior is incorporated through a decoupled photometric-geometric weighting scheme, with the geometric weight applied only to the translational component of pose estimation. Experiments on five public RGB-D benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over direct RGB-D odometry baselines, achieving more than 20\% reduction in absolute trajectory error on ICL-NUIM and approximately 50\% to 80\% reductions on RGB-D Scenes V2, TUM/BONN, and OpenLORIS. These results demonstrate that learned consistency-aware uncertainty can substantially improve the robustness of RGB-D direct visual odometry in challenging environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Con-DSO 用双分支一致性网络在相邻 RGB-D 帧对上学习光度与几何不确定性，转成成对质量并融合为关键帧跟踪的 host-side 质量先验，再以解耦的光度-几何权重（几何权重只作用于位姿平移分量）注入直接稀疏里程计。在五个公开 RGB-D 基准上相对直接法基线一致改进：ICL-NUIM 绝对轨迹误差 (ATE) 降低超过 20%，RGB-D Scenes V2、TUM/BONN 与 OpenLORIS 上降低约 50% 至 80%。
Motivation: RGB-D 直接对齐依赖光度与几何一致性假设，而动态物体、遮挡、光照变化和不可靠深度会破坏这些假设，使直接法里程计在挑战性场景中退化。
Method: 双分支一致性网络以相邻 RGB-D 帧对为输入，用光流引导的光度误差与投影深度一致性误差训练，输出像素级光度/几何不确定性；不确定性先转为成对质量以指导支撑像素选择，再跨帧对融合成关键帧跟踪的质量先验，通过解耦的光度-几何加权方案注入直接 RGB-D 优化，几何权重仅作用于位姿估计的平移分量。
Result: 在五个公开 RGB-D 基准上相对直接 RGB-D 里程计基线一致改进：ICL-NUIM 绝对轨迹误差 (ATE) 降低超过 20%，RGB-D Scenes V2、TUM/BONN 与 OpenLORIS 上降低约 50% 至 80%。

papers.title: D3S2: Diffusion-Guided Dataset Distillation for Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress large-scale datasets into compact synthetic sets while preserving training efficacy. However, existing studies mainly focus on image classification, leaving dense prediction tasks such as semantic segmentation largely underexplored. In this work, we identify three key challenges for segmentation DD: (i) long-tailed class imbalance, (ii) the need for strict pixel-wise alignment between images and dense labels, and (iii) the high computational cost of optimizing high-resolution data with complex models. To address these challenges, we propose D3S2, a Diffusion-guided Dataset Distillation framework for Semantic Segmentation. Our method adopts a two-stage design. In Class-Balanced Mask Selection, we construct a representative mask set via a greedy strategy that prioritizes underrepresented classes. In Diffusion-Guided Image Synthesis, we employ a pretrained layout-to-image diffusion model to generate images conditioned on the selected masks, naturally ensuring spatial alignment. To further enhance the training utility of synthesized data, we introduce guided diffusion sampling with two complementary objectives: a segmentation-consistency loss for pixel-level alignment, and a class-wise feature matching loss for aligning per-class feature statistics across layers. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of D3S2. Notably, at an extremely compression rate of 1%, our method achieves 24.99% and 35.49% mIoU on ADE20K and COCO-Stuff with Mask2Former (Swin-S), outperforming random selection by 9.34% and 5.70%, respectively. Our code is available at https://github.com/zwj084/D3S2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: D3S2 用两阶段流程把大规模语义分割数据集压缩到 1%：先贪心选类均衡掩码，再用 layout-to-image 扩散模型按掩码生成图像，并在采样时加分割一致性损失与类级特征匹配损失保证像素对齐。1% 压缩率下用 Mask2Former (Swin-S) 在 ADE20K 达 24.99% mIoU、COCO-Stuff 达 35.49%，分别超随机筛选 9.34% 和 5.70%。
Motivation: 数据集蒸馏 (DD) 几乎只针对图像分类，稠密预测任务被忽略；分割 DD 还要同时处理长尾类不平衡、图像与密集标签的逐像素对齐，以及高分辨率数据配复杂模型的优化开销。
Method: 两阶段框架：Class-Balanced Mask Selection 用贪心策略优先覆盖低频类构造代表性掩码集；Diffusion-Guided Image Synthesis 用预训练 layout-to-image 扩散模型以掩码为条件生成图像。引导扩散采样再加两个目标：segmentation-consistency loss 保证像素级对齐，class-wise feature matching loss 跨层对齐各类特征统计量。
Result: 压缩率 1% 时，Mask2Former (Swin-S) 在 ADE20K 上 24.99% mIoU、COCO-Stuff 上 35.49% mIoU，分别比 random selection 高 9.34% 和 5.70%。
Conclusion: 掩码条件的扩散生成加类均衡选择与双重引导损失，可在 1% 数据预算下保住分割训练效用，作者称在所测设置下优于随机筛选。

papers.title: Benchmarking the Personalization Capabilities of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Personalization is classically a two-party problem: a sender chooses what to say, and a receiver with independent objectives decides whether to act. A salesperson pitching the same analytics product leads with HIPAA compliance for a hospital and real-time reporting for a retailer, expecting a different argument to work on each. Existing LLM personalization benchmarks measure a narrower, one-party property: whether output matches the preferences of the same user it serves-sender and receiver being the same, as when RLHF aligns an assistant to its own user. The two-party case is harder to study automatically, since it needs ground truth linking specific content to an observed receiver action. Sales outreach provides this: a message written for one prospect, recorded against whether it produced a reply, a call, or a closed deal. We introduce SDR-Arena, a framework for benchmarking two-party generative personalization at scale, and SDR-Bench, a public corpus of 50,000 customer success stories across 22 industries and 3500 enterprises. Given only pre-outcome information, an agent must reconstruct the arguments that won the deal, scored by a weighted nugget-recall metric (WCS). The best model, Claude Sonnet 4.6, reaches 55.8% WCS indicating it recovers only half the winning content-a plateau we observe across model families that costly deep-research pipelines do not close. An ablation shows the cause is retrieval, not reasoning: models improve substantially given the facts a human researcher would gather, but rarely find them through web search alone. Two studies with professional SDRs support the metric: only 48% of generated pitches were rated usable without editing, and WCS yields model rankings consistent with evaluation against expert strategies authored independently of any model output.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两方生成式个性化基准 SDR-Arena 与公开语料 SDR-Bench（50,000 条客户成功案例、22 个行业、3500 家企业），要求 agent 仅凭成交前信息重建赢得订单的论点，用加权 nugget-recall（WCS）打分。最强模型 Claude Sonnet 4.6 只有 55.8% WCS，且消融显示瓶颈在检索而非推理。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 个性化基准只测单方性质（输出匹配同一用户偏好），而真实说服是两方问题：发送方选内容、接收方独立决定是否行动，且需要把内容与可观测接收行为对应起来的 ground truth。
Method: SDR-Arena 框架以销售外呼为载体，SDR-Bench 提供 50,000 条跨 22 行业、3500 家企业的客户成功故事；agent 只能看成交前信息，需重建赢得订单的论点，按加权 nugget-recall（WCS）计分；另做消融区分检索与推理，并用专业 SDR 与独立撰写的专家策略做两项验证研究。
Result: 最佳模型 Claude Sonnet 4.6 达 55.8% WCS，各模型族出现平台期，代价高昂的 deep-research 流水线也未突破；消融显示给出人类研究者会收集的事实后模型表现大幅提升，仅靠 web search 则很少找到；专业 SDR 仅 48% 的生成 pitch 被评为无需编辑即可用，WCS 给出的模型排名与基于独立专家策略的评估一致。
Conclusion: 两方个性化的短板在检索而非推理：模型能用给定事实重建获胜论点，但自己从网络里找不齐，WCS 可作为与专家判断一致的自动评测指标。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning over Predictive Distributions for LLM Regression
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as flexible regressors capable of predicting real-valued quantities from heterogeneous inputs. Yet most LLM regression objectives optimize predictions independently, often yielding poor calibration. We introduce Distribution-Aware Reward (DAR), an on-policy reinforcement learning objective that instead jointly evaluates the empirical predictive distribution formed by multiple predictions for the same input. To translate this distribution-level objective into rollout-level rewards, we assign each prediction credit based on its leave-one-out contribution to the quality of the overall predictive distribution. This encourages predictions that are well-centered and appropriately dispersed around the target. We evaluate on three regression settings: a synthetic task probing interpolation and extrapolation, and two real-world scientific tasks involving code and molecular data. Across tasks, DAR produces better-calibrated uncertainty estimates while consistently reducing prediction error and improving ranking quality over supervised fine-tuning and pointwise reinforcement learning. Together, these results highlight the benefits of distribution-aware training for LLM regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Distribution-Aware Reward (DAR)：把同一输入的多次采样组成经验预测分布，用留一法 (leave-one-out) 给每次 rollout 分配其对整体分布质量的贡献作为奖励，从而在 LLM 回归中同时约束预测的中心与离散程度。在合成插值/外推任务与代码、分子两类真实科学任务上，DAR 相对监督微调与逐点强化学习给出校准更好的不确定性、更低的预测误差和更好的排序质量。
Motivation: LLM 作为回归器预测实数值时，主流目标函数逐条独立优化单个预测，导致预测分布校准差，无法给出可信的不确定性。
Method: DAR 是 on-policy 强化学习目标：对同一输入做多次 rollout 形成经验预测分布，整体分布质量作为目标，再用留一贡献把分布级目标拆成单次 rollout 的奖励，鼓励预测围绕目标既居中又适度分散；对比对象为监督微调 (SFT) 与 pointwise RL。
Result: 在三个回归设置上（合成的插值与外推探针任务，以及涉及代码和分子数据的两个真实科学任务），DAR 相比 SFT 和 pointwise RL 一致降低预测误差、提升排序质量，并给出校准更好的不确定性估计；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 分布级、留一信用分配的奖励能让 LLM 回归在误差、排序与校准上同时受益，说明分布感知训练优于逐点目标。

papers.title: Stochastic Penalty-Barrier Method for Constrained Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Constrained Machine Learning (CML) enables fairness-aware training, physics-informed neural networks, and integration of symbolic domain knowledge into statistical models. In this work, we introduce the Stochastic Penalty-Barrier Method (SPBM) for CML problems. SPBM extends classical penalty and barrier methods by incorporating an exponential averaging of the dual variables, a stabilized penalty schedule, and the Moreau envelope to handle non-smoothness. We analyze the bias that mini-batching introduces in the barrier function and show that the feasible set of the resulting transformed problem is contained within the original one. We compare SPBM with CML baselines across multiple fairness and physics informed neural networks experiments. We find that SPBM is competitive with state-of-the-art methods. We also observe, on our fairness-based computational benchmark, that the per-epoch runtime of CML methods is largely independent of the number of constraints, and within $1.3\times$ of the per-epoch runtime of regularized Adam, for a number of constraints ranging from $90$ to $9900$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Stochastic Penalty-Barrier Method (SPBM) 处理约束机器学习问题：对对偶变量做指数平均、配合稳定的罚函数调度与 Moreau envelope 处理非光滑项。分析表明 mini-batch 会给 barrier 函数引入偏差，且变换后问题的可行集包含于原可行集之内；在公平性与物理信息神经网络 (PINN) 实验中与 CML 基线相比具有竞争力，公平性基准上每 epoch 运行时间在约束数 90 到 9900 范围内基本不随约束数变化，且在正则化 Adam 的 1.3 倍以内。
Motivation: 约束机器学习要同时支撑公平性训练、物理信息神经网络与符号知识嵌入，但经典罚函数/ barrier 方法在 mini-batch 与非光滑项下存在偏差与可行性问题，且约束数增多时的计算开销常被担心。
Method: SPBM 扩展经典罚函数与 barrier 方法：对对偶变量做指数平均 (exponential averaging)，引入稳定的罚函数调度 (stabilized penalty schedule)，并用 Moreau envelope 处理非光滑性；理论上分析 mini-batch 引入的 barrier 偏差，并证明变换后问题的可行集包含于原可行集。
Result: 在多个公平性与 PINN 实验中与 CML 基线比较，SPBM 与最先进方法相当；在公平性计算基准上，CML 方法的每 epoch 运行时间基本独立于约束数量，在约束数 90 至 9900 范围内处于正则化 Adam 每 epoch 运行时间的 1.3 倍以内。
Conclusion: SPBM 是约束机器学习中与 SOTA 竞争的求解方案，且该类方法的每 epoch 成本对约束数量不敏感，可扩展到数千个约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To Call or Not to Call: Diagnosing Intrinsic Over-Calling Bias in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents exhibit a consistent tendency to over-call, invoking tools even in situations where none is needed. On the When2Call benchmark, six models from three families show high call accuracy but much lower no-call accuracy, leaving overall accuracy in the 55%-70% range. We trace this to an Intrinsic Bias Hypothesis (IBH): the call/no-call decision mapping carries an activation-independent call offset, so the model favors call even at activation parity. Using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), we recover behavior-aligned feature bases for the call/no_call decision, reduce them to a signed activation margin, and estimate the offset directly. Across all six models, the model is decision-neutral only when no_call activation outweighs call activation, consistent with IBH. We then causally test IBH with Adaptive Margin-Calibrated Steering (AMCS), a closed-form counter-bias shift along SAE decoder directions. Cancelling the diagnosed offset mitigates over-calling and improves overall accuracy with a negligible drop in call accuracy. Our work recasts over-calling from an empirical phenomenon into a mechanistic object amenable to causal correction. Code is available at https://github.com/SKURA502/agent-sae/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 在 When2Call 上普遍过度调用工具：六个模型调用准确率高但 no-call 准确率明显更低，整体准确率仅 55%–70%。作者用 Intrinsic Bias Hypothesis (IBH) 把过调用解释为 call/no-call 决策映射上一个与激活无关的 call 偏移，并用 Sparse Autoencoder 特征方向上的闭式反偏移转向 (AMCS) 消掉该偏移，从而缓解过调用、提升整体准确率，且 call 准确率仅轻微下降。
Motivation: LLM agent 在无需调用工具时仍倾向调用，导致 When2Call 上 no-call 准确率远低于 call 准确率、整体准确率停在 55%–70%；这一现象此前只是经验观察，缺少机制解释与可干预的因果对象。
Method: 先提出 IBH：call/no-call 决策映射带有一个激活无关的 call 偏移，使模型在激活持平 (activation parity) 时仍偏向 call。再用 Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) 恢复与行为对齐的 call/no_call 特征基，压缩成带符号的激活边际 (signed activation margin) 并直接估计偏移；最后用 Adaptive Margin-Calibrated Steering (AMCS) 沿 SAE decoder 方向做闭式反偏移转向，作为因果检验。
Result: When2Call 上六个模型（来自三个家族）call 准确率高、no-call 准确率低得多，整体准确率处于 55%–70%。六个模型均只在 no_call 激活超过 call 激活时才决策中立，与 IBH 一致。取消诊断出的偏移后过调用被缓解、整体准确率提升，call 准确率仅有可忽略的下降。
Conclusion: 过调用不是随机行为缺陷，而是可定位、可用闭式转向因果纠正的机制性偏移；把过调用从经验现象重述为可修正的机制对象是本文主张。

papers.title: Voice "Cloning" is Style Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Artificially generated speech is increasingly embedded in everyday life. Voice cloning in particular enables applications where identity preservation is important, such as completing a recording, dubbing in a new language, or preserving the voices of individuals with speech loss. However, in our work, we find that despite the term, voice cloning does not faithfully ''clone'' an individual's voice. Instead, we find that widely-used voice cloning models systematically apply style transfer to source voices. As rated by human annotators, cloned voices are perceived as more authoritative, warm, customer-service-like, and human-like compared to their sources. Human annotators also report greater trust in cloned voices than source voices, and a greater willingness to disclose sensitive personal information to them. Our work furthermore shows that voice cloning leads to homogenization of speaker characteristics, as measured by reduced variance in accent, speaking rate, and the audio embedding space. Together, our results highlight a new set of limitations and risks of voice cloning technology and their potential impact on human behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 语音克隆模型并非忠实复制个体声音，而是对源声音系统性施加风格迁移：克隆声音被人工标注者评为更权威、更温暖、更像客服、更像真人，且比源声音获得更多信任与敏感信息披露意愿。克隆还使说话人特征同质化，口音、语速与音频嵌入空间的方差均下降。
Motivation: 语音克隆被用于补录、跨语言配音与失语者声音保存等身份敏感场景，但其是否真正保留个体声音、以及对听者行为的影响缺乏系统证据。
Method: 对广泛使用的语音克隆模型生成的声音与源声音做对照，由人工标注者在权威、温暖、客服感、拟人感、信任与披露敏感信息意愿等维度上评分，并测量口音、语速与音频嵌入空间的方差。
Result: 克隆声音在权威、温暖、客服感、拟人感上评分高于源声音；标注者对克隆声音的信任更高、披露敏感个人信息的意愿更强；口音、语速与音频嵌入空间的方差下降，说话人特征趋于同质化。
Conclusion: 语音克隆的实际机制是风格迁移而非身份复制，会系统性改变听者感知与信任行为，并压缩说话人个体差异，由此带来新的风险。

papers.title: KadiAssistant: A conversational AI Agent for information retrieval in Kadi4Mat
papers.abstract_en: We introduce KadiAssistant, a privacy-by-design AI assistant integrated into the Kadi research data ecosystem, enabling researchers to efficiently access, aggregate, and synthesize information from heterogeneous, privacy-sensitive research data. Interdisciplinary fields such as materials science bring together disciplines with their own terminology and standards. While this convergence fuels innovation, it also makes it increasingly difficult to connect and access knowledge, as data are distributed across disciplines, organizations, and individuals. For example, battery research combines electrochemical measurements, materials characterization data, physics-based simulations, and manufacturing parameters, each using different formats, vocabularies, and standards. Efficiently storing and sharing such heterogeneous data via research data platforms, such as Kadi4Mat, demands domain knowledge, technical expertise, and familiarity with metadata schemas and interfaces. Research data also vary in sensitivity: newly generated 'warm' data are often private, whereas published 'cold' data are usually openly accessible. The Kadi ecosystem offers fine-grained access control needed for sensitive data. A solution for efficient information retrieval in Kadi must therefore respect the fine-grained access permissions. To address these intertwined challenges of information retrieval, strong data privacy, and complex access control, KadiAssistant combines a self-hosted large language model (LLM) with a privacy-preserving semantic search, inspired by retrieval-augmented generation, that can access files and record metadata on Kadi. This allows the assistant to screen, aggregate, and structure information into a highly informative answer. KadiAssistant therefore bridges terminology and standards, lowers access barriers for researchers, and strengthens the Findable pillar of FAIR data principles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KadiAssistant 是嵌入 Kadi 研究数据生态的隐私优先对话式 AI 助手，用自托管 LLM 加受 RAG 启发的隐私保护语义搜索访问 Kadi 上的文件与记录元数据，在尊重细粒度访问权限的前提下把异构、跨学科资料筛出并汇总成结构化答案。它面向材料科学这类术语与标准分裂的领域，降低检索门槛并强化 FAIR 的 Findable 一环。
Motivation: 电池等跨学科研究的数据分散在不同学科、机构与个人手中，格式、词汇和元数据 schema 各异，且新生成的 warm 数据常为私有；在 Kadi4Mat 这类平台上做信息检索既要跨异构数据，又必须遵守细粒度访问控制，通用助手难以兼顾。
Method: 组合自托管 large language model (LLM) 与受 retrieval-augmented generation 启发的隐私保护语义搜索，可访问 Kadi 中的文件与记录元数据，把检索结果筛选、聚合、结构化为答案；隐私按 privacy-by-design 设计，并依赖 Kadi 生态已有的细粒度访问控制。
Result: 提出并集成 KadiAssistant 于 Kadi 研究数据生态，实现对异构、隐私敏感研究数据的访问、聚合与综合，答案生成过程尊重细粒度访问权限；摘要以材料科学（电化学测量、材料表征、物理仿真、制造参数）为典型场景。
Conclusion: 在隐私敏感研究数据平台上，自托管 LLM 加访问感知的语义检索足以桥接学科术语与标准、降低检索门槛，并直接支撑 FAIR 的 Findable 原则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PBT-Bench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Property-Based Testing
papers.abstract_en: Existing code benchmarks measure whether an agent can produce any test that reproduces a known bug, or whether it can produce a patch that fixes a described issue. Neither isolates the distinct skill of property-based testing: deriving a semantic invariant from documentation, and then constructing an input-generation strategy precise enough to make a random search reveal the violation. We introduce PBT-Bench, a benchmark of 100 curated property-based testing problems across 40 real Python libraries. Each problem injects one or more semantic bugs (365 in total, mean 3.65 per problem) designed so that default-strategy random inputs almost never trigger them; the agent must read the library's documentation, identify the relevant invariant, and specify a Hypothesis @given strategy that concentrates mass in the trigger region. Bugs are stratified across three difficulty levels (L1-L3) spanning single-constraint boundary bugs to stateful, cross-function protocol violations. We evaluate eight contemporary LLMs under two prompting regimes (open-ended baseline vs. explicit Hypothesis scaffolding) for three independent runs per configuration. Bug recall under the PBT-guided prompt ranges from 42.1% to 83.4% across models; under the open-ended baseline, from 31.4% to 76.7%. Hypothesis scaffolding lifts mid-capability models by over 20 percentage points, but yields smaller gains for the strongest models, with two exceptions showing degradation, suggesting the structured prompt can interfere with certain model behaviours rather than complementing them. The hardest bugs prove model-specific: different architectures fail on different problems, leaving persistent gaps that no single model closes. We release the benchmark, harness, and full evaluation corpus to support downstream work on documentation-grounded semantic reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track (poster)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PBT-Bench 是一个 100 题、覆盖 40 个真实 Python 库的属性基测试 (property-based testing) 基准，共注入 365 个语义 bug（平均每题 3.65 个），要求 agent 从文档推出不变量并写出能把随机输入质量压进触发区的 Hypothesis @given 策略。8 个 LLM 各跑三次：PBT 引导提示下 bug recall 42.1%–83.4%，开放式基线 31.4%–76.7%；显式 Hypothesis 脚手架让中等能力模型提升超过 20 个百分点，但对最强模型收益更小，其中两个模型反而下降。
Motivation: 现有代码基准只测“能否写出复现已知 bug 的测试”或“能否给出补丁”，没有隔离属性基测试这项独立技能：从文档推导语义不变量，再构造足够精确的输入生成策略让随机搜索暴露违规。
Method: 构建 100 个 PBT 问题、40 个真实 Python 库、365 个语义 bug，按 L1–L3 三级分层（单约束边界 bug 到有状态跨函数协议违规），默认随机策略几乎不会触发；评测 8 个当代 LLM，两种提示制度（开放式基线 vs 显式 Hypothesis 脚手架），每配置独立跑 3 次，指标为 bug recall。
Result: PBT 引导提示下 bug recall 跨模型 42.1%–83.4%，开放式基线 31.4%–76.7%；Hypothesis 脚手架把中等能力模型抬高超过 20 个百分点，对最强模型收益更小，其中两个例外出现下降。最难的 bug 呈模型特异性：不同架构在不同问题上失败，留下没有任何单一模型能关闭的持续缺口。
Conclusion: 结构化 Hypothesis 提示对中等能力模型是净收益，但会与部分最强模型的行为相互干扰，因此不能一律加上脚手架；最难的语义 bug 需要组合多个模型才能覆盖。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents in household environments must plan under partial observation: they need to remember objects, track state changes, and recover when actions fail. Existing benchmarks only partially test this ability. Egocentric video datasets capture realistic human activities but remain passive, while interactive simulators support execution but rely on synthetic scenes and hand-crafted dynamics, introducing a sim-to-real gap and often assuming fully observable state. We introduce Ego2World, an executable benchmark that turns egocentric cooking videos into executable symbolic worlds governed by graph-transition rules. Built on HD-EPIC, Ego2World derives reusable transition rules from video annotations and executes them in a hidden symbolic world graph. During evaluation, the simulator maintains the hidden world graph, while the agent plans over its own partial belief graph using only local observations and execution feedback. This separation forces agents to update memory and replan without observing the true world state. Experiments show that action-overlap scores overestimate physical-state success, and that persistent belief memory improves task completion while reducing repeated visual exploration -- suggesting that belief maintenance should be a first-class target of embodied-agent evaluation.
papers.comment: I have a new version(huge different from previous one),and already put it in arXiv, so I need to withdraw previous version to avoid two articles held on arXiv in the sometime which may cause confusing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Ego2World 把第一人称烹饪视频 HD-EPIC 编译成由图转移规则约束的可执行符号世界，评测时模拟器持有隐藏世界图，智能体只能在自己的局部观测与执行反馈上维护部分信念图并重规划。实验显示 action-overlap 分数会高估物理状态成功，而持续的信念记忆 (persistent belief memory) 提升任务完成率并减少重复视觉探索。
Motivation: 第一人称视频数据真实但被动，交互式模拟器可执行却依赖合成场景与手工动力学，且常假设完全可观测，无法真正检验具身智能体在部分观测下的记忆与失败恢复能力。
Method: 基于 HD-EPIC 视频标注抽取可复用的图转移规则，构建隐藏符号世界图；评测时模拟器维护真实世界图，智能体仅凭局部观测与执行反馈在自己的部分信念图上规划并随执行失败更新记忆、重规划。
Result: 实验发现 action-overlap 分数会高估物理状态层面的成功；持续信念记忆在该可执行基准上提高任务完成度，同时减少重复的视觉探索行为。
Conclusion: 信念维护 (belief maintenance) 应作为具身智能体评测的一等目标，仅靠动作重叠类指标会掩盖真实的状态跟踪失败。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can follow complex instructions in a single turn, yet over long multi-turn interactions they often lose the thread of instructions, persona, and rules. This degradation has been measured behaviorally but not mechanistically explained. We propose a channel-transition account: goal-defining tokens become less accessible through attention, while goal-related information may persist in residual representations. We introduce the Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR), measuring attention from generated tokens to task-defining goal tokens, and combine it with sliding-window ablations and residual-stream probes. When attention to instructions closes, what survives reveals architecture. Across architectures, the transition yields qualitatively distinct failure modes: some models preserve goal-conditioned behavior at vanishing attention, others fail despite decodable residual goal information, and the layer at which this encoding emerges varies from 2 to 27. A within-model causal ablation that force-closes the attention channel in Mistral collapses recall from near-perfect to 11% on a 20-fact retention task and raises persona-constraint violations above an adversarial-pressure baseline without user pressure, with both effects emerging at the predictable crossover turn. Linear probes recover per-episode recall outcomes from residual representations with AUC up to 0.99 across all four primary architectures, while input embeddings remain at chance. Across architectures and model scales, the gap between attention loss and residual decodability predicts whether goal-conditioned behavior survives channel closure. We contribute GAR as a diagnostic, the channel-transition framework as a controlled mechanistic account, and a parametric prediction of failure timing under windowed attention closure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出通道转换 (channel-transition) 假说解释 LLM 多轮对话中丢失指令线索：目标 token 的注意力可达性下降，但目标信息仍留在 residual stream 中。用 Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR)、滑窗消融与线性探针度量这一转换；在 Mistral 上强制关闭注意力通道使 20-fact retention 任务召回从接近满分跌到 11%，探针从 residual 表征预测单轮召回结果 AUC 最高 0.99。
Motivation: LLM 单轮能遵循复杂指令，却在长多轮交互中丢失指令、persona 与规则；这种退化此前只有行为层面测量，缺少机制性解释。
Method: 提出 GAR（生成 token 对任务目标 token 的注意力）作为诊断量，结合滑窗消融 (sliding-window ablations) 与 residual stream 线性探针；在 Mistral 上做通道内的因果消融强制关闭注意力，并对四种主架构与不同规模做跨模型比较。
Result: Mistral 强制关闭注意力后，20-fact retention 任务召回从接近满分降到 11%，persona 约束违反率升至超过对抗压力基线（且无需用户施压），两个效应都在可预测的交叉轮次出现；编码涌现层位在不同架构间从 2 到 27 不等；线性探针从 residual 表征预测单轮召回结果 AUC 最高 0.99（四种主架构），而输入 embedding 仅为随机水平。
Conclusion: 注意力丢失与 residual 可解码性之间的差距可以预测目标条件行为在通道关闭后是否存活，据此给出窗口化注意力关闭下失效时机的参数化预测，并贡献 GAR 与通道转换框架作为可控的机制性解释。

papers.title: Behavioral Guarantees for Proxy-Based Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a framework generalizing recent proxy-based unlearning methods and proves theoretical guarantees about the behavior of the resulting unlearned model: upper bounds on its Kullback-Leibler divergence to the ideal posterior distribution of the retain data. We model approximate unlearning as a constrained optimization problem and interpret a family of solutions as introducing a scaled unlearning signal in the output space. The unlearning signal arises from proxies of the posterior data distributions. Its scale is adapted to the proxies to ensure the behavioral upper bounds. This framework relies on the structure of the data distributions in order to create proxies. If need be, the target serves as a teacher to distill the update in the weights. Our approach is experimentally validated over two forgetting scenarios as reaching the closest classifier to the model retrained from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个统一 proxy-based unlearning 框架，把近似遗忘写成约束优化，解族等价于在输出空间注入按 proxy 缩放的遗忘信号，并证明未遗忘模型到保留数据理想后验的 KL 散度上界。在两个遗忘场景中，该方法得到的分类器是各方法里最接近从头重训模型的。
Motivation: 现有 proxy-based 遗忘方法各自为政，缺少对遗忘后模型行为（与保留数据理想后验的偏差）的统一理论刻画与保证。
Method: 将近似遗忘建模为约束优化问题，解族解释为输出空间中一个缩放的遗忘信号；信号来自后验数据分布的 proxy，其尺度按 proxy 自适应以满足行为上界；框架依赖数据分布结构构造 proxy，必要时用目标模型作 teacher 对权重更新做蒸馏。
Result: 给出未遗忘模型与保留数据理想后验之间 KL 散度的理论上界；在两个遗忘场景的实验验证中，所得分类器是各方法里最接近从头重训 (retrained from scratch) 模型的。
Conclusion: 按 proxy 自适应缩放遗忘信号，可以在统一框架下为 proxy-based unlearning 给出可证明的行为保证，并在实验上逼近重训模型。

papers.title: MSPR: Multi-scale Predictive Representations for Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates robust representation learning in offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL). Particularly in sparse reward scenarios, learning representations that align state and goal latents is a challenge, as the encoder can learn goal-agnostic features that destabilize policy learning. We address this issue by learning the encoder's representation with alignment objectives that capture the environment across multiple scales, from local physical dynamics to long-horizon goal-directed structure. Concretely, we propose MSPR, a framework that leverages multi-scale predictive supervision to enforce goal-directed alignment within the latent space. We demonstrate that MSPR leads to strong performance on both vision and state-based tasks. Furthermore, we show that our approach is resilient under realistic, challenging data regimes, maintaining state-of-the-art performance across a wide variety of tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSPR 用多尺度预测监督 (multi-scale predictive supervision) 训练离线目标条件强化学习 (GCRL) 的编码器，使潜表征从局部物理动力学到长程目标导向结构都与目标对齐，避免编码器学到目标无关特征而破坏策略学习。在视觉与状态两类任务上均取得强性能，并在困难数据条件下保持 SOTA。
Motivation: 离线 GCRL 在稀疏奖励下，编码器容易学到目标无关的潜表征，导致状态与目标潜变量对不齐、策略学习不稳定。
Method: 提出 MSPR 框架：用覆盖多尺度环境结构的对齐目标（局部物理动力学到长程目标导向结构）做预测式监督，强制潜空间内的目标导向对齐，训练离线策略。
Result: 在视觉任务与状态输入任务上都取得强性能；在 realistic、challenging 的数据条件下于多种任务上保持 state-of-the-art 表现。
Conclusion: 把预测监督做成多尺度的目标对齐，可以在稀疏奖励离线 GCRL 中稳定表征并跨任务、跨数据条件维持高性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Particle Monte Carlo Tree Search
papers.abstract_en: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) is a widely used approach for policy improvement and action selection in Reinforcement Learning. Due to its sequential and deterministic nature, principled runtime-scaling of MCTS with parallel compute remains a major challenge. We introduce Particle MCTS (PMCTS), a parallel MCTS algorithm which is suited for neural network evaluations, designed for GPU-acceleration with batch-parallelization and retains MCTS's principled approximate policy improvement interpretation. Empirically, PMCTS scales well with parallel compute and consistently outperforms or compares well to the popular heuristic-based baselines across a range of popular discrete- and continuous-action benchmark domains, including Chess, 19x19 Go, 9x9 Go, Gardner Chess, Snake, classical control environments from Brax and LLM reasoning in Sokoban.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Particle MCTS (PMCTS)，把 MCTS 的树搜索改成可批量并行的粒子式展开以适配 GPU 上的神经网络评估，同时保留 MCTS 的近似策略改进解释。在 Chess、19x19 Go、9x9 Go、Gardner Chess、Snake、Brax 经典控制与 Sokoban LLM 推理等基准上，随并行算力扩展良好，并稳定优于或持平主流启发式并行基线。
Motivation: MCTS 的串行与确定性使其难以随并行算力做有原则的运行时间扩展，而神经网络评估又需要批量吞吐。
Method: PMCTS 以粒子式展开重构 MCTS，采用 batch-parallelization 面向 GPU 加速神经网络评估，同时保留 MCTS 的近似策略改进 (approximate policy improvement) 解释。
Result: 在 Chess、19x19 Go、9x9 Go、Gardner Chess、Snake、Brax 经典控制环境与 Sokoban 的 LLM 推理等离散/连续动作基准上，PMCTS 随并行算力扩展良好，并稳定优于或与主流启发式并行基线相当。
Conclusion: MCTS 的运行时间扩展可以靠面向 GPU 的批量并行实现，而不必牺牲其有原则的近似策略改进解释。

papers.title: A Sharp Finite-Iteration Theory for Asynchronous Categorical Distributional Temporal-Difference Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-iteration behavior of asynchronous categorical distributional temporal-difference methods, covering scalar categorical TD (CTD) in the Cramér geometry and multivariate signed-categorical TD (MTD) in the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) geometry. We establish high-probability guarantees under i.i.d. sampling and under a continuing Markovian trajectory. For CTD, the Cramér sample complexity to the true return law has leading term $\tilde O(ρ_{\min}^{-1}(1-γ)^{-2}\varepsilon^{-2})$ in the i.i.d. and $\tilde O(μ_{\min}^{-1}(1-γ)^{-2}\varepsilon^{-2}+μ_{\min}^{-1}t_{\mathrm{mix}})$ in the Markovian setting, without using variance reduction or data dropping. For MTD, the MMD sample complexity has leading terms $\tilde O(ρ_{\min}^{-1}(1-γ)^{-1-c}\varepsilon^{-2})$ and $\tilde O(μ_{\min}^{-1}(1-γ)^{-1-c}\varepsilon^{-2}+μ_{\min}^{-1}t_{\mathrm{mix}})$, where $c\in(0,2)$ is the homogeneity exponent of the MMD kernel, and they reduce to the CTD rates when $c=1$. These are, to our knowledge, the first finite-iteration rates for MTD. For undiscounted fixed-horizon policy evaluation, the same analysis applies to fixed-horizon versions of CTD and MTD under i.i.d. and episodic sampling, and the rates match the discounted ones with the effective horizon $(1-γ)^{-1}$ replaced by the horizon $H$ in the leading term. Matching minimax lower bounds show that the leading terms, and the implied $1$-Wasserstein rates, are optimal under i.i.d., Markovian, and episodic sampling. Together, these results provide a unified non-asymptotic analysis of asynchronous categorical distributional TD across scalar, multivariate, discounted, and fixed-horizon settings, with rates that are minimax optimal in their leading terms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出异步 categorical distributional TD（CTD 用 Cramér 几何、MTD 用 MMD 几何）的有限迭代高概率收敛界：i.i.d. 与 Markov 轨迹下 CTD 的 Cramér 样本复杂度主项为 Õ(ρ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2}) 与 Õ(μ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2}+μ_min^{-1}t_mix)，MTD 为 Õ(ρ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-1-c}ε^{-2}) 与对应 Markov 形式，且配匹配的 minimax 下界说明主项最优。
Motivation: 异步 categorical distributional TD 此前缺少有限迭代（非渐近）速率理论，尤其 MTD 完全没有；需要在 i.i.d.、Markov、episodic 采样下判定其样本复杂度主项是否最优。
Method: 对 CTD 在 Cramér 几何、对 MTD 在 MMD 几何（核齐次指数 c∈(0,2)）建立 i.i.d. 采样与 continuing Markov 轨迹下的高概率界，不用 variance reduction 或 data dropping；同一分析推广到 undiscounted fixed-horizon 策略评估的 episodic 采样，并推导匹配的 minimax 下界与隐含的 1-Wasserstein 速率。
Result: CTD 的 Cramér 样本复杂度主项：i.i.d. 下 Õ(ρ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2})，Markov 下 Õ(μ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2}+μ_min^{-1}t_mix)；MTD 的 MMD 主项：Õ(ρ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-1-c}ε^{-2}) 与 Õ(μ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-1-c}ε^{-2}+μ_min^{-1}t_mix)，c=1 时退化为 CTD 速率。fixed-horizon 版本把 (1-γ)^{-1} 换成 H 即与折扣情形主项一致。匹配 minimax 下界表明这些主项及隐含 1-Wasserstein 速率在 i.i.d.、Markov、episodic 采样下最优；作者称这是 MTD 的首个有限迭代速率。
Conclusion: 异步 categorical distributional TD 在标量/多变量、折扣/fixed-horizon 各设定下可统一做非渐近分析，其样本复杂度主项是 minimax 最优的。

summary_sections.result: CTD 的 Cramér 样本复杂度主项：i.i.d. 下 Õ(ρ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2})，Markov 下 Õ(μ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-2}ε^{-2}+μ_min^{-1}t_mix)；MTD 的 MMD 主项：Õ(ρ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-1-c}ε^{-2}) 与 Õ(μ_min^{-1}(1-γ)^{-1-c}ε^{-2}+μ_min^{-1}t_mix)，c=1 时退化为 CTD 速率。fixed-horizon 版本把 (1-γ)^{-1} 换成 H 即与折扣情形主项一致。匹配 minimax 下界表明这些主项及隐含 1-Wasserstein 速率在 i.i.d.、Markov、episodic 采样下最优；作者称这是 MTD 的首个有限迭代速率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 异步 categorical distributional TD 在标量/多变量、折扣/fixed-horizon 各设定下可统一做非渐近分析，其样本复杂度主项是 minimax 最优的。

papers.title: MedHorizon: Towards Long-context Medical Video Understanding in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced image understanding and short-video analysis, but real clinical review often requires full-procedure video understanding. Unlike general long videos, medical procedures contain highly redundant anatomical views, while decisive evidence is temporally sparse, spatially subtle, and context dependent. Existing benchmarks often assume this evidence has already been localized through images, short clips, or pre-segmented videos, leaving the retrieval-before-reasoning problem under-tested. We introduce MedHorizon, an in-the-wild benchmark for long-context medical video understanding. MedHorizon preserves 759 hours of full-length clinical procedures and provides 1,253 evidence-grounded multiple-choice questionsthat jointly evaluate sparse evidence understanding and multi-hop clinical reasoning. Its evidence is extremely sparse, with only 0.166% evidence frames on average, requiring models to search noisy procedural streams before interpreting and aggregating findings. We evaluate representative general-domain, medical-domain, and long-video MLLMs. The best model reaches only 41.1% accuracy, showing that current systems remain far from robust full-procedure understanding. Further analysis yields four key findings: performance does not scale reliably with more frames, evidence retrieval and clinical interpretation remain primary bottlenecks; these bottlenecks are rooted in weak procedural reasoning and attention drift under redundancy, and generic sampling methods only partially balances local detail with global coverage. MedHorizon provides a rigorous testbed for MLLMs that retrieve sparse evidence and reason over complete clinical workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedHorizon 是一个 in-the-wild 长上下文医学视频理解基准，保留 759 小时完整临床操作流程，配 1,253 道证据锚定选择题，平均仅 0.166% 帧含关键证据，逼模型先在冗余操作流中检索再做多跳推理。评测通用域、医学域与长视频 MLLM 后，最强模型准确率仅 41.1%，且性能不随输入帧数可靠提升，瓶颈在证据检索与临床解读。
Motivation: 现有医学视频基准默认证据已被图像、短片段或预分割视频定位好，绕开了 retrieval-before-reasoning 这一环；而真实临床复盘需要看完整操作流程，其中解剖视野高度冗余、决定性证据在时间上稀疏、空间上细微且依赖上下文。
Method: 构建 MedHorizon 基准：保留 759 小时全长临床操作视频，出 1,253 道证据锚定多选题，联合考察稀疏证据理解与多跳临床推理；证据平均只占 0.166% 帧。对通用域、医学域和长视频三类代表性 MLLM 做评测，并分析采样方法与失败模式。
Result: 最强模型准确率仅 41.1%；进一步分析给出四条发现：性能不随帧数增加可靠扩展，证据检索与临床解读是主要瓶颈，瓶颈根源是薄弱的过程推理与冗余导致的 attention drift，通用采样方法只能部分兼顾局部细节与全局覆盖。
Conclusion: 当前 MLLM 离稳健的全流程手术操作理解还很远，长视频输入量本身不解决问题；检索稀疏证据并沿完整临床工作流推理才是核心难点，MedHorizon 被定位为该能力的测试台。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Rethinking Adapter Placement: A Dominant Adaptation Module Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that places trainable low-rank adapters into frozen pre-trained models. Recent studies show that using fewer LoRA adapters may still maintain or even improve performance, but existing methods still distribute adapters broadly, leaving \emph{where to place a limited number of adapters to maximize performance} largely open. To investigate this, we introduce \textbf{PAGE} (\textbf{P}rojected \textbf{A}dapter \textbf{G}radient \textbf{E}nergy), a gradient-based sensitivity probe that estimates the initial trainable gradient energy available to each candidate LoRA adapter. Surprisingly, we find that PAGE is highly concentrated on a single shallow FFN down-projection across two model families and four downstream tasks. We term this module the \textbf{dominant adaptation module} and show that its layer index is architecture-dependent but task-stable. Motivated by this finding, we propose \textbf{DomLoRA}, a placement method that places a single adapter at the dominant adaptation module. With only \textbf{0.7\%} of vanilla LoRA's trainable parameters, DomLoRA outperforms it on average across downstream tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, coding, and multi-turn conversation. This method also matches or improves other LoRA variants and reduces training time by up to \textbf{2.74}$\times$ compared with broad placement, supporting the dominant adaptation module perspective as a practical placement guideline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PAGE（Projected Adapter Gradient Energy）这一梯度敏感度探针显示，LoRA 的可训练梯度能量高度集中在单个浅层 FFN down-projection 上，该位置随架构而变、跨任务稳定。据此提出 DomLoRA，只在该 dominant adaptation module 放一个 adapter，用 vanilla LoRA 0.7% 的可训练参数在指令遵循、数学推理、代码、多轮对话四类任务上平均更优，训练时间最多快 2.74×。
Motivation: 已有工作发现减少 LoRA adapter 数量不掉点甚至更好，但现有方法仍把 adapter 平铺到各层，有限数量的 adapter 该放在哪里以最大化性能仍是开放问题。
Method: 提出梯度敏感度探针 PAGE，估计每个候选 LoRA adapter 位置在初始化时可用的可训练梯度能量；在两个模型家族、四个下游任务上定位能量最集中的模块，再据此提出 DomLoRA，把单个 adapter 放在该 dominant adaptation module。
Result: PAGE 能量在两个模型家族、四个下游任务上高度集中于单个浅层 FFN down-projection；DomLoRA 只用 vanilla LoRA 0.7% 的可训练参数，在指令遵循、数学推理、代码、多轮对话上平均超过 vanilla LoRA，也匹配或优于其他 LoRA 变体，训练时间相比广泛放置最多减少 2.74×。
Conclusion: dominant adaptation module 视角可作为实用的 adapter 放置准则：adapter 位置由架构决定、对任务稳定，集中放置能以极少参数和更少训练时间达到或超过广泛放置的效果。

papers.title: PlotPick: AI-powered batch extraction of numerical data from scientific figures
papers.abstract_en: Systematic reviews and meta-analyses often need numerical data reported only in figures, and extracting them with interactive digitisers usually requires a person to select and calibrate each figure. We present PlotPick, an open-source tool that uses vision-language models (VLMs) to extract tabular data from batches of scientific figures, and we benchmark the kind of model it calls: nine VLMs from four providers on ChartX and six of them on PlotQA, against DePlot, a dedicated chart-to-table model, with every system scored on the same items by numeric F1 (F1 over unlabelled numbers at 5% relative tolerance). On six ChartX chart types (n=300) all nine VLMs outperform DePlot in aggregate, at 79.1-96.0% against 74.3%. The lead comes mainly from box plots, where DePlot scores 24.8% against 64.2-97.3%; pooled over the other five types, seven VLMs keep a lead of 4.7 to 11.6 points and the two weakest do not. On a subset of the PlotQA test split (n=529; 427 horizontal bar charts), scored by a lenient best-series variant of the metric, DePlot reaches 87.0%; the two strongest VLMs are level with it or slightly above it, and four fall 3.8 to 30.3 points below. DePlot was trained on PlotQA's training split. Both benchmarks use synthetic charts, and the metric ignores which series a value belongs to. The application itself was not evaluated: its figure detection, structured output, prompt and default model were not tested, and the one benchmarked model it offers, Claude Haiku 4.5, is one of the four below DePlot on PlotQA. Accuracy on biomedical figures has not been established, and every extracted value must be checked against its source figure. This version corrects version 1, which scored most PlotQA replies against category labels instead of plotted values; its claim that every VLM outperformed DePlot on both benchmarks is withdrawn. PlotPick is available at https://plotpick.streamlit.app/.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Version 2 corrects version 1: its PlotQA scores used the wrong axis for most items; DePlot is now scored on the same ChartX items as the VLMs; the claim that every VLM beat DePlot on both benchmarks is withdrawn (all nine lead it in aggregate on six ChartX chart types only). See Section 7. Code and results: https://github.com/tommycarstensen/plotpick-validation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlotPick 是用视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 批量从科学图表提取表格数据的开源工具，并在 ChartX 与 PlotQA 上对九个 VLM 与专用图表转表模型 DePlot 做同题数值 F1 对比。六类 ChartX 图 (n=300) 上九个 VLM 汇总 79.1–96.0% 对 DePlot 74.3%，优势主要来自箱线图 (24.8% 对 64.2–97.3%)；PlotQA 子集 (n=529) 上 DePlot 达 87.0%，两个最强 VLM 持平或略高，四个落后 3.8–30.3 点。作者撤回 v1 中“所有 VLM 在两个基准上都胜过 DePlot”的结论，并要求每个提取值回对原图。
Motivation: 系统综述与 meta 分析常需从只以图形呈现的数值中取数，而交互式数字化工具要求人工逐图选点和标定，批量场景下成本高。
Method: PlotPick 以 VLM 对成批科学图表直接输出结构化表格；作者对来自四家提供商的九个 VLM 在 ChartX 上评测、其中六个在 PlotQA 上评测，与专用 chart-to-table 模型 DePlot 对比，统一按 numeric F1（5% 相对容差下未标注数字的 F1）在相同题目上打分，PlotQA 用宽松的 best-series 变体。
Result: 六类 ChartX 图 (n=300) 上九个 VLM 汇总 79.1–96.0%，DePlot 74.3%；箱线图上 DePlot 24.8% 对 VLM 64.2–97.3%，其余五类合并后七个 VLM 领先 4.7–11.6 点、两个最弱者不领先。PlotQA 测试集子集 (n=529，其中 427 张水平条形图) 上 DePlot 87.0%（其训练集即 PlotQA 训练划分），两个最强 VLM 持平或略高，四个落后 3.8–30.3 点。
Conclusion: VLM 在 ChartX 六类图上整体胜过 DePlot，但优势集中在箱线图，PlotQA 上 DePlot 仍具竞争力；两个基准均为合成图表且指标不校验数值所属系列，工具本身的图检测、结构化输出、prompt 与默认模型未被评测，生物医学图表精度未确立，每个提取值必须回对原图核验。

papers.title: XDecomposer: Learning Prior-Free Set Decomposition for Multiphase X-ray Diffraction
papers.abstract_en: Multiphase powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) analysis remains a fundamental bottleneck in structure identification, as real-world synthesis often produces complex mixtures whose constituent phases (components) cannot be reliably disentangled. While recent advances in representation-based crystal retrieval and generation suggest the possibility of inferring structures directly from PXRD, existing approaches largely assume single-phase inputs and break down in multiphase settings. Here, we present XDecomposer, a prior-free framework for joint decomposition and identification of multiphase XRD patterns without requiring candidate phase lists, structural templates, or prior knowledge of phase number. We formulate multiphase diffraction analysis as a set prediction problem, where the model infers an unordered set of phase-resolved components, their mixture proportions, and corresponding structural representations within a unified architecture. A phase-query-driven decomposition mechanism, together with diffraction-consistent physical reconstruction, enables accurate source separation while preserving crystallographic fidelity. Extensive experiments on both simulated and experimental datasets show that XDecomposer substantially improves reconstruction accuracy and phase identification across diverse chemical systems, while maintaining strong generalization to unseen mixtures. These results provide a practical route toward data-driven, source-resolved multiphase XRD analysis and reduce long-standing dependence on prior-guided iteratively phase matching. The code is openly available at https://github.com/Licht0812/XDecomposer
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: XDecomposer 把多相粉末 X 射线衍射 (multiphase PXRD) 分析建模为集合预测问题，在不需要候选相列表、结构模板或已知相数的前提下，联合分解出无序的相分辨组分、混合比例与结构表示。相查询驱动的分解机制配合衍射一致的物理重建实现源分离并保持晶体学保真度，在模拟与实验数据集上显著提升重建精度与相识别，并对未见混合物保持强泛化。
Motivation: 真实合成常得到复杂混合物，各组成相难以可靠解离；现有基于表示的晶体检索与生成方法基本假设单相输入，在多相场景下失效，且长期依赖先验引导的迭代相比 (iterative phase matching)。
Method: 将多相衍射分析表述为集合预测：模型输出无序的相分辨组分集合、混合比例及对应结构表示，统一在一个架构内；用相查询驱动的分解机制 (phase-query-driven decomposition) 与衍射一致的物理重建 (diffraction-consistent physical reconstruction) 完成源分离，无需候选相列表、结构模板或相数先验。
Result: 在模拟与实验数据集上，XDecomposer 在多种化学体系中大幅提高重建精度与相识别表现，并对未见混合物保持强泛化；摘要以定性表述给出结论，未列具体数值。
Conclusion: 不依赖先验的集合式分解可作为数据驱动、源分辨的多相 XRD 分析路径，减少对先验引导迭代相比的长期依赖；代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Von Neumann Networks
papers.abstract_en: In the mid-twentieth century, mathematician and polymath John von Neumann created a computational system on an array of cells as a simple model of the human brain, where each cell had one of a finite set of roles or states that he predicted would be modelled by a diffusion process. In this work, we show that such a system, when developed in a modern deep learning setting, enables the construction of an artificial neuron having specialized roles that can be learnt. We refer to this neuron as the Von Neumann neuron, and the resulting neural network from such neurons result in a self-engineered design whose architecture is only dependent on the structure and locations of its inputs and outputs on this cellular array. The mathematical framework for these Von Neumann Networks (VNNs) is also constructed and shows that they are based on the extension of neural operators and the learning of Green's functions with convolutions on a cellular topology having a diffusion signature. We also prove that these VNNs are part of a more general computational system called Cellular Machines that are computationally universal. Initial experiments show that VNN based multi-layered perceptrons outperform their equivalent deep learning variant on basic tasks, while being more parameter efficient and are capable of learning new types of tasks. This includes the ability to solve for and construct an extension of the Von Neumann (hardware) architecture common to all modern computers to cells and suggests new opportunities that could be explored.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把冯·诺依曼细胞自动机搬进深度学习，构造角色可学习的 Von Neumann neuron，网络结构由输入输出在细胞阵列上的位置自动决定。VNN 建立在神经算子 (neural operators) 与 Green's 函数学习之上，卷积带扩散签名；初试中 VNN 多层感知机在基础任务上超过等价深度学习变体且更省参数。
Motivation: 经典神经网络的架构需人工设计，而冯·诺依曼的细胞阵列模型中每个细胞角色由扩散过程决定，这一机制尚未被用于构造可自组织的神经元与网络。
Method: 定义具有可学习专门角色的 Von Neumann neuron，其网络为 self-engineered design，架构只依赖输入输出在细胞阵列上的结构与位置；数学框架将 VNN 表述为神经算子的扩展，通过在带扩散签名的细胞拓扑上学习 Green's 函数并以卷积实现，并证明 VNN 属于计算通用的 Cellular Machines。
Result: 初步实验显示 VNN 多层感知机在基础任务上优于等价的深度学习变体，同时参数更高效，并能学习新型任务，包括求解并构造扩展到细胞上的冯·诺依曼（硬件）架构。
Conclusion: 细胞阵列上角色可学习的神经元足以自动生成网络设计，且属于计算通用的 Cellular Machines 一类，为架构自组织与新型任务学习开辟空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SDFlow: Similarity-Driven Flow Matching for Time Series Generation
papers.abstract_en: Vector quantization (VQ) with autoregressive (AR) token modeling is a widely adopted and highly competitive paradigm for time-series generation. However, such models are fundamentally limited by exposure bias: during inference, errors can accumulate across sequential predictions, leading to pronounced quality degradation in long-horizon generation. To address this, we propose SDFlow ($\textbf{S}$imilarity-$\textbf{D}$riven $\textbf{Flow}$ Matching), a non-autoregressive framework that operates entirely in the frozen VQ latent space and enables parallel sequence generation via flow matching. We tackle three key challenges in making this transition: (1) eliminating exposure bias by replacing step-wise token prediction with a global transport map; (2) mitigating the high-dimensionality of VQ token spaces via a low-rank manifold decomposition with a learned anchor prior over the latent manifold; and (3) incorporating discrete supervision into continuous transport dynamics by introducing a categorical posterior over codebook indices within a variational flow-matching formulation. Extensive experiments show that SDFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving Discriminative Score and substantially reducing Context-FID, particularly for challenging long-sequence generation. Moreover, SDFlow provides significant inference speedups over autoregressive baselines, offering both high fidelity and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/William-Liwei/SDFlow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SDFlow 用 flow matching 在冻结的 VQ latent space 里做非自回归时间序列生成，以全局 transport map 取代逐步 token 预测，从而消除自回归推理的 exposure bias 与长序列误差累积。实验显示其 Discriminative Score 达到 SOTA、Context-FID 大幅下降，长序列生成收益最明显，并相对自回归基线有显著推理加速。
Motivation: VQ + 自回归 token 建模是时间序列生成的主流范式，但 exposure bias 使推理期误差跨步累积，长 horizon 生成质量明显退化。
Method: SDFlow 在冻结的 VQ latent space 上以 flow matching 并行生成序列：用全局 transport map 替代逐步 token 预测；对高维 VQ token 空间做 low-rank manifold decomposition 并学习 latent manifold 上的 anchor prior；在 variational flow-matching 框架中引入 codebook index 上的 categorical posterior，把离散监督接入连续 transport 动力学。
Result: 实验中 SDFlow 取得 SOTA：Discriminative Score 提升、Context-FID 显著下降，在长序列生成上改善尤其明显；相对自回归基线推理有显著加速。
Conclusion: 在冻结 VQ 空间里用 flow matching 做全局 transport，可同时摆脱自回归的 exposure bias、拿到长序列保真度与推理效率收益。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Not Every Subject Should Stay: Machine Unlearning for Noisy Engagement Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Engagement recognition datasets are typically subject-indexed and often contain noisy, subjective supervision, making post-hoc dataset revision a practical problem. Existing noisy-label and data-cleaning methods largely operate at the sample level before or during training, but do not directly address a different question: once a model has already been trained, can the influence of an entire problematic subject be removed without full retraining? We study this setting through subject-level machine unlearning as a post-hoc sanitization mechanism for engagement recognition. Starting from a baseline trained on all subjects, we rank candidate harmful subjects using a model-dependent proxy, apply a lightweight approximate unlearning update, and compare the result against an oracle model retrained from scratch on the retained subjects only. We instantiate this protocol on DAiSEE and EngageNet using Tensor-Convolution and Convolution-Transformer Network (TCCT-Net) as a fixed platform and evaluate three matched model states under the same removal scenario: baseline, unlearned, and oracle. In representative K=3 forget-set settings, the unlearned model recovers 89.3% and 92.5% of the oracle gain on EngageNet and DAiSEE, respectively, at roughly one quarter of retraining cost. Across the tested small-audit regimes, effectiveness is strongest at an intermediate forget-set size, indicating that approximate subject-level unlearning is a useful low-cost correction mechanism, but one whose benefit depends on subject selection quality and removal regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在参与度识别 (engagement recognition) 中把机器遗忘 (machine unlearning) 用作事后数据清洗：从全受试者训练的基线出发，用模型相关 proxy 排名有害受试者，做轻量近似遗忘更新，逼近只用保留受试者从头重训的 oracle。在 K=3 遗忘集设定下，EngageNet 与 DAiSEE 分别恢复 oracle 增益的 89.3% 与 92.5%，成本约为重训的四分之一；效果在中等遗忘集规模最强，且取决于受试者选择质量。
Motivation: 参与度识别数据集按受试者索引且监督含噪主观，现有噪声标签与数据清洗方法停留在样本层面，无法在模型已训练后直接移除整个问题受试者的影响而不做全量重训。
Method: 以 TCCT-Net (Tensor-Convolution and Convolution-Transformer Network) 为固定平台，从全受试者基线出发，用模型相关 proxy 对候选有害受试者排序，施加轻量近似遗忘更新，并与仅用保留受试者从头重训的 oracle 对比；在 DAiSEE 与 EngageNet 上评估 baseline、unlearned、oracle 三种同移除场景的模型状态。
Result: 在代表性 K=3 遗忘集设定下，unlearned 模型在 EngageNet 上恢复 oracle 增益的 89.3%，在 DAiSEE 上恢复 92.5%，成本约为重训的四分之一；在所测试的小规模审计区间内，中等遗忘集规模时效果最强。
Conclusion: 近似受试者级遗忘是一种低成本的纠正机制，其收益取决于受试者选择质量与移除规模区间。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Concentration and Calibration in Predictive Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract_en: Predictive Bayesian inference (PBI) represents a model-and prior-agnostic approach to standard Bayesian inference which allows users to quantify uncertainty for a functional of interest only by specifying a forward predictive model for future unobserved data. The flexibility and generality of this framework have led to a host of novel algorithms for implementing this approach, and many empirical applications, yet the reliability of the resulting inferences for the underlying statistical functional of interest remains unclear. Herein, we demonstrate that when using PBI for a population functional of interest, the resulting posterior concentrates onto a well-defined quantity that explicitly depends on the forward predictive model used to implement the predictive recursion underlying the method. Furthermore, the forward predictive model entirely determines the uncertainty quantification produced in PBI. Consequently, our results show that if the predictive model does not capture all relevant features of the data, and, even in very simple examples, the coverage of predictive Bayes credible sets for the population value of the functional of interest can be arbitrarily close to zero. We carefully explain why this occurs, and show that this behavior is directly tied to the inaccuracy of the forward predictive model used to produce future observations within the PBI framework. As a consequence, our results imply that in order for PBI to deliver calibrated posterior inferences, the resulting predictive engine used to generate posterior samples must contain, in a well-defined sense, the true DGP, else inferences generated under this framework will not be calibrated.
papers.comment: This paper has been withdrawn because its primary results have been integrated into a new, expanded study with different methodology, authors, focus and experiments. Please see https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.30622 for the updated work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文证明预测贝叶斯推断 (Predictive Bayesian Inference, PBI) 的后验收缩到一个显式依赖前向预测模型的量，且该模型完全决定不确定性量化；若预测模型未覆盖数据的真实 DGP，即使在极简单例子中，总体泛函真值的可信集覆盖率也可任意接近 0。结论是 PBI 要给出校准的后验推断，其预测引擎必须以明确意义包含真实 DGP。
Motivation: PBI 只需指定面向未来未观测数据的前向预测模型即可量化泛函不确定性，已被大量算法与实证应用采用，但其推断对目标统计泛函的可靠性此前不清楚。
Method: 对总体泛函 (population functional) 情形分析 PBI 的预测递归 (predictive recursion)，证明后验收缩到依赖前向预测模型的明确量，并论证不确定性量化完全由该模型决定；解释覆盖率退化机制并给出即使在简单例子中覆盖率可任意接近 0 的构造。
Result: 后验收缩到显式依赖前向预测模型的量；不确定性量化完全由前向预测模型决定；当预测模型未捕捉数据全部相关特征时，预测 Bayes 可信集对总体泛函真值的覆盖率在极简单例子中可任意接近 0，且该行为直接源于生成未来观测的前向预测模型不准确。
Conclusion: PBI 的校准性由预测引擎是否包含真实 DGP 决定：不包含则推断不校准，因此使用 PBI 时必须保证预测模型覆盖数据生成过程的相关特征。
Relevance: 18
