papers.title: Observable Neural ODEs for Identifiable Causal Forecasting in Continuous Time
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference in continuous-time sequential decision problems is challenged by hidden confounding and partially observed states. We show that, under explicit structural assumptions, observability of the latent state enables identification of dynamic treatment effects through a continuous-time conditional front-door adjustment, even in the presence of hidden confounding. We derive a general adjustment formula and show that it reduces to a tractable state-space formula when unobserved contemporaneous disturbances are temporally uncorrelated. This formula expresses potential-outcome distributions under alternative treatment trajectories through the measurement model, latent dynamics, and the filtering distribution over latent states. We propose Observable Neural ODEs (ObsNODEs), Neural ODE models in observable normal form that implement this tractable adjustment for causal forecasting. ObsNODEs learn continuous-time dynamics with states reconstructible from observations, enabling outcome prediction under alternative treatment paths. Experiments on synthetic, semi-synthetic, and real-world clinical data demonstrate strong performance over recent sequence models, including external validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在连续时间序贯决策中，若隐状态可观测且同期未观测扰动时间不相关，可由连续时间条件 front-door 调整在存在隐藏混杂时识别动态处理效应；据此提出处于可观测标准形的 Observable Neural ODEs (ObsNODEs)，状态可由观测重构，从而对替代处理路径做因果预报。在合成、半合成与真实临床数据上相对近期序列表现模型表现更强，并含外部验证。
Motivation: 连续时间序贯决策中的因果推断同时受隐藏混杂与部分观测状态困扰，动态处理效应难以识别，而现有序列表模型无法给出可识别的反事实预报。
Method: 先在明确结构假设下证明隐状态可观测即可用连续时间条件 front-door 调整识别动态处理效应，导出一般调整公式，并在未观测同期扰动时间不相关时化为可处理的状态空间公式，把潜在结果分布表达为测量模型、隐动力学与隐状态滤波分布的函数；再提出 Observable Neural ODEs (ObsNODEs)，即处于可观测标准形、实现该调整的 Neural ODE 模型。
Result: 在合成、半合成与真实临床数据上的实验显示相对近期序列表现模型（recent sequence models）有强表现，并包含外部验证；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 把可观测性作为结构假设并让 Neural ODE 处于可观测标准形，可在隐藏混杂下识别并执行连续时间因果预报，且在临床数据上可外部验证。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Physics-Informed Conditional Diffusion for Motion-Robust Retinal Temporal Laser Speckle Contrast Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Retinal laser speckle contrast imaging (LSCI) is a noninvasive optical modality for monitoring retinal blood flow dynamics. However, conventional temporal LSCI (tLSCI) reconstruction relies on sufficiently long speckle sequences to obtain stable temporal statistics, which makes it vulnerable to acquisition disturbances and limits effective temporal resolution. A physically informed reconstruction framework, termed RetinaDiff (Retinal Diffusion Model), is proposed for retinal tLSCI that is robust to motion and requires only a few frames. In RetinaDiff, registration based on phase correlation is first applied to stabilize the raw speckle sequence before contrast computation, reducing interframe misalignment so that fluctuations at each pixel primarily reflect true flow dynamics. From the long registered sequence this step yields a high-quality multiframe tLSCI map that serves only as the reconstruction target, while a motion-corrected contrast prior is computed independently from the few input frames. Next, guided by this prior, a conditional diffusion model performs inverse reconstruction by jointly conditioning on the registered few-frame sequence and the prior. On stable sequences acquired with an in-house retinal LSCI system, RetinaDiff improved SSIM from 0.159 to 0.533, PSNR from 14.83 to 18.06 dB, and FID from 211.50 to 111.55 compared with direct five-frame reconstruction, showing improved structural continuity and statistical stability over representative baselines. The framework also remains effective in a small number of extremely challenging cases, where both the direct five-frame input and the conventional multiframe reconstruction are severely degraded. Overall, this work provides a practical and physically grounded route for reliable retinal tLSCI reconstruction from extremely limited frames. The source code and model weights will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RetinaDiff 用相位相关配准加运动校正的对比度先验，引导条件扩散模型从仅 5 帧视网膜散斑序列反演时间 LSCI 图。在自研视网膜 LSCI 系统的稳定序列上，相对直接 5 帧重建 SSIM 从 0.159 升到 0.533、PSNR 从 14.83 升到 18.06 dB、FID 从 211.50 降到 111.55。
Motivation: 时间 LSCI 重建依赖足够长的散斑序列才能得到稳定的统计量，导致其对采集扰动（运动）敏感、有效时间分辨率受限。
Method: 先用 phase correlation 配准稳定原始散斑序列再算对比度，长序列配准后的 tLSCI 图仅作重建目标；同时从少量输入帧独立算出运动校正的对比度先验，条件扩散模型在此先验引导下同时以配准后的少帧序列和先验为条件做逆向重建。
Result: 在自研视网膜 LSCI 系统的稳定序列上，相对直接 5 帧重建：SSIM 0.159 → 0.533，PSNR 14.83 → 18.06 dB，FID 211.50 → 111.55；在少量极端困难案例中，直接 5 帧输入与常规多帧重建都严重退化时该框架仍有效。
Conclusion: 把配准后的长序列当目标、把运动校正先验当条件，可以在极少帧数下得到结构连续、统计稳定的视网膜 tLSCI 重建；源码与模型权重将在接收后发布。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: HRDexDB: A 4D Dexterous Grasping Dataset Across Human and Multiple Robot Embodiments
papers.abstract_en: We present HRDexDB, a real-world 4D dexterous grasping dataset capturing 3D hand-object interaction trajectories over time across five embodiments. The dataset comprises 3.2K trials over 100 diverse objects. Using a synchronized multi-camera system and an integrated reconstruction pipeline, HRDexDB provides multi-view and egocentric RGB observations, 3D hand geometry, robot states, and object 6D pose trajectories, together with success/failure annotations. Human and robotic hands interact with shared objects, enabling the study of embodiment-dependent grasp strategies and contact patterns. We demonstrate the dataset's utility through human-to-robot contact map transfer, visual robot-object contact estimation, and retrieval-assisted grasping. Together, these results establish HRDexDB as a resource for studying and learning dexterous interactions across human and robotic embodiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HRDexDB 是一个跨五种具身（人手与多款机器人手）的真实 4D 灵巧抓取数据集，用同步多相机与重建流水线记录 3.2K 次试验、100 个物体的三维手-物交互轨迹。人手与机器人手操作共享物体，使跨具身的接触图迁移、视觉接触估计与检索辅助抓取成为可学习任务。
Motivation: 灵巧抓取研究缺少同时覆盖人手与多种机器人手、且带时序三维接触与 6D 位姿标注的真实数据，跨具身的抓取策略与接触模式难以直接比较。
Method: 同步多相机系统配合集成重建流水线，输出多视角与第一视角 RGB、三维手几何、机器人状态、物体 6D 位姿轨迹及成功/失败标注；在此之上演示人到机器人接触图迁移、视觉机器人-物体接触估计、检索辅助抓取三项用途。
Result: 数据集包含 3.2K 次试验、100 个多样物体、5 种具身；三项演示（接触图迁移、视觉接触估计、检索辅助抓取）用于说明数据集用途。
Conclusion: 共享物体上的跨具身 4D 交互数据可支撑灵巧抓取策略与接触模式的学习和比较，HRDexDB 被定位为该方向的资源。

papers.title: Scene-Agnostic Object-Centric Representation Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent works on 3D scene understanding leverage 2D masks from visual foundation models (VFMs) to supervise radiance fields, enabling instance-level 3D segmentation. However, the supervision signals from foundation models are not fundamentally object-centric and often require additional mask pre/post-processing or specialized training and loss design to resolve mask identity conflicts across views. The learned identity of the 3D scene is scene-dependent, limiting generalizability across scenes. Therefore, we propose a dataset-level, object-centric supervision scheme to learn object representations in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). Building on a pre-trained slot attention-based Global Object Centric Learning (GOCL) module, we learn a scene-agnostic object codebook that provides consistent, identity-anchored representations across views and scenes. By coupling the codebook with the module's unsupervised object masks, we can directly supervise the identity features of 3D Gaussians without additional mask pre-/post-processing or explicit multi-view alignment. The learned scene-agnostic codebook enables object supervision and identification without per-scene fine-tuning or retraining. Our method thus introduces unsupervised object-centric learning (OCL) into 3DGS, yielding more structured representations and better generalization for downstream tasks such as robotic interaction, scene understanding, and cross-scene generalization.
papers.comment: Published at the Third Workshop for Learning 3D with Multi-View Supervision (3DMV), CVPR 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) Workshops, 2026, pp. 219-228
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 3D Gaussian Splatting 中依赖 2D 基础模型掩码、身份随场景漂移的问题，提出数据集级、场景无关的物体中心监督：基于预训练的 slot attention 模块 GOCL 学一个跨视图与跨场景一致的 object codebook，用它与无监督物体掩码直接监督 3D 高斯的身份特征，无需掩码前后处理、显式多视图对齐或逐场景微调。
Motivation: VFM 掩码监督信号并非真正物体中心，需额外掩码前后处理与专门的损失设计来解决跨视图身份冲突，且学到的身份是场景相关的，跨场景泛化受限。
Method: 在 3DGS 上构建数据集级物体中心监督：以预训练的 slot attention 式 Global Object Centric Learning (GOCL) 模块为基础，学习场景无关 object codebook，提供跨视图、跨场景一致的身份锚定表示；将 codebook 与该模块的无监督物体掩码耦合，直接监督 3D Gaussians 的身份特征，省去掩码前/后处理与显式多视图对齐。
Result: 摘要给出的是定性结果：该方法把无监督物体中心学习 (OCL) 引入 3DGS，得到更结构化的表示，并在机器人交互、场景理解与跨场景泛化等下游任务上具有更好的泛化；物体监督与识别无需逐场景微调或重训练。
Conclusion: 把物体身份监督从逐场景的 VFM 掩码换成数据集级场景无关 codebook，可在不做掩码前后处理与逐场景重训的前提下获得可跨场景复用的物体表示。

papers.title: Sinkhorn doubly stochastic attention rank decay analysis
papers.abstract_en: The self-attention mechanism is central to the success of Transformer architectures. However, standard row-stochastic attention has been shown to suffer from significant signal degradation across layers. In particular, it can induce rank collapse, resulting in increasingly uniform token representations, as well as entropy collapse, characterized by highly concentrated attention distributions. Recent work has highlighted the benefits of doubly stochastic attention as a form of entropy regularization, promoting a more balanced attention distribution and leading to improved empirical performance. In this paper, we study rank collapse across network depth and show that doubly stochastic attention matrices normalized with Sinkhorn algorithm preserve rank more effectively than standard softmax row-stochastic ones. As previously shown for softmax, skip connections are crucial to mitigate rank collapse. We empirically validate this phenomenon on both sentiment analysis and image classification tasks. Moreover, we derive a theoretical bound for the pure self-attention rank decay when using Sinkhorn normalization and find that rank decays to one doubly exponentially with depth, a phenomenon that has already been shown for softmax.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026, https://openreview.net/forum?id=fGItYoS8j1
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Transformer 深度方向上，Sinkhorn 归一化的双随机注意力 (doubly stochastic attention) 比标准 softmax 行随机注意力更有效地保持表征秩；纯自注意力的秩随深度以双重指数 (doubly exponential) 衰减到 1，与 softmax 已知结论一致，而 skip connection 仍是缓解秩坍缩的关键。
Motivation: 标准行随机注意力在层数加深时会引发秩坍缩 (rank collapse) 与熵坍缩，token 表征趋于一致，需要弄清双随机化能否以及在何种速率上改变这一退化。
Method: 用 Sinkhorn 算法把注意力矩阵归一化为双随机形式，沿网络深度分析秩衰减，并推导 Sinkhorn 归一化下纯自注意力秩衰减的理论上界；同时考察 skip connection 的作用。
Result: 推导出 Sinkhorn 归一化纯自注意力的秩随深度双重指数衰减到 1（与 softmax 情形同型）；在情感分析与图像分类任务上对秩保持现象做了经验验证。
Conclusion: 双随机注意力作为熵正则化形式比 softmax 行随机注意力更能保秩，但无法消除深度方向的秩坍缩，skip connection 仍是必要缓解手段。

papers.title: Neural Global Optimization via Iterative Refinement from Noisy Samples
papers.abstract_en: Global optimization of black-box functions from noisy samples is a fundamental challenge in machine learning and scientific computing. Traditional methods such as Bayesian Optimization often converge to local minima on multi-modal functions, while gradient-free methods require many function evaluations. We present a novel neural approach that learns to find global minima through iterative refinement. Our model takes noisy function samples and their fitted spline representation as input, then iteratively refines an initial guess toward the true global minimum. Trained on randomly generated functions with ground truth global minima obtained via exhaustive search, our method achieves a mean error of 8.05 percent on challenging multi-modal test functions, compared to 36.24 percent for the spline initialization, a 28.18 percent improvement. The model successfully finds global minima in 72 percent of test cases with error below 10 percent, demonstrating learned optimization principles rather than mere curve fitting. Our architecture combines encoding of multiple modalities including function values, derivatives, and spline coefficients with iterative position updates, enabling robust global optimization without requiring derivative information or multiple restarts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种从含噪样本做黑箱全局优化的神经迭代精化方法：输入函数采样值及其样条拟合表示，编码函数值、导数与样条系数多种模态，逐步把初始猜测推向真实全局最小值。在多峰测试函数上平均误差 8.05%，而样条初始化为 36.24%，提升 28.18 个百分点；72% 的测试案例误差低于 10%。
Motivation: 黑箱全局优化中，Bayesian Optimization 在多峰函数上常收敛到局部极小，无梯度方法又需要大量函数评估；含噪采样进一步加大了找到真实全局最小值的难度。
Method: 模型以含噪函数采样及其样条拟合表示为输入，对函数值、导数、样条系数等多模态进行编码，再通过迭代位置更新逐步精化初始猜测；训练数据为随机生成的函数，其全局最小值由穷举搜索 (exhaustive search) 提供。方法不需要导数信息，也不需要多次重启。
Result: 在有挑战性的多峰测试函数上平均误差 8.05%，对比样条初始化的 36.24%，提升 28.18 个百分点；72% 的测试案例误差低于 10%。
Conclusion: 迭代精化的神经模型学到的是优化原理而非单纯曲线拟合，可在不依赖导数与多次重启的条件下实现稳健的全局优化。

papers.title: Adaptive Semantic Communication for Wireless Image Transmission Leveraging Mixture-of-Experts Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning based semantic communication has achieved significant progress in wireless image transmission, but most existing schemes rely on fixed models and thus lack robustness to diverse image contents and dynamic channel conditions. To improve adaptability, recent studies have developed adaptive semantic communication strategies that adjust transmission or model behavior according to either source content or channel state. More recently, MoE-based semantic communication has emerged as a sparse and efficient adaptive architecture, although existing designs still mainly rely on single-driven routing. To address this limitation, we propose a novel multi-stage end-to-end image semantic communication system for multi-input multi-output (MIMO) channels, built upon an adaptive MoE Swin Transformer block. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic expert gating mechanism that jointly evaluates both real-time CSI and the semantic content of input image patches to compute adaptive routing probabilities. By selectively activating only a specialized subset of experts based on this joint condition, our approach breaks the rigid coupling of traditional adaptive methods and overcomes the bottlenecks of single-driven routing. Simulation results indicate a significant improvement in reconstruction quality over existing methods while maintaining the transmission efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向 MIMO 信道的多阶段端到端图像语义通信系统，核心是自适应 MoE Swin Transformer 块：动态专家门控同时用实时 CSI 与输入图像 patch 的语义内容计算路由概率，只激活部分专家子集，打破传统自适应方法中信道与内容的刚性耦合。仿真显示重建质量相比现有方法显著提升，同时保持传输效率。
Motivation: 现有深度学习语义通信多依赖固定模型，对多样图像内容与动态信道缺乏鲁棒性；已有的 MoE 语义通信设计仍以单驱动路由为主，无法同时响应信道状态与内容差异。
Method: 构建多阶段端到端图像语义通信系统，作用于 MIMO 信道；以自适应 MoE Swin Transformer 块为核心，动态专家门控联合评估实时 CSI 与输入图像 patch 的语义内容，得到自适应路由概率并只激活一个专家子集。
Result: 仿真结果表明，相比现有方法重建质量显著提升，同时保持传输效率；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 以 CSI 与内容联合驱动的 MoE 稀疏路由替代单驱动路由，可在不牺牲传输效率的前提下提高无线图像语义通信对内容与信道变化的适应性。

papers.title: PRUE: A Practical Recipe for Field Boundary Segmentation at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale maps of field boundaries are essential for agricultural monitoring tasks. Existing deep learning approaches for satellite-based field mapping are sensitive to illumination, spatial scale, and changes in geographic location. We conduct the first systematic evaluation of segmentation and geospatial foundation models (GFMs) for global field boundary delineation using the Fields of The World (FTW) benchmark. We evaluate 18 models under unified experimental settings, showing that a U-Net semantic segmentation model outperforms instance-based and GFM alternatives on a suite of performance and deployment metrics. We propose a new segmentation approach that combines a U-Net backbone, composite loss functions, and targeted data augmentations to enhance performance and robustness under real-world conditions. Our model achieves a 76% IoU and 47% object-F1 on FTW, an increase of 6% and 9% over the previous baseline. Our approach provides a practical framework for reliable, scalable, and reproducible field boundary delineation across model design, training, and inference. We release all models and model-derived field boundary datasets for five countries.

TL;DR: PRUE 给出大规模农田边界分割的可复现配方：在 Fields of The World (FTW) 基准上统一评测 18 个分割与地理基础模型 (GFM)，证明 U-Net 语义分割在性能与部署指标上胜过实例分割和 GFM 方案；其改进版 U-Net（复合损失 + 定向数据增强）在 FTW 上取得 76% IoU 与 47% object-F1，较此前基线分别提升 6 和 9 个百分点，并公开五国的模型与衍生边界数据集。
Motivation: 卫星农田边界制图的现有深度模型对光照、空间尺度和地理位置变化敏感，跨区域大规模部署时可靠性不足，且缺少统一设置下的系统比较。
Method: 先在 FTW 基准上用统一实验设置评测 18 个语义分割与地理基础模型，比较性能与部署指标；再提出以 U-Net 为主干、结合复合损失函数 (composite loss) 与针对性数据增强的分割方法，面向真实条件下的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 FTW 上达到 76% IoU 与 47% object-F1，较此前基线分别提高 6% 与 9%；统一评测显示 U-Net 语义分割在多项性能与部署指标上优于实例分割方案与 GFM 替代方案；发布全部模型及覆盖五个国家的模型衍生农田边界数据集。
Conclusion: 在统一评测下，精心调校的 U-Net 加复合损失与定向增强仍是全球农田边界制图中比地理基础模型更实用、可扩展且可复现的选择。

papers.title: Process-Aware AI for Rainfall-Runoff Modeling: A Mass-Conserving Neural Framework with Hydrological Process Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models can achieve high predictive accuracy in hydrological applications but often lack physical interpretability. The Mass-Conserving Perceptron (MCP) provides a physics-aware artificial intelligence (AI) framework that enforces conservation principles while allowing hydrological process relationships to be learned from data. In this study, we investigate how progressively embedding physically meaningful representations of hydrological processes within a single MCP storage unit improves predictive skill and interpretability in rainfall-runoff modeling. Starting from a minimal MCP formulation, we sequentially introduce bounded soil storage, state-dependent conductivity, variable porosity, infiltration capacity, surface ponding, vertical drainage, and nonlinear water-table dynamics. The resulting hierarchy of process-aware MCP models is evaluated across 15 catchments spanning five hydroclimatic regions of the continental United States using daily streamflow prediction as the target. Results show that progressively augmenting the internal physical structure of the MCP unit generally improves predictive performance. The influence of these process representations is strongly hydroclimate dependent: vertical drainage substantially improves model skill in arid and snow-dominated basins but reduces performance in rainfall-dominated regions, while surface ponding has comparatively small effects. The best-performing MCP configurations approach the predictive skill of a Long Short-Term Memory benchmark while maintaining explicit physical interpretability. These results demonstrate that embedding hydrological process constraints within AI architectures provides a promising pathway toward interpretable and process-aware rainfall-runoff modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出质量守恒感知机 (Mass-Conserving Perceptron, MCP) 层级：在单个储水单元内依次嵌入有界土壤储水、状态依赖导水率、变孔隙度、入渗能力、地表积水、垂向排水和非线性水位动态，用于日尺度径流预报。在全美五个水气候区 15 个流域上，逐步加入物理结构总体提升预报表现，且效果强烈依赖水气候类型：垂向排水显著改善干旱与融雪主导流域、却降低降雨主导区表现，地表积水影响很小；最优 MCP 配置接近 LSTM 基线的预报技巧，同时保持显式物理可解释性。
Motivation: 机器学习水文模型预测精度高但缺乏物理可解释性，需要在保持技巧的同时让模型内部结构对应真实水文过程。
Method: MCP 框架强制执行守恒原则，同时从数据中学习水文过程关系；从最小 MCP 形式出发，按序加入有界土壤储水、状态依赖导水率、变孔隙度、入渗能力、地表积水、垂向排水与非线性水位动态，构成过程感知 MCP 模型层级，以日径流为目标变量。
Result: 在全美五个水气候区 15 个流域的日径流预测上，逐步增强 MCP 单元内部物理结构总体改善预测表现；垂向排水在干旱与融雪主导流域显著提升技巧、在降雨主导区反而降低表现，地表积水影响相对较小；表现最好的 MCP 配置接近 Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) 基线的预报技巧。
Conclusion: 把水文过程约束嵌入 AI 架构是实现可解释、过程感知径流建模的可行路径，但各过程表征的作用强烈依赖水气候区，需按流域类型选择嵌入哪些过程。

papers.title: Unbiased Reward Modeling from Implicit Feedback for LLM Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Despite the success of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), existing reward modeling methods largely rely on explicit feedback, which is costly to collect and difficult to scale. This work studies implicit reward modeling, learning reward models from implicit user feedback, such as clicks, copies and skips. While scalable and cost-effective, implicit feedback poses two key challenges: It lacks definitive negative samples, which makes standard positive-negative classification methods inapplicable; It suffers from selection bias, where responses have heterogeneous propensities to elicit feedback, which further obscures definitive negative samples. To address these challenges, we propose ImplicitRM, which learns unbiased reward models from implicit feedback. It stratifies training samples into four latent groups using a stratification model and derives a likelihood-maximization objective that is theoretically unbiased, thereby addressing both challenges. Experiments across diverse LLM backbones and benchmark datasets validate that ImplicitRM learns accurate reward models from implicit feedback and improves performance on downstream RLHF tasks.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ImplicitRM 从点击、复制、跳过这类隐式反馈学无偏奖励模型：用分层模型把训练样本分成四个潜在组，再在组内做极大似然目标，同时解决缺少确定负样本与选择偏差两个问题。在多种 LLM backbone 与 benchmark 上，学到的奖励模型更准，并提升下游 RLHF 任务表现。
Motivation: RLHF 的奖励建模依赖显式反馈，采集贵且难规模化；隐式反馈可扩展，但没有确定负样本，且不同 response 触发反馈的倾向 (propensity) 不同，选择偏差进一步掩盖负样本。
Method: 提出 ImplicitRM：先用分层模型 (stratification model) 把训练样本划入四个潜在组，再在组上推导一个理论上无偏的极大似然目标，同时处理无负样本与选择偏差两个挑战。
Result: 在多种 LLM backbone 与多个 benchmark 数据集上，ImplicitRM 学到的奖励模型更准确，并提升下游 RLHF 任务性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 隐式反馈足以训练无偏奖励模型，前提是显式建模反馈的潜在分层与选择偏差，而不套用正负样本分类范式。

papers.title: The Dual Mechanisms of Spatial Variable Binding in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Many multimodal tasks, such as image captioning and visual question answering, require vision-language models (VLMs) to bind objects with their properties and spatial relations. Yet it remains unclear where and how such associations are computed within VLMs. In this work, we show that VLMs rely on two concurrent mechanisms to represent spatial variable binding. In the language model backbone, intermediate layers represent content-independent spatial relations on top of visual tokens corresponding to objects. However, this mechanism plays only a secondary role in shaping model predictions. Instead, the dominant source of spatial information originates in the vision encoder, whose representations encode the layout of objects and are directly exploited by the language model backbone. Notably, this spatial signal is distributed globally across visual tokens, extending beyond object regions into surrounding background areas. We validate the generalization of our findings to complex natural images from the COCO dataset, where globally amplifying the vision-derived spatial representations across all image tokens corrects spatial variable binding failures across models of various sizes. Together, our results clarify how spatial variable binding is computed within VLMs and highlight the central role of vision encoders in enabling it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLM 中空间变量绑定 (spatial variable binding) 由两条并行机制承担：语言模型骨干中间层在视觉 token 上表征内容无关的空间关系，但只起次要作用；主导信号来自视觉编码器对物体布局的编码，并被语言骨干直接利用。把视觉来源的空间表征在全部图像 token 上全局放大，可在不同规模的模型上纠正 COCO 复杂自然图像中的空间绑定失败。
Motivation: 图像描述与视觉问答等任务要求 VLM 把物体与其属性、空间关系绑定起来，但这种关联在模型内部何处、如何计算一直不清楚。
Method: 在 VLM 内部分解两条并行机制：追踪语言模型骨干中间层在物体对应视觉 token 上的内容无关空间关系表征，并检验视觉编码器的布局表征如何被语言骨干直接利用；随后在 COCO 数据集上做干预，跨多种模型规模全局放大视觉来源的空间表征。
Result: 语言骨干的空间关系机制只对预测起次要作用，主导空间信息来自视觉编码器；该空间信号全局分布于视觉 token，延伸到物体区域之外的背景区域；在 COCO 上全局放大视觉来源的空间表征可跨不同规模模型纠正空间变量绑定失败。
Conclusion: 空间变量绑定主要由视觉编码器而非语言骨干中间层计算，因此修复绑定失败应针对视觉编码器的空间表征做全局放大，而非只调整语言侧关系表征。

papers.title: FSCE: A Target-Aware Frequency-Spatial Collaborative Enhancement Framework for Noise-Resilient SAR ATR
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar automatic target recognition (SAR ATR) is severely challenged by coherent speckle noise, whose interference can be progressively amplified by hierarchical nonlinear transformations and eventually damage high-level semantic representations. To address this issue, we propose a Target-Aware Frequency-Spatial Collaborative Enhancement (FSCE) framework for noise-resilient SAR ATR, which integrates frequency-spatial modeling for early feature stabilization with semantic regularization. Specifically, we design a Frequency-Spatial Early-stage Adaptive Enhancement (FS-EAE) module at the network entrance to suppress noise propagation and preserve target structures through collaborative spatial-frequency modeling. Building upon stabilized shallow representation, we further introduce an Adaptive Policy-driven Semantic Alignment (APSA) mechanism, which uses an online teacher policy to impose top-down semantic constraints on the student and feeds semantic guidance back to the enhanced early features during training. Experiments on MSTAR, OpenSARShip, and FUSARShip demonstrate the effectiveness of this synergy. Moreover, the competitive performance of our lightweight impletation $\text{FSCE-Net}_μ$ with only 0.17M parameters suggests that the proposed framework is applicable to both high-capacity and lightweight architectures.

TL;DR: FSCE 框架在网络入口用 Frequency-Spatial Early-stage Adaptive Enhancement (FS-EAE) 模块在空-频域协同抑制相干斑噪声传播，再用 Adaptive Policy-driven Semantic Alignment (APSA) 的在线 teacher 策略自顶向下约束 student 并把语义引导反馈回早期特征。在 MSTAR、OpenSARShip、FUSARShip 上验证有效，且仅 0.17M 参数的 FSCE-Net_μ 仍具竞争力性能。
Motivation: SAR ATR 中相干斑噪声会被层级非线性变换逐步放大，最终破坏高层语义表示，需要在网络早期就稳住特征。
Method: FSCE 框架含两部分：网络入口的 FS-EAE 模块做空-频协同建模以抑制噪声传播并保留目标结构；在其稳定后的浅层表示上，APSA 机制用在线 teacher 策略对 student 施加自顶向下语义约束，并在训练中把语义引导反馈回增强后的早期特征。
Result: 在 MSTAR、OpenSARShip、FUSARShip 三个数据集上实验验证了频率-空间协同与语义正则的协同有效性；轻量实现 FSCE-Net_μ 仅 0.17M 参数仍取得有竞争力的性能，说明框架同时适用于大容量与轻量架构。
Conclusion: 在噪声进入网络早期就做空-频协同稳定、再叠加在线语义对齐，可同时支撑高容量与轻量 SAR ATR 架构的抗噪识别。

papers.title: Federated Mixture-of-Experts Alignment on Mobile Edge Networks under Data Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for on-device large language model (LLM) services on mobile edge devices has driven the adoption of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, which scale model capacity with limited computation. Since fine-tuning MoE-based LLMs relies on privacy-sensitive local data, federated learning (FL) offers a natural paradigm for collaborative training without exposing raw data. However, integrating MoE-based LLM fine-tuning into FL faces two critical challenges caused by data heterogeneity across clients: (i) divergent local data distributions drive clients to develop distinct gating preferences, so direct parameter aggregation yields a one-size-fits-none global gating network; and (ii) same-indexed experts develop disparate semantic roles across devices, leading to expert semantic blurring and degraded specialization. To address these challenges, we propose FedAlign-MoE, a federated aggregation alignment framework for edge computing systems that jointly enforces routing consistency and expert semantic alignment. Specifically, FedAlign-MoE aggregates gating behaviors by aligning routing distributions through consistency weighting and optimizes local gating networks through distribution regularization, maintaining cross-client stability while preserving discriminative local gating preferences. Meanwhile, FedAlign-MoE quantifies the semantic consistency of same-indexed experts across devices and selectively aggregates semantically aligned experts, ensuring stable and specialized global experts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedAlign-MoE outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks, achieving faster convergence and higher accuracy in non-IID federated environments with lightweight computation and efficient communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedAlign-MoE 在非 IID 联邦学习中同时对齐 MoE 的路由分布与同索引专家语义：用一致性加权聚合门控行为、分布正则约束本地门控，并只选择性聚合语义一致的专家。摘要称其在非 IID 联邦环境下比 SOTA 基线收敛更快、准确率更高，且计算轻量、通信高效。
Motivation: 移动端 MoE LLM 微调依赖隐私敏感的本地数据，客户端数据异质会同时破坏门控与专家：直接参数聚合得到 one-size-fits-none 的全局门控网络，同索引专家语义漂移导致专长模糊。
Method: 提出 FedAlign-MoE，一个联邦聚合对齐框架，两路并行：一是通过一致性加权 (consistency weighting) 对齐各客户端路由分布、以分布正则 (distribution regularization) 优化本地门控网络，保持跨客户端稳定同时保留判别性本地偏好；二是量化跨设备同索引专家的语义一致性，只选择性聚合语义对齐的专家。
Result: 在非 IID 联邦环境下，FedAlign-MoE 相对 SOTA 基线收敛更快、准确率更高，同时保持轻量计算与高效通信；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 在数据异质的联邦 MoE 微调中，路由一致性与专家语义对齐必须一起做，才能得到既稳定又保持专长的全局门控与专家。

papers.title: Deep Time-Series Forecasting in 10 Years: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Autocorrelation is a common property of time-series, where each observation is dependent on its predecessors. In deep time-series forecasting, it raises two central challenges: (1) designing backbone architectures to model autocorrelation in history sequences, and (2) devising loss functions to model autocorrelation in label sequences. Recent studies have made strides in tackling these challenges, but a systematic survey examining both aspects remains lacking. To bridge this gap, this paper reviews deep time-series forecasting from an autocorrelation modeling perspective, offering two contributions beyond existing surveys. First, it introduces a taxonomy that jointly covers both backbone architectures and loss functions, whereas prior surveys provide limited coverage of the latter. Second, it analyzes the motivations and insights underlying the surveyed literature from a unified autocorrelation perspective, providing a holistic overview of the field's evolution. Additional resources and details are available at https://github.com/Master-PLC/Awesome-TSF-Papers.
papers.comment: This survey is accepted by IEEE TPAMI
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇从自相关 (autocorrelation) 视角统摄深度时间序列预报的综述，把骨干架构建模历史序列自相关与损失函数建模标签序列自相关两条线放进同一套分类体系，并按统一视角重述各文献的动机与洞见。它覆盖了以往综述较少涉及的损失函数部分，配套维护 Awesome-TSF-Papers 论文列表。
Motivation: 深度时间序列预报中自相关带来两个核心难题：历史序列的骨干建模与标签序列的损失建模，而现有综述对后者覆盖有限，缺少同时审视两方面的系统梳理。
Method: 提出同时覆盖骨干架构与损失函数的分类体系 (taxonomy)，并以统一的自相关视角分析被综述文献的动机与洞见；资源与细节发布在 GitHub 仓库 Awesome-TSF-Papers。
Result: 这是一篇综述性论文，给出的产出是新的双维度分类体系与统一自相关视角下的文献演化分析，以及配套的 Awesome-TSF-Papers 资源库；摘要未给出实验指标。
Conclusion: 把骨干与损失放在自相关这一条主线上，可以更完整地刻画深度时间序列预报领域的发展脉络，损失函数是既有综述的明显缺口。

papers.title: World Properties without World Models: Distributional Associations and the Interpretation of Decoding Results from Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A growing literature shows that variables can be linearly decoded from the activations of large language models (LLMs). These range from properties of the world, such as the locations of cities and the lifetimes of historical figures, to emotions and pain. Such findings are often taken as evidence that language models go beyond surface text statistics and form internal models of the world. We show that static word embeddings (fixed, context-insensitive representations learned from corpus statistics) of the same or matched stimuli support much of the same decoding. Across four published cases (place, time, pain and emotion), static vectors predict coordinates and year of death (R^2 = 0.42-0.59), separate pain from matched control sentences (held-out AUC 0.85-0.88), and classify twelve emotions in stories written to avoid naming them (AUC 0.84-0.88). Because static embeddings assign each word a single, context-independent vector, these results are a lower bound on what word associations alone can support. The LLMs retain clear advantages on representational tests, and causal and behavioral findings remain outside the scope of the baseline. On the original authors' entities, where we reproduce their Llama-2 results, the transformer's advantage lies mostly in placing historical figures in the right century and places in the right country, coarse sorting that richer word associations would be expected to improve; within those groups every representation orders items poorly. Static vectors for disambiguated Wikipedia entities, which carry the associations of a particular place or person rather than of the words in its name, close most of the remaining gap, matching Pythia-2.8B on coordinates and Llama-2-7B on year of death. These results indicate that decodability alone cannot distinguish a representation of a property from information already available in fixed distributional associations.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Substantially revised to include analyses of full released Gurnee & Tegmark datasets with Llama-2 and Pythia comparisons; replaces the earlier 100-city, 194-figure analysis; also includes entity-level vectors, and pain and emotion decoding
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 静态词向量本身就能复现大量「LLM 激活可线性解码世界属性」的结果：在地点、时间、疼痛、情绪四个已发表案例上，固定词嵌入预测坐标与死亡年份 R²=0.42–0.59，疼痛区分 held-out AUC 0.85–0.88，十二类情绪分类 AUC 0.84–0.88。消歧后的 Wikipedia 实体静态向量在坐标上追平 Pythia-2.8B、在死亡年份上追平 Llama-2-7B。结论是：仅凭可解码性无法区分「表征了属性」与「固定分布关联里已有该信息」。
Motivation: 大量文献把 LLM 激活中可线性解码的城市坐标、历史人物寿命、疼痛与情绪当作模型超越表面文本统计、形成内部世界模型的证据，但缺少一个只用语料统计的对照基线来判断解码信号的下界。
Method: 用固定、上下文不敏感的静态词嵌入作为基线，在四个已发表解码案例（place、time、pain、emotion）上重跑解码；复现原作者的 Llama-2 结果并对比 Pythia；再用携带具体地点/人物关联的消歧 Wikipedia 实体向量补齐剩余差距，同时分析 Gurnee & Tegmark 完整发布数据集（Llama-2 与 Pythia 对比），并加入实体级向量以及疼痛与情绪解码。
Result: 静态向量预测坐标与死亡年份 R²=0.42–0.59；疼痛句与匹配控制句 held-out AUC 0.85–0.88；在刻意不点名情绪的故事中分类十二类情绪 AUC 0.84–0.88。LLM 的优势主要在把历史人物放进正确世纪、把地点放进正确国家这类粗粒度排序，组内各表征排序都很差；消歧 Wikipedia 实体静态向量在坐标上追平 Pythia-2.8B、在死亡年份上追平 Llama-2-7B。
Conclusion: 可解码性本身不能区分「表征了某属性」与「固定分布关联中已含该信息」，静态词关联构成解码结果的下界；LLM 在表征性测试上仍有明确优势，因果与行为层面的证据不在该基线射程内。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Real-Time Generation of Game Video Commentary with Multimodal LLMs: Pause-Aware Decoding Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video commentary generation provides textual descriptions of ongoing events in videos. It supports accessibility and engagement in domains such as sports, esports, and livestreaming. Commentary generation involves two essential decisions: what to say and when to say it. While recent prompting-based approaches using multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in content generation, they largely ignore the timing aspect. We investigate whether in-context prompting alone can support real-time commentary generation that is both semantically relevant and well-timed. We propose two prompting-based decoding strategies: 1) a fixed-interval approach, and 2) a novel dynamic interval-based decoding approach that adjusts the next prediction timing based on the estimated duration of the previous utterance. Both methods enable pause-aware generation without any fine-tuning. Experiments on Japanese and English datasets of racing and fighting games show that the dynamic interval-based decoding can generate commentary more closely aligned with human utterance timing and content using prompting alone. We release a multilingual benchmark dataset, trained models, and implementations to support future research on real-time video commentary generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对多模态大模型 (MLLM) 实时游戏解说只管说什么、不管何时说的问题，提出两种免微调的 pause-aware 解码策略：固定间隔解码与按上一句预估时长动态调整下一次预测时机的动态间隔解码。在日英双语的赛车与格斗游戏数据集上，动态间隔解码仅靠 in-context prompting 生成的解说在时机与内容上都更贴近人类解说。
Motivation: 近期基于 prompting 的 MLLM 解说方法在内容生成上表现不错，但基本忽略 timing 这一维度，导致实时解说语义相关却时机不对。
Method: 两种 prompting-based 解码策略：固定间隔 (fixed-interval) 解码，以及动态间隔 (dynamic interval-based) 解码——根据上一句解说的预估时长调整下一次预测时机；两者均无需微调，仅依赖 in-context prompting。
Result: 在日语和英语的赛车与格斗游戏数据集上，动态间隔解码仅用 prompting 生成的解说在人类解说时机与内容两方面都更接近；同时发布多语言 benchmark 数据集、训练好的模型与实现。
Conclusion: 仅靠 in-context prompting 配合按上一句时长自适应的解码时机，就能同时改善实时解说的时机与内容，无需微调。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adaptive Bidirectional Task Interaction for Joint Segmentation and Classification of Breast Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Joint lesion segmentation and tissue classification in breast ultrasound are usually trained with a shared encoder, so the two branches stop exchanging information once their decoders separate. That is exactly where boundary detail and semantic evidence are most complementary. The proposed method restores this exchange during decoding and, because its value differs between images, lets the network decide per image how much to keep. A Task Interaction Module (TIM) at each of four decoder levels passes pooled boundary context into the classification representation and modulates decoder channels with class-conditioned priors. An Adaptive Interaction Weighting (AIW) unit then blends interacted and original features with a coefficient computed for each image and level. On BUSI the model reaches 74.19% IoU and 90.60% accuracy, and on BUSI-WHU 86.40% IoU and 95.00% accuracy, ahead of encoder-sharing multi-task, transformer segmentation and decoder-interaction baselines evaluated under the same protocol. The ablation shows that multi-scale context and cross-task exchange are not independent: applied separately they contribute 4.00 points of IoU in total, applied together 6.76. Adding the adaptive blend to task interaction alone raises AUC from 94.41% to 97.31%, indicating that the blend acts primarily on the classification branch. Code: https://github.com/C-loud-Nine/Adaptive-Task-Interaction-BUS.

papers.title: [b] = [d] - [t] + [p]: Self-supervised Speech Models Discover Phonological Vector Arithmetic
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) are known to encode rich phonetic information, yet how this information is structured remains underexplored. We conduct a comprehensive study across 96 languages to analyze the underlying structure of S3M representations, with particular attention to phonological vectors. We first show that there exist linear directions within the model's representation space that correspond to phonological features. We further demonstrate that the scale of these phonological vectors correlate to the degree of acoustic realization of their corresponding phonological features in a continuous manner. For example, the difference between [d] and [t] yields a voicing vector: adding this vector to [p] produces [b], while scaling it results in a continuum of voicing. Together, these findings indicate that S3Ms encode speech using phonologically interpretable and compositional vectors, demonstrating phonological vector arithmetic. All code and interactive demos are available at https://github.com/juice500ml/phonetic-arithmetic .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 96 种语言上系统检验自监督语音模型 (S3M) 的表征结构，发现表征空间中存在与音系特征对应的线性方向，且这些音系向量的模长与对应特征的声学实现程度连续相关。[d] 与 [t] 之差构成浊音 (voicing) 向量，加到 [p] 上得到 [b]，缩放该向量则产生浊音连续统，说明 S3M 以可解释、可组合的音系向量编码语音。
Motivation: 自监督语音模型已知编码了丰富的语音信息，但这些信息在表征空间中如何组织仍缺乏系统刻画，尤其是音系特征是否以可组合的几何形式存在。
Method: 跨 96 种语言对 S3M 表征做综合分析，定位与音系特征对应的线性方向，并检验音系向量模长与特征声学实现程度的连续关系；以 [d]−[t] 得到浊音向量、施加于 [p] 与缩放操作验证向量算术，代码与交互 demo 开源。
Result: 96 种语言的分析显示表征空间中存在对应音系特征的线性方向；音系向量模长与特征声学实现程度呈连续相关；[d]−[t] 浊音向量加到 [p] 上产生 [b]，缩放产生浊音连续统。
Conclusion: S3M 用音系上可解释且可组合的向量编码语音，音系向量算术 (phonological vector arithmetic) 在其表征中真实存在。

papers.title: Multi-Probe Zero Collision Hash (MPZCH): Mitigating Embedding Collisions and Enhancing Model Freshness in Large-Scale Recommenders
papers.abstract_en: Embedding tables are critical components of large-scale recommendation systems, facilitating the efficient mapping of high-cardinality categorical features into dense vector representations. However, as the volume of unique IDs expands, traditional hash-based indexing methods suffer from collisions that degrade model performance and personalization quality. We present Multi-Probe Zero Collision Hash (MPZCH), a novel indexing mechanism based on linear probing that effectively mitigates embedding collisions. With reasonable table sizing, it often eliminates these collisions entirely while maintaining production-scale efficiency. MPZCH utilizes auxiliary tensors and high-performance CUDA kernels to implement configurable probing and active eviction policies. By retiring obsolete IDs and resetting reassigned slots, MPZCH prevents the stale embedding inheritance typical of hash-based methods, ensuring new features learn effectively from scratch. Despite its collision-mitigation overhead, the system maintains training QPS and inference latency comparable to existing methods. Rigorous online experiments demonstrate that MPZCH achieves zero collisions for user embeddings and significantly improves item embedding freshness and quality. The solution has been released within the open-source TorchRec library for the broader community.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), 2026, pp. 1333-1342
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MPZCH 用线性探测 (linear probing) 加可配置探测与主动驱逐策略，在合理表容量下把大规模推荐系统 embedding 的哈希碰撞降到零，并通过回收过期 ID、重置被重新分配的槽位切断旧 embedding 继承，让新特征从零学起。线上实验显示用户 embedding 达到零碰撞，item embedding 新鲜度与质量显著提升，训练 QPS 与推理延迟与现有方法相当。
Motivation: 推荐系统唯一 ID 规模膨胀后，传统哈希索引产生碰撞，损害模型性能与个性化质量，且新 ID 会继承旧 embedding（stale inheritance）。
Method: MPZCH 是基于线性探测的索引机制：用辅助张量与高性能 CUDA kernel 实现可配置探测和主动驱逐策略，回收过期 ID 并重置被重新分配的槽位；已开源进 TorchRec 库。
Result: 线上实验中用户 embedding 实现零碰撞 (zero collisions)，item embedding 新鲜度与质量显著提升；尽管有碰撞缓解开销，训练 QPS 与推理延迟仍与现有方法相当。
Conclusion: 在合理表容量下，线性探测加主动驱逐可以在生产规模上消除 embedding 碰撞并阻断 stale embedding 继承，而不牺牲训练吞吐与推理延迟。

papers.title: SimToolReal: An Object-Centric Policy for Zero-Shot Dexterous Tool Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: The ability to manipulate tools significantly expands the set of tasks a robot can perform. Yet, tool manipulation represents a challenging class of dexterity, requiring grasping thin objects, in-hand object rotations, and forceful interactions. Since collecting teleoperation data for these behaviors is challenging, sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising alternative. However, prior approaches typically require substantial engineering effort to model objects and tune reward functions for each task. In this work, we propose SimToolReal, taking a step towards generalizing sim-to-real RL policies for tool manipulation. Instead of focusing on a single object and task, we procedurally generate a large variety of tool-like object primitives in simulation and train a single RL policy with the universal goal of manipulating each object to random goal poses. This approach enables SimToolReal to perform general dexterous tool manipulation at test-time without any object or task-specific training. We demonstrate that SimToolReal outperforms prior retargeting and fixed-grasp methods by 37% while matching the performance of specialist RL policies trained on specific target objects and tasks. Finally, we show that SimToolReal generalizes across a diverse set of everyday tools, achieving strong zero-shot performance over 120 real-world rollouts spanning 24 tasks, 12 object instances, and 6 tool categories.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 16 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://simtoolreal.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimToolReal 在仿真中程序化生成大量工具类物体原语，训练单一 RL 策略以「把任意物体操纵到随机目标位姿」为通用目标，测试时无需任何物体或任务专属训练即可零样本操作真实工具。在 120 次真实世界 rollout（24 任务、12 个物体实例、6 类工具）上，它比既有的 retargeting 与 fixed-grasp 方法高 37%，并追平针对特定目标物体与任务训练的 specialist RL 策略。
Motivation: 灵巧工具操纵需要抓细长物体、手内旋转与用力交互，遥操作数据难采集；而现有 sim-to-real RL 方法要为每个任务建模物体、调奖励函数，工程量大且不通用。
Method: 不针对单一物体与任务，而是在仿真中程序化生成多种工具类物体原语 (tool-like object primitives)，用通用目标「把每个物体操纵到随机目标位姿」训练一个 RL 策略，把物体与任务的适配从训练期推迟到测试期。
Result: 在 120 次真实世界 rollouts、覆盖 24 个任务、12 个物体实例、6 类日常工具的评测中，SimToolReal 超过既有的 retargeting 与 fixed-grasp 方法 37%，同时达到针对特定目标物体和任务训练的 specialist RL 策略的性能水平。
Conclusion: 把工具操纵重写为「任意物体到随机目标位姿」的单一通用目标并靠程序化生成的物体多样性训练，可以在真实工具上实现零样本灵巧操作，无需逐物体或逐任务的再训练。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ReLoop: Structured Modeling and Behavioral Verification for Reliable LLM-Based Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language problem descriptions into optimization code, but the code is prone to silent failures: it executes and returns a solver-feasible solution while encoding a semantically incorrect formulation. On compositional problems, the resulting feasibility-correctness gap reaches 90 percentage points. We introduce ReLoop, which combines two mechanisms. Structured generation decomposes code production into a four-stage reasoning chain (understand, formalize, synthesize, verify) to reduce formulation errors during generation. Behavioral verification detects the errors that remain by testing whether the formulation responds correctly to solver-based parameter perturbation, a signal that comes from the solver rather than from LLM self-review and requires no ground truth. The two mechanisms address different error structures: structured generation gives the largest gain on compositional problems (+8.5pp accuracy on RetailOpt-190 with Claude Opus 4.6), and behavioral verification gives its largest gain on localized defects (+4.4pp on MAMO-ComplexLP). With diagnostic execution recovery, ReLoop reaches 100% executable code on Claude Opus 4.6, and relative to direct generation it raises or preserves every reported metric of the three chat-tuned foundation models on all three benchmarks. For the narrowly fine-tuned SFT model we test, the chain-of-thought prompt conflicts with its learned output format and lowers its accuracy on MAMO-ComplexLP; we document and analyze this interaction. We release RetailOpt-190, 190 compositional retail optimization scenarios in which several constraints interact.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReLoop 针对 LLM 把自然语言优化问题写成可执行但语义错误的代码，提出结构化生成（understand→formalize→synthesize→verify 四段推理链）加行为验证（用 solver 参数扰动检验响应，不依赖 LLM 自评与 ground truth）。组合问题上可行性-正确性差距可达 90 个百分点；结构化生成在 RetailOpt-190 上用 Claude Opus 4.6 提升 +8.5pp，行为验证在 MAMO-ComplexLP 局部缺陷上提升 +4.4pp，配合诊断式执行恢复达到 100% 可执行代码。
Motivation: LLM 生成的优化代码会静默失败：运行成功、solver 可行，但公式语义错误；在多约束组合问题上可行性与正确性差距高达 90 个百分点，现有 LLM 自评难以发现这类缺陷。
Method: 结构化生成把代码产出拆成 understand、formalize、synthesize、verify 四阶段推理链以在生成期减少公式错误；行为验证通过 solver 参数扰动下公式响应是否正确来检测残留错误，信号来自 solver 而非 LLM 自审且无需 ground truth；另加诊断式执行恢复。
Result: 组合问题上可行性-正确性差距达 90 个百分点；结构化生成在 RetailOpt-190 上以 Claude Op Opus 4.6 提升 +8.5pp accuracy，行为验证在 MAMO-ComplexLP 上提升 +4.4pp；诊断式执行恢复使 Claude Opus 4.6 达到 100% 可执行代码，相对直接生成在三个 chat-tuned 基础模型、三个 benchmark 上所有报告指标均提升或持平；对窄域 SFT 模型，CoT prompt 与其学到的输出格式冲突，反而降低其在 MAMO-ComplexLP 上的准确率。
Conclusion: 结构化生成与行为验证针对不同错误结构（组合性 vs 局部缺陷）互补，可让 LLM 优化代码在无 ground truth 下更可靠；但 CoT prompt 不适用于窄域 SFT 模型，会与其输出格式冲突而降性能。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: 组合问题上可行性-正确性差距达 90 个百分点；结构化生成在 RetailOpt-190 上以 Claude Op Opus 4.6 提升 +8.5pp accuracy，行为验证在 MAMO-ComplexLP 上提升 +4.4pp；诊断式执行恢复使 Claude Opus 4.6 达到 100% 可执行代码，相对直接生成在三个 chat-tuned 基础模型、三个 benchmark 上所有报告指标均提升或持平；对窄域 SFT 模型，CoT prompt 与其学到的输出格式冲突，反而降低其在 MAMO-ComplexLP 上的准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结构化生成与行为验证针对不同错误结构（组合性 vs 局部缺陷）互补，可让 LLM 优化代码在无 ground truth 下更可靠；但 CoT prompt 不适用于窄域 SFT 模型，会与其输出格式冲突而降性能。

papers.title: Scalable next-scale autoregression for medical image generation across anatomical regions
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive pretraining has been key to the scalability of large language models, yet medical generative foundation models remain predominantly based on diffusion. Here we introduce MedVAR, the first foundation model for all-round medical image generation through autoregressive training, and find it offers improved generation quality and efficiency, stronger scalability, and broader adaptability to downstream clinical tasks than diffusion-based models. A tokenizer trained on medical images and separate semantic and structural controls enable generation across six anatomical regions in computed tomography and magnetic resonance imaging. Trained on 438,905 slices from 40 datasets, including seven internal clinical centres, MedVAR generates images 12-19 times faster than 100-step diffusion baselines. Generation quality improves with model size. Pretraining on generated images improves seven-centre hepatocellular carcinoma segmentation Dice from 0.615 to 0.632, while reconstruction using MedVAR images approaches the volumetric segmentation performance of fully sampled volumes. Membership inference reaches 3.54% sensitivity at a 1% false-positive rate, while copy detection performs near chance. These findings establish next-scale autoregression as a scalable and versatile approach to medical image generation and downstream analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MedVAR 用 next-scale 自回归取代扩散做医学图像生成基础模型，靠医学图像 tokenizer 与语义/结构双控件在 CT 和 MRI 的 6 个解剖区域生成图像。在 40 个数据集、438,905 张切片（含 7 家内部临床中心）上训练后，比 100 步扩散基线快 12–19 倍，且生成质量随模型规模上升；用生成图像做预训练把 7 中心肝细胞癌分割 Dice 从 0.615 提到 0.632。
Motivation: 医学生成式基础模型基本都建立在 diffusion 上，训练与采样代价高、跨解剖区域适配弱，作者要检验自回归预训练能否像在 LLM 中那样带来可扩展性与下游临床任务的通用性。
Method: 提出 MedVAR：在医学图像上训练 tokenizer，用 next-scale 自回归训练做生成，配独立的语义控制与结构控制以覆盖 CT/MRI 六个解剖区域；训练数据为 40 个数据集共 438,905 张切片，其中七个为内部临床中心；下游用生成图像做预训练与重建，并做成员推断 (membership inference) 与复制检测 (copy detection) 隐私评估。
Result: 生成速度比 100 步 diffusion 基线快 12–19 倍，生成质量随模型规模增大而提升；用生成图像预训练使七中心肝细胞癌分割 Dice 从 0.615 升至 0.632，MedVAR 图像重建的体积分割性能接近全采集体积；成员推断在 1% 假阳性率下灵敏度为 3.54%，复制检测接近随机水平。

papers.title: UniST-Pred: A Robust Unified Framework for Spatio-Temporal Traffic Forecasting in Transportation Networks Under Disruptions
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal traffic forecasting is a core component of intelligent transportation systems, supporting various downstream tasks such as signal control and network-level traffic management. In real-world deployments, forecasting models must operate under structural and observational uncertainties, conditions that are rarely considered in model design. Recent approaches achieve strong short-term predictive performance by tightly coupling spatial and temporal modeling, often at the cost of increased complexity and limited modularity. In contrast, efficient time-series models capture long-range temporal dependencies without relying on explicit network structure. We propose UniST-Pred, a unified spatio-temporal forecasting framework that first decouples temporal modeling from spatial representation learning, then integrates both through adaptive representation-level fusion. To assess robustness of the proposed approach, we construct a dataset based on an agent-based, microscopic traffic simulator (MATSim) and evaluate UniST-Pred under severe network disconnection scenarios. Additionally, we benchmark UniST-Pred on standard traffic prediction datasets, demonstrating its competitive performance against existing well-established models despite a lightweight design. The results illustrate that UniST-Pred maintains strong predictive performance across both real-world and simulated datasets, while also yielding interpretable spatio-temporal representations under infrastructure disruptions. The source code and the generated dataset are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/UniST-Pred-EF27
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniST-Pred 把时空交通预报解耦为独立的时间建模与空间表示学习，再用自适应表示级融合 (adaptive representation-level fusion) 拼回，在网络中断等结构扰动下仍保持强预测性能。基于 MATSim 微观交通仿真器构建的严重网络断连数据集与标准交通数据集上的评测显示，其表现与成熟模型相当，且模型轻量、表示可解释。
Motivation: 真实部署中预报模型要面对结构与观测不确定性，而这在模型设计中很少被考虑；现有方法靠紧耦合时空建模换取短期精度，代价是复杂度高、模块性差。
Method: 先将时间建模与空间表示学习解耦（时间侧用高效时间序列模型捕捉长程依赖，不依赖显式网络结构），再通过自适应表示级融合整合两者；用基于 MATSim 智能体微观仿真器的数据集评估严重网络断连场景，并在标准交通预测数据集上做基准对比。
Result: 在 MATSim 构建的严重网络断连场景与标准交通预测数据集上，UniST-Pred 均保持强预测性能，与既有成熟模型相比具有竞争力，同时保持轻量设计；源码与生成数据集已公开。
Conclusion: 先解耦时间与空间建模再做表示级融合，可以在网络基础设施中断下同时保住预报性能、模型轻量性与时空表示的可解释性。

papers.title: RAM-Net: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Sparsely Addressable State
papers.abstract_en: Linear attention offers an efficient alternative to full attention with a fixed-size recurrent state. However, this state is shared by all tokens, so information from distinct tokens becomes superposed within it and produces inter-token interference that degrades long-range fine-grained recall. To address this issue, we propose RAM-Net, which replaces dense access to a shared state with sparse address-based access. RAM-Net organizes the recurrent state as a fixed-size array of independent slots and uses an Address Decoder that maps each key or query into a sparse address, selecting a small subset of slots to write to or read from at each step. This design directs tokens with non-overlapping addresses to disjoint slots, suppressing inter-token interference, while keeping per-step state access dependent only on the number of selected slots rather than the total state size. Empirically, RAM-Net outperforms strong recurrent baselines on fine-grained long-range retrieval and achieves the lowest perplexity with competitive commonsense reasoning. It does so while accessing fewer state elements per step than all baselines, e.g., $8\times$ fewer than Mamba2.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://muoncat.github.io/ramnet_web/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RAM-Net 把线性注意力的共享递归状态改成固定大小的独立槽位数组，用 Address Decoder 把每个 key/query 映射为稀疏地址，只读写少量槽位，从而让地址不重叠的 token 落到互不相交的槽位、抑制 token 间干扰。在细粒度长程检索上超过强递归基线并取得最低 perplexity，同时常识推理有竞争力，每步访问的状态元素比所有基线都少（例如比 Mamba2 少 8×）。
Motivation: 线性注意力用固定大小递归状态替代 full attention，但该状态被所有 token 共享，不同 token 的信息叠加产生 inter-token interference，损害长程细粒度召回。
Method: 把递归状态组织为固定大小的独立槽位数组，Address Decoder 将每个 key 或 query 映射为稀疏地址，每步只选中一小部分槽位写入或读取；每步状态访问代价只取决于被选槽位数而非状态总大小。
Result: 在细粒度长程检索 (fine-grained long-range retrieval) 上超过强递归基线，并取得最低 perplexity，同时常识推理 (commonsense reasoning) 有竞争力；每步访问的状态元素少于全部基线，例如比 Mamba2 少 8×。
Conclusion: 用稀疏地址化状态替代共享稠密状态，可以在保持线性时间序列建模的同时抑制 token 间干扰并降低每步状态访问量。

papers.title: Learning to Configure Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Configuring LLM-based agent systems involves choosing workflows, tools, token budgets, and prompts from a large combinatorial design space, and is typically handled today by fixed templates or hand-tuned heuristics that apply the same configuration regardless of query difficulty, leading to brittle behavior and wasted compute. To address this, we formulate agent configuration as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) where each configuration acts as a temporally extended option that determines how an agent system processes a query, and introduce introduce ARC (Agentic Resource & Configuration learner), a lightweight hierarchical policy that dynamically selects query-specific agent configurations. Across reasoning, tool-use, and agentic benchmarks, ARC consistently improves over budget-matched tool-augmented LLMs, increasing average reasoning accuracy by 31.3%, tool-use accuracy by 13.95%, and doubling τ-Bench (Airline) Pass^1 success from 9.0% to 18.0%. These results demonstrate that learning per-query agent configurations is a powerful alternative to "one size fits all" designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM agent 系统的配置选择（工作流、工具、token 预算、提示词）形式化为半马尔可夫决策过程 (SMDP)，其中每个配置是决定系统如何处理查询的时延扩展 option，并提出轻量分层策略 ARC 动态选出按查询定制的配置。在推理、工具使用与 agentic 基准上，ARC 相对预算对齐的工具增强 LLM 平均推理准确率提升 31.3%、工具使用准确率提升 13.95%，τ-Bench (Airline) Pass^1 从 9.0% 翻倍到 18.0%。
Motivation: LLM agent 配置空间是工作流、工具、token 预算与提示词的组合爆炸，目前靠固定模板或手工启发式，对所有查询用同一套配置，导致行为脆弱且浪费算力。
Method: 将 agent 配置建模为 SMDP，每个配置作为时延扩展 option；提出 ARC (Agentic Resource & Configuration learner)，一个按查询动态选择配置的轻量分层策略 (hierarchical policy)。
Result: 在推理、工具使用与 agentic 基准上，ARC 相对预算匹配的工具增强 LLM 平均推理准确率提高 31.3%，工具使用准确率提高 13.95%，τ-Bench (Airline) Pass^1 成功率从 9.0% 翻倍至 18.0%。
Conclusion: 按查询学习 agent 配置是优于“一刀切”设计的有效替代，能同时改善准确率与算力使用。

papers.title: Uncovering Cross-Objective Interference in Multi-Objective Alignment
papers.abstract_en: We study a persistent failure mode in multi-objective alignment for large language models (LLMs), in which scalarized training improves only some objectives while the others degrade. We formalize this phenomenon as cross-objective interference and, to our knowledge, conduct the first systematic study of scalarization algorithms for multi-objective LLM alignment. The study shows that interference is pervasive across algorithms yet strongly model-dependent. To understand how interference arises, we derive a local covariance law stating that an objective improves or degrades at first order according to the sign of the covariance between its reward and the scalarized score. We extend this law to the clipped surrogate objectives of modern reinforcement fine-tuning and show that it still holds under mild conditions. Building on this law, we propose COVariance-floor Enforced Reweighting (COVER), a one-sided controller that raises an objective's weight only when the covariance between its reward and the clipped advantage weight falls below a target. Through extensive experiments, we find that COVER can mitigate cross-objective interference while matching linear scalarization when objectives already co-improve. Finally, to explain why interference is model-dependent, we complement the local covariance law with a global convergence analysis. This analysis gives sufficient conditions for the non-convex scalarized objective to satisfy the Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition and relates interference to model geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM 多目标对齐的标量化训练中，某些目标提升而另一些目标下降的跨目标干扰 (cross-objective interference) 普遍存在且强烈依赖模型。作者推导局部协方差定律：某目标的一阶升降由其 reward 与标量化得分的协方差符号决定，并据此提出单侧控制器 COVER，仅当 reward 与 clipped advantage 权重的协方差低于目标值时才上调该目标权重。实验中 COVER 缓解干扰，同时在目标本就共同提升时与线性标量化持平。
Motivation: 多目标对齐的标量化训练常出现只改善部分目标、其余目标反而变差的持续失败模式，此前缺少对各类标量化算法的系统研究，也缺少解释干扰为何随模型变化的理论。
Method: 先把该现象形式化为跨目标干扰并系统考察标量化算法；推导局部协方差定律并扩展到现代强化微调 (reinforcement fine-tuning) 的 clipped surrogate 目标；据此提出 COVariance-floor Enforced Reweighting (COVER) 单侧控制器；再以全局收敛分析给出非凸标量化目标满足 Polyak--Łojasiewicz 条件的充分条件，把干扰与模型几何联系起来。
Result: 干扰在各算法间普遍存在但强烈依赖模型；局部协方差定律在 clipped surrogate 目标与温和条件下仍成立；实验中 COVER 缓解跨目标干扰，并在目标已共同提升时匹配线性标量化。
Conclusion: 跨目标干扰可由 reward 与标量化得分的协方差符号在一阶上判定并被单侧权重控制器缓解，其模型依赖性则由非凸标量化目标的 Polyak--Łojasiewicz 几何解释。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.tldr: LLM 多目标对齐的标量化训练中，某些目标提升而另一些目标下降的跨目标干扰 (cross-objective interference) 普遍存在且强烈依赖模型。作者推导局部协方差定律：某目标的一阶升降由其 reward 与标量化得分的协方差符号决定，并据此提出单侧控制器 COVER，仅当 reward 与 clipped advantage 权重的协方差低于目标值时才上调该目标权重。实验中 COVER 缓解干扰，同时在目标本就共同提升时与线性标量化持平。
summary_sections.motivation: 多目标对齐的标量化训练常出现只改善部分目标、其余目标反而变差的持续失败模式，此前缺少对各类标量化算法的系统研究，也缺少解释干扰为何随模型变化的理论。
summary_sections.method: 先把该现象形式化为跨目标干扰并系统考察标量化算法；推导局部协方差定律并扩展到现代强化微调 (reinforcement fine-tuning) 的 clipped surrogate 目标；据此提出 COVariance-floor Enforced Reweighting (COVER) 单侧控制器；再以全局收敛分析给出非凸标量化目标满足 Polyak--Łojasiewicz 条件的充分条件，把干扰与模型几何联系起来。
summary_sections.result: 干扰在各算法间普遍存在但强烈依赖模型；局部协方差定律在 clipped surrogate 目标与温和条件下仍成立；实验中 COVER 缓解跨目标干扰，并在目标已共同提升时匹配线性标量化。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨目标干扰可由 reward 与标量化得分的协方差符号在一阶上判定并被单侧权重控制器缓解，其模型依赖性则由非凸标量化目标的 Polyak--Łojasiewicz 几何解释。

papers.title: REPA-G: Test-Time Conditioning with Representation-Aligned Visual Features
papers.abstract_en: While representation alignment with self-supervised models has been shown to improve diffusion model training, its potential for enhancing inference-time conditioning remains largely unexplored. We introduce Representation-Aligned Guidance (REPA-G), a framework that leverages these aligned representations, with rich semantic properties, to enable test-time conditioning from features, in generation. By optimizing a similarity objective (the potential) at inference, we steer the denoising process toward a conditioned representation extracted from a pre-trained feature extractor. Our method provides versatile control at multiple levels of granularity, ranging from patch level matching via single patches to broad semantic guidance using global image feature tokens. We further extend this to multi-concept composition, allowing for the faithful combination of distinct concepts. REPA-G operates entirely at inference time with no additional training required, offering a flexible and precise alternative to often ambiguous text prompts or coarse class labels. Our approach achieves high-quality, diverse generations on ImageNet and COCO. Code is available at https://github.com/valeoai/REPA-G
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: REPA-G 在推理时用与表征对齐的视觉特征做测试时条件控制：优化相似度目标（potential）把去噪过程引向预训练特征提取器抽出的条件表征，无需额外训练。支持从单 patch 匹配到全局图像特征 token 的多粒度控制，并可做多概念组合，在 ImageNet 与 COCO 上生成高质量、多样化的结果。
Motivation: 与自监督模型的表征对齐已被证明能改善扩散模型训练，但其在推理时条件控制上的潜力基本未被探索；文本提示或类别标签作为条件往往含糊或过粗。
Method: 提出 Representation-Aligned Guidance (REPA-G)：在推理阶段优化相似度目标（potential），引导去噪过程对齐来自预训练特征提取器的条件表征；控制粒度覆盖单 patch 匹配到全局图像特征 token，并扩展到多概念组合，全程只在推理时运行、不需训练。
Result: 在 ImageNet 与 COCO 上实现高质量且多样的生成；支持 patch 级到全局 token 级的多粒度条件控制与多概念忠实组合；推理时运行、无需额外训练。
Conclusion: 表征对齐不仅可用于训练阶段，其对齐特征本身就能充当推理时的条件信号，为含糊文本提示或粗粒度类别标签提供更灵活精确的替代控制方式。

papers.title: Recommender system in X inadvertently profiles ideological positions of users
papers.abstract_en: Several data protection laws restrict processing that reveals political opinions, irrespective of the controller's intent. Whether recommender systems do so as a by-product of optimizing relevance has not been measured. From 2.5 million ``Who to Follow'' recommendations shown to 682 volunteers in France, we reconstructed an approximation of the embedding used by X's recommender for 26,509 accounts, computing survey-calibrated ideology scores. One direction in this embedding orders users by Left-Right position (Pearson rho = 0.887), distinct from directions tracking age, gender or popularity. We show this scale exists and affects the recommendations computed from the embedding. Removing it diversified recommendations at a limited cost in accuracy. We document a consequential form of emergent political representation that current definitions of profiling do not clearly address.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 从 X 平台 250 万条 Who to Follow 推荐中重建推荐系统嵌入的近似，发现其中一个方向按左右政治立场排列用户（Pearson rho = 0.887），且该方向确实影响生成的推荐；移除这一方向可使推荐更多样，代价是准确率小幅下降。
Motivation: 多部数据保护法禁止处理揭示政治观点的数据，但推荐系统在优化相关性时是否顺带推断政治立场从未被测量，现行 profiling 定义也难以覆盖这种涌现式政治表征。
Method: 收集 682 名法国志愿者看到的 250 万条 Who to Follow 推荐，重建 X 推荐系统对 26,509 个账号所用嵌入的近似，计算经问卷校准的意识形态得分，并检验嵌入方向与推荐结果的关系。
Result: 嵌入中一个方向按左右立场排序用户，Pearson rho = 0.887，且与追踪年龄、性别、受欢迎度的方向相区分；移除该方向使推荐更多样，准确率代价有限。
Conclusion: 推荐系统在优化相关性时会涌现出明确的政治表征维度，且该维度实际左右输出推荐，这是现行 profiling 定义未清晰覆盖的一种后果性政治表征形式。

papers.title: Local exponential stability of mean-field Langevin descent-ascent and associated particle system
papers.abstract_en: We study the mean-field Langevin descent-ascent (MFL-DA), a coupled optimization dynamics on the space of probability measures for entropically regularized two-player zero-sum games, together with its associated interacting particle system. For general nonconvex-nonconcave payoffs, Wang and Chizat (COLT 2024) asked whether the original single-timescale MFL-DA converges to the mixed Nash equilibrium and, if so, at what rate. We prove a local affirmative answer in Wasserstein space: if the initial datum is sufficiently close to the mixed Nash equilibrium, then the mean-field dynamics converges to it exponentially fast at a quantitative rate. We further show that the finite-$N$ particle system inherits this stability up to times exponential in $N$, with an $N$-independent exponential rate modulo a finite-particle error floor. Combined with the recent counterexample of Mourrat and Pillaud-Vivien for MFL-DA, which shows that global convergence cannot hold in general, our theorem completes the positive local counterpart of the Wang-Chizat question: the mixed Nash equilibrium has a robust basin of attraction, stable under both the mean-field flow and its finite-particle approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对熵正则化两人零和博弈的 mean-field Langevin descent-ascent (MFL-DA)，证明混合 Nash 均衡在 Wasserstein 空间具有鲁棒吸引域：初值足够接近时均场动力学以可量化速率指数收敛，有限 N 粒子系统在指数于 N 的时间内继承该稳定性，速率与 N 无关、仅带有限粒子误差地板。
Motivation: Wang 和 Chizat (COLT 2024) 提出单时间尺度 MFL-DA 对一般非凸非凹收益是否收敛到混合 Nash 均衡及收敛速率的问题；Mourrat 与 Pillaud-Vivien 的反例说明全局收敛一般不成立，需要正面的局部结论。
Method: 在概率测度空间上分析带熵正则的耦合下降-上升动力学 MFL-DA 及其相互作用粒子系统；对一般非凸非凹收益，在混合 Nash 均衡附近做 Wasserstein 空间的局部稳定性论证，给出定量指数速率，并把结论传递到有限 N 粒子系统。
Result: 初值充分接近混合 Nash 均衡时均场动力学指数快收敛且速率可量化；有限 N 粒子系统在指数于 N 的时间内继承该稳定性，指数速率与 N 无关，仅存在有限粒子误差地板。
Conclusion: 结合 Mourrat 与 Pillaud-Vivien 的反例，MFL-DA 的混合 Nash 均衡具有对均场流及其有限粒子逼近都稳定的鲁棒吸引域，构成 Wang-Chizat 问题的正面局部答案。

papers.title: Fast and Efficient Asynchronous Gossip Algorithm for Robust and Non-Smooth Convex Decentralized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Asynchronous primal-dual methods for decentralized non-smooth convex optimization often require each node to maintain $\mathcal{O}(d)$ auxiliary variables, where $d$ is its degree. This dependence on degree increases memory requirements and can amplify the effects of stale information, especially in dense networks. Motivated by the challenge of frugal memory management in decentralized learning, we introduce Goal-PD, an asynchronous gossip-based primal-dual algorithm that maintains only two variables per node, regardless of the node's degree. We establish almost-sure convergence of Goal-PD to a minimizer of the underlying optimization problem, and prove linear convergence when the objective functions are piecewise linear-quadratic. For decentralized mean estimation, we show that pairwise averaging is a special case of Goal-PD, which establishes a direct link between the proposed primal-dual framework and classical gossip. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets over various network topologies, with non-smooth objectives including median estimation, show that Goal-PD converges faster than existing asynchronous baselines while requiring significantly less memory by design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出异步 gossip 原对偶算法 Goal-PD，每个节点只维护两个辅助变量、与节点度数 d 无关，从而把 O(d) 内存压到常数。证明了对底层优化问题的几乎必然收敛，目标为分段线性二次 (piecewise linear-quadratic) 时证明线性收敛；在含中位数估计的非光滑目标上，合成与真实数据集、多种网络拓扑的实验中比现有异步基线收敛更快且内存显著更少。
Motivation: 去中心化非光滑凸优化的异步原对偶方法通常要求每个节点维护 O(d) 个辅助变量，内存随度数增长，并在稠密网络中放大陈旧 (stale) 信息的影响。
Method: Goal-PD：基于 gossip 的异步原对偶算法，每节点仅保留两个变量（与度数无关）；理论上给出几乎必然收敛到极小点的证明，以及目标函数为分段线性二次时的线性收敛证明，并说明 pairwise averaging 是 Goal-PD 的特例。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集、多种网络拓扑、含中位数估计等非光滑目标的实验中，Goal-PD 比现有异步基线收敛更快，且按设计所需内存显著更少；理论上每节点变量数为 2 而非 O(d)，并有几乎必然收敛与分段线性二次情形的线性收敛保证。
Conclusion: 把每节点辅助变量数降到常数即可在去中心化非光滑凸学习中同时改善内存占用与收敛速度，且原对偶框架与经典 gossip 平均直接相通。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Cross-Lingual Activation Steering for Multilingual Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit strong multilingual capabilities, yet significant performance gaps persist between dominant and non-dominant languages. Prior work attributes this gap to imbalances between shared and language-specific neurons in multilingual representations. We propose Cross-Lingual Activation Steering (CLAS), a training-free inference-time intervention that selectively modulates neuron activations. We evaluate CLAS on classification and generation benchmarks, achieving average improvements of 2.3% (Acc.) and 3.4% (F1) respectively, while maintaining high-resource language performance. We discover that effective transfer operates through functional divergence rather than strict alignment; performance gains correlate with increased language cluster separation. Our results demonstrate that targeted activation steering can unlock latent multilingual capacity in existing models without modification to model weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLAS 是一种免训练的推理时干预，选择性调制多语言模型中共享与语言特定神经元的激活，以缩小主流与非主流语言的性能差距。在分类与生成基准上平均提升 2.3%（Acc.）与 3.4%（F1），同时保持高资源语言性能；增益与语言簇分离度上升相关，说明有效迁移靠功能分化而非严格对齐。
Motivation: 多语言 LLM 在主流与非主流语言之间存在持续的性能差距，既有工作将其归因于共享神经元与语言特定神经元的失衡，而修改权重的干预成本高。
Method: 提出 Cross-Lingual Activation Steering (CLAS)：免训练、推理时选择性调制神经元激活，在分类与生成两类基准上评测，不改动模型权重。
Result: 分类基准平均准确率 (Acc.) 提升 2.3%，生成基准平均 F1 提升 3.4%，同时保持高资源语言性能；性能增益与语言簇分离度 (language cluster separation) 增大相关。
Conclusion: 定向激活解锁现有模型的潜在多语言能力而无需改权重；有效跨语言迁移经由功能分化 (functional divergence) 而非严格对齐实现。

papers.title: Precomputing Multi-Agent Path Replanning Using Temporal Flexibility
papers.abstract_en: Executing a multi-agent plan can be challenging when an agent is delayed, because this typically creates conflicts with other agents. So, we need to quickly find a new safe plan. Replanning only the delayed agent often does not yield an efficient plan, and sometimes cannot even yield a feasible one. On the other hand, replanning other agents may lead to a cascade of changes and delays, and it is computationally expensive. We show how to efficiently replan a single delayed agent by tracking and using the temporal flexibility of other agents while avoiding cascading delays. This flexibility is the maximum delay that the agent can take without changing the order with agents other than the initially delayed agent, or further delaying other agents. Our algorithm, FlexSIPP, precomputes all possible plans for the delayed agent and returns the changes to the other agents within the given scenario. We demonstrate our method in a real-world case study of replanning trains in the densely-used Dutch railway network and in the MovingAI MAPF benchmark set. Our experiments show that FlexSIPP provides effective solutions relevant to real-world adjustments, and within a reasonable timeframe.
papers.comment: Revision after a bug was found in the code. The fixes do not alter the conclusions; the MAPF results are slightly different from those published at SoCS26. The railway results changed as the code was rearranged, now returning proper valid paths, with a new data representation to show the actual differences between FlexSIPP and MAEDeR. In the Fig1 example a3s route changed to show a1s rerouting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体计划中某个 agent 被延迟时，FlexSIPP 通过预先计算其他 agent 的 temporal flexibility（在不改变与他人顺序、也不进一步拖延他人的前提下可承受的最大延迟），一次性预计算延迟 agent 的全部可行计划，并直接给出其他 agent 需要的改动，从而避免级联延误。在荷兰稠密铁路网的真实案例与 MovingAI MAPF 基准上，该方法在合理时间内给出有效解。
Motivation: 只重规划被延迟的 agent 往往得不到高效甚至不可行的方案，而重规划其他 agent 又会引发级联改动与延误、计算代价高，需要在快速与低扰动之间取平衡。
Method: 提出 FlexSIPP：跟踪并利用其他 agent 的 temporal flexibility，预先计算被延迟 agent 的所有可能计划，并在给定场景下返回对其他 agent 的改动；在荷兰铁路网重规划案例与 MovingAI MAPF 基准上做实验。

papers.title: Stochastic Siamese MAE Pretraining for Longitudinal Medical Images
papers.abstract_en: Temporally aware image representations are crucial for capturing disease progression in 3D volumes of longitudinal medical datasets. However, recent state-of-the-art self-supervised learning approaches like Masked Autoencoding (MAE), despite their strong representation learning capabilities, lack temporal awareness. In this paper, we propose STAMP (Stochastic Temporal Autoencoder with Masked Pretraining), a Siamese MAE framework that encodes temporal information through a stochastic process by conditioning on the time difference between the 2 input volumes. Unlike deterministic Siamese approaches, which compare scans from different time points but fail to account for the inherent uncertainty in disease evolution, STAMP learns temporal dynamics stochastically by reframing the MAE reconstruction loss as a conditional variational inference objective. We evaluated STAMP on two OCT and one MRI datasets with multiple visits per patient. STAMP pretrained ViT models outperformed both existing temporal MAE methods and foundation models on different late stage Age-Related Macular Degeneration and Alzheimer's Disease progression prediction which require models to learn the underlying non-deterministic temporal dynamics of the diseases.
papers.comment: Provisional Accept at IEEE TMI. Code is available in https://github.com/EmreTaha/STAMP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STAMP 把 Siamese MAE 重写为以两份 3D 体之间时间差为条件的条件变分推断目标，用随机过程编码疾病进展的不确定性。在两个 OCT 与一个 MRI 数据集（多访视、晚期 AMD 与阿尔茨海默病进展预测）上，预训练 ViT 超过既有 temporal MAE 方法与 foundation models。
Motivation: 纵向医学影像需要时间感知的表征来刻画疾病进展，但 MAE 等主流自监督方法缺乏时间感知；确定性 Siamese 只比较不同时间点的扫描，无法反映疾病演化的内在不确定性。
Method: 提出 STAMP（Stochastic Temporal Autoencoder with Masked Pretraining）：Siamese MAE 框架，编码器以两份输入体的时间差为条件，通过随机过程注入时间信息，并把 MAE 重建损失重构为条件变分推断目标；随后用该预训练权重初始化 ViT 做进展预测。
Result: 在两个 OCT 数据集与一个 MRI 数据集（每患者多次访视）上评估晚期年龄相关性黄斑变性 (AMD) 与阿尔茨海默病进展预测，STAMP 预训练的 ViT 在不同任务上均超过现有 temporal MAE 方法与 foundation models。
Conclusion: 把纵向重建目标写成以时间差为条件的随机（变分）形式，能让自监督模型学到疾病进展这类非确定性时间动态，优于确定性 Siamese 与无时间感知的 MAE。

papers.title: Rethinking Fine-Tuning: Unlocking Hidden Capabilities in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning has become the dominant paradigm for adapting Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet most approaches rely on explicit weight updates that introduce a fundamental trade-off. Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) may perturb pretrained representations due to cross-modal gradient interference, whereas Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods rely on additive modules, such as low-rank adapters, which may limit adaptation capacity. In this paper, we rethink VLM adaptation from a structural selection framework that adapts VLMs without modifying backbone weights, and we propose Mask Fine-Tuning (MFT). MFT learns masks that selectively route information through existing pretrained connections, dynamically uncovering subnetworks that better align pretrained representations with downstream objectives. Extensive experiments show that MFT provides an effective structural alternative to both FFT and PEFT, consistently achieving superior performance across multiple vision-language benchmarks without adding knowledge or altering the deployment architecture. Moreover, our analysis with MFT provides new insights into how pretrained VLMs reorganize their internal representational pathways during adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mask Fine-Tuning (MFT) 不改骨干权重，而是学习掩码在既有预训练连接上选择性路由信息，动态挖出与下游目标更匹配的子网络。在多个 vision-language benchmark 上，MFT 相对 Full Fine-Tuning 与 PEFT（如 LoRA）持续取得更优性能，且不引入新知识、不改变部署架构。
Motivation: VLM 适配存在结构性权衡：FFT 的跨模态梯度干扰会扰动预训练表示，PEFT 依赖 LoRA 等加性模块又限制适配容量。
Method: 把 VLM 适配建模为结构选择问题，提出 Mask Fine-Tuning (MFT)：学习掩码在不修改骨干权重的前提下选择性路由信息，通过既有预训练连接动态揭示子网络，使预训练表示与下游任务对齐。
Result: 在多个 vision-language benchmark 上，MFT 相对 FFT 与 PEFT 一致取得更优性能，且不增加知识、不改变部署架构；分析给出预训练 VLM 在适配期间重组内部表示路径的新见解。
Conclusion: 结构选择（掩码路由既有连接）可作为 FFT 与 PEFT 的有效替代范式，同时揭示 VLM 适配时内部表示路径的重组机制。

papers.title: Computationally efficient goodness-of-fit tests through kernelized Stein discrepancy
papers.abstract_en: Models with intractable normalizing constants are widely used in statistics and machine learning. Assessing the adequacy of such models poses significant challenges: obtaining samples from the fitted model often requires sophisticated sampling algorithms. Moreover, model fitting sometimes requires iterative numerical optimization, making bootstrap procedures that require repeated refitting computationally expensive. In this paper, we leverage the kernel-based testing framework to develop a general semiparametric goodness-of-fit test based on the kernelized Stein discrepancy. We establish the consistency and the asymptotic null distribution of the test statistic under general nuisance estimation. To produce a level-$α$ test, we propose a novel influence-adjusted wild bootstrap that requires neither refitting the model nor sampling from it. We prove the consistency of the proposed bootstrap test procedure under the null and the alternative, and characterize its limiting power under contiguous local alternatives. Across simulations ranging from classical normality testing to models with intractable likelihoods, the proposed test delivers competitive or superior power at a computational cost orders of magnitude lower than that of existing approaches. We illustrate the method by assessing the adequacy of a protein signaling network model for reverse-phase protein array data from lung adenocarcinoma tumors. As a complementary insight, we show that the SKSD test can be regarded as a nonparametric score test under exponentially tilted models, connecting score-based and distance-based goodness-of-fit testing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对含不可积归一化常数、且拟合需反复重优化的模型，提出基于核化 Stein 差异 (kernelized Stein discrepancy) 的半参数拟合优度检验，配套 influence-adjusted wild bootstrap：既不重拟合也不从模型采样即可构造 level-α 检验。模拟中从正态性检验到含不可似然模型，功效与现有方法相当或更优，计算成本低若干个数量级。
Motivation: 含不可积归一化常数的模型难以采样评估拟合充分性，而 bootstrap 又需反复重拟合，代价高昂。
Method: 在核检验框架下构造基于 kernelized Stein discrepancy 的半参数拟合优度统计量，证明一般 nuisance 估计下的一致性与渐近零分布；提出 influence-adjusted wild bootstrap 构造 level-α 检验，并证明零假设与备择下的一致性及在邻近局部备择下的极限功效。
Result: 模拟范围从经典正态性检验到含不可似然的模型，所提检验功效 competitive or superior，计算成本比现有方法低 orders of magnitude；在肺腺癌肿瘤反相蛋白芯片 (reverse-phase protein array) 数据上评估蛋白信号网络模型的充分性；并证明 SKSD 检验可视为指数倾斜模型下的非参数得分检验。
Conclusion: 不重拟合、不采样的 wild bootstrap 就能给出有水平保证且功效有竞争力的 Stein 型拟合优度检验，并把基于得分与基于距离的拟合优度检验统一到指数倾斜视角下。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Machine learning Majorana topology using unsupervised and supervised learning
papers.abstract_en: In unsupervised learning, the training data for deep learning does not come with any labels, thus forcing the algorithm to discover hidden patterns in the data for discerning useful information. This, in principle, could be a powerful tool in identifying topological order since topology does not always manifest in obvious physical ways (e.g., topological superconductivity) for its decisive confirmation. The problem, however, is that unsupervised learning is a difficult challenge, necessitating huge computing resources, which may not always work. In the current work, we combine unsupervised and supervised learning to establish that unlabeled (simulated) data in the Majorana splitting in realistic short disordered nanowires may enable not only a distinction between `topological' and `trivial', but also where their crossover happens in the relevant parameter space. This may be a useful tool in identifying topology in experimental Majorana nanowires.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把无监督与有监督学习结合，用无标签的模拟 Majorana 分裂数据在含无序的短纳米线中区分拓扑相与平庸相，并定位两者在参数空间中的交叉位置，为实验 Majorana 纳米线的拓扑判定提供工具。
Motivation: 拓扑序（如拓扑超导）不一定以明显的物理信号显现，难以直接确认；纯无监督学习既困难又消耗大量算力且未必成功。
Method: 结合无监督与有监督深度学习，训练数据为含无序的短纳米线中 Majorana 分裂的模拟（无标签）数据，目标是同时区分类别并定位参数空间中的拓扑—平庸交叉。
Result: 建立表明无标签的 Majorana 分裂模拟数据不仅能区分‘拓扑’与‘平庸’，还能给出二者交叉在相关参数空间中的位置。
Conclusion: 无标签模拟数据配合无监督加有监督学习可作为识别实验 Majorana 纳米线中拓扑的有用工具。

papers.title: MiniScope: Authorizing Agents with Least-Privilege Permissions
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly granted autonomous access to sensitive user data and third-party services, making effective permission management a critical security challenge. Existing permission models, however, typically rely on flat permission structures that fail to balance security with usability: fine-grained confirmation induces user fatigue, while coarse-grained or persistent approval leads to overprivileged agents. To address this tradeoff, we propose a task-centric, hierarchical permission model that treats an agent as a delegate operating within a task-specific role instead of requiring a separate permission decision for every tool call. Building on this model, we present MiniScope, an end-to-end permission system for agents that automates permission-hierarchy discovery and enforces contextual least privilege at runtime. Our evaluation shows that MiniScope reduces simulated permission confirmations by 43.4%-89.4% for cautious and typical personas relative to per-tool prompting and mitigates all privilege-escalation attacks with negligible impact on utility and runtime. Applied to real-world deployments, MiniScope further uncovers six overprivileged connector configurations in ChatGPT and Claude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MiniScope 提出以任务为中心的分层权限模型，把 agent 当作在任务特定角色内行事的受托者，而非每次工具调用都单独审批，并在运行时强制上下文最小权限。相对逐工具提示，模拟权限确认减少 43.4%–89.4%（谨慎与典型 persona），全部权限提升攻击被阻断，效用与运行时开销可忽略；在 ChatGPT 与 Claude 真实部署中发现 6 个过度授权的 connector 配置。
Motivation: 现有权限模型用扁平结构，细粒度确认导致用户疲劳，粗粒度或持久授权又造成 agent 权限过宽，安全与可用性难以兼顾。
Method: MiniScope 是端到端 agent 权限系统：先自动发现权限层级，再在运行时按任务角色施加上下文最小权限；评估覆盖谨慎与典型 persona 的模拟确认、权限提升攻击，以及真实部署检查。
Result: 相对 per-tool prompting，模拟权限确认减少 43.4%–89.4%（cautious 与 typical persona）；缓解全部权限提升攻击，效用与运行时影响可忽略；在 ChatGPT 与 Claude 真实部署中发现 6 个过度授权的 connector 配置。
Conclusion: 把权限从逐工具决策改为任务级角色加运行时上下文最小权限，可在不牺牲效用的前提下同时压低确认负担并挡住权限提升。
