papers.title: Variational Physics-Informed Ansatz for Reconstructing Hidden Interaction Networks from Steady States
papers.abstract_en: Inferring interaction structure from steady-state observations is a central inverse problem when transient trajectories are unavailable. Here we formulate this problem as simultaneous compatibility of a single interaction operator with equilibrium constraints generated by heterogeneous perturbations. We introduce a variational physics-informed ansatz that represents the unknown operator as a trainable object and minimizes the resulting steady-state residuals across experiments. In the affine-interaction setting, the stacked equilibrium equations yield explicit finite-sample identifiability conditions: unique recovery is controlled by the rank of the compatibility matrix after elimination of experiment-wise gauge freedom. Synthetic benchmarks on pairwise, directed, weighted, empirical-topology, and selected higher-order systems illustrate this identifiability picture and show how additional heterogeneous steady states improve structural discrimination under the stated assumptions. The results clarify a concrete steady-state reconstruction regime in which equilibrium observations alone can determine hidden interaction operators when the governing dynamics are known and node-level equilibria are fully observed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把从稳态观测反推隐藏相互作用网络写成单一相互作用算子与多组异质扰动平衡约束的相容性问题，用可训练的 physics-informed ansatz 最小化各实验的稳态残差。在仿射相互作用下，消去实验级规范自由度后，相容矩阵的秩给出有限样本可辨识条件；合成基准（成对、有向、加权、经验拓扑及部分高阶系统）显示更多异质稳态在既定假设下提升结构区分能力。
Motivation: 缺少瞬态轨迹时，反推隐藏相互作用结构是核心逆问题；需要判定仅凭平衡观测在什么条件下能唯一恢复算子。
Method: 提出变分 physics-informed ansatz：把未知相互作用算子表示为可训练对象，跨实验最小化稳态残差；在仿射相互作用设定下堆叠平衡方程，消去实验级规范自由度后由相容矩阵的秩导出可辨识条件。
Result: 给出仿射设定下由相容矩阵秩控制的唯一恢复条件；在 pairwise、directed、weighted、empirical-topology 与部分 higher-order 合成系统上说明该可辨识图景，并显示增加异质稳态可提升结构区分。
Conclusion: 当动力学已知且节点级平衡被完全观测时，仅凭平衡观测即可确定隐藏相互作用算子，且异质稳态越多结构可辨识性越强。

papers.title: InStyle: Instant Appearance Stylization of 3D Shapes
papers.abstract_en: 3D stylization is central to game development, virtual reality, and digital arts, where the demand for diverse assets calls for scalable methods that support fast, high-fidelity manipulation. Existing text-to-3D stylization methods typically distill from 2D image editors, requiring time-intensive per-asset optimization and exhibiting multi-view inconsistency due to the limitations of current text-to-image models, which makes them impractical for large-scale production. In this paper, we introduce GaussianBlender, a pioneering feed-forward framework for text-driven 3D stylization that performs edits instantly at inference. Our method learns structured, disentangled latent spaces with controlled information sharing for geometry and appearance from spatially-grouped 3D Gaussians. A latent diffusion model then applies text-conditioned edits on these learned representations. Comprehensive evaluations show that GaussianBlender not only delivers instant, high-fidelity, geometry-preserving, multi-view consistent stylization, but also surpasses methods that require per-instance test-time optimization - unlocking practical, democratized 3D stylization at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GaussianBlender：把 3D Gaussian 按空间分组，学习几何与外观解耦且可控共享的隐空间，再用文本条件的 latent diffusion 在推理时直接做编辑，实现即时、保几何、多视角一致的 3D 形状风格化。作者称其在综合评测中超过需要逐实例测试时优化的方法。
Motivation: 现有 text-to-3D 风格化多从 2D 图像编辑器蒸馏，需要耗时的逐资产优化，且受 text-to-image 模型限制而多视角不一致，难以用于大规模生产。
Method: GaussianBlender 是前馈式 (feed-forward) 文本驱动 3D 风格化框架：从空间分组的 3D Gaussians 学习结构化解耦的隐空间，几何与外观之间受控共享信息；随后由 latent diffusion 模型在这些表示上施加文本条件编辑，编辑在推理阶段即时完成。
Result: 综合评测显示该方法提供即时、高保真、保几何且多视角一致的风格化，并超过需要逐实例测试时优化 (per-instance test-time optimization) 的方法；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 把风格化从逐资产优化改为前馈隐空间编辑，可让 3D 风格化在保持多视角一致性的同时达到规模化生产可用的速度。

papers.title: Optimal Transportation and Alignment Between Gaussian Measures
papers.abstract_en: Optimal transport (OT) and Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) alignment provide interpretable geometric frameworks for comparing, transforming, and aggregating heterogeneous datasets---tasks ubiquitous in data science and machine learning. Because these frameworks are computationally expensive, large-scale applications often rely on closed-form solutions for Gaussian distributions under quadratic cost. This work provides a comprehensive treatment of Gaussian, quadratic cost OT and inner product GW (IGW) alignment, closing several gaps in the literature to broaden applicability. First, we treat the open problem of IGW alignment between uncentered Gaussians on separable Hilbert spaces by giving an exact variational characterization through a quadratic optimization over isometries and co-isometries (orthogonal matrices in finite dimensions), for which we derive tight analytic upper and lower bounds. If at least one Gaussian measure is centered, the solution reduces to a fully closed-form expression, which we further extend to an analytic solution for the IGW barycenter between centered Gaussians. We also present a reduction of Gaussian multimarginal OT with pairwise quadratic costs to a tractable optimization problem and prove that every second-order stationary point of this problem is globally optimal. To demonstrate utility, we compare embedding distributions of already-trained language-model distillations and cluster synthetic users using covariance spectra of their text embeddings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 给出高斯测度下二次代价 OT 与内积 Gromov-Wasserstein (IGW) 对齐的完整理论处理：非中心高斯在可分 Hilbert 空间上的 IGW 获得经由等距与余等距二次优化的精确变分刻画并导出紧的解析上下界；至少一个高斯中心时退化为完全闭式解，并进一步给出中心高斯 IGW barycenter 的解析解。多边 Gaussian OT 被约化为可解优化问题，且证明其每个二阶驻点都是全局最优。
Motivation: OT 与 GW 对齐计算代价高，大规模应用只能依赖高斯闭式解，但非中心高斯 IGW、中心高斯 barycenter 与多边 Gaussian OT 在文献中留有缺口，限制了适用范围。
Method: 对可分 Hilbert 空间上非中心高斯的 IGW 给出经由等距与余等距（有限维即正交矩阵）二次优化的精确变分刻画并推导紧的解析上下界；把高斯多边 OT（成对二次代价）约化为可解优化问题并证明二阶驻点即全局最优；用已训练语言模型蒸馏的嵌入分布与基于文本嵌入协方差谱的合成用户聚类演示用途。
Result: 非中心高斯 IGW 得到精确变分刻画与紧的解析上下界；单侧中心时化为完全闭式解，并扩展为中心高斯 IGW barycenter 的解析解；多边 Gaussian OT 约化问题的每个二阶驻点全局最优；在语言模型蒸馏嵌入分布比较与合成用户聚类上展示实用性。
Conclusion: 高斯二次代价 OT 与 IGW 的若干开放问题可被闭式或可解优化完全解决，二阶驻点的全局最优性保证使多边情形可直接求解。

papers.title: A Footprint-Aware, High-Resolution Approach for Carbon Flux Prediction Across Diverse Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Eddy-covariance (EC) flux towers provide in situ measurements of $CO_2$ flux and serve as the ground-truth data for predictive `upscaling' models derived from satellite products. However, many satellites now resolve spatial scales smaller than an EC tower's footprint. We show theoretically that upscaling models trained on high-resolution data in heterogeneous landscapes must account for an EC tower's footprint to avoid bias in pixel-level predictors. To address this problem, we introduce Footprint-Aware Regression (FAR), a deep-learning framework that simultaneously predicts spatial footprints and pixel-level estimates of $CO_2$ flux, and show it yields unbiased pixel-level predictions given sufficient training data. We demonstrate FAR on our AMERI-FAR25 dataset, which combines 205 site-years of tower data with corresponding Landsat scenes, and show that FAR outperforms non-footprint-aware models. FAR increased half-hourly $R^2$ from approximately 0.575 to 0.634 and reduced RMSE by about 7% relative to the best fixed-footprint baseline on a dataset of withheld sites. Gains are larger for monthly and yearly averages relative to a coarser 990 m baseline. Site-level analyses show that these gains extend across multiple ecosystem types. These performance gains are observed whether footprints are learned jointly or estimated independently using an established footprint model, despite substantial variation in footprint size between methods. In a regional comparison over the Western Cascades, FAR produces flux estimates with a distribution comparable to that of existing high-resolution process-based models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 涡动相关 (EC) 通量塔的足迹大于卫星像元时，用高分辨率数据训练的上尺度模型会在像元级预测器上引入偏差。提出 Footprint-Aware Regression (FAR)，同时预测空间足迹与像元级 CO2 通量，在 AMERI-FAR25（205 site-years 塔数据 + Landsat）上把半小时 R² 从约 0.575 提到 0.634、RMSE 相对最优固定足迹基线降约 7%，且联合学习或独立用既有足迹模型估计足迹都能取得这些增益。
Motivation: 卫星已能分辨小于 EC 塔足迹的空间尺度，异质景观中若上尺度模型忽略足迹，像元级预测器会带偏差，削弱通量塔作为地面真值的作用。
Method: 提出深度学习框架 Footprint-Aware Regression (FAR)，同时输出空间足迹与像元级 CO2 通量估计；在自建 AMERI-FAR25 数据集（205 site-years 塔数据配对应 Landsat 影像）上训练，并与非足迹感知模型及固定足迹基线、990 m 更粗基线对比，足迹可联合学习或用既有足迹模型独立估计。
Result: 在留出站点数据集上，半小时 R² 从约 0.575 提升到 0.634，RMSE 相对最优固定足迹基线降低约 7%；相对 990 m 更粗基线，月平均与年平均上的增益更大。站点级分析显示增益覆盖多种生态系统类型；足迹联合学习与独立估计两种方式都观测到这些增益，尽管两法足迹尺寸差异显著。Western Cascades 区域对比中，FAR 的通量估计分布与既有高分辨率过程模型相当。
Conclusion: 上尺度模型必须显式处理 EC 塔足迹才能在像元级给出无偏预测，且在训练数据充足时 FAR 对足迹估计方式的差异稳健。
Relevance: 37

papers.title: Aligning LLMs with Biomedical Knowledge using Balanced Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Engineering LLMs to accelerate life sciences research requires a robust alignment with biomedical knowledge. We observe that biomedical text exhibits a fundamentally different uncertainty structure from general text: dense low-confidence runs encode epistemic knowledge gaps (dense causal chains, rare entities) rather than the sparse aleatoric stylistic variation typical of general text. Based on this discovery, we propose Balanced Fine-Tuning (BFT), a dual-scale post-training method that combines group-normalized token reweighting with sequence-level reallocation toward knowledge-dense samples exhibiting dense epistemic uncertainty. Across medical evaluation, biological reasoning, sparse-reward RL, and biological representation tasks, BFT provides more consistent gains than SFT and DFT under a shared training setup. When replacing the default closed-source backbones in GeneAgent (GPT-4o) and VCWorld (Gemini-2.5-Flash), the BFT-aligned 70B model delivers stronger performance across biological process reasoning and chemical perturbation prediction. Critically, all BFT variants further improve after subsequent GRPO with sparse rewards, while SFT and DFT degrade, suggesting that epistemic-aware post-training provides a more robust policy initialization. Beyond text generation, BFT-aligned LLMs produce more accurate and professional biomedical profile texts; after encoding these profiles with a text embedding model, the resulting representations support gene-level, cell-level, and perturbation-response tasks, suggesting that BFT-enhanced generation can facilitate biological representation and, in turn, broader biomedical downstream tasks.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Related work updated
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Balanced Fine-Tuning (BFT)，一种双尺度后训练方法：把生物医学文本中密集的低置信度片段解释为认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty），用组归一化 token 重加权加序列级重分配，把训练信号偏向知识密集样本。在共享训练设置下 BFT 比 SFT 和 DFT 带来更一致的增益，且其模型在后续稀疏奖励 GRPO 中继续提升，而 SFT 和 DFT 变差。
Motivation: 生物医学文本的不确定性结构与通用文本根本不同：密集低置信度片段编码的是因果链密集、稀有实体带来的认知知识缺口，而非通用文本那种稀疏的偶然性风格波动；现有 SFT/DFT 微调未针对这一结构设计。
Method: BFT 是双尺度后训练方法：token 层用 group-normalized token reweighting，序列层把权重重新分配到表现出密集认知不确定性的知识密集样本。评测覆盖医学评估、生物推理、稀疏奖励 RL 与生物表征任务，并在共享训练设置下与 SFT、DFT 对比；另将默认闭源 backbone（GeneAgent 的 GPT-4o、VCWorld 的 Gemini-2.5-Flash）替换为 BFT 对齐的 70B 模型，之后再接稀疏奖励 GRPO。
Result: 在医学评估、生物推理、稀疏奖励 RL 和生物表征四类任务上，BFT 在共享训练设置下比 SFT 与 DFT 提供更一致的增益；替换 GeneAgent (GPT-4o) 与 VCWorld (Gemini-2.5-Flash) 的闭源 backbone 后，BFT 对齐的 70B 模型在生物过程推理与化学扰动预测上表现更强。所有 BFT 变体在后续稀疏奖励 GRPO 后进一步提升，而 SFT 与 DFT 下降；BFT 对齐模型生成的生物医学 profile 文本经文本 embedding 模型编码后，可支撑基因级、细胞级与扰动响应任务。
Conclusion: 认知不确定性感知的后训练（epistemic-aware post-training）能提供更稳健的策略初始化，使模型在稀疏奖励 RL 阶段继续受益而非退化，并让生成质量的提升外溢到生物表征等下游任务。

papers.title: FRAGMENTA: Efficient End-to-end Fragmentation-based Generative Model with Agentic Tuning for Drug Lead Optimization in Small Data Regime
papers.abstract_en: Molecule generation from extremely limited training data is a key challenge in drug discovery. Existing fragment-based methods are more suitable than atom-based approaches in this regime, but typically optimize fragment selection separately from downstream generation. Expert feedback is also especially valuable with limited data, yet translating such feedback into model objectives usually requires AI engineering expertise. We introduce FRAGMENTA, an end-to-end framework for small-data drug lead optimization with two components: (1) LVSEF, a fragment-based generator that jointly optimizes fragmentation and generation through a tabular reward-update mechanism, and (2) an agentic system that converts conversational expert feedback into updated generative objectives. Across three small-data datasets (11--104 molecules), LVSEF outperforms state-of-the-art methods in the smallest-data settings, matches them at larger scales, and trains ${\sim}16\times$ faster. On three public protein targets, iterative closed-loop optimization improves final-round discovery yield by up to ${\sim}16%$ over one-shot LVSEF-only on kinase, with gains depending on how well feedback matches target chemistry. In a real-world cancer drug-discovery deployment, Human-Agent FRAGMENTA identified nearly twice as many molecules with favorable docking scores ($< -6$) as baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FRAGMENTA 是面向小数据药物先导优化的端到端片段生成框架：LVSEF 用表格化奖励更新机制把片段切分与生成联合优化，agentic 系统把对话式专家反馈直接转成生成目标。在 11–104 个分子的三个小数据集上，LVSEF 在最小数据设定下超过 SOTA、较大规模持平且训练快约 16 倍；闭环迭代在三个蛋白靶点上使末轮发现产率比一次性 LVSEF 最多提高约 16%，真实癌症药物发现部署中识别出的优选拓扑分数（<-6）分子接近基线方法的两倍。
Motivation: 小数据下分子生成训练信号稀缺，现有片段方法把片段选择与下游生成分开优化；专家反馈虽最有价值，但转成模型目标通常需要 AI 工程介入。
Method: FRAGMENTA 含两部分：LVSEF 片段生成器通过 tabular reward-update 机制联合优化 fragmentation 与 generation；agentic 系统把对话式专家反馈转成更新后的生成目标，构成迭代闭环优化。
Result: 在三个小数据集（11–104 个分子）上，LVSEF 在最小数据设定下优于 SOTA、在较大数据规模持平，训练快约 16 倍；在三个公开蛋白靶点上，迭代闭环优化使末轮发现产率比一次性 LVSEF-only 在 kinase 上最多提高约 16%，增益取决于反馈与靶点化学的匹配程度；真实癌症药物发现部署中，Human-Agent FRAGMENTA 识别出的优选拓扑分数（<-6）分子接近基线方法的两倍。
Conclusion: 把片段切分与生成端到端联合优化、并让 agentic 反馈直接改写生成目标，可在极小数据下同时拿到更好的产率与训练效率，但增益依赖专家反馈与靶点化学的匹配。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Universe of Thoughts: A Computational Framework for Creative Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning have improved conventional problem solving, but creative reasoning remains comparatively underexplored. Inspired by cognitive science, we formalize combinational, exploratory, and transformational creativity as executable computational operators over structured problem and solution spaces, specifying how each mode combines, explores, or transforms those spaces. Combinational reasoning transfers ideas across domains to form unfamiliar combinations; exploratory reasoning searches for new solutions within an existing conceptual space; and transformational reasoning modifies the rules or constraints that define that space. This formalization yields distinct algorithmic procedures, which we instantiate in Universe of Thoughts (UoT), an LLM reasoning framework. Existing creativity benchmarks emphasize either open-ended ideation or highly constrained problem solving. We therefore introduce three novel creative-reasoning tasks requiring concrete solutions in low-constraint settings. Across 10 generations per method and task, T-UoT with GPT-4o performs strongest on the low-constraint, high-objective-specificity Bridge and Electricity tasks, while C-UoT shows its strongest relative performance on the low-constraint, lower-objective-specificity Society task. In addition, we evaluate UoT on HypoArena, an independent scientific hypothesis-generation benchmark with 100 tasks across biomedical, machine-learning, and social-science domains. With Qwen3-14B, Exploratory UoT ranks first among seven reasoning methods, achieving a 32.7\% pairwise win rate compared with 25.5\% for the next-best method. Our results suggest distinct performance patterns across task structures: T-UoT is strongest in low-constraint, high-specificity settings, E-UoT in more constrained, high-specificity settings, and C-UoT in low-constraint, lower-specificity settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把组合、探索、变换三类创造性推理形式化为可执行算子，据此构建 LLM 推理框架 Universe of Thoughts (UoT)，并新增三个低约束创造性推理任务。在 HypoArena 的 100 个科学假设生成任务上，Qwen3-14B 配 Exploratory UoT 在七种推理方法中排第一，成对胜率 32.7%，次优方法为 25.5%。
Motivation: LLM 推理进展集中在常规问题求解，创造性推理研究不足；现有创造力基准要么偏开放构思、要么偏强约束解题，缺少低约束但要求具体解的任务。
Method: 将 combinational、exploratory、transformational 三种创造力模式映射为作用于结构化问题空间与解空间的可执行算子，导出对应算法流程并实例化为 UoT 框架（C-UoT、E-UoT、T-UoT）；另提出三个低约束创造性任务，并在 HypoArena 上与七种推理方法对比。
Result: 每方法每任务跑 10 代：T-UoT 配 GPT-4o 在低约束、高目标特异性的 Bridge 与 Electricity 任务上最强，C-UoT 在低约束、低特异性的 Society 任务上相对表现最好。HypoArena 含 100 个任务，覆盖生物医学、机器学习、社会科学三个领域；Qwen3-14B 上 Exploratory UoT 在七种方法中居首，成对胜率 32.7%，次优 25.5%。
Conclusion: 不同 UoT 变体的最优区间由任务结构决定：T-UoT 适合低约束高特异性，E-UoT 适合更受约束的高特异性，C-UoT 适合低约束低特异性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Honesty over Accuracy: Trustworthy Language Models through Reinforced Hesitation
papers.abstract_en: Modern language models fail a fundamental requirement of trustworthy intelligence: knowing when not to answer. Despite achieving impressive accuracy on benchmarks, these models produce confident hallucinations, even when wrong answers carry catastrophic consequences. Our evaluations on GSM8K, MedQA and GPQA show frontier models almost never abstain despite explicit warnings of severe penalties, suggesting that prompts cannot override training that rewards any answer over no answer. As a remedy, we propose Reinforced Hesitation (RH): a modification to Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to use ternary rewards (+1 correct, 0 abstention, -$λ$ error) instead of binary. Controlled experiments on logic puzzles reveal that varying $λ$ produces distinct models along a Pareto frontier, where each training penalty yields the optimal model for its corresponding risk regime: low penalties produce aggressive answerers, high penalties conservative abstainers. The same frontier holds on MATH Levels 4--5 and on medical QA, where it transfers to an unseen dataset. We then introduce two inference strategies that exploit trained abstention as a coordination signal: cascading routes queries through models with decreasing risk tolerance, while self-cascading re-queries the same model on abstention. Both outperform majority voting with lower computational cost. These results establish abstention as a first-class training objective that transforms ``I don't know'' from failure into a coordination signal, enabling models to earn trust through calibrated honesty about their limits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Reinforced Hesitation (RH)：把 RLVR 的二元奖励改成三元（答对 +1、弃答 0、答错 −λ），让语言模型学会在不确定时说“我不知道”。在 GSM8K、MedQA、GPQA 上前沿模型几乎从不弃答；训练后 λ 沿 Pareto 前沿生成从激进作答到保守弃答的不同模型，基于弃答的 cascading 与 self-cascading 以低于 majority voting 的计算成本取得更优表现。
Motivation: 高准确率的模型在错误代价极高时仍自信幻觉，且在明确告知重罚的情况下也几乎不弃答，说明提示词无法覆盖“回答优于不回答”的训练偏好。
Method: RH 修改 RLVR 奖励为三元：+1 正确、0 弃答、−λ 错误；通过调节 λ 训练出 Pareto 前沿上不同风险容忍度的模型。推理侧引入 cascading（按递减风险容忍度路由查询）与 self-cascading（弃答时对同一模型重问）两种利用弃答信号的策略。
Result: 在 GSM8K、MedQA、GPQA 上，前沿模型即使被告知严重惩罚也几乎从不弃答。受控逻辑谜题实验中不同 λ 产生沿 Pareto 前沿分布的不同模型：低 λ 得到激进作答者，高 λ 得到保守弃答者；该前沿同样出现在 MATH 4–5 级与医疗 QA 上，并迁移到一个未见过的数据集。cascading 与 self-cascading 均以低于 majority voting 的计算成本胜出。
Conclusion: 弃答应作为一等训练目标：三元奖励能把“我不知道”从失败变成协调信号，让模型通过对自身局限的校准诚实来赢得信任。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PyDPF: A Python Package for Differentiable Particle Filtering
papers.abstract_en: State-space models (SSMs) are a widely used tool in time series analysis. In the complex systems that arise from real-world data, it is common to employ particle filtering (PF), an efficient Monte Carlo method for estimating the hidden state corresponding to a sequence of observations. Applying particle filtering requires specifying both the parametric form and the parameters of the system, which are often unknown and must be estimated. Gradient-based optimisation techniques cannot be applied directly to standard particle filters, as the filters themselves are not differentiable. However, several recently proposed methods modify the resampling step to make particle filtering differentiable. In this paper, we present an implementation of several such differentiable particle filters (DPFs) with a unified API built on the popular PyTorch framework. Our implementation makes these algorithms easily accessible to a broader research community and facilitates straightforward comparison between them. We validate our framework by reproducing experiments from several existing studies and demonstrate how DPFs can be applied to address several common challenges with state space modelling.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 0 figures, under review at the Journal of Statistical Software, the python package can be found at https://pypi.org/project/pydpf/ , the full documentation at https://python-dpf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/#documentation-index , and the source code including experiment replication material at https://github.com/John-JoB/pydpf
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PyDPF 是基于 PyTorch 的可微粒子滤波 (differentiable particle filtering, DPF) Python 包，用统一 API 实现多种改造重采样步使滤波可微的算法，从而让梯度优化能直接估计状态空间模型的参数与隐状态。作者通过复现若干已有研究的实验验证该框架，并演示 DPF 如何处理状态空间建模中的常见挑战。
Motivation: 标准粒子滤波的重采样步不可微，梯度类优化无法直接用于估计状态空间模型中未知的参数形式与参数值；已有多种 DPF 算法分散在不同实现中，难以公平比较和普及。
Method: 在 PyTorch 上以统一 API 实现多种可微粒子滤波算法（改造重采样步使其可微），使参数可用基于梯度的优化估计；通过复现若干已有研究的实验来验证框架，并给出状态空间建模常见挑战的应用演示。
Result: 框架的有效性通过复现若干已有研究的实验得到验证，并演示了 DPF 处理状态空间建模常见挑战的用法；包发布于 PyPI，配套完整文档与含实验复现材料的源码。

papers.title: Quadratic Direct Forecast for Training Multi-Step Time-Series Forecast Models
papers.abstract_en: The design of learning objectives is central to training time-series forecasting models. Existing learning objectives such as mean squared error mostly treat each future step as an independent, equally weighted task, which leads to the following two challenges: (1) they overlook the label autocorrelation effect among future steps, leading to biased learning objectives; (2) they fail to set heterogeneous task weights for different forecasting tasks corresponding to varying future steps, limiting the forecasting performance. To fill this gap, we propose a novel quadratic-form weighted learning objective, addressing both issues simultaneously. Specifically, the off-diagonal elements of the weighting matrix account for the label autocorrelation effect, whereas the non-uniform diagonals are expected to match the preferred weights of the forecasting tasks with varying future steps. On this basis, we propose a Quadratic Direct Forecast (QDF) learning algorithm, which trains the forecast model using the adaptively updated quadratic-form weighting matrix. Experiments show that our QDF effectively improves the performance of various forecast models, achieving state-of-the-art results. Code is available at https://github.com/Master-PLC/QDF.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QDF 用二次型加权学习目标训练多步时间序列预测模型：权重矩阵非对角元刻画未来各步标签自相关，非对角线以外的对角元按不同预测步长赋异质任务权重，并在训练中自适应更新该矩阵。实验显示 QDF 能提升多种预测模型性能并达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: MSE 等现有目标把每个未来步当作独立同权任务，既忽略未来步之间的标签自相关导致目标有偏，也无法对不同预测步长赋异质权重，限制了预测性能。
Method: 提出二次型加权学习目标：权重矩阵非对角元建模标签自相关，非均匀对角元匹配不同步长预测任务的偏好权重；据此提出 Quadratic Direct Forecast (QDF) 算法，用自适应更新的二次型权重矩阵训练预测模型。
Result: 实验表明 QDF 有效提升多种预测模型的性能并取得 state-of-the-art 结果；代码发布于 github.com/Master-PLC/QDF。
Conclusion: 把标签自相关与步长异质权重同时写进二次型目标并自适应更新，是训练多步时间序列预测模型的有效学习目标设计。

papers.title: Time-multiplexed layer reuse for physical neural networks
papers.abstract_en: Physical neural networks (PNNs) are promising candidates for next-generation computing, but existing demonstrations remain several orders of magnitude smaller than modern digital neural networks, whose recent advances have been driven by rapid growth in trainable parameters. This situation resembles the constraints of early digital neural networks, which led to ideas around parameter reuse. We investigate what similarly efficient hardware architectures may look like, focusing specifically on the common bottleneck of slow re-adjustment of the weights in PNNs. We propose the Time-Indexed Deep Alternating Layers Network (TIDAL-Net), which occupies an intermediate regime between recurrent and deep neural networks, specifically aimed at the scales and restrictions of common PNN prototypes. TIDAL-Net leverages the timescale separation found in many PNNs between fast forward dynamics and slowly trainable weights and biases, using layer-by-layer time multiplexing to increase effective depth while limiting implementation cost. Numerical experiments on image classification and natural language processing tasks show that TIDAL-Net improves performance with only minor modifications to conventional PNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIDAL-Net 用逐层时间复用 (layer-by-layer time multiplexing) 在物理神经网络 (PNN) 中把同一组慢速可训练权重在不同时刻复用为不同层，从而在不增加实现成本的前提下提高有效深度。图像分类与自然语言处理任务上的数值实验显示，只需对常规 PNN 做微小改动即可提升性能。
Motivation: 现有 PNN 演示规模比现代数字神经网络小若干个数量级，而数字网络的进展依赖可训练参数的快速增长；PNN 的权重再调整速度慢是共同瓶颈，参数复用思路在物理平台上尚无对应架构。
Method: 提出 Time-Indexed Deep Alternating Layers Network (TIDAL-Net)，处于循环网络与深度网络之间的中间形态；利用 PNN 中前向动力学快、权重与偏置慢的时间尺度分离，用逐层时间复用增加有效深度，同时限制实现成本。
Result: 在图像分类与自然语言处理任务的数值实验中，TIDAL-Net 提升了性能，且仅需对常规 PNN 做微小修改。
Conclusion: 在权重调整慢的物理平台上，按时间复用层是提高有效深度与性能的可行架构路径，代价是常规 PNN 的微小改动。

papers.title: DistDF: Time-Series Forecasting Needs Joint-Distribution Wasserstein Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Training time-series forecasting models requires aligning the conditional distribution of model forecasts with that of the label sequence. The standard direct forecast (DF) approach resorts to minimizing the conditional negative log-likelihood, typically estimated by the mean squared error. However, this estimation proves biased when the label sequence exhibits autocorrelation. In this paper, we propose DistDF, which achieves alignment by minimizing a distributional discrepancy between the conditional distributions of forecast and label sequences. Since such conditional discrepancies are difficult to estimate from finite time-series observations, we introduce a joint-distribution Wasserstein discrepancy for time-series forecasting, which provably upper bounds the conditional discrepancy of interest. The proposed discrepancy is tractable, differentiable, and readily compatible with gradient-based optimization. Extensive experiments show that DistDF improves diverse forecasting models and achieves leading performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DistDF-F66B.
papers.journal_ref: ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DistDF 用联合分布 Wasserstein 差异替代直接预报 (DF) 的条件负对数似然（通常以 MSE 估计）来对齐预测与标签序列的条件分布；该差异可证上界条件差异，且可微、可直接做梯度优化。摘要称其在多种预测模型上带来提升并取得领先性能。
Motivation: 标签序列存在自相关时，用 MSE 估计条件负对数似然会有偏，导致直接预报训练的分布对齐失效；而有限时间序列上条件分布差异本身难以估计。
Method: 提出 DistDF：最小化预测与标签序列条件分布之间的分布差异；由于条件差异难估，改用可证上界该条件差异的联合分布 Wasserstein discrepancy，保持可微、可与梯度优化兼容，并接入多种预报模型训练。
Result: 大量实验显示 DistDF 改进多种不同的预测模型并取得领先性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 时间序列预报的训练目标应从逐点 MSE 转向对条件分布的联合 Wasserstein 对齐，以绕开自相关下 NLL/MSE 估计有偏的问题。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a systematic study of scaling laws for the deepfake detection task. Specifically, we analyze the model performance against the number of real image domains, deepfake generation methods, and training images. Since no existing dataset meets the scale requirements for this research, we construct ScaleDF, the largest dataset to date in this field, which contains over 5.8 million real images from 51 different datasets (domains) and more than 8.8 million fake images generated by 102 deepfake methods. Using ScaleDF, we observe power-law scaling similar to that shown in large language models (LLMs). Specifically, the average detection error follows a predictable power-law decay as either the number of real domains or the number of deepfake methods increases. This key observation not only allows us to forecast the number of additional real domains or deepfake methods required to reach a target performance, but also inspires us to counter the evolving deepfake technology in a data-centric manner. Beyond this, we examine the role of pre-training and data augmentations in deepfake detection under scaling, as well as the limitations of scaling itself.The ScaleDF dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/WenhaoWang/ScaleDF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对深度伪造 (deepfake) 检测做系统 scaling law 研究，构建迄今最大规模的 ScaleDF 数据集（51 个真实域的 580 万+ 真图、102 种伪造方法的 880 万+ 假图），观察到平均检测误差随真实域数量或伪造方法数量增加呈可预测的幂律衰减，形态类似 LLM 的 scaling law。该规律可反推达到目标性能还需补充多少真实域或伪造方法，并支持以数据为中心对抗不断演化的伪造技术。
Motivation: 现有数据集规模不足以支撑深度伪造检测的 scaling law 研究，无法判断增加数据多样性与模型性能之间的定量关系。
Method: 构建 ScaleDF 数据集（51 个真实域、580 万+ 真图；102 种伪造方法、880 万+ 假图），分析模型性能随真实域数量、伪造方法数量、训练图像数量的变化，并检验预训练与数据增强在 scaling 条件下的作用。
Result: 平均检测误差随真实域数量或伪造方法数量增加呈幂律衰减，且该规律可用于预测达到目标性能所需的额外真实域或伪造方法数量；ScaleDF 规模为 51 个域、580 万+ 真图、102 种伪造方法、880 万+ 假图。
Conclusion: 深度伪造检测存在类似 LLM 的可预测幂律 scaling，应对伪造技术演化应转向数据中心（data-centric）路线，同时作者也检验了 scaling 本身的局限。

papers.title: Qubit-centric Transformer for Surface Code Decoding
papers.abstract_en: For reliable large-scale quantum computation, quantum error correction (QEC) is essential to protect logical information distributed across multiple physical qubits. Taking advantage of recent advances in deep learning, neural network-based decoders have emerged as a promising approach to improve the reliability of QEC. We propose the qubit-centric transformer (QCT), a novel and universal QEC decoder based on a transformer architecture with a qubit-centric attention mechanism. Our decoder transforms input syndromes from the stabilizer domain into qubit-centric tokens via a specialized embedding strategy. These qubit-centric tokens are processed through attention layers to effectively identify the underlying logical error. Furthermore, we introduce a graph-based masking method that incorporates the topological structure of quantum codes, enforcing attention toward relevant qubit interactions. Across various code distances for surface codes, QCT achieves state-of-the-art decoding performance, significantly outperforming existing neural decoders and the belief propagation (BP) with ordered statistics decoding (OSD) baseline. Notably, QCT achieves a high threshold of 18.1% under depolarizing noise, which closely approaches the theoretical bound of 18.9% and surpasses both the BP+OSD and the minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) thresholds. This qubit-centric approach provides a scalable and robust framework for surface code decoding, advancing the path toward fault-tolerant quantum computing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向表面码 (surface code) 的量子纠错译码器 QCT：用 qubit-centric attention 把 stabilizer 域的 syndrome 嵌入为按比特组织的 token，再用引入码拓扑结构的 graph-based masking 约束注意力只看向相关比特交互。在 depolarizing 噪声下 QCT 达到 18.1% 阈值，逼近理论界 18.9%，并超过 BP+OSD 与 MWPM 的阈值。
Motivation: 大规模量子计算需要可靠译码来保护跨多个物理比特分布的逻辑信息，而现有神经译码器与 BP+OSD、MWPM 在阈值上仍有差距，且未充分利用量子码的拓扑结构。
Method: QCT 基于 Transformer 架构：先用专门的 embedding 策略把 stabilizer 域输入 syndrome 转成 qubit-centric token，经多层 attention 识别底层逻辑错误；再引入 graph-based masking，把量子码的拓扑结构编码进注意力，强制关注相关比特交互。
Result: 在多种 surface code 码距上达到 state-of-the-art 译码性能，显著优于已有神经译码器与 BP+OSD 基线；depolarizing 噪声下阈值 18.1%，接近理论界 18.9%，并超过 BP+OSD 与 MWPM 的阈值。
Conclusion: 按比特为中心、并把码拓扑注入注意力的译码框架，可扩展且稳健地用于 surface code 译码，把神经译码阈值推到接近理论极限的水平。

papers.title: Speak to a Protein: An Interactive Multimodal Co-Scientist
papers.abstract_en: Building a working mental model of a protein typically requires weeks of reading, cross-referencing crystal and predicted structures, and inspecting ligand complexes, an effort that is slow, unevenly accessible, and often requires specialized computational skills. We introduce \emph{Speak to a Protein}, a new capability that turns protein analysis into an interactive, multimodal dialogue with an expert co-scientist. The AI system retrieves and synthesizes relevant literature, structures, and ligand data; grounds answers in a live 3D scene; and can highlight, annotate, manipulate and see the visualization. It also generates and runs code when needed, explaining results in both text and graphics. papers.title: PiERN: Token-Level Routing for Integrating High-Precision Computation and Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Tasks on complex systems require high-precision numerical computation to support decisions. However, current large language models (LLMs), even with enhanced reasoning capabilities, cannot integrate such computations as an intrinsic and interpretable capability with existing architectures. To this end, we propose Physically-isolated Experts Routing Network (PiERN), an architecture that directs computation and reasoning at token level, thereby enabling iterative alternation within a single chain of thought. We systematically evaluate PiERN on representative computation-reasoning tasks, including PDEBench and battery management tasks. Results show that PiERN achieves not only higher accuracy than directly finetuning LLMs but also significant improvements in response latency, token usage, GPU energy consumption, and experts routing accuracy compared with mainstream multi-agent approaches, while exhibiting no significant degradation in performance on MMLU and GLUE benchmarks. PiERN offers an efficient, interpretable, and scalable paradigm for interfacing language models with scientific systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Physically-isolated Experts Routing Network (PiERN)，在 token 级把高精度数值计算与推理路由分开，使两者能在同一条 chain of thought 内迭代交替。在 PDEBench 与电池管理任务上，其准确率高于直接微调 LLM，同时在响应延迟、token 用量、GPU 能耗与专家路由准确率上相对主流多-agent 方案显著改善，且 MMLU 与 GLUE 无明显性能下降。
Motivation: 复杂系统的决策需要高精度数值计算支撑，但现有 LLM 即便增强推理能力，也无法把这类计算作为内在且可解释的能力整合进架构。
Method: PiERN 以 token 级路由分发计算与推理，让物理隔离的专家 (physically-isolated experts) 在单条 chain of thought 内迭代交替；在 PDEBench 与电池管理任务上评测，并与直接微调 LLM 及主流 multi-agent 方案对比，另在 MMLU、GLUE 上检查通用能力。
Result: 在 PDEBench 与电池管理任务上，PiERN 准确率高于直接微调 LLM；相对主流 multi-agent 方案，响应延迟、token 使用量、GPU 能耗与专家路由准确率均有显著改善；MMLU 与 GLUE 上性能无显著下降。
Conclusion: token 级的计算-推理交替路由可让语言模型以高效、可解释、可扩展的方式对接科学系统，且不牺牲通用基准表现。

papers.title: Feature Space Analysis by Guided Diffusion Model
papers.abstract_en: This paper aims to analyse the feature space of a vision-related Deep Neural Network (DNN) by proposing a decoder that can generate an image whose feature closely matches a user-specified feature. Supported by quantitative evidence of its high feature-matching accuracy, our decoder facilitates precise analysis of the DNN's feature space. Our decoder is implemented as a guided diffusion model that guides the image generation of a pre-trained diffusion model to minimise the Euclidean distance between the feature of a clean image estimated at each step and the user-specified feature. The key advantages of our decoder are its training-free applicability to analyse the feature spaces of different DNNs and its practical feasibility on a single COTS GPU. The experiments targeting CLIP's image encoder and ResNet-50 demonstrate the effectiveness of our decoder both as a feature-matching image generator and as a visual feature space analyser. The codes and data are available at https://github.com/ccilab-doshisha/FeatDec
papers.comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026, 27 pages, 13 figures, 1 table, codes: https://github.com/ccilab-doshisha/FeatDec
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出训练免调的解码器 FeatDec：用 guided diffusion 引导预训练扩散模型逐步生成图像，使每步估计的干净图像特征与用户指定特征的欧氏距离最小，从而反演出能命中目标特征的图像。在 CLIP image encoder 与 ResNet-50 上，该解码器同时作为特征匹配图像生成器和可视化特征空间分析器，具备高特征匹配精度，且可在单块 COTS GPU 上运行。
Motivation: 视觉 DNN 的特征空间难以直接观察：想知道某个特征向量对应什么样的图像，缺少一个能反向解码、且能跨不同 DNN 复用的工具。
Method: 把解码器实现为 guided diffusion：在预训练扩散模型的每一步，估计当前干净图像的特征并计算其与用户指定目标特征的欧氏距离，用该梯度引导生成方向；无需针对被分析的 DNN 重新训练，因此可迁移到不同 DNN 的特征空间。
Result: 在 CLIP image encoder 与 ResNet-50 两个目标网络上，解码器表现出高的特征匹配精度 (feature-matching accuracy)，并被验证既可作为特征匹配的图像生成器，也可作为特征空间的可视化分析器；整个流程可在单块 COTS GPU 上完成。
Conclusion: 特征空间可以通过训练免调的扩散引导解码被直接反演和可视化，且无需为每个 DNN 单独训练，代码与数据已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Practical Feasibility of Gradient Inversion Attacks in Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Gradient inversion attacks are often presented as a serious privacy threat in federated learning, with recent work reporting increasingly strong reconstructions under favorable experimental settings. However, it remains unclear whether such attacks are feasible in modern, performance-optimized systems deployed in practice. In this work, we evaluate the practical feasibility of gradient inversion for image-based federated learning. We conduct a systematic study across multiple datasets and tasks, including image classification and object detection, using canonical vision architectures at contemporary resolutions. Our results show that while gradient inversion remains possible for certain legacy or transitional designs under highly restrictive assumptions, modern, performance-optimized models consistently resist meaningful reconstruction visually. We further demonstrate that many reported successes rely on upper-bound settings, such as inference mode operation or architectural simplifications which do not reflect realistic training pipelines. Taken together, our findings indicate that, under an honest-but-curious server assumption, high-fidelity image reconstruction via gradient inversion does not constitute a critical privacy risk in production-optimized federated learning systems, and that practical risk assessments must carefully distinguish diagnostic attack settings from real-world deployments.
papers.comment: v3: revised manuscript; expanded experiments; added new feasibility probe;
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在图像联邦学习上系统评估梯度反演攻击的现实可行性，发现现代性能优化模型在真实训练管线下能稳定抵抗有意义的视觉重建，只有遗留或过渡性设计在高度受限假设下才可被反演。作者指出许多已报告的成功依赖推理模式运行或架构简化这类上界设置，因此在 honest-but-curious 服务器假设下高保真重建不构成生产级联邦学习的关键隐私风险。
Motivation: 近期工作在有利实验设置下报告越来越强的梯度反演重建，但这类攻击在现代、性能优化的生产系统中是否可行仍不清楚，导致隐私风险评估可能被上界设置误导。
Method: 在多个数据集与任务上做系统研究，涵盖图像分类与目标检测，使用主流视觉架构与当代分辨率；对比诊断性攻击设置（推理模式、架构简化）与真实训练管线，并新增可行性探针 (feasibility probe)。
Result: 现代性能优化模型在视觉上一致抵抗有意义的重建；梯度反演仅在遗留或过渡性设计加高度受限假设下仍可能成功；许多已报告成功依赖推理模式运行或架构简化等不反映真实训练管线的上界设置。
Conclusion: 在 honest-but-curious 服务器假设下，梯度反演的高保真图像重建在生产优化的联邦学习系统中不构成关键隐私风险，风险评估必须区分诊断性攻击设置与真实部署。

papers.title: AEGIS: Runtime-Guided GPU Collocation for Multi-Tenant Deep Learning Training
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning training commonly runs on shared multi-tenant GPU servers, where exclusive allocation provides isolation but can leave resources underutilized and increase queueing time. Collocation can improve efficiency, but interference-agnostic placement may cause severe slowdowns, while inaccurate memory information can lead to out-of-memory (OOM) failures. We present AEGIS, a server-scale runtime scheduling system for controlled collocation of deep learning training workloads on shared multi-GPU servers. AEGIS integrates memory feasibility, post-placement observation, runtime-pressure filtering, placement, and OOM-aware recovery in a single scheduling loop. After placement, AEGIS observes workload activity before permitting further collocation, then uses low-overhead telemetry to determine whether a GPU can safely accept additional work. OOM failures trigger retries under progressively safer memory conditions, eventually falling back to exclusive execution. This online approach avoids costly offline pairwise compatibility profiling. We evaluate AEGIS using vision, Transformer, recommendation, and LLM-style workloads across three production-derived traces. AEGIS reduces geometric-mean makespan by 16% relative to Lucid, 21% relative to Horus, and 27% relative to exclusive allocation. Sensitivity studies show that activity-anchored observation and runtime-pressure filtering balance conservative isolation against interference-agnostic collocation, improving makespan while limiting sharing-induced per-task slowdown.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AEGIS 是面向共享多 GPU 服务器的运行时调度系统，把内存可行性、放置后观察、运行时压力过滤、放置决策与 OOM 恢复放进同一个调度循环，用低开销遥测判断 GPU 能否安全接纳更多负载，从而免去昂贵的离线成对兼容性剖析。在三份生产来源 trace 上评测 vision、Transformer、recommendation 与 LLM 类负载，几何平均 makespan 相对 Lucid 降低 16%、相对 Horus 降低 21%、相对独占分配降低 27%。
Motivation: 共享多租户 GPU 上独占分配虽隔离好但利用率低、排队时间长；干扰无关的共置 (collocation) 又会带来严重减速，内存信息不准还会触发 OOM。
Method: AEGIS 在单一调度循环中串联内存可行性检查、放置后对负载活动的观察、基于低开销遥测的运行时压力过滤、放置决策与 OOM 感知恢复；OOM 触发在更安全内存条件下重试，最终回退到独占执行，从而绕开离线成对兼容性剖析。
Result: 在三份生产来源 traces 上评测 vision、Transformer、recommendation、LLM 类负载：几何平均 makespan 相对 Lucid 降低 16%，相对 Horus 降低 21%，相对独占分配降低 27%；敏感性研究显示活动锚定观察与运行时压力过滤在保守隔离与干扰无关共置之间取得平衡，在限制共享所致单任务减速的同时改善 makespan。
Conclusion: 用运行时观察与压力过滤替代离线兼容性剖析，就能在共享多 GPU 服务器上安全共置训练负载并显著缩短 makespan。

papers.title: LHM-Humanoid: Long-Horizon Human Motion Control for Continuous Object Transport in Cluttered Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Physics-based human motion control can make a simulated character walk, sit, and manipulate objects with high physical realism. Almost always, though, this happens in short, isolated clips that are re-initialized between interactions. We instead aim for continuous, reset-free long-horizon motion: a physically simulated humanoid that repeatedly walks to a displaced object, lifts it with a balanced whole-body posture, carries it past obstacles, and places it at a goal, over and over within a single uninterrupted take. The hard part is not any individual motion but the transitions between them. Without a reset, each cycle must end in a state that both leaves the object just placed undisturbed and lets the next cycle begin, yet every placement leaves the character off-balance in a non-canonical pose where naive end-to-end reinforcement learning fails. Our key idea is to treat this handoff as a two-sided problem of recoverability: the character must disengage from the object it just placed so the prior success is preserved, and settle into a state from which a balanced continuation exists. Instead of engineering a transition by hand, we learn to shape where each cycle ends so that it lands in this recoverable region. We introduce LHM-Humanoid. One goal-conditioned controller completes a fetch--carry--place cycle and, through a learned release-and-retreat behavior, steers its terminal state into this region; a second controller then takes over from the resulting state distribution. Both are regularized by an adversarial motion prior and distilled into a single goal-conditioned policy that runs the whole sequence as one reset-free rollout. Across 350 cluttered layouts spanning four room types, LHM-Humanoid produces far more successful and stable long-horizon motion than end-to-end RL, hierarchical RL, and prior physics-based human-scene-interaction methods, on both seen and unseen scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LHM-Humanoid 把连续无重置的长时程人形运动控制拆成两个控制器的交接问题：第一个控制器完成取-搬-放循环并通过学会的释放-撤退行为把终态推进可恢复区域，第二个控制器从该状态分布接管，再经对抗运动先验正则并蒸馏为单一目标条件策略。在 350 个杂乱布局、四类房间上，其长时程运动成功率与稳定性显著高于端到端 RL、分层 RL 及既有人-景交互方法，且在见过与未见场景均成立。
Motivation: 物理仿真角色的运动控制几乎都局限在片段间重新初始化的短片段里；无重置时每次放置都会让人形处于失衡的非规范姿态，朴素端到端强化学习直接失败。

papers.title: PuzzleJAX: A Benchmark for Reasoning and Learning
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PuzzleJAX, a GPU-accelerated puzzle game engine and description language designed to support rapid benchmarking of tree search, reinforcement learning, and LLM reasoning abilities. Unlike existing GPU-accelerated learning environments that provide hard-coded implementations of fixed sets of games, PuzzleJAX allows dynamic compilation of any game expressible in its domain-specific language (DSL). This DSL follows PuzzleScript, which is a popular and accessible online game engine for designing puzzle games. In this paper, we validate in PuzzleJAX several hundred of the thousands of games designed in PuzzleScript by both professional designers and casual creators since its release in 2013, thereby demonstrating PuzzleJAX's coverage of an expansive, expressive, and human-relevant space of tasks. By analyzing the performance of search, learning, and language models on these games, we show that PuzzleJAX can naturally express tasks that are both simple and intuitive to understand, yet often deeply challenging to master, requiring a combination of control, planning, and high-level insight.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 2 tables, published as a full paper at IEEE Conference on Games 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PuzzleJAX 是一个 GPU 加速的解谜游戏引擎与 DSL，可动态编译任何用该 DSL 表达的游戏，用于快速评测树搜索、强化学习与 LLM 推理能力。作者用它验证了 PuzzleScript 自 2013 年以来的数千款游戏中的数百款，覆盖广阔且与人类相关的任务空间；这些任务上手简单却难以精通，需要控制、规划与高层洞察的结合。
Motivation: 现有 GPU 加速学习环境只提供固定游戏集合的硬编码实现，难以快速扩展到大量新任务；而 PuzzleScript 上已有专业设计师与普通创作者制作的数千款解谜游戏，缺少可直接用于基准评测的执行环境。
Method: 构建 GPU 加速引擎 PuzzleJAX 与遵循 PuzzleScript 的领域专用语言 (DSL)，支持动态编译任意 DSL 可表达的游戏；在其中验证数百款 PuzzleScript 游戏，并分析树搜索、强化学习与语言模型在这些游戏上的表现。
Result: 验证了 PuzzleScript 自 2013 年发布以来由专业设计师与普通创作者设计的数千款游戏中的数百款，表明 DSL 覆盖广阔且具人类相关性的任务空间；搜索、学习与语言模型的性能分析显示这些任务易于理解却往往难以精通，需要控制、规划与高层洞察的结合。
Conclusion: 用 DSL 动态编译游戏的 GPU 环境可以把大量人类设计的解谜任务直接变成推理与学习基准，且这些任务简单直观但难以精通。

papers.title: Cross-Modality Controlled Molecule Generation with Diffusion Language Model
papers.abstract_en: The increasing variety of molecular data creates a need for generative models that can flexibly incorporate heterogeneous constraints across modalities. However, existing SMILES-based diffusion models are typically designed for a fixed conditioning modality, and introducing new constraints often requires retraining the model. To address this limitation, we propose Cross-Modality Controlled Molecule Generation with Diffusion Language Model (CMCM-DLM), a modular framework that extends a pre-trained diffusion model to support heterogeneous molecular constraints without retraining the backbone. We demonstrate CMCM-DLM using two complementary modalities: molecular structure and chemical properties. Specifically, a Structure Control Module (SCM) guides early diffusion steps to establish the molecular scaffold, while a Property Control Module (PCM) subsequently steers generation toward target chemical properties. This staged design enables flexible integration of different molecular constraints within a unified generative framework. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate effective cross-modal controllability and strong adaptability, highlighting the potential of CMCM-DLM for heterogeneous molecular data modeling and data-driven drug discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CMCM-DLM 在不重训预训练扩散语言模型主干的前提下，用两个模块把异构约束接进 SMILES 分子生成：Structure Control Module (SCM) 在扩散早期引导骨架成形，Property Control Module (PCM) 随后把生成拉向目标化学性质。在多个数据集上展示了跨模态可控性与适应性。
Motivation: 现有基于 SMILES 的扩散模型绑定单一条件模态，每加一种新约束都要重训模型，难以适配日益多样的分子数据。
Method: 模块化框架 CMCM-DLM：扩展预训练扩散语言模型，SCM 引导早期扩散步建立分子骨架，PCM 在其后接管并调控目标化学性质，分阶段设计使结构与性质两类约束可在统一生成框架中组合，主干无需重训。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验展示了有效的跨模态可控性与强适应性；摘要未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 分阶段的结构加性质双模块控制可在不重训主干的条件下实现异构分子约束的灵活集成，指向数据驱动的药物发现应用。

papers.title: FedCoT: Communication-Efficient Federated Reasoning Enhancement for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Enhancing LLM reasoning in federated settings is nontrivial due to stringent computational, communication, and privacy constraints, especially in healthcare, where clinically consequential decisions require not only accuracy but also interpretable, auditable rationales to meet safety, accountability, and regulatory requirements. Conventional federated fine-tuning largely imitates final answers rather than cultivating step-by-step reasoning, often relying on privacy-sensitive centralized distillation and still incurring substantial communication overhead. We address this gap with \textbf{\ours{}}, a federated reasoning framework that combines lightweight chain-of-thought resampling with a compact discriminator for selection, and client-aware LoRA stacking with weighted classifier aggregation to accommodate heterogeneity while reducing aggregation noise and communication; clients generate candidate chains and supervision locally, and only lightweight modules are aggregated on the server. Experiments on medical reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains under tight resource budgets while keeping data local and respecting privacy, offering an interpretable and resource-efficient solution. Our code is made publicly available at https://github.com/DIaacKr/FedCoT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FedCoT 在联邦设定下提升 LLM 推理：客户端本地做轻量 chain-of-thought 重采样并用紧凑 discriminator 筛选候选链，配合 client-aware LoRA stacking 与加权分类器聚合，只在服务端聚合轻量模块。医疗推理基准上在紧资源预算下取得一致增益，同时数据保留在本地。
Motivation: 联邦微调多在模仿最终答案而非培养分步推理，且常依赖隐私敏感的集中式蒸馏，通信开销大；医疗场景还要求可解释、可审计的推理链以满足安全与监管。
Method: 框架含两部分：轻量 CoT 重采样加紧凑 discriminator 做候选链选择；client-aware LoRA stacking 加权分类器聚合以适配客户端异质性、降低聚合噪声与通信量。候选链与监督信号均在客户端本地生成，服务端只聚合轻量模块。
Result: 在医疗推理基准 (medical reasoning benchmarks) 上，在紧资源预算下取得一致增益 (consistent gains)，同时保持数据本地、符合隐私要求；代码已公开于 github.com/DIaacKr/FedCoT。
Conclusion: 联邦推理增强可以不靠集中式蒸馏实现：把 CoT 生成与筛选留在客户端、只聚合轻量模块，即可在隐私与通信约束下同时拿到推理质量与可解释性。

papers.title: Too Categorical to be Human: Emotion Concepts in LLMs and Humans
papers.abstract_en: Understanding human emotions is central to user-facing AI applications, safety alignment, and the simulation of human behavior. As emotional stimuli shape high-stakes behavior in Large Language Models (LLMs), there is increasing interest in how models represent emotion concepts internally. Mechanistic accounts of these representations, however, cannot be compared directly against humans: emotion processing in humans is highly distributed and yields no equivalent neural representation. To understand whether LLMs internalize emotion concepts in a way similar to humans, we propose characterizing the abstract concept of an emotion using external behavioral signatures, which we term behavioral representations. Using the theory of cognitive appraisals, which enables representing emotional situations along interpretable evaluative dimensions, we create a benchmark dataset of emotional scenarios spanning 15 emotion categories. We elicit behavioral representations of emotion concepts from LLMs and humans using our benchmark, and study their structural similarity. We find that LLMs represent emotion concepts more categorically, homogeneously, and determinately than humans, representing a single emotion concept with less internal diversity, and place different emotions further apart. The categorical structure of representations in LLMs is further robust to contextual variation, including with different task framing and demographic personas. Analyzing model checkpoints across different training stages, we also find that the discretized nature of representations appears after the mid-training stage itself and is unaffected by different post-training strategies. Through our results, we highlight a key difference in how LLMs behaviorally represent emotion concepts, curbing the subjectivity inherent to the human experience of emotions.
papers.comment: 19 pages of main body; A version was presented at WiML Workshop @ NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用认知评价理论 (cognitive appraisal) 把情绪情境编码为可解释的评价维度，构建覆盖 15 类情绪的基准，让 LLM 与人类各自给出情绪概念的“行为表征” (behavioral representations) 并比较结构。LLM 的情绪概念比人类更类别化、更同质、更确定，不同情绪之间距离更大，且这种离散化在训练中段之后出现、不受后训练策略影响。
Motivation: LLM 内部的情绪机制解释无法与人类直接对照，因为人脑情绪加工高度分布式、没有等价神经表征；需要一个双方共有的外部行为接口来比较二者是否以内化了相同的情绪概念。
Method: 以认知评价理论的可解释评价维度刻画情绪情境，构建含 15 类情绪类别的基准情境数据集；分别从 LLM 和人类被试上引出情绪概念的行为表征，比较其结构相似度（类别化、同质性、确定性、情绪间距离），并跨任务框架与人口统计 persona 检验稳健性，同时分析不同训练阶段的模型 checkpoint。
Result: LLM 表征情绪概念比人类更类别化、更同质、更确定，单一情绪概念内部多样性更低，不同情绪之间距离更大；该类别化结构对任务框架变化与不同人口统计 persona 稳健；跨训练阶段 checkpoint 分析显示离散化性质在中训练 (mid-training) 阶段之后出现，且不受不同后训练策略影响。
Conclusion: LLM 与人类在情绪概念的表征结构上存在关键差异：模型把本应有主观连续谱的情绪压成更离散、边界更远的类别，且这一倾向在中训练阶段就已定型、后训练改不回来。

papers.title: DrugMCTS: a drug repurposing framework combining multi-agent, RAG and Monte Carlo Tree Search
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models have demonstrated considerable potential in scientific domains such as drug repositioning. However, their effectiveness remains constrained when reasoning extends beyond the knowledge acquired during pretraining. Conventional approaches, such as fine-tuning or retrieval-augmented generation, face limitations in either imposing high computational overhead or failing to fully exploit structured scientific data. To overcome these challenges, we propose DrugMCTS, a novel framework that synergistically integrates RAG, multi-agent collaboration, and Monte Carlo Tree Search for drug repositioning. The framework employs five specialized agents tasked with retrieving and analyzing molecular and protein information, thereby enabling structured and iterative reasoning. Extensive experiments on the DrugBank and KIBA datasets demonstrate that DrugMCTS achieves substantially higher recall and robustness compared to both general-purpose LLMs and deep learning baselines. Our results highlight the importance of structured reasoning, agent-based collaboration, and feedback-driven search mechanisms in advancing LLM applications for drug repositioning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DrugMCTS 把 RAG、多智能体协作与 Monte Carlo Tree Search 结合用于药物重定位：五个专职智能体分别检索并分析分子与蛋白信息，驱动结构化迭代推理。在 DrugBank 与 KIBA 数据集上，其 recall 与鲁棒性相比通用 LLM 和深度学习基线均有明显提升。
Motivation: LLM 在药物重定位上的推理受限于预训练知识；微调开销大，常规 RAG 又难以充分利用结构化科学数据。
Method: 框架整合 RAG、多智能体协作与 Monte Carlo Tree Search，设置五个专职智能体负责检索和分析分子与蛋白信息，形成结构化、迭代的推理与反馈驱动搜索。
Result: 在 DrugBank 和 KIBA 数据集上的实验显示，DrugMCTS 的 recall 与鲁棒性相比通用 LLM 基线和深度学习基线均显著更高。
Conclusion: 结构化推理、基于智能体的协作与反馈驱动搜索机制对推进 LLM 在药物重定位中的应用很重要。

papers.title: Direct Regret Optimization in Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization (BO) is a powerful paradigm for optimizing expensive black-box functions. Traditional BO methods typically rely on separate hand-crafted acquisition functions and surrogate models for the underlying function, and often operate in a myopic manner. In this paper, we propose a novel direct regret optimization approach that jointly learns the optimal model and non-myopic acquisition by distilling from a set of candidate models and acquisitions, and explicitly targets minimizing the multi-step regret. Our framework leverages an ensemble of Gaussian Processes (GPs) with varying hyperparameters to generate simulated BO trajectories, each guided by an acquisition function drawn from a pool of conventional choices and terminated by a Bayesian early stop criterion. These trajectories train an end-to-end Decision Transformer that selects the next query so as to improve the ultimate objective, following a dense training sparse learning paradigm: the transformer is trained on abundant simulated data, while a limited number of real evaluations refine the GPs online. On synthetic and real-world benchmarks, our method attains the best or near-best final simple regret against standard, lookahead, trust-region and amortized BO baselines, with the largest gains in high-dimensional settings. Ablations attribute the gains jointly to region-of-interest filtering and the learned policy, and matched-budget comparisons against explicit two-step lookahead acquisitions show that the advantage is not shared by lookahead alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出直接遗憾优化 (direct regret optimization) 的贝叶斯优化框架：用超参数各异的 GP 集成与候选采集函数生成模拟轨迹，端到端训练 Decision Transformer 直接选择下一个查询点以最小化多步 regret。在合成与真实基准上，最终 simple regret 取得最好或接近最好水平，且在高维设置中增益最大。
Motivation: 传统 BO 把代理模型与采集函数分开手工设计，且多为短视 (myopic) 的单步决策，难以直接优化多步累计遗憾。
Method: 用超参数不同的 GP 集成生成模拟 BO 轨迹，每条轨迹由采集函数池中选出的传统采集函数引导，并由 Bayesian early stop 准则终止；这些轨迹端到端训练 Decision Transformer，采用 dense training sparse learning 范式——在大量模拟数据上训练 transformer，再用少量真实评估在线修正 GP。
Result: 在合成与真实基准上，最终 simple regret 相对 standard、lookahead、trust-region 与 amortized BO 基线取得最好或接近最好表现，高维设置中增益最大；消融把增益归因于 region-of-interest filtering 与学习策略的共同作用；与显式 two-step lookahead 采集函数的等预算对比显示该优势并非 lookahead 独有。
Conclusion: 把模型与非短视采集函数一起蒸馏进序列决策策略，可以直接优化多步 regret，且这一优势不能由两步前瞻单独解释。

papers.title: Improving Mixup Calibration with Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In many real-world applications, ensuring the robustness and stability of deep neural networks (DNNs) is crucial, particularly for image classification tasks that encounter various input perturbations. While Mixup-based data augmentation techniques have been widely adopted to enhance the resilience of trained models against such perturbations, our experiments reveal an important corruption robustness-calibration trade-off: stronger Mixup-based augmentation can improve robustness against corrupted data while substantially increasing expected calibration error (ECE). To address this challenge, we introduce DRO-Augment, a framework that integrates Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Optimization (W-DRO) with various Mixup-based data augmentation strategies to mitigate this trade-off. Our method substantially reduces ECE under strong Mixup-based augmentation while largely preserving corruption accuracy across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CIFAR-10-C, and CIFAR-100-C. On the theoretical side, we establish novel generalization error bounds for neural networks trained using a variation-regularized loss function with augmented data, closely related to the W-DRO problem. Furthermore, we introduce a refined CIFAR-C benchmark that corrects inconsistencies in corruption intensities, providing a more reliable evaluation for future robustness research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRO-Augment 把 Wasserstein 分布式鲁棒优化 (W-DRO) 与 Mixup 类数据增强结合，缓解图像分类中「增强越强、抗腐蚀精度越高但校准越差」的权衡：在 CIFAR-10/100 及其 -C 腐蚀版本上显著降低 ECE，同时基本保住腐蚀精度。
Motivation: 强 Mixup 类增强能提升模型对输入扰动的鲁棒性，却会大幅抬高期望校准误差 (ECE)，鲁棒性与校准之间存在此消彼长。
Method: 提出 DRO-Augment 框架，将 W-DRO 与多种 Mixup 类增强策略结合；理论上给出基于变分正则化损失 (variation-regularized loss) 的神经网络泛化误差界，该损失与 W-DRO 问题紧密相关；并构建修正腐蚀强度不一致的 refined CIFAR-C benchmark。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C 上，强 Mixup 增强下 ECE 显著下降，同时腐蚀精度基本保持；提出修正腐蚀强度不一致的 refined CIFAR-C benchmark。
Conclusion: 用 W-DRO 约束 Mixup 类增强可以在不牺牲抗腐蚀精度的前提下改善校准，且修正后的 CIFAR-C 更适合作鲁棒性评测基准。

papers.title: Time-o1: Time-Series Forecasting Needs Transformed Label Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Training time-series forecasting models poses unique challenges in loss function design. Most existing approaches adopt temporal mean squared error, but this study reveals two critical limitations: (1) it ignores the presence of label autocorrelation, which biases it from the true label sequence likelihood; (2) it involves excessive number of tasks, which complicates optimization, especially for long-term forecasting. To address these issues, we introduce Time-o1, a transform-enhanced loss function for time-series forecasting. The central idea is to transform the label sequence into decorrelated components with discriminated significance. Models are then trained to align the most significant components, thereby effectively mitigating label autocorrelation and reducing task amount. Experiments demonstrate that Time-o1 achieves state-of-the-art performance and is compatible with various forecast models. Code is available at https://github.com/Master-PLC/Time-o1.
papers.journal_ref: NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Time-o1 把时间序列预测的标签序列变换成去相关且显著性有别的分量，让模型只对齐最重要的分量，从而绕开时序 MSE 忽略标签自相关、任务数过多这两个缺陷。在多类预测模型上达到 state-of-the-art，且与不同架构兼容。
Motivation: 时序预测普遍用时间维 MSE 作损失，但它偏离真实标签序列似然（忽略标签自相关），且长期预测下任务数量过多使优化困难。
Method: 提出 transform-enhanced 损失 Time-o1：先将标签序列变换为带显著性区分的去相关分量，再训练模型对齐其中最显著的分量，以此同时抑制标签自相关偏差并减少任务量；可搭配不同预测模型使用。
Result: 实验中 Time-o1 达到 state-of-the performance，并与多种预测模型兼容；代码发布于 github.com/Master-PLC/Time-o1。
Conclusion: 时序预测的损失设计应先对标签做去相关变换再选择性对齐显著分量，而不是直接在原始序列上做 MSE。

papers.title: KO: Kinetics-inspired Neural Optimizer with PDE Simulation Approaches
papers.abstract_en: The design of effective optimization algorithms for neural networks remains a fundamental challenge, and most existing methods rely on heuristic extensions of gradient-based updates. We introduce KO (Kinetics-inspired Optimizer), a plug-and-play optimization module grounded in kinetic theory and partial differential equations. KO models parameter dynamics as a particle system, augmenting standard gradient updates with stochastic interactions induced by a discretization of the Boltzmann transport equation. This mechanism naturally promotes parameter diversity and mitigates weight condensation, the tendency of parameters to collapse into low-dimensional subspaces, a phenomenon closely associated with degraded generalization. We provide both a rigorous theoretical analysis and a physical interpretation, showing that KO provably increases parameter diversity while preserving convergence guarantees. Extensive experiments on image classification benchmarks (CIFAR-10/100, ImageNet) and large-scale language model pretraining demonstrate that KO consistently improves accuracy over competitive baselines with negligible additional computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KO 把神经网络参数更新建模为粒子系统，在标准梯度更新上叠加 Boltzmann 输运方程离散化带来的随机相互作用，从而提升参数多样性、抑制权重塌缩 (weight condensation)。理论上可证明 KO 增加参数多样性且保留收敛保证；在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet 图像分类与大规模语言模型预训练上，精度一致优于有竞争力的基线，额外计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 现有优化算法多是对梯度更新的启发式扩展，参数易塌缩到低维子空间，与泛化变差相关，缺少有理论保证的多样性机制。
Method: KO (Kinetics-inspired Optimizer) 是即插即用优化模块：把参数动力学当作粒子系统，用 Boltzmann 输运方程的离散化引入随机相互作用，叠加在标准梯度更新之上；配套给出理论分析与物理解释，证明参数多样性提升且保留收敛保证。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100、ImageNet 图像分类基准及大规模语言模型预训练上，KO 相对有竞争力的基线一致提高准确率，额外计算开销可忽略；理论结果为参数多样性可证明增加并保持收敛保证。
Conclusion: 用动理论与 PDE 给出的随机相互作用可以在不牺牲收敛的前提下缓解参数塌缩，作为即插即用模块普遍改善神经网络训练精度。

papers.title: Boosting Large Language Models with Mask Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: The large language model (LLM) is typically integrated into the mainstream optimization protocol. However, it remains underexplored whether maintaining the model integrity is \textit{indispensable} for promising performance. In this work, we introduce Mask Fine-Tuning (MFT), a novel LLM fine-tuning paradigm demonstrating that carefully breaking the model's structural integrity can surprisingly improve performance without updating model weights. MFT learns and applies binary masks to well-optimized models, using the standard LLM fine-tuning objective as supervision. Based on fully fine-tuned models, MFT uses the same fine-tuning datasets to achieve consistent performance gains across domains and backbones (e.g., an average gain of 2.70/4.15 on IFEval with LLaMA2-7B/3.1-8B). Detailed ablation studies and analyses examine the proposed MFT from different perspectives, including the sparse ratio and the loss surface. Additionally, when deployed on well-trained models, MFT is compatible with other LLM optimization procedures to improve overall model performance. Furthermore, this study extends the masking operation beyond its conventional use in network pruning for model compression to encompass a broader range of model capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mask Fine-Tuning (MFT) 在已全量微调的 LLM 上学习并施加二值掩码、不更新权重，用标准微调目标作监督，靠刻意破坏模型结构完整性换取性能提升。在全量微调后的 LLaMA2-7B/3.1-8B 上用同一微调数据，IFEval 平均提升 2.70/4.15，且与其他优化流程兼容叠加。
Motivation: 主流优化协议默认保持模型结构完整性是必要的，但这一前提是否不可或缺仍被忽视；作者要检验破坏完整性（不改权重）能否反而带来跨领域、跨骨干的稳定增益。
Method: MFT 对已充分微调的模型学习并应用二值掩码 (binary masks)，监督信号就是标准 LLM 微调目标，复用同一微调数据集；配套做关于稀疏比例 (sparse ratio) 与损失面 (loss surface) 的消融分析，并把掩码操作从网络剪枝/模型压缩的常规用途扩展到更广的模型能力范围。
Result: 在全量微调模型上，MFT 跨领域与跨骨干取得一致增益，例如 LLaMA2-7B 与 LLaMA-3.1-8B 在 IFEval 上平均分别提升 2.70 与 4.15；部署到训练好的模型时与其他 LLM 优化流程兼容，可叠加提升整体性能。
Conclusion: 保持模型结构完整性并非取得好性能的必要条件：在不更新权重的前提下施加精心设计的二值掩码即可稳定增益，且掩码的价值不止于剪枝压缩。

papers.title: Causal Effect Estimation under Networked Interference without Networked Unconfoundedness Assumption
papers.abstract_en: Estimating causal effects under networked interference from observational data is a crucial yet challenging problem. Most existing methods mainly rely on the networked unconfoundedness assumption, which guarantees the identification of networked effects. However, this assumption is often violated due to the latent confounders inherent in observational data, thereby hindering the identification of networked effects. To address this issue, we leverage the rich interaction patterns between units in networks, which provide valuable information for recovering these latent confounders. Building on this insight, we develop a confounder recovery framework that explicitly characterizes three categories of latent confounders in networked settings: those affecting only the unit, those affecting only the unit's neighbors, and those influencing both. Based on this framework, we design a networked effect estimator using identifiable representation learning techniques. From a theoretical standpoint, we prove the identifiability of all three types of latent confounders and, by leveraging the recovered confounders, establish a formal identification result for networked effects. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.comment: accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, in press
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在网络化干扰 (networked interference) 下，观测数据的网络化效应估计通常依赖常被潜混杂违反的 networked unconfoundedness；本文利用网络中单元间的交互模式恢复潜混杂，把它们显式分为仅影响该单元、仅影响其邻居、以及同时影响两者三类，并用可辨识表示学习构造网络化效应估计量。理论上证明三类潜混杂均可辨识并据此建立网络化效应的正式识别结果，实验验证了理论结论与方法有效性。
Motivation: 观测数据中固有的潜混杂常使 networked unconfoundedness 不成立，导致网络化效应无法识别，现有方法因此受限。
Method: 提出混杂恢复框架，显式刻画网络场景下三类潜混杂（仅作用于单元、仅作用于邻居、两者皆作用）；在此基础上用可辨识表示学习 (identifiable representation learning) 设计网络化效应估计量，并利用单元间交互模式恢复潜混杂。
Result: 理论上证明三类潜混杂的可辨识性，并基于恢复的混杂建立网络化效应的正式识别结果；摘要称 extensive experiments 验证了理论发现并展示了方法有效性，未给出具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 借助网络交互模式恢复潜混杂，可以在不依赖 networked unconfoundedness 的前提下识别网络化干扰下的网络化效应。

papers.title: Large Language Models for Cryptocurrency Transaction Analysis: A Bitcoin Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Cryptocurrencies are widely used, yet current methods for analyzing transactions often rely on opaque, black-box models. While these models may achieve high performance, their outputs are usually difficult to interpret and adapt, making it challenging to capture nuanced behavioral patterns. Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to address these gaps, but their capabilities in this area remain largely unexplored, particularly in cybercrime detection. In this paper, we test this hypothesis by applying LLMs to real-world cryptocurrency transaction graphs, with a focus on Bitcoin, one of the most studied and widely adopted blockchain networks. We introduce a three-tiered framework to assess LLM capabilities: foundational metrics, characteristic overview, and contextual interpretation. This includes a new, human-readable graph representation format, LLM4TG, and a connectivity-enhanced transaction graph sampling algorithm, CETraS. Together, they significantly reduce token requirements, transforming the analysis of multiple moderately large-scale transaction graphs with LLMs from nearly impossible to feasible under strict token limits. Experimental results demonstrate that LLMs have outstanding performance on foundational metrics and characteristic overview, where the accuracy of recognizing most basic information at the node level exceeds 98.50% and the proportion of obtaining meaningful characteristics reaches 95.00%. Regarding contextual interpretation, LLMs also demonstrate strong performance in classification tasks, even with very limited labeled data, where top-3 accuracy reaches 72.43% with explanations. While the explanations are not always fully accurate, they highlight the strong potential of LLMs in this domain. At the same time, several limitations persist, which we discuss along with directions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 用到真实比特币交易图分析上，提出人类可读的图表示 LLM4TG 与连通性增强采样算法 CETraS，大幅压低 token 需求，使中等规模交易图在严格 token 限制下可分析。节点级基础信息识别准确率超 98.50%，有意义特征获取比例达 95.00%，少标注分类任务 top-3 准确率 72.43% 并附解释。
Motivation: 现有加密货币交易分析多依赖不透明的黑盒模型，输出难以解释与适配，难以捕捉细粒度行为模式；LLM 在该领域（尤其网络犯罪检测）的能力尚未被系统检验。
Method: 提出三层评估框架：基础指标、特征概览、上下文解释；配套新的人类可读交易图表示格式 LLM4TG 与连通性增强的交易图采样算法 CETraS，以压缩 token 需求，并在真实 Bitcoin 交易图上做实验。
Result: 节点级基础信息识别准确率超过 98.50%；获取有意义特征的比例达 95.00%；在标注极少的分类任务上 top-3 准确率达 72.43% 且附带解释。
Conclusion: LLM 在交易图基础度量与特征概览上表现突出，在少标注上下文分类中也具强潜力，但解释并非总是完全准确，仍存在若干局限。

papers.title: Identifiability Analysis of Linear ODE Systems with Hidden Confounders
papers.abstract_en: The identifiability analysis of linear Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) systems is a necessary prerequisite for making reliable causal inferences about these systems. While identifiability has been well studied in scenarios where the system is fully observable, the conditions for identifiability remain unexplored when latent variables interact with the system. This paper aims to address this gap by presenting a systematic analysis of identifiability in linear ODE systems incorporating hidden confounders. Specifically, we investigate two cases of such systems. In the first case, latent confounders exhibit no causal relationships, yet their evolution adheres to specific functional forms, such as polynomial functions of time $t$. Subsequently, we extend this analysis to encompass scenarios where hidden confounders exhibit causal dependencies, with the causal structure of latent variables described by a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). The second case represents a more intricate variation of the first case, prompting a more comprehensive identifiability analysis. Accordingly, we conduct detailed identifiability analyses of the second system under various observation conditions, including both continuous and discrete observations from single or multiple trajectories. To validate our theoretical results, we perform a series of simulations, which support and substantiate our findings.
papers.comment: 38th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2024). v3: revised discrete-observation results; see Appendix D.6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性 ODE 系统含隐藏混淆因子 (hidden confounders) 时给出可识别性 (identifiability) 的系统分析：先处理潜变量无因果关系但按多项式等函数形式演化的情形，再扩展到潜变量间因果结构为 DAG 的情形，并在连续/离散、单/多轨迹观测下分别推导可识别条件。仿真验证了这些理论结论。
Motivation: 全可观测线性 ODE 的可识别性已有成熟结果，但潜变量与系统交互时的可识别条件此前未被研究，而这正是对这类系统做可靠因果推断的前提。
Method: 分两类系统做可识别性分析：第一类潜混淆因子无因果关系、演化服从 t 的多项式等特定函数形式；第二类潜混淆因子间有 DAG 描述的因果依赖。对第二类在连续观测与离散观测、单轨迹与多轨迹等观测条件下分别推导可识别条件，并用一系列仿真检验理论结论。
Result: 给出两类含隐藏混淆因子的线性 ODE 系统在连续与离散观测、单条与多条轨迹下的可识别性分析结果，并通过一系列仿真支持这些理论发现；arXiv v3 修订了离散观测部分的结果（见 Appendix D.6）。
Conclusion: 含隐藏混淆因子的线性 ODE 在特定潜变量结构与观测条件下可判定可识别性，仿真表明这些理论条件成立，可作为该类系统因果推断的前置依据。

papers.title: Large Pretraining Datasets Don't Guarantee Robustness after Fine-Tuning in Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pretrained models are widely leveraged as foundations for learning new specialized tasks via fine-tuning, with the goal of maintaining the general performance of the model while allowing it to gain new skills. A valuable goal for all such models is robustness: the ability to perform well on out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. We assess whether fine-tuning preserves the overall robustness of the pretrained model in image classification, and observed that models pretrained on large datasets exhibited strong catastrophic forgetting and loss of OOD generalization. To systematically assess robustness preservation in fine-tuned models, we propose the Robustness Inheritance Benchmark (ImageNet-RIB). The benchmark, which can be applied to any pretrained model, consists of a set of related but distinct OOD (downstream) tasks and involves fine-tuning on one of the OOD tasks in the set then testing on the rest. We find that though continual learning methods help, fine-tuning reduces robustness across pretrained models. Surprisingly, models pretrained on the largest and most diverse datasets (e.g., LAION-2B) exhibit both larger robustness losses and lower absolute robustness after fine-tuning on small datasets, relative to models pretrained on smaller datasets. We observe this collapse in contrastively pretrained (CLIP) models and their fine-tuned variants, where it grows with pretraining scale; the supervised models we test do not exhibit it. These findings suggest that starting with the strongest foundation model is not necessarily the best approach for performance on specialist tasks. https://jd730.github.io/projects/ImageNet-RIB
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Robustness Inheritance Benchmark (ImageNet-RIB)，在一组相关但不同的 OOD 下游任务上微调其一、测试其余，发现大规模预训练模型微调后出现强烈灾难性遗忘与 OOD 泛化损失；LAION-2B 等最大最多样数据集预训练的模型在小数据集微调后鲁棒性损失更大、绝对鲁棒性更低，且该崩塌随预训练规模增长，出现在对比预训练的 CLIP 及其微调变体中，而受监督模型没有。结论是起步最强的基础模型未必是专家任务的最佳起点。
Motivation: 微调本应在获得新技能的同时保住预训练模型的通用性能，但大规模预训练是否在微调后仍保留 OOD 鲁棒性缺少系统评估手段。
Method: 提出可套用于任意预训练模型的 ImageNet-RIB：构造一组相关但不同的 OOD 下游任务，在其中一个上微调、在其余任务上测试；对比不同预训练数据规模与范式（CLIP 对比预训练 vs 受监督），并考察 continual learning 方法的作用。
Result: 微调导致各预训练模型鲁棒性下降，continual learning 方法有帮助但不能消除；预训练数据最大最多样（如 LAION-2B）的模型在小数据集微调后相对小数据集预训练模型既有更大鲁棒性损失、又有更低的绝对鲁棒性；该崩塌在 CLIP 及其微调变体中随预训练规模增长，受监督模型不出现。
Conclusion: 对专家任务而言，从最强基础模型起步并不必然最好，因为对比预训练模型的规模会放大微调后的鲁棒性崩塌。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Explanations Compete: Policy-Aware Selection Under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty-aware explanation methods often produce several alternatives for the same prediction. Selecting among them requires a policy for balancing prediction confidence, uncertainty, and application constraints. This paper presents a framework for applying such policies to a fixed set of generated explanations. Candidates are characterised by uncertainty change, prediction direction, and, when available, interval position relative to a decision boundary. The framework combines these properties with eligibility rules, optional bidirectional Pareto screening, and policy-aware ranking. A fictitious prostate-cancer example illustrates how different explanatory purposes lead to different selections from the same candidate set. We instantiate the framework with Calibrated Explanations for classification, thresholded regression, and plain regression. Across 41 benchmark datasets, mean candidate counts range from 11.57 to 21.75 for single-feature explanations and from $29.48$ to $69.53$ when conjunctions are included. Equal-weight and confidence-only policies yield an average selection-disagreement rate of $28.7\%$ while favouring the same confidence direction. A supporting $δ$-CLUE experiment demonstrates use with a second generator. By making the selection policy explicit, the framework allows applications to compare and prioritise explanations according to their intended use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个在多个候选解释之间按显式策略做选择的框架：用不确定性变化、预测方向、相对决策边界的区间位置刻画候选，再叠加资格规则、可选双向 Pareto 筛选与策略感知排序。在 41 个基准数据集上，等权策略与仅看置信度策略的平均选择分歧率达 28.7%，但两者偏好同一置信度方向。
Motivation: 不确定性感知解释方法常对同一预测给出多个候选，缺少在预测置信度、不确定性与应用约束之间取舍的显式选择策略，不同解释目的无法在同一候选集上比较与排序。
Method: 框架作用于已生成的固定候选集：以不确定性变化、预测方向、区间相对决策边界的位置刻画候选，结合资格规则、可选的双向 Pareto 筛选与策略感知排序；用 Calibrated Explanations 实例化到分类、阈值回归与普通回归，并以 δ-CLUE 实验接入第二个生成器。
Result: 在 41 个基准数据集上，单特征解释的平均候选数为 11.57 至 21.75，加入合取后为 29.48 至 69.53；等权策略与仅置信度策略的平均选择分歧率为 28.7%，且两者偏好同一置信度方向。另以一个虚构的前列腺癌示例展示不同解释目的如何从同一候选集选出不同解释。
Conclusion: 把选择策略显式化后，应用可按自身用途比较并排序解释；策略差异本身就会在相同候选集上造成接近三成的选择分歧，因此策略必须随用途声明。

papers.title: Convergence of Sharpness-Aware Minimization Algorithms using Increasing Batch Size and Decaying Learning Rate
papers.abstract_en: The sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) algorithm and its variants, including gap guided SAM (GSAM), have been successful at improving the generalization capability of deep neural network models by finding flat local minima of the empirical loss in training. Meanwhile, it has been shown theoretically and practically that increasing the batch size or decaying the learning rate avoids sharp local minima of the empirical loss. In this paper, we consider the GSAM algorithm with increasing batch sizes or decaying learning rates, such as cosine annealing or linear learning rate, and theoretically show its convergence. Moreover, we numerically compare SAM (GSAM) with and without an increasing batch size and conclude that using an increasing batch size { achieves a lower worst-case $\ell_\infty$ adaptive sharpness} than compared with using a constant batch size and learning rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 GSAM（gap guided sharpness-aware minimization）中引入增大批量或衰减学习率（cosine annealing、linear learning rate），理论上证明其收敛，并数值比较增大批量与恒定批量的效果：增大批量得到更低的 worst-case ℓ∞ adaptive sharpness。
Motivation: SAM/GSAM 通过寻找平坦极小值提升泛化，而增大批量或衰减学习率在理论与实践上被证明可避开尖锐极小值；但带这类调度的 GSAM 收敛性尚缺理论刻画。
Method: 考虑带增大批量或衰减学习率（如 cosine annealing、linear learning rate）的 GSAM 算法，给出收敛性的理论证明；并数值比较带与不带增大批量的 SAM (GSAM)。
Result: 数值比较结论：使用增大批量比恒定批量与恒定学习率取得更低的 worst-case ℓ∞ adaptive sharpness。
Conclusion: 带增大批量或衰减学习率的 GSAM 具备收敛保证，且增大批量在自适应锐度这一指标上优于恒定批量与学习率。

papers.title: Modeling Time-Dependent Responses of Optical Compressors with Selective State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a method for modeling optical dynamic range compressors using deep neural networks with Selective State Space models. The proposed approach surpasses previous methods based on recurrent layers by employing a Selective State Space block to encode the input audio. It features a refined technique integrating Feature-wise Linear Modulation and Gated Linear Units to adjust the network dynamically, conditioning the compression's attack and release phases according to external parameters. The proposed architecture is well-suited for low-latency and real-time applications, crucial in live audio processing. The method has been validated on the analog optical compressors TubeTech CL 1B and Teletronix LA-2A, which possess distinct characteristics. Evaluation is performed using quantitative metrics and subjective listening tests, comparing the proposed method with other state-of-the-art models. Results show that our black-box modeling methods outperform all others, achieving accurate emulation of the compression process for both seen and unseen settings during training. We further show a correlation between this accuracy and the sampling density of the control parameters in the dataset and identify settings with fast attack and slow release as the most challenging to emulate.
papers.comment: in Journal of the Audio Engineering Society vol. 73, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 Selective State Space 模型对光学动态范围压缩器 (optical compressor) 做黑箱建模，以 SSM block 编码输入音频，再用 Feature-wise Linear Modulation 与 Gated Linear Unit 按外部参数动态调节 attack/release。在 TubeTech CL 1B 与 Teletronix LA-2A 上，该方法在定量指标与主观听音测试中均优于已有 SOTA 模型，且对训练中未见过的设置也能准确仿真；控制参数采样密度与精度相关，快速 attack 加慢速 release 最难仿真。
Motivation: 光学压缩器的增益随时间变化且依赖外部参数，此前基于循环层的黑箱建模精度不足，而现场实时处理要求低延迟。
Method: 以 Selective State Space block 编码输入音频，配合 Feature-wise Linear Modulation 与 Gated Linear Unit 按外部参数动态调节网络，使压缩的 attack 与 release 阶段随参数变化；架构面向低延迟实时应用，用定量指标与主观听音测试同其他 SOTA 模型对比。
Result: 在 TubeTech CL 1B 与 Teletronix LA-2A 两台特性不同的模拟光学压缩器上，所提黑箱建模方法在定量指标与主观听音测试中均超过其他 SOTA 模型，对训练中见过与未见过的设置都能准确仿真压缩过程；精度与数据集中控制参数的采样密度相关，快速 attack 加慢速 release 的设置最难仿真。
Conclusion: Selective State Space 加 FiLM/GLU 的动态条件化足以在低延迟下准确仿真光学压缩器，建模难点集中在快 attack 慢 release 区域，控制参数采样密度直接决定精度。
