papers.title: Diffusion Model-Based Video Editing: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: The rapid development of diffusion models (DMs) has significantly advanced image and video applications, making "what you want is what you see" a reality. Among these, video editing has gained substantial attention and seen a swift rise in research activity, necessitating a comprehensive and systematic review of the existing literature. This paper reviews diffusion model-based video editing techniques, including theoretical foundations and practical applications. We begin by overviewing the mathematical formulation and image domain's key methods. Subsequently, we categorize video editing approaches by the inherent connections of their core technologies, depicting evolutionary trajectory. This paper also dives into novel applications, including point-based editing and pose-guided human video editing. Additionally, we present a comprehensive comparison using our newly introduced V2VBench. Building on the progress achieved to date, the paper concludes with ongoing challenges and potential directions for future research.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 16 figures, a project related to this paper can be found at https://github.com/wenhao728/awesome-diffusion-v2v
papers.journal_ref: International Journal of Computer Vision 134(10), 440 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇基于扩散模型的视频编辑 (diffusion model-based video editing) 综述，按核心技术的内在联系对方法分类并梳理演化脉络，覆盖点编辑 (point-based editing) 与姿态引导人物视频编辑 (pose-guided human video editing) 等新应用，并提出新基准 V2VBench 做综合比较。与降水、天气预报或资料同化无关联。
Motivation: 扩散模型推动图像与视频应用快速发展，视频编辑方向研究激增，缺少覆盖理论基础与实际应用、并能系统比较现有方法的综述。
Method: 先概述扩散模型的数学形式化与图像域关键方法，再按视频编辑方法核心技术的内在联系分类并描绘演化轨迹；随后介绍点编辑与姿态引导人物视频编辑等新应用，并用作者新提出的 V2VBench 做综合比较。
Result: 提出新基准 V2VBench 并据此对扩散模型视频编辑方法做综合比较；论文为 24 页、16 图的综述，成果发表于 International Journal of Computer Vision 134(10), 440 (2026)。
Conclusion: 扩散模型视频编辑已形成可按核心技术分类的演化谱系，V2VBench 为该方向提供了统一比较平台，后续研究需应对文中归纳的开放挑战与未来方向。

papers.title: FreDF: Learning to Forecast in the Frequency Domain
papers.abstract_en: Time series modeling presents unique challenges due to autocorrelation in both historical data and future sequences. While current research predominantly addresses autocorrelation within historical data, the correlations among future labels are often overlooked. Specifically, modern forecasting models primarily adhere to the Direct Forecast (DF) paradigm, generating multi-step forecasts independently and disregarding label autocorrelation over time. In this work, we demonstrate that the learning objective of DF is biased in the presence of label autocorrelation. To address this issue, we propose the Frequency-enhanced Direct Forecast (FreDF), which mitigates label autocorrelation by learning to forecast in the frequency domain, thereby reducing estimation bias. Our experiments show that FreDF significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods and is compatible with a variety of forecast models. Code is available at https://github.com/Master-PLC/FreDF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FreDF 指出 Direct Forecast (DF) 范式在标签存在自相关时学习目标有偏：多步预报被独立生成，忽略了未来标签之间的时间相关性。它把预测转到频域上学习，用频域损失缓解标签自相关带来的估计偏差，在实验中显著优于现有 SOTA 方法，且可与多种预报模型兼容。
Motivation: 现有时间序列研究主要处理历史数据的自相关，而未来标签之间的相关性被忽略；DF 独立生成多步预报，在标签自相关存在时其学习目标有偏，导致估计偏差。
Method: 提出 Frequency-enhanced Direct Forecast (FreDF)：在频域中学习多步预报，通过频域目标缓解标签自相关、降低估计偏差；方法与多种预报模型兼容，代码已开源。
Result: 实验显示 FreDF 显著优于现有 state-of-the-art 方法，并可与多种 forecast 模型组合使用；摘要未给出具体数据集与指标数值。
Conclusion: 标签自相关是 DF 目标偏差的来源，在频域中学习多步预报可以降低该偏差，且这一改进可移植到不同预报模型上。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Probabilistic Truly Unordered Rule Sets
papers.abstract_en: Rule set learning has recently been frequently revisited because of its interpretability. Existing methods have several shortcomings though. First, most existing methods impose orders among rules, either explicitly or implicitly, which makes the models less comprehensible. Second, due to the difficulty of handling conflicts caused by overlaps (i.e., instances covered by multiple rules), existing methods often do not consider probabilistic rules. Third, learning classification rules for multi-class target is understudied, as most existing methods focus on binary classification or multi-class classification via the ``one-versus-rest" approach. To address these shortcomings, we propose TURS, for Truly Unordered Rule Sets. To resolve conflicts caused by overlapping rules, we propose a novel model that exploits the probabilistic properties of our rule sets, with the intuition of only allowing rules to overlap if they have similar probabilistic outputs. We next formalize the problem of learning a TURS model based on the MDL principle and develop a carefully designed heuristic algorithm. We benchmark against a wide range of rule-based methods and demonstrate that our method learns rule sets that have lower model complexity and highly competitive predictive performance. In addition, we empirically show that rules in our model are empirically ``independent" and hence truly unordered.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 TURS（Truly Unordered Rule Sets）：规则间不施加任何顺序，只允许概率输出相近的规则重叠以化解冲突，并按 MDL 原则形式化学习问题、设计启发式算法。在与多种规则方法的基准对比中，TURS 学到的规则集模型复杂度更低且预测性能高度竞争，规则在经验上相互独立、真正无序。
Motivation: 现有规则集学习有三个短板：显式或隐式给规则排序损害可解释性；重叠导致的冲突难处理，因而很少做概率规则；多分类目标研究不足，多靠 one-versus-rest 绕开。
Method: TURS 用概率规则集模型，只允许概率输出相近的规则重叠来消解冲突；基于 MDL（最小描述长度）原则形式化学习目标，并设计专门的启发式算法求解。
Result: 在与多种规则方法的基准对比中，TURS 学到的规则集模型复杂度更低、预测性能高度竞争；经验上模型中的规则相互独立，因而真正无序。
Conclusion: 去掉规则顺序并用概率一致性约束重叠，可以在不牺牲预测性能的前提下降低规则集复杂度，多分类概率规则学习也可行。

papers.title: Hypergraph-Enhanced Dual Convolutional Network for Bundle Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Bundle recommendation ranks sets of related items rather than isolated items. Its central challenge is to connect user preferences, item interactions, and bundle composition without losing the signals needed to rank bundles. We propose Hypergraph-Enhanced Dual Convolutional Neural Network (HED), which constructs a complete hypergraph containing user--bundle, user--item, and bundle--item interactions together with intra-user and intra-bundle relations. HED couples complete-hypergraph propagation with a user--bundle branch, allowing item-aware higher-order context to inform ranking while preserving recommendation-specific signals. On NetEase, HED-128 improves over the strongest baseline by 5.04--6.97% across the six reported metrics; on Youshu, HED-64 improves by 1.87--4.56%. Ablation results support the contributions of both the user--bundle branch and intra-type relations, and sensitivity analyses identify stable operating ranges for the main hyperparameters. We further quantify the computational trade-off of the complete hypergraph, including its memory cost. The evidence supports HED on the two evaluated bundle-recommendation datasets while making its resource limitations explicit. Code and datasets will be made available upon publication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HED 用完全超图同时承载 user–bundle、user–item、bundle–item 三类交互及 intra-user/intra-bundle 关系，再与 user–bundle 分支耦合做 bundle 排序。在 NetEase 上 HED-128 相对最强基线六项指标全部提升 5.04–6.97%，Youshu 上 HED-64 提升 1.87–4.56%。
Motivation: Bundle 排序需要同时连接用户偏好、单品交互与 bundle 构成，普通图建模容易在聚合高阶上下文时丢掉推荐专用信号。
Method: 构建包含 user–bundle、user–item、bundle–item 交互以及 intra-user、intra-bundle 关系的完全超图，用完全超图传播与 user–bundle 双分支卷积网络 (HED) 耦合，让 item-aware 高阶上下文进入排序；另做消融、超参敏感性分析与完全超图的内存开销量化。
Result: NetEase 上 HED-128 相对最强基线在六项报告指标上提升 5.04–6.97%；Youshu 上 HED-64 提升 1.87–4.56%。消融支持 user–bundle 分支与 intra-type 关系的贡献，敏感性分析给出主超参的稳定区间，并量化了完全超图的内存代价。
Conclusion: 在 NetEase 与 Youshu 两个 bundle 推荐数据集上证据支持 HED，同时明确其完全超图的资源开销限制。

papers.title: Fast, Interpretable, and Deterministic Time Series Classification With a Bag-of-Receptive-Fields
papers.abstract_en: The current trend in the literature on Time Series Classification is to develop increasingly accurate algorithms by combining multiple models in ensemble hybrids, representing time series in complex and expressive feature spaces, and extracting features from different representations of the same time series. As a consequence of this focus on predictive performance, the best time series classifiers are black-box models, which are not understandable from a human standpoint. Even the approaches that are regarded as interpretable, such as shapelet-based ones, rely on randomization to maintain computational efficiency. This poses challenges for interpretability, as the explanation can change from run to run. Given these limitations, we propose the Bag-Of-Receptive-Field (BORF), a fast, interpretable, and deterministic time series transform. Building upon the classical Bag-Of-Patterns, we bridge the gap between convolutional operators and discretization, enhancing the Symbolic Aggregate Approximation (SAX) with dilation and stride, which can more effectively capture temporal patterns at multiple scales. We propose an algorithmic speedup that reduces the time complexity associated with SAX-based classifiers, allowing the extension of the Bag-Of-Patterns to the more flexible Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields, represented as a sparse multivariate tensor. The empirical results from testing our proposal on more than 150 univariate and multivariate classification datasets demonstrate good accuracy and great computational efficiency compared to traditional SAX-based methods and state-of-the-art time series classifiers, while providing easy-to-understand explanations.
papers.comment: Accepted version of the article published in IEEE Access (2024), CC BY 4.0. Substantially revised from v1 ("A Bag of Receptive Fields for Time Series Extrinsic Predictions"), which also covered time series extrinsic regression. Code: https://github.com/fspinna/borf
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 BORF（Bag-Of-Receptive-Field）：把 SAX 离散化与卷积的 dilation、stride 结合，并用算法加速降低 SAX 类分类器的时间复杂度，得到稀疏多变量张量表示的确定性可解释时间序列变换。在 150 多个单变量与多变量分类数据集上，相比传统 SAX 方法与 SOTA 时间序列分类器兼具良好精度、高计算效率和易懂解释。
Motivation: 当前时间序列分类 (TSC) 追求精度而堆叠 ensemble hybrids 与多表示特征，最优模型沦为黑箱；即便 shapelet 类可解释方法也依赖随机化换取效率，导致解释随运行而变。
Method: BORF 在 Bag-Of-Patterns 基础上给 SAX 增加 dilation 与 stride 以捕获多尺度时间模式，并提出算法加速降低 SAX 类分类器的时间复杂度，将 Bag-Of-Patterns 推广为以稀疏多变量张量表示的 Bag-Of-Receptive-Fields；变换本身是确定性的，输出可直接读的解释。
Result: 在 150 多个单变量与多变量分类数据集上的实证结果表明：相比传统 SAX 方法与 state-of-the-art 时间序列分类器，BORF 具有良好的精度与很高的计算效率，同时提供易于理解的解释。
Conclusion: 时间序列分类可以在不牺牲精度的前提下同时做到快速、确定性与可解释，无需依赖 ensemble 拼接或随机化；BORF 以稀疏张量形式给出可复现的解释。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Climbing the Design Ladder: Sequential Knowledge Distillation for Early-Stage Circuit Timing Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Integrated circuit design involves multiple design stages: logic synthesis, floorplanning, placement, and routing, with each stage taking hours to weeks to complete. Discovering timing violations late in this flow forces costly iterations back to earlier stages, wasting computational resources and delaying product launches. While predicting post-routing timing from early-stage data could prevent these failures, existing machine learning approaches struggle with the massive abstraction gap between post-synthesis logical descriptions and post-routing physical layouts. We propose STEP-KD (Sequential Timing Evaluation via Progressive Knowledge Distillation), which leverages intermediate design stages as ``stepping stones'' for progressive knowledge transfer rather than attempting direct prediction. STEP-KD trains teacher models at the post-routing, post-placement, and post-floorplan stages, then sequentially distills their knowledge to a post-synthesis student model through representation alignment. Experiments on diverse circuits demonstrate that STEP-KD reduces timing prediction error compared to direct distillation and supervised baselines, and in most settings compared to the industry-standard Static Timing Analysis (STA) tool. STEP-KD reduces the weighted mean absolute percentage error of Total Negative Slack prediction to 19.78\%, compared with 74.84\% for STA. Our proposed method is step forward to identify timing problems earlier, avoiding expensive late-stage redesigns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STEP-KD 用序列化知识蒸馏把布线后、布局后、布局规划后三个阶段的教师模型依次蒸馏到综合后学生模型，跨越抽象鸿沟直接预测布线后时序。加权 MAPE 上 Total Negative Slack 误差降到 19.78%，而工业标准 STA 工具为 74.84%，在多数设置下也优于直接蒸馏与监督基线。
Motivation: 时序违例若到布线后才暴露，需回退到早期阶段反复迭代，浪费算力并推迟流片；但综合后的逻辑描述与布线后的物理版图之间抽象鸿沟巨大，现有 ML 方法难以直接预测。
Method: STEP-KD (Sequential Timing Evaluation via Progressive Knowledge Distillation) 在 post-routing、post-placement、post-floorplan 三个中间阶段各训练一个教师模型，再通过表示对齐 (representation alignment) 把知识逐级蒸馏到 post-synthesis 学生模型，把中间设计阶段当作进阶踏脚石而非直接预测。
Result: 在多种电路上，STEP-KD 的时序预测误差低于直接蒸馏与监督基线，且在多数设置下低于工业标准 STA 工具；Total Negative Slack 预测的加权 MAPE 为 19.78%，STA 为 74.84%。
Conclusion: 把中间设计阶段作为蒸馏阶梯，可以在综合阶段就识别时序问题，避免昂贵的后期返工。

papers.title: Safeguarding LLMs via Model-Agnostic Latent Safety Signals from Dark Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: LLMs have advanced rapidly, raising growing concerns about their safety. Recent work has proposed approaches to detect and defend against attacks including defenses at decoding stage that leverage models' hidden states. However, existing decoding-stage defenses suffer from two limitations. First, they introduce a trade-off between safety and over-refusal, where strengthening safety degrades the model's helpfulness on benign queries. Second, many of these methods rely on internal hidden states and are thus restricted to specific architectures, incurring substantial overhead and limited generalization across models. To address these limitations, we introduce LADE (Latent Safety Signals for Defense), which leverages latent safety signals extracted by contrasting harmful and benign queries from dark knowledge (i.e., information carried by the output probability distribution beyond its argmax) in the first-token output probability distribution. Our key insight is that, beyond surface-level refusal tokens, the dark knowledge in the first-token distribution contains latent safety signals, defined as tokens whose probabilities differ sharply between harmful and benign queries. We show that these signals consistently align across LLMs, forming a model-agnostic direction that emerges from safety alignment. LADE consists of three components: (1) Extracting Latent Safety Signals from Dark Knowledge, which selects top-k safety-discriminative tokens from the first-token probability distribution; (2) Tokenizer Mapping, which maps these tokens across different tokenizers to enable model-agnostic application; and (3) kNN-based Discrimination, which classifies queries via a k-Nearest Neighbors search over the mapped tokens. Across diverse LLMs and benchmarks, LADE is robust against a wide range of jailbreak attacks and lowers attack success rates while maintaining a competitive safety-utility trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LADE 从首 token 输出概率分布的 dark knowledge 中对比有害与无害查询，抽取概率差异最大的安全判别 token，经 tokenizer 映射后用 kNN 分类查询，得到跨模型共享的模型无关安全方向。在多种 LLM 与基准上对各类 jailbreak 攻击稳健，降低攻击成功率并保持有竞争力的 safety-utility 权衡。
Motivation: 现有解码阶段防御存在安全与过度拒绝 (over-refusal) 的权衡，且依赖内部隐藏状态，被限制在特定架构上，跨模型泛化差、开销大。
Method: LADE 三组件：从首 token 概率分布中选 top-k 安全判别 token；Tokenizer Mapping 跨不同 tokenizer 对齐这些 token 以支持模型无关应用；再对映射后的 token 做 kNN 搜索完成查询分类。
Result: 在多种 LLM 与基准上，LADE 对大范围 jailbreak 攻击稳健，降低攻击成功率 (attack success rate)，同时保持有竞争力的 safety-utility 权衡。
Conclusion: 安全对齐会在首 token 分布中留下跨模型一致的潜在安全信号，据此可在不依赖特定架构隐藏状态的前提下做解码阶段防御。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Targeted search shows that random-device testing underestimates worst-case error in a simulated wave-based neural operator
papers.abstract_en: Wave-based processors promise fast, energy-efficient Fourier layers for neural operators. They are usually validated on randomly sampled devices, but using them requires knowing how large their error can become under fabrication and alignment variation. In a stylised numerical case study, a hybrid Fourier neural operator runs its four spectral layers on simulated coherent 4f processors with 32 toleranced knobs, whose half-widths are representative rather than calibrated. For 120 models (four tasks, six training methods, five seeds), we compared the worst of N random in-spec devices with a searched one. On a deterministic simulator with one frozen draw of the random static errors, the searched device's held-out error was 1.08-3.10 times the maximum over 200 Monte Carlo devices and 1.06-2.71 times that over 1000. With 20 fresh static draws, it still exceeded the maximum over 200 random devices in 116 of 120 models. Under uniform sampling, the probability of drawing such a device is at most 0.37% per model (two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson), which says nothing about how large its error is. The gap persisted with uniform or Sobol' sampling at the search's budget, shared knobs, a second crosstalk model, box scales of 0.25-2 and a pixel-level device model. Models trained only with random static errors reached 3.7-39.9 times their nominal error on searched devices, and fine-tuning on random and gradient-searched devices gave the lowest searched error of the six in all 20 task-seed pairs. For two heat-exchanger quantities, a search targeted at each exceeded the worst of 1000 random devices in all 39 models, and hence the Wilks 95/95 limit (worst of 59). For the mean pressure of 11 models, no random device exceeded a 1% error threshold, but the searched device did. Random testing estimates how often errors exceed a threshold; worst-device search gives a lower bound on how large they can be.
papers.comment: 50 pages (19 main text and references, 31 Supplementary Information), 5 figures, 1 table
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 波基光学处理器上的傅里叶神经算子通常只用随机抽样的在容差器件验证，本文在含 32 个容差旋钮的相干 4f 模拟器上做定向最坏器件搜索，发现随机测试系统性低估最坏误差：搜索器件的留出误差是 200 个 Monte Carlo 器件最大值的 1.08–3.10 倍、1000 个的 1.06–2.71 倍。仅用随机静态误差训练的模型在搜索器件上达到标称误差的 3.7–39.9 倍；作者的结论是随机测试只能估计超阈值频率，最坏器件搜索才给出误差上界的下界。
Motivation: 波基处理器要实际部署就必须知道制造与对准偏差下误差能涨到多大，而现有验证只随机采样在容差器件，给出的是超阈值概率而非误差幅度，对热交换器量这类需要 Wilks 95/95 容差限的场景不够用。
Method: 在风格化数值算例中，让混合傅里叶神经算子 (hybrid FNO) 的四个谱层跑在模拟相干 4f 处理器上，器件有 32 个容差旋钮（半宽为代表性而非标定值）；对 120 个模型（4 任务 × 6 训练方法 × 5 随机种子）比较 N 个随机在容差器件中的最坏者与定向搜索到的器件，并用均匀与 Sobol' 采样、共享旋钮、第二种串扰模型、0.25–2 的 box 尺度、像素级器件模型做稳健性检查。
Result: 在单次冻结随机静态误差的确定性模拟器上，搜索器件的留出误差为 200 个 Monte Carlo 器件最大值的 1.08–3.10 倍、1000 个最大值的 1.06–2.71 倍；换 20 组新静态误差后，120 个模型中仍有 116 个的搜索器件超过 200 个随机器件的最大值。均匀采样下单次抽到此类器件的概率每模型至多 0.37%（双侧 95% Clopper-Pearson）。仅用随机静态误差训练的模型在搜索器件上达到标称误差的 3.7–39.9 倍；在随机与梯度搜索器件上微调，在全部 20 个 task-seed 对中都给出六种训练方法里最低的搜索器件误差。对两个热交换器量，定向搜索在全部 39 个模型中超过 1000 个随机器件的最坏值，因而也超过 Wilks 95/95 限（最坏 59 个）；对 11 个模型的平均压强，没有随机器件超过 1% 误差阈值，而搜索器件超过了。
Conclusion: 随机测试只能刻画误差超阈值的频率，最坏器件搜索才给出误差幅度的下界；在随机器件上训练并辅以梯度搜索器件微调，是降低最坏器件误差的最有效训练配方。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: 在单次冻结随机静态误差的确定性模拟器上，搜索器件的留出误差为 200 个 Monte Carlo 器件最大值的 1.08–3.10 倍、1000 个最大值的 1.06–2.71 倍；换 20 组新静态误差后，120 个模型中仍有 116 个的搜索器件超过 200 个随机器件的最大值。均匀采样下单次抽到此类器件的概率每模型至多 0.37%（双侧 95% Clopper-Pearson）。仅用随机静态误差训练的模型在搜索器件上达到标称误差的 3.7–39.9 倍；在随机与梯度搜索器件上微调，在全部 20 个 task-seed 对中都给出六种训练方法里最低的搜索器件误差。对两个热交换器量，定向搜索在全部 39 个模型中超过 1000 个随机器件的最坏值，因而也超过 Wilks 95/95 限（最坏 59 个）；对 11 个模型的平均压强，没有随机器件超过 1% 误差阈值，而搜索器件超过了。
summary_sections.conclusion: 随机测试只能刻画误差超阈值的频率，最坏器件搜索才给出误差幅度的下界；在随机器件上训练并辅以梯度搜索器件微调，是降低最坏器件误差的最有效训练配方。

papers.title: Activation Denoising: A Robustness View on Parallel vs Sequential LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization is a powerful tool for compressing large language models. The most scalable methods quantize every layer in parallel, but quantization errors then compound through the residual stream, as no layer corrects for the errors of the layers before it. Sequential quantization accounts for this error compounding by re-calibrating each layer on the already-quantized outputs of its predecessors, yielding stronger results but at the cost of a serial schedule that becomes a bottleneck at scale. As a solution, we propose parallel quantization with activation denoising, which recovers much of the sequential benefit while keeping quantization fully parallel. Rather than re-calibrating layer-by-layer, we take a robustness perspective and model the upstream error as noise, regularizing to be robust to it through a preprocessing step followed by metric-weighted rounding. Applied at every layer, this regularization forms a depth-compounding smoothness penalty that dampens how strongly quantization errors amplify through the model. Unlike orthogonal rotations commonly used in quantization, which must preserve the model's function, we multiply the weights by a more general linear transformation. We find that the two are complementary and their effects compound. Empirically, our robustness regularization recovers a significant part of sequential quantization's benefit in a single parallel pass, at a fraction of its time. Overall, by treating compounding quantization errors as a robustness problem, we offer a principled foundation for more efficient and accurate LLM quantization at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出并行量化加激活去噪 (activation denoising)：把上游层的量化误差当作噪声，用预处理加度量加权取整 (metric-weighted rounding) 做鲁棒正则，逐层叠加形成深度复合的平滑惩罚，抑制误差沿残差流放大。单次并行前向即可收回顺序量化 (sequential quantization) 的大部分收益，耗时只占其一小部分。
Motivation: 并行量化各层独立校准，误差在残差流中逐层累积且无人纠正；顺序量化虽能逐层重校准，但串行调度在大规模模型上成为瓶颈。
Method: 对每层把上游量化误差建模为噪声，先做预处理再做度量加权取整，形成深度复合的平滑惩罚；权重乘以一般线性变换而非保持函数的正交旋转，两者互补且效果叠加。
Result: 在单次并行 pass 中收回顺序量化收益的相当一部分，耗时仅为顺序方案的一小部分；与正交旋转类方法互补且效果复合。
Conclusion: 把复合量化误差当作鲁棒性问题处理，可在保持完全并行的同时逼近顺序量化的精度与效率，为规模化 LLM 量化给出原则性基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Grounding What Shapes the Plan: Rethinking Groundedness for Physical Intelligence in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Driving models increasingly ground reasoning in causal relations, spatial structure, perceptual evidence, and predicted futures. These advances make reasoning more faithful to the driving scene, but leave a fundamental question unresolved: what should groundedness mean when the model ultimately outputs an action? Correctly grounded reasoning does not, by itself, ensure desirable driving outcomes. We introduce GroundAct, which starts from a simple premise: driving unfolds through physical entities and their interactions. Entities therefore become the unit of grounding; a lightweight reference token keeps each selected entity's continuous state addressable through symbolic reasoning; and only the referenced entities' interactions with the evolving proposal correct the plan. The result is an explicit path from what reasoning grounds to what the plan does, which we call grounded planning. To assess its practical value, we evaluate GroundAct in both open- and closed-loop settings. GroundAct shows strong open-loop planning across normal, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical scenarios, with closed-loop results extending this evidence to driving in simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GroundAct 把自动驾驶推理的 grounding 单位从抽象理由换成物理实体：用轻量 reference token 让被选实体的连续状态可被符号推理寻址，并只用被引用实体与当前候选方案的交互来修正计划，形成从推理到动作的显式路径（grounded planning）。在开环与闭环两种设置下，GroundAct 在正常、分布外与安全关键场景均表现出强开环规划能力，闭环结果把证据延伸到仿真中的驾驶。
Motivation: 现有驾驶模型把推理锚定在因果关系、空间结构与感知证据上，使推理更贴合场景，但推理正确并不保证驾驶结果良好，而模型最终输出的是动作，groundedness 应当以什么为单位仍未解决。
Method: GroundAct 以物理实体及其交互为 grounding 单位，为每个被选实体挂一个轻量 reference token 保持其连续状态在符号推理中可寻址，只让被引用实体与不断演化的 proposal 之间的交互参与计划修正，从而给出从推理所 ground 的内容到计划动作的显式路径。
Result: 在开环与闭环两种设置下评测：GroundAct 在正常、分布外 (out-of-distribution) 与安全关键 (safety-critical) 场景上均展现强开环规划表现，闭环结果进一步把证据扩展到仿真环境中的驾驶。
Conclusion: 以实体为 grounding 单位并让被引用实体的交互直接修正计划，可以把推理的 groundedness 转化为可追溯到动作的 grounded planning，且该路径在开环与闭环仿真中都成立。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Harmful SFT Leaves a Continuous Trace in LLM Checkpoint Updates
papers.abstract_en: Safety auditing of post-trained large language models typically relies on model behavior, requiring model execution and depending on the coverage of available evaluations. This work asks a different question: Do the target behaviors optimized during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leave readable evidence directly in checkpoint updates? We find that harmful-compliance SFT induces a continuous, objective-dependent ordering in checkpoint-update space. Using a reference geometry defined by pure harmful-compliance, safety-targeted, and benign-utility SFT, we find that a checkpoint-level coordinate s_H tracks controlled harmful-objective composition with Spearman correlations of 0.986-0.992 across four 7-8B backbones, with the same ordering persisting at larger model scales. Matched compliance-versus-refusal controls show that this checkpoint trace reflects the SFT objective rather than harmful-input exposure, while additional controls rule out simple explanations based on harmful-example count or generic training intensity. Building on this structure, we introduce TRACE, a weights-only auditing method that localizes an unknown checkpoint update relative to frozen harmful and non-harmful reference prototypes and converts this geometry into a continuous harmful-objective score. TRACE requires neither model queries nor access to the unknown SFT data, and can be evaluated directly from checkpoint updates. Across distribution shifts, unseen data, different SFT configurations, partial checkpoint access, and LoRA/full-parameter fine-tuning, the trace remains stable and is positively associated with independently measured attack success rates. TRACE remains informative even at low harmful-objective proportions, providing a complementary auditing signal when behavioral evaluation is unavailable or incomplete. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Code4TRACE-54D3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 是一种只读权重的 SFT 安全审计方法：有害顺从 (harmful-compliance) 训练会在 checkpoint 更新空间留下连续、随目标变化的轨迹，用冻结的有害/无害参考原型定位未知更新并换算成连续有害目标分数。checkpoint 级坐标 s_H 在四个 7-8B backbone 上与受控有害目标配比的 Spearman 相关达 0.986–0.992，且不需要模型查询或接触未知 SFT 数据。
Motivation: 对后训练 LLM 的安全审计依赖模型行为与评测覆盖度，需要执行模型且受评测集完备性限制；本文转向直接从 checkpoint 更新中读取 SFT 目标留下的证据。
Method: 用纯有害顺从、安全定向、良性效用三类 SFT 定义参考几何 (reference geometry)，在更新空间构造 checkpoint 级坐标 s_H；TRACE 据此把未知 checkpoint 更新定位到冻结的有害与无害参考原型之间，输出连续有害目标分数，仅需 checkpoint 更新即可评估。
Result: s_H 与受控有害目标配比在四个 7-8B backbone 上 Spearman 相关 0.986–0.992，同一排序在更大规模模型上保持；匹配的顺从 vs 拒绝对照表明该痕迹反映 SFT 目标而非有害输入暴露，并排除了有害样本数与一般训练强度的解释；在分布偏移、未见数据、不同 SFT 配置、部分 checkpoint 访问、LoRA 与全参数微调下痕迹保持稳定，且与独立测得的攻击成功率正相关，在低有害目标占比下仍有信息量。
Conclusion: 有害 SFT 的目标本身在权重更新中留下可读的连续痕迹，因此 weights-only 审计可在行为评测不可用或不完整时提供互补信号。

papers.title: From Local Evidence to Safety Verdicts: Causal Tracing in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: A vision-language model may need to combine an image with a prompt to recognize a safety risk that neither reveals alone. Where does this joint safety judgment become accessible inside the model? We introduce SSU-Bench, a dataset of matched safe and unsafe image-text combinations constructed using single-item prompt edits or image edits with annotated intended regions. Using three vision-language models, we transfer internal states between paired inputs and measure the resulting change in the safety verdict. Across models and both types of counterfactual, interventions at the changed input positions are effective in earlier decoder layers, while interventions at the final input token become effective later. Directions estimated from other examples produce similar late-layer effects. A linear readout of the final-token state also predicts the model's own verdict, including incorrect judgments, and cross-model comparisons reveal similarities in the patterns of counterfactual change. These findings identify a recurring transition in where interventions can influence a joint safety verdict and distinguish a readable model decision from a correct safety judgment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SSU-Bench：用单条 prompt 编辑或图像编辑构造配对的安全/不安全图文组合并标注意图区域，再在三个 vision-language model 之间转移内部状态，测量安全判定的变化。干预在早期 decoder 层对被改动的输入位置有效、对末 token 的干预则在更晚层才生效，且来自其他样本的方向在晚层产生相似效应；末 token 线性读出可预测模型自身判定（含错误判定）。
Motivation: 图文联合的安全风险判定在模型内部何处变得可干预尚不清楚，且需要区分模型可读出的决策与真正正确的安全判断。
Method: 构建 SSU-Bench 数据集（配对安全/不安全图文，编辑方式为单条 prompt 编辑或图像编辑并标注 intended regions），在三个 VLM 上做配对输入间的内部状态转移（counterfactual intervention），并用末 token 状态的线性读出预测模型判定，辅以跨模型比较。
Result: 在三个 VLM 与两类 counterfactual 上：改动输入位置的干预在较早 decoder 层生效，末 token 干预在更晚层生效；来自其他样本估计的方向产生相似的晚层效应；末 token 线性读出可预测模型自身判定（含错误判定）；跨模型比较显示 counterfactual 变化模式相似。
Conclusion: 干预影响联合安全判定的位置存在一个反复出现的层级转变，且模型可读出的决策应与正确的安全判断区分开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Mobile manipulators such as humanoid robots are increasingly deployed in dynamic, unstructured environments to perform dexterous manipulation tasks. However, end-to-end manipulation policies trained to imitate demonstration data collected from a single robot pose are brittle: even centimeter-scale deviations in robot pose at deployment can drive ego-centric observations and end-effector trajectories out of the training distribution, leading to sharp drops in performance. We introduce MobileVISTA, a data generation framework that transforms demonstrations captured at canonical poses into diverse, pose-perturbed training data by jointly (1) augmenting egocentric visual observations and (2) retargeting actions to compensate for base pose changes. Unlike prior methods, which assume a camera rigidly mounted off the actuated chain or non-trivial articulated robot geometry largely out of frame, MobileVISTA targets compatibility with egocentric platforms (e.g., humanoids) where the camera is both influenced by and must observe the robot's kinematic chain as it moves. We study MobileVISTA in simulated tasks spanning humanoid and bimanual embodiments, and on a real Galaxea R1 Pro. We find policies trained on MobileVISTA-augmented data demonstrate improved robustness to previously out-of-distribution poses encountered at test time, without additional demonstration collection or a trained generative model. Additionally, we find MobileVISTA's benefit is largest on tested humanoids, where the camera rides the actuated chain and the robot fills much of the frame. Additional videos and appendix can be found on our website: https://mobilevista.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MobileVISTA 把单一标准位姿下采集的操作演示，同时增广自我中心视觉观测并重定向动作，生成位姿扰动训练数据，使策略在部署时厘米级底座位姿偏移下不再出分布。在人形与双臂仿真任务及真实 Galaxea R1 Pro 上，用其增广数据训练的策略对测试时先前 OOD 位姿更稳健，无需额外演示采集或训练生成模型；收益在相机随运动链运动、机器人占满画面的人形上最大。
Motivation: 端到端操作策略只模仿单一机器人位姿采集的演示，部署时厘米级位姿偏差就会让自我中心观测与末端轨迹出分布，性能骤降。
Method: 数据生成框架同时做两件事：增广自我中心视觉观测，并针对底座位姿变化重定向动作以补偿；面向相机既受运动链影响、又要观察运动链的自我中心平台（如人形），不假设相机刚性外挂。
Result: 在覆盖人形与双臂具身的仿真任务和真实 Galaxea R1 Pro 上，MobileVISTA 增广数据训练的策略对测试时先前出分布位姿表现出更强稳健性，且无需额外演示采集或训练生成模型；收益在被测人形上最大，因为相机随运动链运动且机器人占满画面。
Conclusion: 位姿泛化可以靠视觉增广加动作重定向的数据生成解决，而不必采集新演示或训练生成模型；对相机装在运动链上的自我中心平台收益最明显。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: On Open-Ended Information Seeking for Information Elicitation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Information elicitation is an open-ended information-seeking problem in which an interaction can unfold in many potentially valuable directions, requiring an elicitor to continually determine which information to pursue as new information emerges. In agentic elicitation, these decisions may be delegated to a foundation model, yet how model choice shapes the resulting information-seeking behavior remains understudied. We study how judgments about information value vary across LLMs and how these differences shape sequential information seeking. We first examine these judgments across 11 LLMs spanning multiple model families and parameter scales, using a shared set of information and elicitation objectives. We then develop a controlled elicitation simulation in which different models encounter the same information space and use the same selection rule, isolating these judgments from question generation and respondent behavior. Using this setting, we characterize the breadth-depth behavior that emerges from model-specific information-seeking preferences over the course of elicitation. We further examine how interaction history changes the evaluation and subsequent selection of prospective information. We test the robustness and boundaries of these findings through sensitivity analyses and ablations over the opportunities available to the elicitor, the response labels used to operationalize information-seeking preferences, the presence of interaction history, and whether redundancy is explicitly relevant to the assessment. The project code, data, and trajectory files are available at https://github.com/infosenselab/open-elicitation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究 LLM 作为信息引出代理 (elicitation agent) 时对信息价值的判断如何随模型而异，并用受控模拟隔离这些判断对序列式信息搜寻行为的影响。在 11 个跨家族、跨参数规模的 LLM 上，用同一套信息与引出目标比较判断差异，再让不同模型在同一信息空间、同一选择规则下运行，刻画其随引出过程展开的 breadth-depth 行为。
Motivation: 开放式信息引出中交互可向多个有价值方向展开，引出者需随新信息不断决定追哪条线索；把该决策交给基础模型后，模型选择如何塑造信息搜寻行为这一问题此前研究不足。
Method: 先在 11 个 LLM（跨模型家族与参数规模）上用共享的信息与引出目标集比较其信息价值判断；再构建受控引出模拟，让不同模型面对同一信息空间并使用同一选择规则，把判断与问题生成、受访者行为分离开；最后通过敏感性分析与消融检验稳健性，消融维度包括引出者可用机会、操作化偏好的响应标签、交互历史的有无、以及冗余是否显式纳入评估。
Result: 在 11 个 LLM 上刻画出模型特有的信息搜寻偏好所导致的 breadth-depth 行为差异，并分析交互历史如何改变对候选信息的评估与后续选择；结论经由覆盖机会空间、响应标签、交互历史与冗余相关性的敏感性分析和消融检验。
Conclusion: 模型对信息价值的判断差异会直接转化为不同的序列信息搜寻行为，且这些行为对交互历史与评估设定敏感；代码、数据与轨迹文件已在 GitHub 公开。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Jarvis: A Proactive Speech Agent for Multi-Party Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Speech agents are reactive and dyadic: they speak when spoken to, and to one person at a time. We ask what it takes for a speech agent to instead take part in a conversation among several people and speak up only when it can help. We introduce Jarvis, a real-time proactive speech agent that audibly participates in multi-party human conversations. Grounded in a document shared beforehand, Jarvis follows the discussion and intervenes when the group misses or misstates a fact and does not correct itself within a few turns. We make three contributions: a problem setting based on epistemic breakdowns that makes proactive intervention measurable, realized as CHI-180-proactive, a synthetic multi-party dataset seeded with known gaps, errors, and self-corrections; a proactive backbone that harnesses a small, open-weight model with deterministic checks and grounds every claim in a source sentence; and interaction techniques for taking the floor in live speech and showing the cited evidence on screen. On CHI-180-proactive, Jarvis is correct on most events it addresses and stays silent 97% of the time when the group resolves an issue itself. A live study with 23 participants confirms these trends with real-time interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Jarvis 是一个能主动插话的多方对话语音 agent：基于事先共享的文档跟踪讨论，只在群体遗漏或说错事实且几轮内未自行纠正时才开口。在合成数据集 CHI-180-proactive 上，它对所处理的多数事件判断正确，并在群体自行解决问题时 97% 的时间保持沉默；23 人真人实验复现了这一趋势。
Motivation: 现有语音 agent 是反应式且一对一的：只在被叫到时说话，无法在多人讨论中适时补位，群体说错事实也无人纠正。
Method: 以认识论失效 (epistemic breakdowns) 定义问题设定，使主动干预可度量；构建合成多方数据集 CHI-180-proactive，预埋已知的信息缺口、错误与自我纠正；主动骨干用小型开放权重模型加确定性检查，每条论断都锚定到来源句子；另设计在实时语音中接管发言权 (taking the floor) 与在屏幕上展示引用证据的交互技术。
Result: 在 CHI-180-proactive 上，Jarvis 对其处理的多数事件判断正确，且在群体自行解决问题时 97% 的时间保持沉默；一项 23 名参与者的真人研究确认了这些趋势并展示了实时干预。
Conclusion: 以认识论失效为触发条件、把每条论断绑定到来源句子，可以让语音 agent 在多方对话中只在真正能帮上忙时主动开口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MARS: Multi-resolution Adaptive Routing for Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Long-history recommenders often compress each user's history into a compact, candidate-independent memory that is cached and reused to score large candidate pools. We show that real user histories exhibit multi-scale semantic structure, with short-lived intent, medium-term interests, and long-term preferences coexisting in one sequence, and that monolithic cached memories preserve these scales unevenly: linear probes recover recent and mid-range content far worse than long-range content. We call this failure mode \textit{temporal aliasing}. We propose \textbf{MARS}, a multi-resolution user memory that writes the full history into recurrent state tracks anchored to different half-lives, and a sparse routing reader that materializes compact seed memories by selecting the relevant temporal resolutions for each seed, preserving fixed-size candidate scoring. MARS outperforms strong baselines on three public datasets, with gains that grow with history length. Component-matched ablations with paired tests show that temporal diversity and selective routing each contribute beyond what hard-window memories or added capacity provide. The advantage of MARS over its interface-matched baseline also widens after within-user behavioral shifts, at about $1.02\times$ that baseline's warm-cache serving latency for $1{,}000$ candidates per user.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MARS 把长历史推荐的用户记忆改写成多个不同半衰期 (half-life) 的循环状态轨道，并用稀疏路由读取器按 seed 选择时间分辨率，物化出定长 seed memory，从而在保持固定候选打分接口的同时缓解单块缓存记忆的时间混叠 (temporal aliasing)。在三个公开数据集上超过强基线，且增益随历史长度增长；1000 候选/用户时服务延迟约为接口匹配基线的 1.02 倍。
Motivation: 长历史推荐器把用户历史压成与候选无关的单一缓存记忆，线性探针显示近期与中期内容的可恢复性远差于长期内容，多尺度语义结构被不均匀保留，即 temporal aliasing。
Method: MARS 写入端把完整历史写入锚定在不同 half-life 的多条循环状态轨道 (recurrent state tracks)，读取端用稀疏路由 (sparse routing reader) 为每个 seed 选择相关时间分辨率并物化紧凑 seed memory，保持固定大小的候选打分；用 component-matched 消融配对检验分离 temporal diversity 与 selective routing 的贡献。
Result: 在三个公开数据集上优于强基线，且增益随历史长度增长；配对检验的 component-matched 消融显示 temporal diversity 与 selective routing 各自贡献超出硬窗口记忆与单纯扩容；用户内行为漂移后相对接口匹配基线的优势进一步扩大；1000 候选/用户时 warm-cache 服务延迟约为该基线的 1.02 倍。
Conclusion: 把用户记忆按多时间尺度分轨并按 seed 稀疏路由，可在不改固定候选打分接口、几乎不增延迟的前提下改善长历史推荐，且在行为漂移后优势更明显。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Two-Sample Testing for Random Graphs without Vertex Correspondence
papers.abstract_en: Two populations of graphs often have to be compared without any correspondence between their vertices, for instance when networks come from different communities, or when a graph generative model is evaluated against held-out graphs. We study how many graphs such an unaligned two-sample test needs, and which graph statistics can detect which differences. For an Erdős--Rényi null and a planted two-block difference that leaves every expected degree unchanged, we show that $m\asymp t^{-3}$ graphs per group are necessary and sufficient when the per-graph signal-to-noise ratio is $t<1$. Signed triangle counts attain this rate, and the lower bound holds for every graph size. With aligned vertices $m\asymp t^{-1}$ graphs suffice, so misalignment costs a factor of order $t^{-2}$. When the triangle signal cancels, the rate becomes $t^{-4}$ and $4$-cycles are needed. Statistics built from trees have exactly the same expectation under both hypotheses, and tests based on finitely many of them have asymptotically no power. In the graphon limit, this class includes degree distributions and message-passing graph neural network features. For a non-constant null, a generic difference is visible at first order, and a simple motif test attains the aligned order of sample size, suggesting that misalignment is costly mainly for differences that are invisible at low orders. We also give an exactly valid test for one or two graphs per group, at a cost in power. In our simulations, the fitted exponents are close to the predicted ones, and degree-based and random-GNN evaluation metrics stay at their level in a setting where signed triangles need about $65$ graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究顶点无对应关系的两样本随机图检验的样本复杂度：Erdős–Rényi 零假设下，对保持期望度数不变的 planted two-block 差异，每组需 m≈t^{-3} 张图（t<1 为单图信噪比），signed triangle counts 达到该速率且下界对任意图规模成立；顶点对齐时只需 m≈t^{-1}，错位代价为 t^{-2} 因子。三角形信号相消时速率降为 t^{-4}，需 4-cycles；树类统计量在两假设下期望完全相同，有限个此类检验渐近无功效——graphon 极限下包括度分布与 message-passing GNN 特征。
Motivation: 来自不同社区的网络或生成模型与留出图的比较中，顶点之间没有天然对应，需要知道检出差异到底要多少张图、以及哪些图统计量有功效；度分布与 MP-GNN 特征这类常用评估指标在此类差异上可能完全失效。
Method: 在 Erdős–Rényi 零假设与 planted two-block 备择（保持期望度数不变）下推导未对齐两样本检验的必要充分样本量 m 与信噪比 t 的标度关系；分析 signed triangle counts、4-cycles、树基统计量与 motif 检验的功效，并给出每组一到两张图时精确有效的检验（以功效为代价）；辅以模拟拟合指数。
Result: 未对齐时 m≈t^{-3}（t<1）必要且充分，signed triangle counts 达到该速率，下界对任意图规模成立；对齐时 m≈t^{-1}，错位代价为 t^{-2}。三角形信号相消时速率为 t^{-4}，需 4-cycles。树类统计量（graphon 极限下含度分布与 MP-GNN 特征）在两假设下期望相同，有限个此类检验渐近无功效。非恒定零假设下 generic difference 一阶可见，简单 motif 检验达到对齐阶样本量。模拟中拟合指数接近预测值：signed triangles 需约 65 张图的设定下，度分布与随机 GNN 评估指标停留在原水平。
Conclusion: 错位的代价主要落在低阶不可见的差异上：树类与度分布/GNN 特征类指标对保持度数的结构差异无功效，应改用 signed triangle 等 motif 统计量；每组仅一两张图时可用精确有效检验换取功效。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Source-Learned Reliance for Selective Test-Time Adaptation of Multimodal Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal wearable systems must remain reliable when sensor streams become noisy or unavailable. Existing multimodal test-time adaptation (TTA) methods often assess reliability online, but cross-modal agreement can be misleading when sensors measure different physical processes, and evaluating alternative modality configurations adds inference cost. We propose CARAT, which decouples model reliance from runtime corruption detection to guide omission or attenuation, amortizing reliance estimation through source training. An asymmetric modality-dropout curriculum prepares a missingness-resilient backbone for omission and derives a frozen, backbone-specific reliance proxy from windowed input-projection gradient norms. At deployment, a lightweight one-class detector flags suspect streams, and the proxy guides a joint choice between replacing the suspect set with the backbone's trained missingness symbol and attenuating its representations before fusion, without candidate-subset evaluation. Across four wearable datasets, five corruption types, three backbones, and eight TTA baselines, CARAT achieves the highest overall macro-F1 and best mean rank (2.42), exceeding EATA, the strongest baseline, by 1.58 F1 points across 12 equally weighted dataset-backbone settings. Across five profiled configurations, CARAT uses 9.49% fewer GFLOPs and updates 47.82% fewer parameters than EATA. A pattern also emerges across sensing regimes: multimodal TTA methods such as PTA are competitive on IMU-dominated homogeneous datasets, whereas unimodal TTA methods like TENT and EATA match or exceed it on heterogeneous datasets. These results position CARAT as a practical default to wearable TTA, offering competitive robustness with modest computational requirements and benefits that vary across backbones and dataset regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CARAT 把模态依赖度估计从运行时腐败检测中解耦，在源训练阶段用非对称 modality-dropout 课程预先把依赖度蒸成冻结的代理（窗口化输入投影梯度范数），部署时由单类检测器标记可疑流，再由代理直接决定用缺失符号替换还是衰减该模态表示，无需遍历候选子集。在四个可穿戴数据集、五种腐败、三个 backbone、八个 TTA 基线上取得最高 macro-F1 与最佳平均排名 2.42，比最强基线 EATA 高 1.58 个 F1 点，同时 GFLOPs 少 9.49%、参数更新量少 47.82%。
Motivation: 可穿戴多模态系统在传感流噪声或缺失时需要在线判断可靠性，但跨模态一致性在传感器测量不同物理过程时会误导，且逐个评估备选模态配置会推高推理成本。
Method: 源训练阶段用非对称 modality-dropout 课程训练 missingness-resilient backbone，并从窗口化输入投影梯度范数导出冻结的、backbone 专属依赖度代理；部署时轻量单类检测器标记可疑流，代理在融合前联合决定用训练好的 missingness 符号替换可疑集合还是衰减其表示，不做候选子集评估。
Result: 在四个可穿戴数据集、五种腐败类型、三个 backbone、八个 TTA 基线的 12 个等权 dataset-backbone 设置上，CARAT 取得最高整体 macro-F1 与最佳平均排名 2.42，比最强基线 EATA 高 1.58 个 F1 点；在五个剖析配置中比 EATA 少用 9.49% GFLOPs、少更新 47.82% 参数。跨传感体制的模式是：同质、IMU 主导数据集上多模态 TTA（如 PTA）有竞争力，异质数据集上单模态 TTA（TENT、EATA）持平或更优。
Conclusion: 把依赖度估计摊销到源训练、与运行时腐败检测解耦，可让 CARAT 成为可穿戴 TTA 的实用默认项：以适度算力拿到有竞争力的鲁棒性，且收益随 backbone 与数据集体制变化。

papers.title: Does Muon Need Fine-Grained Spectral Shaping?
papers.abstract_en: Muon combines current and past gradients into matrix momentum. For $M=UΣV^\top$, the idealized polar update $Q=UV^\top$ gives every singular direction the same weight. We refer to this as the flat profile. Several recent optimizers replace this flat profile with fine-grained spectral maps that give each direction its own gain. We ask how much of this spectral detail a Muon update needs. Our spectral diagnostics show that approximately $94$--$97\%$ of measured singular modes lie below an estimated noise edge, yet collectively align positively with a reference gradient. We introduce BulkBoost, a two-band spectral reweighting framework with fixed-rank and noise-calibrated variants. The latter uses split-minibatch gradient differences to calibrate a Marchenko--Pastur reference edge for Muon's Nesterov input, separating the bulk below the edge from the spikes above it. Both variants increase the bulk's relative weight through one shared gain while preserving the Frobenius norm of each matrix's unreweighted direction. For a fixed partition, our theory gives the first-order condition under which moving weight toward the bulk lowers the loss. It also quantifies the fraction of the maximal first-order improvement rate, over all per-mode reallocations, that two bands can capture. Across 30 continued-pretraining settings spanning Pythia-14M to 410M and six corpora, two-band reweighting is competitive with the fine-grained power-law profile of Freon and outperforms Spectra. Measured against Muon's flat profile, Freon reduces final loss by $0.022\%$ of the pre-adaptation loss on average, whereas the two-band variants achieve reductions of $0.073$--$0.147\%$. These observations suggest that useful departures from the flat profile are surprisingly low-dimensional: a single bulk-to-spike gain captures at least as much benefit as the fine-grained spectral profiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Muon 的极分解更新 Q=UV^T 给所有奇异方向等权重（flat profile），本文问细粒度谱整形到底带来多少额外收益。谱诊断显示约 94–97% 的奇异模低于估计噪声边但整体与参考梯度正对齐，据此提出两带谱重加权 BulkBoost（固定秩版与噪声标定版，后者用 split-minibatch 梯度差为 Muon 的 Nesterov 输入标定 Marchenko–Pastur 边）。在 Pythia-14M 到 410M、六个语料共 30 个继续预训练设置上，两带变体相对 flat profile 平均降最终 loss 0.073–0.147%（Freon 为 0.022%），说明有用偏离只需一个 bulk-to-spike 增益。
Motivation: 近期多个优化器用细粒度谱映射替换 Muon 的 flat profile，但每次更新究竟需要多少谱细节并不清楚；若低维重加权即可，细粒度逐模整形的复杂度就不必要。
Method: 先做谱诊断定位噪声边，再提出 BulkBoost 两带谱重加权：把 bulk 与 spike 分开，用一个共享增益提高 bulk 的相对权重，同时保持每个矩阵未重加权方向的 Frobenius 范数；噪声标定变体用 split-minibatch 梯度差为 Muon 的 Nesterov 输入标定 Marchenko–Pastur 参考边。理论部分对固定划分给出把权重移向 bulk 能降低 loss 的一阶条件，并量化两带能捕获的最大一阶改进率的比例。
Result: 谱诊断：约 94–97% 的被测奇异模位于估计噪声边之下，但整体与参考梯度正对齐。在 30 个继续预训练设置（Pythia-14M 至 410M，六个语料）上，两带重加权与 Freon 的细粒度 power-law profile 相当并优于 Spectra；相对 Muon flat profile，Freon 平均把最终 loss 降低 pre-adaptation loss 的 0.022%，两带变体降低 0.073–0.147%。
Conclusion: 对 flat profile 的有用偏离出人意料地低维：单个 bulk-to-spike 增益至少能拿到细粒度谱 profile 的同等收益，Muon 不需要细粒度谱整形。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The interface of data assimilation and machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation (DA) is the process of combining forecasts from a model with observations in order to optimally estimate the state of a system. This is critical for chaotic systems, such as the atmosphere, since if observations are not continually assimilated the model will quickly lose skill. DA is routinely performed (usually every 6 hours) at operational forecasting centres around the world. In this article we discuss the interface of machine learning (ML) and DA. This is still an emerging and quickly developing field, and this article tries to give an overview of some of the main topics and methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇综述性文章，梳理数据同化 (DA) 与机器学习 (ML) 的交叉接口，指出 DA 通过把模型预报与观测结合来最优估计系统状态，对大气这类混沌系统不可或缺——若不持续同化观测，模式会迅速失去技巧；ML 与 DA 的结合仍是新兴且快速发展的方向。
Motivation: DA 与 ML 的交叉是新兴且快速演进的领域，缺少一篇把主要主题和方法串起来的概览，读者难以把握其接口形态。
Method: 以综述形式讨论 ML 与 DA 的接口，覆盖该领域若干主要主题与方法；背景设定为业务预报中心通常每 6 小时执行一次 DA 的实际流程。
Result: 文章给出 ML–DA 接口的综述性概述，说明 DA 通常每 6 小时在世界各地业务预报中心执行一次，且不持续同化观测时混沌系统（如大气）的模式会迅速失去技巧；全文 13 页、2 幅图。
Conclusion: DA 是混沌大气预报维持技巧的常规业务环节，ML 与 DA 的结合已形成值得系统梳理的新兴方向。

papers.title: Who Bears the Burden? Learning Responsibility for Shared Constraints in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: When multiple agents share a cost budget, a common Lagrange multiplier can enforce the aggregate constraint but does not determine how its penalty should be allocated across agents. Uniform penalties ignore heterogeneity in the rewards agents sacrifice, while agent-specific multipliers may still rely on the same aggregate cost signal. We introduce Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation (LiRA), which learns each agent's share of a common multiplier by optimizing social welfare over a finite training horizon. The multiplier enforces the aggregate budget, while responsibility shares redistribute its influence without modifying the original rewards or constraints. For convex games under standard regularity conditions, varying these shares induces a smooth family of normalized generalized Nash equilibria in which active constraints remain at their budgets while welfare varies. To optimize responsibility before convergence, we derive a welfare gradient that accounts for both learning updates and the induced change in data distribution. Across CityLearn, MABIM, Harvest, and MetaDrive, spanning 3 to 400 agents, LiRA improves average social welfare by up to 29% over uniform and agent-specific multiplier baselines. Grid and driving costs remain within budget, inventory violations decrease, and Harvest makes more effective use of available budget.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Project page with code: https://lira-marl.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 多智能体共享成本预算时，公共 Lagrange 乘子只能约束总量、无法决定惩罚在各智能体间如何分摊；LiRA (Lagrangian Responsibility Allocation) 学习每个智能体对公共乘子的责任份额，在不改动原奖励与约束的前提下重新分配其影响。在 CityLearn、MABIM、Harvest、MetaDrive（3–400 个智能体）上，平均社会福利较均匀惩罚与逐智能体乘子基线最高提升 29%，且网格与驾驶成本保持在预算内。
Motivation: 共享预算下均匀惩罚忽略各智能体所牺牲奖励的异质性，而逐智能体乘子仍依赖同一聚合成本信号，无法回答惩罚负担应如何分配。
Method: LiRA 在有限训练时 horizon 上以社会福利为目标学习各智能体对公共乘子的责任份额：乘子负责满足聚合预算，份额只重新分配其影响。作者推导了同时计入学习更新与数据分布诱导变化的 welfare gradient；在凸博弈与标准正则条件下，改变份额会诱导一族光滑的归一化广义 Nash 均衡 (normalized generalized Nash equilibria)，其中活跃约束保持在预算上而福利变化。
Result: 在 CityLearn、MABIM、Harvest、MetaDrive 四个环境（3 至 400 个智能体）上，LiRA 平均社会福利较均匀惩罚与逐智能体乘子基线最高提升 29%；网格与驾驶成本保持在预算内，库存违规 (inventory violations) 下降，Harvest 更有效地使用了可用预算。
Conclusion: 把公共乘子的负担按责任份额重新分配，可以在不修改原奖励与约束的前提下提高共享约束多智能体系统的社会福利，同时维持预算可行性。

summary_sections.method: LiRA 在有限训练时 horizon 上以社会福利为目标学习各智能体对公共乘子的责任份额：乘子负责满足聚合预算，份额只重新分配其影响。作者推导了同时计入学习更新与数据分布诱导变化的 welfare gradient；在凸博弈与标准正则条件下，改变份额会诱导一族光滑的归一化广义 Nash 均衡 (normalized generalized Nash equilibria)，其中活跃约束保持在预算上而福利变化。
summary_sections.result: 在 CityLearn、MABIM、Harvest、MetaDrive 四个环境（3 至 400 个智能体）上，LiRA 平均社会福利较均匀惩罚与逐智能体乘子基线最高提升 29%；网格与驾驶成本保持在预算内，库存违规 (inventory violations) 下降，Harvest 更有效地使用了可用预算。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把公共乘子的负担按责任份额重新分配，可以在不修改原奖励与约束的前提下提高共享约束多智能体系统的社会福利，同时维持预算可行性。

papers.title: Deep Defence on Wheels: A Dual Intrusion Detection System Architecture for Comprehensive In-Vehicle Network Security
papers.abstract_en: Increasing connectivity to the outside world and the lack of inbuilt security mechanisms have made legacy intra-vehicular networks vulnerable to cyberattacks. Initial research focused on maximising detection accuracy for known and unknown attacks, often using large, full-precision machine learning models. However, embedding IDSs into vehicular electronic systems also requires low detection latency, energy efficiency and minimal electronic control unit (ECU) resource overhead to process about 2,000 CAN frames/s. Lightweight models must balance accuracy with these deployment constraints. We propose a dual IDS framework comprising supervised and unsupervised learning-based solutions, each optimised for real-time, resource-constrained automotive platforms. A quantised LSTM-based IDS (QLSTM-IDS) achieves over 99.9% detection accuracy for DoS/Flooding, Fuzzing and Spoofing/Malfunction attacks using a single model architecture evaluated on two widely used datasets. The model is trained using the Brevitas quantisation-aware training library, transformed into a dataflow accelerator with custom blocks compatible with AMD's FINN toolchain, and synthesised using Vitis HLS. Complementing this, an 8-bit quantised convolutional autoencoder-based IDS (QCAE-IDS), quantised using AMD's Vitis-AI toolchain, detects previously unseen anomalies that alter CAN-ID sequence patterns with over 99% accuracy. An integration architecture enables both models to operate on a single FPGA, bridging the network interface IP and processing system to minimise software overhead. QLSTM-IDS achieves 0.25 ms inference latency and 0.8 mJ energy consumption per message, while QCAE-IDS achieves 0.42 ms and 1.1 mJ per block. Both solutions are deployed and evaluated on the ZCU104 SoC (XCZU7EV FPGA), demonstrating a flexible hardware/software co-design for real-time detection of known and unknown attacks on high-speed CAN buses.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables, ACM Transactions on Embedded Computing Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向车载 CAN 总线的双 IDS 架构：量化 LSTM (QLSTM-IDS) 用监督学习抓已知攻击，8-bit 量化卷积自编码器 (QCAE-IDS) 用无监督异常检测抓改变 CAN-ID 序列模式的未知攻击，两者合到单块 FPGA 上实时运行。QLSTM-IDS 在两个常用数据集上对 DoS/Flooding、Fuzzing、Spoofing/Malfunction 达 99.9% 以上准确率、0.25 ms 延迟、每消息 0.8 mJ；QCAE-IDS 对未见异常超 99% 准确率、0.42 ms、每块 1.1 mJ。
Motivation: 车载网络缺乏内建安全机制且对外连接增多，已有 IDS 追求全精度大模型的检测率，却难以满足约 2,000 CAN frames/s 下的低延迟、能效与 ECU 资源开销约束。
Method: QLSTM-IDS 用 Brevitas 量化感知训练，经 AMD FINN 工具链转成含自定义 block 的 dataflow accelerator，再用 Vitis HLS 综合；QCAE-IDS 用 AMD Vitis-AI 做 8-bit 量化。集成架构让两模型跑在同一块 FPGA 上，桥接网络接口 IP 与处理系统以减少软件开销，最终部署在 ZCU104 SoC (XCZU7EV)。
Result: QLSTM-IDS 单一模型架构在两个广泛使用的数据集上对 DoS/Flooding、Fuzzing、Spoofing/Malfunction 检测准确率超过 99.9%，推理延迟 0.25 ms、每条消息能耗 0.8 mJ；QCAE-IDS 对改变 CAN-ID 序列模式的未见异常检测准确率超过 99%，延迟 0.42 ms、每块能耗 1.1 mJ。两者均在 ZCU104 SoC 上部署评测，面向约 2,000 CAN frames/s 的高速 CAN 总线。
Conclusion: 监督量化 LSTM 与无监督量化自编码器的双模型分工可在单 FPGA 上同时覆盖已知与未知攻击，并把延迟压到亚毫秒级、能耗压到每消息毫焦级，满足实时车载部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robust Importance Sampling for Rare Events via Constrained Gaussian Mixtures
papers.abstract_en: We study estimating rare-event probabilities $I = \mathbb{P}(g(\mathbf{X}) > γ)$ with $\mathbf{X} \sim \mathcal{N}(\boldsymbolμ, \boldsymbolΣ)$ and general $g : \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}$. We address this problem through importance sampling, and propose a framework that substantially improves efficiency and robustness over baselines such as crude Monte Carlo, adaptive cross-entropy, variational-inference-based methods (including reverse- and forward-KL approaches), as well as Safe-ICE, Subset Simulation, and Sequential Monte Carlo, drawing on ideas from both rare-event estimation and cross-entropy optimization. The key contribution has two parts: first, we separate the problem into coverage, to overcome the cold-start barrier, and fitting, to refine proposals once a meaningful signal is available; second, we constrain the final GMM proposal so that it has finite importance-sampling variance (since coverage alone is not sufficient -- without safeguards, importance sampling may still suffer from infinite variance). Together, these ingredients yield expressive proposals; finite variance does not by itself guarantee practical stability at a fixed sampling budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate substantial variance reduction, strong robustness across diverse benchmarks, and favorable cost--efficiency trade-offs, with the proposed approach often outperforming these baselines, particularly in high-dimensional and multimodal settings where competing methods frequently become unstable or fail. Our code is available at https://github.com/lorek/robust-cfi-is.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对高斯输入下稀有事件概率 I=P(g(X)>γ) 的重要性采样，把流程拆成 coverage（跨过冷启动）与 fitting（有信号后再精修提案）两阶段，并对最终 GMM 提案加有限方差约束，避免 IS 因提案尾部过重而方差发散。在高维、多模态基准上该方法常优于 crude Monte Carlo、adaptive cross-entropy、reverse/forward-KL 变分法、Safe-ICE、Subset Simulation 与 SMC，后几者在这些设置下常不稳定或失败。
Motivation: 高斯质量下估计稀有事件概率时，cross-entropy 类方法有冷启动障碍，且不受约束的提案即使覆盖到事件区域也可能有无限重要性采样方差，导致高维多模态场景中方差大或直接失效。
Method: 两阶段框架：coverage 阶段先跨过冷启动获得有意义信号，fitting 阶段再精修提案；最终 GMM 提案被约束为具有有限重要性采样方差，思路同时借自稀有事件估计与 cross-entropy 优化。
Result: 在多样基准上相对 crude Monte Carlo、adaptive cross-entropy、基于变分推断的 reverse-KL 与 forward-KL 方法、Safe-ICE、Subset Simulation、Sequential Monte Carlo 表现出大幅方差降低与良好成本-效率权衡，且常优于这些基线，尤其在高维与多模态设置中（竞争方法常不稳定或失败）。
Conclusion: 把冷启动覆盖与提案拟合分开、并给 GMM 提案加有限方差约束，是让重要性采样在高维多模态稀有事件上既高效又稳健的关键；代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpecBraM: What Should an EEG Foundation Model Predict? Masked Band-Power Prediction versus Waveform Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised EEG models often reconstruct masked waveforms or predict discrete codes. We study a task-aligned alternative: masked band-power prediction (MBP), which predicts fixed narrow-band log spectral energy for masked channel-time patches. This target retains rhythm power relevant to sleep staging while avoiding phase-sensitive waveform reconstruction and a learned codebook. Across three pretraining seeds, we compare band-power and waveform targets with matched backbones, pretraining data (2,388 hours), and training steps, including a 2x2 tokenizer-by-target design. On ISRUC and HMC sleep staging, MBP exceeds raw- and band-waveform reconstruction by 1.6-2.8 balanced-accuracy points with all labels and 4.7-7.3 points with 1% of labels under a strict linear probe; the target effect exceeds the tokenizer effect. Its frozen features reach 0.7916/0.7425 balanced accuracy, versus 0.7636/0.7227 for a matched rich handcrafted spectral baseline, although the gap is about one point with 1% of labels. Full fine-tuning reaches 0.8107/0.7669. The gains do not extend to every task with spectral cues, including motor imagery, depression screening, and vigilance regression. These results support choosing pretraining targets to match the physical quantities and spatial and temporal scales relevant to downstream labels.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables; includes an appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SpecBraM 提出掩码带功率预测 (masked band-power prediction, MBP) 作为 EEG 基础模型的预训练目标：对被掩码的通道-时间块直接预测固定窄带对数谱能量，绕开相位敏感的波形重建与学习式 codebook。在 2,388 小时预训练、匹配骨干与训练步数的 2×2 tokenizer×target 对比中，MBP 在 ISRUC 与 HMC 睡眠分期上以严格 linear probe 超出原始/带通波形重建 1.6–2.8 个 balanced-accuracy 点（1% 标签时 4.7–7.3 点），目标效应大于 tokenizer 效应。
Motivation: 自监督 EEG 模型惯用的掩码波形重建与离散码预测目标与下游标签所需的节奏功率不对齐，且波形重建对相位敏感、依赖学习式 codebook，可能浪费容量。
Method: MBP 对掩码 channel-time patch 预测固定窄带 log spectral energy；用匹配骨干、匹配预训练数据 (2,388 小时) 与训练步数、跨 3 个预训练 seed 的对比，并含 2×2 tokenizer-by-target 设计，评测采用严格 linear probe 与 full fine-tuning。
Result: 在 ISRUC 与 HMC 睡眠分期上，MBP 比 raw- 与 band-waveform reconstruction 高 1.6–2.8 个 balanced-accuracy 点（全标签），1% 标签时高 4.7–7.3 点；目标效应超过 tokenizer 效应。冻结特征 balanced accuracy 为 0.7916/0.7425，对照的丰富手工谱特征基线为 0.7636/0.7227（1% 标签时差距约 1 点），full fine-tuning 达 0.8107/0.7669。增益不外推到运动想象、抑郁筛查与警觉度回归等同样含谱线索的任务。
Conclusion: 预训练目标应与下游标签相关的物理量及时空尺度对齐；带功率目标在睡眠分期上优于波形重建，但该收益并非对所有含谱线索的任务都成立。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: In With the Old: Enhancing 'Classical' Document Automation with Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Software-based legal assistance systems have leveraged many different forms of knowledge representation and reasoning. This article explores how document automation services rooted in expert system style and other symbolic approaches can usefully enhance and be enhanced by current generative AI approaches. We discuss the possible benefits and challenges, and report on preliminary experiments in using large language models to identify and fix issues in texts written by laypeople.
papers.comment: 10 pages. AI for Access to Justice Workshop at ICAIL 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 探讨符号式文档自动化（专家系统风格的知识表示与推理）与生成式 AI 如何互相增强，并报告用 LLM 识别并修复普通人所写法律文本问题的初步实验。核心主张是经典符号方法可以提升生成式 AI 在法律文书自动化中的可用性，而非被其取代。
Motivation: 法律援助类文档自动化长期依赖专家系统式符号方法，而当前生成式 AI 虽灵活却缺乏可核查的结构化推理；两者如何互补以改善面向非专业用户的文本纠错尚不清楚。
Method: 以综述讨论加初步实验的方式展开：梳理符号式文档自动化的知识表示与推理形式，分析其与生成式 AI 的互惠收益与挑战，并用大语言模型对 laypeople 撰写的文本做问题识别与修复。
Result: 报告了用 LLM 识别并修复普通人所写文本问题的初步实验；摘要层面为定性探索，未给出指标或数据集数字。
Conclusion: 经典符号式文档自动化与生成式 AI 可以互相增强，符号方法能为法律文书生成提供结构与可核查性。

papers.title: Can Power Draw Constrain Covert Compute? Limits of Analogue Verification for AI Governance
papers.abstract_en: Frontier AI treaties or agreements on limiting computation require external verification; an external auditor must be able to confirm how much computation actually ran and that parties are adhering to the agreement. Analogue, off-chip measurements such as power draw provide an information channel for verification. It is unknown how well these analogue channels can constrain computation against an adversary who actively tries to subvert the audit. We derive a closed form for $β$, the largest hidden computation a power trace cannot exclude, as a fraction of the declared machine capacity. Measurements on NVIDIA A100 GPUs constrain $β= 1.16$ in the worst case, while adversarial matched-energy strategies are shown to hide at least $β= 0.41$ of compute. Analogue power measurements alone therefore constrain compute weakly. Additional restrictions granted by the threat model, such as the ability of the verifier to re-execute the declared work at an observed operating point, let the verifier push $β$ down to $0.059$ in the maximally restricted case. This gives a quantitative estimate of what analogue measurements can contribute to compute verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 AI 算力条约的外部审计，推导 β 的闭式解——功率轨迹在最坏情况下无法排除的隐藏算力占申报机器容量的比例。NVIDIA A100 实测给出最坏情形 β=1.16，对抗性等能量策略至少可藏 β=0.41，仅靠功率测量约束很弱；若威胁模型允许审计者在观测工作点重放申报任务，β 可压到 0.059。

Method: 推导 β 的闭式解，把功率轨迹作为验证信道，量化其无法排除的隐藏算力上限；在 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上做实测，并构造对抗性等能量 (matched-energy) 策略检验最坏情形。
Result: A100 实测最坏情形 β=1.16（占申报机器容量）；对抗性等能量策略至少可隐藏 β=0.41 的算力；在威胁模型允许验证者于观测工作点重放申报任务的最大受限情形下，β 降至 0.059。

papers.title: Adapting to Changes in Agent Behavior via Finite-Depth Policy Sensitivity
papers.abstract_en: Adapting a reinforcement learning policy to changes in another agent's behavior typically requires a large amount of new interaction data. Policy sensitivity provides a first-order prediction of how a locally optimal policy changes with a behavioral parameter, but its computation requires second-order derivatives whose effects propagate across future interactions. We develop a finite-depth framework to estimate this sensitivity by approximating the policy Hessian and mixed derivative using information from a reference environment. The method features an adjustable propagation depth which determines where derivative propagation along the trajectory is truncated. We characterize the derivative contributions omitted by finite-depth propagation and derive truncation-error bounds for the approximated derivatives and resulting policy sensitivity. The bounds are nonincreasing with propagation depth and vanish at full-horizon propagation. Using a belief-driven pursuit-evasion game as a validation scenario, the proposed method generally achieves lower derivative-estimation errors as the propagation depth increases and outperforms the baseline methods in both estimation accuracy and policy adaptation. The sensitivity-based initialization improves zero-shot return over direct transfer, and also shows advantages for the subsequent fine-tuning in the target environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出有限深度 (finite-depth) 策略敏感性估计框架：截断轨迹上的导数传播深度，用参考环境信息近似策略 Hessian 与混合导数，从而在不重算全时域二阶导的情况下预测局部最优策略随行为参数的变化。推导出的截断误差界随传播深度非增、在全时域传播时消失；在信念驱动的追逃博弈中，深度越大导数估计误差通常越低，且在估计精度与策略适应上均优于基线，敏感性初始化的零样本回报高于直接迁移并有利于后续微调。
Motivation: RL 策略要适应另一智能体行为变化通常需要大量新交互数据；已有的一阶 policy sensitivity 预测虽能给出策略随行为参数的变化方向，但计算需二阶导数且沿未来交互传播，代价高。
Method: 用参考环境的信息近似 policy Hessian 与混合导数，引入可调传播深度决定轨迹上导数传播的截断位置；刻画有限深度传播遗漏的导数项并给出近似导数与策略敏感性的截断误差界，再以敏感性结果作为目标环境中的策略初始化。
Result: 截断误差界随传播深度非增、在全时域传播时消失；在信念驱动的追逃 (pursuit-evasion) 验证场景中，估计误差随深度增大总体降低，估计精度与策略适应均优于 baseline；敏感性初始化的零样本回报高于直接迁移，并在后续微调中也占优。
Conclusion: 有限深度截断是计算策略敏感性的可控近似：加深传播即可系统压低误差并换来更好的零样本迁移与微调起点，无需完整二阶导传播。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: PsyCIDRA: A Dual-Agent Framework for Psychiatric Interviewing and Diagnostic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models show promise in clinical reasoning, but psychiatric interviewing requires guiding an evolving conversation. Their ability to carry out this interactive assessment remains less studied. We present PsyCIDRA, a dual-agent framework linking free-form psychiatric interviewing with diagnostic reasoning for expert review. Its interviewer agent uses tools to maintain working notes, load expert-written skills, and retrieve ICD-11 references to guide inquiry. Its diagnostic reasoning agent then receives the completed interview transcript and reports hypotheses alongside supporting, conflicting, and missing evidence, withholding a final hypothesis when none is sufficiently supported. Using patient profiles generated with PsyCPG, we first evaluate PsyCIDRA in simulation. Across four models on 53 evaluation cases, it achieves higher diagnostic agreement than direct prompting. On 81 held-out simulated cases, rank-1 accuracy is 60.5% versus 51.9%. In a blinded study of 101 human participants in separate arms, PsyCIDRA agrees with psychologists on whether to propose a diagnostic hypothesis in 79.6% of cases, compared with 65.4% for direct prompting. Together, these findings support the potential of LLM agents to assist psychiatric assessment through free-form dialogue. By examining diagnostic reasoning, interview quality, and safety together, this study contributes to understanding the capabilities and limitations of psychiatric interview agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PsyCIDRA 把自由问诊与诊断推理拆成双智能体：访谈智能体用工具维护工作笔记、加载专家技能并检索 ICD-11 条目引导提问，推理智能体读完整转录后给出假设及支持/冲突/缺失证据，证据不足时拒绝出结论。在 PsyCPG 生成的模拟病例上，81 例留出集 rank-1 准确率 60.5% 对直接提示 51.9%；101 名人类参与者的盲测中，是否提出诊断假设与心理学家一致率 79.6% 对 65.4%。
Motivation: 大模型在临床推理上有潜力，但精神科访谈要求在动态对话中持续引导，这种交互式评估能力研究不足，且需要把诊断推理、访谈质量与安全性放在一起考察。
Method: 双智能体框架：访谈智能体借助工具维护工作笔记、加载专家撰写 skills、检索 ICD-11 参考来引导追问；诊断推理智能体接收完整访谈转录，输出假设及支持、冲突、缺失证据，证据不足时保留结论。病例由 PsyCPG 生成，先在模拟中评测，再做 101 人分组盲测。
Result: 四个模型、53 例评测中诊断一致性高于直接提示；81 例留出模拟病例 rank-1 准确率 60.5% 对直接提示 51.9%；101 名人类参与者的盲测中，是否提出诊断假设与心理学家一致率 79.6%，直接提示为 65.4%。
Conclusion: LLM 双智能体可通过自由对话辅助精神科评估，把诊断推理、访谈质量与安全性一起检验是评估此类问诊智能体的必要维度。

papers.title: Structure, Not Belief: Correlated Thompson Sampling from LLM-Derived Covariance in Combinatorial Semi-Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Combinatorial Thompson sampling (CTS) draws independent posterior samples for every arm, so its exploration dynamics ignore any relation among arms. We study a minimal change to those dynamics: an LLM is queried once for a partition of the arms, the partition becomes a positive-definite correlation matrix $Σ$ through an RBF kernel on cluster ranks, and the per-round posterior sample is drawn with covariance $Σ$ while the Beta posteriors are updated from real rewards only, so the LLM shapes how the sampler moves, not what it believes. We give a self-contained Bayesian regret bound for the idealized Gaussian sampler whose information gain splits into a $K\log T$ term from the $K$-cluster structure and a ridge term that grows to $d\log T$: the $\sqrt{d/K}$ improvement over independent sampling is a finite-horizon transient, exact only as the within-cluster correlation tends to one. The correlated sampler reduces regret by 19% over CTS on 16 synthetic Bernoulli families at $T=2{,}500$ (6-7% at $T=25{,}000$ with data-adaptive kernels) and by 41% on the Microsoft MIND-small news benchmark ($d=200$ real articles), while pseudo-observation warm starts give nothing. An LLM-free ablation with a simulated oracle of controlled quality shows that on unstructured instances the gain is a property of the kernel shape (a random partition, or a plain tempering of the sampling noise, reproduces it), while belief injection at matched oracle quality never helps.
papers.comment: 15 pages. Accepted (poster) at DynaFront 2026: Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 LLM 给出的臂划分经 RBF 核变成正定协方差 Σ，让组合 Thompson 采样按相关结构探索，而 Beta 后验只用真实奖励更新，即 LLM 只塑造采样运动、不注入信念。在 16 个合成 Bernoulli 族上 T=2,500 时相对 CTS 降低 19% 遗憾（T=25,000 配 data-adaptive 核为 6–7%），在 Microsoft MIND-small（d=200 真实文章）上降低 41%；√(d/K) 改进是有限时域暂态，伪观测热启动无收益。
Motivation: 组合 Thompson 采样对每条臂独立采样，探索动态完全忽略臂之间的关系，浪费了可用的结构信息。
Method: 向 LLM 查询一次得到臂的划分，划分经 cluster ranks 上的 RBF 核转为正定相关矩阵 Σ；每轮后验样本按 Σ 抽取，Beta 后验仅由真实奖励更新。另给出理想化 Gaussian 采样器的自洽 Bayesian regret 界，信息增益分解为 K log T 的聚类项与增长到 d log T 的 ridge 项，并用受控质量的 simulated oracle 做无 LLM 消融。
Result: 16 个合成 Bernoulli 族上 T=2,500 时遗憾较 CTS 降 19%，T=25,000 配 data-adaptive 核降 6–7%；Microsoft MIND-small（d=200 真实文章）上降 41%；伪观测热启动无收益。理论上相对独立采样有 √(d/K) 改进，但只是有限时域暂态，仅在簇内相关趋于 1 时精确。消融显示非结构化实例上的收益来自核形状本身（随机划分或单纯对采样噪声做 tempering 都能复现），而匹配 oracle 质量的 belief injection 从无帮助。
Conclusion: 结构化的采样协方差而非对后验信念的注入才是收益来源：LLM 只需提供一次臂划分来塑造探索路径，√(d/K) 的改进随时域增长衰减。

papers.title: COMPASS: Finding Where Reasoning Lives in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Explicitly eliciting reasoning substantially improves LLM performance. Existing approaches require a predefined characterization of reasoning, whether through CoT prompt design, contrastive CoT directions, or via SAE derived reasoning features. For mathematical reasoning with verifiable answers, we show that a much simpler signal suffices, which is the correctness of the model's own direct answer attempts. This signal yields a latent direction that elicits reasoning. This direction is decodable within the activations of most attention heads, but only a small subset of them can be effectively intervened. We introduce COMPASS, an inference-time steering method that identifies these heads using a logit-space attribution score and steers their activations along the correctness direction, requiring only per-head activation statistics. Across three model families and multiple math benchmarks, COMPASS outperforms the activation-steering baselines we compare against, improves GSM8K accuracy by 16 percentage points on average, and approaches CoT accuracy with 20-70\% fewer generated tokens. Interventions transfer without re-fitting to unseen benchmarks, and ablations show that both the correctness direction and the small set of heads carrying it are necessary, with the effect concentrated in remarkably few heads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: COMPASS 用模型自身直接答题的对错作为信号，学出一个可引出推理的潜方向，再用 logit 空间归因分数挑出少数可干预的 attention head，在推理时沿该方向偏移其激活。跨三个模型家族与多个数学基准，GSM8K 准确率平均提升 16 个百分点，逼近 CoT 精度且少生成 20-70% token。
Motivation: 现有激发推理的方法都依赖预先定义的推理刻画（CoT 提示设计、对比 CoT 方向或 SAE 推理特征），而可验证答案的数学任务上其实只需要更简单的信号。
Method: 以模型直接答案的对错构造正确性方向；用 logit-space attribution score 在激活中定位可有效干预的少数 attention head，仅需 per-head 激活统计即可在推理时沿正确性方向做 steering；消融检验方向与 head 集合的必要性。
Result: 跨三个模型家族和多个数学基准，COMPASS 优于所比较的 activation-steering 基线，GSM8K 准确率平均提高 16 个百分点，以少 20-70% 生成 token 接近 CoT 精度；干预无需重拟合即可迁移到未见基准，效应集中在极少数量的 head 上。
Conclusion: 对可验证的数学推理，正确性方向加少数关键 head 的推理时干预足以逼近 CoT，且方向与 head 集合缺一不可。

summary_sections.method: 以模型直接答案的对错构造正确性方向；用 logit-space attribution score 在激活中定位可有效干预的少数 attention head，仅需 per-head 激活统计即可在推理时沿正确性方向做 steering；消融检验方向与 head 集合的必要性。
summary_sections.result: 跨三个模型家族和多个数学基准，COMPASS 优于所比较的 activation-steering 基线，GSM8K 准确率平均提高 16 个百分点，以少 20-70% 生成 token 接近 CoT 精度；干预无需重拟合即可迁移到未见基准，效应集中在极少数量的 head 上。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对可验证的数学推理，正确性方向加少数关键 head 的推理时干预足以逼近 CoT，且方向与 head 集合缺一不可。

papers.title: Efficient Multimodal Inference through Adaptive Acquisition and Sequential Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal systems often encode every available input, even when a subset suffices for prediction. Adaptive acquisition can reduce this cost by using predictions from incrementally fused evidence to decide which modality to encode next and when to stop. However, sequential fusion makes these predictions order-dependent, so decisions based on them may need to distinguish factorially many histories of the same acquired set. We introduce SemARC, which couples a Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA) with an Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC) and uses acquired evidence to select each modality before its encoder runs. SeMA executes only selected encoder and fusion branches, updates a fixed-size state, and predicts after each acquisition without recomputing earlier branches. We supervise every acquisition prefix under randomized modality subsets and orders to encourage consistent predictions across acquisition orders. ARC combines a set-dependent marginal-utility prior with residual fitted-Q learning to select the next available modality or stop, without inspecting unacquired inputs or retaining acquisition order. Across six multimodal classification datasets and eleven baselines, SemARC achieves 3.2% higher macro-F1 and 61.4% lower total inference GFLOPs on average relative to each dataset's most accurate baseline. End-to-end latency falls by 44.0% across GPU and CPU and by 47.2% on Android INT8 relative to the fastest measured baseline, on average. Under varying runtime modality missingness, SemARC still skips available modalities, matching or exceeding the best baseline macro-F1 in 21 of 24 conditions with 14.8% lower total GFLOPs on average. SemARC thus offers a practical path toward efficient multimodal inference across heterogeneous devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SemARC 用 Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA) 与 Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC) 在编码前决定下一个要采集的模态或停止，把顺序融合的预测做成与采集顺序无关。在六个多模态分类数据集、十一个基线上，相对各数据集最准基线平均 macro-F1 高 3.2%、总推理 GFLOPs 低 61.4%，端到端延迟在 GPU/CPU 上降 44.0%、Android INT8 上降 47.2%。
Motivation: 多模态系统默认编码全部输入，即使子集已足够预测；而顺序融合使预测依赖采集顺序，基于预测的采集决策必须区分同一已采集集合的指数级历史。
Method: SeMA 只执行被选中的编码与融合分支，维护固定大小状态并在每次采集后直接预测，不重算先前分支；在随机模态子集与顺序下对每个采集前缀做监督以保证跨顺序一致。ARC 结合 set-dependent 边际效用先验与 residual fitted-Q learning 选择下一个模态或停止，不查看未采集输入也不保留采集顺序。
Result: 在六个多模态分类数据集、十一个基线上，相对各数据集最准基线平均 macro-F1 提高 3.2%、总推理 GFLOPs 降低 61.4%；端到端延迟相对最快实测基线平均在 GPU 与 CPU 上降 44.0%、在 Android INT8 上降 47.2%。在运行时模态缺失变化下仍会跳过可用模态，24 个条件中 21 个匹配或超过最佳基线 macro-F1，平均 GFLOPs 低 14.8%。
Conclusion: 在编码前用不依赖采集顺序的决策选择模态并及时停止，可在异构设备上同时拿到更高 macro-F1 与大幅更低的计算与延迟开销。

papers.title: Protective Perturbations Must Survive the Resize: Scale-Robust Image Immunization against Malicious Editing
papers.abstract_en: Protective perturbations aim to stop malicious instruction-guided editing of personal photos, but they are optimized and evaluated at the editor's working resolution, whereas shared photos have 10 megapixels or more and editors first downscale them by an unknown factor. We model this resize as a frequency-selective channel. In this model, a perturbation computed at the native resolution decays with the downscaling factor and is weak even without a resize, and a perturbation computed at a fixed working resolution protects only a window of scales. The best worst-case protection over an unknown range of scales degrades only logarithmically with the width of the range, and averaging over scales does not reach it. Guided by this analysis, we propose SRIM, which samples a grid of anchor scales covering the whole range, with weights that favor the currently weakest scale, at the cost of standard expectation over transformation. On full-resolution photos of 9 to 30 megapixels and downscaling factors from 2 to 8, SRIM raises the worst-case disruption of FLUX.2-klein edits from 0.192 LPIPS, attained by the strongest published protection, to 0.463. At equal visibility, it roughly doubles the protection. The same protected photos also protect against the 9B model and against FLUX.2-dev, with worst cases of 0.450 and 0.386 against at most 0.184 for published protections, and SRIM leads on InstructPix2Pix as well.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SRIM 把缩放视为频率选择性信道，用覆盖全尺度范围的锚点尺度网格加权采样来构造保护扰动，使扰动在未知降采样因子下仍存活。在 9–30 MP 全分辨率照片、降采样因子 2–8 上，FLUX.2-klein 编辑的最坏破坏从已发表最强保护的 0.192 LPIPS 提到 0.463，同等可见度下保护约翻倍。
Motivation: 保护扰动 (protective perturbations) 都在编辑器工作分辨率上优化和评测，而真实分享照片常达 10 MP 以上、编辑器会先按未知因子降采样，导致原生分辨率算出的扰动随降采样衰减，固定工作分辨率的扰动只覆盖一个尺度窗口。
Method: 把 resize 建模为频率选择性信道，分析得出最坏尺度保护随尺度范围宽度仅对数退化、跨尺度平均达不到该界；据此提出 SRIM，采样覆盖整个范围的锚点尺度网格，权重偏向当前最弱尺度，代价是标准的 expectation over transformation。
Result: 在 9–30 MP 全分辨率照片、降采样因子 2–8 上，SRIM 将 FLUX.2-klein 编辑的最坏破坏从已发表最强保护的 0.192 LPIPS 提到 0.463，同等可见度下保护约翻倍；对 9B 模型与 FLUX.2-dev 的最坏值分别为 0.450 与 0.386，而已发表保护至多 0.184，并在 InstructPix2Pix 上同样领先。
Conclusion: 原生分辨率或单一工作分辨率的扰动在未知缩放下不可靠，按最弱尺度加权的多锚点尺度采样才能在宽尺度范围上维持最坏情况保护。

papers.title: ElasticFit: Fit-Aware 3D Object Insertion via VLM Reasoning and Generative Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Inserting objects into existing 3D scenes requires more than selecting a plausible location: the inserted object must also fit local geometry while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and generative models enable semantic reasoning and visual content creation, they offer limited 3D grounding and geometric control when an inserted object must fit into constrained local spaces. We introduce \textbf{ElasticFit}, a VLM-guided framework for fit-aware object insertion centered on a novel scene-grounded representation. Given a language instruction and rendered scene observations, ElasticFit infers structured fitting cues that specify where the object should be grounded, what volume it should occupy, how it should be oriented, and its adaptation mode (rigid placement, uniform scaling, or elastic fitting). These cues convert high-level VLM reasoning into explicit 3D constraints that condition object generation and guide downstream geometric fitting. ElasticFit then generates a scene-conditioned object prior, reconstructs it in 3D, and refines the mesh through mode-specific fitting while enforcing collision avoidance, contact consistency, and physical grounding. In fixed-asset baseline comparisons, ElasticFit improves spatial relation success from 50.8\% to 69.7\% and support success from 48.3\% to 91.7\% over the strongest baseline, while providing novel support for generative "make-it-fit" insertions in complex scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ElasticFit 用 VLM 从语言指令与渲染场景观测中推出结构化 fitting cues（落点、体积、朝向、适配模式：rigid placement / uniform scaling / elastic fitting），把高层推理转成显式 3D 约束来驱动生成与几何拟合。在固定资产基线对比中，空间关系成功率从 50.8% 提到 69.7%，支撑成功率从 48.3% 提到 91.7%。
Motivation: VLM 与生成模型能做语义推理和内容生成，但在受限局部空间里插入物体时缺少 3D grounding 与几何控制，难以同时保证贴合、语义意图与物理合理性。
Method: 输入语言指令与渲染场景观测，VLM 推断结构化 fitting cues（grounding 位置、占用体积、朝向、适配模式），转为显式 3D 约束；随后生成场景条件化的物体先验、重建 3D，再按模式做 mesh 精修，同时强制 collision avoidance、contact consistency 与 physical grounding。
Result: 在固定资产基线对比中，空间关系成功率由最强基线的 50.8% 提升至 69.7%，支撑 (support) 成功率由 48.3% 提升至 91.7%；并新增对复杂场景下生成式 make-it-fit 插入的支持。
Conclusion: 把 VLM 的语义推理显式化为 3D fitting 约束并配合模式化几何精修，可在复杂场景中同时提高空间关系与支撑的插入成功率，并使生成式 make-it-fit 插入成为可能。

papers.title: Auditable Claims about AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Organizations make claims about their AI agents: a person approves every external email, every action is logged, an evaluation shows the agent is safe to deploy. Article 12 of the EU AI Act requires high-risk systems to allow the automatic recording of events but does not say which records settle a given claim. The position is one sentence: to be checked, a claim about an agent must first name its policy, its scope, the records that would settle it, and who writes them. Adapting the preconditions of an assurance engagement, we call a claim auditable when these elements and a decision rule are fixed before any verdict and the records are obtainable. This extends the Policy Checkability dimension of our Auditable Agents framework from single actions to claims. Agents add three conditions: coverage by an independent record, authorization bound to each action's arguments, and completeness beyond integrity. Under an explicit model, we prove that support is impossible without each wherever its hypotheses hold. A claim-check table applies the method to six common claims, anchored in current NIST, IETF, and OWASP drafts. A worked case follows one claim through five evidence states. We close with a practice box and steps for operators, buyers, auditors, and standard setters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把保证业务 (assurance engagement) 的前提移植到 AI agent 上，提出可审计声明 (auditable claim) 的判定条件：一条关于 agent 的声明在给出裁决前必须先固定其策略、适用范围、可 settle 该声明的记录、记录写入方以及决策规则，且这些记录可获取。在显式模型下作者证明，缺少独立记录覆盖、绑定到每个 action 参数的授权、以及超越完整性的完备性三者中任一条，support 就不可能成立。
Motivation: 组织对 AI agent 做出的声明（人工复核每封外发邮件、每个动作留痕、评估证明可安全部署）无处落实：EU AI Act 第 12 条只要求高风险系统自动记录事件，没有规定哪些记录才算数。
Method: 改造保证业务的 preconditions 定义 auditable claim（策略、范围、记录、写入方、决策规则在裁决前固定且记录可获取），把 Auditable Agents 框架的 Policy Checkability 维度从单个 action 扩展到声明；agent 额外引入三个条件：独立记录覆盖、授权绑定到每个 action 的参数、完备性超出完整性，并在显式模型下给出不可能性证明。
Result: 在显式模型下证明：只要其假设成立，缺少三个附加条件中的任一条，support 就不可能。给出覆盖六条常见声明的 claim-check 表，锚定当前 NIST、IETF、OWASP 草案；一个 worked case 跟踪单条声明经历五个 evidence states。
Conclusion: 声明要可核查，必须在裁决前把策略、范围、证据记录与决策规则全部定死，并由独立记录、参数级授权和完备性共同支撑，否则 support 在模型内不可达。
