papers.title: Interpretable Hypergraph Learning via Neural Additive Models
papers.abstract_en: Hypergraphs offer a natural framework for modeling networked data, where dependencies among entities are governed by higher-order interactions. While hypergraph learning methods such as hypergraph neural networks have demonstrated remarkable predictive performance, most existing approaches rely on black-box message-passing architectures, making it difficult to disentangle the contributions of node attributes and higher-order structural information. To address this challenge, we introduce the hypergraph neural additive network (HGNAN), an inherently interpretable framework for learning on hypergraph-structured data. HGNAN extends classical neural additive models to higher-order relational data by integrating feature-wise nonlinear decomposition with hypergraph-aware structural aggregation, enabling transparent prediction for both node- and hyperedge-level tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that HGNAN achieves performance comparable with state-of-the-art hypergraph learning methods while providing intrinsic and meaningful interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出超图神经加性网络 (HGNAN)，把经典 neural additive model 的特征逐项非线性分解与超图结构聚合结合，使节点属性与高阶结构各自的贡献可分离、节点级与超边级预测都可解释。在基准数据集上性能与最先进超图学习方法相当，同时给出内在且有意义的可解释性。
Motivation: 超图神经网络多为黑箱消息传递，难以拆分节点属性与高阶结构信息各自的贡献，预测无法解释。
Method: HGNAN 将 neural additive model 扩展到高阶关系数据：特征逐项非线性分解 (feature-wise nonlinear decomposition) 加上超图感知的结构聚合 (hypergraph-aware structural aggregation)，同时支持节点级与超边级任务。

papers.title: AlignQuant: Tile-Aligned Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Generation
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained mixed-precision quantization promises efficient large language model inference, but local precision choices can conflict with regular GPU storage and computation units. This precision-boundary mismatch limits the translation of compression into practical acceleration. We introduce AlignQuant, a post-training quantization method that uses GPU-compatible two-dimensional weight tiles as the common unit of precision allocation, compact storage, and execution. This shared partition lets precision follow sensitivity within output channels. Joint prefill/decode calibration scores precision reductions using projection-output perturbations weighted by language-model loss gradients under quantized activations. Phase-normalized scores prioritize higher precision for tiles important to either phase under a model-wide weight-storage budget. Each tile stores one selected representation, while phase-specialized kernels reuse the packed model and expand lower-bit weights for INT8 computation with 8-bit activations. Across four LLMs spanning 3B to 14B parameters, AlignQuant achieves up to $2.50\times$ generation speedup over BF16 while preserving model quality. Evaluations further cover three GPUs and contexts up to 64K tokens. These results show that local precision flexibility and regular GPU execution can coexist through a shared tile unit. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/AlignQuant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AlignQuant 把混合精度量化 (mixed-precision quantization) 的最小单位统一为 GPU 兼容的二维 weight tile，精度分配、紧凑存储与执行共用同一划分，使精度可沿输出通道跟随敏感度。在 3B–14B 的四个 LLM 上相对 BF16 最高取得 2.50× 生成加速并保持模型质量，覆盖三款 GPU 与最长 64K token 上下文。
Motivation: 细粒度混合精度的局部精度选择与 GPU 规则的存储/计算单元不一致，这种精度边界错配 (precision-boundary mismatch) 让压缩难以转化为实际加速。
Method: 训练后量化 (post-training quantization)：以二维 weight tile 作为精度分配、存储与执行的共同单元；联合 prefill/decode 校准用投影输出扰动、按量化激活下的语言模型损失梯度加权打分，再经 phase-normalized 分数在全模型权重存储预算内排序；每 tile 只存一种表示，phase-specialized kernel 复用打包模型并把低位权重展开做 INT8 计算、8-bit 激活。
Result: 在 3B 到 14B 参数的四个 LLM 上，相对 BF16 最高 2.50× 生成加速且保持模型质量；评测覆盖三款 GPU，上下文最长 64K tokens。
Conclusion: 局部精度灵活性与规则的 GPU 执行可以靠共享 tile 单元共存，混合精度的收益要以对齐硬件执行单元为前提。

papers.title: Active Feature Acquisition for Cost-Efficient Temporal Prediction with Reduced Participant Burden
authors: Junier Oliva (1) ((1) Department of Computer Science
University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
papers.abstract_en: Accurate forecasting of pathological outcomes is a central problem in psychology. To do so, psychologists often collect intensive longitudinal data. However, in such studies, the desire to acquire a large number of variables for the sake of accurate prediction is often counteracted by the need to minimize participant burden. Acquiring more variables per occasion can yield better predictions, but having too many acquisitions increase the risk of non-response and attrition. Longitudinal Active Feature Acquisition (LAFA) is a principled approach to resolve this conundrum. Instead of requiring responses to every item at every acquisition occasion, LAFA produces a policy that seeks to optimally select dynamic subsets of items to be acquired at each timepoint while preserving our ability to forecast a specific outcome. However, existing LAFA methods are mostly based on Neural Networks (NN) that are difficult to interpret in practice. In this work, we introduce a tree distillation method for learning an interpretable policy from NN-based LAFA networks. We validated our method through both a simulation and an empirical EMA dataset on forecasting daily alcohol consumption. In both cases, we find that we can meaningfully reduce the number of items acquired at each occasion with minimal loss in accuracy. Networks (NN) that are difficult to interpret in practice. We validated our method through both a simulation and an empirical EMA dataset on forecasting daily alcohol consumption. In both cases, we find that we can meaningfully reduce the number of items acquired at each occasion with minimal loss in accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出把神经网络 LAFA 策略蒸馏为可解释树模型的方法，在每次采集时动态挑选要问的题目子集，以减少被试负担同时保住对目标结果的预测能力。在模拟数据与一个预测每日饮酒量的 EMA 实证数据集上，该方法都能显著减少每次采集的题目数而准确率损失很小。
Motivation: 心理学密集纵向 (EMA) 研究里，多采变量能提升预测，但采集过多会抬高不回应与脱落风险；现有 LAFA 方法多基于难以解释的神经网络，实践中难以落地。
Method: 在 Longitudinal Active Feature Acquisition (LAFA) 框架下，用树蒸馏 (tree distillation) 从 NN-based LAFA 网络中学习一个可解释的逐时点选题策略，动态选择每次采集的题目子集；通过模拟数据与一个实证 EMA 数据集两部分验证。
Result: 在模拟与预测每日饮酒量的实证 EMA 数据集上，均能有意义地减少每次采集的题目数量，同时准确率损失极小 (minimal loss in accuracy)。
Conclusion: 神经网络 LAFA 策略可以被蒸馏成可解释的树策略，并在心理学密集纵向采集中以更少题目换取接近的预测精度，从而缓解采集广度与被试负担的取舍。

papers.title: Fork-and-Flush: Escaping Idea Basins in Autoresearch Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autoresearch agents tackle open-ended problems by repeatedly proposing candidate solutions, evaluating them, and using feedback to guide subsequent experiments. We show that independent runs of the same agent on the same task often plateau at substantially different scores, with gaps that persist even after considerable additional compute. Embedding their candidate artifacts by functional similarity provides further evidence that trajectories remain in localized regions of the solution space, which we call idea basins. To help agents escape these basins, we study a simple periodic intervention, fork-and-flush. Our method forks the agent into parallel trajectories, each inheriting the accumulated workspace but starting with a fresh chat context. After running each trajectory for a fixed horizon, the agent continues from the highest-scoring one. Across 13 long-horizon research and engineering tasks, with individual agent runs lasting up to several days, fork-and-flush outperformed the single-run and best-of-N baselines by a relative improvement of 66.0% and 44.4%, respectively, on the min-max normalized average score under an equal compute budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 同一 autoresearch agent 在同一任务上独立重复运行会停在差异很大的分数，且追加算力也不收敛，作者把这种解空间局部化称为 idea basin。fork-and-flush 周期性把 agent 分叉成多条并行轨迹，各自继承工作区但重置聊天上下文，固定时长后从最高分那条继续。在 13 个长时程研究与工程任务、等算力预算下，min-max 归一化平均分相对单次运行提升 66.0%，相对 best-of-N 提升 44.4%。
Motivation: 同一 agent 同一任务的独立运行分数长期分叉，候选产物按功能相似度嵌入后仍聚集在解空间局部区域，追加算力无法摆脱这种停滞。
Method: fork-and-flush：周期性把 agent 分叉为并行轨迹，每条继承累积工作区但以全新 chat context 起步，各自运行固定时长后，从得分最高的一条继续后续实验。
Result: 在 13 个长时程研究与工程任务上（单次运行长达数天），等算力预算下 min-max 归一化平均分相对单次运行基线提升 66.0%，相对 best-of-N 基线提升 44.4%。
Conclusion: idea basin 是算力堆不破的停滞，靠重置上下文的并行分叉再择优续跑才能逃出。

papers.title: Decoupling What from Where: How Should a Small GUI Grounding Model Receive the Action Type?
papers.abstract_en: A GUI agent decides which action to take and where to take it; we ask how a small grounding model should receive the action type. Fine-tuning Qwen2-VL-2B with LoRA on Android in the Wild, we compare a flat baseline with five ways of supplying the type under matched data, compute, and decoding: an auxiliary loss, a hard-routed action word, an additive learned embedding, a prepended learned token, and the type written into the prompt. With five seeds, an episode-clustered bootstrap, and seed-level paired tests, the ranking on a mixed stream is clear: the auxiliary loss, the additive embedding, and the prompt word each gain five to seven hit@0.10 points over the baseline, while hard routing and the prepended token are not distinguishable from it. Much of that gain is protection from a preprocessing choice of ours rather than a spatial prior. Our serializer clamps the off-screen touch point AITW records for type events to the origin; that class degrades the baseline's click grounding, and removing it lifts the baseline by nearly seven points, after which no mechanism's hit rate beats it and the intervals exclude a two-point effect, though the auxiliary loss still shortens the average miss; on a stream of taps and swipes none helps. Whether this generalizes beyond one serialization is open. For deployment, the pipeline's margin over the baseline with predicted rather than gold types is not established (+0.016, 95% interval [-0.017, +0.052]), and a wrong type collapses every model conditioned at inference. The prepended token does not help at the shared learning rate, where its rows barely move from initialization; trained ten times faster it reaches the level of the other three, with a margin three seeds do not establish. We also document a silent failure: injecting conditioning through inputs_embeds makes Qwen2-VL fall back to 1-D positions for image tokens, costing nine points.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code and per-example logs are available at https://github.com/aadcha/action-conditioned-gui-agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Qwen2-VL-2B + LoRA 上比较五种向小型 GUI grounding 模型注入动作类型的方式，辅助损失、加性嵌入、prompt 词在混合流上各比平坦基线高 5–7 个 hit@0.10 点，而硬路由与前置 token 与基线无异。该增益主要来自作者自己的序列化缺陷：把 AITW type 事件的屏外触点钳到原点，去掉后基线回升近 7 点，此后没有任何机制的命中率胜过基线。
Motivation: GUI agent 需要同时决定动作类型与位置，但小模型如何接收动作类型这一设计选择缺少受控比较；且注入方式可能与序列化预处理纠缠，掩盖真实的空间先验收益。
Method: 在 Android in the Wild (AITW) 上用 LoRA 微调 Qwen2-VL-2B，在匹配数据、算力与解码下对比五种注入方式：辅助损失、硬路由动作词、加性可学习嵌入、前置可学习 token、写入 prompt 的类型词；用五个种子、episode 聚类 bootstrap 与种子级配对检验，指标为 hit@0.10。
Result: 混合流上辅助损失、加性嵌入、prompt 词各比基线高 5–7 个 hit@0.10 点，硬路由与前置 token 与基线无异；去掉被钳到原点的屏外触点类后基线提升近 7 点，此后各机制均不胜出且区间排除 2 点效应，仅辅助损失仍缩短平均 miss；纯 tap/swipe 流上无一有效。预测类型而非 gold 类型时管线优势不成立（+0.016，95% 区间 [-0.017, +0.052]），类型出错会使所有推理期条件化模型崩溃；前置 token 在共享学习率下几乎不动，训练快十倍才追平其余三种；经 inputs_embeds 注入会让 Qwen2-VL 对图像 token 回退到 1-D 位置，损失 9 点。
Conclusion: 动作类型条件化的收益在很大程度上是序列化缺陷的保护效应而非空间先验，且是否泛化到其他序列化方式仍开放；部署时类型预测误差与 inputs_embeds 的静默失败是必须先排除的风险。

papers.title: Artifact removal improves electrodermal waveforms but not downstream classification in a virtual-reality balance task
papers.abstract_en: Artifact removal routinely precedes the classification of electrodermal activity (EDA), on the assumption that a cleaner signal supports a better decision. We tested this assumption in a virtual-reality (VR) balance-disturbance task. A residual gating network was trained on a benchmark with expert-corrected EDA, frozen, and applied to VR recordings, where raw and gated signals were classified by five published time-series methods under identical leave-one-participant-out evaluation. On the benchmark the gate detected artifacts well (median record AUROC 0.94) and reduced error inside artifact regions by 17.8%. In the VR task it did not improve classification. Changes in balanced accuracy ranged from -1.35 to +0.93 percentage points, no classifier improved and two lost accuracy, and all five were equivalent to raw input within +/- 3.32 points. The benefit was lost between waveform and decision. The correction that lowered waveform error also reduced skin conductance response detection in all 43 benchmark records. Processing left 92.8% of predictions unchanged, and the predictions it did change were corrected and corrupted at similar rates. The VR recordings also carried little contamination (an estimated 4.6% of samples), and even perfect localization of deliberately injected artifacts recovered only 3.3 points in the most sensitive classifier. A pooled association between artifact level and accuracy (11.3 points) disappeared within participants (0.1 points), showing how differences between people can make cleaning look useful. Preprocessing should be judged by the decision it supports, against an unprocessed arm.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Code and frozen data: https://github.com/rtb-1005/FairEDA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 VR 平衡扰动任务中检验「去伪迹让 EDA 分类更好」这一默认假设：残差门控网络在专家校正基准上确实把伪迹区误差降了 17.8%，但下游五种时序分类器的 balanced accuracy 变化仅 -1.35 到 +0.93 个百分点，全部与原始输入等价（±3.32 点）。作者主张预处理必须按它支撑的决策来评判，并对照未处理分支。
Motivation: EDA 分类前普遍先做伪迹去除，理由是更干净的信号应带来更好的决策，但这一假设从未在下游决策层面被直接检验。
Method: 在专家校正 EDA 基准上训练一个残差门控网络 (residual gating network) 并冻结，再应用到 VR 录音；raw 与 gated 两路信号交给五种已发表的时序分类方法，用 leave-one-participant-out 统一评估；另对故意注入的伪迹做完美定位实验，并比较伪迹水平与准确率的合并关联和被试内关联。
Result: 基准上门控 median record AUROC 0.94，伪迹区误差降低 17.8%，但 43 条基准记录的 SCR 检出全部下降；VR 任务中 balanced accuracy 变化 -1.35 至 +0.93 个百分点，无分类器提升、两个下降，五者均与原始输入在 ±3.32 点内等价；92.8% 的预测未被改变，被改变的预测中纠正与污染比例相近；VR 录音污染仅约 4.6% 样本，即便对注入伪迹做完美定位，最敏感分类器也只恢复 3.3 点；伪迹水平与准确率的合并关联为 11.3 点，被试内仅 0.1 点。
Conclusion: 降低波形误差的修正并未转化为决策收益，预处理应以它支撑的决策和未处理分支来评判；被试间差异会让清洗看起来有用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: When Does AI Supervision Help? A Role-Aware Study of Network Fraud Decision Management with Blockchain Auditability
papers.abstract_en: When does a second artificial intelligence (AI) component improve a primary network-fraud decision rather than add operational burden? We study this question through a role-aware Decider-Supervisor (DS) framework with blockchain auditability, evaluating four directional configurations that combine centralised machine learning, a Federated Averaging (FedAvg)-trained federated meta-model, and Base or Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) large language model variants. The analysis compares primary-only and supervised decisions using non-hard fraud performance, intervention burden, conditional calibration, traffic-mix and Review-capacity sensitivity, dependability tests, and blockchain lifecycle controls. The deterministic hard gate resolves 89.994% of fraudulent requests, leaving the non-hard population as the main AI decision setting. Conditional validation calibration does not produce a consistently transferable supervisory advantage on deployment replay. DS-3 QLoRA is the least disruptive supervised configuration, but it still underperforms its primary FedAvg stage in F1 and total errors. Across 36 reweighted traffic mixtures, supervision reduces total errors only for DS-4 Base in two extreme high-fraud scenarios. Blockchain tests support digest verification, tamper detection, authorisation, single-use review resolution, and post-finalisation integrity, while exposing a pre-finalisation single-write limitation. The results show that the value of AI supervision depends on role assignment, calibration, escalation policy, traffic composition, and lifecycle controls rather than on the presence of a second model alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在网络欺诈决策中测试“第二个 AI 监督者”是否真有价值：用 Decider-Supervisor (DS) 框架比较四种配置（集中式 ML、FedAvg 联邦元模型、Base 与 QLoRA 大模型监督者）。确定性硬门拦截 89.994% 欺诈请求；36 种重加权流量混合中仅 DS-4 Base 在两个极端高欺诈场景降低总错误，DS-3 QLoRA 虽干扰最小但 F1 与总错误仍差于其 FedAvg 主模型。
Motivation: 网络欺诈决策中引入第二个 AI 监督者往往增加运维负担，但何时真正改善主决策、何时只是开销，缺少按角色划分的系统评估。
Method: 构建角色感知 Decider-Supervisor 框架并评估四种方向性配置，组合集中式 ML、FedAvg 训练的联邦元模型与 Base/QLoRA 大语言模型变体；对比 primary-only 与受监督决策，考察非硬欺诈表现、干预负担、条件校准、流量混合与审核容量敏感性、可靠性测试及区块链生命周期控制。
Result: 确定性硬门解决 89.994% 欺诈请求，非硬人群成为主要 AI 决策场景；条件验证校准在部署回放上未产生一致可迁移的监督优势；DS-3 QLoRA 是干扰最小的受监督配置，但 F1 与总错误仍逊于其 FedAvg 主阶段；36 种重加权流量混合中监督仅在两个极端高欺诈场景下由 DS-4 Base 降低总错误；区块链测试支持摘要验证、篡改检测、授权、单次审核解析与终态后完整性，并暴露终态前单次写入限制。
Conclusion: AI 监督的价值取决于角色分配、校准、升级策略、流量构成与生命周期控制，而非单纯存在第二个模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: StaFIR: Convex Learning of Stationarity-Aware Causal Filters
papers.abstract_en: Reducing nonstationarity in a persistent time series entails deciding how much of its temporal dependence to remove. In finance, fractional differencing is often tuned using the Augmented Dickey--Fuller (ADF) test, limiting the search to a one-parameter family of lag profiles and addressing input preservation only indirectly. We propose StaFIR, a causal finite-impulse-response filter with a learned nonnegative mixture of exponential lag profiles. Its convex learning objective balances empirical stationarity with similarity to the input. We evaluate StaFIR on ARFIMA--GARCH controlled settings and rolling financial series, including a realized-volatility forecasting task. The experiments show that StaFIR adjusts its filtering strength to persistence while limiting unnecessary transformation in stationary regimes. In downstream forecasting, there is no clear accuracy difference from fixed half-order differencing, while StaFIR achieves higher measured similarity to the raw signal. A complementary direct forecasting experiment finds that greater input similarity is associated with smaller forecasting penalties, although the raw representation remains stronger.
papers.comment: Accepted at the TS-LIMITS Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StaFIR 用可学习的非负指数滞后混合构成因果 FIR 滤波器，以凸目标在平稳性与输入保真之间折中，替代金融中靠 ADF 检验调参的单参数分数阶差分。实验显示它能随持久性调节滤波强度、在平稳体制下少做无谓变换；下游预报精度与固定半阶差分无明显差别，但对原始信号的相似度更高，且相似度越高预报损失越小——尽管原始表示本身仍更强。
Motivation: 金融时间序列去除非平稳性时要权衡删掉多少时间依赖：ADF 调参把搜索限制在单参数滞后族，且只间接处理输入保真问题。
Method: StaFIR 是因果有限冲激响应 (FIR) 滤波器，滞后核取指数滞后剖面的可学习非负混合；凸学习目标同时最小化经验平稳性与和输入的差异。在 ARFIMA--GARCH 受控设定与滚动金融序列上评估，含一个已实现波动率 (realized-volatility) 预报任务，另有一个直接预报对照实验。
Result: StaFIR 的滤波强度随持久性自适应，在平稳体制下减少不必要的变换；下游预报精度与固定半阶差分 (fixed half-order differencing) 没有明显差别，但对原始信号的实测相似度更高；补充的直接预报实验中，输入相似度越高对应预报损失越小，不过原始表示仍然更强。
Conclusion: 在金融序列上，用凸学习的平稳性感知因果滤波可以在不损失预报精度的前提下提高输入保真，但完全不做变换的原始表示在预报上仍占优。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Adaptive Gait Biofeedback With Participant-Held-Out Modeling and Participant-Specific Updating in Chronic Ankle Instability
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive gait biofeedback may support repeated practice in chronic ankle instability, but its evaluation must address model performance and human response. We evaluated a temporal convolutional classifier on protocol-defined, angle-derived GOOD/BAD gait-cycle labels using participant-held-out leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation in 20 participants. Seven participants in the adaptive-intervention group completed nine sessions over three weeks, with one motion-capture recording analyzed per session. Models updated after failed sessions were compared offline with their parent models on the same-session validation subset used for candidate selection and the first subsequent adaptive-session recording. Frontal-plane ankle angle was compared between the adaptive group and 10 sequentially enrolled controls at Baseline, Post, and 7-day Retention. Across 20 held-out folds, mean fold-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.948, sensitivity for angle-threshold-exceeding BAD cycles was 0.941, and specificity for angle-threshold-meeting GOOD cycles was 0.366. Mean BAD-class F1 was higher in candidate models by 0.187 on the same-session subset and 0.118 on the first subsequent recording. At Post, the adaptive group had a baseline-adjusted frontal-plane ankle angle 5.168 degrees lower than controls (95% confidence interval, 1.766-8.569 degrees lower); the Retention contrast was uncertain. These findings characterize population-model discrimination and offline participant-specific updating during repeated biofeedback use, alongside a nonrandomized Post frontal-plane ankle angle association. They do not establish independent clinical gait classification or a causal benefit of updating.
papers.comment: 28 pages (14-page main manuscript and 14-page supplementary material), 5 main figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在慢性踝关节不稳 (CAI) 的步态生物反馈中，时序卷积分类器按协议定义的踝角阈值区分 GOOD/BAD 步态周期，LOSO 跨受试者验证下 AUROC 均值 0.948、BAD 类敏感度 0.941，但 GOOD 类特异度仅 0.366。失败会话后更新的候选模型在同会话子集与随后首次记录上 BAD 类 F1 分别高出母模型 0.187 与 0.118；干预组在 Post 时额状面踝角比对照低 5.168 度 (95% CI 1.766–8.569)，Retention 对比不确定。
Motivation: 步态生物反馈要靠反复练习起效，但既要证明分类模型在未见受试者上判别可靠，又要证明按个体更新模型后人的运动学响应确实改变，两者此前缺少同时评估。
Method: 用时序卷积分类器对协议定义、由踝角阈值导出的 GOOD/BAD 步态周期标签做 20 人 LOSO 留一受试者交叉验证；7 人自适应干预组三周内完成九次会话，每次取一条动作捕捉记录，失败会话后更新的模型与母模型在同一会话候选选择验证子集及随后首次自适应记录上离线比较；额状面踝角在 Baseline、Post、7 天 Retention 与 10 名顺序入组对照比较并做基线校正。
Result: 20 个留出折的折级 AUROC 均值 0.948，超角度阈值 BAD 周期敏感度 0.941，达阈值 GOOD 周期特异度 0.366；候选模型 BAD 类 F1 高于母模型 0.187（同会话子集）与 0.118（随后首次记录）；Post 时自适应组基线校正额状面踝角比对照低 5.168 度 (95% CI 1.766–8.569 度)，Retention 对比不确定。
Conclusion: 结果刻画了群体模型判别力与重复生物反馈中的离线个体化更新，以及非随机化的 Post 额状面踝角关联；作者明确指出这些发现不构成独立的临床步态分类验证，也不证明更新带来因果获益。

papers.title: AccentCL: Robust Accent Classification with Incremental Expansion
papers.abstract_en: Accent classifiers are typically trained with a fixed label inventory and cannot accommodate new accent categories as new data becomes available. Moreover, accented speech corpora often exhibit substantial class imbalance and/or domain shift due to differences in recording conditions across corpora. We present AccentCL, a class-incremental learning framework for English accent classification that is robust to class imbalance and cross-corpus domain shift. AccentCL extracts multi-layer representations from a frozen Whisper-Large-v3 encoder, optimized with an imbalance-aware cross-entropy loss to reduce bias toward the majority accent classes and a domain mean alignment loss that minimizes distributional mean shift across training corpora. The label space is then expanded via replay-based continual learning, using the frozen base model for knowledge retention and an old-to-new margin loss to reduce overprediction on newly added classes. On a five-class accent classification task, AccentCL achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy and a 76.9% macro-averaged F1 score. We further evaluate the model's ability to incrementally incorporate two new accent categories: Spanish-accented and Chinese-accented English. When adding Spanish-accented English to the pretrained model, AccentCL attains an F1 of 83.3% on the new class while retaining 77.3% balanced accuracy on the base classes. When subsequently adding Chinese-accented English, it achieves 61.8% F1 on the new class while preserving 77.6% balanced accuracy on the previously learned classes. These results show that AccentCL enables robust regional accent classification while allowing new accent categories to be added without full retraining.
papers.comment: Published in Proceedings of IEEE Spoken Language Technology Workshop (SLT) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AccentCL 是英语口音分类的类增量学习框架：冻结 Whisper-Large-v3 编码器取多层表征，用不平衡感知交叉熵与域均值对齐损失训练，再以 replay 加 old-to-new margin loss 扩展标签空间。五类任务上 balanced accuracy 77.1%、macro-F1 76.9%；新增 Spanish 口音类 F1 83.3% 且基础类 balanced accuracy 保持 77.3%，再加 Chinese 口音类 F1 61.8%、旧类保持 77.6%，无需全量重训。
Motivation: 口音分类器通常固定标签集，无法在新数据到达时接纳新口音类别；同时口音语料存在类别不平衡与跨语料库域偏移（录音条件差异）。
Method: 冻结 Whisper-Large-v3 编码器并抽取多层表征，用 imbalance-aware cross-entropy 抑制对多数口音类的偏置，配合 domain mean alignment loss 最小化训练语料间的分布均值偏移；标签空间扩展采用 replay-based continual learning，保留冻结基座模型做知识保持，并用 old-to-new margin loss 抑制对新增类的过度预测。
Result: 五类口音分类任务上 balanced accuracy 77.1%、macro-averaged F1 76.9%。增量加入 Spanish-accented English：新类 F1 83.3%，基础类 balanced accuracy 保持 77.3%；随后加入 Chinese-accented English：新类 F1 61.8%，已学类 balanced accuracy 保持 77.6%。
Conclusion: AccentCL 支持在不全量重训的前提下增量加入新口音类别，同时维持区域口音分类的稳健性与旧类性能。

papers.title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
papers.abstract_en: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. Scripted reference layouts pass all 128 tasks, showing that every task is solvable. We evaluate six models and seven workflow and scaffold variants of GPT5.6-Luna, with five attempts per task. The best-performing configuration in the six-model panel, GPT5.6-Luna with ReAct-3, passes 62.3% of attempts and solves 80.5% of tasks at least once (coverage) and 43.8% in all five attempts (consistency). ReAct-3 exceeds the one-pass Plan-and-Execute by 27.0 pass@1 points at 2.46 times the tokens. An expert audit of one sampled verifier-passing layout per covered task, across five ReAct-3 configurations, accepts 56.4% to 63.5% of them. The benchmark evaluates geometric and structural FET layout construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 2D-FET-Bench V2 用 128 个从显微镜剥离薄片轮廓构建的版图任务，测试语言模型 agent 能否按文字器件规格生成 FET 版图。GPT5.6-Luna 配 ReAct-3 在六模型面板中 pass@1 62.3%、任务覆盖 80.5%、五次全过 43.8%，比单趟 Plan-and-Execute 高 27.0 个 pass@1 点但耗 2.46 倍 token。
Motivation: 二维薄片上的 FET 版图目前靠人工逐片绘制，缺少可执行基准来检验语言模型 agent 是否能可靠完成这种随薄片轮廓变化的构造任务。
Method: 构建 128 个任务，每个提供文字器件规格与薄片轮廓坐标（含带孔薄片与多薄片任务）；agent 输出带类型的多边形与路径操作并渲染为 GDSII，由确定性 verifier 检查几何与结构要求，另有完整性检查确认轮廓未被改动；评测六个模型与 GPT5.6-Luna 的七种 workflow/scaffold 变体，每任务五次尝试。
Result: 脚本参考版图通过全部 128 个任务，证明任务均可解；最佳配置 GPT5.6-Luna + ReAct-3 的尝试通过率 62.3%，任务覆盖（至少过一次）80.5%，五次全过（一致性）43.8%；ReAct-3 比单趟 Plan-and-Execute 高 27.0 个 pass@1 点，token 用量为 2.46 倍；专家对每个已覆盖任务抽样一个通过 verifier 的版图、跨五个 ReAct-3 配置审核，接受率 56.4% 到 63.5%。
Conclusion: 语言模型 agent 已能相当程度地完成薄片特定的 FET 版图构造，但 verifier 通过与专家接受之间仍有差距，且高一致性（43.8%）明显低于单次覆盖率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking Label-Revealed Online Updates for EEG BCI Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) signals drift over time, which can cause static brain-computer interface (BCI) models to degrade in practice. We present a benchmark for online adaptation and compare two widely used pipeline families, Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) and Riemannian covariance-based methods, under time-ordered prequential (test-then-train) evaluation. We examine (i) which pipelines benefit most from label-revealed updates, (ii) whether controlled forgetting of older data improves robustness, and (iii) how a minimal-calibration cold start compares with starting from a pretrained model. Across four datasets (three motor-imagery datasets and one movement-decoding dataset), label-revealed online updates improve 13 of 14 model/dataset pairs on the two largest streams, with relative accuracy gains of up to about 18% over a frozen model. A Shapley-based data-valuation analysis over temporal blocks assigns the largest mean value to the most recent block in each of the three analyzed datasets, while older blocks retain positive value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 EEG 随时间漂移导致静态 BCI 模型退化，提出在线自适应基准，在时序 prequential（test-then-train）协议下比较 CSP 与黎曼协方差 (Riemannian covariance) 两条流水线的标签揭示式在线更新。在四个数据集（三个运动想象、一个动作解码）上，两条最大数据流的 14 个模型/数据对中有 13 个被在线更新改善，相对冻结模型准确率提升最高约 18%；Shapley 数据估值显示最近时间块均值最高、旧块仍为正。
Motivation: EEG 信号随时间漂移，静态 BCI 模型在实际使用中性能退化；缺少在时序在线协议下比较主流解码流水线自适应策略的基准。
Method: 构建在线自适应基准，用时序 prequential（test-then-train）评估比较 Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) 与黎曼协方差两类流水线；考察标签揭示式更新、对旧数据的受控遗忘、最小校准冷启动与预训练模型起步三种设定，并对时间块做基于 Shapley 的数据估值分析。
Result: 在四个数据集（三个运动想象、一个动作解码）上，两条最大数据流的 14 个模型/数据对中 13 个被标签揭示式在线更新改善，相对冻结模型的准确率提升最高约 18%。Shapley 数据估值在三个被分析数据集中，最近时间块的平均值均最高，同时较旧的块仍保持正值。
Conclusion: 标签揭示式在线更新对多数 EEG 解码模型/数据组合有效，且近期数据价值最高但历史数据并未失效，因此受控遗忘应保留部分旧数据而非完全丢弃。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Learnable Spectral Activations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are shaped by the spectral structure induced by their input encodings and activation functions. Existing methods improve fitting primarily by modifying which frequencies are available to the network, through coordinate encodings or periodic nonlinearities. However, frequency access is not the only bottleneck: signals with localized or spatially varying structure require the network to efficiently compose frequencies into multi-harmonic internal responses. We introduce learnable spectral activations (LSA), which replace fixed neuron-level nonlinearities with a residual truncated Fourier series whose harmonic amplitudes are learned during training. LSA does not expand the asymptotic function class. Instead, it changes the factorization of the representation: linear weights select features while activation coefficients control spectral shaping, and the two are updated by separate gradients. Because the activation output is affine in the coefficients given fixed pre-activations, spectral tuning becomes a more direct subproblem compared to architectures where it is entangled with feature selection. Empirically, this factorization concentrates more target-signal energy in the leading eigenmodes of the neural tangent kernel, consistent with improved optimization behavior. Across audio, image, neural radiance field, and neural acoustic field tasks, LSA also improves reconstruction quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LSA 用可学习的残差截断 Fourier 级数替换固定神经元非线性，让线性权重选特征、激活系数控谱整形并由各自梯度更新。在音频、图像、NeRF 与神经声场任务上重建质量提升，且把更多目标信号能量集中到 NTK 的前导特征模态。
Motivation: 现有 INR 改进主要靠坐标编码或周期非线性调整可用频率，但频率可及性不是唯一瓶颈：局部或空间变化结构的信号需要网络把频率组合成多谐波内部响应，而谱整形与特征选择在原架构中纠缠。
Method: 提出 learnable spectral activations (LSA)：以训练中学习谐波幅值的残差截断 Fourier 级数取代固定激活；线性权重负责特征选择、激活系数负责谱整形，二者由独立梯度更新。给定固定 pre-activation 时激活输出对系数是仿射的，使谱调节成为更直接的子问题；该设计不扩大渐近函数类，只改变表示的因子分解。
Result: 经验上该因子分解把更多目标信号能量集中到神经切线核 (NTK) 的前导特征模态，与更好的优化行为一致；在音频、图像、神经辐射场 (NeRF) 与神经声场 (neural acoustic field) 任务上重建质量均有提升。
Conclusion: 提升来自表示因子分解而非扩大函数类：把谱整形从特征选择中解耦出来，就能在不增加渐近表达能力的前提下改善 INR 的优化与重建。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization on Function Spaces via Sparse RKHS Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Optimization (BO) has become an established methodology for minimizing black-box functions of a vector input. Often, however, this parameter vector arises from the discretization of an inherently functional relationship. Several recent articles have considered the Functional Bayesian Optimization (FBO) setting, in which the variable to be optimized is not a member of a finite dimensional vector space, but rather an infinite dimensional function space. In this work, we propose $L^0$ Manifold Optimization (L0MO), a simple approach to FBO which searches the subset of a Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS) consisting of functions with a sparse representation in the kernel functions, optimizing both the kernel locations and their coefficients. We discuss in detail the relationship between our method and existing ones, providing a unifying lens through which to view prior works. To assess our method against the state of the art, we conduct an extensive computational study, and along the way develop a novel set of benchmark test functions which port standard finite-dimensional ones to the infinite dimensional domain. Our experiments demonstrate that, on balance, the proposed method achieves superior performance across a wide range of test benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 L0MO (L0 Manifold Optimization)，在 RKHS 中只搜索核函数稀疏表示的子流形，同时优化核位置与系数，把函数型贝叶斯优化 (FBO) 化为可处理的有限维搜索。在把标准有限维测试函数移植到无穷维域的新 benchmark 上做计算研究，整体表现优于现有 FBO 方法。
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化的输入常来自某个函数关系的离散化，而 FBO 要在无穷维函数空间上直接优化，搜索空间过大且缺少统一视角与可比 benchmark。
Method: L0MO 在 RKHS 中限定核函数的稀疏表示子集，联合优化核的位置与系数；作者给出与已有 FBO 方法的统一视角，并新构造一组把标准有限维测试函数移植到无穷维域的 benchmark。
Result: 在覆盖广泛测试函数的计算研究中，L0MO 总体上取得优于现有方法的表现；定量对比以新提出的无穷维 benchmark 测试函数集为设置。
Conclusion: 把 FBO 约束到 RKHS 的稀疏核表示流形上，是一条能统一理解既有工作并整体提升性能的路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Policies with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Active feature acquisition learns policies that sequentially acquire features to maximize information about a target variable. We study how to learn and evaluate such policies from finite offline data using prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which are off-the-shelf models that output posterior predictive distributions without task-specific training. We show that under the imbalanced coverage of offline data, using total predictive entropy as a reward creates an epistemic bias that penalizes acquiring sparsely observed features. Specifically, this reward conflates epistemic uncertainty (arising from lack of offline data) with aleatoric uncertainty (arising from uninformative features). To address this, we target the posterior expected (aleatoric) entropy instead of the total predictive entropy output by a PFN for evaluating feature acquisitions. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently reduces value estimation bias and yields credible intervals with strong empirical coverage, which can translate to improved downstream policy selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在有限离线数据上学主动特征获取 (active feature acquisition) 策略时，用 PFN 输出的总预测熵作奖励会把认知不确定性与偶然不确定性混为一谈，在离线数据覆盖不均时系统性惩罚稀疏观测特征的获取。改用后验期望的偶然熵 (posterior expected aleatoric entropy) 评估特征获取，可一致降低价值估计偏差，并给出经验覆盖良好的可信区间。
Motivation: 离线数据对不同特征的观测覆盖往往不均衡，此时以总预测熵为奖励会把“缺数据”误当成“特征无信息”，导致特征获取价值被系统性低估，进而选错下游策略。
Method: 用 prior-data fitted networks (PFN) 直接输出后验预测分布、无需任务特定训练；指出总预测熵混合了认知不确定性与偶然不确定性，转而以后验期望的偶然熵作为特征获取的评估目标，在合成与真实数据集上做实证评估。
Result: 在合成与真实数据集上的实证评估中，该方法一致降低价值估计偏差，并产生经验覆盖强的可信区间，可转化为更好的下游策略选择。
Conclusion: 评估特征获取应针对后验期望的偶然熵而非 PFN 的总预测熵，否则离线覆盖不均会引入认知偏差、扭曲策略选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What pass@k Cannot Measure: Evaluating Diversity and Capability Retention after Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: pass@$k$, the fraction of problems a model solves within $k$ sampled attempts, is the field's default protocol for deciding whether reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training on verifiable rewards improved a model. At the population level, pass@$k$ depends only on a problem's probability of a correct sample, with no term for how it is distributed across outputs. We show this gap is not academic. Training Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on grade-school math with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and with rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT, training on the model's own shortest verifier-passed rollout) moves three complementary diversity measures (token-level entropy, answer-level entropy, unique answers per prompt) in opposite directions, with zero overlap across three seeds per arm. The gap survives restricting to verifier-correct completions only (lexical diversity among correct solutions is 15% lower for GRPO, after controlling for length) and a count-controlled check isolating diversity among incorrect answers alone, ruling out that GRPO's higher accuracy alone explains it. Yet pass@8 and pass@32 show no consistent winner on GSM8K, and a hard MATH-500 subset shows the same pattern: separation only at low $k$. Compared against the starting checkpoint, no trained arm significantly improves hard-problem coverage: RFT is significantly worse, while GRPO is statistically indistinguishable from it - so GRPO's pass@1 edge over RFT reflects a smaller loss relative to Base, not a capability gain, a missing-control issue, not a failure of pass@$k$. On GSM8K, only pass@1, with no role in detecting diversity by construction, separates the arms cleanly, rewarding the arm whose correct solutions are least diverse. We argue this is a concrete instance of a standard evaluation protocol missing a property it is routinely used to certify.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-training to Post-training (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: pass@k 只依赖单题答对概率，对答案分布无感知，因此无法度量后训练带来的输出多样性。用 GRPO 与 RFT 训练 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 做 GSM8K，三种多样性度量方向相反且三随机种子零重叠，但 pass@8/pass@32 无一致赢家，只有 pass@1 干净区分两臂并奖励正确解最不多样的一方。
Motivation: pass@k 被默认用来认证 RL 后训练是否改进模型，但其总体形式不含输出分布项，可能漏掉甚至反向奖励多样性变化。
Method: 在 grade-school math 上用 GRPO 与 rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT，取自身最短通过验证的 rollout 训练) 训练 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，每臂三个种子；用 token-level entropy、answer-level entropy、unique answers per prompt 三种多样性度量，并做仅保留 verifier-correct 输出与 count-controlled 的错误答案检查以排除准确率混淆。
Result: 三种多样性度量在两臂间方向相反，三个种子零重叠；控制长度后 GRPO 的正确解词法多样性低 15%。GSM8K 上 pass@8 与 pass@32 无一致赢家，hard MATH-500 子集同样只在低 k 分离。相对起始 checkpoint，RFT 显著变差、GRPO 与之统计无差异；GSM8K 上仅 pass@1 能干净区分两臂。
Conclusion: GRPO 相对 RFT 的 pass@1 优势是相对 Base 损失更小而非能力提升，属 missing-control 问题；pass@k 作为常规协议会漏掉它被用来认证的性质（多样性），且低 k 上还会奖励正确解最不多样的一方。

papers.title: Defense-in-Depth for LLMs: Evaluating Memory Gates Against Activation-Induced and Memory-Induced Sycophancy
papers.abstract_en: Long-term memory allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain personalized context across interactions, but retrieved user history can induce memory-induced sycophancy, causing models to favor stored user beliefs over objective evidence. Existing defenses primarily operate on retrieved context and are rarely evaluated jointly with internal behavioral bias. We introduce a $2 \times 2$ defense-in-depth framework separating internal activation steering from external memory handling. We extract sycophancy steering directions from 100 paired prompts and evaluate four open-weight models across 10 steering coefficients and five memory-defense configurations on MemSyco-Bench (answers for all 1,550 items; defense conditions judged on a fixed 250-item subsample), with three LLM judges. Three of the five configurations are new (rewriting every memory, a Router Gate that keeps, rewrites, or drops each memory, and dropping all memory); the other two are MemSyco's baselines. Selective Router Gate filtering preserves substantially more of MemSyco's average accuracy than complete memory removal, and this separation persists when the models are steered toward sycophancy. On Llama 3.1 8B with Router Gate, mild inverse steering ($α= -1.5$) lowers judge-averaged sycophancy from 35.80% to 31.32% while average accuracy moves from 43.99% to 43.31%; this reduction has the same direction under all three judges but is not statistically significant (paired $p = 0.08$ to $0.63$ on 149 items). External memory filtering is the part of the design that holds up; our data do not show that inverse steering adds to it.
papers.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS (IAB, RTCA, AIWILD, and CL4FM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 2×2 防御纵深框架下比较内部激活转向 (activation steering) 与外部记忆处理对 LLM 记忆诱发谄媚 (memory-induced sycophancy) 的作用：选择性 Router Gate 过滤比完全删除记忆更能保住 MemSyco-Bench 平均准确率，且该优势在把模型向谄媚方向转向时依然保持；而在 Llama 3.1 8B 上叠加温和反向转向 (α=-1.5) 只把三裁判平均谄媚率从 35.80% 降到 31.32%（准确率 43.99%→43.31%），配对检验 p=0.08–0.63 不显著，因此外部记忆过滤才是站得住的那部分设计。
Motivation: 长期记忆让 LLM 保留用户历史，但检索出的用户信念会压过客观证据，诱发 memory-induced sycophancy；现有防御几乎只作用于检索到的上下文，且很少与模型内部行为偏差一起评估。
Method: 构建 2×2 防御纵深框架，把内部 activation steering 与外部记忆处理分开：用 100 对 prompts 提取谄媚转向方向，在 4 个 open-weight 模型上扫 10 个 steering coefficient 与 5 种记忆防御配置（新增三种：重写全部记忆、按条保留/重写/丢弃的 Router Gate、丢弃全部记忆；另两种为 MemSyco 基线），在 MemSyco-Bench 上由 3 个 LLM judge 评判。
Result: MemSyco-Bench 全部 1,550 项给出答案，防御条件在固定 250 项子样本上评判；Router Gate 选择性过滤比完全删除记忆保留明显更多的 MemSyco 平均准确率，且在模型被转向谄媚时该差距仍存在。Llama 3.1 8B + Router Gate 下 α=-1.5 反向转向使三 judge 平均谄媚率 35.80%→31.32%，平均准确率 43.99%→43.31%，三个 judge 方向一致但 149 项配对 p=0.08–0.63 不显著。
Conclusion: 外部记忆过滤是设计中真正成立的部分；数据不显示反向转向在其之上还有额外增益。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Fed-BRDECS: Privacy-Preserving and Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Deep Embedded Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Federated deep clustering seeks to learn clustering-friendly representations from decentralized unlabeled data while preserving client privacy. However, Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC)-style objectives depend on global soft-assignment statistics that require clients to reveal their sensitive information. We propose Fed-BRDECS, a privacy-preserving and heterogeneity-aware federated deep embedded clustering framework. Fed-BRDECS replaces the globally normalized clustering objective with a locally computable sample-stability loss, avoiding the transmission of local soft-assignment distributions. To tackle non-IID client distributions, we introduce prediction-balanced sampling, which oversamples locally rare predicted clusters without requiring ground-truth labels, and centroid-level restarting, which periodically refreshes biased or inactive centroids. Experiments on image and text clustering benchmarks show that Fed-BRDECS consistently outperforms representative federated clustering and deep clustering baselines under both IID and non-IID partitions. We further demonstrate its applicability to federated time-series anomaly detection, where it improves reconstruction-based detectors without adding inference-time cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fed-BRDECS 把 DEC 式全局归一化聚类目标换成客户端本地可算的样本稳定性损失 (sample-stability loss)，不再上传局部 soft-assignment 分布，从而在联邦深度聚类中保住隐私。针对 non-IID，它用 prediction-balanced sampling 过采样本地罕见的预测簇（不需标签），并用 centroid-level restarting 定期刷新偏置或失活的质心。在图像与文本聚类基准的 IID 和 non-IID 划分上均稳定优于代表性联邦聚类与深度聚类基线，并可迁移到联邦时间序列异常检测，提升基于重构的检测器且不增加推理开销。
Motivation: DEC 类目标依赖全局 soft-assignment 统计量，客户端必须暴露敏感信息；同时 non-IID 客户端分布会让聚类质心偏置或失活。
Method: Fed-BRDECS 以本地可计算的样本稳定性损失替代全局归一化聚类目标，避免传输局部 soft-assignment 分布；配合 prediction-balanced sampling（无需真值标签地过采样本地罕见预测簇）与 centroid-level restarting（周期性刷新偏置/失活质心）处理 non-IID。
Result: 在图像与文本聚类基准上，IID 与 non-IID 划分下均持续优于代表性联邦聚类与深度聚类基线；在联邦时间序列异常检测上改进基于重构的检测器，且不增加推理时开销。
Conclusion: 不上传全局 soft-assignment 统计、改用本地稳定性损失并配合平衡采样与质心重启，可在保护隐私的同时兼顾 non-IID 聚类质量，且可迁移到时间序列异常检测。

papers.title: A perspective note on likelihood approximation and inference for complex simulation models using a chain of aggregated normalizing flows
papers.abstract_en: We present a new perspective on the problem of likelihood approximation within the framework of simulation-based inference that promotes scalable and controllable simulation routines for large-scale data analysis, allows efficient parameter space exploration or smooth interpolation in high-dimensions and, thus, supports valid statistical treatments of hypothesis testings as well as uncertainty quantification. In particular, we consider a chain of $n$-aggregated normalizing flows for likelihood approximation scheme, where a set of upfront replicated observation datasets from the forward complex simulation model pass through the first set of bijective transformations, and then subsequently pass to the other sets of bijective transformations. Here, we assume that, for any $k \in \{1,\,2, \ldots, n\}$, the parameters corresponding to the first $k$ sets of bijective transformations are estimated sequentially, in some sense of optimality, for constructing flexible probability distributions, regardless of the remaining $(n-k)$ sets of bijective transformations. Moreover, our objects of interest are to highlight two complementary mathematical arguments that leverage an informatics-theoretic formalization, based-on empirical likelihood estimators under moment restrictions, and a sequential decision-making paradigm, with mixing distributions, for updating and aggregating the estimated parameters of the overall normalizing flows. As a by-product, the framework provides a reliable surrogate model, conditioned on the model parameters defining the forward computational simulation, that allows samples generation, with statistical powers, and facilitates computationally tractable scheme in the Bayesian paradigm for inference, hypothesis testings and uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向复杂仿真模型的 simulation-based inference，提出由 n 个聚合 normalizing flow 组成的链式似然近似：复制观测数据集依次通过多组双射变换，参数按序估计并用经验似然与序贯决策两条论证聚合。框架产出以模型参数为条件的代理模型，可生成带统计功效的样本，支撑贝叶斯推断、假设检验与不确定性量化。
Motivation: 复杂前向仿真模型的似然难以写出，大规模数据分析中参数空间探索与高维插值代价高，假设检验和不确定性量化缺少可用的统计处理。
Method: 用 n-aggregated normalizing flow 链做似然近似：前向模型的复制观测集先过第一组双射变换，再依次过后续各组；对每个 k，前 k 组的参数按某种最优性序贯估计，不依赖剩余 n-k 组。聚合更新由两条互补论证支撑：基于矩限制下经验似然估计量 (empirical likelihood under moment restrictions) 的信息论形式化，以及带 mixing distributions 的序贯决策范式。
Result: 摘要为 perspective note，给出的是框架性主张而非实验数字：链式聚合 normalizing flow 可扩展、可控地近似似然，支持高维参数空间探索与平滑插值，并产出条件于前向仿真参数的可靠代理模型，可生成具统计功效的样本。
Conclusion: 似然近似可以拆成序贯估计的双射变换链，用经验似然与序贯决策聚合参数，从而在贝叶斯范式下做推断、假设检验与不确定性量化。
Relevance: 34

summary_sections.tldr: 面向复杂仿真模型的 simulation-based inference，提出由 n 个聚合 normalizing flow 组成的链式似然近似：复制观测数据集依次通过多组双射变换，参数按序估计并用经验似然与序贯决策两条论证聚合。框架产出以模型参数为条件的代理模型，可生成带统计功效的样本，支撑贝叶斯推断、假设检验与不确定性量化。
summary_sections.motivation: 复杂前向仿真模型的似然难以写出，大规模数据分析中参数空间探索与高维插值代价高，假设检验和不确定性量化缺少可用的统计处理。
summary_sections.method: 用 n-aggregated normalizing flow 链做似然近似：前向模型的复制观测集先过第一组双射变换，再依次过后续各组；对每个 k，前 k 组的参数按某种最优性序贯估计，不依赖剩余 n-k 组。聚合更新由两条互补论证支撑：基于矩限制下经验似然估计量 (empirical likelihood under moment restrictions) 的信息论形式化，以及带 mixing distributions 的序贯决策范式。
summary_sections.result: 摘要为 perspective note，给出的是框架性主张而非实验数字：链式聚合 normalizing flow 可扩展、可控地近似似然，支持高维参数空间探索与平滑插值，并产出条件于前向仿真参数的可靠代理模型，可生成具统计功效的样本。
summary_sections.conclusion: 似然近似可以拆成序贯估计的双射变换链，用经验似然与序贯决策聚合参数，从而在贝叶斯范式下做推断、假设检验与不确定性量化。

papers.title: Inference and learning in sparse autoencoders as natural gradient flow
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders are widely used to uncover interpretable features in neural networks, yet reliable recovery remains difficult when features overlap or activate infrequently. These challenges involve both inferring which features explain an input and learning the dictionary that represents them. Here, we unify inference and dictionary learning as natural-gradient flows on a shared variational free energy. We instantiate this framework as BeFOND, an encoder-free sparse coding model with closed-form inference and learning dynamics. We show how recurrent explaining away reduces interference between overlapping features, while Fisher preconditioning can compensate for the slow learning of rare features. On synthetic data, BeFOND improves dictionary recovery and rare-feature detection, with a growing advantage over amortized baselines as superposition increases. On language-model activations, it improves single-feature concept detection and selective intervention, outperforming pretrained reference SAEs with substantially less training data. Its feature quality continues to improve with dictionary width, whereas the evaluated baselines largely plateau. Together, these results show how improving inference and learning within a unified probabilistic framework can make better use of data and dictionary capacity to interpret and intervene on neural representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 的推断与字典学习统一为共享变分自由能上的自然梯度流，实例化为无编码器的稀疏编码模型 BeFOND，推断与学习均为闭式动力学。循环 explaining away 抑制重叠特征间的干扰，Fisher 预条件加速稀有特征学习；在合成数据上随 superposition 加深相对 amortized 基线优势扩大，在语言模型激活上以更少训练数据超过预训练参考 SAE，且特征质量随字典宽度持续提升而基线基本停滞。
Motivation: SAE 在特征重叠或激活稀疏时难以可靠恢复特征，且推断（哪个特征解释输入）与字典学习两个问题彼此耦合、各自为政。
Method: 将推断与字典学习统一为共享变分自由能上的自然梯度流，得到无编码器 (encoder-free)、推断与学习均有闭式动力学的 BeFOND；用循环 explaining away 减少重叠特征干扰，用 Fisher preconditioning 补偿稀有特征的慢学习。
Result: 合成数据上 BeFOND 改善字典恢复与稀有特征检测，且随 superposition 程度增加，相对 amortized 基线的优势扩大；在语言模型激活上提升单特征概念检测与选择性干预 (selective intervention)，以明显更少的训练数据超过预训练参考 SAE；其特征质量随字典宽度继续上升，而被评估的基线大多趋于平台。
Conclusion: 在统一概率框架内同时改进推断与学习，能更充分地利用数据与字典容量，从而更好地解释并干预神经表征。

papers.title: DeepAJM: Deep Association Joint Model for Irregularly Sampled data
papers.abstract_en: Joint Models simultaneously model longitudinal and survival outcomes, leveraging patterns in patients' longitudinal trajectory to improve the prediction of survival outcomes. The classical parametric joint models, however, rely on fixed parametric assumptions, making them susceptible to bias under model misspecification and smaller sample sizes. We propose a deep joint model, DeepAJM, that does not require any parametric assumptions, while retaining a partially interpretable, per-longitudinal-outcome association structure. The joint model uses an encoder-decoder (sequence-to-sequence) architecture to learn the latent structure in patients' time-varying covariate trajectories. The model links the longitudinal processes to the survival processes through a learned interpretable association structure, in which each longitudinal output from the decoder gets remodulated by baseline covariates before it contributes to the risk scores from the survival head of the architecture. The model was evaluated on three datasets ( a cardiovascular-disease EHR cohort, a primary biliary cirrhosis (PBC2) dataset, and a simulated dataset) against a classical parametric joint model, TransformerJM, DA-LSTM and a Cox-based survival-only model. All models were assessed using C-index, integrated brier score (IBS), time-dependent AUROC, and time-dependent AUPRC. Our model achieved the best discrimination in terms of the C-index, time-dependent AUROC, and AUPRC across all datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DeepAJM 用 encoder-decoder (seq2seq) 学患者时变协变量轨迹的潜结构，再经基线协变量再调制的可解释关联结构把纵向过程接到生存头的风险分数上，全程不设参数化假设。在心血管 EHR 队列、PBC2 与模拟数据三个数据集上，相对经典参数化联合模型、TransformerJM、DA-LSTM 与 Cox-only 基线取得最佳 C-index、time-dependent AUROC 与 AUPRC 判别表现。
Motivation: 经典参数化联合模型依赖固定参数化假设，模型误设与小样本下易产生偏倚，而纵向轨迹与生存结局的关联结构往往被迫写死。
Method: encoder-decoder (seq2seq) 架构学习患者时变协变量轨迹的潜结构；解码器的每个纵向输出先由基线协变量再调制，再进入生存头的风险分数，形成按纵向结局分项、部分可解释的关联结构，无需参数化假设。
Result: 在心血管疾病 EHR 队列、原发性胆汁性胆管炎 (PBC2) 与模拟数据集上，对照经典参数化联合模型、TransformerJM、DA-LSTM 与 Cox 生存-only 模型，用 C-index、integrated Brier score (IBS)、time-dependent AUROC、time-dependent AUPRC 评估；DeepAJM 在全部三个数据集上取得最佳 C-index、time-dependent AUROC 与 AUPRC 判别表现。
Conclusion: 无参数化假设的深度联合模型配合部分可解释的逐纵向结局关联结构，可在三个数据集上同时保住纵向-生存联合建模的判别力与可解释性。

papers.title: Semantic Capability Acquisition and Specialization During Vision-Language Model Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning vision-language models (VLMs) is typically evaluated at a single downstream checkpoint, obscuring whether a semantic capability was never acquired or emerged earlier and later declined during specialization. We ask how semantic capabilities are acquired, when they peak, how well they transfer, and what remains at deployment. We study these dynamics as a semantic capability trajectory, tracking identity- and attribute-based capabilities over training. We formulate a trajectory-based framework that separates capability acquisition, capability-specific optima, and later specialization, and introduce Structured Semantic Routing (SSR) to study how the representation of supervision shapes what is acquired. Across six pretrained backbones spanning DFN, MetaCLIP, and OpenAI CLIP, we show that fine-tuning can acquire semantic capability beyond the pretrained state, including gains observed on held-out evaluations. Unstructured name-and-attribute supervision produces strong name-and-attribute retrieval with comparatively weak name-free attribute-profile retrieval, whereas SSR yields substantially stronger name-free attribute-profile retrieval and is further strengthened by stochastic name-branch dropout. Different capabilities can peak at different stages, so a checkpoint selected by target class-name retrieval need not coincide with a transferable semantic optimum. Continued optimization can therefore preserve strong target class-name retrieval while reducing previously acquired transferable semantic capability. In a representative diagnostic study, this late specialization is consistent with reduced cross-modal semantic accessibility while substantial image-only class structure remains available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文把 VLM 微调中的语义能力变化建模为随训练演化的轨迹 (semantic capability trajectory)，区分能力获取、各能力的最优阶段与后期特化，并提出 Structured Semantic Routing (SSR) 检验监督信号的表示形式如何塑造所学到的能力。在 DFN、MetaCLIP、OpenAI CLIP 六个预训练骨干上，非结构化的 name-and-attribute 监督带来强的 name-and-attribute 检索但 name-free attribute-profile 检索较弱，SSR 显著提升后者且再经 stochastic name-branch dropout 进一步增强；不同能力在不同阶段达峰，继续优化可保住目标类名检索却削弱此前获得的可迁移语义能力。
Motivation: VLM 微调通常只在单个下游 checkpoint 上评估，无法区分某能力是从未学到、还是早已出现后在特化过程中衰退；按目标类名检索挑出的 checkpoint 未必对应可迁移的语义最优点。
Method: 提出基于轨迹的框架，把能力获取、各能力专属最优 (capability-specific optima) 与后期特化分开刻画，跨训练追踪基于身份 (identity) 与属性 (attribute) 的能力；引入 Structured Semantic Routing (SSR) 改变监督信号的组织方式，并用 stochastic name-branch dropout 变体加强；实验覆盖 DFN、MetaCLIP、OpenAI CLIP 六个预训练骨干，含 held-out 评测。
Result: 微调可获得超出预训练状态的语义能力，包括在 held-out 评测上的增益；非结构化 name-and-attribute 监督产生强的 name-and-attribute 检索但 name-free attribute-profile 检索相对较弱，SSR 使后者显著更强并被 stochastic name-branch dropout 进一步加强；不同能力在不同训练阶段达峰，持续优化在保持强目标类名检索的同时降低了已获得的可迁移语义能力；代表性诊断研究显示这种后期特化与跨模态语义可及性下降一致，而 image-only 类别结构仍大量保留。
Conclusion: 语义能力沿微调轨迹分阶段获取与衰退，单一部署 checkpoint 的评估会掩盖这一动态；选择 checkpoint 时应按目标能力的峰值阶段而非默认取末期，且后期特化的代价是可迁移语义能力下降。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WildMatch: Weakly Supervised Image Matcher Adaptation for Wildlife Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Individual animal re-identification from camera-trap imagery is an instance retrieval problem central to non-invasive wildlife monitoring: a query image must retrieve the correct individual from a reference set of known animals. This requires computer vision models to recognize distinctive local patterns in fur, skin, or other visual markings. Current approaches either learn global embeddings as a classification problem, requiring many labeled images per individual while largely ignoring local evidence, or apply off-the-shelf, domain-agnostic image matchers. Although such matchers are pretrained on large and diverse image collections, adapting them to wildlife imagery is challenging because available datasets are small and lack correspondence-level annotations. We study weakly supervised adaptation of a pretrained keypoint matcher using only identity labels, without keypoint-level or geometric correspondence ground truth. We mine informative image pairs with the pretrained matcher, derive weak positive and negative supervision from identity agreement, and contrastively fine-tune the matching network to strengthen correspondences for same-identity pairs and suppress them for different identities. Across open-source wildlife re-identification datasets, our approach improves accuracy over off-the-shelf matchers and a state-of-the-art local--global fusion method. Under an open-world protocol with held-out individuals, it learns a transferable correspondence prior rather than memorizing training identities. To our knowledge, this is the first study of matcher-level, identity-supervised adaptation for animal re-identification. Our method enables data-efficient specialization of image matching models to wildlife domains using identity annotations already available in typical monitoring datasets.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://wildmatch.gmum.net
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WildMatch 用身份标签而非关键点标注，对预训练关键点匹配器做弱监督适配：先用匹配器挖掘信息量高的图像对，按身份一致/不一致生成弱正负监督，再对比微调以强化同个体对应、抑制异个体对应。在开源野生动物重识别数据集上准确率超过现成匹配器与一种 local–global 融合的 SOTA 方法，且在留出个体的 open-world 协议下学到可迁移的对应先验而非记忆训练身份。
Motivation: 相机陷阱个体重识别需要识别毛皮、皮肤等局部纹理对应，但可用数据集小且没有关键点级或几何对应标注，导致现成的 domain-agnostic 匹配器难以适配到野生动物域。
Method: 只用身份标签做弱监督：用预训练关键点匹配器挖掘信息图像对，由身份一致与否导出弱正/负监督，再对比微调匹配网络，强化同个体对的对应、抑制异个体对的对应；评测含 open-world 留出个体协议。
Result: 在开源野生动物重识别数据集上，准确率优于现成匹配器以及一种 state-of-the-art 的 local–global 融合方法；在留出个体的 open-world 协议下仍学到可迁移的对应先验。
Conclusion: 匹配器层面、身份监督的适配可行且是该问题上的首次研究，可利用监测数据中已有的身份标注高效地把图像匹配模型特化到野生动物域。

papers.title: HyperNSDE: Personalized Neural SDEs for Joint Static-Longitudinal Clinical Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic patient data generation is a promising solution to the dual challenge of data scarcity and privacy constraints in healthcare machine learning. Realistic synthesis of patient-level clinical data requires jointly modeling heterogeneous static covariates, irregularly sampled longitudinal trajectories, and informative observation times - three tightly coupled components in practice yet rarely addressed together. We propose HyperNSDE, a continuous-time generative model that conditions a latent Neural SDE on static patient representations through a hypernetwork, allowing baseline characteristics to shape trajectory evolution beyond the initial condition without requiring a trajectory encoder, while stochastic latent dynamics capture realistic variability in generated paths. Observation times are modeled jointly through a latent-state-dependent intensity process, and training on irregular stochastic paths is stabilized via a deterministic-stochastic path decomposition with a non-adversarial signature-kernel objective. Experiments on simulated and real clinical datasets show improved observation-time fidelity and competitive performance, while matched-grid analyses reveal that forecasting and correlation metrics are affected by observation-grid regularity and trajectory smoothness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyperNSDE 用超网络把静态患者表征注入潜变量 Neural SDE，使基线特征持续塑造轨迹演化，并用依赖潜状态的强度过程联合建模观测时刻，训练靠确定性-随机路径分解与非对抗的 signature-kernel 目标稳定。在模拟与真实临床数据上观测时刻保真度提升、整体表现具竞争力，同时 matched-grid 分析显示预报与相关性指标受观测网格规则度和轨迹平滑度影响。
Motivation: 临床机器学习同时受数据稀缺与隐私约束，而患者级数据中静态协变量、不规则采样纵向轨迹与信息性观测时刻三者紧密耦合却很少被联合建模。
Method: 连续时间生成模型：超网络 (hypernetwork) 将静态患者表示注入潜 Neural SDE，使基线特征超越初始条件影响轨迹演化，且无需轨迹编码器；随机潜动力学生成路径变异，观测时刻由依赖潜状态的强度过程 (intensity process) 联合建模；不规则随机路径训练用确定性-随机路径分解 (deterministic-stochastic path decomposition) 加非对抗 signature-kernel 目标稳定。
Result: 在模拟与真实临床数据集上，观测时刻保真度 (observation-time fidelity) 提升且整体表现具竞争力；matched-grid 分析显示预报指标与相关性指标会随观测网格规则度和轨迹平滑度变化。
Conclusion: 静态特征、轨迹动力学与观测时刻应联合生成，且评估预报与相关性指标时必须控制观测网格规则度与轨迹平滑度，否则指标可比性受损。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: GeoWM: Efficient Direct World Modeling in Explicit Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Modeling 3D scene geometry and its evolution over time is essential for autonomous driving and robotics. A common paradigm is to use world models to predict future images or latent representations of the environment and subsequently recover geometry from these predictions. However, this paradigm does not explicitly model geometric structure and typically relies on recursive rollouts to reach longer prediction horizons, leading to error accumulation and increasing computational cost. To address these limitations, we present GeoWM, a geometry world model that directly forecasts future scene geometry at specified future horizons without recursive rollout. The key idea is to leverage a geometry foundation model to transform observed RGB frames into a geometric history, which conditions a flow-matching transformer to predict the scene geometry at a specified future horizon. We further show that a lightweight camera-motion predictor can accurately estimate the future viewpoint, and that projecting the observed geometry into the predicted viewpoint provides an effective geometric prior for future geometry forecasting. Extensive experiments on four datasets spanning urban driving, aerial flight, and dynamic manipulation demonstrate that GeoWM outperforms the evaluated world models in forecasting depth, camera pose, and 3D scene geometry, while substantially reducing inference time at longer horizons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoWM 直接在显式几何空间里预报未来场景几何，而非先预测图像再反推几何：用 geometry foundation model 把 RGB 帧转成几何历史，条件化 flow-matching transformer 在指定未来时 horizon 上一次性输出几何，避免递归 rollout 的误差累积。轻量相机运动预测器给出未来视角，把观测几何投影到该视角作为几何先验；在覆盖城市驾驶、航拍与动态操作的四个数据集上，深度、相机位姿与 3D 几何预报均优于所评测的 world model，并在长 horizon 上显著缩短推理时间。
Motivation: 现有 world model 范式先预测未来图像或隐表示、再从中恢复几何，不显式建模几何结构，且必须递归 rollout 才能到达长预测时域，导致误差累积与计算开销随 horizon 增长。
Method: GeoWM 由三部分组成：geometry foundation model 将观测 RGB 帧编码为几何历史；flow-matching transformer 以该历史为条件，直接在指定未来 horizon 预测场景几何，不做递归 rollout；轻量 camera-motion predictor 估计未来视角，并将观测几何投影到预测视角作为未来几何预报的几何先验。
Result: 在四个覆盖城市驾驶、航拍飞行与动态操作的数据集上，GeoWM 在深度、相机位姿与 3D 场景几何预报上均超过所评测的 world model，并在较长 horizon 上大幅降低推理时间。
Conclusion: 把几何作为 world model 的直接预报对象、并用预测视角投影作先验，可以在不递归 rollout 的前提下同时改善长 horizon 几何预报精度与推理效率。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: SimCortex v2: Joint Cortical Surface Reconstruction with Near-Zero Collisions and Self-Intersections
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing cortical WM and pial surfaces from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a prerequisite for surface-based neuroanatomical analysis, yet remains challenging because the cortex is thin and tightly folded. Reconstruction methods can produce geometric artifacts such as mesh self-intersections and collisions between cortical surfaces, and although recent deep learning methods have reduced reconstruction time from hours to minutes, these artifacts persist. We propose SimCortex v2, a deep learning framework for simultaneous reconstruction of the left and right WM and pial surfaces from T1-weighted MRI. SimCortex v2 estimates topologically correct initial surfaces from a volumetric segmentation and refines all four jointly using multi-scale stationary velocity fields predicted by a ribbon-conditioned, U-Net-like network. We evaluated SimCortex v2 on 560 cases from 14 cohorts, thirteen of them unseen during training, spanning ages 6-89, healthy and clinical populations, and scanners from three vendors. SimCortex v2 matched the surface-distance accuracy of the strongest baseline (average symmetric surface distance 0.253 mm) while showing no detected inter-surface collision in 92.14% of cases and the lowest self-intersection fraction (0.044%) among learning-based methods, whereas every baseline produced at least one collision in every case. Source code, configuration files, pretrained weights, preprocessed data, and the exact evaluation splits are publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimCortex v2 从 T1 加权 MRI 的体分割出发，用 ribbon 条件的 U-Net 式网络预测多尺度 stationary velocity field，一次性联合精修左右半球 WM 与 pial 四张皮层表面。在 560 例、14 个队列（13 个训练未见，年龄 6–89，三家厂商扫描仪）上，它达到最强基线的表面距离精度（ASSD 0.253 mm），92.14% 病例无表面间碰撞，自交比例 0.044% 为学习类方法最低，而每个基线在每个病例都至少产生一次碰撞。
Motivation: 皮层薄且高度褶皱，重建常产生网格自交与 WM/pial 表面间碰撞；深度学习虽把耗时从小时级压到分钟级，这些几何伪影依然存在。
Method: 先从体分割估计拓扑正确的初始表面，再用 ribbon-conditioned 的 U-Net-like 网络预测多尺度 stationary velocity fields (SVF)，对左右 WM 与 pial 共四张表面做联合形变精修；在 14 个队列 560 例上评测，其中 13 个队列训练未见，覆盖三家扫描仪厂商。
Result: 平均对称表面距离 (ASSD) 0.253 mm，与最强基线持平；92.14% 病例未检出表面间碰撞，而所有基线在每个病例都至少有一次碰撞；自交比例 0.044%，为学习类方法中最低。
Conclusion: 联合精修四张皮层表面可以在不牺牲表面距离精度的前提下把碰撞压到近零、自交降到学习类方法最低；源码、配置、预训练权重、预处理数据与评测划分全部公开。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in interactive environments, where they need to make sequential decisions through observation, action, and feedback. Although memory can help agents reuse experience, existing work designs memory in isolation, where collecting enough trajectories to populate it is expensive. Existing shared-memory approaches mitigate isolated experience by pooling episodic memories across tasks and environments. However, retrieving shared memory is challenged by the granularity, where retrieved memories can be either too specific to preserve current grounding or too coarse to support the next action. In this work, we propose MemCo, a memory-centric collaboration framework for generalizing LLM agents to unseen interactive environments. It maintains complementary local and global memory spaces, preserving environment-specific details locally while promoting transferable workflows induced from local trajectories to global memory. During online interaction, MemCo routes relevant local and global memories in terms of the agent's current state and decision phase, enabling agents to reuse the experience of other agents without blindly transferring environment-specific details. Experiments on interactive decision-making benchmarks show that MemCo improves task success and reduces redundant exploration compared with isolate-memory and shared-memory baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemCo 为 LLM agent 在未见过的交互环境中泛化提出记忆协作框架：本地记忆保存环境细节，全局记忆沉淀可迁移工作流，在线交互时按 agent 当前状态与决策阶段路由两类记忆，从而复用他人经验而不盲目搬用环境特有细节。在交互决策基准上，相比 isolate-memory 与 shared-memory 基线，任务成功率提升且冗余探索减少。
Motivation: 现有 agent 记忆多为孤立设计，收集足够轨迹成本高；共享记忆又受粒度两难困扰——检索到的记忆要么过细失去当前 grounding，要么过粗无法支撑下一步动作。
Method: MemCo 维护互补的 local 与 global 记忆空间：local 保留环境特有细节，global 沉淀从局部轨迹归纳出的可迁移工作流；在线交互时依据 agent 当前状态与决策阶段路由相关记忆，选择性复用其他 agent 的经验。
Result: 在交互决策基准 (interactive decision-making benchmarks) 上，MemCo 相比 isolate-memory 与 shared-memory 基线提升任务成功率并减少冗余探索；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 把环境特有细节与可迁移工作流分层存放、并按决策阶段动态路由，是让 LLM agent 泛化到未见环境的有效记忆组织方式。

papers.title: Multigroup Fairness and Omniprediction: Separations and Equivalences
papers.abstract_en: Omniprediction is a learning guarantee which requires a single predictor to be competitive relative to the best hypothesis from a benchmark class for any loss chosen from a family of loss functions. Loss Outcome Indistinguishability (loss OI for short) is a stronger notion that implies omniprediction. It requires the predicted distribution on labels to be indistinguishable from the true distribution to tests that depend on the loss functions and the benchmark class. Multiaccuracy and multicalibration are multigroup fairness notions that generalize classical notions of calibration and accuracy in expectation. Most known learning algorithms for omniprediction (both for the standard notion and for strengthenings like loss OI) rely on some version of these multigroup fairness notions, or on an intermediate notion called calibrated multiaccuracy. We ask if this is necessary: Does omniprediction require some form of multigroup fairness? We show that the answer is no for (plain) omniprediction, and yes for loss OI. First, a sequence of works shows that multicalibration or calibrated multiaccuracy imply omniprediction. We rule out even a weak converse, by showing that omniprediction for proper losses does not imply even accuracy in expectation, a much weaker notion than any of calibration, multiaccuracy, or multicalibration. Second, prior work showed how to achieve loss OI from a combination of calibration and multiaccuracy. We show a converse: loss OI is equivalent to a form of calibrated multiaccuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文回答「omniprediction 是否必须依赖 multigroup fairness」：对普通 omniprediction 答案为否——proper loss 上的 omniprediction 连期望意义下的 accuracy 都推不出来；对更强的 loss Outcome Indistinguishability (loss OI) 答案为是——loss OI 与某种 calibrated multiaccuracy 等价。
Motivation: 已知的 omniprediction 算法几乎都建立在 multicalibration、multiaccuracy 或 calibrated multiaccuracy 之上，但这种依赖是本质的还是证明技术的产物并不清楚。
Method: 分两条线给出分离与等价：其一，构造性地证明对 proper losses，omniprediction 不蕴含期望 accuracy（远弱于 calibration、multiaccuracy、multicalibration）；其二，把先前 loss OI 由 calibration + multiachievable 达成的结果反向补全，证明 loss OI 等价于某种 calibrated multiaccuracy。
Result: omniprediction 对 proper losses 不蕴含期望 accuracy，从而排除任何从 omniprediction 反推 multicalibration 或 calibrated multiaccuracy 的弱逆命题；loss OI 与 calibrated multiaccuracy 的一种形式互相蕴含，与先前「calibration + multiaccuracy ⇒ loss OI」合起来构成等价。
Conclusion: multigroup fairness 对普通 omniprediction 并非必要，但对 loss OI 这类更强的不可区分性保证是结构性的：loss OI 恰好就是 calibrated multiaccuracy 的等价形式。

papers.title: Identity-Conditioned Score Fusion for Open-Set Person Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Robust person re-identification often combines complementary cues such as face, gait, and body shape. While adaptive fusion typically targets query quality, model strength also varies across identities. We introduce identity-conditioned score fusion, a framework that tailors weights to each gallery identity without training. By contrasting intra-identity consistency against cross-identity impostors, it extracts identity-specific profiles that couple with query-conditioned adaptation via a parameter-free rule. This widens the separation between true and false matches while preserving score calibration. Evaluations on three clothes-changing person re-identification benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms statistical, rank-based, and learned baselines, achieving up to an 8.8% absolute reduction in the false non-identification rate and demonstrating the value of identity-conditioned fusion in open-set person re-identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的身份条件分数融合 (identity-conditioned score fusion)：针对每个 gallery 身份学习身份特定的融合画像，与查询条件自适应通过无参数规则耦合，从而拉开真匹配与假匹配的距离并保持分数校准。在三个换衣行人重识别 (clothes-changing person re-ID) 基准上一致优于统计、排序与学习型基线，假非识别率 (false non-identification rate) 最多绝对下降 8.8%。
Motivation: 行人重识别常融合人脸、步态、体型等互补线索，但现有自适应融合只按查询质量调权，忽略了模型强度随身份变化这一维度。
Method: 以同一身份内部一致性对比跨身份冒名样本，提取每个 gallery 身份的身份特定画像，再通过无参数规则与查询条件自适应耦合，全程无需训练。
Result: 在三个换衣行人重识别基准上一致优于统计、rank-based 与学习型基线，假非识别率最高绝对下降 8.8%。

papers.title: Dynamic Budget Allocation for LLM Evaluation under Hard Resource Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn interactions through their time-to-event: the number of interaction steps required to produce an event of interest, such as a successful jailbreak or agentic task completion. Under limited compute, interactions may be terminated before the event occurs, so that event times are only partially observed (censored). Existing allocation methods for calibrating time-to-event bounds satisfy the budget only in expectation and can exceed the available budget on a particular evaluation run. Enforcing a hard constraint is particularly challenging as the cost of a trajectory is initially unknown. We introduce Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration (HARP), a budget allocation that satisfies hard resource constraints and adaptively reallocates unused budget. We show how to use HARP to construct lower predictive bounds (LPBs) on the time-to-event and to estimate evaluation metrics such as the jailbreak rate on a fixed benchmark. Although HARP induces dependence in acquisition decisions across different trajectories, we prove that HARP never exceeds the target budget, that its LPBs have finite-sample coverage guarantees, and that its metric estimates are unbiased. Experiments on agentic task success, LLM jailbreaks, toxic content generation, and RAG hallucinations show that HARP achieves coverage close to the nominal level with low variance, while never exceeding the given budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 HARP（Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration）：在算力受限下对 LLM 多轮交互按 time-to-event（产生越狱或任务成功所需步数）做预算分配，硬约束下自适应回收未用预算。证明其从不超出目标预算、下预测界 (LPB) 有有限样本覆盖保证、指标估计无偏；在 agentic 任务成功、越狱、毒性内容与 RAG 幻觉实验中覆盖接近名义水平且方差低。
Motivation: LLM 多轮交互评测中轨迹成本事先未知，事件时间常被截断（censored）；现有校准分配方法只在期望意义下满足预算，单次评测可能超支。
Method: HARP 在硬资源约束下分配交互预算并回收未用额度；据此构造 time-to-event 的下预测界 (LPB)，并估计固定基准上的评测指标（如越狱率），同时处理跨轨迹获取决策带来的依赖。
Result: 证明 HARP 从不超出目标预算、LPB 具备有限样本覆盖保证、指标估计无偏；在 agentic task success、LLM jailbreaks、toxic content generation、RAG hallucinations 四类实验中覆盖接近名义水平、方差低，且始终不超预算。
Conclusion: 硬约束加预算回收的分配方式能在单次运行中保证不超支，同时维持 time-to-event 界与指标估计的统计有效性。

papers.title: Redundancy and synergy in multivariate Gaussians via the Blackwell order
papers.abstract_en: The goal of the partial information decomposition (PID) is to quantify the redundant and synergistic information that multiple sources provide about a target. PID has many applications in machine learning, neuroscience, and other fields, but defining and computing it for high-dimensional continuous systems remains challenging. Here, we define a PID for multivariate Gaussian systems based on the Blackwell order, which formalizes when one channel is more informative than another. We prove that Gaussian channels are optimal for extracting both redundant and union information, yielding an intuitive geometric interpretation and an efficient numerical algorithm for the PID. Our union information and synergy coincide with the well-known BROJA measures, and we derive closed-form expressions for both in the case of two sources. We also argue that Blackwell redundancy (which differs from BROJA) is the only existing redundancy measure that satisfies a set of natural desiderata. We demonstrate the scalability of our method on systems with up to a thousand dimensions or sources. Our approach is illustrated on an optimal control problem, where it identifies redundant and synergistic interactions between sensor and memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 基于 Blackwell 序为多元高斯系统定义部分信息分解 (PID)，证明高斯信道在提取冗余信息与 union 信息上最优，从而给出几何解释与高效数值算法。union 信息与协同 (synergy) 与 BROJA 度量一致且两源情形有闭式解，Blackwell 冗余是唯一满足一组自然公理的现有冗余度量；方法可扩展到上千维度或上千信源。
Motivation: PID 旨在量化多源对目标的冗余与协同信息，但对高维连续系统的定义与计算长期困难，现有冗余度量也缺少公理化依据。
Method: 用 Blackwell 序（刻画一个信道何时比另一个更有信息量）定义高斯系统的 PID；证明高斯信道对提取冗余与 union 信息最优，据此构造高效数值算法，并推导两源情形的闭式表达。
Result: union 信息与协同同 BROJA 度量重合，两源情形有闭式解；Blackwell 冗余与 BROJA 不同，但被论证为唯一满足一组自然公理的冗余度量；在最高达一千维度或一千信源的系统上展示可扩展性，并在一个最优控制问题中识别出传感器与记忆之间的冗余和协同交互。
Conclusion: Blackwell 序能把高维高斯 PID 变成可计算且有几何解释的对象，其冗余度量在公理化意义上优于 BROJA 冗余。

papers.title: Evaluate the Stack, Not the Layer: Do Deterministic and LLM Gates for Agent Actions Fail Independently?
papers.abstract_en: Runtime gates for agent tool calls are stacked on the assumption that their errors multiply. We test it on 1,119 labelled agent actions from three corpora, without an adaptive adversary. The stack has one deterministic rule layer and four LLM judges, three of them re-collected with the served model recorded on every call. We read each stack as a number of multiplication-equivalent layers, n_mult, with its floor under perfect coupling. Under the STRICT miss definition (escalation to a human scored as not stopped), any two judges compose to about 1.2 to 1.4 layers (φ median +0.430, 6 of 6 pairs significant, floors 1.02 to 1.17). The rule layer plus one judge composes to 1.86 to 2.09 layers (φ median +0.014, 0 of 4 significant, floors 1.01 to 1.09). Under PRIMARY (escalation scored as caught) the bands are 1.21 to 1.57 and 1.80 to 2.13. Intervals separate on the pooled data, point estimates split on each corpus, and a third-vendor judge lands in the judge band. Solo accuracy does not predict what a layer adds: a cloud rule pack lowers the rule layer's solo miss rate by 20% and adds no new joint coverage. The difficulty share of judge coupling is not identifiable: 31.8% to 61.8% depending on the probe and the miss definition. One judge tier was served by an unrequested model version in 50 of 112 batches, concentrated on the external corpus. That event overturned a pre-declared analysis rule, and the scoring of review verdicts reversed five conclusions. We report both.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Artifact (data, scripts, provenance): https://github.com/chenglin1112/evaluate-the-stack
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 1,119 条带标注的 agent 动作上检验运行时工具调用门控的“错误相乘”假设，发现任意两个 LLM judge 只合成约 1.2–1.4 个乘法等价层，而一条确定性规则层加一个 judge 合成 1.86–2.09 层，说明堆叠收益远低于独立性假设。单层准确率不预测增益：cloud 规则包把规则层单独 miss 率降 20% 却不增加任何联合覆盖。
Motivation: agent 工具调用的运行时门控常按“多层错误相乘”来堆叠，但各层增益是否独立、单层表现能否预测堆叠收益，此前没有直接检验。
Method: 在三个语料库的 1,119 条标注动作上评估一个确定性规则层加四个 LLM judge（其中三个重新采集并记录每次调用所服务的模型），无自适应对抗；把每个堆栈读成乘法等价层数 n_mult 及其完全耦合下的下界，用 φ 相关与显著性检验，并按 STRICT 与 PRIMARY 两种 miss 定义分别计分。
Result: STRICT 定义下任意两个 judge 合成约 1.2–1.4 层（φ 中位数 +0.430，6/6 对显著，下界 1.02–1.17），规则层加一个 judge 合成 1.86–2.09 层（φ 中位数 +0.014，0/4 显著，下界 1.01–1.09）；PRIMARY 定义下两段分别为 1.21–1.57 与 1.80–2.13。合并数据上区间可分，单语料上点估计分裂，第三方 vendor 的 judge 落在 judge 段内。cloud 规则包使规则层单独 miss 率降低 20% 但不增加联合覆盖；judge 耦合中难度占比在 31.8%–61.8% 之间随探针与 miss 定义变化；一个 judge 层在 112 批中 50 批由未请求的模型版本服务，且集中在外部语料库，该事件推翻了一条预声明分析规则，评审裁决的计分方式反转了五个结论，两者均予报告。
Conclusion: 堆叠门控的收益不能由单层准确率推断，judge 之间高度耦合而规则层与 judge 之间近乎独立，评估应针对整个堆栈而非单层；难度对耦合的贡献不可辨识，且服务模型漂移足以改变结论。

papers.title: Towards Explainable Benchmarking for Data-driven Post-Wildfire Debris Flow Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Post-wildfire debris flows (PFDFs) are destructive sediment-laden hazards triggered when intense rainfall strikes recently burned terrain, destabilizing hillslopes and threatening infrastructure, local economies, and community safety. Data-driven methods have been proposed to learn predictive patterns directly from historical PFDF observations. However, the current research landscape of data-driven PFDF prediction remains highly fragmented across feature spaces, model architectures, and evaluation protocols, making rigorous comparison and the derivation of scientific insights difficult. Moreover, existing studies lack a systematic investigation into the relative importance of heterogeneous factors (e.g., meteorological conditions, terrain characteristics, soil properties, and burn severity) in triggering PFDF. To address these limitations, we present a unified benchmark for data-driven PFDF prediction, enabling fair and comprehensive evaluation across diverse models and feature configurations. Furthermore, to better understand the underlying drivers of PFDF formation, we propose a reinforcement learning-based feature selection framework that identifies factors whose perturbations render positive and negative events indistinguishable, thereby discovering the regional underlying mechanisms of PFDF occurrence across regions. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/KINDLab-Fly/PFDF-Benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对野火后泥石流 (post-wildfire debris flow) 数据驱动预测在特征空间、模型架构与评估协议上的碎片化，提出统一基准 PFDF-Benchmark，并用基于强化学习的特征选择框架识别那些一旦被扰动就让正负事件不可区分的因子，从而发现各区域泥石流发生机制。代码与基准已在 GitHub 公开。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动 PFDF 预测分散在不同特征空间、模型与评估协议之间，难以严格比较并提炼科学结论；同时缺少对气象、地形、土壤性质、燃烧严重度等异质因子相对重要性的系统考察。
Method: 构建统一 PFDF 预测基准，支持跨多种模型与特征配置的公平评估；并提出基于强化学习 (reinforcement learning) 的特征选择框架，以“扰动某因子后正负事件变得不可区分”为准则筛选关键因子，用于跨区域机制发现。
Result: 产出可公开复现的统一基准与代码仓库 (github.com/KINDLab-Fly/PFDF-Benchmark)，并给出一套 RL 驱动的特征重要性识别流程，用于比较气象条件、地形、土壤性质与燃烧严重度对 PFDF 触发的相对作用。
Conclusion: PFDF 预测需要统一的基准与评估协议才能做公平比较，而以扰动不可区分性为目标的 RL 特征选择可被用来反推各区域泥石流发生的驱动机制。
