summary_sections.result: 产出可公开复现的统一基准与代码仓库 (github.com/KINDLab-Fly/PFDF-Benchmark)，并给出一套 RL 驱动的特征重要性识别流程，用于比较气象条件、地形、土壤性质与燃烧严重度对 PFDF 触发的相对作用。
summary_sections.conclusion: PFDF 预测需要统一的基准与评估协议才能做公平比较，而以扰动不可区分性为目标的 RL 特征选择可被用来反推各区域泥石流发生的驱动机制。

papers.title: A Validated Dataset and Benchmark for Coherent Multi-Diagram SysML Models
papers.abstract_en: Systems engineers use several diagrams to describe the structure and behavior of systems. Engineers create these diagrams together to make sure that they use the same elements and remain consistent with one another. Large language models can generate diagrams as text or code, which makes it possible to create system diagrams automatically. However, their ability to generate coherent sets of diagrams is not well understood, and existing datasets and benchmarks do not directly measure this ability at scale. We introduce SEMAADB (Systems Engineering Modeling Assistant with AI Dataset and Benchmark), a dataset of 3,000 engineering contexts and 15,000 diagrams. Each context contains five connected SysML views: Requirement, Block Definition, Activity, State Machine, and Sequence. Here, a view is a diagram that presents one aspect of a system. We checked the diagram sets for consistency and valid rendering. A set of 100 contexts is also human-verified and forms the benchmark test set. We evaluate three language models on two tasks. In diagram repair, the strongest model repairs 64.3% of semantic errors . In cross-diagram update the best propagation F1 is 80.7% when a model applies one change across related diagrams. The results show that syntax repair is nearly solved, but semantic repair and consistency across diagrams are still challenging tasks for models. SEMAADB therefore provides both a large diagram resource and a set of benchmarks for measuring coherent multi-diagram SysML generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SEMAADB 数据集与基准，含 3,000 个工程上下文、15,000 张 SysML 图，每个上下文由 Requirement、Block Definition、Activity、State Machine、Sequence 五张关联视图组成，用于衡量 LLM 生成连贯多图模型的能力。在图修复与跨图更新两项任务上评测三个语言模型：最强模型修复 64.3% 的语义错误，跨图更新最佳 propagation F1 为 80.7%，说明语法修复接近解决而语义修复与跨图一致性仍具挑战。
Motivation: LLM 能以文本或代码生成单张系统图，但生成一组相互一致的图的能力尚不清楚，现有数据集与基准无法在规模上直接度量这一能力。
Method: 构建 SEMAADB：3,000 个工程上下文、15,000 张图，每个上下文含五张关联 SysML 视图；对图集做一致性与合法渲染检查，其中 100 个上下文经人工核验作为基准测试集；在图修复 (diagram repair) 与跨图更新 (cross-diagram update) 两个任务上评测三个语言模型。

papers.title: Tracking Is Not Permanence: What Video World Models Keep of a Hidden Object
papers.abstract_en: Video world models track objects they can see; we ask what they keep of objects they cannot. We hide an object from a frozen V-JEPA 2 predictor and compare its prediction for the hidden region with the encoder's representation of two worlds that differ only inside that region. The predictor's decision keeps a stationary object in part and one carried inside a container not at all, and loses a moving one within 0.3 s (0.5 s under V-JEPA's own tube mask; ViT-H keeps it to 1.1 s at pretraining's 90% masking ratio); in projection a trace remains, below the midpoint, at 14-60% of what a baseline copying the last view retains. The information is there: the encoder reads the object's presence at 1.00 and keeps a closed container's contents decodable for 3.5 s, while the predictor's output, read with the encoder's own probe, contains the ball in 2% of scenes once the box has been closed for half a second. On rendered scenes, permanence is missing on the predictor's side, and training installs it cheaply as a prior: three thousand predictor-only steps on synthetic containers take this belief from 0.05 to 1.00 against two matched controls. They also raise IntPhys-2019 from 84.2% to 93.3%, but so does a curriculum without containers, and which training habit the benchmark credits changes with its scoring rule. Continued training with tube masks produces 1.1-1.6 s of moving-object carry-over on manipulation and internet-style video, so the deficit is not intrinsic to latent prediction. VideoMAE keeps almost nothing, and Cosmos's next-token prediction keeps a stationary hidden object but not one carried inside a moving container.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 冻结的 V-JEPA 2 视频世界模型能追踪可见物体，却几乎不保留被遮挡物体的存续 (object permanence)：静止物体部分保留、容器内被携带的物体完全丢失、运动物体在 0.3 s 内丢失（V-JEPA 自身 tube mask 下 0.5 s，ViT-H 在预训练 90% 遮蔽率下 1.1 s）。信息其实在编码器里（物体存在读出为 1.00，封闭容器内容可解码 3.5 s），仅用 3000 步仅训练 predictor 的合成容器训练即可把该信念从 0.05 提到 1.00，并把 IntPhys-2019 从 84.2% 提到 93.3%。
Motivation: 视频世界模型对可见物体的追踪已被广泛研究，但对不可见物体保留了什么、缺失的是信息还是读出方式，此前没有被分离检验。
Method: 把物体从冻结的 V-JEPA 2 predictor 中隐藏，将其对隐藏区域的预测与编码器对两个仅在该区域不同的世界的表示对比；用编码器自身的 probe 读取 predictor 输出；再做仅训练 predictor 的合成容器训练，并与两个匹配对照比较，同时在 IntPhys-2019 上按不同评分规则检验。
Result: 静止物体部分保留、容器内被携带者为零、运动物体 0.3 s 内丢失（tube mask 0.5 s，ViT-H 1.1 s）；投影下痕迹为复制上一帧基线的 14–60%。编码器读出物体存在为 1.00，封闭容器内容可解码 3.5 s，而 predictor 输出在箱子关闭半秒后仅 2% 场景含球。3000 步训练把信念从 0.05 提到 1.00，IntPhys-2019 从 84.2% 升至 93.3%；无容器的 curriculum 也能提升，且评分规则会改变归因。tube mask 续训在操作与网络视频上带来 1.1–1.6 s 运动物体延续；VideoMAE 几乎不保留，Cosmos 保留静止隐藏物体但不保留移动容器内者。
Conclusion: 物体存续的缺失在 predictor 一侧而非信息本身，且可作为先验用少量训练廉价补上；但基准得分归因随评分规则变化，说明该能力并非 latent prediction 固有。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Evaluating Escalation Signals for LLM Routing: Targets, Controls, and Five Ways to Fool Yourself
papers.abstract_en: Deciding when to escalate a query from a small language model to a larger one requires a cheap signal that predicts, before the large model is called, whether escalating would help. Semantic entropy, originally developed to detect hallucinations, is a natural candidate: it measures how much a model's sampled answers disagree in meaning, and high disagreement often signals an unreliable answer. We test it across three benchmarks and two model families. On GSM8K, with a small/large pair about twelve times apart in size, semantic entropy reliably distinguishes the small model's mistakes (AUROC 0.871) and improves routed accuracy over random escalation by up to nine points at matched cost. An earlier strong-looking result on a synthetic benchmark proved misleading: a simple rule based only on question difficulty, with no model involved, matched semantic entropy almost exactly. This paper's main contribution is a set of checks that catch this before it is reported as real. We show that scoring a cheap, question-only difficulty estimate alongside any signal reveals whether the signal adds real information or just tracks how hard a question looks; that two reasonable definitions of "escalation worked" can produce very different results on the same data; that a benchmark can leave almost no room for any signal to beat simply always using the large model; and that the true cost of live sampling can make routing more expensive than calling the large model directly. For a cheaper alternative that reuses cached past outcomes, we show how to predict whether it will work on a new dataset -- confirmed by correctly forecasting a collapse from AUROC 0.908 to chance level (0.518) ahead of time. We offer these as a general checklist for evaluating escalation signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验语义熵 (semantic entropy) 能否作为把查询从小模型升级到大模型的廉价信号：在 GSM8K 上（小/大模型规模差约 12 倍）它能区分小模型错误，AUROC 0.871，同等成本下比随机升级把路由准确率最多提高 9 个百分点。但合成基准上一个只看题目难度、不含模型的简单规则几乎追平语义熵，说明先前的强结果是假象；作者给出一套检查清单（题目难度对照、两种“升级成功”定义、天花板、实时采样成本），并用缓存历史结果预测新数据集上的表现，提前正确预报 AUROC 从 0.908 崩到 0.518（随机水平）。
Motivation: 升级信号必须在调用大模型之前便宜地预测“升级是否有用”，否则路由会比直接调大模型更贵；而现有评估容易把只反映题目难度的信号误报成模型能力信号。
Method: 在三个基准、两个模型家族上测试语义熵；配套四项检查：把纯题目的难度估计与信号一起打分以判断信号是否只追踪题目难度；比较两种“升级成功”定义；检查基准是否几乎没有留给信号超越“全用大模型”的空间；核算实时采样真实成本。另给出复用缓存历史结果、预测信号在新数据集上是否有效的做法。
Result: GSM8K（小/大模型规模差约 12 倍）：语义熵识别小模型错误 AUROC 0.871，同等成本下路由准确率比随机升级最多高 9 个百分点。合成基准上仅基于题目难度的规则几乎完全追平语义熵。缓存复用方法提前正确预报新数据集上 AUROC 从 0.908 崩到 0.518（随机水平）。
Conclusion: 升级信号的评估必须先排除“只反映题目难度”“定义选择”“基准天花板”“采样成本高于直接调大模型”这五种自我欺骗，语义熵在 GSM8K 上有效但可被简单难度规则冒充。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Trajectory-Retrieval Speculative Decoding: When Does a Model's Own History Help?
papers.abstract_en: Long chain-of-thought reasoning increases sequential decoding cost while creating a growing history of potentially reusable continuations. We investigate when this history supplies useful drafts and complements an existing drafter. Controlled source comparisons reveal trajectory-specific reuse, motivating our method Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval (TLAR). TLAR retrieves approximately matched continuations from the current trajectory and uses recent verification outcomes to adapt retrieval activation and candidate width. TLAR combines retrieved continuations with model-generated drafts in a shared candidate tree, preserving the target model's output distribution through exact verification. Across code debugging, mathematics, and open-ended writing, our evaluation connects source reuse, incremental acceptance, and execution cost. Combining TLAR with strong retrieval baselines improves token acceptance under matched verification budgets and increases end-to-end throughput over the draft-model baseline. These findings support generated trajectories as runtime memory for adaptive inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval (TLAR)，把长链推理中当前轨迹里已生成的续写当作可复用草稿，用近期验证结果自适应控制检索触发与候选宽度，并与模型自身草稿合入同一候选树、经精确验证保持目标模型输出分布。在代码调试、数学与开放写作三类任务上，TLAR 与强检索基线组合在相同验证预算下提高 token 接受率，并相对 draft-model 基线提升端到端吞吐。
Motivation: 长链思维推理使顺序解码成本上升，同时在当前轨迹中积累出可能可复用的续写历史；这些历史何时能提供有用草稿、能否补充现有 drafter，此前缺少受控的来源比较。
Method: TLAR 从当前轨迹检索近似匹配的续写，并利用近期验证结果自适应地决定检索激活与候选宽度；检索到的续写与模型生成草稿在共享候选树中合并，通过 exact verification 保持目标模型输出分布。
Result: 在代码调试、数学与开放写作三类任务上，TLAR 与强检索基线组合在匹配的验证预算下提高 token 接受率，并相对 draft-model 基线提高端到端吞吐；受控来源比较揭示了 trajectory-specific reuse。
Conclusion: 生成轨迹可作为运行时记忆用于自适应推理，在匹配验证预算的条件下同时改善接受率与吞吐。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.conclusion: 生成轨迹可作为运行时记忆用于自适应推理，在匹配验证预算的条件下同时改善接受率与吞吐。

papers.title: RELACE: retrospective likelihood-based action credit estimation for long-horizon language agents
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) avoids a separate critic by estimating advantages from rollout groups. For multi-turn agents, however, trajectory-level supervision provides coarse, noisy credit: terminal rewards do not locate errors and can penalize useful actions alongside mistakes. Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO) and subsequent methods refine supervision through state-conditioned comparisons, but their credit estimates remain sensitive to downstream decisions and outcomes. We introduce RELACE, Retrospective Likelihood-based Action, a critic-free framework that integrates retrospective action assessment with state-conditioned advantage estimation. RELACE evaluates executed actions through teacher-forced likelihood scoring under both their original contexts and outcome-augmented contexts. Comparing these likelihoods yields a trajectory-normalized retrospective factor that captures outcome-dependent changes in action plausibility, rather than hindsight plausibility alone. We use this factor to reweight discounted task returns and construct local advantages by comparing weighted returns among actions from equivalent states within a task. This couples retrospective relevance with observed reward, producing fine-grained credit that complements trajectory-level GRPO supervision. Temporal smoothing and success-protecting masking further stabilize the local signal. RELACE requires neither auxiliary value nor reward models nor additional autoregressive rollouts for credit estimation. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate substantial improvements over GRPO, GiGPO, and HCAPO. With the 1.5B model, RELACE achieves $96.35\%$ success on ALFWorld and $79.43\%$ on WebShop, surpassing GiGPO by $5.47$ and $5.60$ percentage points, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RELACE 是面向多轮长程语言智能体的无 critic 动作信用分配框架：用 teacher-forced 似然在原始上下文与结果增强上下文下分别打分已执行动作，两者之差得到轨迹归一化的 retrospective factor，再据此重加权折扣回报并构造同状态局部优势。在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 训练，成功率分别达 96.35% 与 79.43%，比 GiGPO 高 5.47 和 5.60 个百分点。
Motivation: GRPO 对多轮智能体只给轨迹级监督，终端奖励既定位不了错误，也可能连带惩罚有用动作；GiGPO 等状态条件比较方法的信用估计仍对下游决策与结果敏感。
Method: RELACE 用 teacher-forced 似然在原始上下文和结果增强上下文两种条件下给已执行动作打分，差值经轨迹归一化得到 retrospective factor，用它重加权折扣任务回报，再在任务内等价状态的动作之间比较加权回报构造局部优势，与轨迹级 GRPO 监督互补；辅以 temporal smoothing 与 success-protecting masking 稳定局部信号，不需 value model、reward model 或额外自回归 rollout。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上对比 GRPO、GiGPO、HCAPO：1.5B 模型 RELACE 成功率 96.35%（ALFWorld）与 79.43%（WebShop），分别超出 GiGPO 5.47 与 5.60 个百分点；实验用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。
Conclusion: 把结果依赖的动作似然变化与观测奖励耦合起来，可以在不引入额外 critic 或 rollout 的前提下给出更细粒度的信用分配，从而在长程具身与网页任务上提升成功率。

papers.title: Stepped MoE: Segment-Level Routing with Configurable Inference Complexity
papers.abstract_en: Training large language models (LLMs) is resource-intensive, and adapting them for diverse deployment scenarios with varying computational constraints remains challenging. While elastic architectures enable flexible model deployment and sparsely activated models allow input-adaptive computation, existing approaches treat these dimensions independently. Moreover, models catered towards on-device edge inference need to conform to the memory and compute limitations of the serving devices. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that combines elastic structures with sparsely gated architectures to create models that adapt simultaneously to both deployment constraints and task requirements. Our approach employs a model backbone that conditions on both the context and target efficiency specifications, enabling fine-grained control over the accuracy-efficiency trade-off at inference time. The model learns to activate task-relevant parameters within elastically-nested sub-networks, allowing a single model to span multiple capacity points while maintaining input-adaptive routing. Through experiments we demonstrate that we can create a model that allows the flexibility to use 1,2,3,4 billion parameters while being more accurate than their dense counter-parts (2-5\% on knowledge-intensive benchmarks) and at par with their static versions while delivering similar latency metrics as dense models. Overall, we save on device disk space by sharing the model parameters, allow flexibility of serving based on DRAM and compute available while delivering more accurate results.
papers.comment: Apple Foundation Models, 15 Pages, Edge LLMs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Stepped MoE 把弹性嵌套子网络与稀疏门控路由合成一个框架，骨干同时以任务上下文和目标效率规格为条件，在推理时细粒度控制精度-效率权衡。单一模型可在 1、2、3、4B 参数容量点间切换，知识密集基准上比同规模 dense 模型高 2–5%，延迟与 dense 相当。
Motivation: 弹性结构与稀疏激活模型各自解决部署灵活性和输入自适应计算，但被当作两个独立维度；边缘设备还受内存与算力上限约束，缺少同时兼顾两者的单一模型。
Method: 骨干以语境和目标效率规格为条件，在弹性嵌套子网络 (elastically-nested sub-networks) 中激活任务相关参数，保持输入自适应路由；参数共享以节省设备磁盘占用，并按可用 DRAM 与算力选择服务容量点。
Result: 单一模型支持 1、2、3、4B 参数切换，在知识密集型基准上比对应 dense 模型准确率高 2–5%，与各自的静态版本持平，同时延迟指标与 dense 模型相当。
Conclusion: 把部署约束与任务需求放进同一个条件化路由框架，可在边缘 LLM 上同时换取多容量点灵活性、参数共享的磁盘节省和不劣于 dense 的精度与延迟。

papers.title: Evaluating Behavioral Context for Interpretable IAM Policy Risk Scoring in Cloud Environments
papers.abstract_en: IAM policy analysis typically emphasizes the authorization capabilities encoded in a policy, but security analyst review priority may also depend on the behavioral and environmental context surrounding a policy event. This paper evaluates whether contextual information provides measurable incremental value for interpretable IAM policy risk prioritization beyond policy and effective-authorization information. AWS is used as the experimental cloud provider because its IAM and audit-telemetry ecosystem enables controlled evaluation using AWS IAM Context Bench, a benchmark containing 534 real AWS experimental observations across policy, environment, and behavioral scenarios, including matched cases where policy and environment remain fixed while behavioral context changes. Three Explainable Boosting Machine models are evaluated under the same leakage-controlled grouped cross-validation protocol: a policy-centric baseline, a policy-plus-environment model, and a full-context model incorporating CloudTrail telemetry. The full-context model substantially reduces analyst-priority prediction error relative to the policy-centric baseline and closely tracks the reference priority ordering. In matched same-policy context pairs, the policy-centric model remains invariant, whereas the full-context model separates benign and suspicious behavioral conditions with high directional accuracy. The results also show improved concentration of high-priority cases at the top of simulated analyst review queues. These findings indicate that behavioral and environmental context can provide useful incremental information for analyst-oriented IAM risk prioritization while preserving an interpretable additive model structure. The formulation is applicable beyond AWS conceptually, although cross-provider validation remains future work.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Peer-reviewed and accepted at IEEE Conference ID# 71863; to appear in the IEEE Xplore proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 AWS IAM 策略风险打分中，加入环境与 CloudTrail 行为上下文的可解释模型（Explainable Boosting Machine）比只看策略授权的基线显著降低分析师优先级预测误差，并在策略与环境固定、仅行为不同的配对样本上区分良性与可疑条件，且高优先级案例更集中于模拟审核队列顶部。
Motivation: IAM 策略分析通常只看策略编码的授权能力，但分析师的审核优先级还取决于策略事件周围的行为与环境上下文；缺少量化证据说明这些上下文是否在策略与有效授权信息之外提供增量价值。
Method: 以 AWS 为实验云厂商，使用 AWS IAM Context Bench（534 条真实 AWS 实验观测，覆盖策略、环境、行为场景，含策略与环境固定而行为变化的配对样本）；在同一泄漏受控的分组交叉验证协议下训练三个 Explainable Boosting Machine 模型：策略中心基线、策略加环境模型、纳入 CloudTrail 遥测的全上下文模型。
Result: 全上下文模型相对策略中心基线大幅降低分析师优先级预测误差，并紧密贴合参考优先级排序；在同策略配对样本中策略中心模型保持不变，而全上下文模型以高方向准确率区分良性与可疑行为条件；模拟分析师审核队列顶部的高优先级案例集中度也得到提升。
Conclusion: 行为与环境上下文能为面向分析师的 IAM 风险优先级提供有用的增量信息，同时保持可解释的加性模型结构；该表述在概念上可推广到 AWS 之外，但跨厂商验证仍是后续工作。

papers.title: Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization: Learning to Reason with Adaptive Rationale Scaffolding
papers.abstract_en: On-policy reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, its effectiveness is often limited by reward sparsity: when a model fails to discover correct trajectories for difficult problems, the optimization process receives little useful signal and may stagnate. Existing approaches mitigate this issue by incorporating off-policy demonstrations, expert traces, or model-generated solutions, but they typically require the auxiliary data to match the format of the reinforcement-learning task, often relying on rejection sampling from stronger models to obtain suitable training trajectories. We introduce Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO), a framework that adaptively leverages ground-truth rationale information according to the model's current capability while preserving its freedom to explore. Rather than treating reference solutions as fixed imitation targets, RGPO uses them as temporary scaffolds: rationales help the model generate improved responses, after which only higher-reward, model-generated solutions are transferred back to the original unguided setting. This design allows training to exploit available ground-truth information without requiring off-policy data to follow the same format as the RL task. Across both language-only and vision-language reasoning settings, RGPO consistently improves performance over RLVR baselines, and ablation studies show that adaptive rationale guidance is a key contributor to these gains. These results suggest that RGPO offers a practical and general approach for reducing reward sparsity, stabilizing reinforcement learning, and improving reasoning performance in both text-only and multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RGPO 把 ground-truth rationale 当作可撤除的临时脚手架：按模型当前能力自适应地用 rationale 帮模型生成更好的回答，再只把其中高奖励、模型自己生成的解迁回无引导的原始 RL 任务。这样训练能利用参考解而不强制 off-policy 数据与 RL 任务同格式，在纯语言与视觉语言推理设定下均稳定优于 RLVR 基线。
Motivation: on-policy RL 改进 LLM 推理受限于奖励稀疏：难题上模型找不到正确轨迹，优化信号匮乏而停滞；现有补救依赖与 RL 任务同格式的 off-policy 演示或强模型拒绝采样，代价高。
Method: RGPO (Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization) 按模型当前能力自适应引入 ground-truth rationale 作为临时脚手架，让模型据此生成改进回答，随后仅把更高奖励的模型生成解迁回原始无引导设定，同时保留探索自由；在纯语言与视觉语言推理两类设定下训练并做 ablation。
Result: 在 language-only 与 vision-language 两类推理设定下，RGPO 均一致优于 RLVR 基线；ablation 显示自适应 rationale 引导是这些增益的关键贡献因素。
Conclusion: 把参考解当可撤除脚手架而非固定模仿目标，是缓解奖励稀疏、稳定强化学习并提升推理表现的实用通用途径，且不要求 off-policy 数据与 RL 任务同格式。

papers.title: CausalBind: Causal Modeling and Learning for Protein-Molecule Virtual Screening
papers.abstract_en: Protein-molecule virtual screening is increasingly cast as a problem of representation learning in a shared embedding space. Existing methods rely on dense holistic alignment, entangling invariant binding determinants with nuisance correlations and limiting transfer to new targets. It has been noted that binding in protein-molecule systems involves sparse cross-modality interactions: binding is governed by a small contact interface and a few decisive local interactions (e.g., hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, and salt bridges) rather than the global structures of the protein and molecule. We hypothesize that uncovering and leveraging sparse interaction patterns is critical for generalization beyond the training data, as these patterns are reusable and expected to improve performance across different scenarios. In this paper, we aim to identify and leverage sparse interaction patterns, and verify our hypothesis. Since the training data contain only observed binding pairs, we formalize this prior via a V-structure causal model under Heckman-style selection, and establish three theoretical results: (i) the latent concepts of interacting proteins and molecules are not identifiable without appropriate sparsity constraints; (ii) these concepts and their sparse interactions are component-wise identifiable under structural sparsity conditions; and (iii) a low-rank relaxation of these conditions yields subspace identifiability of the concepts and interactions. Inspired by these principles, we propose CausalBind with three implementation variants. Extensive experiments on DUD-E and LIT-PCBA benchmarks show that all variants consistently outperform strong retrieval baselines, with the largest gains on LIT-PCBA early enrichment, and further generalize to target- and scaffold-level out-of-distribution splits. Code is available at https://github.com/lokali/CausalBind.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CausalBind 把蛋白-分子虚拟筛选建模为共享嵌入空间中的稀疏跨模态交互，用 V-结构因果模型（Heckman 式选择）刻画仅有观测结合对的训练数据，并证明在结构稀疏条件下概念与稀疏交互逐分量可辨识、其低秩松弛给出子空间可辨识。三个实现变体在 DUD-E 与 LIT-PCBA 上一致超过强检索基线，LIT-PCBA early enrichment 提升最大，并能泛化到 target 与 scaffold 级 OOD 划分。
Motivation: 现有虚拟筛选用稠密整体对齐学习表示，把不变的结合决定因素与干扰相关性纠缠在一起，导致对新靶点的迁移受限。
Method: 先以 V-结构因果模型加 Heckman 式选择形式化稀疏交互先验，给出三条理论结果：无适当稀疏约束时概念不可辨识、结构稀疏下逐分量可辨识、低秩松弛下子空间可辨识；据此实现 CausalBind 的三个变体。
Result: 在 DUD-E 与 LIT-PCBA 上，三个变体一致优于强检索基线，最大增益出现在 LIT-PCBA early enrichment，并在 target 级与 scaffold 级 OOD 划分上保持泛化。
Conclusion: 稀疏交互模式是可复用的不变量，识别并利用它即可提升跨场景泛化，稠密整体对齐不是必要选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A doctrine-grounded visual question answering dataset for Tactical Combat Casualty Care
papers.abstract_en: Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TC3) requires responders to connect visual observations of injuries and interventions with established clinical guidance. Developing vision-language models to support this process requires supervision that links visible evidence to traceable doctrine. We present TC3-VQA, a dataset constructed from public instructional and field TC3 videos and authoritative TC3 documents. It contains 581 items spanning 11 concepts, with 1,860 questions covering intervention recognition, doctrine, clinical reasoning, procedural guidance, and refusal when visual information is insufficient. Doctrine-based answers preserve verbatim source passages and character offsets. Construction combines visual annotation, passage retrieval, entailment checks, and verification across model families. Equipment boxes, anatomical labels, temporal segments, and source metadata accompany the question-answer pairs. Automated audits and ratings by two physicians and two medical students characterize annotation quality, with human ratings available for 88 retained items. The dataset provides a resource for adapting vision-language models to TC3, studying the connection between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, and evaluating recognition, doctrine recall, and abstention.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23170287; code: https://github.com/Kamaleswaran-Lab/TC3-VQA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TC3-VQA 是首个把战术战伤救护 (TC3) 视觉证据与条令原文绑定的 VQA 数据集：581 个样本、11 个概念、1,860 道题，覆盖干预识别、条令、临床推理、程序指导以及视觉信息不足时的拒答 (abstention)。答案保留原文逐字片段与字符偏移，配设备框、解剖标注、时序片段与来源元数据，用于适配视觉-语言模型并评测识别、条令回忆与拒答能力。
Motivation: 训练支持战伤救护的视觉-语言模型需要把可见证据与可追溯的临床条令 (doctrine) 联系起来，而现有监督数据无法提供这种可核验的对应关系。
Method: 从公开 TC3 教学与实战视频及权威 TC3 文档构建数据集；构造流程结合视觉标注、段落检索 (passage retrieval)、蕴含校验 (entailment checks) 与跨模型族验证，答案保留逐字原文与字符偏移，并附设备框、解剖标签、时序片段和来源元数据。
Result: 数据集含 581 个条目、11 个概念、1,860 道题，题型覆盖干预识别、条令、临床推理、程序指导与拒答；标注质量由自动化审计以及两名医师和两名医学生评分刻画，其中 88 个保留条目有人工评分。
Conclusion: 把条令原文与字符偏移直接嵌入答案，可为适配 TC3 视觉-语言模型提供可追溯监督，并支持对识别、条令回忆与拒答三类能力的评测。

papers.title: Logbook: Extremely Long-form Audio Event Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Audio benchmarks are built around short, pre-segmented clips, limiting model design to brief inputs or fixed vocabularies. To close this gap, we introduce Logbook, a benchmark for hour-scale audio understanding, with recordings ranging from ten minutes to six days. Given a continuous audio recording and an event label vocabulary, a system must predict a gap-free segmentation with an event label and a description per segment. We compare 52 systems, end-to-end and cascaded, and ablate fine-tuning, context length, and reasoning budget. We find the task tractable, though the best systems remain below the human reference. Also, over-segmentation is pervasive, and fine-tuning partially mitigates it. Finally, end-to-end are often better than cascaded systems, but degrades with longer context.
papers.comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Source code available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/logbook
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Logbook 提出小时级长音频理解基准：输入 10 分钟到 6 天的连续录音与事件标签词表，输出无间断分割、每段标签与描述。对比 52 个端到端与级联系统后发现任务可解但最佳系统仍低于人类参考，过分割普遍存在且微调只能部分缓解，端到端常优于级联但随上下文变长而性能下降。
Motivation: 现有音频基准都建立在短的、预先切好的片段上，把模型设计限制在短输入或固定词表，无法覆盖小时级连续录音的分割与理解。
Method: 任务设定为给定连续录音与事件标签词表，预测带每段标签和文字描述的无间断分割；基准对比 52 个端到端与级联系统，并对微调、上下文长度、推理预算做消融。
Result: 覆盖 10 分钟到 6 天的录音，比较 52 个系统；任务被判定为可解，但最佳系统仍低于人类参考；过分割普遍存在，微调部分缓解；端到端常优于级联，但性能随上下文变长而下降。
Conclusion: 小时级音频事件理解已可解但未达人类水平，长上下文是端到端系统的主要瓶颈，微调只能部分而非完全抑制过分割。

papers.title: Compositional Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Removing copyrighted, unsafe, or user-specified concepts from a deployed text-to-image diffusion model is now a practical requirement. Weight-editing methods can suppress fixed targets, but they require per-target retraining and modify the model checkpoint. Training-free methods, on the other hand, are deployment-friendly, but they suffer from text-side routing failures on compositional prompts. In such prompts, the erase target may be invoked through a related class rather than its lexical name, and its modifiers may migrate onto preserved objects. This paper proposes Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery (HGSS), a training-free framework for compositional concept erasure. The framework lifts both the routing signal and the edit operator used by text-side erasure. First, hierarchical span grounding resolves erase-target spans through lexical, taxonomic, and semantic evidence, while guarding against broad-hypernym and compound-head false positives. Second, dynamic attribute binding refines the text conditioning during early denoising via a counterfactual reference and a preserve-aware cross-attention objective, keeping surviving attribute-noun bindings intact. HGSS selectively removes the erase target without updating model weights or adding learned parameters. On SEE, HGSS cuts hierarchical evasion from 29.54 to 10.02 and roughly halves pairwise attribute leakage, achieving the best Neighbor E and AttrP scores among the reported erasure methods. On UnlearnCanvas, HGSS slightly improves the six-metric average over the matched Semantic Surgery baseline, reaching state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出免训练的分层接地语义手术 (HGSS)，在文本侧做组合式概念擦除：用词法、分类学与语义三层证据定位擦除目标 span，并在早期去噪阶段用反事实参考与保全感知的交叉注意力目标修正文本条件。在 SEE 上把层级逃逸率从 29.54 降到 10.02，成对属性泄漏约减半；在 UnlearnCanvas 上六指标均值略超 Semantic Surgery 基线。
Motivation: 权重编辑法需逐目标重训并改动模型检查点；免训练法部署友好，但在组合式 prompt 上出现文本侧路由失败——擦除目标经相关类名而非字面名被唤起，其修饰语还会迁移到应保留的物体上。
Method: HGSS 含两个部件：hierarchical span grounding 用词法、分类学 (taxonomic) 与语义证据解析擦除目标 span，并抑制宽泛上位词与复合中心词的误报；dynamic attribute binding 在早期去噪步用反事实参考与 preserve-aware 交叉注意力目标细化文本条件，保住存活的属性-名词绑定。全程不更新权重、不加可学习参数。
Result: SEE 上层级逃逸 (hierarchical evasion) 从 29.54 降至 10.02，成对属性泄漏约减半，Neighbor E 与 AttrP 在所报告的擦除方法中最佳；UnlearnCanvas 上六指标均值略高于匹配的 Semantic Surgery 基线，达到 state-of-the-art。
Conclusion: 把文本侧擦除的定位信号与编辑算子同时分层化，可在不改权重的前提下处理组合式 prompt 中的类名绕过与属性迁移问题。

papers.title: Selective Critique for Cost-Aware LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Improving the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents in long-horizon decision-making remains a key challenge. When deployed as autonomous agents interacting with complex environments, early mistakes can propagate through trajectories and cause cascading failures. Recent approaches improve reliability by incorporating external critique or deliberation, but invoking these mechanisms at every step substantially increases token consumption and latency, limiting practical deployment. We propose SAG (Self-improving Agent with Gated critique), a cost-aware framework that formulates critique invocation as a step-wise decision problem during long-horizon interaction. SAG introduces a lightweight, training-free gating mechanism that estimates the utility of critique using action-level ambiguity signals--global entropy and local top-2 margin--computed over admissible actions. From a decision-theoretic perspective, this mechanism approximates the Value of Information (VoI) of critique, enabling the agent to selectively allocate expensive feedback only when its expected benefit justifies the cost. SAG further incorporates online bootstrapped self-improvement, allowing the actor to internalize critic-assisted behaviors and progressively reduce reliance on critique. Across three long-horizon interactive benchmarks and multiple backbone models, SAG substantially improves the performance-cost trade-off compared with both no-critique and always-on critique agents. On ALFWorld, SAG increases task success from 24.6% to 78.4% while maintaining a token budget comparable to ReAct, yielding a $3.1\times$ improvement in normalized token efficiency. Moreover, a 7B actor with a lightweight 3B critic achieves performance comparable to a 14B actor without critique, showing that selective critique can recover most of the reliability benefits of deliberation while dramatically reducing inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SAG（Self-improving Agent with Gated critique）：用全局熵与 top-2 margin 这类动作级歧义信号近似 critique 的 Value of Information，按步决定是否调用昂贵的 critic 反馈，并配合在线 bootstrapped 自我改进让 actor 逐步内化 critic 行为。在 ALFWorld 上任务成功率从 24.6% 升到 78.4%，token 预算与 ReAct 相当，归一化 token 效率提升 3.1 倍。
Motivation: LLM agent 在长程交互中早期错误会沿轨迹传播并引发级联失败；每步都调用外部 critique 或 deliberation 虽能提升可靠性，却显著推高 token 消耗与延迟，阻碍实际部署。
Method: SAG 把 critique 调用建模为逐步决策问题：训练免调的轻量 gating 机制在可行动作上计算全局熵与局部 top-2 margin，从决策论视角近似 critique 的 VoI，只在预期收益覆盖成本时分配昂贵反馈；再用在线 bootstrapped 自我改进让 actor 内化 critic 辅助行为，逐步减少对 critique 的依赖。
Result: 在三个长程交互基准与多个 backbone 上，SAG 相比 no-critique 与 always-on critique 显著改善性能-成本权衡。ALFWorld 任务成功率 24.6% → 78.4%，token 预算与 ReAct 相当，归一化 token 效率提升 3.1 倍；7B actor 配轻量 3B critic 达到与无 critique 的 14B actor 相当的性能。
Conclusion: 选择性 critique 能以远低于 deliberation 的推理成本回收其大部分可靠性收益，按信息价值门控昂贵反馈是长程 LLM agent 的性价比更高的部署方式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Weight Oracles: Reading Neural Network Weights with Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Interpretability methods for neural networks are predominantly reactive: they analyse activations produced during specific forward passes, requiring known inputs to find hidden capabilities such as backdoors. We propose Weight Oracles, fine-tuned language models that diagnose properties of a target network by reading its raw weights directly, without behavioural testing. We investigate this paradigm in two phases. Phase I establishes feasibility: through a staged curriculum and an external chain-of-computation that delegates parameter-free operations to deterministic code, an explainer LLM learns to simulate the forward pass of small transformers from their weights, achieving 99% holdout accuracy on unseen targets. Phase II repurposes this infrastructure for safety auditing. We train an oracle on natural language diagnostic questions about weight anomalies using only benign pathologies as training signal, and evaluate it zero-shot on backdoors absent from training. The oracle achieves AUROC 0.93 on attention-routed backdoors and 0.81 across a diversified threat distribution including stealth and adversarially regularized variants. Hand-crafted statistical detectors are sharp on the threat models they implicitly target but collapse on threat-model shift, while the oracle remains uniformly competent across attack types. Scaling to realistic model sizes remains the principal open challenge.
papers.comment: Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality (NeuralArtifacts), Paris. 14 pages, 10 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Weight Oracles 用微调后的语言模型直接读取目标网络的原始权重来诊断其性质，无需行为测试。两阶段训练先让 explainer LLM 通过分阶段课程与外置 chain-of-computation 从权重模拟小 Transformer 前向传播，在未见目标上达到 99% holdout 准确率；再用良性病理作训练信号做零样本审计，attention-routed backdoor 的 AUROC 为 0.93，跨多样化威胁分布（含 stealth 与 adversarially regularized 变体）为 0.81。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法基本是反应式的：必须有已知输入跑前向传播才能暴露隐藏能力（如后门），无法在不接触行为的情况下直接检查权重。
Method: Phase I 用分阶段课程 (staged curriculum) 训练 explainer LLM，并引入外置 chain-of-computation 把无参数运算交给确定性代码，从而从权重模拟小 Transformer 的前向传播。Phase II 复用该基础设施，只用良性病理 (benign pathologies) 作为训练信号，在自然语言诊断问题上训练 oracle，再对训练中未出现的后门做零样本评估。

papers.title: Memory-Efficient Expert Routing for Distributed MoE Training
papers.abstract_en: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale toward hundreds of experts and higher top-$k$ routing, memory efficiency in distributed training becomes a critical bottleneck. Peak memory is dominated by the MoE block, not attention: every intermediate buffer in the MoE dispatch pipeline is individually scaled by top-k routing. The standard all-to-all dispatcher sends all routed tokens in a single collective step, requiring the full top-$k$-expanded buffer to be constructed at once. In this work, we propose RelayMoE, a ring-based MoE execution model that computes locally as expert weights or tokens circulate, avoiding full top-$k$-expanded dispatch buffers. RelayMoE selects between expert and token routing according to communication volume and overlaps transfers with computation. The ring structure naturally supports memory-efficient MoE recomputation during backward: each hop reconstructs expert intermediates, uses them to compute gradients, and releases them before the next hop. The saved memory supports longer sequences and larger batches, or retains more attention activations to reduce attention recomputation and improve training throughput. We evaluate RelayMoE on 30B$-$57B production MoE models and varied expert configurations. In single-layer MoE experiments, RelayMoE achieves a $2\times$ average speedup over Megatron-LM. In full-model training under the same GPU memory budget, it improves throughput by up to $2.02\times$ and extends the largest tested trainable sequence length by up to $2.85\times$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 RelayMoE：把 MoE 分发改成 ring 式执行，专家权重或 token 在环上流动时就地计算，避免一次性构造 top-k 扩展后的完整 dispatch buffer，并按通信量在 expert routing 与 token routing 之间切换。在 30B–57B 生产 MoE 模型上，单层实验相对 Megatron-LM 平均加速 2 倍，同 GPU 显存预算下全模型训练吞吐最高 2.02 倍、最大可训练序列长度最高延长 2.85 倍。
Motivation: MoE 扩展到数百专家、更高 top-k 后，显存瓶颈由 attention 转移到 MoE 块：dispatch 流水线中每个中间缓冲都被 top-k 放大，标准 all-to-all 一步集体通信要求一次性建好整个扩展缓冲。
Method: RelayMoE 采用 ring-based 执行模型，专家权重或 token 沿环流动时就地计算，跳过完整 top-k 扩展缓冲；按通信量在 expert routing 与 token routing 间选择，并把传输与计算重叠。反向传播中 ring 结构支持显存高效的 MoE recomputation：每一跳重建专家中间量、算完梯度后立即释放再进入下一跳。
Result: 在 30B–57B 生产 MoE 模型与多种专家配置上评测：单层 MoE 实验相对 Megatron-LM 平均 2 倍加速；同 GPU 显存预算的全模型训练吞吐最高提升 2.02 倍，最大可测试训练序列长度最高延长 2.85 倍。
Conclusion: 把 MoE 分发改成 ring 式就地计算并按 hop 做 recomputation，可在固定显存预算下同时换取更高吞吐和更长序列，省下的显存也可用于保留更多 attention 激活以减少 attention 重算。

papers.title: Structuring MoE Expert Selection for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents are frequently implemented using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, yet the co-design of agentic behavior and MoE structures remains underexplored. In this work, we comprehensively study the connections between agentic post-training and MoE expert selection. In off-the-shelf MoE models, we observe expert selection exhibits a specialized structure that naturally aligns with agentic trajectories. Specifically, expert routing overlaps more between turns where the agent performs semantically similar operations (e.g., READ, UPDATE) than between turns with differing operations. However, standard RL algorithms ignore this specialization, allowing the MoE routing to go uncontrolled during training, which empirically limit task performance and inference efficiency. To address this, we introduce a hierarchical routing control framework for agentic tasks. We explicitly encourage turn-level expert selections to align with agentic operations while regularizing token-level expert selections to maintain local consistency. To resolve stability issues that arise during post-training with the proposed methods, we further introduce an entropy-gated control mechanism. Overall, our routing control framework achieves over 10-point improvements in success rate on all evaluated benchmarks. These results demonstrate that agentic trajectory structure provides an effective signal for optimizing MoE capacity during RL post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在长程 LLM agent 的 RL 后训练中，把 MoE 专家路由与 agent 轨迹结构对齐：turn 级专家选择对齐到语义操作（READ、UPDATE 等），token 级选择加局部一致性正则，并用熵门控 (entropy-gated control) 解决训练不稳定。所提分层路由控制框架在全部评估 benchmark 上成功率提升超过 10 个百分点。
Motivation: 长程 LLM agent 常用稀疏 MoE 实现，但 agentic 行为与 MoE 结构的协同设计研究不足；标准 RL 算法忽略专家特化，使路由在训练中失控，限制任务性能与推理效率。
Method: 先观察现成 MoE 模型中专家选择的特化结构：语义操作相同的 turn 之间路由重叠更高。据此提出分层路由控制框架——turn 级专家选择显式对齐 agentic 操作，token 级专家选择正则化以保持局部一致性，并引入 entropy-gated control 机制缓解后训练的稳定性问题。
Result: 观察到语义相似操作（如 READ、UPDATE）的 turn 之间专家路由重叠高于操作不同的 turn；所提路由控制框架在全部评估 benchmark 上成功率提升超过 10 个百分点。
Conclusion: agentic 轨迹结构可作为 RL 后训练中优化 MoE 容量的有效信号，控制路由对齐操作能同时改善任务成功率与推理效率。

papers.title: Advantage of Entangled Learning Rules in Quantum Measurement Class Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning with data in the form of quantum states is of current interest and has led to a variety of problems that boil down to interaction with the available data via quantum measurement and classical post-processing of observed classical outcomes. In quantum measurement PAC learning, one is given a sequence of unknown, prepared quantum states and classical labels, along with a hypothesis class of candidate measurements. The task is to select a measurement from the hypothesis class that minimizes a fixed notion of error in prediction of the classical labels via measurement of a new state by the selected hypothesis. In this work, we consider the advantage of interacting with the given data in the measurement learning framework using learning rules given by measurements that cannot be implemented using local operations and classical communication (LOCC), as opposed to single-copy learning rules. We provide a construction showing that there exist learning scenarios wherein single-copy learning rules are asymptotically suboptimal compared to optimal ones. We then show that learning rules based on entangled measurements enjoy at most a polynomial sample complexity advantage over single-copy learning rules in the PAC learning setting (under a natural joint measurability covering assumption).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在量子测量 PAC 学习中，纠缠测量学习规则（非 LOCC）相对单拷贝规则存在优势：构造出单拷贝规则渐近次优的学习场景，同时证明在自然的联合可测性覆盖假设下，纠缠规则的样本复杂度优势至多为多项式级别。
Motivation: 量子态数据的 PAC 学习中，学习规则能否通过纠缠测量（超出 LOCC 与单拷贝）带来实质优势尚不清楚，需要判定优势的存在性与其量级上界。
Method: 在量子测量 PAC 学习框架下（输入为未知制备量子态序列、经典标签与候选测量假设类），构造一个显式学习场景使单拷贝学习规则渐近次Optimal，并在联合可测性覆盖 (joint measurability covering) 假设下推导纠缠测量规则相对单拷贝规则的样本复杂度上界。
Result: 给出构造表明存在单拷贝学习规则相对最优规则渐近次优的学习场景；并证明基于纠缠测量的学习规则在 PAC 设定下相对单拷贝规则至多具有多项式级别的样本复杂度优势（在自然的联合可测性覆盖假设下）。
Conclusion: 纠缠测量确实能改进量子测量 PAC 学习的样本效率，但该优势在 PAC 框架下被限制在多项式量级，而非指数级。

papers.title: Localize Any Object in X-Ray Security Scans without Human Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Universal object localization in X-ray security inspection is critical for automated threat detection in safety-critical venues. However, unlike everyday RGB images that dominate web-scale visual data, X-ray scans exhibit distinct color patterns, ambiguous boundaries, and compositional structures caused by volumetric superposition. These gaps hinder the direct zero-shot transfer of dense perception foundation models trained on web-scale RGB data. Moreover, annotated X-ray data is scarce and requires expert labeling, limiting both the training of generalizable X-ray native models and the adaptation of RGB foundation models for X-ray data via fine-tuning. Given these challenges, the bright promise of highly generalizable perception models, enabled by data scaling laws in the RGB domain, remains largely out of reach for X-ray inspection. To this end, we introduce LAO-X, a self-supervised adaptation framework that Locates Any Object in X-ray scans using diverse synthesized image--annotation pairs with granularity-aware supervision. LAO-X first designs a saliency-guided X-ray object mining module to separate diverse object instances, which are then used for physics-guided synthesis in the absorbance domain. LAO-X further incorporates an occlusion-controlled curriculum strategy to fine-tune a Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) localizer, progressively adapting it to X-ray scans with increasing object counts and overlap levels. Experiments on six X-ray benchmarks show that LAO-X substantially improves category-agnostic localization, achieving 2\% to 23\% mAP gains over SAM2 and X-ray specific baselines in heavily cluttered scenarios, entirely without human-annotated labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LAO-X 用自监督适配让 SAM2 在无任何人工标注的 X 光安检扫描上做类别无关定位：先用显著性引导的 X 光目标挖掘分离实例，再在吸收率域做物理引导的图像-标注对合成，最后以遮挡受控课程逐步微调 SAM2。在六个 X 光基准的重度杂乱场景下，相对 SAM2 与 X 光专用基线取得 2% 到 23% 的 mAP 提升。
Motivation: X 光扫描有体素叠加造成的颜色模式、模糊边界与组合结构，网页 RGB 数据训练的感知基础模型难以零样本迁移；同时带专家标注的 X 光数据稀缺，既限制 X 光原生模型训练，也限制 RGB 模型微调适配。
Method: LAO-X 分三步：显著性引导的 X 光目标挖掘模块分离多样实例；在吸收率 (absorbance) 域对这些实例做物理引导的合成，生成图像-标注对并施加粒度感知监督 (granularity-aware supervision)；再用遮挡受控课程策略 (occlusion-controlled curriculum) 微调 SAM2 定位器，逐步增加目标数量与重叠程度。
Result: 在六个 X 光基准上，LAO-X 在重度杂乱 (heavily cluttered) 场景中相对 SAM2 与 X 光专用基线取得 2% 到 23% 的 mAP 提升，全程不使用人工标注标签。
Conclusion: 合成图像-标注对加课程式适配可以在零人工标注条件下把 RGB 感知基础模型迁移到 X 光安检定位，绕开专家标注稀缺这一瓶颈。

papers.title: Scale-Invariant Training for Time Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are trained on large collections of time series datasets that span various morphologies and domains. This setting exposes models to series whose scales -- typical magnitudes of their values -- can differ substantially. Affine scaling methods such as Reversible Instance Normalization (ReVIN) scale model inputs and reverse the transform before computing the loss. We show that this inversion multiplies each series' gradient by $b^p$ relative to loss on scaled targets, where $b$ is the scaling denominator (e.g., standard deviation) and $p$ is the loss degree. We call this scale-contaminated training (ScaleCon), because the scale of each series consequently becomes an importance weight, causing high-scale series to dominate training. For any scale-equivariant scaler and residual loss that is homogeneous of degree $p$, including MSE, MAE, and Quantile Loss, we prove that computing loss on scaled targets makes every mini-batch gradient and, consequently, the full optimization trajectory invariant to arbitrary independent rescaling of the training series, yielding scale-invariant training (ScaleIn). Notably, existing TSFMs use both objectives, with neither consistent reporting nor a common convention on how to compute training loss. We isolate the convergence disparity induced by ScaleCon and its correction under ScaleIn in controlled studies on synthetic and real data. In pretraining across four TSFM architectures, ScaleIn lowers MASE in all 24 architecture-benchmark comparisons, with average reductions across TSFMs of 18.8% on GIFT-Eval and 21.9% on the M-competitions. The gains extend to supervised neural forecasting, where it lowers MASE in 16 of 20 matched settings. Most existing time series forecasting pipelines can adopt ScaleIn with a one-line code change.

papers.title: ATLAS-AL: Adaptive Trust-Region for Latent Adversarial Searches via Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Security evaluation of learning-based systems requires more than just testing the system against a fixed collection of attacks. It requires adaptive mechanisms that can efficiently discover \textit{sets} of inputs that induce model failure. We introduce ATLAS (Adaptive Trust-Regions for Latent Adversarial Searches), which is a query-based framework that discovers adversarial input sets for black-box learning systems. ATLAS casts attack generation as an active learning level set estimation problem then combines calibrated approximations with a local-global sampling architecture to find regions of the input space that contain adversarial examples. Once discovered, ATLAS is designed to sample points within these adversarial regions to build adversarial sets that accurately represent the state of robustness of the target model. When applied on toy experiments, we find that ATLAS is able to recover more of the adversarial region under a limited query budget than does previous work. When applied to standard and adversarially trained MNIST, CIFAR, and ImageNet model targets, ATLAS produces better representative attacks than other query-based black-box attacks (NES, SignHunter, BayesOpt). ATLAS represents an automated red-teaming framework that can be used for both analyzing the robustness of learning-based systems under development and continuous auditing to see how the robustness of a system changes over time.
papers.comment: 9 pages main body, plus 10 additional pages for references and appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ATLAS 把黑盒对抗样本搜索写成主动学习的 level set 估计问题，用校准近似加局部-全局采样定位含对抗样本的输入区域，再在区域内采样构建能代表模型鲁棒性状态的对抗集合。在 toy 实验中，同等查询预算下比先前工作恢复更多对抗区域；在标准与对抗训练的 MNIST、CIFAR、ImageNet 目标上，产生的攻击代表性优于 NES、SignHunter、BayesOpt 等查询式黑盒攻击。
Motivation: 对学习系统的安全评估不能只跑固定攻击集合，需要自适应机制高效发现成组导致模型失效的输入，用于开发期鲁棒性分析与持续审计。
Method: ATLAS（Adaptive Trust-Regions for Latent Adversarial Searches）是查询式框架：把攻击生成建模为 active learning level set estimation，结合校准近似 (calibrated approximations) 与 local-global sampling 架构定位对抗区域，再在区域内采样构建对抗集合；目标为黑盒模型。
Result: toy 实验中，ATLAS 在有限查询预算下比先前工作恢复更多对抗区域；在标准与对抗训练的 MNIST、CIFAR、ImageNet 目标模型上，比查询式黑盒攻击 NES、SignHunter、BayesOpt 产生代表性更好的攻击。
Conclusion: ATLAS 可作为自动化 red-teaming 框架，用于分析在研学习系统的鲁棒性并对其随时间的变化做持续审计。

papers.title: Rule-Based Languages for Neurosymbolic AI
papers.abstract_en: Logic programming is increasingly used as the symbolic component of neurosymbolic AI systems. We survey the main rule-based languages in this setting, namely Datalog, answer set, and probabilistic logic programs, along four axes: semantics, expressiveness, neural integration, and evaluation mechanism. We analyse over 50 recent systems and applications, comparing formalism usage across four research areas: databases and programming languages, machine learning, vision, and robotics. We provide a decision matrix mapping application scenarios to required features and close by outlining open problems.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of Rules and Reasoning - 10th International Joint Conference, RuleML+RR 2026, Vilnius, Lithuania
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述以逻辑程序作为神经符号 AI 符号组件的规则语言，按语义、表达力、神经集成、评估机制四条轴比较 Datalog、answer set 与 probabilistic logic programs，并分析 50 多个近期系统在数据库与编程语言、机器学习、视觉、机器人四个领域的形式化使用差异，最后给出从应用场景映射到所需特性的决策矩阵。
Motivation: 逻辑程序被越来越多地用作神经符号系统的符号层，但不同规则语言在语义与神经集成方式上差异大，选型缺少统一对照框架。
Method: 综述性工作：选取 Datalog、answer set、probabilistic logic programs 三类规则语言，沿语义、表达力、神经集成、评估机制四个维度建立比较框架；在此框架下分析 50 多个近期系统与应用，并按数据库与编程语言、机器学习、视觉、机器人四个研究领域横向对比形式化使用情况。
Result: 分析覆盖 50 多个近期系统与应用，跨四个研究领域（数据库与编程语言、机器学习、视觉、机器人）比较三类规则语言的使用；产出为一张把应用场景映射到所需特性的决策矩阵，并列出开放问题。
Conclusion: 规则语言的选择应由应用场景所需特性决定，决策矩阵可直接用于该选型；论文同时指出该方向的开放问题。

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating Inference-Time Overreliance Using Agentic Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agentic memory allows LLM agents to reuse past experience, yet retrieved memories can also distort inference even when they are benign, correctly stored, and appropriately retrieved. We study this failure mode, which we call memory over-reliance. Across benchmarks and memory architectures, we find that memory is useful when past experience transfers to the current task, but can become misleading when only part of the evidence transfers. Failures are strongest under partial query-memory overlap, a pattern further confirmed by controlled experiments thatvary the amount of overlapping evidence. Motivated by this finding, we propose MEMTRIM, a plug-and-play framework that indexes memory evidence at write time and controls its reuse at read time. MEMTRIM removes repeated or conflicting evidence while preserving useful memory-specific information, requires no retraining, and applies to both embedding-based and structured memory systems.Experiments show that MEMTRIM reduces memory overreliance while preserving the benefits of useful memory across models and memory settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LLM agent 的检索记忆即使内容正确、检索恰当也会误导推理，作者把这一失效命名为 memory over-reliance，并发现其强度随查询与记忆的证据重叠程度变化：部分重叠时最严重。据此提出 MEMTRIM，在写入时索引记忆证据、读取时控制复用，删除重复或冲突证据并保留有用的记忆特有信息，无需重训即可用于 embedding 与结构化两类记忆系统。
Motivation: Agentic memory 让 agent 复用过往经验，但即使记忆是良性的、存储正确且检索恰当，仍会扭曲推理；当只有部分证据可迁移时，复用记忆反而有害。
Method: MEMTRIM 是即插即用框架：写入阶段对记忆证据建索引，读取阶段控制复用，删除重复或冲突证据同时保留有用的记忆特有信息；无需重训练，兼容 embedding-based 与 structured memory 两类系统。评测跨多个 benchmark、模型与记忆架构，并用可控实验改变重叠证据的量。
Result: 跨 benchmark 与记忆架构，记忆在过往经验可迁移时有用、仅部分证据迁移时产生误导，失败在 partial query-memory overlap 下最强，受控改变重叠证据量的实验进一步确认该模式；MEMTRIM 在不同模型与记忆设置下降低 memory over-reliance，同时保留有用记忆带来的收益。
Conclusion: 记忆过度依赖的根源是查询与记忆的部分证据重叠，而非记忆本身错误；在写入与读取两端管控证据复用即可在不重训的前提下缓解该失效。

papers.title: From Sandbox to Enforcement: Confidence-Qualified Threat Intelligence for Critical Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Security operations centres and national incident-response teams defending critical infrastructure collect abundant threat data yet struggle to turn it into actionable intelligence. A malware sandbox produces detailed behavioural evidence, but as a large, unranked report whose confidence is unstated. We present CG-CTI, an operational pipeline that converts live sandbox output (CAPEv2) into STIX 2.1, correlates it in a knowledge graph with other critical-infrastructure sensors, and attaches to every intelligence object an explicit confidence status derived from provenance, cross-source corroboration, and observation durability. This status gates automated action: only corroborated intelligence is eligible for automated enforcement, while lower-confidence objects are routed to analyst review or kept as context. A grounded language-model stage then narrates the confidence-qualified evidence, where each statement either cites a supporting object or is marked unsupported, so fabricated references are removed before analyst review. We implement CG-CTI within the CYBERGUARD project, whose consortium includes Romania's national cyber-security directorate, and evaluate it against the live sandbox on a labelled malware corpus, measuring conversion validity, indicator yield, technique coverage, corroboration, enforcement eligibility, latency, and summary grounding. CG-CTI turns fragmented sandbox output into corroborated, confidence-ranked, and auditable intelligence for critical-infrastructure defence.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 21st International Conference on Critical Information Infrastructures Security (CRITIS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CG-CTI 把 CAPEv2 沙箱的原始行为报告转成 STIX 2.1 对象，在知识图谱中与关键基础设施其他传感器做关联，并为每个对象附上由来源、跨源佐证和观测持久度推导的显式置信状态。该状态直接门控自动化动作：只有被佐证的情报才允许进入自动执法，低置信对象转人工审查或仅作上下文；语言模型叙述阶段的每条陈述要么引用支撑对象、要么标记为无支撑，从而在人工审查前剔除捏造引用。
Motivation: 关键基础设施的 SOC 与国家事件响应团队坐拥大量威胁数据却难以转成可执行情报：沙箱产出的行为证据是未排序、未标置信度的大报告，无法直接驱动自动化处置。
Method: CG-CTI 管道将 CAPEv2 实时沙箱输出转换为 STIX 2.1，在知识图谱中与关键基础设施其他传感器数据关联，并依据 provenance、跨源佐证 (cross-source corroboration) 与观测持久度 (observation durability) 为每个情报对象生成显式置信状态；该状态门控自动化动作，随后由 grounded language-model 阶段叙述证据，每条陈述须引用支撑对象或标记为 unsupported。实现于 CYBERGUARD 项目。
Result: 在带标注的恶意软件语料上对照实时沙箱进行评估，测量维度包括转换有效性 (conversion validity)、指标产出 (indicator yield)、技术覆盖 (technique coverage)、佐证度、执法资格、时延与摘要 grounding；摘要未给出各维度的具体数值。
Conclusion: 把置信状态作为自动化执法的准入门控，可将碎片化的沙箱输出变成可佐证、可排序、可审计的关键基础设施防御情报，且低置信内容必须经人工审查而非直接执行。

summary_sections.result: 在带标注的恶意软件语料上对照实时沙箱进行评估，测量维度包括转换有效性 (conversion validity)、指标产出 (indicator yield)、技术覆盖 (technique coverage)、佐证度、执法资格、时延与摘要 grounding；摘要未给出各维度的具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把置信状态作为自动化执法的准入门控，可将碎片化的沙箱输出变成可佐证、可排序、可审计的关键基础设施防御情报，且低置信内容必须经人工审查而非直接执行。

papers.title: The Right Memory in the Wrong Context: Verifying Retrieval Admissibility in Long-Term Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-term-memory agents can retrieve relevant information that is inadmissible for the current request because it belongs to another principal, violates policy, or reflects an incompatible lifecycle state. Recall and final-answer accuracy do not reveal this: a route can appear safe by missing required evidence, while a correct answer may follow inadmissible prompt exposure. We introduce a retrieval-admissibility verification framework that assigns each memory-query pair one of three statuses (admissible, inadmissible, or unresolved), compares routes at matched required-evidence recall with bounds for unresolved cases, and tracks memory IDs through prompt exposure while linking exposure to target-level disclosure. We evaluate its stages on separate, non-pooled populations. A post-hoc top-20 reanalysis of frozen rankings from two public long-term-memory benchmarks, RHELM and MemOps, covers 3,767 queries. All released anchors lie within trusted query namespaces; with within-namespace scores unchanged, off-namespace filtering cannot lower their ranks. Top-20 anchor recall increases from 0.432 to 0.533, 80% recall feasibility from 0.237 to 0.311, and exact similarity evaluations decrease by 98.3%. In a frozen 72-case development diagnostic, a released-metadata reference preserves required evidence, whereas neither text-only verifier detects violations under the 1% required-anchor false-denial limit. Across 1,523 paired benchmark-native cases, namespace routing is associated with judged-accuracy gains of 0.053-0.068 across three readers; recall also changes, so this comparison is observational. In 16 controlled exposure scenarios, only one of four reader-specific 95% confidence intervals excludes zero for relevant-inadmissible literal disclosure (+0.156, 95% CI [0.031, 0.312]). Results motivate separate verification of candidate support, admissibility, prompt exposure, and answer disclosure.
papers.comment: 26 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development". Code: https://github.com/ziwang11112/right-memory-wrong-context
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出检索可采纳性 (retrieval admissibility) 验证框架，把每条记忆-查询对判为 admissible / inadmissible / unresolved 三态，并在匹配的必需证据召回下比较检索路径、追踪 memory ID 到 prompt exposure 与最终披露。在 RHELM 与 MemOps 冻结排名的 top-20 事后重分析（3,767 条查询）中，anchor 召回从 0.432 升到 0.533，80% 召回可行性从 0.237 升到 0.311，精确相似度计算减少 98.3%。
Motivation: 长期记忆 agent 会召回与当前请求不相关的记忆（属于他人、违反策略或生命周期状态不兼容），而 recall 与最终答案准确率都看不出来：路线可能因缺少必需证据而显得安全，正确答案也可能来自不被允许的 prompt 暴露。
Method: 框架给每个 memory-query 对分配三态标签，在匹配的 required-evidence recall 下比较路径并对 unresolved 情形给界，同时追踪 memory ID 经 prompt exposure 到 target 级披露；各阶段在不合并的独立样本上评估，包括冻结排名的 top-20 事后重分析、72 例冻结开发诊断、1,523 对基准原生样本与 16 个受控暴露场景。
Result: RHELM 与 MemOps 上 3,767 条查询的 top-20 anchor 召回 0.432→0.533，80% 召回可行性 0.237→0.311，精确相似度计算减少 98.3%；72 例诊断中 released-metadata reference 保住必需证据，而两个纯文本 verifier 在 1% required-anchor false-denial 限制下都检不出违规；1,523 对样本上 namespace routing 与三种 reader 的 judged-accuracy 增益 0.053–0.068 相关（观察性比较，召回也变化）；16 个受控暴露场景中仅 1/4 个 reader 的 95% CI 排除零，relevant-inadmissible 字面披露 +0.156，95% CI [0.031, 0.312]。
Conclusion: 候选证据支持、可采纳性、prompt exposure 与答案披露必须分开验证，单看 recall 或答案正确率会掩盖不被允许的记忆路径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Polar: LLM-Powered Synthesis of Real-World Cyber Evidence for Prioritization and Mitigation
papers.abstract_en: Cyber threat analysis increasingly depends on evidence distributed across vendor advisories, vulnerability databases, and threat intelligence sources. Turning these fragmented observations into timely decisions requires models to connect technical severity with evolving exploitation evidence and available defensive actions. We present POLAR, an LLM-powered framework for synthesizing real-world cyber evidence into threat-centric assessments for prioritization and mitigation. POLAR first disentangles overlapping incidents and grounds each threat in source-linked evidence. For prioritization, it infers severity metrics from cyber evidence and combines the resulting assessment with temporally ordered exploitation signals to estimate near-term exploitation likelihood. For mitigation, it links the synthesized threat data to authoritative remediation knowledge and organizes applicable actions according to threat urgency and operational constraints. We evaluate POLAR on real-world vulnerability evidence collected from public resources and compare it with multiple baselines. Across heterogeneous incidents and zero-day settings, POLAR improves threat ranking and mitigation retrieval while producing evidence-linked intermediate assessments that support analyst inspection. The results establish evidence synthesis as a practical foundation for LLM-based cyber decision support across related security tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: POLAR 用 LLM 把分散在厂商公告、漏洞库与威胁情报中的证据合成为以威胁为中心的评估：先拆分重叠事件并绑定来源证据，再把严重度评估与时序利用信号结合估计近期被利用概率，最后按紧迫度与运维约束组织缓解措施。在公开资源收集的真实漏洞证据上对比多个基线，POLAR 在异构事件与零日场景中改善了威胁排序与缓解检索，且给出可供分析师检查的证据链中间评估。
Motivation: 威胁分析的证据分散在多个来源且相互重叠，把技术严重度、实际利用信号与可用防御动作连成及时决策是缺口。
Method: POLAR 框架分三步：拆分重叠事件并把每个威胁锚定到带来源的证据；从证据推断严重度指标，再与时间排序的利用信号融合估计近期利用可能性；把合成的威胁数据接到权威修复知识上，按威胁紧迫度与运维约束组织可执行动作。
Result: 在从公开资源收集的真实漏洞证据上与多个基线比较，在异构事件与零日 (zero-day) 设定中，POLAR 改善威胁排序 (threat ranking) 与缓解检索 (mitigation retrieval)，并产出证据关联的中间评估供分析师检查。
Conclusion: 证据合成可以作为 LLM 网络决策支持的实用基础，并可迁移到相关安全任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Assumption-lean logistic regression with missing covariates
papers.abstract_en: Missing covariates are frequently encountered in supervised learning problems, and classical methods for estimation using such data use carefully chosen imputation schemes for missing data, or likelihood approximations that lead to nonconvex $M$-estimation problems. These methods and their relatives are suitable for scenarios in which the covariate distribution is known, and more broadly, have enjoyed tremendous success in linear models. But even in basic nonlinear problems such as logistic regression in moderate dimensions, such methods can experience drastic failure modes when the covariate distribution is unknown. Motivated by the need for reliable alternatives, we consider the problem of parameter estimation in logistic regression with missing covariates. Crucially, we operate in the assumption-lean setting where the covariate distribution is unknown (but bounded). We design a stochastic approximation method that is based on $Z$-estimation with a novel monotone operator, and establish that our algorithm is computationally efficient and achieves provable signal recovery at parametric rates under the hypothesis that covariates are missing completely at random. Our theory sharply characterizes the $\ell_2^2$ risk of the estimator in terms of the missingness profile, accommodating heterogeneous observation probabilities. Importantly, it shows that our method always outperforms the de facto ``complete-case'' estimator that ignores observations with any missing data. Even in the setting with homogeneous missingness (in which each covariate is observed independently with probability $q$), our bounds exhibit intricate and nonstandard dependence on $q$ that can yield significant improvements over using only complete cases. We complement our upper bounds with new information-theoretic lower bounds that show that this intricate dependence on $q$ is fundamental in a minimax sense.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在协变量分布未知的 assumption-lean 设定下，用基于 Z-estimation 与新型单调算子 (monotone operator) 的随机逼近方法估计缺失协变量的 logistic 回归参数，在 MCAR 假设下达到参数级 (parametric rate) 信号恢复。理论给出 ℓ₂² 风险随缺失模式（含异质观测概率）的精确刻画，且该方法总是优于默认的 complete-case 估计量；对齐次缺失（每个协变量以概率 q 独立观测）的界显示对 q 有非标准依赖，可显著优于只用完整样本，并由信息论下界证明这种 q 依赖在 minimax 意义下是本质的。
Motivation: 经典缺失数据处理依赖精心设计的插补或导致非凸 M-estimation 的似然近似，且假设协变量分布已知；在协变量分布未知的中等维 logistic 回归这类基本非线性问题中，这些方法会出现严重失效。
Method: 提出基于 Z-estimation 与新型单调算子的随机逼近 (stochastic approximation) 方法，在协变量分布未知但有界的 assumption-lean 框架下估计 logistic 回归参数；假设缺失完全随机 (MCAR)，并允许异质观测概率。
Result: 在 MCAR 下算法计算高效并达到参数级信号恢复；ℓ₂² 风险被精确刻画为缺失模式的函数，且总是优于忽略任何含缺失观测的 complete-case 估计量；齐次缺失（各协变量以概率 q 独立观测）下界对 q 呈非标准依赖，可相对仅用完整样本带来显著改进；配套的信息论下界表明该 q 依赖在 minimax 意义下是基本的。
Conclusion: 缺失协变量的 logistic 回归在分布未知时不必退回 complete-case 或非凸似然近似：新估计量在 minimax 意义下利用了完整数据中被丢弃的信息，且对 q 的复杂依赖是不可改进的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Single-Loop, Constant-Batch First-Order Penalty Method for Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in penalty-based methods for stochastic bilevel optimization (SBO) have eliminated the need for second-order derivative oracles. However, for stochastic nonconvex-strongly convex bilevel problems, existing first-order methods typically rely on nested loops and/or large batch sizes for attaining $O(ε^{-6})$ or $O(ε^{-4})$ sample complexity under standard bounded-variance assumption or mean-square smoothness assumption. Achieving these rates with a single-loop penalty method and a constant batch size remains challenging due to a large penalty value needed for an accurate approximation. To address this challenge, we develop a stochastic SIngle-loop COnstant-Batch first-order penalty method (SICO) that combines two complementary ingredients. First, it performs one stochastic-gradient update per-iteration for both the original lower-level and penalized problems, with a projection that controls the separation between their iterates. Second, it applies an exponential moving average to stabilize the upper-level gradient estimator. We show that this combination achieves $ O(ε^{-6}) $ sample complexity using only $O(1)$ stochastic-gradient samples per iteration under unbiased, bounded-variance stochastic gradients. Under the additional mean-square smoothness assumption on the lower-level stochastic gradients, the same algorithm improves the complexity to $O(ε^{-4})$ also with $O(1)$ batch size. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to match the best-known convergence rate for fully first-order SBO methods using a single loop and a constant batch size. This result addresses an open problem posed in the literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出单循环、常数批大小的一阶罚函数法 SICO，用于随机双层优化 (SBO)：每轮对原下层问题与罚问题各做一次随机梯度更新并用投影约束两者迭代点间距，再用指数滑动平均 (EMA) 稳定上层梯度估计。在无偏有界方差假设下达到 O(ε^{-6}) 样本复杂度且每轮仅用 O(1) 个梯度样本；加设下层随机梯度的均方光滑性后改进到 O(ε^{-4})，批大小仍为 O(1)。
Motivation: 随机非凸-强凸双层问题的一阶方法此前依赖嵌套循环和大批量才能达到 O(ε^{-6}) 或 O(ε^{-4}) 样本复杂度；单循环加常数批大小时，精确近似所需的罚参数过大，这一组合长期是文献中的公开问题。
Method: SICO 每轮对原下层问题与罚问题各执行一次随机梯度更新，并施加投影控制两个迭代点的分离；上层梯度估计器用指数滑动平均 (EMA) 稳定。分析在无偏有界方差随机梯度下给出样本复杂度，再在下层随机梯度满足均方光滑性时给出改进界。
Result: 无偏有界方差假设下 O(ε^{-6}) 样本复杂度，每轮仅需 O(1) 个随机梯度样本；在下层随机梯度额外满足均方光滑性时改进为 O(ε^{-4})，批大小仍为 O(1)。作者称这是首个用单循环与常数批大小达到全一阶 SBO 方法最佳已知收敛率的工作。
Conclusion: 单循环加常数批大小足以匹配随机双层优化全一阶方法的最佳已知收敛率，从而解决文献中提出的公开问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 无偏有界方差假设下 O(ε^{-6}) 样本复杂度，每轮仅需 O(1) 个随机梯度样本；在下层随机梯度额外满足均方光滑性时改进为 O(ε^{-4})，批大小仍为 O(1)。作者称这是首个用单循环与常数批大小达到全一阶 SBO 方法最佳已知收敛率的工作。
summary_sections.conclusion: 单循环加常数批大小足以匹配随机双层优化全一阶方法的最佳已知收敛率，从而解决文献中提出的公开问题。

papers.title: Catching Developers in the Flow: Low-Latency Agentic Program Repair at Google Scale
papers.abstract_en: Manual repair of program failures is time-consuming and disruptive for software developers, particularly during the pre-submit phase where test failures occur within continuous integration systems. While Automated Program Repair has seen significant advancement through Large Language Models, existing state-of-the-art techniques primarily focus on post-submit workflows, operating offline without the low-latency requirements necessary to assist developers in real-time within their flow before they switch context. In this paper, we introduce FlowAgent, an AI agent deployed at Google to automatically repair test failures in the pre-submit outer-loop workflow inside continuous integration systems. Integrated into Google's internal developer tools, Critique and Cider,FlowAgent utilizes a ReAct-style generate-and-validate loop, as well as rigorous pre-execution and post-execution abstention filters to ensure high-quality suggestions under strict latency constraints. Based on our case studies, FlowAgent is highly effective. First, a manual evaluation conducted on 195 real-world test failures demonstrated 67.18% accuracy in suggesting correct fixes. Following its Google-wide deployment, FlowAgent suggested fixes on 295,508changes, of which developers previewed 65,069 and applied 28,554. Developer feedback from interviews indicate that the agent is useful in suggesting correct fixes, integration of autonomous repair agents into industrial software engineering workflows is received well, while interesting challenges and opportunities still remain.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 41st IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Google 内部 pre-submit CI 流水线上部署的程序修复智能体 FlowAgent，用 ReAct 式生成-验证循环加执行前/执行后两道弃权过滤，在严格延迟约束内给出修复建议。195 个真实测试失败的人工评估中 67.18% 给出正确修复；全公司部署后对 295,508 次变更给出建议，开发者预览 65,069 次、采纳 28,554 次。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 程序修复 (APR) 技术主要面向 post-submit 离线流程，无法满足开发者切换上下文前在 pre-submit 阶段实时、低延迟介入的需求。
Method: FlowAgent 集成进 Google 内部开发者工具 Critique 与 Cider，采用 ReAct 风格的 generate-and-validate 循环，并加入严格的 pre-execution 与 post-execution 弃权过滤，以在低延迟约束下保证建议质量。
Result: 195 个真实测试失败的人工评估中，67.18% 的修复建议正确；Google 全范围部署后在 295,508 次变更上给出建议，开发者预览 65,069 次、实际采纳 28,554 次；访谈反馈显示开发者认为该智能体在给出正确修复方面有用。
Conclusion: 把自主修复智能体接入工业软件工程工作流（pre-submit 外环）被开发者正面接受，但作者指出仍存在挑战与机会。

papers.title: FlexiFlow: Bandit-based Model Switching in ML Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Model optimizations help improve inference performance and accuracy of ML workflows. However, relying on a single model to perform inference across all data batches often fails to maximize accuracy and thus overall performance. In many cases, alternate models could perform better on specific subsets of data where a primary model underperforms. Our experiments with real ML workflows indeed show that switching models improves workflow accuracy by up to 23%. Yet, current systems lack the ability to adaptively switch between models based on performance, forcing users to manually test models in sequence. We present FlexiFlow, a dataflow system that dynamically switches between alternate models when the current model exhibits low accuracy. FlexiFlow learns to rank models using a novel multi-armed bandit approach that accounts for model runtimes, probability of passing user-defined assertions, and the computational structure of the ML workflow. We show that the standard Thompson sampling approach is insufficient for switching models in ML workflows. In contrast, our proposed approaches are effective and scales to complex real-world ML workflows. Experiments show that switching models at runtime while reusing intermediate results provides higher accuracy, but also 48% efficiency gain compared to sequential workflow runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexiFlow 是一个数据流系统，在 ML workflow 推理时当当前模型准确率偏低就动态切换到备选模型，用考虑模型运行时、通过用户自定义断言的概率以及 workflow 计算结构的多臂老虎机 (multi-armed bandit) 对模型排序。真实 ML workflow 上切换模型使准确率最多提升 23%，运行时切换并复用中间结果相比顺序跑完整 workflow 还带来 48% 的效率增益；标准 Thompson sampling 在该场景下不足以完成模型切换。
Motivation: 单一模型对所有数据批次做推理往往拿不到最高准确率，备选模型可能在主模型表现差的子集上更好，但现有系统只能让用户手工逐个试模型，无法按性能自适应切换。
Method: FlexiFlow 作为 dataflow 系统监控当前模型准确率，偏低时切换到备选模型；用新的多臂老虎机方法学习模型排序，目标函数同时纳入模型运行时、通过用户定义断言的概率和 ML workflow 的计算结构，并在切换时复用中间结果。
Result: 在真实 ML workflow 实验中，切换模型使 workflow 准确率最多提升 23%；运行时切换并复用中间结果相比顺序执行整个 workflow 获得 48% 的效率增益，同时准确率更高。标准 Thompson sampling 被证明不足以用于 ML workflow 的模型切换，而所提方法有效并可扩展到复杂的真实 workflow。
Conclusion: 按性能自适应切换模型并复用中间结果，能同时提高 ML workflow 的准确率与效率，而通用的 Thompson sampling 排序不足以支撑这种切换。

papers.title: Empirical-Bayes spectral partial pooling across related tasks
papers.abstract_en: Spectral methods are central to high-dimensional statistics and machine learning, underlying procedures for covariance estimation, matrix denoising, representation learning, clustering, and latent variable modeling. In this work, we focus primarily on spectral estimators for high-dimensional factor models, where leading singular vectors of the data matrix are used to estimate latent structure and covariance parameters. In many modern applications, however, data are collected across related but heterogeneous tasks, studies, domains, or populations. Applying such estimators separately to each task can lead to unstable estimates when sample sizes are limited relative to dimension, while completely pooling the data can obscure meaningful task-specific structure. We introduce Hierarchical Spectral Shrinkage (\texttt{HSS}), a scalable empirical-Bayes framework for partially pooling task-specific spectral estimators. The method regularizes the leading spectral directions of each task toward a data-adaptivelylearned common basis, while allowing the amount of shrinkage to vary across tasks and spectral components. The proposed estimator arises as the posterior mean in a surrogate Bayesian regression formulation of the empirical singular vectors. For factor models, \texttt{HSS} yields partially pooled estimators of the group-specific loading spaces and covariance matrices and can be combined with different spectral estimators by replacing their empirical singular vectors with hierarchically regularized counterparts. More broadly, the same construction provides a mechanism for extending spectral estimators to collections of related but heterogeneous datasets. We demonstrate substantial improvements in estimation accuracy and out-of-sample performance over separate, fully pooled, and shared-subspace approaches in synthetic experiments and multi-study gene-expression data.
papers.comment: 27 pages (including references), 32 pages with supplemental, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Hierarchical Spectral Shrinkage (HSS)，一个可扩展的 empirical-Bayes 框架，把各任务的谱估计向数据自适应学到的公共基做部分池化 (partial pooling)，收缩强度随任务和谱分量变化。在合成实验与多研究基因表达数据上，估计精度和样本外表现相对分别估计、完全池化与共享子空间方法均有显著提升。
Motivation: 高维因子模型的谱估计在样本量相对维度偏小时逐任务估计不稳定，而完全池化又会掩盖任务特有结构，需要在两者之间取中间路线。
Method: HSS 对每个任务数据矩阵的前导奇异向量朝公共基做经验贝叶斯收缩，收缩量按任务与谱分量自适应；该估计量来自经验奇异向量的代理贝叶斯回归后验均值，可替换任意谱估计器的奇异向量以扩展到成组任务。
Result: 在合成实验和多研究基因表达数据上，HSS 相对分别估计、完全池化与共享子空间方法在估计精度和样本外表现上均有 substantial 提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 对相关但异质的任务集合做部分池化的谱估计，比逐任务或完全池化更准，且该构造可作为通用机制扩展到其他谱估计器。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lock-in EP: An In-Situ Training Algorithm for Oscillatory Hardware
papers.abstract_en: Analog hardware platforms offer the potential to reduce energy consumption over digital architectures, but in order to succeed, large-scale analog systems must also be able to operate with or recover from the variability of their components. Towards this goal, we derive and demonstrate the lock-in equilibrium propagation (LIEP) training method. LIEP provides local gradient information for each component in an oscillatory network without separate forward and backward sweeps, potentially allowing for in-situ learning capabilities on analog oscillatory hardware platforms. We demonstrate that LIEP can be used both for ab-initio training as well as recovering performance when pre-trained parameters are perturbed. We show that LIEP can be formulated as a three-factor update rule, and suggest that although the method is currently only validated on shallow networks, alternate architectures may allow it to extend to deep and large-scale networks addressing complex tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 lock-in equilibrium propagation (LIEP)：在振荡神经网络中直接给出每个元件的局部梯度信息，无需分开的前向与反向扫描，从而支持模拟振荡硬件上的原位训练 (in-situ learning)。LIEP 可写成三因子更新规则，既能从零训练 (ab-initio)，也能在预训练参数被扰动后恢复性能；目前仅在浅层网络上验证。
Motivation: 模拟硬件平台有望比数字架构省电，但大规模模拟系统必须能容忍或从元件变异性中恢复；现有训练方式依赖独立的前向与反向扫描，难以在模拟振荡硬件上原位进行。
Method: 推导并演示 LIEP 训练方法，为振荡网络中每个元件提供局部梯度信息，且不需分开的前向/反向扫描；将其表述为三因子更新规则 (three-factor update rule)，用于从零训练与扰动后恢复两类场景。
Result: 演示 LIEP 可用于 ab-initio 训练，也可在预训练参数被扰动后恢复性能；方法被表述为三因子更新规则。验证范围为浅层网络。
Conclusion: LIEP 让振荡网络的原位训练在不依赖反向扫描的条件下可行；作者提出换用其他架构或可将其扩展到深层、大规模网络以处理复杂任务，但该扩展目前尚未验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SAFESHIELD: A Decision-Organization Framework for Deployment-Time Safety of Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Deployment-time safety of language models is commonly implemented through runtime guardrails such as input moderation, routing, retrieval verification, and output filtering. Existing deployment frameworks provide increasingly capable mechanisms for these functions, but offer limited guidance on how the safety decisions they produce should be explicitly organized, coordinated, and audited. We formulate deployment-time safety as a decision-organization problem with two elements: responsibility-oriented decomposition of safety decisions and explicit coordination among them. We instantiate this formulation in SAFESHIELD, a deployment-time safety system for small language models that organizes four recurring decision responsibilities (admission, routing, evidence, and release) and records committed decisions in auditable Decision Traces. We evaluate SAFESHIELD through mechanism-level experiments, aggregate stage ablations, controlled coordination ablations, and a deployment-oriented stress suite. Mechanism-level results show that the instantiated safeguards provide the capabilities required by the decision process, while aggregate ablations show substantial degradation in end-to-end safety as the surrounding safety organization is removed. More importantly, dedicated coordination ablations preserve the participating safeguard mechanisms while selectively severing their dependencies: removing admission gating substantially increases false release, and withholding upstream evidence from the release decision reduces release accuracy from 96.0% to 69.5%. These results provide system-level evidence that deployment-time safety depends not only on the capability of individual guardrails, but also on how their decisions are organized and coordinated.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Application Track of IEEE TPS 2026. 12 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAFESHIELD 把小语言模型的部署时安全重构为决策组织问题：按职责分解为 admission、routing、evidence、release 四类决策，并用可审计的 Decision Traces 记录已提交决策。协调消融显示，切断上游证据对 release 决策的依赖后，release accuracy 从 96.0% 降到 69.5%；移除 admission gating 会大幅增加 false release。结论是部署时安全取决于各 guardrail 决策如何被组织与协调，而不只是单个 guardrail 的能力。
Motivation: 现有部署框架提供了 input moderation、routing、retrieval verification、output filtering 等机制，但对这些安全决策应如何显式组织、协调与审计缺少指导。
Method: SAFESHIELD 以职责导向的决策分解加显式协调来形式化部署时安全，实例化 admission、routing、evidence、release 四个反复出现的决策职责，并把已提交决策写入可审计的 Decision Traces；评测包含机制级实验、聚合阶段消融、受控协调消融与面向部署的压力测试套件。
Result: 机制级结果显示各 safeguard 具备决策过程所需能力；聚合阶段消融显示移除安全组织后端到端安全显著退化；协调消融在保留 safeguard 机制的前提下选择性切断其依赖，移除 admission gating 大幅增加 false release，扣留上游 evidence 使 release accuracy 从 96.0% 降至 69.5%。
Conclusion: 部署时安全是系统级属性：单个 guardrail 能力足够并不够，其决策之间的组织与协调本身贡献了端到端安全。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: SAFESHIELD 以职责导向的决策分解加显式协调来形式化部署时安全，实例化 admission、routing、evidence、release 四个反复出现的决策职责，并把已提交决策写入可审计的 Decision Traces；评测包含机制级实验、聚合阶段消融、受控协调消融与面向部署的压力测试套件。
summary_sections.result: 机制级结果显示各 safeguard 具备决策过程所需能力；聚合阶段消融显示移除安全组织后端到端安全显著退化；协调消融在保留 safeguard 机制的前提下选择性切断其依赖，移除 admission gating 大幅增加 false release，扣留上游 evidence 使 release accuracy 从 96.0% 降至 69.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 部署时安全是系统级属性：单个 guardrail 能力足够并不够，其决策之间的组织与协调本身贡献了端到端安全。

papers.title: A Trust Layer for Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Deterministic benchmark scores show that an agent received credit, but not whether that credit was earned, reported honestly, or would hold on a second run. We introduce a Trust Layer for Agent Evaluation, an additive post-hoc framework that reports, beside each recorded score, whether it should be believed. It verifies four properties: whether the result is supported by the benchmark's own grading logic, whether a passing answer was earned through traceable computation, whether the agent's completion claim matches what occurred, and whether the result is stable under repeated execution. The first three use only saved artifacts; the fourth re-runs the agent. Model judgments only label evidence under majority voting; all verdicts follow deterministic rules and never modify the recorded score. Applied to five agent configurations on 108 tasks from Agents' Last Exam, every model shows passing runs with no traceable computation (at rates varying tenfold), confirmed false completion claims, and unstable results: 18-46% of tasks do not stay in one score band over five runs. Only 22.6% of recorded passes clear all four checks (95% CI 15.0-32.6, n=84). Measuring what an agent can do and verifying that it did it are different problems, and current benchmarks address only the first.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出事后附加的 Trust Layer，在每个已记录分数旁给出该分数是否可信的判定：校验评分逻辑支撑、可追溯计算、完成声明真实性与重复执行稳定性四项属性，前三项只用保存的工件，第四项重跑 agent。在 Agents' Last Exam 的 108 个任务、五种 agent 配置上，仅 22.6% 的记录通过项通过全部四项检查（95% CI 15.0–32.6，n=84），且 18–46% 的任务在五次运行中分数档位不稳定。
Motivation: 确定性 benchmark 分数只说明 agent 拿到了分数，无法说明分数是否真实挣得、是否如实汇报、能否在第二次运行复现；现有 benchmark 只度量能力，不验证执行。
Method: Trust Layer 是加性的事后框架，对每条记录分数并列输出可信度判定：四项属性中前三项仅依赖保存工件，第四项重跑 agent；模型判断只在多数投票下标注证据，所有裁决走确定性规则且绝不修改原始分数。
Result: 在 Agents' Last Exam 的 108 个任务、五种 agent 配置上：每种模型都出现无可追溯计算的通过运行（比率相差十倍）、被证实的虚假完成声明，以及不稳定结果——18–46% 的任务在五次运行中不保持同一分数档；仅 22.6% 的记录通过项通过全部四项检查（95% CI 15.0–32.6，n=84）。
Conclusion: 度量 agent 能做什么与验证它确实做了是两个不同问题，当前 benchmark 只覆盖前者；分数应与可信度判定一同报告。
