papers.title: Algorithmically Aligned Neural Agglomerative Tree Construction
papers.abstract_en: Linkage algorithms for hierarchical clustering (HC) are a powerful and efficient framework for constructing clustering trees, yet it is often unclear which merge rule best suits a given dataset or task. In contrast, neural approaches can learn from data, but often fail to retain the efficiency and size generalization of classical algorithms. We introduce NN-linkage, a neural network (NN) model that can learn task-specific and locally dependent merge rules while retaining the recursive structure and efficient inference of classical linkage algorithms. In particular, our model is algorithmically aligned with the Lance-Williams (LW) recurrence, a parameterized framework for defining a broad, continuous family of linkage rules for agglomerative HC. Classical methods such as single linkage (SL), complete linkage (CL), and average linkage arise as discrete choices within this broader family. We show that NN-linkage is a universal approximator for continuous linkage functions, including LW recurrences, and, when paired with a transformer encoding, can also approximate globally dependent rules such as robust single-linkage. We further show that NN-linkage can exactly implement any symmetric constant-coefficient LW recurrence across all input sizes. On the empirical front, we evaluate NN-linkage in real-world applications, clock-tree routing and phylogenetic reconstruction, using both synthetic and real datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness over both classical algorithms and other neural approaches. By learning merge rules directly from target trees, NN-linkage extends efficient HC to scientific and engineering objectives not adequately captured by existing hand-designed linkage rules.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NN-linkage 把神经网络的合并规则嵌进 Lance-Williams (LW) 递推的参数化框架，保留经典 linkage 的递归结构与高效推理，同时按任务学习局部依赖的合并规则。它被证明是连续 linkage 函数（含 LW 递推）的通用逼近器，配 transformer 编码还能逼近 robust single-linkage 这类全局依赖规则，并可在所有输入规模上精确实现任意对称常系数 LW 递推。
Motivation: 层次聚类 (HC) 的 linkage 选择依赖数据集与任务，难以判定哪种合并规则合适；纯神经方法虽能学习，却常丢失经典算法的效率与尺寸泛化能力。
Method: NN-linkage 用神经网络参数化 Lance-Williams 递推中的合并规则，保留递归 linkage 结构；配 transformer 编码以支持全局依赖规则；直接从目标树 (target trees) 学习合并规则，并给出通用逼近与精确实现对称常系数 LW 递推的理论结果。
Result: 在时钟树布线 (clock-tree routing) 与系统发育重建 (phylogenetic reconstruction) 两类真实应用上，用合成与真实数据集评估，NN-linkage 相对经典算法与其他神经方法表现出有效性；理论上是连续 linkage 函数（含 LW 递推）的通用逼近器，且能在所有输入规模上精确实现任意对称常系数 LW 递推。
Conclusion: 把神经合并规则对齐到 Lance-Williams 递推，可在保留经典 HC 效率与尺寸泛化的同时，把层次聚类扩展到手工 linkage 规则覆盖不到的科学与工程目标。

papers.title: Does the Model Use the Feature? Separating Steering from Mechanism in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Internal features in LLMs are often interpreted as mechanisms when they track a concept and their manipulation changes a related behavior. Yet steering can push a feature far outside its natural range, where its effects need not reflect the model's own computation. We examine this inference and propose an empirical contract whose tests evaluate features at values observed on natural inputs. One test copies a feature's value from an input that shows a behavior into a matched input that does not (installation) or the reverse (removal); the other restores the feature after an upstream edit (downstream rescue). Installation measures how far the feature suffices for the behavior; removal and downstream rescue measure how much the model uses it. Applied to three kinds of representations, the two strengths separate sharply. The published unknown-entity latent strongly steers knowledge abstention, yet installing observed values from either published latent into matched prompts transfers only a small fraction of the natural known--unknown abstention contrast. Dense known--unknown directions show opposite asymmetries between installation and removal in Gemma and Llama, and how fully a released subject--verb agreement feature set reproduces and restores the behavior depends on how its values are written into the model. Tracking a concept and steering a behavior therefore do not by themselves show that the model uses a feature, and each conclusion holds only for the intervention tested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一套经验契约，把「特征能引导行为」与「模型在自然输入上真的使用该特征」分开：只在自然输入观测到的特征取值上做安装 (installation)、移除 (removal) 与下游救援 (downstream rescue) 三项测试。结果发现已发表的 unknown-entity latent 虽能强力引导知识弃答，但把观测取值装入匹配提示只转移了自然 known–unknown 弃答对比的一小部分；Gemma 与 Llama 的稠密 known–unknown 方向在安装与移除上呈相反不对称。
Motivation: 把内部特征当作机制的常见推断依赖远超自然范围的 steering，而这种干预的效果未必反映模型自身的计算，导致「追踪概念 + 操纵改变行为」被过度解读为模型使用该特征。
Method: 提出经验契约，两项测试均在自然输入观测到的特征取值上评估：其一从表现该行为的输入把特征取值复制到匹配的不表现输入 (installation) 或反向 (removal)；其二在上游编辑后恢复该特征 (downstream rescue)。安装度量特征对行为的充分程度，移除与下游救援度量模型对该特征的使用程度，应用于三类表示。
Result: 已发表的 unknown-entity latent 能强力引导知识弃答，但把任一已发表 latent 的观测取值装入匹配提示，只转移自然 known–unknown 弃答对比的一小部分；稠密 known–unknown 方向在 Gemma 与 Llama 中安装与移除呈相反不对称；已发布的 subject–verb agreement 特征集能否复现并恢复行为，取决于其取值写入模型的方式。
Conclusion: 追踪概念与引导行为本身并不表明模型使用该特征，且每条结论只对所测试的那种干预成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Words Keep of a Place: Zero-Shot Language Reasoning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view geo-localization is commonly solved as an image retrieval problem, matching a ground-level image against a database of satellite tiles through a jointly trained embedding. Such models are accurate, but they need large paired supervision and cannot show what evidence supports a match. In this paper, we study a different question: how much of this task can be solved through language alone? We prompt a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to describe each ground panorama and each satellite tile as structured text, and localize by comparing these descriptions. No component is trained. We evaluate on 9,826 VIGOR pairs from four U.S. cities, in three settings. First, the descriptions are faithful but not discriminative. They agree closely across the two views, yet ranking the full pool by description similarity almost never returns the correct tile (0.39% Recall@1). Second, we narrow the pool to ten neighboring tiles, as a coarse prior would do. The same descriptions now become useful: an MLLM judge that scores structural consistency doubles random ranking and matches a strong lexical baseline. It also states which fields of the two descriptions agree and which conflict, which an embedding distance cannot do, and which we see as a step toward interpretable localization. Third, we place the judge on a trained visual retriever. On the queries it ranks wrongly, reranking from images works, while reranking from our descriptions does not (23.5% against 10.7% Recall@1). Scene structure survives the conversion into language, while the fine appearance detail needed to separate nearby places does not. Code and prompts are publicly available at https://github.com/AyeshAbuLehyeh/GeoLingual.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把跨视角地理定位 (cross-view geo-localization) 完全交给语言：用 MLLM 把地面全景与卫星瓦片各写成结构化描述，再靠比较描述定位，全程不训练任何组件。在 VIGOR 的 9,826 对样本上，全库按描述相似度排序 Recall@1 仅 0.39%；缩到邻近 10 块瓦片后 MLLM judge 的排序翻倍并追平强词法基线；把 judge 接到已训练视觉检索器上做重排时，图像重排 23.5% 对描述重排 10.7% Recall@1。
Motivation: 跨视角定位目前靠联合训练的嵌入做图像检索，需要大量配对监督，且无法说明匹配依据；作者要测出仅凭语言能覆盖该任务的多少。
Method: 提示一个多模态大模型 (MLLM) 把每张地面全景与每块卫星瓦片写成结构化文本描述，再以描述相似度比较完成定位，无任何训练组件；三种设置：全库排序、限定邻近 10 块瓦片后由 MLLM judge 按结构一致性打分并指出描述间一致与冲突的字段、以及把 judge 接到已训练视觉检索器上对错误查询做重排。
Result: 在 VIGOR 四个美国城市 9,826 对样本上：全库按描述相似度排序 Recall@1 为 0.39%；限定 10 块邻近瓦片后 MLLM judge 的排序达到随机排序的两倍并追平强词法基线；对视觉检索器排错的查询，图像重排 Recall@1 23.5%，描述重排 10.7%。
Conclusion: 场景结构能经语言保留下来并支撑粗检索与可解释的一致/冲突说明，但区分邻近地点所需的细粒度外观在转写为语言时丢失，因此描述重排不足以替代图像重排。

papers.title: Verifying Coordination in Parallel Coding Agents: NP-Bench and a Scheduling Planner
papers.abstract_en: A team of coding agents can look fine agent by agent yet fail as a team: each passes its own tests while the merged result is broken, and single-agent evaluation never catches it. As teams run several LLM coding agents in parallel on one codebase, the agents collide: two rewrite the same function, one codes against a contract a teammate just changed, and integration fails after the work is done. Most coordination tools react (watch for a conflict, then warn), but at agent speed the warning arrives after the wasted edit. We recast the problem as scheduling: take each work item's declared scope, partition the work into disjoint scopes, and order merges along the producer->consumer graph, all up front. We build this planner into Nerveplane and evaluate it with NP-Bench, an environment-grounded three-arm benchmark (no coordination; reactive detection; proactive planning) that verifies integration off a real git merge, both in a deterministic simulation and with live agents. The planner lifts clean-integration from 1/9 to 9/9 scenarios and cuts merge conflicts from 13 to 0, with a gap that grows in the number of agents. On a live breaking contract change it rescues an outcome both baselines miss on every seed: the clean-integration rate rises from 0 (no coordination and reactive detection) to 1.0 on a frontier model and 0.6 on a small one, while agents respect assigned scopes (0/5 leakage). A cross-session memory drops the repeated-mistake rate from 1.00 to 0.00 on strong and weak models alike. We also report a negative result: routing facts to agents does not rescue long-context accuracy at window-fitting scales; its value is cost and capacity, not attention. Across two capability tiers and two vendors, the benefit did not shrink as models got stronger, because it comes from how work is allocated, not model reasoning.

Motivation: 并行 LLM 编码智能体各自通过测试但合并后整体失败：重复改同一函数、对着刚被改掉的契约写代码，反应式冲突警告到达时浪费的编辑已经发生，单智能体评测抓不到这类团队级失败。

papers.title: Lineage-Aware Memory Governance: A Derivation-Gated Framework for Privacy-Preserving Column-Level Access Control in Enterprise AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise AI agents that share a memory store face two unaddressed risks: sensitive data can leak through legitimately computed results the requester could not derive, and departments can silently compute a same-named key performance indicator (KPI) through conflicting logic. Existing agent-memory systems (e.g., MemGPT, Zep, A-MEM) gate retrieval by content, ownership, and role, not derivation, missing a cached insight that embeds a forbidden column. We introduce the Analytical Memory Unit (AMU), a memory schema that attaches a full derivation (lineage) graph to every cached result, gated by a retrieval policy that serves a hit only when the requester is authorised for every column touched. Provided lineage recording is complete, we prove by construction that the policy blocks retrieval of results derived from a sensitive column outside the requester's permissions, at O(n) worst case -- a conditional design guarantee, not an empirical claim, that excludes derived features encoding sensitive information without naming their source. Eliminating measured leakage required 75-90% recorded lineage completeness, so we treat 90% as a conservative deployment target. Across six experiments, lineage-gated retrieval removes the 18.8-25.5% cross-department leakage naive content-gated memory suffers, keeping 81.5-82.6% of memory reuse at 13.8 microsecond worst-case overhead. A real-agent proof-of-concept with LLM-generated SQL is consistent with the guarantee: zero leaks over 9 round-trips, two conflicts caught automatically -- though a feasibility demonstration, not evidence of production viability. This offers a practical governance layer for shared agent memory, complementing source-layer access control and supporting EU AI Act compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向共享记忆的企业 AI agent，提出 Analytical Memory Unit (AMU)：给每条缓存结果挂完整派生 lineage 图，检索策略只在请求者被授权访问全部被触及列时才返回命中。在 lineage 记录完整度达 75–90% 时可消除实测泄漏，六组实验中把内容门控记忆的 18.8–25.5% 跨部门泄漏降为零，同时保留 81.5–82.6% 的记忆复用，最坏开销 13.8 微秒。
Motivation: 共享 agent 记忆按内容、属主、角色做检索门控，挡不住两类风险：请求者无法自行推导、却嵌入了禁用列的合法计算结果发生泄漏；以及各部门用冲突逻辑静默计算同名 KPI。
Method: AMU 为每条缓存结果附加完整派生 (lineage) 图，检索策略在请求者对被触及的每一列都有权限时才返回命中；在 lineage 记录完整的前提下按构造证明该策略阻断越权派生结果的检索，最坏复杂度 O(n)。评估含六组实验与一个用 LLM 生成 SQL 的真实 agent 概念验证。
Result: 消除实测泄漏需要 75–90% 的 lineage 记录完整度，作者取 90% 作为保守部署目标；六组实验中 lineage 门控检索去除了内容门控记忆的 18.8–25.5% 跨部门泄漏，保留 81.5–82.6% 的记忆复用，最坏开销 13.8 微秒。概念验证 9 次往返零泄漏、自动捕获 2 个冲突。
Conclusion: 在 lineage 记录完整的条件下，派生门控可按构造阻断敏感列的派生泄漏（O(n) 最坏情形，属条件性设计保证而非实证结论）；作者将其定位为源层访问控制之上的治理层，支持 EU AI Act 合规，概念验证仅为可行性演示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemMux: Runtime Verification and Honest Resource Attribution for Fleets of Parallel Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Developers increasingly run a fleet of coding agents side by side on one workstation. The tools they reach for, terminal multiplexers like tmux and a new generation of agent managers, were built to arrange windows, not to govern memory. When ten agents each spawn language servers, test runners, and browsers, no standard tool can say how much memory belongs to which agent, confirm that a terminated agent's descendants are gone, notice a child that has escaped its agent, or keep the machine off the swap cliff when an OOM kill would silently discard uncommitted work. We treat these as runtime-verification problems: an agent-hosting substrate should continuously emit observable signals an operator or auditor can check while agents run. We present MemMux, a local runtime that turns resource governance into checkable signals (per-agent attribution, complete reclamation, escaped-process visibility, bounded footprint under overcommit, and monitoring overhead), with a claims-disciplined benchmark against tmux, a purpose-built agent multiplexer, and a raw-process baseline on identical workloads. Under a binding memory budget on a Linux host, MemMux keeps the fleet under budget (7.5 GiB) with zero swap by admitting a subset and reclaiming under pressure, while the ungoverned tools run every agent, pin the machine at its RAM ceiling (2x over budget), and spill about 2 GiB into swap. MemMux reclaims 100% of a terminated agent's process subtree where the raw baseline strands half of it, and it alone surfaces escaped children (10 of 10 detected). We report the cost: the 1 Hz attribution scan runs near 0.6% CPU at one agent but 2.7% at ten, above our 2% target. Running the harness on real Claude Code sessions shows 100% attribution and low overhead carry over to live agent trees. We release the engine, benchmark, and a one-command reproducer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemMux 把并行编码 agent 的资源治理做成可核验的运行时信号：逐 agent 内存归属、子进程树完整回收、逃逸进程可见、超卖下有界占用与监控开销。在 7.5 GiB 绑定预算下它靠准入子集加压力回收把机群压在预算内且零 swap，而 tmux 等无治理工具跑满全部 agent、顶到 2 倍预算并溢出约 2 GiB 到 swap；回收率 100%（裸进程基线漏掉一半），10/10 逃逸子进程被发现。代价是 1 Hz 归属扫描在 10 个 agent 时占 2.7% CPU，高于 2% 目标。
Motivation: 一台工作站上并行跑十个编码 agent 时，tmux 与新一代 agent 管理器只排窗口不管内存：无法回答内存归谁、被杀 agent 的后代是否清干净、是否有子进程逃逸，也挡不住 OOM kill 静默丢掉未提交工作。
Method: 把这些问题当作 runtime-verification：本地运行时持续发出可核验信号（per-agent 归属、完整回收、逃逸进程可见、超卖下有界占用、监控开销），并用 claims-disciplined benchmark 在相同负载上对比 tmux、专用 agent multiplexer 与裸进程基线；另在真实 Claude Code 会话上跑同一 harness。
Result: 在 Linux 主机的 7.5 GiB 绑定内存预算下，MemMux 通过准入子集加压力回收使机群保持预算内且零 swap；无治理工具跑满全部 agent、达到 2 倍预算并溢出约 2 GiB 到 swap。终止 agent 的进程子树回收率 100%（裸基线漏掉一半），逃逸子进程 10/10 全部检出。1 Hz 归属扫描开销单 agent 约 0.6% CPU、十 agent 2.7%，高于 2% 目标；真实 Claude Code 会话上归属率 100%、开销低。
Conclusion: 把资源治理做成持续可核验的信号，就能在超卖下保住内存预算并完整回收、看见逃逸进程，代价是多 agent 下监控开销会超过 2% 目标；引擎、benchmark 与一键复现器已开源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Graph Saddle Point Problems
papers.abstract_en: Neural algorithmic reasoning, or aligning a neural network with an algorithmic paradigm, has emerged as an approach to solving polynomial-time-solvable and computationally harder combinatorial optimization problems. We propose a new message-passing framework based on the Chambolle-Pock Primal--Dual Hybrid Gradient (PDHG) method called \textsc{GraphPDHG} for solving general graph saddle-point problems. Theoretically, we show that \textsc{GraphPDHG} can efficiently solve a family of graph saddle-point problems by simulating PDHG. We also show that our network can learn an accelerated PDHG algorithm. Experimentally, we support our results on accelerated PDHG by evaluating the performance of our model as a learned warm start for second-order optimization techniques (SSNAL). We also show that alignment with PDHG leads to stronger size generalization than non-aligned graph neural network (GNN) baselines. Overall, we propose a novel architecture for solving a general family of optimization problems on graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 GraphPDHG：把 Chambolle-Pock Primal-Dual Hybrid Gradient (PDHG) 嵌入消息传递框架来解图上的鞍点问题，理论上证明其可高效模拟 PDHG 并能学到加速版 PDHG。实验中该网络作为二阶方法 SSNAL 的学习型 warm start 有效，且与 PDHG 对齐带来比非对齐 GNN 基线更强的规模泛化 (size generalization)。
Motivation: 神经算法对齐 (neural algorithmic reasoning) 已用于组合优化，但图上一般鞍点问题缺少既能模拟经典算法、又具备规模泛化能力的消息传递求解器。
Method: GraphPDHG：以 Chambolle-Pock PDHG 为算法先验构建消息传递网络，理论上证明其模拟 PDHG 并可学习加速版 PDHG；实验中作为二阶优化技术 SSNAL 的学习型 warm start，并与非对齐 GNN 基线比较规模泛化。
Result: 实验支持加速 PDHG 的结果：模型作为 SSNAL 的 learned warm start 表现有效；与 PDHG 对齐比非对齐 GNN 基线带来更强的 size generalization。
Conclusion: 把经典 primal-dual 算法嵌入 GNN 消息传递，可为一般图鞍点问题给出兼具算法对齐与规模泛化的求解架构。

papers.title: Neural Fields Encode Adaptation Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Neural fields are usually evaluated by how well they reconstruct an observation. We show that this misses two useful properties of a fitted network: how easily it can adapt to new observations, and what its weights retain from earlier ones. We study these properties as adaptation geometry. For images, we meta-learn class-specific initializations, adapt each one to a new image, and measure how much the network must change to fit it. A simple local linear model closely predicts this adaptation cost, while replacing one network's tangent kernel with another's substantially worsens the prediction. Adaptation thus depends on the local geometry of the fitted network, not only on its current reconstruction. For physical fields, we repeatedly fit the same network to observations from a sequence. Its weights then retain information about that history. When two wave histories end at exactly the same observation, the final weights recover the sign of the wave velocity with 68.6% accuracy, whereas the current observation alone contains no such information and gives 50%. These two phenomena are quantitatively linked: tangent-kernel eigenvalues predict both which changes are easy to learn and how quickly they are overwritten by later fitting. Together, these results show that neural fields contain useful information beyond what they currently reconstruct: in how they can change and in how they got there.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 2 figures. Extended version of work accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把神经场 (neural fields) 的可适配性与权重对历史观测的保留刻画为“适配几何”：图像上用局部线性模型预测适配代价，物理场上发现反复拟合序列观测的权重保留历史信息——两个波历史终点观测完全相同时，最终权重仍能以 68.6% 恢复波速符号，而当前观测本身只有 50%。切向核 (tangent kernel) 特征值同时预测哪些变化易学、以及多快被后续拟合覆盖。
Motivation: 神经场通常只按重建质量评估，忽略了网络适配新观测的难易程度以及权重保留早期观测的程度，这两个性质对序列拟合与持续学习是可利用的信息。
Method: 图像上做 class-specific 初始化的 meta-learning，各自适配到新图像并测量网络需改变多少，用局部线性模型预测适配代价，并与替换切向核的对照比较；物理场上把同一网络反复拟合到一串观测，检验终点观测相同、波历史不同的两组最终权重能否区分波速符号。
Result: 局部线性模型能很好预测适配代价，替换一个网络的切向核为另一个会显著恶化预测；两个波历史终点观测完全相同时，最终权重恢复波速符号的准确率为 68.6%，当前观测单独判断为 50%；切向核特征值同时预测哪些变化易学与被后续拟合覆盖的速度。
Conclusion: 神经场包含超出当前重建的有用信息：既体现在它能如何变化，也体现在它如何到达当前状态，适配代价由拟合网络的局部几何而非仅由重建决定。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Internalizing Agent Experience into Diffusion Model Weights via On-Policy Context Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Wrapping an image generation model in an agentic harness can effectively boost Text-to-Image task performance: the harness can leverage memory, skills, workflow orchestration, result verification, and iterative refinement to continually construct and revise prompts, thereby eliciting better images. These gains, however, remain external to the diffusion model and are realized only while the full harness runs. We propose Diffusion On-Policy Context Distillation (D-OPCD), which treats the agent-improved prompt as privileged context and distills the knowledge encoded in the agent harness into the weights of the diffusion model, so that the model retains part of the harness's benefit when conditioned on the original query alone. Using a Text-to-Image agent equipped with our proposed Auto Skill Evolver (ASE), we show that D-OPCD can internalize harness capabilities into the generator's weights, raising the average direct-generation score from 60.52 to 65.09 across four benchmarks. With this knowledge absorbed into the weights, the harness can shed its saturated skills and resume evolving: a second ASE round on the updated generator improves on a skill-free harness by additional 1.83 points, pointing toward text-to-image systems in which harness and model keep improving each other through continual co-evolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 agent 改写后的 prompt 当作特权上下文，用 Diffusion On-Policy Context Distillation (D-OPCD) 把 harness 的能力蒸馏进扩散模型权重，使模型仅凭原始 query 也能保留部分收益。四个 benchmark 上直接生成平均分从 60.52 升到 65.09；吸收后 harness 可丢弃已饱和技能并重启演化，第二轮 Auto Skill Evolver (ASE) 相对无技能 harness 再提升 1.83 分。
Motivation: agent harness 用记忆、技能、编排与迭代改写带来的 Text-to-Image 提升只存在于 harness 运行期间，扩散模型本身没有变强，harness 技能也会饱和。
Method: 提出 D-OPCD，把 agent 改写的 prompt 视为特权上下文做 on-policy 蒸馏，将 harness 编码的知识写入扩散模型权重；配套提出 Auto Skill Evolver (ASE) 为 Text-to-Image agent 演化技能，并在更新后的生成器上再跑一轮 ASE。
Result: 四个 benchmark 上直接生成平均分由 60.52 提升到 65.09；在吸收知识后的生成器上，第二轮 ASE 相对无技能 harness 额外提升 1.83 分。
Conclusion: harness 的收益可以部分内化进模型权重，从而让 harness 甩掉饱和技能继续演化，形成 harness 与模型互相提升的持续共演化 (co-evolution) 循环。

papers.title: Can Semantic Geometry Teach an AI Judgement?
authors: Thomson D. Nguy (Radiant Institute for Manifold Studies)
papers.abstract_en: How can an AI agent determine what rules to follow? One rule permits an action. Another imposes a condition, exception, or conflicting obligation. Deterministic systems can resolve those relationships when they have been specified. When they remain implicit in language, an agent can follow one rule while missing another that should stop it. Refusing every unresolved action avoids that risk, but also blocks permissible actions. We wanted the agent to make the distinction and still act. Our initial hypothesis was that geometric measurements could supply a basis for judgment. We represented actions and policies as vectors, then tested whether their geometry could identify governing policies and interpret the action's relation to them. Across four studies, the tested approaches did not establish reliable pre-action judgment. In the final synthetic study, a lexical router recovered every governing and blocking policy while reducing median policy checks by 97.7%. The composed pipeline nevertheless escalated all 2,304 test actions, including those it should have allowed. Supplying every policy to the same downstream mechanism changed no decision. Finding the policies had not solved the problem of interpreting them. This result led us to revise our hypothesis: judgment in AI agents requires developing a consequence graph. Such a graph would connect the actor and authority to policy conditions, exceptions, and the changes an action would produce. Follow-on studies will ask whether making those relationships explicit helps the agent distinguish when to act, stop, or seek review.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Four bounded studies of semantic measurements for pre-action judgment; consequence-graph hypothesis remains untested
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把动作与策略表示为向量、试图用语义几何判定该不该执行，四项研究均未建立可靠的行动前判断 (pre-action judgment)。最终合成研究中 lexical router 找全了所有管辖与阻断策略并把策略检查中位数降 97.7%，但组合管线仍把全部 2,304 个测试动作升级处理，包括本应放行的；把全部策略喂给同一下游机制也不改变任何决策。作者据此把假设改为：AI 判断需要显式的 consequence graph。
Motivation: 规则间的条件、例外与冲突义务在语言中是隐式的，确定性系统无法解析；agent 可能遵守一条规则却漏掉本应叫停它的另一条，而一律拒绝又会挡住本应允许的动作。
Method: 把动作和策略编码为向量，用几何测量识别管辖策略并解释动作与策略的关系；共四项有界研究，最后一项为合成研究，比较 lexical router 与组合管线（找策略 + 下游解释机制）的策略检查量与升级决策。
Result: 四项研究中被测方法都未能建立可靠的行动前判断。最终合成研究里 lexical router 找到全部管辖与阻断策略，策略检查中位数减少 97.7%；组合管线仍升级全部 2,304 个测试动作（含本应允许的），向同一下游机制提供全部策略不改变任何决策。
Conclusion: 找到策略不等于能解释策略：几何与词法路由都解决不了判断问题，作者转而假设需要把行动者、权威、条件、例外与动作后果连成 consequence graph，该假设尚待后续研究检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning What to Distill: Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have shown strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference costs make knowledge distillation an important approach for transferring such capabilities to compact models in resource-constrained scenarios. On-policy self-distillation further reduces the reliance on external large teacher models while improving the reasoning ability of compact language models. However, existing methods typically either distill all token positions uniformly or select tokens using fixed heuristic criteria, assigning the same distillation strength to the selected positions rather than adaptively learning which tokens are most beneficial for distillation. To address these limitations, we propose BiToK-SD (Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation), a bilevel-optimization-based token selection method that learns where distillation should be applied during on-policy self-distillation. Specifically, BiToK-SD is formulated as a bilevel optimization problem, where the lower-level problem models Top-K token selection as a differentiable threshold-based relaxation, allowing the selected positions to adapt as the student policy evolves, while the upper-level problem performs knowledge distillation on the selected positions. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that BiToK-SD achieves the best average performance among all compared methods while requiring only lightweight additional computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiToK-SD 把自蒸馏中的 token 选择写成双层优化：下层用可微阈值松弛求 Top-K 选择位置并随学生策略演化自适应，上层只在选中位置做知识蒸馏。在数学推理基准上取得所有对比方法中最好的平均性能，且额外计算开销轻量。
Motivation: 现有 on-policy 自蒸馏要么对所有 token 位置均匀蒸馏，要么用固定启发式选 token，且对选中位置一律施加相同蒸馏强度，无法学到哪些 token 对蒸馏最有价值。
Method: 提出 BiToK-SD（Bilevel Top-K Token Selection for Self-Distillation）：下层把 Top-K token 选择建模为基于可微阈值的松弛问题，使选中位置随学生策略演化而变化；上层在选中位置上执行知识蒸馏，构成双层优化。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，BiToK-SD 在所有对比方法中取得最好的平均性能，同时只需轻量级额外计算。
Conclusion: 把「蒸馏哪些 token」作为可学习的双层优化问题，优于均匀蒸馏或固定启发式选择，且开销可控。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network for Early Breast Cancer Detection in Low-Resource Clinical Settings
authors: Ethiopia (2) Clinical Oncologist London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine London
papers.abstract_en: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women in Sub-Saharan Africa, where delayed diagnosis results from limited radiology expertise and fragmented clinical data systems. Although deep learning models have demonstrated strong performance in mammographic analysis, most rely solely on imaging data and are trained on Western populations, limiting their applicability in African healthcare settings. This paper presents a Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network (HCMAN) that integrates mammogram images with structured clinical data using transformer-based cross-modal attention mechanisms. The model was developed and validated using a locally collected dataset of 2,560 mammogram images from 1,024 patients across four Ethiopian referral hospitals, with biopsy-confirmed ground truth labels. The proposed framework achieves 97.8% accuracy, 97.2% sensitivity, 98.3% specificity, and an AUC of 0.987, significantly outperforming image-only baselines. The system demonstrates robustness to low-quality images typical of resource-limited settings, with only 3.2% performance degradation compared to 8.7% for image-only models. Cross-modal attention analysis reveals clinically appropriate behavior: higher reliance on clinical features for ambiguous cases such as dense breasts and young patients. The model's lightweight architecture enables deployment on standard hospital workstations (<2 seconds inference on CPU). This work advances sustainable, context-aware AI solutions for equitable breast cancer diagnostics in Africa.
papers.comment: 5 double pages numbers, conference paper presented at AI4SD 2026 (https://www.mu.edu.et/index.php/component/content/article/artificial-intelligence-for-sustainable-development-conference-participants?catid=69&Itemid=101)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出混合跨模态注意力网络 (HCMAN)，用 transformer 跨模态注意力把乳腺 X 线影像与结构化临床数据融合做乳腺癌检测。在埃塞俄比亚四家转诊医院 2,560 张乳腺癌影像、1,024 名患者、活检确诊标签上达到 97.8% 准确率、AUC 0.987，且低质量图像下性能仅下降 3.2%，优于纯影像模型的 8.7%。
Motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲乳腺癌死亡主因是放射科人才短缺与临床数据碎片化导致的诊断延迟；现有深度学习模型只用影像、且在西方人群上训练，难以直接用于非洲医疗场景。
Method: HCMAN 以 transformer 跨模态注意力融合乳腺 X 线图像与结构化临床数据；在四家埃塞俄比亚转诊医院自采的 2,560 张影像、1,024 名患者数据上开发与验证，标签为活检确诊结果，并与纯影像基线对比。
Result: 准确率 97.8%、敏感性 97.2%、特异性 98.3%、AUC 0.987，显著优于纯影像基线；低质量图像下性能仅下降 3.2%（纯影像模型 8.7%）；跨模态注意力在致密乳腺、年轻患者等模糊病例上更依赖临床特征；CPU 推理 <2 秒。
Conclusion: 影像加临床数据的跨模态融合在资源受限环境下比纯影像模型更稳健，且轻量架构可在标准医院工作站上部署。

papers.title: SPECTRUM: Proximal Spectral Modulation for Looped Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: A model that learns from its own outputs inherits more than their correctness: it inherits which solutions it produces. We formulate Looped Self-Distillation, a self-evolution framework for code generation in which a model repeatedly generates and learns from its own raw outputs, under a fixed information budget, without ongoing external assessment or test-based selection of the generated samples. We identify a consequential separation: correctness can improve while the breadth of correct implementations contracts. We introduce SPECTRUM, which re-estimates loss-sensitive key/value geometry from a fixed reference anchor at each round and converts it into full-rank proximal spectral modulation. All generated completions train a single student, whose subsequent inference requires no intervention. After five rounds of experiments on MBPP, SPECTRUM retains 89.9% of the initial model's 64-sample correct AST richness, compared with 66.4% for Vanilla self-distillation and 65.5% for a subspace-projection control. The advantage persists at matched correct-sample counts. Without further training or recalibration, the resulting student also achieves higher matched-correct richness than Vanilla SD on HumanEval+ and APPS Intro, demonstrating transfer of the diversity benefit. These findings establish correct-solution retention as a complementary objective of recursive self-improvement (RSI) and show that generation-time intervention can improve the solution repertoire retained by subsequent students.

papers.title: Benchmarking Time Series Foundation Models for Load Forecasting Under Covariate Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Accurate short-term load forecasting (STLF) is essential for the reliable and efficient operation of modern power systems. While time series foundation models (TSFMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of forecasting tasks, their effectiveness for STLF under realistic operational conditions remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we present a comprehensive benchmark of four trained-from-scratch (TFS) models and four TSFMs across three real-world load forecasting datasets under operational scenarios that differ in the availability and quality of future covariate information. Our results show that Chronos-2 consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both zero-shot and fine-tuned settings when future covariates are available or accurately forecast. However, its performance degrades as covariate forecasts become increasingly noisy, whereas TimesNet exhibits greater robustness under severe covariate uncertainty. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of covariate-informed TSFMs for STLF while highlighting the critical role of robust covariate modeling in real-world forecasting applications.

papers.title: Monocular Navigation Relative to Unknown Spacecraft Using a Transformer-Aided Kalman Filter
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a novel learning-based pipeline for pose estimation of unknown spacecraft using only monocular images from a single servicer. The approach combines a transformer-based neural network with a Multi-State Constraint Kalman Filter (MSCKF) to estimate the pose (i.e., position and orientation of the target spacecraft relative to the camera) throughout rendezvous and proximity operations. Unlike existing vision-based methods that require prior knowledge of the target shape or inertia properties, rely on additional sensing modalities such as depth, lidar, or stereo, or only recover translation up to scale, the proposed pipeline generalizes to previously unseen spacecraft using a single monocular camera. The transformer network estimates the odometry, the change in pose between images up to scale, from SuperPoint features matched by LightGlue. The MSCKF uses these pseudo-measurements along with an orbit and attitude kinematics model to estimate the pose of the target. In particular, the relative orbit elements, the target's attitude with respect to the servicer's camera, and the associated angular velocity are estimated directly by the filter. Given the monocular approach and short distance to the target, the full observability of the range to the target is recovered via attitude maneuvers by the servicer. The method is trained and evaluated on a re-rendered high-resolution version of the SPE3R dataset, which includes synthetic images of 103 spacecraft. Eleven of these spacecraft are held out during training to evaluate the generalization to unseen targets. Monte Carlo simulations are then used to evaluate the navigation pipeline on rendered trajectories of the held out spacecraft. The results demonstrate that learned vision pipelines as a front-end for Kalman filters provide median errors of 3.7° in attitude and 2.2% of range in ROE when navigating about unknown targets.
papers.journal_ref: 2027 IEEE Aerospace Conference, Big Sky, MT, March 6-13, 2027

papers.title: Conditional Flow Matching for Transport Between Markov Processes
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by sequence-to-sequence transport in the context time-series domain adaptation, we study the problem of transportation between trajectories of Markov processes. Given a limited number of trajectories from source distribution and the target distribution, we formulate a flow matching based algorithm which learns a transport map from the source to target trajectory distribution, while preserving the Markov structure. We show that this is consistent in the population limit and derive finite-sample error bounds under mixing time assumptions, following the analysis of classical statistical problems including regression (Nagaraj et al., 2020), principal component analysis (Kumar and Sarkar, 2023), and matrix concentration (Neeman et al., 2024) in the Markov setting. We complement that with a lower-bound construction showing that a mixing-time dependent sample complexity is unavoidable even with regular Gaussian conditional transitions. We evaluate on synthetic and real-world data. For image retrieval from electroencephalography (EEG) on THINGS-EEG2 (Gifford et al., 2022), the task is to identify the viewed image from EEG signals captured from human subjects, which suffers from high inter subject variability. We augment the ENIGMA decoder (Kneeland et al., 2026) with a conditional flow before its subject-specific temporal map. This improves mean top-5 retrieval accuracy from 43.87% to 49.05%, an 11.82% relative improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把条件流匹配 (conditional flow matching) 用到 Markov 过程轨迹之间的传输上，学习保持 Markov 结构的源到目标传输映射，并证明总体极限一致性与依赖 mixing time 的有限样本误差界。在 THINGS-EEG2 的 EEG 图像检索任务中，给 ENIGMA 解码器的 subject-specific temporal map 前插入该条件流，mean top-5 检索准确率从 43.87% 提到 49.05%，相对提升 11.82%。
Motivation: 时间序列域适应需要在源与目标轨迹分布之间做 sequence-to-sequence 传输，但直接套用静态流匹配会破坏轨迹的 Markov 结构，且样本量与 mixing time 的关系缺少理论刻画。
Method: 基于 flow matching 构造保持 Markov 结构的轨迹传输映射；沿用回归 (Nagaraj et al., 2020)、PCA (Kumar and Sarkar, 2023) 与矩阵集中 (Neeman et al., 2024) 在 Markov 设定下的分析手法，证明总体极限一致性并导出 mixing time 假设下的有限样本误差界，另给出下界构造。
Result: 下界构造表明 mixing time 相关的样本复杂度即使在规则高斯条件转移下也不可避免。在 THINGS-EEG2 (Gifford et al., 2022) 上，把条件流加到 ENIGMA 解码器 (Kneeland et al., 2026) 的 subject-specific temporal map 之前，EEG 图像检索 mean top-5 准确率由 43.87% 升至 49.05%，相对提升 11.82%；评测含合成数据与真实数据。
Conclusion: 保持 Markov 结构的流匹配传输在总体极限下一致、误差界随 mixing time 变化且该依赖不可避免，并能在高被试差异的 EEG 信号上改善跨被试图像检索。

papers.title: How Inefficient Is Natural Gradient Descent? From Exact Optimality to Θ( \sqrt{ \log d } ) Divergence
papers.abstract_en: Natural gradient descent (NGD) underlies common methods in ML. For dually flat families, idealized NGD on the forward Kullback--Leibler objective follows the mixture geodesic which is often longer than the shortest Fisher--Rao path. We quantify this overhead by the inefficiency ratio \(R \ge 1\), the Fisher length of the mixture geodesic divided by the Fisher--Rao distance, and bound its supremum over endpoint pairs as a function of the parameter dimension \(d\). A tensor criterion identifies the regime (I) families, with \(R=1\) everywhere: exactly those with quadratic potential or dimension one, such as fixed-covariance Gaussians. For non-quadratic families, we prove two further regimes: (II) bounded third-order skewness plus finite Fisher--Rao diameter yields a dimension-independent bound; and (III) for products of scale families---including Gaussian covariances and Gamma rates---\(R\) grows as \(Θ(\sqrt{\log d})\), unbounded in \(d\). Under a per-step Fisher-chord budget, \(R\) translates to a practical computational cost: NGD requires asymptotically at least \(R\) times as many steps as an optimizer following the Fisher--Rao geodesic. Experiments confirm all three regimes: \(R=1\) to machine precision for quadratic-potential families (I), the categorical bound \(π/(2\sqrt{2})\) is approached but not attained (II), and sampled scale-product \(R\) grows with \(d\), reaching \(R \approx 1.5\) for long, high-dimensional moves (III).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文为自然梯度下降 (NGD) 定义低效比 R（混合测地线的 Fisher 长度除以 Fisher–Rao 距离，R≥1），证明三类分区：二次势或一维族 R 恒为 1；有界三阶偏度加有限 Fisher–Rao 直径给出与维数无关的界；尺度族乘积（含 Gaussian 协方差、Gamma 率）下 R 随 d 增长为 Θ(√log d)。在每步 Fisher-chord 预算下，NGD 至少需要 R 倍于沿 Fisher–Rao 测地线优化器的步数。
Motivation: NGD 在对偶平坦族上沿混合测地线而非最短 Fisher–Rao 路径，路径更长带来的开销此前缺少随参数维数 d 的定量刻画。
Method: 定义低效比 R 并对其上确界随 d 给界；用张量判据刻画 R=1 的 (I) 类族（二次势或一维，如固定协方差 Gaussian）；再证 (II) 有界三阶偏度加有限 Fisher–Rao 直径、(III) 尺度族乘积两类，并以实验检验三个分区。
Result: 实验确认三个分区：(I) 二次势族 R=1 达机器精度；(II) categorical 界 π/(2√2) 被逼近但未达到；(III) 采样的尺度族乘积 R 随 d 增长，长距离高维移动下 R≈1.5。理论上 (III) 为 Θ(√log d)，对 d 无界；每步 Fisher-chord 预算下 NGD 至少需 R 倍步数。
Conclusion: NGD 的低效程度由族的几何决定：二次势族精确最优 (R=1)，而 Gaussian 协方差、Gamma 率等尺度族乘积的开销随维数以 Θ(√log d) 发散。

summary_sections.result: 实验确认三个分区：(I) 二次势族 R=1 达机器精度；(II) categorical 界 π/(2√2) 被逼近但未达到；(III) 采样的尺度族乘积 R 随 d 增长，长距离高维移动下 R≈1.5。理论上 (III) 为 Θ(√log d)，对 d 无界；每步 Fisher-chord 预算下 NGD 至少需 R 倍步数。
summary_sections.conclusion: NGD 的低效程度由族的几何决定：二次势族精确最优 (R=1)，而 Gaussian 协方差、Gamma 率等尺度族乘积的开销随维数以 Θ(√log d) 发散。

papers.title: Minimal Witness Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: ``What are the irreducible conditions that are sufficient to produce an outcome?'' is one of the most common questions that recur across computation and science. Its answers, the minimal sufficient witnesses, are what we mean by explanations, mechanisms and reasons. These problems usually ask for multiple minimal witnesses, yet standard RL methods may reveal only one solution or redundant ones. We formalize this problem as minimal-witness identification and introduce Minimal-Witness Reinforcement Learning (MWRL). MWRL takes the union of the sets certified by successful proposals sampled from the policy and credits each proposal for the coverage the group union would lose without that proposal. This credit assignment, derived directly from the problem definition, unifies the demands for minimality and recovery of alternatives from a single black-box verifier bit. Under this principle, we derive a value iteration planner that recovers the entire family of witnesses and a policy gradient method that can scale to large language models. Across different experimental settings, MWRL recovers most minimal witnesses, while other methods return redundant supersets or a single witness. By making witness families learnable from verifier feedback, MWRL expands the scope of reinforcement learning beyond single-solution optimization. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MWRL 把「找一个解」改成「找齐全部最小充分见证 (minimal sufficient witness)」：对成功 proposal 的集合取并集，再按每个 proposal 对并集覆盖的边际贡献分配信用，从而用单个黑盒 verifier bit 同时约束最小性与备选解恢复。实验中 MWRL 找回大部分最小见证，其他方法只返回冗余超集或单个见证。
Motivation: 标准 RL 面对「产生该结果的不可约充分条件」这类问题时只收敛到一个解或彼此冗余的解，无法给出完整的见证族，解释、机制与原因的多重性因此丢失。
Method: 将问题形式化为 minimal-witness identification；信用分配定义为「去掉该 proposal 后群体并集损失的覆盖」，由问题定义直接导出，仅依赖单个黑盒 verifier bit；据此推导一个能恢复整个见证族的 value iteration planner，以及一个可扩展到大语言模型的 policy gradient 方法。
Result: 在不同实验设置下，MWRL 能找回大部分最小见证，而对照方法返回冗余超集或只返回单个见证；方法可扩展到 LLM，代码发布于 github.com/TSUITUENYUE/MWRL。
Conclusion: 见证族可以从 verifier 反馈中直接学习，RL 的适用范围可从单解优化扩展到多解/全解搜索。

papers.title: TIDE 2.0: an open, model-agnostic engine for keyed de-identification of clinical notes
papers.abstract_en: Clinical notes capture most of what is documented about a patient's care, but they cannot be used for research until protected health information (PHI) is removed. De-identification is often treated as a detection problem. Detection alone is not sufficient: redaction strips clinical content along with identifiers, date blanking destroys the temporal intervals needed for longitudinal analysis, and assigning a fresh random surrogate at each occurrence breaks links between a patient's notes. We present TIDE 2.0, an MIT-licensed engine with two separable stages: an interchangeable recognizer and a keyed anonymizer. Both run on hardware the institution owns. Surrogates are generated cryptographically with no stored linkage table. Dates shift by a per-patient, interval-preserving offset; each value receives the same surrogate across all occurrences under a given key; and a release produced under a new key cannot be linked to earlier releases. We also release TIDE2-Sentry, a recognizer distilled from a large language model. On two gold-annotated corpora from two institutions, the default configuration reached span-level recall of 0.88 in-domain and 0.77 on the second institution's corpus, at precision 0.88 and 0.87. We report recall and precision per category alongside these aggregates. The engine is open source, and the recognizer is available under a gated research-use agreement, so institutions can run, inspect and extend both within their own environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TIDE 2.0 把临床文本去标识化从单纯检测拆成可替换识别器与带密钥匿名器两阶段：同一密钥下每个值跨全部出现位置共享同一替身，日期按患者级保区间偏移平移，新密钥发布无法与旧发布关联，且不存链接表。在两家机构的两份金标准语料上，默认配置 span 级召回 0.88（域内）与 0.77（第二家机构），精确率 0.88 与 0.87。
Motivation: 临床笔记是患者诊疗记录的主体，但含 PHI 不能直接用于研究；仅做检测不够——涂改会连临床内容一起删，日期置空破坏纵向分析所需时间区间，逐次随机替换会切断同一患者笔记间的链接。
Method: MIT 许可的引擎分两阶段：可互换的识别器与 keyed anonymizer，全部在机构自有硬件上运行；替身用密码学方式生成且不存链接表，日期用患者级保区间偏移，同一密钥下每个值在所有出现处取同一替身。另发布从大语言模型蒸馏的识别器 TIDE2-Sentry。
Result: 在两家机构的两份金标注语料上，默认配置 span 级召回域内 0.88、第二家机构语料 0.77，精确率分别为 0.88 与 0.87，并按类别分别报告召回与精确率。
Conclusion: 去标识化应把识别与 keyed 匿名分开：密码学替身加保区间日期偏移能在删除 PHI 的同时保留纵向分析所需的时间与跨笔记链接，且换密钥即可切断与历史发布的关联。

papers.title: Deep Learning Based Illegal Bowling Action Detection
papers.abstract_en: Cricket, often referred to as the "gentleman's game," adheres to a strict rule set for both batsmen and bowlers, where each delivery can significantly impact the match outcome. Detecting illegal bowling actions is crucial for maintaining fair play, yet it remains challenging for umpires to monitor in real time. Existing sensor-based solutions have limitations in live match scenarios, making real-time assessment difficult. This paper proposes a computer vision-based deep learning solution to detect illegal bowling actions in live cricket matches. To develop and evaluate our approach, we compiled a dataset of 62 videos featuring 11 male bowlers, capturing both legal and illegal bowling actions from multiple angles-front, back, and side. However, the dataset predominantly comprises right-handed bowlers with conventional actions. The proposed system identifies two key frames, the shoulder frame and the release frame from video footage of a bowler's delivery and analyzes the change in the bowling arm's angle between these frames. If the angle difference exceeds a predefined threshold (e.g., 15 degrees), the delivery is flagged as potentially illegal. We evaluated the system on a custom dataset and achieved a high true positive rate, suggesting the system's potential effectiveness in real-time match settings. However, further research is required to validate the system across diverse environmental conditions and larger datasets to ensure generalizability and robustness in various live match scenarios. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first AI-based computer vision method for detecting illegal bowling actions in cricket.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于计算机视觉的板球非法投球动作检测系统：从视频中定位肩部帧与释放帧，测量投球臂在两帧间的角度变化，超过预设阈值（如 15 度）即判为疑似违规。在自建的 62 段视频、11 名男性投球手数据集上取得较高真阳性率，作者称是首个 AI 计算机视觉检测板球非法投球动作的方法。
Motivation: 裁判难以在实时比赛中监控投球动作是否违规，现有传感器方案在直播场景中受限，实时评估困难。
Method: 计算机视觉深度学习流程：从投球视频中识别 shoulder frame 与 release frame 两个关键帧，计算投球臂在两帧间的角度差，与预设阈值（如 15 度）比较后标记疑似非法动作；用自建数据集（62 段视频、11 名男性投球手，正面/背面/侧面多角度）开发与评估。
Result: 在自建数据集上取得较高真阳性率 (high true positive rate)；数据集含 62 段视频、11 名男性投球手的合法与非法动作，多角度拍摄，但以右手常规动作为主。
Conclusion: 关键帧角度差阈值判别在实时比赛场景中有应用潜力，但需在更多样环境与更大数据集上验证以保证泛化性与鲁棒性。

papers.title: Data, Numbers, and Geometry: Three Tutorials on Numerical Methods, Machine Learning, and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: We present three practical tutorials on numerical computation and machine learning for mathematical research, developed for the DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry workshop held at the Banff International Research Station in April 2026. The first develops a numerical approach to exterior calculus from pointwise evaluations of differential forms, using a flux formulation of the exterior derivative. Examples in Euclidean space and on the sphere illustrate geometric identities, topological features, and the effects of approximation and finite precision. The second examines how mathematical structure guides neural network design through examples involving elliptic curves, quivers, and a boundary value problem. It explores how architectural choices affect learning and uses interval arithmetic to bound the residual of a trained network over the full interval of the boundary value problem. The third addresses the evaluation and presentation of machine learning results, covering performance metrics, statistical uncertainty, classification thresholds, receiver operating characteristic curves, and accessible figure design. Throughout, the tutorials distinguish numerical agreement, predictive accuracy, structural guarantees, and rigorous bounds as different forms of evidence. Each contribution can be read independently, with accompanying notebooks and exercises that allow readers to reproduce the examples and adapt the methods to other problems.
papers.comment: Combined notes from three tutorials presented at the DANGER: Data, Numbers, and Geometry workshop (BIRS, Banff, April 2026). Includes links to companion code, Jupyter notebooks, and exercises
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 三篇教程讲清三类证据的边界：外微积分的数值离散、数学结构引导的网络设计、以及 ML 结果的评估与呈现，并明确区分数值吻合、预测精度、结构保证与严格界这四种不同性质的证据。第二篇用区间算术对训练后网络在整个边值问题区间上给出残差的严格上界，第三篇覆盖性能指标、统计不确定性、分类阈值与 ROC 曲线。
Motivation: 数学研究中常把数值吻合、预测精度与严格证明混为一谈，读者难以判断一个结果到底属于哪一类证据；教程需要把这四类证据拆开讲清楚。
Method: 第一篇从微分形式的逐点取值出发，用外微积分的通量形式 (flux formulation) 构造数值方法，在欧氏空间与球面上演示几何恒等式、拓扑特征以及近似与有限精度的影响；第二篇以椭圆曲线、quiver 与一个边值问题为例说明结构如何引导网络设计，并用区间算术 (interval arithmetic) 界定训练网络在整个区间上的残差；第三篇讲评估与呈现，含性能指标、统计不确定性、分类阈值、ROC 曲线与可读图表设计。三部分配 Jupyter notebook 与练习。
Result: 摘要给出的是教程内容而非实验对比：三部分分别产出通量形式的外微积分数值方法、区间算术对训练网络残差的严格上界，以及一套覆盖指标、不确定性、阈值与 ROC 的评估流程；全程区分数值吻合、预测精度、结构保证与严格界四类证据。
Conclusion: 数值一致不等于预测可靠，更不等于严格保证，报告 ML 结果时应标明证据属于哪一类，并配可复现的 notebook 与练习。

papers.title: Cascadia: Resident 975B MoE Inference on Eleven AI PCs
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts models make nearly trillion-parameter capacity accessible with sparse per-token computation, provided that the serving system can distribute the weights and coordinate their execution. We present Cascadia's resident execution of Inkling, a 975B-total/41B-active-parameter model, on eleven Intel Core Ultra X7 358H AI PCs, each with 64 GB of memory, Arc B390 integrated graphics and gigabit Ethernet. We contribute a custom resident MoE engine that preserves Inkling's routing rules, constructs compressed graphs for OpenVINO's fused iGPU primitives, and coordinates FP16 expert computation with FP32 output restoration. The engine fits six consecutive decoder layers per machine and represents dense feed-forward blocks as all-active expert slices, reducing measured dense-layer call time from approximately 8.1 to 4.5 ms. A streaming pipeline coordinates concurrent generation, while captured-state draft evaluation measures agreement with the deployed numerical path. Paired measurements at fifteen concurrency levels from 1 to 176 streams reach 60.29 aggregate decode tokens/s at 88 streams, with 46.87 tokens/s over the complete serving phases. At fifteen streams, median first-token latency is 6.05 s. Raising the context budget from the 1,024-position default, real prompts of 1k to 64k tokens recover the embedded code in all 19 measured answers, with first-token time growing as $aN+bN^2$ and decode latency growing approximately linearly, both bounded by a single-threaded CPU attention loop rather than by memory, which holds 512k positions per stream. Evaluation on captured fleet states separates the effects of vocabulary selection and weight quantization on draft agreement. Together, these contributions establish an execution and evaluation approach for large sparse models on distributed client systems with shared CPU-GPU memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Cascadia 在十一台 Intel Core Ultra X7 358H AI PC（各 64GB 内存、Arc B390 核显、千兆以太网）上常驻执行 975B 总参/41B 激活参数的 MoE 模型 Inkling，用保留路由规则的常驻 MoE 引擎与 OpenVINO 融合 iGPU 图把稠密层调用从约 8.1 ms 降到 4.5 ms。在 15 档并发（1–176 流）配对测量中，88 流时聚合解码吞吐达 60.29 tokens/s，完整服务阶段 46.87 tokens/s；上下文从 1,024 默认位扩到 1k–64k 真实提示时 19 个答案全部恢复内嵌代码，首 token 时间按 aN+bN² 增长、解码延迟近线性，瓶颈是单线程 CPU attention 而非内存。
Motivation: 近万亿参数 MoE 的稀疏按 token 计算只有在服务系统能分发权重并协调执行时才可用；把这类大稀疏模型搬到共享 CPU-GPU 内存的分布式客户端系统，需要解决权重常驻、图构建与跨机协调问题。
Method: 提出常驻 MoE 引擎：保留 Inkling 的路由规则，为 OpenVINO 融合 iGPU 原语构建压缩图，以 FP16 专家计算配 FP32 输出恢复；每台机器容纳六个连续 decoder 层，把稠密前馈块表示为全激活专家切片。流式管线协调并发生成，captured-state draft 评估与已部署数值路径的一致性，并在捕获的 fleet 状态上分离词表选择与权重量化对 draft 一致性的影响。
Result: 稠密层调用时间从约 8.1 ms 降至 4.5 ms；15 档并发（1–176 流）配对测量中 88 流达 60.29 聚合 decode tokens/s，完整服务阶段 46.87 tokens/s；15 流时首 token 中位延迟 6.05 s。上下文从 1,024 默认位提升后，1k–64k 真实提示在全部 19 个测量答案中恢复内嵌代码，首 token 时间按 aN+bN² 增长、解码延迟近线性，受单线程 CPU attention 循环限制而非内存（每流可容纳 512k 位置）。
Conclusion: 大稀疏模型可以在共享 CPU-GPU 内存的分布式客户端系统上以常驻执行方式服务，当前扩展瓶颈在单线程 CPU attention 而非内存容量。

papers.title: Constant-Curvature Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein for Heterogeneous Cross-Curvature Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in representation learning have highlighted the utility of constant-curvature models, such as hyperbolic and spherical spaces, for modeling complex data. Mixed-curvature models further enhance this by integrating multiple constant-curvature components. However, these models typically learn each component space independently because spaces with different curvatures are inherently heterogeneous and lack a unified metric. Consequently, they lack explicit mechanisms to enforce geometric consistency across various spaces. Moreover, the problem of comparing probability distributions across mixed-curvature spaces remains unexplored. To compare distributions on heterogeneous spaces, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distances provide a principled framework by aligning their intra-space geometries. Building on this, we propose constant-curvature sliced Gromov-Wasserstein (CCSGW), a novel divergence for aligning distributions supported on heterogeneous constant-curvature spaces. We first introduce the missing geodesic-based one-dimensional projections for spherical spaces, and then extend sliced GW to constant-curvature spaces, enabling efficient and principled comparison across manifolds with different curvatures. This formulation preserves intrinsic geometric relationships while avoiding the high computational cost. We provide theoretical analysis showing that CCSGW controls intrinsic geometric discrepancy across heterogeneous spaces, promoting distribution-level geometric consistency. By integrating CCSGW into existing mixed-curvature learning tasks, including graph anomaly detection, graph node classification, and multimodal learning, we observe consistent performance gains across diverse settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出常曲率切片 Gromov-Wasserstein (CCSGW)，为球面空间补上缺失的测地线一维投影，再把 sliced GW 推广到不同曲率的流形上，使异质常曲率空间之间的分布比较成为可能。理论分析表明 CCSGW 控制跨空间的内在几何差异；接入图异常检测、图节点分类与多模态学习等混合曲率任务后取得一致性能提升。
Motivation: 混合曲率模型中不同曲率的分量空间因缺乏统一度量而各自独立学习，跨空间几何一致性没有显式约束，异质空间之间的分布比较问题此前未被探索。
Method: 以 Gromov-Wasserstein 对齐各空间内部几何为基础，先为球面空间引入测地线一维投影，再将 sliced GW 扩展到常曲率空间，得到 CCSGW 散度；将其作为分布级几何一致性约束接入已有的混合曲率学习任务。
Result: 在图异常检测、图节点分类与多模态学习三类混合曲率任务上均观察到一致的性能增益；理论分析给出 CCSGW 跨异质空间控制内在几何差异的结论。
Conclusion: 用切片 GW 可以在避免高计算代价的同时实现异质常曲率空间的分布级几何对齐，并可作为通用模块嵌入现有混合曲率学习框架。

papers.title: RoboCap: A New Platform for Egocentric Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Despite its promise for scaling robot learning, egocentric manipulation data is still scarce today. Collection at scale requires vertically integrating ergonomic hardware with centimeter-precise 3D algorithms, at a precision that has not been publicly demonstrated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboCap, a 250\,g six-camera dual-IMU hat designed for in-the-wild egocentric data capture, and the Grounded API, a suite of device-agnostic 3D algorithms tuned for RoboCap. In this report, we demonstrate how hardware, calibration, and 3D algorithms interact to achieve state-of-the-art performance on the public benchmarks: our SLAM across diverse settings and rigs, our depth estimation on egocentric settings, and our hand tracking when adapted to third-party devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RoboCap 提出 250 克六相机双 IMU 头戴硬件与设备无关的 Grounded API 3D 算法套件，通过硬件、标定与算法的垂直整合实现野外第一人称机器人操作数据采集，并在公开基准上达到 SOTA：跨场景与设备的 SLAM、第一人称深度估计，以及适配第三方设备后的手部跟踪。
Motivation: 第一人称 (egocentric) 机器人操作数据稀缺，规模化采集需要把符合人体工学的硬件与厘米级精度的 3D 算法垂直整合，而这种精度此前未被公开演示。
Method: RoboCap 头戴硬件含六个相机与两个 IMU，重 250 克，用于野外第一人称数据采集；配套 Grounded API 提供设备无关的 3D 算法（SLAM、深度估计、手部跟踪），并针对 RoboCap 调优，手部跟踪可适配第三方设备。
Result: 在公开基准上达到 state-of-the-art：跨多样场景与设备的 SLAM、第一人称场景深度估计，以及适配第三方设备后的手部跟踪；硬件规格为 250 克、六相机、双 IMU。
Conclusion: 硬件、标定与 3D 算法的垂直整合是把第一人称机器人操作数据采集推到厘米级精度并公开演示的可行路径，且算法套件可跨设备复用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Reward-Driven Learning under Prompt-Level Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model on problems that may themselves be confidential, and the trained model can reveal which problems it saw. We study RLVR under prompt-level differential privacy: the released weights must be (ε,δ)-differentially private with respect to the presence of any one training problem. Taking the group of responses to one prompt as the privacy record, our method aggregates their gradients, clips the prompt's contribution once, adds Gaussian noise, and composes the privacy loss across updates, so the budget depends on neither the number of responses per prompt nor the clipping norm; to our knowledge this is the first differential privacy guarantee for RLVR training. We train Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct with LoRA at a per-run budget of ε=8 and compare, on the same prompts and at the same budget, a control that removes only the reward signal and two private supervised fine-tuning recipes. The reward signal improves accuracy over the control by 2.65 points on MATH and 3.24 on GSM8K, in every seed; the improvement survives a format-robust scorer, at 1.3 points on MATH, and is not explained by response length. At the same budget the private model outperforms both supervised recipes on MATH and GSM8K by 2.3 to 3.8 points, retains 85--90% of the gain of non-private GRPO on these tasks, and on MATH the noise of an eightfold tighter budget costs at most 1.2 points. The reward effect also carries to CommonsenseQA, an exploratory non-mathematical task. Verifier feedback thus remains a usable learning signal under prompt-level privacy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 prompt 级差分隐私 (prompt-level DP) 下训练带可验证奖励的 RLVR：把同一 prompt 的多条响应梯度聚合后只裁剪一次、加高斯噪声并跨更新组合隐私损失，使预算与每 prompt 响应数和裁剪范数无关。用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct + LoRA 在 ε=8 下，奖励信号相对去奖励对照在 MATH 提升 2.65 点、GSM8K 提升 3.24 点，且保留非私有 GRPO 增益的 85–90%。
Motivation: RLVR 的训练题目本身可能保密，而已发布模型权重会泄露它见过哪些题目；现有 RLVR 训练缺少针对单条训练题目在场性的 (ε,δ)-DP 保证。
Method: 以一个 prompt 的整组响应作为隐私记录：聚合该 prompt 的梯度、对该贡献做一次裁剪、加高斯噪声，并在多次更新间做隐私损失组合，使预算不依赖每 prompt 响应数与裁剪范数。训练用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 加 LoRA，单次运行预算 ε=8；对照为仅移除奖励信号的控制组与两种私有 SFT 配方。
Result: 奖励信号相对对照在 MATH 提升 2.65 点、GSM8K 提升 3.24 点，且每个 seed 都成立；换用 format-robust scorer 后 MATH 仍提升 1.3 点，且提升不能由响应长度解释。同预算下私有模型在 MATH 与 GSM8K 上比两种私有 SFT 配方高 2.3–3.8 点，保留非私有 GRPO 增益的 85–90%；在 MATH 上把预算收紧八倍最多损失 1.2 点。奖励效应在 CommonsenseQA 上同样成立。
Conclusion: 在 prompt 级隐私预算下，verifier 反馈仍是可用的学习信号：RLVR 的奖励增益在差分隐私约束下大部分保留，且优于同预算的私有监督微调。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: An overview of machine learning-enhanced iterative methods for systems of linear and nonlinear equations
papers.abstract_en: Systems of equations arise in a wide range of scientific and engineering applications. The present work focuses on solvers for general systems of equations, including but not limited to those arising from partial differential equations. These systems can be broadly categorized into linear and nonlinear problems. For large linear systems, iterative solvers are generally preferred over direct methods due to the latter's superlinear growth of computational costs. Although convergence theory is well-developed under certain assumptions on the coefficient matrix, many classes of systems still pose open challenges. These difficulties become even more severe for systems of nonlinear equations, where nonlinear solvers typically rely on repeated linearization. For example, Newton's method may even converge quadratically near the solution; it can also converge slowly or diverge when the initial guess is not chosen appropriately. A wide range of solvers with diverse variants and hyperparameter settings exists, and the development of efficient and robust iterative methods remains an active area of research. Recently, machine learning (ML) techniques have been applied to enhance the efficiency of classical iterative methods while preserving their interpretability and reliability. We refer to these ML-enhanced iterative methods as hybrid iterative methods, in the sense that they combine classical iterative methods with ML. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of state-of-the-art approaches to constructing hybrid iterative methods for systems of both linear and nonlinear equations, while also discussing open challenges and outlining potential directions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 综述把「机器学习增强的迭代法」定义为 hybrid iterative methods：在保留经典迭代解算器可解释性与可靠性的前提下用 ML 提升求解效率，覆盖线性与非线性方程组的主流构造路线，并指出收敛理论与非线性情形的开放问题。
Motivation: 大型线性系统用直接法代价超线性增长，迭代法收敛理论只在系数矩阵特定假设下成熟，许多系统类仍是开放问题；非线性系统依赖反复线性化，Newton 法初值选不当会收敛很慢甚至发散。
Method: 以综述形式系统梳理构造 hybrid iterative methods 的现有方法：分别针对线性与非线性方程组，归纳 ML 如何嵌入经典迭代解算器（含超参设置与变体），并结合 Newton 法等非线性求解器讨论其作用位置。
Result: 给出线性与非线性方程组的 ML 增强迭代法的全面综述，讨论开放挑战并展望后续研究方向；文中指出 Newton 法在解附近可二次收敛，但初值不当时可能收敛缓慢或发散。
Conclusion: ML 与经典迭代法结合可在保持可解释性与可靠性的同时提升求解效率，是当前仍活跃的研究方向，非线性情形与更广系统类的收敛理论尚存开放问题。
Relevance: 18

summary_sections.result: 给出线性与非线性方程组的 ML 增强迭代法的全面综述，讨论开放挑战并展望后续研究方向；文中指出 Newton 法在解附近可二次收敛，但初值不当时可能收敛缓慢或发散。
summary_sections.conclusion: ML 与经典迭代法结合可在保持可解释性与可靠性的同时提升求解效率，是当前仍活跃的研究方向，非线性情形与更广系统类的收敛理论尚存开放问题。

papers.title: Can LLM-assisted regularization increase forecast accuracy for migration flows in low data regimes?
papers.abstract_en: Predicting migration flows remains a significant challenge for traditional gravity-based forecasting models, which primarily rely on structured socio-economic indicators such as economic disparity, political stability, and geographic distance. This work investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can improve migration forecasting by extracting contextual migration-related signals from news articles and incorporating them into a weighted Lasso forecasting framework through feature-specific regularization penalties. The proposed framework uses hierarchical LLM inference pipelines to classify migration-related push--pull signals from news data and evaluates the resulting forecasting performance across multiple migration corridors between November 2021 and November 2022, including Mexico--United States, Ukraine--Poland, and Syria--Turkey. Experimental results showed mixed performance across migration corridors and modeling strategies, and no single regularization approach consistently outperformed the others across all experiments. The best-performing Mexico configuration, which consisted of a gravity-based model augmented with the proposed push--pull ratios, achieved a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 17.15%, while the strongest Syria configuration achieved a MAPE of 29.29% using Direct LLM-Lasso. For Ukraine, the best-performing configuration used LLM-Assisted Regularization (AR) and achieved a MAPE of 41.05%. Overall, the results suggest that contextual article-derived features and LLM-guided regularization can improve migration forecasting under certain conditions, although migration corridor characteristics, article volume, and hyperparameter configuration strongly influenced performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用 LLM 从新闻中抽取迁移推拉信号，作为特征级正则化惩罚加入加权 Lasso 迁移流量预测。在 2021-11 至 2022-11 的多条迁移走廊上结果混合：墨西哥最优配置（重力模型+推拉比）MAPE 17.15%，叙利亚 Direct LLM-Lasso 29.29%，乌克兰 LLM-Assisted Regularization 41.05%，无单一正则化方法在全部实验中稳定胜出。
Motivation: 基于重力的迁移预测依赖经济差距、政治稳定、地理距离等结构化社会经济指标，缺少对时变情境信号的利用，低数据场景下预测精度受限。
Method: 用分层 LLM 推理管线 (hierarchical LLM inference pipelines) 从新闻文章分类迁移相关 push–pull 信号，将所得特征以特征级正则化惩罚 (feature-specific regularization penalties) 引入加权 Lasso 预测框架，并比较多种正则化策略。
Result: 在 Mexico–United States、Ukraine–Poland、Syria–Turkey 走廊（2021-11 至 2022-11）上：墨西哥最优配置（重力模型+push–pull 比）MAPE 17.15%；叙利亚最强配置为 Direct LLM-Lasso，MAPE 29.29%；乌克兰最优配置为 LLM-Assisted Regularization (AR)，MAPE 41.05%。各走廊与建模策略结果混合，无单一正则化方法在所有实验中一致最优。

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Mixture-of-Experts Training
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs. We propose Distributionally Robust MoE Training (DRMoET), a drop-in objective that treats layer-wise experts as endogenous robustness groups and optimizes high-loss routing outcomes rather than merely equalizing traffic. DRMoET updates a per-layer expert distribution by an entropy-regularized softmax rule on EMA-smoothed, activation-weighted expert losses, strengthening plausible non-top routing paths while preserving standard MoE computation. Under the FLAME-MoE recipe at 746M-total and 10.3B-total scales, DRMoET improves downstream averages over both standard FLAME-MoE and auxiliary-loss-free balancing. At 10.3B total parameters and 67B training tokens, DRMoET improves the seven-task average from 0.6625 to 0.6767, while the auxiliary-loss-free baseline achieves 0.6431. Mechanistic analyses show lower expert-loss variance with nearly unchanged mean loss, 4.3% lower excess loss under forced mid-$k$ misrouting, and improved domain-expert specialization. These results position routing robustness-not only utilization balance-as a practical objective for reliable sparse MoE scaling. Project page and code are available at: https://drmoet.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DRMoET 把 MoE 各层专家当作内生的鲁棒性分组，用 EMA 平滑、激活加权的专家损失做熵正则 softmax 更新每层专家分布，专门优化高损失的路由结果而非仅均衡流量。在 10.3B 总参数、67B token 的 FLAME-MoE 配方下，七任务平均分从 0.6625 提到 0.6767（auxiliary-loss-free 基线 0.6431），强制 mid-k 误路由的 excess loss 降低 4.3%。
Motivation: 稀疏 MoE 只激活每 token 少数专家，路由不完美时负载均衡的模型会把 token 送进训练不足的专家，只调 traffic 均衡解决不了这一可靠性问题。
Method: DRMoET 是一个可直接替换的训练目标：把逐层专家视为内生鲁棒性分组，按 EMA 平滑、激活加权的专家损失用熵正则 softmax 更新每层专家分布，强化 plausible 的非 top 路由路径，同时保持标准 MoE 计算不变；训练配方沿用 FLAME-MoE，规模为 746M 与 10.3B 总参数。
Result: 10.3B 总参数、67B 训练 token 下七任务平均从 0.6625 提升到 0.6767，auxiliary-loss-free 基线为 0.6431；746M 与 10.3B 两个规模上下游平均均高于标准 FLAME-MoE 与 auxiliary-loss-free balancing。机制分析显示专家损失方差下降而均值几乎不变，强制 mid-k 误路由下 excess loss 低 4.3%，domain-expert specialization 改善。
Conclusion: 路由鲁棒性（而不只是利用率均衡）应作为稀疏 MoE 可靠扩展的直接优化目标，且 DRMoET 可作为 drop-in 目标接入现有 MoE 训练。

papers.title: Energy-Conditioned Noise Schedule and Whitening for Spectral Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces an energy-adaptive noise scheduling and whitening strategy for transform-domain diffusion models. Existing spectral diffusion methods account for the non-uniform statistics of transform coefficients through coefficient scaling, normalization, or frequency prioritization, while the forward diffusion noise schedule remains largely independent of the underlying spectral-energy distribution. We investigate whether the temporal evolution of the forward diffusion process should also follow the spectral organization of natural images. The proposed formulation combines global spectral whitening with energy-conditioned noise allocation that jointly modulates the injected noise according to the energy of individual transform coefficients and an image-dependent energy path over diffusion time. The resulting forward process preserves Gaussian transitions with closed-form marginals and remains compatible with standard DDPM and DDIM procedures without modifying the diffusion architecture. Experiments on CIFAR-10 demonstrate the contribution of the proposed energy-conditioned noise schedule and spectral whitening, reducing Fréchet Inception Distance from 142.48 for a compact DCTdiff U-Net variant to 100.45.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, Manuscript submitted for publication in Elsevier Pattern Recognition Letters
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对变换域扩散，提出能量自适应噪声调度与谱白化：前向扩散注入的噪声量按各变换系数的能量和随时间的图像能量路径联合调制，同时保持高斯转移与闭式边缘分布，可直接套用标准 DDPM/DDIM 而不改架构。在 CIFAR-10 上，紧凑型 DCTdiff U-Net 变体的 Fréchet Inception Distance 从 142.48 降到 100.45。
Motivation: 现有谱扩散方法只用系数缩放、归一化或频率优先级处理变换系数的非均匀统计，前向扩散噪声调度却与谱能量分布无关，前向过程的时间演化未跟随自然图像的谱组织。
Method: 组合全局谱白化与能量条件噪声分配：按单个变换系数的能量以及随扩散时间的图像依赖能量路径联合调制注入噪声；前向过程保持高斯转移与闭式边缘，兼容标准 DDPM 和 DDIM，不修改扩散架构。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 上，紧凑型 DCTdiff U-Net 变体的 Fréchet Inception Distance 由 142.48 降至 100.45，消融显示能量条件噪声调度与谱白化各自有贡献。
Conclusion: 前向扩散的噪声调度应跟随谱能量组织，能量条件噪声分配加谱白化能在不改扩散架构的前提下降低生成 FID。

papers.title: Responsible Institutional Analytics: Interpreting Bias with AI Support
papers.abstract_en: Institutional Analytics (IA) dashboards inform decision-making in higher education, yet data limitations, constraints in analytical techniques, and missing contextual information often affect their interpretation. To support more responsible interpretation of IA, we introduce FACTRIA, a framework that organizes potential biasing factors across four areas: the analytics pipeline, institutional context, course-level characteristics, and demographics. We used the FACTRIA framework as input to a generative-AI chatbot designed to prompt users to reflect on these factors while analyzing IA. A qualitative study with stakeholders, drawing on four authentic IA cases, and a transition network analysis showed that the chatbot prompted participants to recognize how overlooked factors influenced their initial interpretation. Findings indicated that combining a structured framework with AI-based guidance can enhance context-aware, responsible interpretation of institutional data.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Universal Computer Science (J.UCS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FACTRIA 把高等教育 Institutional Analytics 仪表盘中的潜在偏差因素组织成分析流水线、机构情境、课程特征、人口统计四个维度，并以此驱动一个生成式 AI 聊天机器人，引导用户在解读数据时主动反思这些因素。基于四个真实 IA 案例的质性研究与 transition network analysis 显示，参与者由此认识到被忽略因素如何影响其最初解读。
Motivation: 高等教育 IA 仪表盘受数据局限、分析技术约束与情境信息缺失影响，解读容易忽略偏差因素，需要结构化框架支撑更负责任的解读。
Method: 提出 FACTRIA 框架，跨四个维度组织潜在偏差因素；将其作为输入驱动一个生成式 AI 聊天机器人，在用户分析 IA 时提示其反思这些因素；以利益相关者为对象开展质性研究，使用四个真实 IA 案例并结合 transition network analysis 分析参与者的解读转变。
Result: 质性研究覆盖四个真实 IA 案例，transition network analysis 显示聊天促使参与者认识到被忽略因素对其初始解读的影响；结构化框架与 AI 引导结合可增强对机构数据的情境感知、负责任解读。
Conclusion: 结构化偏差框架加 AI 引导能提升对机构数据的情境化、负责任解读，适用于高等教育 IA 场景。

papers.title: SPEAR: Five Principles for Interactive Human-Agent Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI alignment work often frames alignment as a pre-deployment optimization problem: collect human feedback, learn preferences or principles, finetune the model, and deploy an aligned system. This framing has produced major progress, but it under-specifies what happens once AI systems act as agents on users' behalf in situated, long-term, and social contexts. This position paper reframes human-agent alignment as an ongoing interaction design problem. We propose SPEAR, five pillars of interactive alignment: Specification (how people express intent and establish shared understanding), Process (how agents decide when to act, ask, defer, or pause), Evaluation (how people judge whether agents succeeded), Adaptation (how agents adapt to users over repeated use), and Recalibration (how people adapt their trust, expectations, and behavior in response to agents).
papers.comment: 3 pages. Best Talk Award at the ACM Conference on Human-AI Complementarity and Alignment (HCOMP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPEAR 把人机对齐从「部署前优化」重构成持续的交互设计问题，提出五个支柱：Specification（表达意图与建立共同理解）、Process（决定何时行动/询问/让位/暂停）、Evaluation（判断成败）、Adaptation（跨重复使用适应用户）、Recalibration（用户相应调整信任与期望）。
Motivation: 现有对齐框架把对齐当作收集反馈、学偏好、微调、部署的一次性流程，但对 AI 作为代理在情境化、长期、社会性场景中替用户行事时会发生什么规定不足。
Method: 立场论文 (position paper)，以概念重构方式提出 SPEAR 五支柱框架，逐一支配交互式人机对齐的设计与研究维度，不涉及模型训练或实验管线。
Result: 提出 SPEAR 五支柱：Specification、Process、Evaluation、Adaptation、Recalibration，作为交互式人机对齐的结构化分解；摘要未给出实验数字。
Conclusion: 人机对齐应被当作贯穿部署后长期交互的持续设计问题，而非一次性的部署前优化步骤。

papers.title: Exact Unlearning via Quantized Sufficient Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Exact unlearning requires a deployed predictor to match one rebuilt without the information named by a deletion request. Existing general-purpose exact methods localize retraining through disjoint shards, but every request still invalidates a model, and smaller shards reduce the data available to each constituent predictor. We introduce Quantized Sufficient Statistics (QSS), which separates a small frozen schema from mutable, sum-decomposable content. The schema learns global structure; the content stores local prediction corrections as additive statistics indexed by quantized regions. Deleting content is therefore exact subtraction rather than optimization. We distinguish two guarantees: QSS-L exactly removes a label while retaining the unlabelled input, whereas QSS-E exactly removes both input and label by learning the schema without deletable examples. A deletion takes the arithmetic fast path with probability $1-ρ$ and triggers a full rebuild with probability $ρ$; all reported expected latencies include both events. Across 15 vision, text, and tabular datasets at $ρ=0.5\%$, QSS-L is within 2 percentage points of SISA on 11 tasks and provides 4--483$\times$ lower expected deletion latency on the low-class-count tasks where a compact schema is effective. QSS-E quantifies the additional accuracy cost of removing every trace of an input.

papers.title: Learning Disentangled Representations with Quantum Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders are powerful representation learning models that map complex data into low-dimensional latent spaces, enabling the discovery of interpretable and disentangled factors. Such representations can facilitate the interpretation and controllable generation of data describing complex scientific systems. Understanding how these factors are organized and encoded in latent space is therefore important for developing reliable representation learning models. Recently, quantum variational autoencoders (QVAEs) have been proposed as quantum representation models, demonstrating informative latent representations and improved latent-space occupancy through quantum regularization. However, it remains unclear whether and how QVAEs can learn disentangled and interpretable latent factors. A key challenge in investigating quantum latent factors is that a small number of qubits spans an exponentially large Hilbert space, making the notion of an individual quantum latent dimension nontrivial. Here, we investigate what constitutes an individual quantum latent dimension and whether it can encode a distinct factor. We develop theoretical insights into quantum latent dimensions and support them with empirical studies on representative synthetic problems, including MNIST variants. Across three datasets, we demonstrate that QVAEs can discover factorized and semantically interpretable latent representations, with individual qubits functioning as meaningful latent factors. These results establish a foundation for understanding quantum latent spaces and their potential for structured and interpretable representation learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出量子变分自编码器 (QVAE) 的潜在维度判据：在少量 qubit 却跨越指数大 Hilbert 空间的前提下，界定何为一个独立的量子潜在维度。在含 MNIST 变体的三个代表性合成数据集上，单个 qubit 可作为语义可解释、彼此因子化的潜在因子，说明 QVAE 能学到解耦表示。
Motivation: QVAE 已被提出作为量子表示模型并展示量子正则化带来的潜在空间占用改善，但 QVAE 能否学到解耦且可解释的潜在因子仍不清楚；且少量 qubit 对应指数大 Hilbert 空间，使“单个量子潜在维度”的定义本身成为非平凡问题。
Method: 先从理论上刻画什么构成一个独立的量子潜在维度、以及它能否编码一个独立因子，再在代表性合成问题（含 MNIST 变体）上做实证研究验证这些理论洞见，共覆盖三个数据集。
Result: 在三个数据集上，QVAE 学到因子化且语义可解释的潜在表示，单个 qubit 充当有意义的潜在因子；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 量子潜在维度可以被界定为可承载独立因子的单位，QVAE 因此具备结构化、可解释表示学习的基础，但该结论目前建立在合成数据集上。

papers.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments Using an Ackermann-Steered Mobile Robot
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) enables robots to navigate through environments using natural language instructions, making human-robot interaction intuitive. Traditional VLN models often rely on navigation graphs, 360-degree views, and perfect localization which pose significant challenges when adapting these models to real-world settings. This work addresses these limitations by performing a simulation-to-real domain shift of a VLN approach that operates in continuous environments without requiring navigation graphs or panoramic views. The proposed system integrates vision-language models that align visual inputs and linguistic instructions within a shared embedding space, facilitating natural language-driven navigation. We employ a Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) based architecture trained on an existing dataset in a simulated environment and fine-tune it using real-world data collected from a custom-built Ackermann-steered robot equipped with a camera and a LiDAR sensor. By utilising linear photometric adjustments and fine-tuning on a limited number of episodes, our model successfully adapts to real-world environments, achieving effective navigation while running offline on dedicated hardware. Experimental results, evaluated using Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) and Normalized Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) metrics, demonstrate the robustness and adaptability of our approach. Keywords: Vision-Language Navigation, Cross-Modal Attention, Natural Language Instructions, Sim-to-Real Transfer, Autonomous Navigation, Ackermann-steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把连续环境中的视觉-语言导航 (VLN) 从仿真迁移到实机：用 Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) 在仿真数据集上训练，再靠线性光度调整与少量 episode 微调适配自建 Ackermann 转向机器人（相机 + LiDAR），在离线专用硬件上完成导航。以 SPL 与 nDTW 评估，结果体现方法的鲁棒性与可迁移性。
Motivation: 传统 VLN 依赖导航图、360 度全景视图与精确定位，难以直接搬到真实机器人；连续环境下的 sim-to-real 域偏移是主要障碍。
Method: 视觉-语言模型把图像与自然语言指令对齐到共享嵌入空间，采用 Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) 架构在现有仿真数据集上训练；随后用自建 Ackermann 转向机器人（相机 + LiDAR）采集的真实数据做微调，并施加线性光度调整 (linear photometric adjustments)，仅用少量 episode 完成适配，系统离线运行在专用硬件上。
Result: 实验以 Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) 与 Normalized Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) 两个指标评估，显示该方法在真实环境中实现有效导航并具备鲁棒性与适应性；适配只用了有限数量的 episode。
Conclusion: 不依赖导航图与全景视图的连续环境 VLN，可以通过光度调整加少量真实 episode 微调完成 sim-to-real 迁移，并在离线硬件上运行。

papers.title: Agentic Design Space Exploration for Joint Hardware Configuration Selection and Mapping of AI Inference Workloads on Heterogeneous Edge SoCs
papers.abstract_en: Modern edge Systems-on-Chip (SoCs) integrate heterogeneous processing units (PUs) such as CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, each with distinct performance and energy characteristics. Deploying AI inference workloads on them under real-time latency and energy constraints requires jointly mapping workloads to PUs and configuring each PU (e.g., selecting the number of active cores and the operating frequency). This joint space grows combinatorially, making exhaustive search infeasible. Most prior work on design space exploration (DSE) applies black-box optimization (BBO) such as evolutionary search, where each evaluation returns only aggregate metrics such as latency and energy. Recent LLM-guided DSE relies on the same sparse feedback. We observe that this limits its efficiency: it offers no insight into the design space or the reasons a design choice performs the way it does, and it leaves the reasoning abilities of LLMs largely unused. We present TraceDSE, an agentic DSE flow that performs joint workload mapping and PU configuration selection for AI inference on heterogeneous SoCs. TraceDSE is an iterative proposer-critic loop driven by richer feedback in the form of system execution traces. The LLM proposer agent generates candidate mappings and PU configurations for hardware evaluation. The LLM critic agent, equipped with programmatic trace-analysis tools, analyzes the traces to identify bottlenecks and suggest targeted refinements. This loop yields deeper insight into each design point, higher-quality decisions, and a more effective search. Across four AI inference workloads (models of varying complexity and a multi-model pipeline) on an Intel Meteor Lake SoC, TraceDSE consistently outperforms two state-of-the-art BBO tools, improving Pareto frontier hypervolume by up to 35% over NSGA-II and up to 68% over Bayesian optimization, while requiring ~6-9x fewer hardware evaluations.
papers.comment: Published at the 2026 ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Machine Learning for CAD (MLCAD '26), Jeju Island, Republic of Korea, September 7-9, 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Machine Learning for CAD (MLCAD '26), September 7-9, 2026, Jeju Island, Republic of Korea. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 8 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraceDSE 用 LLM proposer-critic 迭代环做异构边缘 SoC 上 AI 推理负载的联合任务映射与 PU 配置选择，把系统执行轨迹作为比延迟/能耗标量更丰富的反馈。在 Intel Meteor Lake 上四个推理负载中，Pareto 前沿 hypervolume 相对 NSGA-II 最多提升 35%、相对贝叶斯优化最多 68%，硬件评估次数少约 6–9 倍。
Motivation: 异构 SoC 上工作负载映射与核数/频率配置的联合设计空间组合爆炸，穷举不可行；既有黑盒优化与 LLM 引导 DSE 只拿到延迟、能耗这类聚合指标，无法解释设计点为何好，LLM 的推理能力基本闲置。
Method: TraceDSE 是迭代 proposer-critic 环：LLM proposer 生成候选映射与 PU 配置交硬件评估，LLM critic 配备程序化 trace 分析工具读取系统执行轨迹、定位瓶颈并给出针对性修正建议，以此替代仅含聚合指标的稀疏反馈。
Result: 在 Intel Meteor Lake SoC 上覆盖四个 AI 推理负载（不同复杂度的模型与一个多模型 pipeline），相对 NSGA-II 的 Pareto 前沿 hypervolume 最多提升 35%，相对贝叶斯优化最多提升 68%，所需硬件评估次数少约 6–9 倍。
Conclusion: 把执行轨迹而非聚合指标喂给 LLM critic，能让联合映射与配置搜索用更少评估拿到更高质量的设计点，作者称该流程在四个负载上一致优于两个 SOTA BBO 工具。
Relevance: 2
