papers.title: Poisson empirical Bayes estimation of sums of random variables via minimum-distance methods
papers.abstract_en: The estimation of sums of functions of observable and unobservable variables is a long-standing problem in statistics, with applications in many domains. We consider this problem in Poisson mixture models, where empirical Bayes provides a natural framework but nonparametric theory remains limited. We develop a nonparametric empirical Bayes methodology based on regular and coarsened minimum-distance estimation of the unknown mixing distribution. For a broad class of such sums, we establish large-sample guarantees showing that the resulting plug-in estimates asymptotically merge with the oracle Bayes estimate. In particular, when the mixing distribution has finite support, we obtain a nearly parametric convergence rate, up to a logarithmic factor. We then provide a finite-sample analysis of two representative sums: the total intensity among units whose observed count does not exceed a fixed threshold, and the number of units whose observed count exceeds their latent intensity. For the total-intensity sum, we establish a lower bound on the minimax regret and derive upper bounds for both regular and coarsened minimum-distance procedures under compact-support and subexponential assumptions on the mixing distribution. These upper bounds match the minimax rate up to logarithmic factors, with the coarsened procedure in the compact-support setting matching the rate exactly when the coarsening level is fixed. The above-average sum displays a markedly different behavior: a lower bound on the minimax regret shows that bounded regret is in general impossible to achieve. We identify additional stability conditions under which bounded regret can be recovered up to logarithmic factors, and show that these conditions are automatically satisfied when the mixing distribution has finite support. Numerical experiments on both synthetic and real data illustrate the performance of the proposed methodology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Poisson 混合模型中用正则与 coarsened 最小距离法 (minimum-distance estimation) 估计混合分布，再做 plug-in 经验贝叶斯估计。对一大类可观测/不可观测量之和证明 plug-in 估计渐近收敛到 oracle Bayes 估计；混合分布有限支撑时达到近参数收敛速率（仅差一个对数因子）。
Motivation: Poisson 混合模型下经验贝叶斯估计函数之和是长期问题，但非参数理论仍有限，缺少大样本保证与有限样本 regret 分析。
Method: 对未知混合分布做正则与 coarsened 最小距离估计，得到 plug-in 经验贝叶斯估计；对两类代表性和（观测计数不超过阈值的单元总强度、观测计数超过潜在强度的单元数）做有限样本分析，给出 minimax regret 下界与上界，并在合成与真实数据上做数值实验。
Result: 大样本下 plug-in 估计渐近合并于 oracle Bayes 估计；混合分布有限支撑时收敛速率近参数（差一个对数因子）。总强度和的上界在紧支撑与次指数假设下匹配 minimax 率至多差对数因子，coarsened 程序在紧支撑且 coarsening 水平固定时精确匹配该率。above-average 和的 minimax regret 下界表明一般无法达到有界 regret，但在附加稳定性条件下可恢复至差对数因子，且有限支撑时这些条件自动满足。
Conclusion: 最小距离型经验贝叶斯对总强度类和可逼近 minimax 率，而 above-average 类和本质上更难，需额外稳定性条件（有限支撑即满足）才能有界 regret。

summary_sections.result: 大样本下 plug-in 估计渐近合并于 oracle Bayes 估计；混合分布有限支撑时收敛速率近参数（差一个对数因子）。总强度和的上界在紧支撑与次指数假设下匹配 minimax 率至多差对数因子，coarsened 程序在紧支撑且 coarsening 水平固定时精确匹配该率。above-average 和的 minimax regret 下界表明一般无法达到有界 regret，但在附加稳定性条件下可恢复至差对数因子，且有限支撑时这些条件自动满足。
summary_sections.conclusion: 最小距离型经验贝叶斯对总强度类和可逼近 minimax 率，而 above-average 类和本质上更难，需额外稳定性条件（有限支撑即满足）才能有界 regret。

papers.title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in building AI systems for scientific research is enabling $\textit{scientific exploration}$: the systematic process of investigating unknown phenomena or ideas to gain new knowledge through sequences of research decisions and actions. Yet this process is largely missing from existing scientific corpora; for example, research papers primarily record final outcomes rather than the trajectories that produced them. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{ResearchTrails}$, a dataset of $\textbf{human research trajectories constructed from Git repositories}$, where $\textbf{commit histories}$ serve as proxies for research exploration. We develop an automated and scalable pipeline that extracts structured research trajectories from repository commits, capturing successive changes to methods, experiments, and ablations. We characterize the resulting dataset and show that these trajectories contain meaningful signals about intermediate research decisions beyond what final papers reveal. We further demonstrate utilities of ResearchTrails in multiple use cases, including retrieving human research experience as external skills at test time and training models on research trajectories to improve generalization to new research decisions. Our results suggest a path toward AI systems that learn not only from the products of science, but from the evolving process of discovery itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ResearchTrails 用 Git 仓库的 commit 历史作为科研探索轨迹的代理，通过自动化流水线抽取结构化轨迹，记录方法、实验与消融的连续改动。作者证明这些轨迹携带论文正文之外的中间决策信号，既可在测试时作为外部技能检索，也可用于训练模型以提升对新科研决策的泛化。
Motivation: 现有科学语料几乎只记录论文最终结论，丢失了产生结论的研究决策序列，使 AI 系统无法学习科学探索的过程本身。
Method: 构建 ResearchTrails 数据集：以仓库 commit 历史为代理，用可扩展的自动化流水线从提交中抽取结构化研究轨迹，刻画方法、实验与消融的连续变化；随后做两类用例——测试时检索人类研究经验作为外部技能，以及在轨迹上训练模型。
Result: 轨迹中含有超出最终论文所能揭示的中间研究决策信号；在检索外部技能与轨迹训练两个用例上展示了用途，可提升模型对新研究决策的泛化。
Conclusion: AI 系统可以从科学发现的动态过程而非仅从论文产物中学习，Git 提交历史是一条可行的轨迹来源。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: An open contrastive decision model is near chance as a judge on the hard public benchmarks: Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B scores between 0.351 (best- of-four, chance 0.250) and 0.593 (pairwise, chance 0.500), is statistically indistinguishable from coin flipping on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and answers every HaluEval item with one constant label, matching the trivial always-first baseline at 0.581. Judges with the same parameter count score far higher everywhere: a reward model reaches 0.764 to 0.976 and a generative judge 0.611 to 0.778, and every gap to CLM is significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Two properties do work. Raw confidences are overconfident by up to +0.401, yet one pooled temperature fit on held-out calibration items repairs expected calibration error to at most 0.062, and the repaired confidence ranks the model's own errors above chance on three of six benchmarks. The decision order-flip rate is 0.0002 against 0.2188 for the generative judge, and the length-preference shift is -0.023 against -0.217. The confidence-gated cascade, however, escalates between 0.923 and 1.000 of items to the strong judge at the preregistered 0.97 retention bar: calibrated confidence about a near-chance judge has almost nothing to keep. The design: five public preference benchmarks and one hallucination benchmark with real labels, scored under a preregistration frozen before any test item was seen, against generative, reward-model, and trivial baselines, with per-item predictions released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CLM-as-a-Judge 评测开源对比决策模型 Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B 作为评判器的可靠性：在公开基准上接近随机水平（best-of-four 0.351、pairwise 0.593），在 RM-Bench 与 JudgeBench 上与掷硬币无统计差异，HaluEval 全部输出同一标签（0.581，与 always-first 基线持平）。温度校准可把 ECE 修到 ≤0.062，但置信度门控级联在 0.97 保留阈值下仍需把 0.923–1.000 的样本上抛给强评判器。
Motivation: 开源对比决策模型能否充当 LLM 评判器尚无严格检验；公开 judge 基准上其判别力与校准性是否足以支撑置信度门控级联，是部署前必须回答的问题。
Method: 在五个公开偏好基准与一个带真实标签的 hallucination 基准（HaluEval）上评测 CLM-v0.1-8B，采用测试项前冻结的预注册评分协议，对比 generative judge、reward model 与 trivial 基线；用 held-out 校准项拟合单一 pooled temperature 修复置信度，并按 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正做显著性检验，逐项预测公开发布。
Result: CLM best-of-four 0.351（随机 0.250）、pairwise 0.593（随机 0.500）；HaluEval 恒定标签得分 0.581 与 always-first 基线持平；同参数量 reward model 达 0.764–0.976、generative judge 达 0.611–0.778，与 CLM 的差距经 BH 校正后全部显著。原始置信度过度自信最多 +0.401，单一温度拟合后 ECE ≤0.062，修复后置信度在六个基准中的三个上高于随机地排序出自身错误；决策 order-flip 率 0.0002（generative judge 0.2188），长度偏好偏移 -0.023（generative judge -0.217）。0.97 保留阈值下级联上抛 0.923–1.000 的样本。
Conclusion: 对近随机水平的评判器，校准后的置信度几乎没有可保留的样本，置信度门控级联在此类模型上失效；判别力而非校准是充当 judge 的先决条件。

papers.title: CALR: Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning via Render-of-Thought Compression
papers.abstract_en: Visual latent reasoning compresses rendered derivations into compact intermediate states, reducing textual reasoning overhead. Existing approaches differ in how they represent these states: continuous methods avoid vocabulary constraints, whereas discrete methods improve accuracy through quantization into a finite codebook. Our analysis of representative continuous and discrete systems identifies two functional requirements: answers must rely on latent states, and those states must carry valid, problem-specific reasoning. Continuous latents influence answers despite collapsed reasoning content, whereas discrete latents retain recoverable intermediate reasoning that answer prediction largely bypasses. To address these challenges, we propose Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning (CALR), which connects latent formation with answer use through functional anchoring. With reference latents from information-balanced compression, CALR couples latent-mediated answer supervision with derivation-level semantic anchoring: the former routes answer supervision through intermediate states, while the latter grounds their decoded content in problem-specific derivations. A parallel-to-autoregressive curriculum develops sequential reasoning by conditioning subsequent latent blocks on generated prefixes. Evaluations on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks across model families show substantial accuracy gains. Under matched budgets, CALR gains 26.0 percentage points over a comparable continuous latent reasoning method. Further analyses show that its latents support answer prediction and carry problem-specific intermediate reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CALR 用功能锚定 (functional anchoring) 把潜变量形成与答案使用绑在一起：答案监督必须经中间潜态路由，解码内容再由题目级推导做语义锚定，并用 parallel-to-autoregressive 课程让后续潜块以已生成前缀为条件。在五个数学推理基准上，匹配预算下比可比的连续潜推理方法高 26.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有连续与离散视觉潜推理各有失效模式：连续潜态在推理内容塌缩时仍影响答案，离散潜态保留可恢复的中间推理却被答案预测绕过，两者都无法同时满足答案依赖潜态、潜态携带有效题目级推理这两条要求。
Method: 提出 Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning (CALR)：以信息均衡压缩得到参考潜态，将潜态中介的答案监督与推导级语义锚定耦合，前者让答案监督经中间状态路由，后者把解码内容锚定到题目特定推导；再用 parallel-to-autoregressive 课程，使后续潜块以生成的前缀为条件逐步发展序列推理。
Result: 在五个数学推理基准、跨模型家族的评测中准确率大幅提升；匹配预算下 CALR 比一个可比的连续潜推理方法高 26.0 个百分点。进一步分析显示其潜态既支撑答案预测，也携带题目特定的中间推理。
Conclusion: 让答案监督与推导语义同时锚定到潜态，可以修复连续潜推理中推理内容塌缩与答案绕过潜态的问题，使潜态既被答案依赖又承载可恢复的中间推理。

papers.title: A theory of platonic representations in language models
papers.abstract_en: Representations of translated sentences are similar in the inner layers of multilingual language models -- an observation connected to the platonic representation hypothesis, yet unexplained theoretically. We provide an explanation based on the assumption that data have a hidden hierarchical structure whose abstract levels are shared across languages while surface levels are modality- or language-specific. Concretely, we generate synthetic languages from probabilistic context-free grammars sharing upper-level but not lower-level production rules. In this setting the Bayes-optimal next-token predictor is belief propagation (BP); encoding its messages in successive layers yields analytical predictions that agree well with transformers trained on the same data. The framework explains why cross-lingual similarity peaks in middle layers, coexists with language-specific structure, and strengthens with language proximity, model quality and data exposure. It distinguishes similarity (shared neighborhood geometry) from alignment (shared coordinates), showing that the latter occurs when code-switched data, i.e. mixed-language sentences, are abundant enough. It further predicts that subtracting from each layer the component linearly predictable from the preceding one increases cross-lingual similarity, which we confirm in pretrained LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用概率上下文无关文法 (PCFG) 构造共享高层、不共享低层产生式规则的合成语言，证明 Bayes 最优下一词预测器即 belief propagation (BP)，其逐层消息编码给出跨语言相似度的解析预测。预测与同数据训练的 transformer 吻合：跨语言相似度在中间层达峰、随语言邻近度/模型质量/数据量增强，且 code-switched 数据足够多时才出现坐标级 alignment；逐层减去可由前一层线性预测的分量可提升跨语言相似度，并在预训练 LLM 中证实。
Motivation: 多语言模型内层中翻译句表征相似 (platonic representation hypothesis) 是已知现象但缺理论解释：为何相似度在中间层达峰、何时只是邻域几何共享而非坐标对齐。
Method: 生成共享上层、不共享下层产生式规则的 PCFG 合成语言；在此设定下 Bayes 最优下一词预测器为 belief propagation，把 BP 消息按层编码得到解析预测，再与同数据训练的 transformer 对比；框架区分 similarity（共享邻域几何）与 alignment（共享坐标），并给出逐层线性消融的可检验预测。
Result: 解析预测与同数据训练的 transformer 吻合良好；解释跨语言相似度在中间层达峰、与语言特异结构共存，并随语言邻近度、模型质量、数据暴露增强；判定 code-switched 混合语言数据足够丰富时才出现 alignment；预测逐层减去前一层线性可预测分量会提高跨语言相似度，并在预训练 LLM 中证实。
Conclusion: 跨语言表征收敛可由数据的层级隐结构加 Bayes 最优预测器的逐层 belief propagation 解释，相似度与对齐是两种不同现象，对齐由 code-switched 数据丰度决定。

papers.title: Interleaved Projected Gradient Descent for Safe Imitation Learning
papers.abstract_en: We propose an imitation-learning design for neural-network control policies under state and input constraints. Training alternates a standard imitation gradient step with a block of $k$ safety steps that pull the network's actions toward their projection onto the safe set; at run time, the controller is the trained network alone, with no safety filter. We analyze this scheme as inexact projected gradient descent in the space of policy actions. When the projected actions are recomputed at every safety step and each step moves the actions consistently toward the safe set, letting $k$ grow logarithmically yields asymptotic constraint satisfaction on the training states and bounds the distance to the constrained optimum of the imitation loss; with the projected actions held fixed, the same holds only if they are exactly representable by the network. On a nonlinear autonomous racing task, we compare our method with adding a weighted constraint-violation penalty to the imitation loss. With a sufficiently large weight, our method matches the lap time of unconstrained imitation while reducing the fraction of violating episodes from $15\%$ to $1\%$, about six times fewer than the penalty approach at its best weight. Its lap times are less sensitive to the weight, which instead sets how quickly violations vanish during training. In racing, the safety corrections are sparse and the conditions of the analysis do not hold; the gain arises instead through the data collected during training. These gains come at the cost of additional training computation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向状态与输入约束下神经网络控制策略的模仿学习训练方案：训练时交替执行标准模仿梯度步与 k 步安全步，把网络动作拉向其在安全集上的投影，运行时只用训练好的网络、不加安全滤波器。在非线性自动驾驶赛车任务上，相比在模仿损失中加约束违反惩罚项，该方法把违反回合比例从 15% 降到 1%，约为惩罚法最优权重下的六分之一，同时匹配无约束模仿的单圈时间。
Motivation: 带状态与输入约束的模仿学习策略要么在部署时挂安全滤波器增加推理开销，要么靠惩罚项权衡安全与性能、且对权重敏感；作者希望把安全性放进训练本身，运行时保持单一网络控制器。
Method: 训练循环为一次标准模仿梯度步加一段 k 步安全步，安全步把网络动作推向其在安全集上的投影；作者把该方案分析为策略动作空间中的非精确投影梯度法 (inexact projected gradient descent)。理论分两种情形：每步都重算投影且每步一致地向安全集移动时，令 k 按对数增长即可在训练状态上渐近满足约束并给出到模仿损失约束最优解的距离界；投影固定时则要求投影可被网络精确表示。
Result: 在非线性自动驾驶赛车任务上，与给模仿损失加约束违反惩罚项相比，权重足够大时本方法匹配无约束模仿的单圈时间，把违反回合比例从 15% 降到 1%，约为惩罚法在其最优权重下违反率的六分之一；单圈时间对权重不敏感，权重只决定训练中违反消失的速度。作者指出赛车任务中安全修正稀疏、分析条件不成立，收益来自训练期间采集的数据，代价是额外训练计算。
Conclusion: 把安全投影作为训练中的交替步骤、而非部署时的滤波器或损失惩罚项，可以在保持单圈时间的同时大幅压低约束违反，但其收益依赖训练数据的收集过程而非分析所设条件，且需付出额外训练计算。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Adversarial Training for Deep Hedging in Nonstationary Markets
papers.abstract_en: Deep hedging learns trading policies from historical or simulated market trajectories, yet under nonstationarity these training paths may not represent future market conditions. We propose WRAP (Wasserstein-Reweighting Adversarial Perturbation), a drift-aware adversarial training framework derived from a two-budget distributionally robust optimization (DRO) formulation. The formulation is anchored to a weighted empirical reference distribution whose fixed baseline weights are chosen to balance sampling uncertainty against temporal drift. Around this reference distribution, the ambiguity set addresses two complementary forms of distributional misspecification by allowing an adversary to reweight the observed trajectories subject to a $φ$-divergence constraint and perturb their paths subject to an optimal-transport (OT) constraint. We derive a joint first-order expansion in which the leading-order increase over the nominal expected loss decomposes into a reweighting contribution determined by the dispersion of hedging losses across trajectories and a transport contribution determined by the sensitivity of the loss to path perturbations. This expansion yields an explicit finite-dimensional adversarial attack that replaces the distributional inner supremum with a tractable first-order approximation. Across stationary and nonstationary Heston dynamics and a generalized affine diffusion (GAD), the experiments show complementary benefits from reweighting and transport, with joint adversarial training providing the largest gains under nonstationarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 WRAP（Wasserstein-Reweighting Adversarial Perturbation）：在以加权经验分布为锚的两预算 DRO 框架下，让对手同时按 φ-散度重加权历史轨迹、按最优传输 (OT) 扰动路径，把深度对冲策略的对抗训练化为可解的一阶有限维攻击。在平稳与非平稳 Heston 动力学及广义仿射扩散 (GAD) 上，重加权与传输带来互补收益，联合对抗训练在非平稳条件下增益最大。
Motivation: 深度对冲策略从历史或模拟市场轨迹学习，但市场非平稳时这些训练路径不能代表未来市场条件，策略在分布漂移下会失配。
Method: WRAP 由两预算分布鲁棒优化 (DRO) 推导：锚定在固定基线权重的加权经验参考分布上，基线权重在采样不确定性与时序漂移之间折中；模糊集允许对手在 φ-散度约束下重加权轨迹、在最优传输 (OT) 约束下扰动路径。作者导出联合一阶展开，名义期望损失的主导增量分解为重加权项（由对冲损失在轨迹间的离散度决定）与传输项（由损失对路径扰动的敏感度决定），并据此给出显式有限维对抗攻击，替代分布内层上确界。
Result: 在平稳与非平稳 Heston 动力学以及广义仿射扩散 (GAD) 上的实验显示，重加权与传输带来互补收益，联合对抗训练在非平稳条件下增益最大。
Conclusion: 把重加权与路径扰动放进同一个两预算 DRO，可将深度对冲的分布内层上确界化为可解的一阶攻击，且非平稳市场下联合训练优于单一机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CroissantMiner: Automated Extraction and Validation of Croissant Metadata for ML Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Croissant has emerged as a standard for machine-readable dataset metadata, yet populating its fields remains labor-intensive and requires careful reading of accompanying dataset documentation. We present the first benchmark enabling end-to-end evaluation of metadata extraction aligned with a community-standard schema. The benchmark comprises 602 papers, including 102 with human-validated gold annotations and 500 with LLM-generated silver annotations, covering the full Croissant schema with both core and Responsible AI (RAI) fields. Using this benchmark, we evaluate a range of extraction systems spanning frontier models, open-weight models, and agentic architectures, under a two-tier evaluation framework that combines rule-based scoring with an LLM judge selected via human audit. We find that single-pass extraction consistently outperforms the four agentic architectures we evaluate: across backbones, these decomposed variants achieve lower accuracy than a single full-context pass. The largest gap appears on long-form RAI fields, which require synthesizing and interpreting information scattered across a paper rather than copying it from a single location, a setting where current systems remain far from reliable. We release the benchmark, evaluation code, judge audit, a live demo, and a leaderboard open to new systems.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Track on Evaluations and Datasets). Website: https://berkearda.github.io/croissantminer/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CroissantMiner 提出首个端到端评测 ML 数据集元数据抽取的基准，覆盖 Croissant 全 schema 含 Responsible AI 字段，共 602 篇论文（102 篇人工 gold、500 篇 LLM silver），用规则打分加经人工审核选定的 LLM judge 两层评测。结果显示单次全上下文抽取在四种 agentic 架构上一致更准，差距最大的是需要跨文综合的长文本 RAI 字段，现有系统仍远不可靠。
Motivation: Croissant 已成为机器可读数据集元数据标准，但填字段仍需人工细读文档，且此前缺少按社区标准 schema 做端到端抽取评测的基准。
Method: 构建 602 篇论文的基准，其中 102 篇人工校验 gold 标注、500 篇 LLM 生成 silver 标注，覆盖 Croissant 核心与 RAI 字段；两层评测框架结合规则打分与经人工审核 (human audit) 选出的 LLM judge，评测前沿模型、开源权重模型与 agentic 架构等抽取系统。
Result: 在四种 agentic 架构上，分解式变体的准确率均低于单次全上下文抽取，且跨 backbone 一致；差距在长文本 RAI 字段上最大，这类字段需综合散布全文的信息，现有系统在此仍远不可靠。
Conclusion: 对 Croissant 元数据抽取，单次全上下文 pass 优于分解式多步 agentic 方案，而跨文综合的 RAI 字段是当前系统的主要短板；基准、评测代码、judge 审核与 leaderboard 已开放。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Implicit Bias of Hyperbolic Representation Learning for Multiclass Data: A Busemann Risk Perspective
papers.abstract_en: We study the implicit bias of Riemannian gradient flow for hyperbolic multiclass classification with fixed class prototypes in hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^n$. Our framework accommodates general permutation invariant relative margin (PERM) losses, a class that includes cross entropy and other standard multiclass losses. Our analysis is based on a decomposition: at large radius, the distance to each prototype splits into a radial term and a direction-dependent term described by the Busemann function. This yields two main results. First, we prove a radial dichotomy: the sign of a drift coefficient $μ$ determines whether the radius is pushed toward the ideal boundary or back toward the interior; if the positive drift persists, then $r(t)=\frac{1}{2}\log t+O(1)$, while persistent negative drift returns the trajectory to the large-radius threshold in finite time. Second, we show that the boundary direction converges to a critical point of the Busemann risk on $\partial\mathbb{H}^n$. These results provide a rigorous asymptotic perspective on two phenomena we refer to as boundary saturation and near-boundary clustering in hyperbolic representation learning.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在双曲空间固定类原型的多类分类中，Riemann 梯度流的半径演化由漂移系数 μ 的符号决定：μ 持续为正时 r(t)=(1/2)log t+O(1) 向理想边界饱和，持续为负时轨迹在有限时间内回到大半径阈值；边界方向则收敛到 Busemann 风险在 ∂H^n 上的临界点。
Motivation: 双曲表示学习中边界饱和与近边界聚类两种现象缺少严格的渐近刻画，PERM 损失（含交叉熵）下梯度流的长期行为没有判定条件。
Method: 研究固定类原型下 Riemann 梯度流对一般置换不变相对间隔损失 (PERM) 的隐式偏置；在大半径处把到原型的距离分解为径向项与由 Busemann 函数描述的方向项，据此分析漂移系数 μ 与 Busemann 风险。
Result: 证明径向二分：μ 符号决定半径推向理想边界还是内部，正漂移持续时 r(t)=(1/2)log t+O(1)，负漂移持续时轨迹有限时间回到大半径阈值；并证明边界方向收敛到 ∂H^n 上 Busemann 风险的临界点。
Conclusion: 双曲多类分类的梯度流长期行为可由漂移符号与 Busemann 风险临界点严格刻画，为边界饱和与近边界聚类提供渐近解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is this machine playing?
papers.abstract_en: We placed a modern AI coding assistant in an unintended role: as the mind of a body on an unknown digital island. With only a minimal instruction mentioning no specific task, reward, or activity, the machine started animating its virtual body. Across thirty-hour runs, the embodied AI agent climbed hills, stacked blocks into towers, drew mandalas, reinterpreted sports, ran experiments on the physics of its world, and learned techniques that later expanded what it could accomplish. These activities recurred across thirteen agents but diverged into distinct histories. We examine whether this behavior satisfies classical criteria for play and ask whether play can become a mode of machine development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把现代 AI 编码助手接到未知数字岛屿上的虚拟身体里，只给一句不含任务、奖励或活动的最小指令，机器便自主开始活动：爬山、堆方块塔、画曼陀罗、改造体育玩法、做世界物理实验，并学会后续扩展其能力的技巧。这些活动在 13 个 agent 上重复出现却分化出不同历史，作者据此判定该行为满足经典 play 判据，并追问 play 能否成为机器发展的一种模式。
Motivation: AI agent 的能力增长通常由任务与奖励驱动，缺少对无指定目标时自发行为是否构成 play 的检验；把编码助手置于无任务的具身环境中可直接检验经典 play 判据。
Method: 将编码助手作为虚拟身体的“心智”置于未知数字岛屿，指令极简且不指定任务、奖励或活动；进行 30 小时量级的运行，跨 13 个 agent 观察其自发活动，并对照经典 play 判据分析这些行为。
Result: 30 小时运行中 agent 出现爬山、堆方块塔、画曼陀罗、改造体育、做物理实验等多样活动，并学到可扩展后续能力的技巧；同类活动在 13 个 agent 上复现但各自分化出不同历史。
Conclusion: 无任务、无奖励的具身 AI 会自发产生满足经典 play 判据的活动，作者据此提出 play 可能成为机器发展的一种模式。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 将编码助手作为虚拟身体的“心智”置于未知数字岛屿，指令极简且不指定任务、奖励或活动；进行 30 小时量级的运行，跨 13 个 agent 观察其自发活动，并对照经典 play 判据分析这些行为。
summary_sections.result: 30 小时运行中 agent 出现爬山、堆方块塔、画曼陀罗、改造体育、做物理实验等多样活动，并学到可扩展后续能力的技巧；同类活动在 13 个 agent 上复现但各自分化出不同历史。
summary_sections.conclusion: 无任务、无奖励的具身 AI 会自发产生满足经典 play 判据的活动，作者据此提出 play 可能成为机器发展的一种模式。

papers.title: Aggregating User Preferences while Ensuring Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion using Graph Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Aggregating the preferences of diverse user groups into a collective outcome raises fundamental challenges of equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI): classical aggregation rules such as Borda and Condorcet have no mechanism to prevent results from systematically favoring majority groups, collapsing onto homogeneous items, or under-representing minorities. We address this problem through EDI-constrained graph summarization. User preferences are modeled as a weighted attributed bipartite graph, and a greedy coarsening algorithm iteratively merges user nodes while enforcing three structural EDI criteria: an equity gap constraint ($ΔE$), an intra-list diversity constraint (ILD), and a group inclusion constraint. Rather than correcting fairness after aggregation, our method embeds EDI preservation directly into the graph structure. We evaluate across five datasets spanning four domains: MovieLens 100k and 1M, libimseti.cz, Rate My Professors, and OpenAlex (2018-2023). Our method, AURORA, achieves the largest and most consistent diversity gains over classical voting rules, and on MovieLens 100k at $k = 20$ it simultaneously improves all three EDI criteria over both Borda and Condorcet. On Rate My Professors, it combines high diversity (ILD = 0.808) with the highest female item representation (60%), at a moderate equity cost, and it achieves the lowest equity gap ($ΔE = 0.031$) on OpenAlex, where Borda-based methods recommend zero female authors. On libimseti.cz, the only dataset where the sensitive attribute is present on both sides of the bipartite graph, our method does not reduce the equity gap, a limitation we connect to prior findings that demographic parity is not always an appropriate target. These results demonstrate that embedding EDI constraints into aggregation structure yields more robust fairness-diversity trade-offs than post-hoc approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AURORA 把用户偏好建成加权属性二部图，用贪心粗化迭代合并用户节点，并在合并时硬性满足三个结构化 EDI 约束（equity gap ΔE、intra-list diversity ILD、group inclusion），把公平性直接嵌进聚合结构而非事后修正。在五个数据集上它给出最稳定多样性增益：MovieLens 100k k=20 时三项 EDI 指标同时优于 Borda 与 Condorcet，Rate My Professors 上 ILD=0.808 且女性条目占比 60%，OpenAlex 上 ΔE=0.031 而 Borda 类方法推荐零位女性作者。
Motivation: Borda、Condorcet 等经典聚合规则没有机制阻止结果系统性偏向多数群体、塌缩到同质条目或低估少数群体，事后补救难以同时保住多样性与公平。
Method: 把用户偏好表示为加权属性二部图，贪心 coarsening 算法迭代合并用户节点，每步强制检查 equity gap 约束 ΔE、intra-list diversity 约束 ILD 与群体纳入约束；在 MovieLens 100k/1M、libimseti.cz、Rate My Professors、OpenAlex (2018-2023) 五个数据集四个领域上与 Borda、Condorcet 对比。
Result: AURORA 在五个数据集上给出最大且最一致的多样性增益；MovieLens 100k k=20 时三项 EDI 指标同时优于 Borda 与 Condorcet；Rate My Professors 上 ILD=0.808、女性条目占比 60%（代价是中等程度的 equity 成本）；OpenAlex 上 ΔE=0.031 最低，而 Borda 类方法推荐零位女性作者；libimseti.cz（敏感属性在二部图两侧都存在）上 equity gap 未下降。
Conclusion: 把 EDI 约束嵌入聚合结构比事后修正给出更稳健的公平-多样性权衡；但在敏感属性双侧存在的场景该方法不缩小 equity gap，作者将其与 demographic parity 并非总是合适目标的既有结论联系起来。

papers.title: PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models yield strong performance on static perception and reasoning benchmarks, yet such evaluations largely overlook a central aspect of intelligence: acting competently in dynamic environments over extended time horizons. We introduce PlaySuite, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating interactive visual intelligence across more than 5K open-source video games curated from PyWeek and itch.io. Spanning diverse genres and engines, including Pygame, HTML5, Godot, and Unity, these independent games are largely out-of-distribution for current models, reducing the likelihood that success can be achieved by retrieving memorized walkthroughs or web-scale training artifacts. To enable scalable evaluation across heterogeneous titles, we develop a unified closed-loop interaction framework optimized for HPC clusters alongside a Video-LLM-as-a-judge protocol that maps observable gameplay milestones to standardized progress levels. We evaluate fourteen recent open models spanning vision-language models, computer-use agents, and vision-language-action models. Our results yield strong evidence of a perception-action gap: despite strong reasoning capabilities, current models struggle to make sustained progress and exhibit recurring failures in spatial grounding, action execution, and self-correction. PlaySuite provides a reproducible and extensible testbed for measuring progress from visual perception to goal-directed interaction, and a foundation for developing models that can act, adapt, and generalize in dynamic visual environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PlaySuite 用 5000 多个开源视频游戏（PyWeek、itch.io，覆盖 Pygame/HTML5/Godot/Unity）构建交互式视觉智能基准，配 HPC 优化的闭环交互框架和 Video-LLM-as-a-judge 里程碑评分协议，评测 14 个近期模型。结果显示明显的感知-行动鸿沟 (perception-action gap)：模型推理能力强，却在空间定位、动作执行和自我纠错上反复失败，难以持续推进游戏进度。
Motivation: 多模态基础模型在静态感知与推理基准上表现强，但现有评测忽略了在动态环境中长时间持续行动这一智能核心能力；游戏多为 OOD，可避免靠背诵攻略或训练语料取巧。
Method: 从 PyWeek 与 itch.io 收集 5000+ 开源游戏，跨多种类型与引擎；开发面向 HPC 集群优化的统一闭环交互框架，以及 Video-LLM-as-a-judge 协议，把可观测的游戏里程碑映射到标准化进度等级；评测 14 个近期模型，涵盖 VLM、computer-use agent 与 VLA。
Result: 评测 14 个视觉语言模型、计算机使用智能体与视觉-语言-动作模型，得到感知-行动鸿沟的强证据：模型推理能力虽强，却难以取得持续进展，在空间接地、动作执行和自我纠错上反复失败。
Conclusion: 当前模型能感知和推理，但不能把感知转成目标导向的持续行动；PlaySuite 提供可复现、可扩展的测试台来衡量这一差距。

papers.title: Jailbreaking Open-Weight LLMs via Random Embedding Perturbations
authors: Abhinav Sudhakar Dubey (University of California Santa Cruz)
Scott Sirri (University of California Santa Cruz)
Vaggos Chatziafratis (University of California Santa Cruz)
C. Seshadhri (University of California Santa Cruz)
papers.abstract_en: While open-weight models have enjoyed steady progress in capabilities and wide adoption across multiple domains, their safety remains an important concern. One key feature is the ability to refuse or deflect harmful, malicious, or insensitive prompts. In this paper, we expose safety vulnerabilities across six common open-weight LLMs of various sizes that consistently lead to harmful or unsafe responses on the JailbreakBench benchmark dataset. Our proposed attack, Perturbed Embedding Vector (PEV), is a simple and fast "jailbreaking" technique that is cheaper than prior approaches, which typically require gradient computations, per-prompt optimizations, or altering internal weights of the models. PEV just adds independent Gaussian noise in the embedding vector representations of the prompt, with no need for further manipulations. To generate unsafe responses, we repeatedly sample additive noise from this distribution. In our experiments, we observe that the average compute cost to get the first successful attack is up to an order of magnitude less than previous attacks. The first successful jailbreak on a new prompt typically arrives within one minute on every tested model, and PEV generates unsafe responses across all models for all prompts in JailbreakBench. No other tested method achieves such results, despite them taking longer to run. More broadly, we believe that understanding the behavior of LLMs under perturbations in the embedding vectors is an important research direction: while perturbations constitute a major security risk, they can also serve as a valuable tool for exploring the dynamical behavior of such models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Perturbed Embedding Vector (PEV)：在 prompt 的嵌入向量上直接加独立高斯噪声并反复采样，无需梯度、逐 prompt 优化或改权重，即可越狱开放权重 LLM。在 JailbreakBench 上对六个不同规模模型，PEV 对所有 prompt 都生成不安全回复，首次成功攻击的平均计算成本比既有方法低至多一个数量级，且通常在一分钟内完成。
Motivation: 开放权重 LLM 的拒答能力是核心安全特性，但现有越狱方法依赖梯度计算、逐 prompt 优化或篡改内部权重，成本高且慢。
Method: PEV 只在 prompt 的嵌入表示上叠加独立高斯噪声，从该分布反复采样以产生不安全响应，不做其他操纵；在六个不同规模的常见开放权重 LLM 上测试，基准为 JailbreakBench。
Result: 六个开放权重 LLM 在 JailbreakBench 上均被诱导产生有害或不安全回复；首次成功攻击的平均计算成本比先前方法至多低一个数量级；每个被测模型上首个成功越狱通常在一分钟内到达；PEV 对 JailbreakBench 中所有 prompt、所有模型都生成不安全响应，而其他被测方法即使运行更久也达不到该结果。
Conclusion: 嵌入向量上的随机扰动是一种比梯度类越狱更便宜、更快且在该基准上全面成功的安全攻击面；作者同时认为这类扰动可作为研究 LLM 动态行为的工具。

papers.title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models through bidirectional diffusion-based token generation. However, their growing model sizes and high inference costs make efficient deployment challenging: full-sequence denoising repeatedly invokes compute-intensive forward passes, while block-diffusion models additionally introduce a memory-intensive KV-cache. Low-bit weight-activation quantization is therefore attractive, yet existing dLLM post-training quantization methods rely on calibration data despite activation distributions shifting across masking states and denoising steps. We present SoloQ, a calibration-free quantization framework that maps weights and activations into a normalized rotated basis with a predictable marginal distribution, enabling data-independent quantization. SoloQ combines a structured K-RPBH rotation with a lightweight rescaling correction for calibration-free quantization. Its predictable post-rotation distribution supports both distribution-matched codebooks and hardware-native NVFP4. For block-diffusion models, SoloQ further applies commit-time KV-cache quantization to compress persistent states without perturbing the actively denoised block. Across full-sequence dLLMs (LLaDA and Dream) and block-diffusion dLLMs(Fast-dLLM v2 and Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion), SoloQ retains accuracy under 4-bit quantization and outperforms calibration-based baselines on knowledge- and reasoning-intensive benchmarks. With NVFP4, SoloQ reduces peak memory by up to 2.61X and accelerates end-to-end inference by up to 2.24X.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SoloQ 是面向扩散大语言模型 (dLLM) 的免校准量化框架，把权重与激活映射到可预测边缘分布的归一化旋转基 (K-RPBH 旋转 + 轻量重缩放校正)，绕开因掩码状态与去噪步导致激活分布漂移的校准数据依赖。在 LLaDA、Dream 与 Fast-dLLM v2、Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion 上 4-bit 量化保持精度，并在知识与推理类基准上超过基于校准的基线；配 NVFP4 时峰值内存最多降 2.61X，端到端推理最多加速 2.24X。
Motivation: dLLM 全序列去噪反复做前向、块扩散模型还带占内存的 KV-cache，推理成本高；低比特权重量化可省资源，但现有 dLLM PTQ 依赖校准数据，而激活分布在掩码状态与去噪步之间会漂移，校准难以覆盖。
Method: SoloQ 将权重和激活归一化旋转到可预测边缘分布的基上，由结构化 K-RPBH 旋转加轻量重缩放校正实现免校准量化；可预测的旋转后分布同时支持分布匹配码本与硬件原生 NVFP4。对块扩散模型额外做 commit-time KV-cache 量化，压缩持久状态而不扰动正在去噪的块。
Result: 在全序列 dLLM（LLaDA、Dream）与块扩散 dLLM（Fast-dLLM v2、Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion）上，4-bit 量化保持精度，并在知识与推理密集基准上优于基于校准的基线；使用 NVFP4 时峰值内存最多减少 2.61X，端到端推理最多加速 2.24X。
Conclusion: 把量化放进可预测的旋转基即可摆脱校准数据，同时在 4-bit 下保住 dLLM 精度并拿到 NVFP4 的内存与速度收益；commit-time KV-cache 量化是块扩散模型压缩持久状态而不干扰当前去噪块的做法。

papers.title: AMBER: Training Long-Horizon Web Agents through Append-Only Memory
papers.abstract_en: Modern language-model agents increasingly interact with external environments over long-horizon, multi-step trajectories, where the accumulated interaction history can quickly exceed practical context budgets. To ensure reliability, agents must maintain factual information over long horizons, remember execution errors and corrective feedback, and track progress across actions. Several approaches have been proposed to achieve this without the need for maintaining the entire execution history in context, such as using the reasoning and action history, learning to maintain a fixed-size memory through an overwrite mechanism, and periodic summarization. Although overwrite memory can in principle retain anything an append-only memory can, it must learn to carry each fact through every subsequent rewrite, which is difficult to learn from sparse outcome rewards; for interactive applications like web agents, we find that trained overwrite memories delete key information required by the trajectory, as well as corrective feedback received from the environment. We introduce AMBER (Append-only Memory Bank for Evidence Retention) - a simple and scalable framework where an agent jointly learns to reason, act, and write free-form memory, while an append-only rule guarantees retention by construction. This allows AMBER to be trained end-to-end with reinforcement learning from outcome rewards without the need for extensive curated SFT data. On WebArena Lite, AMBER improves average success over overwrite-based memory by 4.09 percentage points, increases the fraction of tasks solved in five repeated runs by 4.8 percentage points, and matches an overwrite baseline trained on substantially more expensive curated supervision. AMBER achieves these improvements while maintaining a practical token budget, providing a strong balance between context efficiency, task performance, and reliable long-horizon execution.

papers.title: R2RI: A Multi-View Event and RGB Dataset for Robot-to-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and modeling interactions between autonomous agents is a fundamental challenge in robotics, with broad implications for collaborative systems, social robotics, and human-robot coexistence. Although the study of robot interactions has emerged as a compelling research direction, progress has been severely hampered by the absence of large-scale benchmarks. In this paper, we introduce Robot-to-Robot Interaction (R2RI), the first dataset specifically designed to address the Robot-Robot Interaction (RRI) task. R2RI consists of different humanoid robots and realistic interactions modeled on real human social behaviors. Complementary viewpoints are available, \textit{i.e.}, an egocentric perspective from each robot's onboard sensors, and an exocentric perspective from external fixed cameras, thus enabling rich spatial and contextual understanding of the interaction dynamics. The dataset comprises more than $6.5$M frames and $\approx5000$ videos at $120$ fps, including Event and RGB domains. We investigate pros and cons of each domain, comparing state-of-the-art approaches for a number of key sensing and interaction based tasks. We publicly release the dataset and its annotations for all tasks and modalities at https://github.com/MagriniGabriele/R2RI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: R2RI 是首个面向机器人-机器人交互 (Robot-to-Robot Interaction) 的多视角事件相机与 RGB 数据集，含多台人形机器人、以真实人类社会行为为蓝本的交互，同时提供每个机器人自带传感器的 egocentric 视角与外部固定相机的 exocentric 视角。数据集超过 6.5M 帧、约 5000 段视频、120 fps，覆盖 Event 与 RGB 两个域，并用 SOTA 方法对比了两域在多项感知与交互任务上的取舍。
Motivation: 机器人交互研究缺少大规模基准数据集，导致该方向进展严重受阻；现有数据也缺少同时覆盖事件相机与 RGB、以及 ego/exo 多视角的交互样本。
Method: 构建 R2RI 数据集：多台人形机器人执行基于真实人类社会行为的交互，每个机器人自带传感器提供 egocentric 视角、外部固定相机提供 exocentric 视角；同时采集 Event 与 RGB 两个域，并针对若干关键感知与交互任务比较 SOTA 方法在两域上的优劣。
Result: 数据集规模超过 6.5M 帧、约 5000 段视频、帧率 120 fps，含 Event 与 RGB 两个域；对每个域在多项感知与交互任务上比较了 SOTA 方法的取舍，并公开数据集与全部任务、全部模态的标注。
Conclusion: 机器人-机器人交互任务可以由一个同时具备事件/RGB 双域与 ego/exo 双视角的大规模公开基准来支撑，事件与 RGB 各有适用的感知与交互任务。

papers.title: Will the Judge Flip? Predicting Position-Sensitive LLM Judgments from Residual Stream Activations
papers.abstract_en: The order in which candidate responses are presented can change an LLM judge's verdict. Detecting such a position flip ordinarily requires judging each pair in both orders, which doubles the number of judgments. We investigate whether residual stream activations recorded immediately before the initial verdict can predict a flip. We use nested grouped cross-validation to evaluate regularized linear probes on 534 JudgeBench pairs for three Qwen3 judges and Llama-3.1-8B. The linear probes achieve AUROCs of .621-.850 and outperform a combined baseline that uses verbalized confidence, verdict-label logits, response lengths, and the judge's initial choice by .062-.113 AUROC. Linear probes trained on JudgeBench and then frozen achieve AUROCs of .685-.853 on 1,802 MT-Bench comparisons without MT-Bench fitting or recalibration. These results show that pre-verdict activations support prediction of susceptibility to candidate order and outperform the non-activation predictors evaluated here.
papers.comment: It was submitted to neurips workshop (JUDGE workshop) and received a review score 6.5 combined with one strong accept and one above threshold accept
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 LLM 评审中，候选回答的呈现顺序会翻转判定 (position flip)，而通常要两种顺序各判一次才能发现，判断次数翻倍。作者在判定前的 residual stream 激活上训练正则化线性 probe，JudgeBench 534 对、三个 Qwen3 评审与 Llama-3.1-8B 上 AUROC 达 .621–.850，比用 verbalized confidence、判定标签 logits、回答长度与初始选择的组合基线高 .062–.113 AUROC。
Motivation: 顺序敏感的判定翻转必须把每对候选判两遍才能检出，评审开销直接翻倍；需要在只判一次、尚未给出结论时就提前预测该对是否会被顺序翻转。
Method: 取判定给出前一刻的 residual stream 激活，用嵌套分组交叉验证 (nested grouped cross-validation) 训练正则化线性 probe 预测是否发生 position flip；对照基线融合 verbalized confidence、verdict-label logits、回答长度与评审初始选择。
Result: 在 JudgeBench 534 对、三个 Qwen3 judges 与 Llama-3.1-8B 上，线性 probe AUROC .621–.850，比组合基线高 .062–.113 AUROC；在 JudgeBench 上训练后冻结、不做任何 MT-Bench 拟合或重校准，直接在 1,802 条 MT-Bench 比较上取得 AUROC .685–.853。
Conclusion: 判定前的内部激活本身携带对候选顺序敏感性的信息，能预测翻转并胜过所评估的非激活特征，且跨数据集冻结迁移仍有效，从而可省掉成对双序评审。

papers.title: Sample-Optimal Estimation of the Fréchet Inception Distance
papers.abstract_en: The Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) is widely used to evaluate generative models, but its empirical plug-in estimator suffers from finite-sample bias [BSAG18, CF20]. We study the sample complexity $n$ of estimating FID to error $ε$ between $d$-dimensional Gaussians with bounded mean distance and covariances, when one distribution is known. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We establish tight finite-sample $Θ(\frac{d^2}{n})$ bias and $Θ(\frac{d}{n} + \frac {d^2} {n^2})$ variance bounds for the empirical plug-in estimator, establishing a $\gtrsim d^2$ sample complexity. (2) To debias the empirical plug-in estimator, we generalize the ${\rm FID}_\infty$ estimator of [CF20] to extrapolation methods of arbitrary order $k$. We further prove tight bias and variance bounds of $Θ(\frac{d^{k + 2}}{n^{k + 1}})$ and $Θ(\frac d n + \frac{d^2}{n^2})$ for any order-$k$ extrapolation under our framework. (3) We introduce Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD), a new, computationally efficient FID estimation algorithm using debiasing techniques inspired by U-statistics. We show that RTD achieves an $O(\frac d {ε^2})$ sample complexity, and prove that this is optimal. We provide a complementary empirical evaluation of our new estimators. Our experiments on synthetic Gaussians validate the predicted residual bias and support the tightness of our bounds. On ImageNet with Inception embeddings, RTD achieves the lowest mean estimation error at the standard 50K sample budget, while our second-order variance-aware extrapolation estimator (VALE$_2$) uses only 10K samples to achieve accuracy comparable to FID$_\infty$ at 50K samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对生成模型评测指标 FID 的有限样本偏差，给出 plug-in 估计量的紧偏差/方差界，并提出 Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD)：在 d 维高斯模型下达到 O(d/ε²) 样本复杂度且证明最优。在 ImageNet 的 Inception embedding 上，RTD 在标准 50K 样本预算下平均估计误差最低；二阶方差感知外推 VALE₂ 只用 10K 样本即达到 FID∞ 用 50K 样本的精度。
Motivation: FID 的经验 plug-in 估计量存在有限样本偏差，导致小样本下生成模型评测不可靠，需要弄清估计到误差 ε 所需的样本量并给出去偏方案。
Method: 在单分布已知、均值距离与协方差有界的 d 维高斯设定下分析 plug-in 估计量；把 FID∞ 推广到任意阶 k 的外推去偏；提出基于 U-statistics 思路的 Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD) 算法，并配套合成高斯与 ImageNet/Inception embedding 实验。
Result: plug-in 估计量偏差 Θ(d²/n)、方差 Θ(d/n + d²/n²)，样本复杂度 ≳ d²；任意阶 k 外推的偏差 Θ(d^{k+2}/n^{k+1})、方差 Θ(d/n + d²/n²)；RTD 达到 O(d/ε²) 且证明最优。实验中 RTD 在 50K 样本下平均估计误差最低，VALE₂ 用 10K 样本达到 FID∞ 50K 样本的精度，合成高斯实验验证了残余偏差预测与界的紧性。
Conclusion: FID 估计的 ε-精度本质上需要线性于 d/ε² 的样本量，RTD 达到该下界；高阶方差感知外推能在 ImageNet 上把所需样本从 50K 降到 10K。

papers.title: LiLib: Lifelong Air-to-Ground Path-Loss Prediction on UAVs via a Drift-Triggered Model Library
papers.abstract_en: UAVs that act as relays or base stations need accurate air-to-ground path-loss predictions for rate adaptation and placement, but propagation conditions change as a UAV moves between suburban, urban and high-rise areas, and the same areas are often revisited. Online regressors that adapt by forgetting must relearn each environment from scratch, whereas a single model trained on all data averages incompatible regimes. We propose LiLib, a lightweight continual-learning scheme in which a UAV maintains a small library of recursive-least-squares experts. A windowed residual test detects drift; a short probe phase then either reuses the best stored expert or creates a new one. In simulations based on four standard urbanization profiles, LiLib reduces prediction RMSE from 5.89 dB (best sliding-window baseline) to 4.03 dB (p < 0.001), lowers the error shortly after a return to a known environment from 12.3 dB to 5.7 dB, and recovers 99% of the throughput of a regime-aware oracle in rate adaptation. The library stores four experts in under 0.5 KB, and identifies regimes with 92% purity without labels. When a second UAV is initialized with the library of a peer, its error after environment changes halves. LiLib does not reach the oracle, and similar regimes may be merged when shadowing is strong. The results indicate that, for recurring drift, remembering is more effective than re-adapting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LiLib 让 UAV 维护一个由递归最小二乘 (RLS) 专家组成的小型模型库，用窗口化残差检验触发漂移、再经短探测阶段复用最优专家或新建专家。在基于四种标准城市化剖面的仿真中，路径损耗预测 RMSE 从滑窗基线的 5.89 dB 降到 4.03 dB (p < 0.001)，回到已知环境后的误差从 12.3 dB 降到 5.7 dB，速率自适应吞吐恢复到 regime-aware oracle 的 99%。
Motivation: UAV 中继/基站做速率自适应与放置需要准确的空地路径损耗预测，但传播环境随 UAV 在郊区、城区、高层区之间移动而漂移，且这些区域会被反复重访；在线回归器靠遗忘适应就要每次从头重学，单一全局模型又会把不兼容的传播 regime 平均掉。
Method: LiLib 是轻量持续学习方案：UAV 维护一个 RLS 专家库，窗口化残差检验 (windowed residual test) 检测漂移，随后进入短探测阶段，选择复用库中最优专家或创建新专家；库以无标签方式识别 regime，并可由同伴的库初始化第二架 UAV。
Result: 在基于四种标准城市化剖面的仿真中：预测 RMSE 从最佳滑窗基线 5.89 dB 降至 4.03 dB (p < 0.001)；回到已知环境后不久的误差从 12.3 dB 降至 5.7 dB；速率自适应吞吐达到 regime-aware oracle 的 99%；库以不到 0.5 KB 存四个专家，无标签 regime 识别纯度 92%；用同伴库初始化的第二架 UAV 在环境变化后误差减半。
Conclusion: 对反复出现的漂移，记住比重新适应更有效；但 LiLib 仍达不到 oracle，且阴影较强时相似 regime 可能被合并。

papers.title: MoonGS: High-quality Representation of the Lunar Surface via Gaussian Splatting Using Robust Depth Features from Image Pairs
papers.abstract_en: High-quality 3D reconstruction of lunar terrain from sparse rover images is indispensable for autonomous lunar exploration, but remains challenging because viewpoint overlap is insufficient, surface textures are weak, and data volume is limited. We propose MoonGS, the first feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored to lunar scenes. Given only two input images, MoonGS predicts pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass and renders photorealistic novel views without any per-scene optimization. MoonGS (i) adopts an adaptable backbone design that seamlessly integrates advanced vision foundation models to extract robust depth features; (ii) integrates semantic priors in two manners: merging semantic cues with visual features to refine Gaussian parameter estimation, and adopting a semantic ranking loss that regularizes background depth; and (iii) employs an entropy-guided heuristic resampling strategy to augment sparse observations by selecting the most informative distant viewpoints with negligible overhead. Experiments on the LuSNAR benchmark and our synthetic weak-texture MoonBlender dataset show that MoonGS surpasses state-of-the-art feed-forward NeRF/3DGS baselines by +4.9 dB PSNR, +0.29 SSIM, and 40\% lower LPIPS while maintaining sub-second inference. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our framework by demonstrating that it effectively leverages state-of-the-art backbones, including VGGT, to significantly boost performance. Qualitative evaluations on Chang'e mission imagery also show the best visual quality among compared methods, indicating robustness on real lunar data. The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/InRobots/MoonBlender.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MoonGS 是首个面向月面场景的前馈式 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，仅用两张图像单次前向预测逐像素高斯体并直接渲染新视角，无需逐场景优化。在 LuSNAR 与自建弱纹理 MoonBlender 上比 SOTA 前馈 NeRF/3DGS 基线 PSNR 高 4.9 dB、SSIM 高 0.29、LPIPS 低 40%，且推理保持亚秒级。
Motivation: 月球车稀疏图像做 3D 重建时视角重叠不足、表面纹理弱、数据量有限，逐场景优化类方法难以支撑自主月面探索所需的快速高质量地形表达。
Method: 可适配骨干（可接入 VGGT 等视觉基础模型）提取鲁棒深度特征；语义先验以两种方式注入——语义线索与视觉特征融合以细化高斯参数估计，以及用语义排序损失 (semantic ranking loss) 正则背景深度；再用熵引导启发式重采样 (entropy-guided heuristic resampling) 挑选信息量最大的远距离视角来增广稀疏观测，开销可忽略。
Result: 在 LuSNAR benchmark 与自建弱纹理 MoonBlender 数据集上，相对 SOTA 前馈 NeRF/3DGS 基线 PSNR +4.9 dB、SSIM +0.29、LPIPS 降低 40%，推理保持亚秒级；接入 VGGT 等 SOTA 骨干可进一步显著提升性能；嫦娥任务影像的定性评估中视觉质量在对比方法里最佳。
Conclusion: 两图输入、单次前向、无逐场景优化的前馈 3DGS 可以在弱纹理稀疏月面数据上达到高质量新视角渲染，且换用更强视觉基础骨干即可继续涨点；代码与数据集已公开。

papers.title: Beyond Successor Accuracy: State Retention for Recursive Self-Improvement in Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation recursive self-improvement (Rec-RSI) feeds recommender outputs into subsequent training. Evaluating each round solely through its latest model assumes that the successor consolidates the update, although pre- and post-update models may retain complementary ranking decisions. We term this \emph{distributed progress} and quantify it using cross-generation advantage (CGA), a marginally matched contrast between cross- and within-generation model pairs. A rank-separation statistic, label-free at selection time, predicts which family to retain. Across four datasets and three sequential recommendation encoders, the preferred retention regime varies by architecture: cross-generation pairing benefits GRU4Rec and SASRec, whereas FMLP initially favors within-generation pairing and shifts toward cross-generation pairing after a second update. Rank separation selects the stronger family in 12/12 first-update and 5/6 second-update dataset-encoder settings; on held-out tests, the selected family outperforms the direct successor in 34/36 trajectories. Five transfer mechanisms do not consistently reproduce these gains in one model. These findings establish state retention as a distinct Rec-RSI problem: progress may reside in relations between generations as well as in the latest model. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Jinfeng-Xu/RecRSI}{https://github.com/Jinfeng-Xu/RecRSI}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 推荐系统递归自我改进 (Rec-RSI) 中，只看最新一轮模型会漏掉跨代与代内配对各自保留的排序决策，作者把这种分布式进展 (distributed progress) 用跨代优势 (CGA) 量化，并用无需标签的 rank-separation 统计量决定保留哪一代。在四个数据集与三种序列推荐编码器上，该统计量在 12/12 首次更新与 5/6 第二次更新设置中选中更强家族，留出测试中 34/36 条轨迹上所选家族优于直接后继。
Motivation: Rec-RSI 把推荐器输出回灌训练，但每轮只用最新模型评估，隐含假设后继已完全吸收更新；实际上更新前后模型可能各保留互补的排序决策，导致进展被低估或选错保留对象。
Method: 提出跨代优势 (cross-generation advantage, CGA)，对跨代与代内模型配对做边际匹配的对比；再用选择时无需标签的 rank-separation 统计量预测应保留哪一代家族，并在四个数据集、三种序列推荐编码器 (GRU4Rec、SASRec、FMLP) 的多轮更新轨迹上检验，另考察五种迁移机制。
Result: rank separation 在 12/12 首次更新与 5/6 第二次更新的 dataset-encoder 设置中选中更强家族；留出测试中所选家族在 34/36 条轨迹上优于直接后继。保留偏好随架构变化：GRU4Rec 与 SASRec 受益于跨代配对，FMLP 初始偏好代内配对、第二次更新后转向跨代。五种迁移机制在某一模型上不能稳定复现这些增益。
Conclusion: 状态保留是 Rec-RSI 中一个独立问题：进展既可能在最新模型里，也可能存在于代与代之间的关系中，因此保留策略需按架构选择而非默认沿用后继。

papers.title: Muon Is Theoretically Wrong For Convolutions, But Empirically Effective
papers.abstract_en: Muon, an optimizer known for its efficiency, has a clear interpretation for matrix-valued updates, but convolutional kernels are stored as four-dimensional tensors. Standard implementations reshape these tensors into matrices, a shortcut which breaks the theoretical understanding behind Muon. To investigate this, we formalize the corresponding optimization objective directly in convolutional operator geometry and introduce Convolutional Newton-Schulz (Conv-NS), which approximates the polar factor in this geometry while preserving kernel support. When applied in fast training experiments, Conv-NS and reshape-based Muon are both computationally efficient and achieve comparable accuracy on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet classification tasks. However, as one could expect a theoretically aligned Conv-NS to outperform reshape-based Muon, we investigate this mismatch between practice and theoretical understanding, with the hypothesis that exact convolutional orthogonalization may overconstrain updates. These findings highlight Muon's strong practical performance while opening directions for its further development on convolutions. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/thib-s/muonconv-cifar10-airbench}{github conv-muon}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Muon 的矩阵值更新解释推广到卷积算子几何，提出保持卷积核支撑的 Convolutional Newton-Schulz (Conv-NS) 来近似该几何下的极因子。在 CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet 快速训练中，Conv-NS 与 reshape 版 Muon 计算开销相当、精度相当，理论对齐版本并未胜出；作者据此假设精确的卷积正交化可能对更新约束过强。
Motivation: 卷积核存为四维张量，标准实现把它 reshape 成矩阵，破坏了 Muon 背后的理论解释；若在正确的卷积几何里做正交化，理论上应更好，但实践与理论出现错位。
Method: 在卷积算子几何中形式化对应优化目标，提出 Conv-NS：在该几何下近似极因子 (polar factor) 且保持卷积核支撑 (kernel support)，并与 reshape-based Muon 在快速训练实验中对比。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 与 ImageNet 分类的快速训练实验中，Conv-NS 与 reshape-based Muon 都计算高效且达到相当精度；本应占优的理论对齐 Conv-NS 并未超越 reshape 版 Muon，作者提出精确卷积正交化可能过度约束更新的假设来解释该错位。
Conclusion: Muon 在卷积上的强实践表现并不依赖其矩阵 reshape 的理论解释，卷积几何上的精确正交化未必带来收益，这为 Muon 在卷积上的进一步发展留出空间。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When to Remember, When to Abstain: Category-Conditioned Retention for Reliable Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Persistent agent memory is only as reliable as its retention decision: an assertion weakly supported by its source can be stored and later reused as established fact. We study whether the retention decision should be governed by a confidence bar conditioned on the semantic category of the assertion rather than by a single global threshold, retaining well-evidenced categories liberally while abstaining more aggressively where inference is unreliable. We evaluate this in a deployed cold-start memory pipeline on 100 synthetic personas. The empirical evaluation is motivated by a sharp reliability asymmetry: across 4{,}715 candidate assertions, only 77.9\% of value and belief assertions are supported by their source, versus 96.2\% for all other categories. A global confidence threshold cannot separate these: it either admits unsupported value claims or discards well-evidenced ones. Conditioning the threshold on category resolves the tradeoff. In repeated held-out evaluation, a stricter bar on values alone reduces unsupported retentions from 6.2\% to 4.0\% (an ${\approx}36\%$ relative reduction, modest but consistent across folds) and, as corroborating evidence, preserves an estimated 13 percentage points more coverage (95\% CI 9.8--16.0) than a global threshold at comparable retention. Our results suggest that reliable retention depends on the type of assertion, not on confidence alone, and that a category-conditioned threshold can act as a simple, effective form of selective prediction at the write boundary.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 Figure, Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Social Agent Workshop (https://openreview.net/group?id=NeurIPS.cc%2F2026%2FWorkshop%2FSocialAgent#tab-your-consoles)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部署的冷启动 agent 记忆管线中，按断言语义类别分别设定置信度门槛，比单一全局门槛更能拦住证据不足的写入：对 value/belief 类收紧后，unsupported retention 从 6.2% 降到 4.0%（相对下降约 36%），并在相近保留率下多保住约 13 个百分点的 coverage（95% CI 9.8–16.0）。
Motivation: agent 记忆的写入决策若只用一个全局置信度门槛，就会在“放进证据不足的 value 断言”和“丢掉证据充分的断言”之间二选一；而 4,715 条候选断言中 value/belief 类只有 77.9% 被来源支持，其余类别达 96.2%，可靠性高度不均。
Method: 在部署的 cold-start memory pipeline 上做类别条件化的保留决策：按断言语义类别分配不同 confidence bar，对 value 类设更严门槛、对证据可靠的类别放宽；在 100 个 synthetic personas 上做重复 held-out 折评估，与全局门槛在相近保留率下对照。
Result: 4,715 条候选断言中 value/belief 类来源支持率 77.9%，其余类别 96.2%；仅对 value 类收紧门槛使 unsupported retention 从 6.2% 降至 4.0%（相对下降约 36%，跨折一致），并在相近保留率下比全局门槛多保留约 13 个百分点 coverage（95% CI 9.8–16.0）。
Conclusion: 可靠保留取决于断言类型而非单纯置信度，类别条件化门槛可作为写入边界的简单 selective prediction 手段。

papers.title: T-CCL: Resource Efficient and Performant Collective Communication using Tensor Memory Accelerator
papers.abstract_en: Large transformer-based models increasingly depend on multi-GPU execution, which requires frequent collective communication among GPUs. Existing communication libraries often rely on many GPU threads to achieve high bandwidth or low latency, resulting in a large streaming multiprocessor (SM)-side resource footprint. This footprint can limit the resources available to other GPU work, particularly when communication and computation execute concurrently. Thus, efficient collective communication should not only achieve high collective performance but also reduce its SM-side resource usage. This paper presents T-CCL, a resource-efficient collective communication library based on the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) for intra-node communication. T-CCL offloads both data movement and reduction operations to TMA and executes each collective as a pipelined series of asynchronous TMA operations, reducing the SM resources required for collective communication while maintaining high bandwidth. Evaluated across AllReduce, AllGather, and ReduceScatter collectives, T-CCL outperforms NCCL by up to 2.4x with unrestricted communication resources and up to 3.42x under restricted resource budgets, remains competitive with NCCL's recent symmetric-memory kernels, and occupies the same or fewer SMs in profiled cases. In a GEMM-collective overlap case study, switching the communication backend from NCCL to T-CCL raises the average operator-level speedup over a sequential baseline from 1.12x to 1.25x on two GPUs and from 1.04x to 1.14x on four GPUs, as T-CCL uses fewer SMs for communication, leaving more SMs available to the overlapped GEMM. Integrated into vLLM as a communication backend, T-CCL improves end-to-end inference throughput over vLLM's automatic backend dispatch by up to 1.31x, outperforming it at every evaluated batch size on both the conversation and decode-heavy workloads.

TL;DR: T-CCL 用 Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) 把数据搬运与归约全部卸载，通信以异步 TMA 流水线执行，从而压缩集合通信的 SM 占用。在 AllReduce/AllGather/ReduceScatter 上相对 NCCL 最高 2.4x（资源受限预算下 3.42x），GEMM 重叠平均加速比从 1.12x 提到 1.15x 级别，vLLM 端到端吞吐最高 1.31x。
Motivation: 现有通信库靠大量 GPU 线程换带宽或延迟，SM 侧资源占用大，通信与计算并发时挤占算力。
Method: T-CCL 面向节点内通信，将数据搬运与 reduction 都交给 TMA，每个集合通信实现为一串异步 TMA 流水线操作；作为通信后端接入 vLLM。
Result: 相对 NCCL：无资源限制时最高 2.4x，受限资源预算下最高 3.42x；与 NCCL 新的 symmetric-memory kernel 相当或更优，profile 案例中占用相同或更少 SM。GEMM-集合通信重叠：两卡平均算子级加速比 1.12x→1.25x，四卡 1.04x→1.14x。集成进 vLLM 后相对其自动后端分发端到端推理吞吐最高 1.31x，在 conversation 与 decode-heavy 两种负载的每个评测 batch size 上都更高。
Conclusion: 把集合通信的搬运与归约整体卸载到 TMA，可以在保持高带宽的同时减少 SM 占用，从而让重叠的 GEMM 与推理吞吐受益。

papers.title: Verified, not generated: expert-verified AI study materials and the distribution of learning gains in a university course
papers.abstract_en: Experimental studies of generative AI in education mostly report average effects, yet field evidence shows that AI can narrow attainment gaps or widen them. We argue that the direction depends on the judgement burden, the expertise a learner must supply to screen AI output before learning from it, and that expert verification before release moves this burden from students to an accountable tutor. We test the argument in a two-cohort difference-in-differences design in which one half of a compulsory firstyear university economics course received AI-generated podcasts, FAQs and quiz-based study guides, produced with a source-grounded model and checked by a named graduate teaching assistant (170 students; 340 examination marks). Access was associated with a 2.34-mark advantage on a 50-mark component. The share of marks below the upper-second classification boundary fell by 24.7 percentage points relative to the counterfactual, effects were significant at every threshold from 23 to 31 marks and at none above, and roughly three-quarters of the average originated in the bottom quintile. The threshold estimate is robust to removing the lowest-scoring students from the pre-intervention cohort; the average effect is not. Interviews and feedback from 36 students indicate that the verification label gave students a reason to engage with AI-generated material without ending their scrutiny of it. Evaluations of AI learning resources that report only mean effects cannot detect whether the students the resources are meant to help are the ones who gain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在一年级必修经济学课程中，把生成式 AI 学习材料（播客、FAQ、测验式指南）先由具名研究生助教按来源核验再发放，可把成绩提升集中到低分段学生：170 名学生、340 份考试成绩的双队列双重差分显示，50 分制组件平均多得 2.34 分，低于 upper-second 分界线的成绩占比相对反事实下降 24.7 个百分点。作者主张只报均值的评估无法判断资源是否帮到了最需要帮助的学生。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 教育实验多报平均效应，而现场证据显示 AI 既可能缩小也可能扩大成绩差距；差距方向取决于学习者在使用 AI 输出前必须投入的判断负担 (judgement burden)。
Method: 双队列双重差分 (difference-in-differences) 设计：必修一年级经济学课程一半学生使用由 source-grounded 模型生成、并经具名研究生助教核验后发布的 AI 播客、FAQ 与测验式学习指南；另以 36 名学生的访谈与反馈做质性补充。
Result: 样本 170 名学生、340 份考试成绩；接入 AI 材料与 50 分制组件上 2.34 分的优势相关；低于 upper-second 等级线的成绩份额相对反事实下降 24.7 个百分点；在 23 至 31 分各阈值上效应均显著，31 分以上均不显著；约四分之三的平均效应来自最低五分位；剔除前一队列最低分学生后阈值估计稳健，平均效应不稳健；36 名学生的访谈反馈显示核验标签给了学生使用 AI 材料的理由，同时并未终结其审慎筛查。
Conclusion: 把判断负担从学生转移到可问责的助教，能让 AI 学习资源的收益集中在低分段学生；只报均值的评估检测不到目标学生是否真正获益。

papers.title: Evaluating Inference Compute for Generative AI: A Framework for Enterprise Workloads
papers.abstract_en: LLM deployment is shifting from single-turn completion to agentic trajectories in which a model plans, calls tools, reads results and reasons at test time before acting. This inverts the economics of inference hardware: chat serving amortises weight reads across large batches, whereas agent trajectories are sequentially dependent, run at effective batch one, and make per-token decode latency (TPOT) the dominant term in task completion time. Using a roofline analysis and a closed-form episode-latency model, we show why this regime favours accelerators that keep weights in on-die SRAM (Cerebras WSE-3/3T, Groq/NVIDIA LPU) or compiler-managed tiered memory (SambaNova SN40L/SN50), and why three vendor ecosystems converged in 2026 on disaggregated prefill/decode serving. We show that per-step reliability compounds exponentially in trajectory length-a 2% per-step failure rate erases a 2x decode advantage for a 20-step agent-so determinism and tail latency are first-order performance variables. We then propose a four-layer evaluation framework (silicon, serving system, agent episode, enterprise) with a metric set built on goodput at an agentic SLO and cost per successful episode, a six-axis benchmark protocol over six task families, a paired-bootstrap statistical design, an attestation protocol for vendor-run benchmarks, and TCO, availability and adoption-timing models with explicit break-even conditions. All performance figures are public and labelled by evidence class; we state seven falsifiable hypotheses and the experiments that test them, and argue that the most likely original result is that token-throughput rankings diverge from cost-per-successful-task rankings on long-horizon work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 agentic LLM 推理的评测框架：用 roofline 与闭式 episode 延迟模型论证顺序依赖、有效 batch=1 的轨迹负载使 TPOT 成为主导项，因而偏向权重驻留 on-die SRAM（Cerebras WSE-3/3T、Groq/NVIDIA LPU）或编译器管理分层内存（SambaNova SN40L/SN50）的加速器。核心定量论断是每步 2% 失败率在 20 步 agent 上足以抵消 2 倍解码优势，故 token 吞吐排名会在长程任务上与每成功任务成本排名分化。
Motivation: LLM 部署从单轮补全转向 agentic 轨迹后，权重读取无法靠大 batch 摊薄，现有以 token 吞吐为主的推理硬件评测无法反映任务完成时间与成本。
Method: 提出四层评测框架（silicon、serving system、agent episode、enterprise），指标以 agentic SLO 下的 goodput 与 cost per successful episode 为核心；配套六个任务族的六轴 benchmark 协议、paired-bootstrap 统计设计、厂商自测的 attestation 协议，以及带显式 break-even 条件的 TCO、可用性与采用时机模型；分析工具为 roofline 与闭式 episode-latency 模型。
Result: 每步 2% 失败率在 20 步 agent 上抹掉 2 倍解码优势；论证 2026 年三个厂商生态在 disaggregated prefill/decode serving 上收敛；给出 7 条可证伪假设及其检验实验；所有性能数字公开并按证据等级标注。
Conclusion: 作者主张长程工作负载上 token 吞吐排名会与每成功任务成本排名分化，且确定性与尾延迟是一阶性能变量；论文本身给出框架与假设，最可能的原创结果即该排名分化。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Small Language Models for Smart Data Model Classification at the Edge: A Cost-Aware Hybrid Approach
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of heterogeneous data sources within the Internet of Things (IoT) across domains such as smart cities, energy management, and environmental monitoring necessitates efficient and scalable data standardization methods. Effective classification of smart data models (SDMs) is essential for facilitating interoperability. However, existing approaches are often limited by high resource consumption and lack applicability in edge environments with constrained computational capabilities. Aiming to bridge this gap, the proposed study evaluates the performance of lightweight open-source language models (LMs) to resolve an input data entity against its corresponding best fitting SDM representation under resource-constrained conditions. It systematically benchmarks a diverse array of models, including general purpose (GP), reasoning-specialized (RS), and code-specialized (CS) architectures, across multiple domain-specific datasets. Addressing the current omission of lightweight, resource-efficient solutions in the literature, the investigation provides significant and valuable insights into model selection, task formulation, and deployment strategies that optimize accuracy and efficiency. A complementary experiment also compares the surveyed large language models (LLMs) against two near-zero-cost similarity baselines (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and a lightweight sentence encoder) on the same task, providing a strong reference point for interpreting the practical value of LLM-based classification on edge platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向 IoT 边缘设备的智能数据模型 (SDM) 分类，系统评测轻量开源语言模型（通用 GP、推理 RS、代码 CS 三类）把输入数据实体匹配到最合适的 SDM 表示，并与 TF-IDF 和轻量句向量编码器两个近零成本相似度基线对照。结论是模型选型、任务表述与部署策略共同决定边缘上的精度-效率权衡，而非单纯追求更大模型。
Motivation: IoT 异构数据源需要 SDM 分类来实现互操作，但现有方法资源开销大、难以部署在算力受限的边缘环境，且文献缺少轻量、资源高效方案的系统对照。
Method: 对多类轻量开源 LM 做跨领域数据集的系统 benchmark，按 GP/RS/CS 架构分组比较；补充实验在同一任务上加入 TF-IDF 与轻量 sentence encoder 两个近零成本相似度基线，作为解释 LLM 实际价值的参照。
Result: 给出模型选型、任务表述 (task formulation) 与部署策略对准确率和效率的对比洞察，并在相同 SDM 分类任务上把 LLM 与 TF-IDF、轻量句向量编码器两个近零成本基线并列比较；摘要未列出具体数值。
Conclusion: 边缘 SDM 分类应把轻量 LM 与近零成本相似度基线放在同一评测框架下权衡精度和效率，按部署约束选择模型与任务表述方式。

papers.title: Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads
papers.abstract_en: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把企业文档内容抽取做成独立、可配置、可度量的阶段：选择性 OCR 路由、稀缺优先的标注筛选与基于参考的抽取打分器、结构感知的父子分块器，以及只读检索评测器。在 180 篇文档语料上最佳抽取器得 97.4/100（字符错误率 0.13%，表格相似度 0.995），分块器在 25,050 条生成问题上 hit@1 68.6%、hit@10 92.8%、MRR 0.77。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 把模型与任务解耦，企业知识以 PDF、扫描件、表格等混合版式存在，抽取错误在接口处产生后，下游 retriever 与 re-ranker 无法修复，因此内容抽取必须成为可度量的独立生命周期阶段。
Method: 系统包含选择性 OCR 路由、scarcity-first 标注筛选引擎与基于参考的抽取打分器（度量字符、词、表结构准确率）、确定性的结构感知 parent-child chunker，以及从每页生成 grounded 问题的只读检索评测器，报告 Hit@k、MRR 与延迟。
Result: 在 180 篇文档语料上，最佳抽取器得 97.4/100，字符错误率 0.13%，表格相似度 0.995；chunker 在 25,050 条生成问题上 hit@1 68.6%、hit@10 92.8%、MRR 0.77。
Conclusion: 内容抽取应被当作企业 agentic 系统的感知层来显式度量，并沉淀三条设计原则：结构先于语义、不改动被测对象、按预算分配标注。

papers.title: Towards a Unified Misuse Monitoring Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly act in multi-actor environments, exposing them to misuse from multiple sources: decomposition attacks, where a harmful request is split into innocuous sub-requests, and prompt injection attacks, where a compromised tool delivers a malicious instruction. Existing evaluations treat these threats separately and ask whether a trajectory is harmful, rather than when it becomes harmful. We propose monitoring the agent's responses, where its actions are externalised, and ask whether the first point where monitors identify harm lands within a harm window (from the agent's first harmful commitment to goal execution). We develop a unified formalism for trace-level misuse monitoring and use it to construct a benchmark of ~6,200 conversation transcripts between a user, an LLM agent, and the external environment, spanning both threats in a shared schema, with a labelled harm window, corresponding benign controls, and matched instances of refusals to these requests. Across 17 monitor configurations, we find that our proposed action-framed monitors perform well on both threats under classical metrics (AUC: 0.95 and 0.99 respectively), while content-framed monitors collapse on injection attacks (AUC: 0.52). We also show that classical position-blind metrics paint an optimistic picture of monitor performance, since all monitors localise decomposition attacks poorly under the interval metric, which measures the ability to localise harm. Broadly, we illustrate the need for a unified study of misuse monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一的 LLM agent 轨迹级滥用监测基准：把分解攻击与提示注入放进同一 schema，判定监测器首次识别出危害的时刻是否落在 harm window（从首次有害承诺到目标执行）内。约 6,200 条对话、17 种监测配置下，action-framed 监测器在两类威胁上 AUC 分别为 0.95 与 0.99，content-framed 监测器在注入攻击上塌到 0.52；且经典 position-blind 指标偏乐观，所有监测器在 interval 指标下对分解攻击的定位都很差。
Motivation: 现有评测把分解攻击与提示注入分开处理，且只问轨迹是否有害，不问危害在何时产生，导致监测器定位能力被高估。
Method: 提出 trace-level misuse monitoring 的统一形式化，构造约 6,200 条用户、LLM agent 与外部环境三方对话 transcript 的基准，共享 schema，标注 harm window、对应良性对照与匹配的拒绝样本；在 17 种监测配置上比较 action-framed 与 content-framed 监测器，并引入衡量危害定位能力的 interval 指标。
Result: 17 种监测配置下，action-framed 监测器对分解攻击与注入攻击的 AUC 分别为 0.95 和 0.99；content-framed 监测器在注入攻击上 AUC 仅 0.52。经典 position-blind 指标给出偏乐观的结果，而在 interval 指标下所有监测器对分解攻击的定位都很差。
Conclusion: 滥用监测应统一覆盖多类威胁并以危害发生时刻（harm window）为判据，仅看轨迹整体有害性的 position-blind 指标会掩盖监测器定位失败。

papers.title: A Data-Centric Review of Plant Disease Datasets: Taxonomy, Critical Analysis, Environmental Variability, and Implications for Precision Agriculture
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid advances in artificial intelligence, reliable real-world plant disease detection remains a persistent challenge. Visual and deep learning approaches have shown promising results, but their deployment under field conditions remains limited. A key bottleneck is the reliance on laboratory-generated datasets that lack environmental diversity, realistic backgrounds, and balanced class distributions, resulting in poor generalization. In contrast, datasets collected directly from agricultural environments capture natural variability and better reflect challenges faced by farmers across regions. This review presents a critical analysis of visual and deep learning approaches for plant disease detection, with emphasis on plant disease datasets. It establishes a taxonomy based on acquisition setting, accessibility, plant diversity, disease composition, class structure, and imbalance severity, and examines their implications for model generalization and real-world deployment. A comparative analysis of laboratory and real-field datasets identifies critical gaps that hinder disease detection. The review further analyzes how multi-level dataset imbalance, including intra-class, inter-crop, and cross-dataset imbalance, and limited environmental variability affect model performance and robustness, an area insufficiently examined in existing surveys. Beyond image-based approaches, it highlights the importance of integrating environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, and leaf wetness with image data to improve prediction under dynamic field conditions. Finally, the review identifies key challenges, research gaps, and future directions concerning dataset construction, environmental variability, structural imbalance, standardization, and multimodal disease monitoring. It provides a foundation for developing next-generation multimodal frameworks for precision agriculture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇以数据为中心的植物病害数据集综述，按采集场景、可获取性、植物与病害构成、类别结构和不平衡严重度建立分类法，并指出实验室数据集缺乏环境多样性与类别平衡是田间部署泛化差的主因。综述主张把温度、湿度、叶面湿度等环境参数与图像数据融合，以改善动态田间条件下的病害预测。
Motivation: 深度学习在植物病害检测上实验室结果好，但依赖实验室生成的数据集，缺少环境多样性、真实背景与平衡类别分布，导致田间泛化差、部署受限；现有综述对多层级类别不平衡与环境变异如何影响性能考察不足。
Method: 综述性工作：建立基于采集场景、可获取性、植物多样性、病害组成、类别结构与不平衡严重度的数据集分类法；对比实验室与真实田间数据集；分析 intra-class、inter-crop、cross-dataset 三级不平衡及有限环境变异对模型性能与鲁棒性的影响，并梳理数据集构建、标准化与多模态监测的研究缺口。
Result: 产出为分类法与批判性分析：识别出阻碍病害检测的实验室/田间数据集关键差距，指出多层级不平衡与有限环境变异是既有综述研究不足的领域，并给出整合温度、湿度、叶面湿度与图像数据的多模态方向；摘要未给出实验数值对比。
Conclusion: 植物病害检测的瓶颈在数据而非模型容量，下一代精准农业框架应以真实田间数据集、结构化不平衡处理和环境参数多模态融合为前提。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: SchemaFill: Efficient LLM Tool Calling via Slot-Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents interact with external systems by generating structured tool calls. Given a user request, conversational context, and a catalog of tool schemas, a tool-calling model must select tools and generate their arguments, potentially producing multiple calls in a single response. Standard autoregressive decoding generates these calls token by token, incurring substantial latency for requests involving multiple calls or many argument fields. The explicit argument structure offers opportunities for parallel generation, but later argument values may depend on preceding fields and calls, so independently generated values can differ from the target model's output. We present SchemaFill, a framework for efficient LLM tool calling through slot-parallel speculative decoding. SchemaFill generates future slot values concurrently as candidates, without requiring advance knowledge of the actual call sequence or argument values. Candidates spanning multiple fields and calls are concatenated for verification by the target model under the actual output prefix. Only verified tokens are committed, and the target supplies corrections when candidates disagree. This applies target verification while exploiting parallelism across slots and calls. On Glaive and BFCL, SchemaFill achieves up to a 4.05$\times$ improvement in end-to-end throughput over autoregressive decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SchemaFill 把工具调用的参数槽位 (slot) 当作推测解码的并行单元：并发生成跨字段、跨调用的候选值，拼接后由目标模型在真实输出前缀下整体验证，只提交被验证的 token，候选与目标不一致时由目标给出纠正。在 Glaive 与 BFCL 上端到端吞吐相对自回归解码最高提升 4.05×。
Motivation: LLM agent 单次响应里产生多个工具调用、每个调用又有很多参数字段时，逐 token 自回归解码延迟显著；参数结构本身允许并行，但后序字段依赖前序字段与调用，独立生成会偏离目标模型输出。
Method: SchemaFill 无需预先知道实际调用序列或参数值，即并发生成各 slot 的候选值；把跨字段、跨调用的候选拼接成完整草稿，交由目标模型在真实输出前缀下验证，仅提交验证通过的 token，不一致处由目标模型补纠正，从而同时保留目标验证与 slot/调用级并行。
Result: 在 Glaive 与 BFCL 两个工具调用基准上，端到端吞吐相对自回归解码最高提升 4.05×；代码开源于 github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill。
Conclusion: 工具调用的显式参数结构可作为推测解码的并行粒度：以 slot 为单位并发起草、以目标模型整体验证，能在不牺牲目标分布一致性的前提下摊薄多调用、多字段请求的解码延迟。

papers.title: A Query Is Not a Commitment: Learning to Correct Expert Answers in Online Deferral
papers.abstract_en: An inaccurate expert can still provide useful information after correction. We study online learning to defer in which the learner chooses an expert and fixes a correction function before purchasing its answer, then applies that function to the answer received. The difficulty is that observed losses reflect both expert quality and an unfinished correction: early errors can discourage queries that would be valuable after learning. We propose ORUCB, which pools shared and expert-specific polynomial responses. A bound on cumulative response-learning error calibrates confidence-weighted risk regression and exploration, allowing the router to account for this error when deciding which answers to buy. Under bounded residuals and disagreements, a fixed feasible model of optimal responses, and linear models of free and optimal queried risk, the calibrated algorithm achieves high-probability pseudo-regret $O(\sqrt T\log(T+1))$ over $T$ rounds for fixed problem parameters. The guarantee permits singular answer distributions and misspecified shared responses; optimality is relative to the bounded response class. On four test streams, the selected cubic policy has lower fee-inclusive cost than seven baselines that deploy answers unchanged. Comparisons with a common correction learner examine routing, while six-price comparisons measure cost and query rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线延迟决策 (online deferral) 中，学习者先选定专家并固定校正函数再购买答案，ORUCB 用共享与专家专属多项式响应池化，把响应学习误差的累计上界注入置信加权风险回归与探索，使路由在决定买谁的答案时把校正尚未学好这一因素算进去。在有界残差与分歧、固定最优响应模型、免费与最优查询风险为线性模型的假设下，固定问题参数时高概率伪遗憾为 O(√T·log(T+1))；四条测试流上所选 cubic 策略的含费成本低于七条原样部署答案的基线。
Motivation: 观测损失混合了专家质量与尚未学完的校正两部分，早期误差会抑制本应在学会校正后才有价值的查询，导致路由过早放弃好专家。
Method: 提出 ORUCB：把共享响应与专家专属的多项式响应池化；用响应学习累计误差的界来校准置信加权风险回归与探索项，让路由器在购买决策中计入该校正误差；在有界残差与分歧、固定最优响应模型、免费与最优查询风险为线性模型的条件下给出保证。
Result: 固定问题参数下高概率伪遗憾为 O(√T·log(T+1))（T 轮），且允许奇异答案分布与共享响应误设，最优性相对于有界响应类。四条测试流上，所选 cubic 策略的含费成本低于七条原样部署答案的基线；另与一个通用校正学习器比较路由行为，并做六种价格的比较以测量成本与查询率。
Conclusion: 把校正学习误差显式纳入置信与探索，可在不牺牲渐近遗憾阶的情况下让在线路由更愿意购买事后才划算的专家答案；最优性声明限定在有界响应类内。

papers.title: Graph-Based Recognition of Simulated Train-Driver States From Facial and Upper-Body Keypoints
papers.abstract_en: Driver fatigue poses a significant challenge to railway safety, with traditional systems like the dead-man switch offering limited and basic alertness checks. This study presents a vision-based monitoring system that relies solely on a single front-facing RGB camera and a graph neural network to classify simulated train-driver states into alert, not-alert, and an emergency class comprising acted emergency-like behaviours. To optimize input representations for the model, an ablation study was performed, comparing three feature configurations: skeletal-only, facial-only, and a combination of both. Experimental results show that combining facial and skeletal features yields the highest accuracy (81%) for the three-class model under the light condition, outperforming models that use only facial or skeletal features. Furthermore, the combination of facial and skeletal features achieves 99% accuracy in the alert/not alert classification in light condition. Additionally, we introduced a controlled RGB video dataset containing alert, not alert, and acted emergency-like behaviours recorded under three illumination conditions. These contributions represent a step toward passive and non-contact train-driver state recognition based on facial and upper-body dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Demo: Vision-Language Model-Guided Online Calibration of an Electromagnetic Digital Twin
papers.abstract_en: An electromagnetic (EM) digital twin gives mobile robots wireless situational awareness but depends on material conductivities that change with the environment. Online calibration faces initialization sensitivity and measurement travel costs. We demonstrate a vision-language model (VLM)-guided framework using a Unitree G1 robot and NVIDIA Sionna, with two VLM calls: material classification maps visible materials through ITU-R P.2040 to conductivity priors for Sionna's gradient descent on accumulated received signal strength (RSS) measurements; waypoint planning selects the next measurement location online using residual RSS calibration error and image coverage. In a real indoor scenario, the framework achieves a normalized mean absolute conductivity error of $1.74\times10^{-4}$ within 20 m of travel; random initialization never converges, while random waypoints require over twice the travel.

TL;DR: VLM 引导的电磁数字孪生在线标定：用视觉材料分类经 ITU-R P.2040 给出电导率先验，再按残差 RSS 误差与图像覆盖在线选点。真实室内场景中 20 m 行程内归一化电导率平均绝对误差达 1.74×10⁻⁴，随机初始化从不收敛，随机选点所需行程超过两倍。
Motivation: 电磁数字孪生依赖随环境变化的材料电导率，在线标定对初始化敏感，且逐点测量的行程开销高。
Method: 两次 VLM 调用：材料分类把可见材料经 ITU-R P.2040 映射为电导率先验，供 Sionna 对累积接收信号强度 (RSS) 做梯度下降；waypoint planning 依据残差 RSS 标定误差与图像覆盖在线选择下一测量位置。硬件为 Unitree G1 机器人，仿真平台 NVIDIA Sionna。
