papers.title: When Attention Does Not Explain the Peak: Temporal Reference vs. Forecast Output in Attention-Based Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Attention maps are often interpreted as evidence of what a forecasting model uses when making predictions. In our load-forecasting model, a CLS representation of historical demand queries 24 future exogenous horizon tokens through cross-attention, inviting a temporal interpretation in which highly attended horizons may appear to explain forecast peak timing. We test this interpretation using a horizon-level attention descriptor, $Ψ_{\mathrm{out}}$. Across 31 day-aligned windows of the Panama load dataset, the forecast achieves a median peak-time error of 0 h and a 51.6% exact-match rate, whereas the argmax of $Ψ_{\mathrm{out}}$ has a median error of 5 h and 0% exact match. The forecast peak is closer to the observed peak in 27 of 31 windows. This dissociation is not merely an argmax artifact: within $\pm1$ h, attention reaches only $1.16\times$, $1.11\times$, and $1.14\times$ the uniform baseline around observed, predicted, and weekly-naive peaks, respectively, indicating weak and non-selective concentration. Yet the attention profile is structured, with cross-window consistency of 0.83. Replacing 12 future weather features with their training-set means makes the profile nearly uniform, showing sensitivity to future weather variation rather than fixed horizon position alone. The dissociation is also reproduced across three random-seed runs. These results show that structured, input-sensitive, and reproducible horizon-level cross-attention need not provide a valid peak-selective explanation of forecast behavior. The observed behavior is instead consistent with an internal horizon-reference role for integrating future exogenous information, although this functional role is not causally established.
papers.comment: NeurIPS 2026: Accepted to the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Panama 负荷预测模型中，24 个未来外生 horizon token 的 cross-attention 被用来解释预测峰值时刻，但注意力 argmax 的峰值时刻中位误差为 5 h、精确匹配率 0%，而预测本身的中位误差为 0 h、精确匹配率 51.6%。注意力在观测/预测/周朴素峰值附近仅达均匀基线的 1.16×、1.11×、1.14×，说明结构化、输入敏感、可复现的注意力图并不构成对预测峰值的有效解释。
Motivation: 把 attention map 当作预测模型依据的常见做法在时间序列负荷预测中可能失效：高度被注意的 horizon 看似解释峰值时刻，但这种时间性解读未经检验。
Method: 提出 horizon 级注意力描述子 Ψ_out，用它对 CLS 查询 24 个未来外生 horizon token 的 cross-attention 取 argmax，与预测峰值和观测峰值逐窗口比较；在 31 个按日对齐的 Panama 负荷数据窗口上检验，并做替换未来天气特征为训练集均值的消融与三次随机种子复现。
Result: 31 个窗口中预测峰值中位误差 0 h、精确匹配率 51.6%，Ψ_out argmax 中位误差 5 h、精确匹配率 0%；预测峰值在 27/31 个窗口更接近观测峰值。±1 h 内注意力在观测、预测、周朴素峰值附近分别仅为均匀基线的 1.16×、1.11×、1.14×，而跨窗口一致性为 0.83；把 12 个未来天气特征换成训练集均值后注意力剖面近乎均匀，且该解离在三个随机种子上复现。
Conclusion: 结构化、输入敏感、可复现的 horizon 级 cross-attention 仍不构成对预测峰值的有效解释；观测行为更符合注意力承担整合未来外生信息的内部 horizon 参考角色，但该功能角色未被因果确立。

papers.title: Few-Shot Bioactivity Prediction with Meta-Learning under Assay Heterogeneity
papers.abstract_en: Accurate bioactivity prediction is a central challenge in early-stage drug discovery, as individual assays often contain too few measurements to train reliable models independently. Meta-learning offers a principled approach to this few-shot setting, but assay heterogeneity may limit its effectiveness. Here, we test this hypothesis and show that meta-learning performance degrades as meta-training tasks become more heterogeneous. To address this, we introduce MetaHeta, a meta-learning framework that accounts for assay heterogeneity by conditioning predictions on auxiliary data from related assays, with relatedness defined flexibly from available assay information. The architecture of MetaHeta combines linear attention over large auxiliary datasets with exact attention over scarce task-specific context, enabling efficient scaling to the former without compromising exact attention over the latter. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on assays from ChEMBL and BindingDB, improving few-shot bioactivity prediction and downstream compound prioritization in retrospective Bayesian optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MetaHeta 用元学习做少样本生物活性预测，并把 assay 异质性显式纳入条件化：性能随元训练任务异质性上升而下降，因此改为用相关 assay 的辅助数据做条件预测。架构上对大规模辅助集用 linear attention、对稀缺任务上下文用 exact attention，在 ChEMBL 与 BindingDB assay 上提升少样本预测与回顾性贝叶斯优化中的化合物优先排序。
Motivation: 早期药物发现中单个 assay 的测量太少，独立训练不可靠；元学习本可应对少样本，但 assay 异质性会削弱其效果，作者直接检验并证实了这一假设。
Method: 提出元学习框架 MetaHeta：以相关 assay 的辅助数据条件化预测，相关性从已有 assay 信息中灵活定义；架构结合对大规模辅助数据集的 linear attention 与对稀缺任务特定上下文的 exact attention，前者可高效扩展而不牺牲后者的精确注意力。
Result: 在 ChEMBL 与 BindingDB 的 assay 上，MetaHeta 改进了少样本生物活性预测，并改进了回顾性贝叶斯优化 (retrospective Bayesian optimization) 中的下游化合物优先排序；同时实证显示元学习性能随元训练任务异质性增加而下降。
Conclusion: assay 异质性是元学习少样本生物活性预测的实际瓶颈，用相关 assay 的辅助数据做条件化并区分 linear/exact attention 可以缓解它。

papers.title: What Must Replay Preserve? Separating Correctable Bias from Class Correspondence
papers.abstract_en: Class-incremental learning must recognize all classes seen so far without task labels. Logit replay methods such as DER and DER++ mitigate forgetting by matching the model's past predictions on stored examples. Deleting this matching reveals its benefit, but the resulting accuracy cost cannot show whether the stored scores themselves are needed, or whether the cost survives correction of the classifier's bias toward recent classes. We propose a diagnostic framework that treats a cached prediction as temporally heterogeneous supervision: it separates classes known when an example was stored from classes learned afterward, edits each group, and evaluates every model before and after a task-level offset that leaves within-task predictions unchanged. On CIFAR-100 with DER++, suitable fixed constants replace the unrefreshed stored scores of later-learned classes within an equivalence margin of 1 percentage point, and the offset reduces the cost of deleting their matching from 14.9 to 1.8 points. Reassigning the non-gold scores of classes known at storage, which preserves their values and each task's target probability, costs 4.3 points before and 4.0 after the offset, and a parallel cost persists in image distillation. In the tested fixed-head setting, the large cost of deleting later-class matching is thus mostly correctable by this offset, whereas the smaller cost of disrupting class correspondence persists. Code and data are available at anonymous.4open.science/r/replay-preserve-E22B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在类增量学习的 logit replay 中，删除对后期学习类的匹配造成的精度损失主要是可校正的分类器偏置：在 CIFAR-100 上用 DER++，一个不改变任务内预测的 task-level offset 把删除该匹配的代价从 14.9 个百分点压到 1.8 个百分点，且固定常数可在 1 个百分点等价裕度内替代未刷新的存储分数。而破坏存储时已知类的类对应关系（保持数值与每任务目标概率）代价为 4.3 点、offset 后仍为 4.0 点，图像蒸馏中也存在平行代价。
Motivation: 删除 logit 匹配后精度下降，但该代价无法区分两件事：存储分数本身是否必要，还是仅仅反映了分类器偏向近期类的偏置；只有把两者拆开，才知道 replay 真正必须保留什么。
Method: 提出诊断框架，把缓存预测视为时间上异质的监督：按存储时刻把类分为当时已知类与之后学到的类，分别编辑这两组分数，并在每个模型上比较施加 task-level offset 前后的结果（该 offset 不改变任务内预测）。实验在 CIFAR-100 上用 DER++，并对照图像蒸馏设置。
Result: CIFAR-100 + DER++ 上，用合适固定常数替代后期学习类未刷新的存储分数，等价裕度为 1 个百分点；task-level offset 使删除后期类匹配的代价从 14.9 个百分点降到 1.8 个百分点。重分配存储时已知类的非 gold 分数（保留其数值与每任务目标概率）在 offset 前代价 4.3 点、offset 后 4.0 点，图像蒸馏中存在平行代价。
Conclusion: 在所测试的 fixed-head 设定下，删除后期类匹配的大部分代价可被该 offset 校正，而破坏类对应关系的较小代价持续存在，即 replay 必须保留的是类对应而非后期类的存储分数本身。

papers.title: CuratorMAS: Automating Dataset Curation via Multi-Agent Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: High-quality datasets are essential for reliable machine learning, but dataset curation remains costly and hard to generalize across domains. Existing methods typically rely on manually designed heuristics or model-dependent signals, limiting their applicability across tasks and user queries. To address these limitations and automate data curation, we propose \textbf{CuratorMAS}, a multi-agent collaboration framework that orchestrates agents to evaluate and curate high-quality datasets. To achieve the goal of flexible curation, CuratorMAS decomposes the complex curation process into five programmable execution stages and forms a parallelizable workflow. Specifically, CuratorMAS first performs dataset exploration to collect contextual information such as file structures and constraint cues, thereby developing a comprehensive understanding of the given task. In order to acquire up-to-date information, CuratorMAS retrieves domain knowledge from online sources to augment the evaluation process. Next, CuratorMAS derives the necessary evaluation criteria and computes the corresponding metrics. Based on these results, CuratorMAS executes filtering accordingly. Finally, an evolution module summarizes the evaluation outcomes and updates the relevant skills. Extensive and comprehensive experiments demonstrate that CuratorMAS significantly reduces the noise rate by up to 36.03 percentage points (pp) while also improving the F1 score of downstream models by up to 8.88 pp.

papers.title: Learning Decision-Stump Thresholds in Context: Dynamics of Softmax Attention
papers.abstract_en: Estimating a decision threshold requires locating observations near an unknown boundary. We study how gradient-based pretraining learns this statistical rule in a two-parameter softmax-attention model with a fixed feature and inequality direction. Pretraining uses labeled contexts and their true thresholds; a fresh threshold must be inferred from context alone. Under a large-resolution initialization, constant-step gradient descent on $m$ tasks with $n$ examples each produces a frozen estimator with error $\widetilde O((m\wedge n)^{-1}+N^{-1})$ for each fixed interior threshold and every fresh-context size $N$. The two terms separate finite-pretraining accuracy from fresh-context localization. The mechanism is coordinated parameter divergence: population training calibrates the relative label and feature scores, then increases the attention scale as $t^{1/4}$, giving population threshold error $O(t^{-1/4})$. To transfer this mechanism to a fixed finite corpus, we control gradient errors relative to the shrinking directions of progress at successive parameter scales. This certifies a growing training interval without requiring long-time tracking of the population trajectory. We also identify the boundary limitation of the one-head model and explain statistically what a reflected symmetrization could achieve.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在固定特征与不等式方向的两参数 softmax 注意力模型上，证明梯度预训练学会的是“定位未知阈值附近观测”这一统计规则：大分辨率初始化下常数步长梯度下降在 m 个任务、每任务 n 个样本上得到冻结估计器，误差为 õ((m∧n)^{-1}+N^{-1})。机制是参数协同发散——总体训练先校准标签与特征分数的相对值，再让注意力尺度按 t^{1/4} 增长，从而总体阈值误差按 O(t^{-1/4}) 收敛。
Motivation: 阈值估计需要把注意力集中到未知边界附近的观测，但梯度预训练如何在注意力模型中形成这一统计规则、以及有限预训练与新上下文推断各自的误差来源，缺少理论刻画。
Method: 在固定特征与不等式方向的两参数 softmax 注意力模型上，用带标签上下文及其真实阈值做预训练，新阈值仅由上下文推断；在大分辨率初始化下分析常数步长梯度下降，并通过把梯度误差相对各参数尺度上收缩方向受控，把总体轨迹机制转移到固定有限语料，无需长时间追踪总体轨迹。
Result: 每个固定内部阈值、任意新上下文长度 N 下，冻结估计器误差为 õ((m∧n)^{-1}+N^{-1})，两项分别对应有限预训练精度与新上下文定位；总体训练中注意力尺度按 t^{1/4} 增长，总体阈值误差为 O(t^{-1/4})；并给出单头模型的边界局限及其统计解释。
Conclusion: softmax 注意力的阈值学习由“先校准分数、再放大注意力尺度”的协同发散机制驱动，误差可分解为预训练项与新上下文项，而单头模型存在固有边界局限。

papers.title: On Color Alignment in VAE Latent Spaces and Its Applications
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are a key part of modern text-to-image models, which generate images within their latent space. VAEs are known to disentangle the main factors of variation in the data, and color is known to be one of the most structured of these in natural images: decorrelating it yields one luminance axis and two opponent-color axes. Color should therefore be expected to emerge as a distinct factor in the VAE latent space. Yet how these latent spaces represent color remains largely unexplored. In this work, we show that the VAEs of text-to-image models share a color subspace aligned with brightness and opponent-colors. Through a linear approximation of the encoder and targeted latent steering, we find this subspace consistently across a broad range of VAEs, from SD1.5 to FLUX.2 and Z-Image. Building on this characterization, we propose three applications: ColorTuning, which achieves state-of-the-art in precise numerical color generation on the fine-grained CSS3/X11 system of GenColorBench, saturation control, to adjust the global chromatic intensity, and color transfer, to change the palette to match a reference. The code and models are publicly available at https://julian075.github.io/Color_Subspace/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 文本到图像模型的 VAE 潜空间中存在一个与亮度和对手色 (opponent-colors) 对齐的共享颜色子空间，通过编码器线性近似与定向潜变量操控 (latent steering) 可在 SD1.5 到 FLUX.2、Z-Image 的广泛 VAE 上一致找到。基于该刻画提出 ColorTuning、饱和度控制与颜色迁移三项应用，其中 ColorTuning 在 GenColorBench 的细粒度 CSS3/X11 数值颜色生成上达到 state-of-the-art。
Motivation: VAE 被认为能解耦数据的主要变化因子，颜色又是自然图像中结构最强的因子之一（去相关后得到一个亮度轴与两个对手色轴），理应在潜空间中作为独立因子出现，但文本到图像 VAE 的潜空间究竟如何表示颜色此前基本未被探索。
Method: 对编码器做线性近似并配合定向潜变量操控 (targeted latent steering)，在从 SD1.5、FLUX.2 到 Z-Image 的一系列 VAE 中定位与亮度和对手色对齐的颜色子空间；再据此构建三个应用：ColorTuning（数值颜色生成）、全局饱和度控制、以及参照图像的调色板颜色迁移。
Result: 在广泛 VAE 范围（SD1.5 至 FLUX.2、Z-Image）上一致找到该颜色子空间；ColorTuning 在 GenColorBench 的细粒度 CSS3/X11 颜色系统上取得精确数值颜色生成的 state-of-the-art；另两项应用实现饱和度调节与参照调色板迁移；代码与模型已公开。
Conclusion: 文本到图像 VAE 共享一个与亮度和对手色轴对齐的颜色子空间，对该子空间做线性操控即可同时支撑精确数值颜色生成、饱和度控制与颜色迁移。

papers.title: A BEMD-Based Quaternion Filtering Approach Sharp-to-Soft Kernel CT Image Conversion
papers.abstract_en: The quality of computed tomography (CT) images is significantly affected by the selection of reconstruction kernels: sharp kernels improve spatial resolution but increase noise, whereas soft kernels diminish noise at the expense of edge clarity. This study presents an innovative enhancement framework utilising Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition in conjunction with Quaternion Bilateral Filtering (BEMD--QBF) to convert sharp-kernel CT images into representations resembling soft-kernels, while maintaining critical anatomical structures. The technique disaggregates each image into intrinsic mode functions via BEMD and analyzes them inside a cohesive quaternion framework to attain efficient noise reduction and structural integrity. The proposed methodology is evaluated using several reconstruction kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36, B35, B31) and compared with recognised filtering strategies, including Non-Local Means, Anisotropic Diffusion, Bilateral Filtering, and Quaternion Bilateral Filtering. Quantitative evaluations of the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) indicate that BEMD-QBF consistently attains superior structural fidelity and competitive noise reduction across all evaluated kernels. The results underscore the efficacy of the proposed strategy as a viable approach to enhancing post-reconstruction CT images, yielding superior image quality without requiring access to raw projection data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEMD-QBF 把锐利核 CT 图像转成近似软核的图像：先用二维经验模态分解 (BEMD) 把图像拆成本征模态函数，再在四元数框架内做四元数双边滤波 (Quaternion Bilateral Filtering)，在降噪的同时保住解剖结构。在 B50、B46、B41、B36、B35、B31 六种重建核上，SSIM 与 PSNR 显示其结构保真度一致更优、降噪有竞争力，且无需原始投影数据。
Motivation: CT 重建核的选择是权衡：锐利核空间分辨率高但噪声大，软核噪声低但边缘模糊；临床上希望事后把已重建的锐利核图像转成软核观感，而不必重新投影或重扫。
Method: 对每幅图像先做 BEMD 分解得到多个 intrinsic mode functions，再把这些模态放进统一的四元数框架中分析，用 Quaternion Bilateral Filtering 同时实现噪声抑制与结构保持，从而把锐利核图像转换为类软核表示。
Result: 在 B50、B46、B41、B36、B35、B31 六种重建核上，与 Non-Local Means、Anisotropic Diffusion、Bilateral Filtering、Quaternion Bilateral Filtering 对比，SSIM 与 PSNR 评价显示 BEMD-QBF 在全部受评核上均取得更优的结构保真度与有竞争力的降噪表现。
Conclusion: 在不接触原始投影数据的前提下，BEMD 分解加四元数双边滤波是后重建 CT 图像质量增强的可行路径，可在保持关键解剖结构的同时获得更优图像质量。

papers.title: Decomposition-Guided Curvelet Thresholding for Sharp-to-Soft CT Kernel Conversion
papers.abstract_en: Image denoising is a crucial task in image processing, focused on improving image quality by minimizing noise while maintaining essential structural elements. This study presents a hybrid denoising framework that combines several decomposition techniques, including empirical mode decomposition (EMD), variational mode decomposition (VMD), multichannel EMD (MEMD), and bidimensional EMD (BEMD), with curvelet transform thresholding. Each decomposition mode undergoes processing through both soft and hard thresholding, and the denoised modes are combined to rebuild the final image. Comprehensive evaluations of standard CT image datasets reconstructed with various kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36) reveal substantial enhancements in denoising efficacy. VMD consistently achieves the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM), signifying exceptional noise reduction and feature preservation. The study analyses the trade-offs between soft and hard thresholding: soft thresholding maintains intricate visual details, whilst harsh thresholding provides enhanced noise reduction. The suggested method surpasses traditional techniques in both reference and non-reference quality criteria, indicating its potential for broader application in medical imaging and future incorporation with adaptive thresholding algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出分解引导的 curvelet 阈值去噪框架：先用 EMD/VMD/MEMD/BEMD 分解 CT 图像，各模态分别做软、硬阈值处理后再重建。在 B50、B46、B41、B36 多种重建核的标准 CT 数据集上，VMD 组合取得最高 PSNR 与 SSIM；软阈值保细节、硬阈值降噪更强。
Motivation: CT 图像去噪需在压制噪声与保留结构细节之间权衡，不同重建核带来的噪声特性差异需要一种能按模态分别处理的通用方案。
Method: 混合去噪框架：以经验模态分解 (EMD)、变分模态分解 (VMD)、多通道 EMD (MEMD)、二维 EMD (BEMD) 对图像做多尺度分解，每个分解模态分别通过 curvelet transform 的软阈值与硬阈值处理，再将处理后的模态合并重建最终图像。
Result: 在采用多种重建核 (B50、B46、B41、B36) 重建的标准 CT 图像数据集上评测，去噪效果显著提升；VMD 始终取得最高 PSNR 与 SSIM。软阈值保留精细视觉细节，硬阈值降噪更强；该方法在参考与非参考质量指标上均超过传统技术。
Conclusion: VMD 与 curvelet 阈值结合是该框架中最有效的分解选择，软/硬阈值构成细节保真与降噪强度的可调权衡，方法有望推广到医学成像并结合自适应阈值算法。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning to Simulate Individuals from Macro Social Signals
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate how individuals respond to new situations, yet the behavioral reasoning behind these responses is either inherited from pretraining or learned from individual-level annotations, which offer limited behavioral diversity and little supervision of the reasoning itself. We propose to learn behavioral reasoning from prediction markets, whose price trajectories record how populations respond to real-world events at scale. We introduce macro2mind, which trains a language model with GRPO using market signals. A social behavioral decomposition makes behavioral reasoning an explicit step of forecasting: the model infers representative groups of market participants, predicts how each interprets the news and updates its beliefs, reasons about their interactions, and aggregates these responses into a price. A hindsight-regret curriculum with difficulty-aware sampling focuses training on transitions where hindsight-identified groups substantially improve the forecast while prioritizing examples that remain learnable for the current policy. The learned reasoning applies to user simulation without further training. On SWM-Bench, macro2mind achieves state-of-the-art directional accuracy and correlation on Polymarket. Trained on market data, it transfers zero-shot to four user-simulation benchmarks (Humanual, OvertonBench, PRISM, and CAD) and has competitive performance among zero-shot methods. Used as a data generator, macro2mind also raises a downstream simulator's accuracy on unseen users by 15.5 points, outperforming data generated by its backbone by 13.2 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: macro2mind 用 GRPO 从预测市场价格轨迹学社会行为推理：把推理拆成识别代表性群体、各自解读新闻并更新信念、推理群体互动、聚合成价格四步，配 hindsight-regret 课程与难度感知采样。在 SWM-Bench 的 Polymarket 上取得 SOTA 方向准确率与相关性，零样本迁移到四个人模拟基准有竞争力，作数据生成器使下游模拟器在未见用户上准确率提高 15.5 点。
Motivation: LLM 个体模拟的行为推理要么继承预训练、要么靠个体级标注学习，行为多样性有限且推理本身缺少监督。
Method: 用 GRPO 训练语言模型，输入市场信号；社会行为分解 (social behavioral decomposition) 把推理显式化为群体识别、信念更新、互动推理、价格聚合；hindsight-regret 课程配合难度感知采样，聚焦事后被识别为能显著改善预测且当前策略仍可学的转移。
Result: 在 SWM-Bench 上于 Polymarket 取得 SOTA 方向准确率与相关性；零样本迁移到 Humanual、OvertonBench、PRISM、CAD 四个人模拟基准，在零样本方法中表现有竞争力；作为数据生成器使下游模拟器在未见用户上准确率提升 15.5 点，比其 backbone 生成的数据高 13.2 点。
Conclusion: 预测市场的大规模价格轨迹可作为行为推理的监督信号，学到的推理无需再训练即可用于用户模拟，并能充当更好的模拟器训练数据生成器。

papers.title: ImpactMat: Continuous Material Estimation for Inverse Impact Sound Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Impact sound rendering synthesizes the sound produced when a 3D object is struck, but practical renderers often rely on fixed material presets such as wood, plastic, or steel. These presets limit the range of impact sounds a renderer can express, while manually adjusting the underlying material parameters remains difficult without expertise in material acoustics. We therefore study inverse impact sound rendering: predicting material parameters from a reference impact sound so that a simulator can recreate a similar material response. To support this task, we introduce ImpactMat, a dataset and benchmark of single and blended material impact sounds paired with ground-truth material parameters. We further propose a feed-forward model that predicts these parameters from one or more recordings, using blended materials to learn smooth transitions between material types. Experiments show that our method outperforms competitive baselines and enables re-rendering from real recordings without manual parameter tuning. The project page is available https://material-from-impact.github.io/material-from-impact/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ImpactMat 把逆向撞击声渲染做成从一段或多段撞击录音回归材质参数的前馈回归任务，并配套发布含单一与混合材质撞击声、带真值材质参数的数据集与基准。模型用混合材质样本学习材质类型之间的平滑过渡，实验中优于竞争基线，可直接从真实录音重渲染而无需手动调参。
Motivation: 现有撞击声渲染依赖木、塑、钢等固定材质预设，可表达的撞击声范围受限；而手动调整底层材质参数需要声学材质专业知识，门槛高。
Method: 提出 ImpactMat 数据集与基准，收录单一与混合材质撞击声并配对真值材质参数；其上训练一个前馈模型，从一段或多段录音直接预测材质参数，并以混合材质样本驱动材质类型间的平滑过渡学习。
Result: 实验显示该方法优于竞争基线 (competitive baselines)，并支持从真实录音直接重渲染撞击声，无需手动参数调参。
Conclusion: 把材质参数估计当作有真值监督的回归问题并用混合材质数据做平滑过渡，可以绕开材质预设与专家调参，实现从真实录音的逆向撞击声渲染。

papers.title: Skillful Data-Driven Subseasonal Soil Moisture Forecasting: Prospects and Limits for Flash Drought Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Despite substantial progress in short-to-medium-range weather forecasting, predicting high-impact events such as flash droughts remains a key challenge for both early warning operations and physically-based subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) prediction systems. Here we demonstrate that, for S2S soil-moisture forecasting over Europe, forecast skill depends as much on how the prediction problem is formulated as on the forecasting model itself. Using a Vision Transformer-based architecture with dual-pathway temporal and spatial attention, we show that residual learning is essential to outperform persistence. This advantage is realized only when forecasting root-zone soil moisture in physical units rather than standardized anomalies, revealing that the target representation itself constrains predictability. A probabilistic extension via quantile-head fine-tuning further provides well-calibrated predictive distributions. Benchmarked against deep-learning and operational ECMWF S2S baselines over 2021-2022, our model achieves the highest deterministic and probabilistic skill at all lead times and reliably detects anomalously dry root-zone states (below the 20th percentile). Yet flash drought onset, defined by multi-pentad intensification criteria, remains a fundamental challenge shared across all current S2S systems. These findings advance data-driven S2S soil-moisture forecasting while highlighting the remaining challenge of predicting rapid drought development.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in npj Hydrosphere. Supplementary information available with the published version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在欧洲 S2S 时段土壤湿度预报中，技巧更多取决于问题表述方式而非模型本身：Vision Transformer 双通路时空注意力配合残差学习，只有在以物理单位（而非标准化距平）预报根区土壤湿度时才稳定超过持续性基线。分位数头微调给出校准良好的概率分布在 2021–2022 年对 ECMWF S2S 与深度学习基线在所有预报时效上取得最高确定性与概率技巧，并可靠检出低于第 20 百分位的异常干根区状态；但按多个 pentad 加剧标准定义的 flash drought 触发仍是所有 S2S 系统共有的难题。
Motivation: 短中期天气预报已有长足进展，但 flash drought 这类高影响事件的 S2S 早期预警仍困难，且尚不清楚技巧瓶颈来自预报模型还是问题表述方式。
Method: 采用 Vision Transformer 架构，带双通路 (dual-pathway) 时间与空间注意力；引入残差学习 (residual learning) 对抗持续性基线；目标表示在物理单位与标准化距平之间对比；再用分位数头微调 (quantile-head fine-tuning) 扩展为概率预报。
Result: 在 2021–2022 年欧洲 S2S 土壤湿度上，对深度学习与 ECMWF S2S 业务基线，本模型在所有预报时效取得最高确定性与概率技巧；可靠检出低于第 20 百分位的异常干根区状态；残差学习仅在以物理单位预报根区土壤湿度时超过持续性；flash drought 触发（按多 pentad 加剧标准定义）在所有当前 S2S 系统中仍是共同难题。
Conclusion: 目标表示本身约束可预报性：S2S 土壤湿度技巧要靠物理单位加残差学习才能兑现，而 flash drought 的快速加剧在现有 S2S 框架下尚未解决。

papers.title: Crop Yield Prediction for Punjab, Pakistan: A Tree-Ensemble and Leaf-Health Prototype, and What Random Validation Hides
papers.abstract_en: Yield forecasts help planners and farmers decide on inputs, storage and imports, but small agricultural tables can make reported accuracy fail on a new season. We built a crop-yield prototype for Punjab, Pakistan that combines Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression and a Ridge-stacked ensemble with a MobileNetV2 leaf-health classifier, and deployed it as a web application with SHAP explanations. A random 80/20 split of a merged Kaggle-derived table (414 rows) gives the ensemble an R2 of 0.991. An audit showed that the table contains only 46 independent observations: a join with nine temperature records per year copied every crop-year nine times. Holding out whole years takes XGBoost on the same rows from R2 = 0.994 to -0.20. On deduplicated data, and on a longer FAOSTAT table (1990-2024, 70 observations), a per-crop linear trend (leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha) beats every model not given the year (0.84-1.06). Neither pesticide use nor national temperature change explains the trend residuals. An apparent pesticide gain in the Kaggle table disappears on FAOSTAT, where the pesticide series is mostly imputed and the two releases disagree. An independent district-level wheat panel (36 districts, 13 seasons) shows that most variation in Punjab is spatial and that a district mean with a common trend matches the learned models. The leaf classifier reaches 99.87% accuracy on held-out PlantVillage images and recalls 96.4% of 336 unseen diseased leaves after near-duplicates were removed. However, no leaf image is paired with a yield record, so the health score used in the yield models had to be constructed and adds nothing. We report these negative findings together with the prototype.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在旁遮普邦 414 行小表上，随机 80/20 切分让 Ridge 堆叠集成的产量预测 R² 达 0.991，但表中仅 46 个独立观测（与九条温度记录 join 后每个 crop-year 被复制九次）；按整年留出后 XGBoost 的 R² 从 0.994 跌到 -0.20。去重数据与 FAOSTAT 1990–2024（70 观测）上，带年份的逐作物线性趋势 leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha，优于所有未给年份的模型（0.84–1.06）。
Motivation: 小农业产量表上随机切分会把复制行当作独立样本，报告精度在新季节完全失效；需要判断哪些特征真正解释趋势残差。
Method: 用 Random Forest、XGBoost、支持向量回归与 Ridge-stacked 集成，配合 MobileNetV2 叶片健康分类器，部署为带 SHAP 解释的 web 应用；对比随机 80/20 切分与整年留出，并在去重表、FAOSTAT 1990–2024（70 观测）和 36 区 13 季的小麦面板上检验趋势残差。
Result: 随机 80/20 下集成 R²=0.991（414 行，仅 46 独立观测）；整年留出使 XGBoost 从 R²=0.994 降到 -0.20。逐作物线性趋势 leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha，未给年份的模型为 0.84–1.06。农药与全国温度变化不解释趋势残差；Kaggle 表上的农药收益在 FAOSTAT 上消失。叶片分类器在 PlantVillage 留出集准确率 99.87%，去近重复后对 336 张未见病叶召回 96.4%。
Conclusion: 随机验证在小表上会掩盖灾难性泛化失败，产量预测应按年留出并优先用带年份的简单趋势；叶片健康分数因无产量配对而不增加信息。

papers.title: sHAIL-Causal: A Sequential Staircase Procedure for Invariant Causal Predictor Discovery
papers.abstract_en: We introduce sHAIL-Causal, the causal specialization of the Saturated Hierarchical Atomic Incremental Learning (sHAIL) paradigm: a sequential staircase procedure that ascends a nested hierarchy of hypothesis classes H_0 < H_1 < ... < H_K once a saturation signal indicates that mastery of the current stage has plateaued. Where general sHAIL leaves the saturation criterion open, sHAIL-Causal instantiates it with a joint criterion of goodness-of-fit saturation and cross-environment invariance, replacing the complexity control of Structural Risk Minimization. We show, theoretically and by simulation, that complexity-only staircases are seduced by confounded predictors that lower empirical risk without reflecting stable causal structure, whereas an invariance-gated staircase provably halts at the true causal predictor set under a per-variable Richness condition. We show that naive greedy search fails to recover the causal set even under Richness, trace the failure to non-monotonicity of the invariance statistic along single-variable paths, and validate a fix combining bounded-exhaustive block-seeding with a calibrated acceptance threshold. We then extend the guarantee to environments arriving sequentially, yielding a confidence guarantee that stays valid at every arrival, which one-shot exhaustive search cannot offer without repeating its full combinatorial search. We close by formalizing the intervention of a wise teacher who lifts a saturated learner off a plateau of boredom.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Introduces the general sHAIL learning framework and its causal specialization
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: sHAIL-Causal 把 Saturated Hierarchical Atomic Incremental Learning 做成因果特化：沿嵌套假设类 H_0 < ... < H_K 逐级上升，用拟合饱和加跨环境不变性的联合准则（替代结构风险最小化的复杂度控制）决定何时进入下一级。仿真与理论表明，仅按复杂度上升的阶梯会被混淆变量诱骗（降低经验风险却不对应稳定因果结构），而不变性门控的阶梯在逐变量 Richness 条件下可证明停在真实因果预测子集合上。
Motivation: 复杂度控制的模型选择会把降低经验风险的混淆变量误当成稳定因果结构；朴素贪心搜索即使满足 Richness 条件也恢复不出因果集合，且一次性穷举搜索无法在环境逐个到达时给出全程有效的置信保证。
Method: sHAIL-Causal 在饱和信号触发时沿嵌套假设类阶梯上升，饱和判据由拟合饱和与跨环境不变性联合给出；针对贪心搜索因不变性统计量沿单变量路径非单调而失败，加入有界穷举块播种 (bounded-exhaustive block-seeding) 与校准接受阈值；再把保证扩展到环境顺序到达的情形。

papers.title: Behavioral Cloning Mystery
papers.abstract_en: Behavioral cloning (BC), despite its simplicity, exhibits many counterintuitive phenomena in the real world. For example, the performance of BC often keeps increasing as the model overfits more to the dataset, and fully closed-loop policies often completely fail without action chunking. Unfortunately, properly studying these anecdotal phenomena ("behavioral cloning mysteries") is challenging: in the real world, datasets and experiments are costly and not fully controllable; in simulation with synthetic data, these phenomena are often not easily observed partly due to the discrepancy between scripted policies and human demonstrations. In this work, we propose OCBench, a robotic manipulation benchmark with controllable scripted policies that have similar properties to human demonstrations. We show that, by mimicking key properties of human demonstrations, OCBench reproduces many anecdotal BC-related phenomena in controlled settings. With its GPU-accelerated environments and scripted policies, we demonstrate how OCBench enables scientific studies of previously reported BC-related phenomena by analyzing and refuting various hypotheses. Project page: https://seohong.me/projects/ocbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 OCBench：一个带可控脚本策略的机器人操作 benchmark，脚本策略模仿人类演示的关键性质，从而在可控环境中复现真实世界里那些反直觉的 BC 现象（如过拟合越多性能反而持续上升、无 action chunking 时闭环策略完全失败），并用 GPU 加速环境分析和反驳多种已有假设。
Motivation: BC 在真实世界中出现许多反直觉现象，但真实数据与实验昂贵且不可控，仿真中又因脚本策略与人类演示的差异而难以复现这些现象，导致无法系统研究。
Method: 构建 OCBench 机器人操作 benchmark，其脚本策略具备与人类演示相似的关键性质；提供 GPU 加速环境与可控脚本策略，用于在受控条件下复现 BC 现象并检验、反驳已有假设。
Result: 在受控设置下复现了多项此前仅在真实世界报告的 BC 相关现象（过拟合越多性能持续上升、无 action chunking 时闭环策略完全失败），并以此分析和反驳了多种假设。
Conclusion: 只要仿真中的脚本策略模仿了人类演示的关键性质，BC 的反直觉现象就能在可控、可复现的环境中被系统研究，而不必依赖昂贵的真实实验。

papers.title: Data Fusion for Errors-in-Variables
papers.abstract_en: We study errors-in-variables problems in which a target study contains only a single error-prone surrogate of an unobserved exposure, while an external source study provides repeated surrogate measurements from a different population. The measurement error distribution is allowed to depend on the observed error-free variables, and the error-free variable distribution itself may differ between studies. We introduce a conditional transportability assumption that enables the use of external repeated measurements under source-target heterogeneity. Together with additional replicate-error conditions, it identifies the target conditional measurement-error distribution. Building on this identification result, we develop a data-fusion estimator for a broad class of target functionals. The estimator combines conditional deconvolution, flexible nuisance estimation, and orthogonal correction that reduces first-order sensitivity to nuisance estimation. For the proposed estimator, we develop a unified spectral theory covering both diffuse-spectrum and finite atomic-spectrum target functionals, derive a general asymptotic expansion, and establish consistency and target-specific convergence-rate bounds. The resulting convergence-rate bounds depend jointly on the spectral properties of the measurement error, the latent exposure, and the target functional. For finite atomic-spectrum targets, we further establish joint Gaussian and bootstrap limits, yielding inference for smooth moment transformations under an additional centering condition. In the reported simulations, Fuse-EIV has small bias for the primary exposure-related coefficient. Applications to the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey illustrate how accounting for population heterogeneity and error heteroscedasticity can change empirical conclusions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fuse-EIV 针对目标研究只有单个含误差代理变量、而外部源研究提供不同人群重复代理测量的 errors-in-variables 问题，提出条件可迁移性 (conditional transportability) 假设以在源-目标异质下识别目标条件测量误差分布，再用条件反卷积、灵活 nuisance 估计与正交校正构造数据融合估计量。模拟中该估计量对主要暴露相关系数偏差很小，NHANES 应用显示同时处理人群异质与误差异方差会改变经验结论。
Motivation: 目标研究往往只有一次含误差的暴露代理测量，无法自识别测量误差分布；外部重复测量又来自不同人群，误差分布随无误差协变量变化且协变量分布在两研究间不同，直接借用会失效。
Method: 提出条件可迁移性假设，配合重复误差条件识别目标条件测量误差分布；在此之上构建 Fuse-EIV 数据融合估计量，组合条件反卷积 (conditional deconvolution)、灵活 nuisance 估计与降低 nuisance 一阶敏感度的正交校正 (orthogonal correction)，覆盖一大类目标泛函。
Result: 建立覆盖 diffuse-spectrum 与 finite atomic-spectrum 两类目标泛函的统一谱理论，给出一般渐近展开、一致性与目标相关的收敛速率界，速率同时依赖测量误差、潜暴露与目标泛函的谱性质；对 finite atomic-spectrum 目标进一步给出联合高斯与 bootstrap 极限，用于平滑矩变换推断。报告的模拟中 Fuse-EIV 对主要暴露相关系数偏差很小；NHANES 应用表明考虑人群异质与误差异方差会改变经验结论。
Conclusion: 在源-目标异质下，条件可迁移性加重复测量足以识别并推断目标测量误差分布，且收敛速率由误差、暴露与泛函的谱共同决定。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Multi-Task Active Learning with Efficient Resource Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Many scientific studies allow costly auxiliary information to be collected during data labeling but not at deployment. Examples include diagnostic tests, laboratory assays, and expert evaluations. We study prediction under this deployment asymmetry, where auxiliary variables are selectively acquired during labeling under a budget constraint but systematically unavailable at prediction time, creating a missing-by-design problem that couples data acquisition, surrogate construction, and prediction. In this work, we introduce Active Learning with Cost-Adaptive Task Resource Allocations (ALCATRAs), a unified framework for selectively acquiring auxiliary information under resource constraints and leveraging that information to improve downstream prediction. ALCATRAs consists of two main components: a task-selection policy which strategically selects a sequence of cost-effective tasks for unlabeled data to perform, and a surrogate learning procedure which transfers knowledge from completed tasks to enhance model predictions. In theory, we show the effectiveness of surrogate models and sample-efficient task policies in improving the model's prediction error bound. Simulation studies and an application to the UCI heart disease cohort demonstrate improved sample efficiency of the proposed ALCATRAs framework relative to baselines under the studied settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 ALCATRAs：在标注阶段按预算选择性采集昂贵辅助变量（诊断、化验、专家评估），部署时这些变量不可得，用任务选择策略加代理学习把已采集任务的知识迁移回预测。理论上给出代理模型与样本高效任务策略对预测误差界的改进，模拟与 UCI 心脏病队列上相对基线提升样本效率。
Motivation: 许多科学场景中辅助信息只在标注期可采、部署期系统性缺失，形成 missing-by-design，采集、代理构建与预测三者耦合，缺少统一的预算分配框架。
Method: ALCATRAs 两组件：任务选择策略为未标注数据挑选成本效益最优的任务序列；代理学习过程把已完成任务的知识迁移以增强预测。理论上给出代理模型与样本高效任务策略对预测误差界的改进。
Result: 在模拟研究与 UCI 心脏病队列应用中，所研究设置下 ALCATRAs 相对基线展现更好的样本效率。
Conclusion: 在部署不对称下，把成本自适应的任务资源分配与代理学习统一起来，可在预算约束下提升下游预测的样本效率。

papers.title: TRIAGE: Direction-Aware Mismatch Stabilization of Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Low-precision execution can substantially accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models, but discrepancies between learner and sampler execution can destabilize policy optimization. In this paper, we characterize the interaction between mismatch and the policy-gradient direction, distinguishing locally amplifying from contracting update contributions that mismatch magnitude alone cannot identify. In native NVFP4 runs, we observe an early imbalance between the two amplifying regions, favoring negative-advantage, negative-gap updates. Their tail tokens become concentrated in a small fraction of response segments before mismatch spreads globally. Motivated by these findings, we introduce TRIAGE, a direction-aware stabilization method that uses segment-level diagnosis to selectively rebalance policy-gradient updates and applies bounded repair to residual severe mismatch. TRIAGE modifies the optimization objective while retaining native NVFP4 weight-and activation 4-bit (W4A4) forward execution on both the sampler and learner. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B show stable optimization throughout the evaluated training horizon and achieve full precision level performance across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while native NVFP4 with TRIAGE provides up to 2.3x higher rollout throughput than BF16.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRIAGE 针对 LLM 强化学习中 sampler 与 learner 都跑原生 NVFP4 W4A4 时的数值失配，按 policy-gradient 方向区分放大与收缩两类更新贡献，并对段级诊断出的失衡做选择性再平衡加有界修复。在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上训练全程稳定，五个数学推理基准达到全精度水平，rollout 吞吐比 BF16 最高提升 2.3 倍。
Motivation: 低精度执行能加速 LLM 的 RL 训练，但 learner 与 sampler 之间的执行差异会破坏策略优化稳定性；仅看失配幅度无法区分哪些更新被放大、哪些被收缩。
Method: 先刻画失配与 policy-gradient 方向的交互，区分 locally amplifying 与 contracting 的更新贡献；据此提出 TRIAGE：用 segment-level diagnosis 选择性地再平衡策略梯度更新，并对残余严重失配施加 bounded repair，同时在 sampler 与 learner 上保留原生 NVFP4 W4A4 前向执行，只修改优化目标。
Result: 原生 NVFP4 运行中观察到早期两类放大区域失衡，偏向 negative-advantage、negative-gap 更新，其尾部 token 在失配扩散前集中于少量 response segment。在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，TRIAGE 在所评估的训练时程内保持稳定优化，五个数学推理基准达到全精度水平，原生 NVFP4 + TRIAGE 的 rollout 吞吐比 BF16 最高提升 2.3 倍。
Conclusion: 失配的破坏性取决于它与梯度方向的组合而非幅度本身，按方向做段级再平衡加有界修复即可在保留 4-bit 前向执行的同时维持全精度级性能。

papers.title: PAPER2LLM++: Continual Self-Evolution of LLMs from Research Papers
papers.abstract_en: Research on LLMs continually uncovers model limitations, their causes, and potential solutions. Yet these human discoveries remain largely disconnected from model evolution: an LLM does not automatically learn from new research about its own failures. We introduce PAPER2LLM++, a framework for continual self-evolution of LLMs from research papers. Rather than treating papers merely as knowledge to retrieve, PAPER2LLM++ uses the growing literature as a stream of evidence and supervision for model improvement. For each incoming paper, it extracts evidence-grounded findings, tests whether the reported limitation persists in the current model, and, when needed, converts the findings into candidate learning signals. A try-evaluate-commit procedure integrates an update only when it improves the targeted behavior without substantially forgetting prior improvements or degrading general capabilities. Across a sequential stream of research-discovered LLM failures, we show that models can progressively incorporate new findings while retaining earlier gains. PAPER2LLM++ thus takes a step toward closing the loop between human discovery and model evolution, enabling models to continually learn from research about their own limitations and improvements.

papers.title: Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出只以奖励和动作为条件的 reward-based policy，使策略在观测空间完全不同的源域与目标域之间实现零样本迁移。在 Pointmass、Cartpole、2D Car Racing 上训练后，可零样本迁移到不同配色、3D 渲染以及 Habitat-Sim 中的 Stretch 机器人导航，并能进一步引导目标环境中基于观测的策略训练。
Motivation: 深度神经网络策略难以适应新环境，跨观测空间迁移通常需要大量样本。
Method: 训练一个仅以奖励和历史动作为输入、完全不依赖观测的策略；摘要给出训练算法的提出与可行性讨论，并在三个环境中训练该策略。
Result: 在 Pointmass、Cartpole、2D Car Racing 三个环境中训练的 reward policy，可零样本迁移到完全不同的观测（不同配色、3D 渲染、Habitat-Sim 中的 Stretch 机器人导航）；该 reward policy 还可进一步指导目标环境中 observation-based policy 的训练。
Conclusion: 奖励信号本身足以支撑跨观测空间的零样本策略迁移，并可作为目标环境观测策略训练的引导信号。

papers.title: TripleFlow: Training-Free Video Object Removal by Bridging Residual Editing and Native Generation
papers.abstract_en: Video object removal presents a uniquely difficult editing challenge. Because a removal prompt specifies only what to erase rather than what to generate, the model must infer and reconstruct a highly specific occluded background entirely from the surrounding context. Existing training-free methods struggle with this because their editing mechanisms act primarily as localized erasers. They fail to actively synthesize the missing background details and often leave behind ghosting artifacts. To solve this, we propose TripleFlow, a training-free framework that tightly couples erasure and generation. It coordinates a source flow, a residual flow, and a synthesis flow throughout the entire process. By reusing a single target prediction, the residual flow isolates and suppresses the object, while the synthesis flow independently reconstructs the occluded background. Crucially, TripleFlow injects this newly synthesized background back into the editing trajectory at every step. This continuous feedback loop ensures that the generated structures actively guide the removal process, achieving seamless completion that is spatiotemporally consistent with the unedited scene. Extensive evaluations across five challenging benchmarks demonstrate that TripleFlow establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming existing baselines in both reconstruction fidelity and temporal consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TripleFlow 是一个免训练的视频物体移除框架，把源流 (source flow)、残差流 (residual flow) 与合成流 (synthesis flow) 协同起来：残差流用同一份目标预测隔离并压制物体，合成流独立重建被遮挡背景，并在每一步把新合成的背景注回编辑轨迹形成反馈回路。在五个有挑战的基准上达到新的 state-of-the-art，在重建保真度与时序一致性上显著超过现有基线。
Motivation: 移除提示只说明要擦掉什么、不说明要生成什么，模型必须从周围上下文推断被遮挡背景；现有免训练方法的编辑机制本质是局部橡皮擦，不能主动合成缺失细节，常留下鬼影伪影。
Method: 免训练框架 TripleFlow 全程协调 source flow、residual flow、synthesis flow：复用单次目标预测，残差流隔离并抑制物体，合成流独立重建被遮挡背景，并在每一步把新合成背景注入编辑轨迹，形成持续反馈回路以保证时空一致的补全。
Result: 在五个有挑战的基准上的广泛评测中，TripleFlow 建立新的 state-of-the-art，在重建保真度 (reconstruction fidelity) 与时序一致性 (temporal consistency) 两方面显著优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 把擦除与生成紧密耦合、并让合成背景持续引导移除过程，是免训练视频物体移除实现无缝且时空一致补全的有效路径。

papers.title: FineART: Fine-Grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in real-world environments must often execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets provide limited support for this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode, while existing bimanual datasets provide subtask annotations for only part of their recorded hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset comprising 40,543 episodes (1,718 hours) and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask to guide its actions. Mid-training on FineART's subtask annotations improves FineART-VLA's success at following spatial instructions from 32.0% to 100.0%. With step-by-step human subtask guidance, success on unseen long-horizon tasks increases from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, FineART-VLA matches baseline performance on a new robot with 10x less fine-tuning data and generalizes zero-shot to unseen tasks. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.
papers.comment: 26 pages. Code and model weights will be integrated into Hugging Face LeRobot https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FineART 是密集子任务标注的双臂操作数据集（40,543 条 episode、1,718 小时、533,913 个子任务、151 个任务），配套 FineART-VLA 策略会自行预测下一个子任务来引导动作。在 FineART 子任务标注上做 mid-training 后，空间指令遵循成功率从 32.0% 升到 100.0%；在逐步人类子任务引导下，未见长程任务成功率从 16.0% 升到 76.0%。
Motivation: 单臂数据集虽达数十万条轨迹但每条 episode 通常只有一条高层指令，现有双臂数据集也只对部分录制时长做子任务标注，长程多步双臂任务因此缺少可训练的密集监督。
Method: 构建 FineART 双臂数据集并提出 FineART-VLA 视觉-语言-动作策略，该策略预测自身的下一个子任务以指导动作；训练中在 FineART 的子任务标注上做 mid-training，并支持逐步人类子任务引导与跨机器人微调。
Result: FineART 含 40,543 条 episode、1,718 小时、533,913 个子任务、151 个任务；子任务标注 mid-training 使空间指令遵循成功率从 32.0% 提到 100.0%；逐步人类子任务引导下未见长程任务成功率从 16.0% 提到 76.0%；在新机器人上以少 10 倍的微调数据即可匹配基线性能，并对未见任务零样本泛化。
Conclusion: 密集子任务标注加上策略自预测下一子任务，是让长程双臂操作指令遵循与跨机器人泛化同时成立的关键；数据集、模型权重与训练代码全部开源。

papers.title: Segment-Level Risk Discovery in Online Handwriting for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
papers.abstract_en: Online handwriting provides a non-invasive and low-cost behavioral biomarker for Alzheimer's disease (AD) detection, as it reflects both cognitive planning and fine motor control. Existing handwriting-based AD detection methods usually rely on global trajectory features or whole-sample representations, which can be strongly affected by individual writing style, task-specific variation, and acquisition noise. In this paper, we propose NormPaST-Risk, a healthy-normative Paper-Air selective trajectory state-space risk network for interpretable AD detection from online handwriting. Instead of treating the entire trajectory as a single holistic representation, our method reformulates AD handwriting detection as local disease-relevant segment discovery. Specifically, a multi-scale temporal encoder captures stroke dynamics at different temporal resolutions, while a selective Paper-Air state-space encoder models long-range handwriting progression and distinguishes on-paper motor execution from in-air planning and transition behaviors. To explicitly characterize abnormal deviations, a healthy normative branch learns normal handwriting dynamics from healthy controls, and a task-aware multi-expert segment-risk module estimates segment-level AD risk calibrated by hidden-state changes and normative deviations. A weakly supervised segment-level objective further enables high-risk segment discovery without manual segment annotations. Experiments on the DARWIN benchmark demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior AD/HC classification performance compared with existing methods. Moreover, the discovered high-risk segments can be projected back to the original handwriting trajectory, providing interpretable evidence associated with AD-related handwriting variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NormPaST-Risk 把在线手写 AD 检测重构为局部病相关片段发现：多尺度时间编码器抓笔画动力学，Paper-Air 选择性状态空间编码器建模长程书写进程并区分纸上运动执行与空中规划，健康常模分支学习正常动力学，任务感知多专家片段风险模块给出片段级 AD 风险。在 DARWIN 基准上 AD/HC 分类优于现有方法，高风险片段可投影回原始轨迹作为可解释证据。
Motivation: 现有手写 AD 检测依赖全局轨迹特征或整样本表示，容易被个人书写风格、任务差异和采集噪声带偏，且缺少可定位到具体片段的解释。
Method: 多尺度时间编码器捕捉不同时间分辨率的笔画动态；选择性 Paper-Air 状态空间 (state-space) 编码器建模长程书写进程并区分纸上执行与空中规划/过渡行为；健康常模分支从健康对照学习正常书写动力学，任务感知多专家片段风险模块按隐状态变化与常模偏差校准片段级风险；用弱监督片段级目标实现无手工片段标注的高风险片段发现。
Result: 在 DARWIN 基准上，AD/HC 分类性能优于现有方法；发现的高风险片段可投影回原始书写轨迹，提供与 AD 相关书写变化对应的可解释证据。
Conclusion: 把整轨迹表示换成带健康常模对照的片段级风险发现，可在无片段标注下同时拿到 AD/HC 判别力与可回溯到轨迹位置的解释。

papers.title: HARMONY: Hierarchical Agentic Reasoning for MONocular Image-to-Scene Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Compositional 3D scene reconstruction has recently been explored from two directions: agentic reasoning that provides semantic understanding of spatial relationships but lacks precise alignment with input images; and visual geometry foundation models that predict dense point maps from input images but the reconstruction quality is limited. Therefore, recovering a complete 3D scene from a single monocular image with accurate inter-object relationships and high-fidelity reconstruction quality remains challenging. In this paper, we present HARMONY, a hierarchical chain-of-thought framework that leverages both agentic reasoning and visual geometry foundation. Given an image of an indoor scene, starting from an empty 3D floorplan, HARMONY first calibrates the camera against the reference image to establish a semantically-grounded spatial frame, then uses agentic VLM reasoning to recover the 3D room layout and an initial placement order. It then places the objects in a hierarchical order, from wall-mounted elements, free-standing furniture, to dependent decorations on top of furniture. We also use depth-first traversal for furniture so each placement conditions on previously resolved structure and a reflective feedback loop to avoid error accumulation. After each object placement by VLM, we use the point cloud estimations to perform geometry-based refinement so that the rendered image aligns better with the input. HARMONY can produce 3D scenes that are semantically consistent and perceptually aligned with the reference image, extending single-image compositional reconstruction to complex indoor scene images. Experiments on synthetic and real-world images demonstrate that HARMONY outperforms the evaluated reconstruction baselines, while qualitative comparisons with GPT-6 Astra suggest more faithful object arrangements and better preservation of scene details.

papers.title: Schedule optimization for tau-leaping in masked discrete diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusions are popular generative models for discrete distributions. Unlike standard autoregressive sampling, they reveal several coordinates in parallel, approximating each block's joint conditional law by a product of one-coordinate conditionals. The resulting procedure, usually called tau-leaping, reduces computational cost but introduces a factorization error ($\varepsilon_\text{fact}$), even with perfectly learned predictors. We study the resulting tradeoff between generative accuracy and computational cost, focusing on how to choose a denoising schedule to minimize $\varepsilon_\text{fact}$ for a fixed sampling budget. To do so, we establish an exact integral representation of $\varepsilon_\text{fact}$ separating the schedule from the target's dependence structure, summarized by a dependence density $ρ$. This representation yields recursive stationarity equations for optimal schedules and allows us to quantify how estimation errors in $ρ$ affect schedule selection. As the dimension $N$ and sampling budget grow, we characterize the optimal schedule and quantify the cost of random block sizes relative to a deterministic planner. We highlight a fundamental dichotomy: if $ρ$ converges uniformly to a strictly positive continuous profile as $N\to\infty$, schedule optimization can only improve the leading constant of $\varepsilon_\text{fact}$, while if $ρ$ degenerates, schedule optimization can improve the asymptotic order. Examples based on stationary processes and exchangeable mixtures illustrate these regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 masked discrete diffusion 的 tau-leaping 并行采样，给出 ε_fact 的精确积分表示，把 denoising schedule 与目标依赖结构（dependence density ρ）分离，并导出最优 schedule 的递归平稳方程。核心结论是一个二分：若 ρ 随维度 N 一致收敛到严格正的连续剖面，schedule 优化只能改进 ε_fact 的首项常数；若 ρ 退化，则可改进渐近阶。
Motivation: tau-leaping 一次揭示多个坐标、用单坐标条件的乘积近似块的联合条件律，即使预测器完美也会引入 factorization error ε_fact；在固定采样预算下如何选 denoising schedule 来压低这一误差此前缺少刻画。
Method: 建立 ε_fact 的精确积分表示，将 schedule 与目标依赖结构解耦，后者由 dependence density ρ 概括；由此得到最优 schedule 的递归平稳方程，并量化 ρ 的估计误差对 schedule 选择的影响；再分析 N 与采样预算增长时的最优 schedule，并量化随机块大小相对确定性 planner 的代价。
Result: 给出两类渐近体制的刻画：ρ 一致收敛到严格正连续剖面时 schedule 优化只改进 ε_fact 的首项常数，ρ 退化时可改进渐近阶；同时量化了随机块大小相对确定性 planner 的开销，以及 ρ 估计误差对 schedule 选择的影响，并用平稳过程与可交换混合 (exchangeable mixtures) 的例子说明两种 regime。
Conclusion: ε_fact 的 schedule 优化收益取决于目标依赖结构 ρ 的极限行为：正则时只值一个常数因子，退化时才改变误差的渐近阶，因此是否值得做 schedule 优化应先看 ρ 属于哪一类。

papers.title: Local Sparsity Enables Unsupervised LLM Safety Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deployment-time safety methods for large language models (LLMs) are predominantly supervised and assume access to unsafe training data. Nevertheless, new attacks and harm categories regularly arise, not captured by models trained in such a supervised fashion. An alternative approach is to view this problem through the lens of anomaly detection, namely, to rely solely on modeling safe data and flagging out-of-distribution inputs. However, LLM activations lie in a high-dimensional space, raising concerns about whether anomaly detection is statistically feasible. We show that, under the linear representation hypothesis (LRH), there may indeed be hope. In the LRH concept space, which is typically recovered via a sparse autoencoder (SAE), nearby points share a small common active support. Using this local sparsity insight, we propose a framework for locally masked SAE-based anomaly detection, supported by theoretical justifications. We validate it on various architectures and datasets, including both capability-testing datasets and safety-specific datasets. Finally, when we allow algorithms to use 1% out-of-distribution data for calibration, locally sparse methods achieve near-optimal performance, demonstrating their ability to capture meaningful safety information while using only 1-2% of SAE neurons for computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于局部稀疏 (local sparsity) 的无监督 LLM 安全检测框架：在稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 恢复的 LRH 概念空间中，邻近点共享小的共同活跃支撑，据此做局部掩码的 SAE 异常检测。在多种架构与数据集上验证，允许用 1% OOD 数据校准时接近最优，且计算只用 1–2% 的 SAE 神经元。
Motivation: 部署期 LLM 安全检测多为监督式且依赖不安全训练数据，而新攻击与新危害类别不断出现，监督模型覆盖不到；直接做异常检测又受 LLM 激活高维性挑战，统计可行性存疑。
Method: 在 LRH 概念空间（通常由 sparse autoencoder 恢复）中利用邻近点共享小共同活跃支撑这一局部稀疏性质，提出 locally masked SAE-based anomaly detection 框架，并给出理论论证；校准阶段允许使用 1% OOD 数据。
Result: 在多种架构与数据集上验证，涵盖 capability-testing 数据集与 safety-specific 数据集；允许使用 1% OOD 数据校准时，局部稀疏方法达到 near-optimal performance，计算仅使用 1–2% 的 SAE 神经元。
Conclusion: 高维 LLM 激活下的异常检测在 LRH 加局部稀疏假设下统计上可行，仅建模安全数据即可捕捉有意义的安全信息，且计算代价集中在极少数 SAE 神经元上。

papers.title: FrogNano: Training a 4B Coding Agent via Online Task Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We present FrogNano, a 4B coding agent designed to tackle software engineering (SWE) tasks efficiently and effectively, even under resource-constrained environments. It is post-trained exclusively via RL on around 1,500 SWE environments with synthetic tasks. A key ingredient for improving performance is an online task synthesis pipeline that creates tasks calibrated to the frontier of learnability for the current checkpoint. This report provides evidence that competitive small coding agents can be trained with synthetic tasks alone, without traditional distillation from larger models, and that generating tasks at the learnability frontier of the current agent is important. We report details on the training methodology, evaluations across diverse environments, and in-depth analyses, serving as a foundation for our ongoing exploration of lightweight yet capable coding agents that can run on minimal hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FrogNano 是一个 4B 参数的编码智能体，仅用约 1,500 个含合成任务的 SWE 环境做纯 RL 后训练，不依赖从大模型蒸馏。其关键机制是在线任务合成流水线：按当前 checkpoint 的可学习前沿 (learnability frontier) 校准生成任务，摘要称在该前沿生成任务对性能很重要。
Motivation: 资源受限环境下训练有竞争力的小型编码智能体，通常要靠从大模型蒸馏；本文要证明仅用合成任务的纯 RL 后训练这条路可行。
Method: 在线任务合成流水线为每个当前 checkpoint 生成校准到可学习前沿的合成 SWE 任务，围绕约 1,500 个环境做纯 RL 后训练，全程不使用大模型蒸馏；报告训练方法与跨多样环境的评测。
Result: 在约 1,500 个 SWE 环境上仅用合成任务完成 RL 后训练，得到可在最小硬件上运行的 4B 编码智能体；摘要给出的证据是该做法可行，且在当前 agent 的可学习前沿生成任务很重要，未列出具体分数或基线对比数值。
Conclusion: 合成任务加前沿校准的在线任务生成，足以在无蒸馏条件下训练出有竞争力的小型编码智能体，且任务难度须贴着当前 checkpoint 的可学习前沿走。

papers.title: "Train classical, deploy quantum" requires rethinking generalization
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have become central across science and industry, from image and text synthesis to the design of molecules and materials. Quantum generative models are considered one of the most promising applications for quantum computers, since a quantum circuit naturally produces samples from the distribution it encodes, and for suitable circuits that distribution is believed to be hard for any classical computer to reproduce. A leading strategy trains these models on a classical computer and reserves the quantum device for generating samples at deployment. This is possible when the training loss can be evaluated on a classical computer. A prime example is the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD$^2$), a moment-matching loss that compares the model and the data through their Pauli-$Z$ correlations. Research so far has asked whether such models can be trained and whether their sampling is hard; whether minimizing such an objective yields a model that \emph{generalizes}, rather than one that merely reproduces the training statistics, remains poorly understood. We benchmark thirteen quantum and classical generative models by direct sampling on two application-inspired datasets: first a cardinality-constrained dataset at up to $30$ qubits and second a dataset of genomic single-nucleotide variants, whose valid set is the observed data. Models that converge the loss to the same value differ widely in how much of the unseen valid set they cover. These results indicate that a converged moment-matching loss is not a reliable measure of generalization, and that a train-classical, deploy-quantum workflow has to measure generalization by sampling the trained model, a step that at the sizes of interest is believed to require the quantum device.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在「经典训练、量子部署」的生成模型工作流里，MMD² 这类可在经典机上求值的矩匹配损失收敛到同一值的模型，对未见有效集的覆盖差异极大，说明损失收敛不能作为泛化的可靠度量；泛化必须靠对训练后模型直接采样来测，而在目标规模上这一步被认为需要量子设备。
Motivation: 现有研究只问量子生成模型能否训练、其采样是否经典难解，却没回答最小化矩匹配目标得到的是能泛化的模型还是只复现训练统计的模型。
Method: 对 13 个量子与经典生成模型做直接采样 (direct sampling) 基准，用两个应用启发的数据集：最多 30 qubit 的基数约束数据集，以及以观测数据为有效集的基因组单核苷酸变异 (SNV) 数据集；比较收敛到相同 MMD² 损失的模型在未见有效集上的覆盖。
Result: 13 个模型在两个数据集上收敛到相同损失值，但对未见有效集的覆盖差异很大；基数约束数据集规模达 30 qubit。
Conclusion: 收敛的矩匹配损失不是泛化的可靠度量，train-classical、deploy-quantum 工作流必须通过采样训练后模型来测泛化，而这一步在目标规模上被认为需要量子设备。

papers.title: Generation of High-Level Concepts in 3D Scene Graphs via Autoregressive Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Indoor 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) represent environments as multi-layer hierarchies that connect observed geometric primitives (e.g., planes) to higher-level metric-semantic concepts (e.g., rooms, floors, buildings), enabling incremental spatial reasoning for robotic perception and SLAM. However, classical high-level concept generation approaches rely on hand-crafted rules for specific concept classes, while learning-based methods require separate models for graph structure and spatial node features (e.g., centroids), which limits scalability to novel classes and more complex hierarchies. We propose a unified autoregressive diffusion-based graph generative model that jointly learns structure and features, constructing complete 3DSGs bottom-up from observed vertical planes across arbitrary hierarchy depths. Our method consistently surpasses all learning-based and random baselines across 3DSG datasets spanning synthetic scenes, real architectural floor plans, and robotic sensor data, with varying layout complexity and hierarchy depth, and surpasses a one-shot model with oracle access to the target graph size on the largest hierarchy and on real single-floor data. Finally, we propose an adaptation of the Fused Gromov--Wasserstein distance for principled graph-level evaluation of generated 3DSGs against ground truth.

papers.title: Beyond Procrustes distances: a multilinear Gromov-Wasserstein distance capturing chirality
papers.abstract_en: Efficiently and robustly analyzing shape data is critical across many scientific disciplines. While chirality is a fundamental property in numerous applications - most notably in molecular science - existing shape analysis metrics fail to distinguish between a shape and its mirror image. To address this gap, we introduce a multilinear generalization of the Gromov-Wasserstein objective. Under mild assumptions, this objective yields a distance between shapes, represented as probability distributions quotiented by a symmetry group $G$. In particular, for $G = SO(d)$, we introduce the Chiral Gromov-Wasserstein ($\mathrm{CGW}$) distance, sensitive to chirality. We establish robustness properties for the multilinear Gromov-Wasserstein distances and develop efficient algorithms to compute them, reformulating the underlying optimization problem by projecting couplings onto a low-dimensional space. We derive algorithms for both local and approximate global solutions, yielding a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme for these problems. We validate the framework through numerical experiments that demonstrate the effectiveness of $\mathrm{CGW}$ as a shape metric for chiral objects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出多线性 Gromov-Wasserstein 目标的推广，把形状视为在对称群 G 商空间上的概率分布；取 G = SO(d) 时得到对镜像不对称的 Chiral Gromov-Wasserstein (CGW) 距离。通过把 coupling 投影到低维空间重构优化问题，得到局部解与近似全局解算法，并构成完全多项式时间近似方案 (FPTAS)，数值实验证实 CGW 能区分手性物体。
Motivation: 现有形状分析度量无法区分一个形状与其镜像，而手性 (chirality) 在分子科学等应用中是基本性质，需要一个对镜像敏感且稳健的形状距离。
Method: 对 Gromov-Wasserstein 目标做多线性推广，形状表示为对对称群 G 取商的概率分布；在温和假设下证明该目标给出形状距离，并对多线性 GW 距离建立稳健性性质。计算上把 coupling 投影到低维空间以重构优化问题，给出局部解与近似全局解两类算法，构成 FPTAS。
Result: 在温和假设下多线性 GW 目标在商空间上诱导出距离；G = SO(d) 时的 CGW 对手性敏感。算法层面得到完全多项式时间近似方案，并通过数值实验展示 CGW 作为手性物体形状度量的有效性。
Conclusion: 把 GW 目标多线性化并按对称群取商，可以在保留多项式时间可解性的同时得到对手性敏感的形状距离。

papers.title: QUASAR: Lowering the Loss Floor of Quantization-Aware Training with Loss-Aware Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: As large language model inference shifts toward lower precision, post-training quantization (PTQ) becomes increasingly brittle, making quantization-aware training (QAT) essential for preserving model quality. However, QAT has a structural mismatch: gradient updates are applied to latent full-precision weights, while the loss and gradients are computed on lossy reconstructions of those weights. This mismatch can lead to suboptimal training trajectories and a higher loss floor. Second-order PTQ methods address a similar problem by minimizing loss-aware reconstruction error, but applying such expensive reconstruction repeatedly during QAT as the weights evolve is impractical. We introduce QUASAR, a QAT method that brings lightweight, loss-aware reconstruction into the training loop. At each training step, QUASAR reconstructs the latent weights by searching over a small set of clipping ranges and fitting dequantization parameters through saliency-weighted least squares. We use an exponential moving average of squared gradients as the per-parameter saliency signal. Our theoretical analysis shows that optimizing QUASAR's reconstruction objective tightens both the convergence and final-loss bounds of QAT. We evaluate QUASAR across four model families and across INT4, INT3, INT2, and NVFP4 quantization formats. QUASAR consistently achieves lower training and evaluation loss than competitive QAT methods and outperforms QAT and PTQ baselines on downstream benchmarks. At INT2, QUASAR improves average accuracy over the best QAT baseline by 13.3 points with quantization-aware distillation and by 10.9 points with QAT on mathematical reasoning data. Notably, after distillation on only about 600M tokens, QUASAR's INT4 Gemma-4 E4B checkpoint outperforms the corresponding QAT checkpoint released by Google, with 66% lower KL divergence and 1.8 points higher average accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QUASAR 把轻量的 loss-aware reconstruction 嵌进量化感知训练 (QAT) 循环：每步对 latent 权重搜索少量 clipping 范围、用 saliency 加权最小二乘拟合反量化参数，saliency 取平方梯度的指数滑动平均。理论分析表明优化该重建目标同时收紧 QAT 的收敛界与最终 loss 界；在四个模型家族、INT4/INT3/INT2/NVFP4 上训练与评估 loss 均低于竞争 QAT 方法，INT2 下较最佳 QAT 基线平均准确率提升 13.3 点（配合量化感知蒸馏）或 10.9 点（在数学推理数据上 QAT）。
Motivation: QAT 存在结构性错配：梯度更新作用于 latent 全精度权重，而 loss 与梯度却在这些权重的有损重建上计算，导致次优训练轨迹与更高的 loss floor；二阶 PTQ 的 loss-aware 重建虽能缓解，却昂贵到无法在 QAT 中随权重演化反复调用。
Method: 每步训练中对 latent 权重做轻量 loss-aware 重建：在一小簇 clipping 范围上搜索，并以 saliency 加权最小二乘拟合反量化参数；saliency 信号用逐参数平方梯度的指数移动平均 (EMA)。配套给出理论分析，说明优化该重建目标收紧 QAT 的收敛与最终 loss 界。
Result: 在四个模型家族与 INT4、INT3、INT2、NVFP4 格式上，QUASAR 的训练与评估 loss 持续低于竞争 QAT 方法，并在下游基准上超过 QAT 与 PTQ 基线。INT2 下配合量化感知蒸馏平均准确率较最佳 QAT 基线高 13.3 点，在数学推理数据上做 QAT 则高 10.9 点。仅用约 600M token 蒸馏后，QUASAR 的 INT4 Gemma-4 E4B checkpoint 超过 Google 发布的对应 QAT checkpoint，KL 散度低 66%，平均准确率高 1.8 点。
Conclusion: 把 loss-aware 重建以低成本方式放进训练循环，可以压低 QAT 的 loss floor，并在极低比特 (INT2) 与 INT4 上同时改善训练动态和下游准确率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EvoHarness-RL: Learning Runtime Harness Coordination for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents increasingly rely on external execution support to maintain state, track progress, recover from failures, and reuse experience across extended interactions. Yet existing harnesses and their use are often tailored to environments and controlled through prompts, heuristics, or system-specific rules, making agent and harness coordination difficult to jointly optimize. We introduce EvoHarness-RL, a unified framework that separates environment-specific harness implementations from a shared policy-facing interface. EvoHarness-RL organizes external support into a Belief, Progress, and Experience (BPE) workspace and exposes four compact harness actions for accessing and updating this state. We first instantiate BPE as an inference-time scaffold and then make harness coordination learnable through supervised initialization followed by cost-aware GRPO. Across heterogeneous long-horizon tasks, EvoHarness-Base improves the average success rate of frontier models by 10.0 percentage points, while EvoHarness-RL outperforms the strongest open-source baseline by 8.5 percentage points, together with higher RL rollout efficiency and stronger generalization to unseen tasks. Our analyses show that training gradually shifts agents from frequent scaffold use toward selective, environment-dependent harness access as the policy becomes more capable, while the external workspace continues to evolve and refine itself to better support task execution and generalization. Together, these results show that long-horizon agents benefit not only from external scaffolding itself, but also from learning how and when to coordinate with external support as part of a cost-aware policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoHarness-RL 把 LLM agent 的外部执行支撑从环境专用、靠 prompt 与启发式控制的 harness 中解耦出来，统一成共享的策略侧接口：外部状态组织为 Belief、Progress、Experience (BPE) 工作区，只暴露四个紧凑 harness action。先用监督初始化再做 cost-aware GRPO 学习协调策略，EvoHarness-Base 把前沿模型平均成功率抬高 10.0 个百分点，EvoHarness-RL 比最强开源基线高 8.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 长时程 LLM agent 依赖外部 harness 维护状态、追踪进度、从失败中恢复并复用经验，但现有 harness 及其用法按环境定制、由 prompt 或启发式规则控制，agent 与 harness 的协调难以联合优化。
Method: 框架把环境相关的 harness 实现与共享的策略侧接口分离；外部支撑组织为 BPE 工作区并暴露四个紧凑 harness action 供读写状态。先将 BPE 实例化为推理期 scaffold，再通过监督初始化加 cost-aware GRPO 让协调策略可学习。
Result: 在异构长时程任务上，EvoHarness-Base 使前沿模型平均成功率提升 10.0 个百分点；EvoHarness-RL 比最强开源基线高 8.5 个百分点，并带来更高的 RL rollout 效率与对未见任务的更强泛化。训练过程中 agent 从频繁使用 scaffold 逐渐转向按环境选择性访问 harness，外部工作区则持续自我演化 refinement。
Conclusion: 长时程 agent 的收益不只来自外部 scaffold 本身，还来自把「何时、如何调用外部支撑」作为 cost-aware 策略的一部分学出来；策略能力越强，对 harness 的调用越选择性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diagnosing Fine-Grained Inconsistency Classification in Financial Disclosure Text
papers.abstract_en: Financial disclosures may contain numerical, temporal, referential, factual, and policy inconsistencies that require different evidence and reasoning to diagnose. We study fine-grained inconsistency classification: given a passage known to contain a conflict, the goal is to identify its type among 11 categories. Using a fixed snapshot of the synthetic SBID-FD benchmark, we compare frozen and fine-tuned encoders, evidence-augmented classifiers, prompted large language models, and LoRA-adapted generative models under a shared evaluation protocol. Task-specific adaptation yields large improvements over frozen representations, and a fine-tuned 300M encoder performs competitively with substantially larger prompted and adapted models. We further study whether localizing the conflicting claims improves classification through matched predicted-span, reference-span, and distractor-span conditions. The results show that automatically extracted evidence provides additional signal but recovers only part of the benefit obtained from reference spans. Per-class and confusion analyses further reveal that some inconsistency types are especially sensitive to localization quality, whereas others remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is supplied. These findings identify evidence localization and fine-grained type discrimination as distinct challenges and show that compact supervised encoders are strong baselines for this task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在已知存在冲突的金融披露段落中做 11 类细粒度不一致分类，比较冻结/微调编码器、证据增强分类器、prompted LLM 与 LoRA 生成模型。任务适配带来大幅提升，微调 300M 编码器与更大模型相当；自动抽取证据只拿到参考 span 收益的一部分，且部分类型对定位质量特别敏感。
Motivation: 金融披露中的数值、时间、指称、事实与政策不一致需要不同证据与推理才能判定，而现有做法缺少统一协议下的细粒度类型区分与证据定位研究。
Method: 在固定快照的合成基准 SBID-FD 上，用统一评测协议对比冻结与微调编码器、证据增强分类器、prompted LLM 和 LoRA 适配生成模型；再以预测 span、参考 span、distractor span 三种匹配条件检验定位对分类的作用，并做 per-class 与混淆分析。
Result: 任务适配相对冻结表示有大幅提升；微调 300M 编码器与明显更大的 prompted/适配模型表现相当；自动抽取证据提供额外信号，但只复现了参考 span 所带来收益的一部分；部分不一致类型对定位质量特别敏感，另一些即使给出相关证据仍困难。
Conclusion: 证据定位与细粒度类型判别是两个可分离的挑战，紧凑的有监督编码器是该任务的强基线。

summary_sections.motivation: 金融披露中的数值、时间、指称、事实与政策不一致需要不同证据与推理才能判定，而现有做法缺少统一协议下的细粒度类型区分与证据定位研究。
summary_sections.method: 在固定快照的合成基准 SBID-FD 上，用统一评测协议对比冻结与微调编码器、证据增强分类器、prompted LLM 和 LoRA 适配生成模型；再以预测 span、参考 span、distractor span 三种匹配条件检验定位对分类的作用，并做 per-class 与混淆分析。
summary_sections.result: 任务适配相对冻结表示有大幅提升；微调 300M 编码器与明显更大的 prompted/适配模型表现相当；自动抽取证据提供额外信号，但只复现了参考 span 所带来收益的一部分；部分不一致类型对定位质量特别敏感，另一些即使给出相关证据仍困难。
summary_sections.conclusion: 证据定位与细粒度类型判别是两个可分离的挑战，紧凑的有监督编码器是该任务的强基线。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Structural Features for Continual, Comprehensible Visual Recognition in a Developmental Learning Framework
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary machine learning struggles to learn continually, reuse prior knowledge, and expose a comprehensible internal structure. A recently proposed developmental, gradient-free learning framework addresses these limitations by learning a discrete, topological model of its inputs through local variation and selection, yielding an inherent continual-learning guarantee: new observations refine existing structure without overwriting past knowledge, and without replay buffers or predefined task boundaries. Its extension to visual inputs demonstrated this principle on shape recognition, but relied on a feature representation of limited expressivity that capped recognition accuracy. We introduce a new visual feature representation that encodes shape structure across multiple scales, capturing edge and contour features together with their spatial relations, and integrate it with the network-refinement learning process; we further improve the learning dynamics and the read-out used to predict from the learned model. The study targets two-dimensional shape, with class-incremental MNIST as a controlled, interpretable benchmark in which continual-learning behavior can be measured directly. Our approach substantially increases accuracy over the prior representation, matching or exceeding replay- and regularisation-based baselines at comparable storage while storing no past data, and preserves the framework's defining behavior: earlier-learned classes are retained as new ones are introduced, with no destructive adaptation, and the learned representations remain human-interpretable. What separates the methods is retention: the baselines surrender most of a just-trained class within its own cycle and relearn it afterwards, which ours does not. The significance lies in the manner of learning. The system integrates information one sample at a time while provably preserving its responses to...
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在无梯度、发育式 (developmental) 学习框架中引入多尺度形状特征表示（边缘与轮廓及其空间关系），配合网络细化与改进的读出机制，在 class-incremental MNIST 上大幅提升识别精度，并在相近存储下匹配或超过 replay 与 regularization 类持续学习基线，且不存储任何历史数据。关键差异在保持率：基线在刚学类自己的周期内就丢失大部分、事后重学，而该方法不发生破坏性适应。
Motivation: 现有机器学习难以持续学习、复用先验知识并暴露可理解的内部结构；该框架此前的视觉扩展受限于表达能力不足的特征表示，识别精度被卡住。
Method: 采用跨多尺度编码形状结构的视觉特征表示（边缘与轮廓特征及其空间关系），与网络细化 (network-refinement) 学习过程集成，并改进学习动态与从学习模型读出的预测方式；以 class-incremental MNIST 作为可控、可解释的基准，逐样本整合信息，不使用 replay buffer 或预定义任务边界。
Result: 相比先前的特征表示精度显著提升；在相近存储下匹配或超过基于 replay 和 regularization 的基线，且不存储过去数据；早期学到的类在新类引入后被保留，无可破坏性适应；基线在其自身周期内丢失刚训练类的大部分并在事后重学，而该方法不会。
Conclusion: 差异在于学习方式：该系统逐样本整合信息并可证明地保持对先前输入的响应，同时保持人类可解释的表示，持续学习的保持能力可以在不存历史数据的条件下实现。

papers.title: Variational-Ising-Attention:Tailored Attention Matters for Science
papers.abstract_en: Attention enables context modeling via query-key scoring with softmax normalization. Driven by industrial long-context demands, mainstream research has converged toward sparsity and efficiency, yet softmax's independence assumption persists. For scientific tasks unburdened by long-token constraints, however, richer structured coupling may often be essential, making tailored attention both viable and more appropriate. To this end, we propose Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA), which augments softmax normalization with an interacting Ising model; attention patterns emerge from learnable pairwise couplings via variational mean-field inference, extending attention from a ranking over isolated items to a collective state over interacting entities. We instantiate VIA on retrosynthesis reaction center prediction and, as a controlled internal ablation, on protein residue contact prediction, two structured prediction tasks governed by cooperative constraints: cooperative bond-breaking for retrosynthesis and inter-residue interactions for protein contact prediction. Comprehensive experiments across model variants, coupled with mechanistic analyses, demonstrate that VIA substantially outperforms standard softmax attention. More broadly, our findings suggest that for scientific problems, the optimal solution is not general-purpose efficiency, but appropriately tailored attention aligned with intrinsic domain structure. This work provides a theoretically grounded and empirically validated instantiation of this paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VIA 把 softmax 归一化与相互作用 Ising 模型结合，用变分均场推断从可学习的成对耦合中生成注意力模式，使注意力从对孤立项的排序变成对相互作用实体的集体状态。在逆合成反应中心预测与蛋白质残基接触预测两个受协同约束的结构预测任务上，VIA 显著优于标准 softmax 注意力。
Motivation: 主流注意力研究为工业长上下文需求收敛到稀疏与效率，softmax 的独立性假设一直保留；而无长 token 约束的科学任务需要更丰富的结构化耦合，通用效率导向的注意力并不合适。
Method: VIA 在 softmax 归一化之上加入相互作用 Ising 模型，注意力模式由可学习的成对耦合经变分均场推断 (variational mean-field inference) 得到；实例化到逆合成反应中心预测，并以受控内部消融方式用于蛋白质残基接触预测，配套做跨模型变体的实验与机制分析。
Result: 在逆合成反应中心预测与蛋白质残基接触预测上，VIA 在跨模型变体的综合实验中显著优于标准 softmax 注意力；摘要给出的是定性比较结论，未附具体指标数值。
Conclusion: 对受内在领域结构支配的科学问题，最优解不是通用效率，而是与领域结构对齐的定制注意力；VIA 被作为该范式在理论上成立、经验上验证的实例。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Refusal-Gated Decoding: Preserving Refusal Behavior Under High-Temperature Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in truncation-based sampling have helped mitigate drawbacks of high-temperature sampling such as neural text degeneration, thereby enabling greater diversity without sacrificing coherence. However, increasing the entropy of the token probability distribution via high temperatures has also been shown to weaken the model's refusal response. Existing solutions for maintaining the refusal behavior of LLMs either replace the model's own refusal decision with a separate safety classifier or alter its output distribution for every prompt. To address this gap, we propose refusal-gated decoding (RGD): an efficient sequential decoding approach which preserves a model's greedy decoding refusal response at high temperatures and samples all other prompts from its exact direct high-temperature distribution, while incurring minimal additional latency. RGD runs a short greedy probe that reuses the prompt's KV cache and exits as soon as it becomes incompatible with a learned set of refusal prefixes; it returns the greedy response if the probe remains compatible and otherwise discards the probe and samples from the original prompt. Across seven models and three benchmark datasets at T=2.0, RGD raises greedy-refusal preservation from 91.9% under direct sampling to 98.3% on average while adding only 2.2-4.3% to the median per-request latency of non-refusals across temperatures. Unlike prompt-screening baselines which route many greedy non-refusals to greedy decoding, RGD keeps at least 98.1% of greedy non-refusals on unchanged high-temperature sampling, thereby preserving the model's natural high-temperature sampling behavior. We also propose a residual-stream variant of our method which lowers this latency overhead to at most 0.5% with comparable prompt routing accuracy. Our work shows that unlocking greater diversity via high-temperature sampling need not erode a model's refusal behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出拒绝门控解码 (Refusal-Gated Decoding, RGD)：在高温采样下先跑一个复用 KV cache 的短贪心探针，与学到的拒绝前缀集合比对，兼容则返回贪心响应，不兼容则丢弃探针并从原始高温分布采样。7 个模型、3 个基准在 T=2.0 下把贪心拒绝保持率从直接采样的 91.9% 提到平均 98.3%，非拒绝请求中位延迟只增 2.2–4.3%。
Motivation: 高温采样能缓解神经文本退化、提升多样性，但会削弱模型的拒绝响应；现有方案要么用独立安全分类器替换模型自身的拒绝决定，要么对每个 prompt 都改动输出分布。
Method: RGD 是顺序解码方案：跑一个复用 prompt KV cache 的短贪心探针，一旦与学到的拒绝前缀集合不兼容就立即退出；兼容则返回贪心响应，否则丢弃探针、从原始 prompt 的直接高温分布采样。另提出 residual-stream 变体进一步压低延迟开销。
Result: 在 7 个模型、3 个基准数据集上，T=2.0 时贪心拒绝保持率由直接采样的 91.9% 提升到平均 98.3%；各温度下非拒绝请求的中位每请求延迟仅增加 2.2–4.3%。与 prompt-screening 基线不同，RGD 让至少 98.1% 的贪心非拒绝请求保持不变的高温采样。residual-stream 变体把延迟开销降到至多 0.5%，prompt 路由精度相当。
Conclusion: 用高温采样解锁多样性不必以牺牲模型拒绝行为为代价，且无需外置分类器或对所有 prompt 改动分布；residual-stream 变体可把额外延迟压到 0.5% 以内。
Relevance: 1
