papers.title: Data-driven measures of high-frequency trading
papers.abstract_en: Public data do not identify high-frequency trading (HFT), and standard proxies do not separate liquidity-supplying from liquidity-demanding strategies. We overcome this measurement challenge by training machine learning models on proprietary Nasdaq data to map observed HFT activity to public intraday variables. Applying this mapping, we generate daily measures of liquidity-supplying and liquidity-demanding HFT for all U.S. stocks from 2010 to 2023. The measures largely subsume standard proxies and capture time-series variation that those proxies miss. Using proprietary Euronext Paris data, we provide evidence that the approach generalizes across markets and remains predictive years after training. The 14-year panel lets us study HFT and market quality over time. Supply-side HFT is consistently associated with greater pre-announcement information acquisition, more informed trading, and lower bid-ask spreads, while demand-side HFT is associated with the opposite patterns. During COVID-19, HFT-supplied liquidity remained resilient and its association with lower spreads strengthened.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 用机器学习把专有 Nasdaq 数据上的 HFT 活动映射到公开日内变量，从而为 2010–2023 年全部美股生成区分“提供流动性”与“消耗流动性”的日度 HFT 度量。供给方 HFT 与更低价差、更多知情交易和公告前信息获取正相关，需求方 HFT 则相反；COVID-19 期间供给方流动性保持韧性且与低价差的关联更强。
Motivation: 公开数据无法识别 HFT，标准代理变量也无法区分提供流动性与消耗流动性的策略，因而 HFT 与市场质量的关系长期测不准。
Method: 在专有 Nasdaq 数据上训练机器学习模型，把观测到的 HFT 活动映射到公开日内变量，再将该映射应用到全美股生成日度供给方与需求方 HFT 度量；用专有 Euronext Paris 数据检验跨市场泛化。
Result: 生成 2010–2023 年全部美股的 14 年面板；新度量在很大程度上吸收标准代理并捕捉其遗漏的时间序列变异；在 Euronext Paris 上泛化且在训练多年后仍具预测力。供给方 HFT 与更强的公告前信息获取、更多知情交易、更窄买卖价差一致相关，需求方 HFT 呈相反模式；COVID-19 期间 HFT 提供的流动性保持韧性，其与低价差的关联增强。
Conclusion: HFT 对市场质量的方向取决于其是供给方还是需求方，把两者混为一谈的代理变量会掩盖这一分化；该映射可跨市场、跨年份复用。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: The Premise Is the Problem: Exchangeability Failure in Self-Monitored Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Modern forecasting models are often updated after deployment so they can respond to changing data. These updates can also make predictions worse, so practical systems need a reliable monitor that can detect harmful changes and trigger protection. A natural design is to monitor the same prediction errors that guide the updates. This paper asks whether the statistical guarantee behind such a monitor remains valid when monitoring and adaptation use the same feedback. We study this question in multi-step time-series forecasting. We show that overlapping targets and dependence in forecast errors can break a key assumption required by the guarantee. The monitor may then raise alarms even when no harmful change has occurred, and its response can further damage prediction quality. We also find that adaptation can hide sustained changes from its own monitor, while the original frozen model retains a clearer signal. These results expose a basic failure mode in self-monitored adaptation. They show why reliable deployment requires checking the monitor's assumptions, comparing adaptation with the frozen model under realistic feedback, and limiting the effect of every protective response.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在多步时间序列预报的测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation) 中，用同一批预测误差既做更新又做监控会破坏监控保证所需的可交换性 (exchangeability)：重叠预报目标与误差相关性使监控在无有害变化时误报警，且其响应反过来进一步拉低预报质量；同时自适应过程会把自己的持续变化从监控中藏掉，而冻结的原模型仍保留清晰信号。作者主张可靠部署必须检查监控的假设、在真实反馈下对比自适应与冻结模型，并限制每次保护性响应的幅度。
Motivation: 部署后的模型更新可能让预测变差，因此需要监控器检测有害变化并触发保护；但若监控与自适应共用同一份反馈，监控统计保证的前提是否仍成立并不清楚，误报与响应会直接损害预报。
Method: 研究设定为多步时间序列预报的自监控测试时自适应，分析监控与自适应共享反馈时的统计保证；指出重叠的预报目标 (overlapping targets) 与预报误差之间的依赖会破坏保证所需的关键假设，并对比自适应模型与冻结原模型在该反馈下的监控信号。
Result: 证明重叠目标与误差依赖可破坏监控保证的关键假设，导致无有害变化时仍触发误报警，且监控响应会进一步降低预报质量；还发现自适应会向自身监控掩盖持续变化，而冻结原模型保留更清晰的信号。
Conclusion: 自监控自适应存在根本性失效模式：可靠部署需检验监控假设、在真实反馈下对照冻结模型，并限制每次保护响应的作用幅度。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 AF3 类复合物共折叠模型的物理有效性当作推理期约束问题，在去噪器输出的干净坐标估计 x̂0 上施加两个闭式投影算子：链间范德华投影推开最严重冲突原子对，配体距离几何投影修复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性与手性。算子局部、稀疏、位移有上限，不需要网络前向、梯度或重要性采样，在 Boltz-2 与 OpenFold-3 上五个基准实现完全物理有效性，同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标，运行时与内存开销可忽略。
Motivation: AlphaFold 3 类模型结构精度高但大量输出物理无效（链重叠、配体键长键角畸变、环非平面、手性翻转）；现有做法要么用物理势引导采样器、把采样成本与显存放大到大复合物无法推理，要么微调模型、耗时且绑定单一架构。
Method: 把物理有效性建模为约束推理，在扩散模型的去噪干净坐标估计 x̂0 上施加两个闭式投影算子：链间 van der Waals 投影推开冲突最严重的原子对，配体距离几何投影恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性与手性。两算子局部、稀疏、位移有上限，无需网络评估、梯度或重要性采样，不动去噪器权重，可直接插入任意 AF3 式采样器而无需重训练。
Result: 在两个独立开发的模型 Boltz-2 与 OpenFold-3 上，跨五个基准（CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters 单体与复合物集、Boltz physical-validity test set）实现完全物理有效性（perfect physical validity），同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标，运行时和内存开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 物理有效性可在推理期由采样器已持有的量完全验证并用闭式投影恢复，无需重训或物理势引导，是模型无关的全原子结构预测路线。

summary_sections.method: 把物理有效性建模为约束推理，在扩散模型的去噪干净坐标估计 x̂0 上施加两个闭式投影算子：链间 van der Waals 投影推开冲突最严重的原子对，配体距离几何投影恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性与手性。两算子局部、稀疏、位移有上限，无需网络评估、梯度或重要性采样，不动去噪器权重，可直接插入任意 AF3 式采样器而无需重训练。
summary_sections.result: 在两个独立开发的模型 Boltz-2 与 OpenFold-3 上，跨五个基准（CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters 单体与复合物集、Boltz physical-validity test set）实现完全物理有效性（perfect physical validity），同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标，运行时和内存开销可忽略。
summary_sections.conclusion: 物理有效性可在推理期由采样器已持有的量完全验证并用闭式投影恢复，无需重训或物理势引导，是模型无关的全原子结构预测路线。

papers.title: JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)
papers.abstract_en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JIVEAdapter 把多任务权重更新按 JIVE 思想拆成共享的 Joint 结构与逐任务的 Individual 结构，用近正交惩罚保持两者可解释地分离，并在共享池与逐任务池间自适应分配秩。Joint 可一次性学好后冻结，作为新任务的先验复用，只需廉价的逐方向 scale 或训练一个很小的 Individual。在 GLUE 与 SuperGLUE（DeBERTaV3-base）上，在匹配的逐任务有效秩下与强单任务/多任务低秩基线相当，且不引入 MoE 之类额外模块。
Motivation: 现有低秩适配器多为单任务、以乘法形式表示权重更新，无法显式区分跨任务共享成分与任务特有成分，多任务复用时共享部分难以直接迁移。
Method: 受统计学 Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE) 启发，将每个权重更新分解为跨任务 Joint 与逐任务 Individual 两部分；对 Individual 施加与 Joint 近正交的惩罚以保持共享/特有信号分离，并在共享 Joint 池与逐任务 Individual 池之间自适应分配秩。Joint 可按任务组联合学习或逐任务增量学习，之后冻结并作为新任务先验复用。
Result: 在 GLUE 与 SuperGLUE 上用 DeBERTaV3-base，于匹配的逐任务有效秩下与强单任务和多任务低秩基线相当，且不使用 MoE 等额外模块；当存在相关 held-in 任务时，冻结的 Joint 可通过复用该任务的 Individual 加一个廉价的逐方向 scale 来服务 held-out 任务，否则只需训练一个很小的新 Individual。
Conclusion: 把共享与任务特有成分显式分解并正交化，可以在不增加额外模块的前提下让低秩适配器跨任务复用共享结构，性能与强基线持平。

papers.title: Shaping the Wind: Nested Potentials for Kinematically Admissible Urban Wind Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting transient urban winds is fundamental to understanding urban microclimates and designing climate-resilient cities. Building-resolving large-eddy simulation produces detailed incompressible urban wind fields at substantial computational cost for each layout. Neural surrogates offer a faster alternative by learning to predict the evolution of velocity fields. However, minimizing velocity prediction error does not guarantee local mass conservation and wall impermeability, which together define kinematic admissibility. This limitation stems from an unconstrained output representation: geometry conditioning guides predictions but does not restrict them to admissible velocity fields. Correcting boundary violations in these outputs changes the flux balance in adjacent fluid cells and may consequently compromise local mass conservation. To address the challenge, we propose Sculpt, a nested potential framework that builds the coupled, geometry-dependent constraints directly into its parameterization. This nested parameterization generates divergence-free velocity updates through the discrete curl of a volume vector potential on the native three-dimensional staggered grid. A shared scalar potential constrains the vector potential's boundary values so that the same operator also enforces impermeability, without a per-step pressure projection. Because backpropagation through this curl attenuates large-scale gradient signals, we parameterize the volume potential at multiple resolutions to better capture large-scale flow structures. We introduce UrbanWindFlow, an LES dataset spanning urban morphologies and inflow conditions, to evaluate accuracy and kinematic admissibility together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Sculpt 嵌套势框架，把不可压缩与壁面不可穿透直接写进速度场参数化：在原生三维交错网格上用体积矢量势的离散 curl 生成无散度速度更新，共享标量势约束矢量势边界值，从而无需逐步压力投影。配套发布覆盖多种城市形态与来流条件的 LES 数据集 UrbanWindFlow，同时评测预测精度与运动学可容许性。
Motivation: 城市风神经代理若只最小化速度预测误差，无法保证局部质量守恒与壁面不可穿透；几何条件化只引导预测而不约束输出落在可容许速度场上，事后修补边界破坏又会改变相邻流体单元的通量平衡。
Method: Sculpt 用嵌套势参数化：体积矢量势在三维交错网格上取离散 curl 得到无散度速度更新，共享标量势约束该矢量势的边界值以同时保证不可穿透，避免每步压力投影；因反向传播经 curl 会衰减大尺度梯度信号，体积势按多分辨率参数化以捕捉大尺度流动结构。
Result: 提出并构建了 UrbanWindFlow——覆盖不同城市形态与来流条件的建筑解析 LES 数据集，用于同时评测预测精度与运动学可容许性（质量守恒、壁面不可穿透）。
Conclusion: 把耦合且依赖几何的约束直接写进参数化，而非事后修正输出，是让城市风代理输出运动学可容许速度场的路径，且无需逐步压力投影。
Relevance: 36

papers.title: Investigating Model Compression for Neural Machine Translation in the Biomedical Domain
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale pretrained transformer models have achieved state-of-the-art performance across diverse machine translation tasks, including multilingual settings. Knowledge distillation has emerged as a sustainable approach for model compression, transferring knowledge from large teacher models to smaller, more efficient student models. Similarly, quantization, which reduces the numerical precision of model weights and activations (e.g., from 32-bit to 8-bit representations) is widely used to accelerate inference, enabling models to run several times faster during deployment. However, both techniques face limitations when applied to specialized domain data, particularly under low-resource conditions. In knowledge distillation, the effectiveness of transfer is often constrained by the scarcity of domain-specific parallel data, while quantization can lead to performance degradation as bit precision decreases. In this work, we investigate the combined application of knowledge distillation and quantization for French-to-English biomedical translation, a domain characterized by specialized terminology and limited parallel resources. We develop and compare multiple fine-tuning strategies to adapt compressed student models to this challenging setting. Our experiments demonstrate that a collaboratively distilled and quantized student model achieves a 69% reduction in size, a 98.21% increase in inference speed, and a 98.46% reduction in CO2 emissions compared to the original baseline all without sacrificing translation quality. These results indicate that jointly optimized compression techniques can yield efficient, high-performance models suitable for translation service providers operating under resource constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在法译英生物医学翻译这一低资源专业领域，把知识蒸馏与量化（32-bit 降到 8-bit）联合使用并比较多种微调策略，得到的协作蒸馏+量化学生模型相对原始基线体积减少 69%、推理速度提升 98.21%、CO2 排放减少 98.46%，且翻译质量不下降。
Motivation: 知识蒸馏受限于领域平行语料稀缺，量化随位宽下降导致性能退化，两者单独用于专业领域低资源场景时各有瓶颈。
Method: 针对法译英生物医学翻译，联合应用知识蒸馏（大教师模型到小学生模型）与权重量化（32-bit 到 8-bit），并开发、比较多种微调策略以适配压缩后的学生模型。
Result: 协作蒸馏并量化的学生模型相对原始基线：体积减少 69%，推理速度提升 98.21%，CO2 排放减少 98.46%，翻译质量无损失。
Conclusion: 联合优化的压缩技术可在资源受限条件下产出高效且高性能的翻译模型，适合资源受限的翻译服务提供方。

papers.title: Artemis: Geometry-Grounded Multi-Agent Driving World Models with Shared 3D State and Progressive Memory Update
papers.abstract_en: Recent video world models have witnessed the paradigm shift from single-agent to multi-agent involvements, which can reveal more complicated dynamics and cross-agent interaction in the real world. However, existing approaches commonly adopt implicit inter-agent communications via cross attention, which lack explicit geometry constraints and unified 3D state, thereby leading to poor multi-view consistency and struggling with recovering out-of-sight agents. In addition, most of them assume a static background, failing to represent uncontrolled background dynamics. To address these problems, we propose Artemis: a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with explicit memory sharing. An explicit 3D world map is reconstructed from multi-agent observations to enforce a unified 3D state across agents, offering high cross-view consistency. Specifically, an action-guided geometric injection module is developed to simultaneously render decomposed foreground-background control maps, which are then injected into a diffusion transformer through a designed GeoAdapter block. Compared to previous methods assuming static-only background, our GeoAdapter can also distinguish uncontrolled non-agent dynamics, which are conditioned on their own multi-frame history positions to provide consistent motion cues. Keyframes selected from progressive video rollouts are used to progressively update the reconstructed 3D world maps. To effectively capture complex dynamic patterns, we curate a novel dataset sampled from the CARLA simulator called MA-CARLA. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in terms of visual fidelity and cross-view consistency in the generated videos. In addition, our Artemis can support simultaneous multi-modal rollouts with both 2D video and 3D point map maintenance, scale to scenarios beyond two agents and multi-camera setting.
papers.comment: The first three authors contributed equally, and their order was determined by drawing lots. Project Lead: Jiuming Liu. Corresponding Author: Ayush Tewari. Project page: https://liujiuming123.github.io/Artemis/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Artemis 用显式 3D 世界地图统一多智能体状态，通过动作引导几何注入模块渲染前景/背景控制图并经 GeoAdapter 注入 diffusion transformer，再用关键帧渐进更新地图。在自建 CARLA 数据集 MA-CARLA 上，生成视频的视觉保真度与跨视角一致性优于既有方法，并支持 2D 视频与 3D 点图同步 rollout。
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型靠 cross attention 隐式通信，缺少显式几何约束与统一 3D 状态，导致跨视角一致性差、视野外智能体难以恢复，且普遍假设静态背景，无法表示不受控的背景动态。
Method: 从多智能体观测重建显式 3D 世界地图以统一各智能体状态；动作引导几何注入模块同时渲染分解的前景-背景控制图，经 GeoAdapter 注入 diffusion transformer，背景动态以自身多帧历史位置为条件；从渐进视频 rollout 中选取关键帧更新 3D 地图。数据用自建的 CARLA 采样数据集 MA-CARLA。
Result: 在 MA-CARLA 上的实验显示该方法在生成视频的视觉保真度与跨视角一致性方面优于先前假设静态背景的方法；Artemis 支持 2D 视频与 3D 点图同步 rollout，并可扩展到两个以上智能体与多相机设置。
Conclusion: 显式几何与共享 3D 状态加渐进记忆更新，是多智能体世界模型同时做到跨视角一致、视野外恢复与非受控背景动态表示的可行路径。

papers.title: An Empirical Fault Vulnerability Exploration of ReRAM-based Process-in-Memory CNN Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: Resistive random-access memory (ReRAM)-based Processing-in-Memory (PIM) accelerator is a promising platform for processing massively memory intensive matrix-vector multiplications of neural networks in parallel domain, due to its capability of analog computation, ultra-high density, near-zero leakage current, and non-volatility. Despite many advantages, ReRAM-based accelerators are highly error-prone due to limitations of technology fabrication that lead to process variations and defects. These limitations degrade the accuracy of Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (Deep CNNs) running on PIM accelerators. While these CNNs accelerators are widely deployed in safety-critical systems, their vulnerability to fault is not well explored. In this paper, we have developed a fault injection framework to investigate the vulnerability of large-scale CNNs at both software- and hardware-level of inference phases. Faulty ReRAM devices are another reliability challenges due to significant degradation of classification accuracy when CNN parameters are mapped to the accelerators. To investigate this challenge, we map the CNN learning parameter to the ReRAM crossbar and inject faults into crossbar arrays. The proposed framework analyzes the impact of stuck-at high (SaH) and stuck-at low (SaL) fault models on different layers and locations of CNN learning parameters. By performing extensive fault injections, we illustrate that the vulnerability behavior of ReRAM-based PIM accelerator for CNNs is greatly impressible to the types and depth of layers, the location of the learning parameter in every layer, and the value and types of faults. Our observations show that different models have different vulnerabilities to faults. Specifically, we show that SaL further reduces classification accuracy than SaH.
papers.journal_ref: A. Dorostkar, H. Farbeh and H. R. Zarandi, "An Empirical Fault Vulnerability Exploration of ReRAM-Based Process-in-Memory CNN Accelerators," in IEEE Transactions on Reliability, vol. 74, no. 1, pp. 2290-2304, March 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对 ReRAM 存内计算 (PIM) CNN 加速器的故障脆弱性，提出同时覆盖软件层与硬件层推理阶段的故障注入框架：把 CNN 权重映射到 ReRAM crossbar，再向阵列注入 stuck-at high (SaH) 与 stuck-at low (SaL) 故障，逐层逐位置统计分类精度退化。结果显示脆弱性高度依赖层的类型与深度、参数在层内的位置、以及故障的取值与类型，且 SaL 比 SaH 进一步降低分类精度。
Motivation: ReRAM 工艺偏差与缺陷使模拟计算易出错，而部署在安全关键系统中的大规模 CNN 在 PIM 加速器上的故障脆弱性此前缺少系统探索。
Method: 构建故障注入框架，在软件与硬件两个推理层面注入故障：将 CNN 学习参数映射到 ReRAM crossbar 阵列，对不同层、不同参数位置注入 SaH 与 SaL 故障模型，并做大量故障注入以比较不同模型的脆弱性。
Result: 大量故障注入表明，ReRAM PIM 加速器上 CNN 的脆弱性对层的类型与深度、层内参数位置、故障取值与类型都很敏感；不同模型对故障的脆弱程度不同；SaL 相比 SaH 会进一步降低分类精度。
Conclusion: ReRAM PIM 上 CNN 的故障脆弱性不是均匀的，必须按层类型、层深度、参数位置和故障类型分别评估，且 SaL 是比 SaH 更需防范的故障模式。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Identifiable World Models from Pretrained Diffusion Representations
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based world models can generate and predict trajectories in high-dimensional dynamical systems, but predictive accuracy does not imply that their latent coordinates recover the underlying state variables or causal interactions. We ask whether a frozen pretrained diffusion model can be equipped with identifiable coordinates without retraining its generative backbone. We show that auxiliary-variable nonlinear ICA guarantees can be transferred to Contrastive Diffusion Alignment (ConDA), which learns only a lightweight alignment map on top of frozen diffusion latents. Under standard TCL/GCL assumptions, the aligned representation identifies latent dynamical states up to permutation and componentwise invertible transformations, preserves the latent dynamic structural causal model, and reduces lagged graph recovery to transition-Jacobian sparsity. We evaluate TCL-, GCL-, and CEBRA-based ConDA against TDRL, CaRiNG, IDOL, temporal SuaVE, and iVAE across physical and robotic video systems. TCL and GCL achieve near-perfect blockwise state recovery and competitive lagged graph recovery, including exact recovery in a simulated falling-body system. In a simulated bipedal robot, learned dynamics recover the sign and temporal structure of responses to held-out control perturbations. These results show that a frozen generative diffusion model can be equipped with coordinates that are identifiable, structurally interpretable, and useful for analyzing intervention-relevant dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在冻结的预训练 diffusion 潜变量上只训练一个轻量对齐映射（ConDA），把辅助变量非线性 ICA 的可识别性保证迁移过来，使对齐后表示在标准 TCL/GCL 假设下达到置换与逐分量可逆变换意义下的可识别，并保持潜变量动态结构因果模型。TCL 与 GCL 版本在物理与机器人视频系统上取得近乎完美的分块状态恢复，在模拟自由落体系统中实现精确的滞后图恢复。
Motivation: diffusion 世界模型预测精度高，但其潜坐标未必对应真实状态变量或因果关系，导致学到的动力学不可解释、无法用于干预分析。
Method: ConDA 在冻结 diffusion 潜变量之上只训练轻量对齐映射，不重训生成骨干；将辅助变量非线性 ICA 的 TCL/GCL 保证迁移过来，并把滞后图恢复化归为转移 Jacobian 稀疏性；同时实现 TCL、GCL 与 CEBRA 三种对齐版本。
Result: 与 TDRL、CaRiNG、IDOL、temporal SuaVE、iVAE 对比，在物理与机器人视频系统上，TCL 和 GCL 达到近乎完美的分块状态恢复与有竞争力的滞后图恢复，其中模拟自由落体系统中实现精确恢复；在模拟双足机器人上，学到的动力学能复现对留出控制扰动响应的符号与时序结构。
Conclusion: 冻结的生成式 diffusion 模型无需重训即可被赋予可识别、结构上可解释的坐标，足以分析与干预相关的动力学。

papers.title: Offline AI Modules: Voice-First Offline Architecture, Hardware Reference Stack, Quantization and Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: The Offline AI Modules workstream enables practical, low-power, and community-accessible deployment of voice-first AI systems that operate fully offline. Designed for African language communities where speech is the dominant mode of interaction and internet connectivity is unreliable or absent, the workstream delivers three reinforcing components: a modular voice-first offline architecture, a low-cost hardware reference bill of materials, and a reproducible quantization and a reproducible quantization and benchmarking pipeline for instruction-tuned language models in the 2-5B parameter class. This paper presents the first end-to-end benchmark evaluation of the stack across two hardware tiers: an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (TierB) and a Raspberry Pi5 (TierA). Three instruction-tuned models are evaluated across four quantization formats, assessed for deployment metrics (decode throughput, chat latency, memory, power) and multilingual quality (topic classification accuracy on MasakhaNEWS across English, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, and Yoruba; per-language perplexity drift). Speech recognition is evaluated using Ethio-ASR on Amharic and Oromo across both tiers. The principal finding is that Q4_K_M quantization represents the best size-to-quality trade-off for deployment on both tiers: gemma-4-E2B-it achieves 28.8t/s decode throughput and 89.2% topic classification accuracy at Q4_K_M on TierB, while all three models run within the 16GB memory budget on TierA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 面向非洲语言社区的完全离线语音优先 AI 栈，在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (TierB) 与 Raspberry Pi5 (TierA) 两档硬件上做端到端基准：3 个指令微调模型 × 4 种量化格式，测解码吞吐、聊天延迟、内存、功耗与多语种质量。结论是 Q4_K_M 在两档硬件上都是尺寸-质量最佳折中，gemma-4-E2B-it 在 TierB 上 Q4_K_M 达 28.8 t/s 解码吞吐与 89.2% MasakhaNEWS 话题分类准确率，三个模型在 TierA 上均落在 16GB 内存预算内。
Motivation: 非洲语言社区以语音为主要交互方式，但网络不可用或缺失，通用云侧 LLM 无法落地；需要在低功耗、低成本硬件上同时守住部署指标与多语种质量。
Method: 提出模块化语音优先离线架构、低成本硬件参考 BOM，以及可复现的量化与基准流程，覆盖 2–5B 参数级指令微调模型；在两档硬件上评测 3 个模型 × 4 种量化格式，指标含 decode throughput、chat latency、内存、功耗，多语种质量用 MasakhaNEWS 话题分类准确率（English、Hausa、Igbo、Nigerian Pidgin、Yoruba）与逐语言 perplexity drift，语音识别用 Ethio-ASR 测 Amharic 与 Oromo。
Result: gemma-4-E2B-it 在 TierB 上 Q4_K_M 达 28.8 t/s 解码吞吐与 89.2% MasakhaNEWS 话题分类准确率；三个模型在 TierA (Raspberry Pi5) 上全部运行于 16GB 内存预算内；语音识别在 Ethio-ASR 的 Amharic 与 Oromo 上跨两档硬件评测。
Conclusion: Q4_K_M 是两档硬件上部署 2–5B 指令模型的尺寸-质量最佳量化选择，离线语音 AI 栈可在 16GB 级低成本硬件上跑通。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: WiSPER: Pose-Supervised Predictive and Residual Flow Refinement For Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With WiFi CSI
papers.abstract_en: Multi-person 3D pose estimation with WiFi channel state information (CSI) is challenging because reflections from different people overlap without directly identifying individual joints. Existing masked embedding objectives capture wireless relationships without explicit pose supervision, while structured decoders can retain coordinate errors. We propose WiSPER, a two-stage framework combining pose-aware predictive pretraining with conditional residual flow refinement. Pose-Aware Masked Embedding Learning (PAMEL) couples masked latent prediction with auxiliary pose-set supervision on the same CSI context, guiding the encoder toward joint localization from partial observations. Residual Flow refinement with Transformer (ReFT) generates a set of pose candidates to accommodate a variable number of people and refines each candidate through a conditional flow guided by its coarse coordinates and per-joint decoder features. Both stages use paired CSI and pose annotations during training, while inference requires only CSI. Experiments on the PiW3D dataset show that WiSPER achieves an overall mean per-joint position error of 63.72 mm, a 40.0% reduction relative to WiFi-JEPA. For experiments with two and three people, WiSPER reduces MPJPE by 42.1% and 38.1%, respectively. Pose-supervised pretraining configurations obtain lower errors than CSI-only JEPA, and enabling the trained residual refiner reduces overall MPJPE by 13.8-15.6% across the evaluated configurations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WiSPER 用两阶段框架从 WiFi CSI 估计多人 3D 姿态：PAMEL 把掩码潜变量预测与姿态集合监督耦合在同一 CSI 上下文上，ReFT 生成可变人数的姿态候选并用条件流按粗坐标与逐关节特征细化。在 PiW3D 上整体 MPJPE 为 63.72 mm，比 WiFi-JEPA 降低 40.0%，两人/三人场景分别降低 42.1% 与 38.1%。
Motivation: WiFi CSI 中多人反射互相叠加、无法直接定位单个关节；已有掩码嵌入目标只学无线关联而缺少显式姿态监督，结构化解码器又会保留坐标误差。
Method: 两阶段：PAMEL 在同一 CSI 上下文上联合掩码潜变量预测与辅助姿态集合监督，引导编码器从部分观测定位关节；ReFT 先生成一组姿态候选以适配可变人数，再用以粗坐标和逐关节解码特征为条件的 flow 对每个候选细化。训练用配对 CSI 与姿态标注，推理只需 CSI。
Result: PiW3D 上整体 MPJPE 63.72 mm，相对 WiFi-JEPA 降低 40.0%；两人与三人实验分别降低 42.1% 与 38.1%。姿态监督预训练配置误差低于仅 CSI 的 JEPA；启用已训练的残差细化器在各评估配置上使整体 MPJPE 再降低 13.8–15.6%。
Conclusion: 把姿态监督放进掩码预训练并叠加条件残差流细化，可在只用 CSI 推理的条件下显著压低多人 3D 姿态的关节位置误差。

papers.title: Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SSRFT 把 LLM 安全对齐从学习拒绝模式重构为内化一个预定义的安全角色：用心理测量问题、少量越狱提示和安全角色描述构造 SRQA 数据集，合成角色一致回答并扩展到多样场景。在多个 Base 与 Instruct 模型上，它比标准 SFT 更抗 prefilling 攻击、对未见越狱域泛化更好，同时降低良性查询上的过度拒绝并保持通用能力。
Motivation: 现有 SFT 与 RLHF 对齐依赖大量针对具体攻击的监督和算力，仍停留在浅层安全对齐，既易被越狱攻破又会过度拒绝。
Method: 提出 Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning (SSRFT)：从心理测量问题、有限越狱提示与安全角色描述构建 Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) 数据集，合成角色一致回答，经验证后扩展到多样场景，使模型内化安全价值观而非显式拒绝规则，再做监督微调。
Result: 在多个 Base 和 Instruct 模型上，SSRFT 比标准 SFT 更稳健、更可泛化：对 prefilling 攻击的鲁棒性显著更强，对未见越狱域泛化更好，良性查询上的过度拒绝减少，且保持模型通用能力。
Conclusion: 安全角色内化 (safe-role internalization) 可作为以拒绝为中心的安全对齐的有效替代路径，兼顾鲁棒性、泛化性与不过度拒绝。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在多个 Base 和 Instruct 模型上，SSRFT 比标准 SFT 更稳健、更可泛化：对 prefilling 攻击的鲁棒性显著更强，对未见越狱域泛化更好，良性查询上的过度拒绝减少，且保持模型通用能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 安全角色内化 (safe-role internalization) 可作为以拒绝为中心的安全对齐的有效替代路径，兼顾鲁棒性、泛化性与不过度拒绝。

papers.title: Calibrated Answers About Randomized Trials From a 4-Billion-Parameter Open Model: A Registered Test and a License-Clean Release
papers.abstract_en: Fiorillo v0.5 is an open model that answers typed questions with a probability for each answer. Its main specialist reads a randomized trial's article, cut to 6,144 tokens, and answers whether an intervention significantly increased, significantly decreased or did not significantly change an outcome against a comparator (Evidence Inference 2.0, EI). It is Qwen3-4B-Base with low-rank adapters and a decision head, fine-tuned for EI only on the 1,431 of 2,657 training articles whose own license allows reuse. Four criteria registered on the Open Science Framework before this version's test predictions decided its release, the second bar judged on EI's test split, whose labels are public. On that split (1,218 prompts in 333 articles), the expected calibration error was 0.0168 against a limit of 0.05; log loss was below the prior's by 0.8603 (95 percent interval 0.8104 to 0.9078) and below that of Gemma 4 31B-it, reading the same input, by 0.1829 (0.1164 to 0.2598); and macro-F1 was 0.9248 against 0.8668, so all four criteria passed. Training the same recipe on clean articles alone cost 0.0123 in accuracy (0.0034 to 0.0207; descriptive). With no article, macro-F1 fell to 0.4384; the title alone raised it by 0.0939 (0.0655 to 0.1234), which a title stating the result or recall of the trial could explain; exchanging intervention and comparator reversed 0.6652 of its direction answers. Run as released, the files matched the evaluated predictions within limits set in advance. The release is under the Apache License 2.0 (digital object identifier 10.57967/hf/10722).
papers.comment: 20 pages, 2 figures, 13 tables. Code, results files and the paper's sources: https://github.com/johann-e-li/fiorillo. Model: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10722. Registration: https://osf.io/kaxmn/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Fiorillo v0.5 是一个 40 亿参数开源模型，对随机对照试验文章输出带概率的三分类答案（显著升高/显著降低/无显著变化）。在 Evidence Inference 2.0 测试集（1,218 条提示、333 篇文章）上 ECE 为 0.0168（限值 0.05），log loss 比先验低 0.8603、比 Gemma 4 31B-it 低 0.1829，macro-F1 0.9248 对 0.8668，四项预注册标准全部通过。
Motivation: 让小型开放模型对随机对照试验给出既准确又校准良好的概率化结论判断，且训练语料须许可证干净、发布前标准须在 OSF 预注册，以保证结果可复核。
Method: 基于 Qwen3-4B-Base 加 LoRA 与 decision head，仅在 2,657 篇训练文章中许可证允许复用的 1,431 篇上针对 Evidence Inference 2.0 微调；主阅读器读取截断至 6,144 token 的文章并输出三分类概率；四项发布标准在 OSF 上于本版本测试预测之前注册，第二项在标签公开的 EI 测试划分上判定。
Result: EI 测试划分（1,218 条提示、333 篇文章）上 ECE 0.0168（限值 0.05）；log loss 低于先验 0.8603（95% 区间 0.8104–0.9078），低于同输入的 Gemma 4 31B-it 0.1829（0.1164–0.2598）；macro-F1 0.9248 对 0.8668，四项标准全部通过。仅用干净文章训练损失 0.0123 的准确率（0.0034–0.0207，描述性）。无文章时 macro-F1 降至 0.4384，仅标题提升 0.0939（0.0655–0.1234），交换干预与比较组使 0.6652 的方向答案反转。
Conclusion: 许可证干净的语料加预注册标准可以训出校准与判别兼优的小型开放试验问答模型，但其方向判断对标题泄漏与干预/比较组顺序敏感。发布文件按原样运行与评估预测在预设限值内一致，采用 Apache License 2.0。

papers.title: When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers. Self-verification offers a practical way to improve answer reliability without relying on external judges, but existing methods typically depend on a single verification criterion or fixed prompt, resulting in incomplete and unstable reliability estimates. We first systematically analyze how verifier capability and prompt design affect verification performance. Our findings show that stronger verifiers provide more reliable judgments, while verification performance is highly sensitive to prompt choice, with no single prompt consistently dominating across tasks. Guided by these findings, we propose \texttt{MOTIVE}, a \textbf{M}ulti-View Self-Verificati\textbf{O}n wi\textbf{T}h Rel\textbf{I}ability-Guided Selecti\textbf{VE} Rethinking framework for reliable multimodal reasoning. \texttt{MOTIVE} evaluates each candidate answer from complementary verification perspectives and learns a correctness-aligned reliability score through correctness-grounded multi-view verification learning. During inference, this score governs an accept-or-rethink decision, allowing reliable answers to be returned directly while uncertain ones trigger history-guided rethinking. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks and VLM backbones demonstrate that \texttt{MOTIVE} consistently outperforms strong self-verification and self-correction baselines. Further results show that reliable verification improves accept-or-rethink decisions and reduces unnecessary reasoning turns, enabling more reliable and efficient self-verification without an external judge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOTIVE 用多视角自验证加可靠性分数决定「接受还是重想」：分数高直接返回答案，低则触发历史引导的重想。它在多个多模态基准上稳定超过强自验证与自纠错基线，并减少不必要的推理轮次。
Motivation: VLM 常给出看似合理但错误的答案；现有自验证只依赖单一验证准则或固定 prompt，可靠性估计不完整也不稳定。
Method: MOTIVE 从互补验证视角评估候选答案，用 correctness-grounded multi-view verification learning 学一个与正确性对齐的可靠性分数；推理时该分数驱动 accept-or-rethink 决策，不确定答案触发 history-guided rethinking。先系统分析验证器能力与 prompt 设计对验证性能的影响。
Result: 分析发现更强的验证器给出更可靠判断，验证性能对 prompt 高度敏感且无单一 prompt 在所有任务上占优。在多个多模态基准与多种 VLM backbone 上，MOTIVE 持续优于强自验证与自纠错基线，并减少不必要的推理轮次。
Conclusion: 多视角验证加可靠性引导的重想决策，可以在不依赖外部 judge 的前提下同时提升自验证的可靠性与效率。

papers.title: Anchor and Adapt: Asymmetric Prompt Adaptation for Few-Shot Industrial Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: In few-shot industrial anomaly detection, the few normal target images provide no direct defect supervision, making anomaly prompts difficult to learn from these samples alone. Some vision-language methods therefore use manually specified descriptions to supply explicit anomaly semantics. However, constructing these descriptions requires product-specific effort, and their effectiveness depends on prompt selection. We propose Anchor and Adapt, a two-stage prompt learning framework that separates the acquisition of anomaly semantics from adaptation to target normal appearance. Stage I learns transferable normal and abnormal anchors from annotated auxiliary data. Stage II keeps these anchors fixed and adapts an additional normal branch using the few target normal samples. The inherited and adapted normal branches jointly characterize target normality, with text-anchor regularization encouraging consistency with the generic normal prior and separation from the abnormal anchors. This design retains learned anomaly knowledge while reducing dependence on category-specific anomaly templates, without requiring synthetic anomaly generation. Cross-dataset experiments between MVTec-AD and VisA under 1-, 2-, and 4-shot settings demonstrate competitive detection and localization performance. Controlled ablations assess the roles of transferred anchors, asymmetric adaptation, dual-normal representations, and anchor regularization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出两阶段提示学习框架 Anchor and Adapt：Stage I 从带标注辅助数据学可迁移的正常/异常 anchor，Stage II 固定 anchor、只用少量目标正常样本适配额外正常分支，并用 text-anchor 正则约束其贴近通用正常先验、远离异常 anchor。在 MVTec-AD 与 VisA 的 1/2/4-shot 跨数据集设定下展示有竞争力的检测与定位表现，且无需合成异常生成。
Motivation: 少样本工业异常检测中目标域只有正常图、没有缺陷监督，异常提示难以从这些样本学出；依赖人工描述又需按产品定制且效果取决于提示选择。
Method: 两阶段提示学习：Stage I 从带标注辅助数据学习可迁移的 normal/abnormal anchors；Stage II 冻结 anchors，仅用少量目标正常样本适配一个额外 normal 分支，继承分支与适配分支共同刻画目标正常性，并施加 text-anchor 正则（对通用 normal prior 保持一致、与 abnormal anchors 分离），不使用合成异常生成。
Result: 在 MVTec-AD 与 VisA 之间做跨数据集实验，覆盖 1-shot、2-shot、4-shot 设定，检测与定位表现有竞争力；受控消融分别考察迁移 anchor、非对称适配、双正常表示与 anchor 正则的作用。
Conclusion: 把异常语义获取与目标正常外观适配解耦，可在保留已学异常知识的同时减少对类别特定异常模板的依赖。

papers.title: DTFormer: Text-Guided Semantic Alignment for RGB-D Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: RGB-D semantic segmentation has made notable progress by fusing RGB and Depth, yet mainstream models still learn features almost exclusively from pixel-level supervision, lacking direct high-level semantic constraints. This raises a central question-can external knowledge such as language priors inject stronger semantic discriminability into mainstream RGB-D segmentation models. We present DTFormer, a novel tri-modal (RGB-D-Text) semantic segmentation framework. At its core is Text-guided Semantic Alignment Module (TSAM) that first encodes textual cues into a set of semantic prototypes and then explicitly aligns multi-modal RGB-D features with these prototypes at multiple encoder and decoder layers. This design imposes strong semantic regularization on representation learning, guiding the network toward more discriminative features. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that DTFormer delivers consistent gains while remaining simple and efficient. Our results demonstrate that explicit semantic alignment offers an effective and practical route to improving RGB-D semantic segmentation. The code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.comment: This is submitted to IEEE Journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DTFormer 把文本先验引入 RGB-D 语义分割，用 Text-guided Semantic Alignment Module (TSAM) 把文本编码成语义原型，并在编码器与解码器多个层上显式对齐 RGB-D 特征，从而给原本只有像素级监督的表征加上高层语义约束。在多个基准上取得一致增益且保持简单高效。
Motivation: 主流 RGB-D 分割几乎只靠像素级监督学特征，缺少直接的高层语义约束，语言先验能否注入更强的语义判别力是待验证的核心问题。
Method: 提出三模态 (RGB-D-Text) 框架 DTFormer，核心为 TSAM：先把文本线索编码为一组语义原型 (semantic prototypes)，再在编码器与解码器的多个层上将多模态 RGB-D 特征与这些原型显式对齐，作为表征学习的语义正则。
Result: 在多个基准 (multiple benchmarks) 上取得一致增益 (consistent gains)，同时保持方法简单高效；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 显式语义对齐是提升 RGB-D 语义分割的一条有效且实用的路径，代码将在论文接收后发布。

papers.title: Which Image Property Carries the Jailbreak? A Controlled Dissection of Image-to-Text Jailbreaks
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-text jailbreaks place harmful intent in text, image content, or the relationship between them. We examine image-side factors across four published attack families on a 313-prompt StrongREJECT slice, using five multimodal models and an additional appendix evaluation of InternVL3.5-8B. The harmful instruction is held constant across conditions; the baseline matrix uses one draw per prompt, and paired ablations use three draws with an automated rubric judge. A bare harmful query, with or without a benign unrelated image, produces little attack success on most victims, while attack images substantially increase it. First, per-tile entropy and JPEG size do not reliably distinguish attack tiles from size-matched benign distractors, limiting density-only screening. Second, earlier tile-count ladders were confounded by payload visibility. A corrected region-count test found no detectable effect, so the role of tile-count structure remains unresolved. Third, on Qwen3-VL-8B, the E4 manipulation that removes query-specific relatedness lowers ASR by about 0.12. This supports a bounded attribution to the relatedness manipulation, although image-text congruence remains unmeasured. A within-category control reproduces the direction on overlapping stimuli. Five tests survive the global statistical correction, but only E4 supports attribution to one measured descriptor; the within-category result is a robustness check, not a separate attribution. These conclusions remain conditional on the rubric judge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 313 条 StrongREJECT 提示、五个多模态模型上做受控消融，发现图像侧真正携带越狱能力的是图文相关性 (relatedness)：在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上移除 query-specific relatedness 的 E4 操作使 ASR 下降约 0.12，而 per-tile 熵、JPEG 大小与修正后的 tile-count 阶梯均不能区分攻击图与对照。
Motivation: 图像越狱把恶意意图藏进图像内容或图文关系，但此前的 tile-count 阶梯结论被 payload 可见性混淆，密度类筛查指标也缺少受控验证，无法判断究竟是哪项图像属性在起作用。
Method: 覆盖四个已发表攻击家族、313 条 StrongREJECT 提示切片、五个多模态受害者模型，另加 InternVL3.5-8B 附录评估；恶意指令在各条件下固定，基线矩阵每提示一次采样，配对消融三次采样并用自动 rubric judge 打分，另做 within-category 对照与全局统计校正。
Result: 裸恶意查询（配或不配无关良性图）在多数受害者上攻击成功率很低，攻击图像显著抬高 ASR；per-tile 熵与 JPEG 大小无法可靠区分攻击 tile 与同尺寸良性干扰块；修正 region-count 后 tile 数量无可检测效应；Qwen3-VL-8B 上 E4 移除相关性使 ASR 降约 0.12；五项检验通过全局统计校正，仅 E4 支持归因到单一被测描述符。
Conclusion: 图像越狱的可归因属性目前只有图文 relatedness 一项站得住，密度与 tile-count 结构不足以支撑筛查；结论仍以 rubric judge 为条件，image-text congruence 尚未测量，within-category 结果只是稳健性检查而非独立归因。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning to Curate What You Generate for Generalizable Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) aims to learn novel classes from limited annotations while preserving prior knowledge. Existing methods typically assume a sufficiently large base session, but this assumption fails when both base and incremental data are scarce, leading to weak initial representations, semantic drift, and unstable boundaries. We study this underexplored yet realistic setting, termed Generalizable FSCIL (G-FSCIL), where the base session itself contains only a few classes. Although synthetic data can alleviate supervision scarcity, naively mixing generated samples often introduces semantic noise and exacerbates old-new boundary conflicts. To address this, we propose a framework that curates trustworthy synthetic knowledge for stable G-FSCIL. Specifically, we first construct class-specific synthetic candidate pools using a frozen latent diffusion model, where class inversion is performed at the first observation and the resulting condition embeddings are reused for on-demand generation. Building on these candidates, we learn a knowledge curation strategy that selects samples with both semantic consistency and visual diversity, and distill this process into a transferable selection policy during the base session, which is then reused without further optimization. Leveraging the curated synthetic data, we further design a boundary-stable incremental adaptation scheme, including synthetic-informed prototype initialization and bidirectional boundary calibration to mitigate old-new conflicts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing FSCIL baselines, with reduced forgetting and improved balance between old and new classes. Code is available at https://github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 base session 本身只有少数类的 G-FSCIL 设定下，用冻结的 latent diffusion 按类反演条件嵌入并复用生成候选池，再学一个兼顾语义一致性与视觉多样性的知识筛选策略并蒸馏成可迁移的选样策略，配合原型初始化与双向边界校准缓解新旧类冲突。实验显示该方法持续优于现有 FSCIL 基线，遗忘减少、新旧类平衡改善。
Motivation: 现有 FSCIL 假设 base session 足够大，当 base 与增量数据都稀缺时初始表征弱、语义漂移、边界不稳；直接混入合成样本又会引入语义噪声并加剧新旧边界冲突。
Method: 用冻结的 latent diffusion 构建按类的合成候选池，首次观测时做 class inversion 并复用条件嵌入按需生成；在 base session 学习兼顾语义一致性与视觉多样性的知识筛选策略并蒸馏为可迁移的选样策略，之后不再优化；再用合成数据做原型初始化与双向边界校准 (bidirectional boundary calibration) 的增量适配。
Result: 在广泛实验中持续优于现有 FSCIL 基线，遗忘减少，新旧类之间的平衡改善；代码发布于 github.com/NiHaoWoJiaoYYC/G-FSCIL。
Conclusion: 在 base 与增量数据都稀缺的 G-FSCIL 下，先筛选可信合成知识再做边界稳定的增量适配，比直接混用生成样本更能稳住新旧类边界。

papers.title: STOCK-JEPA: Prior-Anchored Latent Revision Representation Learning in Equity Markets
papers.abstract_en: Learning effective representations helps characterize the structure and dynamics of equity markets from financial data with a low signal-to-noise ratio. Black-box deep models can capture complex patterns but may overfit sample noise and lack explicit economic structure. Meanwhile, classic linear financial models provide interpretable references, but their oversimplified assumptions leave non-linear signals uncaptured. To combine the strengths of these two directions, we propose Stock-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive framework that learns predictable incremental revisions relative to a point-in-time financial prior. First, we leverage a low-complexity financial model to produce fixed statistics summarizing multi-horizon return and risk. A prior projector then maps these statistics into the target encoder's latent space as an anchor. Second, we design a context-conditioned revision predictor to estimate the future representation's predictable displacement from the anchor. Separate losses update the two branches: the anchor learns from prior statistics, while the revision captures additional predictable information from historical context. Third, we freeze all representation modules and train a downstream readout, evaluating its forecasts through cross-sectional ranking and portfolio performance. Theoretically, we prove that optimal revision reduces the prior anchor's expected squared error for the same future representation by exactly $\mathbb{E}[\|\boldsymbolΔ\|_2^2]$. This non-negative gain is the expected squared magnitude of the additional signal predictable from historical context. Experimentally, Stock-JEPA outperforms 13 strong baselines across large-scale China and U.S. equity universes on 5 key evaluation metrics. Ablation studies and representation analysis further demonstrate the value of the learned revisions for representation learning in equity markets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Stock-JEPA 用联合嵌入预测框架 (JEPA) 学习相对于时点金融先验的可预测增量修订：低复杂度金融模型产出多期收益与风险统计，先验投影器将其映射为目标编码器隐空间的锚点，上下文条件化的修订预测器估计未来表示相对锚点的位移。理论上证明最优修订使先验锚点对同一未来表示的期望平方误差恰好降低 E[‖Δ‖₂²]；实验在中国与美国大规模股票域上以 5 项关键指标胜过 13 个强基线。
Motivation: 金融数据信噪比低，黑箱深度模型易过拟合样本噪声且缺乏显式经济结构，而经典线性模型假设过简、抓不住非线性信号，两条路线各有短板。
Method: 三部分：低复杂度金融模型生成汇总多期收益与风险的固定统计量，先验投影器 (prior projector) 把统计量映射到目标编码器隐空间作锚点；上下文条件化修订预测器估计未来表示相对锚点的可预测位移；两支分别用不同损失更新（锚点学先验统计，修订学历史上下文的额外可预测信息），随后冻结全部表示模块、只训下游 readout。
Result: 理论上证明最优修订把先验锚点对同一未来表示的期望平方误差恰好降低 E[‖Δ‖₂²]，该非负增益等于历史上下文中可预测的额外信号的期望平方幅度；实验中 Stock-JEPA 在大规模中国与美国股票域上以 5 项关键评估指标（横截面排序与组合表现）胜过 13 个强基线，并有消融与表示分析支撑。
Conclusion: 把线性金融先验作为隐空间锚点、只学习其上的增量修订，能在保留经济结构的同时补上非线性信号，且该修订的收益有可证明的误差下降保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Where Does the Audio Jailbreak Live? A Controlled Frequency-Depth Audit of AdvWave-P on Qwen2-Audio
papers.abstract_en: We audit frequency and decoder-depth claims for AdvWave-P, an additive audio jailbreak, on Qwen2-Audio. The protocol masks frequency components of the perturbation in the short-time Fourier transform (STFT) domain and measures attack success and audio-span representations. On 520 AdvBench prompts, the primary judge labels 76.7% of adversarial inputs as jailbreaks. A condition-blind, single-annotator validation yields a Rogan-Gladen sensitivity estimate of 0.87 for this condition (about 0.83-0.95 with validation-rate uncertainty); this correction is not applied to masked conditions. The apparent frequency ranking depends on the partition: energy share alone predicts the standard eight-band ranking (Spearman's rho = 0.95), and equal-Hz and equal-energy partitions show that masking any tested band can sharply reduce attack success. At a finer 16-band equal-energy resolution, however, masking the narrow 7520-7960 Hz band leaves ASR at 0.10, which remains unresolved without a matched control. Matched-energy scattered-removal tests show that contiguous removal is more damaging in lower bands, while both forms approach the floor in upper bands. Global rescaling leaves ASR near baseline but tests amplitude sensitivity rather than frequency location. In a re-optimization pilot (n = 20), tested single- and two-band supports reach ASRs of 0.00, 0.25, and 0.40, while random supports covering about half the STFT bins reach a mean of 0.86. In a prompt- and energy-adjusted model, audio-span divergence is associated with band necessity, with the coefficient rising from +0.63 at the projector output to +0.93 at layer 30 (contrast +0.293, 95% CI [0.11, 0.51]). This association is not a causal localization, and single-layer patching does not establish a causal layer. The results support partition-aware auditing of frequency claims, leaving the fine-resolution top-band result and broader generality open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对音频越狱 AdvWave-P 在 Qwen2-Audio 上做受控频率-深度审计：在 STFT 域掩蔽扰动频带并测攻击成功率 (ASR) 与 audio-span 表征。520 条 AdvBench 提示上主判官标出 76.7% 越狱；频率排序依赖频带划分方式，16 段等能量下掩蔽 7520–7960 Hz 窄带后 ASR 仍为 0.10，作者主张频率类越狱结论必须做 partition-aware 审计。
Motivation: AdvWave-P 等加性音频越狱的频率归因结论可能只是频带划分方式的产物，且 decoder 深度上的表征关联被当作定位证据，需要受控审计区分真实频率位置与划分伪影。
Method: 在 STFT 域按标准八段、等 Hz、等能量及 16 段等能量划分掩蔽扰动，测 ASR 与 audio-span 表征；用 Rogan-Gladen 校正估计判官灵敏度（条件盲、单标注者验证）；另做 matched-energy 散射去除、全局重缩放、n=20 的再优化试点，以及 prompt 与 energy 调整后的回归模型关联 projector 输出到 layer 30。
Result: 520 条 AdvBench 提示上主判官判 76.7% 为越狱，Rogan-Gladen 灵敏度 0.87（约 0.83–0.95）；能量占比预测标准八段排序 Spearman rho = 0.95；16 段等能量下掩蔽 7520–7960 Hz 后 ASR = 0.10；再优化试点 (n=20) 中单/双频带支持 ASR 达 0.00、0.25、0.40，覆盖约一半 STFT bin 的随机支持均值 0.86；audio-span 散度系数从 projector 输出 +0.63 升到 layer 30 的 +0.93（对比 +0.293，95% CI [0.11, 0.51]）。
Conclusion: 频率类越狱声明需按频带划分方式审计；细分辨率顶频带结果与更广普适性仍悬置，audio-span 关联非因果定位，单层 patching 也不构成因果层证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topology-Consistent Task Planning over Cellular Workflow Complexes for LLM-based Agents
papers.abstract_en: Task planning for LLM agents requires workflows that satisfy both user intent and complex sub-task dependencies. While existing planners work well for sequential or directed acyclic graph (DAG)-like structures, they struggle with workflow patterns such as verification-correction loops, convergent branch merging, and reusable intermediate states that arise naturally in real-world tool orchestration. We present TopoPlanner, a topology-consistent planning framework that lifts tool dependency graphs into cellular workflow complexes and uses them as topologyaware context for LLM tool planning. TopoPlanner retrieves a request-relevant closed subcomplex through cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval, performs multidimensional structural reasoning over the retrieved topology, and interfaces the resulting cellular representation with the planner LLM for tool-sequence generation. Experiments on four tool-planning benchmarks with topology-guided loop, merge, and loop-merge workflows show consistent improvements over prompt-based and graph-enhanced baselines across different local LLM backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TopoPlanner 把工具依赖图提升为 cellular workflow complex，用 cosheaf-consistent 检索取回请求相关的闭子复形，再让 planner LLM 在该拓扑表示上生成工具序列，从而支持验证-修正环、汇聚合并与可复用中间态这类非 DAG 工作流。在四个工具规划基准（含 topology-guided loop、merge、loop-merge 工作流）上，相对 prompt 基线与 graph-enhanced 基线在不同本地 LLM backbone 上均有一致提升。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 规划器擅长顺序或 DAG 结构，遇到验证-修正环、分支汇聚合并、可复用中间态等真实工具编排中自然出现的模式时失效。
Method: 将工具依赖图提升为 cellular workflow complex 作为拓扑感知上下文；用 cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval 检索请求相关的闭子复形；在检索到的拓扑上做多维结构推理，再把 cellular 表示交给 planner LLM 生成工具序列。
Result: 在四个工具规划基准上，覆盖 topology-guided loop、merge、loop-merge 三类工作流，相对 prompt-based 与 graph-enhanced 基线在多种本地 LLM backbone 上取得一致改进（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把子任务依赖显式编码成拓扑一致的 cellular 结构，可让 LLM 规划器稳定处理非 DAG 的工具编排模式。

papers.title: Should We Skip Diffusion?
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models learn semantic representations while generating images. In the Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT), a condition encoder provides features that guide a velocity decoder in denoising. To enable effective denoising at all noise levels, these features must capture both high-level abstract structures and low-level details. However, skip/residual connections in the encoder allow shallow features to bypass successive transformations, which may limit progressive abstraction, or at least make it difficult to disentangle different levels of abstraction. We propose DDT-RFE, which removes the residual connections around the Self-Attention and MLP operations in each encoder block while maintaining stable training. To retain the information that abstraction discards but that the decoder still needs, we fuse the input patch embedding with intermediate and final encoder features to form the encoder output. The decoder thus has access to information from multiple encoder depths, while each encoder block is able to learn more abstract representations. DDT-RFE achieves overall improvements over DDT across visual understanding tasks, including image classification, semantic segmentation, object discovery, and semantic correspondence, while using fewer encoder blocks. It also achieves a lower FID for image generation on ImageNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT) 中去掉编码器各 block 内 Self-Attention 与 MLP 周围的残差连接（DDT-RFE），改用输入 patch embedding 与中间、末层特征融合来补回解码器所需信息，使每个 block 能逐级做更抽象的表征。在图像分类、语义分割、object discovery、semantic correspondence 等视觉理解任务上整体优于 DDT 且用更少 encoder block，ImageNet 生成 FID 更低。
Motivation: DDT 的条件编码器靠 skip/residual 连接让浅层特征绕过逐层变换，可能限制渐进抽象、或难以解耦不同抽象层级，而 velocity decoder 在各噪声水平下既需要高层结构也需要低层细节。
Method: 提出 DDT-RFE：移除编码器每个 block 中 Self-Attention 与 MLP 周围的残差连接并保持训练稳定；将输入 patch embedding 与中间层、最终层编码器特征融合形成编码器输出，使解码器同时获得多深度信息。
Result: 在图像分类、语义分割、object discovery、semantic correspondence 等视觉理解任务上相对 DDT 取得整体提升，且使用更少的 encoder block；在 ImageNet 图像生成上取得更低的 FID。
Conclusion: 去掉编码器残差连接并以多深度特征融合补偿，可以在减少 encoder block 数量的同时提升 DDT 的视觉理解与生成表现。

papers.title: Mask-Guided KV Cache Eviction in Block Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Block diffusion language models keep a large key-value (KV) cache throughout generation and attend to it at every denoising step, limiting both memory capacity and generation speed. Reducing these costs requires deciding which past tokens to use for denoising the current block (selection) and which to keep in memory for future blocks (eviction). We propose MaskAhead, a training-free method that solves both tasks with a single mask-query-based ranking mechanism. Current-block masks guide selection, while probes of upcoming masked blocks guide eviction. Both rank KV entries by their estimated contribution to the attention output. Our quantized variant, Q-MaskAhead, computes selection and attention directly from low-bit KV, largely preserving the selected entries. Experiments on Fast-dLLM-v2, DreamReasoner, and LLaDA2.0-mini cover long-generation reasoning, long-prompt question answering, and needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. On long-prompt QA, MaskAhead reduces KV memory by $9.5\times$ on average with a 1.2-point mean F1 loss relative to dense inference. Q-MaskAhead increases the reduction to $20.1\times$ with a 2.3-point mean F1 loss. In a batch-32 systems profile, MaskAhead achieves $1.23\times$ end-to-end and $1.68\times$ decode-stage speedups over dense inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MaskAhead 用单一 mask-query 排序机制同时解决块扩散语言模型的 KV 选择与驱逐：当前块 mask 指导选择、未来 masked 块的探针指导驱逐，按对注意力输出的估计贡献排序，训练无关。长 prompt QA 上平均省 9.5 倍 KV 内存、相对 dense 推理 F1 平均只掉 1.2 点；量化版 Q-MaskAhead 把压缩提到 20.1 倍、F1 掉 2.3 点，batch-32 下端到端加速 1.23 倍、解码阶段 1.68 倍。
Motivation: 块扩散语言模型在整个生成期间保留大 KV cache 并在每个去噪步全量注意力，内存与生成速度同时受限；需要区分哪些历史 token 用于当前块去噪（selection）、哪些留在内存供后续块使用（eviction）。
Method: MaskAhead 是训练无关方法，用一个 mask-query 排序机制同时做 selection 与 eviction：当前块 mask 引导选择，对未来 masked 块的探针引导驱逐，二者都按 KV 条目对注意力输出的估计贡献排序。量化变体 Q-MaskAhead 直接从低位宽 KV 计算选择与注意力，基本保留被选中的条目。
Result: 在 Fast-dLLM-v2、DreamReasoner、LLaDA2.0-mini 上覆盖长生成推理、长 prompt 问答与 needle-in-a-haystack 检索。长 prompt QA 上 MaskAhead 平均减少 9.5 倍 KV 内存，相对 dense 推理 F1 平均损失 1.2 点；Q-MaskAhead 把压缩提高到 20.1 倍，F1 平均损失 2.3 点。batch-32 系统测试中 MaskAhead 相对 dense 推理取得 1.23 倍端到端加速与 1.68 倍解码阶段加速。
Conclusion: 用对注意力输出贡献的 mask-query 排序可以一次性替代 selection 与 eviction 两个决策，在几乎不损 F1 的前提下大幅压缩 KV 内存并提速，量化后压缩率还能继续放大。

papers.title: Joint upper-bound coverage and route-choice utility: an empirical evaluation on two urban proxy tasks
papers.abstract_en: Whether more accurate traffic forecasts or higher uncertainty coverage improve route decisions is unclear. We evaluate this question with a frozen protocol that separates speed error, joint candidate path upper bound coverage, route selection, and realized loss. Using processed road speed data from Beijing and Chengdu, we construct offline proxy tasks with 150 origin destination pairs, three candidate paths, and 14 test days per city. We compare raw 90th percentile path time bounds with jointly calibrated upper bounds under minimum bound route choice. Joint coverage rises from 83.19% to 92.26% in Beijing M1, from 75.14% to 88.33% in Chengdu M1, and from 74.01% to 90.64% in Chengdu M2. Yet C2 increases lateness by 0.1633, 0.7848, and 0.9200 percentage points, respectively, and mean travel time by 0.588, 3.082, and 4.418 seconds. In a separate Chengdu predictor comparison, a 14.91% reduction in speed mean absolute error accompanies a 1.4571 percentage point reduction in lateness under C0. Joint coverage is therefore not a surrogate for downstream route utility in these frozen tasks the offline results do not establish online or causal benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在交通路径选择的冻结离线协议下，把 90 分位路径时间上界换成联合校准上界后，联合覆盖率在北京 M1 从 83.19% 升到 92.26%、成都 M1 从 75.14% 到 88.33%、成都 M2 从 74.01% 到 90.64%，但最小上界选路的迟到率反而上升 0.1633、0.7848、0.9200 个百分点，平均出行时间增加 0.588、3.082、4.418 秒。结论是联合覆盖率不能替代下游路径效用。
Motivation: 更准的交通预报或更高的不确定性覆盖率是否真的改善路径决策并不清楚；需要把速度误差、联合候选路径上界覆盖、路径选择与实际损失分开评估。
Method: 用北京与成都的已处理道路速度数据构建离线代理任务：150 个 OD 对、3 条候选路径、每城 14 个测试日；冻结协议依次度量速度误差、联合候选路径上界覆盖、最小上界选路与实际损失，对比原始 90 分位路径时间上界与联合校准上界（C2），另设成都预测器对比（C0）。
Result: 联合覆盖：北京 M1 83.19%→92.26%，成都 M1 75.14%→88.33%，成都 M2 74.01%→90.64%；C2 使迟到率分别上升 0.1633、0.7848、0.9200 个百分点，平均出行时间增加 0.588、3.082、4.418 秒。成都预测器对比中速度 MAE 降低 14.91% 伴随 C0 下迟到率下降 1.4571 个百分点。
Conclusion: 在这些冻结任务中联合覆盖率不是下游路径效用的替代指标，离线结果也不构成在线或因果收益的证据。

papers.title: TARE: Weigh a Never-Poisoned Twin Before Reading Backdoor-Defense Costs
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor-defense leaderboards print a clean-accuracy drop and read it as removal cost. Measured on the poisoned victim alone, the drop cannot separate removal from what the defense does to any model, and inherits the victim's start, which for three of BackdoorBench's sixteen attacks is a configuration file: WaNet, BPP and Input-Aware ship a MultiStepLR that never fires, so their victims never anneal and are the least accurate in 30/31 public CIFAR cells at $\leq$5%. On PreAct-ResNet18, fine-tuning-family defenses return a low start to their own level, so there the published cost is negative, the benchmark's rating clips the "gain" to zero, and 2 of 48 citing defense papers we read rest a no-cost claim on those cells; TSBD and CGD, re-run with their code, "gain" on a never-poisoned model too. A $2\times2$ editing only that scheduler line isolates the cause, its swapped arms self-registered before they ran: the sign of the fine-tuning family's clean-model cost reverses both ways while its published gain on the annealed victim only shrinks toward zero, 44/44 seeds following the schedule, replicated on BPP, FT-SAM, CIFAR-100 and VGG19-BN and induced in a second toolkit. TARE runs the same defense on a never-poisoned twin of the same recipe, schedule and seed (on BackdoorBench, $\leq$10 poisoned images, admitted only below 5% attack success); what the twin loses is the tare. On the BadNets grid seven of eight defenses charge the twin (Neural Cleanse only where its detector fires), +0.13 (fine-tuning) to +5.70 points (I-BAU); the eighth, ABL, destroys it. Within an attack the start cancels from rankings, so the tare re-orders nothing there; what poisoning adds beyond it is printed under two estimators and not corrected, its removal share unidentified. We ship the three-key patch, a signed tare column (7 attacks $\times$ 8 defenses) and TARE-Z, a twin-free estimator for seed-stable defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TARE 指出后门防御榜单把「干净精度下降」直接读成移除成本是错的：该下降混入了防御对任何模型都会造成的影响，且继承受害模型的起点。做法是给同一配方、调度和随机种子跑一个从未投毒的孪生模型，孪生的损失即皮重 (tare)；在 BadNets 网格上八个防御中七个对孪生收费，从微调族的 +0.13 分到 I-BAU 的 +5.70 分，第八个 ABL 直接摧毁孪生。
Motivation: BackdoorBench 的干净精度下降只在被投毒的受害模型上测，无法把「移除」与「防御对任何模型的普遍影响」分开，还继承受害模型的起点；WaNet、BPP、Input-Aware 三个攻击的受害者因配置文件里永不触发的 MultiStepLR 而从不退火，是 30/31 个公开 CIFAR 单元中精度最低的。
Method: 对同一配方、调度、种子的从未投毒孪生模型跑同一防御，取孪生损失作为皮重；用只改一行调度器的 2×2 编辑隔离因果（两臂在运行前自注册），44/44 个种子按调度跟随，并在 BPP、FT-SAM、CIFAR-100、VGG19-BN 与第二个工具包中复现；同时发布三键补丁、带签名的 tare 列（7 攻击 × 8 防御）与面向种子稳定防御的免孪生估计器 TARE-Z。
Result: BadNets 网格上八个防御中七个对孪生收费，+0.13（微调族）到 +5.70 分（I-BAU），第八个 ABL 摧毁孪生；Neural Cleanse 仅在其检测器触发时收费。2×2 编辑中微调族干净模型成本的符号双向反转，而已发表的退火受害模型上的增益只向零收缩；44/44 种子遵循调度。2 of 48 篇引用防御的论文把零成本主张建立在这些单元上；TARE 在 BackdoorBench 上要求 ≤10 张投毒图像且仅在攻击成功率 <5% 时纳入。
Conclusion: 防御的干净精度下降应拆成对任何模型都有的普遍成本与投毒额外带来的部分；在单个攻击内部起点会从排名中抵消，因此 tare 不改变攻击内排序，而投毒超出皮重的部分以两种估计器并列打印且未被校正，其移除份额不可识别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DART-ES: Difficulty-Aware Reweighting and Targeted Replay for Fine-Tuning LLMs with Evolution Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Evolution Strategies (ES) enable memory efficient full parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) using only forward computation. However, standard ES uniformly averages rewards across problems and compresses problem level population feedback into a single scalar, making it difficult to capture how the learning value of each problem changes with model capability. To address this limitation, we propose Difficulty-Aware Reweighting and Targeted Replay for Evolution Strategies (DART-ES). DART-ES estimates the local solvability of each problem from its pass rate across the perturbation population and aggregates historical observations to construct a dynamic difficulty state. This shared state jointly guides continuous difficulty reweighting and rare solvable sample replay, thereby improving perturbation direction evaluation and training data allocation without introducing an additional difficulty model or backpropagation. Extensive experiments show that DART-ES achieves good fine-tuning performance. DART-ES outperforms ES on all five base models and improves the average accuracy from 72.07\% to 73.53\%, exceeding the 73.26\% achieved by GRPO on GSM8K. Across five challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, DART-ES achieves an average accuracy of 49.20\%, compared with 48.34\% for ES and remains competitive with strong 7B models trained with RL. Further experiments show consistent gains in instruction tuning, code generation and the Countdown task with a 14B model, demonstrating strong generalization across tasks and scalability to larger models. Beyond performance gains, DART-ES also shows clear advantages in system efficiency. It reduces runtime per step by 15.2\%--50.2\% and peak memory usage per GPU by 21.1\%--51.1\% compared with GRPO. Despite performing full parameter fine-tuning, DART-ES also requires less runtime and GPU memory than GRPO+LoRA.

papers.title: When better traffic forecasts fail to improve signal control: a layered diagnostic study of forecast-to-decision value
papers.abstract_en: Improved traffic forecasts do not necessarily yield better signal-control decisions. We investigate this gap through a layered diagnostic study using 29 days of reconstructed demand from Xuancheng, China, with seven dates reserved for testing. The framework evaluates point forecasts, conformal intervals, dependence-aware scenarios, and matched closed-loop controllers. Entry-level and movement-level forecasts reduce mean absolute error by 4.03% and 3.92%, respectively, relative to historical means. A nominal 90% conformal interval achieves 90.72% marginal coverage but only 75.66% on an ex-post high-demand subset. Interface audits identify decision-time leakage and reveal that only two of nine controlled intersections offer multiple effective actions. We correct the temporal interface and compare causal forecasts with a five-second event oracle using exhaustive joint-action search. A synthetic positive control demonstrates that future information can reduce the internal rollout cost by 61.5%. On the frozen test dates, however, causal forecasts and the event oracle increase queue vehicle?seconds by 6.09% and 3.39% relative to the matched no-future rollout, while the oracle reduces spillback exposure by 3.78%; paired-day bootstrap intervals cross zero. These findings indicate that forecast value depends on temporal observability, action identifiability, dynamics consistency, and objective alignment. The proposed protocol provides a practical way to diagnose where predictive improvements fail to translate into operational benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 交通信号控制场景下，预测精度提升并不转化为控制收益：宣城 29 天重构需求（7 天留作测试）上，入口级与转向级预测相对历史均值仅把 MAE 降低 4.03% 和 3.92%；修正时间接口后，因果预测与五秒事件 oracle 相对 matched no-future rollout 反而使排队车辆·秒上升 6.09% 和 3.39%。作者据此判定预测价值取决于时间可观测性、动作可辨识性、动力学一致性与目标对齐四个条件。
Motivation: 预测指标改善常被默认等于决策改善，但在信号控制里这一链条可能断裂，且缺少可定位断点在哪一层的诊断手段。
Method: 分层诊断框架：用宣城 29 天重构需求（7 天测试）评估点预测、conformal 区间、依赖感知场景与 matched 闭环控制器；做接口审计排查决策时泄漏；修正时间接口后用穷举联合动作搜索比较因果预测与五秒事件 oracle，并加入合成正对照（future information）验证管线能产生收益。
Result: 入口级/转向级预测 MAE 相对历史均值降低 4.03%/3.92%；名义 90% conformal 区间边际覆盖 90.72%，但在事后高需求子集上仅 75.66%；九个受控路口中仅两个存在多个有效动作；合成正对照使内部 rollout 成本降低 61.5%；冻结测试日上因果预测与事件 oracle 使排队车辆·秒相对 matched no-future rollout 分别上升 6.09% 与 3.39%，oracle 使溢出暴露下降 3.78%，配对日 bootstrap 区间跨零。
Conclusion: 预测改进要转化为运营收益，须同时满足时间可观测、动作可辨识、动力学一致与目标对齐；该协议可用于定位预测增益在哪一层失效。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: State-Aware Interaction MIL for Rare Joint Molecular Phenotype Prediction in Colorectal Cancer and Lung Adenocarcinoma
papers.abstract_en: Joint molecular phenotype prediction is complicated by small joint-positive populations and overlapping histological features across alternative molecular states. Existing computational pathology approaches typically predict biomarkers independently or formulate the joint-positive phenotype as a binary endpoint. Independent prediction does not model interactions between biomarker-specific histological representations, whereas binary joint prediction collapses the double-negative and two single-positive configurations into a single negative class. We propose State-Aware Interaction MIL, a weakly supervised method that preserves biomarker-specific histological representations, models their interaction, and supervises the complete four-state molecular configuration. We evaluate the proposed approach for joint BRAF+/MSI+ prediction in colorectal cancer and EGFR+/TP53+ prediction in lung adenocarcinoma using frozen UNI2-h and CONCH pathology foundation-model representations. With UNI2-h, State-Aware Interaction MIL achieved an average precision of 0.5566 in colorectal cancer (joint-positive prevalence 6.8%) compared with 0.5161 for NaiveMTL, and 0.2784 in lung adenocarcinoma (joint-positive prevalence 8.6%) compared with 0.2525 for IndependentPair. With CONCH, State-Aware achieved an average precision of 0.4410 compared with 0.3932 for DirectJoint in colorectal cancer and 0.1659 compared with 0.1226 for DirectJoint in lung adenocarcinoma. These results indicate that pathology foundation-model representations contain predictive information for rare joint molecular phenotypes and that preserving biomarker-specific representations within a structured molecular-state formulation can improve prediction of these phenotypes from histopathology.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI at Scale for Clinical Impact (ASCI): Cancer Pathology Foundation Models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 State-Aware Interaction MIL：保留各生物标志物专属的组织学表征、建模其交互，并对完整四态分子构型（双阴性与两个单阳性分开）做弱监督，用于稀有联合分子表型预测。在 UNI2-h 表征下，结直肠癌 BRAF+/MSI+ 平均精度 0.5566（联合阳性率 6.8%），高于 NaiveMTL 的 0.5161；肺腺癌 EGFR+/TP53+ 为 0.2784（率 8.6%），高于 IndependentPair 的 0.2525。
Motivation: 联合阳性样本极稀少且不同分子状态组织形态重叠：现有方法要么各标志物独立预测（不建模交互），要么把联合阳性压成二分类（把双阴性和两个单阳性并成同一负类）。
Method: 弱监督 MIL 框架，保留生物标志物专属组织学表征并显式建模交互，监督完整四态分子构型；用冻结的病理基础模型 UNI2-h 与 CONCH 提取表征，任务为结直肠癌 BRAF+/MSI+ 与肺腺癌 EGFR+/TP53+ 联合预测。
Result: UNI2-h 下：结直肠癌 AP 0.5566（联合阳性率 6.8%）vs NaiveMTL 0.5161；肺腺癌 AP 0.2784（率 8.6%）vs IndependentPair 0.2525。CONCH 下：结直肠癌 AP 0.4410 vs DirectJoint 0.3932；肺腺癌 AP 0.1659 vs DirectJoint 0.1226。
Conclusion: 病理基础模型表征本身含稀有联合分子表型的预测信息，而保留标志物专属表征并置于结构化分子状态框架中可提升从组织学预测这类表型的效果。

papers.title: Repair Lot Skyline: A Weighted Constraint Satisfaction Approach to Pavement Repair Optimization from Geospatial Hazard Density
papers.abstract_en: Pavement agencies must translate a spatially distributed distress inventory into a bounded, actionable repair-lot plan: accident-critical defects (potholes) must always be addressed, lower-risk defects (cracks) should be included only when their benefit justifies the repair cost, and historical patch locations signal re-degradation risk without themselves triggering repair. We formalize this as a Repair Lot Skyline problem: a Weighted Constraint Satisfaction Problem (WCSP) defined over chainage (distance along the road) rather than over time, so that it requires only a single-epoch distress survey and makes no claim about future deterioration. The WCSP identifies 143 candidate hazard clusters (61 hard, 82 soft), of which 106 are merged into a final repair plan totaling 1,997.4 m---83.7% of the 2,385.9 m that would be required if every soft candidate were included regardless of cost. This plan covers 100% of observed potholes (138/138) and 91.6% of observed cracks (404/441), capturing 93.6% (542/579) of the total hazard benefit available in the full candidate set. The skyline frontier shows pronounced diminishing returns beyond this point: the remaining 37 excluded soft candidates would add only 6.8% additional benefit for a 19.4% increase in repair length. We further formalize the minimum-lot-length $L_{\min}$ and historical-context radius $κ$ as a joint, four-objective hyperparameter search over this WCSP; on the same case study, the recommended configuration ($L_{\min} = 14.7$ m, $κ= 10$ m) reduces repair-crew mobilizations by 7.1% relative to an untuned default, at the cost of a 12.9% larger budget and a 1.1-percentage-point lower crack coverage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把路面病害修复规划形式化为定义在 chainage（沿路里程）而非时间轴上的加权约束满足问题 (WCSP)——Repair Lot Skyline，只用单期巡检数据、不对未来劣化做预测。求解得到 106 个候选簇合并成 1,997.4 m 修复计划，覆盖 100% 坑洞 (138/138) 与 91.6% 裂缝 (404/441)，占全候选集 93.6% 的危害收益；推荐超参配置 L_min=14.7 m、κ=10 m 使班组出动次数比未调默认值降 7.1%，代价是预算增 12.9%、裂缝覆盖率降 1.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 路面管理机构要把空间分布的病害清单变成预算受限的可执行修复批次：坑洞必须全修，裂缝仅在收益抵得过成本时纳入，历史补丁位置只提示再劣化风险而不直接触发修复；现有做法缺少在 chainage 维度上做权衡的形式化。
Method: 提出 Repair Lot Skyline：一个定义在 chainage 上的 WCSP，硬约束保证事故关键坑洞必修，软约束按收益-成本权衡裂缝，并把历史补丁位置作为上下文而非触发条件；在此 WCSP 上对最小批次长度 L_min 与历史上下文半径 κ 做四目标联合超参搜索。
Result: WCSP 识别 143 个候选危害簇（61 hard、82 soft），其中 106 个合并为 1,997.4 m 的最终计划，相当于全纳入软候选所需 2,385.9 m 的 83.7%；覆盖 100% 观测坑洞 (138/138)、91.6% 观测裂缝 (404/441)，捕获全候选集 93.6% (542/579) 的总危害收益。skyline 显示此后收益急剧递减：剩余 37 个被排除软候选只增加 6.8% 收益却要多 19.4% 修复长度。推荐配置 L_min=14.7 m、κ=10 m 相对未调默认值减少 7.1% 修复班组出动，代价是预算大 12.9%、裂缝覆盖率低 1.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 在单期病害数据上，用 WCSP 求 skyline 可以在少 16.3% 修复长度内保住几乎全部危害收益，且收益在该点之后明显递减；L_min 与 κ 的取值直接决定出动次数、预算与裂缝覆盖率之间的取舍。

papers.title: An Information-Theoretic Evaluation Framework for Benchmark and Model Diagnosis in Knowledge Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge tracing (KT) models are predominantly evaluated using aggregate metrics such as area under the curve (AUC) and accuracy. However, these global scores obscure where the remaining errors originate and fail to indicate whether a benchmark is approaching saturation. While estimating a global theoretical performance limit is challenging in realistic KT settings, it is possible to quantify local predictability. To address this, we propose an information-theoretic evaluation framework for KT benchmark diagnosis. We use Context Tree Weighting (CTW) on item-response histories and current-item queries as an operational causal uncertainty coordinate, while distinguishing it from the unobserved Local Irreducible Uncertainty (LIU) under the full KT information set. By projecting predictions onto this shared uncertainty coordinate, we evaluate model performance gains across distinct entropy bands rather than only at the global level. Comprehensive evaluations on NIPS Task 3/4 and Algebra 2005 reveal that model improvements are highly non-uniform. Modern KT models show substantial gains in high-entropy regions, and additional item-aware references, log-loss, and equal-frequency analyses support this localization. The framework also flags regions where apparent gains require checks for noise-sensitive behavior. By surfacing these local modeling failures alongside genuine gains, this approach provides a diagnostic tool for studying both residual predictive structure and the limitations of current KT benchmarks and models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对知识追踪 (KT) 评测只看 AUC、accuracy 这类全局分数、看不出误差来源与基准是否饱和的问题，提出信息论诊断框架：用 Context Tree Weighting (CTW) 在作答历史与当前题目查询上构造可操作的因果不确定性坐标，并与完整信息集下不可观测的 Local Irreducible Uncertainty (LIU) 区分，把模型预测投影到该坐标上按熵带分层评估。在 NIPS Task 3/4 与 Algebra 2005 上，现代 KT 模型的提升高度非均匀，主要集中在高熵区。
Motivation: KT 模型普遍只用 AUC、accuracy 等聚合指标评测，这些全局分数掩盖了剩余误差的来源，也无法指示基准是否接近饱和；而在真实 KT 设定下估计全局理论性能上限很困难。
Method: 以 CTW 对题目作答历史与当前题目查询建模，作为可操作的因果不确定性坐标，同时与完整 KT 信息集下未观测的 LIU 区分开；把各模型预测投影到这一共享坐标上，按不同熵带而非全局评估性能增益，并辅以 item-aware 参照、log-loss 与等频 (equal-frequency) 分析做交叉验证。
Result: 在 NIPS Task 3/4 与 Algebra 2005 上的综合评测显示模型提升高度非均匀：现代 KT 模型在高熵区有显著增益，item-aware 参照、log-loss 与等频分析支持这一局部化结论；框架同时标出那些需要检查噪声敏感行为的表观增益区域。
Conclusion: KT 的真实进步集中在高不确定性题目上，全局指标会掩盖这种非均匀性；该框架可同时诊断残余预测结构与当前 KT 基准、模型的局限，并提示部分表观增益需核查噪声敏感性。

papers.title: EPOCH: Reliable Discovery through Evidence-Governed Search
papers.abstract_en: AI research agents are increasingly used to search over programs, mathematical constructions, and proofs. However, existing systems typically optimize evaluator feedback without adequately governing how that feedback is interpreted, challenged, and reused. As a result, promising but fragile candidates can be promoted as discoveries, while benchmark improvements, finite certificates, and theorem-level claims are too easily conflated. We introduce EPOCH, an evidence-governed architecture designed to close this gap. EPOCH implements an evidence-governed discovery loop by combining explicit task contracts, typed memory, active falsification, admission checks, and independent replay, so that each candidate is evaluated against the strength and scope of the claim it supports. EPOCH achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance on AlgoTune, substantially exceeding the strongest baseline in mean normalized score (0.65 vs. 0.53), and attains the highest mean score on the internal Math14 suite (0.57). It further shows favorable held-out behavior under official-test replay and leads the descriptive aggregate on AgentHPO. Across ten discovery problems, EPOCH delivers substantial task-specific advances, including improved executable constructions, optimized algorithms, counterexamples, and proof-supported results. These advances demonstrate its ability to convert search into concrete progress across mathematical and computational domains. Together, the results suggest that evidence governance is a necessary step toward AI research agents that produce not only stronger solutions, but also more trustworthy scientific discoveries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EPOCH 用证据治理架构约束 AI 研究智能体如何解释、质疑和复用评估反馈，使候选解按其支撑主张的强度与范围被判定。在 AlgoTune 上平均归一化分数 0.65 对最强基线 0.53，内部 Math14 套件均分 0.57，并在十个发现问题上给出可执行构造、优化算法、反例与证明支撑结果。
Motivation: 现有 AI 研究智能体只优化评估器反馈，却不治理反馈如何被解释与复用，导致脆弱候选被当作发现、基准提升与定理级主张被混为一谈。
Method: EPOCH 组合显式任务契约 (task contracts)、类型化记忆 (typed memory)、主动证伪 (active falsification)、准入检查 (admission checks) 与独立重放 (independent replay)，构成证据治理发现循环，让每个候选按其支撑主张的强度与范围被评估。
Result: AlgoTune 上取得 SOTA 聚合表现，平均归一化分数 0.65 对最强基线 0.53；内部 Math14 套件均分 0.57 为最高；官方测试重放下 held-out 行为有利，并在 AgentHPO 上领先描述性聚合；十个发现问题上给出可执行构造、优化算法、反例与证明支撑结果。
Conclusion: 证据治理是让 AI 研究智能体既给出更强解、又产出更可信科学发现的必要环节，能把搜索转化为数学与计算领域的真实进展。

papers.title: CrystalJev: thinking fast and slow with atomistic foundation models for materials discovery
papers.abstract_en: Atomistic foundation models triage millions of hypothetical materials but are used as slow simulators, their thresholded energies taken at face value. They are better read as fast decision-makers. CrystalJev queries a frozen interatomic potential once per unrelaxed structure and answers typed questions with calibrated probabilities, finite-sample guarantees and a rule for when to think slowly. Across 65 Matbench Discovery models, a 'stable' call is a probability in disguise, explained by a model's errors and the candidate population. Once trained, one forward pass decides nearly as well as a relaxation at a thirtieth of its cost, and a value-of-information theory sends slower computation only where decisions can change. The same layer answers electronic, mechanical and molecular questions. In a registered prospective test with 700 new density-functional calculations, single-pass forecasts calibrated only on existing data over-stated the stable fraction of unseen candidates (5.8%) by at most 2.1 percentage points.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 6 main figures, 5 Extended Data figures, 1 Extended Data table; Supplementary Information included
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CrystalJev 把原子级基础模型从慢速模拟器改成快速决策器：对每个未弛豫结构只查询一次冻结的原子间势，输出带校准概率的分类型问题答案，并用 value-of-information 理论决定何时才值得做慢速弛豫。在注册的前瞻测试（700 个新 DFT 计算）中，仅用既有数据校准的单次前向预测把未见候选的 stable 比例（5.8%）高估了至多 2.1 个百分点。
Motivation: 原子级基础模型被当作慢速模拟器逐个弛豫数百万假想材料，阈值化能量被直接采信；但分类决策本身是概率性的，误差与候选群体共同决定一个 'stable' 判定的可信度，逐结构弛豫成本高。
Method: 对每个未弛豫结构只查询一次冻结的 interatomic potential，用一个共享层回答带类型的问题（stable 判定以及电子、力学、分子性质），输出经校准的概率与有限样本保证；再由 value-of-information 理论把慢速计算只导向决策会翻转的样本。在 65 个 Matbench Discovery 模型上分析 'stable' 判定如何由模型误差与候选群体解释。
Result: 训练后单次前向的决策质量接近弛豫，成本约为其三十分之一；注册前瞻测试含 700 个新密度泛函计算，仅用既有数据校准的单次预测把未见候选 stable 比例（5.8%）高估至多 2.1 个百分点；同一层可同时回答电子、力学与分子问题。
Conclusion: 把基础模型当快速决策器并配校准概率与按需慢算规则，可在远低于弛豫的成本下做出接近的材料稳定性判断，且校准误差有明确上界。
