papers.title: A Data-Driven Framework for Unsupervised Monitoring of Transmission Systems Using End-of-Line Testing Data: A Case Study at Ford Motor Company
papers.abstract_en: Sensing technologies have advanced rapidly across industries ranging from energy to automotive manufacturing. These systems generate high-dimensional (HD) data characterized by complex nonlinear patterns and strong temporal dependencies. Traditional statistical monitoring methods are often limited in their ability to capture such nonlinear structure. Likewise, many analytical approaches used in End-of-Line testing rely on predefined thresholds and heuristic rules, which restrict their ability to detect informative anomaly signatures in HD temporal data. In contrast, while modern deep learning and generative AI models offer strong predictive capabilities, they are often unsuitable in applications where data are costly to collect and where the monitoring system must remain interpretable, low-latency, computationally efficient, and usable by non-technical practitioners. To overcome these limitations, we propose an advanced multivariate monitoring framework for HD data. The framework operates in two stages. In the first stage, the data are preprocessed to remove incomplete and non-informative samples and to temporally align time series data. In the second stage, nonlinear dimensionality reduction is performed, followed by anomaly detection through a control chart based phase I monitoring procedure. The framework can be used in both unsupervised and supervised settings, depending on the availability of ground truth labels during training. Moreover, its flexible and modular structure allows practitioners to adapt its components to different domains and operational requirements. We evaluate the proposed framework on real production data from an automotive manufacturing environment at Ford Motor Company. The proposed method achieves higher accuracy, recall, and F1 score than the company's existing model, improving these metrics from 0.50, 0.30, and 0.429 to 0.625, 1.00, and 0.769, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出面向高维时序产线终检 (End-of-Line testing) 数据的两阶段无监督监控框架：先清洗并对齐时间序列，再做非线性降维并接 control chart 式 Phase I 异常检测。在 Ford Motor Company 真实生产数据上，accuracy、recall、F1 从公司现有模型的 0.50、0.30、0.429 提升到 0.625、1.00、0.769。
Motivation: 传统统计监控难以捕捉高维数据的非线性与时序依赖，终检环节又依赖预设阈值和启发式规则，漏掉有信息量的异常；深度模型在数据昂贵、要求低延迟可解释的场景不适用。
Method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段剔除不完整与无信息样本并对齐时间序列；第二阶段做非线性降维，再用基于 control chart 的 Phase I 监控程序做异常检测。框架可按训练期有无 ground truth 标签在无监督与有监督之间切换，组件模块化可替换。
Result: 在 Ford Motor Company 汽车制造真实生产数据上，accuracy 从 0.50 提到 0.625，recall 从 0.30 提到 1.00，F1 从 0.429 提到 0.769，均高于公司现有模型。
Conclusion: 非线性降维加 control chart 的两阶段监控在数据稀缺、要求可解释低延迟的产线终检场景中，比公司现有模型检出更多异常且精度更高。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchy-GBP: Accelerating Factor Graph Inference via Abstraction and Recovery
papers.abstract_en: Gaussian Belief Propagation (GBP) is a distributed inference algorithm that passes messages in graphical models, making it attractive for scalable spatial intelligence. However, we find GBP most effective locally: it rapidly smooths message errors that vary sharply between neighbor variables, but corrects global errors across distant graph regions incrementally through long-range message propagations. We propose Hierarchy-GBP (H-GBP), an iterative, two-stage framework that accelerates GBP by first solving these global errors with a coarse graph approximation (abstraction) and projecting the results back to the original graph (recovery), then refining the remaining local errors with GBP. We prove H-GBP convergence to the optimum by deriving the combined matrix operator of our abstraction and recovery steps and analyzing its spectral radius. Experiments on linear sparse graphs show that H-GBP converges fundamentally faster than standard GBP. Moreover, we validate H-GBP on two important spatial problems: Pose Graph Optimization (PGO) and Bundle Adjustment (BA). H-GBP markedly accelerates large-scale PGO and achieves state-of-the-art runtime across all tested BA scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: H-GBP 把 GBP 的两阶段加速框架化：先用粗图近似 (abstraction) 求解跨远距离区域的全局误差并投影回原图 (recovery)，再用 GBP 精修剩余局部误差。通过推导抽象与恢复步骤的合并矩阵算子并分析其谱半径，证明收敛到最优解；线性稀疏图实验显示其收敛速度本质上快于标准 GBP，并在大规模 Pose Graph Optimization 上显著加速、在所有测试 BA 规模上取得最先进 runtime。
Motivation: GBP 擅长快速消去邻近变量间剧烈变化的消息误差，但对跨越远距离图区域的全局误差只能靠长程消息传播逐次修正，导致大规模图推理慢。
Method: 两阶段迭代框架 H-GBP：先以粗图近似求解全局误差并投影回原图（abstraction + recovery），再用标准 GBP 精修局部误差；通过推导抽象与恢复的合并矩阵算子并分析其谱半径来证明收敛到最优解。
Result: 线性稀疏图实验中 H-GBP 收敛速度快于标准 GBP；在 Pose Graph Optimization (PGO) 上显著加速大规模问题，并在所有测试规模的 Bundle Adjustment (BA) 上取得 state-of-the-art runtime。
Conclusion: 把全局误差交给粗图层级处理、局部误差留给 GBP，可以在保持收敛到最优解的同时大幅加速图推理，尤其适用于大规模空间推理问题。
Relevance: 1

summary_sections.method: 两阶段迭代框架 H-GBP：先以粗图近似求解全局误差并投影回原图（abstraction + recovery），再用标准 GBP 精修局部误差；通过推导抽象与恢复的合并矩阵算子并分析其谱半径来证明收敛到最优解。
summary_sections.result: 线性稀疏图实验中 H-GBP 收敛速度快于标准 GBP；在 Pose Graph Optimization (PGO) 上显著加速大规模问题，并在所有测试规模的 Bundle Adjustment (BA) 上取得 state-of-the-art runtime。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把全局误差交给粗图层级处理、局部误差留给 GBP，可以在保持收敛到最优解的同时大幅加速图推理，尤其适用于大规模空间推理问题。

papers.title: Visual-Invariance-Augmented Feature Optimal Alignment for Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Closed-Source MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remain vulnerable to transferable adversarial examples, especially in black-box settings where only open-source surrogate models are accessible. Existing targeted transfer attacks mainly align adversarial and target samples using global image-level features, such as encoder [CLS] embeddings. However, such coarse alignment insufficiently exploits patch-level visual structures, limiting transferability across heterogeneous closed-source MLLMs. We propose IAU-FOA, a visual-invariance-augmented feature optimal alignment attack with adaptive unbalanced transport, to improve targeted transferability against closed-source MLLMs. IAU-FOA aligns adversarial and target samples at both global and local levels: a cosine-based objective narrows their global semantic gap, while patch tokens are clustered into compact local patterns and matched through optimal transport for fine-grained feature alignment. Balanced optimal transport enforces fixed marginal masses even for local clusters without reliable counterparts, potentially introducing misleading alignment gradients. We therefore introduce confidence-adaptive unbalanced transport to relax these constraints for weakly matched clusters, aiming to reduce unreliable local alignment and improve adversarial transferability. We further study the effect of input transformations and propose visual-invariance augmentation, which applies bidirectional pixel-intensity rescaling and per-channel white-balance adjustment to simulate exposure, contrast, illumination, and color-temperature variations. This strategy encourages adversarial perturbations to generalize across different visual encoders. Extensive experiments on open-source and closed-source MLLMs show that IAU-FOA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art transferable attack methods. Code is available at https://github.com/jiaxiaojunQAQ/IAU-FOA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IAU-FOA 针对闭源 MLLM 的定向可迁移对抗攻击，用余弦全局对齐加 patch token 聚类的最优传输做细粒度匹配，并以置信度自适应的非平衡传输放松弱匹配簇的边际质量约束，再配合双向像素强度缩放与逐通道白平衡的视觉不变性增强。在开源与闭源 MLLM 上的实验中，IAU-FOA 一致优于现有最优可迁移攻击方法。
Motivation: 现有定向迁移攻击只用 [CLS] 等图像级全局特征对齐对抗样本与目标样本，粗粒度对齐无法利用 patch 级视觉结构，在异构闭源 MLLM 之间迁移性受限。
Method: IAU-FOA 分三层：余弦目标缩小全局语义差；patch token 聚成紧凑局部模式后用 optimal transport 匹配做细粒度对齐；针对平衡 OT 对无可靠对应簇仍强制固定边际质量、产生误导性梯度的问题，引入 confidence-adaptive unbalanced transport 放松弱匹配簇约束。另加 visual-invariance augmentation，做双向像素强度重缩放与逐通道白平衡调整，模拟曝光、对比度、光照与色温变化。
Result: 在开源与闭源 MLLM 上的大量实验中，IAU-FOA 一致优于 state-of-the-art 可迁移攻击方法；代码发布于 github.com/jiaxiaojunQAQ/IAU-FOA。
Conclusion: 把全局语义对齐与 patch 级非平衡最优传输、视觉不变性增强组合起来，可提升针对闭源 MLLM 的定向对抗样本迁移性。

papers.title: How Much Do LLM-as-a-Judge Design Choices Matter? A Systematic Comparison of Prompt Designs, Rating Scales, and Models
papers.abstract_en: Researchers increasingly use Large Language Models as judges (LLM-as-a-judge) to evaluate model outputs. Yet there are no standards for how to design these judges. Typically, researchers choose the prompt, rating scale, and model intuitively. If these choices change the judge's verdicts, two studies can reach different conclusions about the same facts. To address this risk and to provide an empirical basis for judge designs, we evaluate 10 reasoning models across multiple designs on two tasks: a scalar rating of sentence sentiment and toxicity (over 500 items per category), as well as a binary accuracy classification of question-answer pairs (n=600). For the rating tasks, despite judges showing significant disagreements with the human ground truth, the practical size of differences is small enough to consider most judges reliable (mean absolute deviation of 0.11 points on a 1 - 7 scale); toxicity judges even outperform standard classifiers. Judges are also highly accurate on average (96.5%) for the accuracy classification task. However, design choices can produce shifts: changing the rating scale alone can shift measured bias by up to 0.93 points (rating task), and while accuracy levels are rarely impacted, design choices consistently impact judge leniency (classification task; leniency drop of 28.9 percentage points when using detailed prompts, and up to 56.1 percentage points when switching models). Counterintuitively, lower reasoning effort affects neither accuracy nor leniency. Across both tasks, model identity is the dominant source of variance. These findings suggest that while LLM judges are broadly trustworthy in aggregate, design choices can be meaningful sources of variance. Given the growing reliance on automated evaluation in LLM research, we intend this study as a methodological reference for designing more robust and replicable LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 系统比较 LLM-as-a-Judge 的提示词、评分尺度与模型选择三类设计选择：10 个推理模型在情感/毒性 1–7 评分（每类 500+ 条）与问答准确率二分类（n=600）上整体可靠（平均绝对偏差 0.11 分、准确率 96.5%），但设计选择会系统性移动判定——仅换评分尺度可使测得偏差移动最多 0.93 分，详细提示使宽松度下降 28.9 个百分点，换模型最多 56.1 个百分点，且模型身份是方差的主导来源。
Motivation: LLM 评审正被广泛用于评估模型输出，但提示、评分尺度与模型的选择全凭直觉、无标准；若这些选择改变判定，两项研究可能对同一事实得出不同结论。
Method: 在两个任务上评测 10 个推理模型的多种设计组合：句子情感与毒性的 1–7 标量评分（每类超过 500 条，对照人类 ground truth），以及问答对的二分类准确率判定（n=600）；跨提示设计、评分尺度与模型身份做系统对照。
Result: 评分任务平均绝对偏差 0.11 分（1–7 量表），毒性评审甚至优于标准分类器；准确率分类任务平均准确率 96.5%。仅改变评分尺度可使测得偏差移动最多 0.93 分；详细提示使宽松度下降 28.9 个百分点，切换模型最多 56.1 个百分点；准确率水平很少受影响，而更低的 reasoning effort 对准确率与宽松度均无影响；模型身份是跨两个任务的主导方差来源。
Conclusion: LLM 评审在总体上大体可信，但设计选择是实质性的方差来源，模型身份影响最大；作者将本研究定位为设计更稳健、可复现的 LLM-as-a-Judge 流程的方法学参考。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty in Representation Learning on Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) methods represent entities and predicates in continuous vector spaces to infer missing knowledge. Despite strong benchmark performance, their predictions often lack principled reliability guarantees, limiting their use in high-stakes applications. Moreover, uncertainty arises throughout the KGE pipeline, from incomplete or probabilistic input knowledge to stochastic training and prediction. This thesis systematically investigates three sources of uncertainty in KGE: knowledge uncertainty, arising from incomplete, noisy, or probabilistic input knowledge; algorithmic uncertainty, induced by randomness in model training; and predictive uncertainty, concerning the reliability of model outputs. To address algorithmic uncertainty, the thesis demonstrates that models trained under identical settings can produce substantially different predictions and introduces a voting-based aggregation framework to mitigate this instability. To quantify predictive uncertainty, it adapts conformal prediction to KGE, constructing answer sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees and extending them to provide predicate-conditional reliability guarantees. To support reasoning under knowledge uncertainty, it develops statistically valid prediction intervals for confidence-scored triples and an embedding-based approach to approximate probabilistic reasoning over statistical ontologies with formal soundness guarantees. Together, these complementary, model-agnostic methods provide a practical and theoretically grounded approach to uncertainty in KGE, advancing beyond predictive accuracy toward reliable and uncertainty-aware knowledge graph reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于知识图谱嵌入 (KGE) 不确定性的博士论文，把不确定性拆成知识、算法、预测三类并分别给出模型无关的处理方法：用投票聚合缓解训练随机性导致的预测分歧，把 conformal prediction 改造到 KGE 上给出无分布覆盖保证与谓词条件可靠性保证，并为置信度打分的三元组构造统计有效的预测区间。核心论断是 KGE 的可靠性问题可以靠这些互补方法系统处理，把评价标准从预测精度推进到可靠、可校准的知识图谱推理。
Motivation: KGE 在基准上精度高但预测缺乏有原则的可靠性保证，难以用于高风险场景；且不确定性贯穿整条流水线，从不完整或概率性输入知识到随机训练与预测，此前缺少统一处理。
Method: 论文系统研究三类不确定性：知识不确定性（不完整、含噪或概率性输入）、算法不确定性（训练随机性）、预测不确定性（输出可靠性）。对应方法为投票聚合框架缓解训练不稳定；将 conformal prediction 适配到 KGE 构造带无分布覆盖保证的答题集合，并扩展出谓词条件可靠性保证；为置信度打分的三元组给出统计有效的预测区间，并提出基于嵌入的方法近似统计本体上的概率推理并保留形式可靠性保证。
Result: 论文证明在相同设置下训练出的模型会给出显著不同的预测，以此作为算法不确定性的实证依据；所提出的各方法分别带有分布无关覆盖保证、谓词条件可靠性保证与形式可靠性保证。摘要未给出基准数据集上的精度数值对比。
Conclusion: 这些模型无关、兼具理论依据的方法合起来构成一套处理 KGE 不确定性的实用方案，把知识图谱推理的目标从预测精度推进到可靠且不确定性感知的推理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Event Cameras for Melt-Pool Monitoring in Additive Manufacturing: A Benchmark and a Cross-Machine Transfer Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Melt-pool monitoring is central to qualifying metal additive manufacturing (AM), yet no public event-camera benchmark exists for this domain. Event cameras report per-pixel brightness changes with microsecond timing instead of reading full frames, giving the temporal resolution AM transients demand at a fraction of the data rate. We present SynAM-E (Synthetic AM Events), the first public multi-source simulated event-camera benchmark for metal-AM melt-pool monitoring: 85 physics-calibrated event shards from 15 sources across 8 institutions, with public baselines and fixed cross-machine evaluation splits. On a single-machine case study, event-spatial monitoring matches dense-frame accuracy (0.874 versus 0.863 macro-F1), and the absolute intensity that events discard adds only +0.006 under fusion. On the NIST Additive Manufacturing Metrology Testbed (AMMT) build, a near-sensor event-rate counter recovers a raw-frame-confirmed 528.7 Hz intensity oscillation at ~380 times less sensor readout than the frame stream requires. A compact 93 k-parameter spiking model runs at 15 times lower modeled inference energy for a 0.073 macro-F1 cost. Every cross-source task includes a built-in trust test against camera identity shortcuts: process-type classification passes while material classification remains confounded by camera band, a corpus-structural limitation the release documents and the trust test exposes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 发布金属增材制造熔池监测的首个公开事件相机基准 SynAM-E：85 个物理标定事件分片、来自 8 家机构的 15 个源，配公开基线与固定跨机评估划分。单机案例中事件空间监测达到与密集帧相当的精度（macro-F1 0.874 对 0.863），融合被事件丢弃的绝对强度仅再加 +0.006；近传感器事件率计数器以约 380 倍低于帧流的读出量复现 NIST AMMT 构建中经原始帧确认的 528.7 Hz 强度振荡。
Motivation: 金属增材制造的熔池监测缺少公开事件相机基准，跨机器泛化与相机身份捷径（camera identity shortcuts）问题无固定评测协议可依。
Method: 构建 SynAM-E：物理标定的模拟事件数据，含公开基线与固定跨机器评估划分；每个跨源任务内置针对相机身份捷径的 trust test；另在单机案例与 NIST AMMT 构建上做事件空间监测、近传感器事件率计数与紧凑脉冲神经网络推理对比。
Result: 单机案例中事件空间监测 macro-F1 0.874，密集帧 0.863，融合绝对强度再增 +0.006；NIST AMMT 构建上事件率计数器以约 380 倍低于帧流的读出量复现经原始帧确认的 528.7 Hz 强度振荡；93 k 参数脉冲模型推理能耗按模型估算低 15 倍，代价为 macro-F1 下降 0.073；trust test 中过程类型分类通过，材料分类仍被相机波段混淆。
Conclusion: 事件相机在熔池监测上可用远低于帧流的数据率匹配密集帧精度，但材料分类受相机波段混淆是语料结构性限制，发布文档与 trust test 已将其暴露。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 构建 SynAM-E：物理标定的模拟事件数据，含公开基线与固定跨机器评估划分；每个跨源任务内置针对相机身份捷径的 trust test；另在单机案例与 NIST AMMT 构建上做事件空间监测、近传感器事件率计数与紧凑脉冲神经网络推理对比。
summary_sections.result: 单机案例中事件空间监测 macro-F1 0.874，密集帧 0.863，融合绝对强度再增 +0.006；NIST AMMT 构建上事件率计数器以约 380 倍低于帧流的读出量复现经原始帧确认的 528.7 Hz 强度振荡；93 k 参数脉冲模型推理能耗按模型估算低 15 倍，代价为 macro-F1 下降 0.073；trust test 中过程类型分类通过，材料分类仍被相机波段混淆。
summary_sections.conclusion: 事件相机在熔池监测上可用远低于帧流的数据率匹配密集帧精度，但材料分类受相机波段混淆是语料结构性限制，发布文档与 trust test 已将其暴露。

papers.title: BoT-Feedback: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Biomechanical Evidence for Explainable Human Action Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in visual understanding and multimodal reasoning, yet they remain fundamentally limited in Human Action Feedback Generation. Existing methods infer coaching feedback directly from visual observations, producing generic advice, limited interpretability, and physically implausible hallucinations. In contrast, expert human coaches diagnose performance through explicit biomechanical reasoning over joint kinematics, posture, and body dynamics. We introduce BoT-Feedback, a framework that grounds MLLM reasoning in structured biomechanical evidence. Our key contribution is Biomechanics of Thought (BoT), a four-stage reasoning framework that progressively identifies the action, localises the critical body regions, analyses quantitative biomechanical differences between expert and student performances, and synthesises interpretable coaching feedback. To support this reasoning process, we develop a plug-and-play Biomechanical Data Parser (BDP) that converts videos into structured biomechanical descriptors and an alignment strategy that temporally matches expert and student motions. We further introduce BiomAF, a benchmark containing paired teacher-student videos, 3D skeletons, biomechanical attributes, and expert-coaching annotations. Experiments across twelve open- and closed-source MLLMs demonstrate that grounding reasoning in biomechanical evidence consistently improves feedback quality, interpretability, and robustness while substantially reducing biomechanical hallucinations. BoT-Feedback improves the average expert evaluation score from 2.07 to 2.95 (+40%), enabling compact open-source MLLMs to approach the performance of substantially larger proprietary systems for explainable action feedback generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BoT-Feedback 把 MLLM 的动作反馈生成锚定在结构化生物力学证据上：Biomechanics of Thought (BoT) 四阶段推理依次识别动作、定位关键身体部位、量化对比专家与学生的生物力学差异，再合成可解释的教练反馈。在自建 BiomAF 基准上跨 12 个开闭源 MLLM 评测，专家平均评分从 2.07 提到 2.95（+40%），生物力学幻觉显著减少。
Motivation: 现有方法直接从视觉观测生成教练反馈，导致建议泛化、可解释性差且出现物理上不合理的幻觉；而人类教练是靠关节运动学、姿态与身体动力学的显式推理来诊断的。
Method: 四阶段 BoT 推理框架配合即插即用的 Biomechanical Data Parser (BDP)，把视频转成结构化生物力学描述子，并用时间对齐策略匹配专家与学生的动作；新基准 BiomAF 提供配对师生视频、3D 骨架、生物力学属性与专家教练标注。
Result: 在 BiomAF 上对 12 个开闭源 MLLM 实验，专家评价平均分由 2.07 升至 2.95（+40%），反馈质量、可解释性与稳健性一致提升，生物力学幻觉大幅减少，紧凑开源模型可接近体量大得多的专有系统。
Conclusion: 把推理显式锚定在量化生物力学证据上，是让 MLLM 动作反馈既可解释又物理可信的关键，开源小模型也能逼近专有大模型水平。

papers.title: AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AegisFlow 用 Watchdog 采集运行时遥测、Repair agent 基于 LLM 自动生成并测试部署补丁，配合非侵入的 Parallel Shadow Patching 与 MAPE-K 循环在 digital twin 环境中验证，把数据管道故障的 MTTR 从平均 170 分钟降到 3.2 分钟（提升 98.1%），补丁成功率 92%。JSON schema 变更与标点漂移分别达 96% 与 98%，Shadow DOM 场景最低为 85%。
Motivation: 数据管道因上游 schema 漂移、API 契约变更或 DOM 修改频繁失效，现有可观测性工具只对人报警，导致 MTTR 高、运维疲劳重。
Method: Watchdog agent 收集运行时遥测，Repair agent 用 LLM 自动生成、测试并部署代码补丁；非侵入的 Parallel Shadow Patching 基于 MAPE-K 循环在 digital twin 环境中生成并验证补丁，框架以插件方式接入既有编排系统。
Result: 在五类常见故障场景上评测：MTTR 提升 98.1%（平均 170 分钟/补丁 → 3.2 分钟），补丁成功率 92%；JSON schema 变更 96%、标点漂移 98%、Shadow DOM 85%；释放约 98% 的数据工程 on-call 时间。
Conclusion: 闭环的检测到自动修复能把数据管道故障处理从人工救火转为自动补丁部署，且对 schema 与文本类漂移最有效、对 Shadow DOM 类故障最弱。

papers.title: EVFormer: An Egocentric Vision-EMG Bidirectional Attention Model for Bimanual Hand Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Egocentric bimanual hand pose estimation is important for virtual interaction, wearable control, and rehabilitation, but visual observations are often degraded by self-occlusion, hand-hand contact, and object manipulation. We propose EVFormer, a multimodal framework that combines the current RGB frame with the preceding 200 ms of bilateral wrist surface electromyography (sEMG) to estimate 44 finger and wrist joint angles. EVFormer separately encodes visual spatial features and sEMG temporal features, enables cross-modal information exchange through sequential bidirectional cross-attention, and integrates the two modalities using feature-wise gated fusion. We evaluate EVFormer in a single-participant feasibility study using one synchronized public EgoEMG recording with chronologically separated training, validation, and test splits. On 296 test samples, EVFormer achieves a mean absolute error of 11.482 degrees, compared with 13.228-13.610 degrees for vision-only, sEMG-only, late-fusion, and training-mean baselines. This corresponds to relative error reductions of 13.20% compared with the vision-only model and 14.23% compared with late fusion. EVFormer also achieves the lowest error in four of the five evaluated gesture classes. These results provide preliminary evidence that feature-level interaction between egocentric vision and sEMG can improve bimanual hand pose estimation. Further evaluation across participants, recording sessions, sensor placements, and real-world interaction conditions is required to establish the generalizability of the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EVFormer 把第一人称 RGB 帧与此前 200 ms 的双腕 sEMG 通过序列化双向交叉注意力和特征级门控融合，估计 44 个手指与腕关节角度。在单被试 EgoEMG 可行性研究的 296 个测试样本上，MAE 11.482 度，优于视觉-only、sEMG-only、晚期融合与训练均值基线的 13.228–13.610 度，相对误差较视觉-only 降 13.20%、较晚期融合降 14.23%。
Motivation: 第一人称双手姿态估计中，视觉常被自遮挡、双手接触和物体操作破坏，需要在特征层面引入肌电这类不依赖视线的信号来补足。
Method: EVFormer 分别编码视觉空间特征与 sEMG 时间特征，用序列化双向 cross-attention (sequential bidirectional cross-attention) 做跨模态信息交换，再以 feature-wise gated fusion 整合两路；输入为当前 RGB 帧加此前 200 ms 双腕表面肌电，输出 44 个手指与腕关节角度，按时间顺序切分训练/验证/测试。
Result: 单被试可行性研究，使用一份同步的公开 EgoEMG 记录，296 个测试样本上 MAE 11.482 度；视觉-only、sEMG-only、晚期融合与训练均值基线为 13.228–13.610 度，相对误差较视觉-only 降低 13.20%、较晚期融合降低 14.23%；在五个手势类中的四类上误差最低。
Conclusion: 第一人称视觉与 sEMG 的特征级交互能改善双手姿态估计，但目前只是单被试的初步证据，跨被试、跨录制、跨传感器位置与真实交互条件的评估是确立泛化性的前提。

papers.title: APEX: Active Protection at Execution Boundaries for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) hides adversarial instructions in content that large language model (LLM) agents read at runtime. As agents compose heterogeneous capability units, including Tools, MCP servers, and Skills, the carriers of injection multiply, and defenses built to recognize attack patterns fall behind them. We instead shift defense from covering attack patterns to one stable point: whatever the carrier and however the injection propagates, harm materializes only at the \emph{execution boundary}, where the agent turns internal state into an external action or released output. Safety there turns on two conditions, both settled by the trusted task rather than by the run: whether the proposed effect is authorized, and whether the runtime information reaching it is endorsed by that task. We present APEX, an active defense that enforces both at this boundary from a single authorization contract compiled before untrusted execution: \emph{evidence-gated prevention} admits an effect only when the contract justifies it, while \emph{deception-based exposure} makes unendorsed use reveal itself before the effect commits. Protection therefore follows from what the task permits rather than from how an attack is built, and applies uniformly across capability units without attack-specific policies or taint tracking. Against 13 baselines, APEX attains 0\% attack success on five of six benchmarks and 0.56\% on the sixth, holds 0\% under adaptive attacks on all three capability-unit types, and remains effective across defender backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhengXR930/APEX_official/tree/official.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: APEX 把 LLM agent 的间接提示注入 (IPI) 防御从识别攻击模式改为守住执行边界：在不可信执行前编译一份授权契约 (authorization contract)，用 evidence-gated prevention 只放行契约证成的效果，用 deception-based exposure 让未获任务背书的使用在效果提交前自我暴露。对 13 个基线，APEX 在六个基准中五个达到 0% 攻击成功率，第六个为 0.56%，在三类 capability unit 的自适应攻击下均保持 0%。
Motivation: LLM agent 组合 Tools、MCP servers、Skills 等异构能力单元后，注入载体不断增多，依赖识别攻击模式的防御始终落后于攻击构造方式。
Method: 在不可信执行前由可信任务编译单一授权契约，运行时在执行边界（内部状态转为外部动作或输出处）同时检查两件事：拟议效果是否被授权，以及到达该效果的运行时信息是否被任务背书。evidence-gated prevention 按契约放行效果，deception-based exposure 诱导未背书使用在提交前暴露；不需要针对具体攻击的策略或污点跟踪 (taint tracking)。
Result: 对 13 个基线，APEX 在六个基准中五个达到 0% 攻击成功率，第六个为 0.56%；在 Tools、MCP servers、Skills 三类 capability unit 的自适应攻击下均保持 0% 攻击成功率，并在不同 defender backbone 上保持有效。
Conclusion: 防护应由任务允许什么决定，而非由攻击如何构造决定，因此同一执行边界防御可跨能力单元统一生效，无需攻击特定策略或污点跟踪。

papers.title: Principles that Guide, Actions that Inform: Agent Evolution via Knowledge Abstraction
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interactive environments, yet their ability to continually evolve from experience remains limited. Although fine-tuning enables adaptation, its dependence on parameter access and high computational costs restrict its flexibility, especially for large-scale and closed-source LLMs. External memory offers an alternative by allowing agents to accumulate experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing methods mainly focus on experience representation and organization, while the acquired knowledge remains tightly coupled with specific tasks and contexts, limiting generalization. A key challenge is how to transform concrete interactions into abstract and reusable knowledge that guides future decisions beyond individual experiences. To address this challenge, we propose SAGA (\underline{\textbf{S}}elf-evolving \underline{\textbf{A}}gents through Experience-\underline{\textbf{G}}rounded \underline{\textbf{A}}bstraction), a framework for experience-grounded knowledge abstraction and utilization in LLM agents. SAGA progressively transforms interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, while maintaining links to execution evidence. Retrieved principles are instantiated into task-specific guidance and used to refine candidate actions through corrective feedback and resampling. This creates an execution--abstraction feedback loop, where accumulated knowledge guides future interactions and new experiences continuously update hierarchical memory. Experiments on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld demonstrate improved task performance, with ablation studies highlighting the importance of contextual instantiation and action regulation for leveraging principle-level knowledge.

papers.title: Verdicts Without Annotated Evidence: Rejection Sampling or Label-Only Post-Training for Evidence Recovery?
papers.abstract_en: In many review workflows the verdict is the only thing retained. The passages behind it are not marked, because that annotation costs far more than recording the decision. We measure how much of that evidence a small language model can recover when it is post-trained on the verdicts alone, with no human evidence labels at any stage. On ContractNLI the human evidence spans are held out until evaluation. Matching the recorded verdict and agreeing with those spans are not the same thing: across six systems the two scores are only weakly related and rank the systems differently, so accuracy is a poor guide when the citations have to be reviewable. Label-only training on the bare verdict reaches accuracy 0.896 and span F1 0.564. Rejection sampling, which keeps a generated trace only when its verdict matches the record and then picks one by an automatic source-grounding score, reaches 0.797 and 0.556, against 0.747 and 0.493 before training. Verbatim citation rises from 0.597 to 0.729 under label-only training and to 0.701 under rejection sampling. One seed on one corpus cannot say which method is better, but both improve the evidence without anyone annotating it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在只有裁决标签、无人工证据标注的条件下，用 label-only 后训练与 rejection sampling 两种方式让小语言模型从 ContractNLI 恢复证据 span。label-only 达到 accuracy 0.896、span F1 0.564，rejection sampling 达到 0.797 与 0.556，均高于训练前的 0.747 与 0.493；但六个系统上裁决匹配分与 span 一致性仅弱相关且排序不同，说明 accuracy 不能替代可审查的引用质量。
Motivation: 审查流程里往往只留下裁决结论，支撑它的段落不做标注，因为标注成本远高于记录决策本身；需要在完全没有证据标签的情况下恢复可审查的证据，而裁决准确率与证据一致性并不等价。
Method: 在 ContractNLI 上把人工证据 span 一直扣到评测阶段才使用；两条训练路径均只用记录的裁决：label-only 直接以裸裁决后训练，rejection sampling 只保留生成轨迹中裁决与记录一致者，再按自动 source-grounding 分数挑选一条。
Result: label-only 训练后 accuracy 0.896、span F1 0.564；rejection sampling 为 0.797 与 0.556；训练前基线为 0.747 与 0.493。verbatim citation 从 0.597 升至 label-only 的 0.729、rejection sampling 的 0.701。六个系统上裁决匹配与 span 一致性仅弱相关且给出不同排序。
Conclusion: 两种只用裁决的后训练都能在无人工标注下改善证据恢复，但单种子、单语料不足以判定哪种方法更好；当引用需要可审查时，accuracy 是不可靠的代理指标。

papers.title: DistScene: Object-to-Scene Distillation for 3D Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: We present DistScene, a framework for single-image compositional 3D scene generation by jointly modeling the environment and individual objects. Unlike existing methods that represent scenes primarily as collections of objects, we model the environment as an explicit scene component to provide geometric context for object placement. Specifically, we introduce Scene-Frame Generation, which jointly generates separate environment and object components in a shared coordinate frame, allowing their geometry and relative placement to be learned together. Then we introduce Object-Centric Refinement to refine each object in a local frame with scene context. Finally, we develop Object-to-Scene Distillation to transfer pretrained object-generation priors to scene generation through automatically composed and rendered synthetic scenes. Evaluations on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate improved scene-level spatial coherence over the evaluated baselines. Project page: https://coolbeam.github.io/DistScene/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DistScene 把单图组合式 3D 场景生成拆成环境与物体两个显式分量，在共享坐标系里联合生成 (Scene-Frame Generation)，再用局部坐标系的 Object-Centric Refinement 精修各物体，最后通过自动合成与渲染的合成场景做 Object-to-Scene Distillation，把预训练物体生成先验迁移到场景生成。在室内与室外基准上，场景级空间一致性优于所评估的基线。
Motivation: 现有方法把场景主要当作物体集合，环境缺少显式表示，物体的几何与相对摆放无法一起学习，导致场景级空间一致性不足。
Method: 三段式管线：Scene-Frame Generation 在共享坐标系中分别生成环境与物体分量，使几何与相对摆放联合学习；Object-Centric Refinement 在带场景上下文的局部坐标系中逐物体精修；Object-to-Scene Distillation 用自动合成并渲染的合成场景，把预训练物体生成先验蒸馏到场景生成。
Result: 在室内与室外基准上的评测显示，场景级空间一致性优于所评估的基线。
Conclusion: 把环境建为与物体并列的显式分量、并借物体先验蒸馏，可以提升单图驱动的组合式 3D 场景生成的空间一致性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ROMA: LLM System for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception
papers.abstract_en: Humans inherently understand the physical world through an active process. When sensory evidence is insufficient to infer physical properties, we naturally interact with the environment by deciding what information is missing, how to acquire it, and when sufficient evidence has been obtained. In stark contrast, existing multi-sensory robot systems mainly integrate sensory inputs rather than actively acquiring missing evidence through interactions. In this work, we introduce ROMA, an LLM-based system for Real-World Object-Centric Multi-Sensory Active Perception. ROMA integrates vision, audio, tactile, and force sensing into a reasoning-interaction-feedback loop. The model identifies missing evidence and determines the target objects, interactions, and modalities, while a physical interface executes the selected interactions and collects the multi-sensory feedback. To support this capability, we construct ROMI-2K, a large-scale real-world multi-sensory object interaction dataset covering nearly 2,000 objects and 6 atomic interactions with synchronized sensory feedback. Building on these data, we develop a two-stage training framework that aligns sensory modalities and equips the LLM to assess evidence sufficiency, select informative interactions, and reason over the multi-sensory feedback. We further characterize active perception as perception chains, where acquired evidence guides subsequent interactions and reasoning, and establish ROMA Bench to evaluate single-attribute, long-horizon multi-attribute, and intent-driven active perception. Experiments show that ROMA can actively acquire missing evidence and solve complex, long-chain multi-sensory perception tasks that existing methods struggle to handle, laying a strong perceptual foundation for active multi-sensory embodied agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ROMA 是基于 LLM 的主动多感官感知系统，把视觉、听觉、触觉与力觉接进推理-交互-反馈闭环：模型自己判断证据是否充分、缺什么、该对哪个物体做什么交互来补，物理接口执行并回传多感官反馈。配套构建近 2000 个物体、6 种原子交互的 ROMI-2K 数据集与两阶段训练，实验显示它能主动补足缺失证据并完成现有方法难以处理的长链多感官感知任务。
Motivation: 现有多感官机器人系统主要融合已有传感输入，而不是在证据不足时主动通过交互获取缺失信息，难以处理需要多步交互才能推断物体属性的任务。
Method: ROMA 用 LLM 驱动推理-交互-反馈循环，识别缺失证据并选定目标物体、交互方式与模态，由物理接口执行交互并采集同步多感官反馈；训练用两阶段框架，先对齐各感官模态，再让 LLM 学会评估证据充分性、选择有信息量的交互并推理反馈。数据基础是 ROMI-2K，覆盖近 2,000 个物体与 6 种原子交互。
Result: 构建 ROMI-2K（近 2,000 个真实物体、6 种原子交互、同步感官反馈）与 ROMA Bench，评测单属性、长时程多属性与意图驱动三类主动感知任务；实验显示 ROMA 能主动获取缺失证据并解决复杂的长链多感官感知任务，而现有方法难以处理。
Conclusion: 把主动感知形式化为 perception chains（已获证据引导后续交互与推理），并用 LLM 加多感官对齐训练，可为具身主动多感官智能体提供感知基础。

papers.title: Do Neural PDE Solvers Learn the Right Dynamics?
papers.abstract_en: Neural PDE solvers can achieve low prediction errors, but do they reproduce the dynamics of the systems they model? Prediction scores alone offer an incomplete answer: they measure agreement with reference solutions but provide limited insight into how errors accumulate, nearby states diverge, or extreme events arise. We propose an evaluation framework that directly examines these behaviors in deterministic and stochastic neural solvers. By evolving ensembles of nearby initial states and comparing them with direct numerical simulation, we assess three complementary aspects of learned dynamics: error formation, ensemble geometry, and extreme events. Experiments on two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow reveal limitations that conventional scores can obscure. Smaller trajectory errors can reflect weaker error amplification despite less accurate local updates. Models can match an ensemble's overall spread and effective dimension while failing to capture the spatial directions where nearby states diverge. Similarly, matching overall event frequencies can conceal failures to predict persistent extreme events. These findings show that improved prediction accuracy does not necessarily imply greater dynamical fidelity. Our framework makes this distinction measurable, providing concrete criteria for evaluating whether advances in neural PDE solvers better capture the underlying dynamics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个直接检验神经 PDE 求解器是否学到真实动力学的评估框架：演化一组邻近初值的集合并与直接数值模拟 (DNS) 对比，从误差形成、集合几何、极端事件三方面刻画学习到的动力学。在二维 Kolmogorov flow 上，更小的轨迹误差可能来自更弱的误差放大而非更准的局部更新，集合整体散布与有效维度匹配也可能掩盖发散方向错误，事件频率匹配会掩盖持续性极端事件预测失败。
Motivation: 神经 PDE 求解器预测误差低不等于复现了系统动力学：预测分数只衡量与参考解的一致性，对误差如何累积、邻近状态如何发散、极端事件如何产生几乎没有约束。
Method: 框架演化多组邻近初始状态的集合，与直接数值模拟 (DNS) 结果对比，评估确定性与随机两类神经求解器的三个互补维度——误差形成 (error formation)、集合几何 (ensemble geometry)、极端事件；实验在二维 Kolmogorov flow 上进行。
Result: 二维 Kolmogorov flow 实验揭示常规分数会掩盖的失败：更小的轨迹误差可能反映更弱的误差放大而非更准确的局部更新；模型可匹配集合整体散布与有效维度却抓不住邻近状态发散的空间方向；匹配整体事件频率也可能掩盖对持续性极端事件的预测失败。
Conclusion: 预测精度提升不必然带来动力学保真度 (dynamical fidelity) 提升，二者必须用误差形成、集合几何、极端事件这组可测准则分开评估。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Learning to Decide, Not to Reason: Parameter-Efficient Decision Operators via Low-Rank Activation Steering
papers.abstract_en: Injecting skills into a frozen language model currently costs a million parameters and a reinforcement-learning pipeline. We introduce \method{}, a System-1 decision operator trained by behavior cloning that lowers this cost by roughly two orders of magnitude. The default operator uses 330K parameters to match a 1.33M-parameter operator trained with reinforcement learning, exceeds or achieve comparable performance, while collapsing 3,685-token deliberation into a 6-token decision with no loss in accuracy. A rank-4 variant with 23K parameters, 1/58 of the strongest published skill operator, suffices for SearchQA and near-suffices for LiveMath, where higher rank still helps; the same recipe transfers across five tasks and three backbones, with out-of-distribution gains persisting on LiveMath problems released months after training. The gap to prior work is trainability, and it is set jointly by initialization and architecture: the initialization of prior operators zeroes the gradient of both large factor matrices at the first optimization step, whereas our zero-initialized output projection inside a shared low-rank backbone receives a gradient immediately, which a gradient-flow probe confirms directly. The gain isn't chain-of-thought compression: 23 of 57 LiveMath points beat the base model's best-of-8 sampling, and a logit-lens probe shows the operator amplifies the answer along the model's existing late-layer pathway, not writing it earlier. Gains track the base model's headroom across 13 base--task pairs, and skills compose as approximately linear operators that can be added, interpolated, and hot-swapped at inference time. Code on https://github.com/rlisml/decisionsteer.

papers.title: AdaLoop: Adaptive-Depth Latent Reasoning for Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio language models answer questions about speech, sound, and music, yet their accuracy drops sharply on tasks that need fine-grained acoustic analysis. Judging which of two speakers has the higher pitch demands iterative signal-level reasoning that a content question does not. Current models spend the same computational depth on both. We introduce AdaLoop, a lightweight recurrent module that learns how many latent refinement steps a given audio--question pair requires. A shared transformer block iterates over the audio representation, guided by the question, while a learned halting mechanism exits the loop once the representation is ready. AdaLoop adds fewer than 3\% of the base model's parameters and plugs into any audio encoder--language model pair without modifying either component. Evaluated on three architecturally distinct models across MMSU, MMAU-Pro, and MMAR, AdaLoop raises the average accuracy by 2.9 to 3.8 points, with the largest gains on perception-heavy subtasks where the model learns to apply deeper reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaLoop 为音频语言模型加一个轻量循环模块，按音频-问题对自适应决定 latent 精修步数：共享 transformer 块在问题引导下迭代音频表示，学到的 halting 机制在表示就绪时退出。在三种架构不同的模型上、于 MMSU、MMAU-Pro、MMAR 评测，平均准确率提升 2.9 至 3.8 个百分点，感知类子任务增益最大。
Motivation: 音频语言模型在需要细粒度声学分析的任务（如判断两位说话人谁音高更高）上准确率骤降，这类任务需要迭代的信号级推理，而现有模型对内容型问题与感知型问题一律使用相同计算深度。
Method: AdaLoop 是一个轻量循环模块：共享 transformer 块在问题引导下对音频表示做迭代精修，由学到的 halting 机制决定何时退出；模块不改动音频编码器与语言模型任一组件，可插入任意 encoder–LM 组合，新增参数少于基座模型的 3%。
Result: 在三种架构不同的模型上、覆盖 MMSU、MMAU-Pro、MMAR 三个基准评测，平均准确率提升 2.9 至 3.8 个百分点；增益在感知密集 (perception-heavy) 子任务上最大，因为模型在这些子任务上学会了投入更深推理。参数开销少于基座模型的 3%。
Conclusion: 按音频-问题对自适应分配推理深度比固定深度更有效，且在不修改编码器与语言模型的前提下即可插入实现。

papers.title: FactorBench: A Portfolio-Aware Benchmark for Automated Factor Mining
papers.abstract_en: Factor mining seeks to discover signals from financial data that predict future asset returns and guide portfolio construction. Automated factor mining now spans genetic programming, reinforcement learning, generative models, and large language model agents. Yet it remains unclear whether advances across these paradigms yield more generalizable, distinct, and economically useful financial signals. We introduce FactorBench, a portfolio-aware benchmark comparing roughly five thousand mined factors from nine automated mining methods across five equity markets. A shared data and evaluation contract supports both symbolic expressions and executable Python factors, connecting heterogeneous discovery algorithms to common signal combination and portfolio construction procedures. FactorBench traces the outputs of mining systems across three levels: factor validity, temporal generalization, and predictiveness beyond measured risk and style exposures; within- and across-method pool distinctness, including similarity to the benchmark Alpha101; and composite-signal quality and after-cost long-only and long--short portfolio performance. After systematically assessing whether advances in factor mining translate into signal quality and portfolio performance, FactorBench finds that no paradigm consistently dominates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FactorBench 是一个面向组合的自动因子挖掘基准，用统一的数据与评测契约比较 9 种自动挖掘方法在 5 个股票市场上挖出的约 5000 个因子，同时支持符号表达式与可执行 Python 因子。评测沿三层展开：因子有效性、时间泛化、超越风险与风格暴露的预测力，方法内/间池的差异度（含与 Alpha101 的相似度），以及合成信号与扣费后多头、多空组合表现。结论是没有任何一类挖掘范式持续占优。
Motivation: 遗传规划、强化学习、生成模型与 LLM 智能体等自动因子挖掘范式各自推进，但这些进展是否真的产出更可泛化、彼此更不同、经济上更有用的信号并不清楚，且缺少跨方法的共同评测口径。
Method: FactorBench 建立共享的数据与评测契约，把异构发现算法统一接到同一套信号组合与组合构建流程上，兼容符号表达式与可执行 Python 因子；对约 5000 个因子、9 种挖掘方法、5 个股票市场做三层追踪：因子有效性与时间泛化、超越已测风险与风格暴露的预测力、方法内与方法间的池内差异度（对照 Alpha101），最后评估合成信号质量与扣费后的多头及多空组合表现。
Result: 在约 5000 个因子、9 种自动挖掘方法、5 个股票市场的系统评测中，没有任何一种挖掘范式在信号质量与组合表现上持续占优。
Conclusion: 自动因子挖掘的范式进步不会自动转化为稳定更优的信号质量与组合业绩，跨范式比较必须放在统一的数据、信号组合与组合构建契约下进行。

papers.title: Beyond the Linear Representation Hypothesis: Non-Linear Activation Steering in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability often relies on the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which assumes that high-level concepts are encoded as linear directions in activation space. Yet a natural visual concept does not necessarily require a linear visual transition: between sunny and stormy lies an intermediate weather state such as a sky with a few white clouds, not simply a weaker storm; between a caterpillar and a butterfly, the progression is not a caterpillar with continuously growing wings. This raises the question of whether such true intermediate states are also represented nonlinearly by the model. Indeed, when we prompt text-to-image models directly for intermediate attributes, their activations rarely fall along the straight direction connecting the endpoints. Therefore, we propose KANSteer, which models concept traversal as a curve passing through its intermediate states. Seeking a representation that is both simple and interpretable, we propose to use Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs), which provide a one-dimensional coordinate whose learned functions define the trajectory. This allows the steering direction to vary along the concept while preserving an interpretable representation. Across several concepts and text-to-image diffusion transformers, we find that their activation trajectories substantially deviate from straight lines, and that KANSteer provide a closer fit and smoother traversal of intermediate attributes than linear steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对文本到图像扩散模型中线性表示假设 (LRH) 不成立的问题，提出 KANSteer，用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) 的一维坐标与学习函数把概念遍历建模为穿过中间态的曲线，使转向方向随概念位置变化。在多个概念与多种文本到图像 diffusion transformer 上，激活轨迹明显偏离直线，KANSteer 对中间属性的拟合更紧、遍历更平滑。
Motivation: LRH 假设高层概念是激活空间中的线性方向，但真实中间天气状态（如少云天空而非更弱的风暴）并非端点的线性插值，直接提示中间属性时激活也不落在端点直线上，线性转向因此失真。
Method: KANSteer 把概念遍历建模为经过中间态的曲线，用 Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) 提供一维坐标，其学习函数定义轨迹，从而让转向方向沿概念变化且保持可解释表示；在多个概念与多种文本到图像 diffusion transformer 上与线性转向对比。
Result: 在若干概念和多个文本到图像 diffusion transformer 上，激活轨迹显著偏离直线；KANSteer 比线性转向对中间属性给出更接近的拟合与更平滑的遍历。
Conclusion: 概念在文本到图像模型中以非线性曲线而非直线方向表示，用 KAN 的一维坐标建模轨迹比线性转向更贴合中间态。
Relevance: 14

papers.title: Learning to Remember: Distilling Memory Retention for Compact Recurrent Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models, particularly recurrent neural networks and their variants, such as long short-term memory, have significantly advanced time series analysis. These models capture complex, sequential patterns in time series, enabling real-time assessments. However, their high computational complexity and large model sizes pose challenges for deployment in resource-constrained environments, such as wearable devices and edge computing platforms. Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a solution by transferring knowledge from a large, complex model (teacher) to a smaller, more efficient model (student), thereby retaining high performance while reducing computational demands. Current KD methods, originally designed for computer vision tasks, neglect the unique temporal dependencies and memory retention characteristics of time series models. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel KD framework termed Memory-Discrepancy Knowledge Distillation (MemKD). MemKD leverages a specialized loss function to capture memory retention discrepancies between the teacher and student models across subsequences within time series data, ensuring that the student model effectively mimics the teacher's behaviour. This approach facilitates the development of compact, high-performing recurrent neural networks suitable for real-time, time series analysis tasks. We provide additional experiments, in-depth theoretical analysis, and insights into the proposed framework across extended time series benchmarks. Our experiments demonstrate that MemKD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art KD methods. Additionally, we demonstrate that it can match the teacher model's performance across a wide range of compression levels, achieving notable reductions in parameter count and memory usage without a significant loss in accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MemKD 把知识蒸馏 (KD) 的损失从单步输出扩展到教师与学生在时间序列各子序列上的记忆保持差异，使紧凑 RNN/LSTM 在压缩后仍能复现教师行为。在扩展的时间序列基准上，MemKD 显著优于现有 KD 方法，并在多种压缩比下匹配教师性能，参数量与内存占用明显下降而精度无显著损失。
Motivation: RNN/LSTM 参数量与计算开销大，难以部署到可穿戴与边缘设备；现有 KD 方法源自计算机视觉，忽略时间序列的时序依赖与记忆保持特性。
Method: 提出 Memory-Discrepancy Knowledge Distillation (MemKD)：用专门设计的损失函数度量教师与学生模型在时间序列各子序列 (subsequence) 上的记忆保持差异，迫使学生模仿教师的时序行为，从而得到可用于实时时间序列分析的紧凑 RNN。
Result: 在扩展的时间序列基准上，MemKD 显著优于 state-of-the-art KD 方法；在很宽的压缩比范围内可匹配教师模型性能，参数量与内存占用获得显著缩减而精度无明显下降；摘要另称补充了额外实验与理论分析。
Conclusion: 针对时序记忆保持的蒸馏损失可以让紧凑循环网络在高压缩比下保住教师级精度，即边缘部署的 RNN 不必以准确率为代价换体积。

papers.title: UniPro: Unified Multi-Mode Medical Image Segmentation from 2D Images to 3D Volumes via Propagation
papers.abstract_en: Medical image segmentation remains fragmented along two axes: segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality. Existing methods are typically developed separately for semantic, in-context, and interactive segmentation, and are further specialized to either native 2D images or 3D volumetric data. In clinical practice, however, segmentation workflows take many forms: a case may be initialized by semantic prediction, reference-guided segmentation, or user interaction. Regardless of how it begins, fine-grained refinement is naturally performed on 2D views; for volumetric scans, such 2D edits must propagate coherently to the rest of the volume. We present UniPro, a unified model that bridges segmentation paradigms and data dimensionality, using propagation to extend 2D segmentation to 3D volumes. Our key insight is that volumetric propagation and in-context segmentation share the same reference-conditioned prediction mechanism, differing only in whether the reference image-mask pairs come from other cases or from previously segmented neighboring slices. Building on this view, UniPro supports semantic, in-context, interactive, and propagation-based segmentation within a single slice-based framework, using class priors, reference exemplars, user clicks, and neighboring-slice predictions as mode-specific conditioning inputs. To improve propagation reliability, UniPro further incorporates bidirectional and 3D supervision to regularize slice-wise propagation beyond per-slice losses. Extensive experiments across diverse modalities and anatomies show that UniPro achieves strong performance across all segmentation settings, enabling annotation-efficient 3D segmentation from sparse 2D initialization and reducing slice-by-slice correction effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UniPro 把语义、in-context、交互式与传播式分割统一进一个基于切片的框架，用「参考图-掩码对条件预测」这一同一机制解释体数据传播与 in-context 分割，仅参考对来自其他病例还是相邻已分割切片之别。以类别先验、参考样本、用户点击和邻切片预测作为各模式的条件输入，并加入双向与 3D 监督约束逐切片传播，实现从稀疏 2D 初始化做标注高效的 3D 分割。
Motivation: 医学分割沿范式与数据维度两条轴割裂：语义、in-context、交互式方法各自独立开发，且分别只针对原生 2D 图像或 3D 体数据，而临床工作流常以任一方式起步、最终在 2D 视图上细化并需一致传播到整个体。
Method: UniPro 以单一基于切片的框架同时支持 semantic、in-context、interactive 与 propagation 分割，把类别先验、参考图-掩码样本、用户点击、邻切片预测作为各模式的条件输入；核心假设是体传播与 in-context 分割共享同一 reference-conditioned 预测机制。为提升传播可靠性，在逐切片损失之外加入双向 (bidirectional) 与 3D 监督来正则化 slice-wise propagation。
Result: 在多种模态与解剖部位上的大量实验中，UniPro 在全部分割设置上都取得强表现，并支持从稀疏 2D 初始化做标注高效的 3D 分割、降低逐切片修正的工作量。
Conclusion: 体数据传播与 in-context 分割可视为同一参考条件预测问题，因此用一个切片级框架即可跨范式、跨维度覆盖临床分割工作流，并把 2D 编辑一致地传播到 3D 体。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: QiYao-I: A Manifold Based Foundation Model for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Irregular multivariate time series forecasting is a challenging yet important problem in real-world applications, where observations are often irregularly sampled and asynchronously recorded across variables. Existing time series foundation models are mostly built on regularly sampled sequences, making them difficult to generalize to irregular time intervals and asynchronous cross-variable dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose QiYao-I, a manifold based foundation model for irregular multivariate time series forecasting. Specifically, we introduce a novel sampling-conditioned temporal manifold attention mechanism that maps real timestamps into a learnable temporal manifold feature space and injects temporal manifold biases into attention layers, enabling the model to capture both irregular time intervals and local sampling structures. Further, we propose a dynamic variable interaction mechanism with frequency awareness. It selectively performs cross-variable message passing under asynchronous observations. Extensive experiments on real-world irregular multivariate forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that QiYao-I achieves superior performance compared with both time series foundation models and end-to-end irregular forecasting models, showing strong generalization ability in zero-shot and few-shot settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: QiYao-I 是面向不规则采样多变量时间序列的基础模型：用采样条件化的时间流形注意力 (sampling-conditioned temporal manifold attention) 把真实时间戳映射到可学习流形特征空间并注入注意力偏置，再用带频率感知的动态变量交互机制在异步观测下选择性做跨变量消息传递。在真实世界不规则多变量预测基准上，它同时优于时间序列基础模型与端到端不规则预测模型，并在 zero-shot 与 few-shot 设置下表现出强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型大多建立在规则采样序列上，难以泛化到不规则时间间隔与跨变量异步依赖，而不规则采样、异步记录正是真实数据的常态。
Method: 提出 QiYao-I：其一为 sampling-conditioned temporal manifold attention，将真实时间戳映射到可学习的 temporal manifold 特征空间，并把流形偏置注入 attention 层，以同时刻画不规则时间间隔与局部采样结构；其二为带频率感知的动态变量交互机制，在异步观测下选择性执行跨变量消息传递。
Result: 在真实世界不规则多变量预测基准上的实验中，QiYao-I 相比时间序列基础模型与端到端不规则预测模型均取得更优性能，并在 zero-shot 与 few-shot 设置下展现强泛化能力（摘要未列出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 把时间戳本身建模成流形特征并配合频率感知的跨变量交互，是处理不规则多变量时间序列预测的一条有效路径，且能在 zero-shot 与 few-shot 下保持泛化。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: RADC: Risk-Aware Dual Caching for Vision-Language Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Cache-based test-time adaptation (TTA) for vision-language models is often hindered by background bias in global representations and unreliable entropy-based cache admission under representation variations. To address these limitations, we propose RADC, which enhances prototype learning through reliable dual caching. RADC introduces a Semantic Foreground Cache that aggregates category-consistent spatial evidence from CLIP representations, yielding foreground prototypes that complement the global cache while mitigating background interference. To reliably manage both caches, Gaussian Risk Admission models multi-view representations as diagonal Gaussian distributions and jointly considers class separation and feature uncertainty to prioritize reliable cache candidates. RADC integrates zero-shot logits with complementary global- and foreground-cache predictions for robust inference. Extensive experiments on cross-domain and out-of-distribution benchmarks demonstrate consistent state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RADC 用双缓存改造视觉-语言模型的测试时自适应 (TTA)：Semantic Foreground Cache 从 CLIP 表征中聚合类别一致的空间证据形成前景原型，Gaussian Risk Admission 把多视角表征建模为对角高斯分布，同时权衡类间分离度与特征不确定性来决定缓存准入，推理时融合零样本 logits 与全局/前景两路缓存预测。在跨域与分布外基准上取得一致的 SOTA 表现。
Motivation: 缓存式 TTA 受两处拖累：全局表征里的背景偏置污染原型，表征漂移下基于熵的缓存准入不可靠。
Method: RADC 在 CLIP 表征上维护全局缓存与 Semantic Foreground Cache（聚合类别一致的空间证据，产出前景原型）；Gaussian Risk Admission 将多视角表征建模为对角高斯分布，联合类间分离度与特征不确定性排序候选；推理时把零样本 logits 与全局、前景两路缓存预测互补融合。
Result: 在跨域 (cross-domain) 与分布外 (out-of-distribution) 基准上取得一致的 state-of-the-art 表现，缓解背景干扰并提升缓存准入可靠性。
Conclusion: 前景原型与基于不确定性的风险准入结合，可让缓存式 TTA 在表征变化下保持稳健推理并达到 SOTA。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Near-Optimal Sample Complexity for Recursive Entropic Risk Reinforcement Learning with a Generative Model
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the sample complexities of value and policy learning in finite discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs) under recursive entropic risk preferences with risk parameter \(β\neq 0\), assuming access to a generative model of the MDP. We provide a refined analysis of model-based risk-sensitive Q-value iteration (MB-RS-QVI), a plug-in model-based method introduced in prior work, and derive \((\varepsilon,δ)\)-PAC guarantees for both learning the optimal \(Q\)-value function and an \(\varepsilon\)-optimal policy. Our bounds improve the exponential dependence on the effective horizon \(1/(1-γ)\) compared with the best existing guarantees for this setting. In particular, they match the existing lower bounds in their exponential dependence on \(|β|/(1-γ)\), as well as in \(S\), \(A\), \(\varepsilon\), and \(|β|\), up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our analysis removes the exponential gap between the previously known upper and lower bounds, leaving only a polynomial gap in the effective horizon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在带生成模型的有限折扣 MDP 中，对递归熵风险 (recursive entropic risk) 偏好下的风险敏感 Q 值迭代 MB-RS-QVI 给出精细化分析，得到学习最优 Q 值函数与 ε-最优策略的 (ε,δ)-PAC 保证。界在 |β|/(1-γ)、S、A、ε、|β| 的指数依赖上与已有下界匹配（仅差对数因子），并把有效视界 1/(1-γ) 上的指数依赖改进为仅剩多项式差距。
Motivation: 递归熵风险强化学习在生成模型设定下，此前已知的样本复杂度上界与下界之间存在有效视界上的指数级差距，上界过松。
Method: 对已有插件式基于模型的风险敏感 Q 值迭代 MB-RS-QVI 做精细化分析，推导最优 Q 值函数学习与 ε-最优策略学习的 (ε,δ)-PAC 样本复杂度界，风险参数为 β≠0。
Result: 改进了相对已有最好保证在有效视界 1/(1-γ) 上的指数依赖；在 |β|/(1-γ)、S、A、ε、|β| 的指数依赖上与已有下界匹配至对数因子，从而消除上下界之间的指数差距，仅余有效视界的多项式差距。
Conclusion: MB-RS-QVI 的样本复杂度在风险参数与规模维度上已近最优，剩余待改进的只有有效视界上的多项式因子。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Low-Rank and Structured Sparse Tensor Decomposition for Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Functional Data
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate functional data arise in many modern manufacturing systems, where multiple sensors record densely sampled process trajectories. Monitoring such data is challenging because nominal variation is strongly correlated across samples, sensors, and time, while faults may appear either as isolated deviations or as structured departures concentrated within a limited number of sensor-specific temporal trajectories. We propose two unsupervised sparse tensor decomposition methods that preserve this multimode structure. Entrywise Sparse CP Decomposition (ES-CP) uses an entrywise \(\ell_1\) penalty to identify localized anomalies, whereas Fiberwise Sparse-Group Lasso CP Decomposition (FG-Lasso) combines entrywise and fiberwise penalties to detect both localized deviations and anomalies concentrated within temporal fibers. Both methods represent nominal process behavior through a low-rank CP decomposition and are estimated using alternating optimization with closed-form sparse-component updates. Two simulation studies evaluate performance under different fault structures, signal severities, noise levels, and missing observations. FG-Lasso attains or ties the highest macro F$_1$ score in almost all settings in the first study and achieves the highest macro F$_1$ score. In a multichannel forging-process case study, FG-Lasso and ES-CP obtain macro F$_1$ scores of 0.85 and 0.82, respectively, compared with 0.69 or lower for TRPCA and PCA-based anomaly detectors. The results demonstrate that explicitly matching the sparse penalty to the anticipated fault structure improves both anomaly detection and fault localization in high-dimensional functional processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对制造过程多传感器稠密轨迹的异常检测，提出两种保持多模态结构的无监督稀疏张量分解：ES-CP 用逐元素 ℓ1 惩罚抓局部异常，FG-Lasso 叠加纤维级 Sparse-Group Lasso 同时抓局部与沿时间纤维聚集的异常，二者都以低秩 CP 表示正常行为、用交替优化加闭式稀疏更新求解。锻造案例中 FG-Lasso 与 ES-CP 的 macro F1 分别为 0.85 和 0.82，而 TRPCA 与基于 PCA 的检测器仅 0.69 或更低。
Motivation: 制造过程的多变量函数型数据中，正常波动在样本、传感器与时间三个模态上强相关，故障既可能是孤立偏离也可能是集中在少数传感器时间轨迹上的结构性偏离，常规监测方法难以同时刻画这两种结构。
Method: 两个无监督方法共用低秩 CP 分解表示正常过程行为：ES-CP 施加逐元素 ℓ1 惩罚定位局部异常；FG-Lasso 组合逐元素与纤维级 (fiberwise) 惩罚（Sparse-Group Lasso），同时检测局部偏离与沿时间纤维聚集的异常。两者均用交替优化估计，稀疏分量有闭式更新。
Result: 两项仿真研究覆盖不同故障结构、信号强度、噪声水平与缺失观测设置；第一项研究中 FG-Lasso 在几乎所有设置取得或并列最高 macro F1，第二项研究中取得最高 macro F1。多通道锻造过程案例中，FG-Lasso 与 ES-CP 的 macro F1 分别为 0.85 与 0.82，TRPCA 和基于 PCA 的异常检测器为 0.69 或更低。
Conclusion: 把稀疏惩罚的结构与预期故障结构对齐（逐元素 vs. 纤维级），可在高维函数过程中同时改善异常检测与故障定位。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 两项仿真研究覆盖不同故障结构、信号强度、噪声水平与缺失观测设置；第一项研究中 FG-Lasso 在几乎所有设置取得或并列最高 macro F1，第二项研究中取得最高 macro F1。多通道锻造过程案例中，FG-Lasso 与 ES-CP 的 macro F1 分别为 0.85 与 0.82，TRPCA 和基于 PCA 的异常检测器为 0.69 或更低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 把稀疏惩罚的结构与预期故障结构对齐（逐元素 vs. 纤维级），可在高维函数过程中同时改善异常检测与故障定位。

papers.title: Metonymic Circuits for Abstract Concept Grounding in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We study how Vision Transformers ground abstract concepts (e.g., angry) when training data provide limited direct referential evidence. We hypothesize a metonymic grounding mechanism in which abstract predictions are driven by concrete, interpretable anchor concepts (e.g., fire) that bridge visual signals to abstract semantics. By applying Transcoders on CLIP and DINO vision encoders, we recover intermediate features that can be associated with semantic labels for more concrete concepts, and trace their contributions in circuits underlying abstract concept recognition. Experiments on a carefully curated icon dataset reveal structured metonymic circuits, in which perceptual primitives dominate early layers and object-like anchors precede abstract targets. Images containing rendered text instead recruit a distinct perceptual-to-textual route. Causal interventions further validate that metonymic intermediates are functionally involved in grounding abstract concepts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出视觉 Transformer 抽象概念落地的转喻回路 (metonymic circuits) 假说：抽象预测由具体可解释的锚概念（如 fire 之于 angry）驱动。用 Transcoder 在 CLIP 与 DINO 编码器上恢复可标注的中间特征并追踪其在回路中的贡献，因果干预证实这些转喻中间量在抽象概念识别中起功能作用。
Motivation: 训练数据对抽象概念缺少直接指称证据时，Vision Transformer 如何把视觉信号接到抽象语义上缺乏可解释的机制说明。
Method: 对 CLIP 与 DINO 视觉编码器施加 Transcoder，恢复可关联到具体概念语义标签的中间特征，并在抽象概念识别的回路中追踪其贡献；在精心整理的图标 (icon) 数据集上做实验，并用因果干预 (causal intervention) 检验。
Result: 图标数据集上识别出结构化的转喻回路：早期层由感知基元 (perceptual primitives) 主导，物体样锚概念先于抽象目标出现；含渲染文字的图像改走一条独立的感知到文本 (perceptual-to-textual) 路径；因果干预验证转喻中间量在抽象概念落地中具有功能参与。
Conclusion: 抽象概念落地可由具体锚概念构成的可解释回路解释，且文字渲染会改变所走的回路路径。

papers.title: AttSVD:Prompt-Adaptive Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Attention-Guided SVD
papers.abstract_en: The key-value (KV) cache of autoregressive transformers grows linearly with context length and dominates memory at long context. Most training-free remedies evict low-importance tokens, an irreversible choice along the sequence axis. We instead keep every token and store it more cheaply along the "feature" axis. We therefore propose AttSVD, a new "interpretable" low-rank compression whose basis is derived from each prompt's own attention geometry: an online, per-prompt truncated SVD that keeps only the directions attention actually reads, cutting persistent per-head KV memory in proportion to the retained rank. We propose two decode-time caching strategies, accumulating and streaming, for short and long generation regimes. Furthermore, we propose two refinements that make compression adaptive. A per-matrix energy rule sizes the logit space and the attention mass independently. An attention-aware basis truncates only in the spaces attention actually reads, preserving both the attention logits and the attention output. The same factors also provide free, per-head interpretability insights into the effective rank and the geometry attention consumes. Across multiple models, on both an agentic benchmark and the full LongBench suite AttSVD stays on par with the dense cache while using up to 50% of the KV-cache memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AttSVD 不丢弃任何 token，而是按每个 prompt 自身的注意力几何在线做逐 prompt 截断 SVD，只保留注意力真正读取的方向，把持久化 KV cache 按保留秩等比例压缩。在多个模型的 agentic benchmark 与完整 LongBench 上，只用至多 50% KV-cache 内存时性能与 dense cache 持平。
Motivation: 自回归 Transformer 的 KV cache 随上下文长度线性增长并在长上下文主导显存；主流免训练方法沿序列轴驱逐低重要度 token，这一选择不可逆。
Method: AttSVD 沿特征轴做低秩压缩：基于每个 prompt 的注意力几何在线做逐 prompt truncated SVD，只保留注意力读取的方向；提出 accumulating 与 streaming 两种解码期缓存策略分别对应短/长生成；再加两条自适应细化——按矩阵的能量规则分别设定 logit 空间与注意力质量的秩，以及只在注意力读取的空间截断以同时保住 attention logits 与 attention output。
Result: 在多个模型上，于 agentic benchmark 与完整 LongBench 两个评测中，AttSVD 使用至多 50% 的 KV-cache 内存仍与 dense cache 表现持平；同一批分解还免费给出逐 head 的有效秩与注意力所消耗几何的可解释性信息。
Conclusion: 沿特征轴按注意力几何做逐 prompt 低秩压缩，可以在不丢 token 的前提下把持久化 KV 内存按秩成比例削减而基本不损长上下文性能。

papers.title: RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RadOnc-Agent 把放疗流程形式化为四个临床阶段，由 LLM 控制器把临床意图映射为 schema 约束的函数调用并跨阶段保留患者与工作流上下文，提供 26 个可调用功能。单功能执行中意图函数选中率 98.79%，脚本化跨阶段工作流完成率 96.50%，真实患者工作流完成率 96.67%；去掉纵向状态后跨阶段完成率从 96.50% 降到 84.00%，关闭 schema 与身份校验使错配后端分派从 0% 升到 95.28%。
Motivation: 放疗各环节的 AI 能力分散在不同临床阶段、软件环境与数据模态中，与从治疗决策到随访的纵向工作流脱节，缺少统一编排层。
Method: 以 agentic AI 框架把放疗形式化为四个临床阶段，提供 26 个可调用函数与对话接口；LLM 控制器将临床意图映射为 schema 约束的调用，维护患者与工作流状态并路由到专科服务。评测含 2,600 次单功能请求（7,800 次重复执行）、200 个预设合成跨阶段场景（600 次执行）以及来自 60 份去标识患者记录的 120 个工作流实例（360 次干净执行）。
Result: 单功能执行中选中预期函数的比例为 98.79%；脚本化跨阶段工作流完成率 96.50%，真实患者工作流完成率 96.67%。消融中移除纵向状态使跨阶段完成率由 96.50% 降至 84.00%；禁用 schema 与身份校验后，错配后端分派在 replay/test 评估中由 0% 升至 95.28%。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果确立了 LLM 编排架构在纵向放疗工作流中协调异构能力与信息的技术可行性，但明确指出这不构成临床正确性、临床效用或前瞻性获益的证据。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Extending Music Annotation Schemas: Zero-Shot Prediction or Few-Shot Adaptation?
papers.abstract_en: Automatic music annotation is typically tackled under the assumption of a fixed annotation schema. In practice, commercial music catalogs often need to accommodate new musical attributes as needs evolve. Given that expert music annotation is expensive, it is not evident which methodological approach is most effective at accommodating new attributes and backfilling existing tracks; audio-language models promise zero-shot prediction, but at what annotation budget does supervised adaptation become more compelling? We propose a benchmark based on the MGPHot popular music annotation dataset for simulating music schema extension across different annotation budgets. We investigate zero-shot prediction with audio-language models, learning new attributes from pretrained representations, and adapting models trained on existing annotations. Our results suggest that supervised adaptation is more effective than zero-shot prediction even with small annotation budgets, while frozen representation reuse remains the most effective approach for modest budgets without the tuning required by deeper adaptation.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027; under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在 MGPHot 流行音乐标注数据集上构建标注 schema 扩展基准，比较音频-语言模型零样本预测、从预训练表示学习新属性、以及在已有标注上训练的模型做适配三种路线。结论是即使标注预算很小，监督适配也比零样本预测更有效；中等预算下冻结表示复用 (frozen representation reuse) 效果最好且无需深层适配的调参。
Motivation: 商业音乐库需要不断新增音乐属性并回填存量曲目，而专家标注昂贵；音频-语言模型许诺零样本预测，但尚不清楚标注预算到什么水平时监督适配才更划算。
Method: 提出基于 MGPHot 流行音乐标注数据集的基准，模拟不同标注预算下的 schema 扩展；评测三条路线：音频-语言模型零样本预测新属性、从预训练表示学习新属性、以及适配已在既有标注上训练的模型。
Result: 结果表明即使标注预算很小，监督适配也比零样本预测更有效；在中等预算下，冻结表示复用是无需深层适配调参的最有效方案。
Conclusion: 新属性回填不应默认走零样本：小预算就值得做监督适配，中等预算优先复用冻结表示而非深度调参。

papers.title: Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Similarity is typically measured using cosine similarity, which provides a single fixed geometry. Semantic similarity, however, is inherently context dependent: two images may be similar because they depict the same object, share a visual style, or are relevant to the same clinical finding. We show that contrastive representations naturally encompass a family of geometries that can be specialized to particular semantic structure. The key idea is to use an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between probability distributions over "anchors" and Bregman geometries on the representation space. We use this correspondence to define "Anchor Divergences", a method for specifying context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Under this correspondence, modeling the anchor distribution models the geometry itself. Experiments on retrieval show that anchor divergences provide an effective and efficient way to specify context-specific semantic similarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Anchor Divergence：借助对比学习、指数族与信息几何的对应，把表示空间上 anchor 的概率分布映射为 Bregman 几何，从而在固定表示上指定随语境变化的语义相似度。检索实验表明该方法能有效且高效地给出上下文特定的语义相似性。
Motivation: cosine similarity 只给出单一固定几何，而语义相似本身依赖语境（同物体、同视觉风格、同临床发现可各自构成相似），固定几何无法表达这种多样性。
Method: 利用对比学习、指数族 (exponential families) 与信息几何之间的对应，建立 anchor 上的概率分布与表示空间 Bregman 几何的等价关系；据此定义 Anchor Divergences，在不改动预训练表示的前提下指定上下文特定几何，建模 anchor 分布即建模几何本身。
Result: 检索 (retrieval) 实验显示 Anchor Divergences 提供了指定上下文特定语义相似性的有效且高效的方式；摘要未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 对比表示天然包含一族可按语义结构特化的几何，通过 anchor 分布来参数化几何是可行路径。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Learning from Unreliable Trajectories: Adversarially-Robust Federated Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study federated reinforcement learning in which multiple agents interact with a common Markov decision process and communicate through a central server to collaboratively learn the optimal state-action value function. Our goal is to understand whether the sample-efficiency benefits of collaboration can be retained when a fraction of the agents behave adversarially and transmit arbitrarily corrupted information. To address this problem, we introduce Robust Async-Fed-Q, an epoch-based federated learning algorithm that combines variance-reduced estimation of the Bellman optimality operator at the agents with robust aggregation at the server. We establish high-probability finite-time guarantees showing that the proposed method preserves the statistical gains of collaboration among the honest agents while tolerating adversarial corruption. In particular, the effect of the adversarial agents decreases as the amount of data collected by each honest agent grows and eventually vanishes in the infinite-sample limit. We complement these guarantees with information-theoretic lower bounds that characterize the unavoidable statistical cost of adversarial corruption, leading to the first nearly matching upper and lower bounds for adversarially robust federated reinforcement learning. We further extend our framework to accommodate single-trajectory Markovian sampling and heterogeneous partial coverage, where different agents may explore different regions of the state-action space and learning relies on their collective coverage. Finally, our epoch-based design substantially improves the best known communication complexity for federated Q-learning under asynchronous sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在部分智能体被对手完全污染的联邦 Q 学习中，Robust Async-Fed-Q 用智能体端的 Bellman 最优算子方差缩减估计加服务器端鲁棒聚合，证明高概率有限样本界：对手影响随诚实智能体样本量增长而衰减，并在无穷样本极限下消失。配合信息论下界给出首个近乎匹配的上下界，并把通信复杂度降到已知最优水平之下。
Motivation: 联邦强化学习里协作带来的样本效率优势，会在部分智能体传输任意伪造信息时被破坏；需要在保留诚实智能体统计增益的同时量化对抗污染的不可避免代价。
Method: 提出基于 epoch 的 Robust Async-Fed-Q：各智能体对 Bellman 最优算子做方差缩减估计，服务器做鲁棒聚合；进一步扩展到单轨迹 Markov 采样与异质部分覆盖（各智能体探索不同状态-动作区域、依赖集体覆盖）。
Result: 给出高概率有限样本上界，显示对抗智能体的影响随诚实智能体数据量增长而减小并在无穷样本极限下消失；给出刻画对抗污染统计代价的信息论下界，与上界近乎匹配；在异步采样下大幅改进联邦 Q 学习的已知最好通信复杂度。
Conclusion: 对抗鲁棒联邦强化学习的统计代价可被上下界近乎匹配地刻画，且 epoch 化设计能在异步采样下同时改善通信复杂度。

papers.title: FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Prefill-decode disaggregation is becoming a common architecture for LLM serving because it separates two phases with distinct execution patterns and SLO objectives. Existing systems typically combine a fixed prefill/decode worker ratio with request routing across workers. However, real-world workloads exhibit both short bursts and sustained shifts in the prefill-to-decode demand ratio. As a result, a configuration that is well provisioned at one time may quickly become mismatched, causing latency SLO violations even when idle capacity exists elsewhere. Existing autoscaling mechanisms can add capacity, but they react slowly, require spare GPUs, and do not directly address short-timescale phase imbalance. We present FluidPD, a P/D-disaggregated serving system that provides SLO-aware in-place elasticity. FluidPD introduces two complementary mechanisms. FluidToken handles transient imbalance by offloading a bounded portion of prefill computation to decode workers when decode-side slack is available. FluidRole handles sustained imbalance by reassigning running workers between prefill and decode roles in place, avoiding model reload and engine restart. Both mechanisms are guided by lightweight pressure indices that expose prefill and decode-side resource pressure before they appear as SLO violations. Across production Azure trace workloads, FluidPD improves overall SLO attainment over static SGLang by up to 94.6 percentage points, demonstrating that SLO-aware in-place P/D elasticity improves service quality without provisioning additional workers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FluidPD 为 P/D 分离的 LLM 服务系统提供 SLO 感知的原地弹性：FluidToken 在 decode 侧有空闲时把一部分 prefill 计算卸载过去以应对瞬时失衡，FluidRole 在不重载模型、不重启引擎的前提下原地把运行中的 worker 在 prefill/decode 角色间重分配以应对持续失衡，两者都由轻量压力指数 (pressure indices) 在 SLO 违约前驱动。在生产 Azure trace 负载上，相对静态 SGLang 的整体 SLO 达成率最高提升 94.6 个百分点，且无需增配 worker。
Motivation: P/D 分离通常靠固定 prefill/decode worker 比例加请求路由，但真实负载既有短时突发也有持续的 prefill-to-decode 需求比漂移，配置会迅速失配，即使别处有空闲容量也会触发延迟 SLO 违约；现有 autoscaling 反应慢、需要备用 GPU，管不了短时间尺度的阶段失衡。
Method: FluidPD 含两个互补机制：FluidToken 在 decode 侧存在 slack 时把有界的 prefill 计算卸载到 decode worker；FluidRole 原地重分配运行中 worker 的 prefill/decode 角色，避免模型重载与引擎重启。两者都由轻量压力指数引导，在资源压力表现为 SLO 违约之前暴露 prefill 与 decode 侧压力。
Result: 在生产 Azure trace 工作负载上，FluidPD 相对静态 SGLang 的整体 SLO 达成率最高提升 94.6 个百分点 (percentage points)，且未增配 worker。
Conclusion: SLO 感知的原地 P/D 弹性（瞬时靠 FluidToken 卸载、持续靠 FluidRole 换角色）能在不增加 worker 的前提下改善服务质量，比依赖扩容的 autoscaling 更适合短时间尺度的阶段失衡。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain
papers.abstract_en: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions. We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference accounted for over 97\% of observed runtime in every reported group. These small, DataBrain-specific results do not establish production readiness, general text-to-SQL accuracy, or an efficiency advantage over manual dashboard construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Text2Dashboard 是面向企业 DataBrain 的受治理 agent 架构，把自然语言分析请求转成可检视的仪表盘：模型只提议动作，确定性软件（typed tools、持久状态、Hooks）控制执行并记录状态转移。在冻结的真实 DataBrain 任务上严格成功率为 metadata/SQL 任务 6/8，最终发布版通过 4/4 单面板任务，全部 10 个注入故障场景均达成预期结果且无未授权外部副作用。
Motivation: 企业内用自然语言生成仪表盘时，模型直接执行 SQL 与写操作缺乏审批、审计与故障恢复，且 text-to-SQL 的列契约与语义正确性难以同时保证。
Method: Codex 插件加独立 Agent Runtime：schema 约束的模型决策配 typed tools、持久状态与确定性 Hooks（审批、审计、检查点、恢复、故障处理）；流水线依次做实体解析、元数据发现、只读 SQL 强制、仪表盘组装，并叠加静态检查、动态 preflight 与浏览器检视；评测用冻结的真实 DataBrain 任务与受控 Hook 故障注入。
Result: metadata/SQL 任务严格成功 6/8：metadata 选择 4/4 通过，4 个 SQL 任务全部满足语义标准，其中 2/4 满足精确输出列契约；最终发布版通过 4/4 单面板仪表盘任务、1 个双面板任务与 1 个已有仪表盘微调任务，1 个参数化任务超出步数上限；10 个故障场景全部达成指定结果且无未授权外部副作用；每组报告中模型推理占观测运行时间 97% 以上。
Conclusion: 让模型提议、确定性软件执行并记录状态，可在 DataBrain 域内把审批与故障语义做严；作者明确这组小规模、DataBrain 专用结果不构成生产就绪、通用 text-to-SQL 精度或相对手工建表的效率优势证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents to make underspecified assumptions, yielding incomplete mechanics, disconnected gameplay flows, and limited visual aesthetics. To resolve this issue, this paper presents GameGo, a scalable framework that systematically transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry game-development practices. To retain core gameplay constraints without restricting design exploration, GameGo uses task-specific dynamic compression to maximize information density while preserving instruction following. Based on this pipeline, GameGoData is constructed with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D, 2.5D, and 3D games, alongside GameGoBench, a benchmark comprising 124 diverse game queries. Training GameGoCoder on GameGoData yields a model that outperforms matched baselines and is comparable to frontier models across gamedev benchmarks. All code, datasets, and models will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GameGo 把简短游戏种子扩写成符合行业规范的 PRD，再用任务特定动态压缩保留核心玩法约束，据此合成 55,060 条 2D/2.5D/3D 游戏开发轨迹训练 GameGoCoder。在含 124 条游戏查询的 GameGoBench 上，该模型超过匹配基线并可与前沿模型相当。
Motivation: 稀疏用户查询直接驱动编码 agent 合成复杂游戏时，agent 只能做欠定假设，导致机制不完整、流程断裂、视觉表现有限；现有工作又多依赖多轮工作流或只做静态评测。
Method: GameGo 框架分两步：把简短 game seed 系统扩写为基于行业游戏开发实践的完整 PRD，再用任务特定动态压缩 (task-specific dynamic compression) 在保留指令遵循的前提下最大化信息密度；据此构建 GameGoData 轨迹集并训练 GameGoCoder。
Result: 构建 GameGoData，含 55,060 条覆盖 2D、2.5D、3D 的开发轨迹；构建 GameGoBench，含 124 条多样化游戏查询；在 GameGoData 上训练的 GameGoCoder 在 gamedev 基准上超过匹配基线 (matched baselines)，并与前沿模型相当。
Conclusion: 用 PRD 扩写加动态压缩生成的合成轨迹，足以把编码 agent 训练到接近前沿模型的游戏合成水平；代码、数据集与模型将全部公开。
