papers.title: Nonlocal Hamiltonian Dynamics on Sparse Lévy Graphs: Spectral Analysis and Multimodal Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We develop a sparse graph method for transporting probability mass toward multimodal target distributions through damped nonlocal Hamiltonian dynamics. The formulation combines logarithmic-mean mobility with symmetric Lévy-type interaction weights, coupling the evolving density to an edge momentum field. A graph constructed from nearest-neighbor connections and sampled long-range edges provides direct mass exchange between spatially separated regions. Once the graph is constructed, the density evolution is deterministic, and each update costs linear in the number of nodes and the long-range sampling budget. Linearization around the target distribution yields a damped oscillator governed by a weighted graph Laplacian. Its spectrum characterizes the interaction between nonlocal connectivity and inertia, with the Lévy exponent alpha tuning the nonlocal connectivity: the spectral gap determines the optimal asymptotic damping, while the largest eigenvalue governs the time-step stability. Experiments on synthetic multimodal distributions demonstrate improved mode balance and more stable mode coverage relative to first-order and MCMC baselines. The resulting framework provides a sparse implementation of nonlocal inertial density transport for sampling problems with low-dimensional spatial structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出基于稀疏 Lévy 图的阻尼非线性 Hamiltonian 动力学，把对数平均迁移率与对称 Lévy 型交互权重结合，用最近邻加长程采样边直接在分离模态间搬运概率质量。图构造后密度演化确定，单步代价对节点数与长程采样预算为线性；线性化给出由加权图 Laplacian 控制的阻尼振子，谱隙决定最优渐近阻尼、最大特征值决定时间步稳定。合成多模态分布上相对一阶方法与 MCMC 基线改善了模态平衡与覆盖稳定性。
Motivation: 多模态目标采样中，分离模态之间缺乏直接质量交换通道，一阶扩散与 MCMC 方法模态覆盖不均衡、混合慢；需要一种构造后即确定、单步代价可控的非局部惯性输运机制。
Method: 用对数平均迁移率 (logarithmic-mean mobility) 与对称 Lévy 型交互权重耦合演化密度与边动量场；图由最近邻连接加采样长程边构成，图构造后演化确定，每次更新对节点数与长程采样预算线性。在目标分布附近线性化得到由加权图 Laplacian 支配的阻尼振子，Lévy 指数 alpha 调节非局部连通性，谱隙给出最优渐近阻尼、最大特征值给出时间步稳定条件。
Result: 在合成多模态分布上，相对一阶方法与 MCMC 基线改善了模态平衡 (mode balance) 与模态覆盖稳定性；单步更新代价为节点数与长程采样预算的线性量级。
Conclusion: 非局部惯性密度输运可稀疏实现在低维空间结构的采样问题上，且其动力学稳定性与阻尼优劣可直接由加权图 Laplacian 的谱隙和最大特征值判定。

papers.title: Reward on Path: Learning Intermediate Supervision Signals for Knowledge Graph Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) aims to answer user questions by reasoning over Knowledge Graphs (KGs). Recent methods use supervision derived from answer labels or refined by Large Language Models (LLMs) to train models that retrieve KG evidence for LLM-based answer reasoning. However, answer-derived supervision treats every answer-reaching path as correct and thus yields noisy training signals, whereas LLM-refined supervision mitigates this noise at substantial cost. To address these limitations, we propose Reward on Path (RoP), a framework to learn a lightweight, question-conditioned path reward from answer labels with an asymmetric objective. Paths reaching the same answer are supervised jointly as a bag, allowing the reward model to learn their relative contributions, while each path is penalized individually for retrieving non-answer entities. The learned reward then trains an LLM-based relation path generator in two stages: reward distillation transfers reward-induced preferences over candidate paths into the generator, and on-policy optimization with GRPO further refines the policy on self-generated paths. Generated paths are grounded in the KG to retrieve evidence for answer reasoning. Experiments on multiple KGQA datasets show that RoP improves F1 over answer-derived methods by at least 2.6\% while outperforming LLM-refined methods without costly supervision construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Reward on Path (RoP)：从答案标签学一个轻量、随问题条件化的路径奖励，用非对称目标把到达同一答案的路径作为包联合监督、同时对每条路径检索到非答案实体单独惩罚，再用该奖励经 reward distillation 与 GRPO 在线优化训练 LLM 关系路径生成器。在多个 KGQA 数据集上，RoP 的 F1 比答案派生监督方法至少高 2.6%，并以更低成本超过 LLM 精修监督方法。
Motivation: 答案派生监督把每条到达答案的路径都当正确，训练信号带噪；LLM 精修能降噪但监督构造成本高。
Method: RoP 用非对称目标从答案标签学问题条件化的轻量路径奖励：同一答案的路径作为 bag 联合监督以学相对贡献，每条路径检索到非答案实体则单独受罚。学到的奖励分两步训练 LLM 关系路径生成器——reward distillation 把奖励诱导的候选路径偏好蒸馏进生成器，再用 GRPO 在自生成路径上在线优化策略；生成路径在 KG 上 grounding 后检索证据供 LLM 作答。
Result: 在多个 KGQA 数据集上，RoP 相比答案派生监督方法 F1 至少提升 2.6%，同时在不构造昂贵监督的前提下超过 LLM 精修监督方法。
Conclusion: 从答案标签学出的路径级奖励可以替代高成本的 LLM 精修监督，为 LLM 路径生成器提供更干净的训练信号。

papers.title: Component and Dimension Sparsity in Transformer Refusal Mechanisms
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering manipulates large language model behavior by intervening on internal activations, but the mechanistic basis of these interventions remains poorly understood. We decompose refusal steering into component-level interventions across four open-weight models, identifying the sparse subsets of attention and MLP components whose steering suffices to reproduce the full behavioral effect. We find that refusal directions concentrate in sparse component mechanisms comprising 28--48\% of upstream components, retaining 88--101\% of steering effectiveness. Within these mechanisms, effective steering further concentrates in approximately 50\% of residual stream dimensions, retaining 85--98\% of the component-mechanism baseline, consistent with a privileged basis structure. Sparsity thus operates at two levels: which components are steered, and which dimensions within those components carry the signal. Together these findings show that refusal is not diffusely encoded across a transformer but assembled by a structured, identifiable mechanism, providing a foundation for mechanistic understanding of how refusal behaviors are represented and steered. To facilitate reproducibility, we release all code and raw experimental results in https://github.com/wang-research-lab/Refusal_Mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对四个开源模型做拒绝方向 (refusal direction) 的组件级与维度级分解，发现只需干预上游组件的 28–48% 即可保留 88–101% 的转向效果，其中约 50% 的残差流维度再保留组件机制基线的 85–98%。拒绝并非弥散编码，而是集中在稀疏、可识别的结构化机制上。
Motivation: Activation steering 能改变大模型行为，但这些干预的机制基础不清楚：拒绝究竟弥散分布在全网络，还是集中在少数组件与维度上，缺乏组件级证据。
Method: 把拒绝转向分解为组件级干预，在四个开源权重模型上定位足以复现完整行为效果的注意力与 MLP 组件稀疏子集，再在这些机制内部定位承载信号的残差流维度；代码与原始实验结果已开源至 GitHub。
Result: 拒绝方向集中在占上游组件 28–48% 的稀疏组件机制上，保留 88–101% 的转向效果；机制内部约 50% 的残差流维度承载有效转向，保留组件机制基线的 85–98%，与特权基 (privileged basis) 结构一致。
Conclusion: 拒绝不是弥散编码在 Transformer 中，而是由结构化、可识别的机制组装而成，稀疏性同时作用于组件选择与组件内维度两层。

papers.title: Medical Image Alignment Assessment as a Test of Generalist Visual Reasoning in Frontier Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly positioned as general purpose visual reasoners as part of the quest for artificial general intelligence. A key test of this generality is whether they can perform novel visual judgments that humans can make reliably from visual evidence and task instructions, without task-specific parameter optimisation. We investigate this question through the task of medical image alignment assessment, where the goal is to establish whether there is anatomical correspondence between two images. Human visual assessment of image alignment is still the gold standard and most common approach; however, it requires trained operators and is impractical to scale for large datasets. We evaluate recent generations of MLLMs on two exemplar medical image alignment tasks, varying both prompting strategies and image-presentation methods. We compare against a locally fine-tuned MLLM and a task-specific CNN to examine the trade-off between frontier general purpose models and smaller models that require specific task optimisation but can be used locally. We show that are reaching an inflection point, where frontier MLLMs can now perform effective visual assessment of medical image alignment. Models released only a few months ago generalise poorly and, in some settings, perform barely above chance, whereas GPT-6 achieves over 85% across almost all scenarios tested. Fine-tuned local models can match or exceed frontier-model performance on the tasks on which they are trained, but transfer substantially less effectively to unseen settings. These findings identify medical image alignment as a useful test bed for generalist visual reasoning and suggest that frontier multimodal models are beginning to acquire capabilities that could support a common quality-control mechanism across heterogeneous medical-imaging pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把医学图像配准一致性判断当作通用视觉推理测试，评测前沿 MLLM 在两种配准任务上判断两幅图像解剖对应关系的能力。GPT-6 在几乎所有测试场景中超过 85%，而几个月前发布的模型在部分设置中仅略高于随机水平；微调的本地模型在训练过的任务上可匹配或超过前沿模型，但迁移到未见设置时明显变差。
Motivation: 医学图像配准一致性评估目前依赖受训阅片人员的人工目视判断，难以扩展到大规模数据集；需要检验前沿 MLLM 能否在不做任务特定参数优化的前提下完成这类新奇视觉判断。
Method: 在两个示例性医学图像配准评估任务上评测多代 MLLM，系统改变提示策略 (prompting strategies) 与图像呈现方式 (image-presentation methods)，并以本地微调的 MLLM 和任务专用 CNN 作为对照，比较前沿通用模型与需任务优化的小模型之间的取舍。
Result: GPT-6 在几乎所有测试场景中达到 85% 以上的准确率；仅几个月前发布的模型泛化差，部分设置下表现仅略高于随机水平；微调本地模型在训练任务上可匹配或超过前沿模型，但向未见设置的迁移能力明显更弱。
Conclusion: 医学图像配准评估可作为通用视觉推理的有效测试床，前沿 MLLM 已到达可支撑异构医学影像流水线统一质量控制的拐点。

papers.title: Memory Prediction Excess: A Probabilistic Quantity for Predictive Gain and Memory Length in Stochastic Processes
papers.abstract_en: A central question in the prediction of stochastic processes is the extent to which past information can improve the probability of correctly predicting the next state. We introduce the Memory Prediction Excess (MPE) to address this question quantitatively. The MPE measures the average improvement in prediction accuracy obtained by using the entire observed history relative to using only the static marginal distribution, in discrete-time finite-state processes. It is defined as the difference between the expected optimal conditional prediction accuracy and the optimal static prediction accuracy. Its basic properties are examined: the MPE is always non-negative; it admits an upper bound depending on the static accuracy, attained if and only if the future is almost surely a deterministic function of the past; and degenerate cases in which the MPE vanishes are characterized. A normalized version, taking values in the unit interval, is introduced as a dimensionless measure of predictive efficiency. A lower bound is derived by comparing predictions based on histories of different lengths, showing that the expected optimal prediction accuracy is monotone with respect to the history length. The framework is extended to finite-length histories, where the finite-history MPE (FH-MPE) measures the predictive gain attainable when only the most recent observations are retained. This leads to the notion of a minimal memory length required to achieve the same predictive performance as the full history. For finite-order Markov chains, this minimal memory length is shown to be bounded by the Markov order. The MPE and its variants are formulated in terms of conditional probabilities and prediction accuracies, offering a probabilistic perspective on the predictive utility of memory that is complementary to classical information-theoretic approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Memory Prediction Excess (MPE)：离散时间有限状态随机过程中，用完整历史的最优条件预测精度减去仅用静态边缘分布的最优预测精度，量化记忆带来的预测增益。MPE 恒非负，且存在依赖静态精度的上界，当且仅当未来几乎必然是过去的确定函数时取到；归一化版本落在单位区间作为预测效率。有限历史版本 FH-MPE 进一步给出与全历史同等性能所需的最小记忆长度，对有限阶 Markov 链该长度被 Markov 阶数界定。
Motivation: 随机过程预测中，过去信息到底能把正确预测下一状态的概率提高多少，缺少一个直接的概率化度量；经典信息论途径（如熵、互信息）与预测精度不是同一语言。
Method: 在离散时间有限状态过程上定义 MPE 为期望最优条件预测精度与最优静态预测精度之差；考察非负性、上界与退化情形，构造取值于单位区间的归一化版本；通过比较不同历史长度的预测推导下界并证明预测精度对历史长度单调；再扩展到有限长度历史得到 FH-MPE 与最小记忆长度概念。
Result: MPE 恒非负；上界依赖静态精度，当且仅当未来几乎必然是过去的确定函数时达到；归一化 MPE 取值于单位区间；由不同历史长度比较导出的下界蕴含期望最优预测精度关于历史长度单调；有限阶 Markov 链的最小记忆长度以 Markov 阶数为界。
Conclusion: MPE 及其变体用条件概率与预测精度表述记忆的预测效用，给出与经典信息论方法互补的概率视角；最小记忆长度由过程阶数控制。
Relevance: 34

papers.title: Axiom Satisfiability of Linear Rewards in Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Learning from human preference data is the dominant route to aligning language models with human values. In linear social choice, where rewards are linear in a fixed feature representation of prompt-response pairs, Ge et al.[2024] show that fitting such a reward by minimizing any non-decreasing convex loss, including BTL, fails PO and PMC. Moreover, no rule that reads only the majority relation can satisfy PO once the output is required to be linearly induced. We ask what it costs to enforce these axioms anyway. To this end, we relax the linear model to allow per-candidate slack. We compute the relaxed linear reward with the smallest total slack that satisfies the axioms with a margin $η$, the minimum required difference between two reward values. Our solution satisfies the axioms under no assumptions about the voters or how comparisons were collected. We bound the optimal total slack by $O(1)$ when $η$ is at most $O(\frac{1}{m^2})$ for $m$ candidates. Furthermore, we exhibit an instance that forces this bound, concluding that the rate is tight up to constants. In practice, the no. of candidates far exceeds the feature dimension, and only a linear reward can be evaluated on unseen responses. We therefore introduce a new method that charges the linear part for each comparison it gets wrong. It simultaneously minimizes the total slack and the no. of violations, with a parameter $λ$ trading off between them. We show that the total slack is monotone but saturating in $λ$: raising it reduces the violations of the deployed linear reward and increases the slack, yet the slack stays below $(η+Δ\sqrt{d})\lfloor m^2/4\rfloor$, where $Δ$ and $d$ are the diameter and dimension of the features, respectively. Experiments on both synthetic and real-life preference data corroborate our theory and show that the linear reward output by our method beats linear BTL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在线性社会选择框架下证明：用任意非递减凸损失（含 BTL）拟合线性奖励无法满足 PO 与 PMC，因此改为允许逐候选 slack 的松弛线性模型，求满足公理且带 margin η 的最小总 slack。理论上总 slack 在 η ≤ O(1/m²) 时为 O(1) 且该速率紧致；新方法以参数 λ 同时最小化总 slack 与线性部分的比较违反数，slack 随 λ 单调但饱和，上界为 (η+Δ√d)⌊m²/4⌋，在合成与真实偏好数据上输出的线性奖励优于线性 BTL。
Motivation: 偏好学习是对齐语言模型的主流路径，但 Ge et al. [2024] 表明线性奖励拟合无法满足 PO 与 PMC，且只读多数关系的规则在线性诱导输出下也无法满足 PO；实际中候选数远超特征维度，只有线性奖励能作用于未见回复，因此需要知道强行满足这些公理的代价。
Method: 把线性模型松弛为允许逐候选 slack，求满足公理且两奖励值差至少为 margin η 的最小总 slack 解，对选民与比较采集方式不作假设；再引入对线性部分每次比较出错计费的目标，用参数 λ 在总 slack 与违反数之间权衡，同时最小化两者。
Result: 当 η ≤ O(1/m²)（m 为候选数）时最优总 slack 为 O(1)，并构造出达到该界的实例，说明速率在常数意义下紧；λ 增大降低部署线性奖励的违反数但抬高 slack，slack 单调且饱和，始终低于 (η+Δ√d)⌊m²/4⌋（Δ 为特征直径、d 为维度）；合成与真实偏好数据实验印证理论，输出的线性奖励胜过线性 BTL。
Conclusion: 线性奖励要同时满足 PO/PMC 就必须付出可量化的 slack 代价，该代价在 η 为 O(1/m²) 时为 O(1) 且紧；带 λ 权衡的方法能在候选数远超特征维度时给出违反更少、slack 有界的线性奖励，优于线性 BTL。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Event-Driven ML Pipeline Orchestration for Manufacturing: An AWS Industry Experience
papers.abstract_en: We present an industry experience report on three years of operating an event-driven cloud infrastructure for continuous machine learning training in automotive manufacturing. Our system orchestrates GPU-accelerated training of product-specialized model pairs, a physics prediction model and a reinforcement-learning control policy, across multiple plants, coordinating long-running GPU workloads triggered by manufacturing events. The architecture combines Amazon ECS with EC2 GPU capacity providers, SQS-based messaging with dead-letter queues, and an admission-controlled Lambda dispatcher that enforces cluster concurrency limits. A Conductor orchestrator on ECS Fargate initiates dependency-aware retraining chains on a weekly schedule. The entire infrastructure is codified in modular Terraform with multi-account separation. From 40000+ production training jobs we report a 72-78% cost reduction versus always-on GPU infrastructure. A discrete-event simulation confirms that admission control is necessary (naive dispatch loses 65% of jobs) and that queue-draining matches AWS Step Functions latency while eliminating per-job startup overhead. We provide lessons learned and release the simulator and Terraform module skeletons as open-source artifacts.
papers.comment: Accepted in the 14th IEEE International Conference on Cloud Engineering (IC2E 2026). It will be hosted on October 13th-15th, 2026 at Santa Clara, California, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一份汽车制造业事件驱动云基础设施的三年工业实践报告：用 Amazon ECS + EC2 GPU、SQS 死信队列与带准入控制的 Lambda 调度器编排产品专用模型对（物理预测模型 + 强化学习控制策略）的持续训练。基于 40000+ 生产训练任务，成本比常开 GPU 基础设施降低 72–78%；离散事件仿真显示无准入控制的朴素调度会丢掉 65% 的任务，而排空队列的延迟与 AWS Step Functions 持平且省去逐任务启动开销。
Motivation: 跨多个工厂、由制造事件触发的长时 GPU 训练任务若用常开 GPU 资源成本高，朴素分发又会因并发超限大量丢任务，需要可编排、可限流的云上训练流水线。
Method: 架构组合 Amazon ECS 与 EC2 GPU capacity providers、带死信队列的 SQS 消息传递、执行集群并发上限的准入控制 Lambda dispatcher；ECS Fargate 上的 Conductor orchestrator 按周调度依赖感知的重训练链，全部基础设施用模块化 Terraform 做多账号隔离；另建离散事件仿真验证调度策略。
Result: 在 40000+ 生产训练任务上，成本相对常开 GPU 基础设施降低 72–78%；离散事件仿真表明朴素分发丢失 65% 的任务，准入控制因此是必要的；排空队列 (queue-draining) 的延迟与 AWS Step Functions 相当，同时消除逐任务启动开销。
Conclusion: 事件驱动 + 准入控制的云编排能在制造业持续训练中大幅削减 GPU 成本而不牺牲任务完成度，作者据此开源仿真器与 Terraform 模块骨架并给出经验教训。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Zero-Shot Visualization: Exploring Text Corpora with User-Prompted Axes
papers.abstract_en: We study the application of large language models (LLMs) to the visual exploration of textual corpora. We introduce zero-shot visualization (ZSV), a task in which users specify concepts in natural language and documents are mapped onto the corresponding concept axes for visualization. Building a ZSV system of practical value is non-trivial, as it requires choices at the intersection of feature functions, efficient implementation tradeoffs, and pre/post-processing decisions affecting visualization quality. To that end, we establish a benchmark that compares methods spanning embedding similarity, direct semantic judgments, and conditional likelihood estimation in this setting. Across multiple datasets and use cases we evaluate the properties of different scoring methods and design choices in terms of semantic faithfulness, score fidelity, and computational cost. Our results identify that scoring based on next-token probabilities offers the strongest practical trade-off among the evaluated methods. We further apply this approach to unlabeled corpora to examine its behavior in realistic exploratory settings. These experiments highlight additional design considerations, including the use of graded axes together with binary relevance filtering, and reveal a compositional sentiment bias in off-topic documents. Based on these findings, we provide practical guidelines for constructing end-to-end ZSV baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出零样本可视化 (zero-shot visualization, ZSV) 任务：用户用自然语言给出概念轴，把文档映射到该轴上做语料探索，并建立基准比较 embedding 相似度、直接语义判断与条件似然打分。结果显示基于 next-token 概率的打分在语义忠实度、分数保真度与计算成本之间给出最强的实用折中；在无标注语料上还发现离题文档存在组合性情感偏置。
Motivation: 用 LLM 做文本语料的可视化探索缺少可比较的任务定义与评测基准，特征函数、实现开销与前后处理的选择都会影响可视化质量，难以判断哪种打分方式实用。
Method: 定义 ZSV 任务并建立基准，比较三类打分方法：embedding 相似度、直接语义判断、条件似然估计 (next-token probability)；在多个数据集与用例上按语义忠实度、分数保真度、计算成本三个维度评估设计选择，再把最优方案用于无标注语料的探索性实验。
Result: 在多个数据集与用例上，next-token 概率打分在所评估方法中给出最强的实用折中；无标注语料实验显示离题文档存在组合性 (compositional) 情感偏置，并指出分级轴配合二元相关性过滤的设计选择。
Conclusion: next-token 概率打分应作为端到端 ZSV 基线的首选方案，构建时需同时采用分级轴与二元相关性过滤，并注意离题文档的情感偏置。

papers.title: Dynamical low-rank equilibrium computation for stochastic games between advanced persistent threats and moving target defense
papers.abstract_en: Moving target defense (MTD) against advanced persistent threats (APTs) in industrial control systems (ICS) has well-established game-theoretic formulations, but their practical value hinges on equilibrium computation: full-rank value iteration is prohibitively expensive at industrial state dimensions, and the resulting defense strategies admit no certified robustness against adversarial perturbations. We first reveal that the attack and defense influence matrices of ICS dynamics are intrinsically low-rank: APTs infiltrate through a handful of entry points, and MTD reconfigures only a limited subset of components per cycle. We prove that this structure propagates through the non-smooth Bellman operator of the zero-sum stochastic game: an augmented gradient matrix bridging physical and algorithmic low rank certifies that every Bellman target lies near a low-dimensional subspace, with an explicit error bound on the optimal value function. Because these subspaces drift under value iteration, static low-rank projections are inadequate. We therefore propose dynamical low-rank equilibrium computation (DLR-NE), which augments the rank-r search space at each iteration, regularizes the core matrix spectrum, and retracts via truncated SVD, extracting a Nash equilibrium at every step. Four guarantees follow: explicit approximation error; geometric convergence to a neighborhood with five physically interpretable error sources; per-step cost O(nr^2), a Theta(n/r^2) speedup over full-rank value iteration; and robustness in which a single weight trades accuracy against certified safety. Experiments on a nonlinear power-system testbed confirm each prediction, with 94% parameter compression at 0.16% utility loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对工业控制系统 (ICS) 中 APT 与移动目标防御 (MTD) 的零和随机博弈均衡计算，提出动态低秩均衡算法 DLR-NE：利用攻防影响矩阵的内禀低秩结构，每步迭代扩张 rank-r 搜索空间、正则化 core 矩阵谱并经截断 SVD 收缩，逐步提取 Nash 均衡。证明 Bellman 目标落在低维子空间附近并给出值函数显式误差界，单步代价 O(nr^2)，相对全秩值迭代加速 Θ(n/r^2)；非线性电力系统测试床上 94% 参数压缩仅损失 0.16% 效用。
Motivation: ICS 的 MTD 博弈已有成熟公式化，但工业状态维度下全秩 value iteration 计算代价过高，且所得防御策略对对抗扰动没有可认证的鲁棒性。
Method: DLR-NE：先证明攻防影响矩阵低秩且该结构穿过非光滑 Bellman 算子（用连接物理低秩与算法低秩的增广梯度矩阵），每步迭代扩张 rank-r 搜索空间、正则化 core 矩阵谱、经 truncated SVD 收缩，同时给出近似误差、几何收敛到邻域、单步 O(nr^2) 代价与用单一权重折衷精度和可认证安全的鲁棒性四类保证。
Result: 四项保证：显式近似误差；带五个物理可解释误差源的几何收敛到邻域；单步代价 O(nr^2)、相对全秩值迭代 Θ(n/r^2) 加速；单一权重折衷精度与可认证安全。非线性电力系统测试床实验确认各项预测，达到 94% 参数压缩、0.16% 效用损失。
Conclusion: ICS 攻防博弈的低秩结构可以穿过 Bellman 算子并被动态低秩子空间追踪利用，从而在工业状态规模上以可控误差和可认证鲁棒性算出 Nash 均衡。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Learning When to Refine: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Budgeted Neural-Operator PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators provide fast surrogates for time-dependent PDEs, but autoregressive deployment creates a refinement-allocation problem: prediction errors vary over space and time, while only a finite number of local corrections can be committed along a trajectory. We formulate this as budgeted adaptive neural-operator solving. A global Fourier neural operator advances the full field, a local operator proposes patch-wise residual corrections, and a set-aware selector chooses where to refine. A macro policy decides when and how much of the remaining refinement budget to spend. We introduce rollout-verified policy improvement (RV-PI), which evaluates feasible refinement counts through actual continuation rollouts of the learned PDE solver, converts long-horizon advantages into conservative policy targets, and accepts an update only when held-out trajectory error improves. On the shallow-water benchmark with a 32-intervention budget, RV-PI achieves a three-seed mean trajectory relative L2 error of 0.6910, improving over immediate-only policy improvement by 5.37% and RandomMacro by 2.41%. On the forcing-driven Brusselator benchmark with a 76-intervention budget, RV-PI attains 0.09954, improving over immediate-only policy improvement by 2.31% and RandomMacro by 5.32%. These results show that, under a fixed refinement budget, the value of a local correction depends on its downstream effect on the autoregressive trajectory, not only on its immediate error reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把神经算子自回归求解 PDE 建模为预算受限的自适应精化问题：全局 Fourier neural operator 推进全场，局域算子提出 patch 残差修正，set-aware selector 决定在哪精化，宏策略决定何时花掉剩余预算。新算法 rollout-verified policy improvement (RV-PI) 用真实续推 rollout 评估可行精化次数，把长程优势转成保守策略目标，仅在留出轨迹误差改善时接受更新；在 shallow-water（32 次干预预算）上三种子平均轨迹相对 L2 误差 0.6910，比 immediate-only 提升 5.37%、比 RandomMacro 提升 2.41%。
Motivation: 神经算子做时变 PDE 的快速代理时，自回归部署下误差在时空上分布不均，而沿轨迹可用的局部修正次数有限，需要决定把有限精化预算花在哪、何时花。
Method: 系统由全局 Fourier neural operator（推进全场）、局域 operator（提出 patch 级残差修正）、set-aware selector（选择精化位置）与宏策略（决定何时及花多少剩余预算）组成；核心训练算法 RV-PI 通过学习到的 PDE 求解器的真实 continuation rollout 评估可行的精化次数，把长程优势转成保守策略目标，并仅当留出轨迹误差改善时接受该更新。
Result: shallow-water 基准、32 次干预预算下，RV-PI 三种子平均轨迹相对 L2 误差 0.6910，较 immediate-only policy improvement 改善 5.37%，较 RandomMacro 改善 2.41%；forcing-driven Brusselator 基准、76 次干预预算下为 0.09954，较 immediate-only 改善 2.31%，较 RandomMacro 改善 5.32%。
Conclusion: 在固定精化预算下，一次局部修正的价值取决于它对自回归轨迹的下游影响，而不只是当下的误差削减，因此精化时机与分配应按长程效果而非即时收益来学。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Comparative review of hybrid forecasting models for short-term prediction of building thermal load
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, a comparative review of different hybrid models for short-term forecasting of building thermal demand is carried out. Particularly, the assessment tackles the comparison of data-driven models enhanced with other state-of-the-art techniques. At the first step, the existing techniques reported in the literature are analysed. It is concluded that Metaheuristics or a data-driven model are used to identify the parameters of the basic model. The qualitative evaluation includes for each method the input and output features, main advantages and drawbacks. At the second step, an existing dataset of historical thermal demand from Scottish households, as well as historical weather forecasts are utilized to assess additionally the performance of existing hybrid methods. From the assessment of 13 hybrid methods, the Empirical Modal Decomposition - long short-term memory - Markov (EMD-LSTM-Markov) model can predict with the highest accuracy the day-ahead power pattern of heating and domestic hot water (DHW) demands. Though local power peaks are also accurately predicted, high power swells and spikes are underestimated. Other methods, such as Support Vector Machine - Simulated Annealing (SVM-SA) and Random Forest - Improved Sparrow Search Algorithm - LSTM (RF-ISSA-LSTM) predict a smooth pattern of heating and DHW demand profiles with rapid changes underestimating most power peaks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对建筑热负荷短期预测的混合模型做比较综述：先梳理文献中用元启发式算法或数据驱动模型辨识基础模型参数的做法，再用苏格兰住户历史热需求与历史天气预报数据集实测 13 种混合方法。EMD-LSTM-Markov 在日前供热与生活热水 (DHW) 功率曲线预测上精度最高，局部功率峰值也能跟住，但高功率涌浪与尖峰被低估；SVM-SA 与 RF-ISSA-LSTM 输出平滑曲线，快速变化处多数峰值被低估。
Motivation: 建筑热负荷日前预测的混合模型种类繁多，缺少在统一数据集上对输入输出特征、优缺点与实测精度的横向比较，选型时无从判断哪种结构能跟住功率峰值。
Method: 两步走：先分析文献中已有的混合技术，归纳其输入/输出特征与主要优缺点，并指出常用做法是用元启发式算法或数据驱动模型辨识基础模型参数；再用苏格兰住户历史热需求数据集加历史天气预报，对 13 种混合方法统一评估日前供热与 DHW 功率预测表现。
Result: 在 13 种混合方法中，EMD-LSTM-Markov 对日前供热与 DHW 功率曲线的预测精度最高，局部功率峰值预测也准确，但高功率涌浪和尖峰被低估；SVM-SA 与 RF-ISSA-LSTM 给出平滑的供热和 DHW 曲线，在快速变化处低估大部分功率峰值。
Conclusion: 分解-循环-随机混合结构 (EMD-LSTM-Markov) 最能跟住建筑热负荷的日前波动，但所有被测方法对极端功率涌浪都系统性低估，选型时应重点核对峰值还原能力。
Relevance: 18

papers.title: Neutrosophic Ensemble Classification for Uncertainty-Aware Bearing Fault Detection: Evidence from Laboratory and Variable-Speed Industrial Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning classifiers for bearing fault detection produce scalar confidence scores that conflate confident errors with genuinely ambiguous predictions, and the conventional truth/falsity pair (F = 1 - T) is algebraically redundant by construction. We operationalize a refined neutrosophic decomposition of a Random Forest + XGBoost + Logistic Regression ensemble into four indicators -- T-hat (top-class evidence), F-hat (best-competitor evidence), predictive entropy I1-hat, and decision disagreement I2-hat -- evaluated on two bearing benchmarks (CWRU and JNU, 600-1000 rpm) under a leave-one-condition-out protocol. On CWRU, after correcting a file-to-class mapping error, the ensemble reaches 100.00 percent accuracy on three of four held-out loads (92.27 percent on the fourth), leaving too few errors for uncertainty analysis. On JNU, holding out 1000 rpm, accuracy collapses to 40.64 percent, below a majority-class baseline; Logistic Regression (57.91 percent) generalizes far better than the tree ensembles. I1-hat shows a robust association with error beyond T-hat/F-hat, while I2-hat contributes little; standalone Logistic Regression confidence outperforms the full decomposition, a boundary condition we report honestly. Two further results extend this: fusing a time-domain and a frequency-domain model of the same signal and scoring their Jensen-Shannon divergence beats that model own entropy (AURC 0.29 vs. 0.36 on the standard split; 0.54 vs. 0.73 under a harder single-condition reproduction), the only indicator moving correctly under a CWRU-versus-JNU distributional-shift contrast; and, on CWRU alone, literature-verified bearing fault frequencies, correctly demodulated via the envelope spectrum, separate most fault classes almost perfectly (99.57 percent) using three interpretable features. Code, logs, and figures are released for independent verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把 Random Forest + XGBoost + Logistic Regression 集成的置信度拆成四个中智 (neutrosophic) 指标——T-hat（首选类证据）、F-hat（最强竞争者证据）、预测熵 I1-hat、决策分歧 I2-hat——用于轴承故障检测的不确定性刻画。在 CWRU 与 JNU（600–1000 rpm）留一工况协议下，跨转速泛化崩溃：JNU 留出 1000 rpm 时准确率 40.64%，低于多数类基线；I1-hat 与错误稳健相关而 I2-hat 几乎无贡献，时域-频域模型 Jensen-Shannon 散度融合是唯一在分布偏移对比下方向正确的指标（AURC 0.29 vs 0.36）。
Motivation: 分类器输出的标量置信度把「自信的错误」和「真正的歧义」混在一起，而传统真/假对 (F = 1 - T) 在代数上冗余，无法区分这两类失败，跨工况泛化失败时尤其危险。
Method: 对 RF + XGBoost + Logistic Regression 集成做细化中智分解，得到四个指标 T-hat、F-hat、预测熵 I1-hat、决策分歧 I2-hat；在 CWRU 与 JNU 两个轴承基准（600–1000 rpm）上用 leave-one-condition-out 协议评估，并修正了 CWRU 的文件到类别映射错误。另做两项扩展：融合同一信号的时域与频域模型并计算 Jensen-Shannon 散度；在 CWRU 上用包络谱正确解调的文献验证故障频率，取三个可解释特征。
Result: CWRU 四个留出负载中三个达 100.00% 准确率，第四个 92.27%，错误太少无法做不确定性分析；JNU 留出 1000 rpm 时准确率塌到 40.64%，低于多数类基线，而 Logistic Regression 57.91% 远好于树集成。I1-hat 在 T-hat/F-hat 之外仍与错误稳健相关，I2-hat 贡献很小，单独的 Logistic Regression 置信度优于完整分解。时域+频域 JS 散度融合优于该模型自身熵：标准划分 AURC 0.29 vs 0.36，更难的单工况复现 0.54 vs 0.73；CWRU 上包络谱故障频率加三个可解释特征分离大多数故障类达 99.57%。
Conclusion: 跨工况轴承故障检测中，预测熵类指标比真/假对与分歧指标更能预警错误，时域-频域分歧是唯一在分布偏移下方向正确的信号；作者如实报告完整分解被单独 Logistic Regression 置信度超过这一边界条件，并公开代码、日志与图供独立复核。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: When Can World Models Recover Physical Laws?
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction does not establish that a world model has recovered a physical law: distinct dynamics can generate identical records under the same observation protocol. We formulate law recovery on a fixed physical domain under an explicit catalog of experiments, sensor uncertainty, and an acquisition budget. A rate--distortion converse separates the information needed to describe a law from the information the apparatus can reveal. Its constructive counterpart gives a finite response codebook and an explicit decoding budget. On compact world classes, uniform recovery is possible exactly when every pair of different laws is experimentally distinguishable; equivalently, the apparatus can recover all the entropy of every finite law source. An inverse response modulus quantifies stability. For Lipschitz fields on a $d$-dimensional state--action domain, noisy full-state readouts after resets require minimax budget $Θ(\varepsilon^{-(d+4)/2})$ for squared law error $\varepsilon$, compared with $Θ(\varepsilon^{-(d+2)/2})$ for direct field observations. Exact crossing-time symmetries establish the lower bound under adaptive experiment selection and arbitrary durations with constant inputs. Reproducible synthetic cases illustrate the separate roles of intervention, calibration, and repeated measurement. Together, the results identify which evidence supports a claim of physical-law recovery and the cost of acquiring it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文把「世界模型是否恢复了物理定律」形式化为在固定物理域、显式实验目录、传感不确定性和采集预算下的率-失真问题，并给出可恢复的充要条件：任意两条不同定律都可被实验区分。核心定量结论是，对 d 维状态-动作域上的 Lipschitz 场，复位后含噪全状态读出的 minimax 预算为 Θ(ε^{-(d+4)/2})（平方定律误差 ε），而直接场观测只需 Θ(ε^{-(d+2)/2})。
Motivation: 预测准确并不等于恢复了物理定律：同一观测协议下不同动力学可以产生完全相同的记录，现有世界模型评估无法区分二者。
Method: 在固定物理域上以实验目录、传感不确定性和采集预算为输入，构造率-失真 converse 分离描述定律所需信息与装置可揭示信息，其 constructive 对偶给出有限响应码本与显式解码预算；用 inverse response modulus 度量稳定性，并以精确 crossing-time 对称性在自适应实验选择与任意时长常值输入下证明下界，辅以可复现合成算例。
Result: 紧致世界类上一致恢复成立当且仅当任意两条不同定律实验可区分，等价于装置能恢复每个有限定律源的全部熵；Lipschitz 场在 d 维状态-动作域上，复位后含噪全状态读出的 minimax 预算为 Θ(ε^{-(d+4)/2})，直接场观测为 Θ(ε^{-(d+2)/2})，平方定律误差为 ε。
Conclusion: 物理定律能否被恢复取决于实验证据的可区分性而非预测精度，而采集成本由观测形式决定：含噪全状态读出比直接场观测需要更高的预算阶。
Relevance: 38

papers.title: Statistical Turbulence and High-Fidelity Disturbance Fields for Quadrotor Flight Control
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement-learning quadrotor controllers are usually trained under simplified wind models, yet the impact of wind-field fidelity, as opposed to magnitude, on policy robustness remains unquantified. This paper compares five disturbance-fidelity levels, from wind-free flight and discrete 1-cosine gusts through statistical turbulence and synthetic coherent structures to large-eddy-simulation fields of the atmospheric boundary layer, in a full cross-fidelity train test evaluation of proximal policy optimization (PPO) agents, with cascaded PID and geometric SE(3) controllers as training-free references, over a 0-12 m/s wind sweep. Before any controller comparison is made, all disturbance data are validated: every synthetic generator is checked quantitatively against its analytical or certification-standard reference, and the large-eddy-simulation fields against the imposed log law. On a racing-class quadrotor in hover, the train test matrix is remarkably flat, and the cheapest structured training wind, which is discrete-gust domain randomization, ranks first in every test column, a ranking replicated on a wind-sensitive 27 g platform; a once-tuned geometric controller brackets the learned PPO policies at zero crash rate. Mechanism diagnostics show that control authority, not wind realism, bounds robustness, so wind-fidelity investment should scale with platform wind sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 在四旋翼 PPO 控制器的全交叉保真度训练-测试中，五档风场保真度（无风、1-cosine 离散阵风、统计湍流、合成相干结构、大气边界层 LES 场）在 0–12 m/s 风速扫描下的排名几乎持平：最便宜的结构化训练风——离散阵风域随机化——在每个测试列都排第一，并在 27 g 风敏感平台上复现。机制诊断给出控制权限而非风场真实度决定鲁棒性，因此风保真度投入应随平台风敏感度缩放。
Motivation: RL 四旋翼控制器通常在简化风模型下训练，风场保真度（而非幅值）对策略鲁棒性的影响此前未被量化。
Method: 比较五档扰动保真度（无风、1-cosine 离散阵风、统计湍流、合成相干结构、大气边界层 LES 场），对 PPO 智能体做全交叉保真度 train-test 评估，以级联 PID 与几何 SE(3) 控制器作免训练参照，风速扫描 0–12 m/s；比较前先定量校验所有扰动数据：合成生成器对照解析或认证标准参照，LES 场对照所施加的 log law。
Result: train-test 矩阵非常平坦，离散阵风域随机化在每个测试列均排第一，且在 27 g 风敏感平台上复现该排名；一次调好的几何控制器在零坠毁率下把学到的 PPO 策略夹在中间；机制诊断显示限制鲁棒性的是控制权限而非风场真实度。
Conclusion: 风场保真度投资应随平台风敏感度缩放：对控制权限充裕的平台，最便宜的结构化训练风（离散阵风域随机化）已足够。

papers.title: The Geometry of Statistical Feature Learning in Mean-Field Langevin Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a geometric formulation of statistical feature learning for supervised regression. Feature learning is defined through a base--fiber decomposition: the base is the feature-side geometry produced by training, and the fiber is the learned feature space where estimation is performed. We prove this property for spherical mean-field Langevin dynamics, viewed as the Wasserstein gradient flow of a negative entropy-regularized empirical risk. In Gaussian multi-index models, the low-temperature stationary distribution concentrates near the hidden indices, forms a multi-spike structure, and yields parameter recovery with high probability, even though negative entropy regularization penalizes concentration. This concentration has a sharp transition at temperature $λ\asymp 1$. In Gaussian single-index models, the stationary measure satisfies a concentration property, with parity determining whether it lives on $S_2^{d-1}$ or $\mathbb{RP}^{d-1}$. The induced learned feature space aligns the regression signal and yields rates $d/N$ and $Md/N$, up to logarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 为监督回归的统计特征学习给出 base–fiber 几何分解：base 是训练产生的特征侧几何，fiber 是做估计的已学习特征空间，并对球面 mean-field Langevin dynamics（负熵正则经验风险的 Wasserstein 梯度流）证明该性质。高斯 multi-index 模型中低温稳态分布在隐藏指标附近集中成 multi-spike，以高概率实现参数恢复，且在温度 λ≈1 处有尖锐相变；诱导特征空间对齐回归信号，给出 d/N 与 Md/N 的速率（至多差对数因子）。
Motivation: 统计特征学习缺少一个把训练产生的特征几何与后续估计空间分开刻画的框架，也缺少对 mean-field Langevin 动力学何时真正恢复隐藏方向的理论判据。
Method: 提出 base–fiber 分解的几何表述，并对球面 mean-field Langevin dynamics（视为负熵正则经验风险的 Wasserstein 梯度流）证明该分解；在高斯 multi-index 与 single-index 模型中分析低温稳态分布的集中行为，single-index 情形由奇偶性决定支撑在 S_2^{d-1} 还是 RP^{d-1}。
Result: multi-index 模型低温稳态集中在隐藏指标附近形成 multi-spike，尽管负熵正则惩罚集中，仍以高概率实现参数恢复；集中转变在温度 λ≈1 处是尖锐的。诱导特征空间对齐回归信号，给出速率 d/N 与 Md/N（至多差对数因子）。
Conclusion: mean-field Langevin 动力学在低温下能克服熵正则的去集中倾向、恢复隐藏结构，特征学习可用 base–fiber 几何分解来刻画并导出回归速率。

papers.title: When Does External Guidance Help LLM Reasoning? A Bias-Variance Theory of Guidance-Augmented GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant paradigm for eliciting multi-step reasoning in large language models, and a recent wave of methods (LUFFY, ExPO, PAPO, TAPO) further augments RL with \emph{external guidance} - expert traces, self-explanations, or retrieved thought patterns. Although each method reports empirical gains, none provides convergence rates, bias bounds, or an optimal weighting rule for the guidance signal. We close this gap with \emph{Guidance-Augmented GRPO} (GA-GRPO), a unified theoretical framework that casts external guidance as a stochastic guidance operator G re-writing the question distribution, and analyses the resulting policy-gradient estimator as a biased on-policy estimator whose bias is bounded by the total-variation guidance divergence delta\_G between the guidance-augmented sampling distribution and the policy's own distribution. The framework subsumes vanilla GRPO, LUFFY, ExPO, PAPO, and TAPO as special cases obtained by particular choices of G. Under smoothness and bounded-divergence assumptions we prove that GA-GRPO converges at rate O(1/sqrt(T)) to an O(delta sqrt(T))-neighbourhood of the GRPO stationary point, derive the closed-form MSE-optimal guidance weight lambda-star(T, delta, sigma\_0 squared) = sigma\_0 squared / (sigma\_0 squared + R\_max squared delta squared T), and prove a matching minimax lower bound showing the Omega(delta squared T) bias term is unavoidable. Experiments on Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base across nine math and OOD benchmarks confirm that optimal-weight GA-GRPO matches or surpasses TAPO, LUFFY, ExPO, and vanilla GRPO while requiring 31\% fewer GPU-hours, and eight analysis experiments validate each theoretical prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 把外部引导统一写成随机算子 G 重写问题分布，GA-GRPO 的策略梯度估计器是有偏 on-policy 估计，偏差由总变差引导散度 δ_G 界定；在光滑与有界散度假设下收敛率为 O(1/√T) 且收敛到 GRPO 稳定点的 O(δ√T) 邻域，并给出闭式 MSE 最优引导权重 λ*(T,δ,σ₀²)=σ₀²/(σ₀²+R_max²δ²T) 与匹配的 minimax 下界。
Motivation: LUFFY、ExPO、PAPO、TAPO 等用专家轨迹、自解释或检索思维模式增强 RLVR 的方法各自报告经验增益，但都缺少收敛速率、偏差界和引导信号的最优加权规则。
Method: 提出 Guidance-Augmented GRPO (GA-GRPO)：把外部引导建模为随机引导算子 G，将所得策略梯度估计器视为有偏 on-policy 估计，偏差由引导增强采样分布与策略自身分布之间的总变差散度 δ_G 界定；vanilla GRPO、LUFFY、ExPO、PAPO、TAPO 都是 G 特定取值下的特例。
Result: 在光滑与有界散度假设下证明收敛率 O(1/√T)，收敛到 GRPO 稳定点的 O(δ√T) 邻域；推导 MSE 最优权重 λ*(T,δ,σ₀²)=σ₀²/(σ₀²+R_max²δ²T)，并证明 Ω(δ²T) 偏差项不可避免的匹配 minimax 下界。在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Base 上跨九个数学与 OOD benchmark，最优权重 GA-GRPO 追平或超过 TAPO、LUFFY、ExPO 与 vanilla GRPO，同时少用 31% GPU-hours；另有八项分析实验验证各理论预测。
Conclusion: 外部引导的收益与偏差由 δ 和 T 共同决定，按 λ*(T,δ,σ₀²) 加权即可在有偏性与方差间取到 MSE 最优，且 δ²T 量级的偏差项无法通过设计消除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trajectools Demo: Towards No-Code Solutions for Movement Data Analytics
papers.abstract_en: This demo paper presents the conceptual foundations and the first steps towards implementation of a novel no-code solution for movement data analytics based on the open-source Python library MovingPandas and the open-source geographic information system QGIS. The resulting Trajectools plugin is available open-source at https://github.com/movingpandas/qgis-processing-trajectory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Trajectools 是基于 MovingPandas 与 QGIS 的开源无代码轨迹分析插件，把移动数据 (movement data) 分析能力封装进 QGIS 处理框架，让不写代码的用户也能做轨迹处理。论文给出概念基础与实现的第一步，插件已在 GitHub 开源。
Motivation: 轨迹类移动数据的分析通常依赖编程，非技术用户难以直接使用 MovingPandas 这类 Python 库；需要把轨迹处理下沉到 QGIS 的可视化无代码环境中。
Method: 以开源 Python 库 MovingPandas 和开源 GIS 软件 QGIS 为基础，构建 Trajectools 插件，接入 QGIS 处理框架提供轨迹分析算子；论文报告概念设计与实现的初步阶段。
Result: 产出 Trajectools 插件，以开源形式发布于 github.com/movingpandas/qgis-processing-trajectory；论文本身为 demo paper，给出概念基础与实现的第一步。
Conclusion: 移动数据分析可以通过 MovingPandas 加 QGIS 插件的形式做成无代码方案，用户无需编写 Python 即可完成轨迹处理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TEMPEST: Temporal Embeddings for Scalable Driver Identification via Angular Margin Learning
papers.abstract_en: Scalable driver identification requires embedding models that maintain discriminative performance as fleet size grows, yet existing triplet-loss formulations degrade rapidly with driver pool size and overfit to session-specific patterns under rigorous temporal evaluation. We introduce TEMPEST, a Temporal Convolutional Network embedding model trained with an additive angular margin (ArcFace) loss that enforces global class-level separation in a normalized angular space. TEMPEST maps 60-second multimodal driving windows to compact 96-dimensional embeddings, supporting truly dynamic enrollment without any retraining or classifier refitting. Under rigorous temporal evaluation on a 45-driver dataset, TEMPEST achieves 91.71% Rank-1 accuracy, outperforming the best classical model by 17.9 pp and the strongest triplet-loss baseline by 58.4 pp. TEMPEST degrades by only 4.3 pp when growing the subject pool from 10 to 45 drivers, compared to 22 pp and 32.5 pp for supervised and unsupervised triplet-loss baselines, and its cross-session advantage is corroborated on the public KIA Soul dataset, where it outperforms the best classical model by 7.3 pp within-session and 14.3 pp cross-session. With 720K parameters, a 2.80 MB footprint, and 50-epoch convergence, TEMPEST establishes a rigorous, reproducible baseline for scalable behavioral driver biometric identification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEMPEST 用时序卷积网络 (TCN) 配 ArcFace 加性角度间隔损失，把 60 秒多模态驾驶窗口映射为 96 维嵌入，实现无需重训的动态注册。在 45 名司机的严格时序评估上 Rank-1 达 91.71%，比最优经典模型高 17.9 pp、比最强 triplet-loss 基线高 58.4 pp；司机池从 10 扩到 45 人仅降 4.3 pp，而监督/无监督 triplet 基线分别降 22 pp 和 32.5 pp。
Motivation: 现有 triplet-loss 嵌入在司机池规模扩大时性能快速退化，并在严格时序评估下过拟合到单次会话的模式，难以支撑车队规模增长下的可扩展驾驶员识别。
Method: TEMPEST 以 TCN 为骨干，用归一化角度空间上的 ArcFace 加性角度间隔损失强制全局类别级分离；输入为 60 秒多模态驾驶窗口，输出 96 维嵌入，注册新司机无需重训或重训分类器。模型 720K 参数、2.80 MB，50 epoch 收敛。
Result: 在 45 司机数据集的严格时序评估中 Rank-1 准确率 91.71%，超最优经典模型 17.9 pp、超最强 triplet-loss 基线 58.4 pp；司机池 10→45 仅退化 4.3 pp（监督与无监督 triplet 基线分别 22 pp、32.5 pp）。在公开 KIA Soul 数据集上，会话内超最优经典模型 7.3 pp、跨会话超 14.3 pp。
Conclusion: 在归一化角度空间用类别级间隔损失替代 triplet 损失，可在不重训的前提下让驾驶员生物特征识别随车队规模扩展，作者据此将其定位为可复现的可扩展行为驾驶员识别基线。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: TEMPEST 以 TCN 为骨干，用归一化角度空间上的 ArcFace 加性角度间隔损失强制全局类别级分离；输入为 60 秒多模态驾驶窗口，输出 96 维嵌入，注册新司机无需重训或重训分类器。模型 720K 参数、2.80 MB，50 epoch 收敛。
summary_sections.result: 在 45 司机数据集的严格时序评估中 Rank-1 准确率 91.71%，超最优经典模型 17.9 pp、超最强 triplet-loss 基线 58.4 pp；司机池 10→45 仅退化 4.3 pp（监督与无监督 triplet 基线分别 22 pp、32.5 pp）。在公开 KIA Soul 数据集上，会话内超最优经典模型 7.3 pp、跨会话超 14.3 pp。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在归一化角度空间用类别级间隔损失替代 triplet 损失，可在不重训的前提下让驾驶员生物特征识别随车队规模扩展，作者据此将其定位为可复现的可扩展行为驾驶员识别基线。

papers.title: Beyond Marginals: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation Framework for Multi-Table Synthetic Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data generation is critical for privacy compliance, machine learning augmentation, and software testing. While single-table evaluation is well established, multi-table (relational) synthesis, the dominant enterprise use case, lacks a unified evaluation framework. Existing approaches assess marginal column distributions in isolation, overlooking joint distributions, cross-table structural integrity, downstream utility, and production-readiness edge cases. We present SynEval, a six-dimensional evaluation framework for multi-table synthetic databases. SynEval jointly assesses per-column fidelity, multivariate structure preservation including a novel conditional distribution check, cross-table integrity, ML utility, privacy protection, and edge-case robustness. The framework produces a unified weighted quality score with per-table and per-dimension drill-down, and is generator-agnostic, operating on any pair of real and synthetic CSV folders with automatic schema inference. SynEval is a framework to combine conditional distribution checks P(Y|X), cross-table cardinality validation, and production-readiness edge-case testing within a single evaluation pipeline for relational synthetic data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 SynEval：面向多表（关系型）合成数据库的六维评估框架，把逐列保真度、含新型条件分布检验 P(Y|X) 的多变量结构、跨表完整性、ML 效用、隐私保护与边缘场景稳健性统一到一条流水线中，输出带逐表逐维下钻的加权质量分。框架生成器无关，可对任意真实/合成 CSV 文件夹自动推断 schema 后直接评测。
Motivation: 单表合成数据的评估已成熟，但企业主流的多表关系型合成缺少统一评估框架；现有方法只孤立看边缘列分布，忽略联合分布、跨表结构完整性、下游效用与生产就绪的边缘场景。
Method: SynEval 六维联合评估：逐列保真度、多变量结构（含新颖的条件分布检验 P(Y|X)）、跨表完整性（含 cardinality 校验）、ML 效用、隐私保护、边缘场景稳健性；输出统一加权质量分并支持逐表逐维下钻，生成器无关，输入为真实与合成 CSV 文件夹对，自动推断 schema。
Result: 提出并形式化一个六维评估框架，将条件分布检验 P(Y|X)、跨表 cardinality 校验与生产就绪边缘场景测试整合进单一关系型合成数据评估流水线，产出可下钻的统一加权质量分。
Conclusion: 多表合成数据的评估应从边缘分布扩展到联合分布、跨表完整性、效用、隐私与边缘场景的加权多维打分，且评估器应与生成器解耦。
